  `c` exactly at the Hubble radius.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_properDistance_eq_iff {χ c : ℝ} {t : Time} (ht : t ∈ U.I)
    (hH : hubbleConstant U.a t ≠ 0) :
    ∂ₜ (U.properDistance χ) t = c ↔ U.properDistance χ t = U.hubbleRadius c t

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.transverseComovingDistance
entries.docstring: The transverse comoving distance `r(χ) = S(χ)` for the spatial geometry of an FLRW model.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def transverseComovingDistance (χ : ℝ) : ℝ

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.transverseComovingDistance_of_curvature_pos
entries.docstring: For a positive curvature parameter `K`, `r(χ) = (1 / √K) sin (√K χ)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma transverseComovingDistance_of_curvature_pos (hK : 0 < U.geometry.curvature) (χ : ℝ) :
    U.transverseComovingDistance χ
      = 1 / √U.geometry.curvature * Real.sin (√U.geometry.curvature * χ)

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.transverseComovingDistance_of_curvature_eq_zero
entries.docstring: For a zero curvature parameter, `r(χ) = χ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma transverseComovingDistance_of_curvature_eq_zero (hK : U.geometry.curvature = 0) (χ : ℝ) :
    U.transverseComovingDistance χ = χ

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.transverseComovingDistance_of_curvature_neg
entries.docstring: For a negative curvature parameter `K`, `r(χ) = (1 / √(-K)) sinh (√(-K) χ)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma transverseComovingDistance_of_curvature_neg (hK : U.geometry.curvature < 0) (χ : ℝ) :
    U.transverseComovingDistance χ
      = 1 / √(-U.geometry.curvature) * Real.sinh (√(-U.geometry.curvature) * χ)

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.particleHorizon
entries.docstring:
The particle horizon at `t`, the integral of `c / a` over the times of the interval of the
  model before `t`. It is a Lebesgue integral, equal to `0` when the integrand is not
  integrable.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def particleHorizon (c : ℝ) (t : Time) : ℝ

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.eventHorizon
entries.docstring:
The event horizon at `t`, the integral of `c / a` over the times of the interval of the
  model after `t`. It is a Lebesgue integral, equal to `0` when the integrand is not
  integrable.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def eventHorizon (c : ℝ) (t : Time) : ℝ

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.particleHorizon_einsteinDeSitter
entries.docstring: The particle horizon of the Einstein-de Sitter model at `t > 0` is `3 c t₀^(2/3) t^(1/3)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma particleHorizon_einsteinDeSitter {t₀ : Time} {c : ℝ} (ht₀ : 0 < t₀.val) {t : Time}
    (ht : 0 < t.val) :
    (einsteinDeSitter t₀ ht₀).particleHorizon c t
      = 3 * c * t₀.val ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * t.val ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ)

entries.name: Cosmology.CosmicFluid.NullEnergyCondition
entries.docstring:
The null energy condition at time `t`, `0 ≤ ρ + p / c²`, for the total energy density `ρ`
  and the pressure `p` of the cosmic fluid, `c` being the speed of light.
entries.snippet: def NullEnergyCondition : Prop

entries.name: Cosmology.CosmicFluid.WeakEnergyCondition
entries.docstring:
The weak energy condition at time `t`, `0 ≤ ρ ∧ 0 ≤ ρ + p / c²`, for the total energy density
  `ρ` and the pressure `p` of the cosmic fluid, `c` being the speed of light.
entries.snippet: def WeakEnergyCondition : Prop

entries.name: Cosmology.CosmicFluid.StrongEnergyCondition
entries.docstring:
The strong energy condition at time `t`, `0 ≤ ρ + p / c² ∧ 0 ≤ ρ + 3 p / c²`, for the total
  energy density `ρ` and the pressure `p` of the cosmic fluid, `c` being the speed of light.
entries.snippet: def StrongEnergyCondition : Prop

entries.name: Cosmology.CosmicFluid.DominantEnergyCondition
entries.docstring:
The dominant energy condition at time `t`, `0 ≤ ρ ∧ |p| ≤ ρ c²`, for the total energy density
  `ρ` and the pressure `p` of the cosmic fluid, `c` being the speed of light.
entries.snippet: def DominantEnergyCondition : Prop

entries.name: Cosmology.CosmicFluid.DominantEnergyCondition.weakEnergyCondition
entries.docstring: For `c ≠ 0`, the dominant energy condition implies the weak energy condition.
entries.snippet:
lemma DominantEnergyCondition.weakEnergyCondition (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h : F.DominantEnergyCondition c t) : F.WeakEnergyCondition c t

entries.name: Cosmology.CosmicFluid.WeakEnergyCondition.nullEnergyCondition
entries.docstring: The weak energy condition implies the null energy condition.
entries.snippet:
lemma WeakEnergyCondition.nullEnergyCondition (h : F.WeakEnergyCondition c t) :
    F.NullEnergyCondition c t

entries.name: Cosmology.CosmicFluid.StrongEnergyCondition.nullEnergyCondition
entries.docstring: The strong energy condition implies the null energy condition.
entries.snippet:
lemma StrongEnergyCondition.nullEnergyCondition (h : F.StrongEnergyCondition c t) :
    F.NullEnergyCondition c t

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.friedmannSolution_iff_addCosmologicalConstant
entries.docstring:
An FLRW model filled with the cosmic fluid `F` solves the Friedmann equations with the
  cosmological constant `Λ` if and only if it solves them without cosmological constant for the
  fluid `F` with `Λ` folded in.

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannSolution.deriv_deriv_scaleFactor_pos_iff
entries.docstring:
On the interval of a solution without cosmological constant, the second derivative
  `∂ₜ ∂ₜ a` of the scale factor is positive (the expansion accelerates) if and only if
  `ρ + 3 p / c² < 0`, that is, if and only if the strong energy condition of the cosmic fluid
  fails through its second inequality.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_deriv_scaleFactor_pos_iff (h : U.FriedmannSolution F 0 G c) (hG : 0 < G) {t : Time}
    (ht : t ∈ U.I) : 0 < ∂ₜ (∂ₜ U.a) t ↔ F.ρ t + 3 * F.p t / c ^ 2 < 0

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannSolution.deriv_deriv_scaleFactor_pos_iff_lambda
entries.docstring:
With cosmological constant `Λ`, on the interval of a solution, `∂ₜ ∂ₜ a` is positive if and
  only if the total fluid, `Λ` folded in as the `w = -1` component, violates
  `0 ≤ ρ + 3 p / c²`.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_deriv_scaleFactor_pos_iff_lambda (h : U.FriedmannSolution F Λ G c) (hG : 0 < G)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) {t : Time} (ht : t ∈ U.I) :
    0 < ∂ₜ (∂ₜ U.a) t ↔ (F.ρ t + cosmologicalConstantDensity Λ G c)
      + 3 * (F.p t + cosmologicalConstantPressure Λ G c) / c ^ 2 < 0

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannSolution.decelerationParameter_eq_sum
entries.docstring:
For a solution of the Friedmann equations without cosmological constant whose cosmic fluid is
  a sum of barotropic components of pressure `w_i ρ_i c²`, the deceleration parameter is
  `q = ½ Σ_i Ω_i (1 + 3 w_i)` at the times of the interval of the model at which `H ≠ 0`, for
  `G ≠ 0` and `c ≠ 0`.
entries.snippet:
lemma decelerationParameter_eq_sum {n : ℕ} {Fi : Fin n → CosmicFluid} {w : Fin n → ℝ}
    (h : U.FriedmannSolution F 0 G c) (hG : G ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hρ : ∀ s, F.ρ s = ∑ i, (Fi i).ρ s) (hp : ∀ s, F.p s = ∑ i, (Fi i).p s)
    (hw : ∀ i, (Fi i).p = barotropicPressure (w i) (Fi i).ρ c) {t : Time} (ht : t ∈ U.I)
    (hH : hubbleConstant U.a t ≠ 0) :
    decelerationParameter U.a t
      = 1 / 2 * ∑ i, U.densityParameter (Fi i) G t * (1 + 3 * w i)

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannSolution.decelerationParameter_lambdaCDM
entries.docstring:
For a solution of the Friedmann equations whose cosmic fluid is the sum of matter (zero
  pressure) and radiation (pressure `ρ_r c² / 3`), the deceleration parameter is
  `q = ½ (Ω_m + 2 Ω_r - 2 Ω_Λ)` at the times of the interval of the model, for `c ≠ 0` (the ΛCDM
  case).
entries.snippet:
lemma decelerationParameter_lambdaCDM {Fm Fr : CosmicFluid} (h : U.FriedmannSolution F Λ G c)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (hρ : ∀ s, F.ρ s = Fm.ρ s + Fr.ρ s) (hp : ∀ s, F.p s = Fm.p s + Fr.p s)
    (hm : Fm.p = barotropicPressure 0 Fm.ρ c) (hr : Fr.p = barotropicPressure (1 / 3) Fr.ρ c)
    {t : Time} (ht : t ∈ U.I) :
    decelerationParameter U.a t = 1 / 2 * (U.densityParameter Fm G t
      + 2 * U.densityParameter Fr G t - 2 * U.lambdaDensityParameter Λ c t)

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannSolution.deriv_scaleFactor_ne_zero
entries.docstring:
For a spatial geometry of non-positive curvature parameter, `0 ≤ Λ` and a positive density
  at a time `t` of the interval, the first-order Friedmann equation forces `0 < H²` at `t`:
  the derivative `∂ₜ a` of the scale factor does not vanish at `t`.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_scaleFactor_ne_zero (h : U.FriedmannSolution F Λ G c)
    (hk : U.geometry.curvature ≤ 0) (hΛ : 0 ≤ Λ) (hG : 0 < G) {t : Time} (ht : t ∈ U.I)
    (hρ : 0 < F.ρ t) : ∂ₜ U.a t ≠ 0

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannSolution.deriv_scaleFactor_pos
entries.docstring:
If moreover the density is positive on the interval and the model expands at one time `t₀`
  of `U.I`, it expands at all times of `U.I`: with a non-positive curvature parameter, `0 ≤ Λ`
  and a positive density, an expanding model expands forever.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_scaleFactor_pos (h : U.FriedmannSolution F Λ G c) (hk : U.geometry.curvature ≤ 0)
    (hΛ : 0 ≤ Λ) (hG : 0 < G) (hρ : ∀ s ∈ U.I, 0 < F.ρ s) {t₀ : Time} (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ U.I)
    (h0 : 0 < ∂ₜ U.a t₀) {t : Time} (ht : t ∈ U.I) : 0 < ∂ₜ U.a t

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannSolution.deriv_deriv_scaleFactor_nonpos
entries.docstring:
With `0 ≤ ρ`, `0 ≤ p` and `Λ = 0` at a time `t` of the interval, the second-order Friedmann
  equation gives `∂ₜ ∂ₜ a ≤ 0` at `t`: the expansion decelerates.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_deriv_scaleFactor_nonpos (h : U.FriedmannSolution F 0 G c) (hG : 0 < G)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) {t : Time} (ht : t ∈ U.I) (hρ : 0 ≤ F.ρ t) (hp : 0 ≤ F.p t) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ U.a) t ≤ 0

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannSolution.lt_of_mem_I
entries.docstring:
The Big-Bang bound for a solution of the Friedmann equations with `0 ≤ ρ`, `0 ≤ p` and
  `Λ = 0` on its interval: if the model expands at `t₀ ∈ U.I`, every time of `U.I` is later than
  `t₀ - 1 / H(t₀)`, the Big Bang being at most `1 / H(t₀)` in the past.
entries.snippet:
lemma lt_of_mem_I (h : U.FriedmannSolution F 0 G c) (hG : 0 < G) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hρ : ∀ s ∈ U.I, 0 ≤ F.ρ s) (hp : ∀ s ∈ U.I, 0 ≤ F.p s) {t₀ : Time} (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ U.I)
    (h0 : 0 < ∂ₜ U.a t₀) {t : Time} (ht : t ∈ U.I) :
    t₀.val - 1 / hubbleConstant U.a t₀ < t.val

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannSolution.bddBelow_I
entries.docstring: Under the same assumptions, the interval of the model is bounded below.
entries.snippet:
lemma bddBelow_I (h : U.FriedmannSolution F 0 G c) (hG : 0 < G) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hρ : ∀ s ∈ U.I, 0 ≤ F.ρ s) (hp : ∀ s ∈ U.I, 0 ≤ F.p s) {t₀ : Time} (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ U.I)
    (h0 : 0 < ∂ₜ U.a t₀) : BddBelow U.I

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannEquation.ContinuityEquation
entries.docstring:
The continuity equation of the cosmic fluid at the instant `t`:
  `∂ₜ ρ + 3 H (ρ + p / c²) = 0`, with `H = hubbleConstant a`.
entries.snippet: def ContinuityEquation (a ρ p : Time → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (t : Time) : Prop

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannEquation.deriv_firstOrderFriedmann
entries.docstring:
Differentiating the first-order Friedmann equation, assumed at all times near `t`, at `t`:
  `2 H (a''/a - H²) = (8 π G / 3) ρ' + 2 k c² H / a²`.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_firstOrderFriedmann {a ρ : Time → ℝ} {k Λ G c : ℝ} {t : Time} (ha : a t ≠ 0)
    (hd1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ a t) (hd2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (∂ₜ a) t)
    (hdρ : DifferentiableAt ℝ ρ t) (hF1 : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 t, FirstOrderFriedmann a ρ k Λ G c s) :
    2 * (∂ₜ a t / a t) * (∂ₜ (∂ₜ a) t / a t - (∂ₜ a t / a t) ^ 2)
      = 8 * π * G / 3 * ∂ₜ ρ t + 2 * k * c ^ 2 * (∂ₜ a t / a t) / (a t) ^ 2

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannEquation.continuityEquation_of_friedmann
entries.docstring:
The continuity equation follows from the first-order Friedmann equation, assumed at all
  times near `t`, and the second-order Friedmann equation at `t`; `a` must be twice
  differentiable and `ρ` differentiable at `t`.
entries.snippet:
lemma continuityEquation_of_friedmann {a ρ p : Time → ℝ} {k Λ G c : ℝ} {t : Time}
    (hG : G ≠ 0) (ha : a t ≠ 0) (hd1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ a t)
    (hd2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (∂ₜ a) t)
    (hdρ : DifferentiableAt ℝ ρ t) (hF1 : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 t, FirstOrderFriedmann a ρ k Λ G c s)
    (hF2 : SecondOrderFriedmann a ρ p Λ G c t) :
    ContinuityEquation a ρ p c t

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannEquation.secondOrderFriedmann_of_continuityEquation
entries.docstring:
The second-order Friedmann equation at `t` follows from the first-order Friedmann
  equation, assumed at all times near `t`, and the continuity equation at `t`, provided
  `∂ₜ a t ≠ 0`. Together with `continuityEquation_of_friedmann`, the three equations are not
  independent.
entries.snippet:
lemma secondOrderFriedmann_of_continuityEquation {a ρ p : Time → ℝ} {k Λ G c : ℝ}
    {t : Time} (ha : a t ≠ 0) (ha' : ∂ₜ a t ≠ 0) (hd1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ a t)
    (hd2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (∂ₜ a) t) (hdρ : DifferentiableAt ℝ ρ t)
    (hF1 : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 t, FirstOrderFriedmann a ρ k Λ G c s)
    (hC : ContinuityEquation a ρ p c t) :
    SecondOrderFriedmann a ρ p Λ G c t

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannSolution.continuityEquation
entries.docstring:
If the FLRW model `U` filled with the cosmic fluid `F` solves the Friedmann equations, the
  continuity equation holds at every time of the interval `U.I` at which the energy density is
  differentiable: it is obtained from the two Friedmann equations through
  `continuityEquation_of_friedmann`.
entries.snippet:
lemma _root_.Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannSolution.continuityEquation {U : FLRW} {F : CosmicFluid}
    {Λ G c : ℝ} (h : U.FriedmannSolution F Λ G c) (hG : G ≠ 0) {t : Time} (ht : t ∈ U.I)
    (hdρ : DifferentiableAt ℝ F.ρ t) :
    ContinuityEquation U.a F.ρ F.p c t

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannEquation.barotropicPressure
entries.docstring: The barotropic pressure `p = w ρ c²` with constant equation-of-state parameter `w`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def barotropicPressure (w : ℝ) (ρ : Time → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : Time → ℝ

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannEquation.deriv_of_continuityEquation_barotropic
entries.docstring: Under the barotropic continuity equation, `∂ₜ ρ = -3 (1 + w) H ρ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_of_continuityEquation_barotropic {a ρ : Time → ℝ} {w c : ℝ} {t : Time} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hC : ContinuityEquation a ρ (barotropicPressure w ρ c) c t) :
    ∂ₜ ρ t = -3 * (1 + w) * hubbleConstant a t * ρ t

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannEquation.density_scaling
entries.docstring:
The density scaling law: under the barotropic continuity equation at all times, with `a`
  and `ρ` differentiable and `a > 0`, `ρ t = ρ t₀ (a t / a t₀)^(-3(1+w))`. The proof shows that
  `ρ a^(3(1+w))` has zero derivative along the time chart.
entries.snippet:
lemma density_scaling {a ρ : Time → ℝ} {w c : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (hd1 : Differentiable ℝ a)
    (hdρ : Differentiable ℝ ρ) (hapos : ∀ s, 0 < a s)
    (hC : ∀ s, ContinuityEquation a ρ (barotropicPressure w ρ c) c s) (t t₀ : Time) :
    ρ t = ρ t₀ * (a t / a t₀) ^ (-(3 * (1 + w)))

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannEquation.continuityEquation_of_scaling
entries.docstring:
Conversely, `ρ = ρ₀ (a / a₀)^(-3(1+w))` satisfies the barotropic continuity equation at
  all times, for `a` differentiable and positive.
entries.snippet:
lemma continuityEquation_of_scaling {a : Time → ℝ} {w c ρ₀ a₀ : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (ha₀ : a₀ ≠ 0)
    (hd1 : Differentiable ℝ a) (hapos : ∀ s, 0 < a s) (t : Time) :
    ContinuityEquation a (fun s => ρ₀ * (a s / a₀) ^ (-(3 * (1 + w))))
      (barotropicPressure w (fun s => ρ₀ * (a s / a₀) ^ (-(3 * (1 + w)))) c) c t

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannEquation.density_scaling_dust
entries.docstring: Dust, `w = 0`: `ρ ∝ a⁻³`.
entries.snippet:
lemma density_scaling_dust {a ρ : Time → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (hd1 : Differentiable ℝ a)
    (hdρ : Differentiable ℝ ρ) (hapos : ∀ s, 0 < a s)
    (hC : ∀ s, ContinuityEquation a ρ (barotropicPressure 0 ρ c) c s) (t t₀ : Time) :
    ρ t = ρ t₀ * (a t₀ / a t) ^ 3

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannEquation.density_scaling_radiation
entries.docstring: Radiation, `w = 1/3`: `ρ ∝ a⁻⁴`.
entries.snippet:
lemma density_scaling_radiation {a ρ : Time → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (hd1 : Differentiable ℝ a)
    (hdρ : Differentiable ℝ ρ) (hapos : ∀ s, 0 < a s)
    (hC : ∀ s, ContinuityEquation a ρ (barotropicPressure (1 / 3) ρ c) c s) (t t₀ : Time) :
    ρ t = ρ t₀ * (a t₀ / a t) ^ 4

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannEquation.density_scaling_vacuum
entries.docstring: Vacuum energy, `w = -1`: `ρ` is constant.
entries.snippet:
lemma density_scaling_vacuum {a ρ : Time → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (hd1 : Differentiable ℝ a)
    (hdρ : Differentiable ℝ ρ) (hapos : ∀ s, 0 < a s)
    (hC : ∀ s, ContinuityEquation a ρ (barotropicPressure (-1) ρ c) c s) (t t₀ : Time) :
    ρ t = ρ t₀

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannEquation.firstOrderFriedmann_iff_lambdaFluid
entries.docstring:
The first-order Friedmann equation with `Λ` is the first-order Friedmann equation without
  `Λ` for the density `ρ + ρ_Λ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma firstOrderFriedmann_iff_lambdaFluid {a ρ : Time → ℝ} {k Λ G c : ℝ} {t : Time}
    (hG : G ≠ 0) :
    FirstOrderFriedmann a ρ k Λ G c t ↔
      FirstOrderFriedmann a (fun s => ρ s + cosmologicalConstantDensity Λ G c) k 0 G c t

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannEquation.secondOrderFriedmann_iff_lambdaFluid
entries.docstring:
The second-order Friedmann equation with `Λ` is the second-order Friedmann equation
  without `Λ` for the density `ρ + ρ_Λ` and the pressure `p + p_Λ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma secondOrderFriedmann_iff_lambdaFluid {a ρ p : Time → ℝ} {Λ G c : ℝ} {t : Time}
    (hG : G ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    SecondOrderFriedmann a ρ p Λ G c t ↔
      SecondOrderFriedmann a (fun s => ρ s + cosmologicalConstantDensity Λ G c)
        (fun s => p s + cosmologicalConstantPressure Λ G c) 0 G c t

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannEquation.cosmologicalConstantPressure_eq_barotropic
entries.docstring: `p_Λ` is the barotropic pressure of `ρ_Λ` with `w = -1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma cosmologicalConstantPressure_eq_barotropic (Λ G c : ℝ) (t : Time) :
    cosmologicalConstantPressure Λ G c
      = barotropicPressure (-1) (fun _ => cosmologicalConstantDensity Λ G c) c t

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannEquation.reducedHubble
entries.docstring:
The reduced Hubble function `E(x) = √(Ω_Λ + Ω_m x⁻³ + Ω_r x⁻⁴ + Ω_K x⁻²)` of the standard
  cosmological model: the Hubble parameter in units of its value `H₀` at the reference time,
  as a function of the scale factor `x = a / a₀` in units of its reference value. The four
  terms are the shares of the cosmological constant, matter, radiation and curvature at the
  reference time, each diluted by its own power of `x`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def reducedHubble (ΩΛ Ωm Ωr ΩK x : ℝ) : ℝ

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannEquation.equalityScaleFactorRadiationMatter
entries.docstring:
The radiation-matter equality scale factor `a_eq = Ω_r / Ω_m`: the value of `x = a / a₀`
  at which the matter and radiation terms of `E²` are equal; radiation dominates before it.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def equalityScaleFactorRadiationMatter (Ωr Ωm : ℝ) : ℝ

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannEquation.equalityScaleFactorMatterLambda
entries.docstring:
The matter-Λ equality scale factor `a_Λ = (Ω_m / Ω_Λ)^(1/3)`: the value of `x = a / a₀`
  at which the matter term of `E²` equals `Ω_Λ`; the cosmological constant dominates after
  it.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def equalityScaleFactorMatterLambda (Ωm ΩΛ : ℝ) : ℝ

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannEquation.equalityScaleFactorRadiationMatter_spec
entries.docstring: At `a_eq`, the matter and radiation terms of `E²` are equal.
entries.snippet:
lemma equalityScaleFactorRadiationMatter_spec {Ωr Ωm : ℝ} (hr : 0 < Ωr) (hm : 0 < Ωm) :
    Ωm * equalityScaleFactorRadiationMatter Ωr Ωm ^ (-3 : ℝ)
      = Ωr * equalityScaleFactorRadiationMatter Ωr Ωm ^ (-4 : ℝ)

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannEquation.equalityScaleFactorMatterLambda_spec
entries.docstring: At `a_Λ`, the matter term of `E²` equals `Ω_Λ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma equalityScaleFactorMatterLambda_spec {Ωm ΩΛ : ℝ} (hm : 0 < Ωm) (hL : 0 < ΩΛ) :
    Ωm * equalityScaleFactorMatterLambda Ωm ΩΛ ^ (-3 : ℝ) = ΩΛ

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannSolution.sq_hubbleConstant_eq_mul_densityParameters
entries.docstring:
For a solution of the Friedmann equations whose density is that of matter plus that of
  radiation, take two times `t` and `t₀` of the interval of the model with `H(t₀) ≠ 0` at which
  `ρ_m(t) = ρ_m(t₀) (a(t₀) / a(t))³` and `ρ_r(t) = ρ_r(t₀) (a(t₀) / a(t))⁴`. Then
  `H² = H₀² (Ω_Λ + Ω_m x⁻³ + Ω_r x⁻⁴ + Ω_K x⁻²)` with `x = a(t) / a(t₀)` and the density
  parameters taken at `t₀`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sq_hubbleConstant_eq_mul_densityParameters (h : U.FriedmannSolution F Λ G c)
    (hρ : ∀ s, F.ρ s = Fm.ρ s + Fr.ρ s) {t t₀ : Time} (ht : t ∈ U.I) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ U.I)
    (hH₀ : hubbleConstant U.a t₀ ≠ 0)
    (hm : Fm.ρ t = Fm.ρ t₀ * (U.a t₀ / U.a t) ^ 3) (hr : Fr.ρ t = Fr.ρ t₀ * (U.a t₀ / U.a t) ^ 4) :
    hubbleConstant U.a t ^ 2 = hubbleConstant U.a t₀ ^ 2
      * (U.lambdaDensityParameter Λ c t₀ + U.densityParameter Fm G t₀ * (U.a t / U.a t₀) ^ (-3 : ℝ)
        + U.densityParameter Fr G t₀ * (U.a t / U.a t₀) ^ (-4 : ℝ)
        + U.curvatureDensityParameter c t₀ * (U.a t / U.a t₀) ^ (-2 : ℝ))

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannSolution.sq_hubbleConstant_eq_reducedHubble
entries.docstring:
`H² = H₀² E(a / a₀)²`, under the hypotheses of
  `sq_hubbleConstant_eq_mul_densityParameters`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sq_hubbleConstant_eq_reducedHubble (h : U.FriedmannSolution F Λ G c)
    (hρ : ∀ s, F.ρ s = Fm.ρ s + Fr.ρ s) {t t₀ : Time} (ht : t ∈ U.I) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ U.I)
    (hH₀ : hubbleConstant U.a t₀ ≠ 0)
    (hm : Fm.ρ t = Fm.ρ t₀ * (U.a t₀ / U.a t) ^ 3) (hr : Fr.ρ t = Fr.ρ t₀ * (U.a t₀ / U.a t) ^ 4) :
    hubbleConstant U.a t ^ 2 = hubbleConstant U.a t₀ ^ 2
      * reducedHubble (U.lambdaDensityParameter Λ c t₀) (U.densityParameter Fm G t₀)
        (U.densityParameter Fr G t₀) (U.curvatureDensityParameter c t₀) (U.a t / U.a t₀) ^ 2

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.FriedmannSolution.hubbleConstant_eq_reducedHubble
entries.docstring:
`H = H₀ E(a / a₀)` for `0 < H₀` and `0 ≤ H`, under the hypotheses of
  `sq_hubbleConstant_eq_reducedHubble`.
entries.snippet:
lemma hubbleConstant_eq_reducedHubble (h : U.FriedmannSolution F Λ G c)
    (hρ : ∀ s, F.ρ s = Fm.ρ s + Fr.ρ s) {t t₀ : Time} (ht : t ∈ U.I) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ U.I)
    (hH₀ : 0 < hubbleConstant U.a t₀) (hH : 0 ≤ hubbleConstant U.a t)
    (hm : Fm.ρ t = Fm.ρ t₀ * (U.a t₀ / U.a t) ^ 3) (hr : Fr.ρ t = Fr.ρ t₀ * (U.a t₀ / U.a t) ^ 4) :
    hubbleConstant U.a t = hubbleConstant U.a t₀
      * reducedHubble (U.lambdaDensityParameter Λ c t₀) (U.densityParameter Fm G t₀)
        (U.densityParameter Fr G t₀) (U.curvatureDensityParameter c t₀) (U.a t / U.a t₀)

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.milne
entries.docstring:
The Milne model, defined on the interval `I = {t | 0 < t.val}` after the Big Bang at
  `t.val = 0`: the FLRW model with the scale factor `milneScaleFactor c`, `c > 0`, and the saddle
  geometry `Saddle 1` of curvature parameter `-1`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def _root_.Cosmology.FLRW.milne (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) : FLRW where

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.friedmannSolution_milne
entries.docstring:
The Milne model filled with the empty cosmic fluid solves the Friedmann equations with
  `Λ = 0` on its interval `t > 0`.
entries.snippet:
lemma _root_.Cosmology.FLRW.friedmannSolution_milne (G : ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (FLRW.milne c hc).FriedmannSolution CosmicFluid.empty 0 G c

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.einsteinDeSitter
entries.docstring: The Einstein-de Sitter model, the flat power-law model with `n = 2/3`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def FLRW.einsteinDeSitter (t₀ : Time) (ht₀ : 0 < t₀.val) : FLRW

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.einsteinDeSitter_a
entries.docstring: The scale factor of the Einstein-de Sitter model is `einsteinDeSitterScaleFactor t₀`.
entries.snippet:
lemma FLRW.einsteinDeSitter_a {t₀ : Time} (ht₀ : 0 < t₀.val) :
    (FLRW.einsteinDeSitter t₀ ht₀).a = einsteinDeSitterScaleFactor t₀

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.friedmannSolution_einsteinDeSitter
entries.docstring:
The Einstein-de Sitter model, filled with dust of density `3 n² / (8 π G t²)` with `n = 2/3`,
  that is `1 / (6 π G t²)`, and zero pressure, solves the Friedmann equations without cosmological
  constant on its interval.
entries.snippet:
lemma FLRW.friedmannSolution_einsteinDeSitter {t₀ : Time} (ht₀ : 0 < t₀.val)
    {G c : ℝ} (hG : 0 < G) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (FLRW.einsteinDeSitter t₀ ht₀).FriedmannSolution
      (CosmicFluid.powerLaw (2 / 3) 0 G c) 0 G c

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.powerLaw
entries.docstring:
The spatially flat power-law model `a(t) = (t / t₀) ^ n` on the interval `t > 0`, after the
  origin `t.val = 0` of the time chart (for `n > 0`, the Big Bang), for a normalisation epoch
  `t₀ > 0`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def FLRW.powerLaw (t₀ : Time) (ht₀ : 0 < t₀.val) (n : ℝ) : FLRW where

entries.name: Cosmology.CosmicFluid.powerLaw
entries.docstring:
The cosmic fluid of the flat power-law solution: the density `ρ = 3 n² / (8 π G t²)` imposed by
  the first-order Friedmann equation, and the pressure `p = w ρ c²`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def CosmicFluid.powerLaw (n w G c : ℝ) : CosmicFluid

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.friedmannSolution_powerLaw
entries.docstring:
The flat power-law model with `n ≠ 0`, filled with the fluid `CosmicFluid.powerLaw n w G c`
  where `1 + 3 w = 2 (1 - n) / n`, solves the Friedmann equations without cosmological constant on
  its interval `t > 0`.
entries.snippet:
lemma FLRW.friedmannSolution_powerLaw {t₀ : Time} (ht₀ : 0 < t₀.val)
    {n w G c : ℝ} (hG : 0 < G) (hc : 0 < c) (hn : n ≠ 0) (hw : 1 + 3 * w = 2 * (1 - n) / n) :
    (FLRW.powerLaw t₀ ht₀ n).FriedmannSolution (CosmicFluid.powerLaw n w G c) 0 G c

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.radiationDominated_a

entries.snippet:
lemma FLRW.radiationDominated_a {t₀ : Time} (ht₀ : 0 < t₀.val) :

entries.name: Cosmology.FLRW.friedmannSolution_radiationDominated
entries.docstring:
The radiation-dominated model, filled with radiation of density `3 n² / (8 π G t²)` with
  `n = 1/2`, that is `3 / (32 π G t²)`, and pressure `ρ c² / 3`, solves the Friedmann equations
  without cosmological constant on its interval.
entries.snippet:
lemma FLRW.friedmannSolution_radiationDominated {t₀ : Time} (ht₀ : 0 < t₀.val)
    {G c : ℝ} (hG : 0 < G) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (FLRW.radiationDominated t₀ ht₀).FriedmannSolution
      (CosmicFluid.powerLaw (1 / 2) (1 / 3) G c) 0 G c

@[simp]
lemma distTensorDeriv_basis_repr_apply {d} {μν : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) × (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d)}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) :
    (Lorentz.CoVector.basis.tensorProduct Lorentz.Vector.basis).repr (distTensorDeriv A ε) μν =
    distDeriv μν.1 A ε μν.2

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.toTensor_distTensorDeriv_basis_repr_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma toTensor_distTensorDeriv_basis_repr_apply {d} (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) (b : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor d)
      (Fin.append ![Color.down] ![Color.up])) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (Tensorial.toTensor (distTensorDeriv A ε)) b =
    distDeriv (b 0) A ε (b 1)

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity
entries.docstring: The Lorentz current density, also called four-current as a distribution.
entries.snippet: abbrev TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity (d : ℕ := 3)

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity
entries.docstring: The charge density underlying a Lorentz current density which is a distribution.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def chargeDensity {d : ℕ} (c : SpeedOfLight) :
    (TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity d) →ₗ[ℝ] (Time × Space d) →d[ℝ] ℝ where

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity
entries.docstring:
The underlying (non-Lorentz) current density associated with a distributive
  Lorentz current density.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def currentDensity (c : SpeedOfLight) :
    TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity d →ₗ[ℝ] (Time × Space d) →d[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) where

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.IsExtrema
entries.docstring:
The proposition on an electromagnetic potential, corresponding to the statement that
  it is an extrema of the lagrangian.

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.isExtrema_iff_gradLagrangian
entries.snippet:
lemma isExtrema_iff_gradLagrangian {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (J : TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity d) :
    IsExtrema 𝓕 A J ↔ A.gradLagrangian 𝓕 J = 0

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.isExtrema_iff_components
entries.snippet:
lemma isExtrema_iff_components {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (J : TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity d) :
    IsExtrema 𝓕 A J ↔ (∀ ε, A.gradLagrangian 𝓕 J ε (Sum.inl 0) = 0)
    ∧ (∀ ε i, A.gradLagrangian 𝓕 J ε (Sum.inr i) = 0)

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.isExtrema_iff_space_time
entries.snippet:
lemma isExtrema_iff_space_time {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (J : TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity d) :
    IsExtrema 𝓕 A J ↔
      (∀ ε, distSpaceDiv (A.electricField 𝓕.c) ε = (1/𝓕.ε₀) * (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c) ε) ∧
      (∀ ε i, 𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀ * (Space.distTimeDeriv (A.electricField 𝓕.c)) ε i -
      ∑ j, ((PiLp.basisFun 2 ℝ (Fin d)).tensorProduct (PiLp.basisFun 2 ℝ (Fin d))).repr
        ((Space.distSpaceDeriv j (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c)) ε) (j, i) +
      𝓕.μ₀ * J.currentDensity 𝓕.c ε i = 0)

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.isExtrema_iff_vectorPotential
entries.snippet:
lemma isExtrema_iff_vectorPotential {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (J : TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity d) :
    IsExtrema 𝓕 A J ↔
      (∀ ε, distSpaceDiv (A.electricField 𝓕.c) ε = (1/𝓕.ε₀) * (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c) ε) ∧
      (∀ ε i, 𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀ * distTimeDeriv (A.electricField 𝓕.c) ε i -
      (∑ x, -(distSpaceDeriv x (distSpaceDeriv x (A.vectorPotential 𝓕.c)) ε i
        - distSpaceDeriv x (distSpaceDeriv i (A.vectorPotential 𝓕.c)) ε x)) +
      𝓕.μ₀ * J.currentDensity 𝓕.c ε i = 0)

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.isExterma_iff_tensor
entries.snippet:
lemma isExterma_iff_tensor {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (J : TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity d) :
    IsExtrema 𝓕 A J ↔ ∀ ε,
    {((1/ 𝓕.μ₀ : ℝ) • distTensorDeriv A.fieldStrength ε | κ κ ν') + - (J ε | ν')}ᵀ = 0

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.isExterma_equivariant
entries.snippet:
lemma isExterma_equivariant {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (J : TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity d) (Λ : LorentzGroup d) :
    IsExtrema 𝓕 (Λ • A) (Λ • J) ↔ IsExtrema 𝓕 A J

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.gradKineticTerm
entries.docstring:
The gradient of the kinetic term for an Electromagnetic potential which
  is a distribution.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def gradKineticTerm {d} (𝓕 : FreeSpace) :
    TempDistElectromagneticPotential d →ₗ[ℝ] (SpaceTime d) →d[ℝ] Lorentz.Vector d where

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.gradKineticTerm_eq_sum_sum
entries.snippet:
lemma gradKineticTerm_eq_sum_sum {d} {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d) (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) :
    A.gradKineticTerm 𝓕 ε = ∑ ν, ∑ μ,
        (1 / (𝓕.μ₀) * (η μ μ * η ν ν * distDeriv μ (distDeriv μ A) ε ν -
        distDeriv μ (distDeriv ν A) ε μ)) • Lorentz.Vector.basis ν

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.gradKineticTerm_eq_fieldStrength
entries.snippet:
lemma gradKineticTerm_eq_fieldStrength {d} {𝓕 : FreeSpace} (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) :
    A.gradKineticTerm 𝓕 ε = ∑ ν, (1/𝓕.μ₀ * η ν ν) •
    (∑ μ, ((Vector.basis.tensorProduct Vector.basis).repr
      (distDeriv μ (A.fieldStrength) ε) (μ, ν))) • Lorentz.Vector.basis ν

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.gradKineticTerm_sum_inl_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma gradKineticTerm_sum_inl_eq {d} {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d) (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) :
    A.gradKineticTerm 𝓕 ε (Sum.inl 0) =
    (1/(𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.c) * (distTimeSlice 𝓕.c).symm (Space.distSpaceDiv (A.electricField 𝓕.c)) ε)

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.gradKineticTerm_sum_inr_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma gradKineticTerm_sum_inr_eq {d} {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d) (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) (i : Fin d) :
    A.gradKineticTerm 𝓕 ε (Sum.inr i) =
    (𝓕.μ₀⁻¹ * (1 / 𝓕.c ^ 2 * (distTimeSlice 𝓕.c).symm
      (Space.distTimeDeriv (A.electricField 𝓕.c)) ε i -
      ∑ j, ((PiLp.basisFun 2 ℝ (Fin d)).tensorProduct (PiLp.basisFun 2 ℝ (Fin d))).repr
        ((distTimeSlice 𝓕.c).symm (Space.distSpaceDeriv j
          (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c)) ε) (j, i)))

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.gradKineticTerm_eq_distTensorDeriv
entries.snippet:
lemma gradKineticTerm_eq_distTensorDeriv {d} {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d) (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    A.gradKineticTerm 𝓕 ε ν = η ν ν * ((Tensorial.toTensor (M := Lorentz.Vector d)).symm
    (permT id (IsReindexing.auto) {(1/ 𝓕.μ₀ : ℝ) •
    distTensorDeriv A.fieldStrength ε | κ κ ν'}ᵀ)) ν

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.gradFreeCurrentPotential
entries.docstring: The variational gradient of the free current potential for distributional potentials.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def gradFreeCurrentPotential {d} :
    TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity d →ₗ[ℝ] ((SpaceTime d) →d[ℝ] Lorentz.Vector d) where

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.gradFreeCurrentPotential_eq_sum_basis
entries.snippet:
lemma gradFreeCurrentPotential_eq_sum_basis {d}
    (J : TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity d) (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) :
    (gradFreeCurrentPotential J) ε =
    (∑ μ, (η μ μ • (J ε μ) • Lorentz.Vector.basis μ))

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.gradFreeCurrentPotential_sum_inl_0
entries.snippet:
lemma gradFreeCurrentPotential_sum_inl_0 (𝓕 : FreeSpace) {d}
    (J : TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity d) (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) :
    (gradFreeCurrentPotential J) ε (Sum.inl 0) =
    𝓕.c * (distTimeSlice 𝓕.c).symm (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c) ε

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.gradFreeCurrentPotential_sum_inr_i
entries.snippet:
lemma gradFreeCurrentPotential_sum_inr_i (𝓕 : FreeSpace) {d}
    (J : TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity d) (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) (i : Fin d) :
    (gradFreeCurrentPotential J) ε (Sum.inr i) =
    - (distTimeSlice 𝓕.c).symm (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c) ε i

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.gradFreeCurrentPotential_eq_tensor
entries.snippet:
lemma gradFreeCurrentPotential_eq_tensor {d}
    (J : TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity d) (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ))
    (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    gradFreeCurrentPotential J ε ν = η ν ν * ((Tensorial.toTensor (M := Lorentz.Vector d)).symm
    (permT id (IsReindexing.auto) {J ε | ν'}ᵀ)) ν

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.gradLagrangian
entries.docstring:
The variational gradient of lagrangian for an electromagnetic potential which is
  a distribution.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def gradLagrangian {d} (𝓕 : FreeSpace) (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (J : TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity d) : ((SpaceTime d) →d[ℝ] Lorentz.Vector d)

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.gradLagrangian_sum_inl_0
entries.snippet:
lemma gradLagrangian_sum_inl_0 {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d) (J : TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) :
    A.gradLagrangian 𝓕 J ε (Sum.inl 0) =
    (1/(𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.c) * (distTimeSlice 𝓕.c).symm (Space.distSpaceDiv (A.electricField 𝓕.c)) ε)
    - 𝓕.c * (distTimeSlice 𝓕.c).symm (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c) ε

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.gradLagrangian_sum_inr_i
entries.snippet:
lemma gradLagrangian_sum_inr_i {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d) (J : TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) (i : Fin d) :
    A.gradLagrangian 𝓕 J ε (Sum.inr i) =
    𝓕.μ₀⁻¹ * (1 / 𝓕.c ^ 2 *
      (distTimeSlice 𝓕.c).symm (Space.distTimeDeriv (A.electricField 𝓕.c)) ε i -
      ∑ j, ((PiLp.basisFun 2 ℝ (Fin d)).tensorProduct (PiLp.basisFun 2 ℝ (Fin d))).repr
        ((distTimeSlice 𝓕.c).symm (Space.distSpaceDeriv j (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c)) ε) (j, i)) +
    (distTimeSlice 𝓕.c).symm (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c) ε i

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.gradLagrangian_eq_tensor
entries.snippet:
lemma gradLagrangian_eq_tensor {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d) (J : TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    A.gradLagrangian 𝓕 J ε ν =
    η ν ν * ((Tensorial.toTensor (M := Lorentz.Vector d)).symm
    (permT id (IsReindexing.auto) {((1/ 𝓕.μ₀ : ℝ) • (distTensorDeriv A.fieldStrength ε) | κ κ ν') +
    - (J ε | ν')}ᵀ)) ν

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.electricField
entries.docstring: The electric field of an electromagnetic potential which is a distribution.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def electricField {d} (c : SpeedOfLight) :
    TempDistElectromagneticPotential d →ₗ[ℝ]
    (Time × Space d) →d[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) where

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.electricField_eq_fieldStrength
entries.snippet:
lemma electricField_eq_fieldStrength {d} {c : SpeedOfLight}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d) (ε : 𝓢(Time × Space d, ℝ))
    (i : Fin d) : A.electricField c ε i = - c * (Vector.basis.tensorProduct Vector.basis).repr
      (distTimeSlice c (A.fieldStrength) ε) (Sum.inl 0, Sum.inr i)

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.fieldStrengthAux
entries.docstring:
An auxiliary definition for the field strength of an electromagnetic potential
  based on a distribution. On Schwartz maps this has the same value as the field strength
  tensor, but no linearity or continuous properties built in.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fieldStrengthAux {d} (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) : Lorentz.Vector d ⊗[ℝ] Lorentz.Vector d

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.fieldStrengthAux_eq_add
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrengthAux_eq_add {d} (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d) (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) :
    fieldStrengthAux A ε =
    Tensorial.toTensor.symm
      (permT id (IsReindexing.auto) {(η d | μ μ' ⊗ distTensorDeriv A ε | μ' ν)}ᵀ)
    - Tensorial.toTensor.symm (permT ![1, 0] (IsReindexing.auto)
      {(η d | μ μ' ⊗ distTensorDeriv A ε | μ' ν)}ᵀ)

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.toTensor_fieldStrengthAux
entries.snippet:
lemma toTensor_fieldStrengthAux {d} (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) :
    Tensorial.toTensor (fieldStrengthAux A ε) =
    (permT id (IsReindexing.auto) {(η d | μ μ' ⊗ distTensorDeriv A ε | μ' ν)}ᵀ)
    - (permT ![1, 0] (IsReindexing.auto)
      {(η d | μ μ' ⊗ distTensorDeriv A ε | μ' ν)}ᵀ)

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.toTensor_fieldStrengthAux_basis_repr
entries.snippet:
lemma toTensor_fieldStrengthAux_basis_repr {d} (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ))
    (b : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor d) (Fin.append ![Color.up] ![Color.up])) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (Tensorial.toTensor (fieldStrengthAux A ε)) b =
    ∑ κ, (η (b 0) κ * SpaceTime.distDeriv κ A ε (b 1) -
      η (b 1) κ * SpaceTime.distDeriv κ A ε (b 0))

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.fieldStrengthAux_tensor_basis_eq_basis
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrengthAux_tensor_basis_eq_basis {d} (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ))
    (b : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor d) (Fin.append ![Color.up] ![Color.up])) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (Tensorial.toTensor (A.fieldStrengthAux ε)) b =
    (Lorentz.Vector.basis.tensorProduct Lorentz.Vector.basis).repr (A.fieldStrengthAux ε)
      (b 0, b 1)

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.fieldStrengthAux_basis_repr_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrengthAux_basis_repr_apply {d} {μν : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) × (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d)}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d) (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) :
    (Lorentz.Vector.basis.tensorProduct Lorentz.Vector.basis).repr (A.fieldStrengthAux ε) μν =
    ∑ κ, ((η μν.1 κ * distDeriv κ A ε μν.2) - η μν.2 κ * distDeriv κ A ε μν.1)

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.fieldStrengthAux_basis_repr_apply_eq_single
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrengthAux_basis_repr_apply_eq_single {d} {μν : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) × (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d)}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d) (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) :
    (Lorentz.Vector.basis.tensorProduct Lorentz.Vector.basis).repr (A.fieldStrengthAux ε) μν =
    ((η μν.1 μν.1 * distDeriv μν.1 A ε μν.2) - η μν.2 μν.2 * distDeriv μν.2 A ε μν.1)

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.fieldStrengthAux_eq_basis
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrengthAux_eq_basis {d} (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) :
    (A.fieldStrengthAux ε) = ∑ μ, ∑ ν,
      ((η μ μ * distDeriv μ A ε ν) - η ν ν * distDeriv ν A ε μ)
      • Lorentz.Vector.basis μ ⊗ₜ[ℝ] Lorentz.Vector.basis ν

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.fieldStrength
entries.docstring: The field strength of an electromagnetic potential which is a distribution.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fieldStrength {d} :
    TempDistElectromagneticPotential d →ₗ[ℝ]
    (SpaceTime d) →d[ℝ] Lorentz.Vector d ⊗[ℝ] Lorentz.Vector d where

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.fieldStrength_eq_fieldStrengthAux
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrength_eq_fieldStrengthAux {d} (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) :
    A.fieldStrength ε = A.fieldStrengthAux ε

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.fieldStrength_eq_basis
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrength_eq_basis {d} (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) :
    A.fieldStrength ε = ∑ μ, ∑ ν,
      ((η μ μ * distDeriv μ A ε ν) - η ν ν * distDeriv ν A ε μ)
      • Lorentz.Vector.basis μ ⊗ₜ[ℝ] Lorentz.Vector.basis ν

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.fieldStrength_basis_repr_eq_single
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrength_basis_repr_eq_single {d} {μν : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) × (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d)}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d) (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) :
    (Lorentz.Vector.basis.tensorProduct Lorentz.Vector.basis).repr (A.fieldStrength ε) μν =
    ((η μν.1 μν.1 * distDeriv μν.1 A ε μν.2) - η μν.2 μν.2 * distDeriv μν.2 A ε μν.1)

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.fieldStrength_diag_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fieldStrength_diag_zero {d} (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    (Lorentz.Vector.basis.tensorProduct Lorentz.Vector.basis).repr
    (A.fieldStrength ε) (μ, μ) = 0

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.distDeriv_fieldStrength_diag_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma distDeriv_fieldStrength_diag_zero {d} (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    (Lorentz.Vector.basis.tensorProduct Lorentz.Vector.basis).repr
    (distDeriv ν A.fieldStrength ε) (μ, μ) = 0

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.fieldStrength_antisymmetric_basis
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrength_antisymmetric_basis {d} (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (ε : 𝓢(SpaceTime d, ℝ)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    (Vector.basis.tensorProduct Vector.basis).repr
    (A.fieldStrength ε) (μ, ν) = - (Vector.basis.tensorProduct Vector.basis).repr
    (A.fieldStrength ε) (ν, μ)

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.fieldStrength_equivariant
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrength_equivariant {d} (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (Λ : LorentzGroup d) :
    (Λ • A).fieldStrength = Λ • A.fieldStrength

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.magneticFieldMatrix
entries.docstring: The magnetic field matrix of an electromagnetic potential which is a distribution.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def magneticFieldMatrix {d} (c : SpeedOfLight) :
    TempDistElectromagneticPotential d →ₗ[ℝ]
    (Time × Space d) →d[ℝ] (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) ⊗[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) where

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.magneticFieldMatrix_eq_vectorPotential
entries.snippet:
lemma magneticFieldMatrix_eq_vectorPotential {c : SpeedOfLight}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (ε : 𝓢(Time × Space d, ℝ)) :
    A.magneticFieldMatrix c ε = ∑ i, ∑ j,
    (Space.distSpaceDeriv j (A.vectorPotential c) ε i -
      Space.distSpaceDeriv i (A.vectorPotential c) ε j) •
    EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin d) ℝ i ⊗ₜ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin d) ℝ j

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.magneticFieldMatrix_basis_repr_eq_vector_potential
entries.snippet:
lemma magneticFieldMatrix_basis_repr_eq_vector_potential {c : SpeedOfLight}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (ε : 𝓢(Time × Space d, ℝ)) (i j : Fin d) :
    ((PiLp.basisFun 2 ℝ (Fin d)).tensorProduct (PiLp.basisFun 2 ℝ (Fin d))).repr
        (A.magneticFieldMatrix c ε) (i, j) =
      Space.distSpaceDeriv j (A.vectorPotential c) ε i -
      Space.distSpaceDeriv i (A.vectorPotential c) ε j

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.magneticFieldMatrix_distSpaceDeriv_basis_repr_eq_vector_potential
entries.snippet:
lemma magneticFieldMatrix_distSpaceDeriv_basis_repr_eq_vector_potential {c : SpeedOfLight}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (ε : 𝓢(Time × Space d, ℝ)) (i j k : Fin d) :
    ((PiLp.basisFun 2 ℝ (Fin d)).tensorProduct (PiLp.basisFun 2 ℝ (Fin d))).repr
    (Space.distSpaceDeriv k (A.magneticFieldMatrix c) ε) (i, j) =
    Space.distSpaceDeriv k (Space.distSpaceDeriv j (A.vectorPotential c)) ε i -
    Space.distSpaceDeriv k (Space.distSpaceDeriv i (A.vectorPotential c)) ε j

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.magneticFieldMatrix_basis_repr_eq_fieldStrength
entries.snippet:
lemma magneticFieldMatrix_basis_repr_eq_fieldStrength {c : SpeedOfLight}
    (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (ε : 𝓢(Time × Space d, ℝ)) (i j : Fin d) :
    ((PiLp.basisFun 2 ℝ (Fin d)).tensorProduct (PiLp.basisFun 2 ℝ (Fin d))).repr
        (A.magneticFieldMatrix c ε) (i, j) =
      (Lorentz.Vector.basis.tensorProduct Lorentz.Vector.basis).repr
        (distTimeSlice c A.fieldStrength ε) (Sum.inr i, Sum.inr j)

@[simp]
lemma magneticFieldMatrix_one_dim_eq_zero {c : SpeedOfLight}
