entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.IsIntertwining.comap_isInvariant
entries.docstring: Pulling back an invariant state along an intertwining channel preserves invariance.
entries.snippet:
lemma comap_isInvariant {Φ : E →ₚ₁[ℝ] F} (h : IsIntertwining ρ σ Φ)
    {ω : 𝓢[ℝ, F]} (hω : IsInvariant σ ω) :
    IsInvariant ρ (UnitalPositiveLinearMap.comap Φ ω)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Reversible.isIntertwining_transport
entries.docstring: A reversible transformation intertwines an action with its transport.
entries.snippet:
lemma isIntertwining_transport :
    IsIntertwining ρ (e.transport ρ) e.toChannel

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Reversible.isIntertwining_iff_eq_transport
entries.docstring:
A reversible transformation intertwines two actions exactly when the target action
is the transport of the source action.
entries.snippet:
lemma isIntertwining_iff_eq_transport :
    IsIntertwining ρ σ e.toChannel ↔ σ = e.transport ρ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Reversible
entries.docstring:
A reversible transformation between observable spaces: a linear bijection that preserves and
reflects the order and preserves the order unit. Both it and its inverse are channels.
entries.snippet:
structure Reversible (E F : Type*) [OrderUnitSpace E] [OrderUnitSpace F]
    extends E ≃ₗ[ℝ] F where
  map_le_map_iff' : ∀ {x y : E}, toLinearEquiv x ≤ toLinearEquiv y ↔ x ≤ y
  map_one' : toLinearEquiv 1 = 1

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Reversible.«instance@a9235cbc»
entries.snippet: instance : FunLike (Reversible E F) E F where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Reversible.ext
entries.snippet:
@[ext]
lemma ext {e f : Reversible E F} (h : ∀ x, e x = f x) : e = f

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Reversible.refl
entries.docstring: The identity reversible transformation.
entries.snippet: def refl (E : Type*) [OrderUnitSpace E] : Reversible E E where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Reversible.symm
entries.docstring: The inverse of a reversible transformation.
entries.snippet: def symm (e : Reversible E F) : Reversible F E where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Reversible.trans
entries.docstring: Composition of reversible transformations, applying `e₁` before `e₂`.
entries.snippet: def trans (e₁ : Reversible E F) (e₂ : Reversible F H) : Reversible E H where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Reversible.automorphismGroup
entries.docstring: Reversible transformations of a single space form a group under composition.
entries.snippet: instance automorphismGroup : Group (Reversible E E) where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Reversible.toChannel
entries.docstring: A reversible transformation regarded as a channel.
entries.snippet: def toChannel (e : Reversible E F) : E →ₚ₁[ℝ] F

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Reversible.toChannelHom
entries.docstring: Regarding reversible transformations as channels is a homomorphism of monoids.
entries.snippet: def toChannelHom : Reversible E E →* (E →ₚ₁[ℝ] E) where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Reversible.instMulActionState
entries.docstring: The action on states induced by the inverse of a reversible transformation.
entries.snippet: instance instMulActionState : MulAction (Reversible E E) (𝓢[ℝ, E]) where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Reversible.smul_state_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma smul_state_apply (φ : Reversible E E) (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (x : E) :
    (φ • ω) x = ω (φ.symm x)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Reversible.conj
entries.docstring: Conjugation by a reversible transformation transports automorphisms from `E` to `F`.
entries.snippet: def conj : Reversible E E →* Reversible F F where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Reversible.transport
entries.docstring: Transport a group action from `E` to `F` along a reversible transformation.
entries.snippet: def transport : G →* Reversible F F

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.IsInvariant
entries.docstring: A state is invariant if it is fixed by every transformation of the group action.
entries.snippet:
def IsInvariant {G E : Type*} [Group G] [OrderUnitSpace E] (ρ : G →* Reversible E E)
    (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) : Prop

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Effect.coe_complement
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coe_complement (e : Effect E) : ((complement e : Effect E) : E) = 1 - e

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Effect.effectEquiv
entries.docstring:
Effects correspond to points of the order-unit-norm ball by doubling and re-centering at the
order unit: `e ↦ 2 • e - 1`, with inverse `A ↦ (1 + A) / 2`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def effectEquiv : Effect E ≃ {A : E // orderUnitNorm A ≤ 1} where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet
entries.docstring: The observables of each subsystem, with channels into larger subsystems.
entries.snippet:
@[ext]
structure LocalNet (R : Type*) [Preorder R] (A : R → Type*)
    [∀ X, OrderUnitSpace (A X)] where
  incl : ∀ {X Y : R}, X ≤ Y → A X →ₚ₁[ℝ] A Y
  incl_refl : ∀ X : R, incl (le_refl X) = .id ℝ (A X)
  incl_trans : ∀ {X Y Z : R} (h₁ : X ≤ Y) (h₂ : Y ≤ Z) (h₃ : X ≤ Z),
    incl h₃ = (incl h₂).comp (incl h₁)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.incl_trans_apply
entries.docstring: Including an observable through an intermediate subsystem agrees with direct inclusion.
entries.snippet:
lemma incl_trans_apply (h₁ : X ≤ Y) (h₂ : Y ≤ Z) (h₃ : X ≤ Z) (a : A X) :
    N.incl h₃ a = N.incl h₂ (N.incl h₁ a)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.IsOrderEmbedding
entries.docstring: The inclusion maps are order embeddings if each reflects positivity.
entries.snippet:
class IsOrderEmbedding (N : LocalNet R A) : Prop where
  nonneg_of_incl_nonneg : ∀ {X Y : R} (h : X ≤ Y) {a : A X}, 0 ≤ N.incl h a → 0 ≤ a

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.map_le_map_iff
entries.docstring: Inclusion in an order-embedding net preserves and reflects inequalities.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_le_map_iff [N.IsOrderEmbedding] (h : X ≤ Y) {a b : A X} :
    N.incl h a ≤ N.incl h b ↔ a ≤ b

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.incl_injective
entries.docstring: The inclusion maps of an order-embedding net are injective.
entries.snippet: lemma incl_injective [N.IsOrderEmbedding] (h : X ≤ Y) : Function.Injective (N.incl h)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.inclLin
entries.docstring:
The inclusions as linear maps: the transition maps of the direct limit defining
`N.Quasilocal`.
entries.snippet: abbrev inclLin (N : LocalNet R A) ⦃X Y : R⦄ (h : X ≤ Y) : A X →ₗ[ℝ] A Y

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.directedSystem
entries.docstring:
The inclusions form a directed system: including a subsystem into itself does nothing, and
successive inclusions compose.
entries.snippet: instance directedSystem (N : LocalNet R A) : DirectedSystem A fun _ _ h => N.inclLin h where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal
entries.docstring: The algebraic direct limit of the local observable spaces.
entries.snippet: def Quasilocal (N : LocalNet R A) : Type _

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.«instance@b7b2efd2»
entries.docstring: Quasilocal observables add, as elements of a direct limit of vector spaces.
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance : AddCommGroup N.Quasilocal

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.«instance@8c2fd4c3»
entries.docstring: Quasilocal observables can be scaled by real numbers.
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance : Module ℝ N.Quasilocal

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.toQuasilocal
entries.docstring: Regard an observable of subsystem `i` as a quasilocal observable.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def toQuasilocal (i : R) : A i →ₗ[ℝ] N.Quasilocal

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.toQuasilocal_incl
entries.docstring: Including an observable in a larger subsystem does not change its quasilocal representation.
entries.snippet:
lemma toQuasilocal_incl {i j : R} (h : i ≤ j) (a : A i) :
    toQuasilocal N j (N.incl h a) = toQuasilocal N i a

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.toQuasilocal_eq_of_incl_eq
entries.docstring:
Observables that agree in a common larger subsystem represent the same quasilocal
observable.
entries.snippet:
lemma toQuasilocal_eq_of_incl_eq {i j k : R} (hik : i ≤ k) (hjk : j ≤ k) {a : A i} {b : A j}
    (h : N.incl hik a = N.incl hjk b) : toQuasilocal N i a = toQuasilocal N j b

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.exists_incl_eq_of_toQuasilocal_eq
entries.docstring:
Observables representing the same quasilocal observable agree in a common larger
subsystem.

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.toQuasilocal_eq_iff
entries.docstring:
Two local observables represent the same quasilocal observable exactly when they agree in a
common larger subsystem.
entries.snippet:
lemma toQuasilocal_eq_iff {i j : R} (a : A i) (b : A j) :
    toQuasilocal N i a = toQuasilocal N j b ↔
      ∃ (k : R) (hik : i ≤ k) (hjk : j ≤ k), N.incl hik a = N.incl hjk b

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.toQuasilocal_injective
entries.docstring: Order-embedding inclusions keep distinct local observables distinct in the quasilocal space.
entries.snippet:
lemma toQuasilocal_injective [N.IsOrderEmbedding] (i : R) :
    Function.Injective (toQuasilocal N i)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.exists_toQuasilocal_eq
entries.docstring: Every quasilocal observable has a representative in some subsystem.
entries.snippet: lemma exists_toQuasilocal_eq (x : N.Quasilocal) : ∃ (i : R) (a : A i), toQuasilocal N i a = x

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.exists_toQuasilocal_eq₂
entries.docstring: Any two quasilocal observables have representatives in a common subsystem.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_toQuasilocal_eq₂ (x y : N.Quasilocal) :
    ∃ (i : R) (a b : A i), toQuasilocal N i a = x ∧ toQuasilocal N i b = y

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.positive
entries.docstring: Global observables with a positive local representative.
entries.snippet: def positive : Set N.Quasilocal

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.toQuasilocal_mem_pos
entries.docstring: A positive local observable is positive globally.
entries.snippet:
lemma toQuasilocal_mem_pos {i : R} {a : A i} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    toQuasilocal N i a ∈ positive N

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.smul_mem_pos
entries.docstring: Nonnegative scaling preserves global positivity.
entries.snippet:
lemma smul_mem_pos {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) {x : N.Quasilocal}
    (hx : x ∈ positive N) : c • x ∈ positive N

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.add_mem_pos
entries.docstring: The sum of positive global observables is positive.
entries.snippet:
lemma add_mem_pos {x y : N.Quasilocal} (hx : x ∈ positive N) (hy : y ∈ positive N) :
    x + y ∈ positive N

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.eq_zero_of_mem_pos_of_neg_mem_pos
entries.docstring: A global observable that is both positive and negative is zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_zero_of_mem_pos_of_neg_mem_pos {x : N.Quasilocal}
    (hx : x ∈ positive N) (hx' : -x ∈ positive N) : x = 0

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.«instance@c03d65a5»
entries.docstring: The common global image of the local units.
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance : One N.Quasilocal

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.one_eq_toQuasilocal
entries.docstring: The global unit is represented by the unit of the chosen subsystem.
entries.snippet:
lemma one_eq_toQuasilocal :
    (1 : N.Quasilocal) = toQuasilocal N (Classical.arbitrary R) 1

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.toQuasilocal_one
entries.docstring: Every local unit represents the global unit.
entries.snippet: lemma toQuasilocal_one (i : R) : toQuasilocal N i 1 = (1 : N.Quasilocal)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.posCone
entries.docstring: The cone of positive global observables.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def posCone : AddGroupCone N.Quasilocal where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.«instance@1038dde8»
entries.docstring: The order on global observables induced by local positivity.
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance : PartialOrder N.Quasilocal

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.le_iff
entries.docstring: `x ≤ y` exactly when `y - x` has a positive local representative.
entries.snippet: lemma le_iff {x y : N.Quasilocal} : x ≤ y ↔ y - x ∈ positive N

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.nonneg_iff
entries.docstring: A global observable is nonnegative exactly when it belongs to `positive N`.
entries.snippet: lemma nonneg_iff {x : N.Quasilocal} : 0 ≤ x ↔ x ∈ positive N

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.toQuasilocal_nonneg_iff
entries.docstring: A local observable is positive globally exactly when it is positive locally.
entries.snippet: lemma toQuasilocal_nonneg_iff (i : R) (a : A i) : 0 ≤ toQuasilocal N i a ↔ 0 ≤ a

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.«instance@7cd3186c»
entries.docstring: Adding the same global observable preserves a comparison.
entries.snippet: instance : IsOrderedAddMonoid N.Quasilocal

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.«instance@7edc434d»
entries.docstring: Nonnegative scaling preserves comparisons between global observables.
entries.snippet: instance : PosSMulMono ℝ N.Quasilocal where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.«instance@6ac2521e»
entries.docstring: Global observables form an ordered real vector space.
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance : OrderedVectorSpace N.Quasilocal where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.toQuasilocal_le_iff
entries.docstring: A comparison of local observables has the same meaning globally.
entries.snippet:
lemma toQuasilocal_le_iff (i : R) (a b : A i) :
    toQuasilocal N i a ≤ toQuasilocal N i b ↔ a ≤ b

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.«instance@89314c20»
entries.docstring: The global observable space inherits an order unit from its subsystems.
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance : OrderUnitSpace N.Quasilocal where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.toQuasilocalChannel
entries.docstring: Regard a subsystem observable as a global observable by a channel.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def toQuasilocalChannel (i : R) : A i →ₚ₁[ℝ] N.Quasilocal

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.«instance@2aa344a1»
entries.docstring: The global observable space is Archimedean when every subsystem is Archimedean.
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance : ArchimedeanOrderUnitSpace N.Quasilocal where

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.comap
entries.docstring:
The state on `E` that evaluates an observable by first sending it through a channel `f` and
then evaluating the state `ω` on the result.
entries.snippet: def comap (f : E →ₚ₁[ℝ] F) (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, F]) : 𝓢[ℝ, E] where

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.comap_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma comap_apply (f : E →ₚ₁[ℝ] F) (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, F]) (x : E) : comap f ω x = ω (f x)

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.mix
entries.docstring:
Randomize between two states with probability `t` of choosing the first, so
`t • ω + σ t • φ` with `σ t = 1 - t`.
entries.snippet: def mix (ω φ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (t : unitInterval) : 𝓢[ℝ, E]

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.mix_apply
entries.docstring: Evaluation of a mixture is the pointwise convex combination.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma mix_apply (ω φ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (t : unitInterval) (A : E) :
    mix ω φ t A = (t : ℝ) * ω A + (1 - (t : ℝ)) * φ A

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.toLinearMap_mix
entries.docstring: The underlying linear map of a mixture is the corresponding combination of linear maps.
entries.snippet:
lemma toLinearMap_mix (ω φ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (t : unitInterval) :
    (mix ω φ t).toLinearMap = (t : ℝ) • ω.toLinearMap + (1 - (t : ℝ)) • φ.toLinearMap

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.mix_symm
entries.docstring: Swapping the two states swaps the weights: `σ` is the symmetry of the interval.
entries.snippet: lemma mix_symm (ω φ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (t : unitInterval) : mix ω φ t = mix φ ω (σ t)

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.stateSpace
entries.docstring: States embedded into the algebraic dual.
entries.snippet: def stateSpace : Set (E →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.stateSpace_convex
entries.docstring: The state space is convex in the algebraic dual.
entries.snippet: lemma stateSpace_convex : Convex ℝ (stateSpace (E := E))

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.IsPure
entries.docstring: A state is pure when it is an extreme point of the state space.
entries.snippet: def IsPure (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) : Prop

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.IsMixed
entries.docstring: A state is mixed when it isn't pure.
entries.snippet: def IsMixed (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) : Prop

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.isPure_iff_forall_mem_openSegment
entries.docstring: A state is pure exactly when any open segment containing it has both endpoints equal to it.
entries.snippet:
lemma isPure_iff_forall_mem_openSegment {ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E]} :
    ω.IsPure ↔ ∀ φ ψ : 𝓢[ℝ, E],
      ω.toLinearMap ∈ openSegment ℝ φ.toLinearMap ψ.toLinearMap → φ = ω ∧ ψ = ω

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.isMixed_iff_exists_mem_openSegment
entries.docstring: A state is mixed exactly when it lies in an open segment with a different endpoint.
entries.snippet:
lemma isMixed_iff_exists_mem_openSegment {ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E]} :
    ω.IsMixed ↔ ∃ φ ψ : 𝓢[ℝ, E],
      ω.toLinearMap ∈ openSegment ℝ φ.toLinearMap ψ.toLinearMap ∧ (φ ≠ ω ∨ ψ ≠ ω)

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.mem_openSegment_iff_exists_mix
entries.docstring: Open segments between states consist exactly of their genuine mixtures.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_openSegment_iff_exists_mix (ω φ ψ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) :
    ω.toLinearMap ∈ openSegment ℝ φ.toLinearMap ψ.toLinearMap ↔
      ∃ t : unitInterval, 0 < t ∧ t < 1 ∧ mix φ ψ t = ω

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.isPure_iff_forall_mix_eq
entries.docstring: A state is pure exactly when every genuine binary mixture producing it is trivial.
entries.snippet:
lemma isPure_iff_forall_mix_eq {ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E]} :
    ω.IsPure ↔ ∀ φ ψ t, 0 < t → t < 1 → mix φ ψ t = ω → φ = ω ∧ ψ = ω

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.successProb
entries.docstring:
Probability of guessing right between `ω₀` (prior `p`) and `ω₁` (prior `1 - p`) using test
`e`: guess `ω₀` on a click, `ω₁` otherwise.
entries.snippet: def successProb (ω₀ ω₁ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (p : unitInterval) (e : Effect E) : ℝ

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.advantage
entries.docstring: How much test `e` improves on the baseline of always guessing `ω₁`.
entries.snippet: def advantage (ω₀ ω₁ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (p : unitInterval) (e : Effect E) : ℝ

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.successProb_eq_add_advantage
entries.docstring: Success probability equals the baseline `1 - p` plus the advantage of test `e`.
entries.snippet:
lemma successProb_eq_add_advantage (ω₀ ω₁ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (p : unitInterval) (e : Effect E) :
    successProb ω₀ ω₁ p e = (1 - p) + advantage ω₀ ω₁ p e

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.advantage_le
entries.docstring: No test's advantage beats the prior weight `p` of the state it favors.
entries.snippet:
lemma advantage_le (ω₀ ω₁ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (p : unitInterval) (e : Effect E) :
    advantage ω₀ ω₁ p e ≤ p

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.bddAbove_advantage
entries.docstring: Advantages of tests are bounded above.
entries.snippet:
lemma bddAbove_advantage (ω₀ ω₁ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (p : unitInterval) :
    BddAbove (Set.range (advantage ω₀ ω₁ p))

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.optimalSuccessProb
entries.docstring: The best a single test can do.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def optimalSuccessProb (ω₀ ω₁ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (p : unitInterval) : ℝ

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.optimalSuccessProb_eq
entries.docstring:
The Helstrom bound: optimal success probability is the baseline `1 - p` plus the best
advantage any test can give.
entries.snippet:
lemma optimalSuccessProb_eq (ω₀ ω₁ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (p : unitInterval) :
    optimalSuccessProb ω₀ ω₁ p = (1 - p) + ⨆ e : Effect E, advantage ω₀ ω₁ p e

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.sub_complement_eq_neg_sub
entries.docstring: Complementing an effect negates `ω₀ e - ω₁ e`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sub_complement_eq_neg_sub (ω₀ ω₁ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (e : Effect E) :
    ω₀ (complement e) - ω₁ (complement e) = -(ω₀ e - ω₁ e)

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.bddAbove_abs_sub
entries.docstring: The differences `|ω₀ e - ω₁ e|` over effects are bounded above.
entries.snippet:
lemma bddAbove_abs_sub (ω₀ ω₁ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) :
    BddAbove (Set.range fun e : Effect E => |ω₀ e - ω₁ e|)

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.bddAbove_sub
entries.docstring: The differences `ω₀ e - ω₁ e` over effects are bounded above.
entries.snippet:
lemma bddAbove_sub (ω₀ ω₁ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) :
    BddAbove (Set.range fun e : Effect E => ω₀ e - ω₁ e)

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.ciSup_sub_eq_ciSup_abs_sub
entries.docstring:
The supremum of the state-value difference equals that of its absolute value: complementing
an effect flips the sign.
entries.snippet:
lemma ciSup_sub_eq_ciSup_abs_sub (ω₀ ω₁ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) :
    (⨆ e : Effect E, (ω₀ e - ω₁ e)) = ⨆ e : Effect E, |ω₀ e - ω₁ e|

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.dist_eq_ciSup_abs_sub
entries.docstring: The state distance is the supremum of the differences on recentered effects.
entries.snippet:
lemma dist_eq_ciSup_abs_sub (ω₀ ω₁ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) :
    dist ω₀ ω₁ =
      ⨆ e : Effect E, |ω₀ (effectEquiv e) - ω₁ (effectEquiv e)|

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.dist_eq_two_mul_ciSup_sub
entries.docstring: The state distance is twice the largest state-value difference over all effects.
entries.snippet:
lemma dist_eq_two_mul_ciSup_sub (ω₀ ω₁ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) :
    dist ω₀ ω₁ = 2 * ⨆ e : Effect E, (ω₀ e - ω₁ e)

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.optimalSuccessProb_half_half_eq
entries.docstring: For equal priors, the Helstrom bound is `1/2` plus a quarter of the state distance.
entries.snippet:
lemma optimalSuccessProb_half_half_eq (ω₀ ω₁ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) :
    optimalSuccessProb ω₀ ω₁ ⟨1 / 2, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩ = 1 / 2 + dist ω₀ ω₁ / 4

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.restrict
entries.docstring: Restrict a state of `Y` to `X` by pulling it back along the observable inclusion channel.
entries.snippet: def restrict (h : X ≤ Y) (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, A Y]) : 𝓢[ℝ, A X]

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.restrict_apply
entries.docstring: Restriction evaluates an observable through its inclusion into the larger subsystem.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_apply (h : X ≤ Y) (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, A Y]) (a : A X) :
    N.restrict h ω a = ω (N.incl h a)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.restrict_refl
entries.docstring: Restriction to the same subsystem is the identity.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_refl (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, A X]) : N.restrict (le_refl X) ω = ω

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.restrict_restrict
entries.docstring: Successive restrictions agree with direct restriction.
entries.snippet:
lemma restrict_restrict (h₁ : X ≤ Y) (h₂ : Y ≤ Z) (h₃ : X ≤ Z) (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, A Z]) :
    N.restrict h₁ (N.restrict h₂ ω) = N.restrict h₃ ω

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.CompatibleStates
entries.docstring: A state on each subsystem whose restrictions agree with the states of smaller subsystems.
entries.snippet:
@[ext]
structure CompatibleStates (N : LocalNet R A) where
  state : ∀ X, 𝓢[ℝ, A X]
  compat : ∀ {X Y : R} (h : X ≤ Y), N.restrict h (state Y) = state X

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.CompatibleStates.compat_apply
entries.docstring: An observable has the same expectation in every subsystem containing it.
entries.snippet:
lemma CompatibleStates.compat_apply {N : LocalNet R A} (ω : N.CompatibleStates)
    {X Y : R} (h : X ≤ Y) (a : A X) :
    ω.state Y (N.incl h a) = ω.state X a

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.«instance@a9974e67»
entries.docstring: Decidable equality used internally by the direct-limit construction.
entries.snippet: noncomputable local instance : DecidableEq R

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.lift
entries.docstring: The expectation functional of `LocalNet.CompatibleStates` on the whole system.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def lift (σ : N.CompatibleStates) : N.Quasilocal →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.lift_apply
entries.docstring:
The expectation functional of `LocalNet.CompatibleStates` evaluates a quasilocal observable
in any subsystem representing it.
entries.snippet:
lemma lift_apply (σ : N.CompatibleStates) (i : R) (a : A i) :
    lift σ (toQuasilocal N i a) = σ.state i a

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.toState
entries.docstring: The state of the whole system defined by `LocalNet.CompatibleStates`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def toState (σ : N.CompatibleStates) : 𝓢[ℝ, N.Quasilocal]

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.toState_apply
entries.docstring: On a quasilocal observable represented in the subsystem `i`, `toState σ` is the state of `i`.
entries.snippet:
lemma toState_apply (σ : N.CompatibleStates) (i : R) (a : A i) :
    toState σ (toQuasilocal N i a) = σ.state i a

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.LocalNet.Quasilocal.stateEquiv
entries.docstring: A state of the whole system is the same as `LocalNet.CompatibleStates`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def stateEquiv : 𝓢[ℝ, N.Quasilocal] ≃ N.CompatibleStates where

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.apply_le_one
entries.docstring: A state takes values at most `1` on observables bounded by the unit.
entries.snippet:
lemma apply_le_one {F : Type*} [OrderUnitSpace F] (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, F]) {A : F} (hA : A ≤ 1) :
    ω A ≤ 1

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.apply_le_orderUnitNorm
entries.docstring: A state never overshoots the order-unit norm.
entries.snippet: lemma apply_le_orderUnitNorm (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (A : E) : ω A ≤ orderUnitNorm A

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.abs_apply_le_orderUnitNorm
entries.docstring: A state's values are bounded by the order-unit norm in both directions.
entries.snippet: lemma abs_apply_le_orderUnitNorm (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (A : E) : |ω A| ≤ orderUnitNorm A

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.abs_apply_sub_apply_le_two
entries.docstring:
Two states' predictions on any observable of order-unit norm at most `1` never differ by more
than `2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma abs_apply_sub_apply_le_two (ω φ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) {A : E} (hA : orderUnitNorm A ≤ 1) :
    |ω A - φ A| ≤ 2

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.dist_bddAbove
entries.docstring:
The values `|ω A - φ A|` of two states, restricted to the order-unit-norm unit ball, are
bounded by `2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma dist_bddAbove (ω φ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) :
    BddAbove (Set.range fun A : {A : E // orderUnitNorm A ≤ 1} => |ω A - φ A|)

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.instNonemptyOrderUnitBall
entries.snippet: instance instNonemptyOrderUnitBall : Nonempty {A : E // orderUnitNorm A ≤ 1}

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.dist
entries.docstring:
The operator-norm distance between two states: how far apart their predictions can get on an
observable of order-unit norm at most `1`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def dist (ω φ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) : ℝ

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.dist_nonneg
entries.docstring: Distances between states are nonnegative.
entries.snippet: lemma dist_nonneg (ω φ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) : 0 ≤ dist ω φ

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.dist_le_two
entries.docstring: The whole state space has diameter at most `2`: it's a bounded metric space.
entries.snippet: lemma dist_le_two (ω φ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) : dist ω φ ≤ 2

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.dist_self
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma dist_self (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) : dist ω ω = 0

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.dist_comm
entries.docstring: The state distance is symmetric.
entries.snippet: lemma dist_comm (ω φ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) : dist ω φ = dist φ ω

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.dist_triangle
entries.docstring: The state distance satisfies the triangle inequality.
entries.snippet: lemma dist_triangle (ω φ ψ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) : dist ω ψ ≤ dist ω φ + dist φ ψ

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.eq_of_dist_eq_zero
entries.docstring: `dist` separates states: two states at distance `0` are equal.
entries.snippet: lemma eq_of_dist_eq_zero {ω φ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]} (h : dist ω φ = 0) : ω = φ

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.apply_effectEquiv
entries.docstring:
A state's value at a doubled, re-centered effect (`effectEquiv`) is twice its value at
the effect, minus one.
entries.snippet:
lemma apply_effectEquiv (ψ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (e : Effect E) :
    ψ (effectEquiv e) = 2 * ψ e - 1

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.instMetricSpace
entries.docstring: States, metrized by the operator norm induced by the order-unit norm on `E`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance instMetricSpace : MetricSpace (𝓢[ℝ, E]) where

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.distToPure
entries.docstring: The infimum distance to the set of pure states, using `Metric.infDist`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def distToPure (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) : ℝ

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.distToPure_nonneg
entries.docstring: The distance to the set of pure states is nonnegative.
entries.snippet: lemma distToPure_nonneg (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) : 0 ≤ distToPure ω

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.distToPure_eq_zero_of_isPure
entries.docstring: A pure state is at distance `0` from the set of pure states.
entries.snippet: lemma distToPure_eq_zero_of_isPure {ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E]} (h : IsPure ω) : distToPure ω = 0

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.apply_mem_Icc
entries.docstring: State–effect evaluation takes values in `[0, 1]`.
entries.snippet: lemma apply_mem_Icc (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (e : Effect E) : ω e ∈ Set.Icc 0 1

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.apply_mix
entries.docstring: Evaluation is affine in the effect argument.
entries.snippet:
lemma apply_mix (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (e f : Effect E) (t : unitInterval) :
    ω (Effect.mix e f t) = (t : ℝ) * ω e + (1 - (t : ℝ)) * ω f

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.ext_of_effect_eq_of_nonneg
entries.docstring: Two states that agree on all effects agree on every nonnegative element.
entries.snippet:
lemma ext_of_effect_eq_of_nonneg {ω φ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]}
    (h : ∀ e : Effect E, ω e = φ e) {B : E} (hB : 0 ≤ B) : ω B = φ B

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.ext_of_effect_eq
entries.docstring: A state is determined by its values on effects.
entries.snippet:
lemma ext_of_effect_eq {ω φ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]}
    (h : ∀ e : Effect E, ω e = φ e) : ω = φ

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.injective_apply_effect
entries.docstring: Evaluation on effects is injective on states.
entries.snippet:
lemma injective_apply_effect :
    Function.Injective (fun (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (e : Effect E) => ω e)

entries.name: Effect.dist_eq_sSup_abs_apply
entries.docstring:
The distance between two effects is the supremum of the difference in their evaluations over
all states.
entries.snippet:
lemma dist_eq_sSup_abs_apply [Nontrivial E] (e f : Effect E) :
    Dist.dist e f = sSup (Set.range fun ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E] => |ω e - ω f|)

entries.name: Effect.ext_of_forall_apply_eq
entries.docstring: An effect is determined by its values under all states.
entries.snippet:
lemma ext_of_forall_apply_eq {e f : Effect E}
    (h : ∀ ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E], ω e = ω f) : e = f

entries.name: Effect.injective_apply_state
entries.docstring: Evaluation by states is injective on effects.
entries.snippet:
lemma injective_apply_state :
    Function.Injective (fun (e : Effect E) (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) => ω e)

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.apply_eq_zero_of_apply_one_eq_zero
entries.docstring: A positive functional vanishing at the order unit vanishes everywhere.
entries.snippet:
lemma apply_eq_zero_of_apply_one_eq_zero [OrderUnitSpace E] {p : E →ₚ[ℝ] ℝ}
    (h1 : p (1 : E) = 0) (A : E) : p A = 0

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.exists_apply_neg_of_not_nonneg
entries.docstring: Every element outside the positive cone is strictly separated from it by a state.
entries.snippet: lemma exists_apply_neg_of_not_nonneg {A : E} (hA : ¬ 0 ≤ A) : ∃ ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E], ω A < 0

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.nonneg_iff_forall_state_nonneg
entries.docstring: An element is positive iff every state assigns it a nonnegative value.
entries.snippet: lemma nonneg_iff_forall_state_nonneg (A : E) : 0 ≤ A ↔ ∀ ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E], 0 ≤ ω A

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.instNonemptyState
entries.docstring: Every nontrivial Archimedean order-unit space has a state.
entries.snippet: instance instNonemptyState [Nontrivial E] : Nonempty (𝓢[ℝ, E])

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.orderUnitNorm_le_iff_forall_abs_apply_le
entries.docstring: The order-unit norm is at most `r` iff every state predicts an absolute value at most `r`.
entries.snippet:
lemma orderUnitNorm_le_iff_forall_abs_apply_le [Nontrivial E] (A : E) (r : ℝ) :
    orderUnitNorm A ≤ r ↔ ∀ ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E], |ω A| ≤ r

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.sSup_abs_apply_eq_orderUnitNorm
entries.docstring: The order-unit norm is the supremum of `|ω A|` over all states `ω`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sSup_abs_apply_eq_orderUnitNorm [Nontrivial E] (A : E) :
    sSup (Set.range fun ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E] => |ω A|) = orderUnitNorm A

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.orderUnitNorm_one
entries.docstring: The order unit has norm exactly `1`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma orderUnitNorm_one [Nontrivial E] : orderUnitNorm (1 : E) = 1

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.ext_of_forall_apply_eq
entries.docstring: States separate points: if `ω A = ω B` for every state `ω`, then `A = B`.
entries.snippet: lemma ext_of_forall_apply_eq {A B : E} (h : ∀ ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E], ω A = ω B) : A = B

entries.name: Weight.IsState.toState
entries.docstring: A finite normalized weight extends to a state.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def toState (hw : w.IsState) : 𝓢[ℝ, E]

entries.name: Weight.IsState.toState_apply
entries.docstring: The extended state agrees with the weight on positive observables.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toState_apply (hw : w.IsState) (A : PosCone E) : hw.toState A = (w A).toReal

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.toWeight
entries.docstring:
The weight induced by a state: `ENNReal.ofReal` applied to the state's values on the positive
cone, where they are automatically nonnegative.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def toWeight (s : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) : Weight E where

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.toWeight_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toWeight_apply (s : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (A : PosCone E) : s.toWeight A = ENNReal.ofReal (s (A : E))

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.toReal_toWeight_apply
entries.docstring: The weight induced by a state agrees with the state itself on the positive cone.
entries.snippet:
lemma toReal_toWeight_apply (s : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (A : PosCone E) :
    (s.toWeight A).toReal = s (A : E)

entries.name: UnitalPositiveLinearMap.toWeight_isState
entries.docstring: The weight induced by a state is finite and normalized.
entries.snippet: lemma toWeight_isState (s : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) : s.toWeight.IsState where

entries.name: Weight.stateEquiv
entries.docstring: Finite normalized weights correspond exactly to states.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def stateEquiv : {w : Weight E // w.IsState} ≃ 𝓢[ℝ, E] where

entries.name: Weight
entries.docstring: An extended nonnegative linear functional on the positive cone.
entries.snippet: abbrev Weight (E : Type*) [OrderedVectorSpace E]

entries.name: Weight.IsFaithful
entries.docstring: Only the zero positive element has weight zero.
entries.snippet: def IsFaithful (w : Weight E) : Prop

entries.name: Weight.IsFinite
entries.docstring: A weight has no infinite values.
entries.snippet: def IsFinite (w : Weight E) : Prop

entries.name: Weight.IsSemifinite
entries.docstring: A weight is the supremum of its finite values below each positive element.
entries.snippet: def IsSemifinite (w : Weight E) : Prop

entries.name: Weight.monotone
entries.docstring: Weights are monotone on the positive cone.
entries.snippet: lemma monotone (w : Weight E) : Monotone w

entries.name: Weight.IsFinite.isSemifinite
entries.docstring: A finite weight is semifinite.
entries.snippet: lemma IsFinite.isSemifinite {w : Weight E} (hw : w.IsFinite) : w.IsSemifinite

entries.name: Weight.IsFinite.toReal_map_add
entries.docstring: A finite weight's real value is additive.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsFinite.toReal_map_add {w : Weight E} (hw : w.IsFinite) (A B : PosCone E) :
    (w (A + B)).toReal = (w A).toReal + (w B).toReal

entries.name: Weight.toReal_map_nnreal_smul
entries.docstring: A weight's real value scales linearly under nonnegative real scaling.
entries.snippet:
lemma toReal_map_nnreal_smul (w : Weight E) (k : ℝ≥0) (A : PosCone E) :
    (w (k • A)).toReal = k * (w A).toReal

entries.name: Weight.IsNormal
entries.docstring:
A weight is normal when it preserves least upper bounds of increasing sequences in the
positive cone.
entries.snippet: def IsNormal (w : Weight E) : Prop

entries.name: Weight.IsState
entries.docstring: A weight that's finite everywhere and gives the certain outcome weight exactly `1`.
entries.snippet:
structure IsState (w : Weight E) : Prop where
  finite : w.IsFinite
  normalized : w 1 = 1

entries.name: Weight.normalize
entries.docstring: Rescale a weight by the inverse of its value at the order unit.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def normalize (w : Weight E) : Weight E where

entries.name: Weight.IsFinite.normalize_isFinite
entries.docstring: Normalizing a finite weight that's nonzero at the order unit keeps it finite.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsFinite.normalize_isFinite {w : Weight E} (hw : w.IsFinite) (h : w 1 ≠ 0) :
    (normalize w).IsFinite

entries.name: Weight.IsFinite.normalize_isState
entries.docstring:
Normalizing a finite weight that's nonzero at the order unit makes it a state: the order unit
is scaled to weight exactly `1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsFinite.normalize_isState {w : Weight E} (hw : w.IsFinite) (h : w 1 ≠ 0) :
    (normalize w).IsState where

entries.name: PosCone.coe_nnreal_smul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coe_nnreal_smul (t : ℝ≥0) (P : PosCone E) : ((t • P : PosCone E) : E) = (t : ℝ) • (P : E)

entries.name: PosCone.map_sub_eq_map_sub
entries.docstring: `P - Q ↦ f P - f Q` does not depend on how an element is written as a difference.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_sub_eq_map_sub {P Q P' Q' : PosCone E} (h : (P : E) - Q = P' - Q') :
    f P - f Q = f P' - f Q'

entries.name: PosCone.exists_sub
entries.docstring: In an order unit space, every element is a difference of positive elements.
entries.snippet: lemma exists_sub (A : E) : ∃ P Q : PosCone E, (P : E) - Q = A

entries.name: PosCone.extendFun
entries.docstring: The value of the extension, computed from a chosen decomposition `A = P - Q`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def extendFun (A : E) : ℝ

entries.name: PosCone.extendFun_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma extendFun_eq {A : E} {P Q : PosCone E} (h : (P : E) - Q = A) :
    extendFun f A = f P - f Q

entries.name: PosCone.extend
entries.docstring: The `ℝ`-linear extension of an `ℝ≥0`-linear map on an order unit space's positive cone.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def extend : E →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ where

entries.name: PosCone.extend_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma extend_apply {P Q : PosCone E} : extend f ((P : E) - Q) = f P - f Q

entries.name: PosCone.extend_coe
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma extend_coe (P : PosCone E) : extend f (P : E) = f P

entries.name: Weight.IsFinite.toReal
entries.docstring: A finite weight, read as a real-valued `ℝ≥0`-linear map on the positive cone.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def IsFinite.toReal (hw : w.IsFinite) : PosCone E →ₗ[ℝ≥0] ℝ where

entries.name: Weight.IsFinite.toReal_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma IsFinite.toReal_apply (hw : w.IsFinite) (A : PosCone E) : hw.toReal A = (w A).toReal

entries.name: Weight.IsFinite.toLinearMap
entries.docstring: The `ℝ`-linear map extending a finite weight.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def IsFinite.toLinearMap (hw : w.IsFinite) : E →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ

entries.name: Weight.IsFinite.toLinearMap_coe
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma IsFinite.toLinearMap_coe (hw : w.IsFinite) (A : PosCone E) :
    hw.toLinearMap (A : E) = (w A).toReal

entries.name: BlackBody
entries.docstring: An idealized black body in thermal equilibrium at temperature `T`.
entries.snippet:
structure BlackBody where
  T : Temperature

entries.name: BlackBody.spectralRadiance
entries.docstring:
The spectral radiance per unit frequency of blackbody radiation at frequency `ν`
    for a black body `B` and speed of light `c`:

    `B(ν, T) = 2 h ν³ / c² · 1 / (e^{h ν / (k_B T)} - 1)`

    By the homogeneity and isotropy of blackbody radiation, the spectral radiance
    is independent of position and direction, so it depends only on frequency
    and temperature.

    Extended by zero outside the physical domain `0 < ν`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def spectralRadiance (B : BlackBody) (c : SpeedOfLight) (ν : Frequency) : ℝ

entries.name: BlackBody.spectralRadiance_pos
entries.docstring:
The spectral radiance of blackbody radiation is positive for positive frequency
    and positive temperature.
entries.snippet:
lemma spectralRadiance_pos (B : BlackBody) (c : SpeedOfLight) (ν : Frequency)
    (hν : 0 < ν.val) (hT : 0 < (B.T : ℝ)) : 0 < B.spectralRadiance c ν

entries.name: BlackBody.spectralRadiance_nonneg
entries.docstring: The spectral radiance per unit frequency is non-negative on the physical domain.
entries.snippet:
lemma spectralRadiance_nonneg (B : BlackBody) (c : SpeedOfLight) (ν : Frequency)
    (hν : 0 < ν.val) (hT : 0 < (B.T : ℝ)) : 0 ≤ B.spectralRadiance c ν

entries.name: BlackBody.spectralRadiance_absZero
entries.docstring: The spectral radiance vanishes at absolute zero temperature.
entries.snippet:
lemma spectralRadiance_absZero (c : SpeedOfLight) (ν : Frequency) :
    spectralRadiance ⟨0⟩ c ν = 0

entries.name: BlackBody.spectralRadiance_zeroFreq
entries.docstring: The spectral radiance vanishes at zero frequency.
entries.snippet:
lemma spectralRadiance_zeroFreq (B : BlackBody) (c : SpeedOfLight) :
    B.spectralRadiance c 0 = 0

entries.name: BlackBody.spectralRadiance_eq_zero_of_nonpos_freq
entries.docstring: The spectral radiance vanishes when frequency is non-positive.
entries.snippet:
lemma spectralRadiance_eq_zero_of_nonpos_freq (B : BlackBody) (c : SpeedOfLight) (ν : Frequency)
    (hν : ν.val ≤ 0) : B.spectralRadiance c ν = 0

entries.name: BlackBody.spectralRadianceWave
entries.docstring:
Spectral radiance per unit wavelength of blackbody radiation at wavelength
  `λ` for a black body `B` and speed of light `c`:

    `B(λ, T) = 2 h c² / λ⁵ · 1 / (e ^ (h c / (λ kB T)) - 1)`,

  extended by zero outside the physical domain `0 < λ`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def spectralRadianceWave (B : BlackBody) (c : SpeedOfLight) (lam : Wavelength) : ℝ

entries.name: BlackBody.spectralRadianceWave_pos
entries.docstring:
The spectral radiance per unit wavelength is positive for positive wavelength
  and positive temperature.
entries.snippet:
lemma spectralRadianceWave_pos (B : BlackBody) (c : SpeedOfLight) (lam : Wavelength)
    (hlam : 0 < lam.val) (hT : 0 < (B.T : ℝ)) : 0 < B.spectralRadianceWave c lam

entries.name: BlackBody.spectralRadianceWave_nonneg
entries.docstring: The spectral radiance per unit wavelength is non-negative on the physical domain.
entries.snippet:
lemma spectralRadianceWave_nonneg (B : BlackBody) (c : SpeedOfLight) (lam : Wavelength)
    (hlam : 0 < lam.val) (hT : 0 < (B.T : ℝ)) : 0 ≤ B.spectralRadianceWave c lam

entries.name: BlackBody.spectralRadianceWave_absZero
entries.docstring: The spectral radiance per unit wavelength vanishes at absolute zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma spectralRadianceWave_absZero (c : SpeedOfLight) (lam : Wavelength) :
    spectralRadianceWave ⟨0⟩ c lam = 0

entries.name: BlackBody.spectralRadianceWave_zeroWave
entries.docstring: The spectral radiance per unit wavelength vanishes at zero wavelength.
entries.snippet:
lemma spectralRadianceWave_zeroWave (B : BlackBody) (c : SpeedOfLight) :
    B.spectralRadianceWave c 0 = 0

entries.name: BlackBody.spectralRadianceWave_eq_zero_of_nonpos_wave
entries.docstring:
The spectral radiance per unit wavelength vanishes when wavelength is
  non-positive.
entries.snippet:
lemma spectralRadianceWave_eq_zero_of_nonpos_wave (B : BlackBody) (c : SpeedOfLight)
    (lam : Wavelength) (hlam : lam.val ≤ 0) : B.spectralRadianceWave c lam = 0

entries.name: BlackBody.spectralRadianceWave_eq_spectralRadiance
entries.docstring:
Correspondence between the wavelength and frequency forms of Planck's law:
  `B(λ, T) = (c / λ²) B(ν = c / λ, T)`, where the frequency `c / λ` is given by
  `Frequency.ofWavelength`.
entries.snippet:
lemma spectralRadianceWave_eq_spectralRadiance (B : BlackBody) (c : SpeedOfLight)
    (lam : Wavelength) (hlam : 0 < lam.val) (hT : 0 < (B.T : ℝ)) :
    B.spectralRadianceWave c lam
      = ((c : ℝ) / (lam.val : ℝ) ^ 2) * B.spectralRadiance c
          (Frequency.ofWavelength c.toWithDim lam hlam)

entries.name: BlackBody.firstRadiationConstant
entries.docstring: The first radiation constant `c₁L = 2 h c²`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def firstRadiationConstant (c : SpeedOfLight) : ℝ

entries.name: BlackBody.firstRadiationConstant_pos
entries.docstring: The first radiation constant is positive.
entries.snippet:
lemma firstRadiationConstant_pos (c : SpeedOfLight) :
    0 < firstRadiationConstant c

entries.name: BlackBody.firstRadiationConstant_eq
entries.docstring: The first radiation constant equals `2 * h * c ^ 2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma firstRadiationConstant_eq (c : SpeedOfLight) :
    firstRadiationConstant c = 2 * h * (c : ℝ) ^ 2

entries.name: BlackBody.secondRadiationConstant
entries.docstring: The second radiation constant `c₂ = h c / kB`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def secondRadiationConstant (c : SpeedOfLight) : ℝ

entries.name: BlackBody.secondRadiationConstant_pos
entries.docstring: The second radiation constant is positive.
entries.snippet:
lemma secondRadiationConstant_pos (c : SpeedOfLight) :
    0 < secondRadiationConstant c

entries.name: BlackBody.secondRadiationConstant_eq
entries.docstring: The second radiation constant equals `h * c / kB`.
entries.snippet:
lemma secondRadiationConstant_eq (c : SpeedOfLight) :
    secondRadiationConstant c = (h : ℝ) * (c : ℝ) / kB

entries.name: BlackBody.spectralRadianceWave_eq_constants
entries.docstring:
Planck's law per unit wavelength in terms of the radiation constants:
  `B(λ, T) = (c₁L / λ⁵) / (e ^ (c₂ / (λ T)) - 1)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma spectralRadianceWave_eq_constants (B : BlackBody) (c : SpeedOfLight) (lam : Wavelength)
    (hlam : 0 < lam.val) (hT : 0 < (B.T : ℝ)) :
    B.spectralRadianceWave c lam
      = firstRadiationConstant c / (lam.val : ℝ) ^ 5
        / (Real.exp (secondRadiationConstant c / ((lam.val : ℝ) * (B.T : ℝ))) - 1)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.momentumState_comp_momentumCLM
entries.docstring:
The momentum state `momentumState p` is a generalized eigenvector of `𝐩 i` with eigenvalue
`ℏ pᵢ`, in the bra form `⟨p| 𝐩ᵢ = ℏ pᵢ ⟨p|` as functionals on Schwartz space. Since `𝐩 i` is
symmetric and `ℏ pᵢ` is real, this is equivalent to the ket form `𝐩ᵢ |p⟩ = ℏ pᵢ |p⟩`.
entries.snippet:
lemma momentumState_comp_momentumCLM (p : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    momentumState p ∘L 𝐩 i = (ℏ * p i : ℂ) • momentumState p

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.positionState_comp_positionCLM
entries.docstring:
The position state `positionState x` is a generalized eigenvector of `𝐱 i` with eigenvalue
`xᵢ`, in the bra form `⟨x| 𝐱ᵢ = xᵢ ⟨x|` as functionals on Schwartz space. Since `𝐱 i` is
symmetric and `xᵢ` is real, this is equivalent to the ket form `𝐱ᵢ |x⟩ = xᵢ |x⟩`.
entries.snippet:
lemma positionState_comp_positionCLM (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    positionState x ∘L 𝐱 i = (x i : ℂ) • positionState x

entries.name: CompleteTensorProduct.tIncl₃ₗᵢ
entries.docstring:
The embedding of the algebraic threefold tensor product `E ⊗[𝕜] F ⊗[𝕜] G` into the complete
  tensor product `E ⊗ₕ[𝕜] F ⊗ₕ[𝕜] G` as a linear isometry: `E ⊗[𝕜] F` is first embedded into
  `E ⊗ₕ[𝕜] F`, then `(E ⊗ₕ[𝕜] F) ⊗[𝕜] G` is embedded into its completion.
entries.snippet: def tIncl₃ₗᵢ : E ⊗[𝕜] F ⊗[𝕜] G →ₗᵢ[𝕜] E ⊗ₕ[𝕜] F ⊗ₕ[𝕜] G

entries.name: CompleteTensorProduct.tIncl₃'ₗᵢ
entries.docstring:
The embedding of the algebraic threefold tensor product `E ⊗[𝕜] (F ⊗[𝕜] G)` into the
  complete tensor product `E ⊗ₕ[𝕜] (F ⊗ₕ[𝕜] G)` as a linear isometry: `F ⊗[𝕜] G` is first
  embedded into `F ⊗ₕ[𝕜] G`, then `E ⊗[𝕜] (F ⊗ₕ[𝕜] G)` is embedded into its completion.
entries.snippet: def tIncl₃'ₗᵢ : E ⊗[𝕜] (F ⊗[𝕜] G) →ₗᵢ[𝕜] E ⊗ₕ[𝕜] (F ⊗ₕ[𝕜] G)

entries.name: CompleteTensorProduct.tIncl₃ₗᵢ_tmul
entries.docstring: On a simple tensor `x ⊗ₜ y ⊗ₜ z`, the embedding `tIncl₃ₗᵢ` is the nested coercion.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma tIncl₃ₗᵢ_tmul (x : E) (y : F) (z : G) :
    tIncl₃ₗᵢ (x ⊗ₜ[𝕜] y ⊗ₜ[𝕜] z) = (x ⊗ₜ[𝕜] y ⊗ₜ[𝕜] z : (E ⊗ₕ[𝕜] F) ⊗[𝕜] G)

entries.name: CompleteTensorProduct.tIncl₃'ₗᵢ_tmul
entries.docstring: On a simple tensor `x ⊗ₜ (y ⊗ₜ z)`, the embedding `tIncl₃'ₗᵢ` is the nested coercion.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma tIncl₃'ₗᵢ_tmul (x : E) (y : F) (z : G) :
    tIncl₃'ₗᵢ (x ⊗ₜ[𝕜] (y ⊗ₜ[𝕜] z)) = (x ⊗ₜ[𝕜] (y ⊗ₜ[𝕜] z) : E ⊗[𝕜] (F ⊗ₕ[𝕜] G))

entries.name: CompleteTensorProduct.assoc_tIncl₃ₗᵢ
entries.docstring:
`CompleteTensorProduct.assoc` acting on an element of the algebraic threefold tensor product
  reduces to `TensorProduct.assoc`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma assoc_tIncl₃ₗᵢ (x : E ⊗[𝕜] F ⊗[𝕜] G) :
    assoc 𝕜 E F G (tIncl₃ₗᵢ x) = tIncl₃'ₗᵢ (TensorProduct.assoc 𝕜 E F G x)

entries.name: CompleteTensorProduct.assoc_symm_tIncl₃'ₗᵢ
entries.docstring:
The inverse of `CompleteTensorProduct.assoc` acting on an element of the algebraic threefold
  tensor product reduces to the inverse of `TensorProduct.assoc`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma assoc_symm_tIncl₃'ₗᵢ (x : E ⊗[𝕜] (F ⊗[𝕜] G)) :
    (assoc 𝕜 E F G).symm (tIncl₃'ₗᵢ x) = tIncl₃ₗᵢ ((TensorProduct.assoc 𝕜 E F G).symm x)

entries.name: CompleteTensorProduct.assoc_tmul
entries.docstring: `CompleteTensorProduct.assoc` on simple tensors (c.f. `TensorProduct.assoc_tmul`).
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma assoc_tmul (x : E) (y : F) (z : G) :
    assoc 𝕜 E F G (x ⊗ₜ[𝕜] y ⊗ₜ[𝕜] z : (E ⊗ₕ[𝕜] F) ⊗[𝕜] G) =
      (x ⊗ₜ[𝕜] (y ⊗ₜ[𝕜] z) : E ⊗[𝕜] (F ⊗ₕ[𝕜] G))

entries.name: CompleteTensorProduct.assoc_symm_tmul
entries.docstring:
The inverse of `CompleteTensorProduct.assoc` on simple tensors
  (c.f. `TensorProduct.assoc_symm_tmul`).
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma assoc_symm_tmul (x : E) (y : F) (z : G) :
    (assoc 𝕜 E F G).symm (x ⊗ₜ[𝕜] (y ⊗ₜ[𝕜] z) : E ⊗[𝕜] (F ⊗ₕ[𝕜] G)) =
      (x ⊗ₜ[𝕜] y ⊗ₜ[𝕜] z : (E ⊗ₕ[𝕜] F) ⊗[𝕜] G)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HydrogenAtom.polyBddSchwartzSubmodule_le_hamiltonianOperator_domain
entries.docstring:
Polynomially-bounded Schwartz maps `f` with `‖x‖ ^ (-k) * ‖f x‖ ≤ Cₖ` for all `k ≤ ⌊2 - d/2⌋`
  lie in the domain of the Hamiltonian. For `d ≥ 3` these are all Schwartz maps.
entries.snippet:
lemma polyBddSchwartzSubmodule_le_hamiltonianOperator_domain :
    PolyBddSchwartzSubmodule d ⌊1 - d / 2 - (-1 : ℝ)⌋.toNat ≤
      H.hamiltonianOperator.domain

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HydrogenAtom.hamiltonianOperator_hasDenseDomain
entries.docstring: The Hamiltonian of the hydrogen atom is densely defined, in any dimension.
entries.snippet: lemma hamiltonianOperator_hasDenseDomain : H.hamiltonianOperator.HasDenseDomain

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HydrogenAtom.angularMomentum_cyclic_lrl
entries.docstring:
`𝐋ᵢⱼ𝐀(ε)ₖ + 𝐋ⱼₖ𝐀(ε)ᵢ + 𝐋ₖᵢ𝐀(ε)ⱼ = 0`; in three dimensions this is `𝐋 · 𝐀(ε) = 0`.
  The identity is trivial unless `i`, `j`, `k` are pairwise distinct, so it has no content in
  fewer than three dimensions.
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentum_cyclic_lrl (ε : ℝˣ) (i j k : Fin d) :
    𝐋 i j ∘L H.lrlOperator ε k + 𝐋 j k ∘L H.lrlOperator ε i + 𝐋 k i ∘L H.lrlOperator ε j = 0

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HydrogenAtom.lrl_cyclic_angularMomentum
entries.docstring:
`𝐀(ε)ₖ𝐋ᵢⱼ + 𝐀(ε)ᵢ𝐋ⱼₖ + 𝐀(ε)ⱼ𝐋ₖᵢ = 0`; in three dimensions this is `𝐀(ε) · 𝐋 = 0`.
  The identity is trivial unless `i`, `j`, `k` are pairwise distinct, so it has no content in
  fewer than three dimensions.
entries.snippet:
lemma lrl_cyclic_angularMomentum (ε : ℝˣ) (i j k : Fin d) :
    H.lrlOperator ε k ∘L 𝐋 i j + H.lrlOperator ε i ∘L 𝐋 j k + H.lrlOperator ε j ∘L 𝐋 k i = 0

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumCLM_inner
entries.docstring: The component symmetry identity, expressed directly on Schwartz maps.
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentumCLM_inner (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    ⟪(schwartzEquiv volume (𝐋 i j f) : SpaceDHilbertSpace d), schwartzEquiv volume g⟫_ℂ =
      ⟪(schwartzEquiv volume f : SpaceDHilbertSpace d), schwartzEquiv volume (𝐋 i j g)⟫_ℂ

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumSqOperator
entries.docstring:
Angular momentum squared on the Hilbert space, with the invariant Schwartz domain.
This transports the existing Schwartz operator `𝐋²`, including its factor `1/2`.
entries.snippet: def angularMomentumSqOperator : SpaceDHilbertSpace d →ₗ.[ℂ] SpaceDHilbertSpace d where

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumSqOperator_domain_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentumSqOperator_domain_eq :
    (angularMomentumSqOperator (d := d)).domain = SchwartzSubmodule d

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumSqOperator_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentumSqOperator_apply (ψ : SchwartzSubmodule d) : angularMomentumSqOperator ψ =
    schwartzEquiv volume (𝐋² ((schwartzEquiv volume).symm ψ))

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumSqOperator_apply_ae
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentumSqOperator_apply_ae (ψ : SchwartzSubmodule d) :
    angularMomentumSqOperator ψ =ᵐ[volume] 𝐋² ((schwartzEquiv volume).symm ψ)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumSqOperator_range
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentumSqOperator_range (ψ : SchwartzSubmodule d) :
    angularMomentumSqOperator ψ ∈ SchwartzSubmodule d

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumSqOperator_apply_eq_sum
entries.docstring:
The squared operator is the sum of squares of Hilbert-space components on their
common invariant domain. The inner applications land in Schwartz by `angularMomentumOperator_range`.
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentumSqOperator_apply_eq_sum (ψ : SchwartzSubmodule d) :
    angularMomentumSqOperator ψ = (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, ∑ j,
      angularMomentumOperator i j
        ⟨angularMomentumOperator i j ψ, angularMomentumOperator_range i j ψ⟩

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumSqOperator_hasDenseDomain
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentumSqOperator_hasDenseDomain :
    (angularMomentumSqOperator (d := d)).HasDenseDomain

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumSqr_inner
entries.docstring: Symmetry of `𝐋²` follows by moving each component across the inner product twice.
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentumSqr_inner (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    ⟪(schwartzEquiv volume (𝐋² f) : SpaceDHilbertSpace d), schwartzEquiv volume g⟫_ℂ =
      ⟪(schwartzEquiv volume f : SpaceDHilbertSpace d), schwartzEquiv volume (𝐋² g)⟫_ℂ

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumSqOperator_isSymmetric
entries.docstring: Angular momentum squared is symmetric on the Schwartz domain.
entries.snippet: lemma angularMomentumSqOperator_isSymmetric : (angularMomentumSqOperator (d := d)).IsSymmetric

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumSqOperator_isUnbounded
entries.docstring: In Physlib terminology, the squared operator is densely defined and closable.
entries.snippet: lemma angularMomentumSqOperator_isUnbounded : (angularMomentumSqOperator (d := d)).IsUnbounded

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentum_cyclic_position
entries.docstring:
`𝐋ᵢⱼ𝐱ₖ + 𝐋ⱼₖ𝐱ᵢ + 𝐋ₖᵢ𝐱ⱼ = 0`; in three dimensions this is `𝐋 · 𝐱 = 0`.
  The identity is trivial unless `i`, `j`, `k` are pairwise distinct, so it has no content in
  fewer than three dimensions.
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentum_cyclic_position :
    𝐋 i j ∘L 𝐱 k + 𝐋 j k ∘L 𝐱 i + 𝐋 k i ∘L 𝐱 j = 0

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentum_cyclic_momentum
entries.docstring:
`𝐋ᵢⱼ𝐩ₖ + 𝐋ⱼₖ𝐩ᵢ + 𝐋ₖᵢ𝐩ⱼ = 0`; in three dimensions this is `𝐋 · 𝐩 = 0`.
  The identity is trivial unless `i`, `j`, `k` are pairwise distinct, so it has no content in
  fewer than three dimensions.
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentum_cyclic_momentum :
    𝐋 i j ∘L 𝐩 k + 𝐋 j k ∘L 𝐩 i + 𝐋 k i ∘L 𝐩 j = 0

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentum_commutation_positionDotMomentum
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma angularMomentum_commutation_positionDotMomentum : ⁅𝐋 i j, 𝐱[d] ⬝ᵥ 𝐩⁆ = 0

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumDimThreeOperator
entries.docstring: The Cartesian Hilbert-space components, ordered as `x, y, z`.
entries.snippet:
def angularMomentumDimThreeOperator (i : Fin 3) :
    SpaceDHilbertSpace 3 →ₗ.[ℂ] SpaceDHilbertSpace 3 where

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumDimThreeCLM_zero_eq
entries.snippet: lemma angularMomentumDimThreeCLM_zero_eq : 𝐋₃ 0 = 𝐋 1 2

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumDimThreeCLM_one_eq
entries.snippet: lemma angularMomentumDimThreeCLM_one_eq : 𝐋₃ 1 = 𝐋 2 0

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumDimThreeCLM_two_eq
entries.snippet: lemma angularMomentumDimThreeCLM_two_eq : 𝐋₃ 2 = 𝐋 0 1

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_domain_eq
entries.snippet: lemma angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_domain_eq : (𝓛₃ i).domain = SchwartzSubmodule 3

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_apply (ψ : SchwartzSubmodule 3) :
    𝓛₃ i ψ = schwartzEquiv volume (𝐋₃ i ((schwartzEquiv volume).symm ψ))

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_apply_ae
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_apply_ae (ψ : SchwartzSubmodule 3) :
    𝓛₃ i ψ =ᵐ[volume] 𝐋₃ i ((schwartzEquiv volume).symm ψ)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_range
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_range (ψ : SchwartzSubmodule 3) :
    𝓛₃ i ψ ∈ SchwartzSubmodule 3

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_apply_apply
entries.docstring: Composing two components stays on the common Schwartz domain.
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_apply_apply (j : Fin 3) (ψ : SchwartzSubmodule 3) :
    𝓛₃ i ⟨𝓛₃ j ψ, angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_range j ψ⟩ =
      schwartzEquiv volume (𝐋₃ i (𝐋₃ j ((schwartzEquiv volume).symm ψ)))

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_hasDenseDomain
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_hasDenseDomain :
    (𝓛₃ i).HasDenseDomain

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_isSymmetric
entries.snippet: lemma angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_isSymmetric : (𝓛₃ i).IsSymmetric

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_isUnbounded
entries.snippet: lemma angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_isUnbounded : (𝓛₃ i).IsUnbounded

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumOperatorSqr_eq_sum_dimThree
entries.docstring: The antisymmetric-index definition agrees with the Cartesian sum of squares.
entries.snippet: lemma angularMomentumOperatorSqr_eq_sum_dimThree : 𝐋²[3] = ∑ i : Fin 3, 𝐋₃ i ∘L 𝐋₃ i

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumSqOperator_apply_eq_sum_dimThree
entries.docstring: The same Cartesian sum of squares, evaluated on a Hilbert-space Schwartz vector.
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentumSqOperator_apply_eq_sum_dimThree (ψ : SchwartzSubmodule 3) :
    angularMomentumSqOperator ψ = ∑ i : Fin 3, 𝓛₃ i
      ⟨𝓛₃ i ψ, angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_range i ψ⟩

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumDimThree_commutation
entries.docstring: The Cartesian angular momentum algebra, with the right-handed Levi-Civita symbol.
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentumDimThree_commutation (j : Fin 3) : ⁅𝐋₃ i, 𝐋₃ j⁆ =
    (I * ℏ) • ∑ k : Fin 3, (leviCivitaSymbol ![i, j, k] : ℂ) • 𝐋₃ k

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumDimThree_commutation_xy
entries.docstring: `[Lx, Ly] = iℏ Lz`.
entries.snippet: lemma angularMomentumDimThree_commutation_xy : ⁅𝐋₃ 0, 𝐋₃ 1⁆ = (I * ℏ) • 𝐋₃ 2

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumDimThree_commutation_yz
entries.docstring: `[Ly, Lz] = iℏ Lx`.
entries.snippet: lemma angularMomentumDimThree_commutation_yz : ⁅𝐋₃ 1, 𝐋₃ 2⁆ = (I * ℏ) • 𝐋₃ 0

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumDimThree_commutation_zx
entries.docstring: `[Lz, Lx] = iℏ Ly`.
entries.snippet: lemma angularMomentumDimThree_commutation_zx : ⁅𝐋₃ 2, 𝐋₃ 0⁆ = (I * ℏ) • 𝐋₃ 1

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumSqr_commutation_dimThree
entries.docstring: Angular momentum squared commutes with every Cartesian component on Schwartz maps.
entries.snippet: lemma angularMomentumSqr_commutation_dimThree : ⁅𝐋²[3], 𝐋₃ i⁆ = 0

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_commutation
entries.docstring: The Cartesian commutation algebra on the common Hilbert-space Schwartz domain.
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_commutation (j : Fin 3) (ψ : SchwartzSubmodule 3) :
    𝓛₃ i ⟨𝓛₃ j ψ, angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_range j ψ⟩ -
      𝓛₃ j ⟨𝓛₃ i ψ, angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_range i ψ⟩ =
      (I * ℏ) • ∑ k : Fin 3, (leviCivitaSymbol ![i, j, k] : ℂ) • 𝓛₃ k ψ

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumSqOperator_commutation_dimThree
entries.docstring: `[L², Li] = 0` on the common invariant Hilbert-space domain.
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentumSqOperator_commutation_dimThree (ψ : SchwartzSubmodule 3) :
    angularMomentumSqOperator ⟨𝓛₃ i ψ, angularMomentumDimThreeOperator_range i ψ⟩ -
      𝓛₃ i ⟨angularMomentumSqOperator ψ, angularMomentumSqOperator_range ψ⟩ = 0

entries.snippet: def angularMomentumRaisingOperator : SpaceDHilbertSpace 3 →ₗ.[ℂ] SpaceDHilbertSpace 3 where

entries.snippet: def angularMomentumLoweringOperator : SpaceDHilbertSpace 3 →ₗ.[ℂ] SpaceDHilbertSpace 3 where

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumLoweringOperator_apply

lemma angularMomentumLoweringOperator_apply (ψ : SchwartzSubmodule 3) :
    𝓛⁻ ψ = schwartzEquiv volume (𝐋⁻ ((schwartzEquiv volume).symm ψ))

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.angularMomentumRaisingOperator_apply_eq
entries.snippet:

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.mulOperator_eq_iff_ae_eq
entries.docstring:
For a `μ`-a.e. strongly measurable `f` and σ-finite `μ`, the multiplication
  operator determines the function up to `μ`-a.e. equality.
  No measurability of `g` is needed.

lemma mulOperator_eq_iff_ae_eq {μ : Measure (Space d)} [SigmaFinite μ] {f g : Space d → ℂ}
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) : 𝓜 μ f = 𝓜 μ g ↔ f =ᵐ[μ] g

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.PoschlTeller.polyDeriv
entries.docstring:
The derivative acting on the polynomial of a wave `p(tanh (κ x)) e^{i k x}`,
  `p ↦ κ (1 - X²) p' + i k p`, so that
  `∂ₓ (p(tanh (κ x)) e^{i k x}) = (polyDeriv k p)(tanh (κ x)) e^{i k x}`.
entries.snippet: def polyDeriv (k : ℝ) (p : ℂ[X]) : ℂ[X]

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.PoschlTeller.polyRaise
entries.docstring:
The raising operator `-∂ₓ + n κ tanh (κ x)` acting on the polynomial of a wave
  `p(tanh (κ x)) e^{i k x}`.
entries.snippet: def polyRaise (k : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (p : ℂ[X]) : ℂ[X]

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.PoschlTeller.polyReducedHamiltonian
entries.docstring:
The operator `-∂ₓ² - n (n + 1) κ² / cosh² (κ x)` acting on the polynomial of a wave
  `p(tanh (κ x)) e^{i k x}`. This is `2 m / ℏ²` times the Hamiltonian of the Pöschl-Teller system
  with family number `n`.
entries.snippet: def polyReducedHamiltonian (k : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (p : ℂ[X]) : ℂ[X]

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.PoschlTeller.polyReducedHamiltonian_polyRaise
entries.docstring: The raising operator intertwines the Hamiltonians with family numbers `n` and `n + 1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma polyReducedHamiltonian_polyRaise (k : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (p : ℂ[X]) :
    Q.polyReducedHamiltonian k (n + 1) (Q.polyRaise k (n + 1) p) =
      Q.polyRaise k (n + 1) (Q.polyReducedHamiltonian k n p)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.PoschlTeller.polyDeriv_C
entries.docstring: The derivative of a constant multiple of the plane wave `c e^{i k x}` is `i k c e^{i k x}`.
entries.snippet: lemma polyDeriv_C (k : ℝ) (c : ℂ) : Q.polyDeriv k (C c) = C (k * I * c)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.PoschlTeller.polyRaise_C_mul
entries.docstring: The raising operator is linear with respect to constant multiples.
entries.snippet:
lemma polyRaise_C_mul (k : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (p : ℂ[X]) :
    Q.polyRaise k n (C c * p) = C c * Q.polyRaise k n p

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.PoschlTeller.polyScattering
entries.docstring:
The polynomial `Pₖ` of the scattering state `Pₖ(tanh (κ x)) e^{i k x}` of the Pöschl-Teller
  system with family number `n`, obtained by applying the raising operators with
  `1, …, n` to `1`.
entries.snippet:
def polyScattering (k : ℝ) : ℕ → ℂ[X]
  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 => Q.polyRaise k (n + 1) (polyScattering k n)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.PoschlTeller.polyReducedHamiltonian_polyScattering
entries.docstring:
The scattering polynomial with family number `n` is an eigenvector of the reduced Hamiltonian
  with eigenvalue `k²`.
entries.snippet:
lemma polyReducedHamiltonian_polyScattering (k : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    Q.polyReducedHamiltonian k n (Q.polyScattering k n) =
      C ((k : ℂ) ^ 2) * Q.polyScattering k n

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.PoschlTeller.eval_one_polyRaise
entries.docstring: At `tanh (κ x) = 1` the raising operator acts as multiplication by `n κ - i k`.
entries.snippet:
lemma eval_one_polyRaise (k : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (p : ℂ[X]) :
    (Q.polyRaise k n p).eval 1 = (n * Q.κ - k * I) * p.eval 1

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.PoschlTeller.eval_neg_one_polyRaise
entries.docstring: At `tanh (κ x) = -1` the raising operator acts as multiplication by `-n κ - i k`.
entries.snippet:
lemma eval_neg_one_polyRaise (k : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (p : ℂ[X]) :
    (Q.polyRaise k n p).eval (-1) = (-(n * Q.κ) - k * I) * p.eval (-1)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.PoschlTeller.polyScattering_eval_one
entries.docstring: The value at `1` of the scattering polynomial is `∏ₙ (n κ - i k)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma polyScattering_eval_one (k : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (Q.polyScattering k n).eval 1 = ∏ j ∈ Finset.range n, ((j + 1) * Q.κ - k * I)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.PoschlTeller.polyScattering_eval_neg_one
entries.docstring: The value at `-1` of the scattering polynomial is `∏ₙ (-n κ - i k)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma polyScattering_eval_neg_one (k : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (Q.polyScattering k n).eval (-1) = ∏ j ∈ Finset.range n, (-((j + 1) * Q.κ) - k * I)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.PoschlTeller.polyScattering_eval_one_ne_zero
entries.docstring: The value at `1` of the scattering polynomial is non-zero.
entries.snippet: lemma polyScattering_eval_one_ne_zero (k : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : (Q.polyScattering k n).eval 1 ≠ 0

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.PoschlTeller.polyScattering_eval_neg_one_ne_zero
entries.docstring: The value at `-1` of the scattering polynomial is non-zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma polyScattering_eval_neg_one_ne_zero (k : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (Q.polyScattering k n).eval (-1) ≠ 0

    endEquivMatrix (gamma μ) ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin 4) ℂ

entries.name: spaceTime.γ.γProd
entries.docstring:
The product, with increasing indices, of the gamma matrices in the Dirac representation whose
index lies in `s`; the empty product is `1`. The index `i : Fin 4` labels the image of
`CliffordAlgebra.ι diracForm (Pi.single i 1)` under `ofCliffordAlgebra`.
entries.snippet: def γProd (s : Finset (Fin 4)) : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℂ

entries.name: spaceTime.γ.γProd_mem_diracAlgebra
entries.docstring: Each product `γProd s` lies in `diracAlgebra`.
entries.snippet: lemma γProd_mem_diracAlgebra (s : Finset (Fin 4)) : γProd s ∈ diracAlgebra

entries.name: spaceTime.γ.γProd_singleton
entries.docstring: The product `γProd {i}` is the gamma matrix of index `i`.
entries.snippet:
lemma γProd_singleton (i : Fin 4) :
    γProd {i} = endEquivMatrix (gamma (finSumFinEquiv.symm i))

entries.name: spaceTime.γ.γ_mul_γProd
entries.docstring:
The gamma matrix of index `j` commutes past `γProd s` up to the sign `(-1) ^ #(s.erase j)`,
as it anticommutes with the gamma matrices of the other indices.
entries.snippet:
lemma γ_mul_γProd (j : Fin 4) (s : Finset (Fin 4)) :
    endEquivMatrix (gamma (finSumFinEquiv.symm j)) * γProd s =
      (-1 : ℂ) ^ (s.erase j).card • (γProd s * endEquivMatrix (gamma (finSumFinEquiv.symm j)))

entries.name: spaceTime.γ.γProd_mem_unitary
entries.docstring: Each product `γProd s` is unitary.
entries.snippet: lemma γProd_mem_unitary (s : Finset (Fin 4)) : γProd s ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin 4) ℂ

entries.name: spaceTime.γ.trace_star_γProd_mul_γProd
entries.docstring:
The products `γProd s` are orthogonal for the trace form `tr (star A * B)`, each with square
norm `4`.
entries.snippet:
lemma trace_star_γProd_mul_γProd (t s : Finset (Fin 4)) :
    (star (γProd t) * γProd s).trace = if t = s then 4 else 0

entries.name: spaceTime.γ.linearIndependent_γProd
entries.docstring:
The 16 products `γProd s` are linearly independent over `ℝ`, since they are orthogonal for the
trace form `tr (star A * B)`.
entries.snippet: lemma linearIndependent_γProd : LinearIndependent ℝ γProd

entries.name: lorentzAlgebra.hasDerivAt_boost_tanh_zero
entries.docstring:
The tangent at zero of the finite boost curve parametrized by rapidity
is the negative of the named boost generator.
entries.snippet:
lemma hasDerivAt_boost_tanh_zero (i : Fin 3) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => (LorentzGroup.boost i (Real.tanh r) (Real.abs_tanh_lt_one r)).1)
      (-boostGenerator i) 0

entries.name: LorentzGroup.star_toComplex_apply

lemma star_toComplex_apply (Λ : LorentzGroup d) (i j : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    star (toComplex Λ i j) = toComplex Λ i j

entries.name: LorentzGroup.γ_tanh

entries.snippet: lemma γ_tanh (r : ℝ) : γ (Real.tanh r) = Real.cosh r

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup_eq_one_iff
entries.docstring: The kernel of the homomorphism from `SL(2, ℂ)` to the Lorentz group is `{1, -1}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma toLorentzGroup_eq_one_iff (M : SL(2, ℂ)) :
    toLorentzGroup M = 1 ↔ M.1 = 1 ∨ M.1 = -1

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.cayleyKlein
entries.docstring:
The element `!![a, -conj b; b, conj a]` of `SL(2, ℂ)`, given by its Cayley–Klein
parameters `a b` with `‖a‖² + ‖b‖² = 1`.
entries.snippet: def cayleyKlein (a b : ℂ) (h : normSq a + normSq b = 1) : SL(2, ℂ)

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.cayleyKlein_mem_unitaryGroup
entries.docstring: A Cayley–Klein element is unitary.
entries.snippet:
lemma cayleyKlein_mem_unitaryGroup (a b : ℂ) (h : normSq a + normSq b = 1) :
    (cayleyKlein a b h).1 ∈ unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup_cayleyKlein_mem_rotations
entries.docstring: The image of a Cayley–Klein element is a rotation.
entries.snippet:
lemma toLorentzGroup_cayleyKlein_mem_rotations (a b : ℂ) (h : normSq a + normSq b = 1) :
    toLorentzGroup (cayleyKlein a b h) ∈ LorentzGroup.Rotations 3

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.cayleyKleinRotation
entries.docstring:
The rotation of the Cayley–Klein parameters `a b`, as an element of the Lorentz rotation
subgroup.
entries.snippet: def cayleyKleinRotation (a b : ℂ) (h : normSq a + normSq b = 1) : LorentzGroup.Rotations 3

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.cayleyKleinRotation_inr_inr
entries.docstring: The spatial block of the rotation of the Cayley–Klein parameters `a b`.

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.exists_cayleyKleinRotation_apply_two
entries.docstring: Every unit vector is the image of the third axis under some Cayley–Klein rotation.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_cayleyKleinRotation_apply_two (n : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hn : n 0 ^ 2 + n 1 ^ 2 + n 2 ^ 2 = 1) :
    ∃ a b, ∃ h : normSq a + normSq b = 1,
      ∀ i, (cayleyKleinRotation a b h).1.1 (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inr 2) = n i

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.exists_unitary_toLorentzGroup_eq
entries.docstring: Every rotation is the image of a unitary element of `SL(2, ℂ)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_unitary_toLorentzGroup_eq (Λ : LorentzGroup.Rotations 3) :
    ∃ M : SL(2, ℂ), M.1 ∈ unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ ∧ toLorentzGroup M = Λ

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.exists_toVector_toLorentzGroup_eq
entries.docstring: Every velocity is the image of the time axis under some element of `SL(2, ℂ)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_toVector_toLorentzGroup_eq (u : Velocity 3) :
    ∃ M : SL(2, ℂ), LorentzGroup.toVector (toLorentzGroup M) = u.1

entries.name: SpeedOfLight.«instance@a324d4d5»

entries.name: SpeedOfLight.scaleUnit_val

  dimension of length over time.
entries.snippet:

lemma scaleUnit_val (c : SpeedOfLight) (u1 u2 : LTMCTUnitChoices) :

entries.name: SpeedOfLight.toWithDim_scaleUnit

    (scaleUnit u1 u2 c).toWithDim = scaleUnit u1 u2 c.toWithDim

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.permT_basis_repr_of_id
entries.docstring: A reindexing whose slot map is pointwise the identity only transports the labels.
entries.snippet:
lemma permT_basis_repr_of_id {n : ℕ} {c c1 : Fin n → C} {σ : Fin n → Fin n}
    (hσ : ∀ i, σ i = i) (h : IsReindexing c c1 σ) (t : S.Tensor c)
    (φ : ComponentIdx (S := S) c1) :
    (basis c1).repr (permT σ h t) φ =
    (basis c).repr t (fun i => basisIdxCongr (by rw [← h.2 i, hσ]) (φ i))

entries.name: complexLorentzTensor.basisIdx

  Weyl colors and `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3` for the vector colors.

abbrev basisIdx : Color → Type
  | Color.upL => Fin 2
  | Color.downL => Fin 2
  | Color.upR => Fin 2
  | Color.downR => Fin 2
  | Color.up => Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3
  | Color.down => Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3

  | Color.downR => inferInstance
  | Color.up => inferInstance
  | Color.down => inferInstance

entries.name: complexLorentzTensor.Color.bar
entries.docstring: Complex conjugation of colours: it swaps handedness and fixes the vector colours.

  | Color.upR => Color.upL
  | Color.downR => Color.downL
  | Color.up => Color.up
  | Color.down => Color.down

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.ComponentIdx.insert
entries.docstring:
Splitting a component index at a named slot: the label at slot `i`, together with a component
index for the colours of the remaining slots. The dependent counterpart of `Fin.cons`, and the
single-slot analogue of the two-slot `DropPairSection.ofFinEquiv`.
entries.snippet:
def insert {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → C} (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    basisIdx (c i) × ComponentIdx (S := S) (c ∘ i.succAbove) ≃ ComponentIdx (S := S) c

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.ComponentIdx.insert_apply_self
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insert_apply_self {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → C} (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (x : basisIdx (c i) × ComponentIdx (S := S) (c ∘ i.succAbove)) :
    insert (S := S) i x i = x.1

    insert (S := S) i x (i.succAbove m) = x.2 m
