entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.bar_tau_of_bar
entries.docstring: If `bar a = d`, then `bar (τ d) = τ a`.
entries.snippet: lemma bar_tau_of_bar {a d : C} (hbar : S.bar a = d) : S.bar (S.τ d) = S.τ a

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.toMatrix_conjT
entries.docstring:
Conjugating a rank-two tensor conjugates each component and bars both indices:
`(T̄)_{ĪJ̄} = (T_{IJ})*`, where barring a barred index removes the bar. For example, `ψ_α χ_β` goes
to `ψ̄_α̇ χ̄_β̇`, and a tensor `M_{IJ̄}` goes to `(M̄)_{ĪJ} = (M_{IJ̄})*`.
entries.snippet:
lemma toMatrix_conjT {cs : Fin 2 → C} (t : S.Tensor cs) :
    toMatrix (S.conjT t) = ((toMatrix t).map star).submatrix
      (Equiv.cast (S.barIdx_eq (cs 0))) (Equiv.cast (S.barIdx_eq (cs 1)))

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.conjSingleT
entries.docstring:
Conjugation of a vector, `vᴵ ↦ v̄^Ī = (vᴵ)*`, landing at the conjugate colour. For example, a
left-handed Weyl spinor `ψ_α` goes to the right-handed `ψ̄_α̇`.
entries.snippet: def conjSingleT (x : C) : S.Tensor ![x] →ₛₗ[starRingEnd k] S.Tensor ![S.bar x]

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.conjSingleT_basis
entries.docstring:
Conjugation sends the basis vector `e_I` to `ē_Ī`, the basis vector of the conjugate colour with
the same label.
entries.snippet:
lemma conjSingleT_basis (x : C) (z : basisIdx x) :
    S.conjSingleT x (basis ![x] (ComponentIdx.single.symm z)) =
      basis ![S.bar x] (ComponentIdx.single.symm (cast (S.barIdx_eq x).symm z))

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.toSquareMatrix
entries.docstring:
The matrix `(M_{IJ̄})`, with entries unchanged, regarded as a square matrix over the labels of
`I`. Lean needs this step because the labels of a colour and of its conjugate are different types,
identified by `barIdx_eq`; only for a square matrix are Hermiticity, positive-definiteness and the
inverse defined. Convention: the unbarred index is the row and the barred index the column, entry
`(I, J)` being `M_{IJ̄}`, as physicists write the matrix. For a Kähler metric `g_{IJ̄}` it is the
usual matrix `(g_{IJ̄})`.
entries.snippet:
def toSquareMatrix {c : Fin 2 → C} (M : S.Tensor c) (hbar : S.bar (c 0) = c 1 := by rfl) :
    Matrix (basisIdx (c 0)) (basisIdx (c 0)) k

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.toSquareMatrix_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma toSquareMatrix_apply {c : Fin 2 → C} (hbar : S.bar (c 0) = c 1) (M : S.Tensor c)
    (i j : basisIdx (c 0)) :
    S.toSquareMatrix M hbar i j =
      toMatrix M i ((Equiv.cast (hbar ▸ S.barIdx_eq (c 0))).symm j)

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.toMatrix_eq_submatrix_toSquareMatrix
entries.docstring: `toMatrix M` is `toSquareMatrix M` with its columns labelled by `J̄` instead of `J`.
entries.snippet:
lemma toMatrix_eq_submatrix_toSquareMatrix {c : Fin 2 → C} (hbar : S.bar (c 0) = c 1)
    (M : S.Tensor c) :
    toMatrix M =
      (S.toSquareMatrix M hbar).submatrix id (Equiv.cast (hbar ▸ S.barIdx_eq (c 0)))

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.conjT_eq_permT_swap_iff_toSquareMatrix_isHermitian
entries.docstring:
For `M_{IJ̄}`, the conjugate `(M̄)_{ĪJ} = (M_{IJ̄})*` and the swapped tensor `M_{JĪ}` have the
same index types, a barred index then an ordinary one. They are equal, `(M_{IJ̄})* = M_{JĪ}`,
exactly when the matrix `(M_{IJ̄})` is Hermitian. A Kähler metric satisfies this.
entries.snippet:
lemma conjT_eq_permT_swap_iff_toSquareMatrix_isHermitian {c : Fin 2 → C}
    (hbar : S.bar (c 0) = c 1) (M : S.Tensor c) :
    S.conjT M = permT ![1, 0] (IsReindexing.swap_of_eq hbar.symm
      ((congrArg S.bar hbar).symm.trans (S.bar_involution (c 0))).symm) M ↔
    (S.toSquareMatrix M hbar).IsHermitian

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.toMatrix_contractInnerT_eq_toSquareMatrix_mul
entries.docstring:
The matrix of `g_{IJ̄} t^{J̄K}` is the product of the square matrix `(g_{IJ̄})` and the matrix
`(t^{J̄K})`, with the rows of `(t^{J̄K})` labelled by `J`.
entries.snippet:
lemma toMatrix_contractInnerT_eq_toSquareMatrix_mul [HasContrDualBases S.toTensorSpecies]
    {cs ds : Fin 2 → C} (hbar : S.bar (cs 0) = cs 1) (h : S.τ (cs 1) = ds 0) (M : S.Tensor cs)
    (t : S.Tensor ds) :
    toMatrix (contractInnerT h M t) =
      S.toSquareMatrix M hbar * (toMatrix t).submatrix
        (dualIdxEquiv h ∘ (Equiv.cast (hbar ▸ S.barIdx_eq (cs 0))).symm)
        (id : basisIdx (ds 1) → _)

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.isContrDualMatching_bar
entries.docstring:
The conjugate bases are dual: if `e_α` contracted with `e^β` is `δ_α^β`, then `ē_α̇` contracted
with `ē^β̇` is `δ_α̇^β̇`.
entries.snippet:
lemma isContrDualMatching_bar [HasContrDualBases S.toTensorSpecies] (d : C) :
    IsContrDualMatching S.toTensorSpecies (S.bar d)
      ((basisIdxCongr (S.bar_tau d)).symm.trans ((Equiv.cast (S.barIdx_eq (S.τ d))).trans
        ((contrDualIdxEquiv S.toTensorSpecies d).trans (Equiv.cast (S.barIdx_eq d)).symm)))

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.dualIdxEquiv_bar
entries.docstring:
`dualIdxEquiv` sends a lower label `α` to the upper label `α` it contracts with to `1`.
Conjugation commutes with this: the dotted label `α̇` pairs with the dotted upper label `α̇`.
entries.snippet:
lemma dualIdxEquiv_bar [Nontrivial k] [HasContrDualBases S.toTensorSpecies] {c1 c2 c3 : C}
    (h : S.τ c1 = c2) (h' : S.τ (S.bar c1) = c3) (hbar : S.bar c2 = c3) (x : basisIdx c1) :
    dualIdxEquiv h' (cast (S.barIdx_eq c1).symm x) =
      cast (hbar ▸ S.barIdx_eq c2).symm (dualIdxEquiv h x)

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.dualIdxEquiv_bar_tau
entries.docstring:
Removing a bar and lowering an index commute on labels. From a label of the upper barred index
`J̄`, removing the bar and then lowering gives the same label of the lower index `J` as lowering and
then removing the bar.
```
upper J̄ (τ d)  → remove bar →  upper J (τ a)
      ↓ lower                        ↓ lower
lower J̄ (d)    → remove bar →  lower J (a)
```
The left-hand side of the statement goes across the top and down, the right-hand side down and
across the bottom.
entries.snippet:
lemma dualIdxEquiv_bar_tau [Nontrivial k] [HasContrDualBases S.toTensorSpecies] {a d : C}
    (hbar : S.bar a = d) (j : basisIdx (S.τ d)) :
    dualIdxEquiv (S.τ_τ_apply a)
        ((Equiv.cast (S.bar_tau_of_bar hbar ▸ S.barIdx_eq (S.τ d))).symm j) =
      Equiv.cast (hbar ▸ S.barIdx_eq a) ((dualIdxEquiv (rfl : S.τ d = S.τ d)).symm j)

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.toSesqForm
entries.docstring:
The Hermitian form `⟨s, t⟩ = M(t, s̄) = M_{IJ̄} tᴵ s̄^J̄` of a tensor `M_{IJ̄}`, on vectors
`s, t`. Convention: as in Mathlib it is conjugate-linear in its left argument `s`; `s̄` fills the
second, barred slot of `M` and `t` the first, so the argument order is opposite to the slot order.
entries.snippet:
def toSesqForm (x : C) {c : Fin 2 → C} (M : S.Tensor c) (hbar : S.bar (c 0) = c 1 := by rfl)
    (hx : S.τ x = c 0 := by rfl) : S.Tensor ![x] →ₗ⋆[k] S.Tensor ![x] →ₗ[k] k

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.toMatrix₂_toSesqForm
entries.docstring:
Since the left argument of the form fills the second slot of `M` (`toSesqForm`),
`⟨e_I, e_J⟩ = M(e_J, ē_I) = M_{JĪ}`: the matrix of the form is the transpose of `(M_{IJ̄})`. For a
Kähler metric, `⟨∂_I, ∂_J⟩ = ∂_J ∂_Ī K = g_{JĪ}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma toMatrix₂_toSesqForm [HasContrDualBases S.toTensorSpecies] {x : C} {c : Fin 2 → C}
    (hbar : S.bar (c 0) = c 1) (hx : S.τ x = c 0) (M : S.Tensor c) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix₂ ((basis ![x]).reindex (ComponentIdx.single.trans (dualIdxEquiv hx)))
        ((basis ![x]).reindex (ComponentIdx.single.trans (dualIdxEquiv hx)))
        (S.toSesqForm x M hbar hx) = (S.toSquareMatrix M hbar)ᵀ

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.isSymm_toSesqForm_iff_toSquareMatrix_isHermitian
entries.docstring: `⟨s, t⟩* = ⟨t, s⟩` for all `s, t` exactly when `(M_{IJ̄})* = M_{JĪ}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma isSymm_toSesqForm_iff_toSquareMatrix_isHermitian [HasContrDualBases S.toTensorSpecies]
    {x : C} {c : Fin 2 → C} (hbar : S.bar (c 0) = c 1) (hx : S.τ x = c 0) (M : S.Tensor c) :
    (S.toSesqForm x M hbar hx).IsSymm ↔ (S.toSquareMatrix M hbar).IsHermitian

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.isSymm_toSesqForm_iff_conjT_eq_permT
entries.docstring:
`⟨s, t⟩* = ⟨t, s⟩` for all `s, t` exactly when the conjugate of `M` equals `M` with its two
indices swapped, `(M_{IJ̄})* = M_{JĪ}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma isSymm_toSesqForm_iff_conjT_eq_permT [HasContrDualBases S.toTensorSpecies]
    {x : C} {c : Fin 2 → C} (hbar : S.bar (c 0) = c 1) (hx : S.τ x = c 0) (M : S.Tensor c) :
    (S.toSesqForm x M hbar hx).IsSymm ↔ S.conjT M = permT ![1, 0] (IsReindexing.swap_of_eq hbar.symm
      ((congrArg S.bar hbar).symm.trans (S.bar_involution (c 0))).symm) M

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.isPosDef_toSesqForm_iff_toSquareMatrix_posDef
entries.docstring:
The form is positive-definite, Hermitian with `M_{IJ̄} tᴵ t̄^J̄ > 0` for every `t ≠ 0`, exactly
when the matrix `(M_{IJ̄})` is. A Kähler metric is positive-definite, which makes kinetic terms
positive.
entries.snippet:
lemma isPosDef_toSesqForm_iff_toSquareMatrix_posDef [HasContrDualBases S.toTensorSpecies]
    {x : C} {c : Fin 2 → C} (hbar : S.bar (c 0) = c 1) (hx : S.τ x = c 0) (M : S.Tensor c) :
    (S.toSesqForm x M hbar hx).IsPosDef ↔ (S.toSquareMatrix M hbar).PosDef

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.isUnit_det_toSquareMatrix_of_isPosDef
entries.docstring: Over a field, the matrix `(M_{IJ̄})` of a positive-definite tensor is invertible.

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.inverseT
entries.docstring:
The inverse `g^{J̄I}` of a tensor `g_{IJ̄}`. Its matrix, with row `J` and column `I`, is
`(g_{IJ̄})⁻¹`, and it is zero when `(g_{IJ̄})` is not invertible.
entries.snippet:
def inverseT {c : Fin 2 → C} (M : S.Tensor c) (hbar : S.bar (c 0) = c 1 := by rfl) :
    S.Tensor ![S.τ (c 1), S.τ (c 0)]

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.toMatrix_inverseT
entries.docstring:
The component `g^{J̄I}` is the entry `(J, I)` of `(g_{IJ̄})⁻¹`. The upper indices `J̄` and `I`
are labelled by the lower indices `J` and `I` they contract with.
entries.snippet:
lemma toMatrix_inverseT {c : Fin 2 → C} (hbar : S.bar (c 0) = c 1) (M : S.Tensor c) :
    toMatrix (S.inverseT M hbar) =
      (S.toSquareMatrix M hbar)⁻¹.submatrix
        (Equiv.cast (hbar ▸ S.barIdx_eq (c 0)) ∘
          (dualIdxEquiv (rfl : S.τ (c 1) = S.τ (c 1))).symm)
        (dualIdxEquiv (S.τ_τ_apply (c 0)))

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.toSquareMatrix_inverseT
entries.docstring:
The matrix `(g^{J̄I})`, row `J` from the first, barred index and column `I` from the second, is
`(g_{IJ̄})⁻¹`.
entries.snippet:
lemma toSquareMatrix_inverseT {c : Fin 2 → C} (hbar : S.bar (c 0) = c 1) (M : S.Tensor c) :
    S.toSquareMatrix (S.inverseT M hbar) (S.bar_tau_of_bar hbar) =
      (S.toSquareMatrix M hbar)⁻¹.submatrix
        (Equiv.cast (hbar ▸ S.barIdx_eq (c 0)) ∘
          (dualIdxEquiv (rfl : S.τ (c 1) = S.τ (c 1))).symm)
        (Equiv.cast (hbar ▸ S.barIdx_eq (c 0)) ∘
          (dualIdxEquiv (rfl : S.τ (c 1) = S.τ (c 1))).symm)

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.isSymm_toSesqForm_inverseT
entries.docstring:
The inverse of a Hermitian tensor is Hermitian. If `(g_{IJ̄})* = g_{JĪ}`, then
`(g^{J̄I})* = g^{ĪJ}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma isSymm_toSesqForm_inverseT {x y : C} {c : Fin 2 → C} (hbar : S.bar (c 0) = c 1)
    (hx : S.τ x = c 0) (hy : S.τ y = S.τ (c 1)) {M : S.Tensor c}
    (hM : (S.toSesqForm x M hbar hx).IsSymm) :
    (S.toSesqForm y (S.inverseT M hbar) (S.bar_tau_of_bar hbar) hy).IsSymm

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.isPosDef_toSesqForm_inverseT
entries.docstring:
The inverse of a positive-definite tensor is positive-definite, so `g^{J̄I} t_J̄ t̄_I > 0` for
every covector `t ≠ 0`.
entries.snippet:
lemma isPosDef_toSesqForm_inverseT {x y : C} {c : Fin 2 → C} (hbar : S.bar (c 0) = c 1)
    (hx : S.τ x = c 0) (hy : S.τ y = S.τ (c 1)) {M : S.Tensor c}
    (hM : (S.toSesqForm x M hbar hx).IsPosDef) :
    (S.toSesqForm y (S.inverseT M hbar) (S.bar_tau_of_bar hbar) hy).IsPosDef

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.contractInnerT_inverseT
entries.docstring:
If the matrix `(g_{IJ̄})` is invertible, `g_{IJ̄} g^{J̄K} = δ_I^K`. The first colour of the unit
tensor is renamed from `τ (τ (cs 0))` to `cs 0`.
entries.snippet:
lemma contractInnerT_inverseT {cs : Fin 2 → C} (hbar : S.bar (cs 0) = cs 1) (M : S.Tensor cs)
    (hM : IsUnit (S.toSquareMatrix M hbar).det) :
    contractInnerT rfl M (S.inverseT M hbar) =
      permT id (IsReindexing.unitTensor_of_tau_eq (S.τ_τ_apply (cs 0)))
        (unitTensor (S := S.toTensorSpecies) (S.τ (cs 0)))

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.inverseT_contractInnerT
entries.docstring: If the matrix `(g_{IJ̄})` is invertible, `g^{J̄I} g_{IK̄} = δ^J̄_K̄`.
entries.snippet:
lemma inverseT_contractInnerT {cs : Fin 2 → C} (hbar : S.bar (cs 0) = cs 1) (M : S.Tensor cs)
    (hM : IsUnit (S.toSquareMatrix M hbar).det) :
    contractInnerT (S.τ_τ_apply (cs 0)) (S.inverseT M hbar) M =
      unitTensor (S := S.toTensorSpecies) (cs 1)

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.eq_inverseT_of_contractInnerT_eq_unitTensor
entries.docstring:
If `(g_{IJ̄})` is invertible and `g_{IJ̄} t^{J̄K} = δ_I^K`, then `t` is the inverse
`g^{J̄K}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_inverseT_of_contractInnerT_eq_unitTensor {cs : Fin 2 → C} (hbar : S.bar (cs 0) = cs 1)
    (M : S.Tensor cs) (hM : IsUnit (S.toSquareMatrix M hbar).det)
    {t : S.Tensor ![S.τ (cs 1), S.τ (cs 0)]}
    (ht : contractInnerT rfl M t =
      permT id (IsReindexing.unitTensor_of_tau_eq (S.τ_τ_apply (cs 0)))
        (unitTensor (S := S.toTensorSpecies) (S.τ (cs 0)))) :
    t = S.inverseT M hbar

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.toConjDualAtIndex
entries.docstring:
The linear equivalence that contracts slot `i` of a tensor with the first index of `M`, when
the matrix `(M_{IJ̄})` is invertible. Slot `i` changes from `τ (cs 0)` to its conjugate dual
`cs 1`, and the inverse contracts with `inverseT M`. For a metric `g_{IJ̄}` this lowers an
unbarred index to a barred one, `t_{J̄} = g_{IJ̄} t^I`.
entries.snippet:
def toConjDualAtIndex {cs : Fin 2 → C} (M : S.Tensor cs) (hbar : S.bar (cs 0) = cs 1)
    (hM : IsUnit (S.toSquareMatrix M hbar).det) :
    {n : ℕ} → {c : Fin n → C} → (i : Fin n) → (he : c i = S.τ (cs 0)) →
      S.Tensor c ≃ₗ[k] S.Tensor (Function.update c i (cs 1))
  | 0, _, i, _ => i.elim0
  | _ + 1, _, i, he =>
    crossToSlotEquiv i he ((congrArg S.τ he).trans (S.τ_τ_apply (cs 0))) rfl M (S.inverseT M hbar)
      (S.contractInnerT_inverseT hbar M hM)
      ((S.inverseT_contractInnerT hbar M hM).trans (permT_id_self _).symm)

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.toConjDualAtIndex_apply
entries.docstring: `toConjDualAtIndex` is the contraction `crossToSlot` of slot `i` with the first index of `M`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toConjDualAtIndex_apply {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {cs : Fin 2 → C} (M : S.Tensor cs)
    (hbar : S.bar (cs 0) = cs 1) (hM : IsUnit (S.toSquareMatrix M hbar).det)
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (he : c i = S.τ (cs 0)) (t : S.Tensor c) :
    S.toConjDualAtIndex M hbar hM i he t =
      crossToSlot i 0 ((congrArg S.τ he).trans (S.τ_τ_apply (cs 0))) M t

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.toConjDualAtIndex_symm_apply
entries.docstring:
The inverse of `toConjDualAtIndex` is the contraction `crossToSlotInv` of slot `i` with the
first index of `inverseT M`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toConjDualAtIndex_symm_apply {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {cs : Fin 2 → C}
    (M : S.Tensor cs) (hbar : S.bar (cs 0) = cs 1) (hM : IsUnit (S.toSquareMatrix M hbar).det)
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (he : c i = S.τ (cs 0)) (t : S.Tensor (Function.update c i (cs 1))) :
    (S.toConjDualAtIndex M hbar hM i he).symm t =
      crossToSlotInv (S := S.toTensorSpecies) (d := cs 1) i he rfl (S.inverseT M hbar) t

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.fromMatrixT
entries.docstring:
Rank-two tensors and their component matrices, as a linear equivalence: `fromMatrixT c0 c1 M`
  is the tensor with component matrix `M`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fromMatrixT (c0 c1 : C) :
    Matrix (basisIdx c0) (basisIdx c1) k ≃ₗ[k] S.Tensor ![c0, c1] where

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.fromMatrixT_basis_repr
entries.snippet:
lemma fromMatrixT_basis_repr (c0 c1 : C) (M : Matrix (basisIdx c0) (basisIdx c1) k)
    (φ : ComponentIdx ![c0, c1]) :
    (basis ![c0, c1]).repr (fromMatrixT (S := S) c0 c1 M) φ = M (φ 0) (φ 1)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix
entries.docstring:
The component matrix of a rank-two tensor: the `(x, y)` entry is
  `repr t (ComponentIdx.pair.symm (x, y))`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def toMatrix {cs : Fin 2 → C} (t : S.Tensor cs) :
    Matrix (basisIdx (cs 0)) (basisIdx (cs 1)) k

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toMatrix_apply {cs : Fin 2 → C} (t : S.Tensor cs)
    (x : basisIdx (cs 0)) (y : basisIdx (cs 1)) :
    toMatrix t x y = (basis cs).repr t (ComponentIdx.pair.symm (x, y))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_apply_cons
entries.docstring:
`toMatrix_apply` at a `cons` colour list `![c0, c1]`, where the labels are named by the
  colours.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toMatrix_apply_cons {c0 c1 : C} (t : S.Tensor ![c0, c1])
    (x : basisIdx c0) (y : basisIdx c1) :
    toMatrix t x y = (basis ![c0, c1]).repr t (ComponentIdx.pair.symm (x, y))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_fromMatrixT
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toMatrix_fromMatrixT (c0 c1 : C) (M : Matrix (basisIdx c0) (basisIdx c1) k) :
    toMatrix (fromMatrixT (S := S) c0 c1 M) = M

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.fromMatrixT_toMatrix
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fromMatrixT_toMatrix {c0 c1 : C} (t : S.Tensor ![c0, c1]) :
    fromMatrixT (S := S) c0 c1 (toMatrix t) = t

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_injective
entries.docstring: Rank-two tensors with equal component matrices are equal.
entries.snippet:
lemma toMatrix_injective {cs : Fin 2 → C} :
    Function.Injective (toMatrix (S := S) (cs := cs))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_permT_swap
entries.docstring: Swapping the two slots of a rank-two tensor transposes its component matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma toMatrix_permT_swap {c c1 : Fin 2 → C} (h0 : c 1 = c1 0) (h1 : c 0 = c1 1)
    (t : S.Tensor c) :
    toMatrix (permT ![1, 0] (IsReindexing.swap_of_eq h0 h1) t) =
      (toMatrix t).transpose.submatrix (basisIdxCongr h0.symm) (basisIdxCongr h1.symm)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrPCoeff_basisVector
entries.docstring:
For a species with dual bases (`HasContrDualBases`), the contraction coefficient of a basis
  vector is the Kronecker δ of its labels at `i` and `j`, the label at `j` read as a label at the
  color `c i`. The per-species `contrPCoeff_basis` lemmas follow from it.
entries.snippet:
lemma Pure.contrPCoeff_basisVector [HasContrDualBases S] {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} (i j : Fin n)
    (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j) (φ : ComponentIdx (S := S) c) :
    Pure.contrPCoeff i j hij (Pure.basisVector c φ) =
      if φ i = HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv S (c i) (basisIdxCongr hij.2.symm (φ j)) then 1
      else 0

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT_basis_repr_apply_eq_sum_dual
entries.docstring:
For a species with dual bases (`HasContrDualBases`), a component of a contraction is a single
  sum over the labels at the first contracted index: the δ law
  (`HasContrDualBases.contr_basis_eq_ite`) fixes the label at the second. This collapses the double
  sum of `contrT_basis_repr_apply_eq_sum_fin`.
entries.snippet:
lemma contrT_basis_repr_apply_eq_sum_dual [HasContrDualBases S] {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    {i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)} (h : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j) (t : Tensor S c)
    (φ : ComponentIdx (c ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove i j)) :
    (basis (c ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove i j)).repr (contrT n i j h t) φ =
    ∑ x : basisIdx (c i), (basis c).repr t
      (DropPairSection.ofFinEquiv h.1 φ
        (x, basisIdxCongr h.2 ((HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv S (c i)).symm x))).1

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_basis
entries.docstring:
Cross contraction of two basis tensors: the contraction of the two contracted basis vectors
times the basis tensor of the surviving labels. These values determine `crossToEnd i j hc`, a
bilinear map in the two tensors.
entries.snippet:
lemma crossToEnd_basis {nA nB : ℕ} {cA : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {cB : Fin (nB + 1) → C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin (nB + 1)) (hc : S.τ (cA i) = cB j)
    (φA : ComponentIdx (S := S) cA) (φB : ComponentIdx (S := S) cB) :
    crossToEnd i j hc (basis cA φA) (basis cB φB) =
      S.contr (cA i) (b (cA i) (φA i) ⊗ₜ[k] b (S.τ (cA i)) (basisIdxCongr hc.symm (φB j))) •
        basis (Fin.append (cA ∘ i.succAbove) (cB ∘ j.succAbove))
          (ComponentIdx.prod.symm (fun m => φA (i.succAbove m), fun m => φB (j.succAbove m)))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_basis_repr_eq_sum_fin
entries.docstring:
The component formula for a cross contraction at arbitrary slots and ranks, for any species:
each contracted label is summed over its own slot, with the contraction of the two basis vectors as
coefficient. The counterpart of `contrT_basis_repr_apply_eq_sum_fin` for two tensors.
entries.snippet:
lemma crossToEnd_basis_repr_eq_sum_fin {nA nB : ℕ} {cA : Fin (nA + 1) → C}
    {cB : Fin (nB + 1) → C} (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin (nB + 1)) (hc : S.τ (cA i) = cB j)
    (t1 : Tensor S cA) (t2 : Tensor S cB)
    (φ : ComponentIdx (S := S) (Fin.append (cA ∘ i.succAbove) (cB ∘ j.succAbove))) :
    (basis (Fin.append (cA ∘ i.succAbove) (cB ∘ j.succAbove))).repr
        (crossToEnd i j hc t1 t2) φ =
      ∑ x₁ : basisIdx (cA i), ∑ x₂ : basisIdx (cB j),
        ((basis cA).repr t1 (ComponentIdx.insert i (x₁, φ.prod.1)) *
          (basis cB).repr t2 (ComponentIdx.insert j (x₂, φ.prod.2))) *
        S.contr (cA i) (b (cA i) x₁ ⊗ₜ[k]
          b (S.τ (cA i)) (basisIdxCongr (by rw [hc]) x₂))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_basis_repr_eq_sum_dual
entries.docstring:
The component formula for a cross contraction at arbitrary slots and ranks, for a species with
contraction-dual bases: the contraction coefficient is `δ` and one sum remains, the contracted label
of `t2` matched to that of `t1` by `contrDualIdxEquiv`.
entries.snippet:
lemma crossToEnd_basis_repr_eq_sum_dual [HasContrDualBases S] {nA nB : ℕ} {cA : Fin (nA + 1) → C}
    {cB : Fin (nB + 1) → C} (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin (nB + 1)) (hc : S.τ (cA i) = cB j)
    (t1 : Tensor S cA) (t2 : Tensor S cB)
    (φ : ComponentIdx (S := S) (Fin.append (cA ∘ i.succAbove) (cB ∘ j.succAbove))) :
    (basis (Fin.append (cA ∘ i.succAbove) (cB ∘ j.succAbove))).repr
        (crossToEnd i j hc t1 t2) φ =
      ∑ x : basisIdx (cA i),
        (basis cA).repr t1 (ComponentIdx.insert i (x, φ.prod.1)) *
        (basis cB).repr t2 (ComponentIdx.insert j
          (basisIdxCongr hc ((HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv S (cA i)).symm x),
            φ.prod.2))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_pair_basis_repr
entries.docstring:
The component formula for cross-contracting the last slot of a rank-two tensor with the first
slot of another. The surviving labels are supplied as a dependent pair, so the formula applies when
the species has colour-dependent basis-index types.
entries.snippet:
lemma crossToEnd_pair_basis_repr [HasContrDualBases S] {c0 c1 c2 c3 : C} (h : S.τ c1 = c2)
    (t1 : Tensor S ![c0, c1]) (t2 : Tensor S ![c2, c3])
    (y0 : basisIdx c0) (y3 : basisIdx c3) :
    (basis (Fin.append (![c0, c1] ∘ (Fin.last 1).succAbove)
        (![c2, c3] ∘ (0 : Fin 2).succAbove))).repr
      (crossToEnd (Fin.last 1) (0 : Fin 2) h t1 t2)
      (ComponentIdx.pair.symm (y0, y3)) =
      ∑ x : basisIdx c1,
        (basis ![c0, c1]).repr t1 (ComponentIdx.pair.symm (y0, x)) *
        (basis ![c2, c3]).repr t2
          (ComponentIdx.pair.symm
            (basisIdxCongr h ((HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv S c1).symm x), y3))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_crossToEnd_pair
entries.docstring:
Cross contraction of two rank-two tensors is the product of their component matrices, the
  middle labels matched by `HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv`.
entries.snippet:
lemma toMatrix_crossToEnd_pair [HasContrDualBases S] {c0 c1 c2 c3 : C} (h : S.τ c1 = c2)
    (t1 : S.Tensor ![c0, c1]) (t2 : S.Tensor ![c2, c3]) :
    toMatrix (crossToEnd (Fin.last 1) (0 : Fin 2) h t1 t2) =
      toMatrix t1 * (toMatrix t2).submatrix
        (fun x : basisIdx (![c0, c1] 1) => HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv h x) id

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_basis_repr_eq_sum_fin
entries.docstring:
The component formula for a cross contraction into an arbitrary slot, for a species whose bases
are not assumed adapted to the contraction: each contracted label is summed over its own slot and
the contraction of the two basis vectors remains an opaque coefficient. Rotating the survivor back
to its slot only transports the surviving labels, so this is `crossToEnd_basis_repr_eq_sum_fin` read
through the cycle.
entries.snippet:
lemma crossToSlot_basis_repr_eq_sum_fin {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C}
    {cM : Fin 2 → C} (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin 2) (hc : S.τ (c i) = cM j)
    (M : S.Tensor cM) (t : S.Tensor c)
    (φ : ComponentIdx (S := S) (Function.update c i (cM (j.succAbove 0)))) :
    (basis (Function.update c i (cM (j.succAbove 0)))).repr
        (crossToSlot i j hc M t) φ =
      ∑ x₁ : basisIdx (c i), ∑ x₂ : basisIdx (cM j),
        ((basis c).repr t (ComponentIdx.insert i
            (x₁, fun m => basisIdxCongr (by simp [Function.update_of_ne]) (φ (i.succAbove m)))) *
          (basis cM).repr M (ComponentIdx.insert j
            (x₂, fun m => basisIdxCongr (by fin_cases m; simp) (φ i)))) *
        S.contr (c i) (b (c i) x₁ ⊗ₜ[k]
          b (S.τ (c i)) (basisIdxCongr (by rw [hc]) x₂))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_basis_repr_eq_sum_dual
entries.docstring:
The component formula for a cross contraction into an arbitrary slot, for a species with
contraction-dual bases: the contraction coefficient is `δ` and one sum remains, the contracted label
of `M` matched to that of `t` by `contrDualIdxEquiv`.
entries.snippet:
lemma crossToSlot_basis_repr_eq_sum_dual [HasContrDualBases S] {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C}
    {cM : Fin 2 → C} (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin 2) (hc : S.τ (c i) = cM j)
    (M : S.Tensor cM) (t : S.Tensor c)
    (φ : ComponentIdx (S := S) (Function.update c i (cM (j.succAbove 0)))) :
    (basis (Function.update c i (cM (j.succAbove 0)))).repr
        (crossToSlot i j hc M t) φ =
      ∑ x : basisIdx (c i),
        (basis c).repr t (ComponentIdx.insert i
          (x, fun m => basisIdxCongr (by simp [Function.update_of_ne]) (φ (i.succAbove m)))) *
        (basis cM).repr M (ComponentIdx.insert j
          (basisIdxCongr hc ((HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv S (c i)).symm x),
            fun m => basisIdxCongr (by fin_cases m; simp) (φ i)))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toLinearMap₂
entries.docstring:
The bilinear map `t, s ↦ M_{μν} tᵘ sᵛ` of a rank-two tensor: `t` fills the first index of `M`,
`s` the second. For the Minkowski metric this is the inner product `η_{μν} tᵘ sᵛ`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def toLinearMap₂ (x y : C) {cM : Fin 2 → C} (M : Tensor S cM)
    (hx : S.τ x = cM 0 := by rfl) (hy : S.τ y = cM 1 := by rfl) :
    Tensor S ![x] →ₗ[k] Tensor S ![y] →ₗ[k] k

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toLinearMap₂_apply
entries.docstring: In components, the bilinear map is `∑_{μ,ν} M_{μν} tᵘ sᵛ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma toLinearMap₂_apply [HasContrDualBases S] {x y : C} {cM : Fin 2 → C} (hx : S.τ x = cM 0)
    (hy : S.τ y = cM 1) (M : Tensor S cM) (t : Tensor S ![x]) (s : Tensor S ![y]) :
    toLinearMap₂ x y M hx hy t s =
      ∑ w : basisIdx y, ∑ z : basisIdx x,
        (basis ![x]).repr t (ComponentIdx.single.symm z) *
          toMatrix M (HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv hx z) (HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv hy w) *
          (basis ![y]).repr s (ComponentIdx.single.symm w)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix₂_toLinearMap₂
entries.docstring:
On basis vectors, the bilinear map gives `M(e_μ, e_ν) = M_{μν}`, so its matrix is the component
matrix `(M_{μν})`.
entries.snippet:
lemma toMatrix₂_toLinearMap₂ [HasContrDualBases S] {x y : C} {cM : Fin 2 → C}
    (hx : S.τ x = cM 0) (hy : S.τ y = cM 1) (M : Tensor S cM) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix₂
      ((basis ![x]).reindex (ComponentIdx.single.trans (HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv hx)))
      ((basis ![y]).reindex (ComponentIdx.single.trans (HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv hy)))
      (toLinearMap₂ x y M hx hy) = toMatrix M

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contractInnerT
entries.docstring:
The contraction `A_{μν} B^{νρ}` of the second index of `A` with the first index of `B`, whose
colours are dual by `h`. The result has the indices `μ` and `ρ`, in that order.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def contractInnerT {cs ds : Fin 2 → C} (h : S.τ (cs 1) = ds 0) :
    Tensor S cs →ₗ[k] Tensor S ds →ₗ[k] Tensor S ![cs 0, ds 1]

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contractInnerT_apply
entries.docstring:
`contractInnerT` is `crossToEnd` of the last index of `A` with the first index of `B`, with the
colours of the result renamed to `![cs 0, ds 1]`.
entries.snippet:
lemma contractInnerT_apply {cs ds : Fin 2 → C} (h : S.τ (cs 1) = ds 0) (a : Tensor S cs)
    (b : Tensor S ds) :
    contractInnerT h a b = permT id (IsReindexing.on_id.mpr fun j => by fin_cases j <;> rfl)
      (crossToEnd (Fin.last 1) (0 : Fin 2) h a b)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_eq_permT_contractInnerT
entries.docstring:
`crossToEnd` of the last index of `A` with the first index of `B` is `contractInnerT` with its
colours renamed. This is `contractInnerT_apply` read from right to left.
entries.snippet:
lemma crossToEnd_eq_permT_contractInnerT {cs ds : Fin 2 → C} (h : S.τ (cs 1) = ds 0)
    (a : Tensor S cs) (b : Tensor S ds) :
    crossToEnd (Fin.last 1) (0 : Fin 2) h a b =
      permT id (IsReindexing.on_id.mpr fun j => by fin_cases j <;> rfl) (contractInnerT h a b)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_contractInnerT
entries.docstring:
The matrix of `A_{μν} B^{νρ}` is the matrix product of `(A_{μν})` and `(B^{νρ})`, with the
labels of `ν` in `B` matched to those in `A` by `dualIdxEquiv`. This is `toMatrix_crossToEnd_pair`
at general colour lists.
entries.snippet:
lemma toMatrix_contractInnerT [HasContrDualBases S] {cs ds : Fin 2 → C} (h : S.τ (cs 1) = ds 0)
    (a : Tensor S cs) (b : Tensor S ds) :
    toMatrix (contractInnerT h a b) =
      toMatrix a * (toMatrix b).submatrix (HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv h) id

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contractInnerT_right_injective
entries.docstring:
If the matrix `(M_{μν})`, made square by the label bijection `e`, is invertible, then
`t ↦ M_{μν} t^{νρ}` is injective.
entries.snippet:
lemma contractInnerT_right_injective [HasContrDualBases S] {cs ds : Fin 2 → C}
    (h : S.τ (cs 1) = ds 0) (e : basisIdx (cs 0) ≃ basisIdx (cs 1)) (M : Tensor S cs)
    (hM : IsUnit ((toMatrix M).submatrix id e).det) :
    Function.Injective (contractInnerT h M)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contractInnerT_equivariant
entries.docstring:
`contractInnerT` commutes with the action of `G`. For a Lorentz transformation `Λ`,
`(Λ A)_{μν} (Λ B)^{νρ} = Λ (A_{μν} B^{νρ})`.
entries.snippet:
lemma contractInnerT_equivariant {cs ds : Fin 2 → C} (h : S.τ (cs 1) = ds 0) (g : G)
    (a : Tensor S cs) (b : Tensor S ds) :
    contractInnerT h (g • a) (g • b) = g • contractInnerT h a b

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contractInnerT_eq_unitTensor_comm
entries.docstring:
If the label sets of the two indices of `M` are in bijection, `M_{μν} M'^{νρ} = δ_μ^ρ` implies
`M'^{νρ} M_{ρσ} = δ^ν_σ`. Without the bijection `e` this fails, since `A B = 1` does not imply
`B A = 1` for rectangular matrices.
entries.snippet:
lemma contractInnerT_eq_unitTensor_comm [HasContrDualBases S] {cs ds : Fin 2 → C}
    (hb : S.τ (cs 1) = ds 0) (ha : S.τ (ds 1) = cs 0) (e : basisIdx (cs 0) ≃ basisIdx (cs 1))
    (M : Tensor S cs) (M' : Tensor S ds)
    (h : contractInnerT hb M M' =
      permT id (IsReindexing.unitTensor_of_tau_eq ha) (unitTensor (S := S) (ds 1))) :
    contractInnerT ha M' M =
      permT id (IsReindexing.unitTensor_of_tau_eq hb) (unitTensor (S := S) (cs 1))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contractInnerT_dual_metricTensor_metricTensor
entries.docstring:
The metric at `τ c` contracted with the metric at `c` is the unit tensor at `c`,
  `η^{μν} η_{νρ} = δ^μ_ρ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma contractInnerT_dual_metricTensor_metricTensor {c : C} :
    contractInnerT (S.τ_τ_apply c) (metricTensor (S := S) (S.τ c)) (metricTensor (S := S) c) =
      permT (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2) (IsReindexing.unitTensor_of_tau_eq rfl)
        (unitTensor (S := S) c)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contractInnerT_metricTensor_metricTensor_eq_dual_unit
entries.docstring:
The metric at `c` contracted with the metric at `τ c` is the unit tensor at `τ c`,
  `η_{μν} η^{νρ} = δ_μ^ρ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma contractInnerT_metricTensor_metricTensor_eq_dual_unit {c : C} :
    contractInnerT rfl (metricTensor (S := S) c) (metricTensor (S := S) (S.τ c)) =
      permT (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2) (IsReindexing.unitTensor_of_tau_eq (S.τ_τ_apply c))
        (unitTensor (S := S) (S.τ c))

entries.name: realLorentzConjTensor
entries.docstring:
The real Lorentz tensors as a conjugation species: over `ℝ` conjugation is trivial, so every
  colour is its own conjugate.
entries.snippet:
def realLorentzConjTensor (d : ℕ := 3) : ConjTensorSpecies ℝ Color (LorentzGroup d)
    (modules d) (fun _ => Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d)
    (fun | Color.up => Lorentz.ContrMod.rep | Color.down => Lorentz.CoMod.rep)
    (fun | Color.up => Lorentz.contrBasis d | Color.down => Lorentz.coBasis d) where

entries.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.contr_metric
entries.snippet:
lemma ContrMod.contr_metric {d : ℕ} :
    (TensorProduct.comm ℝ _ _ <|
      (TensorProduct.lid ℝ _).lTensor _ <|
      (ContrMod.contr.toLinearMap.rTensor (CoMod d)).lTensor (ContrMod d) <|
      (TensorProduct.assoc ℝ (ContrMod d) (CoMod d) (CoMod d)).symm.toLinearMap.lTensor
        (ContrMod d) <|
      TensorProduct.assoc ℝ (ContrMod d) (ContrMod d) ((CoMod d) ⊗[ℝ] (CoMod d)) <|
      (ContrMod.metric d 1) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (CoMod.metric d 1)) = ContrMod.unit d (1 : ℝ)

lemma CoMod.contr_metric {d : ℕ} :
    (TensorProduct.comm ℝ _ _ <|
    (TensorProduct.lid ℝ _).lTensor _ <|
    (CoMod.contr.toLinearMap.rTensor (ContrMod d)).lTensor (CoMod d) <|
    (TensorProduct.assoc ℝ (CoMod d) (ContrMod d) (ContrMod d)).symm.toLinearMap.lTensor
      (CoMod d) <|

    (CoMod.metric d 1) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (ContrMod.metric d 1)) = CoMod.unit d (1 : ℝ)

entries.name: realLorentzTensor.basisIdxCongr_basisIdxColorToComplex_symm

    (ContrMod.unit d) (1 : ℝ) = LinearMap.lTensor _ (LinearEquiv.cast (by simp)).toLinearMap
    (TensorProduct.comm ℝ _ _ ((CoMod.unit d) (1 : ℝ)))

entries.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.contr
entries.docstring:
The linear map from ContrMod d ⊗ CoMod d to ℝ given by
    summing over components of contravariant Lorentz vector and
    covariant Lorentz vector in the
    standard basis (i.e. the dot product).
    In terms of index notation this is the contraction is ψⁱ φᵢ.
entries.snippet:
def ContrMod.contr : ((ContrMod.rep).tprod (CoMod.rep)).IntertwiningMap
    (Representation.trivial ℝ (LorentzGroup d) ℝ) where

entries.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.contr_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma ContrMod.contr_tmul (ψ : ContrMod d) (φ : CoMod d) :
    ⟪ψ, φ⟫ₘ = ψ.toFin1dℝ ⬝ᵥ φ.toFin1dℝ

entries.name: Lorentz.CoMod.contr
entries.docstring:
The linear map from CoMod d ⊗ ContrMod d to ℝ given by
    summing over components of contravariant Lorentz vector and
    covariant Lorentz vector in the
    standard basis (i.e. the dot product).
    In terms of index notation this is the contraction is ψⁱ φᵢ.
entries.snippet:
def CoMod.contr : ((CoMod.rep (d := d)).tprod (ContrMod.rep (d := d))).IntertwiningMap
    (Representation.trivial ℝ (LorentzGroup d) ℝ) where

entries.name: Lorentz.CoMod.contr_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma CoMod.contr_tmul (φ : CoMod d) (ψ : ContrMod d) :
    ⟪φ, ψ⟫ₘ = φ.toFin1dℝ ⬝ᵥ ψ.toFin1dℝ

entries.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.contr_tmul_symm
entries.snippet: lemma ContrMod.contr_tmul_symm (φ : ContrMod d) (ψ : CoMod d) : ⟪φ, ψ⟫ₘ = ⟪ψ, φ⟫ₘ

entries.name: Lorentz.CoMod.contr_tmul_symm
entries.snippet: lemma CoMod.contr_tmul_symm (φ : CoMod d) (ψ : ContrMod d) : ⟪φ, ψ⟫ₘ = ⟪ψ, φ⟫ₘ

entries.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.contr_basis
entries.snippet:
lemma ContrMod.contr_basis {d : ℕ} (i j : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    ContrMod.contr (contrBasis d i ⊗ₜ coBasis d j) = if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0

entries.name: Lorentz.CoMod.contr_basis
entries.snippet:
lemma CoMod.contr_basis {d : ℕ} (i j : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    CoMod.contr (coBasis d i ⊗ₜ[ℝ] contrBasis d j) = if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0

entries.name: Lorentz.Velocity.ofSpatialPart
entries.docstring:
The unit future four-velocity with spatial part `p` and time component
`Real.sqrt (1 + ‖p‖ ^ 2)`. The spatial part is unrestricted.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def ofSpatialPart (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) : Velocity d

entries.name: Lorentz.Velocity.spatialPart_ofSpatialPart
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma spatialPart_ofSpatialPart (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    (ofSpatialPart p).1.spatialPart = p

entries.name: Lorentz.Velocity.timeComponent_ofSpatialPart
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma timeComponent_ofSpatialPart (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    (ofSpatialPart p).1.timeComponent = Real.sqrt (1 + ‖p‖ ^ 2)

entries.name: Lorentz.Velocity.ofSpatialPart_spatialPart
entries.docstring: A future unit four-velocity is determined by its spatial part.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofSpatialPart_spatialPart (u : Velocity d) : ofSpatialPart u.1.spatialPart = u

entries.name: Lorentz.Velocity.continuous_ofSpatialPart
entries.docstring: The spatial-coordinate parametrization of future unit four-velocities is continuous.
entries.snippet:
@[fun_prop]
lemma continuous_ofSpatialPart : Continuous (ofSpatialPart (d := d))

entries.name: Lorentz.Velocity.norm_spatialPart_le_of_orthogonal
entries.docstring:
A bound on the proper norm of a vector orthogonal to a unit future
four-velocity controls its spatial norm in the chosen frame.
entries.snippet:
lemma norm_spatialPart_le_of_orthogonal (u : Velocity d) (A : Vector d)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (horth : ⟪u.1, A⟫ₘ = 0) (hacc : -⟪A, A⟫ₘ ≤ C ^ 2) :
    ‖A.spatialPart‖ ≤ C * u.1.timeComponent

entries.name: Lorentz.Velocity.minkowskiProduct_eq_zero_of_hasDerivAt
entries.docstring:
The derivative of a curve of unit future-directed four-velocities is Minkowski
orthogonal to its value.

entries.name: Lorentz.Velocity.hasDerivAt_ofSpatialPart
entries.docstring:
The ambient derivative of the unit future-directed four-velocity determined by
a differentiable spatial-part curve.
entries.snippet:
lemma hasDerivAt_ofSpatialPart {d : ℕ} {p : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)}
    {p' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)} {t : ℝ} (hp : HasDerivAt p p' t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => (ofSpatialPart (p s)).1)
      (Vector.ofTemporalComponent (inner ℝ (p t) p' / Real.sqrt (1 + ‖p t‖ ^ 2)) +
        Vector.ofSpatialComponent p') t

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.swap_of_eq
entries.docstring:
The swap `![1, 0]` reindexes two rank-two colour lists whose colours match crosswise; `swap`
with the target colours given by equations.
entries.snippet:
lemma swap_of_eq {c c1 : Fin 2 → C} (h0 : c 1 = c1 0) (h1 : c 0 = c1 1) :
    IsReindexing c c1 ![1, 0]

entries.name: TensorSpecies.basisIdxCongr_heq
entries.docstring: A transported label is heterogeneously equal to the original.
entries.snippet: lemma basisIdxCongr_heq {c c1 : C} (h : c = c1) (x : basisIdx c) : basisIdxCongr h x ≍ x

entries.name: TensorSpecies.basisIdxCongr_const
entries.docstring:
For a species whose every colour carries the same label type `I`, a label transport is the
identity.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma basisIdxCongr_const {I : Type} {c c1 : C} (h : c = c1) :
    basisIdxCongr (basisIdx := fun _ : C => I) h = Equiv.refl I

entries.name: TensorSpecies.contr_basis_congr
entries.docstring:
The contraction of two basis vectors does not change when their colour is transported along an
equality and their labels with it.
entries.snippet:
lemma contr_basis_congr {a a' : C} (h : a = a') (x : basisIdx a) (y : basisIdx (S.τ a)) :
    S.contr a (basis a x ⊗ₜ[k] basis (S.τ a) y) =
      S.contr a' (basis a' (basisIdxCongr h x) ⊗ₜ[k]
        basis (S.τ a') (basisIdxCongr (congrArg S.τ h) y))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.equivCast_basis
entries.docstring:
`map_basis_eq` with the cast spelled `Equiv.cast`, the form `contr_tmul_symm` applies to its
  first vector.
entries.snippet:
lemma equivCast_basis {c c1 : C} (h : c = c1) (i : basisIdx c) :
    Equiv.cast (congrArg V h) (basis c i) = basis c1 (basisIdxCongr h i)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.WithMetric
entries.docstring:
Instance of a metric on a tensor species. For each color `c` an invariant tensor
  in `V c ⊗ V c`, whose contraction against the metric of the dual color `τ c` is the unit.
  Not every species has one: it requires every color to be self-dual,
  which fails for the fundamental of `SU(N)`, `3 ≤ N`.
entries.snippet:
class WithMetric {k : Type} [CommRing k] {C : Type} {G : Type} [Group G]
    {V : C → Type} [∀ c, AddCommGroup (V c)] [∀ c, Module k (V c)]
    {basisIdx : C → Type} [∀ c, Fintype (basisIdx c)] [∀ c, DecidableEq (basisIdx c)]
    {rep : (c : C) → Representation k G (V c)} {basis : (c : C) → Basis (basisIdx c) k (V c)}
    (S : TensorSpecies k C G V basisIdx rep basis) where
  metric : (c : C) → ((Representation.trivial k G k)).IntertwiningMap ((rep c).tprod (rep c))
  contr_metric : ∀ c,
    (TensorProduct.comm k _ _ <|
      (TensorProduct.lid k _).lTensor _ <|
      ((S.contr c).toLinearMap.rTensor (V (S.τ c))).lTensor (V c) <|
      (TensorProduct.assoc k (V c) (V (S.τ c)) (V (S.τ c))).symm.toLinearMap.lTensor (V c) <|
      TensorProduct.assoc k (V c) (V c) (V (S.τ c) ⊗[k] V (S.τ c)) <|
      (metric c 1) ⊗ₜ[k] (metric (S.τ c) 1)) = S.unit c (1 : k)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.metric
entries.docstring: The metric of a species with a metric, at the color `c`.
entries.snippet:
abbrev metric [S.WithMetric] (c : C) :
    ((Representation.trivial k G k)).IntertwiningMap ((rep c).tprod (rep c))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.contr_metric
entries.docstring: On contracting metrics we get the unit.
entries.snippet:
lemma contr_metric [S.WithMetric] (c : C) :
    (TensorProduct.comm k _ _ <|
      (TensorProduct.lid k _).lTensor _ <|
      ((S.contr c).toLinearMap.rTensor (V (S.τ c))).lTensor (V c) <|
      (TensorProduct.assoc k (V c) (V (S.τ c)) (V (S.τ c))).symm.toLinearMap.lTensor (V c) <|
      TensorProduct.assoc k (V c) (V c) (V (S.τ c) ⊗[k] V (S.τ c)) <|
      (S.metric c 1) ⊗ₜ[k] (S.metric (S.τ c) 1)) = S.unit c (1 : k)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.IsContrDualMatching
entries.docstring:
A matching `e` of the basis labels at `S.τ c` with those at `c` satisfies the δ law:
  contracting a basis vector at `c` with one at `S.τ c` gives `1` if `e` matches their labels and
  `0` otherwise.
entries.snippet:
def IsContrDualMatching (S : TensorSpecies k C G V basisIdx rep b) (c : C)
    (e : basisIdx (S.τ c) ≃ basisIdx c) : Prop

entries.name: TensorSpecies.IsContrDualMatching.unique
entries.docstring:
Over a nontrivial ring the δ law determines the matching: the label matched with `x₂` is the
  one whose basis vector pairs with `b (S.τ c) x₂` to `1`.

entries.name: TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases
entries.docstring:
A tensor species whose basis at `S.τ c` is dual to its basis at `c` under the pairing
  `S.contr c`: for every color some matching of the labels satisfies the δ law.
entries.snippet:
class HasContrDualBases (S : TensorSpecies k C G V basisIdx rep b) : Prop where
  exists_matching : ∀ c, ∃ e, IsContrDualMatching S c e

entries.name: TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv
entries.docstring:
A matching of the basis labels at `S.τ c` with those at `c` satisfying the δ law, chosen by
  `Classical.choose`. Over a nontrivial ring it is the only one
  (`contrDualIdxEquiv_eq_of_isContrDualMatching`).
entries.snippet: noncomputable def contrDualIdxEquiv (c : C) : basisIdx (S.τ c) ≃ basisIdx c

entries.name: TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.contr_basis_eq_ite
entries.docstring: The δ law for `contrDualIdxEquiv`.
entries.snippet:
lemma contr_basis_eq_ite (c : C) (x₁ : basisIdx c) (x₂ : basisIdx (S.τ c)) :
    S.contr c (b c x₁ ⊗ₜ[k] b (S.τ c) x₂) =
      if x₁ = contrDualIdxEquiv S c x₂ then 1 else 0

entries.name: TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv_eq_of_isContrDualMatching
entries.docstring:
Any matching satisfying the δ law is `contrDualIdxEquiv`. This is how a concrete species
  identifies its matching.

entries.name: TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv
entries.docstring:
The equivalence between labels of dual indices: a label at `c1` carried across the variance
  dual by `contrDualIdxEquiv`, then along `h`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def dualIdxEquiv {c1 c2 : C} (h : S.τ c1 = c2) : basisIdx c1 ≃ basisIdx c2

entries.name: TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma dualIdxEquiv_apply {c1 c2 : C} (h : S.τ c1 = c2) (x : basisIdx c1) :
    dualIdxEquiv h x = basisIdxCongr h ((contrDualIdxEquiv S c1).symm x)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv_tau
entries.docstring:
The matching at `S.τ c` is the inverse of the one at `c`, once `S.τ (S.τ c)` is identified
  with `c` by `S.τ_τ_apply`. The inverse matching satisfies the δ law at `S.τ c` by
  `contr_tmul_symm`, so uniqueness identifies the two.
entries.snippet:
lemma contrDualIdxEquiv_tau [Nontrivial k] (c : C) (x : basisIdx (S.τ (S.τ c))) :
    contrDualIdxEquiv S (S.τ c) x =
      (contrDualIdxEquiv S c).symm (basisIdxCongr (S.τ_τ_apply c) x)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv_symm
entries.docstring: The inverse of `dualIdxEquiv` from `c1` to `c2` is `dualIdxEquiv` from `c2` to `c1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma dualIdxEquiv_symm [Nontrivial k] {c1 c2 : C} (h : S.τ c1 = c2) (h' : S.τ c2 = c1) :
    (dualIdxEquiv h).symm = dualIdxEquiv h'

entries.name: TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.contr_tmul_basis_eq_dualBasis
entries.docstring:
The functional `v ↦ S.contr c (v ⊗ₜ b (S.τ c) x)` is the element of `(b c).dualBasis` at the
  label matched with `x`.
entries.snippet:
lemma contr_tmul_basis_eq_dualBasis (c : C) (x : basisIdx (S.τ c)) (v : V c) :
    S.contr c (v ⊗ₜ[k] b (S.τ c) x) = (b c).dualBasis (contrDualIdxEquiv S c x) v

entries.name: TensorSpecies.unitTensor_pair_basis_repr
entries.docstring:
For a species with dual bases at dual colours, the unit tensor's components are a Kronecker δ,
  the first label carried across the variance dual by `contrDualIdxEquiv`.
entries.snippet:
lemma unitTensor_pair_basis_repr [HasContrDualBases S] (c : C) (J y : basisIdx c) :
    (basis ![S.τ c, c]).repr (unitTensor c)
        (ComponentIdx.pair.symm ((HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv S c).symm J, y)) =
      if J = y then 1 else 0

entries.name: TensorSpecies.unitTensor_basis_repr_eq_ite
entries.docstring: `unitTensor_pair_basis_repr` at an arbitrary component index.
entries.snippet:
lemma unitTensor_basis_repr_eq_ite [HasContrDualBases S] (c : C)
    (φ : ComponentIdx (S := S) ![S.τ c, c]) :
    (basis ![S.τ c, c]).repr (unitTensor c) φ =
      if HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv S c (φ 0) = φ 1 then 1 else 0

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_permT_unitTensor
entries.docstring:
The component matrix of a unit tensor recoloured without moving its slots is the identity, with
  the labels transported back to the unit tensor's colours.
entries.snippet:
lemma toMatrix_permT_unitTensor [HasContrDualBases S] (c : C) {cs : Fin 2 → C}
    {σ : Fin 2 → Fin 2} (hσ : ∀ i, σ i = i) (hperm : IsReindexing ![S.τ c, c] cs σ) :
    toMatrix (permT σ hperm (unitTensor (S := S) c)) =
      (1 : Matrix (basisIdx c) (basisIdx c) k).submatrix
        (fun x => HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv S c
          (basisIdxCongr (by rw [← hperm.2 0, hσ]; rfl) x))
        (fun y => basisIdxCongr (by rw [← hperm.2 1, hσ]; rfl) y)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_unitTensor
entries.docstring: The unit tensor's component matrix is the identity, carried along `contrDualIdxEquiv`.
entries.snippet:
lemma toMatrix_unitTensor [HasContrDualBases S] (c : C) :
    toMatrix (unitTensor (S := S) c) =
      (1 : Matrix (basisIdx c) (basisIdx c) k).submatrix
        ⇑(HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv S c) id

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.unitTensor_of_tau_eq
entries.docstring:
If `τ e = a`, the identity is a reindexing from `![τ e, e]` to `![a, e]`, so `permT` renames the
  colours of `unitTensor e` to `![a, e]`.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsReindexing.unitTensor_of_tau_eq {a e : C} (h : S.τ e = a) :
    IsReindexing (![S.τ e, e] : Fin 2 → C) ![a, e] (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_permT_unitTensor_of_tau_eq
entries.docstring:
The matrix of `unitTensor e`, with its colours renamed to `![a, e]`, is the identity matrix with
its rows relabelled by `dualIdxEquiv h`.
entries.snippet:
lemma toMatrix_permT_unitTensor_of_tau_eq [HasContrDualBases S] {a e : C} (h : S.τ e = a) :
    toMatrix (permT id (IsReindexing.unitTensor_of_tau_eq h) (unitTensor (S := S) e)) =
      (1 : Matrix (basisIdx e) (basisIdx e) k).submatrix (dualIdxEquiv h).symm id

entries.name: Space.laplacian_comp_linearIsometryEquiv
entries.docstring:
The Laplacian of `f ∘ R` at `x` is the Laplacian of `f` at `R x`, for a linear isometry `R`
  of space.
entries.snippet:
lemma laplacian_comp_linearIsometryEquiv {d : ℕ} (f : Space d → ℝ) (R : Space d ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Space d)
    (x : Space d) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (R x)) :
    Δ (fun y => f (R y)) x = Δ f (R x)

entries.name: Space.laplacianVec_comp_linearIsometryEquiv
entries.docstring:
The vector Laplacian of `f ∘ R` at `x` is the vector Laplacian of `f` at `R x`, for a linear
  isometry `R` of space.
entries.snippet:
lemma laplacianVec_comp_linearIsometryEquiv {d : ℕ} (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (R : Space d ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Space d) (x : Space d)
    (hf : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => f y i)) (R x)) :
    Δᵥ (fun y => f (R y)) x = Δᵥ f (R x)

entries.name: Space.IsDistBounded.«instance@28ab7db1»
entries.snippet:
instance {D1 : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup D1] [MeasurableSpace D1]
    {D2 : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup D2] [MeasurableSpace D2]
    (μ1 : Measure D1) (μ2 : Measure D2)
    [Measure.HasTemperateGrowth μ1] [Measure.HasTemperateGrowth μ2]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace (D1 × D2)] :
    Measure.HasTemperateGrowth (μ1.prod μ2) where

entries.name: SpaceTime.deriv_add
entries.docstring: Derivatives on spacetime distribute over addition.
entries.snippet:
@[to_fun]
lemma deriv_add {M : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M] {d : ℕ}
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (f g : SpaceTime d → M) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (hg : Differentiable ℝ g) :
    ∂_ μ (f + g) = ∂_ μ f + ∂_ μ g

entries.name: SpaceTime.deriv_const_smul
entries.docstring: Derivatives on spacetime commute with multiplication by a constant.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_const_smul {M R : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M] [Semiring R]
    [Module R M] [SMulCommClass ℝ R M] [ContinuousConstSMul R M] {d : ℕ}
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (c : R) {f : SpaceTime d → M} (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) :
    ∂_ μ (c • f) = c • ∂_ μ f

entries.name: SpaceTime.foldl_deriv_perm
entries.docstring:
For a smooth function, iterated derivatives along a list of directions do not depend on the
  order of the list.

entries.name: SpaceTime.iteratedDeriv
entries.docstring: The iterated derivative of `f`, differentiating once along each element of `s`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def iteratedDeriv {M : Type} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℝ M] [TopologicalSpace M]
    {d : ℕ} (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d)) (f : SpaceTime d → M) : SpaceTime d → M

entries.name: SpaceTime.iteratedDeriv_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma iteratedDeriv_zero {M : Type} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℝ M] [TopologicalSpace M] {d : ℕ}
    (f : SpaceTime d → M) :
    iteratedDeriv 0 f = f

entries.name: SpaceTime.iteratedDeriv_singleton
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma iteratedDeriv_singleton {M : Type} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℝ M] [TopologicalSpace M]
    {d : ℕ} (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (f : SpaceTime d → M) :
    iteratedDeriv {μ} f = ∂_ μ f

entries.name: SpaceTime.contDiff_iteratedDeriv
entries.docstring: Iterated derivatives of a smooth function are smooth.

entries.name: SpaceTime.iteratedDeriv_cons
entries.docstring: An iterated derivative of a smooth function may begin with any of its directions.

entries.name: SpaceTime.iteratedDeriv_add
entries.docstring: Iterated derivatives of smooth functions distribute over addition.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedDeriv_add {M : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M] {d : ℕ}
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d)) {f g : SpaceTime d → M} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) :
    iteratedDeriv s (f + g) = iteratedDeriv s f + iteratedDeriv s g

entries.name: SpaceTime.iteratedDeriv_const_smul
entries.docstring: Iterated derivatives of smooth functions commute with multiplication by a constant.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedDeriv_const_smul {M R : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M] [Semiring R]
    [Module R M] [SMulCommClass ℝ R M] [ContinuousConstSMul R M] {d : ℕ}
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d)) (c : R) {f : SpaceTime d → M} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    iteratedDeriv s (c • f) = c • iteratedDeriv s f

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra
entries.docstring: Formal power series in the four spacetime directions, with complex coefficients.
entries.snippet: abbrev SpaceTimeAlgebra : Type

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.pderiv_comm
entries.docstring: Formal partial derivatives commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma pderiv_comm (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    pderiv μ (pderiv ν f) = pderiv ν (pderiv μ f)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.«instance@a97f55b7»
entries.docstring: Formal partial differentiation can be iterated over a multiset of directions.
entries.snippet: instance : RightCommutative (fun (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) => pderiv μ f) where

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv
entries.docstring:
The iterated formal partial derivative `∂^s f`, differentiating once along each element of
  `s`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def iteratedPDeriv (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    SpaceTimeAlgebra

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma iteratedPDeriv_zero (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) : iteratedPDeriv 0 f = f

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv_cons
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma iteratedPDeriv_cons (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    iteratedPDeriv (μ ::ₘ s) f = iteratedPDeriv s (pderiv μ f)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv_singleton
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma iteratedPDeriv_singleton (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    iteratedPDeriv {μ} f = pderiv μ f

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv_add
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedPDeriv_add (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (f g : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    iteratedPDeriv s (f + g) = iteratedPDeriv s f + iteratedPDeriv s g

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv
entries.docstring: The base-point value of `∂^s f` is `s!` times the coefficient of `x^s` in `f`.
entries.snippet:
lemma constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    constantCoeff (iteratedPDeriv s f) =
      ((∏ ν, (s.count ν).factorial : ℕ) : ℂ) * coeff (Multiset.toFinsupp s) f

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv_mul
entries.docstring: The all-orders Leibniz rule for iterated formal partial derivatives.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedPDeriv_mul (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (f g : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    iteratedPDeriv s (f * g) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p => iteratedPDeriv p.1 f * iteratedPDeriv p.2 g).sum

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv_mul
entries.docstring: The Leibniz rule for the base-point derivative values of a product.
entries.snippet:
lemma constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv_mul (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (f g : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    constantCoeff (iteratedPDeriv s (f * g)) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        constantCoeff (iteratedPDeriv p.1 f) * constantCoeff (iteratedPDeriv p.2 g)).sum

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.ext_of_constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv
entries.docstring: Series whose iterated derivatives have the same base-point values are equal.

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.eq_C_of_pderiv_eq_zero
entries.docstring: A series with vanishing first derivatives is constant.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_C_of_pderiv_eq_zero {f : SpaceTimeAlgebra} (hf : ∀ μ, pderiv μ f = 0) :
    f = C (constantCoeff f)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.ofDerivValues
entries.docstring: The series whose base-point derivative values are `F`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def ofDerivValues (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ) : SpaceTimeAlgebra

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_ofDerivValues
entries.snippet:
lemma coeff_ofDerivValues (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ) (m : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff m (ofDerivValues F) =
      ((∏ ν, (m ν).factorial : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹ * F (Finsupp.toMultiset m)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv_ofDerivValues
entries.docstring: The base-point derivative values of `ofDerivValues F` are `F`.
entries.snippet:
lemma constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv_ofDerivValues (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    constantCoeff (iteratedPDeriv s (ofDerivValues F)) = F s

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.ofDerivValues_constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv
entries.docstring: A series is recovered from its base-point derivative values by `ofDerivValues`.
entries.snippet:
lemma ofDerivValues_constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    ofDerivValues (fun s => constantCoeff (iteratedPDeriv s f)) = f

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.derivValuesEquiv
entries.docstring: The linear equivalence between series and their base-point derivative values.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def derivValuesEquiv : SpaceTimeAlgebra ≃ₗ[ℂ] (Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.derivValuesEquiv_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma derivValuesEquiv_apply (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    derivValuesEquiv f s = constantCoeff (iteratedPDeriv s f)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.derivValuesEquiv_symm_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma derivValuesEquiv_symm_apply (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ) :
    derivValuesEquiv.symm F = ofDerivValues F

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_star

@[simp]
lemma coeff_star (n : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    coeff n (star f) = star (coeff n f)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.constantCoeff_star
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma constantCoeff_star (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    constantCoeff (star f) = star (constantCoeff f)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.«instance@76438617»
entries.docstring: The spacetime algebra is a star ring under coefficientwise conjugation.
entries.snippet: instance : StarRing SpaceTimeAlgebra where

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.star_C

@[simp]
lemma star_C (a : ℂ) : star (C a : SpaceTimeAlgebra) = C (star a)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.star_X

@[simp]
lemma star_X (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : star (X μ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) = X μ

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.«instance@7d3063e0»
entries.docstring: Conjugation fixes real scalars, `star (r • f) = r • star f`.

entries.docstring: Conjugation conjugates complex scalars, `star (c • f) = star c • star f`.
entries.snippet: instance : StarModule ℂ SpaceTimeAlgebra where

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.pderiv_star
entries.docstring: Conjugation commutes with formal partial derivatives.
entries.snippet:
lemma pderiv_star (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    pderiv μ (star f) = star (pderiv μ f)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv_star
entries.docstring: Conjugation commutes with iterated formal partial derivatives.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedPDeriv_star (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    iteratedPDeriv s (star f) = star (iteratedPDeriv s f)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.taylorSeries
entries.docstring: The Taylor series at `x₀` of a complex-valued function on spacetime.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def taylorSeries (x₀ : SpaceTime) (f : SpaceTime → ℂ) : SpaceTimeAlgebra

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_taylorSeries
entries.snippet:
lemma coeff_taylorSeries (x₀ : SpaceTime) (f : SpaceTime → ℂ) (m : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff m (taylorSeries x₀ f) =
      ((∏ ν, (m ν).factorial : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹ * iteratedDeriv (Finsupp.toMultiset m) f x₀

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv_taylorSeries
entries.docstring: The base-point derivative values of `taylorSeries x₀ f` are the derivatives of `f` at `x₀`.
entries.snippet:
lemma constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv_taylorSeries (x₀ : SpaceTime) (f : SpaceTime → ℂ)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    constantCoeff (iteratedPDeriv s (taylorSeries x₀ f)) = iteratedDeriv s f x₀

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.taylorSeries_add
entries.snippet:
lemma taylorSeries_add (x₀ : SpaceTime) {f g : SpaceTime → ℂ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) :
    taylorSeries x₀ (f + g) = taylorSeries x₀ f + taylorSeries x₀ g

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.taylorSeries_const_smul
SpaceTimeAlgebra.taylorSeries_deriv
entries.docstring: The Taylor series of a derivative is the formal partial derivative of the Taylor series.

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.seriesAction
entries.docstring: The action of series on derivative symbols, defined on monomials by the product rule.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def seriesAction : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* Module.End ℂ SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ where

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.seriesAction_basis
entries.docstring: The action of `χ` on a monomial `∂^s` is its Leibniz expansion.
entries.snippet:
lemma seriesAction_basis (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    seriesAction χ ∂^[s] =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun t => constantCoeff (iteratedPDeriv t.1 χ) • ∂^[t.2]).sum

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.pairing_seriesAction
entries.docstring: The action of `χ` multiplies by `χ` before applying the symbol.
entries.snippet:
lemma pairing_seriesAction (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (p : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ)
    (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    pairing (seriesAction χ p) f = pairing p (χ * f)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.seriesAction_C
entries.docstring: The constant series `C c` acts as scalar multiplication by `c`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma seriesAction_C (c : ℂ) : seriesAction (C c) = c • LinearMap.id

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.seriesAction_apply_one
entries.docstring: A series acts on the unit symbol by its base-point value.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma seriesAction_apply_one (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    seriesAction χ 1 = constantCoeff χ • 1

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.seriesAction_basis_singleton
entries.docstring: A series `χ` sends `∂_μ` to `χ(x₀) ∂_μ + (∂_μ χ)(x₀)`, the product rule.
entries.snippet:
lemma seriesAction_basis_singleton (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    seriesAction χ ∂[μ] = constantCoeff χ • ∂[μ] + constantCoeff (pderiv μ χ) • 1

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.seriesAction_mul_basis_singleton
entries.docstring: The action commutes with multiplication by `∂_μ` up to the action of `pderiv μ χ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma seriesAction_mul_basis_singleton (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (p : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ)
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    seriesAction χ (p * ∂[μ]) = seriesAction χ p * ∂[μ] + seriesAction (pderiv μ χ) p

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ
entries.docstring:
The algebra of derivative symbols on spacetime, the polynomials in four commuting symbols
  `∂_μ`.
entries.snippet: abbrev SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ : Type

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis
entries.docstring: The monomial basis of the derivative algebra, in which `basis s` is the monomial `∂^s`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def basis : Module.Basis (Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) ℂ SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis_apply
entries.docstring:
The monomial `∂^s` is the polynomial monomial whose exponents are the multiplicities in
  `s`.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_apply (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    ∂^[s] = (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis).symm
      (MvPolynomial.monomial (Multiset.toFinsupp s) 1)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis_zero
entries.docstring: The empty monomial is the unit.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma basis_zero : ∂^[0] = 1

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis_singleton
entries.docstring: The monomial of a single direction `μ` is the derivative symbol `∂_μ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_singleton (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    ∂[μ] = SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _ (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis μ)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis_mul
entries.docstring: Monomials multiply by adding multisets, `∂^s ∂^t = ∂^(s + t)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_mul (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    ∂^[s] * ∂^[t] = ∂^[s + t]

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.pairing
entries.docstring:
The pairing of a symbol `P` with a series `f`, given by the value of `P f` at the base
  point.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def pairing : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ →ₗ[ℂ] SpaceTimeAlgebra →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.pairing_basis
entries.docstring: The monomial `∂^s` pairs with `f` to the base-point value `(∂^s f)(x₀)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma pairing_basis (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    pairing ∂^[s] f = constantCoeff (iteratedPDeriv s f)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.pairing_one
entries.docstring: The unit symbol pairs with `f` to its base-point value `f(x₀)`.
entries.snippet: lemma pairing_one (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) : pairing 1 f = constantCoeff f

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.pairing_monomial
entries.docstring:
Pairing a symbol with the series `x^s` gives `s!` times the coefficient of `∂^s` in the
  symbol.
entries.snippet:
lemma pairing_monomial (p : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    pairing p (monomial (Multiset.toFinsupp s) 1) =
      ((∏ ν, (s.count ν).factorial : ℕ) : ℂ) * basis.repr p s

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.pairing_injective
entries.docstring: The pairing separates derivative symbols.
entries.snippet: lemma pairing_injective : Function.Injective pairing

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.ext_of_pairing_eq
entries.docstring: Symbols that pair equally with every series are equal.
entries.snippet:
lemma ext_of_pairing_eq {p q : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ} (h : ∀ f, pairing p f = pairing q f) :
    p = q

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.pairing_mul_basis_singleton
entries.docstring: Multiplying a symbol by `∂_μ` corresponds to applying `pderiv μ` to the series.
entries.snippet:
lemma pairing_mul_basis_singleton (p : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    pairing (p * ∂[μ]) f = pairing p (pderiv μ f)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.pairing_basis_mul
entries.docstring: Pairing `∂^s` with a product `χ f` expands by the Leibniz rule.
entries.snippet:
lemma pairing_basis_mul (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (χ f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    pairing ∂^[s] (χ * f) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun t =>
        constantCoeff (iteratedPDeriv t.1 χ) * pairing ∂^[t.2] f).sum

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.pairing_constr_leibniz
entries.docstring:
Replacing each monomial `∂^s` of `p` by its Leibniz expansion with `χ` gives a symbol that
  pairs with `f` as `p` pairs with `χ f`.
entries.snippet:
lemma pairing_constr_leibniz (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (p : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ)
    (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    pairing (basis.constr ℂ (fun s => (s.antidiagonal.map fun t =>
      constantCoeff (iteratedPDeriv t.1 χ) • ∂^[t.2]).sum) p) f = pairing p (χ * f)

entries.name: Time.chartAt_apply
entries.docstring: The chart of `Time` at `t₀` is `t ↦ t -ᵥ t₀`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma chartAt_apply (t₀ t : Time) : chartAt ℝ t₀ t = t -ᵥ t₀

entries.name: Time.chartAt_symm_apply
entries.docstring: The inverse of the chart of `Time` at `t₀` is `τ ↦ τ +ᵥ t₀`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma chartAt_symm_apply (t₀ : Time) (τ : ℝ) : (chartAt ℝ t₀).symm τ = τ +ᵥ t₀

entries.name: Time.extChartAt_apply
entries.docstring: The extended chart of `Time` at `t₀` is `t ↦ t -ᵥ t₀`.
entries.snippet: lemma extChartAt_apply (t₀ t : Time) : extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) t₀ t = t -ᵥ t₀

entries.name: Time.contMDiff_vadd

entries.snippet:
lemma contMDiff_vadd (t₀ : Time) (n : ℕ∞ω) :

entries.name: Time.contMDiff_vsub
entries.docstring: The map `t ↦ t -ᵥ t₀` from `Time` to `ℝ` is smooth.
entries.snippet:
lemma contMDiff_vsub (t₀ : Time) (n : ℕ∞ω) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) n (fun t : Time ↦ t -ᵥ t₀)

entries.name: Time.hasDerivAt_mk_of_differentiableAt
entries.docstring:
A curve `f : Time → ℝ` differentiable at `t` gives the curve `σ ↦ f ⟨σ⟩` on `ℝ`,
  whose Mathlib derivative at `t.val` is the time derivative `∂ₜ f t`.

entries.name: Time.continuousAt_of_continuousAt_vadd
entries.docstring: Continuity of the coordinate curve at `0` gives continuity at `x`.
entries.snippet:
private lemma continuousAt_of_continuousAt_vadd {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {γ : Time → X} {x : Time} (h : ContinuousAt (fun τ : ℝ ↦ γ (τ +ᵥ x)) 0) : ContinuousAt γ x

entries.name: Time.contMDiffAt_iff_contDiffAt_vadd
entries.docstring: A curve into a normed space is `C^n` at `x` iff its coordinate curve is `C^n` at `0`.
entries.snippet:
lemma contMDiffAt_iff_contDiffAt_vadd (γ : Time → F) (x : Time) (n : ℕ∞ω) :
    ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, F) n γ x ↔ ContDiffAt ℝ n (fun τ : ℝ ↦ γ (τ +ᵥ x)) 0

entries.name: Time.mdifferentiableAt_iff_differentiableAt_vadd
entries.docstring: A curve into a normed space is differentiable at `x` iff its coordinate curve is at `0`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mdifferentiableAt_iff_differentiableAt_vadd (γ : Time → F) (x : Time) :
    MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, F) γ x ↔ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun τ : ℝ ↦ γ (τ +ᵥ x)) 0

entries.name: Time.vadd_vadd_comp
entries.docstring: Shifting the base instant by `s` shifts the coordinate curve by `s`.
entries.snippet:
private lemma vadd_vadd_comp {X : Type*} (γ : Time → X) (t₀ : Time) (s : ℝ) :
    (fun τ : ℝ ↦ γ (τ +ᵥ (s +ᵥ t₀))) = fun τ ↦ (fun σ : ℝ ↦ γ (σ +ᵥ t₀)) (τ + s)

entries.name: Time.contMDiff_iff_contDiff_vadd
entries.docstring:
A curve `γ : Time → F` into a normed space is `C^n` iff the coordinate curve
`τ ↦ γ (τ +ᵥ t₀)` is `C^n`.
entries.snippet:
lemma contMDiff_iff_contDiff_vadd (γ : Time → F) (t₀ : Time) (n : ℕ∞ω) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, F) n γ ↔ ContDiff ℝ n (fun τ : ℝ ↦ γ (τ +ᵥ t₀))

entries.name: Time.mdifferentiableAt_vadd_iff
entries.docstring:
A curve into a normed space is differentiable at `s +ᵥ t₀` iff its coordinate curve based
at `t₀` is differentiable at `s`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mdifferentiableAt_vadd_iff (γ : Time → F) (t₀ : Time) (s : ℝ) :
    MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, F) γ (s +ᵥ t₀) ↔
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun τ : ℝ ↦ γ (τ +ᵥ t₀)) s

entries.name: Time.writtenInExtChartAt_eq_vadd
entries.docstring: A curve read in the extended chart at `x` is its coordinate curve based at `x`.
entries.snippet:
lemma writtenInExtChartAt_eq_vadd (γ : Time → F) (x : Time) :
    writtenInExtChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, F) x γ = fun τ : ℝ ↦ γ (τ +ᵥ x)

entries.name: Time.mfderiv_eq_deriv_vadd
entries.docstring:
The manifold derivative of a curve into a normed space at `s +ᵥ t₀` applied to `1`
equals the ordinary derivative of the coordinate curve at `s`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mfderiv_eq_deriv_vadd (γ : Time → F) (t₀ : Time) (s : ℝ) :
    mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, F) γ (s +ᵥ t₀) (1 : ℝ) = deriv (fun τ : ℝ ↦ γ (τ +ᵥ t₀)) s

entries.name: Time.tangentMap_eq_deriv_vadd
entries.docstring:
The tangent map of a curve into a normed space sends `⟨s +ᵥ t₀, 1⟩` to the point and
the ordinary derivative of the coordinate curve.
entries.snippet:
lemma tangentMap_eq_deriv_vadd (γ : Time → F) (t₀ : Time) (s : ℝ) :
    tangentMap 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, F) γ ⟨s +ᵥ t₀, (1 : ℝ)⟩ =
      ⟨γ (s +ᵥ t₀), deriv (fun τ : ℝ ↦ γ (τ +ᵥ t₀)) s⟩

entries.name: LTMCTUnitChoices.dimScaleUnits
entries.docstring:
The scaling factor `dimScale u1 u2 d` regarded as a unit of `ℝ≥0`, that is as a strictly
  positive real. Dimensionful quantities are scaled by this rather than by `dimScale u1 u2 d`
  itself, so that a type whose elements are strictly positive, such as `SpeedOfLight`, can carry
  a dimension: no action of `ℝ≥0` on such a type can be compatible with the magnitude, since
  compatibility at `a = 0` would give `val (0 • m) = 0` while `val` is strictly positive.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def dimScaleUnits (u1 u2 : LTMCTUnitChoices) (d : Dimension LTMCTDimensionBase) :
    ℝ≥0ˣ

entries.name: LTMCTUnitChoices.dimScaleUnits_coe
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma dimScaleUnits_coe (u1 u2 : LTMCTUnitChoices) (d : Dimension LTMCTDimensionBase) :
    ((dimScaleUnits u1 u2 d : ℝ≥0)) = dimScale u1 u2 d

entries.name: LTMCTUnitChoices.dimScaleUnits_transitive
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma dimScaleUnits_transitive (u1 u2 u3 : LTMCTUnitChoices)
    (d : Dimension LTMCTDimensionBase) :
    dimScaleUnits u1 u2 d * dimScaleUnits u2 u3 d = dimScaleUnits u1 u3 d

entries.name: LTMCTUnitChoices.dimScaleUnits_smul
entries.docstring:
Scaling by `dimScaleUnits` agrees with scaling by `dimScale` whenever the type also carries
  an action of `ℝ≥0`, so that statements phrased either way normalise to the same form.
entries.snippet:
lemma dimScaleUnits_smul {M : Type} [MulAction ℝ≥0 M] (u1 u2 : LTMCTUnitChoices)
    (d : Dimension LTMCTDimensionBase) (m : M) :
    dimScaleUnits u1 u2 d • m = dimScale u1 u2 d • m

entries.name: LTMCTUnitChoices.dimScaleUnits_mul_dim
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma dimScaleUnits_mul_dim (u1 u2 : LTMCTUnitChoices)
    (d1 d2 : Dimension LTMCTDimensionBase) :
    dimScaleUnits u1 u2 (d1 * d2) = dimScaleUnits u1 u2 d1 * dimScaleUnits u1 u2 d2

entries.name: LTMCTUnitChoices.dimScaleUnits_self
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma dimScaleUnits_self (u : LTMCTUnitChoices) (d : Dimension LTMCTDimensionBase) :
    dimScaleUnits u u d = 1

entries.name: «instance@dae29c4a»
entries.snippet: instance {M : Type} [CarriesDimension M] : MulAction ℝ≥0ˣ (Dimensionful M) where

entries.name: «instance@a1266d77»
entries.docstring:
When `M` itself carries an action of `ℝ≥0`, a dimensionful quantity of `M` may be scaled by
  any non-negative real, not only by a strictly positive one.
entries.snippet:
instance {M : Type} [HasDim M] [MulAction ℝ≥0 M] :
    MulAction ℝ≥0 (Dimensionful M) where

entries.name: Dimensionful.smul_apply_units
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma Dimensionful.smul_apply_units {M : Type} [CarriesDimension M]
    (a : ℝ≥0ˣ) (f : Dimensionful M) (u : LTMCTUnitChoices) :
    (a • f).1 u = a • f.1 u

entries.name: CarriesDimension.toDimensionful_apply_apply_units
entries.docstring:
The value of `toDimensionful`, scaled by `dimScaleUnits`. This is the general form, holding
  for every type carrying a dimension.
entries.snippet:
lemma CarriesDimension.toDimensionful_apply_apply_units
    {M : Type} [CarriesDimension M] (u1 u2 : LTMCTUnitChoices) (m : M) :
    (toDimensionful u1 m).1 u2 = (u1.dimScaleUnits u2 (dim M)) • m
