entries.name: PositiveRealUnitCore.unitsSMul
entries.docstring:
The rescaling of a unit magnitude by a strictly positive real, given as a unit of `ℝ≥0`.
  This is `scale` at a factor known to be positive, so the `scale` lemmas may be applied to
  `u • x` after rewriting with `units_smul_eq_scale`.
entries.snippet: def unitsSMul (u : ℝ≥0ˣ) (x : U) : U

entries.name: PositiveRealUnitCore.instMulActionUnitsNNReal
entries.docstring:
A unit magnitude may be rescaled by a strictly positive real, that is by a unit of `ℝ≥0`.
  No action of `ℝ≥0` on `U` can be compatible with the magnitude: taking `a > 0` and `b = 0` in
  `mul_smul` would force `0 • x` to be a fixed point of every rescaling, and no element of `U`
  is.
entries.snippet: instance instMulActionUnitsNNReal : MulAction ℝ≥0ˣ U where

entries.name: PositiveRealUnitCore.units_smul_eq_scale
entries.docstring:
A rescaling by a unit of `ℝ≥0` is the rescaling by its underlying positive factor. Rewriting
  with this makes the `scale` lemmas applicable; `simp` does not see through `HSMul.hSMul` on its
  own.
entries.snippet:
lemma units_smul_eq_scale (u : ℝ≥0ˣ) (x : U) :
    u • x = scale ((u : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) x (by
      have hu : ((u : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by simp [Units.ne_zero u]
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne (by positivity) (Ne.symm hu))

entries.name: PositiveRealUnitCore.val_units_smul
entries.docstring: The magnitude of a rescaling by a unit of `ℝ≥0`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma val_units_smul (u : ℝ≥0ˣ) (x : U) :
    val (u • x) = ((u : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) * val x

entries.name: LTMCTUnitChoices.dimScaleUnits_scaleUnit
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma LTMCTUnitChoices.dimScaleUnits_scaleUnit {u1 u2 u : LTMCTUnitChoices}
    (d : Dimension LTMCTDimensionBase) :
    u.dimScaleUnits (scaleUnit u1 u2 u) d = u1.dimScaleUnits u2 d

entries.name: Dimensionful.of_scaleUnit_units
entries.snippet:
lemma Dimensionful.of_scaleUnit_units {M : Type} [CarriesDimension M] {u1 u2 u : LTMCTUnitChoices}
    (c : Dimensionful M) :
    c.1 (scaleUnit u1 u2 u) =
    u1.dimScaleUnits u2 (dim M) • c.1 (u)

entries.name: «instance@b2b38793»
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance {M1 : Type} [CarriesDimension M1] : UnitDependent M1 where

entries.name: HasDim.scaleUnit_apply_units
entries.snippet:
lemma HasDim.scaleUnit_apply_units {M : Type} [CarriesDimension M]
    (u1 u2 : LTMCTUnitChoices) (m : M) :
    scaleUnit u1 u2 m = (u1.dimScaleUnits u2 (dim M)) • m

entries.name: «instance@bd96099e»
entries.docstring:
A type carrying a dimension which also has a `MulAction ℝ≥0` compatible with the scaling by
  units is `MulUnitDependent`. A type whose elements are strictly positive carries no action of
  `ℝ≥0` compatible with its magnitude, and so is `UnitDependent` only.
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance {M1 : Type} [HasDim M1] [MulAction ℝ≥0 M1] : MulUnitDependent M1 where

entries.name: WithDim.smul_val_units
entries.docstring: The underlying value of a scaling by a unit of `ℝ≥0`, that is by a strictly positive real.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma smul_val_units {B : Type} [DimensionBasis B] {d : Dimension B} {M : Type}
    [MulAction ℝ≥0 M] (a : ℝ≥0ˣ) (m : WithDim d M) :
    (a • m).val = (a : ℝ≥0) • m.val

entries.name: WithDim.ofPositiveRealUnit
entries.docstring:
A positive-real quantity which carries a dimension, regarded as a dimension-tagged real, so
  that it can be used alongside the other dimension-tagged quantities. The dimension is read off
  the `HasDim` instance, so the two cannot drift apart.
entries.snippet:
def ofPositiveRealUnit {U : Type} [PositiveRealUnitCore U] [HasDim U] (x : U) :
    WithDim (dim U) ℝ

entries.name: WithDim.ofPositiveRealUnit_val
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofPositiveRealUnit_val {U : Type} [PositiveRealUnitCore U] [HasDim U] (x : U) :
    (ofPositiveRealUnit x).val = PositiveRealUnitCore.val x

entries.name: WithDim.ofPositiveRealUnit_units_smul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofPositiveRealUnit_units_smul {U : Type} [PositiveRealUnitCore U] [HasDim U]
    (a : ℝ≥0ˣ) (x : U) :
    ofPositiveRealUnit (a • x) = a • ofPositiveRealUnit x

entries.name: WithDim.ofPositiveRealUnit_of_scaleUnit
entries.docstring:
A dimensionful positive-real quantity, such as the speed of light, may be tagged with its
  dimension either before or after a change of units: `ofPositiveRealUnit` commutes with
  `scaleUnit`.
entries.snippet:
lemma ofPositiveRealUnit_of_scaleUnit {U : Type} [PositiveRealUnitCore U] [HasDim U]
    {u1 u2 u : LTMCTUnitChoices} (c : Dimensionful U) :
    ofPositiveRealUnit (c.1 (UnitDependent.scaleUnit u1 u2 u)) =
    UnitDependent.scaleUnit u1 u2 (ofPositiveRealUnit (c.1 u))

entries.name: WithDim.scaleUnit_val_pos
entries.docstring:
Scaling by a change of units preserves positivity of the value of a dimensionful
quantity.
entries.snippet:
lemma scaleUnit_val_pos {d : Dimension LTMCTDimensionBase} (m : WithDim d ℝ≥0) (hm : 0 < m.val)
    (u1 u2 : LTMCTUnitChoices) : 0 < (scaleUnit u1 u2 m).val

entries.name: GaugeBoson
entries.docstring:
The target vector space of the gauge-boson field: a spacetime covector
  with values in the gauge algebra. Its components are the fields `A_μ^a`; here the
  adjoint index is kept abstract, as the gauge-algebra factor.
entries.snippet:
@[ext]
structure GaugeBoson where
  val : Lorentz.CoVector ⊗[ℝ] 𝔤

entries.name: GaugeBoson.valEquiv
entries.docstring: Identifies a gauge boson with its underlying tensor-product value.
entries.snippet: def valEquiv : (GaugeBoson 𝔤) ≃ Lorentz.CoVector ⊗[ℝ] 𝔤 where

entries.docstring: The linear identification with the underlying tensor product.
entries.snippet: def valLinEquiv : (GaugeBoson 𝔤) ≃ₗ[ℝ] Lorentz.CoVector ⊗[ℝ] 𝔤 where

entries.name: GaugeBoson.valLinEquiv_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma valLinEquiv_apply (v : (GaugeBoson 𝔤)) : (valLinEquiv 𝔤) v = v.val

entries.name: GaugeBoson.valLinEquiv_symm_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma valLinEquiv_symm_apply (m : Lorentz.CoVector ⊗[ℝ] 𝔤) :
    (valLinEquiv 𝔤).symm m = ⟨m⟩

entries.name: GaugeBoson.val_add
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma val_add (v₁ v₂ : (GaugeBoson 𝔤)) : (v₁ + v₂).val = v₁.val + v₂.val

entries.name: GaugeBoson.val_smul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma val_smul (r : ℝ) (v : (GaugeBoson 𝔤)) : (r • v).val = r • v.val

entries.snippet: instance : Module.Finite ℝ (GaugeBoson 𝔤)

entries.name: GaugeBoson.repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the gauge-boson target space: the covector action on the
  spacetime index, and the trivial action on the gauge-algebra factor.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def repLorentzGroup : Representation ℝ SL(2,ℂ) (GaugeBoson 𝔤) where

entries.name: GaugeBoson.repValue
entries.docstring:
The global gauge action on the gauge-boson target space: the adjoint action on the
  gauge-algebra factor, and the trivial action on the spacetime index.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repValue {G₀ : Type} [Monoid G₀] (ρ : Representation ℝ G₀ 𝔤) :
    Representation ℝ G₀ (GaugeBoson 𝔤) where

entries.name: GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace
entries.docstring:
The jet component space of the gauge-boson field: the span of the component functions
  `∂_s A_μ^φ`. The `SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ` factor carries the derivative label `s`, and the
  dual factor the spacetime and adjoint indices — the latter as an abstract covector on
  the gauge algebra, with no basis chosen. Unlike a matter field, the gauge boson is real,
  so there is no conjugate half.
entries.snippet: abbrev JetComponentSpace : Type

entries.name: GaugeBoson.componentDual
entries.docstring:
The covector on the gauge-boson target space pairing the spacetime index against a
  covector `ω` and the adjoint index against `φ`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def componentDual :
    Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector →ₗ[ℝ]
      Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ (GaugeBoson 𝔤) where

entries.name: GaugeBoson.componentDual_apply_val_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma componentDual_apply_val_tmul (ω : Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) (v : Lorentz.CoVector) (a : 𝔤) :
    (componentDual 𝔤) ω φ ⟨v ⊗ₜ[ℝ] a⟩ = ω v * φ a

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra
entries.docstring:
The local gauge field algebra, the jet algebra of the gauge bosons: the free
  commutative algebra on the component functions `∂_s A_μ^φ` of the gauge-boson field,
  realized as the symmetric algebra on the jet component space. The commutativity of the
  product is the Bose statistics of the gauge fields.
entries.snippet: abbrev LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra : Type

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.ofComponent
entries.docstring:
The undifferentiated component function `A^φ` of the gauge-boson field along a
  covector `φ` on the target space.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def ofComponent : Module.Dual ℝ (GaugeBoson 𝔤) →ₗ[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.ofComponent_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma ofComponent_apply (φ : Module.Dual ℝ (GaugeBoson 𝔤)) :
    (ofComponent 𝔤) φ = SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ _ ((1 : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.ofA
entries.docstring:
**The component function `A_μ^φ` of the gauge-boson field**: the spacetime index `μ`
  paired against the Lorentz coordinate basis, the adjoint index against the abstract
  covector `φ` on the gauge algebra. These are the generators the ambient theory sees;
  no basis of the gauge algebra is involved.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def ofA (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.ofA_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma ofA_apply (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (ofA 𝔤) μ φ = (ofComponent 𝔤) ((GaugeBoson.componentDual 𝔤)
      (Lorentz.CoVector.basis.dualBasis μ) φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.adjoin_ι_eq_top
entries.docstring: The jet algebra is generated by the component functions.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjoin_ι_eq_top :
    Algebra.adjoin ℝ (Set.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤))) = ⊤

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.derivA
entries.docstring:
The derivative symbols `∂_s A_μ^φ` of the local gauge field algebra, as a family over
  the derivative multiset `s` and the spacetime index `μ`: the iterated total derivative of
  the gauge-field generator. The field strength and its covariant derivatives are built
  out of this family.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def derivA (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.derivA_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma derivA_apply (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) : derivA 𝔤 s μ φ = iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤 s (ofA 𝔤 μ φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.derivA_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma derivA_zero (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : derivA 𝔤 0 μ = ofA 𝔤 μ

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.derivA_eq_iteratedJetDeriv
entries.docstring: The derivative symbols are the iterated derivatives of the undifferentiated symbol.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivA_eq_iteratedJetDeriv (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) : derivA 𝔤 s μ φ = iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤 s (derivA 𝔤 0 μ φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.gaugeField_eq_one_tmul_derivA
entries.docstring: The complexified symbols `gaugeField` are the images of the real symbols.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeField_eq_one_tmul_derivA (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) : gaugeField 𝔤 s μ φ = (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] derivA 𝔤 s μ φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.algHom_ext
entries.docstring:
Two algebra maps out of the local gauge field algebra agreeing on the derivative
  symbols `∂_s A_μ^φ` are equal.

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.fieldStrength
entries.docstring:
The field strength `F_μν = ∂_μ A_ν − ∂_ν A_μ + ⁅A_μ, A_ν⁆` of the local gauge field
  algebra: the underived field strength of the family of derivative symbols, in the
  conventions of `GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength`, where the bracket of the gauge
  algebra carries the physicists' factor of `i`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fieldStrength (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.fieldStrength_apply
entries.docstring: The field strength written in the generators of the algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrength_apply (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    fieldStrength 𝔤 μ ν φ = jetDeriv 𝔤 μ (ofA 𝔤 ν φ) - jetDeriv 𝔤 ν (ofA 𝔤 μ φ)
      + bracketFam (ofA 𝔤 μ) (ofA 𝔤 ν) φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.fieldStrength_swap
entries.docstring: The field strength is antisymmetric in its two covector indices.
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrength_swap (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    fieldStrength 𝔤 ν μ = - fieldStrength 𝔤 μ ν

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.covDerivFieldStrength
entries.docstring:
The iterated covariant derivative `∇_{l₁} ⋯ ∇_{lₙ} F_μν` of the field strength along an
  ordered list of directions, with `∇_ρ F = ∂_ρ F + ⁅A_ρ, F⁆` the covariant derivative in
  the adjoint. Covariant derivatives do not commute, so the iteration is indexed by a list
  and not by a multiset; the empty list gives the field strength itself.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def covDerivFieldStrength (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.covDerivFieldStrength_nil
entries.docstring: Zero covariant derivatives: the field strength itself.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma covDerivFieldStrength_nil (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    covDerivFieldStrength 𝔤 [] μ ν = fieldStrength 𝔤 μ ν

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_bracketFam
entries.docstring:
The Leibniz rule of the iterated total derivative on a bracket of families: the
  antidiagonal convolution of the iterated derivatives of the two factors.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_bracketFam (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (f g : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤 s (bracketFam f g φ) = (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
      bracketFam (iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤 p.1 ∘ₗ f) (iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤 p.2 ∘ₗ g) φ).sum

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.bracketFamConv_derivA
entries.docstring:
If a family consists of the iterated derivatives of its base value, so does its derived
  bracket against the gauge field: the Leibniz convolution is the iterated derivative of the
  bracket of the base values.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFamConv_derivA (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ]
    LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)
    (hF : ∀ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤),
      F s φ = iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤 s (F 0 φ))
    (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    bracketFamConv (derivA 𝔤) ρ F s φ
      = iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤 s (bracketFam (ofA 𝔤 ρ) (F 0) φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.covDerivAdjoint_derivA
entries.docstring:
The covariant derivative of a family of iterated derivatives is again a family of
  iterated derivatives.
entries.snippet:
lemma covDerivAdjoint_derivA (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ]
    LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)
    (hF : ∀ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤),
      F s φ = iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤 s (F 0 φ))
    (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    covDerivAdjoint (derivA 𝔤) F ρ s φ
      = iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤 s (covDerivAdjoint (derivA 𝔤) F ρ 0 φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.fieldStrength_derivA
entries.docstring:
The derivative symbols of the field strength are the iterated derivatives of the field
  strength.
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrength_derivA (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength (derivA 𝔤) μ ν s φ
      = iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤 s (fieldStrength 𝔤 μ ν φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength_derivA
entries.docstring:
The derivative symbols of the covariant derivatives of the field strength are the
  iterated derivatives of their base values.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength_derivA (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    iteratedCovDerivAdjoint (derivA 𝔤) l (GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength (derivA 𝔤) μ ν)
        s φ
      = iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤 s (covDerivFieldStrength 𝔤 l μ ν φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.covDerivFieldStrength_cons
entries.docstring:
The covariant derivative `∇_ρ F = ∂_ρ F + ⁅A_ρ, F⁆` peeled off the front of the list:
  the recursion on elements of the algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma covDerivFieldStrength_cons (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    covDerivFieldStrength 𝔤 (ρ :: l) μ ν φ
      = jetDeriv 𝔤 ρ (covDerivFieldStrength 𝔤 l μ ν φ)
        + bracketFam (ofA 𝔤 ρ) (covDerivFieldStrength 𝔤 l μ ν) φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.one_tmul_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength
entries.docstring:
The complexified covariant tower of the identity realization is the image of the real
  one.
entries.snippet:
lemma one_tmul_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] iteratedCovDerivAdjoint (derivA 𝔤) l
        (GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength (derivA 𝔤) μ ν) s φ
      = iteratedCovDerivAdjoint (gaugeField 𝔤) l
        (GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength (gaugeField 𝔤) μ ν) s φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength
entries.docstring:
The gauge law of the covariant derivatives of the field strength at every derivative
  order: a jet acts by the Leibniz convolution of the dual adjoint Taylor coefficients of
  `U⁻¹` against lower derivative symbols, with no Maurer–Cartan shift.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength (U : GJ) (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repJet jets U (iteratedCovDerivAdjoint (derivA 𝔤) l
        (GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength (derivA 𝔤) μ ν) s φ)
      = (s.antidiagonal.map fun p => iteratedCovDerivAdjoint (derivA 𝔤) l
          (GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength (derivA 𝔤) μ ν) p.2
          (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_covDerivFieldStrength
entries.docstring:
The gauge law of the covariant derivatives of the field strength: a jet acts through
  the zeroth dual adjoint Taylor coefficient of `U⁻¹` on the adjoint index alone.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_covDerivFieldStrength (U : GJ) (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repJet jets U (covDerivFieldStrength 𝔤 l μ ν φ)
      = covDerivFieldStrength 𝔤 l μ ν (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ 0 φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_covDerivFieldStrength_eval
entries.docstring:
On the covariant derivatives of the field strength the local gauge action factors
  through evaluation: a jet `U` acts through the dual base-point adjoint action of the
  value `jets.eval U⁻¹` of its inverse, and the derivatives of the jet are not seen. The
  covariant expressions are gauge covariant, not gauge invariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_covDerivFieldStrength_eval (U : GJ) (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repJet jets U (covDerivFieldStrength 𝔤 l μ ν φ)
      = covDerivFieldStrength 𝔤 l μ ν ((jets.adjoint (jets.eval U⁻¹)).dualMap φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_fieldStrength
entries.docstring: The field strength transforms in the adjoint.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_fieldStrength (U : GJ) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repJet jets U (fieldStrength 𝔤 μ ν φ)
      = fieldStrength 𝔤 μ ν ((jets.adjoint (jets.eval U⁻¹)).dualMap φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_comp_ofA
entries.docstring: The Lorentz action on the gauge-field generator, as a linear map.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_comp_ofA (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (repLorentzGroup 𝔤 Λ) ∘ₗ ofA 𝔤 μ = ∑ a, L[Λ] a μ • ofA 𝔤 a

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_derivA
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of the derivative symbols, read off the complexified law
  `repLorentz_gaugeField` along the injective `x ↦ 1 ⊗ₜ x`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_derivA (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repLorentzGroup 𝔤 Λ (derivA 𝔤 (List.ofFn l) μ φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ i, L[Λ] (p i) (l i)) •
          ∑ a, L[Λ] a μ • derivA 𝔤 (List.ofFn p) a φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_bracketFam_ofA
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action passes through the bracket of a gauge-field generator against a
  family, mixing the covector index of the generator.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_bracketFam_ofA (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (F : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repLorentzGroup 𝔤 Λ (bracketFam (ofA 𝔤 ρ) F φ)
      = ∑ a, L[Λ] a ρ • bracketFam (ofA 𝔤 a) ((repLorentzGroup 𝔤 Λ) ∘ₗ F) φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_fieldStrength
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of the field strength: both covector indices mix by the columns of the
  Lorentz matrix, the adjoint index is untouched.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_fieldStrength (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repLorentzGroup 𝔤 Λ (fieldStrength 𝔤 μ ν φ)
      = ∑ a, L[Λ] a μ • ∑ b, L[Λ] b ν • fieldStrength 𝔤 a b φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_covDerivFieldStrength
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of the covariant derivatives of the field strength: every covariant
  slot and both covector indices of the field strength mix by the columns of the Lorentz
  matrix, the adjoint index is untouched.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covDerivFieldStrength (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) {n : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repLorentzGroup 𝔤 Λ (covDerivFieldStrength 𝔤 (List.ofFn l) μ ν φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ i, L[Λ] (p i) (l i)) •
          ∑ a, L[Λ] a μ • ∑ b, L[Λ] b ν • covDerivFieldStrength 𝔤 (List.ofFn p) a b φ

entries.name: GaugeBoson.adjointTransport
entries.docstring:
The adjoint transport on the gauge-boson target space at `p` derivatives: the adjoint
  Taylor coefficient on the gauge-algebra factor, the identity on the spacetime index.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def adjointTransport (U : GJ) (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    (GaugeBoson 𝔤) →ₗ[ℝ] (GaugeBoson 𝔤)

entries.name: GaugeBoson.adjointTransport_mk_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointTransport_mk_tmul (U : GJ) (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (v : Lorentz.CoVector) (a : 𝔤) :
    adjointTransport jets U p ⟨v ⊗ₜ[ℝ] a⟩ = ⟨v ⊗ₜ[ℝ] jets.adjointCoeff U p a⟩

entries.name: GaugeBoson.adjointTransport_one
entries.docstring: The adjoint transport at the identity: only the base point survives.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointTransport_one (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    adjointTransport jets 1 p = if p = 0 then LinearMap.id else 0

entries.name: GaugeBoson.adjointTransport_mul
entries.docstring: The adjoint transport of a product: the antidiagonal convolution of transports.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointTransport_mul (U V : GJ) (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    adjointTransport jets (U * V) p
      = (p.antidiagonal.map fun r =>
          adjointTransport jets U r.1 ∘ₗ adjointTransport jets V r.2).sum

entries.name: GaugeBoson.dualMap_adjointTransport_componentDual
entries.docstring:
The dual transport carries a component covector to the component covector of the
  transported adjoint index: the spacetime slot is untouched.
entries.snippet:
lemma dualMap_adjointTransport_componentDual (U : GJ)
    (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ω : Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (adjointTransport jets U p).dualMap ((componentDual 𝔤) ω φ)
      = (componentDual 𝔤) ω (φ ∘ₗ jets.adjointCoeff U p)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.transportFun
entries.docstring:
The value of the transport on the derivative symbol at `s`: the all-orders Leibniz
  convolution of the dual adjoint transports against lower derivative symbols.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def transportFun (U : GJ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    Module.Dual ℝ (GaugeBoson 𝔤) →ₗ[ℝ] (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.transport
entries.docstring:
The linear part of the gauge action on the jet component space: on a component
  function `∂_s A^ψ` it is the all-orders Leibniz convolution of the Taylor coefficients
  of the adjoint action of `U` against the lower component functions.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def transport (U : GJ) :
    (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) →ₗ[ℝ] (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.transport_basis_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma transport_basis_tmul (U : GJ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ (GaugeBoson 𝔤)) :
    transport jets U (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset s ⊗ₜ[ℝ] ψ)
      = (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset p.2 ⊗ₜ[ℝ]
            (GaugeBoson.adjointTransport jets U p.1).dualMap ψ).sum

entries.name: GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace.ext_of_basis
entries.docstring:
Two maps out of the jet component space agree if they agree on the components
  `∂_s A^ψ` with `s` a derivative multiset and `ψ` an arbitrary covector.
entries.snippet:
lemma _root_.GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace.ext_of_basis
    {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module ℝ M]
    {F G : (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) →ₗ[ℝ] M}
    (h : ∀ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ (GaugeBoson 𝔤)),
      F (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset s ⊗ₜ[ℝ] ψ)
        = G (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset s ⊗ₜ[ℝ] ψ)) : F = G

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.transport_one
entries.docstring: The transport of the identity is the identity.
entries.snippet: lemma transport_one : transport jets (1 : GJ) = LinearMap.id

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.transport_mul
entries.docstring:
The transport is an anti-homomorphism: the transport of a product is the reverse
  composite. Composed with the inverse, it becomes the linear part of the gauge
  representation.
entries.snippet:
lemma transport_mul (U V : GJ) :
    transport jets (U * V) = transport jets V ∘ₗ transport jets U

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.mcBosonCoeff
entries.docstring:
The Taylor coefficient of the Maurer–Cartan form of `U` at the derivative multiset
  `s`, packaged as a gauge boson: the spacetime index runs over the coordinate
  directions, the adjoint index over the base-point Taylor coefficients of the
  Maurer–Cartan form.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def mcBosonCoeff (U : GJ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    (GaugeBoson 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.mcBosonCoeff_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma mcBosonCoeff_one (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) : mcBosonCoeff jets 1 s = 0

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.mcBosonCoeff_mul
entries.docstring:
The Maurer–Cartan Taylor coefficients of a product: the cocycle identity, with the
  adjoint transport convoluted in by the Taylor–Leibniz theorem.
entries.snippet:
lemma mcBosonCoeff_mul (U V : GJ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    mcBosonCoeff jets (U * V) s
      = mcBosonCoeff jets U s
        + (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
            GaugeBoson.adjointTransport jets U p.1 (mcBosonCoeff jets V p.2)).sum

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.mcShift
entries.docstring:
The Maurer–Cartan shift: the linear functional on the component space pairing a
  component `∂_s A^ψ` with the Taylor coefficient of the Maurer–Cartan form of `U`. It is
  the constant part of the affine gauge action.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def mcShift (U : GJ) : (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.mcShift_basis_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma mcShift_basis_tmul (U : GJ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ (GaugeBoson 𝔤)) :
    mcShift jets U (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset s ⊗ₜ[ℝ] ψ)
      = ψ (mcBosonCoeff jets U s)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.mcShift_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma mcShift_one : mcShift jets (1 : GJ) = 0

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.mcShift_mul
entries.docstring: The cocycle identity for the Maurer–Cartan shift.
entries.snippet:
lemma mcShift_mul (U V : GJ) :
    mcShift jets (U * V) = mcShift jets V ∘ₗ transport jets U + mcShift jets U

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.gaugeGen
entries.docstring:
The affine action of a jet of gauge transformations on the generators of the jet
  algebra: the transported component plus the Maurer–Cartan shift, both of `U⁻¹` — the
  contragredient convention for an action on component functions.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def gaugeGen (U : GJ) :
    (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) →ₗ[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.gaugeGen_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeGen_apply (U : GJ) (x : (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)) :
    gaugeGen jets U x = SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ _ (transport jets U⁻¹ x)
      + algebraMap ℝ (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) (mcShift jets U⁻¹ x)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet
entries.docstring:
The action of the jet gauge group on the gauge-boson jet algebra: the substitution
  homomorphism determined by the affine action on the generators, `∂_s A^ψ` going to its
  transported convolution plus the Maurer–Cartan shift of `U⁻¹`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def repJet : Representation ℝ GJ (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) where

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJetAlgHom
entries.docstring:
The action of `U` as an algebra homomorphism: a jet of gauge transformations acts on
  a Lagrangian term factor by factor.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repJetAlgHom (U : GJ) :
    (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) →ₐ[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_ι
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repJet_ι (U : GJ) (x : (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)) :
    repJet jets U (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ _ x)
      = SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ _ (transport jets U⁻¹ x)
        + algebraMap ℝ (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) (mcShift jets U⁻¹ x)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_apply_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repJet_apply_one (U : GJ) :
    repJet jets U (1 : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) = 1

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_apply_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_apply_mul (U : GJ) (x y : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) :
    repJet jets U (x * y) = repJet jets U x * repJet jets U y

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_algebraMap
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repJet_algebraMap (U : GJ) (r : ℝ) :
    repJet jets U (algebraMap ℝ (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) r)
      = algebraMap ℝ (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) r

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.componentDual_dualBasis_mcBosonCoeff
entries.docstring:
The component covector at `μ` picks the `μ`-th Maurer–Cartan Taylor coefficient out
  of the shift.
entries.snippet:
lemma componentDual_dualBasis_mcBosonCoeff (W : GJ)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (GaugeBoson.componentDual 𝔤) (Lorentz.CoVector.basis.dualBasis μ) φ (mcBosonCoeff jets W s)
      = φ (jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s
          (jets.maurerCartan W μ)))

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_iteratedJetDeriv_ofA
entries.docstring:
The transformation law of the derivative generators, in the form used by
  `GaugeAlgebraRealization`: a jet of gauge transformations acts on `∂_s A_μ^φ` by the all-orders
  Leibniz convolution of the adjoint Taylor coefficients of `U⁻¹` against lower
  generators, plus the Taylor coefficient of the Maurer–Cartan form of `U⁻¹`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_iteratedJetDeriv_ofA (U : GJ)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repJet jets U ((iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤) s ((ofA 𝔤) μ φ))
      = (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          (iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤) p.2 ((ofA 𝔤) μ (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ p.1 φ))).sum
        + algebraMap ℝ (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)
            (φ (jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s
              (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ μ))))

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJet
entries.docstring:
The action of the jet gauge group on the complexified gauge-boson jet algebra, by
  base change.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def complexRepJet :
    Representation ℂ GJ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) where

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJet_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma complexRepJet_tmul (U : GJ) (z : ℂ) (x : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) :
    complexRepJet jets U (z ⊗ₜ[ℝ] x) = z ⊗ₜ[ℝ] repJet jets U x

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJetAlgHom
entries.docstring:
The action of a jet on the complexified gauge-boson jet algebra, as an algebra
  endomorphism: the base change of `repJetAlgHom`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def complexRepJetAlgHom (U : GJ) :
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJet_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma complexRepJet_apply (U : GJ) (x : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) :
    complexRepJet jets U x = complexRepJetAlgHom jets U x

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJet_apply_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma complexRepJet_apply_mul (U : GJ)
    (x y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) :
    complexRepJet jets U (x * y)
      = complexRepJet jets U x * complexRepJet jets U y

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedD_complexJetDeriv_one_tmul
entries.docstring:
The iterated complexified derivative of a real element is the complexification of the
  iterated real derivative.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedD_complexJetDeriv_one_tmul (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (x : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) :
    Lorentz.iteratedD (complexJetDeriv 𝔤) complexJetDeriv_comm s ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] x)
      = (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤) s x

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.one_tmul_algebraMap
entries.docstring: A real scalar in the complexified jet algebra is the corresponding complex scalar.
entries.snippet:
lemma one_tmul_algebraMap (r : ℝ) :
    (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (algebraMap ℝ (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) r)
      = algebraMap ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) ((r : ℝ) : ℂ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJet_iteratedD_one_tmul_ofA
entries.docstring:
The transformation law of the derivative generators on the complexification: the
  form consumed by the laws of a `GaugeAlgebraRealization`.
entries.snippet:
lemma complexRepJet_iteratedD_one_tmul_ofA (U : GJ)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    complexRepJet jets U (Lorentz.iteratedD (complexJetDeriv 𝔤) complexJetDeriv_comm s
        ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (ofA 𝔤) μ φ))
      = (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          Lorentz.iteratedD (complexJetDeriv 𝔤) complexJetDeriv_comm p.2
            ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (ofA 𝔤) μ (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ p.1 φ))).sum
        + algebraMap ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤))
            (((φ (jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s
              (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ μ))) : ℝ)) : ℂ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.gaugeField
entries.docstring:
The gauge-field derivative symbols of the complexified gauge-boson jet algebra, as a
  family over the derivative multiset, the spacetime index and the dual of the gauge
  algebra — the form consumed by the abstract covariance machinery.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def gaugeField (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.gaugeField_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gaugeField_apply (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (gaugeField 𝔤) s μ φ = Lorentz.iteratedD (complexJetDeriv 𝔤) complexJetDeriv_comm s
      ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (ofA 𝔤) μ φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentz_gaugeField
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of the jet algebra: the symbol `∂_s A_μ^φ` carries one covector index,
  and each derivative slot transforms as a covector, by `IsLorentzDeriv`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_gaugeField (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (complexRepLorentzGroup 𝔤) Λ (gaugeField 𝔤 (List.ofFn l) μ φ) =
      ∑ (p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)),
        (∏ (i : Fin n), (((SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 (p i) (l i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) •
      ∑ a, (((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 a μ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        gaugeField 𝔤 (List.ofFn p) a φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_gaugeField
entries.docstring:
The gauge law of the jet algebra: a jet `U` acts on `∂_s A_μ^φ` by the Leibniz
  convolution of the dual adjoint Taylor coefficients of `U⁻¹` against lower symbols, plus
  the base-point value of the `s`-th derivative of the Maurer–Cartan form of `U⁻¹`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_gaugeField (U : GJ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    complexRepJet jets U (gaugeField 𝔤 s μ φ) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p => gaugeField 𝔤 p.2 μ (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum
      + algebraMap ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)
          (φ (jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ μ))))

entries.name: GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
The derivative of components in the jet component space, in the direction `ν`: the
  shift `∂_s A_μ^φ ↦ ∂_{s + {ν}} A_μ^φ` of the derivative label, i.e. right multiplication
  by the degree-one symbol `∂_ν` on the `SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ` factor.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (JetComponentSpace 𝔤) →ₗ[ℝ] (JetComponentSpace 𝔤)

entries.name: GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv_tmul (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ (GaugeBoson 𝔤)) :
    (JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv 𝔤) ν (a ⊗ₜ[ℝ] φ)
      = (a * SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset
          ({ν} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] φ

entries.name: GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv_comm
entries.docstring:
Total derivatives commute on the component space: the derivative labels live in a
  symmetric algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv_comm (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    ((JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv 𝔤) μ).comp ((JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv 𝔤) ν)
      = ((JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv 𝔤) ν).comp ((JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv 𝔤) μ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
The formal total spacetime derivative on the gauge-boson jet algebra in the direction
  `ν`: the derivation extending the shift `∂_s A_μ^φ ↦ ∂_{s + {ν}} A_μ^φ` of the component
  functions.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetDeriv (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) →ₗ[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.jetDeriv_ι
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDeriv_ι (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)) :
    (jetDeriv 𝔤) ν (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ _ x)
      = SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ _ ((GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv 𝔤) ν x)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.jetDeriv_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDeriv_one (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : (jetDeriv 𝔤) ν (1 : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) = 0

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.jetDeriv_algebraMap
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDeriv_algebraMap (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (r : ℝ) :
    (jetDeriv 𝔤) ν (algebraMap ℝ (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) r) = 0

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.jetDeriv_mul
entries.docstring: The total derivative is a derivation: the Leibniz rule.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_mul (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x y : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) :
    (jetDeriv 𝔤) ν (x * y) = (jetDeriv 𝔤) ν x * y + x * (jetDeriv 𝔤) ν y

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.jetDeriv_comm_apply
entries.docstring: Mixed partials agree on the jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_comm_apply (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) :
    (jetDeriv 𝔤) μ ((jetDeriv 𝔤) ν x) = (jetDeriv 𝔤) ν ((jetDeriv 𝔤) μ x)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.jetDeriv_comm
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_comm (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    ((jetDeriv 𝔤) μ).comp ((jetDeriv 𝔤) ν) = ((jetDeriv 𝔤) ν).comp ((jetDeriv 𝔤) μ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.«instance@8569bc14»
entries.snippet:
instance : RightCommutative
    (fun (D : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) →ₗ[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) =>
      D.comp ((jetDeriv 𝔤) μ)) where

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv
entries.docstring:
The iterated total derivative `∂_s` along a multiset `s` of directions, well defined
  because the directional derivatives commute.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def iteratedJetDeriv (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) →ₗ[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_zero :
    (iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤) (0 : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) = LinearMap.id

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.foldl_comp_eq
entries.docstring: Any initial map factors out of the fold defining the iterated derivative.
entries.snippet:
lemma foldl_comp_eq (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    ∀ D : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) →ₗ[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤),
      s.foldl (fun D μ => D.comp ((jetDeriv 𝔤) μ)) D = D ∘ₗ (iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤) s

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_cons
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_cons (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    (iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤) (μ ::ₘ s) = (jetDeriv 𝔤) μ ∘ₗ (iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤) s

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_singleton
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_singleton (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤) ({μ} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) = (jetDeriv 𝔤) μ

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_add
entries.docstring: Differentiating along `s + t` is differentiating along `t` and then along `s`.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_add (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    (iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤) (s + t) = (iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤) t ∘ₗ (iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤) s

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_cons'
entries.docstring:
The companion of `iteratedJetDeriv_cons`, peeling the new derivative on the inside:
  the derivatives commute, so the extra direction may equally be applied first.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_cons' (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    (iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤) (μ ::ₘ s) = (iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤) s ∘ₗ (jetDeriv 𝔤) μ

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_ι
entries.docstring:
On a component function the iterated derivative writes the derivative symbol `∂_s`
  into the derivative label.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_ι (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ (GaugeBoson 𝔤)) :
    (iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤) s (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ _ (a ⊗ₜ[ℝ] φ))
      = SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ _
          ((a * SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset s) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_ofA
entries.docstring:
**The derivative generator `∂_s A_μ^φ`**: the iterated derivative of the gauge-field
  component function.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_ofA (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤) s ((ofA 𝔤) μ φ)
      = SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ _
          (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset s ⊗ₜ[ℝ]
            (GaugeBoson.componentDual 𝔤) (Lorentz.CoVector.basis.dualBasis μ) φ)

entries.name: GaugeBoson.dual_eq_sum_componentDual
entries.docstring:
Every covector on the gauge-boson target space decomposes along the Lorentz coordinate
  directions into component covectors: the spacetime index is expanded in the coordinate
  basis, while the adjoint index stays abstract.
entries.snippet:
lemma _root_.GaugeBoson.dual_eq_sum_componentDual
    (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ (GaugeBoson 𝔤)) :
    ψ = ∑ μ, (GaugeBoson.componentDual 𝔤) (Lorentz.CoVector.basis.dualBasis μ)
      (ψ ∘ₗ (GaugeBoson.valLinEquiv 𝔤).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.mk ℝ Lorentz.CoVector 𝔤 (Lorentz.CoVector.basis μ))

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.adjoin_iteratedJetDeriv_eq_top
entries.docstring:
**The jet algebra is generated by the gauge fields and their derivatives.** Every
  element is a polynomial in the derivative generators `∂_s A_μ^φ` — nothing else is
  available to write down for the gauge sector of a Lagrangian.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjoin_iteratedJetDeriv_eq_top :
    Algebra.adjoin ℝ
      (⋃ s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), ⋃ μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3,
        Set.range (fun φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 => (iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤) s ((ofA 𝔤) μ φ)))
      = (⊤ : Subalgebra ℝ (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤))

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexJetDeriv
entries.docstring:
The formal total derivative on the complexified gauge-boson jet algebra, by base
  change. This is the derivative the ambient Lagrangian theory uses.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def complexJetDeriv (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexJetDeriv_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma complexJetDeriv_tmul (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (z : ℂ) (x : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) :
    (complexJetDeriv 𝔤) ν (z ⊗ₜ[ℝ] x) = z ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (jetDeriv 𝔤) ν x

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexJetDeriv_mul
entries.docstring: The Leibniz rule on the complexification.
entries.snippet:
lemma complexJetDeriv_mul (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) :
    (complexJetDeriv 𝔤) ν (x * y)
      = (complexJetDeriv 𝔤) ν x * y + x * (complexJetDeriv 𝔤) ν y

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexJetDeriv_comm
entries.docstring: The complexified total derivatives commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma complexJetDeriv_comm (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    ((complexJetDeriv 𝔤) μ).comp ((complexJetDeriv 𝔤) ν)
      = ((complexJetDeriv 𝔤) ν).comp ((complexJetDeriv 𝔤) μ)

entries.name: GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the jet component space of the gauge bosons: the derivative
  label transforms in `SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ`, the target index contragrediently.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup :
    Representation ℝ SL(2,ℂ) (JetComponentSpace 𝔤)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.repLorentzGroup_basis_singleton
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the singleton derivative symbol: the derivative slot transforms
  by the columns of the Lorentz matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma _root_.SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.repLorentzGroup_basis_singleton
    (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.repLorentzGroup Λ
        (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset ({μ} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))) =
      ∑ a, ((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 a μ) •
        SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset ({a} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))

entries.name: GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup_jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
**The derivative shift is a Lorentz vector on the component space**: appending `∂_μ`
  and then acting is acting and then appending the transformed `∂_μ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup_jetDeriv (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (v : (JetComponentSpace 𝔤)) :
    (JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup 𝔤) Λ ((JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv 𝔤) μ v) =
      ∑ a, ((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 a μ) •
        (JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv 𝔤) a ((JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup 𝔤) Λ v)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
**The Lorentz action on the gauge-boson jet algebra**: the symmetric-algebra functor
  applied to the Lorentz action on the jet component space.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def repLorentzGroup : Representation ℝ SL(2,ℂ) (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) where

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) :
    (repLorentzGroup 𝔤) Λ x =
      SymmetricAlgebra.map ((GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup 𝔤) Λ) x

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_apply_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_one (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    (repLorentzGroup 𝔤) Λ (1 : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) = 1

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_apply_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_mul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x y : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) :
    (repLorentzGroup 𝔤) Λ (x * y) = (repLorentzGroup 𝔤) Λ x * (repLorentzGroup 𝔤) Λ y

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_ι
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repLorentzGroup_ι (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (v : (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)) :
    (repLorentzGroup 𝔤) Λ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ _ v) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ _ ((GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup 𝔤) Λ v)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_jetDeriv
entries.docstring: **The total derivative on the gauge-boson jet algebra is a Lorentz vector.**
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_jetDeriv (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) :
    (repLorentzGroup 𝔤) Λ ((jetDeriv 𝔤) μ x) =
      ∑ a, ((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 a μ) •
        (jetDeriv 𝔤) a ((repLorentzGroup 𝔤) Λ x)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepLorentzGroup
entries.docstring: The Lorentz action on the complexified gauge-boson jet algebra, by base change.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def complexRepLorentzGroup :

entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma complexRepLorentzGroup_tmul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (z : ℂ) (x : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) :

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepLorentzGroupAlgHom

noncomputable def complexRepLorentzGroupAlgHom (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepLorentzGroup_apply

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepLorentzGroup_apply_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma complexRepLorentzGroup_apply_mul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) :
    (complexRepLorentzGroup 𝔤) Λ (x * y)
      = (complexRepLorentzGroup 𝔤) Λ x * (complexRepLorentzGroup 𝔤) Λ y

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepLorentzGroup_jetDeriv
entries.docstring: **The complexified total derivative is a Lorentz vector.**
entries.snippet:
lemma complexRepLorentzGroup_jetDeriv (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (x : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) :
    (complexRepLorentzGroup 𝔤) Λ ((complexJetDeriv 𝔤) μ x) =

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.instIsLorentzDeriv
entries.docstring:
The complexified total derivatives form a Lorentz derivative, giving access to the
  boost-weight machinery.
entries.snippet:
instance instIsLorentzDeriv :
    Lorentz.IsLorentzDeriv (complexRepLorentzGroup 𝔤) (complexJetDeriv 𝔤) where

entries.name: GaugeBoson.repLorentzGroup_dual_componentDual
entries.docstring:
The contragredient Lorentz action passes through a component covector to its spacetime
  slot: the adjoint index is Lorentz-inert.
entries.snippet:
lemma _root_.GaugeBoson.repLorentzGroup_dual_componentDual (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (ω : Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (GaugeBoson.repLorentzGroup 𝔤).dual Λ ((GaugeBoson.componentDual 𝔤) ω φ)
      = (GaugeBoson.componentDual 𝔤) (Lorentz.CoVector.sl2Rep.dual Λ ω) φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_ofA
entries.docstring:
**The gauge field is a Lorentz covector**: the generator `A_μ^φ` mixes into the `A_a^φ`
  by the columns of the Lorentz matrix, with the adjoint index untouched.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_ofA (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (repLorentzGroup 𝔤) Λ ((ofA 𝔤) μ φ)
      = ∑ a, ((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 a μ) • (ofA 𝔤) a φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepLorentzGroup_one_tmul_ofA
entries.docstring: The Lorentz law of the gauge-field generators on the complexification.
entries.snippet:
lemma complexRepLorentzGroup_one_tmul_ofA (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (complexRepLorentzGroup 𝔤) Λ ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (ofA 𝔤) μ φ)
      = ∑ a, (((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 a μ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
          ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (ofA 𝔤) a φ)

entries.name: GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale
entries.docstring:
The mass-weight scaling on the jet component space of the gauge bosons: the generator
  `∂_s A_μ^φ` is scaled by `c ^ (2 + 2 |s|)`, through the derivative-degree scaling
  `SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.gradeScale` on the derivative label.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale (c : ℝ) :
    (JetComponentSpace 𝔤) →ₗ[ℝ] (JetComponentSpace 𝔤)

entries.name: GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale_tmul (c : ℝ) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ (GaugeBoson 𝔤)) :
    (JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale 𝔤) c (a ⊗ₜ[ℝ] φ)
      = c ^ 2 • (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.gradeScale (c ^ 2) a ⊗ₜ[ℝ] φ)

entries.name: GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale_jetDeriv
entries.docstring: **The derivative shift carries mass weight two** on the component space.
entries.snippet:
lemma JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale_jetDeriv (c : ℝ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (v : (JetComponentSpace 𝔤)) :
    (JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale 𝔤) c ((JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv 𝔤) μ v)
      = c ^ 2 • (JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv 𝔤) μ ((JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale 𝔤) c v)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.massWeightScale
entries.docstring:
**The mass-weight scaling on the gauge-boson jet algebra**: the algebra endomorphism
  scaling the generator `∂_s A_μ^φ` by `c ^ (2 + 2 |s|)`, the functorial lift of the
  scaling on the jet component space.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def massWeightScale (c : ℝ) :
    (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) →ₐ[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.massWeightScale_ι
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma massWeightScale_ι (c : ℝ) (x : (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)) :
    (massWeightScale 𝔤) c (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ _ x)
      = SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ _ ((GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale 𝔤) c x)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.massWeightScale_ofA
entries.docstring: **The gauge field carries mass weight two** — mass dimension one.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma massWeightScale_ofA (c : ℝ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (massWeightScale 𝔤) c ((ofA 𝔤) μ φ) = c ^ 2 • (ofA 𝔤) μ φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.massWeightScale_jetDeriv
entries.docstring: **A total derivative adds mass weight two.**
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightScale_jetDeriv (c : ℝ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) :
    (massWeightScale 𝔤) c ((jetDeriv 𝔤) μ x) = c ^ 2 • (jetDeriv 𝔤) μ
      ((massWeightScale 𝔤) c x)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.massWeightScale_iteratedJetDeriv
entries.docstring: **The iterated derivative `∂_s` adds mass weight `2 |s|`.**
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightScale_iteratedJetDeriv (c : ℝ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (x : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) :
    (massWeightScale 𝔤) c ((iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤) s x)
      = c ^ (2 * Multiset.card s) • (iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤) s ((massWeightScale 𝔤) c x)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.monomialₗ
entries.docstring:
The monomial map into polynomials over the complexified jet algebra, as a map of
  `ℝ`-modules rather than of modules over the complexified jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def monomialₗ (n : ℕ) :
    (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) →ₗ[ℝ]
      Polynomial (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.monomialₗ_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma monomialₗ_apply (n : ℕ) (x : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    (monomialₗ (𝔤 := 𝔤)) n x = Polynomial.monomial n x

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.ιComplex
entries.docstring:
A component function, viewed inside the complexified jet algebra: the generator
  `∂_s A_μ^φ` tensored with the scalar one.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def ιComplex :
    (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) →ₗ[ℝ] ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.ιComplex_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ιComplex_apply (x : (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)) :
    (ιComplex (𝔤 := 𝔤)) x =
      (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) x

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.jetComponentPoly
entries.docstring:
The mass-weight polynomial of a component function: the linear map sending the symbol
  `∂_s A^φ` to `X ^ (2 + 2 |s|)` times itself, read off from the multiset basis of the real
  derivative symbols.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetComponentPoly :
    (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) →ₗ[ℝ]
      Polynomial (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.jetComponentPoly_basisMultiset_tmul
entries.docstring:
On the symbol `∂_s A^φ` the component map is the monomial of degree `2 + 2 |s|`: the
  gauge field contributes two and each derivative two more.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetComponentPoly_basisMultiset_tmul (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ (GaugeBoson 𝔤)) :
    (jetComponentPoly (𝔤 := 𝔤)) (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset s ⊗ₜ[ℝ] φ) =
      Polynomial.monomial (2 + 2 * Multiset.card s)
        (ιComplex (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset s ⊗ₜ[ℝ] φ))

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.massWeightPoly
entries.docstring:
The mass-weight polynomial on the gauge-boson jet algebra: the `ℝ`-algebra map sending
  a generator of mass weight `n` to `X ^ n` times its image in the complexification. It
  needs no side condition because the target is commutative.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def massWeightPoly :
    LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤 →ₐ[ℝ]
      Polynomial (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.massWeightPoly_ι
entries.docstring: On a component function the mass-weight polynomial is the component-function map.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma massWeightPoly_ι (x : (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)) :
    (massWeightPoly (𝔤 := 𝔤)) (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) x) =
      jetComponentPoly x

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.massWeightPoly_iteratedJetDeriv_ofA
entries.docstring: The generator `∂_s A_μ^φ` is a monomial eigenvector of mass weight `2 + 2 |s|`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma massWeightPoly_iteratedJetDeriv_ofA (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (massWeightPoly (𝔤 := 𝔤)) (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤 s
        (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.ofA 𝔤 μ φ)) =
      Polynomial.monomial (2 + 2 * Multiset.card s) ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ]
        LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤 s
          (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.ofA 𝔤 μ φ))

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.massWeightPoly_ofA
entries.docstring: The undifferentiated gauge field has mass weight two — mass dimension one.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_ofA (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (massWeightPoly (𝔤 := 𝔤)) (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.ofA 𝔤 μ φ) =
      Polynomial.monomial 2 ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.ofA 𝔤 μ φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexMassWeightPoly
entries.docstring:
The mass-weight polynomial on the complexified gauge-boson jet algebra: the `ℂ`-algebra
  map obtained from the real one by extending the scalars, the grading the jet algebra of
  the Standard Model sees on its gauge sector.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def complexMassWeightPoly :
    (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) →ₐ[ℂ]
      Polynomial (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexMassWeightPoly_tmul
entries.docstring: On a pure tensor the complexified grading is the scalar times the real grading.
entries.snippet:
lemma complexMassWeightPoly_tmul (z : ℂ) (x : LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    (complexMassWeightPoly (𝔤 := 𝔤)) (z ⊗ₜ[ℝ] x) =
      Polynomial.C (z ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (1 : LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)) * massWeightPoly x

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexMassWeightPoly_tmul_iteratedJetDeriv_ofA
entries.docstring:
The generator `∂_s A_μ^φ` of the complexified jet algebra, with any complex coefficient,
  is a monomial eigenvector of mass weight `2 + 2 |s|`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma complexMassWeightPoly_tmul_iteratedJetDeriv_ofA (z : ℂ)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (complexMassWeightPoly (𝔤 := 𝔤)) (z ⊗ₜ[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤 s
        (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.ofA 𝔤 μ φ)) =
      Polynomial.monomial (2 + 2 * Multiset.card s) (z ⊗ₜ[ℝ]
        LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv 𝔤 s
          (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.ofA 𝔤 μ φ))

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.jetComponentPoly_eval_one
entries.docstring:
Setting the formal variable to one collapses the component map back to the component
  function it graded. The derivative monomials span, so it is enough to check this on the
  multiset basis.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetComponentPoly_eval_one (x : (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)) :
    ((jetComponentPoly (𝔤 := 𝔤)) x).eval 1 = ιComplex x

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.massWeightPoly_eval_one
entries.docstring:
Setting the formal variable to one recovers the original element, viewed in the
  complexification.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_eval_one (x : LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    ((massWeightPoly (𝔤 := 𝔤)) x).eval 1 =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := ℝ) (A := ℂ)
        (B := LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) x

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexMassWeightPoly_eval_one
entries.docstring:
Setting the formal variable to one recovers the original element of the complexified
  jet algebra: the mass-weight pieces sum back to it.
entries.snippet:
lemma complexMassWeightPoly_eval_one (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    ((complexMassWeightPoly (𝔤 := 𝔤)) y).eval 1 = y

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexMassWeightPoly_injective
entries.docstring:
The mass-weight polynomial on the complexification is injective: an element is
  recovered from its graded pieces.
entries.snippet: lemma complexMassWeightPoly_injective : Function.Injective (complexMassWeightPoly (𝔤 := 𝔤))

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization
entries.docstring:
A real algebra `B` carrying the gauge bosons of the package `jets`: a real algebra map
  out of the local gauge field algebra, equivariant for the jet gauge group and the Lorentz
  group, both acting on the whole of `B` by algebra endomorphisms. It is built from the
  fields `toAlgHom`, `map_fst`, `map_snd`, `fst_mul`, `snd_mul` of
  `Representation.EquivariantAlgHom`, which the lemmas `map_repJet`, `map_repLorentz`,
  `repJet_mul` and `repLorentz_mul` name.
entries.snippet:
abbrev Realization (jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 GJ 𝔤J) (B : Type) [Ring B] [Algebra ℝ B]
    (repJet : Representation ℝ GJ B) (repLorentz : Representation ℝ SL(2,ℂ) B)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.id
entries.docstring: The local gauge field algebra realized in itself, by the identity.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def id : Realization jets (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)
    (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet jets) (repLorentzGroup 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.id_toAlgHom
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma id_toAlgHom : (id jets).toAlgHom = AlgHom.id ℝ (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.map_repJet
entries.docstring: The map is equivariant for the jet gauge group.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_repJet (U : GJ) (x : LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    h.toAlgHom (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet jets U x) = repJet U (h.toAlgHom x)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.map_repLorentz
entries.docstring: The map is equivariant for the Lorentz group.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_repLorentz (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x : LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    h.toAlgHom (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup 𝔤 Λ x) = repLorentz Λ (h.toAlgHom x)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.repJet_mul
entries.docstring: The jet gauge group acts on the whole of `B` by algebra endomorphisms.
entries.snippet: lemma repJet_mul (U : GJ) (b₁ b₂ : B) : repJet U (b₁ * b₂) = repJet U b₁ * repJet U b₂

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.repLorentz_mul
entries.docstring: The Lorentz group acts on the whole of `B` by algebra endomorphisms.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_mul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (b₁ b₂ : B) :
    repLorentz Λ (b₁ * b₂) = repLorentz Λ b₁ * repLorentz Λ b₂

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.A
entries.docstring:
The derivative symbols `∂_s A_μ^φ` of a realization: the images of the algebra's own
  symbols `derivA`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def A (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.A_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma A_apply (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    h.A s μ φ = h.toAlgHom (derivA 𝔤 s μ φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.id_A
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma id_A : (id jets).A = derivA 𝔤

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.commute_A
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_A (p q : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ ψ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) : Commute (h.A p μ φ) (h.A q ν ψ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.ext_A
entries.docstring: Two realizations with the same derivative symbols are equal.

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.gauge_apply_deriv
entries.docstring:
The gauge law: a jet `U` acts on `∂_s A_μ^φ` by the Leibniz convolution of the dual
  adjoint Taylor coefficients of `U⁻¹` against lower symbols, plus the base-point value of
  the `s`-th derivative of the Maurer–Cartan form of `U⁻¹`.
entries.snippet:
lemma gauge_apply_deriv (U : GJ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repJet U (h.A s μ φ) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p => h.A p.2 μ (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum
      + algebraMap ℝ B (φ (jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ μ))))

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.lorentz_apply
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law: the symbol carries one covector index, and each derivative slot
  transforms as a covector.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentz_apply (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repLorentz Λ (h.A (List.ofFn l) μ φ) =
      ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ i, ((SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 (p i) (l i) : ℝ)) •
        ∑ a, ((SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 a μ : ℝ) • h.A (List.ofFn p) a φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.toAlgHom_covDerivFieldStrength
entries.docstring:
The map of a realization carries the covariant derivatives of the field strength to
  those of its symbols.
entries.snippet:
lemma toAlgHom_covDerivFieldStrength (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    h.toAlgHom (covDerivFieldStrength 𝔤 l μ ν φ)
      = GaugeAlgebraRealization.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint h.A l
        (GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength h.A μ ν) 0 φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.toAlgHom_fieldStrength
entries.snippet:
lemma toAlgHom_fieldStrength (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    h.toAlgHom (fieldStrength 𝔤 μ ν φ) = GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength h.A μ ν 0 φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.toGaugeAlgebraRealization
entries.docstring:
The complexification of a real realization in a complex algebra, by `AlgHom.liftEquiv`;
  the symbols are unchanged.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def toGaugeAlgebraRealization
    (h : Realization jets B (repJet.restrictScalars ℝ) (repLorentz.restrictScalars ℝ)) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization jets B repJet repLorentz where

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.toGaugeAlgebraRealization_A
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toGaugeAlgebraRealization_A
    (h : Realization jets B (repJet.restrictScalars ℝ) (repLorentz.restrictScalars ℝ)) :
    h.toGaugeAlgebraRealization.A = h.A

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.toGaugeAlgebraRealization_toAlgHom_one_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma toGaugeAlgebraRealization_toAlgHom_one_tmul
    (h : Realization jets B (repJet.restrictScalars ℝ) (repLorentz.restrictScalars ℝ))
    (x : LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    h.toGaugeAlgebraRealization.toAlgHom ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] x) = h.toAlgHom x

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.toRealization
entries.docstring:
The restriction of scalars of a complex realization: the algebra map precomposed with
  `x ↦ 1 ⊗ₜ x`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def _root_.GaugeAlgebraRealization.toRealization
    (h : GaugeAlgebraRealization jets B repJet repLorentz) :
    Realization jets B (repJet.restrictScalars ℝ) (repLorentz.restrictScalars ℝ) where

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.toRealization_toAlgHom_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma _root_.GaugeAlgebraRealization.toRealization_toAlgHom_apply
    (h : GaugeAlgebraRealization jets B repJet repLorentz) (x : LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    h.toRealization.toAlgHom x = h.toAlgHom ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] x)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.toRealization_A
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma _root_.GaugeAlgebraRealization.toRealization_A
    (h : GaugeAlgebraRealization jets B repJet repLorentz) : h.toRealization.A = h.A

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.toRealization_id_toAlgHom
entries.snippet:
lemma _root_.GaugeAlgebraRealization.toRealization_id_toAlgHom :
    (GaugeAlgebraRealization.id jets).toRealization.toAlgHom
      = (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
          LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤 →ₐ[ℝ] ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.equivGaugeAlgebraRealization
entries.docstring: For a complex target, real realizations are the complex realizations.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def equivGaugeAlgebraRealization :
    Realization jets B (repJet.restrictScalars ℝ) (repLorentz.restrictScalars ℝ)
      ≃ GaugeAlgebraRealization jets B repJet repLorentz where

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra
entries.docstring:
The covariant field algebra of the gauge bosons: the real unital subalgebra of the
  local gauge field algebra generated by the field strength and its iterated covariant
  derivatives `∇_{l₁} ⋯ ∇_{lₙ} F_μν^φ`, along all ordered lists of directions.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra : Subalgebra ℝ (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.mem_tower_iff
entries.docstring: The generating set, as the covariant derivatives of the field strength.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_tower_iff (x : LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    x ∈ GaugeAlgebraRealization.tower (derivA 𝔤) ↔
      ∃ (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤),
        x = covDerivFieldStrength 𝔤 l μ ν φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.covDerivFieldStrength_mem
entries.snippet:
lemma covDerivFieldStrength_mem (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) : covDerivFieldStrength 𝔤 l μ ν φ ∈ LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.fieldStrength_mem
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrength_mem (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    fieldStrength 𝔤 μ ν φ ∈ LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.adjoin_preimage_tower_eq_top
entries.docstring:
Inside the covariant field algebra, the preimage of the generating tower under the
  inclusion generates the whole real subalgebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjoin_preimage_tower_eq_top :
    Algebra.adjoin ℝ ((Subtype.val : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤 → LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)
      ⁻¹' GaugeAlgebraRealization.tower (derivA 𝔤)) = ⊤

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.induction
entries.docstring:
The generation principle: a property holding on the covariant derivatives of the
  field strength and on the scalars, and closed under sums and products, holds on the
  whole covariant field algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma induction {P : LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤 → Prop} {x : LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤}
    (hx : x ∈ LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤)
    (hgen : ∀ (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤),
      P (covDerivFieldStrength 𝔤 l μ ν φ))
    (halg : ∀ r : ℝ, P (algebraMap ℝ (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) r))
    (hadd : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (hmul : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x * y)) : P x

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.mapsTo
entries.docstring:
An algebra endomorphism carrying the generators into the covariant field algebra
  carries the whole covariant field algebra into itself.
entries.snippet:
lemma mapsTo (f : LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤 →ₐ[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)
    (hgen : ∀ (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤),
      f (covDerivFieldStrength 𝔤 l μ ν φ) ∈ LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤)
    {x : LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤} (hx : x ∈ LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    f x ∈ LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.covF
entries.docstring: The generators `∇_l F_μν^φ` of the covariant field algebra, as elements of it.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def covF (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤 where

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.coe_covF
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coe_covF (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (covF 𝔤 l μ ν φ : LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) = covDerivFieldStrength 𝔤 l μ ν φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.coe_covF_nil
entries.snippet:
lemma coe_covF_nil (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (covF 𝔤 [] μ ν φ : LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) = fieldStrength 𝔤 μ ν φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.val_comp_covF
entries.snippet:
lemma val_comp_covF (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤).val.toLinearMap ∘ₗ covF 𝔤 l μ ν
      = covDerivFieldStrength 𝔤 l μ ν

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.algHom_ext
entries.docstring:
Two algebra maps out of the covariant field algebra agreeing on the generators are
  equal. This is uniqueness only: the covariant field algebra is not free on the generators,
  so an assignment of their images does not by itself define a map.
entries.snippet:
lemma algHom_ext {B : Type} [Semiring B] [Algebra ℝ B]
    {f g : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤 →ₐ[ℝ] B}
    (h : ∀ (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤),
      f (covF 𝔤 l μ ν φ) = g (covF 𝔤 l μ ν φ)) : f = g

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_mem
entries.docstring:
The jet gauge group preserves the covariant field algebra: a jet rotates the adjoint
  index of each generator through the value of its inverse.

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_mem
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz group preserves the covariant field algebra: the generators mix among
  themselves by the columns of the Lorentz matrix.

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.repJet
entries.docstring:
The action of the jet gauge group on the covariant field algebra, restricted from the
  local gauge field algebra.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def repJet : Representation ℝ GJ (LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.coe_repJet
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coe_repJet (U : GJ) (x : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    (repJet jets U x : LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) = LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet jets U x

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_apply_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_apply_mul (U : GJ) (x y : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    repJet jets U (x * y) = repJet jets U x * repJet jets U y

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The action of the Lorentz group on the covariant field algebra, restricted from the
  local gauge field algebra.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def repLorentzGroup : Representation ℝ SL(2,ℂ) (LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.coe_repLorentzGroup
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coe_repLorentzGroup (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    (repLorentzGroup 𝔤 Λ x : LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)
      = LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup 𝔤 Λ x

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_apply_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_mul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x y : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    repLorentzGroup 𝔤 Λ (x * y) = repLorentzGroup 𝔤 Λ x * repLorentzGroup 𝔤 Λ y

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.repValue
entries.docstring:
The action of the ordinary gauge group on the covariant field algebra: the jet action
  at the constant jets.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def repValue : Representation ℝ G₀ (LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.coe_repValue
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coe_repValue (g : G₀) (x : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    (repValue jets g x : LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)
      = LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet jets (jets.ofConstant g) x

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.repValue_apply_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma repValue_apply_mul (g : G₀) (x y : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    repValue jets g (x * y) = repValue jets g x * repValue jets g y

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_eq_repValue_eval
entries.docstring:
The action of the jet gauge group on the covariant field algebra factors through
  evaluation: a jet acts as the constant jet of its value. The derivatives of a gauge
  transformation act trivially on covariant expressions.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_eq_repValue_eval (U : GJ) (x : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    repJet jets U x = repValue jets (jets.eval U) x

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.repValue_covF
entries.docstring:
The ordinary gauge group rotates the adjoint index of a generator through the dual
  adjoint action of the inverse.
entries.snippet:
lemma repValue_covF (g : G₀) (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repValue jets g (covF 𝔤 l μ ν φ) = covF 𝔤 l μ ν ((jets.adjoint g⁻¹).dualMap φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_covF
entries.docstring: A jet acts on a generator through the value of its inverse alone.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_covF (U : GJ) (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repJet jets U (covF 𝔤 l μ ν φ)
      = covF 𝔤 l μ ν ((jets.adjoint (jets.eval U⁻¹)).dualMap φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_covF
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of the generators: every covariant slot and both covector indices mix
  by the columns of the Lorentz matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covF (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repLorentzGroup 𝔤 Λ (covF 𝔤 (List.ofFn l) μ ν φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ i, ((SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 (p i) (l i) : ℝ)) •
          ∑ a, ((SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 a μ : ℝ) • ∑ b, ((SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 b ν : ℝ) •
            covF 𝔤 (List.ofFn p) a b φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.complexVal
entries.docstring:
The complexified covariant field algebra inside the complexified local gauge field
