  algebra: the base change of `Subalgebra.val` along `ℝ → ℂ`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def complexVal :
    (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.complexVal_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma complexVal_tmul (z : ℂ) (x : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    complexVal 𝔤 (z ⊗ₜ[ℝ] x) = z ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (x : LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.complexVal_injective
entries.snippet: lemma complexVal_injective : Function.Injective (complexVal 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.complexRepValue
entries.docstring:
The action of the ordinary gauge group on the complexified covariant field algebra, by
  base change.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def complexRepValue :
    Representation ℂ G₀ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.complexRepValue_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma complexRepValue_tmul (g : G₀) (z : ℂ) (x : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    complexRepValue jets g (z ⊗ₜ[ℝ] x) = z ⊗ₜ[ℝ] repValue jets g x

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.complexRepLorentzGroup
entries.docstring: The Lorentz action on the complexified covariant field algebra, by base change.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def complexRepLorentzGroup :
    Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.complexRepLorentzGroup_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma complexRepLorentzGroup_tmul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (z : ℂ) (x : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    complexRepLorentzGroup 𝔤 Λ (z ⊗ₜ[ℝ] x) = z ⊗ₜ[ℝ] repLorentzGroup 𝔤 Λ x

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.complexVal_complexRepValue
entries.docstring: Along the complexified inclusion the ordinary gauge group acts as the constant jets.
entries.snippet:
lemma complexVal_complexRepValue (g : G₀) (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    complexVal 𝔤 (complexRepValue jets g y)
      = LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJet jets (jets.ofConstant g) (complexVal 𝔤 y)

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.complexVal_complexRepLorentzGroup
entries.docstring: Along the complexified inclusion the Lorentz action is the ambient one.
entries.snippet:
lemma complexVal_complexRepLorentzGroup (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    complexVal 𝔤 (complexRepLorentzGroup 𝔤 Λ y)
      = LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepLorentzGroup 𝔤 Λ (complexVal 𝔤 y)

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization
entries.docstring:
A real algebra `B` carrying the covariant gauge-boson tower of the package `jets`: a
  real algebra map out of the covariant field algebra, equivariant for the ordinary gauge
  group and the Lorentz group, both acting on the whole of `B` by algebra endomorphisms. It
  is built from the fields `toAlgHom`, `map_fst`, `map_snd`, `fst_mul`, `snd_mul` of
  `Representation.EquivariantAlgHom`, which the lemmas `map_repValue`, `map_repLorentz`,
  `repGauge_mul` and `repLorentz_mul` name.
entries.snippet:
abbrev Realization (jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 GJ 𝔤J) (B : Type) [Ring B] [Algebra ℝ B]
    (repGauge : Representation ℝ G₀ B) (repLorentz : Representation ℝ SL(2,ℂ) B)

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.id
entries.docstring: The covariant field algebra realized in itself, by the identity.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def id : Realization jets (LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) (repValue jets)
    (repLorentzGroup 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.id_toAlgHom
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma id_toAlgHom : (id jets).toAlgHom = AlgHom.id ℝ (LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤)

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.map_repValue
entries.docstring: The map is equivariant for the ordinary gauge group.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_repValue (g : G₀) (x : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    k.toAlgHom (repValue jets g x) = repGauge g (k.toAlgHom x)

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.map_repLorentz
entries.docstring: The map is equivariant for the Lorentz group.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_repLorentz (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    k.toAlgHom (repLorentzGroup 𝔤 Λ x) = repLorentz Λ (k.toAlgHom x)

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.repGauge_mul
entries.docstring: The ordinary gauge group acts on the whole of `B` by algebra endomorphisms.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_mul (g : G₀) (b₁ b₂ : B) :
    repGauge g (b₁ * b₂) = repGauge g b₁ * repGauge g b₂

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.repLorentz_mul
entries.docstring: The Lorentz group acts on the whole of `B` by algebra endomorphisms.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_mul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (b₁ b₂ : B) :
    repLorentz Λ (b₁ * b₂) = repLorentz Λ b₁ * repLorentz Λ b₂

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.F
entries.docstring:
The covariant tower `∇_l F_μν^φ` of a realization: the images of the generators of the
  covariant field algebra.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def F (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.F_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma F_apply (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    k.F l μ ν φ = k.toAlgHom (covF 𝔤 l μ ν φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.id_F
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma id_F : (id jets).F = covF 𝔤

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.F_nil
entries.snippet:
lemma F_nil (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    k.F [] μ ν φ = k.toAlgHom ⟨fieldStrength 𝔤 μ ν φ, fieldStrength_mem μ ν φ⟩

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.commute_F
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_F (l l' : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν μ' ν' : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ ψ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) : Commute (k.F l μ ν φ) (k.F l' μ' ν' ψ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.ext_F
entries.docstring:
Two realizations with the same covariant tower are equal. This is uniqueness only: a
  tower in `B` need not come from a realization.

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.gauge_F
entries.docstring:
The gauge law of the covariant tower: the adjoint index rotates through the dual
  adjoint action of the inverse.
entries.snippet:
lemma gauge_F (g : G₀) (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repGauge g (k.F l μ ν φ) = k.F l μ ν ((jets.adjoint g⁻¹).dualMap φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.lorentz_F
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of the covariant tower: every covariant slot and both covector indices
  mix by the columns of the Lorentz matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentz_F (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repLorentz Λ (k.F (List.ofFn l) μ ν φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ i, ((SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 (p i) (l i) : ℝ)) •
          ∑ a, ((SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 a μ : ℝ) • ∑ b, ((SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 b ν : ℝ) •
            k.F (List.ofFn p) a b φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.map_repJet
entries.docstring:
A covariant realization intertwines the jet action with the `G₀` action at the value
  of the jet.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_repJet (U : GJ) (x : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    k.toAlgHom (repJet jets U x) = repGauge (jets.eval U) (k.toAlgHom x)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.restrict
entries.docstring:
The restriction of a realization of the local gauge field algebra to the covariant
  field algebra, along the inclusion; the ordinary gauge group acts on the target as the
  constant jets.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def restrict :
    LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization jets B (repJet.comp jets.ofConstant) repLorentz

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.restrict_toAlgHom_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_toAlgHom_apply (x : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    h.restrict.toAlgHom x = h.toAlgHom x

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.restrict_id_toAlgHom
entries.snippet:
lemma restrict_id_toAlgHom :
    (id jets).restrict.toAlgHom = (LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤).val

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.restrict_F
entries.snippet:
lemma restrict_F (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    h.restrict.F l μ ν φ = h.toAlgHom (covDerivFieldStrength 𝔤 l μ ν φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.restrict_F_eq_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint
entries.docstring: The covariant tower of a restriction is the covariant tower of the symbols of `B`.
entries.snippet:
lemma restrict_F_eq_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    h.restrict.F l μ ν φ = GaugeAlgebraRealization.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint h.A l
      (GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength h.A μ ν) 0 φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.restrict_F_nil
entries.snippet:
lemma restrict_F_nil (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    h.restrict.F [] μ ν φ = GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength h.A μ ν 0 φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.restrict_map_repJet
entries.snippet:
lemma restrict_map_repJet (U : GJ) (x : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    h.restrict.toAlgHom (LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.repJet jets U x)
      = repJet U (h.restrict.toAlgHom x)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.Realization.repJet_restrict_toAlgHom
entries.docstring:
On the image of the covariant field algebra a jet acts as the constant jet of its
  value; nothing is assumed about the jet action elsewhere in `B`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_restrict_toAlgHom (U : GJ) (x : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    repJet U (h.restrict.toAlgHom x)
      = repJet (jets.ofConstant (jets.eval U)) (h.restrict.toAlgHom x)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization
entries.docstring:
An algebra `B` carrying the gauge bosons of the package `jets`: an algebra map out of
  the complexified gauge-boson jet algebra, equivariant for the jet gauge group and the
  Lorentz group, with both groups acting on the whole of `B` by algebra endomorphisms.
  The gauge-field symbols of `B` are the images of the jet algebra's symbols,
  `GaugeAlgebraRealization.A`, and they satisfy the jet algebra's laws by transport.
entries.snippet:
structure GaugeAlgebraRealization (jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 GJ 𝔤J) (B : Type) [Ring B]
    [Algebra ℂ B] (repJet : Representation ℂ GJ B) (repLorentz : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) B)
    where
  toAlgHom : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤 →ₐ[ℂ] B
  A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B
  A_eq : ∀ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤),
    A s μ φ = toAlgHom (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.gaugeField 𝔤 s μ φ)
  map_repJet : ∀ (U : GJ) (x : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤),
    toAlgHom (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJet jets U x) = repJet U (toAlgHom x)
  map_repLorentz : ∀ (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤),
    toAlgHom (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepLorentzGroup 𝔤 Λ x) = repLorentz Λ (toAlgHom x)
  repJet_mul : ∀ (U : GJ) (b₁ b₂ : B), repJet U (b₁ * b₂) = repJet U b₁ * repJet U b₂
  repLorentz_mul : ∀ (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (b₁ b₂ : B),
    repLorentz Λ (b₁ * b₂) = repLorentz Λ b₁ * repLorentz Λ b₂

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.id
entries.docstring: The gauge-boson jet algebra realized in itself, by the identity.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def id : GaugeAlgebraRealization jets (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤)
    (complexRepJet jets) (complexRepLorentzGroup 𝔤) where

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.A_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma A_apply (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    h.A s μ φ = h.toAlgHom (gaugeField 𝔤 s μ φ)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.id_A
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma id_A : (GaugeAlgebraRealization.id jets).A = gaugeField 𝔤

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.ext
entries.docstring: A realization is determined by its algebra map.
entries.snippet:
lemma ext {h₁ h₂ : GaugeAlgebraRealization jets B repJet repLorentz}
    (h : h₁.toAlgHom = h₂.toAlgHom) : h₁ = h₂

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.commute_A
entries.docstring:
The gauge-field symbols of a realization commute, being images of a commutative
  algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_A (p q : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ ψ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) : Commute (h.A p μ φ) (h.A q ν ψ)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.lorentz_apply
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law: the gauge-field symbol carries one covector index, and each derivative
  slot transforms as a covector.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentz_apply (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repLorentz Λ (h.A (List.ofFn l) μ φ) =
      ∑ (p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)),
        (∏ (i : Fin n), (((SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 (p i) (l i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) •
      ∑ a, (((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 a μ : ℝ) : ℂ) • h.A (List.ofFn p) a φ

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.gauge_apply_deriv
entries.docstring:
The gauge law: a jet `U` acts on the derivative symbol `∂_s A_μ^φ` by the Leibniz
  convolution of the dual adjoint Taylor coefficients of `U⁻¹` against lower symbols (the
  multiset antidiagonal carrying the multinomial coefficients), plus the base-point value of
  the `s`-th derivative of the Maurer–Cartan form of `U⁻¹`.
entries.snippet:
lemma gauge_apply_deriv (U : GJ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repJet U (h.A s μ φ) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p => h.A p.2 μ (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum
      + algebraMap ℂ B (φ (jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ μ))))

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.gauge_mul
entries.docstring:
The gauge action preserves products: gauge transformations act on the algebra of local
  expressions as algebra homomorphisms.
entries.snippet: lemma gauge_mul (U : GJ) (b₁ b₂ : B) : repJet U (b₁ * b₂) = repJet U b₁ * repJet U b₂

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength
entries.docstring:
The field strength `F_μν = ∂_μ A_ν − ∂_ν A_μ + ⁅A_μ, A_ν⁆` of a family of
  gauge-field symbols, as a family of derivative symbols: the `s`-th derivative has
  the derivative terms through the shifted symbols `A (μ ::ₘ s) ν`, the commutator
  term through the Leibniz convolution `commutatorFam`. This is the physicists'
  `F_μν^a = ∂_μ A_ν^a − ∂_ν A_μ^a + f^a_{bc} A_μ^b A_ν^c`: the gauge-algebra bracket
  already carries the physicists' factor of `i`, so no explicit factor appears — the
  same normalization as in the structural equation of the Maurer–Cartan form, which
  is exactly what makes the field strength transform without inhomogeneous terms
  (`repGauge_fieldStrength`).
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fieldStrength
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fieldStrength_apply
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    fieldStrength A μ ν s φ = A (μ ::ₘ s) ν φ - A (ν ::ₘ s) μ φ + commutatorFam A μ ν s φ

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength_zero
entries.docstring:
The underived field strength: derivative symbols on singletons, plus the plain
  commutator.
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrength_zero
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    fieldStrength A μ ν 0 = A {μ} ν - A {ν} μ + commutator A μ ν

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.pair_eq_fieldStrength_sub_commutatorFam
entries.docstring:
The antisymmetrized pair of derivative symbols is the field strength minus its
  commutator term.
entries.snippet:
lemma pair_eq_fieldStrength_sub_commutatorFam
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (ν μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    A (ν ::ₘ s) μ - A (μ ::ₘ s) ν = fieldStrength A ν μ s - commutatorFam A ν μ s

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_swap_of_commute
entries.docstring:
The bracket of two component families with commuting values is antisymmetric: in
  the basis expansion the structure constants are antisymmetric in the two gauge
  indices, and the two field factors of each term may be exchanged.

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.commutatorFam_swap
entries.docstring:
The derived commutator term is antisymmetric in its two directions when the symbols
  of the gauge field commute: swapping the two parts of the antidiagonal matches the
  Leibniz convolution with the swapped one termwise.
entries.snippet:
lemma commutatorFam_swap
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (hA : ∀ (s s' : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ μ' : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
      (ψ ψ' : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤), Commute (A s μ ψ) (A s' μ' ψ'))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    commutatorFam A ν μ s = - commutatorFam A μ ν s

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength_swap
entries.docstring:
The field strength is antisymmetric in its two covector indices when the symbols of
  the gauge field commute: the two derivative terms swap outright, the commutator term
  by `commutatorFam_swap`.
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrength_swap
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (hA : ∀ (s s' : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ μ' : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
      (ψ ψ' : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤), Commute (A s μ ψ) (A s' μ' ψ'))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    fieldStrength A ν μ s = - fieldStrength A μ ν s

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength_map
entries.docstring:
The field strength is natural in the algebra: a multiplicative linear map carries the
  field strength of a family to the field strength of its image.
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrength_map {B' : Type} [Ring B'] [Module ℝ B'] [SMulCommClass ℝ B' B']
    [IsScalarTower ℝ B' B'] (Φ : B →ₗ[ℝ] B') (hΦ : ∀ b₁ b₂, Φ (b₁ * b₂) = Φ b₁ * Φ b₂)
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    fieldStrength (fun p ρ => Φ ∘ₗ A p ρ) μ ν s = Φ ∘ₗ fieldStrength A μ ν s

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repGauge_fieldStrength
entries.docstring:
**The field strength transforms in the adjoint, at every derivative order**: under
  a gauge jet `U` every derivative symbol of `F_μν` transforms by the pure Leibniz
  convolution of the dual adjoint action over the multiset antidiagonal — the exact
  analogue of `gauge_apply_deriv` with *no* Maurer–Cartan shift, since the field
  strength transforms homogeneously. The `κ`-into-the-adjoint splittings of the
  derivative terms (`repGauge_cons_apply`) cancel the `ad` cross-term convolutions of
  the commutator (`repGauge_commutatorFam`) through the coassociativity and swap of
  the antidiagonal, and the derived Maurer–Cartan shifts cancel the bracket-shift
  convolution through the all-orders structural equation.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_fieldStrength
    (U : GJ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repGauge U (fieldStrength h.A μ ν s φ) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        fieldStrength h.A μ ν p.2 (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.transformsInAdjoint_fieldStrength
entries.docstring:
**The field strength is an adjoint gauge tensor**: the packaging of
  `repGauge_fieldStrength` as `TransformsInAdjoint` — the base case of the
  covariant-derivative recursion `TransformsInAdjoint.covDerivAdjoint`.
entries.snippet:
lemma transformsInAdjoint_fieldStrength
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : TransformsInAdjoint jets repGauge (fieldStrength h.A μ ν)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repGauge_fieldStrength_zero
entries.docstring:
The underived transformation law: at `s = 0` the Leibniz convolution collapses to
  the homogeneous law — the field strength transforms by the base-point dual adjoint
  action of `U⁻¹` on the adjoint index.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_fieldStrength_zero
    (U : GJ) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repGauge U (fieldStrength h.A μ ν 0 φ) =
      fieldStrength h.A μ ν 0 (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ 0 φ)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.dualPairEquiv
entries.docstring:
The canonical equivalence, through finite-dimensional duality, between
  algebra-valued fields `B ⊗ 𝔤` and their component families `φ ↦ A^φ`: the element
  `b ⊗ a` corresponds to the family `φ ↦ φ(a) b`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def dualPairEquiv :
    (B ⊗[ℝ] 𝔤) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.tensorBracket
entries.docstring:
The bracket of two algebra-valued fields: multiplication in `B` on the first
  factors, the Lie bracket of the gauge algebra on the second, so that on pure
  tensors `⁅b₁ ⊗ a₁, b₂ ⊗ a₂⁆ = (b₁ b₂) ⊗ ⁅a₁, a₂⁆`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def tensorBracket :
    (B ⊗[ℝ] 𝔤) →ₗ[ℝ] (B ⊗[ℝ] 𝔤) →ₗ[ℝ] B ⊗[ℝ] 𝔤

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.commutator
entries.docstring:
The commutator term `⁅A_μ, A_ν⁆` of the field strength, as a component family:
  the physicists' `f^a_{bc} A_μ^b A_ν^c` contracted with a dual adjoint vector, but
  basis-free — the two fields are assembled into `B ⊗ 𝔤` by `dualPairEquiv.symm`,
  bracketed there by `tensorBracket`, and read back out as components.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def commutator
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repGauge_apply
entries.docstring:
The gauge transformation of the underived symbol `A_μ^φ`: the special case `s = 0`
  of `gauge_apply_deriv`, with no Leibniz convolution left over — the dual adjoint
  action of the value of `U⁻¹` plus the Maurer–Cartan shift.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_apply (U : GJ)
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repGauge U (h.A 0 μ φ) = h.A 0 μ (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ ∅ φ) +
      algebraMap ℂ B (φ (jets.evalLie (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ μ)))

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repGauge_deriv_apply
entries.docstring:
The gauge transformation of the once-derived symbol `∂_ρ A_σ`: the case `s = {ρ}`
  of `gauge_apply_deriv` — the two Leibniz splittings of one derivative, plus the
  base-point value of the derived Maurer–Cartan form.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_deriv_apply
    (U : GJ) (ρ σ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repGauge U (h.A {ρ} σ φ) =
      h.A {ρ} σ (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ 0 φ) + h.A 0 σ (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ {ρ} φ) +
      algebraMap ℂ B (φ (jets.evalLie
        (jets.deriv ρ (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ σ))))

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.dualPairEquiv_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma dualPairEquiv_tmul (b : B) (a : 𝔤) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    dualPairEquiv (b ⊗ₜ[ℝ] a) φ = φ a • b

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.tensorBracket_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma tensorBracket_tmul (b₁ b₂ : B) (a₁ a₂ : 𝔤) :
    tensorBracket (b₁ ⊗ₜ[ℝ] a₁) (b₂ ⊗ₜ[ℝ] a₂) = (b₁ * b₂) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] ⁅a₁, a₂⁆

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.dualPairEquiv_map_left
entries.snippet:
lemma dualPairEquiv_map_left (Φ : B →ₗ[ℝ] B) (t : B ⊗[ℝ] 𝔤)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    dualPairEquiv ((TensorProduct.map Φ LinearMap.id) t) φ = Φ (dualPairEquiv t φ)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.dualPairEquiv_map_right
entries.snippet:
lemma dualPairEquiv_map_right (T : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] 𝔤)
    (t : B ⊗[ℝ] 𝔤) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    dualPairEquiv ((TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id T) t) φ =
      dualPairEquiv t (T.dualMap φ)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symm_comp_left
entries.snippet:
lemma symm_comp_left (Φ : B →ₗ[ℝ] B) (f : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    dualPairEquiv.symm (Φ ∘ₗ f) =
      (TensorProduct.map Φ LinearMap.id) (dualPairEquiv.symm f)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symm_comp_right
entries.snippet:
lemma symm_comp_right (T : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] 𝔤)
    (f : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    dualPairEquiv.symm (f ∘ₗ T.dualMap) =
      (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id T) (dualPairEquiv.symm f)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.tensorBracket_map_left
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorBracket_map_left (Φ : B →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (hΦ : ∀ b₁ b₂, Φ (b₁ * b₂) = Φ b₁ * Φ b₂) (s t : B ⊗[ℝ] 𝔤) :
    tensorBracket ((TensorProduct.map Φ LinearMap.id) s)
        ((TensorProduct.map Φ LinearMap.id) t) =
      (TensorProduct.map Φ LinearMap.id) (tensorBracket s t)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.tensorBracket_map_right
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorBracket_map_right (T : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] 𝔤)
    (hT : ∀ a b, T ⁅a, b⁆ = ⁅T a, T b⁆) (s t : B ⊗[ℝ] 𝔤) :
    tensorBracket ((TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id T) s)
        ((TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id T) t) =
      (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id T) (tensorBracket s t)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.tensorBracket_one_right
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorBracket_one_right (c : 𝔤) (s : B ⊗[ℝ] 𝔤) :
    tensorBracket s ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] c) =
      -(TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (LieAlgebra.ad ℝ 𝔤 c)) s

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.tensorBracket_one_left
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorBracket_one_left (c : 𝔤) (t : B ⊗[ℝ] 𝔤) :
    tensorBracket ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] c) t =
      (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (LieAlgebra.ad ℝ 𝔤 c)) t

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.dualPairEquiv_one_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma dualPairEquiv_one_tmul (c : 𝔤) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    dualPairEquiv ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] c) φ = algebraMap ℂ B (φ c)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repGauge_commutator
entries.docstring:
The gauge transformation law of the commutator term: writing the field law as
  `A_μ ↦ Ad₀ A_μ + c_μ` with `Ad₀` the base-point adjoint of `U₀⁻¹` and
  `c_μ = maurerCartan(U⁻¹)_μ|₀` the constant Maurer–Cartan shift, bilinearity of the bracket
  gives

  `⁅A_μ, A_ν⁆ ↦ Ad₀ ⁅A_μ, A_ν⁆ + ⁅Ad₀ A_μ, c_ν⁆ + ⁅c_μ, Ad₀ A_ν⁆ + ⁅c_μ, c_ν⁆`:

  the adjoint-transported commutator, two cross terms linear in the field (the
  bracket against `c` acting on the dual index through `ad`), and the constant
  commutator of the two Maurer–Cartan shifts. Uses that the gauge action is by
  algebra homomorphisms (`gauge_mul`) and that the base-point adjoint transport is a
  morphism of Lie algebras.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_commutator
    (U : GJ) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repGauge U (commutator h.A μ ν φ) =
      commutator h.A μ ν (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ 0 φ)
      - h.A 0 μ (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ 0 (φ ∘ₗ LieAlgebra.ad ℝ 𝔤
          (jets.evalLie (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ ν))))
      + h.A 0 ν (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ 0 (φ ∘ₗ LieAlgebra.ad ℝ 𝔤
          (jets.evalLie (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ μ))))
      + algebraMap ℂ B (φ ⁅jets.evalLie (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ μ),
          jets.evalLie (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ ν)⁆)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repGauge_deriv_deriv_apply
entries.docstring:
The gauge transformation of the twice-derived symbol `∂_ρ ∂_σ A_τ`: the case
  `s = ρ ::ₘ {σ}` of `gauge_apply_deriv` — the four Leibniz splittings of two
  derivatives, plus the base-point value of the twice-derived Maurer–Cartan form.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_deriv_deriv_apply
    (U : GJ) (ρ σ τ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repGauge U (h.A (ρ ::ₘ {σ}) τ φ) =
      h.A (ρ ::ₘ {σ}) τ (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ 0 φ)
      + h.A {ρ} τ (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ {σ} φ)
      + h.A {σ} τ (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ {ρ} φ)
      + h.A 0 τ (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ (ρ ::ₘ {σ}) φ)
      + algebraMap ℂ B (φ (jets.evalLie (jets.deriv ρ
          (jets.deriv σ (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ τ)))))

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam
entries.docstring:
The bracket of two arbitrary component families, generalizing `commutator` (which
  is the case of two field symbols): assemble into `B ⊗ 𝔤` by `dualPairEquiv.symm`,
  bracket by `tensorBracket`, read back out as components.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def bracketFam (f g : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.commutator_eq_bracketFam
entries.snippet:
lemma commutator_eq_bracketFam
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : commutator A μ ν = bracketFam (A 0 μ) (A 0 ν)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.commutatorFam
entries.docstring:
**The derived commutator family**: the `s`-derivative of the commutator term, given
  by the Leibniz convolution of the derivative symbols over the multiset antidiagonal.
  With the derivative symbols as primitives this convolution is the definition; for
  `s = 0` it is the commutator itself (`commutatorFam_zero`).
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def commutatorFam
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.commutatorFam_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma commutatorFam_zero
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : commutatorFam A μ ν 0 = commutator A μ ν

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_add_left
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFam_add_left (f₁ f₂ g : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    bracketFam (f₁ + f₂) g = bracketFam f₁ g + bracketFam f₂ g

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_add_right
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFam_add_right (f g₁ g₂ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    bracketFam f (g₁ + g₂) = bracketFam f g₁ + bracketFam f g₂

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_smul_left
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFam_smul_left (c : ℝ) (f g : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    bracketFam (c • f) g = c • bracketFam f g

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_smul_right
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFam_smul_right (c : ℝ) (f g : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    bracketFam f (c • g) = c • bracketFam f g

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_apply_eq_sum
entries.docstring:
The bracket of two component families expanded through a basis of the gauge
  algebra: the physicists' `f^a_{bc} f^b g^c`, with `φ⁅e_j, e_k⁆` the structure
  constants contracted with the dual vector.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFam_apply_eq_sum (f g : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    bracketFam f g φ = ∑ j, ∑ k,
      φ ⁅Module.Free.chooseBasis ℝ 𝔤 j,
          Module.Free.chooseBasis ℝ 𝔤 k⁆ •
        (f ((Module.Free.chooseBasis ℝ 𝔤).coord j) *
          g ((Module.Free.chooseBasis ℝ 𝔤).coord k))

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_apply_eq_zero_of_map_lie
entries.docstring:
A dual vector vanishing on every bracket of the gauge algebra, such as the coordinate of an
  abelian factor, vanishes on the bracket of any two families: every structure constant
  `φ⁅e_j, e_k⁆` it sees is zero.

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_map
entries.docstring:
The bracket of families is natural in the algebra: a multiplicative linear map carries
  the bracket of two families to the bracket of their images.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFam_map {B' : Type} [Ring B'] [Module ℝ B'] [SMulCommClass ℝ B' B']
    [IsScalarTower ℝ B' B'] (Φ : B →ₗ[ℝ] B') (hΦ : ∀ b₁ b₂, Φ (b₁ * b₂) = Φ b₁ * Φ b₂)
    (f g : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    bracketFam (Φ ∘ₗ f) (Φ ∘ₗ g) = Φ ∘ₗ bracketFam f g

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.commutatorFam_map
entries.docstring: The derived commutator family is natural in the algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma commutatorFam_map {B' : Type} [Ring B'] [Module ℝ B'] [SMulCommClass ℝ B' B']
    [IsScalarTower ℝ B' B'] (Φ : B →ₗ[ℝ] B') (hΦ : ∀ b₁ b₂, Φ (b₁ * b₂) = Φ b₁ * Φ b₂)
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    commutatorFam (fun p ρ => Φ ∘ₗ A p ρ) μ ν s = Φ ∘ₗ commutatorFam A μ ν s

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_comp_dualMap
entries.docstring: The bracket of families against a common Lie-algebra morphism on the dual index.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFam_comp_dualMap (T : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] 𝔤)
    (hT : ∀ a b, T ⁅a, b⁆ = ⁅T a, T b⁆) (f g : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    bracketFam (f ∘ₗ T.dualMap) (g ∘ₗ T.dualMap) = bracketFam f g ∘ₗ T.dualMap

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.tensorBracket_map_left_derivation
entries.docstring:
`tensorBracket` is a derivation in the algebra factor: for `Δ` satisfying the
  Leibniz rule on `B`, applying `Δ ⊗ id` to a bracket distributes over the two
  arguments.
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorBracket_map_left_derivation (Δ : B →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (hΔ : ∀ b₁ b₂, Δ (b₁ * b₂) = Δ b₁ * b₂ + b₁ * Δ b₂) (s t : B ⊗[ℝ] 𝔤) :
    (TensorProduct.map Δ LinearMap.id) (tensorBracket s t) =
      tensorBracket ((TensorProduct.map Δ LinearMap.id) s) t +
      tensorBracket s ((TensorProduct.map Δ LinearMap.id) t)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_derivation
entries.docstring:
The bracket of families under a derivation of the algebra: the Leibniz rule, in
  family form.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFam_derivation (Δ : B →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (hΔ : ∀ b₁ b₂, Δ (b₁ * b₂) = Δ b₁ * b₂ + b₁ * Δ b₂) (f g : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    Δ ∘ₗ bracketFam f g = bracketFam (Δ ∘ₗ f) g + bracketFam f (Δ ∘ₗ g)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.tensorBracket_map_right_derivation
entries.docstring:
`tensorBracket` under a relative derivation on the Lie factor: if
  `T₁ ⁅a, b⁆ = ⁅T₁ a, T₀ b⁆ + ⁅T₀ a, T₁ b⁆`, the two mixed brackets sum to the
  `T₁`-image of the bracket. This is how the once-derived adjoint transport
  distributes over the commutator.
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorBracket_map_right_derivation (T₀ T₁ : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] 𝔤)
    (hT : ∀ a b, T₁ ⁅a, b⁆ = ⁅T₁ a, T₀ b⁆ + ⁅T₀ a, T₁ b⁆) (s t : B ⊗[ℝ] 𝔤) :
    tensorBracket ((TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id T₁) s)
        ((TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id T₀) t) +
      tensorBracket ((TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id T₀) s)
        ((TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id T₁) t) =
      (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id T₁) (tensorBracket s t)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_dualMap_derivation
entries.docstring:
The family-level form of `tensorBracket_map_right_derivation`: a relative
  derivation on the dual index distributes over the bracket of families.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFam_dualMap_derivation (T₀ T₁ : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] 𝔤)
    (hT : ∀ a b, T₁ ⁅a, b⁆ = ⁅T₁ a, T₀ b⁆ + ⁅T₀ a, T₁ b⁆)
    (f g : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    bracketFam (f ∘ₗ T₁.dualMap) (g ∘ₗ T₀.dualMap) +
      bracketFam (f ∘ₗ T₀.dualMap) (g ∘ₗ T₁.dualMap) =
      bracketFam f g ∘ₗ T₁.dualMap

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repGauge_bracketFam
entries.docstring:
The gauge transformation of the bracket of two component families with affine
  transformation laws `f ↦ f' + φ(c_f)·1` and `g ↦ g' + φ(c_g)·1`: the bracket of the
  transformed families, two `ad` cross terms, and the constant bracket `⁅c_f, c_g⁆`.
  Pure bilinearity, with `tensorBracket_one_left/right` computing the cross terms;
  `repGauge_commutator` is the special case of two field symbols.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_bracketFam
    (U : GJ) {f g f' g' : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B}
    {cf cg : 𝔤}
    (hf : ∀ ψ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤,
      repGauge U (f ψ) = f' ψ + algebraMap ℂ B (ψ cf))
    (hg : ∀ ψ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤,
      repGauge U (g ψ) = g' ψ + algebraMap ℂ B (ψ cg))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repGauge U (bracketFam f g φ) =
      bracketFam f' g' φ
      + g' (φ ∘ₗ LieAlgebra.ad ℝ 𝔤 cf)
      - f' (φ ∘ₗ LieAlgebra.ad ℝ 𝔤 cg)
      + algebraMap ℂ B (φ ⁅cf, cg⁆)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.commutatorFam_mem
entries.docstring:
Every derived commutator term is a polynomial in derivative symbols of order at
  most that of the derivative: each Leibniz splitting contributes a product of two
  lower-order symbols.
entries.snippet:
lemma commutatorFam_mem
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (s' : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ν lam : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    commutatorFam A ν lam s' φ ∈
      Algebra.adjoin ℂ {b : B | ∃ (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
        (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤), p.card ≤ s'.card ∧ b = A p μ φ}

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_zero_left
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFam_zero_left (g : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    bracketFam 0 g = 0

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_zero_right
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFam_zero_right (f : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    bracketFam f 0 = 0

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_sum_left
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFam_sum_left (S : Multiset (Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B))
    (g : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    bracketFam S.sum g = (S.map fun f => bracketFam f g).sum

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_sum_right
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFam_sum_right (f : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (S : Multiset (Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)) :
    bracketFam f S.sum = (S.map fun g => bracketFam f g).sum

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_finset_sum_left
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFam_finset_sum_left {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) (g : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    bracketFam (∑ i ∈ S, f i) g = ∑ i ∈ S, bracketFam (f i) g

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_finset_sum_right
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFam_finset_sum_right {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι)
    (f : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) (g : ι → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    bracketFam f (∑ i ∈ S, g i) = ∑ i ∈ S, bracketFam f (g i)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.tensorBracket_map_right_antidiagonal
entries.docstring:
`tensorBracket` under an antidiagonal family of transports on the Lie factor:
  if `T x` distributes over the bracket as the antidiagonal convolution of the
  `T m`, so does `id ⊗ T x` over `tensorBracket`.
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorBracket_map_right_antidiagonal
    (T : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] 𝔤)
    (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (hT : ∀ a b : 𝔤, T x ⁅a, b⁆ =
      (x.antidiagonal.map fun p => ⁅T p.1 a, T p.2 b⁆).sum)
    (s t : B ⊗[ℝ] 𝔤) :
    (x.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
      tensorBracket ((TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (T p.1)) s)
        ((TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (T p.2)) t)).sum =
      (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (T x)) (tensorBracket s t)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_adjointDualCoeff
entries.docstring:
The bracket of families against an iterated dual adjoint coefficient: the
  antidiagonal convolution — the all-orders form of `bracketFam_comp_dualMap` and
  `bracketFam_dualMap_derivation`.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFam_adjointDualCoeff (U : GJ) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (f g : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    bracketFam f g (jets.adjointDualCoeff U x φ) =
      (x.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        bracketFam (f ∘ₗ jets.adjointDualCoeff U p.1)
          (g ∘ₗ jets.adjointDualCoeff U p.2) φ).sum

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repGauge_cons_apply
entries.docstring:
The `κ ::ₘ s` case of `gauge_apply_deriv` with the extra derivative traced through:
  the Leibniz splittings where `κ` stays a derivative, minus (by
  `LocalGaugeData.adjointDualCoeff_cons`) the splittings where `κ` hits the adjoint — an `ad` of the
  derived Maurer–Cartan form — plus the derived Maurer–Cartan shift.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_cons_apply
    (U : GJ) (κ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (τ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repGauge U (h.A (κ ::ₘ s) τ φ) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        h.A (κ ::ₘ p.2) τ (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum
      - (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          (p.1.antidiagonal.map fun q =>
            h.A p.2 τ (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ q.2
              (φ ∘ₗ LieAlgebra.ad ℝ 𝔤 (jets.evalLie
                (jets.iteratedDeriv q.1 (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ κ)))))).sum).sum
      + algebraMap ℂ B (φ (jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv (κ ::ₘ s)
          (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ τ))))

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repGauge_commutatorFam
entries.docstring:
The all-orders gauge transformation of the derived commutator term: the Leibniz
  convolution of the transformed commutator, the two `ad` cross-term convolutions,
  and the convolution of Maurer–Cartan bracket shifts. This is `repGauge_commutator`
  at every derivative order simultaneously; the regrouping of the four-fold splitting
  is `Multiset.sum_antidiagonal_exchange`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_commutatorFam
    (U : GJ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repGauge U (commutatorFam h.A μ ν s φ) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        commutatorFam h.A μ ν p.2 (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum
      + (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          (p.2.antidiagonal.map fun r =>
            h.A r.2 ν (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ r.1
              (φ ∘ₗ LieAlgebra.ad ℝ 𝔤 (jets.evalLie
                (jets.iteratedDeriv p.1 (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ μ)))))).sum).sum
      - (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          (p.1.antidiagonal.map fun q =>
            h.A q.2 μ (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ q.1
              (φ ∘ₗ LieAlgebra.ad ℝ 𝔤 (jets.evalLie
                (jets.iteratedDeriv p.2 (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ ν)))))).sum).sum
      + (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          algebraMap ℂ B (φ ⁅jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv p.1
              (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ μ)),
            jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv p.2
              (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ ν))⁆)).sum

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symmetrizedDeriv
entries.docstring:
The symmetrized derivative symbol `sym(∂_s A)^φ`: the average over the directions
  `μ ∈ s` of the symbols `∂_{s−μ} A_μ^φ`, so that the direction of the gauge field is
  symmetrized into the derivative multiset.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def symmetrizedDeriv (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) : B

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symmetrizedDeriv_singleton
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma symmetrizedDeriv_singleton (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) : symmetrizedDeriv ({μ}) A φ = A 0 μ φ

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symmetrizedDeriv_empty
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma symmetrizedDeriv_empty
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) : symmetrizedDeriv 0 A φ = 0

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.deriv_sub_symmetrizedDeriv_eq_sum
entries.docstring:
The symmetrization defect of a symbol: the average of its differences with the symbols
  in which one derivative direction has been exchanged with the field direction.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_sub_symmetrizedDeriv_eq_sum (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    A s μ φ - symmetrizedDeriv (μ ::ₘ s) A φ =
      ((1/(s.card + 1 : ℝ)) • ((s.map fun ν => A s μ φ - A (μ ::ₘ s - {ν}) ν φ).sum))

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symmetrizedDerivₗ
entries.docstring: The symmetrized symbols are linear in the dual index.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def symmetrizedDerivₗ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B where

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symmetrizedDeriv_eq_sum_coord
entries.docstring: The expansion of a symmetrized symbol in a basis of the gauge algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma symmetrizedDeriv_eq_sum_coord {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (bv : Module.Basis ι ℝ 𝔤)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    symmetrizedDeriv s A φ = ∑ j, φ (bv j) • symmetrizedDeriv s A (bv.coord j)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint
entries.docstring:
The iterated covariant derivative `𝒟_l F` of an adjoint family of derivative
  symbols along a *list* of directions: covariant derivatives do not commute (their
  commutator is an `ad F` term), so the iteration is order-dependent and indexed by a
  list. The result is again a family of derivative symbols; the underived covariant
  tower is its value at the empty multiset.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def iteratedCovDerivAdjoint
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →
      (Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) →
      Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B
  | [], F => F
  | ρ :: l, F => covDerivAdjoint A (iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l F) ρ

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_map
entries.docstring: The iterated covariant derivative is natural in the algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_map {B' : Type} [Ring B'] [Module ℝ B'] [SMulCommClass ℝ B' B']
    [IsScalarTower ℝ B' B'] (Φ : B →ₗ[ℝ] B') (hΦ : ∀ b₁ b₂, Φ (b₁ * b₂) = Φ b₁ * Φ b₂)
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    iteratedCovDerivAdjoint (fun p σ => Φ ∘ₗ A p σ) l (fun p => Φ ∘ₗ F p) =
      fun p => Φ ∘ₗ iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l F p

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength_map
entries.docstring:
The covariant tower of the field strength is natural in the algebra: the tower of the
  image family is the image of the tower.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength_map {B' : Type} [Ring B'] [Module ℝ B']
    [SMulCommClass ℝ B' B'] [IsScalarTower ℝ B' B'] (Φ : B →ₗ[ℝ] B')
    (hΦ : ∀ b₁ b₂, Φ (b₁ * b₂) = Φ b₁ * Φ b₂)
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    iteratedCovDerivAdjoint (fun p σ => Φ ∘ₗ A p σ) l
        (fieldStrength (fun p σ => Φ ∘ₗ A p σ) μ ν) 0 φ
      = Φ (iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l (fieldStrength A μ ν) 0 φ)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_apply_of_map_lie
entries.docstring:
At a dual vector vanishing on every bracket, such as the coordinate of an abelian factor,
  the iterated covariant derivative is the ordinary derivative along the multiset of its
  directions: no bracket correction survives at any order.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_apply_of_map_lie {φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤}
    (hφ : ∀ x y : 𝔤, φ ⁅x, y⁆ = 0)
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l F s φ = F (↑l + s) φ

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_apply_perm_of_map_lie
entries.docstring:
Hence at such a dual vector the covariant derivatives commute: the iterated covariant
  derivative depends only on the multiset of its directions.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_apply_perm_of_map_lie {φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤}
    (hφ : ∀ x y : 𝔤, φ ⁅x, y⁆ = 0)
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    {l l' : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)} (hl : l.Perm l') (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l F s φ = iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l' F s φ

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symbolsLE
entries.docstring: The derivative symbols `∂_p A_μ^φ` with at most `n` derivatives.
entries.snippet: abbrev symbolsLE (n : ℕ) : Set B

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symbols
entries.docstring: All derivative symbols `∂_p A_μ^φ`.
entries.snippet: abbrev symbols : Set B

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symSymbolsLE
entries.docstring: The symmetrized symbols `sym(∂_r A)^φ` with at least one and at most `n` derivatives.
entries.snippet: abbrev symSymbolsLE (n : ℕ) : Set B

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.towerLT
entries.docstring:
The covariant derivatives `𝒟_l F_{ν λ}^φ` of the field strength with fewer than `n`
  derivatives.
entries.snippet: abbrev towerLT (n : ℕ) : Set B

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.tower
entries.docstring: All covariant derivatives `𝒟_l F_{ν λ}^φ` of the field strength.
entries.snippet: abbrev tower : Set B

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symbolsLE_mono
entries.snippet: lemma symbolsLE_mono {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) : symbolsLE A n ⊆ symbolsLE A m

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symbolsLE_subset_symbols
entries.snippet: lemma symbolsLE_subset_symbols (n : ℕ) : symbolsLE A n ⊆ symbols A

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symSymbolsLE_mono
entries.snippet: lemma symSymbolsLE_mono {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) : symSymbolsLE A n ⊆ symSymbolsLE A m

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.towerLT_mono
entries.snippet: lemma towerLT_mono {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) : towerLT A n ⊆ towerLT A m

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.towerLT_subset_tower
entries.snippet: lemma towerLT_subset_tower (n : ℕ) : towerLT A n ⊆ tower A

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.adjoin_symbols_mono
entries.docstring: Symbol subalgebras are monotone in the order bound.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjoin_symbols_mono {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) :
    Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A n) ≤ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A m)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symmetrizedDeriv_mem_adjoin_symbolsLE
entries.docstring:
A symmetrized symbol with `r` derivatives is a polynomial in the symbols with fewer
  than `r` derivatives.
entries.snippet:
lemma symmetrizedDeriv_mem_adjoin_symbolsLE (r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    symmetrizedDeriv r A φ ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A (r.card - 1))

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_mem_adjoin_symbols
entries.docstring:
The bracket of two component families whose components are order-`n` symbol
  polynomials is again an order-`n` symbol polynomial, componentwise.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFam_mem_adjoin_symbols {n : ℕ} {f g : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B}
    (hf : ∀ ψ, f ψ ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A n))
    (hg : ∀ ψ, g ψ ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A n)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    bracketFam f g φ ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A n)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength_mem_adjoin_symbols
entries.docstring:
Every derivative symbol of the field strength is a symbol polynomial of order
  one higher than the number of derivatives.
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrength_mem_adjoin_symbols (q : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ν lam : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    fieldStrength A ν lam q φ ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A (q.card + 1))

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_sub_mem
entries.docstring:
Unitriangularity of the covariant tower: the covariant and plain derivative symbols of
  the field strength differ by a polynomial in lower-order symbols. Stated at every
  derivative multiset `s`, as needed for the induction: the covariant derivative shifts
  the family index.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_sub_mem (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ν lam : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l (fieldStrength A ν lam) s φ -
        fieldStrength A ν lam (Multiset.ofList l + s) φ ∈
      Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A (l.length + s.card))

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength_mem_adjoin_symbols
entries.docstring:
The underived covariant field-strength tower consists of polynomials in the
  gauge-field symbols.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength_mem_adjoin_symbols
    (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ν lam : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l (fieldStrength A ν lam) 0 φ ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbols A)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symbol_mem_symFieldAdjoin_sup
entries.docstring:
The inductive step of the generation theorem: every derivative symbol of order `n + 1`
  lies in the subalgebra generated by its symmetrization, the covariant derivatives of the
  field strength of order `n`, and the symbols of order at most `n`.
entries.snippet:
lemma symbol_mem_symFieldAdjoin_sup (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    A s μ φ ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symSymbolsLE A (s.card + 1) ∪ towerLT A s.card) ⊔
      Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A (s.card - 1))

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symbolAdjoin_eq_symFieldAdjoin
entries.docstring:
The generation theorem, by strong induction on the order: the derivative symbols of
  order at most `n` and the symmetrized symbols together with the covariant field-strength
  tower generate the same subalgebra,

  `adjoin({ ∂_p A : |p| ≤ n }) = adjoin({ sym(∂_p A) : |p| ≤ n + 1 } ∪ { 𝒟_q F : |q| < n })`.
entries.snippet:
lemma symbolAdjoin_eq_symFieldAdjoin (n : ℕ) :
    Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A n) =
      Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symSymbolsLE A (n + 1) ∪ towerLT A n)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symbolAdjoin_eq_symFieldAdjoin_top
entries.docstring:
The generation theorem, unbounded version: the derivative symbols of all orders, and
  the symmetrized symbols together with the full covariant field-strength tower, generate
  the same subalgebra of local expressions,

  `adjoin({ ∂_p A }) = adjoin({ sym(∂_p A) } ∪ { 𝒟_q F })`.
entries.snippet:
lemma symbolAdjoin_eq_symFieldAdjoin_top :
    Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbols A) =
      Algebra.adjoin ℂ ({b | ∃ (r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤),
        r ≠ 0 ∧ b = symmetrizedDeriv r A φ} ∪ tower A)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symbolAdjoin_union_eq_symFieldAdjoin_union
entries.docstring: The generation theorem relativized to an arbitrary set `S` of extra generators.
entries.snippet:
lemma symbolAdjoin_union_eq_symFieldAdjoin_union (n : ℕ) (S : Set B) :
    Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A n ∪ S) =
      Algebra.adjoin ℂ ((symSymbolsLE A (n + 1) ∪ towerLT A n) ∪ S)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.exists_le_of_mem_adjoin_symbols_union
entries.docstring:
Finite order bound: membership in the subalgebra generated by all symbols and `S`
  uses only finitely many generators, hence symbols of some bounded order.

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repGauge_symmetrizedDeriv
entries.docstring:
The gauge transformation of the symmetrized derivatives: averaging the transformation
  law `gauge_apply_deriv` of the individual derivative symbols over the multiset `s`, the
  homogeneous part is the symmetrized adjoint convolution and the inhomogeneous
  Maurer–Cartan shifts average to exactly the base-point value of the symmetrized
  Maurer–Cartan form of `U⁻¹`:

  `U • sym(∂_s h.A)^φ = (1/|s|) ∑_{μ ∈ s} ∑_{x+y=s−μ} ∂_y A_μ^{∂_x Ad*(U⁻¹) φ}`
  `                   + φ( sym(ω(U⁻¹))_s |₀ )`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_symmetrizedDeriv
    (U : GJ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repGauge U (symmetrizedDeriv s h.A φ) =
      (1/(s.card : ℝ)) • (s.map fun μ =>
        ((s - {μ}).antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          h.A p.2 μ (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum).sum
      + algebraMap ℂ B (φ (jets.evalLie (jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm U⁻¹ s)))

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repGauge_symmetrizedDeriv_truncationKer
entries.docstring:
The action of a pure jet on the symmetrized derivatives is through the symmetrized
  Maurer–Cartan data: for a gauge jet `U` with identity value, the inhomogeneous shift of
  `sym(∂_s h.A)^φ` is the pairing of `φ` with the symmetrized Maurer–Cartan coefficient of
  `U⁻¹` at `s`, the very data that classifies pure jets.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_symmetrizedDeriv_truncationKer
    (U : jets.truncationKer 0) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repGauge U.1 (symmetrizedDeriv s h.A φ) =
      (1/(s.card : ℝ)) • (s.map fun μ =>
        ((s - {μ}).antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          h.A p.2 μ (jets.adjointDualCoeff (U.1)⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum).sum
      + algebraMap ℂ B (φ (jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff U⁻¹ ⟨s, hs⟩))

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.exists_repGauge_symmetrizedDeriv_shift
entries.docstring:
The pure jets realize arbitrary translations of the symmetrized derivative
  coordinates: for any prescribed family `c` of gauge-algebra values there is a pure jet
  `U` whose action shifts every symmetrized symbol by exactly `φ (c s)`, by the freeness of
  the symmetrized Maurer–Cartan data.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_repGauge_symmetrizedDeriv_shift [jets.Free]
    (c : {r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) // r ≠ 0} → 𝔤) :
    ∃ U : jets.truncationKer 0,
      ∀ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (hs : s ≠ 0) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤),
        repGauge U.1 (symmetrizedDeriv s h.A φ) =
          (1/(s.card : ℝ)) • (s.map fun μ =>
            ((s - {μ}).antidiagonal.map fun p =>
              h.A p.2 μ (jets.adjointDualCoeff (U.1)⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum).sum
          + algebraMap ℂ B (φ (c ⟨s, hs⟩))

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repGauge_symmetrizedDeriv_translation
entries.docstring:
Pure translation: when all positive dual adjoint coefficients of `U⁻¹` below the order
  of `s` vanish, the adjoint convolution in the transformation of the symmetrized symbol
  collapses to the symbol itself, and the action is an honest translation by the
  symmetrized Maurer–Cartan coefficient.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_symmetrizedDeriv_translation
    (U : jets.truncationKer 0) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (hU : ∀ x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), x ≠ 0 → x.card < s.card →
      jets.adjointDualCoeff (U.1)⁻¹ x = 0)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repGauge U.1 (symmetrizedDeriv s h.A φ) =
      symmetrizedDeriv s h.A φ +
        algebraMap ℂ B (φ (jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff U⁻¹ ⟨s, hs⟩))

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.exists_translation_of_support
entries.docstring:
Realization of top-order translations: any coefficient family supported at exactly
  order `N` is realized by a pure jet trivial to order `N - 1`, by freeness of the
  symmetrized Maurer–Cartan data together with Maurer–Cartan triangularity.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_translation_of_support [jets.Free] (N : ℕ)
    (c : {r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) // r ≠ 0} → 𝔤) (hcN : ∀ r, r.1.card ≠ N → c r = 0) :
    ∃ U : jets.truncationKer 0,
      jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff U⁻¹ = c ∧
      ∀ x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), x ≠ 0 → x.card < N →
        jets.adjointDualCoeff (U.1)⁻¹ x = 0

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.smul_mem_center
entries.docstring: Real multiples of central elements are central.
entries.snippet:
lemma smul_mem_center (r : ℝ) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ Subring.center B) :
    r • x ∈ Subring.center B

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_mem_center
entries.docstring: The bracket of component families with central components is central.

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.commutatorFam_mem_center
entries.docstring: The derived commutator terms of central symbols are central.
entries.snippet:
lemma commutatorFam_mem_center
    (hc : ∀ (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤),
      A p μ φ ∈ Subring.center B)
    (ν lam : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength_mem_center
entries.docstring:
If the derivative symbols of the gauge field are central, so are all derivative symbols
  of the covariant derivatives of the field strength.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength_mem_center
    (hc : ∀ (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤),
      A p μ φ ∈ Subring.center B)
    (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ν lam : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l (fieldStrength A ν lam) s φ ∈ Subring.center B

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symmetrizedDeriv_mem_center
entries.docstring:
If the derivative symbols of the gauge field are central, so are the symmetrized
  symbols.
entries.snippet:
lemma symmetrizedDeriv_mem_center
    (hc : ∀ (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤),
      A p μ φ ∈ Subring.center B)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    symmetrizedDeriv s A φ ∈ Subring.center B

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.TransformsInAdjoint.repGauge_eq_of_mem_truncationKer_zero
entries.docstring:
Anything that transforms in the adjoint is invariant under the pure jets: at `s = 0`
  the transformation law is the dual adjoint action of the base-point value `U₀⁻¹ = 1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma TransformsInAdjoint.repGauge_eq_of_mem_truncationKer_zero
    {F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B}
    (hF : TransformsInAdjoint jets repGauge F) (U : jets.truncationKer 0)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) : repGauge U.1 (F 0 φ) = F 0 φ

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.transformsInAdjoint_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint
entries.docstring:
Every iterated covariant derivative of the field strength is an adjoint gauge tensor:
  the recursion of `TransformsInAdjoint.covDerivAdjoint` over the list of directions, from
  the base case `transformsInAdjoint_fieldStrength`.
entries.snippet:
lemma transformsInAdjoint_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (ν lam : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    TransformsInAdjoint jets repGauge
      (iteratedCovDerivAdjoint h.A l (fieldStrength h.A ν lam))

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repGauge_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength_of_mem_truncationKer_zero
entries.docstring: The covariant derivatives of the field strength are invariant under the pure jets.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength_of_mem_truncationKer_zero
    (U : jets.truncationKer 0)
    (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ν lam : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repGauge U.1 (iteratedCovDerivAdjoint h.A l (fieldStrength h.A ν lam) 0 φ) =
      iteratedCovDerivAdjoint h.A l (fieldStrength h.A ν lam) 0 φ

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repGauge_one
entries.docstring: The gauge action fixes the unit, being multiplicative and invertible.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_one (U : GJ) :
    repGauge U (1 : B) = 1

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repGaugeRingHom
entries.docstring:
The gauge action of a jet as a ring endomorphism of the algebra of local
  expressions.
entries.snippet: def repGaugeRingHom (U : GJ) : B →+* B where

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repGaugeRingHom_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repGaugeRingHom_apply (U : GJ) (x : B) :
    repGaugeRingHom h U x = repGauge U x

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.commute_of_mem_adjoin
entries.docstring: Commutation with a generating set extends to the generated subalgebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_of_mem_adjoin {X : Set B} {y : B} (hX : ∀ x ∈ X, Commute x y)
    {r : B} (hr : r ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ X) : Commute r y

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.commute_symmetrizedDeriv_right
entries.docstring:
Anything commuting with all gauge-field symbols commutes with the symmetrized
  symbols.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_symmetrizedDeriv_right {y : B}
    (hy : ∀ (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤),
      Commute y (A p μ φ))
    (r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    Commute y (symmetrizedDeriv r A φ)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.commute_symmetrizedDeriv
entries.docstring: For a bosonic gauge field the symmetrized symbols commute with each other.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_symmetrizedDeriv
    (hcomm : ∀ (p q : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
      (φ ψ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤), Commute (A p μ φ) (A q ν ψ))
    (r r' : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ φ' : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    Commute (symmetrizedDeriv r A φ) (symmetrizedDeriv r' A φ')

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.eq_zero_of_forall_sum_smul_pow_eq_zero
entries.docstring:
A `B`-valued polynomial function of one real variable that vanishes identically
  has vanishing coefficients: pair with real-linear functionals, which separate
  points, and use that a real polynomial vanishing everywhere is zero.

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.exists_polynomial_rep
entries.docstring:
Any element of the subalgebra generated by a subalgebra `R` and a single element `y`
  commuting with `R` is a polynomial in `y` with coefficients in `R`: the subalgebra is the
  image of `R[X]` under evaluation at `y`.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_polynomial_rep (R : Subalgebra ℂ B) (y : B) (hy : ∀ r ∈ R, Commute r y)
    {x : B} (hx : x ∈ R ⊔ Algebra.adjoin ℂ {y}) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (r : ℕ → B), (∀ k, r k ∈ R) ∧ x = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, r k * y ^ k

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.map_mul_pow_eq_sum
entries.docstring:
The binomial expansion of the translate of a single monomial `r * y ^ k` under an
  endomorphism fixing `r` and shifting `y` by a real scalar `t`.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_mul_pow_eq_sum (Φ : B →+* B) {r y : B} (hr : Φ r = r) {t : ℝ}
    (hy : Φ y = y + algebraMap ℂ B (t : ℂ)) (k : ℕ) :
    Φ (r * y ^ k) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), t ^ j • ((k.choose j : ℂ) • (r * y ^ (k - j)))

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.mem_of_translationInvariant_single
entries.docstring:
The single-variable extraction: an element of `R[y]` invariant under a family of ring
  endomorphisms fixing `R` pointwise and translating `y` by arbitrary real scalars lies in
  `R`. Invariance forces the top coefficient of any chosen polynomial representation to
  vanish, by expanding the translated polynomial in powers of the shift.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_translationInvariant_single (R : Subalgebra ℂ B) (y : B)
    (hy : ∀ r ∈ R, Commute r y) (Φ : ℝ → B →+* B)
    (hΦR : ∀ t : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ R, Φ t z = z)
    (hΦy : ∀ t : ℝ, Φ t y = y + algebraMap ℂ B (t : ℂ))
    {x : B} (hx : x ∈ R ⊔ Algebra.adjoin ℂ {y}) (hinv : ∀ t, Φ t x = x) : x ∈ R

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.mem_of_translationInvariant
entries.docstring:
The extraction theorem: if a family of ring endomorphisms fixes a subalgebra `R`
  pointwise and translates finitely many commuting elements `y i`, each commuting with
  `R`, by arbitrary prescribable scalars, then an element of the subalgebra generated by
  `R` and the `y i` that is invariant under the whole family lies in `R`. The variables are
  eliminated one at a time by `mem_of_translationInvariant_single`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_translationInvariant {ι : Type} [Fintype ι]
    (R : Subalgebra ℂ B) (y : ι → B)
    (hyR : ∀ i, ∀ r ∈ R, Commute r (y i)) (hyy : ∀ i j, Commute (y i) (y j))
    (Φ : (ι → ℝ) → (B →+* B)) (hΦR : ∀ t, ∀ z ∈ R, Φ t z = z)
    (hΦy : ∀ t i, Φ t (y i) = y i + algebraMap ℂ B (t i))
    {x : B} (hx : x ∈ R ⊔ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range y)) (hinv : ∀ t, Φ t x = x) :
    x ∈ R

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repGauge_eq_of_mem_adjoin_symSymbolsLE
entries.docstring:
h.A pure jet trivial to order `m` fixes every generator of order at most `m`: the
  symmetrized symbols with at most `m` derivatives, the covariant tower and `S`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_eq_of_mem_adjoin_symSymbolsLE {U : jets.truncationKer 0}
    (hU : ∀ x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), x ≠ 0 → x.card ≤ m →
      jets.adjointDualCoeff (U.1)⁻¹ x = 0)
    (hUsym : ∀ (r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (hr : r ≠ 0), r.card ≤ m →
      jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff U⁻¹ ⟨r, hr⟩ = 0)
    {z : B} (hz : z ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symSymbolsLE h.A m ∪ (tower h.A ∪ S))) :
    repGauge U.1 z = z

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.commute_symmetrizedDeriv_of_mem_adjoin_symSymbolsLE
entries.docstring: Every element of the order-`m` subalgebra commutes with every symmetrized symbol.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_symmetrizedDeriv_of_mem_adjoin_symSymbolsLE
    {z : B} (hz : z ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symSymbolsLE h.A m ∪ (tower h.A ∪ S)))
    (r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    Commute z (symmetrizedDeriv r h.A φ)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.topCoord
entries.docstring:
The top-order coordinates: the symmetrized symbols of order `m + 1` in the basis
  `bv`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def topCoord : Sym (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (m + 1) × ι → B

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.shiftFamily
entries.docstring: The shift family supported at order `m + 1` with coordinates `t` in the basis `bv`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def shiftFamily (t : Sym (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (m + 1) × ι → ℝ) :
    {r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) // r ≠ 0} → 𝔤

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.shiftFamily_eq_zero_of_card_ne
entries.snippet:
lemma shiftFamily_eq_zero_of_card_ne (t : Sym (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (m + 1) × ι → ℝ)
    (r : {r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) // r ≠ 0}) (hr : r.1.card ≠ m + 1) :
    shiftFamily m bv t r = 0

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.coord_shiftFamily
entries.snippet:
lemma coord_shiftFamily (t : Sym (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (m + 1) × ι → ℝ)
    (ps : Sym (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (m + 1)) (hp0 : (ps : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) ≠ 0) (j : ι) :
    bv.coord j (shiftFamily m bv t ⟨ps, hp0⟩) = t (ps, j)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.commute_topCoord_of_mem_adjoin_symSymbolsLE
entries.docstring: The top-order coordinates commute with the order-`m` subalgebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_topCoord_of_mem_adjoin_symSymbolsLE (p : Sym (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (m + 1) × ι)
    {z : B} (hz : z ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symSymbolsLE h.A m ∪ (tower h.A ∪ S))) :
    Commute z (topCoord h.A m bv p)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.mem_sup_adjoin_range_topCoord
entries.docstring:
An element of the order-`m + 1` subalgebra lies in the sup of the order-`m` subalgebra
  and the subalgebra generated by the top-order coordinates.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_sup_adjoin_range_topCoord {z : B}
    (hz : z ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symSymbolsLE h.A (m + 1) ∪ (tower h.A ∪ S))) :
    z ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symSymbolsLE h.A m ∪ (tower h.A ∪ S)) ⊔
      Algebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range (topCoord h.A m bv))

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repGauge_topCoord
entries.docstring:
The pure jet realizing the shift family `t` translates each top-order coordinate by
  the corresponding value of `t`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_topCoord {U : jets.truncationKer 0}
    (t : Sym (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (m + 1) × ι → ℝ)
    (hU1 : jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff U⁻¹ = shiftFamily m bv t)
    (hU2 : ∀ x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), x ≠ 0 → x.card < m + 1 →
      jets.adjointDualCoeff (U.1)⁻¹ x = 0)
    (p : Sym (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (m + 1) × ι) :
    repGauge U.1 (topCoord h.A m bv p) = topCoord h.A m bv p + algebraMap ℂ B ((t p : ℝ) : ℂ)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.mem_adjoin_symSymbolsLE_of_repGauge_eq
entries.docstring:
The descent: an element of the order-`m + 1` subalgebra fixed by all pure jets lies
  in the order-`m` subalgebra. The pure jets realizing the shift families at order
  `m + 1` fix the order-`m` subalgebra and translate the top-order coordinates by arbitrary
  real scalars, so `mem_of_translationInvariant` applies.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_adjoin_symSymbolsLE_of_repGauge_eq [jets.Free] {z : B}
    (hz : z ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symSymbolsLE h.A (m + 1) ∪ (tower h.A ∪ S)))
    (hzinv : ∀ U : jets.truncationKer 0, repGauge U.1 z = z) :
    z ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symSymbolsLE h.A m ∪ (tower h.A ∪ S))

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.invariant_mem_adjoin_fieldStrength
entries.docstring:
The classification of invariants: a gauge-invariant element of the subalgebra
  generated by the gauge-field symbols and a set `S` of `truncationKer 0`-fixed
  elements is a polynomial in the covariant derivatives of the field strength and the
  elements of `S`. Requires only that the gauge-field symbols commute with each other
  (the gauge field is bosonic) and with the elements of `S`, nothing about the rest
  of `B`, and no independence hypothesis.
entries.snippet:
lemma invariant_mem_adjoin_fieldStrength [jets.Free] (S : Set B)
    (hcS : ∀ (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
      (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤), ∀ y ∈ S, Commute y (h.A p μ φ))
    (hS : ∀ y ∈ S, ∀ U : jets.truncationKer 0, repGauge U.1 y = y)
    {x : B} (hx : x ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbols h.A ∪ S))
    (hinv : ∀ U : GJ, repGauge U x = x) :
    x ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (tower h.A ∪ S)

entries.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.invariant_mem_adjoin_fieldStrength
entries.docstring:
The classification of gauge invariants of the gauge-boson jet algebra: for a free
  package, a gauge-invariant element of the subalgebra generated by the gauge-field symbols
  `∂_s A_μ^φ` and a set `S` of elements fixed by the pure jets is a polynomial in the
  covariant derivatives of the field strength and the elements of `S`. This is the case of
  the identity realization; the commutation of `S` with the symbols is automatic in the
  commutative jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma invariant_mem_adjoin_fieldStrength [jets.Free] (S : Set (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤))
    (hS : ∀ y ∈ S, ∀ U : jets.truncationKer 0, complexRepJet jets U.1 y = y)
    {x : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤}
    (hx : x ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ ({b : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤 |
      ∃ (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤),
      b = gaugeField 𝔤 p μ φ} ∪ S))
    (hinv : ∀ U : GJ, complexRepJet jets U x = x) :
    x ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ ({b : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤 |
      ∃ (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ν lam : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤),
      b = GaugeAlgebraRealization.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint (gaugeField 𝔤) l
        (GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength (gaugeField 𝔤) ν lam) 0 φ} ∪ S)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.TransformsInAdjoint
entries.docstring:
A family of derivative symbols `F` *transforms in the adjoint* (is an adjoint gauge
  tensor) for the gauge representation `repGauge` when each symbol `[∂_s F^φ]`
  transforms by the Leibniz convolution of the dual adjoint coefficients against lower
  symbols — the shape of `gauge_apply_deriv` with no Maurer–Cartan shift. At `s = 0`
  this is the homogeneous law `U • F^φ = F^{Ad₀^* φ}`.
entries.snippet:
def TransformsInAdjoint (repGauge : Representation ℂ GJ B)
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) : Prop

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.TransformsInAdjoint.repGauge_zero
entries.docstring:
An adjoint gauge tensor transforms at the base point through the dual adjoint
  coefficient of the value of the gauge jet alone: the antidiagonal of the empty multiset
  has a single term.
entries.snippet:
lemma TransformsInAdjoint.repGauge_zero
    {F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B}
    (hF : TransformsInAdjoint jets repGauge F) (U : GJ) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repGauge U (F 0 φ) = F 0 (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ 0 φ)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFamConv
entries.docstring:
**The derived bracket family** `⁅A_ρ, F⁆`: the `s`-derivative of the bracket of the
  gauge field against a family, given by the Leibniz convolution of the derivative
  symbols over the multiset antidiagonal.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def bracketFamConv
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivAdjoint
entries.docstring:
The covariant derivative `∇_ρ F = [∂_ρ F] + ⁅A_ρ, F⁆` of an adjoint-valued family
  of derivative symbols: the extra derivative on the symbol plus the derived bracket
  against the gauge field. The gauge-algebra bracket carries the physicists' `i`, so
  in matrix terms this is `∂_ρ F + i [A_ρ, F]` — the adjoint-representation covariant
  derivative in the same `D = ∂ + i A` convention as the field strength. It preserves
  `TransformsInAdjoint` (`TransformsInAdjoint.covDerivAdjoint`).
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def covDerivAdjoint
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivAdjoint_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma covDerivAdjoint_apply
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    covDerivAdjoint A F ρ s φ = F (ρ ::ₘ s) φ + bracketFamConv A ρ F s φ

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivAdjoint_apply_of_map_lie
entries.docstring:
At a dual vector vanishing on every bracket the derived bracket term drops out and the
  covariant derivative is the ordinary one, `(∇_ρ F)^φ = ∂_ρ F^φ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma covDerivAdjoint_apply_of_map_lie {φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤}
    (hφ : ∀ x y : 𝔤, φ ⁅x, y⁆ = 0)
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    covDerivAdjoint A F ρ s φ = F (ρ ::ₘ s) φ

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFamConv_map
entries.docstring: The derived bracket family is natural in the algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFamConv_map {B' : Type} [Ring B'] [Module ℝ B'] [SMulCommClass ℝ B' B']
    [IsScalarTower ℝ B' B'] (Φ : B →ₗ[ℝ] B') (hΦ : ∀ b₁ b₂, Φ (b₁ * b₂) = Φ b₁ * Φ b₂)
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    bracketFamConv (fun p σ => Φ ∘ₗ A p σ) ρ (fun p => Φ ∘ₗ F p) s =
      Φ ∘ₗ bracketFamConv A ρ F s

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivAdjoint_map
entries.docstring: The covariant derivative is natural in the algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma covDerivAdjoint_map {B' : Type} [Ring B'] [Module ℝ B'] [SMulCommClass ℝ B' B']
    [IsScalarTower ℝ B' B'] (Φ : B →ₗ[ℝ] B') (hΦ : ∀ b₁ b₂, Φ (b₁ * b₂) = Φ b₁ * Φ b₂)
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    covDerivAdjoint (fun p σ => Φ ∘ₗ A p σ) (fun p => Φ ∘ₗ F p) ρ s =
      Φ ∘ₗ covDerivAdjoint A F ρ s

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.TransformsInAdjoint.repGauge_cons
entries.docstring:
If `F` transforms in the adjoint, so do its `κ ::ₘ s`-derived symbols with the
  extra derivative traced through `LocalGaugeData.adjointDualCoeff_cons`: the Leibniz splittings
  where `κ` stays a derivative, minus the convolution where `κ` hits the adjoint —
  an `ad` of the derived Maurer–Cartan form.
entries.snippet:
lemma TransformsInAdjoint.repGauge_cons
    {F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B}
    (hF : TransformsInAdjoint jets repGauge F)
    (U : GJ) (κ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repGauge U (F (κ ::ₘ s) φ) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        F (κ ::ₘ p.2) (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum
      - (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          (p.1.antidiagonal.map fun q =>
            F p.2 (jets.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ q.2
              (φ ∘ₗ LieAlgebra.ad ℝ 𝔤 (jets.evalLie
                (jets.iteratedDeriv q.1
                  (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ κ)))))).sum).sum

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.TransformsInAdjoint.repGauge_bracketFamConv
entries.docstring:
