entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.coe_covFieldStrength
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coe_covFieldStrength (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (covFieldStrength T l μ ν φ : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) = T.covDerivFieldStrength l μ ν φ

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.coe_covFermion
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coe_covFermion (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)) :
    (covFermion T i l φ : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) = T.covDerivFermion i l φ

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.coe_covConjFermion
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coe_covConjFermion (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))) :
    (covConjFermion T i l φ : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) = T.covDerivConjFermion i l φ

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.coe_covBoson
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coe_covBoson (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)) :
    (covBoson T j l φ : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) = T.covDerivBoson j l φ

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.coe_covConjBoson
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coe_covConjBoson (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))) :
    (covConjBoson T j l φ : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) = T.covDerivConjBoson j l φ

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.algHom_ext_towers
entries.docstring:
Two algebra maps out of the covariant field algebra agreeing on the five towers are
  equal. Like `GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.algHom_ext` this is uniqueness only.
entries.snippet:
lemma algHom_ext_towers {B : Type} [Semiring B] [Algebra ℂ B]
    {f g : ↥T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] B}
    (hF : ∀ (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤),
      f (covFieldStrength T l μ ν φ) = g (covFieldStrength T l μ ν φ))
    (hψ : ∀ (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)),
      f (covFermion T i l φ) = g (covFermion T i l φ))
    (hψc : ∀ (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))),
      f (covConjFermion T i l φ) = g (covConjFermion T i l φ))
    (hφ : ∀ (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)),
      f (covBoson T j l φ) = g (covBoson T j l φ))
    (hφc : ∀ (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))),
      f (covConjBoson T j l φ) = g (covConjBoson T j l φ)) : f = g

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_mem
entries.docstring:
The jet gauge group preserves the covariant field algebra: a jet carries each generator
  to a generator of the same tower.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_mem (U : GJ) {x : T.LocalFieldAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    T.repJet U x ∈ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_mem
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz group preserves the covariant field algebra under
  `GaugeFieldData.GaugeLorentzCompatible`: the generators mix among themselves.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_mem (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    {x : T.LocalFieldAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    T.repLorentzGroup Λ x ∈ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet
entries.docstring:
The action of the jet gauge group on the covariant field algebra, restricted from the
  local field algebra.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def repJet : Representation ℂ GJ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.coe_repJet
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coe_repJet (U : GJ) (x : T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    (repJet T U x : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) = T.repJet U x

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_apply_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_apply_mul (U : GJ) (x y : T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    repJet T U (x * y) = repJet T U x * repJet T U y

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The action of the Lorentz group on the covariant field algebra, restricted from the
  local field algebra under `GaugeFieldData.GaugeLorentzCompatible`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repLorentzGroup (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) :
    Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.coe_repLorentzGroup
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coe_repLorentzGroup (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (x : T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    (repLorentzGroup T hGL Λ x : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) = T.repLorentzGroup Λ x

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_apply_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_mul (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (x y : T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    repLorentzGroup T hGL Λ (x * y) = repLorentzGroup T hGL Λ x * repLorentzGroup T hGL Λ y

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repValue
entries.docstring:
The action of the ordinary gauge group on the covariant field algebra: the jet action at
  the constant jets.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def repValue : Representation ℂ G₀ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.coe_repValue
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coe_repValue (g : G₀) (x : T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    (repValue T g x : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) = T.repJet (jets.ofConstant g) x

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repValue_apply_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma repValue_apply_mul (g : G₀) (x y : T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    repValue T g (x * y) = repValue T g x * repValue T g y

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_eq_ofConstant_eval_of_mem
entries.docstring:
Under `GaugeFieldData.PureJetsActTrivially`, a jet acts on every element of the
  covariant field algebra as the constant jet of its value, stated in the local field
  algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_eq_ofConstant_eval_of_mem (hP : T.PureJetsActTrivially) (U : GJ)
    {x : T.LocalFieldAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    T.repJet U x = T.repJet (jets.ofConstant (jets.eval U)) x

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_eq_repValue_eval
entries.docstring:
Under `GaugeFieldData.PureJetsActTrivially`, the action of the jet gauge group on the
  covariant field algebra factors through evaluation: a jet acts as the constant jet of its
  value, so the derivatives of a gauge transformation act trivially on covariant
  expressions.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_eq_repValue_eval (hP : T.PureJetsActTrivially) (U : GJ)
    (x : T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) : repJet T U x = repValue T (jets.eval U) x

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repValue_covFieldStrength
entries.docstring:
The ordinary gauge group rotates the adjoint index of the field-strength tower through
  the dual adjoint action of the inverse.
entries.snippet:
lemma repValue_covFieldStrength (g : G₀) (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repValue T g (covFieldStrength T l μ ν φ)
      = covFieldStrength T l μ ν ((jets.adjoint g⁻¹).dualMap φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_covFieldStrength
entries.docstring: A jet acts on the field-strength tower through the value of its inverse alone.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_covFieldStrength (U : GJ) (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repJet T U (covFieldStrength T l μ ν φ)
      = covFieldStrength T l μ ν ((jets.adjoint (jets.eval U⁻¹)).dualMap φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_covFermion
entries.docstring:
A jet acts on the covariant tower of a fermionic species through the zeroth dual Taylor
  coefficient of its inverse on the value index.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_covFermion (U : GJ) (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)) :
    repJet T U (covFermion T i l φ)
      = covFermion T i l (repDualCoeff (T.fermion i).repJet U⁻¹ 0 φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_covConjFermion
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_covConjFermion (U : GJ) (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))) :
    repJet T U (covConjFermion T i l φ)
      = covConjFermion T i l
          (repDualCoeff (JetComponentSpace.repConj (T.fermion i).repJet) U⁻¹ 0 φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_covBoson
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_covBoson (U : GJ) (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)) :
    repJet T U (covBoson T j l φ) = covBoson T j l (repDualCoeff (T.boson j).repJet U⁻¹ 0 φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_covConjBoson
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_covConjBoson (U : GJ) (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))) :
    repJet T U (covConjBoson T j l φ)
      = covConjBoson T j l
          (repDualCoeff (JetComponentSpace.repConj (T.boson j).repJet) U⁻¹ 0 φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_covFieldStrength
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of the field-strength tower in the covariant field algebra: every
  covariant slot and both covector indices mix by the columns of the Lorentz matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covFieldStrength (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repLorentzGroup T hGL Λ (covFieldStrength T (List.ofFn l) μ ν φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ k, L[Λ] (p k) (l k)) •
          ∑ a, L[Λ] a μ • ∑ b, L[Λ] b ν • covFieldStrength T (List.ofFn p) a b φ

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_covFermion
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of the covariant tower of a fermionic species in the covariant field
  algebra: every covariant slot mixes by the columns of the Lorentz matrix and the value
  index transforms contragrediently.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covFermion (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)) :
    repLorentzGroup T hGL Λ (covFermion T i l φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ k, L[Λ] (p k) (l k)) •
          covFermion T i p ((T.fermion i).repLorentz.dual Λ φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_covConjFermion
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covConjFermion (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))) :
    repLorentzGroup T hGL Λ (covConjFermion T i l φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ k, L[Λ] (p k) (l k)) •
          covConjFermion T i p ((T.fermion i).repLorentz.conj.dual Λ φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_covBoson
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covBoson (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)) :
    repLorentzGroup T hGL Λ (covBoson T j l φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ k, L[Λ] (p k) (l k)) •
          covBoson T j p ((T.boson j).repLorentz.dual Λ φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_covConjBoson
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covConjBoson (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))) :
    repLorentzGroup T hGL Λ (covConjBoson T j l φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ k, L[Λ] (p k) (l k)) •
          covConjBoson T j p ((T.boson j).repLorentz.conj.dual Λ φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.includeCovConnection
entries.docstring:
The complexified covariant gauge-only algebra inside the local field algebra: the
  complexification of the real covariant subalgebra inclusion, followed by the connection
  inclusion.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def includeCovConnection :
    (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) →ₐ[ℂ] T.LocalFieldAlgebra

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.includeCovConnection_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma includeCovConnection_apply (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    T.includeCovConnection y
      = T.includeConnection (LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.complexVal 𝔤 y)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.includeCovConnection_one_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma includeCovConnection_one_tmul (x : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    T.includeCovConnection ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] x)
      = T.includeConnection ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (x : LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤))

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.includeCovConnection_injective
entries.docstring: The complexified covariant gauge-only algebra embeds in the local field algebra.
entries.snippet: lemma includeCovConnection_injective : Function.Injective T.includeCovConnection

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.range_includeCovConnection
entries.docstring: The range of the inclusion is the covariant gauge sector.
entries.snippet:
lemma range_includeCovConnection :
    T.includeCovConnection.range = T.CovSectorAlgebra {FieldCategory.gauge}

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.includeCovConnection_mem_covGaugeSector
entries.snippet:
lemma includeCovConnection_mem_covGaugeSector (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    T.includeCovConnection y ∈ T.CovSectorAlgebra {FieldCategory.gauge}

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.covGaugeSectorEquiv
entries.docstring:
The covariant gauge sector is the complexification of the covariant gauge-only algebra:
  the inclusion, corestricted to its range.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def covGaugeSectorEquiv :
    (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) ≃ₐ[ℂ] ↥(T.CovSectorAlgebra {FieldCategory.gauge})

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.coe_covGaugeSectorEquiv
entries.docstring: In the local field algebra the equivalence is the canonical inclusion.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coe_covGaugeSectorEquiv (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    (T.covGaugeSectorEquiv y : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) = T.includeCovConnection y

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.covGaugeSectorEquiv_symm_includeCovConnection
entries.docstring: The inverse recovers an element from its inclusion.
entries.snippet:
lemma covGaugeSectorEquiv_symm_includeCovConnection (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤)
    (hy : T.includeCovConnection y ∈ T.CovSectorAlgebra {FieldCategory.gauge}) :
    T.covGaugeSectorEquiv.symm ⟨T.includeCovConnection y, hy⟩ = y

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.coe_covGaugeSectorEquiv_one_tmul_covF
entries.docstring:
A generator, embedded with the scalar `1`, is the included tower element with the same
  derivative labels, spacetime indices and adjoint covector.
entries.snippet:
lemma coe_covGaugeSectorEquiv_one_tmul_covF (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (T.covGaugeSectorEquiv ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.covF 𝔤 l μ ν φ) :
        T.LocalFieldAlgebra) = T.covDerivFieldStrength l μ ν φ

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.coe_covGaugeSectorEquiv_one_tmul_covF_nil
entries.docstring: Zero covariant derivatives: the included field strength itself.
entries.snippet:
lemma coe_covGaugeSectorEquiv_one_tmul_covF_nil (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (T.covGaugeSectorEquiv ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.covF 𝔤 [] μ ν φ) :
        T.LocalFieldAlgebra)
      = T.includeConnection ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.fieldStrength 𝔤 μ ν φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.coe_covGaugeSectorEquiv_tmul
entries.docstring: `z ⊗ₜ x` maps to `z` times the image of `1 ⊗ₜ x`.
entries.snippet:
lemma coe_covGaugeSectorEquiv_tmul (z : ℂ) (x : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    (T.covGaugeSectorEquiv (z ⊗ₜ[ℝ] x) : T.LocalFieldAlgebra)
      = z • (T.covGaugeSectorEquiv ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] x) : T.LocalFieldAlgebra)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.covGaugeSectorEquiv_complexRepValue
entries.docstring:
The equivalence intertwines the complexified gauge-only action of the ordinary gauge
  group with the value action of the covariant gauge sector.
entries.snippet:
lemma covGaugeSectorEquiv_complexRepValue (g : G₀) (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    T.covGaugeSectorEquiv (LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.complexRepValue jets g y)
      = CovSectorAlgebra.repValue T {FieldCategory.gauge} g (T.covGaugeSectorEquiv y)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.covGaugeSectorEquiv_complexRepLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The equivalence intertwines the complexified gauge-only Lorentz action with the Lorentz
  action of the covariant gauge sector.
entries.snippet:
lemma covGaugeSectorEquiv_complexRepLorentzGroup (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible)
    (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    T.covGaugeSectorEquiv (LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.complexRepLorentzGroup 𝔤 Λ y)
      = CovSectorAlgebra.repLorentzGroup T {FieldCategory.gauge} hGL Λ
          (T.covGaugeSectorEquiv y)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv
entries.docstring:
Realizations of the covariant gauge sector are the real realizations of the covariant
  gauge-only algebra, the target keeping its complex actions restricted to `ℝ`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) :
    CovSectorAlgebra.Realization T {FieldCategory.gauge} hGL B repGauge repLorentz
      ≃ LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization jets B (repGauge.restrictScalars ℝ)
          (repLorentz.restrictScalars ℝ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv_toAlgHom
entries.snippet:
lemma covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv_toAlgHom
    (k : CovSectorAlgebra.Realization T {FieldCategory.gauge} hGL B repGauge repLorentz) :
    (T.covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv hGL k).toAlgHom
      = ((k.toAlgHom.comp T.covGaugeSectorEquiv.toAlgHom).restrictScalars ℝ).comp
          Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv_toAlgHom_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv_toAlgHom_apply
    (k : CovSectorAlgebra.Realization T {FieldCategory.gauge} hGL B repGauge repLorentz)
    (x : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    (T.covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv hGL k).toAlgHom x
      = k.toAlgHom (T.covGaugeSectorEquiv ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] x))

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv_F
entries.docstring:
The field-strength tower of the corresponding real realization is the sector tower,
  with the same derivative labels, spacetime indices and adjoint covector.
entries.snippet:
lemma covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv_F
    (k : CovSectorAlgebra.Realization T {FieldCategory.gauge} hGL B repGauge repLorentz)
    (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (T.covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv hGL k).F l μ ν φ
      = k.toAlgHom
          (T.covGaugeSectorEquiv ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.covF 𝔤 l μ ν φ))

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv_symm_toAlgHom
entries.snippet:
lemma covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv_symm_toAlgHom
    (h : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization jets B (repGauge.restrictScalars ℝ)
      (repLorentz.restrictScalars ℝ)) :
    ((T.covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv hGL).symm h).toAlgHom
      = (AlgHom.liftEquiv ℝ ℂ (LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) B h.toAlgHom).comp
          T.covGaugeSectorEquiv.symm.toAlgHom

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv_symm_toAlgHom_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv_symm_toAlgHom_apply
    (h : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization jets B (repGauge.restrictScalars ℝ)
      (repLorentz.restrictScalars ℝ)) (x : T.CovSectorAlgebra {FieldCategory.gauge}) :
    ((T.covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv hGL).symm h).toAlgHom x
      = AlgHom.liftEquiv ℝ ℂ (LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra 𝔤) B h.toAlgHom
          (T.covGaugeSectorEquiv.symm x)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv_symm_toAlgHom_covF
entries.docstring:
The sector towers of the corresponding sector realization are the tower of the real
  realization; at `l = []` this is the field strength.
entries.snippet:
lemma covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv_symm_toAlgHom_covF
    (h : LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.Realization jets B (repGauge.restrictScalars ℝ)
      (repLorentz.restrictScalars ℝ)) (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    ((T.covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv hGL).symm h).toAlgHom
        (T.covGaugeSectorEquiv ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] LocalGaugeCovFieldAlgebra.covF 𝔤 l μ ν φ))
      = h.F l μ ν φ

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv_restrictCovSector
entries.docstring:
Restricting a realization of the local field algebra to the covariant gauge sector and
  passing to the gauge-only side gives the covariant restriction of its ordinary gauge-only
  realization.
entries.snippet:
lemma covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv_restrictCovSector
    {repJet : Representation ℂ GJ B} (h : Realization T B repJet repLorentz) :
    T.covGaugeSectorRealizationEquiv hGL (h.restrictCovSector hGL {FieldCategory.gauge})
      = (T.gaugeSectorRealizationEquiv (h.restrictSector {FieldCategory.gauge})).restrict

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization
entries.docstring:
A complex algebra `B` carrying the covariant expressions of the datum `T`: a complex
  algebra map out of the covariant field algebra, equivariant for the ordinary gauge group
  and the Lorentz group, both acting on the whole of `B` by algebra endomorphisms. The
  Lorentz action of the source needs `GaugeFieldData.GaugeLorentzCompatible`, which is a
  parameter; no other species condition is used. It is built from the fields `toAlgHom`,
  `map_fst`, `map_snd`, `fst_mul`, `snd_mul` of `Representation.EquivariantAlgHom`, which
  the lemmas `map_repValue`, `map_repLorentz`, `repGauge_mul` and `repLorentz_mul` name.
entries.snippet:
abbrev Realization (T : GaugeFieldData jets) (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) (B : Type)
    [Semiring B] [Algebra ℂ B] (repGauge : Representation ℂ G₀ B)
    (repLorentz : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) B)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.id
entries.docstring: The covariant field algebra realized in itself, by the identity.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def id : Realization T hGL (↥T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) (repValue T)
    (repLorentzGroup T hGL)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.id_toAlgHom
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma id_toAlgHom : (id T hGL).toAlgHom = AlgHom.id ℂ ↥T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.map_repValue
entries.docstring: The map is equivariant for the ordinary gauge group.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_repValue (g : G₀) (x : ↥T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    k.toAlgHom (repValue T g x) = repGauge g (k.toAlgHom x)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.map_repLorentz
entries.docstring: The map is equivariant for the Lorentz group.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_repLorentz (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x : ↥T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    k.toAlgHom (repLorentzGroup T hGL Λ x) = repLorentz Λ (k.toAlgHom x)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.repGauge_mul
entries.docstring: The ordinary gauge group acts on the whole of `B` by algebra endomorphisms.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_mul (g : G₀) (b₁ b₂ : B) :
    repGauge g (b₁ * b₂) = repGauge g b₁ * repGauge g b₂

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.repLorentz_mul
entries.docstring: The Lorentz group acts on the whole of `B` by algebra endomorphisms.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_mul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (b₁ b₂ : B) :
    repLorentz Λ (b₁ * b₂) = repLorentz Λ b₁ * repLorentz Λ b₂

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.fieldStrength
entries.docstring: The realized field-strength tower `∇_l F_μν^φ`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fieldStrength (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) : B

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.fermion
entries.docstring: The realized covariant tower `∇_l ψ^φ` of a fermionic species.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fermion (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i) →ₗ[ℂ] B

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.conjFermion
entries.docstring: The realized conjugate covariant tower of a fermionic species.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def conjFermion (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i)) →ₗ[ℂ] B

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.boson
entries.docstring: The realized covariant tower of a bosonic species.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def boson (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j) →ₗ[ℂ] B

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.conjBoson
entries.docstring: The realized conjugate covariant tower of a bosonic species.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def conjBoson (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j)) →ₗ[ℂ] B

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.fermion_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma fermion_apply (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)) :
    k.fermion i l φ = k.toAlgHom (covFermion T i l φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.conjFermion_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma conjFermion_apply (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))) :
    k.conjFermion i l φ = k.toAlgHom (covConjFermion T i l φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.boson_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma boson_apply (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)) :
    k.boson j l φ = k.toAlgHom (covBoson T j l φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.conjBoson_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma conjBoson_apply (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))) :
    k.conjBoson j l φ = k.toAlgHom (covConjBoson T j l φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.id_fermion
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma id_fermion (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    (id T hGL).fermion i l = covFermion T i l

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.id_fieldStrength
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma id_fieldStrength (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (id T hGL).fieldStrength l μ ν = covFieldStrength T l μ ν

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.ext_towers
entries.docstring:
Two realizations with the same five towers are equal. This is uniqueness only: the
  covariant field algebra is not free on its towers, so an assignment of the tower images
  does not by itself define a realization.
entries.snippet:
lemma ext_towers {k₁ k₂ : Realization T hGL B repGauge repLorentz}
    (hF : ∀ (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤),
      k₁.fieldStrength l μ ν φ = k₂.fieldStrength l μ ν φ)
    (hψ : ∀ (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)), k₁.fermion i l φ = k₂.fermion i l φ)
    (hψc : ∀ (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))),
      k₁.conjFermion i l φ = k₂.conjFermion i l φ)
    (hφ : ∀ (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)), k₁.boson j l φ = k₂.boson j l φ)
    (hφc : ∀ (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))),
      k₁.conjBoson j l φ = k₂.conjBoson j l φ) : k₁ = k₂

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.gauge_fieldStrength
entries.docstring:
The gauge law of the realized field-strength tower: the adjoint index rotates through
  the dual adjoint action of the inverse.
entries.snippet:
lemma gauge_fieldStrength (g : G₀) (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repGauge g (k.fieldStrength l μ ν φ)
      = k.fieldStrength l μ ν ((jets.adjoint g⁻¹).dualMap φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.gauge_fermion
entries.docstring:
The gauge law of a realized matter tower: the value index rotates through the zeroth
  dual Taylor coefficient of the inverse constant jet.
entries.snippet:
lemma gauge_fermion (g : G₀) (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)) :
    repGauge g (k.fermion i l φ)
      = k.fermion i l (repDualCoeff (T.fermion i).repJet (jets.ofConstant g)⁻¹ 0 φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.gauge_conjFermion
entries.snippet:
lemma gauge_conjFermion (g : G₀) (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))) :
    repGauge g (k.conjFermion i l φ) = k.conjFermion i l
      (repDualCoeff (JetComponentSpace.repConj (T.fermion i).repJet)
        (jets.ofConstant g)⁻¹ 0 φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.gauge_boson
entries.snippet:
lemma gauge_boson (g : G₀) (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)) :
    repGauge g (k.boson j l φ)
      = k.boson j l (repDualCoeff (T.boson j).repJet (jets.ofConstant g)⁻¹ 0 φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.gauge_conjBoson
entries.snippet:
lemma gauge_conjBoson (g : G₀) (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))) :
    repGauge g (k.conjBoson j l φ) = k.conjBoson j l
      (repDualCoeff (JetComponentSpace.repConj (T.boson j).repJet)
        (jets.ofConstant g)⁻¹ 0 φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.lorentz_fieldStrength
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of the realized field-strength tower: every covariant slot and both
  covector indices mix by the columns of the Lorentz matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentz_fieldStrength (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repLorentz Λ (k.fieldStrength (List.ofFn l) μ ν φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ a, L[Λ] (p a) (l a)) •
          ∑ a, L[Λ] a μ • ∑ b, L[Λ] b ν • k.fieldStrength (List.ofFn p) a b φ

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.lorentz_fermion
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of a realized matter tower: every covariant slot mixes by the columns of
  the Lorentz matrix and the value index transforms contragrediently.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentz_fermion (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)) :
    repLorentz Λ (k.fermion i l φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ a, L[Λ] (p a) (l a)) •
          k.fermion i p ((T.fermion i).repLorentz.dual Λ φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.lorentz_conjFermion
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentz_conjFermion (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))) :
    repLorentz Λ (k.conjFermion i l φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ a, L[Λ] (p a) (l a)) •
          k.conjFermion i p ((T.fermion i).repLorentz.conj.dual Λ φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.lorentz_boson
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentz_boson (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)) :
    repLorentz Λ (k.boson j l φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ a, L[Λ] (p a) (l a)) •
          k.boson j p ((T.boson j).repLorentz.dual Λ φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.lorentz_conjBoson
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentz_conjBoson (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))) :
    repLorentz Λ (k.conjBoson j l φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ a, L[Λ] (p a) (l a)) •
          k.conjBoson j p ((T.boson j).repLorentz.conj.dual Λ φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.Realization.restrict
entries.docstring:
The restriction of a realization of the local field algebra to the covariant field
  algebra, along the inclusion; the ordinary gauge group acts on the target through the
  constant jets. No species condition beyond `hGL` is used.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def restrict :
    LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization T hGL B (repJet.comp jets.ofConstant) repLorentz

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.Realization.restrict_toAlgHom
entries.snippet: lemma restrict_toAlgHom : (h.restrict hGL).toAlgHom = h.toAlgHom.comp T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.val

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.Realization.restrict_toAlgHom_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_toAlgHom_apply (x : ↥T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    (h.restrict hGL).toAlgHom x = h.toAlgHom x

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.Realization.restrict_id_toAlgHom
entries.snippet:
lemma restrict_id_toAlgHom :
    ((id T).restrict hGL).toAlgHom = T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.val

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.Realization.restrict_fieldStrength
entries.snippet:
lemma restrict_fieldStrength (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (h.restrict hGL).fieldStrength l μ ν φ = h.toAlgHom (T.covDerivFieldStrength l μ ν φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.Realization.restrict_fermion
entries.snippet:
lemma restrict_fermion (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)) :
    (h.restrict hGL).fermion i l φ = h.toAlgHom (T.covDerivFermion i l φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.Realization.restrict_conjFermion
entries.snippet:
lemma restrict_conjFermion (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))) :
    (h.restrict hGL).conjFermion i l φ = h.toAlgHom (T.covDerivConjFermion i l φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.Realization.restrict_boson
entries.snippet:
lemma restrict_boson (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)) :
    (h.restrict hGL).boson j l φ = h.toAlgHom (T.covDerivBoson j l φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.Realization.restrict_conjBoson
entries.snippet:
lemma restrict_conjBoson (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))) :
    (h.restrict hGL).conjBoson j l φ = h.toAlgHom (T.covDerivConjBoson j l φ)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.Realization.restrict_fieldStrength_eq_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint
entries.docstring:
The field-strength tower of a restriction is the covariant tower of the realized
  gauge-boson symbols.
entries.snippet:
lemma restrict_fieldStrength_eq_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    (h.restrict hGL).fieldStrength l μ ν φ
      = GaugeAlgebraRealization.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint h.gaugeRealization.A l
        (GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength h.gaugeRealization.A μ ν) 0 φ

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.Realization.restrict_fermion_eq_covDerivIter
entries.docstring:
A matter tower of a restriction is the covariant tower of the realized symbols of the
  species, computed against the realized gauge-boson symbols.
entries.snippet:
lemma restrict_fermion_eq_covDerivIter (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)) :
    (h.restrict hGL).fermion i l φ
      = GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivIter h.gaugeRealization.A (T.fermion i).repAlgebra
        (h.fermionSymbol i) n l 0 φ

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.Realization.restrict_conjFermion_eq_covDerivIter
entries.snippet:
lemma restrict_conjFermion_eq_covDerivIter (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))) :
    (h.restrict hGL).conjFermion i l φ
      = GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivIter h.gaugeRealization.A
        (LocalGaugeData.actionConj (T.fermion i).repAlgebra) (h.conjFermionSymbol i) n l 0 φ

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.Realization.restrict_boson_eq_covDerivIter
entries.snippet:
lemma restrict_boson_eq_covDerivIter (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)) :
    (h.restrict hGL).boson j l φ
      = GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivIter h.gaugeRealization.A (T.boson j).repAlgebra
        (h.bosonSymbol j) n l 0 φ

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.Realization.restrict_conjBoson_eq_covDerivIter
entries.snippet:
lemma restrict_conjBoson_eq_covDerivIter (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))) :
    (h.restrict hGL).conjBoson j l φ
      = GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivIter h.gaugeRealization.A
        (LocalGaugeData.actionConj (T.boson j).repAlgebra) (h.conjBosonSymbol j) n l 0 φ

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.Realization.restrict_map_repJet
entries.docstring: Full jet equivariance survives restriction, with no species condition.
entries.snippet:
lemma restrict_map_repJet (U : GJ) (x : ↥T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    (h.restrict hGL).toAlgHom (LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet T U x)
      = repJet U ((h.restrict hGL).toAlgHom x)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.Realization.repJet_restrict_toAlgHom
entries.docstring:
Under `GaugeFieldData.PureJetsActTrivially`, a jet acts on the realized covariant image
  as the constant jet of its value; nothing is assumed about the jet action elsewhere in
  `B`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_restrict_toAlgHom (hP : T.PureJetsActTrivially) (U : GJ)
    (x : ↥T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    repJet U ((h.restrict hGL).toAlgHom x)
      = repJet (jets.ofConstant (jets.eval U)) ((h.restrict hGL).toAlgHom x)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.Realization.map_repJet
entries.docstring:
Under `GaugeFieldData.PureJetsActTrivially`, a covariant realization intertwines the
  source jet action with the target action of the ordinary gauge group at the value of the
  jet.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_repJet (k : Realization T hGL B repGauge repLorentz) (hP : T.PureJetsActTrivially)
    (U : GJ) (x : ↥T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    k.toAlgHom (repJet T U x) = repGauge (jets.eval U) (k.toAlgHom x)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.covCategoryGenerators
entries.docstring: The covariant generators of one field category.
entries.snippet:
def covCategoryGenerators : FieldCategory → Set T.LocalFieldAlgebra
  | .fermion => ⋃ i, ⋃ n : ℕ, ⋃ l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
      Set.range (T.covDerivFermion i l) ∪ Set.range (T.covDerivConjFermion i l)
  | .gauge => ⋃ l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), ⋃ μ, ⋃ ν, Set.range (T.covDerivFieldStrength l μ ν)
  | .scalar => ⋃ j, ⋃ n : ℕ, ⋃ l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
      Set.range (T.covDerivBoson j l) ∪ Set.range (T.covDerivConjBoson j l)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.CovSectorAlgebra.induction
entries.docstring:
A property holding on the selected towers and the scalars and closed under sums and
  products holds on the covariant sector algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma induction {P : T.LocalFieldAlgebra → Prop} {x : T.LocalFieldAlgebra}
    (hx : x ∈ T.CovSectorAlgebra S)
    (hF : FieldCategory.gauge ∈ S → ∀ (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
      (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤), P (T.covDerivFieldStrength l μ ν φ))
    (hψ : FieldCategory.fermion ∈ S → ∀ (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ}
      (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)),
      P (T.covDerivFermion i l φ))
    (hψc : FieldCategory.fermion ∈ S → ∀ (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ}
      (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))),
      P (T.covDerivConjFermion i l φ))
    (hφ : FieldCategory.scalar ∈ S → ∀ (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ}
      (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)),
      P (T.covDerivBoson j l φ))
    (hφc : FieldCategory.scalar ∈ S → ∀ (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ}
      (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))),
      P (T.covDerivConjBoson j l φ))
    (halg : ∀ z : ℂ, P (z • (1 : T.LocalFieldAlgebra)))
    (hadd : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (hmul : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x * y)) : P x

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.CovSectorAlgebra.algHom_ext
entries.docstring:
Two algebra maps out of a covariant sector algebra agreeing on the selected towers
  are equal. This is uniqueness only: the algebra is not free on its towers, so an
  assignment on them need not extend to a map.
entries.snippet:
lemma algHom_ext {B : Type} [Semiring B] [Algebra ℂ B]
    {f g : ↥(T.CovSectorAlgebra S) →ₐ[ℂ] B}
    (hF : ∀ (hS : FieldCategory.gauge ∈ S) (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
      (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤),
      f ⟨T.covDerivFieldStrength l μ ν φ, covDerivFieldStrength_mem hS l μ ν φ⟩
        = g ⟨T.covDerivFieldStrength l μ ν φ, covDerivFieldStrength_mem hS l μ ν φ⟩)
    (hψ : ∀ (hS : FieldCategory.fermion ∈ S) (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ}
      (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)),
      f ⟨T.covDerivFermion i l φ, covDerivFermion_mem hS i l φ⟩
        = g ⟨T.covDerivFermion i l φ, covDerivFermion_mem hS i l φ⟩)
    (hψc : ∀ (hS : FieldCategory.fermion ∈ S) (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ}
      (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))),
      f ⟨T.covDerivConjFermion i l φ, covDerivConjFermion_mem hS i l φ⟩
        = g ⟨T.covDerivConjFermion i l φ, covDerivConjFermion_mem hS i l φ⟩)
    (hφ : ∀ (hS : FieldCategory.scalar ∈ S) (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ}
      (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)),
      f ⟨T.covDerivBoson j l φ, covDerivBoson_mem hS j l φ⟩
        = g ⟨T.covDerivBoson j l φ, covDerivBoson_mem hS j l φ⟩)
    (hφc : ∀ (hS : FieldCategory.scalar ∈ S) (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ}
      (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))),
      f ⟨T.covDerivConjBoson j l φ, covDerivConjBoson_mem hS j l φ⟩
        = g ⟨T.covDerivConjBoson j l φ, covDerivConjBoson_mem hS j l φ⟩) : f = g

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.CovSectorAlgebra.Realization
entries.docstring:
A complex algebra `B` carrying the covariant sector `S` of the datum `T`: a complex
  algebra map out of the covariant sector algebra, equivariant for the ordinary gauge group
  and the Lorentz group, both acting on the whole of `B` by algebra endomorphisms. The source
  Lorentz action needs `hGL`; no other species condition is used. The lemmas `map_repValue`,
  `map_repLorentz`, `repGauge_mul` and `repLorentz_mul` name its fields.
entries.snippet:
abbrev Realization (T : GaugeFieldData jets) (S : Finset FieldCategory)
    (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) (B : Type) [Semiring B] [Algebra ℂ B]
    (repGauge : Representation ℂ G₀ B) (repLorentz : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) B)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.CovSectorAlgebra.Realization.id
entries.docstring: A covariant sector algebra realized in itself, by the identity.

@[simp]
lemma id_toAlgHom : (id T S hGL).toAlgHom = AlgHom.id ℂ (T.CovSectorAlgebra S)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.CovSectorAlgebra.Realization.map_repValue
entries.snippet:
lemma map_repValue (g : G₀) (x : T.CovSectorAlgebra S) :
    k.toAlgHom (repValue T S g x) = repGauge g (k.toAlgHom x)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.CovSectorAlgebra.Realization.map_repLorentz
entries.snippet:
lemma map_repLorentz (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x : T.CovSectorAlgebra S) :
    k.toAlgHom (repLorentzGroup T S hGL Λ x) = repLorentz Λ (k.toAlgHom x)
