      (T.fermion i).repLorentz (T.fermionSymbol i)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.isLorentzDerivTransforms_conjFermionSymbol
entries.docstring:
The conjugate symbols of a fermionic species transform as the derivative symbols of a
  field in the conjugate of the Lorentz representation of the species.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzDerivTransforms_conjFermionSymbol (i : T.FermionSpecies) :
    IsLorentzDerivTransforms (A := T.LocalFieldAlgebra) T.repLorentzGroup
      (T.fermion i).repLorentz.conj (T.conjFermionSymbol i)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.isLorentzDerivTransforms_bosonSymbol
entries.docstring:
The symbols of a bosonic species transform as the derivative symbols of a field in the
  Lorentz representation of the species.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzDerivTransforms_bosonSymbol (j : T.BosonSpecies) :
    IsLorentzDerivTransforms (A := T.LocalFieldAlgebra) T.repLorentzGroup
      (T.boson j).repLorentz (T.bosonSymbol j)

entries.name: GaugeFieldData.isLorentzDerivTransforms_conjBosonSymbol
entries.docstring:
The conjugate symbols of a bosonic species transform as the derivative symbols of a
  field in the conjugate of the Lorentz representation of the species.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzDerivTransforms_conjBosonSymbol (j : T.BosonSpecies) :
    IsLorentzDerivTransforms (A := T.LocalFieldAlgebra) T.repLorentzGroup
      (T.boson j).repLorentz.conj (T.conjBosonSymbol j)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.adjointCoeff
entries.docstring:
The physicists' `∂_x (Ad_U)^a_b|₀`: include a constant gauge algebra element into
  jets, act by the adjoint of `U`, differentiate `x` times, and evaluate at the base
  point. For `x = 0` this is the adjoint action of the value of `U`; for `x ≠ 0` it sees
  the derivatives of the gauge transformation.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def adjointCoeff (U : GJ) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] 𝔤

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.adjointCoeff_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointCoeff_apply (U : GJ) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : 𝔤) :
    jets.adjointCoeff U x a =
      jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv x (jets.adjointJ U (jets.ofConstantLie a)))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.adjointCoeff_zero
entries.docstring: The zeroth coefficient is the adjoint action of the value of the jet.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma adjointCoeff_zero (U : GJ) : jets.adjointCoeff U 0 = jets.adjoint (jets.eval U)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.adjointCoeff_zero_of_eval_eq_one
entries.docstring: A jet with trivial value has trivial zeroth coefficient.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointCoeff_zero_of_eval_eq_one {U : GJ} (hU : jets.eval U = 1) :
    jets.adjointCoeff U 0 = LinearMap.id

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.adjointCoeff_one
entries.docstring: The coefficients of the identity jet: only the base point survives.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointCoeff_one (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    jets.adjointCoeff (1 : GJ) p = if p = 0 then LinearMap.id else 0

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.adjointCoeff_lie
entries.docstring:
The coefficients are derivations of the bracket up to convolution, by the iterated
  Leibniz rule for the jet bracket.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointCoeff_lie (U : GJ) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a b : 𝔤) :
    jets.adjointCoeff U x ⁅a, b⁆ =
      (x.antidiagonal.map fun p => ⁅jets.adjointCoeff U p.1 a, jets.adjointCoeff U p.2 b⁆).sum

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.deriv_adjoint_ofConstantLie
entries.docstring:
One derivative of the adjoint action on a constant is minus the bracket with the
  Maurer–Cartan form: the Leibniz rule `deriv_adjoint` with the constant's derivative
  killed.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_adjoint_ofConstantLie (U : GJ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : 𝔤) :
    jets.deriv μ (jets.adjointJ U (jets.ofConstantLie a)) =
      -⁅jets.maurerCartan U μ, jets.adjointJ U (jets.ofConstantLie a)⁆

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.adjointCoeff_cons
entries.docstring:
One more derivative of a coefficient: differentiating the adjoint once produces minus
  `ad` of the Maurer–Cartan form, and the remaining derivatives distribute over the bracket
  by the Leibniz rule.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointCoeff_cons (U : GJ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    jets.adjointCoeff U (μ ::ₘ x) =
      -((x.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        LieAlgebra.ad ℝ 𝔤 (jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv p.1 (jets.maurerCartan U μ))) ∘ₗ
          jets.adjointCoeff U p.2).sum)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.evalLie_iteratedDeriv_adjoint_cons
entries.docstring:
The inductive step of the Taylor–Leibniz theorem: the rule for `μ ::ₘ s` derivatives
  follows from the rule for every sub-multiset of `s`. Peeling off `∂_μ` by the Leibniz
  rule `deriv_adjoint` leaves `Ad_U (∂_μ Y)`, handled by the rule for `s`, and a bracket
  with the Maurer–Cartan form, handled by the rule for the parts of `s`; on the other side
  the coefficients at `μ ::ₘ p` unfold by `adjointCoeff_cons`, and the two triple sums
  agree by coassociativity of the antidiagonal.
entries.snippet:
lemma evalLie_iteratedDeriv_adjoint_cons (U : GJ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (Y : 𝔤J)
    (ih : ∀ t ≤ s, ∀ Z : 𝔤J, jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv t (jets.adjointJ U Z)) =
      (t.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        jets.adjointCoeff U p.1 (jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv p.2 Z))).sum) :
    jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv (μ ::ₘ s) (jets.adjointJ U Y)) =
      ((μ ::ₘ s).antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        jets.adjointCoeff U p.1 (jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv p.2 Y))).sum

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.evalLie_iteratedDeriv_adjointJ
entries.docstring:
The Taylor–Leibniz theorem for the adjoint action: the base-point Taylor coefficients
  of `Ad_U Y` are the antidiagonal convolution of the coefficients `adjointCoeff U` of
  `Ad_U` with those of `Y`. For a matrix group this is the Leibniz rule for products of
  matrices of power series; here it follows from the single-derivative Leibniz rule
  `deriv_adjoint` by strong induction on the number of derivatives.
entries.snippet:
lemma evalLie_iteratedDeriv_adjointJ (U : GJ) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (Y : 𝔤J) :
    jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv x (jets.adjointJ U Y)) =
      (x.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        jets.adjointCoeff U p.1 (jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv p.2 Y))).sum

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.evalLie_iteratedDeriv_adjoint_eq_zero
entries.docstring:
The base-point Taylor data of `Ad_U Y` vanish up to a given order whenever those of
  `Y` do.

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.adjointCoeff_mul
entries.docstring:
The coefficients are multiplicative up to convolution: the coefficient of a product of
  jets is the antidiagonal convolution of the coefficients of the factors.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointCoeff_mul (U V : GJ) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    jets.adjointCoeff (U * V) x =
      (x.antidiagonal.map fun p => jets.adjointCoeff U p.1 ∘ₗ jets.adjointCoeff V p.2).sum

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.adjointDualCoeff
entries.docstring:
The physicists' `∂_x (Ad_U)^a_b|₀` acting on the dual adjoint index of a gauge-field
  symbol: the transpose of `adjointCoeff U x`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def adjointDualCoeff (U : GJ) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.adjointDualCoeff_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointDualCoeff_apply (U : GJ) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤)
    (a : 𝔤) : jets.adjointDualCoeff U x φ a = φ (jets.adjointCoeff U x a)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.adjointDualCoeff_zero
entries.docstring:
The zeroth dual coefficient is the dual of the adjoint action of the value of the
  jet.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointDualCoeff_zero (U : GJ) :
    jets.adjointDualCoeff U 0 = (jets.adjoint (jets.eval U)).dualMap

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.adjointDualCoeff_zero_of_eval_eq_one
entries.docstring: A jet with trivial value has trivial zeroth dual coefficient.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointDualCoeff_zero_of_eval_eq_one {U : GJ} (hU : jets.eval U = 1) :
    jets.adjointDualCoeff U 0 = LinearMap.id

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.adjointDualCoeff_cons
entries.docstring:
The dual form of `adjointCoeff_cons`: one more derivative of a dual coefficient is
  minus the antidiagonal convolution of lower dual coefficients against `ad` of the derived
  Maurer–Cartan form.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointDualCoeff_cons (U : GJ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    jets.adjointDualCoeff U (μ ::ₘ x) φ =
      -((x.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        jets.adjointDualCoeff U p.2 (φ ∘ₗ LieAlgebra.ad ℝ 𝔤
          (jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv p.1 (jets.maurerCartan U μ))))).sum)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.adjointDualCoeff_singleton
entries.docstring:
The dual coefficient at a single derivative is minus the underived coefficient
  precomposed with `ad` of the base-point Maurer–Cartan form. This is what cancels the
  Leibniz cross terms of the gauge law against the commutator cross terms in the field
  strength.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointDualCoeff_singleton (U : GJ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    jets.adjointDualCoeff U {μ} φ =
      -jets.adjointDualCoeff U 0 (φ ∘ₗ LieAlgebra.ad ℝ 𝔤
        (jets.evalLie (jets.maurerCartan U μ)))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.adjointDualCoeff_pair
entries.docstring:
The dual coefficient at two derivatives: the underived coefficient against `ad` of the
  derived Maurer–Cartan form, and the once-derived coefficient against `ad` of the
  Maurer–Cartan form itself.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointDualCoeff_pair (U : GJ) (ρ μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    jets.adjointDualCoeff U (ρ ::ₘ {μ}) φ =
      -jets.adjointDualCoeff U 0 (φ ∘ₗ LieAlgebra.ad ℝ 𝔤
        (jets.evalLie (jets.deriv ρ (jets.maurerCartan U μ))))
      - jets.adjointDualCoeff U {ρ} (φ ∘ₗ LieAlgebra.ad ℝ 𝔤
        (jets.evalLie (jets.maurerCartan U μ)))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.maurerCartan_one
entries.docstring: The Maurer–Cartan form of the identity vanishes: the cocycle law at `1 * 1 = 1`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma maurerCartan_one (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : jets.maurerCartan 1 μ = 0

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.maurerCartan_inv
entries.docstring:
The Maurer–Cartan form of an inverse: `ω_μ(U⁻¹) = − Ad_{U⁻¹} ω_μ(U)`, the cocycle
  law applied to `U⁻¹ U = 1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma maurerCartan_inv (U : GJ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ μ = - jets.adjointJ U⁻¹ (jets.maurerCartan U μ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.evalLie_adjointJ_ofConstantLie
entries.docstring:
At the base point, the adjoint action of a jet on a constant is the adjoint action of
  its value.
entries.snippet:
lemma evalLie_adjointJ_ofConstantLie (U : GJ) (a : 𝔤) :
    jets.evalLie (jets.adjointJ U (jets.ofConstantLie a)) = jets.adjoint (jets.eval U) a

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.maurerCartan_eq_of_deriv_adjointJ
entries.docstring:
The Maurer–Cartan form is determined by the Leibniz rule, up to the centre. Since
  `adjointJ U` is invertible, `deriv_adjointJ` says exactly that the inner derivation
  `⁅maurerCartan U μ, ·⁆` is `adjointJ U ∘ deriv μ ∘ adjointJ U⁻¹ − deriv μ`; so any other
  form obeying the same rule differs from it by something acting trivially in the adjoint
  representation of `𝔤J`. It follows that the Maurer–Cartan form is redundant data exactly
  when that representation is faithful — which it is not for the Standard Model, whose jet
  gauge algebra has a central `u(1)` factor. That is why `maurerCartan` is a field of the
  structure rather than a construction from the rest of it.
entries.snippet:
lemma maurerCartan_eq_of_deriv_adjointJ
    (hfaithful : ∀ x y : 𝔤J, (∀ z : 𝔤J, ⁅x, z⁆ = ⁅y, z⁆) → x = y)
    (ω : GJ → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → 𝔤J)
    (hω : ∀ (U : GJ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : 𝔤J),
      jets.deriv μ (jets.adjointJ U x)
        = jets.adjointJ U (jets.deriv μ x) - ⁅ω U μ, jets.adjointJ U x⁆) :
    ω = jets.maurerCartan

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.evalLie_iteratedDeriv_bracket_congr
entries.docstring:
The base-point Taylor data of a bracket is determined by that of its arguments.
  If the base-point values of the iterated derivatives of `a` and `b` along sub-multisets
  of `w` agree with those of `a'` and `b'`, then so do those of the brackets: the iterated
  Leibniz rule expands the bracket over the antidiagonal of `w`, whose parts are all
  sub-multisets of `w`.
entries.snippet:
lemma evalLie_iteratedDeriv_bracket_congr (w : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a b a' b' : 𝔤J)
    (ha : ∀ p ≤ w, jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv p a)
      = jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv p a'))
    (hb : ∀ p ≤ w, jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv p b)
      = jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv p b')) :
    jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv w ⁅a, b⁆)
      = jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv w ⁅a', b'⁆)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.Faithful
entries.docstring:
A package is faithful when an element of `𝔤J` is determined by the base-point values
  of its iterated derivatives (Taylor determinacy) and a jet with vanishing Maurer–Cartan
  form is the constant jet of its value.
entries.snippet:
class Faithful (jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 GJ 𝔤J) : Prop where
  ext_of_evalLie_iteratedDeriv : ∀ {x y : 𝔤J},
    (∀ s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
      jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s x) = jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s y)) → x = y
  eq_ofConstant_of_maurerCartan_eq_zero : ∀ {U : GJ},
    jets.maurerCartan U = 0 → U = jets.ofConstant (jets.eval U)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.ext_of_evalLie_iteratedDeriv
entries.docstring: Taylor determinacy of a faithful package, in the form of an extensionality lemma.
entries.snippet:
lemma ext_of_evalLie_iteratedDeriv [jets.Faithful] {x y : 𝔤J}
    (h : ∀ s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
      jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s x) = jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s y)) :
    x = y

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.U1Factor
entries.docstring:
**A `U(1)` factor** of the local gauge data: a unitary jet `u U` attached to each gauge
  jet, with the corresponding components `φ c` of the gauge algebra and `φJ a` of its jets,
  related by the Maurer–Cartan form `φJ (ω_μ U) = i (∂_μ u) u⁻¹` and invariant under the
  adjoint action.
entries.snippet:
structure U1Factor (jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 GJ 𝔤J) where
  u : GJ →* unitary SpaceTimeAlgebra
  φ : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] ℂ
  φJ : 𝔤J → SpaceTimeAlgebra
  φJ_ofConstantLie : ∀ c, φJ (jets.ofConstantLie c) = C (φ c)
  φJ_cc_foldl : ∀ (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : 𝔤J),
    constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv p (φJ a))
      = φ (jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv p a))
  φJ_maurerCartan : ∀ (U : GJ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
    φJ (jets.maurerCartan U μ)
      = Complex.I • (pderiv μ (u U : SpaceTimeAlgebra) * star (u U : SpaceTimeAlgebra))
  φJ_adjoint : ∀ (U : GJ) (c : 𝔤),
    φJ (jets.adjointJ U (jets.ofConstantLie c)) = φJ (jets.ofConstantLie c)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.SUFactor
entries.docstring:
**An `SU(n)` factor** of the local gauge data: a unitary matrix of jets `u U` attached
  to each gauge jet, with the corresponding matrix components `φ c` of the gauge algebra
  and `φJ a` of its jets, related by the Maurer–Cartan form `φJ (ω_μ U) = i (∂_μ u) u⁻¹`
  and transforming by conjugation under the adjoint action.
entries.snippet:
structure SUFactor (jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 GJ 𝔤J) (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    where
  u : GJ →* Matrix n n SpaceTimeAlgebra
  u_unitary : ∀ U, star (u U) * u U = 1
  φ : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ
  φJ : 𝔤J → Matrix n n SpaceTimeAlgebra
  φJ_ofConstantLie : ∀ c, φJ (jets.ofConstantLie c) = (φ c).map (C : ℂ → SpaceTimeAlgebra)
  φJ_cc_foldl : ∀ (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : 𝔤J),
    ((φJ a).map fun f => constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv p f))
      = φ (jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv p a))
  φJ_maurerCartan : ∀ (U : GJ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
    φJ (jets.maurerCartan U μ)
      = Complex.I • (((u U).map fun f => pderiv μ f) * star (u U))
  φJ_adjoint : ∀ (U : GJ) (c : 𝔤),
    φJ (jets.adjointJ U (jets.ofConstantLie c)) = u U * φJ (jets.ofConstantLie c) * star (u U)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.Factor
entries.docstring:
**A factor of the gauge group**, presented in the local gauge data: a `U(1)` factor or
  an `SU(n)` factor.
entries.snippet:
inductive Factor (jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 GJ 𝔤J)
  | U1 (F : U1Factor jets)
  | SU {n : ℕ} (F : SUFactor jets (Fin n))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.Factors
entries.docstring: **A gauge group presented by its factors.**
entries.snippet: abbrev Factors (jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 GJ 𝔤J) : Type

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.U1Factor.comap
entries.docstring: A `U(1)` factor pulled back along a morphism.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def U1Factor.comap (F : U1Factor jets') (h : Hom jets jets') : U1Factor jets where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.SUFactor.comap
entries.docstring: An `SU(n)` factor pulled back along a morphism.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def SUFactor.comap {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (F : SUFactor jets' n)
    (h : Hom jets jets') : SUFactor jets n where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.Factor.comap
entries.docstring: A factor pulled back along a morphism.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable abbrev Factor.comap (h : Hom jets jets') : Factor jets' → Factor jets
  | .U1 F => .U1 (F.comap h)
  | .SU F => .SU (F.comap h)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.Factors.comap
entries.docstring:
A list of factors pulled back along a morphism. Written by recursion rather than as
  `List.map`, so that it unfolds at reducible transparency, as the charge tuples of a table
  over `Factors.factors` require.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable abbrev Factors.comap (h : Hom jets jets') : Factors jets' → Factors jets
  | [] => []
  | F :: Fs => F.comap h :: Factors.comap h Fs

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets
entries.docstring:
**A presentation of gauge jets by matrices**: the value group, its Lie algebra, the jet
  group and its Lie algebra of jets embed into `κ × κ` matrices, and every structure map of
  the local gauge data is what it is for matrices: the entrywise constant coefficient,
  inclusion of constants, derivative and coordinate multiplication, conjugation for the
  adjoint actions and `i (∂_μ U) U†` for the Maurer–Cartan form.
entries.snippet:
structure MatrixJets (κ : Type) [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (G₀ : Type) [Group G₀]
    (𝔤 : Type) [LieRing 𝔤] [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤] (GJ : Type) [Group GJ]
    (𝔤J : Type) [LieRing 𝔤J] [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤J] where
  toMat₀ : G₀ →* Matrix κ κ ℂ
  toMat₀_injective : Function.Injective toMat₀
  toMatJ : GJ →* Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra
  toMatJ_injective : Function.Injective toMatJ
  toMatJ_mul_star : ∀ U, toMatJ U * star (toMatJ U) = 1
  star_toMatJ_mul : ∀ U, star (toMatJ U) * toMatJ U = 1
  lie₀ : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix κ κ ℂ
  lie₀_injective : Function.Injective lie₀
  lie₀_bracket : ∀ a b, lie₀ ⁅a, b⁆ = Complex.I • (lie₀ a * lie₀ b - lie₀ b * lie₀ a)
  lieJ : 𝔤J →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra
  lieJ_injective : Function.Injective lieJ
  lieJ_bracket : ∀ a b, lieJ ⁅a, b⁆ = Complex.I • (lieJ a * lieJ b - lieJ b * lieJ a)
  eval : GJ →* G₀
  toMat₀_eval : ∀ U, toMat₀ (eval U) = (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix (toMatJ U)
  ofConstant : G₀ →* GJ
  toMatJ_ofConstant : ∀ g, toMatJ (ofConstant g) = (C : ℂ →+* SpaceTimeAlgebra).mapMatrix (toMat₀ g)
  evalLie : 𝔤J →ₗ[ℝ] 𝔤
  lie₀_evalLie : ∀ a, lie₀ (evalLie a) = (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix (lieJ a)
  ofConstantLie : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] 𝔤J
  lieJ_ofConstantLie : ∀ a, lieJ (ofConstantLie a) = (C : ℂ →+* SpaceTimeAlgebra).mapMatrix (lie₀ a)
  deriv : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → 𝔤J →ₗ[ℝ] 𝔤J
  lieJ_deriv : ∀ μ a, lieJ (deriv μ a) = (lieJ a).map (pderiv μ)
  coord : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → 𝔤J →ₗ[ℝ] 𝔤J
  lieJ_coord : ∀ μ a, lieJ (coord μ a) = (X μ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • lieJ a
  adjoint : Representation ℝ GJ 𝔤J
  lieJ_adjoint : ∀ U a, lieJ (adjoint U a) = toMatJ U * lieJ a * star (toMatJ U)
  adjointValue : Representation ℝ G₀ 𝔤
  lie₀_adjointValue : ∀ g a, lie₀ (adjointValue g a) = toMat₀ g * lie₀ a * star (toMat₀ g)
  maurerCartan : GJ → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → 𝔤J
  lieJ_maurerCartan : ∀ U μ, lieJ (maurerCartan U μ)
    = Complex.I • ((toMatJ U).map (pderiv μ) * star (toMatJ U))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.eval_ofConstant
entries.snippet: lemma eval_ofConstant (g : G₀) : M.eval (M.ofConstant g) = g

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.evalLie_lie
entries.snippet: lemma evalLie_lie (a b : 𝔤J) : M.evalLie ⁅a, b⁆ = ⁅M.evalLie a, M.evalLie b⁆

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.ofConstantLie_lie
entries.snippet:
lemma ofConstantLie_lie (a b : 𝔤) :
    M.ofConstantLie ⁅a, b⁆ = ⁅M.ofConstantLie a, M.ofConstantLie b⁆

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.evalLie_ofConstantLie
entries.snippet: lemma evalLie_ofConstantLie (a : 𝔤) : M.evalLie (M.ofConstantLie a) = a

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.deriv_comm
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_comm (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : 𝔤J) :
    M.deriv μ (M.deriv ν a) = M.deriv ν (M.deriv μ a)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.deriv_bracket
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_bracket (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x y : 𝔤J) :
    M.deriv μ ⁅x, y⁆ = ⁅M.deriv μ x, y⁆ + ⁅x, M.deriv μ y⁆

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.deriv_ofConstantLie
entries.snippet: lemma deriv_ofConstantLie (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : 𝔤) : M.deriv μ (M.ofConstantLie a) = 0

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.deriv_coord
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_coord (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : 𝔤J) :
    M.deriv μ (M.coord ν a) = M.coord ν (M.deriv μ a) + if μ = ν then a else 0

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.evalLie_coord
entries.snippet: lemma evalLie_coord (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : 𝔤J) : M.evalLie (M.coord μ a) = 0

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.coord_lie
entries.snippet: lemma coord_lie (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a b : 𝔤J) : ⁅M.coord μ a, b⁆ = M.coord μ ⁅a, b⁆

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.conj_mul_conj
entries.docstring: Conjugation by a unitary matrix respects products.
entries.snippet:
lemma conj_mul_conj (U : GJ) (A B : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    (M.toMatJ U * A * star (M.toMatJ U)) * (M.toMatJ U * B * star (M.toMatJ U))
      = M.toMatJ U * (A * B) * star (M.toMatJ U)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.adjoint_lie
entries.snippet:
lemma adjoint_lie (U : GJ) (x y : 𝔤J) :
    M.adjoint U ⁅x, y⁆ = ⁅M.adjoint U x, M.adjoint U y⁆

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.evalLie_adjoint
entries.snippet:
lemma evalLie_adjoint (U : GJ) (x : 𝔤J) :
    M.evalLie (M.adjoint U x) = M.adjointValue (M.eval U) (M.evalLie x)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.maurerCartan_ofConstant
entries.snippet:
lemma maurerCartan_ofConstant (g : G₀) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    M.maurerCartan (M.ofConstant g) μ = 0

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.maurerCartan_cocycle
entries.snippet:
lemma maurerCartan_cocycle (U V : GJ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    M.maurerCartan (U * V) μ = M.maurerCartan U μ + M.adjoint U (M.maurerCartan V μ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.maurerCartan_structure
entries.snippet:
lemma maurerCartan_structure (U : GJ) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    M.deriv μ (M.maurerCartan U ν) - M.deriv ν (M.maurerCartan U μ)
      + ⁅M.maurerCartan U μ, M.maurerCartan U ν⁆ = 0

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.deriv_adjoint
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_adjoint (U : GJ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : 𝔤J) :
    M.deriv μ (M.adjoint U x) = M.adjoint U (M.deriv μ x)
      - ⁅M.maurerCartan U μ, M.adjoint U x⁆

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.evalLieHom
entries.docstring: Evaluation of Lie algebra jets, as a morphism of Lie algebras.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def evalLieHom : 𝔤J →ₗ⁅ℝ⁆ 𝔤 where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.evalLieHom_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma evalLieHom_apply (a : 𝔤J) : M.evalLieHom a = M.evalLie a

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.toLocalGaugeData
entries.docstring: **The local gauge data presented by matrices of jets.**
entries.snippet: noncomputable def toLocalGaugeData : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 GJ 𝔤J where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.lieJ_iteratedDeriv
entries.docstring: The iterated derivative is the entrywise iterated formal derivative.
entries.snippet:
lemma lieJ_iteratedDeriv (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : 𝔤J) :
    M.lieJ (M.toLocalGaugeData.iteratedDeriv s a)
      = (M.lieJ a).map fun f => SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv s f

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.lie₀_evalLie_iteratedDeriv
entries.docstring: The base-point value of the iterated derivative, entrywise.
entries.snippet:
lemma lie₀_evalLie_iteratedDeriv (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : 𝔤J) :
    M.lie₀ (M.toLocalGaugeData.evalLie (M.toLocalGaugeData.iteratedDeriv s a))
      = (M.lieJ a).map fun f => constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv s f)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.faithful
entries.docstring:
**A package presented by matrices is faithful**: a jet is determined entrywise by the
  constant coefficients of its derivatives, and a jet with vanishing Maurer–Cartan form has
  constant entries.
entries.snippet: lemma faithful : M.toLocalGaugeData.Faithful where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.suFactor
entries.docstring:
**The canonical `SU`-type factor** of a package presented by matrices: the matrices of
  jets themselves.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def suFactor : SUFactor M.toLocalGaugeData κ where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.lieJ_radial
entries.docstring:
The radial component of the Maurer–Cartan form, in matrices:
  `∑_μ x_μ · i (∂_μ U) U†`.
entries.snippet:
lemma lieJ_radial (U : GJ) :
    M.lieJ (M.toLocalGaugeData.radial U) =
      ∑ μ, (X μ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) •
          (Complex.I • ((M.toMatJ U).map (pderiv μ) * star (M.toMatJ U)))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.mem_truncationKer_zero_iff
entries.docstring: A gauge jet is pure exactly when its matrix is the identity at the base point.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_truncationKer_zero_iff (U : GJ) :
    U ∈ M.toLocalGaugeData.truncationKer 0 ↔
      (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix (M.toMatJ U) = 1

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixJets.free
entries.docstring:
**A criterion for freeness.** A presentation by matrices is free when every matrix of
  jets built entrywise from Taylor data in `𝔤` is a Lie algebra jet, the Lie algebra jets
  are hermitian, and every unitary solution `V` of `E V = −i P V`, `V(0) = 1`, for a Lie
  algebra jet `P`, is a gauge jet.
entries.snippet:
lemma free
    (hTaylor : ∀ c : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → 𝔤,
      ∃ Y, M.lieJ Y = SpaceTimeAlgebra.taylorMatrix fun s => M.lie₀ (c s))
    (hherm : ∀ a, star (M.lieJ a) = M.lieJ a)
    (hlift : ∀ (ρ : 𝔤J) (V : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra),
      (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix V = 1 → V * star V = 1 →
      ∑ μ, (X μ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • V.map (pderiv μ) = ((-Complex.I) • M.lieJ ρ) * V →
      ∃ U, M.toMatJ U = V) :
    M.toLocalGaugeData.Free where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.evalLie_iteratedDeriv_maurerCartan_structure
entries.docstring:
The all-orders structural equation of the Maurer–Cartan form, at the base point:
  the `s`-th derivative of `∂_μ ω_ν − ∂_ν ω_μ + ⁅ω_μ, ω_ν⁆ = 0`, with the bracket
  expanded by the iterated Leibniz rule.
entries.snippet:
lemma evalLie_iteratedDeriv_maurerCartan_structure
    (U : GJ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv (μ ::ₘ s) (jets.maurerCartan U ν)) =
      jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv (ν ::ₘ s) (jets.maurerCartan U μ))
      - (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          ⁅jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv p.1 (jets.maurerCartan U μ)),
            jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv p.2 (jets.maurerCartan U ν))⁆).sum

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm
entries.docstring:
The symmetrized Maurer–Cartan form `ω̄_r(U) = (1/|r|) ∑_{μ ∈ r} ∂_{r − {μ}} ω_μ(U)`:
  the average, over the directions of `r`, of the Maurer–Cartan form in one direction
  differentiated along the remaining ones.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm (U : GJ) (r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) : 𝔤J

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm_apply_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm_apply_zero (U : GJ) :
    jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm U 0 = 0

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm_one : jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm 1 = 0

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm_ofConstant
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm_ofConstant (g : G₀) :
    jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm (jets.ofConstant g) = 0

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm_singleton
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm_singleton (U : GJ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm U {μ} = jets.maurerCartan U μ

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm_cons
entries.docstring:
The recursion for the symmetrized Maurer–Cartan form: peeling one direction off the
  multiset.
entries.snippet:
lemma symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm_cons (U : GJ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) : jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm U (μ ::ₘ r) =
    (1/(r.card + 1 : ℝ) : ℝ) • (jets.iteratedDeriv r (jets.maurerCartan U μ))
    + ((r.card : ℝ)/(r.card + 1 : ℝ)) •
      jets.deriv μ (jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm U r)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.iteratedDeriv_maurerCartan_eq_symmetrized_add
entries.docstring:
The symmetrization defect of the Maurer–Cartan form: an iterated derivative of
  `ω` is the corresponding symmetrized form plus an average of iterated derivatives
  of brackets of `ω` in strictly fewer directions. This is the structural equation
  `maurerCartan_structure` used to trade the antisymmetric part for lower-order data.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedDeriv_maurerCartan_eq_symmetrized_add (U : GJ)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    jets.iteratedDeriv s (jets.maurerCartan U μ) =
      jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm U (μ ::ₘ s) +
      (1/(s.card + 1 : ℝ)) • (s.map fun ν =>
        jets.iteratedDeriv (s.erase ν)
          ⁅jets.maurerCartan U μ, jets.maurerCartan U ν⁆).sum

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.evalLie_iteratedDeriv_maurerCartan_eq_zero_of_symmetrized_eq_zero
entries.docstring:
Maurer–Cartan triangularity, base-point half: if the base-point symmetrized
  Maurer–Cartan data of `U` vanish in every nonempty multiset of at most `n` directions,
  then so do all its base-point Maurer–Cartan Taylor coefficients below order `n`. The
  induction is on the order: the symmetrization defect
  `iteratedDeriv_maurerCartan_eq_symmetrized_add` expresses `∂_s ω_μ` through the
  symmetrized form, which vanishes by hypothesis, and brackets of `ω`s differentiated
  strictly fewer times, which vanish by the inductive hypothesis through
  `evalLie_iteratedDeriv_bracket_congr`.
entries.snippet:
lemma evalLie_iteratedDeriv_maurerCartan_eq_zero_of_symmetrized_eq_zero (U : GJ) {n : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), r ≠ 0 → r.card ≤ n →
      jets.evalLie (jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm U r) = 0)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (hs : s.card < n) :
    jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s (jets.maurerCartan U μ)) = 0

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.evalLie_iteratedDeriv_maurerCartan_eq_of_symmetrized_eq
entries.docstring:
Determination step: if the base-point symmetrized Maurer–Cartan data of `U` and
  `V` agree, and their Maurer–Cartan Taylor data agree in fewer than `n` directions,
  then they agree in `n` directions.
entries.snippet:
lemma evalLie_iteratedDeriv_maurerCartan_eq_of_symmetrized_eq (U V : GJ) (n : ℕ)
    (hsym : ∀ r, jets.evalLie (jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm U r) =
      jets.evalLie (jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm V r))
    (ih : ∀ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), s.card < n →
      jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s (jets.maurerCartan U μ)) =
        jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s (jets.maurerCartan V μ)))
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (hs : s.card = n) :
    jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s (jets.maurerCartan U μ)) =
      jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s (jets.maurerCartan V μ))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.evalLie_iteratedDeriv_maurerCartan_eq_of_symmetrized_eq_all
entries.docstring:
**The symmetrized data determine the Maurer–Cartan Taylor data**: if the base-point
  symmetrized Maurer–Cartan data of `U` and `V` agree, so do all base-point Taylor
  coefficients of their Maurer–Cartan forms. Strong induction on the order, with
  `evalLie_iteratedDeriv_maurerCartan_eq_of_symmetrized_eq` as the step.
entries.snippet:
lemma evalLie_iteratedDeriv_maurerCartan_eq_of_symmetrized_eq_all (U V : GJ)
    (hsym : ∀ r, jets.evalLie (jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm U r) =
      jets.evalLie (jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm V r))
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s (jets.maurerCartan U μ)) =
      jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s (jets.maurerCartan V μ))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.maurerCartan_eq_zero_iff
entries.docstring: In a faithful package, the Maurer–Cartan form vanishes exactly on the constant jets.
entries.snippet:
lemma maurerCartan_eq_zero_iff [jets.Faithful] (U : GJ) :
    jets.maurerCartan U = 0 ↔ U = jets.ofConstant (jets.eval U)

instance instFinite𝔤 : (Γ : List FactorSpec) → Module.Finite ℝ (𝔤 Γ)
  | [] => inferInstanceAs (Module.Finite ℝ Unit)
  | [f] => inferInstanceAs (Module.Finite ℝ f.𝔤)
  | f :: g :: gs =>
    letI

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.trivial
entries.docstring: The trivial local gauge data, of the empty list of factors.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def trivial : LocalGaugeData Unit Unit Unit Unit where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.instFaithfulTrivial
entries.snippet: instance instFaithfulTrivial : trivial.Faithful where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.instFreeTrivial
entries.snippet: instance instFreeTrivial : trivial.Free where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.ofFactors
entries.docstring:
**The local gauge data of a list of factors**: the product, in the order of the list,
  of the local gauge data of the factors.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def ofFactors : (Γ : List FactorSpec) → LocalGaugeData (G₀ Γ) (𝔤 Γ) (G Γ) (𝔤J Γ)
  | [] => trivial
  | [f] => f.data
  | f :: g :: gs => f.data.prod (ofFactors (g :: gs))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.ofFactors_nil
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofFactors_nil : ofFactors [] = trivial

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.ofFactors_singleton
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofFactors_singleton (f : FactorSpec) : ofFactors [f] = f.data

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.ofFactors_cons_cons
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofFactors_cons_cons (f g : FactorSpec) (gs : List FactorSpec) :
    ofFactors (f :: g :: gs) = f.data.prod (ofFactors (g :: gs))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.instFaithfulOfFactors
entries.docstring: The local gauge data of a list of factors is faithful.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable instance instFaithfulOfFactors : (Γ : List FactorSpec) → (ofFactors Γ).Faithful
  | [] => inferInstanceAs trivial.Faithful
  | [f] => inferInstanceAs f.data.Faithful
  | f :: g :: gs =>
    letI

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.instFreeOfFactors
entries.docstring: The local gauge data of a list of factors is free.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable instance instFreeOfFactors : (Γ : List FactorSpec) → (ofFactors Γ).Free
  | [] => inferInstanceAs trivial.Free
  | [f] => inferInstanceAs f.data.Free
  | f :: g :: gs =>
    letI

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.Factors.factors
entries.docstring: **The canonical factors** of the local gauge data of a list of factors.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable abbrev Factors.factors : (Γ : List FactorSpec) → Factors (ofFactors Γ)
  | [] => []
  | [f] => [f.factor]
  | f :: g :: gs =>
    f.factor.comap Hom.fst :: (Factors.factors (g :: gs)).comap Hom.snd

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.prod
entries.docstring: **The product of two local gauge data**: every structure map acts componentwise.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def prod : LocalGaugeData (G₀₁ × G₀₂) (𝔤₁ × 𝔤₂) (G₁ × G₂) (𝔤J₁ × 𝔤J₂) where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.prod_eval
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma prod_eval (U : G₁ × G₂) : (j₁.prod j₂).eval U = (j₁.eval U.1, j₂.eval U.2)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.prod_ofConstant
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma prod_ofConstant (g : G₀₁ × G₀₂) :
    (j₁.prod j₂).ofConstant g = (j₁.ofConstant g.1, j₂.ofConstant g.2)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.prod_evalLie
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma prod_evalLie (a : 𝔤J₁ × 𝔤J₂) : (j₁.prod j₂).evalLie a = (j₁.evalLie a.1, j₂.evalLie a.2)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.prod_ofConstantLie
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma prod_ofConstantLie (a : 𝔤₁ × 𝔤₂) :
    (j₁.prod j₂).ofConstantLie a = (j₁.ofConstantLie a.1, j₂.ofConstantLie a.2)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.prod_deriv
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma prod_deriv (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : 𝔤J₁ × 𝔤J₂) :
    (j₁.prod j₂).deriv μ a = (j₁.deriv μ a.1, j₂.deriv μ a.2)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.prod_adjointJ
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma prod_adjointJ (U : G₁ × G₂) (a : 𝔤J₁ × 𝔤J₂) :
    (j₁.prod j₂).adjointJ U a = (j₁.adjointJ U.1 a.1, j₂.adjointJ U.2 a.2)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.prod_maurerCartan
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma prod_maurerCartan (U : G₁ × G₂) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (j₁.prod j₂).maurerCartan U μ = (j₁.maurerCartan U.1 μ, j₂.maurerCartan U.2 μ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.prod_iteratedDeriv
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma prod_iteratedDeriv (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : 𝔤J₁ × 𝔤J₂) :
    (j₁.prod j₂).iteratedDeriv s a = (j₁.iteratedDeriv s a.1, j₂.iteratedDeriv s a.2)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.Hom.fst
entries.docstring: The first projection, as a morphism of local gauge data.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def Hom.fst : Hom (j₁.prod j₂) j₁ where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.Hom.snd
entries.docstring: The second projection, as a morphism of local gauge data.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def Hom.snd : Hom (j₁.prod j₂) j₂ where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.instFaithfulProd
entries.docstring: The product of two faithful packages is faithful.
entries.snippet: instance instFaithfulProd [j₁.Faithful] [j₂.Faithful] : (j₁.prod j₂).Faithful where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.prod_mulCoord
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma prod_mulCoord (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : 𝔤J₁ × 𝔤J₂) :
    (j₁.prod j₂).mulCoord μ a = (j₁.mulCoord μ a.1, j₂.mulCoord μ a.2)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.prod_radial
entries.docstring:
The radial component of the Maurer–Cartan form of a product jet is the pair of the
  radial components of its factors.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma prod_radial (U : G₁ × G₂) :
    (j₁.prod j₂).radial U = (j₁.radial U.1, j₂.radial U.2)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.mem_prod_truncationKer_iff
entries.docstring: A product jet lies in the `n`-th truncation kernel exactly when both of its factors do.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_prod_truncationKer_iff (n : ℕ) (U : G₁ × G₂) :
    U ∈ (j₁.prod j₂).truncationKer n ↔
      U.1 ∈ j₁.truncationKer n ∧ U.2 ∈ j₂.truncationKer n

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.instFreeProd
entries.docstring:
The product of two free packages is free: Taylor data and radial components are
  realized factor by factor and paired.
entries.snippet: instance instFreeProd [j₁.Free] [j₂.Free] : (j₁.prod j₂).Free where

entries.name: suTensor.adjBasis
entries.docstring: The generalized Gell-Mann basis `1 ⊗ λ_a` of the complexified Lie algebra `ℂ ⊗[ℝ] su(N)`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def adjBasis : Basis (GellMann.Index N) ℂ (SUAlgebraComplexified N)

entries.name: suTensor.adjBasis_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma adjBasis_apply (a : GellMann.Index N) :
    adjBasis N a = (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] GellMann.realBasis a

entries.name: suTensor.val_inv_mul_val
entries.snippet: lemma val_inv_mul_val (g : SU N) : (g⁻¹).1 * g.1 = 1

entries.name: suTensor.val_inv
entries.snippet: lemma val_inv (g : SU N) : (g⁻¹).1 = star g.1

entries.name: suTensor.adjRep
entries.docstring:
The adjoint representation on the complexified Lie algebra: the complexification of the
  adjoint action `X ↦ g X g⁻¹` on `su(N)`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def adjRep : Representation ℂ (SU N) (SUAlgebraComplexified N) where

entries.name: suTensor.adjMat
entries.docstring:
The matrix of an element of the complexified Lie algebra, `z ⊗ X ↦ z X`: a traceless complex
  matrix.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def adjMat : SUAlgebraComplexified N →ₗ[ℂ] Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ

entries.name: suTensor.adjMat_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma adjMat_tmul (z : ℂ) (X : SUAlgebra N) : adjMat N (z ⊗ₜ X) = z • X.1

entries.name: suTensor.adjMat_adjBasis
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma adjMat_adjBasis (a : GellMann.Index N) : adjMat N (adjBasis N a) = GellMann.matrix a

entries.name: suTensor.trace_adjMat
entries.docstring: The matrix of an element of the complexified Lie algebra is traceless.
entries.snippet: lemma trace_adjMat (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N) : (adjMat N A).trace = 0

entries.name: suTensor.adjMat_adjRep
entries.docstring: The adjoint representation moves the matrix by conjugation.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma adjMat_adjRep (g : SU N) (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N) :
    adjMat N (adjRep N g A) = g.1 * adjMat N A * (g⁻¹).1

entries.name: suTensor.adjBasis_repr_apply
entries.docstring:
The coordinates in the Gell-Mann basis are read off by the trace form,
  `A = ∑ (tr (λ_a A) / 2) λ_a`.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjBasis_repr_apply (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N) (a : GellMann.Index N) :
    (adjBasis N).repr A a = (GellMann.matrix a * adjMat N A).trace / 2

entries.name: suTensor.adjMat_injective
entries.docstring: An element of the complexified Lie algebra is determined by its matrix.
entries.snippet: lemma adjMat_injective : Function.Injective (adjMat N)

entries.name: suTensor.ofTraceless
entries.docstring: The element of the complexified Lie algebra with a given traceless matrix.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def ofTraceless (M : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) : SUAlgebraComplexified N

entries.name: suTensor.adjMat_ofTraceless
entries.docstring: Every traceless matrix is the matrix of an element of the complexified Lie algebra.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma adjMat_ofTraceless {M : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ} (hM : M.trace = 0) :
    adjMat N (ofTraceless M) = M

entries.name: suTensor.adjMatrix
entries.docstring: The matrix of the adjoint action of `g` in the Gell-Mann basis.
entries.snippet: noncomputable abbrev adjMatrix (g : SU N) : Matrix (GellMann.Index N) (GellMann.Index N) ℂ

entries.name: suTensor.adjMatrix_apply
entries.docstring: The entries of the matrix of the adjoint action, `tr (λ_a g λ_b g⁻¹) / 2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjMatrix_apply (g : SU N) (a b : GellMann.Index N) :
    adjMatrix g a b = (GellMann.matrix a * (g.1 * GellMann.matrix b * (g⁻¹).1)).trace / 2

entries.name: suTensor.star_adjMatrix_apply
entries.docstring: The matrix of the adjoint action is real, the Gell-Mann matrices being hermitian.
entries.snippet:
lemma star_adjMatrix_apply (g : SU N) (a b : GellMann.Index N) :
    star (adjMatrix g a b) = adjMatrix g a b

entries.name: suTensor.adjMatrix_inv
entries.docstring:
The matrix of the adjoint action of `g⁻¹` is the transpose of that of `g`, by the cyclicity
  of the trace.
entries.snippet: lemma adjMatrix_inv (g : SU N) : adjMatrix g⁻¹ = (adjMatrix g)ᵀ

entries.name: suTensor.adjMatrix_inv_mul
entries.docstring: The matrix of the adjoint action of `g⁻¹` times that of `g` is the identity.
entries.snippet: lemma adjMatrix_inv_mul (g : SU N) : adjMatrix g⁻¹ * adjMatrix g = 1

entries.name: suTensor.traceForm
entries.docstring: The trace form `A ⊗ B ↦ tr (A B)` on the complexified Lie algebra.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def traceForm : LinearMap.BilinForm ℂ (SUAlgebraComplexified N)

entries.name: suTensor.traceForm_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma traceForm_apply (A B : SUAlgebraComplexified N) :
    traceForm N A B = (adjMat N A * adjMat N B).trace

entries.name: suTensor.traceForm_isSymm
entries.docstring: The trace form is symmetric.
entries.snippet: lemma traceForm_isSymm : (traceForm N).IsSymm

entries.name: suTensor.traceForm_adjBasis
entries.docstring: The trace form against a Gell-Mann basis vector is twice the coordinate.
entries.snippet:
lemma traceForm_adjBasis (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N) (a : GellMann.Index N) :
    traceForm N A (adjBasis N a) = 2 * (adjBasis N).repr A a

entries.name: suTensor.traceForm_separatingLeft
entries.docstring:
An element orthogonal to every element under the trace form vanishes: its coordinates are its
  trace pairings with the Gell-Mann basis.
entries.snippet:
lemma traceForm_separatingLeft (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N) (hA : ∀ B, traceForm N A B = 0) :
    A = 0

entries.name: suTensor.traceForm_nondegenerate
entries.docstring: The trace form is nondegenerate on the complexified Lie algebra.
entries.snippet: lemma traceForm_nondegenerate : (traceForm N).Nondegenerate

entries.name: suTensor.adjContr
entries.docstring: The contraction of two adjoint indices, the trace form `A ⊗ B ↦ tr (A B)`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def adjContr : ((adjRep N).tprod (adjRep N)).IntertwiningMap
    (Representation.trivial ℂ (SU N) ℂ) where

entries.name: suTensor.adjContr_flip_injective
entries.docstring: The trace form separates the complexified Lie algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjContr_flip_injective :
    Function.Injective (TensorProduct.curry (adjContr N).toLinearMap).flip

entries.name: SUAlgebraOver.submodule
entries.docstring: The submodule of traceless hermitian matrices.
entries.snippet:
abbrev SUAlgebraOver.submodule (R : Type) [CommRing R] [StarRing R] [Algebra ℝ R]
    [StarModule ℝ R] (n : ℕ) : Submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R)

entries.name: SUAlgebraOver
entries.docstring:
**The Lie algebra `su(n)` over `R`**: traceless hermitian `n × n` matrices with entries in
  `R`, a real Lie algebra with bracket `i (a b − b a)`.
entries.snippet:
abbrev SUAlgebraOver (R : Type) [CommRing R] [StarRing R] [Algebra ℝ R] [StarModule ℝ R]
    (n : ℕ) : Type

entries.name: SUAlgebraOver.mem_iff
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_iff (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) :
    A ∈ submodule R n ↔ star A = A ∧ A.trace = 0

entries.name: SUAlgebraOver.ofMatrix
entries.docstring: An element from a traceless hermitian matrix.
entries.snippet:
def ofMatrix (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (hA : star A = A) (hT : A.trace = 0) :
    SUAlgebraOver R n

entries.name: SUAlgebraOver.ofMatrix_val
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofMatrix_val (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (hA : star A = A) (hT : A.trace = 0) :
    (ofMatrix A hA hT).1 = A

entries.name: SUAlgebraOver.star_val
entries.snippet: lemma star_val (a : SUAlgebraOver R n) : star a.1 = a.1

entries.name: SUAlgebraOver.trace_val
entries.snippet: lemma trace_val (a : SUAlgebraOver R n) : a.1.trace = 0

entries.name: SUAlgebraOver.ext
entries.snippet:
@[ext]
lemma ext {a b : SUAlgebraOver R n} (h : a.1 = b.1) : a = b

entries.name: SUAlgebraOver.conj
entries.docstring: **The conjugation representation** of the unitary group on `su(n)`: `a ↦ U a U†`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def conj : Representation ℝ (unitaryGroup (Fin n) R) (SUAlgebraOver R n) where

entries.name: SUAlgebraOver.conj_apply_val
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma conj_apply_val (U : unitaryGroup (Fin n) R) (a : SUAlgebraOver R n) :
    (conj U a).1 = U.1 * a.1 * star U.1

entries.name: SUAlgebraOver.«instance@647e80aa»
entries.docstring: The bracket `i (a b − b a)`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance : Bracket (SUAlgebraOver R n) (SUAlgebraOver R n) where

entries.name: SUAlgebraOver.bracket_val
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma bracket_val (a b : SUAlgebraOver R n) :
    ⁅a, b⁆.1 = Complex.I • (a.1 * b.1 - b.1 * a.1)

entries.name: SUAlgebraOver.«instance@ebd4ad36»
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance : LieRing (SUAlgebraOver R n) where

entries.name: SUAlgebraOver.«instance@ac251fdd»
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance : LieAlgebra ℝ (SUAlgebraOver R n) where

entries.name: SUAlgebraComplexified
entries.docstring: **The complexified Lie algebra `su(n)_ℂ = ℂ ⊗[ℝ] su(n)`**, a complex vector space.
entries.snippet: abbrev SUAlgebraComplexified (n : ℕ) : Type

entries.name: SU
entries.docstring: The gauge group `SU(n)`.
entries.snippet: abbrev SU (n : ℕ) : Type

entries.name: JetSU
entries.docstring:
Jets of `SU(n)` gauge transformations: special unitary matrices of formal power
  series.
entries.snippet: abbrev JetSU (n : ℕ) : Type

entries.name: SUAlgebra
entries.docstring: The Lie algebra `su(n)`: traceless hermitian matrices.
entries.snippet: abbrev SUAlgebra (n : ℕ) : Type

entries.name: JetSUAlgebra
entries.docstring: Jets of the Lie algebra `su(n)`: traceless hermitian matrices of formal power series.
entries.snippet: abbrev JetSUAlgebra (n : ℕ) : Type

entries.name: JetSU.val_mul_star
entries.snippet: lemma val_mul_star (U : JetSU n) : U.1 * star U.1 = 1

entries.name: JetSU.star_mul_val
entries.snippet: lemma star_mul_val (U : JetSU n) : star U.1 * U.1 = 1

entries.name: JetSU.det_val
entries.snippet: lemma det_val (U : JetSU n) : U.1.det = 1

entries.name: JetSU.star_val_eq_adjugate
entries.docstring: For a special unitary matrix, the conjugate transpose is the adjugate.
entries.snippet: lemma star_val_eq_adjugate (U : JetSU n) : star U.1 = U.1.adjugate

entries.name: JetSU.eval
entries.docstring:
Evaluation of a jet of an `SU(n)` gauge transformation at the base point: the entrywise
  constant coefficient.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def eval : JetSU n →* SU n where

entries.name: JetSU.eval_val
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma eval_val (U : JetSU n) : (eval U).1 =
    (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix U.1

entries.name: JetSU.ofConstant
entries.docstring:
The jet of a constant `SU(n)` gauge transformation: the entrywise inclusion of
  constants.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def ofConstant : SU n →* JetSU n where

entries.name: JetSU.ofConstant_val
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofConstant_val (u : SU n) : (ofConstant u).1 =
    (C : ℂ →+* SpaceTimeAlgebra).mapMatrix u.1

entries.name: JetSU.trace_mcMatrix
entries.docstring:
The Maurer–Cartan matrix `i (∂_μ U) U†` is traceless, by Jacobi's formula and
  `det U = 1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma trace_mcMatrix (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (U : JetSU n) :
    (Complex.I • (U.1.map (pderiv μ) * star U.1)).trace = 0

entries.name: JetSUAlgebra.deriv
entries.docstring: The formal derivative in the direction `μ`, entrywise.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def deriv (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : JetSUAlgebra n →ₗ[ℝ] JetSUAlgebra n where

entries.name: JetSUAlgebra.deriv_val
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma deriv_val (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : JetSUAlgebra n) :
    (deriv μ a).1 = a.1.map (pderiv μ)

entries.name: JetSUAlgebra.coord
entries.docstring: Multiplication by the coordinate `x_μ`, entrywise.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def coord (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : JetSUAlgebra n →ₗ[ℝ] JetSUAlgebra n where

entries.name: JetSUAlgebra.coord_val
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coord_val (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : JetSUAlgebra n) :
    (coord μ a).1 = (X μ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • a.1

entries.name: JetSUAlgebra.star_mapMatrix_constantCoeff
entries.snippet:
lemma star_mapMatrix_constantCoeff (a : JetSUAlgebra n) :
    star ((constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix a.1)
      = (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix a.1

entries.name: JetSUAlgebra.trace_mapMatrix_constantCoeff
entries.snippet:
lemma trace_mapMatrix_constantCoeff (a : JetSUAlgebra n) :
    ((constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix a.1).trace = 0

entries.name: JetSUAlgebra.evalLie
entries.docstring: Evaluation at the base point: the entrywise constant coefficient.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def evalLie : JetSUAlgebra n →ₗ[ℝ] SUAlgebra n where

entries.name: JetSUAlgebra.evalLie_val
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma evalLie_val (a : JetSUAlgebra n) :
    (evalLie a).1 = (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix a.1

entries.name: JetSUAlgebra.star_mapMatrix_C
entries.snippet:
lemma star_mapMatrix_C (a : SUAlgebra n) :
    star ((C : ℂ →+* SpaceTimeAlgebra).mapMatrix a.1) =
        (C : ℂ →+* SpaceTimeAlgebra).mapMatrix a.1

entries.name: JetSUAlgebra.trace_mapMatrix_C
entries.snippet:
lemma trace_mapMatrix_C (a : SUAlgebra n) :
    ((C : ℂ →+* SpaceTimeAlgebra).mapMatrix a.1).trace = 0

entries.name: JetSUAlgebra.ofConstantLie
entries.docstring: A constant as a jet: the entrywise constant power series.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def ofConstantLie : SUAlgebra n →ₗ[ℝ] JetSUAlgebra n where

entries.name: JetSUAlgebra.ofConstantLie_val
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofConstantLie_val (a : SUAlgebra n) :
    (ofConstantLie a).1 = (C : ℂ →+* SpaceTimeAlgebra).mapMatrix a.1

entries.name: JetSUAlgebra.adjoint
entries.docstring: The adjoint action `a ↦ U a U†` of the jets of `SU(n)` on the jets of `su(n)`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def adjoint : Representation ℝ (JetSU n) (JetSUAlgebra n)

entries.name: JetSUAlgebra.adjoint_val
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma adjoint_val (U : JetSU n) (a : JetSUAlgebra n) :
    (adjoint U a).1 = U.1 * a.1 * star U.1

entries.name: JetSUAlgebra.adjointValue
entries.docstring: The adjoint action `a ↦ U a U†` of `SU(n)` on `su(n)`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def adjointValue : Representation ℝ (SU n) (SUAlgebra n)

entries.name: JetSUAlgebra.adjointValue_val
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma adjointValue_val (U : SU n) (a : SUAlgebra n) :
    (adjointValue U a).1 = U.1 * a.1 * star U.1

entries.name: JetSUAlgebra.mc
entries.docstring: The Maurer–Cartan form `i (∂_μ U) U†` of an `SU(n)` gauge jet.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def mc (U : JetSU n) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : JetSUAlgebra n

entries.name: JetSUAlgebra.mc_val
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma mc_val (U : JetSU n) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (mc U μ).1 = Complex.I • (U.1.map (pderiv μ) * star U.1)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.suMatrixJets
entries.docstring:
**The presentation of `SU(n)` by matrices of jets**: the carriers are subtypes of
  matrices and every structure map is the matrix one.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def suMatrixJets (n : ℕ) :
    MatrixJets (Fin n) (SU n) (SUAlgebra n) (JetSU n) (JetSUAlgebra n) where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.su
entries.docstring:
**The local gauge data of `SU(n)`**: special unitary jets, traceless hermitian jets
  with the bracket `i (a b − b a)` and the conjugation action, and the Maurer–Cartan form
  `i (∂_μ U) U⁻¹`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def su (n : ℕ) : LocalGaugeData (SU n) (SUAlgebra n) (JetSU n) (JetSUAlgebra n)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.suFactor
entries.docstring: The canonical `SU(n)` factor of the local gauge data of `SU(n)`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def suFactor (n : ℕ) : SUFactor (su n) (Fin n)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.instFaithfulSU
entries.docstring: The local gauge data of `SU(n)` is faithful.
entries.snippet: instance instFaithfulSU : (su n).Faithful

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.instFreeSU
entries.docstring:
The local gauge data of `SU(n)` is free. Traceless hermitian Taylor data give a
  traceless hermitian matrix of jets, and the unitary Euler transport of a traceless
  hermitian jet has unit determinant by Jacobi's formula.
entries.snippet: instance instFreeSU : (su n).Free

entries.name: GellMann.Index
entries.docstring:
The labels of the generalized Gell-Mann matrices: a pair `j < k` for each symmetric and each
  antisymmetric matrix, and `l : Fin (N - 1)` for the diagonal matrix of size `n = l + 1`.
entries.snippet: abbrev Index (N : ℕ) : Type

entries.name: GellMann.diagProfile
entries.docstring:
The diagonal profile of size `n = l + 1`: `1` on the first `n` entries, `-n` on the next, and
  `0` beyond.
entries.snippet: def diagProfile (l : Fin (N - 1)) (m : Fin N) : ℂ

entries.name: GellMann.diagNorm
entries.docstring: The normalization `√(2 / (n (n + 1)))` of the diagonal matrix of size `n = l + 1`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def diagNorm (l : Fin (N - 1)) : ℂ

entries.name: GellMann.matrix
entries.docstring: The generalized Gell-Mann matrices.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def matrix : Index N → Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ
  | .inl p => single p.1.1 p.1.2 1 + single p.1.2 p.1.1 1
  | .inr (.inl p) => single p.1.1 p.1.2 (-Complex.I) + single p.1.2 p.1.1 Complex.I
  | .inr (.inr l) => diagNorm l • diagonal (diagProfile l)

entries.name: GellMann.profile
entries.docstring: The profile as a function of the position, `1` below `n`, `-n` at `n`, `0` above.
entries.snippet: private def profile (n m : ℕ) : ℂ

entries.name: GellMann.sum_range_profile
entries.snippet:
private lemma sum_range_profile {n : ℕ} :
    ∀ M, n < M → ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, profile n m = 0

entries.name: GellMann.sum_diagProfile
entries.snippet: lemma sum_diagProfile (l : Fin (N - 1)) : ∑ m, diagProfile l m = 0

entries.name: GellMann.profile_mul_of_lt
entries.snippet:
private lemma profile_mul_of_lt {n n' : ℕ} (h : n < n') (m : ℕ) :
    profile n m * profile n' m = profile n m

entries.name: GellMann.profile_mul_self
entries.snippet:
private lemma profile_mul_self (n m : ℕ) :
    profile n m * profile n m = (if m < n then 1 else 0) + (if m = n then (n : ℂ) ^ 2 else 0)

entries.name: GellMann.sum_range_indicator_lt
entries.snippet:
private lemma sum_range_indicator_lt {n : ℕ} :
    ∀ M, n ≤ M → ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, (if m < n then (1 : ℂ) else 0) = n

entries.name: GellMann.sum_diagProfile_mul
entries.docstring: The diagonal profiles are orthogonal, with `∑ d_l (m)² = n (n + 1)` for `n = l + 1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_diagProfile_mul (l l' : Fin (N - 1)) :
    ∑ m, diagProfile l m * diagProfile l' m
      = if l = l' then ((l.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((l.val + 2 : ℕ) : ℂ) else 0

entries.name: GellMann.diagNorm_mul_self
entries.docstring:
The square of the normalization of the diagonal matrix of size `n = l + 1` is
  `2 / (n (n + 1))`.
entries.snippet:
lemma diagNorm_mul_self (l : Fin (N - 1)) :
    diagNorm l * diagNorm l * (((l.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((l.val + 2 : ℕ) : ℂ)) = 2

entries.name: GellMann.trace_matrix_inl_mul
entries.docstring: The trace of a symmetric Gell-Mann matrix against `X`.
entries.snippet:
lemma trace_matrix_inl_mul (p : {p : Fin N × Fin N // p.1 < p.2}) (X : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) :
    (matrix (.inl p) * X).trace = X p.1.2 p.1.1 + X p.1.1 p.1.2

entries.name: GellMann.trace_matrix_inr_inl_mul
entries.docstring: The trace of an antisymmetric Gell-Mann matrix against `X`.
entries.snippet:
lemma trace_matrix_inr_inl_mul (p : {p : Fin N × Fin N // p.1 < p.2})
    (X : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) :
    (matrix (.inr (.inl p)) * X).trace
      = -Complex.I * X p.1.2 p.1.1 + Complex.I * X p.1.1 p.1.2

entries.name: GellMann.trace_matrix_inr_inr_mul
entries.docstring: The trace of a diagonal Gell-Mann matrix against `X`.
entries.snippet:
lemma trace_matrix_inr_inr_mul (l : Fin (N - 1)) (X : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) :
    (matrix (.inr (.inr l)) * X).trace = diagNorm l * ∑ m, diagProfile l m * X m m

entries.name: GellMann.matrix_inl_apply
entries.docstring: The entries of a symmetric Gell-Mann matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma matrix_inl_apply (p : {p : Fin N × Fin N // p.1 < p.2}) (m n : Fin N) :
    matrix (.inl p) m n
      = (if p.1.1 = m ∧ p.1.2 = n then 1 else 0) + (if p.1.2 = m ∧ p.1.1 = n then 1 else 0)

entries.name: GellMann.matrix_inr_inl_apply
entries.docstring: The entries of an antisymmetric Gell-Mann matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma matrix_inr_inl_apply (p : {p : Fin N × Fin N // p.1 < p.2}) (m n : Fin N) :
    matrix (.inr (.inl p)) m n = (if p.1.1 = m ∧ p.1.2 = n then -Complex.I else 0)
      + (if p.1.2 = m ∧ p.1.1 = n then Complex.I else 0)

entries.name: GellMann.matrix_inr_inr_apply
entries.docstring: The entries of a diagonal Gell-Mann matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma matrix_inr_inr_apply (l : Fin (N - 1)) (m n : Fin N) :
    matrix (.inr (.inr l)) m n = if m = n then diagNorm l * diagProfile l m else 0

entries.name: GellMann.not_cross
entries.docstring: Two ordered pairs `j < k` and `j' < k'` never match crosswise.
entries.snippet:
private lemma not_cross {j k j' k' : Fin N} (h : j < k) (h' : j' < k') :
    ¬ (j' = k ∧ k' = j) ∧ ¬ (k' = j ∧ j' = k)

entries.name: GellMann.trace_matrix_inl_mul_matrix
entries.docstring: The symmetric Gell-Mann matrices are orthogonal to all others and have norm `2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma trace_matrix_inl_mul_matrix (p : {p : Fin N × Fin N // p.1 < p.2}) (b : Index N) :
    (matrix (.inl p) * matrix b).trace = if .inl p = b then 2 else 0

entries.name: GellMann.trace_matrix_inr_inl_mul_matrix
entries.docstring: The antisymmetric Gell-Mann matrices are orthogonal to all others and have norm `2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma trace_matrix_inr_inl_mul_matrix (p : {p : Fin N × Fin N // p.1 < p.2}) (b : Index N) :
    (matrix (.inr (.inl p)) * matrix b).trace = if .inr (.inl p) = b then 2 else 0

entries.name: GellMann.trace_matrix_inr_inr_mul_matrix
entries.docstring: The diagonal Gell-Mann matrices are orthogonal to all others and have norm `2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma trace_matrix_inr_inr_mul_matrix (l : Fin (N - 1)) (b : Index N) :
    (matrix (.inr (.inr l)) * matrix b).trace = if .inr (.inr l) = b then 2 else 0

entries.name: GellMann.trace_matrix_mul_matrix
entries.docstring:
The generalized Gell-Mann matrices are orthogonal under the trace form:
  `tr (λ_a λ_b) = 2 δ_ab`.
entries.snippet:
lemma trace_matrix_mul_matrix (a b : Index N) :
    (matrix a * matrix b).trace = if a = b then 2 else 0

entries.name: GellMann.trace_matrix
entries.docstring: The generalized Gell-Mann matrices are traceless.
entries.snippet: lemma trace_matrix (a : Index N) : (matrix a).trace = 0

entries.name: GellMann.conjTranspose_matrix
entries.docstring: The generalized Gell-Mann matrices are hermitian.
entries.snippet: lemma conjTranspose_matrix (a : Index N) : (matrix a)ᴴ = matrix a

entries.name: GellMann.traceless
entries.docstring: The generalized Gell-Mann matrices as traceless matrices.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def traceless (a : Index N) :
    ↥(LinearMap.ker (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin N) ℂ ℂ))

entries.name: GellMann.linearIndependent_traceless
entries.docstring: The generalized Gell-Mann matrices are linearly independent, by orthogonality.
entries.snippet: lemma linearIndependent_traceless : LinearIndependent ℂ (traceless (N := N))

entries.name: GellMann.two_mul_card_lt_add
entries.docstring:
There are `N² - 1` ordered pairs with `j < k`, counted twice, and `N - 1` diagonal labels:
  `2 #{j < k} + N = N²`.
entries.snippet:
lemma two_mul_card_lt_add :
    2 * Fintype.card {p : Fin N × Fin N // p.1 < p.2} + N = N * N

entries.name: GellMann.finrank_traceless
entries.docstring: The traceless `N × N` matrices have dimension `N² - 1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma finrank_traceless :
    finrank ℂ ↥(LinearMap.ker (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin N) ℂ ℂ)) = N * N - 1

entries.name: GellMann.card_index
entries.snippet:
lemma card_index : Fintype.card (Index N)
    = finrank ℂ ↥(LinearMap.ker (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin N) ℂ ℂ))

entries.name: GellMann.basis
entries.docstring: **The generalized Gell-Mann basis** of the traceless complex `N × N` matrices.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def basis : Basis (Index N) ℂ ↥(LinearMap.ker (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin N) ℂ ℂ))

entries.name: GellMann.basis_apply_val
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma basis_apply_val (a : Index N) : (basis a).1 = matrix a

entries.name: GellMann.basis_repr_apply
entries.docstring:
The coordinates of a traceless matrix in the Gell-Mann basis are read off by the trace form,
  `x = ∑ (tr (λ_a x) / 2) λ_a`.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_repr_apply (x : ↥(LinearMap.ker (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin N) ℂ ℂ))) (a : Index N) :
    basis.repr x a = (matrix a * x.1).trace / 2

entries.name: GellMann.hermitian
entries.docstring: The generalized Gell-Mann matrices as elements of the real Lie algebra `su(N)`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def hermitian (a : Index N) : SUAlgebraOver ℂ N

entries.name: GellMann.linearIndependent_hermitian
entries.docstring: The generalized Gell-Mann matrices are linearly independent over the reals.
entries.snippet: lemma linearIndependent_hermitian : LinearIndependent ℝ (hermitian (N := N))

entries.name: GellMann.trace_mul_ofReal_re
entries.docstring: The trace pairing of two hermitian matrices is real.
entries.snippet:
lemma trace_mul_ofReal_re {A H : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ} (hA : Aᴴ = A) (hH : Hᴴ = H) :
    (((A * H).trace.re : ℝ) : ℂ) = (A * H).trace

entries.name: GellMann.eq_sum_re_trace_smul_hermitian
entries.docstring:
A traceless hermitian matrix is the real combination `∑ (tr (λ_a H) / 2) λ_a` of the
  generalized Gell-Mann matrices.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_sum_re_trace_smul_hermitian (H : SUAlgebraOver ℂ N) :
    ∑ a, ((matrix a * H.1).trace.re / 2) • hermitian a = H

entries.name: GellMann.realBasis
entries.docstring: **The generalized Gell-Mann basis** of the real Lie algebra `su(N)`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def realBasis : Basis (Index N) ℝ (SUAlgebraOver ℂ N)

entries.name: GellMann.realBasis_apply_val
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma realBasis_apply_val (a : Index N) : (realBasis a).1 = matrix a

entries.name: suTensor.eq_zero_of_adjRep_eq_self
entries.docstring:
An invariant element of the complexified Lie algebra is zero: its matrix commutes with every
  element of `SU(N)`, so it is a scalar, and its trace vanishes.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_zero_of_adjRep_eq_self {A : SUAlgebraComplexified N} (hA : ∀ g : SU N, adjRep N g A = A) :
    A = 0

entries.name: suTensor.eq_zero_of_invariant_adj
entries.docstring: An invariant tensor with one adjoint index is zero.
entries.snippet: lemma eq_zero_of_invariant_adj (t : SuT[N, .adj]) (ht : ∀ g : SU N, g • t = t) : t = 0

entries.name: suTensor.adjPairIdx
entries.docstring:
The component indices of a tensor with two adjoint indices, as the pair of their Gell-Mann
  labels.
entries.snippet: def adjPairIdx : ComponentIdx (S := suTensor N) ![.adj, .adj] ≃ (Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N) where

entries.name: suTensor.basis_repr_smul_adjPair
entries.docstring:
The components of `g • t` for a tensor with two adjoint indices: the matrix of components
  `C` is moved to `M C Mᵀ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_repr_smul_adjPair (g : SU N) (t : SuT[N, .adj, .adj])
    (n : Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (g • t) (adjPairIdx.symm n)
      = ∑ x, ∑ y, adjMatrix g (n 0) x * adjMatrix g (n 1) y
        * (Tensor.basis _).repr t (adjPairIdx.symm ![x, y])

entries.name: suTensor.adjUnitTensor
entries.docstring: The unit tensor of the adjoint color, `∑ λ_a ⊗ λ_a / 2`, with two adjoint indices.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def adjUnitTensor : SuT[N, .adj, .adj]

entries.name: suTensor.adjUnitTensor_invariant
entries.docstring: The unit tensor of the adjoint color is invariant.
entries.snippet: lemma adjUnitTensor_invariant (g : SU N) : g • adjUnitTensor N = adjUnitTensor N

entries.name: suTensor.basis_repr_adjUnitTensor
entries.docstring:
The components of the unit tensor of the adjoint color: `δ / 2`, the Gell-Mann matrices
  being orthogonal with `tr (λ_a λ_b) = 2 δ_ab`.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_repr_adjUnitTensor (n : Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (adjUnitTensor N) (adjPairIdx.symm n)
      = if n 0 = n 1 then 1 / 2 else 0

entries.name: suTensor.exists_eq_smul_adjUnitTensor_of_invariant
entries.docstring:
An invariant tensor with two adjoint indices is a multiple of the unit tensor of the adjoint
  color. Its matrix of components commutes with the matrices of the adjoint action, so it is the
  matrix of an endomorphism commuting with the adjoint action, which is scalar.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_eq_smul_adjUnitTensor_of_invariant (t : SuT[N, .adj, .adj])
    (ht : ∀ g : SU N, g • t = t) : ∃ a : ℂ, t = a • adjUnitTensor N

entries.name: suTensor.reducesInvariantsTo_bot_of_isEquivariant_adj
entries.docstring:
For an equivariant map out of the tensors with one adjoint index, the invariants of the range
  reduce to `⊥`.

entries.name: suTensor.invariantReductionToAdjUnitImage
entries.docstring:
For an equivariant map `f` out of the tensors with two adjoint indices, the invariants of the
  range reduce to the span of the image of the unit tensor.

entries.name: suTensor.adjIdx
entries.docstring: The component indices of a tensor with one adjoint index, as its Gell-Mann label.
entries.snippet: def adjIdx : ComponentIdx (S := suTensor N) ![.adj] ≃ GellMann.Index N where

entries.name: suTensor.adjMap
entries.docstring:
The linear map out of the tensors with one adjoint index sending the basis tensor with label
  `a` to `T a`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def adjMap (T : GellMann.Index N → B) : SuT[N, .adj] →ₗ[ℂ] B

entries.name: suTensor.adjMap_smul_of_law
entries.docstring:
A linear map moving a family indexed by one adjoint label by the matrix of the adjoint action
  of `g` intertwines the map of the family with the action of `g`.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjMap_smul_of_law (T : GellMann.Index N → B) {σ : B →ₗ[ℂ] B} (g : SU N)
    (hσ : ∀ a : GellMann.Index N, σ (T a) = ∑ b, adjMatrix g b a • T b) (t : SuT[N, .adj]) :
    σ (adjMap T t) = adjMap T (g • t)

entries.name: suTensor.isEquivariant_adjMap
entries.docstring:
The map of a family indexed by one adjoint label is equivariant when the family moves by the
  matrix of the adjoint action, the summed label first.
entries.snippet:
lemma isEquivariant_adjMap (T : GellMann.Index N → B)
    (hT : ∀ (g : SU N) (a : GellMann.Index N), ρ g (T a) = ∑ b, adjMatrix g b a • T b) :
    (suTensor N).IsEquivariant ![.adj] ρ (adjMap T)

entries.name: suTensor.reducesInvariantsTo_bot_span_of_adjMap
entries.docstring:
For a family indexed by one adjoint label whose map is equivariant, the invariants of the
  span of the family reduce to `⊥`.

entries.name: suTensor.adjPairMap
entries.docstring:
The linear map out of the tensors with two adjoint indices sending the basis tensor with
  labels `n` to `T n`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def adjPairMap (T : (Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N) → B) :
    SuT[N, .adj, .adj] →ₗ[ℂ] B

entries.name: suTensor.adjPairMap_two_smul_adjUnitTensor
entries.docstring: The map of a family sends twice the unit tensor to the trace contraction `∑ a, T ![a, a]`.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjPairMap_two_smul_adjUnitTensor (T : (Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N) → B) :
    adjPairMap T ((2 : ℂ) • adjUnitTensor N) = ∑ a, T ![a, a]

entries.name: suTensor.adjPairMap_smul_of_law
entries.docstring:
A linear map moving a family indexed by two adjoint labels by the matrix of the adjoint
  action of `g` on each label intertwines the map of the family with the action of `g`.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjPairMap_smul_of_law (T : (Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N) → B) {σ : B →ₗ[ℂ] B} (g : SU N)
    (hσ : ∀ l : Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N, σ (T l)
      = ∑ a : Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N, (adjMatrix g (a 0) (l 0) * adjMatrix g (a 1) (l 1)) • T a)
    (t : SuT[N, .adj, .adj]) :
    σ (adjPairMap T t) = adjPairMap T (g • t)

entries.name: suTensor.isEquivariant_adjPairMap
entries.docstring:
The map of a family indexed by two adjoint labels is equivariant when the family moves by the
  matrix of the adjoint action on each label, the summed label first.
entries.snippet:
lemma isEquivariant_adjPairMap (T : (Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N) → B)
    (hT : ∀ (g : SU N) (l : Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N), ρ g (T l)
      = ∑ a : Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N, (adjMatrix g (a 0) (l 0) * adjMatrix g (a 1) (l 1)) • T a) :
    (suTensor N).IsEquivariant ![.adj, .adj] ρ (adjPairMap T)

entries.name: suTensor.invariantReductionToTrace
entries.docstring:
For a family indexed by two adjoint labels whose map is equivariant, the invariants of the
  span of the family reduce to the span of the trace contraction `∑ a, T ![a, a]`.

entries.name: SU.planeInclusion
entries.docstring:
The inclusion of the plane of the coordinates `p` and `q`: the `N × 2` matrix whose columns
  are the basis vectors `e_p` and `e_q`.
entries.snippet: def planeInclusion (p q : Fin N) : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin 2) ℂ

entries.name: SU.planeInclusion_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma planeInclusion_apply (p q : Fin N) (x : Fin N) (i : Fin 2) :
    planeInclusion p q x i = if x = ![p, q] i then 1 else 0

entries.name: SU.planeInclusion_transpose_mul
entries.docstring: The inclusion of the plane of two distinct coordinates is an isometry.
entries.snippet:
lemma planeInclusion_transpose_mul {p q : Fin N} (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ * planeInclusion p q = 1

entries.name: SU.conjTranspose_planeInclusion
entries.docstring: The inclusion of the plane has real entries, so its conjugate transpose is its transpose.
entries.snippet:
lemma conjTranspose_planeInclusion (p q : Fin N) :
    (planeInclusion p q)ᴴ = (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ

entries.name: SU.planeMatrix
entries.docstring:
The matrix acting as `U` on the plane of the coordinates `p` and `q` and as the identity on
  the other coordinates.
entries.snippet: def planeMatrix (p q : Fin N) (U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ

entries.name: SU.planeMatrix_one
entries.docstring: The plane matrix of the identity is the identity.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma planeMatrix_one : planeMatrix p q 1 = 1

entries.name: SU.planeMatrix_mul
entries.docstring: The plane matrices multiply as the matrices on the plane.
entries.snippet:
lemma planeMatrix_mul (hpq : p ≠ q) (U V : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    planeMatrix p q U * planeMatrix p q V = planeMatrix p q (U * V)

entries.name: SU.conjTranspose_planeMatrix
entries.docstring:
The conjugate transpose of a plane matrix is the plane matrix of the conjugate
  transpose.
entries.snippet:
lemma conjTranspose_planeMatrix (U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    (planeMatrix p q U)ᴴ = planeMatrix p q Uᴴ

entries.name: SU.det_planeMatrix
entries.docstring: A plane matrix has the determinant of the matrix on the plane.
entries.snippet:
lemma det_planeMatrix (hpq : p ≠ q) (U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    (planeMatrix p q U).det = U.det

entries.name: SU.planeMatrix_mul_planeInclusion
entries.docstring: A plane matrix moves the plane as the matrix on the plane does.
entries.snippet:
lemma planeMatrix_mul_planeInclusion (hpq : p ≠ q) (U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    planeMatrix p q U * planeInclusion p q = planeInclusion p q * U

entries.name: SU.transpose_planeInclusion_mul_planeMatrix
entries.docstring:
The transpose of the inclusion of the plane intertwines a plane matrix with the matrix on
  the plane.
entries.snippet:
lemma transpose_planeInclusion_mul_planeMatrix (hpq : p ≠ q) (U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ * planeMatrix p q U = U * (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ

entries.name: SU.planeMatrix_conj
entries.docstring: Conjugating a matrix supported on the plane by a plane matrix conjugates it on the plane.
entries.snippet:
lemma planeMatrix_conj (hpq : p ≠ q) (U M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    planeMatrix p q U * (planeInclusion p q * M * (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ) * (planeMatrix p q U)ᴴ
      = planeInclusion p q * (U * M * Uᴴ) * (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ

entries.name: SU.planeBlock_conj
entries.docstring:
The block on the plane of a matrix conjugated by a plane matrix is the conjugate of its
  block.
entries.snippet:
lemma planeBlock_conj (hpq : p ≠ q) (U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (C : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) :
    (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ * (planeMatrix p q U * C * (planeMatrix p q U)ᴴ) * planeInclusion p q
      = U * ((planeInclusion p q)ᵀ * C * planeInclusion p q) * Uᴴ

entries.name: SU.planeBlock_apply
entries.docstring:
The entries of the block on the plane are the entries of the matrix at the two
  coordinates.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma planeBlock_apply (C : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) (i j : Fin 2) :
    ((planeInclusion p q)ᵀ * C * planeInclusion p q) i j = C (![p, q] i) (![p, q] j)

entries.name: SU.planeMatrix_diagonal
entries.docstring: A plane matrix of a diagonal matrix is diagonal.
entries.snippet:
lemma planeMatrix_diagonal (hpq : p ≠ q) (a b : ℂ) :
    planeMatrix p q (diagonal ![a, b])
      = diagonal fun x => if x = p then a else if x = q then b else 1

entries.name: SU.planeEmbed
entries.docstring:
`SU(2)` acting on the plane of the coordinates `p` and `q` and trivially on the others: a
  homomorphism from `SU(2)` to `SU(N)`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def planeEmbed (p q : Fin N) (hpq : p ≠ q) : SU 2 →* SU N where

entries.name: SU.planeEmbed_val
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma planeEmbed_val (hpq : p ≠ q) (U : SU 2) : (planeEmbed p q hpq U).1 = planeMatrix p q U.1

entries.name: SU.diagPhase
entries.docstring: The diagonal element `diag (u, ū)` of `SU(2)`, for a complex number `u` of modulus one.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def diagPhase (u : ℂ) (hu : u * star u = 1) : SU 2

entries.name: SU.diagPhase_val
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma diagPhase_val (u : ℂ) (hu : u * star u = 1) :
    (diagPhase u hu).1 = diagonal ![u, star u]

entries.name: SU.rotation
entries.docstring: The rotation `!![c, -s; s, c]` of `SU(2)`, for real `c` and `s` with `c² + s² = 1`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def rotation (c s : ℝ) (h : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) : SU 2

entries.name: SU.rotation_val
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma rotation_val (c s : ℝ) (h : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    (rotation c s h).1 = !![(c : ℂ), -s; s, c]

entries.name: SU.planeBlock_eq_of_conj_eq
entries.docstring:
A matrix fixed by conjugation by a plane matrix has its block on the plane fixed by
  conjugation by the matrix on the plane.
entries.snippet:
lemma planeBlock_eq_of_conj_eq (hpq : p ≠ q) {U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ}
    {C : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ} (hC : planeMatrix p q U * C * (planeMatrix p q U)ᴴ = C) :
    U * ((planeInclusion p q)ᵀ * C * planeInclusion p q) * Uᴴ
      = (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ * C * planeInclusion p q

entries.name: SU.conj_eq_of_commute
entries.docstring: A matrix commuting with every element of `SU(N)` is fixed by conjugation.
entries.snippet:
lemma conj_eq_of_commute {C : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ} (hC : ∀ g : SU N, g.1 * C = C * g.1)
    (g : SU N) : g.1 * C * g.1ᴴ = C

entries.name: SU.apply_eq_of_commute
entries.docstring:
A matrix commuting with every element of `SU(N)` is diagonal, with equal diagonal
  entries.
entries.snippet:
lemma apply_eq_of_commute {C : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ} (hC : ∀ g : SU N, g.1 * C = C * g.1)
    (hpq : p ≠ q) : C p q = 0 ∧ C p p = C q q

entries.name: SU.eq_smul_one_of_commute
entries.docstring: A matrix commuting with every element of `SU(N)` is scalar.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_smul_one_of_commute {C : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ}
    (hC : ∀ g : SU N, g.1 * C = C * g.1) : ∃ z : ℂ, C = z • 1

entries.name: suTensor.offDiag
entries.docstring:
The matrix unit at `(x, y)` off the diagonal, as an element of the complexified Lie algebra,
  and zero on the diagonal.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def offDiag (x y : Fin N) : SUAlgebraComplexified N

entries.name: suTensor.diagDiff
entries.docstring:
The difference of the diagonal matrix units at `x` and at `y`, as an element of the
  complexified Lie algebra.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def diagDiff (x y : Fin N) : SUAlgebraComplexified N

entries.name: suTensor.adjMat_offDiag
entries.snippet:
lemma adjMat_offDiag (x y : Fin N) :
    adjMat N (offDiag x y) = if x = y then 0 else single x y 1

entries.name: suTensor.adjMat_offDiag_of_ne
entries.snippet: lemma adjMat_offDiag_of_ne {x y : Fin N} (h : x ≠ y) : adjMat N (offDiag x y) = single x y 1

entries.name: suTensor.offDiag_self
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma offDiag_self (x : Fin N) : offDiag x x = 0

entries.name: suTensor.adjMat_diagDiff
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma adjMat_diagDiff (x y : Fin N) : adjMat N (diagDiff x y) = single x x 1 - single y y 1

entries.name: suTensor.diagDiff_self
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma diagDiff_self (x : Fin N) : diagDiff x x = 0

entries.name: suTensor.planeInclusion_single
entries.docstring:
The inclusion of the plane carries the matrix units of the plane to those of the
  coordinates.
entries.snippet:
lemma planeInclusion_single (p q : Fin N) (i j : Fin 2) :
    planeInclusion p q * single i j (1 : ℂ) * (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ
