      = single (![p, q] i) (![p, q] j) 1

entries.name: suTensor.adjMat_adjRep_planeEmbed
entries.docstring:
The adjoint action of an element of `SU(2)` embedded in a plane on a matrix supported on the
  plane.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjMat_adjRep_planeEmbed {p q : Fin N} (hpq : p ≠ q) (U : SU 2)
    (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N) (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (hA : adjMat N A = planeInclusion p q * M * (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ) :
    adjMat N (adjRep N (planeEmbed p q hpq U) A)
      = planeInclusion p q * (U.1 * M * U.1ᴴ) * (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ

entries.name: suTensor.sqrtI
entries.docstring: The phase `(1 + i) / √2`, a square root of `i` of modulus one.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def sqrtI : ℂ

entries.name: suTensor.sqrt_two_mul_sqrt_two
entries.snippet: lemma sqrt_two_mul_sqrt_two : (Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ) * (Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ) = 2

entries.name: suTensor.sqrt_two_ne_zero
entries.snippet: lemma sqrt_two_ne_zero : (Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ) ≠ 0

entries.name: suTensor.star_sqrtI
entries.snippet: lemma star_sqrtI : star sqrtI = (1 - Complex.I) / (Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ)

entries.name: suTensor.sqrtI_mul_star
entries.snippet: lemma sqrtI_mul_star : sqrtI * star sqrtI = 1

entries.name: suTensor.sqrtI_mul_self
entries.snippet: lemma sqrtI_mul_self : sqrtI * sqrtI = Complex.I

entries.name: suTensor.star_sqrtI_mul_self
entries.snippet: lemma star_sqrtI_mul_self : star sqrtI * star sqrtI = -Complex.I

entries.name: suTensor.sqrtI_ne_I
entries.snippet: lemma sqrtI_ne_I : sqrtI ≠ Complex.I

entries.name: suTensor.star_sqrtI_ne_I
entries.snippet: lemma star_sqrtI_ne_I : star sqrtI ≠ Complex.I

entries.name: suTensor.adjMat_adjRep_apply_of_diagonal
entries.docstring:
The adjoint action of a diagonal matrix of `SU(N)` scales the entry at `(x, y)` by
  `d x * star (d y)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjMat_adjRep_apply_of_diagonal {g : SU N} {d : Fin N → ℂ} (hg : g.1 = diagonal d)
    (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N) (x y : Fin N) :
    adjMat N (adjRep N g A) x y = d x * adjMat N A x y * star (d y)

entries.name: suTensor.map_offDiag_eq_smul
entries.docstring:
For `p ≠ q`, an endomorphism commuting with the adjoint action sends the matrix unit at
  `(p, q)` to a multiple of itself. The phase `diag (ω, ω̄)` in the plane of `p` and `q`, with
  `ω² = i`, multiplies that matrix unit by `i` and no other entry by `i`.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_offDiag_eq_smul (hL : ∀ (g : SU N) (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N),
    L (adjRep N g A) = adjRep N g (L A)) {p q : Fin N} (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    L (offDiag p q) = adjMat N (L (offDiag p q)) p q • offDiag p q

entries.name: suTensor.adjRep_quarterTurn_offDiag
entries.docstring:
The quarter turn in the plane of `p` and `q` sends the matrix unit at `(p, q)` to minus the
  one at `(q, p)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjRep_quarterTurn_offDiag {p q : Fin N} (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    adjRep N (planeEmbed p q hpq (rotation 0 1 (by norm_num))) (offDiag p q) = -offDiag q p

entries.name: suTensor.coeff_offDiag_swap
entries.docstring: The coefficients of the matrix units at `(p, q)` and at `(q, p)` agree.
entries.snippet:
lemma coeff_offDiag_swap (hL : ∀ (g : SU N) (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N),
    L (adjRep N g A) = adjRep N g (L A)) {p q : Fin N} (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    adjMat N (L (offDiag q p)) q p = adjMat N (L (offDiag p q)) p q

entries.name: suTensor.invSqrtTwo
entries.docstring: The cosine of an eighth of a turn, `1 / √2`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def invSqrtTwo : ℝ

entries.name: suTensor.invSqrtTwo_sq_add
entries.snippet: lemma invSqrtTwo_sq_add : invSqrtTwo ^ 2 + invSqrtTwo ^ 2 = 1

entries.name: suTensor.invSqrtTwo_mul_self
entries.snippet: lemma invSqrtTwo_mul_self : (invSqrtTwo : ℂ) * invSqrtTwo = 1 / 2

entries.name: suTensor.adjRep_eighthTurn_offDiag
entries.docstring:
The eighth turn in the plane of `p` and `q` sends the sum of the matrix units at `(p, q)`
  and at `(q, p)` to minus the difference of the diagonal matrix units at `p` and at `q`.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjRep_eighthTurn_offDiag {p q : Fin N} (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    adjRep N (planeEmbed p q hpq (rotation invSqrtTwo invSqrtTwo invSqrtTwo_sq_add))
      (offDiag p q + offDiag q p) = -diagDiff p q

entries.name: suTensor.map_diagDiff_eq_smul
entries.docstring:
For `p ≠ q`, an endomorphism commuting with the adjoint action scales the difference of the
  diagonal matrix units at `p` and at `q` by the coefficient of the matrix unit at `(p, q)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_diagDiff_eq_smul (hL : ∀ (g : SU N) (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N),
    L (adjRep N g A) = adjRep N g (L A)) {p q : Fin N} (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    L (diagDiff p q) = adjMat N (L (offDiag p q)) p q • diagDiff p q

entries.name: suTensor.coeff_offDiag_eq
entries.docstring:
For distinct `p`, `q` and `r`, the coefficients of the matrix units at `(p, q)` and at
  `(p, r)` agree: the difference of the diagonal units at `p` and `r` is the sum of those at `p`
  and `q` and at `q` and `r`.
entries.snippet:
lemma coeff_offDiag_eq (hL : ∀ (g : SU N) (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N),
    L (adjRep N g A) = adjRep N g (L A)) {p q r : Fin N} (hpq : p ≠ q) (hpr : p ≠ r)
    (hqr : q ≠ r) : adjMat N (L (offDiag p r)) p r = adjMat N (L (offDiag p q)) p q

entries.name: suTensor.exists_coeff_offDiag_eq
entries.docstring:
All the matrix units off the diagonal have the same coefficient under an endomorphism
  commuting with the adjoint action.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_coeff_offDiag_eq (hL : ∀ (g : SU N) (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N),
    L (adjRep N g A) = adjRep N g (L A)) :
    ∃ μ : ℂ, ∀ x y : Fin N, x ≠ y → adjMat N (L (offDiag x y)) x y = μ

entries.name: suTensor.eq_sum_offDiag_add_sum_diagDiff
entries.docstring:
An element of the complexified Lie algebra is the combination of the entries of its matrix off
  the diagonal against the matrix
  units, and of its diagonal entries against the differences of the diagonal matrix units at a
  fixed coordinate.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_sum_offDiag_add_sum_diagDiff (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N) (x₀ : Fin N) :
    A = ∑ x, ∑ y, adjMat N A x y • offDiag x y + ∑ x, adjMat N A x x • diagDiff x x₀

entries.name: suTensor.eq_smul_id_of_commute_adjRep
entries.docstring:
An endomorphism of the complexified Lie algebra commuting with the adjoint action of every
  element of `SU(N)` is scalar: a form of Schur's lemma for the adjoint representation.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_smul_id_of_commute_adjRep (hL : ∀ (g : SU N) (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N),
    L (adjRep N g A) = adjRep N g (L A)) :
    ∃ z : ℂ, L = z • LinearMap.id

entries.name: suTensor.basis_repr_smul_fund
entries.docstring:
The components of `g • t` for a tensor with `n` fundamental indices: one factor of `g` per
  index.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_repr_smul_fund {n : ℕ} (g : SU N) (t : (suTensor N).Tensor fun _ : Fin n => .fund)
    (φ : Fin n → Fin N) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (g • t) φ
      = ∑ ψ : Fin n → Fin N, (∏ i, g.1 (φ i) (ψ i)) * (Tensor.basis _).repr t ψ

entries.name: suTensor.basis_repr_smul_antiFund
entries.docstring:
The components of `g • t` for a tensor with `n` anti-fundamental indices: one factor of the
  complex conjugate of `g` per index.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_repr_smul_antiFund {n : ℕ} (g : SU N)
    (t : (suTensor N).Tensor fun _ : Fin n => .antiFund) (φ : Fin n → Fin N) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (g • t) φ = ∑ ψ : Fin n → Fin N,
      (∏ i, starRingEnd ℂ (g.1 (φ i) (ψ i))) * (Tensor.basis _).repr t ψ

entries.name: suTensor.sum_fin_two_arrow
entries.docstring: A sum over pairs of labels is a double sum.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_fin_two_arrow {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (F : (Fin 2 → Fin N) → M) :
    ∑ ψ : Fin 2 → Fin N, F ψ = ∑ x, ∑ y, F ![x, y]

entries.name: suTensor.epsilonFund
entries.docstring: The antisymmetric symbol `ε^{ab}` with two fundamental indices of `SU(2)`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def epsilonFund : (suTensor 2).Tensor fun _ : Fin 2 => .fund

entries.name: suTensor.epsilonAntiFund
entries.docstring: The antisymmetric symbol `ε_{ab}` with two anti-fundamental indices of `SU(2)`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def epsilonAntiFund : (suTensor 2).Tensor fun _ : Fin 2 => .antiFund

entries.name: suTensor.basis_repr_epsilonFund
entries.docstring: The components of the antisymmetric symbol.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_repr_epsilonFund (φ : Fin 2 → Fin 2) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr epsilonFund φ
      = (if φ = ![0, 1] then 1 else 0) - (if φ = ![1, 0] then 1 else 0)

entries.name: suTensor.basis_repr_epsilonAntiFund
entries.docstring: The components of the antisymmetric symbol.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_repr_epsilonAntiFund (φ : Fin 2 → Fin 2) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr epsilonAntiFund φ
      = (if φ = ![0, 1] then 1 else 0) - (if φ = ![1, 0] then 1 else 0)

entries.name: suTensor.eq_smul_epsilon_of_fixed
entries.docstring:
A function of two labels fixed by a diagonal matrix with entries squaring to `-1` and by
  the quarter turn, acting by one factor of `M g` per label, is a multiple of the antisymmetric
  symbol.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_smul_epsilon_of_fixed (M : SU 2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) {u v : ℂ}
    (hu : u * u = -1) (hv : v * v = -1)
    (hD : M (diagPhase Complex.I (by simp)) = diagonal ![u, v])
    (hR : M (rotation 0 1 (by norm_num)) = !![0, -1; 1, 0]) {c : (Fin 2 → Fin 2) → ℂ}
    (hc : ∀ (g : SU 2) (φ : Fin 2 → Fin 2),
      c φ = ∑ ψ : Fin 2 → Fin 2, (∏ i, M g (φ i) (ψ i)) * c ψ) (φ : Fin 2 → Fin 2) :
    c φ = c ![0, 1] * ((if φ = ![0, 1] then 1 else 0) - (if φ = ![1, 0] then 1 else 0))

entries.name: suTensor.exists_eq_smul_epsilonFund_of_invariant
entries.docstring:
An invariant tensor with two fundamental indices of `SU(2)` is a multiple of the
  antisymmetric symbol.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_eq_smul_epsilonFund_of_invariant (t : (suTensor 2).Tensor fun _ : Fin 2 => .fund)
    (ht : ∀ g : SU 2, g • t = t) : ∃ a : ℂ, t = a • epsilonFund

entries.name: suTensor.exists_eq_smul_epsilonAntiFund_of_invariant
entries.docstring:
An invariant tensor with two anti-fundamental indices of `SU(2)` is a multiple of the
  antisymmetric symbol.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_eq_smul_epsilonAntiFund_of_invariant
    (t : (suTensor 2).Tensor fun _ : Fin 2 => .antiFund) (ht : ∀ g : SU 2, g • t = t) :
    ∃ a : ℂ, t = a • epsilonAntiFund

entries.name: suTensor.det_fin_two_eq_one
entries.docstring: The determinant of an element of `SU(2)`, written out.
entries.snippet: lemma det_fin_two_eq_one (g : SU 2) : g.1 0 0 * g.1 1 1 - g.1 0 1 * g.1 1 0 = 1

entries.name: suTensor.epsilonFund_invariant
entries.docstring:
The antisymmetric symbol with two fundamental indices is invariant: `g ⊗ g` scales it by
  `det g = 1`.
entries.snippet: lemma epsilonFund_invariant (g : SU 2) : g • epsilonFund = epsilonFund

entries.name: suTensor.epsilonAntiFund_invariant
entries.docstring:
The antisymmetric symbol with two anti-fundamental indices is invariant: `ḡ ⊗ ḡ` scales it
  by the conjugate of `det g = 1`.
entries.snippet: lemma epsilonAntiFund_invariant (g : SU 2) : g • epsilonAntiFund = epsilonAntiFund

entries.name: suTensor.rootOfUnity
entries.docstring: The primitive `N`-th root of unity `exp (2 π i / N)`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def rootOfUnity (N : ℕ) : ℂ

entries.name: suTensor.rootOfUnity_isPrimitiveRoot
entries.snippet: lemma rootOfUnity_isPrimitiveRoot (hN : N ≠ 0) : IsPrimitiveRoot (rootOfUnity N) N

entries.name: suTensor.rootOfUnity_mul_star
entries.snippet: lemma rootOfUnity_mul_star : rootOfUnity N * star (rootOfUnity N) = 1

entries.name: suTensor.centre
entries.docstring: The centre element `ω 1` of `SU(N)`, for `ω` the primitive `N`-th root of unity.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def centre (N : ℕ) (hN : N ≠ 0) : SU N

entries.name: suTensor.basis_repr_centre_smul_fund
entries.docstring: The centre element scales the components of a tensor with two fundamental indices by `ω²`.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_repr_centre_smul_fund (hN : N ≠ 0) (t : (suTensor N).Tensor fun _ : Fin 2 => .fund)
    (φ : Fin 2 → Fin N) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (centre N hN • t) φ
      = rootOfUnity N ^ 2 * (Tensor.basis _).repr t φ

entries.name: suTensor.basis_repr_centre_smul_antiFund
entries.docstring:
The centre element scales the components of a tensor with two anti-fundamental indices by
  `ω̄²`.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_repr_centre_smul_antiFund (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (t : (suTensor N).Tensor fun _ : Fin 2 => .antiFund) (φ : Fin 2 → Fin N) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (centre N hN • t) φ
      = starRingEnd ℂ (rootOfUnity N) ^ 2 * (Tensor.basis _).repr t φ

entries.name: suTensor.rootOfUnity_sq_ne_one
entries.snippet: lemma rootOfUnity_sq_ne_one (hN : 3 ≤ N) : rootOfUnity N ^ 2 ≠ 1

entries.name: suTensor.eq_zero_of_invariant_fundPair
entries.docstring:
For `N ≥ 3` the only invariant tensor with two fundamental indices is zero: the centre
  element scales it by `ω² ≠ 1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_zero_of_invariant_fundPair (hN : 3 ≤ N) (t : (suTensor N).Tensor fun _ : Fin 2 => .fund)
    (ht : ∀ g : SU N, g • t = t) : t = 0

entries.name: suTensor.eq_zero_of_invariant_antiFundPair
entries.docstring:
For `N ≥ 3` the only invariant tensor with two anti-fundamental indices is zero: the centre
  element scales it by `ω̄² ≠ 1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_zero_of_invariant_antiFundPair (hN : 3 ≤ N)
    (t : (suTensor N).Tensor fun _ : Fin 2 => .antiFund) (ht : ∀ g : SU N, g • t = t) :
    t = 0

entries.name: suTensor.fundMap
entries.docstring:
The linear map out of the tensors with `n` fundamental indices sending the basis tensor with
  labels `l` to `T l`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fundMap {n : ℕ} (T : (Fin n → Fin N) → B) :
    (suTensor N).Tensor (fun _ : Fin n => .fund) →ₗ[ℂ] B

entries.name: suTensor.antiFundMap
entries.docstring:
The linear map out of the tensors with `n` anti-fundamental indices sending the basis tensor
  with labels `l` to `T l`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def antiFundMap {n : ℕ} (T : (Fin n → Fin N) → B) :
    (suTensor N).Tensor (fun _ : Fin n => .antiFund) →ₗ[ℂ] B

entries.name: suTensor.fundMap_basis
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fundMap_basis {n : ℕ} (T : (Fin n → Fin N) → B) (l : Fin n → Fin N) :
    fundMap T (Tensor.basis (S := suTensor N) (fun _ : Fin n => Color.fund) l) = T l

entries.name: suTensor.antiFundMap_basis
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma antiFundMap_basis {n : ℕ} (T : (Fin n → Fin N) → B) (l : Fin n → Fin N) :
    antiFundMap T (Tensor.basis (S := suTensor N) (fun _ : Fin n => Color.antiFund) l) = T l

entries.name: suTensor.fundMap_smul_of_law
entries.docstring:
A linear map moving a family with `n` fundamental labels by one factor of `g` per label
  intertwines the map of the family with the action of `g`.
entries.snippet:
lemma fundMap_smul_of_law {n : ℕ} (T : (Fin n → Fin N) → B) {σ : B →ₗ[ℂ] B} (g : SU N)
    (hσ : ∀ l : Fin n → Fin N, σ (T l) = ∑ a : Fin n → Fin N, (∏ i, g.1 (a i) (l i)) • T a)
    (t : (suTensor N).Tensor fun _ : Fin n => .fund) :
    σ (fundMap T t) = fundMap T (g • t)

entries.name: suTensor.antiFundMap_smul_of_law
entries.docstring:
A linear map moving a family with `n` anti-fundamental labels by one factor of the complex
  conjugate of `g` per label intertwines the map of the family with the action of `g`.
entries.snippet:
lemma antiFundMap_smul_of_law {n : ℕ} (T : (Fin n → Fin N) → B) {σ : B →ₗ[ℂ] B} (g : SU N)
    (hσ : ∀ l : Fin n → Fin N, σ (T l)
      = ∑ a : Fin n → Fin N, (∏ i, starRingEnd ℂ (g.1 (a i) (l i))) • T a)
    (t : (suTensor N).Tensor fun _ : Fin n => .antiFund) :
    σ (antiFundMap T t) = antiFundMap T (g • t)

entries.name: suTensor.isEquivariant_fundMap
entries.docstring:
The map of a family with `n` fundamental labels is equivariant when the family moves by one
  factor of `g` per label, the summed label first.
entries.snippet:
lemma isEquivariant_fundMap {n : ℕ} (T : (Fin n → Fin N) → B)
    (hT : ∀ (g : SU N) (l : Fin n → Fin N), ρ g (T l)
      = ∑ a : Fin n → Fin N, (∏ i, g.1 (a i) (l i)) • T a) :
    (suTensor N).IsEquivariant (fun _ => .fund) ρ (fundMap T)

entries.name: suTensor.isEquivariant_antiFundMap
entries.docstring:
The map of a family with `n` anti-fundamental labels is equivariant when the family moves by
  one factor of the complex conjugate of `g` per label, the summed label first.
entries.snippet:
lemma isEquivariant_antiFundMap {n : ℕ} (T : (Fin n → Fin N) → B)
    (hT : ∀ (g : SU N) (l : Fin n → Fin N), ρ g (T l)
      = ∑ a : Fin n → Fin N, (∏ i, starRingEnd ℂ (g.1 (a i) (l i))) • T a) :
    (suTensor N).IsEquivariant (fun _ => .antiFund) ρ (antiFundMap T)

entries.name: suTensor.fundMap_epsilonFund
entries.docstring:
The map of a family with two fundamental labels sends the antisymmetric symbol to the
  epsilon contraction.
entries.snippet:
lemma fundMap_epsilonFund (T : (Fin 2 → Fin 2) → B) :
    fundMap T epsilonFund = T ![0, 1] - T ![1, 0]

entries.name: suTensor.antiFundMap_epsilonAntiFund
entries.docstring:
The map of a family with two anti-fundamental labels sends the antisymmetric symbol to the
  epsilon contraction.
entries.snippet:
lemma antiFundMap_epsilonAntiFund (T : (Fin 2 → Fin 2) → B) :
    antiFundMap T epsilonAntiFund = T ![0, 1] - T ![1, 0]

entries.name: suTensor.invariantReductionToEpsilonFund
entries.docstring:
For a family with two fundamental labels of `SU(2)` whose map is equivariant, the invariants
  of the span reduce to the span of the epsilon contraction `T ![0, 1] - T ![1, 0]`.

entries.name: suTensor.invariantReductionToEpsilonAntiFund
entries.docstring:
For a family with two anti-fundamental labels of `SU(2)` whose map is equivariant, the
  invariants of the span reduce to the span of the epsilon contraction
  `T ![0, 1] - T ![1, 0]`.

entries.name: suTensor.reducesInvariantsTo_bot_span_of_fundMap
entries.docstring:
For `N ≥ 3` and a family with two fundamental labels whose map is equivariant, the
  invariants of the span reduce to `⊥`.

entries.name: suTensor.reducesInvariantsTo_bot_span_of_antiFundMap
entries.docstring:
For `N ≥ 3` and a family with two anti-fundamental labels whose map is equivariant, the
  invariants of the span reduce to `⊥`.

entries.name: suTensor.fundAntiFundIdx
entries.docstring:
The component indices of a tensor with a fundamental and an anti-fundamental index, as the
  pair of their labels.
entries.snippet: def fundAntiFundIdx : ComponentIdx (S := suTensor N) ![.fund, .antiFund] ≃ (Fin 2 → Fin N) where

entries.name: suTensor.delta
entries.docstring:
The Kronecker delta `δᵃ_b`, the unit tensor of the anti-fundamental color, with a
  fundamental and an anti-fundamental index.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def delta : SuT[N, .fund, .antiFund]

entries.name: suTensor.delta_invariant
entries.docstring: The Kronecker delta is invariant.
entries.snippet: lemma delta_invariant (g : SU N) : g • delta N = delta N

entries.name: suTensor.basis_repr_delta
entries.docstring: The components of the Kronecker delta.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_repr_delta (n : Fin 2 → Fin N) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (delta N) (fundAntiFundIdx.symm n) = if n 0 = n 1 then 1 else 0

entries.name: suTensor.basis_repr_smul_fundAntiFund
entries.docstring:
The components of `g • t` for a tensor with a fundamental and an anti-fundamental index:
  the matrix of components `C` is moved to `g C g⁻¹`.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_repr_smul_fundAntiFund (g : SU N) (t : SuT[N, .fund, .antiFund])
    (n : Fin 2 → Fin N) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (g • t) (fundAntiFundIdx.symm n)
      = ∑ x, ∑ y, g.1 (n 0) x * (g⁻¹).1 y (n 1)
        * (Tensor.basis _).repr t (fundAntiFundIdx.symm ![x, y])

entries.name: suTensor.exists_eq_smul_delta_of_invariant
entries.docstring:
An invariant tensor with a fundamental and an anti-fundamental index is a multiple of the
  Kronecker delta: its matrix of components commutes with every element of `SU(N)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_eq_smul_delta_of_invariant (t : SuT[N, .fund, .antiFund])
    (ht : ∀ g : SU N, g • t = t) : ∃ a : ℂ, t = a • delta N

entries.name: suTensor.invariantReductionToDeltaImage
entries.docstring:
For an equivariant map `f` out of the tensors with a fundamental and an anti-fundamental
  index, the invariants of the range of `f` reduce to the span of the image `f (delta N)` of the
  Kronecker delta.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def invariantReductionToDeltaImage
    (hf : (suTensor N).IsEquivariant ![.fund, .antiFund] ρ f) :
    InvariantReductionToSpan (fun g : SU N => ρ g) (LinearMap.range f)

entries.name: suTensor.fundAntiFundMap
entries.docstring:
The linear map out of the tensors with a fundamental and an anti-fundamental index sending
  the basis tensor with labels `n` to `T n`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fundAntiFundMap (T : (Fin 2 → Fin N) → B) :
    SuT[N, .fund, .antiFund] →ₗ[ℂ] B

entries.name: suTensor.fundAntiFundMap_delta
entries.docstring: The map of a family sends the Kronecker delta to the contraction `∑ a, T ![a, a]`.
entries.snippet:
lemma fundAntiFundMap_delta (T : (Fin 2 → Fin N) → B) :
    fundAntiFundMap T (delta N) = ∑ a, T ![a, a]

entries.name: suTensor.fundAntiFundMap_smul_of_law
entries.docstring:
A linear map moving a family as `g` moves the components of a tensor with a fundamental and an
  anti-fundamental index intertwines the map of the family with the action of `g`: a factor of `g`
  on the first index and of its complex conjugate on the second, the summed index first.
entries.snippet:
lemma fundAntiFundMap_smul_of_law (T : (Fin 2 → Fin N) → B) {σ : B →ₗ[ℂ] B} (g : SU N)
    (hσ : ∀ l : Fin 2 → Fin N, σ (T l)
      = ∑ a : Fin 2 → Fin N, (g.1 (a 0) (l 0) * starRingEnd ℂ (g.1 (a 1) (l 1))) • T a)
    (t : SuT[N, .fund, .antiFund]) :
    σ (fundAntiFundMap T t) = fundAntiFundMap T (g • t)

entries.name: suTensor.isEquivariant_fundAntiFundMap
entries.docstring:
The map of a family is equivariant when the family moves as the components of a tensor
  with a fundamental and an anti-fundamental index.
entries.snippet:
lemma isEquivariant_fundAntiFundMap (T : (Fin 2 → Fin N) → B)
    (hT : ∀ (g : SU N) (l : Fin 2 → Fin N), ρ g (T l)
      = ∑ a : Fin 2 → Fin N, (g.1 (a 0) (l 0) * starRingEnd ℂ (g.1 (a 1) (l 1))) • T a) :
    (suTensor N).IsEquivariant ![.fund, .antiFund] ρ (fundAntiFundMap T)

entries.name: suTensor.invariantReductionToDelta
entries.docstring:
For a family whose map is equivariant, the invariants of the span of the family reduce to
  the span of the delta contraction `∑ a, T ![a, a]`.

entries.name: suTensor.epsilon
entries.docstring: The antisymmetric symbol of `SU(2)` as a function of two labels.
entries.snippet: def epsilon (a b : Fin 2) : ℂ

entries.name: suTensor.sum_mul_epsilon
entries.docstring: The antisymmetric symbol is invariant: `∑ g a x g b y ε x y = det g ε a b`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_mul_epsilon (g : SU 2) (a b : Fin 2) :
    ∑ x, ∑ y, g.1 a x * g.1 b y * epsilon x y = epsilon a b

entries.name: suTensor.epsilonPair₁₂
entries.docstring:
The pairing `ε^{ab} ε^{cd}` of the first index with the second and the third with the
  fourth.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def epsilonPair₁₂ : (suTensor 2).Tensor fun _ : Fin 4 => .fund

entries.name: suTensor.epsilonPair₁₃
entries.docstring:
The pairing `ε^{ac} ε^{bd}` of the first index with the third and the second with the
  fourth.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def epsilonPair₁₃ : (suTensor 2).Tensor fun _ : Fin 4 => .fund

entries.name: suTensor.basis_repr_epsilonPair₁₂
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_repr_epsilonPair₁₂ (l : Fin 4 → Fin 2) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr epsilonPair₁₂ l = epsilon (l 0) (l 1) * epsilon (l 2) (l 3)

entries.name: suTensor.basis_repr_epsilonPair₁₃
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_repr_epsilonPair₁₃ (l : Fin 4 → Fin 2) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr epsilonPair₁₃ l = epsilon (l 0) (l 2) * epsilon (l 1) (l 3)

entries.name: suTensor.sum_fin_four_arrow
entries.docstring: A sum over four labels is a fourfold sum.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_fin_four_arrow {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (F : (Fin 4 → Fin 2) → M) :
    ∑ ψ : Fin 4 → Fin 2, F ψ = ∑ x, ∑ y, ∑ z, ∑ w, F ![x, y, z, w]

entries.name: suTensor.sum_mul_epsilon_mul_epsilon
entries.docstring: A product of two invariant pairings of labels is invariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_mul_epsilon_mul_epsilon (g : SU 2) (l : Fin 4 → Fin 2) (i j k m : Fin 4)
    (hijkm : ∀ ψ : Fin 4 → Fin 2, (∏ r, g.1 (l r) (ψ r))
      = g.1 (l i) (ψ i) * g.1 (l j) (ψ j) * (g.1 (l k) (ψ k) * g.1 (l m) (ψ m)))
    (F : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 4 → Fin 2) (hF : ∀ x y z w, F x y z w i = x ∧
      F x y z w j = y ∧ F x y z w k = z ∧ F x y z w m = w)
    (hsum : ∀ G : (Fin 4 → Fin 2) → ℂ, ∑ ψ, G ψ = ∑ x, ∑ y, ∑ z, ∑ w, G (F x y z w)) :
    ∑ ψ : Fin 4 → Fin 2, (∏ r, g.1 (l r) (ψ r)) * (epsilon (ψ i) (ψ j) * epsilon (ψ k) (ψ m))
      = epsilon (l i) (l j) * epsilon (l k) (l m)

entries.name: suTensor.epsilonPair₁₂_invariant
entries.docstring: The pairing `ε^{ab} ε^{cd}` is invariant.
entries.snippet: lemma epsilonPair₁₂_invariant (g : SU 2) : g • epsilonPair₁₂ = epsilonPair₁₂

entries.name: suTensor.epsilonPair₁₃_invariant
entries.docstring: The pairing `ε^{ac} ε^{bd}` is invariant.
entries.snippet: lemma epsilonPair₁₃_invariant (g : SU 2) : g • epsilonPair₁₃ = epsilonPair₁₃

entries.name: suTensor.eq_zero_of_not_dvd
entries.docstring:
The phase `diag (ω, ω̄)`, with `ω` a primitive eighth root of unity, scales the component at
  `l` by `ω` to the power of the number of zeros of `l` plus seven times the number of ones, so
  the component vanishes unless that power is a multiple of eight.
entries.snippet: lemma eq_zero_of_not_dvd (l : Fin 4 → Fin 2) (hl : ¬ 8 ∣ ∑ i, ![1, 7] (l i)) : c l = 0

entries.name: suTensor.quarterTurn_relations
entries.docstring: The quarter turn equates each balanced component with its complement.

entries.name: suTensor.unbalanced_eq_zero
entries.docstring: The ten unbalanced components vanish.

entries.name: suTensor.sum_balanced_eq_zero
entries.docstring:
The eighth turn carries the component at `![0, 0, 0, 0]` to a quarter of the sum of the
  balanced components, so that sum vanishes.

entries.name: suTensor.eq_add_of_pairings
entries.docstring:
An invariant function of four labels is a combination of the two pairings, with the
  components at `![0, 1, 0, 1]` and `![0, 0, 1, 1]` as coefficients.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_add_of_pairings (l : Fin 4 → Fin 2) :
    c l = c ![0, 1, 0, 1] * (epsilon (l 0) (l 1) * epsilon (l 2) (l 3))
      + c ![0, 0, 1, 1] * (epsilon (l 0) (l 2) * epsilon (l 1) (l 3))

entries.name: suTensor.mem_span_epsilonPairs_of_invariant
entries.docstring:
An invariant tensor with four fundamental indices of `SU(2)` is a combination of the two
  pairings of its indices by the antisymmetric symbol.

entries.name: suTensor.reducesInvariantsTo_span_map_epsilonPairs
entries.docstring:
For an equivariant map `f` out of the tensors with four fundamental indices of `SU(2)`, the
  invariants of the range reduce to the span of the images of the two pairings.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_span_map_epsilonPairs
    {f : (suTensor 2).Tensor (fun _ : Fin 4 => .fund) →ₗ[ℂ] B}
    (hf : (suTensor 2).IsEquivariant (fun _ => .fund) ρ f) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : SU 2 => ρ g) (LinearMap.range f)
      (Submodule.span ℂ {f epsilonPair₁₂, f epsilonPair₁₃})

entries.name: suTensor.fundMap_epsilonPair₁₂
entries.docstring:
The map of a family sends the first pairing to the contraction pairing the first label with
  the second and the third with the fourth.
entries.snippet:
lemma fundMap_epsilonPair₁₂ (T : (Fin 4 → Fin 2) → B) :
    fundMap T epsilonPair₁₂
      = T ![0, 1, 0, 1] - T ![0, 1, 1, 0] - T ![1, 0, 0, 1] + T ![1, 0, 1, 0]

entries.name: suTensor.fundMap_epsilonPair₁₃
entries.docstring:
The map of a family sends the second pairing to the contraction pairing the first label with
  the third and the second with the fourth.
entries.snippet:
lemma fundMap_epsilonPair₁₃ (T : (Fin 4 → Fin 2) → B) :
    fundMap T epsilonPair₁₃
      = T ![0, 0, 1, 1] - T ![0, 1, 1, 0] - T ![1, 0, 0, 1] + T ![1, 1, 0, 0]

entries.name: suTensor.reducesInvariantsTo_span_epsilonContractions
entries.docstring:
For a family with four fundamental labels of `SU(2)` whose map is equivariant, the invariants
  of the span of the family reduce to the span of its two epsilon contractions.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_span_epsilonContractions {T : (Fin 4 → Fin 2) → B}
    (hT : (suTensor 2).IsEquivariant (fun _ => .fund) ρ (fundMap T)) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : SU 2 => ρ g) (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range T))
      (Submodule.span ℂ
        {T ![0, 1, 0, 1] - T ![0, 1, 1, 0] - T ![1, 0, 0, 1] + T ![1, 0, 1, 0],
          T ![0, 0, 1, 1] - T ![0, 1, 1, 0] - T ![1, 0, 0, 1] + T ![1, 1, 0, 0]})

entries.name: suTensor.Color
entries.docstring: The colors of the complex tensors of `SU(N)`.
entries.snippet:
inductive Color
  | fund : Color
  | antiFund : Color
  | adj : Color
  deriving DecidableEq

entries.name: suTensor.modules
entries.docstring: The carriers of the three colors.
entries.snippet:
abbrev modules : Color → Type
  | .fund => Fin N → ℂ
  | .antiFund => Fin N → ℂ
  | .adj => SUAlgebraComplexified N

entries.name: suTensor.modulesAddCommGroup
entries.snippet:
noncomputable instance modulesAddCommGroup : ∀ c, AddCommGroup (modules N c)
  | .fund => inferInstance
  | .antiFund => inferInstance
  | .adj => inferInstance

entries.name: suTensor.modulesModule
entries.snippet:
noncomputable instance modulesModule : ∀ c, Module ℂ (modules N c)
  | .fund => inferInstance
  | .antiFund => inferInstance
  | .adj => inferInstance

entries.name: suTensor.basisIdx
entries.docstring:
The labels of the basis vectors: `Fin N` for the fundamental and anti-fundamental colors,
  and the labels of the generalized Gell-Mann matrices for the adjoint.
entries.snippet:
abbrev basisIdx : Color → Type
  | .fund => Fin N
  | .antiFund => Fin N
  | .adj => GellMann.Index N

entries.name: suTensor.basisIdxFintype
entries.snippet:
instance basisIdxFintype : ∀ c, Fintype (basisIdx N c)
  | .fund => inferInstance
  | .antiFund => inferInstance
  | .adj => inferInstance

entries.name: suTensor.basisIdxDecidableEq
entries.snippet:
instance basisIdxDecidableEq : ∀ c, DecidableEq (basisIdx N c)
  | .fund => inferInstance
  | .antiFund => inferInstance
  | .adj => inferInstance

entries.name: suTensor.basis
entries.docstring:
The bases of the carriers: the standard basis for the fundamental and anti-fundamental colors,
  and the generalized Gell-Mann matrices for the adjoint.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable abbrev basis : (c : Color) → Basis (basisIdx N c) ℂ (modules N c)
  | .fund => Pi.basisFun ℂ (Fin N)
  | .antiFund => Pi.basisFun ℂ (Fin N)
  | .adj => adjBasis N

entries.name: suTensor.fundRep
entries.docstring: The fundamental representation, `v ↦ g v`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def fundRep : Representation ℂ (SU N) (Fin N → ℂ) where

entries.name: suTensor.antiFundRep
entries.docstring:
The anti-fundamental representation, `v ↦ (g⁻¹)ᵀ v`, the dual of the fundamental one. For
  unitary `g`, `(g⁻¹)ᵀ` is the complex conjugate of `g`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def antiFundRep : Representation ℂ (SU N) (Fin N → ℂ) where

entries.name: suTensor.rep
entries.docstring: The representations of the three colors.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable abbrev rep : (c : Color) → Representation ℂ (SU N) (modules N c)
  | .fund => fundRep N
  | .antiFund => antiFundRep N
  | .adj => adjRep N

entries.name: suTensor.fundContr
entries.docstring:
The contraction of a fundamental against an anti-fundamental index, the dot product
  `v ⊗ w ↦ ∑ vᵢ wᵢ`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fundContr : ((fundRep N).tprod (antiFundRep N)).IntertwiningMap
    (Representation.trivial ℂ (SU N) ℂ) where

entries.name: suTensor.antiFundContr
entries.docstring:
The contraction of an anti-fundamental against a fundamental index, the dot product
  `w ⊗ v ↦ ∑ wᵢ vᵢ`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def antiFundContr : ((antiFundRep N).tprod (fundRep N)).IntertwiningMap
    (Representation.trivial ℂ (SU N) ℂ) where

entries.name: suTensor.coevalMap
entries.docstring: The endomorphism `x ↦ ∑ contr (x ⊗ wᵢ) vᵢ` of `V` attached to `∑ wᵢ ⊗ vᵢ ∈ W ⊗ V`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def coevalMap (contr : (ρ.tprod σ).IntertwiningMap
    (Representation.trivial ℂ (SU N) ℂ)) : W ⊗[ℂ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V

entries.name: suTensor.coevalMap_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coevalMap_tmul (w : W) (v x : V) :
    coevalMap contr (w ⊗ₜ v) x = contr (x ⊗ₜ w) • v

entries.name: suTensor.lid_rTensor_assoc_symm_eq_coevalMap
entries.docstring: The contraction of `x` against the first factor of `U` is `coevalMap contr U x`.
entries.snippet:
lemma lid_rTensor_assoc_symm_eq_coevalMap (x : V) (U : W ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    TensorProduct.lid ℂ V (contr.toLinearMap.rTensor V
      ((TensorProduct.assoc ℂ V W V).symm (x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] U))) = coevalMap contr U x

entries.name: suTensor.coevalMap_injective
entries.docstring: `coevalMap` is injective when the contraction separates `W`.
entries.snippet:
lemma coevalMap_injective [FiniteDimensional ℂ V]
    (h : Function.Injective (TensorProduct.curry contr.toLinearMap).flip) :
    Function.Injective (coevalMap contr)

entries.name: suTensor.coevalMap_map
entries.docstring:
Transforming both factors of `U` conjugates `coevalMap contr U`, by the invariance of the
  contraction.
entries.snippet:
lemma coevalMap_map (g : SU N) (U : W ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    coevalMap contr (TensorProduct.map (σ g) (ρ g) U)
      = ρ g ∘ₗ coevalMap contr U ∘ₗ ρ g⁻¹

entries.name: suTensor.map_eq_self_of_coevalMap_eq_id
entries.docstring:
An element whose `coevalMap` is the identity is invariant, when the contraction separates
  `W`.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_eq_self_of_coevalMap_eq_id [FiniteDimensional ℂ V]
    (h : Function.Injective (TensorProduct.curry contr.toLinearMap).flip) {U : W ⊗[ℂ] V}
    (hU : coevalMap contr U = LinearMap.id) (g : SU N) :
    TensorProduct.map (σ g) (ρ g) U = U

entries.name: suTensor.unitOf
entries.docstring: The unit intertwining map `a ↦ a • U` of an invariant element `U ∈ W ⊗ V`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def unitOf {U : W ⊗[ℂ] V} (hU : ∀ g : SU N, TensorProduct.map (σ g) (ρ g) U = U) :
    (Representation.trivial ℂ (SU N) ℂ).IntertwiningMap (σ.tprod ρ) where

entries.name: suTensor.unitOf_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma unitOf_apply {U : W ⊗[ℂ] V} (hU : ∀ g : SU N, TensorProduct.map (σ g) (ρ g) U = U)
    (a : ℂ) : unitOf hU a = a • U

entries.name: suTensor.pairUnitVal
entries.docstring:
The element `∑ eᵢ ⊗ eᵢ` of `ℂᴺ ⊗ ℂᴺ`, the unit of the fundamental and of the anti-fundamental
  color.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def pairUnitVal : (Fin N → ℂ) ⊗[ℂ] (Fin N → ℂ)

entries.name: suTensor.comm_pairUnitVal
entries.snippet: lemma comm_pairUnitVal : TensorProduct.comm ℂ _ _ (pairUnitVal N) = pairUnitVal N

entries.name: suTensor.dotProduct_flip_injective
entries.docstring: The dot product separates vectors.
entries.snippet:
lemma dotProduct_flip_injective : Function.Injective
    (TensorProduct.curry (TensorProduct.lift (dotProductBilin ℂ ℂ) :
      (Fin N → ℂ) ⊗[ℂ] (Fin N → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)).flip

entries.name: suTensor.coevalMap_pairUnitVal
entries.docstring: Contracting against `∑ eᵢ ⊗ eᵢ` by the dot product is the identity.
entries.snippet:
lemma coevalMap_pairUnitVal {ρ σ : Representation ℂ (SU N) (Fin N → ℂ)}
    (contr : (ρ.tprod σ).IntertwiningMap (Representation.trivial ℂ (SU N) ℂ))
    (h : contr.toLinearMap = TensorProduct.lift (dotProductBilin ℂ ℂ)) :
    coevalMap contr (pairUnitVal N) = LinearMap.id

entries.name: suTensor.fundUnit
entries.docstring: The unit of the fundamental color, `∑ eᵢ ⊗ eᵢ` in anti-fundamental ⊗ fundamental.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fundUnit : (Representation.trivial ℂ (SU N) ℂ).IntertwiningMap
    ((antiFundRep N).tprod (fundRep N))

entries.name: suTensor.antiFundUnit
entries.docstring: The unit of the anti-fundamental color, `∑ eᵢ ⊗ eᵢ` in fundamental ⊗ anti-fundamental.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def antiFundUnit : (Representation.trivial ℂ (SU N) ℂ).IntertwiningMap
    ((fundRep N).tprod (antiFundRep N))

entries.name: suTensor.adjUnitVal
entries.docstring:
The element `∑ b_a ⊗ bᵃ` of `su(N)_ℂ ⊗ su(N)_ℂ`, for the Gell-Mann basis `b` and its dual basis
  `bᵃ` under the trace form: the unit of the adjoint color.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def adjUnitVal : (SUAlgebraComplexified N) ⊗[ℂ] (SUAlgebraComplexified N)

entries.name: suTensor.coevalMap_adjUnitVal
entries.snippet: lemma coevalMap_adjUnitVal : coevalMap (adjContr N) (adjUnitVal N) = LinearMap.id

entries.name: suTensor.coevalMap_comm_adjUnitVal
entries.snippet:
lemma coevalMap_comm_adjUnitVal :
    coevalMap (adjContr N) (TensorProduct.comm ℂ _ _ (adjUnitVal N)) = LinearMap.id

entries.name: suTensor.comm_adjUnitVal
entries.docstring: The unit of the adjoint color is symmetric.
entries.snippet: lemma comm_adjUnitVal : TensorProduct.comm ℂ _ _ (adjUnitVal N) = adjUnitVal N

entries.name: suTensor.adjUnit
entries.docstring: The unit of the adjoint color, `∑ b_a ⊗ bᵃ`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def adjUnit : (Representation.trivial ℂ (SU N) ℂ).IntertwiningMap
    ((adjRep N).tprod (adjRep N))

entries.name: suTensor
entries.docstring:
The complex tensor species of `SU(N)`, with fundamental, anti-fundamental and adjoint
  indices. The fundamental and anti-fundamental colors are dual to each other, the adjoint
  color dual to itself.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def suTensor (N : ℕ) : TensorSpecies ℂ suTensor.Color (SU N)
    (suTensor.modules N) (suTensor.basisIdx N) (suTensor.rep N)
    (suTensor.basis N) where

entries.name: suTensor.toMatrix_fundRep
entries.snippet:
lemma toMatrix_fundRep (g : SU N) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (Pi.basisFun ℂ (Fin N)) (Pi.basisFun ℂ (Fin N)) (fundRep N g) = g.1

entries.name: suTensor.toMatrix_antiFundRep
entries.snippet:
lemma toMatrix_antiFundRep (g : SU N) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (Pi.basisFun ℂ (Fin N)) (Pi.basisFun ℂ (Fin N)) (antiFundRep N g)
      = (g⁻¹).1ᵀ

entries.name: suTensor.toMatrix_rep_inv
entries.docstring: On every color, the matrix of `g⁻¹` is the conjugate transpose of the matrix of `g`.
entries.snippet:
lemma toMatrix_rep_inv (k : Color) (g : SU N) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (basis N k) (basis N k) (rep N k g⁻¹)
      = (LinearMap.toMatrix (basis N k) (basis N k) (rep N k g))ᴴ

entries.name: suTensor.isAdjointClosed
entries.docstring: Every list of colors of the `SU(N)` tensors is closed under adjoints, with `g' = g⁻¹`.
entries.snippet: lemma isAdjointClosed {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Color) : (suTensor N).IsAdjointClosed c

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.truncationKer
entries.docstring:
The jets trivial to order `n`: value the identity, and base-point Taylor coefficients
  of the Maurer–Cartan form vanishing below order `n`. Closure under products and inverses
  is the cocycle law together with the Taylor–Leibniz theorem for the adjoint action.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def truncationKer (n : ℕ) : Subgroup GJ where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.mem_truncationKer_zero_iff
entries.docstring: The zeroth truncation kernel is the group of pure jets, those with identity value.
entries.snippet: lemma mem_truncationKer_zero_iff {U : GJ} : U ∈ jets.truncationKer 0 ↔ jets.eval U = 1

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.adjointCoeff_eq_zero_of_mem_truncationKer
entries.docstring:
Deep jets kill the positive adjoint coefficients: for a jet trivial to order `n`, the
  adjoint coefficients of order between `1` and `n` vanish. One derivative of the adjoint
  is `ad` of the Maurer–Cartan form, whose base-point data vanish below order `n`.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointCoeff_eq_zero_of_mem_truncationKer {n : ℕ} {U : GJ} (hU : U ∈ jets.truncationKer n)
    {x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hxn : x.card ≤ n) :
    jets.adjointCoeff U x = 0

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.adjointDualCoeff_eq_zero_of_mem_truncationKer
entries.docstring: The dual form of `adjointCoeff_eq_zero_of_mem_truncationKer`.

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.adjointCoeff_mul_of_mem_truncationKer_right
entries.docstring: Up to order `n`, a jet trivial to order `n` is invisible on the right of a product.

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.adjointCoeff_conj_of_mem_truncationKer
entries.docstring:
Up to order `n`, a conjugate of a jet trivial to order `n` has the adjoint
  coefficients of the identity.

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.evalLie_iteratedDeriv_adjoint_conj_of_mem_truncationKer
entries.docstring:
Up to order `n`, a conjugate of a jet trivial to order `n` acts trivially on the
  base-point Taylor data of the jet Lie algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma evalLie_iteratedDeriv_adjoint_conj_of_mem_truncationKer (g : GJ) {n : ℕ} {U : GJ}
    (hU : U ∈ jets.truncationKer n) {s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)} (hs : s.card ≤ n)
    (Y : 𝔤J) : jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s (jets.adjointJ (g * U * g⁻¹) Y)) =
      jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s Y)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.maurerCartan_conj
entries.docstring:
The Maurer–Cartan form of a conjugate, by the cocycle law: the conjugating jet
  contributes its own form and its transport by the conjugate.
entries.snippet:
lemma maurerCartan_conj (g U : GJ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    jets.maurerCartan (g * U * g⁻¹) μ =
      jets.maurerCartan g μ + jets.adjointJ g (jets.maurerCartan U μ)
        - jets.adjointJ (g * U * g⁻¹) (jets.maurerCartan g μ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.truncationKer_normal
entries.docstring:
The truncation kernels are normal subgroups: conjugating a jet trivial to order `n`
  gives a jet trivial to order `n`.
entries.snippet: instance truncationKer_normal (n : ℕ) : (jets.truncationKer n).Normal where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.truncationProjZero
entries.docstring:
The projection of a jet onto the pure jets, stripping its value: `U ↦ U · (U₀)⁻¹`.
  This is not a group homomorphism; it is the cocycle of the splitting of `GJ` by the
  constant jets.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def truncationProjZero (U : GJ) : jets.truncationKer 0

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.coe_truncationProjZero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coe_truncationProjZero (U : GJ) :
    (jets.truncationProjZero U : GJ) = U * (jets.ofConstant (jets.eval U))⁻¹

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.eq_truncationProjZero_mul_ofConstant
entries.docstring: Every jet is its pure part times the constant jet of its value.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_truncationProjZero_mul_ofConstant (U : GJ) :
    U = jets.truncationProjZero U * jets.ofConstant (jets.eval U)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.truncationProjZero_eq_one_iff
entries.docstring: The pure part of a jet is trivial exactly when the jet is constant.
entries.snippet:
lemma truncationProjZero_eq_one_iff {U : GJ} :
    jets.truncationProjZero U = 1 ↔ U = jets.ofConstant (jets.eval U)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.truncationProjZero_ofConstant
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma truncationProjZero_ofConstant (g : G₀) :
    jets.truncationProjZero (jets.ofConstant g) = 1

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.maurerCartan_truncationProjZero
entries.docstring:
Stripping the value of a jet does not change its Maurer–Cartan form: by the cocycle
  law, right multiplication by a constant jet drops out.
entries.snippet:
lemma maurerCartan_truncationProjZero (U : GJ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    jets.maurerCartan (jets.truncationProjZero U) μ = jets.maurerCartan U μ

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff
entries.docstring:
The symmetrized Maurer–Cartan data of a pure jet: the base-point values of its
  symmetrized Maurer–Cartan forms, indexed by nonempty multisets of directions. Total
  symmetry is automatic from the multiset indexing.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff (U : jets.truncationKer 0)
    (r : {r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) // r ≠ 0}) : 𝔤

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff_apply (U : jets.truncationKer 0)
    (r : {r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) // r ≠ 0}) :
    jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff U r =
      jets.evalLie (jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm U.1 r.1)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.mem_truncationKer_of_symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff_eq_zero
entries.docstring:
Maurer–Cartan triangularity: a pure jet whose symmetrized Maurer–Cartan data vanish
  up to order `n` is trivial to order `n`. The symmetrized data control the Taylor data of
  the Maurer–Cartan form through the symmetrization defect.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_truncationKer_of_symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff_eq_zero (U : jets.truncationKer 0)
    (n : ℕ) (h : ∀ (r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (hr : r ≠ 0), r.card ≤ n →
      jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff U ⟨r, hr⟩ = 0) :
    U.1 ∈ jets.truncationKer n

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff_eq_zero_of_mem_truncationKer
entries.docstring:
Conversely, the symmetrized Maurer–Cartan data of a jet trivial to order `n` vanish
  up to order `n`: each term of the symmetrized form carries fewer than `n` derivatives.

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.mem_truncationKer_iff_symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff_eq_zero
entries.docstring:
The truncation filtration through the symmetrized Maurer–Cartan data: a pure jet is
  trivial to order `n` exactly when its symmetrized data vanish up to order `n`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_truncationKer_iff_symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff_eq_zero (U : jets.truncationKer 0)
    (n : ℕ) : U.1 ∈ jets.truncationKer n ↔
      ∀ (r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (hr : r ≠ 0), r.card ≤ n →
        jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff U ⟨r, hr⟩ = 0

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.maurerCartan_injOn_truncationKer_zero
entries.docstring:
A pure jet of a faithful package is determined by its Maurer–Cartan form. By the
  cocycle and inverse laws `ω(V⁻¹ U) = Ad_{V⁻¹}(ω(U) − ω(V)) = 0`, so `V⁻¹ U` is the
  constant jet of its value, which is the identity.
entries.snippet:
lemma maurerCartan_injOn_truncationKer_zero {U V : GJ} (hU : U ∈ jets.truncationKer 0)
    (hV : V ∈ jets.truncationKer 0) (h : jets.maurerCartan U = jets.maurerCartan V) :
    U = V

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff_injective
entries.docstring:
A pure jet of a faithful package is determined by its symmetrized Maurer–Cartan data.
  The symmetrized data determine all base-point Taylor data of the Maurer–Cartan form
  (`evalLie_iteratedDeriv_maurerCartan_eq_of_symmetrized_eq_all`), hence the form itself by
  Taylor determinacy, hence the jet by `maurerCartan_injOn_truncationKer_zero`.
entries.snippet:
lemma symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff_injective :
    Function.Injective jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.radial
entries.docstring: The radial component `∑_μ x_μ ω_μ(U)` of the Maurer–Cartan form of a jet.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def radial (U : GJ) : 𝔤J

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff_eq_evalLie_iteratedDeriv_radial
entries.docstring:
The symmetrized Maurer–Cartan data are the Taylor data of the radial component:
  `sym(ω(U))_r|₀ = (1/|r|) (∂_r ρ(U))|₀`.
entries.snippet:
lemma symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff_eq_evalLie_iteratedDeriv_radial (U : jets.truncationKer 0)
    (r : {r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) // r ≠ 0}) :
    jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff U r =
      (1 / (r.1.card : ℝ)) • jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv r.1 (jets.radial U.1))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.Free
entries.docstring:
A package is free when it is faithful and its jets are honest formal power series in
  the coordinates: every family of base-point Taylor data is realized by an element of
  `𝔤J` (Taylor completeness), and every element vanishing at the base point is the radial
  component of the Maurer–Cartan form of a pure jet (radial integrability, the solution of
  the Euler equation `∑_μ x_μ ∂_μ U = −i ρ U` with `U(0) = 1`). Both hold for the full jet
  group of any matrix group. Freeness makes the symmetrized Maurer–Cartan data free
  coordinates on the pure jets, `symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff_bijective`; like `Faithful`
  it is recorded separately from the structure because the covariance theory does not
  need it, only the classification of invariants does.
entries.snippet:
class Free (jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 GJ 𝔤J) : Prop extends Faithful jets where
  exists_evalLie_iteratedDeriv_eq : ∀ c : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → 𝔤,
    ∃ Y : 𝔤J, ∀ s, jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s Y) = c s
  exists_radial_eq : ∀ ρ : 𝔤J, jets.evalLie ρ = 0 → ∃ U : jets.truncationKer 0, jets.radial U.1 = ρ

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.exists_evalLie_iteratedDeriv_eq
entries.docstring: Taylor completeness of a free package.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_evalLie_iteratedDeriv_eq (c : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → 𝔤) :
    ∃ Y : 𝔤J, ∀ s, jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s Y) = c s

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.exists_radial_eq
entries.docstring: Radial integrability of a free package.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_radial_eq {ρ : 𝔤J} (hρ : jets.evalLie ρ = 0) :
    ∃ U : jets.truncationKer 0, jets.radial U.1 = ρ

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff_surjective
entries.docstring:
Every family of symmetrized Maurer–Cartan data is realized by a pure jet: realize the
  data, rescaled by the order, as the Taylor data of an element `ρ` vanishing at the base
  point, and integrate `ρ` to a pure jet.
entries.snippet:
lemma symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff_surjective :
    Function.Surjective jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff_bijective
entries.docstring:
The symmetrized Maurer–Cartan data are free coordinates on the pure jets of a free
  package.
entries.snippet:
lemma symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff_bijective :
    Function.Bijective jets.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff

entries.name: JetU1.coord

lemma coord_val (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : JetU1Algebra) :

entries.name: JetU1.star_mcVal
entries.docstring: The Maurer–Cartan scalar `i (∂_μ u) u⁻¹` of a unitary jet is self-adjoint.
entries.snippet:
lemma star_mcVal (u : JetU1) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    star (Complex.I • (pderiv μ (u : SpaceTimeAlgebra) * star (u : SpaceTimeAlgebra)))
      = Complex.I • (pderiv μ (u : SpaceTimeAlgebra) * star (u : SpaceTimeAlgebra))

entries.name: JetU1.mc

lemma mc_val (u : JetU1) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :

**The local gauge data of `U(1)`**: unitary jets, self-adjoint scalar jets with
  vanishing bracket and trivial adjoint action, and the Maurer–Cartan form
  `i (∂_μ u) u⁻¹`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def u1 : LocalGaugeData U1 U1Algebra JetU1 JetU1Algebra

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.u1_iteratedDeriv_val
entries.docstring: The iterated derivative on `u(1)` jets is the iterated formal derivative.

The local gauge data of `U(1)` is free. Real Taylor data give a self-adjoint jet, and

entries.name: MatterField
entries.docstring:
**A matter field** of a gauge theory over the gauge context `jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 GJ 𝔤J`:
  a finite-dimensional complex target space `V`, the Lorentz representation on `V`, a
  fibrewise action of `GJ` on the jets `SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V` of the field, the infinitesimal
  action of the gauge algebra generating it, the mass weight of the field (in the units
  in which a derivative has weight `2`), and its declared statistics.
entries.snippet:
structure MatterField {G₀ : Type} [Group G₀] {𝔤 : Type} [LieRing 𝔤] [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤]
    {GJ : Type} [Group GJ] {𝔤J : Type} [LieRing 𝔤J] [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤J]
    (jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 GJ 𝔤J) where
  V : Type
  [instAddCommGroup : AddCommGroup V]
  [instModule : Module ℂ V]
  [instFree : Module.Free ℂ V]
  [instFinite : Module.Finite ℂ V]
  repLorentz : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) V
  repJet : Representation ℂ GJ (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)
  repAlgebra : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V
  repJet_smul : ∀ (U : GJ) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V), repJet U (χ • z) =
      χ • repJet U z
  repAlgebra_isInfinitesimalAction : jets.IsInfinitesimalActionOf repAlgebra repJet
  massWeight : ℕ
  statistic : FieldStatistic

entries.name: MatterField.PureJetsActTrivially
entries.docstring:
Pure gauge jets act trivially at the base point: a jet with trivial value has identity
  zeroth Taylor coefficient on the value space. With the fibrewise law, the base-point
  value of the jet action is then a function of the value of the jet.
entries.snippet: def PureJetsActTrivially : Prop

entries.name: MatterField.GaugeLorentzCompatible
entries.docstring:
The infinitesimal gauge action commutes with the Lorentz representation on the value
  space.
entries.snippet: def GaugeLorentzCompatible : Prop

entries.name: MatterField.chargePow
entries.docstring: The unitary power series `U ^ n` of a `U(1)` jet, for an integer charge `n`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def chargePow (n : ℤ) (U : unitary SpaceTimeAlgebra) : SpaceTimeAlgebra

entries.name: MatterField.chargePow_one
entries.snippet: lemma chargePow_one (n : ℤ) : chargePow n 1 = 1

entries.name: MatterField.chargePow_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma chargePow_mul (n : ℤ) (U W : unitary SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    chargePow n (U * W) = chargePow n U * chargePow n W

entries.name: MatterField.chargeRep
entries.docstring:
**The charge-`n` action of `U(1)` jets on the jets of a `V`-valued field**:
  multiplication of the jet-ring factor by `U ^ n`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def chargeRep (n : ℤ) (V : Type) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] :
    Representation ℂ (unitary SpaceTimeAlgebra) (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) where

entries.name: MatterField.chargeRep_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma chargeRep_tmul (n : ℤ) (U : unitary SpaceTimeAlgebra) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (v : V) :
    chargeRep n V U (f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v) = (chargePow n U * f) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v

entries.name: MatterField.chargeRep_smul
entries.docstring: **The charge action is fibrewise**: it commutes with multiplication by scalar jets.
entries.snippet:
lemma chargeRep_smul (n : ℤ) (U : unitary SpaceTimeAlgebra) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra)
    (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    chargeRep n V U (χ • z) = χ • chargeRep n V U z

entries.name: MatterField.charged
entries.docstring:
**The charged matter field**: a field with values in `V`, Lorentz representation
  `repLorentz`, electric charge `n`, mass weight `w` and declared statistic `σ`, as a matter
  field for the jets of `U(1)`, in any gauge context `jets` whose jet group is
  `unitary SpaceTimeAlgebra`.

  The infinitesimal action `act` of the gauge algebra is supplied, not constructed. For a
  charge-`n` field it is `c ↦ (i n φ(c)) • id` for the functional `φ` reading off the
  `u(1)` component of `c`, and no such functional is available: `jets` relates the gauge
  algebra `𝔤` to the jets only through `evalLie` and `maurerCartan`, neither of which
  identifies a `u(1)` direction in an arbitrary `𝔤`. The rest of the data does not depend
  on `jets` beyond its jet group, so it is supplied polymorphically.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def charged {𝔤 : Type} [LieRing 𝔤] [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤]
    {G₀ : Type} [Group G₀] {𝔤J : Type} [LieRing 𝔤J] [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤J]
    (jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 (unitary SpaceTimeAlgebra) 𝔤J) [Module.Free ℂ V] [Module.Finite ℂ V]
    (repLorentz : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) V) (n : ℤ) (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (hact : jets.IsInfinitesimalActionOf act (chargeRep n V)) (w : ℕ) (σ : FieldStatistic) :
    MatterField jets where

entries.name: MatterField.charged_V
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma charged_V {𝔤 : Type} [LieRing 𝔤] [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤]
    {G₀ : Type} [Group G₀] {𝔤J : Type} [LieRing 𝔤J] [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤J]
    (jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 (unitary SpaceTimeAlgebra) 𝔤J) [Module.Free ℂ V] [Module.Finite ℂ V]
    (repLorentz : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) V) (n : ℤ) (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (hact : jets.IsInfinitesimalActionOf act (chargeRep n V)) (w : ℕ) (σ : FieldStatistic) :
    (charged jets repLorentz n act hact w σ).V = V

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff
entries.docstring:
The base-point Taylor coefficient of the representation: include the constant
  vector into `V`-valued jets, act by `rep U`, differentiate `x` times, evaluate at
  the base point. The composite is complex-linear: the physicists'
  `∂_x (rep U)^i_j|₀` as a ℂ-linear map on the value space.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repCoeff (rep : Representation ℂ GJ (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V))
    (U : GJ) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) : V →ₗ[ℂ] V

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repDualCoeff
entries.docstring:
The physicists' `∂_x (rep U)^i_j|₀` acting on the complex dual index of a
  matter-field symbol: the transpose of `repCoeff`. This is the analogue of
  `adjointDualCoeff` for a general representation of the jet gauge group; for `x = 0`
  it is the dual (contragredient) action of the value of `U`, and for `x ≠ 0` it sees
  the derivatives of the gauge transformation.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repDualCoeff (rep : Representation ℂ GJ (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V))
    (U : GJ) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ V

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.jetEval_rep_of_smul
entries.docstring:
For a fibrewise representation, evaluating the transform of a jet at the base point
  is the zeroth Taylor coefficient of the transform of its base-point value: the jet ring
  factor passes through the action and is then evaluated.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetEval_rep_of_smul (rep : Representation ℂ GJ (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V))
    (hlin : ∀ (U : GJ) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V), rep U
        (χ • z) = χ • rep U z)
    (U : GJ) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    jetEval (rep U z) = repCoeff rep U 0 (jetEval z)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff_zero_mul
entries.docstring:
The zeroth Taylor coefficients of a fibrewise representation are multiplicative: they
  form a representation of the jet gauge group on the value space.
entries.snippet:
lemma repCoeff_zero_mul (rep : Representation ℂ GJ (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V))
    (hlin : ∀ (U : GJ) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V), rep U
        (χ • z) = χ • rep U z)
    (U W : GJ) : repCoeff rep (U * W) 0 = repCoeff rep U 0 ∘ₗ repCoeff rep W 0

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.tensorAction
entries.docstring:
The action of an adjoint-valued field on a matter field at the tensor level:
  multiplication in `B` on the first factors, the ℂ-linear infinitesimal action `act`
  of the gauge algebra on `V` on the second, so that on pure tensors
  `(b₁ ⊗ c) · (b₂ ⊗ v) = (b₁ b₂) ⊗ act c v`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def tensorAction (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V) :
    (B ⊗[ℝ] 𝔤) →ₗ[ℝ] (B ⊗[ℂ] V) →ₗ[ℂ] B ⊗[ℂ] V

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.tensorAction_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma tensorAction_tmul (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V) (b₁ b₂ : B)
    (c : 𝔤) (v : V) :
    tensorAction act (b₁ ⊗ₜ[ℝ] c) (b₂ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v) = (b₁ * b₂) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] act c v

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.tensorAction_map_left
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorAction_map_left (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V) (Φ : B →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (hΦ : ∀ b₁ b₂, Φ (b₁ * b₂) = Φ b₁ * Φ b₂) (s : B ⊗[ℝ] 𝔤)
    (t : B ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    tensorAction act ((TensorProduct.map (Φ.restrictScalars ℝ) LinearMap.id) s)
        ((TensorProduct.map Φ LinearMap.id) t) =
      (TensorProduct.map Φ LinearMap.id) (tensorAction act s t)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.tensorAction_one_left
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorAction_one_left (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V) (c : 𝔤)
    (t : B ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    tensorAction act ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] c) t =
      (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (act c)) t

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.tensorAction_map_right_antidiagonal
entries.docstring:
`tensorAction` under an antidiagonal pair of transport families: if the
  `V`-transports intertwine `act` with the `𝔤`-transports as an
  antidiagonal convolution, so do `id ⊗ ·` over `tensorAction`.
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorAction_map_right_antidiagonal (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (Tg : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] 𝔤)
    (Tv : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → V →ₗ[ℂ] V) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (hT : ∀ (c : 𝔤) (w : V), Tv x (act c w) =
      (x.antidiagonal.map fun p => act (Tg p.1 c) (Tv p.2 w)).sum)
    (s : B ⊗[ℝ] 𝔤) (t : B ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    (x.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
      tensorAction act ((TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (Tg p.1)) s)
        ((TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (Tv p.2)) t)).sum =
      (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (Tv x)) (tensorAction act s t)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.dualPairEquivC
entries.docstring:
The canonical equivalence between matter fields `B ⊗[ℂ] V` and their component
  families `φ ↦ F^φ` over the complex dual — `dualPairEquiv` for a general
  finite-dimensional complex value space.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def dualPairEquivC : (B ⊗[ℂ] V) ≃ₗ[ℂ] (Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.dualPairEquivC_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma dualPairEquivC_tmul (b : B) (v : V) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    dualPairEquivC (b ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v) φ = φ v • b

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.dualPairEquivC_map_left
entries.snippet:
lemma dualPairEquivC_map_left (Φ : B →ₗ[ℂ] B) (t : B ⊗[ℂ] V)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    dualPairEquivC ((TensorProduct.map Φ LinearMap.id) t) φ =
      Φ (dualPairEquivC t φ)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.dualPairEquivC_map_right
entries.snippet:
lemma dualPairEquivC_map_right (T : V →ₗ[ℂ] V) (t : B ⊗[ℂ] V)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    dualPairEquivC ((TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id T) t) φ =
      dualPairEquivC t (T.dualMap φ)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symm_comp_left_C
entries.snippet:
lemma symm_comp_left_C (Φ : B →ₗ[ℂ] B) (g : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B) :
    dualPairEquivC.symm (Φ ∘ₗ g) =
      (TensorProduct.map Φ LinearMap.id) (dualPairEquivC.symm g)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.symm_comp_right_C
entries.snippet:
lemma symm_comp_right_C (T : V →ₗ[ℂ] V) (g : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B) :
    dualPairEquivC.symm (g ∘ₗ T.dualMap) =
      (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id T) (dualPairEquivC.symm g)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFam
entries.docstring:
The action of an adjoint-indexed component family on a matter one, through the
  infinitesimal action `act`: assemble both into fields, act by `tensorAction`, read
  back out as components. This is the physicists' `f^a (T_a)^i_j g^j` with `T = act`,
  basis-free.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def actionFam (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (f : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) (g : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B) :
    Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFam_add_left
entries.snippet:
lemma actionFam_add_left (f₁ f₂ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (g : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B) :
    actionFam act (f₁ + f₂) g = actionFam act f₁ g + actionFam act f₂ g

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFam_add_right
entries.snippet:
lemma actionFam_add_right (f : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (g₁ g₂ : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B) :
    actionFam act f (g₁ + g₂) = actionFam act f g₁ + actionFam act f g₂

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFam_zero_left
entries.snippet:
lemma actionFam_zero_left (g : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B) :
    actionFam act 0 g = 0

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFam_zero_right
entries.snippet:
lemma actionFam_zero_right (f : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    actionFam act f 0 = 0

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFam_sum_left
entries.snippet:
lemma actionFam_sum_left (S : Multiset (Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B))
    (g : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B) :
    actionFam act S.sum g = (S.map fun f => actionFam act f g).sum

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFam_sum_right
entries.snippet:
lemma actionFam_sum_right (f : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (S : Multiset (Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)) :
    actionFam act f S.sum = (S.map fun g => actionFam act f g).sum

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repGauge_actionFam
entries.docstring:
The gauge transformation of the action of an affinely-transforming
  adjoint-indexed family on a linearly-transforming matter family: the action of the
  transformed families plus one `act`-type cross term. This is `repGauge_bracketFam`
  with a homogeneous second slot and the bracket replaced by a general action.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_actionFam
    (U : GJ) {f f' : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B}
    {g g' : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B} {cf : 𝔤}
    (hf : ∀ ψ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤,
      repGauge U (f ψ) = f' ψ + algebraMap ℂ B (ψ cf))
    (hg : ∀ ψ : Module.Dual ℂ V, repGauge U (g ψ) = g' ψ)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    repGauge U (actionFam act f g φ) =
      actionFam act f' g' φ + g' (φ ∘ₗ act cf)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFamConv
entries.docstring:
The derived action family `A_ρ · F`: the `s`-derivative of the action of the
  gauge field on a matter family, given by the Leibniz convolution of the derivative
  symbols over the multiset antidiagonal — the matter analogue of `bracketFamConv`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def actionFamConv
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V) (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivAction
entries.docstring:
The covariant derivative `∇_ρ F = [∂_ρ F] + A_ρ · F` of a matter family of
  derivative symbols, in the single direction `ρ`: the extra derivative on the symbol
  plus the derived action of the gauge field on the value index. With the physicists'
  factor of `i` absorbed into `act` (as it is in the gauge-algebra bracket), this is
  `∂_ρ F + i A_ρ^a T_a F` in the `D = ∂ + i A` convention.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def covDerivAction
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivAction_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma covDerivAction_apply
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    covDerivAction A act F ρ s φ = F (ρ ::ₘ s) φ + actionFamConv A act ρ F s φ

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivIter
entries.docstring:
**The iterated covariant derivative** `∇_{l 0} ⋯ ∇_{l (n-1)} F` of a matter family
  along an ordered tuple of directions: covariant derivatives do not commute (their
  commutator is the action of the field strength), so the iteration is order-dependent
  and indexed by `(n : ℕ)` and `l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)` — the same ordered-tuple
  indexing as the derivative labels of `IsHiggsAlgebraValued`. The result is again a
  family of derivative symbols; the physical iterated covariant derivative is its
  value at the empty multiset.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def covDerivIter
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B) :
    (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) →
      Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B
  | 0, _ => F
  | n + 1, l => covDerivAction A act (covDerivIter A act F n fun i => l i.succ) (l 0)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivIter_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma covDerivIter_zero (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (l : Fin 0 → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    covDerivIter A act F 0 l = F

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivIter_succ
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma covDerivIter_succ (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    {n : ℕ} (l : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    covDerivIter A act F (n + 1) l =
      covDerivAction A act (covDerivIter A act F n fun i => l i.succ) (l 0)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.dualPairEquiv_symm_eq_sum
entries.docstring:
Decomposition of an assembled adjoint-indexed family along a basis of the gauge
  algebra: the components against the dual basis, tensored with the basis vectors.
entries.snippet:
lemma dualPairEquiv_symm_eq_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (bW : Module.Basis ι ℝ 𝔤)
    (g : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    dualPairEquiv.symm g = ∑ i, g (bW.coord i) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] bW i

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.dualPairEquivC_symm_eq_sum
entries.docstring: Decomposition of an assembled matter family along a basis of the value space.
entries.snippet:
lemma dualPairEquivC_symm_eq_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (bW : Module.Basis ι ℂ V)
    (g : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B) :
    dualPairEquivC.symm g = ∑ i, g (bW.coord i) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] bW i

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFam_apply_mem
entries.docstring:
The value of an action of families lies in any subalgebra containing the values
  of both families: the action is a finite sum of products of components.

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivIter_sub_mem
entries.docstring:
**Unitriangularity of the covariant matter tower**: the covariant and plain
  derivative symbols of a matter family differ by an element of the subalgebra
  generated by the gauge-field symbols and the strictly lower-order matter symbols.
  Stated at every derivative multiset `s`, as needed for the induction.
entries.snippet:
lemma covDerivIter_sub_mem (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    covDerivIter A act F n l s φ - F (List.ofFn l + s) φ ∈
      Algebra.adjoin ℂ
        ({b : B | ∃ (u : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
            (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤), b = A u μ ψ} ∪
          {b : B | ∃ (t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (χ : Module.Dual ℂ V),
            t.card < n + s.card ∧ b = F t χ})

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivIter_mem_adjoin_symbols
entries.docstring:
Every derivative symbol of the covariant tower is a polynomial in the gauge-field
  symbols and the matter symbols.
entries.snippet:
lemma covDerivIter_mem_adjoin_symbols (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    covDerivIter A act F n l s φ ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ
      ({b : B | ∃ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
          (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤), b = A s μ ψ} ∪
        {b : B | ∃ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V),
          b = F s φ})

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.adjoin_symbols_eq_adjoin_covDerivIter
entries.docstring:
**The span lemma**: the algebra of symbols generated by the gauge field together
  with a matter family's *derivative* symbols equals the one generated by the gauge
  field together with the matter family's *covariant* derivative tower. The
  correction `∇_ρ − ∂_ρ` is the derived action of the gauge field — a sum of products
  of symbols, absorbed by the algebra structure.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjoin_symbols_eq_adjoin_covDerivIter (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B) :
    Algebra.adjoin ℂ
      ({b : B | ∃ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
          (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤), b = A s μ ψ} ∪
        {b : B | ∃ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V),
          b = F s φ}) =
    Algebra.adjoin ℂ
      ({b : B | ∃ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
          (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤), b = A s μ ψ} ∪
        {b : B | ∃ (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V),
          b = covDerivIter A act F n l 0 φ})

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFam_map
entries.docstring:
The action of an adjoint-indexed family on a matter family is natural in the
  algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma actionFam_map (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V) (f : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (g : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B) :
    actionFam act (Φ.restrictScalars ℝ ∘ₗ f) (Φ ∘ₗ g) = Φ ∘ₗ actionFam act f g

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFamConv_map
entries.docstring: The derived action family is natural in the algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma actionFamConv_map
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V) (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    actionFamConv (fun p σ => Φ.restrictScalars ℝ ∘ₗ A p σ) act ρ (fun p => Φ ∘ₗ F p) s
      = Φ ∘ₗ actionFamConv A act ρ F s

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivAction_map
entries.docstring: The covariant derivative of a matter family is natural in the algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma covDerivAction_map
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    covDerivAction (fun p σ => Φ.restrictScalars ℝ ∘ₗ A p σ) act (fun p => Φ ∘ₗ F p) ρ s
      = Φ ∘ₗ covDerivAction A act F ρ s

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivIter_map
entries.docstring:
The iterated covariant derivative of a matter family is natural in the algebra: the
  image of the tower is the tower of the image families, at every ordered tuple of
  directions and every derivative multiset.
entries.snippet:
lemma covDerivIter_map
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    covDerivIter (fun p σ => Φ.restrictScalars ℝ ∘ₗ A p σ) act (fun p => Φ ∘ₗ F p) n l
      = fun s => Φ ∘ₗ covDerivIter A act F n l s

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf
entries.docstring:
`act` is the *infinitesimal action* of the gauge algebra underlying the
  representation `rep` of the jet gauge group, when the base-point Taylor
  coefficients of `rep` satisfy the two laws forced by `rep` being generated by
  `act`:

  * `repCoeff_cons` — the Leibniz rule in the Maurer–Cartan form: differentiating
    the representation once produces minus the action of the Maurer–Cartan form,
    with the remaining derivatives distributed over the antidiagonal (for the
    adjoint representation this is `LocalGaugeData.adjointCoeff_cons`);
  * `repCoeff_act` — the transports of `rep` intertwine `act` with the adjoint
    transports, as an antidiagonal convolution (for the adjoint representation this
    is `LocalGaugeData.adjointCoeff_lie`); at `x = 0` it is the classical equivariance
    `rep(U)|₀ ∘ act c = act (Ad(U) c)|₀ ∘ rep(U)|₀`.

  These are exactly the identities consumed by the proof that the covariant
  derivative `covDerivAction` preserves `TransformsIn`.
entries.snippet:
structure IsInfinitesimalActionOf (jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 GJ 𝔤J)
    (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (rep : Representation ℂ GJ (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)) : Prop where
  repCoeff_cons : ∀ (U : GJ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)),
    repCoeff rep U (μ ::ₘ x) =
      -((x.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        act (jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv p.1 (jets.maurerCartan U μ))) ∘ₗ
          repCoeff rep U p.2).sum)
  repCoeff_act : ∀ (U : GJ) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (c : 𝔤),
    repCoeff rep U x ∘ₗ act c =
      ((x.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        act (jets.adjointCoeff U p.1 c) ∘ₗ repCoeff rep U p.2).sum)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf.repDualCoeff_cons
entries.docstring:
The dual form of the Leibniz law: the once-more-derived dual coefficient is
  minus the antidiagonal convolution of dual coefficients against `act` of the
  derived Maurer–Cartan form — the analogue of `LocalGaugeData.adjointDualCoeff_cons`.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsInfinitesimalActionOf.repDualCoeff_cons
    {act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V}
    {rep : Representation ℂ GJ (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)}
    (h : IsInfinitesimalActionOf jets act rep) (U : GJ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    repDualCoeff rep U (μ ::ₘ x) φ =
      -((x.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        repDualCoeff rep U p.2 (φ ∘ₗ act (jets.evalLie
          (jets.iteratedDeriv p.1 (jets.maurerCartan U μ))))).sum)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf.actionFam_repDualCoeff
entries.docstring:
The action of families against the dual representation coefficients: the
  antidiagonal convolution mixing the adjoint transport on the field slot with the
  representation transport on the matter slot — the family-level form of
  `IsInfinitesimalActionOf.repCoeff_act`, and the analogue of
  `bracketFam_adjointDualCoeff`.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsInfinitesimalActionOf.actionFam_repDualCoeff
    (h : IsInfinitesimalActionOf jets act rep) (U : GJ)
    (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (f : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (g : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    actionFam act f g (repDualCoeff rep U x φ) =
      (x.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        actionFam act (f ∘ₗ jets.adjointDualCoeff U p.1)
          (g ∘ₗ repDualCoeff rep U p.2) φ).sum

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.TransformsIn.repGauge_cons
entries.docstring:
If `F` transforms in `rep`, so do its `κ ::ₘ s`-derived symbols, with the extra
  derivative traced through `IsInfinitesimalActionOf.repDualCoeff_cons`: the Leibniz
  splittings where `κ` stays a derivative, minus the convolution where `κ` hits the
  representation — `act` of the derived Maurer–Cartan form.
entries.snippet:
lemma TransformsIn.repGauge_cons
    {F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B}
    (hF : TransformsIn repGauge rep F)
    (hact : IsInfinitesimalActionOf jets act rep)
    (U : GJ) (κ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    repGauge U (F (κ ::ₘ s) φ) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        F (κ ::ₘ p.2) (repDualCoeff rep U⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum
      - (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          (p.1.antidiagonal.map fun q =>
            F p.2 (repDualCoeff rep U⁻¹ q.2
              (φ ∘ₗ act (jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv q.1
                (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ κ)))))).sum).sum

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.TransformsIn.repGauge_actionFamConv
entries.docstring:
The all-orders gauge transformation of the derived action `A_ρ · F` for `F`
  transforming in `rep`: since `F` transforms homogeneously, only one cross-term
  convolution through `act` survives — the analogue of
  `TransformsInAdjoint.repGauge_bracketFamConv` with a matter field in the second
  slot.
entries.snippet:
lemma TransformsIn.repGauge_actionFamConv
    {F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B}
    (hF : TransformsIn repGauge rep F)
    (hact : IsInfinitesimalActionOf jets act rep)
    (U : GJ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    repGauge U (actionFamConv h.A act ρ F s φ) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        actionFamConv h.A act ρ F p.2 (repDualCoeff rep U⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum
      + (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          (p.2.antidiagonal.map fun r =>
            F r.2 (repDualCoeff rep U⁻¹ r.1
              (φ ∘ₗ act (jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv p.1
                (jets.maurerCartan U⁻¹ ρ)))))).sum).sum

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.TransformsIn.covDerivAction
entries.docstring:
The covariant derivative preserves `TransformsIn`: if `F` transforms in the
  representation `rep` and `act` is the infinitesimal action underlying `rep`, then
  `∇_ρ F = [∂_ρ F] + A_ρ · F` transforms in `rep`. The single inhomogeneous
  convolution of `[∂_{ρ ::ₘ s} F]` cancels the single `act` cross-term convolution of
  `A_ρ · F` through the coassociativity of the antidiagonal — the matter-field
  analogue of `TransformsInAdjoint.covDerivAdjoint`.
entries.snippet:
lemma TransformsIn.covDerivAction
    {F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B}
    (hF : TransformsIn repGauge rep F)
    (hact : IsInfinitesimalActionOf jets act rep) (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
