    TransformsIn repGauge rep (GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivAction h.A act F ρ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.TransformsIn.covDerivIter
entries.docstring:
Every iterated covariant derivative preserves `TransformsIn`: if `F` transforms
  in `rep` and `act` is the infinitesimal action underlying `rep`, then
  `∇_{l 0} ⋯ ∇_{l (n-1)} F` transforms in `rep` — the recursion of
  `TransformsIn.covDerivAction` over the tuple of directions.
entries.snippet:
lemma TransformsIn.covDerivIter
    {F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B}
    (hF : TransformsIn repGauge rep F)
    (hact : IsInfinitesimalActionOf jets act rep)
    (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    TransformsIn repGauge rep (GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivIter h.A act F n l)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.actionConj
entries.docstring:
The conjugate of an infinitesimal action: the same maps, read on the conjugate
  module — the generators of the conjugate representation.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def actionConj (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V) :
    𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] ConjModule V →ₗ[ℂ] ConjModule V where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.actionConj_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma actionConj_apply (act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V) (c : 𝔤) :
    actionConj act c = ConjModule.endConj (act c)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.conjJetEquiv
entries.docstring:
The identification of the jets of a conjugate field with the conjugates of the
  jets: conjugation is monoidal, and the star of the jet-ring factor absorbs the
  twist — `conj (g ⊗ u) ↦ star g ⊗ conj u`. This is the equivalence along which
  `JetComponentSpace.repConj` carries the conjugated representation.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def conjJetEquiv :
    ConjModule (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) ≃ₗ[ℂ] SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] ConjModule V

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.conjJetEquiv_conjEquiv_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma conjJetEquiv_conjEquiv_tmul (g : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (u : V) :
    conjJetEquiv (conjEquiv (k := ℂ) (M := SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) (g ⊗ₜ[ℂ] u))
      = star g ⊗ₜ[ℂ] conjEquiv (k := ℂ) (M := V) u

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.repConj_conjJetEquiv
entries.docstring: The conjugate representation acts through `conjJetEquiv` by the original maps.
entries.snippet:
lemma repConj_conjJetEquiv (rep : Representation ℂ GJ (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V))
    (U : GJ) (w : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    JetComponentSpace.repConj rep U
        (conjJetEquiv (conjEquiv (k := ℂ) (M := SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) w))
      = conjJetEquiv (conjEquiv (k := ℂ) (M := SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) (rep U w))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.repCoeff_repConj
entries.docstring:
The base-point Taylor coefficients of the conjugate representation are the
  conjugated coefficients: the derivative directions are real, so conjugation passes
  through `∂_x` and the base-point evaluation untouched.
entries.snippet:
lemma repCoeff_repConj (rep : Representation ℂ GJ (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V))
    (U : GJ) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    repCoeff (JetComponentSpace.repConj rep) U x
      = ConjModule.endConj (repCoeff rep U x)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.repCoeff_repConj_zero_eq_id
entries.docstring:
The base-point triviality of the zeroth Taylor coefficient passes to the
  conjugate representation.

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf.conj
entries.docstring:
The conjugate of an infinitesimal action underlies the conjugate
  representation: conjugating the Taylor coefficients preserves both the
  Maurer–Cartan Leibniz law and the adjoint intertwining, since the gauge-algebra
  inputs are real.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsInfinitesimalActionOf.conj (h : IsInfinitesimalActionOf jets act rep) :
    IsInfinitesimalActionOf jets (actionConj act) (JetComponentSpace.repConj rep)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace
entries.docstring:
The space of component functions of the matter field `M`: the span of the symbols
`∂_s ψ_α` and their conjugates `∂_s ψ̄_α`, where `α` runs over the target space `M.V`. The
first factor holds the unconjugated symbols, the second the conjugate ones; in each,
`SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ` carries the derivative label `s` and the dual factor the target
component `α`.

Only `M.V` enters the space itself; the field's Lorentz and gauge representations and its
mass weight enter the structure carried on it below. Taking the whole matter field rather
than its value space is what lets that structure be read off `M` instead of being supplied
by hand at each use.
entries.snippet: abbrev JetComponentSpace (M : MatterField jets) : Type

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
**The Lorentz action on the jet component space.** Under a Lorentz transformation a
matter field transforms as `ψ(x) ↦ ρ(Λ) ψ(Λ⁻¹ x)`, so a derivative symbol `∂_s ψ_α` is
acted on in *both* of its labels: the derivative multiset `s` by the Lorentz action on
covectors, extended to `SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ`, and the target index `α` by the
contragredient of `ρ`.

Unlike the gauge action, this needs no fibrewise-linearity or finite-dimensionality
hypothesis: the two labels transform independently, so the action is simply a tensor
product of representations. The conjugate half is the same with `ρ` replaced by its
conjugate, the symbols `∂_s ψ̄_α` transforming by `star` of the spinor matrix.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup (M : MatterField jets) :
    Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) (JetComponentSpace M)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup_fst
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup_fst (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    (JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup M Λ x).1
      = (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.repLorentzGroup.tprod M.repLorentz.dual) Λ x.1

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup_snd
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup_snd (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    (JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup M Λ x).2
      = (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.repLorentzGroup.tprod M.repLorentz.conj.dual) Λ x.2

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup_fst_tmul
entries.docstring:
On a pure symbol the Lorentz action is diagonal in the two labels: the derivative
label transforms in `SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ`, the target index contragrediently.
entries.snippet:
lemma JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup_fst_tmul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V)
    (y : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    (JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup M Λ (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ, y)).1
      = SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.repLorentzGroup Λ a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (φ ∘ₗ M.repLorentz Λ⁻¹)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
the derivative of components in the jet component space,
  in the direction `μ`: the shift `∂_s ψ_α ↦ ∂_{s + {μ}} ψ_α` of the derivative label,
  and likewise on the conjugate components.

  This is right multiplication by the degree-one element `∂_μ` on the
  `SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ` factor, leaving the target index untouched. It uses a basis of
  the Lorentz covectors — that is what the index `μ` is — but no basis of `V`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    JetComponentSpace M →ₗ[ℂ] JetComponentSpace M

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv_fst_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv_fst_tmul (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V)
    (y : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    (JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv μ (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ, y)).1
      = (a * SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis ({μ} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv_snd_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv_snd_tmul (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (x : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ M.V)
    (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    (JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv μ (x, a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ)).2
      = (a * SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis ({μ} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv_comm
entries.docstring:
**Total derivatives commute.** Mixed partials agree because the derivative labels
  live in a *symmetric* algebra; no basis of `V` is involved.
entries.snippet:
lemma JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv_comm (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv (M := M) μ).comp (JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv ν)
      = (JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv (M := M) ν).comp (JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv μ)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv_eq_ι
entries.docstring:
The element being multiplied in is the degree-one derivative symbol `∂_μ`, the image
  of the dual basis covector under `SymmetricAlgebra.ι`.
entries.snippet:
lemma JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv_eq_ι (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv (M := M) μ
      = LinearMap.prodMap
        (TensorProduct.map
          (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ (Module.Dual ℂ Lorentz.ComplexCoVector)
            (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis μ))) LinearMap.id)
        (TensorProduct.map
          (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ (Module.Dual ℂ Lorentz.ComplexCoVector)
            (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis μ))) LinearMap.id)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv_fst
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv_fst (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (v : JetComponentSpace M) :
    (JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv μ v).1
      = TensorProduct.map
        (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis ({μ} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))))
        LinearMap.id v.1

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv_snd
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv_snd (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (v : JetComponentSpace M) :
    (JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv μ v).2
      = TensorProduct.map
        (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis ({μ} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))))
        LinearMap.id v.2

entries.name: repLorentzGroup_tprod_mulRight_jetSymbol
entries.docstring:
The covariance of the derivative-symbol multiplication on one tensor factor of the
  component space, for an arbitrary representation on the other factor.
entries.snippet:
private lemma repLorentzGroup_tprod_mulRight_jetSymbol {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W]
    [Module ℂ W] (ρ : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) W) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (w : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] W) :
    (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.repLorentzGroup.tprod ρ) Λ
      (TensorProduct.map
        (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis ({μ} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))))
        LinearMap.id w) =
    ∑ a, (((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 a μ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
      TensorProduct.map
        (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis ({a} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))))
        LinearMap.id ((SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.repLorentzGroup.tprod ρ) Λ w)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup_jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
**The jet derivative is a Lorentz vector on the component space.** Appending `∂_μ` and
  then acting is acting and then appending the transformed `∂_μ`, which is a combination of
  the `∂_a`. Both halves of the component space are covered by the same argument: the
  derivative label lives in the first tensor factor, and what sits in the second factor —
  `M.repLorentz.dual` or `M.repLorentz.conj.dual` — plays no role.
entries.snippet:
lemma JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup_jetDeriv (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (v : JetComponentSpace M) :
    JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup M Λ (JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv μ v) =
      ∑ a, (((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 a μ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv a (JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup M Λ v)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.comap
entries.docstring:
**The component space is contravariant in the target space.** A linear map `f : M.V →ₗ N.V`
  of target spaces pulls the component functions of the field `N` back to component
  functions of the field `M`: a component function is a *covector* on the target, so it
  transposes. The derivative label is untouched, and the conjugate half transposes the
  conjugate of `f`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def JetComponentSpace.comap (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) :
    JetComponentSpace N →ₗ[ℂ] JetComponentSpace M

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.comap_fst_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma JetComponentSpace.comap_fst_tmul (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ N.V) (y : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule N.V)) :
    (JetComponentSpace.comap f (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ, y)).1 = a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (φ ∘ₗ f)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.comap_snd_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma JetComponentSpace.comap_snd_tmul (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V)
    (x : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ N.V) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule N.V)) :
    (JetComponentSpace.comap f (x, a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ)).2 = a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (φ ∘ₗ ConjModule.map f)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.comap_id
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma JetComponentSpace.comap_id :
    JetComponentSpace.comap (LinearMap.id : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] M.V) = LinearMap.id

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.comap_comp
entries.docstring:
Functoriality: pulling back along `g ∘ f` is pulling back along `g` and then along `f`.
  The order reverses, as it must for a contravariant construction.
entries.snippet:
lemma JetComponentSpace.comap_comp {P : MatterField jets}
    (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) (g : N.V →ₗ[ℂ] P.V) :
    JetComponentSpace.comap (g.comp f)
      = (JetComponentSpace.comap f).comp (JetComponentSpace.comap g)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.comapEquiv
entries.docstring:
A relabelling of the target space relabels the component functions. An isomorphism
  `e : M.V ≃ₗ N.V` of target spaces identifies the two component spaces, contravariantly: the
  component functions of the field `N` become those of the field `M`. This is
  `comap` upgraded to an equivalence, the two directions being mutually inverse by
  functoriality.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def JetComponentSpace.comapEquiv (e : M.V ≃ₗ[ℂ] N.V) :
    JetComponentSpace N ≃ₗ[ℂ] JetComponentSpace M

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.comapEquiv_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma JetComponentSpace.comapEquiv_apply (e : M.V ≃ₗ[ℂ] N.V) (x : JetComponentSpace N) :
    JetComponentSpace.comapEquiv e x = JetComponentSpace.comap e.toLinearMap x

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.comap_comp_repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
**An equivariant map of target spaces gives an equivariant pullback.** If `f : M.V →ₗ N.V`
  intertwines the two Lorentz representations then `comap f` intertwines the induced actions on
  the component spaces, in the opposite direction. Component functions are covectors, so
  the unconjugated half transposes `f` against the contragredient action and the conjugate
  half against its conjugate; both reduce to equivariance of `f` at `Λ⁻¹`.
entries.snippet:
lemma JetComponentSpace.comap_comp_repLorentzGroup (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V)
    (hf : ∀ Λ : SL(2,ℂ), f.comp (M.repLorentz Λ) = (N.repLorentz Λ).comp f)
    (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    (JetComponentSpace.comap f).comp (JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup N Λ)
      = (JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup M Λ).comp (JetComponentSpace.comap f)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.comap_jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
**The pullback commutes with the jet derivative.** The two act on different tensor
  factors — the derivative label and the target index — so an inclusion of species is a map
  of differential algebras.
entries.snippet:
lemma JetComponentSpace.comap_jetDeriv (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (JetComponentSpace.comap f).comp (JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv μ)
      = (JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv μ).comp (JetComponentSpace.comap f)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale
entries.docstring:
The mass-weight scaling on the jet component space of a field of mass weight `w`
  (twice the mass dimension): the generator `∂_s φ_α` and its conjugate are scaled by
  `c ^ (w + 2 |s|)`, through the derivative-degree scaling `SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.gradeScale`
  on the derivative label.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale (w : ℕ) (c : ℂ) :
    JetComponentSpace M →ₗ[ℂ] JetComponentSpace M

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale_fst_basis_tmul
entries.docstring:
On an unconjugated component function `∂_s φ_α` the mass-weight scaling is
  multiplication by `c ^ (w + 2 |s|)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale_fst_basis_tmul (w : ℕ) (c : ℂ)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V)
    (y : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    (JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale w c
        ((SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ, y) : JetComponentSpace M)).1
      = c ^ (w + 2 * Multiset.card s) • (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale_fst
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale_fst (w : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (v : JetComponentSpace M) :
    (JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale w c v).1
      = c ^ w • TensorProduct.map
          (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.gradeScale (c ^ 2)).toLinearMap LinearMap.id v.1

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale_snd
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale_snd (w : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (v : JetComponentSpace M) :
    (JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale w c v).2
      = c ^ w • TensorProduct.map
          (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.gradeScale (c ^ 2)).toLinearMap LinearMap.id v.2

entries.name: gradeScale_map_mulRight_basis
entries.docstring:
The derivative-degree scaling intertwines multiplication by a single derivative
  symbol up to one factor of the scaling parameter, on either half of the component
  space.
entries.snippet:
private lemma gradeScale_map_mulRight_basis {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W]
    (c : ℂ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] W) :
    TensorProduct.map (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.gradeScale (c ^ 2)).toLinearMap LinearMap.id
      (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ
        (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis ({μ} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)))) LinearMap.id x)
    = c ^ 2 • TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ
        (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis ({μ} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)))) LinearMap.id
        (TensorProduct.map (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.gradeScale (c ^ 2)).toLinearMap
          LinearMap.id x)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale_jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
**The total derivative carries mass weight two** on the component space: the scaling
  intertwines the derivative shift up to a factor `c ^ 2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale_jetDeriv (w : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale (M := M) w c).comp (JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv μ)
      = c ^ 2 • (JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv μ).comp
          (JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale w c)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.comap_comp_massWeightScale
entries.docstring:
**The mass-weight scaling is natural in the target space.** It commutes with every
  pullback, acting as it does on the derivative label and not on the target index. So the
  scaling cannot see which part of a target space a component function came from: in
  `JetComponentSpace (∀ i, V i)`, where a species enters through
  `comap (LinearMap.proj i)`, every species is scaled by the same weight. This is why the
  generator space of a multi-species theory, `GaugeFieldData.FermionGenerators`, records
  the weights on a direct sum, one per species, rather than on a single component space of
  the product.
entries.snippet:
lemma JetComponentSpace.comap_comp_massWeightScale (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) (w : ℕ) (c : ℂ) :
    (JetComponentSpace.comap f).comp (JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale w c)
      = (JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale w c).comp (JetComponentSpace.comap f)

entries.name: prodPiEquiv
entries.docstring:
A pair of families is the same thing as a family of pairs. This is the last step of
  the splitting of a component space over a product of target spaces: the two halves split
  separately into families, and this puts the two families back together index by index.
  Everything is the identity on underlying data, so every law is `rfl`.
entries.snippet:
def prodPiEquiv {A B : ι → Type*} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (A i)] [∀ i, Module ℂ (A i)]
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (B i)] [∀ i, Module ℂ (B i)] :
    ((∀ i, A i) × (∀ i, B i)) ≃ₗ[ℂ] ∀ i, (A i × B i) where

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.fstPiEquiv
entries.docstring:
**The unconjugated half of the component space of a finite direct sum splits.** The
  symbols `∂_s ψ_α` of a `(∀ i, E i)`-valued field are the families, over the index, of
  the symbols of the summands: the dual distributes over the finite product and the
  derivative label is untouched.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def JetComponentSpace.fstPiEquiv :
    (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ (∀ i, E i))
      ≃ₗ[ℂ] ∀ i, SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ (E i)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.fstPiEquiv_tmul
entries.docstring:
On a pure symbol the splitting restricts the target index to one summand: the
  component `∂_s ψ_α` of the direct sum in the summand `i` is `∂_s` of the covector `φ`
  precomposed with the inclusion of that summand.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma JetComponentSpace.fstPiEquiv_tmul (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (∀ i, E i)) (i : ι) :
    fstPiEquiv E (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ) i = a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (φ ∘ₗ LinearMap.single ℂ E i)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.sndPiEquiv
entries.docstring:
**The conjugate half of the component space of a finite direct sum splits**, by the
  same argument applied to the conjugate modules, using that conjugation commutes with
  products.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def JetComponentSpace.sndPiEquiv :
    (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (∀ i, E i)))
      ≃ₗ[ℂ] ∀ i, SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (E i))

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.sndPiEquiv_tmul
entries.docstring:
On a pure conjugate symbol the splitting again restricts the target index to one
  summand, the inclusion being read through the conjugation.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma JetComponentSpace.sndPiEquiv_tmul (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ)
    (ψ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (∀ i, E i))) (i : ι) :
    sndPiEquiv E (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ψ) i
      = a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (ψ ∘ₗ ConjModule.map (k := ℂ) (LinearMap.single ℂ E i))

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.fstPiEquiv_symm_single
entries.docstring:
The splitting sends the family supported on one summand back to the pullback along
  the projection onto that summand: a component function of the summand `i`, read as a
  component function of the whole, is `φ ∘ proj i`.
entries.snippet:
lemma JetComponentSpace.fstPiEquiv_symm_single (i : ι)
    (z : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ (E i)) :
    (fstPiEquiv E).symm (Pi.single i z)
      = TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (Module.Dual.transpose (LinearMap.proj i)) z

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.sndPiEquiv_symm_single
entries.docstring:
The conjugate half of the splitting behaves in the same way, the projection read
  through the conjugation.
entries.snippet:
lemma JetComponentSpace.sndPiEquiv_symm_single (i : ι)
    (z : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (E i))) :
    (sndPiEquiv E).symm (Pi.single i z)
      = TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id
          (Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (k := ℂ) (LinearMap.proj i))) z

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.symbolAction
entries.docstring:
**The action of a coefficient on the symbols.** A coefficient `g ⊗ T` acts by
`jetRingAction g` on the derivative label — the Leibniz convolution redistributing
derivatives between the gauge transformation and the field — and by the transpose `Tᵀ` on
the target index.

A coefficient is allowed to change the value space, so that the symbol action of an
endomorphism and the pullback along a map of value spaces are the same construction; at
`W = V` this is the action on `Module.End ℂ (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗ Module.Dual ℂ V)` that
`repDual` uses.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def symbolAction :
    (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] (V →ₗ[ℂ] W)) →ₗ[ℂ]
      ((SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ W) →ₗ[ℂ]
        (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ V))

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.symbolAction_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma symbolAction_tmul (g : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (T : V →ₗ[ℂ] W) :
    symbolAction (g ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T)
      = TensorProduct.map (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction g) (Module.Dual.transpose T)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.symbolAction_one_tmul
entries.docstring:
**A coefficient acts on the undifferentiated symbol through its value at the base
point.** On `1 ⊗ φ` — the symbol `ψ_φ` carrying no derivatives — only the constant term of
the power-series coefficient survives, so the result is again undifferentiated and the
target index is acted on by the transpose of the base-point value.
entries.snippet:
lemma symbolAction_one_tmul (c : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    symbolAction c ((1 : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ)
      = (1 : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
        Module.Dual.transpose (jetEval ∘ₗ TensorProduct.lift
          ((LinearMap.llcomp ℂ V V (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)).comp
            (TensorProduct.mk ℂ SpaceTimeAlgebra V)) c) φ

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.repDual
entries.docstring:
**The gauge action on the symbols.** Given a fibrewise gauge action on the jets of a
`V`-valued field, this is the induced (contragredient) action on the derivative symbols
`∂_s ψ_α`, which span `SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗ Module.Dual ℂ V`.

Multiplicativity is bookkeeping: `coeff_mul_of_smul_comm` makes the coefficient
multiplicative, `symbolAction_mul` makes its action an anti-homomorphism, and the inverse
flips that back.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repDual [Module.Free ℂ V] [Module.Finite ℂ V]
    (rep : Representation ℂ GJ (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V))
    (hlin : ∀ (U : GJ) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V),
      rep U (χ • z) = χ • rep U z) :
    Representation ℂ GJ (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ V) where

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.repDual_one_tmul
entries.docstring:
**The undifferentiated symbol transforms by the value of the gauge transformation at
the base point.** No derivative of the gauge jet contributes: the symbol `ψ_φ` is acted on
by the contragredient of `rep U⁻¹` restricted to constant jets and evaluated at the base
point.
entries.snippet:
lemma repDual_one_tmul [Module.Free ℂ V] [Module.Finite ℂ V]
    (rep : Representation ℂ GJ (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V))
    (hlin : ∀ (U : GJ) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V),
      rep U (χ • z) = χ • rep U z)
    (U : GJ) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    repDual rep hlin U ((1 : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ)
      = (1 : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
        Module.Dual.transpose (jetEval ∘ₗ (rep U⁻¹).comp jetOfConstant) φ

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.repJet
entries.docstring:
**The gauge action on the jet component space.** The induced action of the jets of
gauge transformations on the full space of component functions of the matter field `M` —
the symbols `∂_s ψ_α` together with their conjugates `∂_s ψ̄_α`.

The unconjugated half is `repDual M.repJet`, the contragredient action on the symbols. The
conjugate half is the *same* construction applied to `repConj M.repJet`, the action on the
jets of the conjugate field; `repConj_smul_comm` supplies the fibrewise-linearity it needs.
The conjugate half therefore carries `star` of the gauge matrix, which is the physicists'
`ψ̄ ↦ ψ̄ U†`.

Everything the construction needs is a field of `MatterField`: the jet action `M.repJet`,
its fibrewise linearity `M.repJet_smul`, and the freeness and finiteness of `M.V`. Taking
the matter field rather than a bare value space is what removes all three from the
argument list.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repJet (M : MatterField jets) :
    Representation ℂ GJ (JetComponentSpace M)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.repJet_fst
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repJet_fst (M : MatterField jets) (U : GJ) (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    (repJet M U x).1 = repDual M.repJet M.repJet_smul U x.1

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.repJet_snd
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repJet_snd (M : MatterField jets) (U : GJ) (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    (repJet M U x).2
      = repDual (repConj M.repJet) (repConj_smul_comm M.repJet_smul) U x.2

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.map_transpose_comp_symbolAction
entries.docstring:
Pulling back and then acting is acting and then pulling back, on the symbols of a
coefficient. Precomposing the symbol action of a coefficient of `W` with the pullback
along `f` is the symbol action of the coefficient precomposed with `f`.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_transpose_comp_symbolAction (f : V →ₗ[ℂ] W) (y : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] Module.End ℂ W) :
    (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (Module.Dual.transpose f)).comp (symbolAction y)
      = symbolAction (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra (LinearMap.lcomp ℂ W f) y)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.symbolAction_comp_map_transpose
entries.docstring:
The companion of `map_transpose_comp_symbolAction` on the other side: postcomposing
  the symbol action of a coefficient of `V` with the pullback along `f` is the symbol
  action of the coefficient postcomposed with `f`.
entries.snippet:
lemma symbolAction_comp_map_transpose (f : V →ₗ[ℂ] W) (x : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) :
    (symbolAction x).comp (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (Module.Dual.transpose f))
      = symbolAction (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra (LinearMap.llcomp ℂ V V W f) x)

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.comap_comp_repDual
entries.docstring:
The gauge action on the unconjugated symbols is natural in the value space. A
linear map of value spaces intertwining two fibrewise jet actions makes the pullback of
symbols equivariant for the two contragredient actions. The whole content is the naturality
of the coefficient, `JetComponentSpace.jetCoeff_naturality`, read through the symbol
action; the group element is inverted on both sides alike, so no convention is disturbed
by it.
entries.snippet:
lemma comap_comp_repDual [Module.Free ℂ V] [Module.Finite ℂ V]
    [Module.Free ℂ W] [Module.Finite ℂ W]
    (repV : Representation ℂ GJ (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V))
    (hV : ∀ (U : GJ) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V), repV U
        (χ • z) = χ • repV U z)
    (repW : Representation ℂ GJ (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] W))
    (hW : ∀ (U : GJ) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] W), repW U
        (χ • z) = χ • repW U z)
    (f : V →ₗ[ℂ] W)
    (hf : ∀ U : GJ, (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra f).comp (repV U)
      = (repW U).comp (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra f)) (U : GJ) :
    (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (Module.Dual.transpose f)).comp (repDual repW hW U)
      = (repDual repV hV U).comp
        (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (Module.Dual.transpose f))

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.comap_comp_repJet
entries.docstring:
The gauge action on the jet component space is natural in the value space. If
`f : M.V →ₗ N.V` intertwines the two fields' actions on the jets, then the pullback of component
functions along `f` intertwines the induced actions on the component spaces, in the
opposite direction — the pullback of a component function of a `W`-valued field being a
component function of a `V`-valued field.

Both halves are covered and every derivative label is carried: the statement is an equality
of linear maps on the whole component space, not a statement about undifferentiated
symbols. The conjugate half is the unconjugated argument applied to `repConj M.repJet` and
`repConj N.repJet`, whose intertwining is `JetComponentSpace.lTensor_comp_repConj`.
entries.snippet:
lemma comap_comp_repJet {M N : MatterField jets} (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V)
    (hf : ∀ U : GJ, (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra f).comp (M.repJet U)
      = (N.repJet U).comp (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra f)) (U : GJ) :
    (comap f).comp (repJet N U) = (repJet M U).comp (comap f)

entries.name: jetIteratedDeriv_tmul
entries.docstring:
The iterated formal derivative of a `V`-valued jet acts on the jet-ring factor of a
  pure tensor: the value factor carries no spacetime dependence.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetIteratedDeriv_tmul (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (v : V) :
    jetIteratedDeriv x (f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v) = SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv x f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.jetCoeffAt
entries.docstring:
The base-point Taylor coefficient at `x` derivatives of a jet of endomorphisms of `V`:
  differentiate `x` times and evaluate at the base point. It is the `V`-valued jet toolkit
  applied to the value space `Module.End ℂ V`, and it is what a coefficient in
  `SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗ End V` contributes to the derivative symbol `∂_x`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetCoeffAt (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.jetCoeffAt_tmul
entries.docstring:
On a pure coefficient `f ⊗ T` the Taylor coefficient is the base-point Taylor
  coefficient of `f` times `T`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetCoeffAt_tmul (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (T : Module.End ℂ V) :
    jetCoeffAt x (f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T)
      = constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv x f) • T

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.jetCoeffAt_apply
entries.docstring:
The Taylor coefficient of a jet of endomorphisms, evaluated at a vector, is the Taylor
  coefficient of the `V`-valued jet obtained by feeding that vector to the coefficient.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetCoeffAt_apply (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (c : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) :
    jetCoeffAt x c v = jetEval (jetIteratedDeriv x (TensorProduct.lift
      ((LinearMap.llcomp ℂ V V (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)).comp
        (TensorProduct.mk ℂ SpaceTimeAlgebra V)) c v))

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.jetCoeffAt_jetCoeff
entries.docstring:
The Taylor coefficients of the gauge coefficient are the Taylor coefficients of the
  representation: `jetCoeff rep U` reproduces `rep U` on constant jets, and both sides of
  this identity read off the same derivative of that.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetCoeffAt_jetCoeff [Module.Free ℂ V] [Module.Finite ℂ V]
    (rep : Representation ℂ G (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)) (U : G)
    (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    jetCoeffAt x (jetCoeff rep U) = GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff rep U x

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.dualMap_add_apply
entries.docstring: The transpose is additive in the endomorphism.
entries.snippet:
private lemma dualMap_add_apply (A B : Module.End ℂ V) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    (A + B).dualMap φ = A.dualMap φ + B.dualMap φ

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.dualMap_smul_apply
entries.docstring: The transpose is homogeneous in the endomorphism.
entries.snippet:
private lemma dualMap_smul_apply (c : ℂ) (T : Module.End ℂ V) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    (c • T).dualMap φ = c • T.dualMap φ

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.sum_tmul_right
entries.docstring: A multiset sum in the derivative label distributes out of a pure symbol.
entries.snippet:
private lemma sum_tmul_right (m : Multiset SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) (w : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    m.sum ⊗ₜ[ℂ] w = (m.map fun a => a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] w).sum

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.symbolAction_basis_tmul
entries.docstring:
A coefficient acts on the derivative symbol `∂_s ψ_φ` by the all-orders Leibniz
  convolution of its base-point Taylor coefficients: each splitting `s = s₁ + s₂` of the
  derivative multiset contributes the Taylor coefficient at `s₁` acting on the target index
  of the lower symbol `∂_{s₂} ψ_φ`.

  This is `SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_basis_multiset` in the derivative label,
  together with the identification of the scalars it produces as `jetCoeffAt`; both sides
  are additive in the coefficient, so it suffices to check it on a pure tensor.
entries.snippet:
lemma symbolAction_basis_tmul (c : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    symbolAction c (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ)
      = (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis p.2 ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (jetCoeffAt p.1 c).dualMap φ).sum

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.repDual_basis_tmul
entries.docstring:
The transformation law of the derivative symbol `∂_s ψ_φ` under the jet gauge group:
  the all-orders Leibniz convolution of the dual representation coefficients
  `GaugeAlgebraRealization.repDualCoeff` against lower symbols, with no inhomogeneous term. This is
  the identity the `LocalGaugeData.TransformsIn` obligations of a matter field rest on.

  Nothing here is special to the unconjugated half of the component space: the conjugate
  half is this lemma at `repConj rep`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repDual_basis_tmul [Module.Free ℂ V] [Module.Finite ℂ V]
    (rep : Representation ℂ G (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V))
    (hlin : ∀ (U : G) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V),
      rep U (χ • z) = χ • rep U z)
    (U : G) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    repDual rep hlin U (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ)
      = (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis p.2 ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
            GaugeAlgebraRealization.repDualCoeff rep U⁻¹ p.1 φ).sum

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.sum_derivConv_sum_fam
entries.docstring:
A scalar combination of convolutions against the gauge field is linear in the
  right-hand families.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_derivConv_sum_fam {ι κ ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype ι']
    (f : ι → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) (coef : ι → κ → ℂ) (c : ι' → ℂ)
    (g : ι' → κ → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    ∑ j, ∑ k, coef j k • derivConv (f j) (fun y => ∑ i, c i • g i k y) s =
      ∑ i, c i • ∑ j, ∑ k, coef j k • derivConv (f j) (g i k) s

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_eq_lorentzMix
entries.docstring:
A Lorentz law in the tuple form, read on the underlying multisets: the transformed
  family mixes by `lorentzMix`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_eq_lorentzMix (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (f g : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B)
    (hfg : ∀ (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)), repLorentz Λ (f (List.ofFn l)) =
      ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ i, L[Λ] (p i) (l i)) • g (List.ofFn p))
    (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) : repLorentz Λ (f x) = lorentzMix Λ g x 0

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_apply_mix
entries.docstring: The Lorentz law of the gauge-field symbols, in the multiset form.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_apply_mix (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (χ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    repLorentz Λ (h.A x μ χ) = lorentzMix Λ (fun t => ∑ a, L[Λ] a μ • h.A t a χ) x 0

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.isLorentzDerivTransforms_mix
entries.docstring: The Lorentz law of a family of derivative symbols, in the multiset form.

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_sum_derivConv
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of a scalar combination of convolutions against the gauge field: the
  direction of the gauge field mixes by its own column, the derivative slots by
  `lorentzMix`, and the right-hand families are replaced by their transforms.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_sum_derivConv (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (bg : Module.Basis ι ℝ 𝔤) (coef : ι → κ → ℂ)
    (g g' : κ → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B)
    (hg : ∀ k y, repLorentz Λ (g k y) = lorentzMix Λ (g' k) y 0)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    repLorentz Λ (∑ j, ∑ k, coef j k • derivConv (fun x => h.A x ρ (bg.coord j)) (g k) s) =
      ∑ a, L[Λ] a ρ • lorentzMix Λ
        (fun t => ∑ j, ∑ k, coef j k • derivConv (fun x => h.A x a (bg.coord j)) (g' k) t)
        s 0

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFam_apply_eq_sum
entries.docstring: The action of families expanded in bases of the gauge algebra and the value space.
entries.snippet:
lemma actionFam_apply_eq_sum {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (bg : Module.Basis ι ℝ 𝔤) (bv : Module.Basis κ ℂ V)
    (f : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) (g : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    actionFam act f g φ =
      ∑ j, ∑ k, φ (act (bg j) (bv k)) • (f (bg.coord j) * g (bv.coord k))

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFamConv_eq_sum
entries.docstring: The derived action family expanded in bases.
entries.snippet:
lemma actionFamConv_eq_sum {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (bg : Module.Basis ι ℝ 𝔤) (bv : Module.Basis κ ℂ V)
    (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (G : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    actionFamConv A act ρ G s φ = ∑ j, ∑ k, φ (act (bg j) (bv k)) •
      derivConv (fun x => A x ρ (bg.coord j)) (fun y => G y (bv.coord k)) s

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFamConv_sum_fam
entries.docstring: The derived action family is linear in the matter family.
entries.snippet:
lemma actionFamConv_sum_fam {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (c : ι → ℂ)
    (H : ι → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    actionFamConv A act ρ (fun t => ∑ i, c i • H i t) s φ =
      ∑ i, c i • actionFamConv A act ρ (H i) s φ

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_actionFamConv
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of the derived action family: the derivative slots mix, the direction
  of the gauge field mixes by its own column, and the value index is carried by the
  transformed matter family.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_actionFamConv (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (G G' : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (hG : ∀ y χ, repLorentz Λ (G y χ) = lorentzMix Λ (fun t => G' t χ) y 0)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    repLorentz Λ (actionFamConv h.A act ρ G s φ) =
      ∑ a, L[Λ] a ρ • lorentzMix Λ (fun t => actionFamConv h.A act a G' t φ) s 0

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.dual_twist
entries.docstring:
The twist of the value index past the gauge action: an endomorphism commuting with
  the gauge action may be moved from the dual basis onto the dual vector.
entries.snippet:
lemma dual_twist {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] (bv : Module.Basis κ ℂ V) (T : V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (hT : ∀ (c : 𝔤) (v : V), act c (T v) = T (act c v))
    (ψ : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B) (c : 𝔤) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    ∑ k, φ (act c (bv k)) • ψ (T.dualMap (bv.coord k)) =
      ∑ k, (T.dualMap φ) (act c (bv k)) • ψ (bv.coord k)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFam_comp_dual
entries.docstring:
The contragredient action may be pulled out of an action of families, provided the
  gauge action commutes with it on the value space.
entries.snippet:
lemma actionFam_comp_dual (T : V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (hT : ∀ (c : 𝔤) (v : V), act c (T v) = T (act c v))
    (f : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B) (g : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    actionFam act f (g ∘ₗ T.dualMap) φ = actionFam act f g (T.dualMap φ)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFamConv_comp_dual
entries.docstring: The contragredient action may be pulled out of a derived action family.
entries.snippet:
lemma actionFamConv_comp_dual (T : V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (hT : ∀ (c : 𝔤) (v : V), act c (T v) = T (act c v)) (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (K : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    actionFamConv A act ρ (fun t => K t ∘ₗ T.dualMap) s φ =
      actionFamConv A act ρ K s (T.dualMap φ)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_covDerivIter
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of the iterated covariant derivative of a matter family: the ordered
  covariant slots mix by their own columns and the multiset of plain derivative slots
  mixes by `lorentzMix`, while the value index transforms contragrediently.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_covDerivIter {rep : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) V}
    (hcomm : ∀ (c : 𝔤) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (v : V), act c (rep Λ v) = rep Λ (act c v))
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (hF : IsLorentzDerivTransforms repLorentz rep F) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    repLorentz Λ (covDerivIter h.A act F n l s φ) = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
      (∏ i, L[Λ] (p i) (l i)) •
        lorentzMix Λ (fun t => covDerivIter h.A act F n p t (rep.dual Λ φ)) s 0

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.isLorentzCovDerivTransforms_covDerivIter
entries.docstring:
The iterated covariant derivative of a matter family transforms as the covariant
  derivatives of a Lorentz-covariant field, given the Lorentz law of the bare symbols,
  the Lorentz law of the gauge field, and the commutation of the infinitesimal gauge
  action with the Lorentz action on the value space.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzCovDerivTransforms_covDerivIter {rep : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) V}
    (hcomm : ∀ (c : 𝔤) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (v : V), act c (rep Λ v) = rep Λ (act c v))
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (hF : IsLorentzDerivTransforms repLorentz rep F) :
    IsLorentzCovDerivTransforms repLorentz rep (fun {n} l => covDerivIter h.A act F n l 0)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionConj_comm_repConj
entries.docstring:
Conjugation preserves the commutation of the gauge action with the Lorentz action:
  both are read on the conjugate module through the same underlying maps.
entries.snippet:
lemma actionConj_comm_repConj (rep : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) V)
    (hcomm : ∀ (c : 𝔤) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (v : V), act c (rep Λ v) = rep Λ (act c v))
    (c : 𝔤) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (v : ConjModule V) :
    LocalGaugeData.actionConj act c (rep.conj Λ v) =
      rep.conj Λ (LocalGaugeData.actionConj act c v)

entries.name: GaugeAlgebraRealization.isLorentzCovDerivTransforms_covDerivIter_conj
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of the covariant tower of a conjugate family, from the commutation of
  the gauge action with the Lorentz action of the unconjugated species.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzCovDerivTransforms_covDerivIter_conj {rep : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) V}
    (hcomm : ∀ (c : 𝔤) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (v : V), act c (rep Λ v) = rep Λ (act c v))
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule V) →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (hF : IsLorentzDerivTransforms repLorentz rep.conj F) :
    IsLorentzCovDerivTransforms repLorentz rep.conj
      (fun {n} l => covDerivIter h.A (LocalGaugeData.actionConj act) F n l 0)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep
entries.docstring:
**A matrix representation** of the jets of gauge transformations on an internal index
  `ι`: the jets act by the matrix of jets `mat U`, the gauge algebra by the matrix `act c`,
  and the jets of the gauge algebra by the matrix of jets `jetAct a`, subject to the
  derivative identity and the equivariance identity that make `act` the infinitesimal
  action underlying `mat`.
entries.snippet:
structure MatrixRep (jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 GJ 𝔤J) (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    where
  mat : GJ → Matrix ι ι SpaceTimeAlgebra
  mat_one : mat 1 = 1
  mat_mul : ∀ U V, mat (U * V) = mat U * mat V
  act : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix ι ι ℂ
  jetAct : 𝔤J → Matrix ι ι SpaceTimeAlgebra
  jetAct_ofConstantLie : ∀ c, jetAct (jets.ofConstantLie c) = (act c).map (C : ℂ → SpaceTimeAlgebra)
  jetAct_map_cc_foldl : ∀ (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : 𝔤J),
    ((jetAct a).map fun f => constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv p f))
      = act (jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv p a))
  mat_map_pderiv : ∀ (U : GJ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
    (mat U).map (fun f => pderiv μ f) = -(jetAct (jets.maurerCartan U μ) * mat U)
  mat_mul_jetAct : ∀ (U : GJ) (c : 𝔤),
    mat U * jetAct (jets.ofConstantLie c)
      = jetAct (jets.adjointJ U (jets.ofConstantLie c)) * mat U

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.pderivPi
entries.docstring: The entrywise formal derivative on `ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra`, as a `ℂ`-linear map.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def pderivPi (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : (ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra) →ₗ[ℂ]
    (ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra) where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.pderivPi_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma pderivPi_apply (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (w : ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra) (i : ι) :
    pderivPi μ w i = pderiv μ (w i)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.foldPi
entries.docstring: The entrywise iterated formal derivative on `ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra`, as a `ℂ`-linear map.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def foldPi (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    (ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra) →ₗ[ℂ] (ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra) where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.foldPi_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma foldPi_apply (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (w : ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra) (i : ι) :
    foldPi x w i = SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv x (w i)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.foldPi_zero
entries.snippet: lemma foldPi_zero : foldPi (ι := ι) 0 = LinearMap.id

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.pderivPi_comp_foldPi
entries.snippet:
lemma pderivPi_comp_foldPi (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    pderivPi (ι := ι) μ ∘ₗ foldPi x = foldPi (μ ::ₘ x)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.ccPi
entries.docstring: The entrywise base-point evaluation on `ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra`, as a `ℂ`-linear map.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def ccPi : (ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra) →ₗ[ℂ] (ι → ℂ) where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.ccPi_apply
entries.snippet: lemma ccPi_apply (w : ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra) (i : ι) : ccPi w i = constantCoeff (w i)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.C_mul_eq_smul
entries.docstring: A constant jet times a jet is the scalar multiple.
entries.snippet: lemma C_mul_eq_smul (z : ℂ) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) : (C z : SpaceTimeAlgebra) * f = z • f

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.ccPi_foldPi_mulVec
entries.docstring:
The base-point evaluation of the iterated derivative of a matrix–vector product with
  constant entries is the matrix–vector product of the base-point coefficients.
entries.snippet:
lemma ccPi_foldPi_mulVec (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (A : Matrix ι ι SpaceTimeAlgebra)
    (v : ι → ℂ) :
    ccPi (foldPi x (A.mulVec fun k => (C (v k) : SpaceTimeAlgebra)))
      = (A.map fun f => constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv x f)).mulVec v

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.jetEquiv
entries.docstring:
The jets of a `V`-valued field as `S ⊗ (ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra)`, through the identification
  `e : V ≃ S ⊗ (ι → ℂ)`: the jet ring is absorbed into the internal index.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetEquiv (e : V ≃ₗ[ℂ] S ⊗[ℂ] (ι → ℂ)) :
    SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V ≃ₗ[ℂ] S ⊗[ℂ] (ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.jetEquiv_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma jetEquiv_tmul (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (s : S) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    jetEquiv e (f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] e.symm (s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v)) = s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (fun i => v i • f)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.induction_on
entries.docstring: Induction on the jets of a `V`-valued field through the identification `e`.
entries.snippet:
lemma induction_on {P : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V → Prop} (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)
    (tmul : ∀ (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (s : S) (v : ι → ℂ), P (f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] e.symm (s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v)))
    (add : ∀ a b, P a → P b → P (a + b)) : P z

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.jetEquiv_jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
The identification of jets intertwines the formal derivative with the entrywise
  derivative.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetEquiv_jetDeriv (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    jetEquiv e (jetDeriv μ z) = LinearMap.lTensor S (pderivPi μ) (jetEquiv e z)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.jetEquiv_jetIteratedDeriv
entries.docstring:
The identification of jets intertwines the iterated formal derivative with the
  entrywise iterated derivative.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetEquiv_jetIteratedDeriv (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    jetEquiv e (jetIteratedDeriv x z) = LinearMap.lTensor S (foldPi x) (jetEquiv e z)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.jetEval_eq
entries.docstring: The base-point evaluation of a jet through the identification.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetEval_eq (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    jetEval z = e.symm (LinearMap.lTensor S ccPi (jetEquiv e z))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.jetEquiv_smul
entries.docstring: Multiplication by a scalar jet through the identification.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetEquiv_smul (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    jetEquiv e (χ • z)
      = LinearMap.lTensor S
          ((LinearMap.lsmul SpaceTimeAlgebra (ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra) χ).restrictScalars ℂ)
          (jetEquiv e z)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.jetEquiv_jetOfConstant
entries.docstring: A jet of a constant through the identification.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetEquiv_jetOfConstant (s : S) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    jetEquiv e (jetOfConstant (e.symm (s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v))) = s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (fun i => C (v i))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.valEndAlgHom
entries.docstring:
The endomorphism of the target space `V ≃ S ⊗ (ι → ℂ)` defined by a complex matrix on
  the internal index, as an algebra map.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def valEndAlgHom : Matrix ι ι ℂ →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.valEnd
entries.docstring:
The endomorphism of the target space `V ≃ S ⊗ (ι → ℂ)` defined by a complex matrix on
  the internal index, with the Lorentz factor untouched.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def valEnd (B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : V →ₗ[ℂ] V

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.valEnd_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma valEnd_apply (B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (d : V) :
    valEnd e B d = e.symm (LinearMap.lTensor S (Matrix.toLin' B) (e d))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.valEnd_apply_symm_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma valEnd_apply_symm_tmul (B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (s : S) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    valEnd e B (e.symm (s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v)) = e.symm (s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (B.mulVec v))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.valEnd_add
entries.snippet: lemma valEnd_add (A B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : valEnd e (A + B) = valEnd e A + valEnd e B

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.valEnd_smul
entries.snippet: lemma valEnd_smul (z : ℂ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : valEnd e (z • A) = z • valEnd e A

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.valEnd_zero
entries.snippet: lemma valEnd_zero : valEnd e (0 : Matrix ι ι ℂ) = 0

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.valEnd_neg
entries.snippet: lemma valEnd_neg (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : valEnd e (-A) = -valEnd e A

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.valEnd_multiset_sum
entries.snippet:
lemma valEnd_multiset_sum (m : Multiset (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) :
    valEnd e m.sum = (m.map (valEnd e)).sum

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.valEnd_mul
entries.snippet: lemma valEnd_mul (A B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : valEnd e (A * B) = valEnd e A ∘ₗ valEnd e B

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.valEnd_one
entries.snippet: lemma valEnd_one : valEnd e (1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ) = LinearMap.id

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.jetEnd
entries.docstring:
The endomorphism of `S ⊗ (ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra)` defined by a matrix of jets on the internal
  index.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetEnd (A : Matrix ι ι SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    S ⊗[ℂ] (ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra) →ₗ[ℂ] S ⊗[ℂ] (ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.jetEnd_eq_lTensor
entries.snippet:
lemma jetEnd_eq_lTensor (A : Matrix ι ι SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    jetEnd S A = LinearMap.lTensor S
      ((Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv' A : Module.End SpaceTimeAlgebra
          (ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra)).restrictScalars ℂ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.jetEnd_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma jetEnd_tmul (A : Matrix ι ι SpaceTimeAlgebra) (s : S) (w : ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    jetEnd S A (s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] w) = s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (A.mulVec w)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.jetEnd_one
entries.snippet: lemma jetEnd_one : jetEnd S (1 : Matrix ι ι SpaceTimeAlgebra) = LinearMap.id

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.jetEnd_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma jetEnd_mul (A B : Matrix ι ι SpaceTimeAlgebra) : jetEnd S (A * B) =
    jetEnd S A ∘ₗ jetEnd S B

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.matEnd
entries.docstring:
The endomorphism of the jets `SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗ V` of the field defined by a matrix of jets
  on the internal index, through `jetEquiv`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def matEnd
    (A : Matrix ι ι SpaceTimeAlgebra) : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V →ₗ[ℂ] SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.matEnd_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma matEnd_apply (A : Matrix ι ι SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    matEnd e A z = (jetEquiv e).symm (jetEnd S A (jetEquiv e z))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.matEnd_one
entries.snippet: lemma matEnd_one : matEnd e (1 : Matrix ι ι SpaceTimeAlgebra) = LinearMap.id

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.matEnd_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma matEnd_mul (A B : Matrix ι ι SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    matEnd e (A * B) = matEnd e A ∘ₗ matEnd e B

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.matEnd_smul
entries.docstring:
The matrix endomorphisms are fibrewise: they commute with multiplication by scalar
  jets.
entries.snippet:
lemma matEnd_smul (A : Matrix ι ι SpaceTimeAlgebra) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra)
    (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    matEnd e A (χ • z) = χ • matEnd e A z

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.repJet
entries.docstring:
**The jet gauge action** of a matrix representation on the jets of a `V`-valued
  field: the matrix of jets acts on the internal index by matrix–vector multiplication,
  with the Lorentz factor untouched.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def repJet : Representation ℂ GJ (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.repJet_apply
entries.snippet: lemma repJet_apply (U : GJ) : R.repJet e U = matEnd e (R.mat U)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.repJet_smul
entries.docstring:
**The jet gauge action is fibrewise**: it commutes with multiplication by scalar
  jets.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_smul (U : GJ) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    R.repJet e U (χ • z) = χ • R.repJet e U z

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.repAlgebra
entries.docstring:
**The action of the gauge algebra** of a matrix representation on the target space
  `V ≃ S ⊗ (ι → ℂ)`: the action matrix acts on the internal index, real-linearly in the
  algebra slot and complex-linearly in the value slot.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def repAlgebra : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.repAlgebra_apply
entries.snippet: lemma repAlgebra_apply (c : 𝔤) : R.repAlgebra e c = valEnd e (R.act c)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.repCoeff_eq
entries.docstring:
**The base-point Taylor coefficients of the jet gauge action** are the endomorphisms
  of the base-point Taylor coefficients of the matrix of jets.
entries.snippet:
lemma repCoeff_eq (U : GJ) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff (R.repJet e) U x
      = valEnd e ((R.mat U).map fun f =>
          constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv x f))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.isInfinitesimalActionOf
entries.docstring:
**The action of the gauge algebra of a matrix representation is the infinitesimal
  action underlying its jet gauge action**: the base-point Taylor coefficients obey the
  Maurer–Cartan Leibniz law and intertwine the action with the adjoint transports.
entries.snippet:
lemma isInfinitesimalActionOf :
    jets.IsInfinitesimalActionOf (R.repAlgebra e) (R.repJet e)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.repLorentz
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the target space `V ≃ S ⊗ (ι → ℂ)`: the given action on the
  Lorentz factor `S`, transported through `e`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repLorentz (ρ : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) S) :
    Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) V

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.repGlobal
entries.docstring:
**The global gauge action** of a matrix representation of jets: a global gauge
  transformation acts by the constant term of the matrix of its constant jet.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def repGlobal : Representation ℂ G₀ V where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.repGlobal_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma repGlobal_apply (g : G₀) :
    R.repGlobal e g = valEnd e
        ((R.mat (jets.ofConstant g)).map (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra → ℂ))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.repGlobal_apply_symm_tmul
entries.docstring:
The global action on a pure tensor: the constant term of the matrix acts on the
  internal index.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGlobal_apply_symm_tmul (g : G₀) (s : S) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    R.repGlobal e g (e.symm (s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v))
      = e.symm (s ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
          ((R.mat (jets.ofConstant g)).map (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra → ℂ)).mulVec v)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.map_C_mulVec_smul
entries.docstring:
A matrix of constant jets acts on a scalar jet times a constant vector through its
  constant matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_C_mulVec_smul (B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (v : ι → ℂ) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    (B.map (C : ℂ → SpaceTimeAlgebra)).mulVec (fun i => v i • χ) = fun i => (B.mulVec v) i • χ

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.repJet_ofConstant
entries.docstring:
**On jets of constant gauge transformations the jet action is the global action** on
  the value factor, provided the matrices of constant jets are constant.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_ofConstant
    (hconst : ∀ g, R.mat (jets.ofConstant g)
      = ((R.mat (jets.ofConstant g)).map (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra → ℂ)).map
          (C : ℂ → SpaceTimeAlgebra))
    (g : G₀) :
    R.repJet e (jets.ofConstant g) = TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (R.repGlobal e g)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.matterField
entries.docstring:
**The matter field of a matrix representation**: the target space `V ≃ S ⊗ (ι → ℂ)`
  with the Lorentz action on `S`, the jet gauge action of the matrix representation, and
  the given mass weight and declared statistics.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def matterField (ρ : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) S) (w : ℕ) (σ : FieldStatistic) :
    MatterField jets where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.matterField_V
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma matterField_V : (R.matterField e ρ w σ).V = V

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.matterField_repLorentz
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma matterField_repLorentz : (R.matterField e ρ w σ).repLorentz = repLorentz e ρ

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.matterField_repJet
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma matterField_repJet : (R.matterField e ρ w σ).repJet = R.repJet e

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.matterField_repAlgebra
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma matterField_repAlgebra : (R.matterField e ρ w σ).repAlgebra = R.repAlgebra e

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.matterField_massWeight
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma matterField_massWeight : (R.matterField e ρ w σ).massWeight = w

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.matterField_statistic
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma matterField_statistic : (R.matterField e ρ w σ).statistic = σ

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.repLorentz_apply_symm_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_apply_symm_tmul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (s : S) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    repLorentz e ρ Λ (e.symm (s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v)) = e.symm (ρ Λ s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.repAlgebra_comm_repLorentz
entries.docstring:
The gauge algebra acts on the internal index and the Lorentz group on the Lorentz
  factor, so the two actions commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma repAlgebra_comm_repLorentz (c : 𝔤) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (v : V) :
    R.repAlgebra e c (repLorentz e ρ Λ v) = repLorentz e ρ Λ (R.repAlgebra e c v)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.matterField_gaugeLorentzCompatible
entries.docstring:
The matter field of a matrix representation satisfies `MatterField.GaugeLorentzCompatible`,
  for every matrix representation and Lorentz factor: the two actions live on different
  tensor factors.
entries.snippet:
lemma matterField_gaugeLorentzCompatible :
    (R.matterField e ρ w σ).GaugeLorentzCompatible

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.matterField_pureJetsActTrivially
entries.docstring:
The matter field of a matrix representation satisfies `MatterField.PureJetsActTrivially`
  as soon as the matrix of every jet with trivial value has identity constant term. This
  hypothesis is not a consequence of the axioms of `MatrixRep`, which fix the constant term
  of `mat` on pure jets only up to a scalar character.
entries.snippet:
lemma matterField_pureJetsActTrivially
    (hmat : ∀ {W : GJ}, jets.eval W = 1 → (R.mat W).map
        (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra → ℂ) = 1) :
    (R.matterField e ρ w σ).PureJetsActTrivially

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.kronecker_one_map
entries.snippet:
lemma kronecker_one_map [MulZeroOneClass α] [MulZeroOneClass β] (φ : α → β) (h0 : φ 0 = 0)
    (A : Matrix ι₁ ι₁ α) :
    (A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix ι₂ ι₂ α)).map φ = (A.map φ) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix ι₂ ι₂ β)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.one_kronecker_map
entries.snippet:
lemma one_kronecker_map [MulZeroOneClass α] [MulZeroOneClass β] (φ : α → β) (h0 : φ 0 = 0)
    (B : Matrix ι₂ ι₂ α) :
    ((1 : Matrix ι₁ ι₁ α) ⊗ₖ B).map φ = (1 : Matrix ι₁ ι₁ β) ⊗ₖ (B.map φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.kronecker_map_of_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma kronecker_map_of_mul [Mul α] [Mul β] (φ : α → β) (hφ : ∀ a b, φ (a * b) = φ a * φ b)
    (A : Matrix ι₁ ι₁ α) (B : Matrix ι₂ ι₂ α) :
    (A ⊗ₖ B).map φ = (A.map φ) ⊗ₖ (B.map φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.neg_kronecker
entries.snippet:
lemma neg_kronecker [Mul α] [HasDistribNeg α] (A : Matrix ι₁ ι₁ α) (B : Matrix ι₂ ι₂ α) :
    (-A) ⊗ₖ B = -(A ⊗ₖ B)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.kronecker_neg
entries.snippet:
lemma kronecker_neg [Mul α] [HasDistribNeg α] (A : Matrix ι₁ ι₁ α) (B : Matrix ι₂ ι₂ α) :
    A ⊗ₖ (-B) = -(A ⊗ₖ B)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.trivial
entries.docstring:
**The trivial representation**: the one-dimensional singlet, on which every gauge jet
  acts as the identity and the gauge algebra by zero.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def trivial : MatrixRep jets (Fin 1) where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.kron
entries.docstring:
**The Kronecker product** of two matrix representations: the gauge jets act by the
  Kronecker product of the two matrices of jets, the gauge algebra by the Kronecker sum
  of the two action matrices.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def kron (R₁ : MatrixRep jets ι₁) (R₂ : MatrixRep jets ι₂) :
    MatrixRep jets (ι₁ × ι₂) where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.foldl_pderiv_star
entries.docstring: The iterated formal derivative commutes with conjugation.
entries.snippet:
lemma foldl_pderiv_star (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    x.foldl (fun h ρ => pderiv ρ h) (star f) = star (x.foldl (fun h ρ => pderiv ρ h) f)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.conj
entries.docstring:
**The conjugate representation**: the gauge jets act by the entrywise conjugate matrix
  of jets, the gauge algebra by the entrywise conjugate action matrix.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def conj (R : MatrixRep jets ι) : MatrixRep jets ι where

entries.name: MatterField.pderiv_chargePow
entries.docstring:
**The derivative of a power of a unitary jet**: `∂_μ (u ^ n) = n · u ^ n · (u⁻¹ ∂_μ u)`,
  for every integer `n`.
entries.snippet:
lemma pderiv_chargePow (n : ℤ) (w : unitary SpaceTimeAlgebra) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    pderiv μ (chargePow n w)
      = (n : ℂ) •
          (chargePow n w * (star (w : SpaceTimeAlgebra) * pderiv μ (w : SpaceTimeAlgebra)))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.U1Factor.pderiv_chargePow_u
entries.docstring:
The derivative of the charge-`n` power of the unitary jet of a gauge jet, in terms of
  the Maurer–Cartan form: `∂_μ (u ^ n) = -(i n) φJ (ω_μ U) · u ^ n`.
entries.snippet:
lemma pderiv_chargePow_u (n : ℤ) (U : GJ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    pderiv μ (chargePow n (F.u U))
      = -(((Complex.I * n) • F.φJ (jets.maurerCartan U μ)) * chargePow n (F.u U))

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.U1Factor.charge
entries.docstring:
**The charge twist**: a matrix representation twisted by the charge-`n` power of the
  unitary jet of the `U(1)` factor. The gauge algebra acts by the original action plus
  `i n` times the `u(1)` component.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def charge (n : ℤ) (R : MatrixRep jets ι) : MatrixRep jets ι where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.SUFactor.fund
entries.docstring:
**The fundamental representation** of an `SU(n)` factor: the gauge jets act by their
  unitary matrices of jets, the gauge algebra by `i` times its matrix component.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def fund : MatrixRep jets n where

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.SURep
entries.docstring: **A representation label under `SU(n)`.**
entries.snippet:
inductive SURep
  | singlet
  | fund
  | antifund
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.SURep.dim
entries.docstring: The dimension of the representation of `SU(n)` a label names.
entries.snippet:
abbrev SURep.dim (n : ℕ) : SURep → ℕ
  | .singlet => 1
  | .fund => n
  | .antifund => n

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.SURep.rep
entries.docstring: The matrix representation of an `SU(n)` factor named by a label.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def SURep.rep {n : ℕ} (F : SUFactor jets (Fin n)) :
    (r : SURep) → MatrixRep jets (Fin (r.dim n))
  | .singlet => MatrixRep.trivial
  | .fund => F.fund
  | .antifund => F.fund.conj

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.Factor.Charge
entries.docstring:
The charge a field carries under a factor: an integer under `U(1)`, a representation
  label under `SU(n)`.
entries.snippet:
abbrev Factor.Charge : Factor jets → Type
  | .U1 _ => ℤ
  | .SU _ => SURep

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.Charges
entries.docstring:
**The charge tuple** of a row: one charge per factor, as a nested pair so that a row
  reads `(1, .fund, .fund)`.
entries.snippet:
abbrev Charges : Factors jets → Type
  | [] => Unit
  | [f] => f.Charge
  | f :: g :: gs => f.Charge × Charges (g :: gs)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.IdxOfDims
entries.docstring:
**The internal index of a list of dimensions**: the product of the `Fin n` over the
  list, with `Fin 1` for the empty list and no trailing factor for a one-element list.
entries.snippet:
abbrev IdxOfDims : List ℕ → Type
  | [] => Fin 1
  | [n] => Fin n
  | n :: m :: ms => Fin n × IdxOfDims (m :: ms)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.IdxOfDims.fintype
entries.docstring: The index of a list of dimensions is finite.
entries.snippet:
@[instance_reducible]
def IdxOfDims.fintype : (ds : List ℕ) → Fintype (IdxOfDims ds)
  | [] => inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Fin 1))
  | [n] => inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Fin n))
  | n :: m :: ms =>
    letI

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.IdxOfDims.decidableEq
entries.docstring: The index of a list of dimensions has decidable equality.
entries.snippet:
@[instance_reducible]
def IdxOfDims.decidableEq : (ds : List ℕ) → DecidableEq (IdxOfDims ds)
  | [] => inferInstanceAs (DecidableEq (Fin 1))
  | [n] => inferInstanceAs (DecidableEq (Fin n))
  | n :: m :: ms =>
    letI

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.«instance@7bb18e9d»
entries.snippet: instance (ds : List ℕ) : Fintype (IdxOfDims ds)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.«instance@66d570e5»
entries.snippet: instance (ds : List ℕ) : DecidableEq (IdxOfDims ds)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.SURep.dims
entries.docstring:
The dimensions an `SU(n)` label contributes to the internal index: none for the
  singlet, `n` for the fundamental and the antifundamental.
entries.snippet:
abbrev SURep.dims (n : ℕ) : SURep → List ℕ
  | .singlet => []
  | .fund => [n]
  | .antifund => [n]

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.Charges.dims
entries.docstring:
**The dimensions of the internal index** of a charge tuple: the sizes of the
  nontrivial `SU(n)` representations it names, in the order of the factors. `U(1)` factors
  and singlets contribute nothing, so that a field charged under a single `SU(n)` factor is
  indexed by `Fin n` alone.
entries.snippet:
abbrev Charges.dims : (Γ : Factors jets) → Charges Γ → List ℕ
  | [], _ => []
  | [.U1 _], _ => []
  | [.SU (n := n) _], r => SURep.dims n r
  | .U1 _ :: g :: gs, c => Charges.dims (g :: gs) c.2
  | .SU (n := n) _ :: g :: gs, c => SURep.dims n c.1 ++ Charges.dims (g :: gs) c.2

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.Idx
entries.docstring:
**The internal index** of a field with the given charges: the product of the
  nontrivial `SU(n)`-representation indices.
entries.snippet: abbrev Idx (Γ : Factors jets) (c : Charges Γ) : Type

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.kronDims
entries.docstring:
The Kronecker product with the representation on the remaining dimensions, with the
  trivial representation dropped when there are none.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def MatrixRep.kronDims {n : ℕ} (R₁ : MatrixRep jets (Fin n)) :
    (ds : List ℕ) → MatrixRep jets (IdxOfDims ds) → MatrixRep jets (IdxOfDims (n :: ds))
  | [], _ => R₁
  | _ :: _, R₂ => R₁.kron R₂

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.SURep.repDims
entries.docstring:
The matrix representation of an `SU(n)` factor named by a label, on the index of the
  dimensions the label contributes.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def SURep.repDims {n : ℕ} (F : SUFactor jets (Fin n)) :
    (r : SURep) → MatrixRep jets (IdxOfDims (r.dims n))
  | .singlet => MatrixRep.trivial
  | .fund => F.fund
  | .antifund => F.fund.conj

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.Charges.suRep
entries.docstring:
The `SU(n)` part of the representation named by a charge tuple: the Kronecker product
  of the nontrivial representations the labels name.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def Charges.suRep :
    (Γ : Factors jets) → (c : Charges Γ) → MatrixRep jets (IdxOfDims (Charges.dims Γ c))
  | [], _ => MatrixRep.trivial
  | [.U1 _], _ => MatrixRep.trivial
  | [.SU F], r => SURep.repDims F r
  | .U1 _ :: g :: gs, c => Charges.suRep (g :: gs) c.2
  | .SU _ :: g :: gs, (.singlet, c) => Charges.suRep (g :: gs) c
  | .SU F :: g :: gs, (.fund, c) => F.fund.kronDims _ (Charges.suRep (g :: gs) c)
  | .SU F :: g :: gs, (.antifund, c) => F.fund.conj.kronDims _ (Charges.suRep (g :: gs) c)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.Charges.twist
entries.docstring:
The `U(1)` part of the representation named by a charge tuple: the charge twists of
  all the `U(1)` factors, applied to a given representation.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def Charges.twist {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] :
    (Γ : Factors jets) → Charges Γ → MatrixRep jets ι → MatrixRep jets ι
  | [], _, R => R
  | [.U1 F], q, R => F.charge q R
  | [.SU _], _, R => R
  | .U1 F :: g :: gs, c, R => F.charge c.1 (Charges.twist (g :: gs) c.2 R)
  | .SU _ :: g :: gs, c, R => Charges.twist (g :: gs) c.2 R

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.Charges.rep
entries.docstring:
**The matrix representation named by a charge tuple**: the Kronecker product of the
  nontrivial `SU(n)` representations the labels name, twisted by the charge powers of the
  `U(1)` jets.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def Charges.rep (Γ : Factors jets) (c : Charges Γ) : MatrixRep jets (Idx Γ c)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.LorentzLabel
entries.docstring: **The Lorentz label of a field**: a left- or right-handed Weyl spinor or a scalar.
entries.snippet:
inductive LorentzLabel
  | L
  | R
  | scalar
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.LorentzLabel.statistic
entries.docstring:
The statistics a table row declares for a field with the given label, fermionic for a
  Weyl spinor and bosonic for a scalar. Like `massWeight`, it is a convention of the tables,
  chosen to match the spin–statistics relation.
entries.snippet:
def statistic : LorentzLabel → FieldStatistic
  | .L => .fermionic
  | .R => .fermionic
  | .scalar => .bosonic

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.LorentzLabel.Space
entries.docstring: The Lorentz factor of the target space of a field with the given label.
entries.snippet:
abbrev Space : LorentzLabel → Type
  | .L => Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl
  | .R => Fermion.RightHandedWeyl
  | .scalar => ℂ

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.LorentzLabel.«instance@f816994b»
entries.snippet: instance : Module.Finite ℂ Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.LorentzLabel.«instance@547dbfce»
entries.snippet: instance : Module.Finite ℂ Fermion.RightHandedWeyl

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.LorentzLabel.instAddCommGroupSpace
entries.snippet:
instance instAddCommGroupSpace : (l : LorentzLabel) → AddCommGroup l.Space
  | .L => inferInstanceAs (AddCommGroup Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl)
  | .R => inferInstanceAs (AddCommGroup Fermion.RightHandedWeyl)
  | .scalar => inferInstanceAs (AddCommGroup ℂ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.LorentzLabel.instModuleSpace
entries.snippet:
instance instModuleSpace : (l : LorentzLabel) → Module ℂ l.Space
  | .L => inferInstanceAs (Module ℂ Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl)
  | .R => inferInstanceAs (Module ℂ Fermion.RightHandedWeyl)
  | .scalar => inferInstanceAs (Module ℂ ℂ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.LorentzLabel.instFreeSpace
entries.snippet:
instance instFreeSpace : (l : LorentzLabel) → Module.Free ℂ l.Space
  | .L => inferInstanceAs (Module.Free ℂ Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl)
  | .R => inferInstanceAs (Module.Free ℂ Fermion.RightHandedWeyl)
  | .scalar => inferInstanceAs (Module.Free ℂ ℂ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.LorentzLabel.instFiniteSpace
entries.snippet:
instance instFiniteSpace : (l : LorentzLabel) → Module.Finite ℂ l.Space
  | .L => inferInstanceAs (Module.Finite ℂ Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl)
  | .R => inferInstanceAs (Module.Finite ℂ Fermion.RightHandedWeyl)
  | .scalar => inferInstanceAs (Module.Finite ℂ ℂ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.LorentzLabel.rep
entries.docstring: The representation of the Lorentz group on the Lorentz factor of a label.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def rep : (l : LorentzLabel) → Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) l.Space
  | .L => Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl.rep
  | .R => Fermion.RightHandedWeyl.rep
  | .scalar => Representation.trivial ℂ SL(2,ℂ) ℂ

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.LorentzLabel.massWeight
entries.docstring:
The mass weight of a field with the given label, in the units in which a derivative
  has weight `2`: `3` for a Weyl spinor, `2` for a scalar.
entries.snippet:
def massWeight : LorentzLabel → ℕ
  | .L => 3
  | .R => 3
  | .scalar => 2

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.LorentzLabel.basisIndex
entries.docstring:
The index of the basis of the Lorentz factor of a label: the two spinor components of
  a Weyl spinor, one component for a scalar.
entries.snippet:
abbrev basisIndex : LorentzLabel → Type
  | .L => Fin 2
  | .R => Fin 2
  | .scalar => Unit

entries.name: MatterField.piMap_add_piMap
entries.snippet:
private lemma piMap_add_piMap (f g : ∀ i, W i →ₗ[ℂ] W i) :
    LinearMap.piMap (fun i => f i + g i) = LinearMap.piMap f + LinearMap.piMap g

entries.name: MatterField.piMap_neg
entries.snippet:
private lemma piMap_neg (f : ∀ i, W i →ₗ[ℂ] W i) :
    LinearMap.piMap (fun i => -f i) = -LinearMap.piMap f

entries.name: MatterField.piMap_comp
MatterField.piMap_multiset_sum
entries.snippet:
private lemma piMap_multiset_sum {κ : Type} (S : Multiset κ)
    (f : κ → ∀ i, W i →ₗ[ℂ] W i) :
    LinearMap.piMap (fun i => (S.map fun k => f k i).sum)
      = (S.map fun k => LinearMap.piMap (f k)).sum

entries.name: MatterField.repPi
entries.docstring:
The product of a family of representations, acting index by index. This is the
  indexed analogue of `Representation.prod`, which Mathlib provides only in the binary
  case.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repPi {W : ι → Type} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (W i)]
    [∀ i, Module ℂ (W i)] (ρ : ∀ i, Representation ℂ GJ (W i)) :
    Representation ℂ GJ (∀ i, W i) where

entries.name: MatterField.repJetPi
entries.docstring:
**The jet gauge action of an indexed direct sum**: the family of actions, read
  through the identification of the jets of `∀ i, (M i).V` with the family of jets.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def repJetPi : Representation ℂ GJ (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] (∀ i, (M i).V)) where
