entries.name: MatterField.repJetPi_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetPi_apply (U : GJ) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] (∀ i, (M i).V)) :
    repJetPi M U z = (jetPiEquiv fun i => (M i).V).symm
      (fun i => (M i).repJet U (jetPiEquiv (fun i => (M i).V) z i))

entries.name: MatterField.repJetPi_smul
entries.docstring:
The jet gauge action of an indexed direct sum is fibrewise. It acts index by
  index, and each summand is fibrewise, so multiplication by a scalar jet passes through
  the splitting untouched. This is the field `repJet_smul` of `MatterField.pi`, stated
  separately so that it can be used without fixing a common mass weight.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetPi_smul (U : GJ) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] (∀ i, (M i).V)) :
    repJetPi M U (χ • z) = χ • repJetPi M U z

entries.name: MatterField.lTensor_proj_repJetPi
entries.docstring:
A summand is a subrepresentation of the jet gauge action of the direct sum. The
  projection onto the value space of one summand, applied to the jets, intertwines the
  summed action with that summand's own: the summed action is the family of the actions,
  and reading off a summand of the jets is the projection on the value factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma lTensor_proj_repJetPi (i : ι) (U : GJ) :
    (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra (LinearMap.proj i)).comp (repJetPi M U)
      = ((M i).repJet U).comp (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra (LinearMap.proj i))

entries.name: MatterField.repAlgebraPi
entries.docstring:
**The infinitesimal action of an indexed direct sum**: the family of actions, one on
  each summand.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def repAlgebraPi : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] (∀ i, (M i).V) →ₗ[ℂ] (∀ i, (M i).V) where

entries.name: MatterField.repAlgebraPi_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repAlgebraPi_apply (c : 𝔤) :
    repAlgebraPi M c = LinearMap.piMap fun i => (M i).repAlgebra c

entries.name: MatterField.repCoeff_repJetPi
entries.docstring:
The base-point Taylor coefficients of the summed jet action are the family of the
  coefficients of the summands: `jetOfConstant`, `jetIteratedDeriv` and `jetEval` all act
  index by index through `jetPiEquiv`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repCoeff_repJetPi (U : GJ) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff (repJetPi M) U x =
      LinearMap.piMap fun i => GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff (M i).repJet U x

entries.name: MatterField.isInfinitesimalActionOf_repAlgebraPi
entries.docstring:
**The index-by-index algebra action generates the index-by-index jet action**: both
  laws of `IsInfinitesimalActionOf` are the corresponding laws of the summands, read
  through `repCoeff_repJetPi`, since `piMap` is additive in the family and composes index
  by index.
entries.snippet:
lemma isInfinitesimalActionOf_repAlgebraPi :
    jets.IsInfinitesimalActionOf (repAlgebraPi M) (repJetPi M) where

entries.name: MatterField.pi
entries.docstring:
**The direct sum of a finite family of matter fields** with common mass weight `w` and
  common statistics `σ`, given with proofs that every summand has them. It is one field
  valued in `∀ i, (M i).V`, of weight `w` and statistics `σ`, with every action acting index
  by index.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def pi (w : ℕ) (_h : ∀ i, (M i).massWeight = w) (σ : FieldStatistic)
    (_hσ : ∀ i, (M i).statistic = σ) : MatterField jets where

entries.name: MatterField.pi_V
entries.snippet: lemma pi_V : (pi M w h σ hσ).V = ∀ i, (M i).V

entries.name: MatterField.pi_repJet
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma pi_repJet : (pi M w h σ hσ).repJet = repJetPi M

entries.name: MatterField.pi_repAlgebra
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma pi_repAlgebra : (pi M w h σ hσ).repAlgebra = repAlgebraPi M

entries.name: MatterField.pi_massWeight
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma pi_massWeight : (pi M w h σ hσ).massWeight = w

entries.name: MatterField.pi_statistic
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma pi_statistic : (pi M w h σ hσ).statistic = σ

entries.name: MatterField.pi_repLorentz_apply
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action of the direct sum is the family of Lorentz actions, acting index by
  index.
entries.snippet:
lemma pi_repLorentz_apply (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (v : ∀ i, (M i).V) (i : ι) :
    (pi M w h σ hσ).repLorentz Λ v i = (M i).repLorentz Λ (v i)

entries.name: MatterField.jetComponentSpacePiEquiv
entries.docstring:
**The component space of a direct sum of matter fields splits.** A component function
  of `MatterField.pi M w h σ hσ` is exactly a family, one component function per summand. Both
  halves split by `JetComponentSpace.fstPiEquiv` and `JetComponentSpace.sndPiEquiv`, and
  the pair of families is reassembled into a family of pairs index by index.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetComponentSpacePiEquiv :
    JetComponentSpace (pi M w h σ hσ) ≃ₗ[ℂ] ∀ i, JetComponentSpace (M i)

entries.name: MatterField.jetComponentSpacePiEquiv_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma jetComponentSpacePiEquiv_apply (x : JetComponentSpace (pi M w h σ hσ)) (i : ι) :
    jetComponentSpacePiEquiv M w h σ hσ x i =
      (JetComponentSpace.fstPiEquiv (fun i => (M i).V) x.1 i,
        JetComponentSpace.sndPiEquiv (fun i => (M i).V) x.2 i)

entries.name: MatterField.jetComponentSpacePiEquiv_symm_single
entries.docstring:
**The summand of one species is the pullback along the projection onto it.** A
  component function of the summand `i`, placed in the family and read back as a component
  function of the direct sum, is that function precomposed with the projection onto the
  summand. This is what identifies the splitting with the species inclusions of a direct
  sum of component spaces.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetComponentSpacePiEquiv_symm_single (i : ι) (x : JetComponentSpace (M i)) :
    (jetComponentSpacePiEquiv M w h σ hσ).symm (Pi.single i x)
      = JetComponentSpace.comap
        (LinearMap.proj (φ := fun i => (M i).V) i : (pi M w h σ hσ).V →ₗ[ℂ] (M i).V) x

entries.name: MatterField.prodMap_add_prodMap
entries.snippet:
private lemma prodMap_add_prodMap {V₁ V₂ : Type} [AddCommGroup V₁] [Module ℂ V₁]
    [AddCommGroup V₂] [Module ℂ V₂] (f₁ f₂ : V₁ →ₗ[ℂ] V₁) (g₁ g₂ : V₂ →ₗ[ℂ] V₂) :
    (f₁ + f₂).prodMap (g₁ + g₂) = f₁.prodMap g₁ + f₂.prodMap g₂

entries.name: MatterField.prodMap_multiset_sum
entries.snippet:
private lemma prodMap_multiset_sum {ι V₁ V₂ : Type} [AddCommGroup V₁] [Module ℂ V₁]
    [AddCommGroup V₂] [Module ℂ V₂] (S : Multiset ι) (f : ι → V₁ →ₗ[ℂ] V₁)
    (g : ι → V₂ →ₗ[ℂ] V₂) :
    ((S.map f).sum).prodMap ((S.map g).sum) = (S.map fun i => (f i).prodMap (g i)).sum

entries.name: MatterField.repJetProd
entries.docstring:
**The jet gauge action of a direct sum**: the two actions, read through the
  identification of the jets of `M.V × N.V` with the pair of jets.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repJetProd :
    Representation ℂ GJ (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] (M.V × N.V)) where

entries.name: MatterField.repJetProd_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetProd_apply (U : GJ) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] (M.V × N.V)) :
    repJetProd M N U z =
      jetProdEquiv.symm (M.repJet U (jetProdEquiv z).1, N.repJet U (jetProdEquiv z).2)

entries.name: MatterField.repAlgebraProd
entries.docstring: **The infinitesimal action of a direct sum**: the two actions on the two summands.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def repAlgebraProd : 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] (M.V × N.V) →ₗ[ℂ] (M.V × N.V) where

entries.name: MatterField.repAlgebraProd_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repAlgebraProd_apply (c : 𝔤) :
    repAlgebraProd M N c = (M.repAlgebra c).prodMap (N.repAlgebra c)

entries.name: MatterField.repCoeff_repJetProd
entries.docstring:
The base-point Taylor coefficients of the summed jet action are the pair of the
  coefficients of the summands: `jetOfConstant`, `jetIteratedDeriv` and `jetEval` all act
  componentwise through `jetProdEquiv`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repCoeff_repJetProd (U : GJ) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff (repJetProd M N) U x =
      (GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff M.repJet U x).prodMap
        (GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff N.repJet U x)

entries.name: MatterField.isInfinitesimalActionOf_repAlgebraProd
entries.docstring:
**The componentwise algebra action generates the componentwise jet action**: both laws
  of `IsInfinitesimalActionOf` are the corresponding laws of the summands, read through
  `repCoeff_repJetProd`, since `prodMap` is additive in both slots at once and composes
  componentwise.
entries.snippet:
lemma isInfinitesimalActionOf_repAlgebraProd :
    jets.IsInfinitesimalActionOf (repAlgebraProd M N) (repJetProd M N) where

entries.name: MatterField.prod
entries.docstring:
**The direct sum of two matter fields** of the same mass weight and statistics, one field
  valued in `M.V × N.V` with every action acting componentwise and with the weight and
  statistics of `M`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def prod (_h : M.massWeight = N.massWeight) (_hσ : M.statistic = N.statistic) :
    MatterField jets where

entries.name: MatterField.prod_V
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma prod_V : (prod M N h hσ).V = (M.V × N.V)

entries.name: MatterField.prod_repJet
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma prod_repJet : (prod M N h hσ).repJet = repJetProd M N

entries.name: MatterField.prod_repAlgebra
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma prod_repAlgebra : (prod M N h hσ).repAlgebra = repAlgebraProd M N

entries.name: MatterField.prod_repLorentz
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma prod_repLorentz : (prod M N h hσ).repLorentz = M.repLorentz.prod N.repLorentz

entries.name: MatterField.prod_massWeight
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma prod_massWeight : (prod M N h hσ).massWeight = M.massWeight

entries.name: MatterField.prod_massWeight_right
entries.docstring:
The shared weight, read off the second summand: this is what the hypothesis of `prod`
  buys — the direct sum has one weight, and it is the weight of either summand.
entries.snippet: lemma prod_massWeight_right : (prod M N h hσ).massWeight = N.massWeight

entries.name: MatterField.prod_statistic
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma prod_statistic : (prod M N h hσ).statistic = M.statistic

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.prodEquiv
entries.docstring:
**The component space of a direct sum splits.** The component functions of the direct
  sum `M.prod N h hσ` are those of `M` together with those of `N`: the dual and the conjugate
  both distribute over the finite product, and the derivative label is untouched. Only the
  value spaces enter, so the hypotheses `h` and `hσ` are carried along and not used.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def _root_.JetComponentSpace.prodEquiv (M N : MatterField jets)
    (h : M.massWeight = N.massWeight) (hσ : M.statistic = N.statistic) :
    JetComponentSpace (M.prod N h hσ) ≃ₗ[ℂ] JetComponentSpace M × JetComponentSpace N

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.TransformsIn
entries.docstring:
A component family `F`, valued in `B` and indexed by the complex dual of the
  representation space `V`, *transforms in* the representation `rep` of the jet gauge
  group — with the ambient action `repGauge` on `B` — when each derivative symbol
  `[∂_s F^φ]` transforms by the Leibniz convolution of the dual representation
  coefficients against lower symbols, with no inhomogeneous term — the generalization
  of `TransformsInAdjoint` from the adjoint representation to an arbitrary one, and
  the form consumed by `AlgebraRealization`.

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.TransformsIn.repGauge_zero
entries.docstring:
A matter gauge tensor transforms at the base point through the dual coefficient of the
  base-point value of the gauge jet alone: the antidiagonal of the empty multiset has a
  single term.
entries.snippet:
lemma TransformsIn.repGauge_zero (hF : TransformsIn repGauge rep F) (U : GJ)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    repGauge U (F 0 φ) = F 0 (repDualCoeff rep U⁻¹ 0 φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.TransformsIn.repGauge_eq_of_eval_eq_one
entries.docstring:
Matter gauge tensors whose zeroth representation coefficient is trivial on pure
  jets are fixed by pure jets: for a family transforming in `rep`, a gauge jet with
  trivial base-point value acts trivially on the underived symbol, provided the
  representation's zeroth Taylor coefficient is the identity on such jets.
entries.snippet:
lemma TransformsIn.repGauge_eq_of_eval_eq_one {𝔤 : Type} [LieRing 𝔤] [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤]
    {G₀ : Type} [Group G₀] {𝔤J : Type} [LieRing 𝔤J] [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤J]
    {jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 GJ 𝔤J} (hF : TransformsIn repGauge rep F)
    (hrep : ∀ {W : GJ}, jets.eval W = 1 → repCoeff rep W 0 = LinearMap.id)
    {U : GJ} (hU : jets.eval U = 1) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    repGauge U (F 0 φ) = F 0 φ

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.repCoeff_zero_eq_ofConstant_eval
entries.docstring:
If pure jets act trivially at the base point, the zeroth Taylor coefficient of a jet
  is that of the constant jet of its value: every jet is a pure jet times the constant jet
  of its value, and the zeroth coefficients are multiplicative for a fibrewise
  representation.
entries.snippet:
lemma repCoeff_zero_eq_ofConstant_eval {𝔤 : Type} [LieRing 𝔤] [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤]
    {G₀ : Type} [Group G₀] {𝔤J : Type} [LieRing 𝔤J] [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤J]
    (jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 GJ 𝔤J) (rep : Representation ℂ GJ (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V))
    (hlin : ∀ (U : GJ) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V), rep U
        (χ • z) = χ • rep U z)
    (hrep : ∀ {W : GJ}, jets.eval W = 1 → repCoeff rep W 0 = LinearMap.id) (U : GJ) :
    repCoeff rep U 0 = repCoeff rep (jets.ofConstant (jets.eval U)) 0

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.TransformsIn.repGauge_zero_eq_ofConstant_eval
entries.docstring:
If pure jets act trivially at the base point, a matter gauge tensor transforms at the
  base point as under the constant jet of the value of the gauge jet: the jet action on
  underived symbols factors through evaluation.
entries.snippet:
lemma TransformsIn.repGauge_zero_eq_ofConstant_eval {𝔤 : Type} [LieRing 𝔤] [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤]
    {G₀ : Type} [Group G₀] {𝔤J : Type} [LieRing 𝔤J] [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤J]
    {jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 GJ 𝔤J} (hF : TransformsIn repGauge rep F)
    (hlin : ∀ (U : GJ) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V), rep U
        (χ • z) = χ • rep U z)
    (hrep : ∀ {W : GJ}, jets.eval W = 1 → repCoeff rep W 0 = LinearMap.id) (U : GJ)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    repGauge U (F 0 φ) = repGauge (jets.ofConstant (jets.eval U)) (F 0 φ)

entries.name: LocalGaugeData.TransformsIn.repGauge_eq_of_mem_truncationKer_zero
entries.docstring:
Matter gauge tensors are fixed by pure jets: the members of the zeroth truncation kernel
  are the jets with trivial base-point value, so `repGauge_eq_of_eval_eq_one` applies.
entries.snippet:
lemma TransformsIn.repGauge_eq_of_mem_truncationKer_zero {𝔤 : Type} [LieRing 𝔤] [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤]
    {G₀ : Type} [Group G₀] {𝔤J : Type} [LieRing 𝔤J] [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤J]
    {jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 GJ 𝔤J} (hF : TransformsIn repGauge rep F)
    (hrep : ∀ {W : GJ}, jets.eval W = 1 → repCoeff rep W 0 = LinearMap.id)
    (U : jets.truncationKer 0) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    repGauge U.1 (F 0 φ) = F 0 φ

entries.name: ClassicalFieldTheory.Local.«lemma@102e1711»
entries.snippet:
private lemma
    isCritical_iff_eulerLagrange_zero_of_contDiff_and_coordinateRegularity_of_hasFiniteAction
    (L : Lagrangian d m k) (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hcoord : Lagrangian.ContDiffCoordDerivInCoordinates L)
    (hbase : HasFiniteAction L f)
    (hlocal :
      ∀ η : AdmissibleVariation d (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)),
        HasCompactlySupportedActionVariationDifference L f η) :
    IsCritical L f ↔ eulerLagrangeOp L f = 0

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.angularMomentum
entries.docstring: The angular momentum `L = q × p` of a particle at position `q` with momentum `p`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def angularMomentum (p q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.angularMomentum_apply_zero
entries.docstring: The x-component of the angular momentum is `q₁ p₂ - q₂ p₁`.
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentum_apply_zero (p q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    angularMomentum p q 0 = q 1 * p 2 - q 2 * p 1

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.angularMomentum_apply_one
entries.docstring: The y-component of the angular momentum is `q₂ p₀ - q₀ p₂`.
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentum_apply_one (p q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    angularMomentum p q 1 = q 2 * p 0 - q 0 * p 2

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.angularMomentum_apply_two
entries.docstring: The z-component of the angular momentum is `q₀ p₁ - q₁ p₀`.
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentum_apply_two (p q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    angularMomentum p q 2 = q 0 * p 1 - q 1 * p 0

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.angularMomentumSq
entries.docstring:
The squared magnitude `L² = ‖q × p‖²` of the angular momentum, as a function on phase
space.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def angularMomentumSq (p q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : ℝ

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.angularMomentumZ
entries.docstring: The component `L_z` of the angular momentum along the z-axis, as a function on phase space.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def angularMomentumZ (p q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : ℝ

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.angularMomentumSq_eq_sum
entries.docstring: The squared magnitude of the angular momentum is the sum of the squares of its components.
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentumSq_eq_sum (p q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    angularMomentumSq p q =
      angularMomentum p q 0 ^ 2 + angularMomentum p q 1 ^ 2 + angularMomentum p q 2 ^ 2

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.angularMomentumSq_eq
entries.docstring:
Lagrange's identity: the squared magnitude of the angular momentum `q × p` is
`⟪q, q⟫ ⟪p, p⟫ - ⟪q, p⟫²`.
entries.snippet:
lemma angularMomentumSq_eq (p q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    angularMomentumSq p q = ⟪q, q⟫_ℝ * ⟪p, p⟫_ℝ - ⟪q, p⟫_ℝ ^ 2

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.contDiff_angularMomentumSq
entries.docstring: The squared magnitude of the angular momentum is a smooth function on phase space.
entries.snippet: lemma contDiff_angularMomentumSq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry angularMomentumSq)

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.contDiff_angularMomentumZ
entries.docstring: The z-component of the angular momentum is a smooth function on phase space.
entries.snippet: lemma contDiff_angularMomentumZ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry angularMomentumZ)

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.hasGradientAt_angularMomentumSq_momentum
entries.docstring: The momentum gradient of `L²` is `2 ⟪q, q⟫ p - 2 ⟪q, p⟫ q`.
entries.snippet:
lemma hasGradientAt_angularMomentumSq_momentum (p q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    HasGradientAt (fun p' => angularMomentumSq p' q)
      ((2 * ⟪q, q⟫_ℝ) • p - (2 * ⟪q, p⟫_ℝ) • q) p

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.hasGradientAt_angularMomentumSq_position
entries.docstring: The position gradient of `L²` is `2 ⟪p, p⟫ q - 2 ⟪q, p⟫ p`.
entries.snippet:
lemma hasGradientAt_angularMomentumSq_position (p q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    HasGradientAt (fun q' => angularMomentumSq p q')
      ((2 * ⟪p, p⟫_ℝ) • q - (2 * ⟪q, p⟫_ℝ) • p) q

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.hasGradientAt_angularMomentumZ_momentum
entries.docstring: The momentum gradient of `L_z` is `q₀ e₁ - q₁ e₀`.
entries.snippet:
lemma hasGradientAt_angularMomentumZ_momentum (p q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    HasGradientAt (fun p' => angularMomentumZ p' q)
      (q 0 • EuclideanSpace.single 1 1 - q 1 • EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) p

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.hasGradientAt_angularMomentumZ_position
entries.docstring: The position gradient of `L_z` is `p₁ e₀ - p₀ e₁`.
entries.snippet:
lemma hasGradientAt_angularMomentumZ_position (p q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    HasGradientAt (fun q' => angularMomentumZ p q')
      (p 1 • EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 - p 0 • EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) q

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.poissonBracket_angularMomentumSq_angularMomentumZ
entries.docstring: The squared magnitude of the angular momentum and its z-component are in involution.
entries.snippet:
lemma poissonBracket_angularMomentumSq_angularMomentumZ (p q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    poissonBracket angularMomentumSq angularMomentumZ p q = 0

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.poissonBracket_angularMomentumSq_eq_zero_of_hasGradientAt
entries.docstring:
`L²` Poisson-commutes with any phase-space function whose momentum gradient is parallel to the
momentum and whose position gradient is parallel to the position.

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.poissonBracket_angularMomentumZ_eq_zero_of_hasGradientAt
entries.docstring:
`L_z` Poisson-commutes with any phase-space function whose momentum gradient is parallel to
the momentum and whose position gradient is parallel to the position.

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.poissonBracket_angularMomentumSq_hamiltonian
entries.docstring:
Away from the centre of force, the squared magnitude of the angular momentum Poisson-commutes
with the Hamiltonian of a central-force system, so is conserved by the motion.
entries.snippet:
lemma poissonBracket_angularMomentumSq_hamiltonian (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
    {q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    poissonBracket angularMomentumSq S.hamiltonian p q = 0

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.poissonBracket_angularMomentumZ_hamiltonian
entries.docstring:
Away from the centre of force, the z-component of the angular momentum Poisson-commutes with
the Hamiltonian of a central-force system, so is conserved by the motion.
entries.snippet:
lemma poissonBracket_angularMomentumZ_hamiltonian (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
    {q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    poissonBracket angularMomentumZ S.hamiltonian p q = 0

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce
entries.docstring:
A particle in three-dimensional space under a conservative central force centred at the origin,
specified by its mass `m` and a radial potential `V` smooth at positive radii.
entries.snippet:
structure CentralForce where
  m : ℝ
  V : ℝ → ℝ
  m_pos : 0 < m
  contDiffOn_V : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V (Set.Ioi 0)

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.m_ne_zero
entries.docstring: The mass of the particle is non-zero.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma m_ne_zero : S.m ≠ 0

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.hamiltonian
entries.docstring:
The Hamiltonian `H(p, q) = ⟪p, p⟫ / (2 m) + V ‖q‖` of a central-force system, as a function of
the momentum `p` and the position `q`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def hamiltonian (p q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : ℝ

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.hasGradientAt_hamiltonian_momentum
entries.docstring: The momentum gradient of the Hamiltonian of a central-force system is the velocity `p / m`.
entries.snippet:
lemma hasGradientAt_hamiltonian_momentum (p q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    HasGradientAt (fun p' => S.hamiltonian p' q) (S.m⁻¹ • p) p

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.hasGradientAt_hamiltonian_position
entries.docstring:
Away from the centre of force, the position gradient of the Hamiltonian of a central-force
system is `V'(‖q‖) q / ‖q‖`, which is parallel to the position.
entries.snippet:
lemma hasGradientAt_hamiltonian_position (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
    {q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    HasGradientAt (fun q' => S.hamiltonian p q') ((deriv S.V ‖q‖ / ‖q‖) • q) q

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.CentralForce.contDiffOn_hamiltonian
entries.docstring: The Hamiltonian of a central-force system is smooth away from the centre of force.
entries.snippet:
lemma contDiffOn_hamiltonian :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry S.hamiltonian) {x | x.2 ≠ 0}

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.LiouvilleIntegrableOn
entries.docstring:
A Liouville integrable system for a Hamiltonian `H` on an open dense domain `U` of the
`2d`-dimensional phase space `EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)`, whose points
are read as `(p, q)`: `d` smooth conserved quantities, one per degree of freedom, that are pairwise
in involution and functionally independent at every point of `U`.
entries.snippet:
structure LiouvilleIntegrableOn {d : ℕ}
    (U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)))
    (H : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ) where
  isOpen : IsOpen U
  dense : Dense U
  f : Fin d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ
  contDiffOn : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry (f i)) U
  exists_hamiltonian : ∃ i, f i = H
  involutive : ∀ i j, ∀ x ∈ U, poissonBracket (f i) (f j) x.1 x.2 = 0
  independent : ∀ x ∈ U, LinearIndependent ℝ
    (fun i => (gradient (fun p' => f i p' x.2) x.1, gradient (fun q' => f i x.1 q') x.2))

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.LiouvilleIntegrableOn.deriv_comp_eq_zero
entries.docstring:
Each conserved quantity of a Liouville integrable system has zero time derivative along a
solution of Hamilton's equations for `H` which lies in the domain `U` at time `t`.

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.LiouvilleIntegrableOn.oneDegreeOfFreedom
entries.docstring:
A Hamiltonian system with one degree of freedom is Liouville integrable, with the Hamiltonian as
its single conserved quantity, on any open dense domain on which the Hamiltonian is smooth and has
non-vanishing phase-space gradient.
entries.snippet:
def LiouvilleIntegrableOn.oneDegreeOfFreedom
    {U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))}
    {H : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) → ℝ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hdense : Dense U) (hH : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry H) U)
    (hgrad : ∀ x ∈ U,
      (gradient (fun p' => H p' x.2) x.1, gradient (fun q' => H x.1 q') x.2) ≠ 0) :
    LiouvilleIntegrableOn U H where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.translation
entries.docstring: Translation of finitely supported configurations: `(T a ψ) m = ψ (m - a)`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def translation : Multiplicative Λ →* Module.End K (Λ →₀ M) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.translation_single
entries.snippet:
lemma translation_single (a : Multiplicative Λ) (m : Λ) (v : M) :
    translation (K := K) a (Finsupp.single m v)
      = Finsupp.single (m + Multiplicative.toAdd a) v

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.charFun
entries.docstring: A character `χ` of `Λ`, viewed as a function on the multiplicative group of translations.
entries.snippet: def charFun (χ : AddChar Λ K) : Multiplicative Λ → K

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.ev
entries.docstring: Fourier evaluation at the character `χ`: `ev χ ψ = ∑ m, χ m • ψ m`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def ev (χ : AddChar Λ K) : (Λ →₀ M) →ₗ[K] M

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.ev_translation
entries.snippet:
lemma ev_translation (χ : AddChar Λ K) (a : Multiplicative Λ) (ψ : Λ →₀ M) :
    ev χ (translation (K := K) a ψ) = charFun χ a • ev χ ψ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.ev_single_zero
entries.snippet: lemma ev_single_zero (χ : AddChar Λ K) (v : M) : ev χ (Finsupp.single 0 v) = v

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.ev_surjective
entries.snippet: lemma ev_surjective (χ : AddChar Λ K) : Function.Surjective (ev (M := M) χ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.sub_single_ev_mem_cobound
entries.docstring:
Every configuration is congruent, modulo the fiber relations, to its Fourier evaluation
placed in the origin cell.
entries.snippet:
lemma sub_single_ev_mem_cobound (χ : AddChar Λ K) (ψ : Λ →₀ M) :
    ψ - Finsupp.single 0 (ev χ ψ)
      ∈ cobound (translation (K := K) (Λ := Λ) (M := M)) (charFun χ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.ker_ev
entries.docstring: The kernel of Fourier evaluation is exactly the span defining the momentum fiber.
entries.snippet:
lemma ker_ev (χ : AddChar Λ K) :
    LinearMap.ker (ev (M := M) χ)
      = cobound (translation (K := K) (Λ := Λ) (M := M)) (charFun χ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.fiberEquiv
entries.docstring:
The momentum fiber of the translation action at `χ` is canonically the unit-cell space
`M`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fiberEquiv (χ : AddChar Λ K) :
    Fiber (translation (K := K) (Λ := Λ) (M := M)) (charFun χ) ≃ₗ[K] M

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.symbol
entries.docstring:
The Bloch matrix of a linear map `D` at the character `χ`: apply `D` to the unit cell at the
origin and Fourier-evaluate.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def symbol (χ : AddChar Λ K) (D : (Λ →₀ M) →ₗ[K] (Λ →₀ M)) :
    M →ₗ[K] M

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.symbol_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma symbol_apply (χ : AddChar Λ K) (D : (Λ →₀ M) →ₗ[K] (Λ →₀ M)) (v : M) :
    symbol χ D v = ev χ (D (Finsupp.single 0 v))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.ev_apply
entries.docstring:
**Bloch theorem.** Fourier evaluation intertwines a translation-equivariant linear map with
its Bloch matrix.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.symbol_comp
entries.docstring: The Bloch matrix is multiplicative: only the left factor needs to be equivariant.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.symbol_add
entries.docstring: The Bloch matrix is additive.
entries.snippet:
lemma symbol_add (χ : AddChar Λ K) (D₁ D₂ : (Λ →₀ M) →ₗ[K] (Λ →₀ M)) :
    symbol χ (D₁ + D₂) = symbol χ D₁ + symbol χ D₂

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.isUnit_symbol
entries.docstring:
If an equivariant map is invertible by an equivariant map, its Bloch matrix is invertible a
every momentum.
entries.snippet:
lemma isUnit_symbol {D E : (Λ →₀ M) →ₗ[K] (Λ →₀ M)}
    (hD : IsEquivariant (translation (K := K)) (translation (K := K)) D)
    (hE : IsEquivariant (translation (K := K)) (translation (K := K)) E)
    (h₁ : D ∘ₗ E = LinearMap.id) (h₂ : E ∘ₗ D = LinearMap.id) (χ : AddChar Λ K) :
    IsUnit (symbol χ D)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.hop
entries.docstring: One hopping term: apply `Hn` in each cell, then translate by `n`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def hop (n : Λ) (Hn : M →ₗ[K] M) : (Λ →₀ M) →ₗ[K] (Λ →₀ M)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.hopping
entries.docstring:
A finite-range hopping operator with hopping matrices `H n : M → M`:
`(hopping H ψ) m = ∑ n, H n (ψ (m - n))`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def hopping (H : Λ →₀ (M →ₗ[K] M)) : (Λ →₀ M) →ₗ[K] (Λ →₀ M)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.isEquivariant_hop
entries.snippet:
lemma isEquivariant_hop (n : Λ) (Hn : M →ₗ[K] M) :
    IsEquivariant (translation (K := K)) (translation (K := K)) (hop n Hn)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.isEquivariant_hopping
entries.snippet:
lemma isEquivariant_hopping (H : Λ →₀ (M →ₗ[K] M)) :
    IsEquivariant (translation (K := K)) (translation (K := K)) (hopping H)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.symbol_hopping
entries.docstring: **Bloch Hamiltonian.** The Bloch matrix of a hopping operator is `∑ n, χ n • H n`.
entries.snippet:
lemma symbol_hopping (χ : AddChar Λ K) (H : Λ →₀ (M →ₗ[K] M)) :
    symbol χ (hopping H) = H.sum fun n Hn => χ n • Hn

entries.name: CondensedMatter.FiniteBloch.hopping
entries.docstring:
The hopping operator `(B ψ) x = ∑_r A_r ψ (x - r)` on configurations of a finite periodic
crystal.
entries.snippet:
def hopping (A : G → Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) :
    (G → Fin N → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (G → Fin N → ℂ) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.FiniteBloch.hopping_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma hopping_apply (A : G → Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) (ψ : G → Fin N → ℂ) (x : G) :
    hopping A ψ x = ∑ r, (A r).mulVec (ψ (x - r))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.FiniteBloch.bloch
entries.docstring: The Bloch matrix `b(χ) = ∑_r χ(-r) A_r` of a hopping operator.
entries.snippet: def bloch (A : G → Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) (χ : AddChar G ℂ) : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.FiniteBloch.fourier
entries.docstring: The Fourier transform `ψ̂(χ) = ∑_x χ(-x) ψ(x)` of a configuration.
entries.snippet: def fourier (χ : AddChar G ℂ) (ψ : G → Fin N → ℂ) : Fin N → ℂ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.FiniteBloch.fourier_hopping
entries.docstring:
**Bloch's theorem on a finite crystal.** The Fourier transform of `B ψ` at momentum `χ` is
the Bloch matrix applied to the Fourier transform of `ψ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma fourier_hopping (A : G → Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) (χ : AddChar G ℂ)
    (ψ : G → Fin N → ℂ) : fourier χ (hopping A ψ) = (bloch A χ).mulVec (fourier χ ψ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.FiniteBloch.mem_spectrum_iff_exists
entries.docstring: An eigenvalue of an operator on a finite-dimensional space is a point of its spectrum.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_spectrum_iff_exists {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] [FiniteDimensional ℂ V]
    (f : Module.End ℂ V) (μ : ℂ) : μ ∈ spectrum ℂ f ↔ ∃ v, v ≠ 0 ∧ f v = μ • v

entries.name: CondensedMatter.FiniteBloch.mem_spectrum_matrix_iff
entries.docstring: A complex number is in the spectrum of a matrix exactly when it has an eigenvector.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_spectrum_matrix_iff (M : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) (μ : ℂ) :
    μ ∈ spectrum ℂ M ↔ ∃ v : Fin N → ℂ, v ≠ 0 ∧ M.mulVec v = μ • v

entries.name: CondensedMatter.FiniteBloch.fourier_smul
entries.snippet:
lemma fourier_smul (χ : AddChar G ℂ) (c : ℂ) (ψ : G → Fin N → ℂ) :
    fourier χ (c • ψ) = c • fourier χ ψ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.FiniteBloch.sum_character_smul_fourier
entries.docstring: **Fourier inversion** on a finite abelian group.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_character_smul_fourier (ψ : G → Fin N → ℂ) (x : G) :
    ∑ χ : AddChar G ℂ, χ x • fourier χ ψ = (Fintype.card G : ℂ) • ψ x

entries.name: CondensedMatter.FiniteBloch.eq_zero_of_fourier_eq_zero
entries.docstring: A configuration with vanishing Fourier transform vanishes.
entries.snippet: lemma eq_zero_of_fourier_eq_zero {ψ : G → Fin N → ℂ} (h : ∀ χ, fourier χ ψ = 0) : ψ = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.FiniteBloch.hopping_planeWave
entries.docstring: A plane wave of crystal momentum `χ` is mapped to a plane wave with the same momentum.
entries.snippet:
lemma hopping_planeWave (A : G → Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) (χ : AddChar G ℂ)
    (v : Fin N → ℂ) :
    hopping A (fun x => χ x • v) = fun x => χ x • (bloch A χ).mulVec v

entries.name: CondensedMatter.FiniteBloch.spectrum_hopping
entries.docstring:
**The spectrum of a translation-invariant operator on a finite periodic crystal is the union
of the spectra of its Bloch matrices.**
entries.snippet:
lemma spectrum_hopping (A : G → Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) :
    spectrum ℂ (hopping A) = ⋃ χ : AddChar G ℂ, spectrum ℂ (bloch A χ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.hypercubicCone
entries.docstring: The cone `0 ≤ k_{d-1} ≤ … ≤ k_0 ≤ 1/2` of coordinates.
entries.snippet: def hypercubicCone (d : ℕ) : Set (Fin d → ℝ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.hypercubicZone
entries.docstring: The irreducible zone of the hypercubic lattice: the momenta with coordinates in the cone.
entries.snippet: def hypercubicZone (d : ℕ) : Set (BrillouinZone (Fin d → ℤ))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.signedPerm_mem_symmetries
entries.docstring: **A signed permutation is a bond-preserving symmetry of the hypercubic lattice.**
entries.snippet:
lemma signedPerm_mem_symmetries (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) (ε : Fin d → Bool) :
    (⟨signedPerm π ε, 1, 0⟩ : CellSymmetry (Fin d → ℤ) Unit) ∈
      (hypercubicGraph d).symmetries

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.smul_brillouinPoint_of_linear
entries.docstring:
The coordinates of the image of a momentum under a symmetry whose linear part is a signed
permutation.
entries.snippet:
lemma smul_brillouinPoint_of_linear {F : Type*} (s : CellSymmetry (Fin d → ℤ) F)
    (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) (ε : Fin d → Bool) (h : s.linear = signedPerm π ε)
    (k : Fin d → ℝ) :
    s • brillouinPoint k = brillouinPoint (fun j => (signOf (ε j) : ℝ) * k (π.symm j))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.smul_brillouinPoint_signedPerm
entries.docstring: The coordinates of the image of a momentum under a signed permutation.
entries.snippet:
lemma smul_brillouinPoint_signedPerm (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) (ε : Fin d → Bool) (k : Fin d → ℝ) :
    (⟨signedPerm π ε, 1, 0⟩ : CellSymmetry (Fin d → ℤ) Unit) • brillouinPoint k =
      brillouinPoint (fun j => (signOf (ε j) : ℝ) * k (π.symm j))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.exists_signedPerm_to_cone
entries.docstring: **Every momentum is carried into the irreducible zone by a signed permutation.**
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_signedPerm_to_cone (k : Fin d → ℝ) :
    ∃ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) (ε : Fin d → Bool) (k' : Fin d → ℝ), k' ∈ hypercubicCone d ∧
      (⟨signedPerm π ε, 1, 0⟩ : CellSymmetry (Fin d → ℤ) Unit) • brillouinPoint k =
        brillouinPoint k'

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.coversOrbits_hypercubic
entries.docstring: **The hypercubic zone covers the orbits of the point group.**
entries.snippet:
lemma coversOrbits_hypercubic :
    CoversOrbits (hypercubicGraph d) (hypercubicZone d)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.hypercubicBand
entries.docstring:
The band of nearest-neighbour hopping with amplitude `t` on the hypercubic lattice, at the
momentum with coordinates `k`: `2 t ∑_j cos (2π k_j)`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def hypercubicBand (t : ℝ) (k : Fin d → ℝ) : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.brillouinPoint_single_sign
CondensedMatter.Bloch.circle_exp_add_neg
CondensedMatter.Bloch.hoppingSymbol_hypercubic
entries.docstring:
**The Bloch matrix of nearest-neighbour hopping on the hypercubic lattice** is the `1 × 1`
matrix with the entry `2 t ∑_j cos (2π k_j)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma hoppingSymbol_hypercubic (t : ℝ) (k : Fin d → ℝ) :
    hoppingSymbol (uniformHopping (hypercubicGraph d) (t : ℂ)) (brillouinPoint k) =
      Matrix.of fun _ _ => ((hypercubicBand t k : ℝ) : ℂ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.spectrum_const
entries.snippet:
private lemma spectrum_const (c : ℂ) :
    spectrum ℂ (Matrix.of fun (_ : Unit) (_ : Unit) => c) = {c}

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.iUnion_spectrum_hypercubic
entries.docstring:
**The spectrum of nearest-neighbour hopping on the hypercubic lattice** is the set of values
of the band `2 t ∑_j cos (2π k_j)` on the irreducible zone `0 ≤ k_{d-1} ≤ … ≤ k_0 ≤ 1/2`, which is
`1 / (2^d d!)` of the Brillouin zone.
entries.snippet:
lemma iUnion_spectrum_hypercubic (t : ℝ) :
    (⋃ χ : BrillouinZone (Fin d → ℤ),
        spectrum ℂ (hoppingSymbol (uniformHopping (hypercubicGraph d) (t : ℂ)) χ)) =
      {z : ℂ | ∃ k ∈ hypercubicCone d, z = ((hypercubicBand t k : ℝ) : ℂ)}

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.convex_hypercubicCone
entries.snippet: lemma convex_hypercubicCone : Convex ℝ (hypercubicCone d)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.continuous_hypercubicBand
entries.snippet: lemma continuous_hypercubicBand (t : ℝ) : Continuous (hypercubicBand (d := d) t)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.abs_hypercubicBand_le
entries.snippet:
lemma abs_hypercubicBand_le (t : ℝ) (k : Fin d → ℝ) :
    |hypercubicBand t k| ≤ 2 * d * |t|

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.hypercubicBand_image
entries.docstring:
**The band of nearest-neighbour hopping takes exactly the values in `[-2 d |t|, 2 d |t|]` on
the irreducible zone.**
entries.snippet:
lemma hypercubicBand_image (t : ℝ) :
    hypercubicBand t '' hypercubicCone d = Set.Icc (-(2 * d * |t|)) (2 * d * |t|)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.iUnion_spectrum_hypercubic_eq_Icc
entries.docstring:
**The spectrum of nearest-neighbour hopping on the hypercubic lattice is the interval
`[-2 d |t|, 2 d |t|]`.**
entries.snippet:
lemma iUnion_spectrum_hypercubic_eq_Icc (t : ℝ) :
    (⋃ χ : BrillouinZone (Fin d → ℤ),
        spectrum ℂ (hoppingSymbol (uniformHopping (hypercubicGraph d) (t : ℂ)) χ)) =
      ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) '' Set.Icc (-(2 * d * |t|)) (2 * d * |t|)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.littleGroup_gamma
entries.docstring: **The centre `Γ` of the Brillouin zone is fixed by every symmetry.**
entries.snippet:
lemma littleGroup_gamma (d : ℕ) :
    (hypercubicGraph d).littleGroup (brillouinPoint (0 : Fin d → ℝ)) = ⊤

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.littleGroup_corner
entries.docstring:
**The corner `R = (1/2, …, 1/2)` of the Brillouin zone is fixed by every symmetry**: its
little group is the whole group.
entries.snippet:
lemma littleGroup_corner (d : ℕ) :
    (hypercubicGraph d).littleGroup (brillouinPoint (fun _ : Fin d => (1 / 2 : ℝ))) = ⊤

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.fibreMatrix
entries.docstring:
The fibre matrix of a symmetry `s = (A, σ, b)` at the momentum `χ`: the monomial matrix with
the entry `χ(b i)` at `(σ i, i)`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fibreMatrix (s : CellSymmetry G F) (χ : BrillouinZone G) :
    Matrix F F ℂ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.fibreMatrix_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma fibreMatrix_apply (s : CellSymmetry G F) (χ : BrillouinZone G) (j i : F) :
    fibreMatrix s χ j i = if j = s.perm i then (χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd (s.shift i)) : ℂ) else 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.fibreMatrix_mul
entries.docstring: **The cocycle identity** for the fibre matrices: `V_{st}(χ) = V_s(χ) V_t(s⁻¹ • χ)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma fibreMatrix_mul (s t : CellSymmetry G F) (χ : BrillouinZone G) :
    fibreMatrix (s * t) χ = fibreMatrix s χ * fibreMatrix t (s⁻¹ • χ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.circle_mul_star
entries.snippet: private lemma circle_mul_star (z : Circle) : (z : ℂ) * star (z : ℂ) = 1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.fibreMatrix_mul_conjTranspose
entries.docstring: The fibre matrices are unitary.
entries.snippet:
lemma fibreMatrix_mul_conjTranspose (s : CellSymmetry G F) (χ : BrillouinZone G) :
    fibreMatrix s χ * (fibreMatrix s χ)ᴴ = 1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.fibreMatrix_conjTranspose_mul
entries.docstring: The fibre matrices are unitary.
entries.snippet:
lemma fibreMatrix_conjTranspose_mul (s : CellSymmetry G F) (χ : BrillouinZone G) :
    (fibreMatrix s χ)ᴴ * fibreMatrix s χ = 1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.hoppingSymbol
entries.docstring: The Bloch matrix `b(χ) = ∑_r χ(r) T r` of a finite family of hopping matrices.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def hoppingSymbol (T : G →₀ Matrix F F ℂ) (χ : BrillouinZone G) : Matrix F F ℂ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.IsInvariant
entries.docstring:
A family of hopping matrices is invariant under a symmetry `(A, σ, b)` when
`T (A r + b i - b j) (σ i) (σ j) = T r i j`: the amplitude to hop from `j` to `i` across `r`
equals the amplitude between the transformed sites across the transformed displacement.
entries.snippet: def IsInvariant (T : G →₀ Matrix F F ℂ) (s : CellSymmetry G F) : Prop

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.IsCovariant
entries.docstring:
A symbol `b` on the Brillouin zone is covariant under a symmetry when the fibre matrix
intertwines it: `V_s(s • χ) b(χ) = b(s • χ) V_s(s • χ)`.
entries.snippet: def IsCovariant (b : BrillouinZone G → Matrix F F ℂ) (s : CellSymmetry G F) : Prop

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.entry
entries.docstring:
The entries of a hopping family at a fixed pair of orbitals, as a finitely supported function
of the displacement.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def entry (T : G →₀ Matrix F F ℂ) (i j : F) : G →₀ ℂ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.hoppingSymbol_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma hoppingSymbol_apply (T : G →₀ Matrix F F ℂ) (χ : BrillouinZone G) (i j : F) :
    hoppingSymbol T χ i j = (entry T i j).sum fun r m => (χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd r) : ℂ) * m

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.smul_apply_linear
entries.snippet:
lemma smul_apply_linear (s : CellSymmetry G F) (χ : BrillouinZone G) (r : G) :
    (s • χ) (Multiplicative.ofAdd (s.linear r)) = χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd r)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.isCovariant_of_invariant
entries.docstring: **Invariant hopping has a covariant Bloch symbol.**
entries.snippet:
lemma isCovariant_of_invariant {T : G →₀ Matrix F F ℂ} {s : CellSymmetry G F}
    (hT : IsInvariant T s) : IsCovariant (hoppingSymbol T) s

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.conj_of_covariant
entries.docstring: A covariant symbol is conjugated by the fibre matrix between a momentum and its image.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.charpoly_eq_of_covariant
entries.docstring: The Bloch matrices at related momenta have the same characteristic polynomial.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.eigenvalues_eq_of_covariant
entries.docstring:
**The bands agree at momenta related by a symmetry.** If the Bloch matrices are Hermitian,
their eigenvalues at `χ` and `s • χ` coincide.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.bandsOnZone
entries.docstring:
**The bands are functions on the irreducible zone.** For a symbol that is covariant under all
bond-preserving symmetries of a crystal, the eigenvalues of the Bloch matrices depend only on the
orbit of the momentum under the point group.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.commute_of_smul_eq
entries.docstring: At a momentum fixed by a symmetry, the Bloch matrix commutes with its fibre matrix.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.le_finrank_eigenspace
entries.docstring:
**Symmetry-enforced degeneracy.** If `M` commutes with a set of matrices and every nonzero
subspace invariant under them has dimension at least `m`, every eigenspace of `M` has dimension
at least `m`.
entries.snippet:
lemma le_finrank_eigenspace (M : Matrix F F ℂ) (S : Set (Matrix F F ℂ))
    (hcomm : ∀ V ∈ S, V * M = M * V) {m : ℕ}
    (hS : ∀ W : Submodule ℂ (F → ℂ), W ≠ ⊥ → (∀ V ∈ S, ∀ w ∈ W, V.mulVec w ∈ W) →
      m ≤ Module.finrank ℂ W) (μ : ℂ) (hμ : ∃ v : F → ℂ, v ≠ 0 ∧ M.mulVec v = μ • v) :
    m ≤ Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' M) μ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.le_finrank_eigenspace_of_littleGroup
entries.docstring:
**Degeneracy forced by the little group.** For a symbol covariant under the bond-preserving
symmetries of a crystal, if every nonzero subspace of `ℂ^F` invariant under the fibre matrices of
the little group at `χ` has dimension at least `m`, every eigenspace of the Bloch matrix at `χ` has
dimension at least `m`.
entries.snippet:
lemma le_finrank_eigenspace_of_littleGroup {g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G F)}
    {b : BrillouinZone G → Matrix F F ℂ} (hb : ∀ s : g.symmetries, IsCovariant b s)
    (χ : BrillouinZone G) {m : ℕ}
    (hS : ∀ W : Submodule ℂ (F → ℂ), W ≠ ⊥ →
      (∀ s ∈ g.littleGroup χ, ∀ w ∈ W, (fibreMatrix (s : CellSymmetry G F) χ).mulVec w ∈ W) →
      m ≤ Module.finrank ℂ W) (μ : ℂ) (hμ : ∃ v : F → ℂ, v ≠ 0 ∧ (b χ).mulVec v = μ • v) :
    m ≤ Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' (b χ)) μ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.uniformHopping
entries.docstring:
Hopping with the amplitude `t` between any two bonded sites of a periodic graph: the entry
`(i, j)` of the matrix at the displacement `r` is `t` when the site `j` of a cell is bonded to the
site `i` of the cell displaced by `r`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def uniformHopping (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G F)) (t : ℂ) :
    G →₀ Matrix F F ℂ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.uniformHopping_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma uniformHopping_apply (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G F)) (t : ℂ) (r : G) (i j : F) :
    uniformHopping g t r i j = if g.Bonded j i r then t else 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.isInvariant_uniformHopping
entries.docstring: **Uniform hopping is invariant under every bond-preserving symmetry.**
entries.snippet:
lemma isInvariant_uniformHopping (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G F)) (t : ℂ)
    {s : CellSymmetry G F} (hs : s ∈ g.symmetries) : IsInvariant (uniformHopping g t) s

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.isCovariant_uniformHopping
entries.docstring: **Uniform hopping has a covariant Bloch symbol under every bond-preserving symmetry.**
entries.snippet:
lemma isCovariant_uniformHopping (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G F)) (t : ℂ)
    (s : g.symmetries) : IsCovariant (hoppingSymbol (uniformHopping g t)) s

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.isHermitian_hoppingSymbol
entries.docstring: If `(T r)ᴴ = T (-r)` for all `r`, the Bloch matrices are Hermitian.
entries.snippet:
lemma isHermitian_hoppingSymbol {T : G →₀ Matrix F F ℂ} (hT : ∀ r, (T r)ᴴ = T (-r))
    (χ : BrillouinZone G) : (hoppingSymbol T χ).IsHermitian

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.bonded_symm
entries.docstring:
Bonds are symmetric: the bond from `i` to `j` across `d` is the bond from `j` to `i` across
`-d`.
entries.snippet:
lemma bonded_symm (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G F)) (i j : F) (d : G) :
    g.Bonded i j d ↔ g.Bonded j i (-d)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.isHermitian_hoppingSymbol_uniform
entries.docstring: Uniform real hopping gives Hermitian Bloch matrices at every momentum.
entries.snippet:
lemma isHermitian_hoppingSymbol_uniform (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G F)) (t : ℝ)
    (χ : BrillouinZone G) : (hoppingSymbol (uniformHopping g (t : ℂ)) χ).IsHermitian

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.CoversOrbits
entries.docstring:
A set of momenta covers the orbits of the point group when every momentum is carried into it by
some element of the point group. An irreducible zone is a set that covers the orbits.
entries.snippet: def CoversOrbits (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G F)) (D : Set (BrillouinZone G)) : Prop

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.spectrum_eq_range_eigenvalues
entries.docstring: The spectrum of a Bloch matrix is the set of its eigenvalues.
entries.snippet:
lemma spectrum_eq_range_eigenvalues {M : Matrix F F ℂ} (hM : M.IsHermitian) :
    spectrum ℂ M = ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) '' Set.range hM.eigenvalues

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.spectrum_eq_of_covariant
entries.docstring: **The spectra of the Bloch matrices at related momenta agree.**

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.iUnion_spectrum_eq_of_covers
entries.docstring:
**The spectrum over the whole Brillouin zone is the spectrum over an irreducible zone.** If a
symbol is covariant under the bond-preserving symmetries, it suffices to take the union of the
spectra of its Bloch matrices over a set of momenta that covers the orbits of the point group.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.two_le_finrank_of_no_common_eigenvector
entries.docstring:
**A criterion for twofold degeneracy.** If the matrices in `S` have no common eigenvector, every
nonzero invariant subspace has dimension at least `2`. Combined with
`le_finrank_eigenspace_of_littleGroup`, this forces every eigenvalue of the Bloch matrix at a
momentum whose little group has no common eigenvector in `ℂ^F` to be at least twofold degenerate.
entries.snippet:
lemma two_le_finrank_of_no_common_eigenvector (S : Set (Matrix F F ℂ))
    (h : ¬∃ v : F → ℂ, v ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ V ∈ S, ∃ c : ℂ, V.mulVec v = c • v)
    (W : Submodule ℂ (F → ℂ)) (hW : W ≠ ⊥) (hinv : ∀ V ∈ S, ∀ w ∈ W, V.mulVec w ∈ W) :
    2 ≤ Module.finrank ℂ W

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.measurePreserving_addRight
entries.docstring: Translation of a discrete group preserves the counting measure.
entries.snippet:
lemma measurePreserving_addRight (g : G) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun x : G => x + g) (Measure.count : Measure G) Measure.count

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.shift
entries.docstring: Translation by `a`, as a permutation of the group.
entries.snippet: def shift (a : G) : Equiv.Perm G where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.translations
entries.docstring: The translation action of the group on itself, as permutations.
entries.snippet: def translations : Multiplicative G →* Equiv.Perm G where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.measurePreserving_translations
entries.snippet:
lemma measurePreserving_translations (g : Multiplicative G) :
    MeasurePreserving (translations g) (Measure.count : Measure G) Measure.count

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.Space
entries.docstring:
The Hilbert space `ℓ²(G, ℂ^N)` of square-summable functions on `G` with values in the internal
space `ℂ^N`, as `L²` of the counting measure.
entries.snippet: abbrev Space

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.translation
entries.docstring: **The translation representation** on `ℓ²(G, ℂ^N)`: `(U_g ψ)(x) = ψ(x - g)`.
entries.snippet: def translation : Multiplicative G →* unitary (Space G N →L[ℂ] Space G N)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.pointwise
entries.docstring: Pointwise action of an operator of the internal space on `ℓ²(G, ℂ^N)`.
entries.snippet:
abbrev pointwise (L : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N) →L[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N)) :
    Space G N →L[ℂ] Space G N

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.pointwise_apply_ae
entries.snippet:
lemma pointwise_apply_ae (L : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N) →L[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N))
    (f : Space G N) : pointwise G N L f =ᵐ[Measure.count] fun x => L (f x)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.pointwise_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma pointwise_mul (A B : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N) →L[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N)) :
    pointwise G N (A * B) = pointwise G N A * pointwise G N B

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.pointwise_one
entries.snippet:
lemma pointwise_one : pointwise G N (1 : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N) →L[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N)) =
    1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.pointwise_star
entries.snippet:
lemma pointwise_star (L : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N) →L[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N)) :
    pointwise G N (star L) = star (pointwise G N L)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.internal
entries.docstring: **The internal algebra**: a matrix acts on the internal index of a wavefunction, pointwise.
entries.snippet: def internal : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (Space G N →L[ℂ] Space G N) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.translation_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma translation_apply (g : Multiplicative G) (f : Space G N) :
    ((translation G N g : unitary (Space G N →L[ℂ] Space G N)) : Space G N →L[ℂ] Space G N) f =
      Lp.compMeasurePreserving (translations g⁻¹) (measurePreserving_translations g⁻¹) f

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.commute_translation_internal
entries.docstring:
The translations commute with the internal algebra: the matrices act on the internal index and
the translations move the site.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_translation_internal (g : Multiplicative G) (M : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) :
    Commute ((translation G N g : unitary (Space G N →L[ℂ] Space G N)) :
      Space G N →L[ℂ] Space G N) (internal M)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.localized
entries.docstring: The state localized at the origin with internal state `e`.
entries.snippet: def localized (e : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N)) : Space G N

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.count_preimage_ne_top
entries.snippet:
lemma count_preimage_ne_top (g : Multiplicative G) :
    (Measure.count : Measure G) ((translations g⁻¹) ⁻¹' {(0 : G)}) ≠ ⊤

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.translation_localized
entries.docstring: Translating a localized state moves it to the translated site.
entries.snippet:
lemma translation_localized (g : Multiplicative G) (e : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N)) :
    ((translation G N g : unitary (Space G N →L[ℂ] Space G N)) : Space G N →L[ℂ] Space G N)
        (localized e) =
      indicatorConstLp 2 ((measurableSet_singleton (0 : G)).preimage
        (measurable_of_countable (translations g⁻¹))) (count_preimage_ne_top g) e

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.inner_localized_translation
entries.docstring: **The matrix coefficients of a localized state are the Kronecker delta.**
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_localized_translation (g : Multiplicative G) (e e' : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N)) :
    ⟪localized (G := G) e, ((translation G N g : unitary (Space G N →L[ℂ] Space G N)) :
      Space G N →L[ℂ] Space G N) (localized e')⟫_ℂ = if g = 1 then ⟪e, e'⟫_ℂ else 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.pointwise_localized
entries.snippet:
lemma pointwise_localized (L : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N) →L[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N))
    (e : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N)) : pointwise G N L (localized e) = localized (L e)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.localized_add
entries.snippet:
lemma localized_add (e e' : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N)) :
    localized (G := G) (e + e') = localized e + localized e'

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.localized_smul
entries.snippet:
lemma localized_smul (c : ℂ) (e : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N)) :
    localized (G := G) (c • e) = c • localized e

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.vectorMeasure_localized
entries.docstring:
**A localized state has a uniform momentum distribution**: its spectral measure for the
translations is the Haar measure of the dual group, weighted by the squared norm of the internal
state.
entries.snippet:
lemma vectorMeasure_localized (e : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N)) :
    UnitaryRep.vectorMeasure (translation G N) (localized e) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (‖e‖ ^ 2) • dualHaar (G := G)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.projection_localized_ne_zero
entries.docstring:
The spectral projection of a nonempty open set of crystal momenta does not annihilate a
localized state of nonzero internal state.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.hasFullSupport
entries.docstring:
**The regular representation has full support**: every crystal momentum occurs in every
internal state.
entries.snippet:
lemma hasFullSupport :
    UnitaryRep.HasFullSupport (translation G N) (internal (G := G) (N := N))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.«instance@0a0a481a»
entries.docstring: Every set of sites is measurable.
entries.snippet: instance : MeasurableSpace (CellSite G F)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.«instance@0b289137»
entries.snippet: instance : MeasurableSingletonClass (CellSite G F)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.«instance@4f848d4e»
entries.snippet: instance [Countable G] [Countable F] : Countable (CellSite G F)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.measurePreserving_count
entries.docstring: A permutation of a countable set preserves the counting measure.
entries.snippet:
lemma measurePreserving_count {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSingletonClass X]
    [Countable X] (e : Equiv.Perm X) :
    MeasurePreserving e (Measure.count : Measure X) Measure.count

entries.name: CondensedMatter.SiteSpace
entries.docstring: The square-summable functions on the sites of a crystal built from a unit cell.
entries.snippet: abbrev SiteSpace (G F : Type*)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.siteTranslationPerm
entries.docstring: The translations act on the sites by permutations.
entries.snippet:
def siteTranslationPerm (G F : Type*) [AddCommGroup G] :
    Multiplicative G →* Equiv.Perm (CellSite G F)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.siteTranslation
entries.docstring: **The translation representation** on `ℓ²` of the sites: `(U_a ψ)(x) = ψ(-a + x)`.
entries.snippet:
def siteTranslation (G F : Type*) [AddCommGroup G] [Countable G] [Countable F] :
    Multiplicative G →* unitary (SiteSpace G F →L[ℂ] SiteSpace G F)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.siteSymmetryPerm
entries.docstring: The bond-preserving symmetries act on the sites by permutations.
entries.snippet: def siteSymmetryPerm : g.symmetries →* Equiv.Perm (CellSite G F)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.siteSymmetry
entries.docstring: **The symmetry representation** on `ℓ²` of the sites: `(U_s ψ)(x) = ψ(s⁻¹ • x)`.
entries.snippet: def siteSymmetry : g.symmetries →* unitary (SiteSpace G F →L[ℂ] SiteSpace G F)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.latticeAut
entries.docstring: The action of a symmetry on the lattice of translations, through its linear part.
entries.snippet: def latticeAut : g.symmetries →* MulAut (Multiplicative G) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.siteSymmetryPerm_translation
entries.docstring:
A symmetry moves a translated site to the correspondingly translated image: the permutations
of the sites satisfy `s ∘ τ_a = τ_{A a} ∘ s`.
entries.snippet:
lemma siteSymmetryPerm_translation (s : g.symmetries) (a : Multiplicative G) :
    siteSymmetryPerm g s * siteTranslationPerm G F a =
      siteTranslationPerm G F (latticeAut g s a) * siteSymmetryPerm g s

entries.name: CondensedMatter.siteTranslation_covariant
entries.docstring:
**The translations and the bond-preserving symmetries form a covariant representation on
`ℓ²` of the sites.**
entries.snippet:
lemma siteTranslation_covariant :
    UnitaryRep.IsCovariantRep (latticeAut g) (siteTranslation G F) (siteSymmetry g)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.spectrum_sectorOp_eq_site
entries.docstring:
**Symmetry reduction on a crystal.** Let `T` be a bounded operator on `ℓ²` of the sites of a
crystal, commuting with the translations and with the bond-preserving symmetries. Its restriction
to the sector of total momenta in a set `S` of characters is unitarily equivalent to its restriction
to the sector of momenta in the image of `S` under any symmetry, by the symmetry itself. In
particular their spectra agree.
entries.snippet:
lemma spectrum_sectorOp_eq_site {T : SiteSpace G F →L[ℂ] SiteSpace G F}
    (hTπ : ∀ a, Commute ((siteTranslation G F a : unitary _) : SiteSpace G F →L[ℂ] SiteSpace G F) T)
    (hTρ : ∀ s, Commute ((siteSymmetry g s : unitary _) : SiteSpace G F →L[ℂ] SiteSpace G F) T)
    (s : g.symmetries) {S : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))} (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
    spectrum ℂ (UnitaryRep.sectorOp hTπ S) =
      spectrum ℂ (UnitaryRep.sectorOp hTπ (UnitaryRep.dualAct (latticeAut g) s '' S))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.norm_sq_calculus_projection_localized
entries.docstring:
The norm of a continuous function of the translations applied to the momentum-`W` component of
a localized state: the `L²` norm of the function over `W`, for the Haar measure.
entries.snippet:
lemma norm_sq_calculus_projection_localized (g : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), ℂ))
    {W : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))} (hW : MeasurableSet W)
    (e : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N)) :
    ‖UnitaryRep.calculus (translation G N) g
        (UnitaryRep.projection (translation G N) W (localized e))‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖e‖ ^ 2 * ∫ χ in W, ‖g χ‖ ^ 2 ∂(dualHaar (G := G))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.toEuclideanCLM_single_apply
entries.docstring: The matrix unit `E_{ij}` acts on a vector as the `j`-th coordinate carried to the `i`-th.
entries.snippet:
lemma toEuclideanCLM_single_apply (i j : Fin N) (e : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N)) :
    Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin N) (𝕜 := ℂ) (Matrix.single i j (1 : ℂ)) e =
      e j • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℂ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.internal_single_localized
entries.docstring:
The internal matrix unit `E_{ij}` acts on a localized state by moving the `j`-th component
to the `i`-th.
entries.snippet:
lemma internal_single_localized (i j : Fin N) (e : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N)) :
    internal (G := G) (Matrix.single i j (1 : ℂ)) (localized e) =
      e j • localized (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℂ))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.blochOperator
entries.docstring: The translation-invariant operator `∫ f dP` of a symbol `f` on `ℓ²(G, ℂ^N)`.
entries.snippet:
abbrev blochOperator (f : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)) :
    Space G N →L[ℂ] Space G N

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.commute_projection_internal
entries.docstring: The internal matrix units commute with the spectral projections.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_projection_internal (W : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G)))
    (M : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) :
    Commute (UnitaryRep.projection (translation G N) W) (internal (G := G) M)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.blochOperator_projection_localized
entries.docstring:
**Action of a symbol on a spectral component of a localized state**: the operator of a symbol
`f` applied to the momentum-`W` component of the state localized at the origin with internal state
`e` is the sum over the internal indices `i` of functions of the translations applied to the
momentum-`W` component of the state localized in the `i`-th internal state.
entries.snippet:
lemma blochOperator_projection_localized
    (f : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ))
    (W : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))) (e : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N)) :
    blochOperator f (UnitaryRep.projection (translation G N) W (localized e)) =
      ∑ i, UnitaryRep.calculus (translation G N) (∑ j, e j • UnitaryRep.entry f i j)
        (UnitaryRep.projection (translation G N) W
          (localized (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℂ))))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.entry_combination_apply
entries.docstring: The `i`-th component of a symbol applied to a vector is the combination of its entries.
entries.snippet:
lemma entry_combination_apply
    (f : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ))
    (e : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N)) (i : Fin N) (χ : PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G)) :
    (∑ j, e j • UnitaryRep.entry f i j) χ =
      (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin N) (𝕜 := ℂ) (f χ) e) i

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.sum_norm_entry_combination
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_norm_entry_combination
    (f : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ))
    (e : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N)) (χ : PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G)) :
    ∑ i, ‖(∑ j, e j • UnitaryRep.entry f i j) χ‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin N) (𝕜 := ℂ) (f χ) e‖ ^ 2

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.norm_blochOperator_projection_localized_le
entries.docstring:
**The symbol acts on spectral components of a localized state with the size of the symbol on
those momenta**: if the symbol moves the internal state `e` by at most `δ` at all crystal momenta
in `W`, then the operator of the symbol moves the momentum-`W` component of the localized state by
at most `√N δ` times its norm, up to the norm of `e`.
entries.snippet:
lemma norm_blochOperator_projection_localized_le
    (f : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ))
    {W : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))} (hW : MeasurableSet W)
    (e : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N)) {δ : ℝ}
    (hδ : ∀ χ ∈ W, ‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin N) (𝕜 := ℂ) (f χ) e‖ ≤ δ) :
    ‖blochOperator f (UnitaryRep.projection (translation G N) W (localized e))‖ ^ 2 ≤
      N * δ ^ 2 * (dualHaar (G := G)).real W

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.norm_sq_projection_localized
entries.docstring: The squared norm of the momentum-`W` component of a localized state.
entries.snippet:
lemma norm_sq_projection_localized {W : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))}
    (hW : MeasurableSet W) (e : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin N)) :
    ‖UnitaryRep.projection (translation G N) W (localized e)‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖e‖ ^ 2 * (dualHaar (G := G)).real W

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.spectrum_blochOperator
entries.docstring:
**The spectrum of a translation-invariant operator is the union of its Bloch bands.** For
every continuous symbol `b` on the Brillouin zone, the spectrum of the operator `∫ b dP` on
`ℓ²(G, ℂ^N)` is the union over crystal momenta `χ` of the spectra of the matrices `b(χ)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma spectrum_blochOperator
    (b : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)) :
    spectrum ℂ (blochOperator b) =
      ⋃ χ : PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), spectrum ℂ (b χ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Bloch.RegularRep.spectrum_blochOperator_eq_bands
entries.docstring:
**The band structure**: for a Hermitian symbol, the spectrum of the translation-invariant
operator on `ℓ²(G, ℂ^N)` is exactly the set of band values `ε_k(χ)`, the ordered eigenvalues of the
Bloch matrices.
entries.snippet:
lemma spectrum_blochOperator_eq_bands
    (b : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ))
    (hb : ∀ χ, (b χ).IsHermitian) :
    spectrum ℂ (blochOperator b) =
      {z | ∃ (χ : PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G)) (k : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin N))),
        z = ((bandOf (hb χ) k : ℝ) : ℂ)}

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.ball
entries.docstring: The sites within `n` bonds of a site.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.self_mem_ball
entries.snippet: lemma self_mem_ball (n : ℕ) (x : C.Site) : x ∈ g.ball n x

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.ball_mono
entries.snippet: lemma ball_mono {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) (x : C.Site) : g.ball m x ⊆ g.ball n x

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.mem_ball_add
entries.docstring: Following `m` bonds and then `n` bonds stays within `m + n` bonds.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_ball_add {m n : ℕ} {a b c : C.Site} (hb : b ∈ g.ball n a) (hc : c ∈ g.ball m b) :
    c ∈ g.ball (m + n) a

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.mem_neighbors_smul_iff
entries.docstring:
A group action preserving the bonds carries the neighbours of a site to the neighbours of
its image.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_neighbors_smul_iff (hH : ∀ (h : H) (x y : C.Site),
    g.toSimpleGraph.Adj (h • x) (h • y) ↔ g.toSimpleGraph.Adj x y) (h : H) (x y : C.Site) :
    h • y ∈ g.neighbors (h • x) ↔ y ∈ g.neighbors x

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.mem_ball_smul_iff
entries.docstring: A group action preserving the bonds carries balls to balls.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_ball_smul_iff (hH : ∀ (h : H) (x y : C.Site),
    g.toSimpleGraph.Adj (h • x) (h • y) ↔ g.toSimpleGraph.Adj x y) (h : H) (n : ℕ)
    (x y : C.Site) : h • y ∈ g.ball n (h • x) ↔ y ∈ g.ball n x

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal
entries.docstring:
A perfectly repeating arrangement of sites under the translation group `G`.
Every site belongs to one of finitely many families of translated copies.
entries.snippet:
structure Crystal (G : Type u) [AddGroup G] where
  Site : Type v
  [translations : AddAction G Site]
  [free : IsCancelVAdd G Site]
  [finiteSiteOrbits : Finite (AddAction.orbitRel.Quotient G Site)]

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.«instance@dd96c4e5»
entries.docstring: Translate a site by changing its cell index and preserving its label.
entries.snippet: instance {G F : Type*} [AddGroup G] : AddAction G (CellSite G F) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.«instance@2341d563»
entries.docstring: Different cell translations give different copies of a site.
entries.snippet: instance {G F : Type*} [AddGroup G] : IsCancelVAdd G (CellSite G F) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.ofUnitCell
entries.docstring:
Construct a crystal by repeating a unit cell containing one site for each label in `F`.
The group `G` indexes translated cells. A site of the resulting crystal has address
`⟨n, i⟩`, where `n : G` specifies its cell and `i : F` identifies the site within that cell.
entries.snippet:
@[reducible]
def ofUnitCell (G : Type u) (F : Type v) [AddGroup G] [Finite F] : Crystal G where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.«instance@cb0860ea»
entries.docstring: A finite translation group gives a finite crystal.
entries.snippet: instance {G : Type*} [AddGroup G] [Finite G] (C : Crystal G) : Finite C.Site

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.BrillouinZone
entries.docstring:
The Brillouin zone of a crystal with translation group `G`: the crystal momenta, which are the
characters of `G`.
entries.snippet: abbrev BrillouinZone (G : Type*) [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G]

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.dualMap
entries.docstring: A lattice automorphism acts on a character by precomposition.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def dualMap (A : G ≃+ G) (χ : BrillouinZone G) : BrillouinZone G where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.dualMap_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma dualMap_apply (A : G ≃+ G) (χ : BrillouinZone G) (a : G) :
    dualMap A χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd a) = χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd (A a))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.dualMap_refl
entries.snippet: lemma dualMap_refl (χ : BrillouinZone G) : dualMap (AddEquiv.refl G) χ = χ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.dualMap_trans
entries.snippet:
lemma dualMap_trans (A B : G ≃+ G) (χ : BrillouinZone G) :
    dualMap B (dualMap A χ) = dualMap (B.trans A) χ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.«instance@bd92f17e»
entries.docstring:
The symmetries of a crystal act on the crystal momenta: a symmetry with linear part `A` sends
`χ` to `χ ∘ A⁻¹`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance : MulAction (CellSymmetry G F) (BrillouinZone G) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.smul_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma smul_apply (s : CellSymmetry G F) (χ : BrillouinZone G) (a : G) :
    (s • χ) (Multiplicative.ofAdd a) = χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd (s.linear.symm a))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.translation_smul_brillouin
entries.docstring: Translations act trivially on crystal momenta.
entries.snippet:
lemma translation_smul_brillouin (a : G) (χ : BrillouinZone G) :
    (CellSymmetry.translation a : CellSymmetry G F) • χ = χ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.symmetryAction
entries.docstring: The bond-preserving symmetries act on the Brillouin zone by permutations.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def symmetryAction : g.symmetries →* Equiv.Perm (BrillouinZone G)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.translations_le_ker_symmetryAction
entries.snippet:
lemma translations_le_ker_symmetryAction :
    (CellSymmetry.translations G F).subgroupOf g.symmetries ≤ (symmetryAction g).ker

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.pointAction
entries.docstring: **The point group acts on the Brillouin zone.**
entries.snippet: noncomputable def pointAction : g.pointGroup →* Equiv.Perm (BrillouinZone G)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.«instance@2c2effbd»
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance : MulAction g.pointGroup (BrillouinZone G)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.mk_smul
entries.snippet:
lemma mk_smul (s : g.symmetries) (χ : BrillouinZone G) :
    (QuotientGroup.mk s : g.pointGroup) • χ = s • χ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.littleGroup
entries.docstring:
The little group of a momentum: the bond-preserving symmetries that fix it. It contains all
translations.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def littleGroup (χ : BrillouinZone G) : Subgroup g.symmetries

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.littleCoGroup
entries.docstring: The little co-group of a momentum: the elements of the point group that fix it.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def littleCoGroup (χ : BrillouinZone G) : Subgroup g.pointGroup

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.mem_littleGroup
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_littleGroup (χ : BrillouinZone G) (s : g.symmetries) :
    s ∈ g.littleGroup χ ↔ s • χ = χ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.translation_mem_littleGroup
entries.snippet:
lemma translation_mem_littleGroup (χ : BrillouinZone G) (a : G) :
    (⟨CellSymmetry.translation a, g.translation_mem_symmetries a⟩ : g.symmetries) ∈
      g.littleGroup χ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.littleGroup_eq_comap
entries.docstring: The little group is the preimage of the little co-group.
entries.snippet:
lemma littleGroup_eq_comap (χ : BrillouinZone G) :
    g.littleGroup χ = (g.littleCoGroup χ).comap (QuotientGroup.mk' _)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.IrreducibleZone
entries.docstring: The irreducible Brillouin zone: the momenta modulo the point group.
entries.snippet: abbrev IrreducibleZone

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.irreducibleZone_mk_eq_iff
entries.docstring: Momenta in the same orbit of the point group are identified in the irreducible zone.
entries.snippet:
lemma irreducibleZone_mk_eq_iff (χ ψ : BrillouinZone G) :
    (Quotient.mk (MulAction.orbitRel g.pointGroup (BrillouinZone G)) χ : g.IrreducibleZone) =
      Quotient.mk _ ψ ↔ ∃ p : g.pointGroup, p • ψ = χ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.brillouinPoint
entries.docstring:
The momentum with coordinates `k` along the reciprocal basis: the character
`r ↦ exp (2πi k · r)` of `ℤ^d`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def brillouinPoint (k : Fin d → ℝ) : BrillouinZone (Fin d → ℤ) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.brillouinPoint_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma brillouinPoint_apply (k : Fin d → ℝ) (r : Fin d → ℤ) :
    brillouinPoint k (Multiplicative.ofAdd r) =
      Circle.exp (2 * Real.pi * ∑ j, k j * (r j : ℝ))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.brillouinPoint_single
entries.snippet:
lemma brillouinPoint_single (k : Fin d → ℝ) (j : Fin d) :
    brillouinPoint k (Multiplicative.ofAdd (Pi.single j 1)) = Circle.exp (2 * Real.pi * k j)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.brillouinPoint_eq_iff
entries.docstring: **Two sets of coordinates give the same momentum exactly when they differ by integers.**
entries.snippet:
lemma brillouinPoint_eq_iff (k k' : Fin d → ℝ) :
    brillouinPoint k = brillouinPoint k' ↔ ∀ j, ∃ z : ℤ, k j - k' j = z

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.brillouinZone_ext
entries.docstring: A character of `ℤ^d` is determined by its values on the basis vectors.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.brillouinPoint_surjective
entries.docstring: **Every momentum has coordinates.**
entries.snippet: lemma brillouinPoint_surjective : Function.Surjective (brillouinPoint (d := d))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.apply_eq_sum_single
entries.docstring: A lattice automorphism is determined by its values on the basis vectors.
entries.snippet:
lemma apply_eq_sum_single (A : (Fin d → ℤ) ≃+ (Fin d → ℤ)) (r : Fin d → ℤ) (i : Fin d) :
    A r i = ∑ j, r j * A (Pi.single j 1) i

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.smul_brillouinPoint
entries.docstring:
**A symmetry acts on the coordinates of a momentum** by the transpose of the inverse of the
matrix of its linear part.
entries.snippet:
lemma smul_brillouinPoint {F : Type*} (s : CellSymmetry (Fin d → ℤ) F) (k : Fin d → ℝ) :
    s • brillouinPoint k =
      brillouinPoint (fun j => ∑ i, k i * (s.linear.symm (Pi.single j 1) i : ℝ))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.torsionPoint
entries.docstring: The momentum with coordinates `m / n`: a point of finite order of the Brillouin zone.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def torsionPoint (n : ℕ) (m : Fin d → ℤ) : BrillouinZone (Fin d → ℤ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.torsionPoint_eq_iff
entries.docstring: **Momenta of finite order are equal exactly when the numerators agree modulo `n`.**
entries.snippet:
lemma torsionPoint_eq_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (m m' : Fin d → ℤ) :
    torsionPoint n m = torsionPoint n m' ↔ ∀ j, (n : ℤ) ∣ m j - m' j

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.smul_torsionPoint
entries.docstring: A symmetry acts on a momentum of finite order by an integer matrix on the numerators.
entries.snippet:
lemma smul_torsionPoint {F : Type*} (n : ℕ) (s : CellSymmetry (Fin d → ℤ) F) (m : Fin d → ℤ) :
    s • torsionPoint n m =
      torsionPoint n (fun j => ∑ i, m i * s.linear.symm (Pi.single j 1) i)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.mem_littleGroup_torsionPoint_iff
entries.docstring:
**The little group of a momentum of finite order**, as integer arithmetic: a bond-preserving
symmetry fixes the momentum with numerators `m` modulo `n` exactly when the integer vector
obtained from the matrix of its linear part is congruent to `m` modulo `n`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_littleGroup_torsionPoint_iff {F : Type*} [Finite F]
    (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell (Fin d → ℤ) F)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (m : Fin d → ℤ) (s : g.symmetries) :
    s ∈ g.littleGroup (torsionPoint n m) ↔
      ∀ j, (n : ℤ) ∣ (∑ i, m i * (s : CellSymmetry (Fin d → ℤ) F).linear.symm (Pi.single j 1) i) -
        m j
