entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.box
entries.docstring: The cube `{0, …, m-1}^d` of the lattice `ℤ^d`.
entries.snippet: def box (d m : ℕ) : Finset (Fin d → ℤ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.card_box
entries.snippet: lemma card_box (d m : ℕ) : (box d m).card = m ^ d

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.image_add_box
entries.snippet:
lemma image_add_box (d m : ℕ) (h : Fin d → ℤ) :
    (box d m).image (· + h) = Fintype.piFinset fun j => Finset.Ico (h j) (m + h j)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.card_image_add_box
entries.snippet: lemma card_image_add_box (d m : ℕ) (h : Fin d → ℤ) : ((box d m).image (· + h)).card = m ^ d

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.card_inter_box
entries.docstring: The overlap of the cube with its translate.
entries.snippet:
lemma card_inter_box (d m : ℕ) (h : Fin d → ℤ) :
    ((box d m).image (· + h) ∩ box d m).card =
      ∏ j, (Finset.Ico (h j) (m + h j) ∩ Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) m).card

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.card_Ico_inter
entries.snippet:
lemma card_Ico_inter (m : ℕ) (a : ℤ) (ha : |a| ≤ m) :
    (Finset.Ico a (m + a) ∩ Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) m).card = m - a.natAbs

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.card_sdiff_add_card_sdiff
entries.docstring: The number of points of the cube not shared with its translate.
entries.snippet:
lemma card_sdiff_add_card_sdiff (d m : ℕ) (h : Fin d → ℤ) :
    (((box d m).image (· + h) \ box d m).card + (box d m \ (box d m).image (· + h)).card : ℝ) =
      2 * ((m : ℝ) ^ d - ∏ j, ((Finset.Ico (h j) (m + h j) ∩ Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) m).card : ℝ))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.tendsto_box_sdiff
entries.docstring:
**The cubes are asymptotically invariant under translation**: the fraction of the points of
`{0, …, n}^d` that are not shared with a fixed translate tends to zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma tendsto_box_sdiff (d : ℕ) (h : Fin d → ℤ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (((box d (n + 1)).image (· + h) \ box d (n + 1)).card +
      (box d (n + 1) \ (box d (n + 1)).image (· + h)).card : ℝ) / ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ d)
      atTop (𝓝 0)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.boxes
entries.docstring: The cubes `{0, …, n}^d`, as finite sets of the translation group.
entries.snippet: def boxes (d n : ℕ) : Finset (Multiplicative (Fin d → ℤ))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.image_mul_boxes
entries.snippet:
lemma image_mul_boxes (d n : ℕ) (h : Multiplicative (Fin d → ℤ)) :
    (boxes d n).image (· * h) =
      ((box d (n + 1)).image (· + Multiplicative.toAdd h)).map
        Multiplicative.ofAdd.toEmbedding

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.isRightFolner_boxes
entries.docstring:
**The cubes are a Følner family** for the translations of `ℤ^d`, along any ultrafilter on
`ℕ` finer than the filter of large cubes.
entries.snippet:
lemma isRightFolner_boxes (d : ℕ) (𝒰 : Ultrafilter ℕ) (h𝒰 : (𝒰 : Filter ℕ) ≤ atTop) :
    IsRightFolner (boxes d) 𝒰

lemma distance_of_links {G F A : Type*} [AddGroup G] [Finite F] [MetricSpace A]
    (R : Geometry (Crystal.ofUnitCell G F) A) (b : Bond G F)

entries.docstring: The sites reached from `x` by following any of the listed bonds in either direction.
entries.snippet:
def bondEndpoints {G F : Type*} [AddGroup G] [DecidableEq G] [DecidableEq F]
    (bonds : List (Bond G F)) (x : CellSite G F) : Finset (CellSite G F)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.mem_bondEndpoints
entries.docstring: Every reached site is an endpoint of one of the listed bonds.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_bondEndpoints {G F : Type*} [AddGroup G] [DecidableEq G] [DecidableEq F]
    (bonds : List (Bond G F)) (x y : CellSite G F) :
    y ∈ bondEndpoints bonds x ↔ ∃ b ∈ bonds, b.Links x y ∨ b.Links y x

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.neighborsFromBonds
entries.docstring: The distinct neighboring sites connected by the listed bonds, excluding `x` itself.
entries.snippet:
def neighborsFromBonds {G F : Type*} [AddGroup G] [DecidableEq G] [DecidableEq F]
    (bonds : List (Bond G F)) (x : CellSite G F) : Finset (CellSite G F)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.ofBonds
entries.docstring:
Construct the periodic graph of a repeated unit cell from its bonds.
Each bond connects its source label to its target label at the specified cell displacement,
in every cell. Connections are undirected; repeated connections and self-loops do not add
neighbors.
entries.snippet:
def PeriodicGraph.ofBonds {G F : Type*} [AddGroup G] [Finite F]
    [DecidableEq G] [DecidableEq F] (bonds : List (Bond G F)) :
    PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G F) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.neighbors_ofBonds
entries.docstring:
The neighbors in the graph of a bond list are the endpoints of its bonds, without the site
itself.
entries.snippet:
lemma PeriodicGraph.neighbors_ofBonds {G F : Type*} [AddGroup G] [Finite F]
    [DecidableEq G] [DecidableEq F] (bonds : List (Bond G F)) (x : CellSite G F) :
    (PeriodicGraph.ofBonds bonds).neighbors x = neighborsFromBonds bonds x

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.card_neighbors_cell
entries.docstring: The coordination number of a cell site equals that of its reference-cell copy.
entries.snippet:
lemma PeriodicGraph.card_neighbors_cell {G F : Type*} [AddGroup G] [Finite F]
    (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G F)) (n : G) (i : F) :
    (g.neighbors ⟨n, i⟩).card = (g.neighbors ⟨0, i⟩).card

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.cubeUltrafilter
entries.docstring: An ultrafilter on the sizes of the cubes, finer than the filter of large cubes.
entries.snippet: def cubeUltrafilter : Ultrafilter ℕ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.cubeUltrafilter_le
entries.snippet: lemma cubeUltrafilter_le : (cubeUltrafilter : Filter ℕ) ≤ atTop

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.translationInvariantLimit
entries.docstring:
**The translation invariant limit of a state of the crystal `ℤ^d`**: the limit of its
averages over the translations by the points of the cubes.
entries.snippet:
def translationInvariantLimit (φ : AlgState (crystalAlgebra Ω₀ (Fin d → ℤ) F)) :
    AlgState (crystalAlgebra Ω₀ (Fin d → ℤ) F)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.translationInvariantLimit_invariant
entries.docstring: **The translation invariant limit of a state is invariant under the translations.**
entries.snippet:
lemma translationInvariantLimit_invariant (φ : AlgState (crystalAlgebra Ω₀ (Fin d → ℤ) F))
    (a : Fin d → ℤ) (x : crystalAlgebra Ω₀ (Fin d → ℤ) F) :
    translationInvariantLimit Ω₀ φ (translationAction Ω₀ (Multiplicative.ofAdd a) x) =
      translationInvariantLimit Ω₀ φ x

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Interaction.translationInvariantState
entries.docstring:
**The translation invariant state of the canonical ensemble** of an interaction on the crystal
`ℤ^d`: the translation average of a thermodynamic limit state of the finite boxes.
entries.snippet:
def _root_.CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Interaction.translationInvariantState [Nonempty Ω₀]
    (I : Interaction (fun _ : CellSite (Fin d → ℤ) F => Ω₀)) (β : ℝ) :
    AlgState (crystalAlgebra Ω₀ (Fin d → ℤ) F)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.translationInvariantState_invariant
entries.docstring: The translation invariant state of an interaction is invariant under the translations.
entries.snippet:
lemma translationInvariantState_invariant [Nonempty Ω₀]
    (I : Interaction (fun _ : CellSite (Fin d → ℤ) F => Ω₀)) (β : ℝ) (a : Fin d → ℤ)
    (x : crystalAlgebra Ω₀ (Fin d → ℤ) F) :
    I.translationInvariantState β (translationAction Ω₀ (Multiplicative.ofAdd a) x) =
      I.translationInvariantState β x

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.robertson_det_translationInvariantState
entries.docstring:
**Robertson's relation for several observables in the translation invariant state** of an
interaction on the crystal `ℤ^d`.
entries.snippet:
lemma robertson_det_translationInvariantState {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (a : ι → selfAdjoint (crystalAlgebra Ω₀ (Fin d → ℤ) F)) :
    |((I.translationInvariantState β).bracketMatrix a).det| ≤
      ((I.translationInvariantState β).covarianceMatrix a).det

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.covariance_translationInvariantState_eq_zero
entries.docstring:
In the translation invariant state, an observable fixed and one reversed by a translation
are uncorrelated.
entries.snippet:
lemma covariance_translationInvariantState_eq_zero :
    (I.translationInvariantState β).covariance A B = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.bracket_translationInvariantState_eq_zero
entries.docstring:
In the translation invariant state, an observable fixed and one reversed by a translation
have a bracket of expectation zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracket_translationInvariantState_eq_zero :
    (I.translationInvariantState β).bracket A B = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.manyBodyRep
entries.docstring: **The unitary representation of the symmetries on the GNS space** of an invariant state.
entries.snippet: def manyBodyRep : H →* unitary (ω.GNS →L[ℂ] ω.GNS)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.translationIn
entries.docstring: The translations as elements of the symmetry subgroup.
entries.snippet: def translationIn : Multiplicative G →* H

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.manyBodyTranslation
entries.docstring: The translation representation on the GNS space.
entries.snippet: def manyBodyTranslation : Multiplicative G →* unitary (ω.GNS →L[ℂ] ω.GNS)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.manyBodyTranslation_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma manyBodyTranslation_apply (a : Multiplicative G) :
    manyBodyTranslation H ω hω htrans a = manyBodyRep H ω hω (translationIn H htrans a)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.linearAut
entries.docstring: The action of a symmetry on the lattice of translations, through its linear part.
entries.snippet: def linearAut : H →* MulAut (Multiplicative G) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.manyBodyRep_covariant
entries.docstring: **The translations and the symmetries are covariant on the GNS space.**
entries.snippet:
lemma manyBodyRep_covariant :
    UnitaryRep.IsCovariantRep (linearAut H) (manyBodyTranslation H ω hω htrans)
      (manyBodyRep H ω hω)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.commute_manyBodyRep
entries.docstring:
A dynamics commuting with a symmetry is implemented by an operator commuting with the
unitary implementing the symmetry.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_manyBodyRep (s : H) :
    Commute ((manyBodyRep H ω hω s : unitary (ω.GNS →L[ℂ] ω.GNS)) : ω.GNS →L[ℂ] ω.GNS)
      (AlgState.gnsAut τ hτ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.commute_manyBodyTranslation
entries.docstring: A dynamics commuting with the symmetries commutes with the translation representation.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_manyBodyTranslation (a : Multiplicative G) :
    Commute ((manyBodyTranslation H ω hω htrans a : unitary (ω.GNS →L[ℂ] ω.GNS)) :
      ω.GNS →L[ℂ] ω.GNS) (AlgState.gnsAut τ hτ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.spectrum_sectorOp_eq_manyBody
entries.docstring:
**Symmetry reduction of a many-body dynamics on an infinite crystal.** Let `ω` be a state of the
quasi-local algebra invariant under a group `H` of cell symmetries containing the translations,
and `τ` an automorphism preserving `ω` and commuting with `H`: a time evolution. Then the unitary
implementing `τ` is reduced by the sectors of total momentum, and its restriction to the sector of
the momenta in a set `S` has the same spectrum as its restriction to the sector of the momenta in
the image of `S` under any symmetry `s` in `H`.
entries.snippet:
lemma spectrum_sectorOp_eq_manyBody (s : H)
    {S : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))} (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
    spectrum ℂ (UnitaryRep.sectorOp
        (commute_manyBodyTranslation H ω hω htrans τ hτ hcomm) S) =
      spectrum ℂ (UnitaryRep.sectorOp
        (commute_manyBodyTranslation H ω hω htrans τ hτ hcomm)
        (UnitaryRep.dualAct (linearAut H) s '' S))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.pointStabilizer
entries.docstring: The lattice automorphisms that map bonded displacements to bonded displacements.
entries.snippet:
def pointStabilizer (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G Unit)) :
    Subgroup (Multiplicative (AddAut G)) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.linearHom
entries.docstring: The linear part of a cell symmetry as a homomorphism to the lattice automorphisms.
entries.snippet: def linearHom (G F : Type*) [AddCommGroup G] : CellSymmetry G F →* Multiplicative (AddAut G) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.linear_mem_pointStabilizer
entries.docstring: Bond-preserving symmetries have linear parts in the point stabilizer.
entries.snippet:
lemma linear_mem_pointStabilizer (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G Unit))
    {s : CellSymmetry G Unit} (hs : s ∈ g.symmetries) :
    Multiplicative.ofAdd s.linear ∈ g.pointStabilizer

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.pointHom
entries.docstring:
The homomorphism from bond-preserving symmetries to the point stabilizer taking a symmetry to
its action on the lattice.
entries.snippet:
def pointHom (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G Unit)) :
    g.symmetries →* g.pointStabilizer

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.pointHom_surjective
entries.snippet:
lemma pointHom_surjective (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G Unit)) :
    Function.Surjective (pointHom g)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.ker_pointHom
entries.snippet:
lemma ker_pointHom (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G Unit)) :
    (pointHom g).ker = (CellSymmetry.translations G Unit).subgroupOf g.symmetries

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.pointGroupEquiv
entries.docstring:
**The point group of a crystal with one site per cell is the group of lattice automorphisms
preserving the bonded displacements.**
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def pointGroupEquiv (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G Unit)) :
    g.pointGroup ≃* g.pointStabilizer

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.pointLinearHom
entries.docstring:
**The point group of any crystal acts on its translation lattice** through the linear parts of
its symmetries.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def pointLinearHom {F : Type*} [Finite F]
    (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G F)) : g.pointGroup →* Multiplicative (AddAut G)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.act
entries.docstring: The linear map of `ℤⁿ` taking the basis vectors to the given vectors.
entries.snippet: def act (v : Fin n → Fin n → ℤ) : (Fin n → ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] (Fin n → ℤ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.act_apply
entries.snippet: lemma act_apply (v : Fin n → Fin n → ℤ) (d : Fin n → ℤ) : act v d = ∑ j, d j • v j

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.act_single
entries.snippet: lemma act_single (v : Fin n → Fin n → ℤ) (j : Fin n) : act v (Pi.single j 1) = v j

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.apply_eq_act
entries.docstring: A lattice automorphism is determined by the images of the basis vectors.
entries.snippet:
lemma apply_eq_act (A : AddAut (Fin n → ℤ)) (d : Fin n → ℤ) :
    A d = act (fun j => A (Pi.single j 1)) d

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.Admissible
entries.docstring:
A tuple of neighbour displacements is admissible when its linear map takes the set of
neighbour displacements into itself, injectively.
entries.snippet:
structure Admissible (N : Finset (Fin n → ℤ)) (v : Fin n → Fin n → ℤ) : Prop where
  mem : ∀ j, v j ∈ N
  mapsTo : ∀ d ∈ N, act v d ∈ N
  injOn : Set.InjOn (act v) N

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.Admissible.image_eq
entries.docstring: An admissible tuple maps the set of neighbour displacements onto itself.
entries.snippet:
lemma Admissible.image_eq {v : Fin n → Fin n → ℤ} (hv : Admissible N v) :
    N.image (act v) = N

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.Admissible.surjective
entries.docstring: An admissible tuple gives a surjective linear map.
entries.snippet:
lemma Admissible.surjective {v : Fin n → Fin n → ℤ} (hv : Admissible N v) :
    Function.Surjective (act v)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.Admissible.injective
entries.docstring: An admissible tuple gives an injective linear map.
entries.snippet:
lemma Admissible.injective {v : Fin n → Fin n → ℤ} (hv : Admissible N v) :
    Function.Injective (act v)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.Admissible.act_mem_iff
entries.docstring: A displacement is a neighbour exactly when its image under an admissible tuple is.
entries.snippet:
lemma Admissible.act_mem_iff {v : Fin n → Fin n → ℤ} (hv : Admissible N v) (d : Fin n → ℤ) :
    act v d ∈ N ↔ d ∈ N

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.Admissible.equiv
entries.docstring: The lattice automorphism of an admissible tuple.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def Admissible.equiv {v : Fin n → Fin n → ℤ} (hv : Admissible N v) :
    AddAut (Fin n → ℤ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.Admissible.equiv_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma Admissible.equiv_apply {v : Fin n → Fin n → ℤ} (hv : Admissible N v) (d : Fin n → ℤ) :
    hv.equiv hN d = act v d

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.pointStabilizerEquiv
entries.docstring:
**The point group of a Bravais lattice is in bijection with the admissible tuples of
neighbour displacements.**
entries.snippet: noncomputable def pointStabilizerEquiv : g.pointStabilizer ≃ {v // Admissible N v} where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.card_pointGroup
entries.docstring:
**The order of the point group** is the number of admissible tuples of neighbour
displacements.
entries.snippet: lemma card_pointGroup : Nat.card g.pointGroup = Nat.card {v // Admissible N v}

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.bondNeighbors
entries.docstring:
The neighbour displacements of a bond list on a one-site cell: the bond displacements and
their negatives, without zero.
entries.snippet: def bondNeighbors (bonds : List (Bond (Fin n → ℤ) Unit)) : Finset (Fin n → ℤ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.mem_bondNeighbors
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_bondNeighbors (bonds : List (Bond (Fin n → ℤ) Unit)) (d : Fin n → ℤ) :
    d ∈ bondNeighbors bonds ↔ d ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ b ∈ bonds, d = b.displacement ∨ d = -b.displacement

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.bonded_ofBonds_unit
entries.docstring: The bonded displacements of a graph generated by bonds on a one-site cell.
entries.snippet:
lemma bonded_ofBonds_unit (bonds : List (Bond (Fin n → ℤ) Unit)) (d : Fin n → ℤ) :
    (PeriodicGraph.ofBonds bonds).Bonded () () d ↔ d ∈ bondNeighbors bonds

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.admissibleEquiv
entries.docstring: The admissible triples can be counted among triples of neighbour displacements.
entries.snippet:
def admissibleEquiv (N : Finset (Fin n → ℤ)) :
    {v // Admissible N v} ≃ {w : Fin n → ↥N // Admissible N (fun j => (w j : Fin n → ℤ))} where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.«instance@08536617»
entries.snippet: instance (N : Finset (Fin n → ℤ)) (v : Fin n → Fin n → ℤ) : Decidable (Admissible N v)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.fcc_card_pointGroup
entries.docstring: **The point group of the face-centred cubic lattice has order `48`.**
entries.snippet: lemma fcc_card_pointGroup : Nat.card fccGraph.pointGroup = 48

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.bcc_card_pointGroup
entries.docstring: **The point group of the body-centred cubic lattice has order `48`.**
entries.snippet: lemma bcc_card_pointGroup : Nat.card bccGraph.pointGroup = 48

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.l1
entries.docstring: The sum of the absolute values of the coordinates.
entries.snippet: def l1 (r : Fin d → ℤ) : ℤ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.l1_neg
entries.snippet: lemma l1_neg (r : Fin d → ℤ) : l1 (-r) = l1 r

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.l1_single
entries.snippet: lemma l1_single (j : Fin d) : l1 (Pi.single j (1 : ℤ) : Fin d → ℤ) = 1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.hypercubic_bonded_iff_exists
entries.docstring: The bonded displacements of the hypercubic lattice are the vectors `±e_j`.
entries.snippet:
lemma hypercubic_bonded_iff_exists (r : Fin d → ℤ) :
    (hypercubicGraph d).Bonded () () r ↔ ∃ j, r = Pi.single j 1 ∨ r = -Pi.single j 1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.hypercubic_bonded_iff
entries.docstring:
**Two sites of the hypercubic lattice are bonded exactly when their cells differ by a vector
whose coordinates have absolute values summing to one.**
entries.snippet:
lemma hypercubic_bonded_iff (r : Fin d → ℤ) :
    (hypercubicGraph d).Bonded () () r ↔ l1 r = 1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.signOf
entries.docstring: The sign `+1` for `true` and `-1` for `false`.
entries.snippet: def signOf (b : Bool) : ℤ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.signOf_mul_self
entries.snippet: lemma signOf_mul_self (b : Bool) : signOf b * signOf b = 1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.abs_signOf
entries.snippet: lemma abs_signOf (b : Bool) : |signOf b| = 1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.signOf_ne_zero
entries.snippet: lemma signOf_ne_zero (b : Bool) : signOf b ≠ 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.signOf_injective
entries.snippet: lemma signOf_injective : Function.Injective signOf

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.signedPerm
entries.docstring:
The lattice automorphism that permutes the axes by `π` and multiplies the `i`-th coordinate
by the sign `ε i`.
entries.snippet: def signedPerm (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) (ε : Fin d → Bool) : (Fin d → ℤ) ≃+ (Fin d → ℤ) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.signedPerm_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma signedPerm_apply (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) (ε : Fin d → Bool) (r : Fin d → ℤ) (i : Fin d) :
    signedPerm π ε r i = signOf (ε i) * r (π.symm i)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.l1_signedPerm
entries.docstring: A signed permutation preserves the sum of the absolute values of the coordinates.
entries.snippet:
lemma l1_signedPerm (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) (ε : Fin d → Bool) (r : Fin d → ℤ) :
    l1 (signedPerm π ε r) = l1 r

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.signedPerm_single
entries.snippet:
lemma signedPerm_single (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) (ε : Fin d → Bool) (j : Fin d) :
    signedPerm π ε (Pi.single j 1) = Pi.single (π j) (signOf (ε (π j)))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.signedPerm_injective
entries.snippet:
lemma signedPerm_injective :
    Function.Injective fun p : Equiv.Perm (Fin d) × (Fin d → Bool) => signedPerm p.1 p.2

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.signedPerm_mem_pointStabilizer
entries.docstring: **A signed permutation preserves the bonds of the hypercubic lattice.**
entries.snippet:
lemma signedPerm_mem_pointStabilizer (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) (ε : Fin d → Bool) :
    Multiplicative.ofAdd (signedPerm π ε) ∈ (hypercubicGraph d).pointStabilizer

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.mem_pointStabilizer_hypercubic_iff
entries.docstring:
**The lattice automorphisms preserving the bonds of the hypercubic lattice are exactly the
signed permutations.**
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_pointStabilizer_hypercubic_iff (A : Multiplicative (AddAut (Fin d → ℤ))) :
    A ∈ (hypercubicGraph d).pointStabilizer ↔
      ∃ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) (ε : Fin d → Bool), Multiplicative.toAdd A = signedPerm π ε

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.pointStabilizerEquivSignedPerm
entries.docstring:
**The point group of the hypercubic lattice is the group of signed permutations of the
axes**: it is in bijection with the pairs of a permutation and a choice of signs.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def pointStabilizerEquivSignedPerm :
    (Equiv.Perm (Fin d) × (Fin d → Bool)) ≃ (hypercubicGraph d).pointStabilizer

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.card_pointGroup_hypercubic
entries.docstring: **The point group of the hypercubic lattice in `d` dimensions has order `2 ^ d * d !`.**
entries.snippet:
lemma card_pointGroup_hypercubic (d : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (hypercubicGraph d).pointGroup = 2 ^ d * d.factorial

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.monoclinicPointTriples
entries.docstring:
The four point operations of the primitive monoclinic lattice: the identity, the reflection
`b ↦ -b`, the rotation by `π` about `b` and the inversion.
entries.snippet: def monoclinicPointTriples : Finset (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℤ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.monoclinic_admissible_iff
entries.docstring:
The point operations of the primitive monoclinic lattice are the four of
`monoclinicPointTriples`.
entries.snippet:
lemma monoclinic_admissible_iff (v : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℤ) :
    Admissible (bondNeighbors monoclinicBonds) v ↔ v ∈ monoclinicPointTriples

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.baseCentredMonoclinicPointTriples
entries.docstring:
The four point operations of the base-centred monoclinic lattice, in the basis
`baseCentredMonoclinicVectors`.
entries.snippet: def baseCentredMonoclinicPointTriples : Finset (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℤ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.baseCentredMonoclinic_admissible_iff
entries.docstring:
The point operations of the base-centred monoclinic lattice are the four of
`baseCentredMonoclinicPointTriples`.
entries.snippet:
lemma baseCentredMonoclinic_admissible_iff (v : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℤ) :
    Admissible (bondNeighbors baseCentredMonoclinicBonds) v ↔
      v ∈ baseCentredMonoclinicPointTriples

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.triclinicPointTriples
entries.docstring: The two point operations of the triclinic lattice: the identity and the inversion.
entries.snippet: def triclinicPointTriples : Finset (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℤ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.triclinic_admissible_iff
entries.docstring: The point operations of the triclinic lattice are the identity and the inversion.
entries.snippet:
lemma triclinic_admissible_iff (v : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℤ) :
    Admissible (bondNeighbors triclinicBonds) v ↔ v ∈ triclinicPointTriples

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.monoclinic_card_pointGroup
entries.docstring: **The point group of the primitive monoclinic lattice has order `4`.**
entries.snippet: lemma monoclinic_card_pointGroup : Nat.card monoclinicGraph.pointGroup = 4

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.baseCentredMonoclinic_card_pointGroup
entries.docstring: **The point group of the base-centred monoclinic lattice has order `4`.**
entries.snippet:
lemma baseCentredMonoclinic_card_pointGroup :
    Nat.card baseCentredMonoclinicGraph.pointGroup = 4

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.triclinic_card_pointGroup
entries.docstring: **The point group of the triclinic lattice has order `2`.**
entries.snippet: lemma triclinic_card_pointGroup : Nat.card triclinicGraph.pointGroup = 2

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.PassesTests
entries.docstring:
The triple `(a, b, c)` passes the tests `D₀`, `D₁`, `D₂` on its first, first two and three
vectors: each test `d` and its image under the triple are neighbours together.
entries.snippet:
def PassesTests (N : Finset (Fin 3 → ℤ)) (D₀ : List ℤ) (D₁ : List (ℤ × ℤ))
    (D₂ : List (Fin 3 → ℤ)) (a b c : Fin 3 → ℤ) : Prop

entries.snippet:
instance (N : Finset (Fin 3 → ℤ)) (D₀ : List ℤ) (D₁ : List (ℤ × ℤ)) (D₂ : List (Fin 3 → ℤ))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.admissible_iff_of_tests
entries.docstring:
The admissible triples are the triples of `S`, if every triple of `S` is admissible and only
the triples of `S` pass the tests.
entries.snippet:
lemma admissible_iff_of_tests (hN : ∀ j, (Pi.single j 1 : Fin 3 → ℤ) ∈ N)
    {S : Finset (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℤ)} (D₀ : List ℤ) (D₁ : List (ℤ × ℤ))
    (D₂ : List (Fin 3 → ℤ)) (hS : ∀ v ∈ S, Admissible N v)
    (hD : ∀ a ∈ N, ∀ b ∈ N, ∀ c ∈ N, PassesTests N D₀ D₁ D₂ a b c → ![a, b, c] ∈ S)
    (v : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℤ) : Admissible N v ↔ v ∈ S

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.card_pointGroup_ofBonds

    {S : Finset (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℤ)} (h : ∀ v, Admissible (bondNeighbors bonds) v ↔ v ∈ S) :
    Nat.card (ofBonds bonds).pointGroup = S.card

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.bondDisplacements
entries.docstring:
The displacements `d` such that site `i` of the reference cell is bonded to site `j` of the
cell `d`, in the graph of a bond list.
entries.snippet: def bondDisplacements (bonds : List (Bond G F)) (i j : F) : Finset G

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.bonded_ofBonds_iff
entries.snippet:
lemma bonded_ofBonds_iff (bonds : List (Bond G F)) (i j : F) (d : G) :
    (ofBonds bonds).Bonded i j d ↔ d ∈ bondDisplacements bonds i j

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.mem_symmetries_ofBonds_iff
entries.docstring:
**A finite criterion for the symmetries of the graph of a bond list**: `(A, σ, b)` is a
symmetry exactly when `d ↦ A d + b j - b i` maps `E i j` onto `E (σ i) (σ j)` for all labels.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_symmetries_ofBonds_iff (bonds : List (Bond G F)) (s : CellSymmetry G F) :
    s ∈ (ofBonds bonds).symmetries ↔ ∀ i j, (bondDisplacements bonds i j).image
      (fun d => s.linear d + s.shift j - s.shift i) =
        bondDisplacements bonds (s.perm i) (s.perm j)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.bondDifferences
entries.docstring:
The nonzero differences `d₁ - d₂` of two displacements in a common `E i j`: translations
between two sites with the same label that are bonded to a common site.
entries.snippet: def bondDifferences (bonds : List (Bond G F)) : Finset G

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.mem_bondDifferences
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_bondDifferences (bonds : List (Bond G F)) (e : G) :
    e ∈ bondDifferences bonds ↔ e ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ i j, ∃ d₁ ∈ bondDisplacements bonds i j,
      ∃ d₂ ∈ bondDisplacements bonds i j, e = d₁ - d₂

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.linear_mem_bondDifferences
CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.linear_mem_bondDifferences_iff
entries.docstring: **The linear part of a symmetry preserves the differences of bonds.**

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.linearToLattice
entries.docstring:
The linear part of a symmetry, as an element of the point stabilizer of the lattice of
differences.
entries.snippet:
def linearToLattice (hΔ : bondDifferences bonds = bondNeighbors bonds') :
    (ofBonds bonds).symmetries →* (ofBonds bonds').pointStabilizer

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.ker_linearToLattice
entries.snippet:
lemma ker_linearToLattice (hΔ : bondDifferences bonds = bondNeighbors bonds')
    (hker : ∀ s ∈ (ofBonds bonds).symmetries, s.linear = AddEquiv.refl _ →
      s ∈ CellSymmetry.translations (Fin n → ℤ) F) :
    (linearToLattice hΔ).ker =
      (CellSymmetry.translations (Fin n → ℤ) F).subgroupOf (ofBonds bonds).symmetries

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.pointGroupMulEquivOfLift
entries.docstring:
**The point group of a crystal with several sites per cell is the point group of its lattice
of differences**, if only translations have the identity as linear part and every point
operation of the lattice lifts to a symmetry.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def pointGroupMulEquivOfLift (hΔ : bondDifferences bonds = bondNeighbors bonds')
    (hker : ∀ s ∈ (ofBonds bonds).symmetries, s.linear = AddEquiv.refl _ →
      s ∈ CellSymmetry.translations (Fin n → ℤ) F)
    (hlift : Function.Surjective (linearToLattice hΔ)) :
    (ofBonds bonds).pointGroup ≃* (ofBonds bonds').pointGroup

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.shiftCandidates
entries.docstring: The candidates for the cell offsets of a symmetry, relative to the label `i₀`.
entries.snippet: def shiftCandidates (bonds : List (Bond (Fin n → ℤ) F)) (i₀ : F) : Finset (Fin n → ℤ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.mem_translations_of_linear_eq
entries.docstring:
**Only translations have the identity as linear part**, if every label is bonded to `i₀` and
this holds for the finitely many candidate offsets.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_translations_of_linear_eq (i₀ : F)
    (hconn : ∀ i, i = i₀ ∨ (bondDisplacements bonds i₀ i).Nonempty)
    (h : ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm F, ∀ r ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun _ => shiftCandidates bonds i₀,
      r i₀ = 0 → (∀ i j, (bondDisplacements bonds i j).image (fun d => d + r j - r i) =
        bondDisplacements bonds (σ i) (σ j)) → σ = 1 ∧ r = 0)
    (s : CellSymmetry (Fin n → ℤ) F) (hs : s ∈ (ofBonds bonds).symmetries)
    (hL : s.linear = AddEquiv.refl _) : s ∈ CellSymmetry.translations (Fin n → ℤ) F

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.lift_of_admissible
entries.docstring:
**Every point operation of the lattice of differences lifts to a symmetry**, if every
admissible tuple of neighbours does, with a permutation and offsets `b i ∈ T i`.
entries.snippet:
lemma lift_of_admissible (hΔ : bondDifferences bonds = bondNeighbors bonds')
    (hN : ∀ j, (Pi.single j 1 : Fin n → ℤ) ∈ bondNeighbors bonds') (T : F → Finset (Fin n → ℤ))
    (h : ∀ w : Fin n → bondNeighbors bonds', Admissible (bondNeighbors bonds') (fun j => w j) →
      ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm F, ∃ b ∈ Fintype.piFinset T, ∀ i j, (bondDisplacements bonds i j).image
        (fun d => act (fun j => w j) d + b j - b i) = bondDisplacements bonds (σ i) (σ j)) :
    Function.Surjective (linearToLattice hΔ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.toAdd_pow_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma toAdd_pow_apply {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] (A : Multiplicative (AddAut G)) (n : ℕ)
    (x : G) : (Multiplicative.toAdd (A ^ n) : AddAut G) x =
      (Multiplicative.toAdd A : AddAut G)^[n] x

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.pow_eq_one_of_admissible
entries.docstring:
If the `n`-th power of every admissible triple fixes the basis, then every element of the
point stabilizer satisfies `A ^ n = 1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma pow_eq_one_of_admissible (n : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ v, Admissible N v → ∀ j, (act v)^[n] (Pi.single j 1) = Pi.single j 1)
    (A : Multiplicative (AddAut (Fin 3 → ℤ))) (hA : A ∈ g.pointStabilizer) : A ^ n = 1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.crystalAlgebra
entries.docstring:
**The quasi-local algebra of an infinite crystal** whose sites all carry the finite
configuration space `Ω₀`.
entries.snippet: abbrev crystalAlgebra (G F : Type*) [DecidableEq (CellSite G F)]

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.cellSymmetryAction
entries.docstring: **The cell symmetries of a crystal act on its quasi-local algebra** by `*`-automorphisms.
entries.snippet: def cellSymmetryAction : CellSymmetry G F →* (crystalAlgebra Ω₀ G F ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] crystalAlgebra Ω₀ G F)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.translationHom
entries.docstring: The translations as cell symmetries.
entries.snippet: def translationHom (G F : Type*) [AddCommGroup G] : Multiplicative G →* CellSymmetry G F where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.translationAction
entries.docstring: **The translations act on the quasi-local algebra** by `*`-automorphisms.
entries.snippet: def translationAction : Multiplicative G →* (crystalAlgebra Ω₀ G F ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] crystalAlgebra Ω₀ G F)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.cellSymmetryAction_translation_conj
entries.docstring: **Covariance**: a cell symmetry carries the translation by `a` to the translation by `A a`.
entries.snippet:
lemma cellSymmetryAction_translation_conj (s : CellSymmetry G F) (a : G) :
    cellSymmetryAction Ω₀ s * cellSymmetryAction Ω₀ (CellSymmetry.translation a) *
        (cellSymmetryAction Ω₀ s)⁻¹ =
      cellSymmetryAction Ω₀ (CellSymmetry.translation (s.linear a))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.phase
entries.docstring:
The phase accumulated by a plane wave of wave vector `k` under the lattice translation
`n`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def phase (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D)) (n : Multiplicative (Fin d → ℤ)) : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.dualCharacter
entries.docstring: The character of the translation group `ℤ^d` given by the plane wave of wave vector `k`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def dualCharacter (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D)) :
    PontryaginDual (Multiplicative (Fin d → ℤ)) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.reciprocalLattice
entries.docstring:
The reciprocal lattice: wave vectors whose plane wave is trivial on every lattice
translation.
entries.snippet: def reciprocalLattice : AddSubgroup (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D)) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.dualCharacter_apply
entries.docstring: Evaluating the character of a wave vector gives the exponential of the phase.
entries.snippet:
lemma dualCharacter_apply (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D)) (n : Multiplicative (Fin d → ℤ)) :
    dualCharacter a k n = Circle.exp (phase a k n)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.phase_add
entries.docstring: The phase of a lattice translation is additive in the wave vector.
entries.snippet:
lemma phase_add (k l : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D)) (n : Multiplicative (Fin d → ℤ)) :
    phase a (k + l) n = phase a k n + phase a l n

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.dualCharacter_eq_one_iff
entries.docstring: A wave vector gives the trivial character exactly when it lies in the reciprocal lattice.
entries.snippet:
lemma dualCharacter_eq_one_iff (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D)) :
    dualCharacter a k = 1 ↔ k ∈ reciprocalLattice a

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.dualCharacter_add_of_mem
entries.docstring: Wave vectors differing by a reciprocal lattice vector give the same character.
entries.snippet:
lemma dualCharacter_add_of_mem {k l : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D)}
    (hl : l ∈ reciprocalLattice a) : dualCharacter a (k + l) = dualCharacter a k

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.latticeBasis
entries.docstring: The basis of space formed by independent primitive translations.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def latticeBasis (ha : LinearIndependent ℝ a) :
    Module.Basis (Fin d) ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.reciprocalBasis
entries.docstring: The reciprocal basis `b_i`, characterized by `⟨a_j, b_i⟩ = 2π δ_ij`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def reciprocalBasis (ha : LinearIndependent ℝ a) (i : Fin d) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.inner_reciprocalBasis
entries.docstring: The reciprocal basis is dual to the primitive translations up to the factor `2π`.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_reciprocalBasis (ha : LinearIndependent ℝ a) (i j : Fin d) :
    ⟪a j, reciprocalBasis ha i⟫ = if i = j then 2 * Real.pi else 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.dualCharacter_surjective
entries.docstring: Every character of the translation group is the plane wave of some wave vector.
entries.snippet:
lemma dualCharacter_surjective (ha : LinearIndependent ℝ a) :
    Function.Surjective (dualCharacter a)
