entries.snippet: def translation (a : G) : CellSymmetry G F

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.CellSymmetry.translation_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma translation_mul (a b : G) :
    (translation a : CellSymmetry G F) * translation b = translation (a + b)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.CellSymmetry.mul_translation_mul_inv
entries.docstring: Conjugating a translation by a symmetry gives the translation by the transformed vector.
entries.snippet:
lemma mul_translation_mul_inv (s : CellSymmetry G F) (a : G) :
    s * translation a * s⁻¹ = translation (s.linear a)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.CellSymmetry.translations
entries.docstring: The subgroup of translations.
entries.snippet: def translations (G F : Type*) [AddCommGroup G] : Subgroup (CellSymmetry G F) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.CellSymmetry.«instance@644df05e»
entries.snippet: instance : (translations G F).Normal where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.CellSymmetry.PointGroup
entries.docstring: The abstract point group of a crystal: cell symmetries modulo translations.
entries.snippet: abbrev PointGroup (G F : Type*) [AddCommGroup G]

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.Bonded
entries.docstring: Site `i` of the reference cell is bonded to site `j` of the cell `d`.
entries.snippet: def Bonded (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G F)) (i j : F) (d : G) : Prop

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.adj_iff_bonded
entries.docstring: Bonds between any two cells are the translates of bonds to the reference cell.
entries.snippet:
lemma adj_iff_bonded (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G F)) (n m : G) (i j : F) :
    g.toSimpleGraph.Adj ⟨n, i⟩ ⟨m, j⟩ ↔ g.Bonded i j (m - n)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.symmetries
entries.docstring: A symmetry preserves the bonds of the graph.
entries.snippet: def symmetries (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G F)) : Subgroup (CellSymmetry G F) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.mem_symmetries_iff
entries.docstring:
**A finite criterion for bond-preserving symmetries.** The data `(A, σ, b)` is a symmetry of
the crystal graph exactly when site `i` is bonded to site `j` in the cell `d` if and only if site
`σ i` is bonded to site `σ j` in the cell `A d + b j - b i`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_symmetries_iff (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G F)) (s : CellSymmetry G F) :
    s ∈ g.symmetries ↔ ∀ i j d, g.Bonded i j d ↔
      g.Bonded (s.perm i) (s.perm j) (s.linear d + s.shift j - s.shift i)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.symmetryIso
entries.docstring: A bond-preserving symmetry is an automorphism of the bond graph.
entries.snippet:
def symmetryIso (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G F)) (s : g.symmetries) :
    g.toSimpleGraph ≃g g.toSimpleGraph where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.translation_mem_symmetries
entries.docstring: Translations are bond-preserving symmetries.
entries.snippet:
lemma translation_mem_symmetries (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G F)) (a : G) :
    CellSymmetry.translation a ∈ g.symmetries

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.pointGroup
entries.docstring: The point group of a periodic graph: its bond-preserving symmetries modulo translations.
entries.snippet: abbrev pointGroup (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G F))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.Crystal.PeriodicGraph.exists_symmetry_of_equivariant
entries.docstring:
**Every automorphism of the bond graph that normalises the translations is a cell symmetry.**
If `φ` is a graph automorphism and `A` an automorphism of the translation group with
`φ (a +ᵥ x) = A a +ᵥ φ x`, then `φ` acts as a bond-preserving cell symmetry with linear part `A`.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_symmetry_of_equivariant (g : PeriodicGraph (Crystal.ofUnitCell G F))
    (φ : g.toSimpleGraph ≃g g.toSimpleGraph) (A : G ≃+ G)
    (hφ : ∀ (a : G) (x : CellSite G F), φ (a +ᵥ x) = A a +ᵥ φ x) :
    ∃ s ∈ g.symmetries, s.linear = A ∧ ∀ x, s • x = φ x

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel
entries.docstring: A classical nearest-neighbor Ising model on the specified undirected graph.
entries.snippet:
structure IsingModel {X : Type*} (graph : SimpleGraph X) where
  J : ℝ
  h : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.Configuration
entries.docstring: Up or down spins at every site of the crystal.
entries.snippet: abbrev Configuration (_I : IsingModel g)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.spin
entries.docstring: The dimensionless spin value, with `true` denoting up.
entries.snippet: def spin (b : Bool) : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.pairSpin
entries.docstring: The exchange contribution of an ordered pair; nonadjacent sites contribute zero.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def pairSpin (I : IsingModel g) (σ : I.Configuration) (x y : X) : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.energy
entries.docstring:
Energy of the spins and internal edges of a finite region. The factor `1/2` counts each
undirected graph edge once. Spins outside the region do not contribute.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def energy (I : IsingModel g) (Λ : Finset X)
    (σ : I.Configuration) : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.energy_congr
entries.docstring: A region's energy depends only on the spin configuration inside that region.
entries.snippet:
lemma energy_congr (I : IsingModel g) (Λ : Finset X) {σ τ : I.Configuration}
    (hστ : ∀ x ∈ Λ, σ x = τ x) : I.energy Λ σ = I.energy Λ τ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.pairSpin_comm
entries.docstring: The exchange contribution is symmetric in the endpoints of a bond.
entries.snippet:
lemma pairSpin_comm (I : IsingModel g) (σ : I.Configuration) (x y : X) :
    I.pairSpin σ x y = I.pairSpin σ y x

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.energy_union
entries.docstring: Joining disjoint regions adds exactly their crossing exchange interactions.
entries.snippet:
lemma energy_union [DecidableEq X] (I : IsingModel g) (Λ M : Finset X)
    (hΛM : Disjoint Λ M) (σ : I.Configuration) :
    I.energy (Λ ∪ M) σ = I.energy Λ σ + I.energy M σ -
      I.J * ∑ x ∈ Λ, ∑ y ∈ M, I.pairSpin σ x y

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.abs_pairSpin
entries.docstring: An ordered bond contributes at most one in absolute spin units.
entries.snippet:
lemma abs_pairSpin (I : IsingModel g) (σ : I.Configuration) (x y : X) :
    |I.pairSpin σ x y| = if g.Adj x y then 1 else 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.abs_sum_pairSpin_le
entries.docstring: The total exchange spin sum is bounded by the number of connections between the regions.
entries.snippet:
lemma abs_sum_pairSpin_le (I : IsingModel g) (Λ M : Finset X)
    (σ : I.Configuration) :
    |∑ x ∈ Λ, ∑ y ∈ M, I.pairSpin σ x y| ≤ g.bondCountBetween Λ M

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.abs_energy_union_sub_le
entries.docstring: Failure of energy additivity is controlled solely by the bonds crossing the boundary.
entries.snippet:
lemma abs_energy_union_sub_le [DecidableEq X] (I : IsingModel g)
    (Λ M : Finset X) (hΛM : Disjoint Λ M) (σ : I.Configuration) :
    |I.energy (Λ ∪ M) σ - I.energy Λ σ - I.energy M σ| ≤
      |I.J| * g.bondCountBetween Λ M

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.abs_energy_le
entries.docstring: The absolute energy is bounded by the internal bond count and the number of spins.
entries.snippet:
lemma abs_energy_le (I : IsingModel g) (Λ : Finset X) (σ : I.Configuration) :
    |I.energy Λ σ| ≤ |I.J| / 2 * g.bondCountBetween Λ Λ + |I.h| * Λ.card

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.abs_energy_le_of_degree_le
entries.docstring: A coordination bound gives a uniform energy bound proportional to the region's volume.
entries.snippet:
lemma abs_energy_le_of_degree_le [g.LocallyFinite] (I : IsingModel g) (Λ : Finset X)
    (σ : I.Configuration) (q : ℕ) (hq : ∀ x ∈ Λ, (g.neighborFinset x).card ≤ q) :
    |I.energy Λ σ| ≤ (|I.J| * q / 2 + |I.h|) * Λ.card

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.IsGroundState
entries.docstring:
A configuration minimizing the energy of the finite region `Λ`.
Only interactions internal to the region enter this definition.
entries.snippet: def IsGroundState (I : IsingModel g) (Λ : Finset X) (σ : I.Configuration) : Prop

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.polarized
entries.docstring: Uniform spins aligned with the field; at zero field the up orientation is chosen.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def polarized (I : IsingModel g) : I.Configuration

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.groundEnergy
entries.docstring: The least finite-region energy over all spin configurations.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def groundEnergy (I : IsingModel g) (Λ : Finset X) : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.groundEnergy_eq_of_isGroundState
entries.docstring: An energy-minimizing configuration attains the least energy.
entries.snippet:
lemma groundEnergy_eq_of_isGroundState (I : IsingModel g) (Λ : Finset X)
    {σ : I.Configuration} (hσ : I.IsGroundState Λ σ) :
    I.groundEnergy Λ = I.energy Λ σ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.energy_polarized
entries.docstring: Uniform field-aligned polarization has saturated exchange and field contributions.
entries.snippet:
lemma energy_polarized (I : IsingModel g) (Λ : Finset X) :
    I.energy Λ I.polarized =
      -(I.J / 2) * g.bondCountBetween Λ Λ - |I.h| * Λ.card

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.energy_lower_bound
entries.docstring: Ferromagnetic energies cannot lie below the saturated exchange and field contributions.
entries.snippet:
lemma energy_lower_bound (I : IsingModel g) (hJ : 0 ≤ I.J) (Λ : Finset X)
    (σ : I.Configuration) :
    -(I.J / 2) * g.bondCountBetween Λ Λ - |I.h| * Λ.card ≤ I.energy Λ σ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.isGroundState_polarized
entries.docstring: Uniform field-aligned polarization is a ground state on every finite ferromagnetic region.
entries.snippet:
lemma isGroundState_polarized (I : IsingModel g) (hJ : 0 ≤ I.J) (Λ : Finset X) :
    I.IsGroundState Λ I.polarized

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.groundEnergy_eq
entries.docstring: The exact ferromagnetic minimum counts internal bonds and field-aligned spins.
entries.snippet:
lemma groundEnergy_eq (I : IsingModel g) (hJ : 0 ≤ I.J) (Λ : Finset X) :
    I.groundEnergy Λ = -(I.J / 2) * g.bondCountBetween Λ Λ - |I.h| * Λ.card

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.groundEnergyDensity
entries.docstring: The minimum finite-region energy divided by the number of sites.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def groundEnergyDensity (I : IsingModel g) (Λ : Finset X) : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.groundEnergyDensity_eq
entries.docstring: The ferromagnetic minimum per site is determined by average internal coordination.
entries.snippet:
lemma groundEnergyDensity_eq (I : IsingModel g) (hJ : 0 ≤ I.J) (Λ : Finset X)
    (hΛ : Λ.Nonempty) :
    I.groundEnergyDensity Λ =
      -(I.J / 2) * ((g.bondCountBetween Λ Λ : ℝ) / Λ.card) - |I.h|

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.tendsto_groundEnergyDensity
entries.docstring:
Convergent average internal coordination gives a ferromagnetic ground-state energy density.
The statement applies to any sequence of nonempty finite regions on any graph.
entries.snippet:
lemma tendsto_groundEnergyDensity (I : IsingModel g) (hJ : 0 ≤ I.J)
    (Λ : ℕ → Finset X) (hΛ : ∀ n, (Λ n).Nonempty) (z : ℝ)
    (hz : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n => (g.bondCountBetween (Λ n) (Λ n) : ℝ) / (Λ n).card)
      Filter.atTop (nhds z)) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => I.groundEnergyDensity (Λ n))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (-(I.J / 2) * z - |I.h|))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.translate
entries.docstring: Transport a configuration along a crystal translation.
entries.snippet: def translate (I : IsingModel g.toSimpleGraph) (a : G) (σ : I.Configuration) : I.Configuration

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.translateRegion
entries.docstring: Translate a finite region by the existing bijective action on crystal sites.
entries.snippet: def translateRegion (a : G) (Λ : Finset C.Site) : Finset C.Site

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.pairSpin_translate
entries.docstring: Exchange contributions are unchanged by translating both spins and sites.
entries.snippet:
lemma pairSpin_translate (I : IsingModel g.toSimpleGraph) (a : G) (σ : I.Configuration)
    (x y : C.Site) :
    I.pairSpin (I.translate a σ) (a +ᵥ x) (a +ᵥ y) = I.pairSpin σ x y

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.energy_translate
entries.docstring:
Uniform Ising interactions inherit the crystal's translation symmetry. Translating the
region as well as its configuration preserves its energy.
entries.snippet:
lemma energy_translate (I : IsingModel g.toSimpleGraph) (a : G)
    (Λ : Finset C.Site) (σ : I.Configuration) :
    I.energy (translateRegion a Λ) (I.translate a σ) = I.energy Λ σ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.hypercubic
entries.docstring: Uniform classical Ising interactions on the hypercubic bond graph in arbitrary dimension.
entries.snippet: def hypercubic (d : ℕ) (J h : ℝ) : IsingModel (Crystal.hypercubicGraph d).toSimpleGraph

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.square
entries.docstring: The square-lattice model, specializing the hypercubic construction to two dimensions.
entries.snippet: def square (J h : ℝ) : IsingModel Crystal.squareGraph.toSimpleGraph

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.honeycomb
entries.docstring: The honeycomb classical Ising model, using the crystal's existing bonds.
entries.snippet: def honeycomb (J h : ℝ) : IsingModel Crystal.honeycombGraph.toSimpleGraph

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.Hypercube.cells
entries.docstring: The cells `{0, …, n}^d` of a hypercube of side `n + 1` unit cells.
entries.snippet: def cells (d n : ℕ) : Finset (Fin d → ℤ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.Hypercube.mem_cells
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_cells {d n : ℕ} (c : Fin d → ℤ) :
    c ∈ cells d n ↔ ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i ∧ c i ≤ n

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.Hypercube.card_cells
entries.snippet: lemma card_cells (d n : ℕ) : (cells d n).card = (n + 1) ^ d

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.Hypercube.interior
entries.docstring: The cells at least `R` unit cells away from every face of the hypercube.
entries.snippet: def interior (d n R : ℕ) : Finset (Fin d → ℤ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.Hypercube.mem_interior
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_interior {d n R : ℕ} (c : Fin d → ℤ) :
    c ∈ interior d n R ↔ ∀ i, (R : ℤ) ≤ c i ∧ c i ≤ n - R

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.Hypercube.card_interior
entries.docstring: The interior of a hypercube of side `n + 1` is a hypercube of side `n + 1 - 2 R`.
entries.snippet: lemma card_interior (d n R : ℕ) : (interior d n R).card = (n + 1 - 2 * R) ^ d

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.Hypercube.interior_subset
entries.snippet: lemma interior_subset {d n R : ℕ} : interior d n R ⊆ cells d n

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.Hypercube.region
entries.docstring: All sites of the crystal with unit cell labels `F` that lie in the cells `B`.
entries.snippet: def region (B : Finset (Fin d → ℤ)) : Finset (Crystal.ofUnitCell (Fin d → ℤ) F).Site

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.Hypercube.mem_region
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_region {B : Finset (Fin d → ℤ)} (x : (Crystal.ofUnitCell (Fin d → ℤ) F).Site) :
    x ∈ region B ↔ x.cell ∈ B

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.Hypercube.sum_region
CondensedMatter.IsingModel.Hypercube.card_region
entries.snippet:
lemma card_region (B : Finset (Fin d → ℤ)) :
    (region (F := F) B).card = B.card * Fintype.card F

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.Hypercube.region_cells_nonempty
entries.docstring: Every hypercube contains at least one site if the unit cell does.
entries.snippet:
lemma region_cells_nonempty [Nonempty F] (d n : ℕ) :
    (region (F := F) (cells d n)).Nonempty

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.Hypercube.exists_range
entries.docstring:
Bonds have a finite range: there is a distance `R`, in units of the cell spacing, beyond
which no two sites are connected. This holds because the coordination is finite and every
site is a translate of one of finitely many reference sites.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_range :
    ∃ R : ℕ, ∀ x y : (Crystal.ofUnitCell (Fin d → ℤ) F).Site,
      g.toSimpleGraph.Adj x y → ∀ k, |y.cell k - x.cell k| ≤ R

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.Hypercube.neighbors_subset_region
entries.docstring:
Sites in the interior of a hypercube have all their neighbors in the sample, once
the interior is at least the bond range away from the surface.
entries.snippet:
lemma neighbors_subset_region {n R : ℕ}
    (hR : ∀ x y : (Crystal.ofUnitCell (Fin d → ℤ) F).Site,
      g.toSimpleGraph.Adj x y → ∀ k, |y.cell k - x.cell k| ≤ R)
    {x : (Crystal.ofUnitCell (Fin d → ℤ) F).Site} (hx : x.cell ∈ interior d n R) :
    g.neighbors x ⊆ region (cells d n)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.Hypercube.meanCoordination
entries.docstring:
The mean number of neighbors per site of a crystal with unit cell `F`: the coordination
averaged over the sites of one unit cell.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def meanCoordination : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.Hypercube.sum_card_neighbors_region
entries.docstring:
Summing the coordination over the sites of a set of cells counts every unit-cell
coordination once per cell.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_card_neighbors_region (B : Finset (Fin d → ℤ)) :
    ∑ x ∈ region B, (g.neighbors x).card =
      B.card * ∑ i : F, (g.neighbors ⟨0, i⟩).card

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.Hypercube.bondCountBetween_le
entries.docstring: The ordered bonds inside a region number at most the total coordination of its sites.
entries.snippet:
lemma bondCountBetween_le (Λ : Finset (Crystal.ofUnitCell (Fin d → ℤ) F).Site) :
    g.toSimpleGraph.bondCountBetween Λ Λ ≤ ∑ x ∈ Λ, (g.neighbors x).card

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.Hypercube.sum_interior_le_bondCountBetween
entries.docstring: Every site in the interior of the hypercube has all its bonds inside the hypercube.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_interior_le_bondCountBetween {n R : ℕ}
    (hR : ∀ x y : (Crystal.ofUnitCell (Fin d → ℤ) F).Site,
      g.toSimpleGraph.Adj x y → ∀ k, |y.cell k - x.cell k| ≤ R) :
    ∑ x ∈ region (F := F) (interior d n R), (g.neighbors x).card ≤
      g.toSimpleGraph.bondCountBetween (region (cells d n)) (region (cells d n))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.Hypercube.tendsto_averageCoordination
entries.docstring:
The average coordination of hypercubes converges to the mean coordination of the
crystal: the sites near the surface, whose neighbors are cut off, become a vanishing fraction
of the sample.
entries.snippet:
lemma tendsto_averageCoordination :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ => (g.toSimpleGraph.bondCountBetween (region (cells d n))
        (region (cells d n)) : ℝ) / (region (F := F) (cells d n)).card)
      Filter.atTop (nhds (meanCoordination g))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.tendsto_groundEnergyDensity_hypercube
entries.docstring:
The ground-state energy per spin of a ferromagnetic Ising model on any crystal, in
hypercubes of growing size, converges to `-(J / 2) z̄ - |h|`, where `z̄` is the mean
coordination. Each spin carries the energy `-J` for half of its bonds; the missing bonds
at the surface of the sample do not contribute in the limit. The field may have either
sign, and the lattice may have several sites per unit cell.
entries.snippet:
lemma tendsto_groundEnergyDensity_hypercube (I : IsingModel g.toSimpleGraph) (hJ : 0 ≤ I.J) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => I.groundEnergyDensity (region (cells d n)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (-(I.J / 2) * meanCoordination g - |I.h|))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.meanCoordination_honeycomb
entries.docstring: The honeycomb lattice has three neighbors per site.
entries.snippet: lemma meanCoordination_honeycomb : Hypercube.meanCoordination Crystal.honeycombGraph = 3

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.tendsto_groundEnergyDensity_honeycomb
entries.docstring:
The ground-state energy per spin of the ferromagnetic honeycomb Ising model converges to
`-3 J / 2 - |h|` as the sample grows.
entries.snippet:
lemma tendsto_groundEnergyDensity_honeycomb (J h : ℝ) (hJ : 0 ≤ J) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (honeycomb J h).groundEnergyDensity
        (Hypercube.region (Hypercube.cells 2 n)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (-(3 * J / 2) - |h|))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.meanCoordination_square
entries.docstring: The square lattice has four neighbors per site.
entries.snippet: lemma meanCoordination_square : Hypercube.meanCoordination Crystal.squareGraph = 4

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.tendsto_groundEnergyDensity_square
entries.docstring:
The ground-state energy per spin of the ferromagnetic square-lattice Ising model
converges to `-2 J - |h|` as the sample grows.
entries.snippet:
lemma tendsto_groundEnergyDensity_square (J h : ℝ) (hJ : 0 ≤ J) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (square J h).groundEnergyDensity
        (Hypercube.region (Hypercube.cells 2 n)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (-(2 * J) - |h|))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.meanCoordination_of_card
entries.docstring: If every site has `q` neighbors, the mean coordination is `q`.
entries.snippet:
lemma meanCoordination_of_card {q : ℕ} (h : ∀ x, (g.neighbors x).card = q) :
    Hypercube.meanCoordination g = q

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.tendsto_groundEnergyDensity_of_card
entries.docstring:
**The ferromagnetic ground-state energy density of a `q`-regular crystal** converges to
`-q J / 2 - |h|`.
entries.snippet:
lemma tendsto_groundEnergyDensity_of_card {q : ℕ} (h : ∀ x, (g.neighbors x).card = q)
    (I : IsingModel g.toSimpleGraph) (hJ : 0 ≤ I.J) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => I.groundEnergyDensity (Hypercube.region (Hypercube.cells d n)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (-(q * I.J / 2) - |I.h|))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.tendsto_groundEnergyDensity_diamond
entries.docstring: The diamond lattice has four neighbors per site.
entries.snippet:
lemma tendsto_groundEnergyDensity_diamond (J h : ℝ) (hJ : 0 ≤ J) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (⟨J, h⟩ : IsingModel Crystal.diamondGraph.toSimpleGraph
        ).groundEnergyDensity (Hypercube.region (Hypercube.cells 3 n)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (-(4 * J / 2) - |h|))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.tendsto_groundEnergyDensity_fcc
entries.docstring: The face-centred cubic lattice has twelve neighbors per site.
entries.snippet:
lemma tendsto_groundEnergyDensity_fcc (J h : ℝ) (hJ : 0 ≤ J) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (⟨J, h⟩ : IsingModel Crystal.fccGraph.toSimpleGraph
        ).groundEnergyDensity (Hypercube.region (Hypercube.cells 3 n)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (-(12 * J / 2) - |h|))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.tendsto_groundEnergyDensity_bcc
entries.docstring: The body-centred cubic lattice has eight neighbors per site.
entries.snippet:
lemma tendsto_groundEnergyDensity_bcc (J h : ℝ) (hJ : 0 ≤ J) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (⟨J, h⟩ : IsingModel Crystal.bccGraph.toSimpleGraph
        ).groundEnergyDensity (Hypercube.region (Hypercube.cells 3 n)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (-(8 * J / 2) - |h|))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.IsingModel.tendsto_groundEnergyDensity_hcp
entries.docstring: The hexagonal close-packed crystal has twelve neighbors per site.
entries.snippet:
lemma tendsto_groundEnergyDensity_hcp (J h : ℝ) (hJ : 0 ≤ J) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (⟨J, h⟩ : IsingModel Crystal.hcpGraph.toSimpleGraph
        ).groundEnergyDensity (Hypercube.region (Hypercube.cells 3 n)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (-(12 * J / 2) - |h|))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.gibbsWeight
entries.docstring: The Gibbs weight `e^{-h}` of an energy operator `h`.
entries.snippet: def gibbsWeight (h : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.gibbsRoot
entries.docstring: The square root `e^{-h/2}` of the Gibbs weight.
entries.snippet: def gibbsRoot (h : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.gibbsWeight_eq_root_mul
entries.snippet: lemma gibbsWeight_eq_root_mul (h : Matrix n n ℂ) : gibbsWeight h = gibbsRoot h * gibbsRoot h

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.gibbsRoot_isHermitian
entries.snippet:
lemma gibbsRoot_isHermitian {h : Matrix n n ℂ} (hh : h.IsHermitian) :
    (gibbsRoot h).IsHermitian

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.gibbsWeight_isHermitian
entries.snippet:
lemma gibbsWeight_isHermitian {h : Matrix n n ℂ} (hh : h.IsHermitian) :
    (gibbsWeight h).IsHermitian

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.partition
entries.docstring: The **partition function** `tr e^{-h}`.
entries.snippet: def partition (h : Matrix n n ℂ) : ℂ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.partition_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma partition_eq (h : Matrix n n ℂ) (hh : h.IsHermitian) :
    partition h = ((gibbsRoot h)ᴴ * gibbsRoot h).trace

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.gibbsRoot_ne_zero
entries.snippet: lemma gibbsRoot_ne_zero [Nonempty n] (h : Matrix n n ℂ) : gibbsRoot h ≠ 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.partition_pos
entries.docstring: **The partition function of a Hermitian operator is positive.**
entries.snippet: lemma partition_pos [Nonempty n] {h : Matrix n n ℂ} (hh : h.IsHermitian) : 0 < partition h

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.partition_ne_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma partition_ne_zero [Nonempty n] {h : Matrix n n ℂ} (hh : h.IsHermitian) :
    partition h ≠ 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.gibbsFunctional
entries.docstring: The Gibbs functional `a ↦ tr(e^{-h} a) / tr(e^{-h})`.
entries.snippet: def gibbsFunctional (h : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.gibbsFunctional_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma gibbsFunctional_apply (h a : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    gibbsFunctional h a = (partition h)⁻¹ * (gibbsWeight h * a).trace

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inv_partition_nonneg
entries.docstring: The inverse of the partition function is a nonnegative real number.
entries.snippet:
lemma inv_partition_nonneg [Nonempty n] {h : Matrix n n ℂ} (hh : h.IsHermitian) :
    0 ≤ (partition h)⁻¹

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.gibbsState
entries.docstring:
**The Gibbs state of a Hermitian operator** is a state of the matrix algebra: normalized,
Hermitian and positive.
entries.snippet: def gibbsState [Nonempty n] (h : Matrix n n ℂ) (hh : h.IsHermitian) : AlgState (Matrix n n ℂ) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.canonicalState
entries.docstring: **The canonical ensemble** at inverse temperature `β` for a Hamiltonian `H`.
entries.snippet:
def canonicalState [Nonempty n] (β : ℝ) (H : Matrix n n ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian) :
    AlgState (Matrix n n ℂ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.grandCanonicalOp
entries.docstring: The operator whose Gibbs weight is the grand canonical weight: `β (H - μ N)`.
entries.snippet: def grandCanonicalOp (β μ : ℝ) (H N : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.grandCanonicalOp_isHermitian
entries.snippet:
lemma grandCanonicalOp_isHermitian {H N : Matrix n n ℂ} (hH : H.IsHermitian) (hN : N.IsHermitian)
    (β μ : ℝ) : (grandCanonicalOp β μ H N).IsHermitian

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.grandCanonicalState
entries.docstring:
**The grand canonical ensemble** at inverse temperature `β` and chemical potential `μ`, for a
Hamiltonian `H` and a charge `N`.
entries.snippet:
def grandCanonicalState [Nonempty n] (β μ : ℝ) (H N : Matrix n n ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    (hN : N.IsHermitian) : AlgState (Matrix n n ℂ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.grandCanonicalOp_zero
entries.docstring: At zero chemical potential the grand canonical ensemble is the canonical one.
entries.snippet:
lemma grandCanonicalOp_zero (β : ℝ) (H N : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    grandCanonicalOp β 0 H N = (β : ℂ) • H

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.grandCanonicalWeight_of_commute
entries.docstring:
**Factorization for a conserved charge**: if `H` and `N` commute, the grand canonical weight is
the canonical weight times the fugacity factor `e^{βμ N}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma grandCanonicalWeight_of_commute (β μ : ℝ) {H N : Matrix n n ℂ} (hc : Commute H N) :
    gibbsWeight (grandCanonicalOp β μ H N) =
      gibbsWeight ((β : ℂ) • H) * NormedSpace.exp (((β * μ : ℝ) : ℂ) • N)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.gibbsWeight_diagonal
entries.docstring:
**For a diagonal energy operator the Gibbs weight is the Boltzmann factor** `e^{-E(c)}` of each
configuration `c`: the classical Gibbs distribution.
entries.snippet:
lemma gibbsWeight_diagonal (v : n → ℂ) :
    gibbsWeight (Matrix.diagonal v) = Matrix.diagonal fun c => Complex.exp (-v c)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.partition_diagonal
entries.docstring: The partition function of a diagonal energy operator is the sum of the Boltzmann factors.
entries.snippet: lemma partition_diagonal (v : n → ℂ) : partition (Matrix.diagonal v) = ∑ c, Complex.exp (-v c)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.quantumIso_exp
entries.docstring: Moving commutes with the exponential.
entries.snippet:
lemma quantumIso_exp (γ : Γ) (X : Finset S) (a : Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X) :
    quantumIso γ X (NormedSpace.exp a) = NormedSpace.exp (quantumIso γ X a)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.quantumIso_trace
entries.docstring: Moving preserves the trace.
entries.snippet:
lemma quantumIso_trace (γ : Γ) (X : Finset S) (a : Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X) :
    (quantumIso γ X a).trace = a.trace

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.quantumIso_gibbsWeight
entries.snippet:
lemma quantumIso_gibbsWeight (γ : Γ) (X : Finset S) (a : Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X) :
    quantumIso γ X (gibbsWeight a) = gibbsWeight (quantumIso γ X a)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.quantumIso_partition
entries.snippet:
lemma quantumIso_partition (γ : Γ) (X : Finset S) (a : Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X) :
    partition (quantumIso γ X a) = partition a

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.gibbsFunctional_quantumIso
entries.docstring: **The Gibbs functional is covariant.**
entries.snippet:
lemma gibbsFunctional_quantumIso (γ : Γ) (X : Finset S) (h b : Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X) :
    gibbsFunctional (quantumIso γ X h) (quantumIso γ X b) = gibbsFunctional h b

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Interaction.IsInvariant
entries.docstring: An interaction is *invariant* under `γ` if moving a term gives the term of the moved region.
entries.snippet: def Interaction.IsInvariant (I : Interaction (fun _ : S => Ω₀)) (γ : Γ) : Prop

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.powersetSmul
entries.docstring: The bijection between the regions of a box and the regions of the moved box.
entries.snippet: def powersetSmul (γ : Γ) (Λ : Finset S) : Λ.powerset ≃ (γ • Λ).powerset where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Interaction.hamiltonian_smul
entries.docstring:
**The Hamiltonian of a moved box**: for an invariant interaction, moving the Hamiltonian of a
box gives the Hamiltonian of the moved box.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Interaction.canonicalState_smul
entries.docstring:
**The canonical ensemble is covariant**: the expectation of a moved observable in the
ensemble of the moved box is the expectation of the observable in the ensemble of the box.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.siteSmul
entries.docstring: The bijection between the sites of a box and the sites of the moved box.
entries.snippet: def siteSmul (γ : Γ) (Λ : Finset S) : ↥Λ ≃ ↥(γ • Λ) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.chargeOp_smul
entries.docstring: **A uniform charge is moved to the uniform charge of the moved box.**
entries.snippet:
lemma chargeOp_smul (q₀ : Ω₀ → ℝ) (γ : Γ) (Λ : Finset S) :
    quantumIso γ Λ (chargeOp (fun _ : S => q₀) Λ) = chargeOp (fun _ : S => q₀) (γ • Λ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.grandCanonicalOp_quantumIso
entries.docstring:
The charge of a moved box, as a statement about the operator whose weight is the grand
canonical one.
entries.snippet:
lemma grandCanonicalOp_quantumIso (γ : Γ) (Λ : Finset S) (β μ : ℝ) (H N : Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) Λ) :
    quantumIso γ Λ (grandCanonicalOp β μ H N) =
      grandCanonicalOp β μ (quantumIso γ Λ H) (quantumIso γ Λ N)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Interaction.grandCanonicalState_smul
entries.docstring:
**The grand canonical ensemble is covariant**, for an invariant interaction and a uniform
charge.
entries.snippet:
lemma Interaction.grandCanonicalState_smul (I : Interaction (fun _ : S => Ω₀)) {γ : Γ}
    (hI : I.IsInvariant γ) (q₀ : Ω₀ → ℝ) (β μ : ℝ) (Λ : Finset S)
    (a : Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) Λ) :
    I.grandCanonicalState (fun _ : S => q₀) β μ (γ • Λ) (quantumIso γ Λ a) =
      I.grandCanonicalState (fun _ : S => q₀) β μ Λ a

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.quantumNet
entries.docstring:
**The quantum net**: the matrices on the configurations of each region, with `M ↦ M ⊗ 1` as
inclusion.
entries.snippet: def quantumNet : AlgebraNet S where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.CAlg
entries.docstring: The classical algebra of a region: the complex functions on its configurations.
entries.snippet: abbrev CAlg (X : Finset S) : Type _

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.classicalIncl
entries.docstring: A function of the values in `X` is a function of the values in a larger region `Y`.
entries.snippet: def classicalIncl {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) : CAlg Ω X →⋆ₐ[ℂ] CAlg Ω Y where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.classicalNet
entries.docstring: **The classical net**: the functions on the configurations of each region.
entries.snippet: def classicalNet : AlgebraNet S where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.diagonalInclusion
entries.docstring: The classical algebra of a region as the diagonal operators.
entries.snippet: def diagonalInclusion (X : Finset S) : CAlg Ω X →⋆ₐ[ℂ] Alg Ω X where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.diagonalInclusion_incl
entries.docstring:
**The classical net is a subnet of the quantum net**: the diagonal inclusion commutes with the
inclusions of regions.
entries.snippet:
lemma diagonalInclusion_incl {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (f : CAlg Ω X) :
    inclMat h (diagonalInclusion Ω X f) = diagonalInclusion Ω Y (classicalIncl Ω h f)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Interaction
entries.docstring: **An interaction**: a Hermitian operator of each finite region.
entries.snippet:
structure Interaction where
  Φ : ∀ X : Finset S, Alg Ω X
  isHermitian : ∀ X, (Φ X).IsHermitian

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Interaction.hamiltonian
entries.docstring:
**The Hamiltonian of a finite box**: the sum of the lifts to the box of the terms of the
interaction supported inside it.
entries.snippet: def Interaction.hamiltonian (I : Interaction Ω) (Λ : Finset S) : Alg Ω Λ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Interaction.hamiltonian_isHermitian
entries.snippet:
lemma Interaction.hamiltonian_isHermitian (I : Interaction Ω) (Λ : Finset S) :
    (I.hamiltonian Λ).IsHermitian

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclMat_exp
entries.docstring: The lift `M ↦ M ⊗ 1` commutes with the exponential.
entries.snippet:
lemma inclMat_exp {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (a : Alg Ω X) :
    inclMat h (NormedSpace.exp a) = NormedSpace.exp (inclMat h a)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclMat_gibbsWeight
entries.docstring: **The lift of a Gibbs weight is the Gibbs weight of the lift.**
entries.snippet:
lemma inclMat_gibbsWeight {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (a : Alg Ω X) :
    inclMat h (gibbsWeight a) = gibbsWeight (inclMat h a)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Charge
entries.docstring:
A charge: a real number attached to each value of the configuration space of each site, such
as the occupation number of a mode.
entries.snippet: abbrev Charge (Ω : S → Type*)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.chargeOp
entries.docstring:
**The total charge of a box**: the diagonal operator with the value `∑_{x ∈ Λ} q_x(c_x)` on
the configuration `c`.
entries.snippet: def chargeOp (q : Charge Ω) (Λ : Finset S) : Alg Ω Λ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.chargeOp_isHermitian
entries.snippet: lemma chargeOp_isHermitian (q : Charge Ω) (Λ : Finset S) : (chargeOp q Λ).IsHermitian

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Interaction.canonicalState
entries.docstring: **The canonical ensemble of a box** at inverse temperature `β`.
entries.snippet:
def Interaction.canonicalState (I : Interaction Ω) (β : ℝ) (Λ : Finset S) :
    AlgState (Alg Ω Λ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Interaction.grandCanonicalState
entries.docstring:
**The grand canonical ensemble of a box** at inverse temperature `β` and chemical potential
`μ` for the charge `q`.
entries.snippet:
def Interaction.grandCanonicalState (I : Interaction Ω) (q : Charge Ω) (β μ : ℝ)
    (Λ : Finset S) : AlgState (Alg Ω Λ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Interaction.Conserves
entries.docstring:
The interaction conserves the charge: the Hamiltonian of every box commutes with its
total charge.
entries.snippet: def Interaction.Conserves (I : Interaction Ω) (q : Charge Ω) : Prop

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Interaction.grandCanonicalWeight_of_conserves
entries.docstring:
**For a conserved charge the grand canonical weight of a box is its canonical weight times a
fugacity.**
entries.snippet:
lemma Interaction.grandCanonicalWeight_of_conserves (I : Interaction Ω) {q : Charge Ω}
    (hq : I.Conserves q) (β μ : ℝ) (Λ : Finset S) :
    gibbsWeight (grandCanonicalOp β μ (I.hamiltonian Λ) (chargeOp q Λ)) =
      gibbsWeight ((β : ℂ) • I.hamiltonian Λ) *
        NormedSpace.exp (((β * μ : ℝ) : ℂ) • chargeOp q Λ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.invariantLimit
entries.docstring:
**The invariant limit of a state of a uniform lattice system**: the Følner limit of its
averages over the site symmetries.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.invariantLimit_invariant
entries.docstring: **The invariant limit of a state is invariant under the site symmetries.**
entries.snippet:
lemma invariantLimit_invariant (φ : AlgState (uniformNet (S := S) Ω₀).Quasilocal)
    (F : ι → Finset Γ) (hne : ∀ i, (F i).Nonempty) (𝒰 : Ultrafilter ι)
    (hF : IsRightFolner F 𝒰) (γ : Γ) (a : (uniformNet (S := S) Ω₀).Quasilocal) :
    invariantLimit φ F hne 𝒰 (symAction (Ω₀ := Ω₀) γ a) = invariantLimit φ F hne 𝒰 a

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.exists_invariant_state
entries.docstring:
**Existence of invariant states**: if the finite sets of site symmetries are asymptotically
invariant, every state of the quasi-local algebra has an invariant limit state.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_invariant_state (φ : AlgState (uniformNet (S := S) Ω₀).Quasilocal)
    (F : ι → Finset Γ) (hne : ∀ i, (F i).Nonempty) (𝒰 : Ultrafilter ι)
    (hF : IsRightFolner F 𝒰) :
    ∃ ψ : AlgState (uniformNet (S := S) Ω₀).Quasilocal,
      ∀ (γ : Γ) a, ψ (symAction (Ω₀ := Ω₀) γ a) = ψ a

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Interaction.invariantLimitState
entries.docstring:
**The symmetric thermodynamic limit state of the canonical ensemble** of an interaction on a
uniform lattice system.
entries.snippet:
def Interaction.invariantLimitState (I : Interaction (fun _ : S => Ω₀)) (β : ℝ)
    (𝒰₀ : Ultrafilter (Finset S)) (h𝒰₀ : (𝒰₀ : Filter (Finset S)) ≤ atTop) (F : ι → Finset Γ)
    (hne : ∀ i, (F i).Nonempty) (𝒰 : Ultrafilter ι) :
    AlgState (uniformNet (S := S) Ω₀).Quasilocal

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Interaction.invariantLimitState_invariant
entries.docstring: The symmetric limit state of an interaction is invariant under the site symmetries.
entries.snippet:
lemma Interaction.invariantLimitState_invariant (I : Interaction (fun _ : S => Ω₀)) (β : ℝ)
    (𝒰₀ : Ultrafilter (Finset S)) (h𝒰₀ : (𝒰₀ : Filter (Finset S)) ≤ atTop) (F : ι → Finset Γ)
    (hne : ∀ i, (F i).Nonempty) (𝒰 : Ultrafilter ι) (hF : IsRightFolner F 𝒰) (γ : Γ)
    (a : (uniformNet (S := S) Ω₀).Quasilocal) :
    I.invariantLimitState β 𝒰₀ h𝒰₀ F hne 𝒰 (symAction (Ω₀ := Ω₀) γ a) =
      I.invariantLimitState β 𝒰₀ h𝒰₀ F hne 𝒰 a

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.matrix_exists_sumSq
entries.docstring:
In a matrix algebra every `a* a` lies below a multiple of the identity by a sum of
squares.
entries.snippet:
lemma matrix_exists_sumSq {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (a : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, ∃ p ∈ sumSq (Matrix n n ℂ), star a * a + p = (c : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.quantumNet_isLocallyBounded
entries.docstring: **The net of operators is locally bounded.**
entries.snippet: lemma quantumNet_isLocallyBounded : (quantumNet Ω).IsLocallyBounded

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Interaction.canonicalLimitState
entries.docstring:
**The thermodynamic limit state of the canonical ensemble** along an ultrafilter of boxes:
a state of the infinite system.
entries.snippet:
def Interaction.canonicalLimitState (I : Interaction Ω) (β : ℝ) (𝒰 : Ultrafilter (Finset S))
    (h𝒰 : (𝒰 : Filter (Finset S)) ≤ atTop) : AlgState (quantumNet Ω).Quasilocal

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Interaction.grandCanonicalLimitState
entries.docstring:
**The thermodynamic limit state of the grand canonical ensemble** along an ultrafilter of
boxes.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Interaction.canonicalLimitState_of
entries.docstring:
The limit state of the canonical ensemble on a local observable is the limit of the box
expectations.
entries.snippet:
lemma Interaction.canonicalLimitState_of (I : Interaction Ω) (β : ℝ) (𝒰 : Ultrafilter (Finset S))
    (h𝒰 : (𝒰 : Filter (Finset S)) ≤ atTop) (X : Finset S) (a : Alg Ω X) :
    Tendsto (localSeq (N := quantumNet Ω) (fun Λ => I.canonicalState β Λ) X a) 𝒰
      (nhds (I.canonicalLimitState β 𝒰 h𝒰 ((quantumNet Ω).of X a)))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Cfg
entries.docstring:
The configurations of a region: a value of the local configuration space at each of its
sites.
entries.snippet: abbrev Cfg (X : Finset S) : Type _

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.restr
entries.docstring: The restriction of a configuration of a region to a subregion.
entries.snippet: abbrev restr {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (c : Cfg Ω Y) : Cfg Ω X

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Agree
entries.docstring: Two configurations of a region agree outside a subregion.
entries.snippet: def Agree {X Y : Finset S} (_h : X ≤ Y) (c c' : Cfg Ω Y) : Prop

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.«instance@4b3bfb02»
entries.snippet: instance {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (c c' : Cfg Ω Y) : Decidable (Agree h c c')

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.glue
entries.docstring: Replace the values of `c` inside the subregion `X` by those of `a`.
entries.snippet: def glue {X Y : Finset S} (_h : X ≤ Y) (c : Cfg Ω Y) (a : Cfg Ω X) : Cfg Ω Y

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.restr_glue
entries.snippet:
lemma restr_glue {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (c : Cfg Ω Y) (a : Cfg Ω X) :
    restr h (glue h c a) = a

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.agree_glue
entries.snippet:
lemma agree_glue {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (c : Cfg Ω Y) (a : Cfg Ω X) :
    Agree h c (glue h c a)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.agree_iff_glue
entries.snippet:
lemma agree_iff_glue {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) {c c' : Cfg Ω Y} :
    Agree h c c' ↔ glue h c (restr h c') = c'

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.agree_refl
entries.snippet: lemma agree_refl {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (c : Cfg Ω Y) : Agree h c c

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Agree.symm
entries.snippet:
lemma Agree.symm {X Y : Finset S} {h : X ≤ Y} {c c' : Cfg Ω Y} (hc : Agree h c c') :
    Agree h c' c

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Agree.trans
entries.snippet:
lemma Agree.trans {X Y : Finset S} {h : X ≤ Y} {c c' c'' : Cfg Ω Y} (hc : Agree h c c')
    (hc' : Agree h c' c'') : Agree h c c''

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.eq_of_agree_of_restr_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_of_agree_of_restr_eq {X Y : Finset S} {h : X ≤ Y} {c c' : Cfg Ω Y} (hc : Agree h c c')
    (hr : restr h c = restr h c') : c = c'

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Alg
entries.docstring: The operators on the sites of a region: matrices indexed by configurations.
entries.snippet: abbrev Alg (X : Finset S) : Type _

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclMat
entries.docstring:
The operator `M ⊗ 1` on a larger region: `M` on the sites of `X` and the identity on the other
sites.
entries.snippet: def inclMat {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (M : Alg Ω X) : Alg Ω Y

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclMat_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma inclMat_apply {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (M : Alg Ω X) (c c' : Cfg Ω Y) :
    inclMat h M c c' = if Agree h c c' then M (restr h c) (restr h c') else 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclMat_one
entries.snippet: lemma inclMat_one {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) : inclMat h (1 : Alg Ω X) = 1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclMat_add
entries.snippet:
lemma inclMat_add {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (M N : Alg Ω X) :
    inclMat h (M + N) = inclMat h M + inclMat h N

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclMat_smul
entries.snippet:
lemma inclMat_smul {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (r : ℂ) (M : Alg Ω X) :
    inclMat h (r • M) = r • inclMat h M

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclMat_conjTranspose
entries.snippet:
lemma inclMat_conjTranspose {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (M : Alg Ω X) :
    inclMat h Mᴴ = (inclMat h M)ᴴ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclMat_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma inclMat_mul {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (M N : Alg Ω X) :
    inclMat h (M * N) = inclMat h M * inclMat h N

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclMat_refl
entries.snippet: lemma inclMat_refl {X : Finset S} (M : Alg Ω X) : inclMat (le_refl X) M = M

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.agree_trans_iff
entries.snippet:
lemma agree_trans_iff {X Y Z : Finset S} (h₁ : X ≤ Y) (h₂ : Y ≤ Z) (c c' : Cfg Ω Z) :
    Agree (h₁.trans h₂) c c' ↔ Agree h₂ c c' ∧ Agree h₁ (restr h₂ c) (restr h₂ c')

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclMat_trans
entries.snippet:
lemma inclMat_trans {X Y Z : Finset S} (h₁ : X ≤ Y) (h₂ : Y ≤ Z) (M : Alg Ω X) :
    inclMat (h₁.trans h₂) M = inclMat h₂ (inclMat h₁ M)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclStarAlg
entries.docstring: The operator `M ⊗ 1` as a unital `*`-homomorphism.
entries.snippet: def inclStarAlg {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) : Alg Ω X →⋆ₐ[ℂ] Alg Ω Y where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.cfgEquiv
entries.docstring: A configuration of the region `γ • X` is a configuration of `X`: read it at `γ • x`.
entries.snippet: def cfgEquiv (γ : Γ) (X : Finset S) : Cfg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) (γ • X) ≃ Cfg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.quantumIso
entries.docstring: The operator of `γ • X` that acts as `M` after moving the configurations back to `X`.
entries.snippet:
def quantumIso (γ : Γ) (X : Finset S) :
    Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X →⋆ₐ[ℂ] Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) (γ • X) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.smul_mono
entries.snippet: lemma smul_mono (γ : Γ) {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) : γ • X ≤ γ • Y

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.restr_cfgEquiv
entries.snippet:
lemma restr_cfgEquiv (γ : Γ) {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y)
    (c : Cfg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) (γ • Y)) :
    restr h (cfgEquiv Γ Ω₀ γ Y c) = cfgEquiv Γ Ω₀ γ X (restr (smul_mono γ h) c)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.agree_cfgEquiv
entries.snippet:
lemma agree_cfgEquiv (γ : Γ) {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y)
    (c c' : Cfg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) (γ • Y)) :
    Agree h (cfgEquiv Γ Ω₀ γ Y c) (cfgEquiv Γ Ω₀ γ Y c') ↔ Agree (smul_mono γ h) c c'

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.quantumIso_incl
entries.docstring: **Naturality**: moving operators commutes with extending them by the identity.
entries.snippet:
lemma quantumIso_incl (γ : Γ) {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (M : Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X) :
    quantumIso γ Y (inclMat h M) = inclMat (smul_mono γ h) (quantumIso γ X M)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.cfgCast
entries.docstring: Transport of configurations along an equality of regions.
entries.snippet:
def cfgCast {X Y : Finset S} (e : X = Y) (c : Cfg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) Y) :
    Cfg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.regionIso
entries.docstring: Transport of operators along an equality of regions.
entries.snippet:
def regionIso {X Y : Finset S} (e : X = Y) :
    Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X →⋆ₐ[ℂ] Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) Y

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.regionIso_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma regionIso_apply {X Y : Finset S} (e : X = Y) (M : Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X)
    (c c' : Cfg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) Y) :
    regionIso e M c c' = M (cfgCast e c) (cfgCast e c')

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.uniformNet
entries.docstring: The quantum net of a system whose sites all carry the same finite configuration space.
entries.snippet: abbrev uniformNet (Ω₀ : Type*) [Fintype Ω₀] [DecidableEq Ω₀] : AlgebraNet S

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.of_regionIso
entries.snippet:
lemma of_regionIso {X Y : Finset S} (e : X = Y) (M : Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X) :
    (uniformNet Ω₀).of Y (regionIso e M) = (uniformNet Ω₀).of X M

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.symAct
entries.docstring:
**The action of a site symmetry on the quasi-local algebra**: an endomorphism that moves the
observables of a region `X` to those of `γ • X`.
entries.snippet:
def symAct (γ : Γ) :
    (uniformNet (S := S) Ω₀).Quasilocal →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (uniformNet (S := S) Ω₀).Quasilocal

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.symAct_of
entries.snippet:
lemma symAct_of (γ : Γ) (X : Finset S) (M : Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X) :
    symAct (Ω₀ := Ω₀) γ ((uniformNet Ω₀).of X M) = (uniformNet Ω₀).of (γ • X) (quantumIso γ X M)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.quantumIso_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma quantumIso_mul (γ₁ γ₂ : Γ) (X : Finset S) (M : Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X) :
    regionIso (mul_smul γ₁ γ₂ X) (quantumIso (γ₁ * γ₂) X M) =
      quantumIso γ₁ (γ₂ • X) (quantumIso γ₂ X M)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.quantumIso_one
entries.snippet:
lemma quantumIso_one (X : Finset S) (M : Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X) :
    regionIso (one_smul Γ X) (quantumIso (1 : Γ) X M) = M

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.symAct_mul
entries.docstring: The action of site symmetries is multiplicative.
entries.snippet:
lemma symAct_mul (γ₁ γ₂ : Γ) :
    symAct (Ω₀ := Ω₀) (S := S) (γ₁ * γ₂) = (symAct γ₁).comp (symAct γ₂)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.symAct_one
entries.snippet: lemma symAct_one : symAct (Ω₀ := Ω₀) (S := S) (1 : Γ) = StarAlgHom.id ℂ _

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.symEquiv
entries.docstring: **A group acting on the sites acts on the quasi-local algebra by automorphisms.**
entries.snippet:
def symEquiv (γ : Γ) : (uniformNet (S := S) Ω₀).Quasilocal ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ]
    (uniformNet (S := S) Ω₀).Quasilocal

entries.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.symAction
entries.docstring:
**The symmetry action** of a group on the sites, as a homomorphism to the automorphisms of the
quasi-local algebra.
entries.snippet:
def symAction : Γ →* ((uniformNet (S := S) Ω₀).Quasilocal ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ]
    (uniformNet (S := S) Ω₀).Quasilocal) where

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.hopping_eq_zero_of_degenerate
entries.docstring: Without hopping, or with a single site, the hopping operator is zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma hopping_eq_zero_of_degenerate (T : TightBindingChain) (h : T.t = 0 ∨ T.N < 2) :
    T.hopping = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bracket_openHamiltonian_position_eq_zero_iff
entries.docstring:
On one chain, the Hamiltonian and the position commute if and only if there is no hopping or
only one site.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracket_openHamiltonian_position_eq_zero_iff (T : TightBindingChain) :
    ⁅T.openHamiltonianObservable, T.positionObservable⁆ = 0 ↔ T.t = 0 ∨ T.N < 2

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.axisBracket_maxCurrentCubeVectorState_ne_zero
entries.docstring:
In the maximal current state of the cube, the expectation of `⁅H, X⁆` is nonzero on each
axis.
entries.snippet:
lemma axisBracket_maxCurrentCubeVectorState_ne_zero (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0)
    (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0) (hNx : 2 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 2 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 2 ≤ Tz.N) (k : Fin 3) :
    Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) k ≠ 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bracket_cubePairs_pair_ne_zero
entries.docstring: The Hamiltonian and the position of one axis of the cube do not commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracket_cubePairs_pair_ne_zero (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0) (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0)
    (hNx : 2 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 2 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 2 ≤ Tz.N) (k : Fin 3) :
    ⁅Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz (0, k), Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz (1, k)⁆ ≠ 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.variance_mul_variance_cubePairs_pos
entries.docstring:
In the maximal current state of the cube, the variances of `H` and `X` of each axis have a
positive product.
entries.snippet:
lemma variance_mul_variance_cubePairs_pos (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0) (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0)
    (hNx : 2 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 2 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 2 ≤ Tz.N) (k : Fin 3) :
    0 < variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz (0, k)) *
      variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz (1, k))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bracket_cubePairs_eq_zero_iff
entries.docstring: Two distinct observables of the cube commute if and only if they lie on different axes.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracket_cubePairs_eq_zero_iff (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0) (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0)
    (hNx : 2 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 2 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 2 ≤ Tz.N) {p q : Fin 2 × Fin 3} (h : p ≠ q) :
    ⁅Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz p, Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz q⁆ = 0 ↔ p.2 ≠ q.2

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.CubeHilbertSpace
entries.docstring: The Hilbert space of the cube: states on the sites `(nx, ny, nz)`.
entries.snippet: abbrev CubeHilbertSpace

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.CubeOperators
entries.docstring: The operators on the Hilbert space of the cube.
entries.snippet: abbrev CubeOperators

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.alongX
entries.docstring: An observable of the chain `Tx` acting on the `x` axis of the cube.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable abbrev alongX (a : Observable (Tx.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] Tx.HilbertSpace)) :
    Observable (Tx.CubeOperators Ty Tz)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.alongY
entries.docstring: An observable of the chain `Ty` acting on the `y` axis of the cube.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable abbrev alongY (b : Observable (Ty.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] Ty.HilbertSpace)) :
    Observable (Tx.CubeOperators Ty Tz)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.alongZ
entries.docstring: An observable of the chain `Tz` acting on the `z` axis of the cube.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable abbrev alongZ (c : Observable (Tz.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] Tz.HilbertSpace)) :
    Observable (Tx.CubeOperators Ty Tz)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bracket_eq_zero_of_mul_comm
entries.docstring: Commuting observables have a vanishing bracket.
entries.snippet:
private lemma bracket_eq_zero_of_mul_comm {A : Type*} [CStarAlgebra A]
    {a b : Observable A} (h : (a : A) * b = b * a) : ⁅a, b⁆ = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bracket_alongX_alongY
entries.docstring: Observables of the `x` and `y` axes commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracket_alongX_alongY (a : Observable (Tx.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] Tx.HilbertSpace))
    (b : Observable (Ty.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] Ty.HilbertSpace)) :
    ⁅Tx.alongX Ty Tz a, Tx.alongY Ty Tz b⁆ = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bracket_alongX_alongZ
entries.docstring: Observables of the `x` and `z` axes commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracket_alongX_alongZ (a : Observable (Tx.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] Tx.HilbertSpace))
    (c : Observable (Tz.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] Tz.HilbertSpace)) :
    ⁅Tx.alongX Ty Tz a, Tx.alongZ Ty Tz c⁆ = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bracket_alongY_alongZ
entries.docstring: Observables of the `y` and `z` axes commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracket_alongY_alongZ (b : Observable (Ty.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] Ty.HilbertSpace))
    (c : Observable (Tz.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] Tz.HilbertSpace)) :
    ⁅Tx.alongY Ty Tz b, Tx.alongZ Ty Tz c⁆ = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.maxCurrentCubeState
entries.docstring: The maximal current state of the cube, the product of those of the three chains.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def maxCurrentCubeState : Tx.CubeHilbertSpace Ty Tz

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.norm_maxCurrentCubeState
entries.snippet: lemma norm_maxCurrentCubeState : ‖Tx.maxCurrentCubeState Ty Tz‖ = 1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.maxCurrentCubeVectorState
entries.docstring: The maximal current state of the cube as a state on its operators.
entries.snippet: noncomputable abbrev maxCurrentCubeVectorState : 𝓢[ℂ, Tx.CubeOperators Ty Tz]

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.variance_alongX
entries.docstring: Along `x`, the cube sees the statistics of the chain `Tx`.
entries.snippet:
lemma variance_alongX :
    variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongX Ty Tz a) =
      variance Tx.maxCurrentVectorState a

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.centeredGramDefect_alongX
entries.snippet:
lemma centeredGramDefect_alongX :
    centeredGramDefect (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongX Ty Tz a)
      (Tx.alongX Ty Tz b) = centeredGramDefect Tx.maxCurrentVectorState a b

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.variance_alongY
entries.docstring: Along `y`, the cube sees the statistics of the chain `Ty`.
entries.snippet:
lemma variance_alongY :
    variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongY Ty Tz b') =
      variance Ty.maxCurrentVectorState b'

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.centeredGramDefect_alongY
entries.snippet:
lemma centeredGramDefect_alongY :
    centeredGramDefect (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongY Ty Tz b')
      (Tx.alongY Ty Tz c') = centeredGramDefect Ty.maxCurrentVectorState b' c'

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.variance_alongZ
entries.docstring: Along `z`, the cube sees the statistics of the chain `Tz`.
entries.snippet:
lemma variance_alongZ :
    variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz b'') =
      variance Tz.maxCurrentVectorState b''

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.centeredGramDefect_alongZ
entries.snippet:
lemma centeredGramDefect_alongZ :
    centeredGramDefect (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz b'')
      (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz c'') = centeredGramDefect Tz.maxCurrentVectorState b'' c''

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatio_alongX
entries.docstring: The `x` axis of the cube carries the constant `C` of the chain `Tx`.
entries.snippet:
lemma uncertaintyRatio_alongX :
    √(variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongX Ty Tz Tx.openHamiltonianObservable) *
      variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongX Ty Tz Tx.positionObservable)) /
        |Tx.a * Tx.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (Tx.N + 1))| = Tx.uncertaintyRatio

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatio_alongY
entries.docstring: The `y` axis of the cube carries the constant `C` of the chain `Ty`.
entries.snippet:
lemma uncertaintyRatio_alongY :
    √(variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongY Ty Tz Ty.openHamiltonianObservable) *
      variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongY Ty Tz Ty.positionObservable)) /
        |Ty.a * Ty.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (Ty.N + 1))| = Ty.uncertaintyRatio

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatio_alongZ
entries.docstring: The `z` axis of the cube carries the constant `C` of the chain `Tz`.
entries.snippet:
lemma uncertaintyRatio_alongZ :
    √(variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz Tz.openHamiltonianObservable) *
      variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz Tz.positionObservable)) /
        |Tz.a * Tz.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (Tz.N + 1))| = Tz.uncertaintyRatio

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.centeredGramDefect_alongX_eq_zero_iff
entries.docstring:
Along `x`, the centered Gram defect vanishes, that is the uncertainty relation is an
equality, iff the axis has `2` or `3` sites.
entries.snippet:
lemma centeredGramDefect_alongX_eq_zero_iff (ht : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ Tx.N) :
    centeredGramDefect (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
      (Tx.alongX Ty Tz Tx.openHamiltonianObservable) (Tx.alongX Ty Tz Tx.positionObservable) = 0 ↔
      Tx.N = 2 ∨ Tx.N = 3

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.centeredGramDefect_alongY_eq_zero_iff
entries.docstring: Along `y`, the uncertainty relation is an equality iff the axis has `2` or `3` sites.
entries.snippet:
lemma centeredGramDefect_alongY_eq_zero_iff (ht : Ty.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ Ty.N) :
    centeredGramDefect (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
      (Tx.alongY Ty Tz Ty.openHamiltonianObservable) (Tx.alongY Ty Tz Ty.positionObservable) = 0 ↔
      Ty.N = 2 ∨ Ty.N = 3

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.centeredGramDefect_alongZ_eq_zero_iff
entries.docstring: Along `z`, the uncertainty relation is an equality iff the axis has `2` or `3` sites.
entries.snippet:
lemma centeredGramDefect_alongZ_eq_zero_iff (ht : Tz.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ Tz.N) :
    centeredGramDefect (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
      (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz Tz.openHamiltonianObservable) (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz Tz.positionObservable) = 0 ↔
      Tz.N = 2 ∨ Tz.N = 3

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.robertson_schrodinger_cube
entries.docstring:
Robertson–Schrödinger on the cube. From `4 × 4 × 4` on, the uncertainty relation of
the maximal current state is strict on the three axes at once: the centered Gram defect of each
axis is positive.
entries.snippet:
lemma robertson_schrodinger_cube (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0) (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0)
    (hNx : 4 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 4 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 4 ≤ Tz.N) :
    0 < centeredGramDefect (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
        (Tx.alongX Ty Tz Tx.openHamiltonianObservable) (Tx.alongX Ty Tz Tx.positionObservable) ∧
      0 < centeredGramDefect (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
        (Tx.alongY Ty Tz Ty.openHamiltonianObservable) (Tx.alongY Ty Tz Ty.positionObservable) ∧
      0 < centeredGramDefect (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
        (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz Tz.openHamiltonianObservable) (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz Tz.positionObservable)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.conjugatePair

noncomputable def conjugatePair (T : TightBindingChain) :

The six observables of the cube, the conjugate pair `(H, X)` of each axis: `(j, k)` is the

entries.snippet: noncomputable def cubePairs : Fin 2 × Fin 3 → Observable (Tx.CubeOperators Ty Tz)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.axisBracket

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.cubePairs_x
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma cubePairs_x (j : Fin 2) :
    Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz (j, 0) = Tx.alongX Ty Tz (Tx.conjugatePair j)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.cubePairs_y
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma cubePairs_y (j : Fin 2) :
    Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz (j, 1) = Tx.alongY Ty Tz (Ty.conjugatePair j)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.cubePairs_z
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma cubePairs_z (j : Fin 2) :
    Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz (j, 2) = Tx.alongZ Ty Tz (Tz.conjugatePair j)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bracket_swap
entries.docstring: Swapping a bracket flips its sign.
entries.snippet:
private lemma bracket_swap {A : Type*} [CStarAlgebra A] (a b : Observable A) :
    ⁅b, a⁆ = -⁅a, b⁆

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bracket_swap_eq_zero
entries.snippet:
private lemma bracket_swap_eq_zero {A : Type*} [CStarAlgebra A] {a b : Observable A}
    (h : ⁅a, b⁆ = 0) : ⁅b, a⁆ = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bracket_cubePairs_of_ne
entries.docstring: Observables of different axes of the cube commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracket_cubePairs_of_ne {p q : Fin 2 × Fin 3} (h : p.2 ≠ q.2) :
    ⁅Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz p, Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz q⁆ = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.expectation_zero
entries.snippet:
private lemma expectation_zero {A : Type*} [CStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A]
    [StarOrderedRing A] (ω : 𝓢[ℂ, A]) : ω⟨(0 : Observable A)⟩ = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.expectation_neg
entries.snippet:
private lemma expectation_neg {A : Type*} [CStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A]
    [StarOrderedRing A] (ω : 𝓢[ℂ, A]) (a : Observable A) : ω⟨-a⟩ = -ω⟨a⟩

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bracketMatrix_cubePairs
entries.docstring:
In every state of the cube the bracket matrix `Ω` of the six observables is block diagonal,
one antisymmetric `2 × 2` block per axis.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketMatrix_cubePairs (ω : 𝓢[ℂ, Tx.CubeOperators Ty Tz]) :
    bracketMatrix ω (Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz) =
      blockDiagonal fun k => !![0, Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz ω k; -Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz ω k, 0]

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.robertson_det_cube
entries.docstring:
**Robertson's relation on the cube.** In every state of the cube the volume `det Σ` of the
dispersion of the six observables is at least the product of the squared brackets of the three
axes.
entries.snippet:
lemma robertson_det_cube (ω : 𝓢[ℂ, Tx.CubeOperators Ty Tz]) :
    (Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz ω 0 * Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz ω 1 * Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz ω 2) ^ 2 ≤
      (covarianceMatrix ω (Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz)).det

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.covariance_alongX
entries.snippet:
lemma covariance_alongX :
    covariance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongX Ty Tz a) (Tx.alongX Ty Tz b) =
      covariance Tx.maxCurrentVectorState a b

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.covariance_alongY
entries.snippet:
lemma covariance_alongY :
    covariance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongY Ty Tz b') (Tx.alongY Ty Tz c') =
      covariance Ty.maxCurrentVectorState b' c'

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.covariance_alongZ
entries.snippet:
lemma covariance_alongZ :
    covariance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz b'') (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz c'') =
      covariance Tz.maxCurrentVectorState b'' c''

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.covariance_alongX_alongY
entries.docstring: In the maximal current state of the cube the `x` and `y` axes are uncorrelated.
entries.snippet:
lemma covariance_alongX_alongY :
    covariance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongX Ty Tz a) (Tx.alongY Ty Tz b') = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.covariance_alongX_alongZ
entries.docstring: In the maximal current state of the cube the `x` and `z` axes are uncorrelated.
entries.snippet:
lemma covariance_alongX_alongZ :
    covariance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongX Ty Tz a) (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz b'') = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.covariance_alongY_alongZ
entries.docstring: In the maximal current state of the cube the `y` and `z` axes are uncorrelated.
entries.snippet:
lemma covariance_alongY_alongZ :
    covariance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongY Ty Tz b') (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz b'') =
      0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.covarianceMatrix_maxCurrentCubeState
entries.docstring:
In the maximal current state of the cube the covariance matrix `Σ` of the six observables is
block diagonal, the block of each axis being the covariance matrix of its chain.
entries.snippet:
lemma covarianceMatrix_maxCurrentCubeState :
    covarianceMatrix (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz) =
      blockDiagonal ![covarianceMatrix Tx.maxCurrentVectorState Tx.conjugatePair,
        covarianceMatrix Ty.maxCurrentVectorState Ty.conjugatePair,
        covarianceMatrix Tz.maxCurrentVectorState Tz.conjugatePair]

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.det_covarianceMatrix_conjugatePair
entries.docstring:
In the maximal current state of a chain, `det Σ = C² (a t cos (π / (N + 1)))²` for the
pair `(H, X)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma det_covarianceMatrix_conjugatePair (T : TightBindingChain) (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    (covarianceMatrix T.maxCurrentVectorState T.conjugatePair).det =
      T.uncertaintyRatio ^ 2 * (T.a * T.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1))) ^ 2

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.sq_axisBracket_maxCurrentCubeState
entries.docstring:
In the maximal current state of the cube, the bracket of each axis is that of its chain,
`± a t cos (π / (N + 1))`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sq_axisBracket_maxCurrentCubeState :
    (Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) 0 *
        Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) 1 *
        Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) 2) ^ 2 =
      (Tx.a * Tx.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (Tx.N + 1)) *
        (Ty.a * Ty.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (Ty.N + 1))) *
        (Tz.a * Tz.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (Tz.N + 1)))) ^ 2

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.det_covarianceMatrix_maxCurrentCubeState
entries.docstring:
In the maximal current state of the cube, `det Σ = C(x)² C(y)² C(z)² |det Ω|`:
the ratio of the two sides of Robertson's relation is the product of the constants of the three
axes.
entries.snippet:
lemma det_covarianceMatrix_maxCurrentCubeState (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0) (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0)
    (hNx : 2 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 2 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 2 ≤ Tz.N) :
    (covarianceMatrix (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz)).det =
      (Tx.uncertaintyRatio * Ty.uncertaintyRatio * Tz.uncertaintyRatio) ^ 2 *
        (Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) 0 *
          Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) 1 *
          Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) 2) ^ 2

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.robertson_det_maxCurrentCubeState_strict
entries.docstring:
**Robertson's relation is strict in the maximal current state of the cube.** From
`4 × 4 × 4` on, `|det Ω| < det Σ` for the six observables of the cube.
entries.snippet:
lemma robertson_det_maxCurrentCubeState_strict (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0)
    (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0) (hNx : 4 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 4 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 4 ≤ Tz.N) :
    |(bracketMatrix (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz)).det| <
      (covarianceMatrix (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz)).det

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.mandelstamTammRatio_alongX
entries.docstring: Along `x`, the maximal current state of the cube has the ratio `1 / C²` of `Tx`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mandelstamTammRatio_alongX :
    (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)⟨Tx.alongX Ty Tz Tx.currentObservable⟩ ^ 2 /
      (4 * (variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
          (Tx.alongX Ty Tz Tx.openHamiltonianObservable) *
        variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
          (Tx.alongX Ty Tz Tx.positionObservable))) = 1 / Tx.uncertaintyRatio ^ 2

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.mandelstamTammRatio_alongY
entries.docstring: Along `y`, the maximal current state of the cube has the ratio `1 / C²` of `Ty`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mandelstamTammRatio_alongY :
    (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)⟨Tx.alongY Ty Tz Ty.currentObservable⟩ ^ 2 /
      (4 * (variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
          (Tx.alongY Ty Tz Ty.openHamiltonianObservable) *
        variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
          (Tx.alongY Ty Tz Ty.positionObservable))) = 1 / Ty.uncertaintyRatio ^ 2

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.mandelstamTammRatio_alongZ
entries.docstring: Along `z`, the maximal current state of the cube has the ratio `1 / C²` of `Tz`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mandelstamTammRatio_alongZ :
    (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)⟨Tx.alongZ Ty Tz Tz.currentObservable⟩ ^ 2 /
      (4 * (variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
          (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz Tz.openHamiltonianObservable) *
        variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
          (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz Tz.positionObservable))) = 1 / Tz.uncertaintyRatio ^ 2

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.volQuantum
entries.docstring:
The volumetric quantum of the cube `Nx × Ny × Nz`: the product of the dimensional quanta of
its axes, each axis carrying its own `C` (`uncertaintyRatio_alongX`, `uncertaintyRatio_alongY`,
`uncertaintyRatio_alongZ`).
entries.snippet: noncomputable def volQuantum : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.volQuantum_eq_zero_iff
entries.docstring: The volumetric quantum vanishes iff some axis has `2` or `3` sites.
entries.snippet:
lemma volQuantum_eq_zero_iff (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0) (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0)
    (hNx : 2 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 2 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 2 ≤ Tz.N) :
    volQuantum Tx Ty Tz = 0 ↔
      (Tx.N = 2 ∨ Tx.N = 3) ∨ (Ty.N = 2 ∨ Ty.N = 3) ∨ (Tz.N = 2 ∨ Tz.N = 3)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.volQuantum_pos
entries.docstring: From `4 × 4 × 4` on, the volumetric quantum is positive.
entries.snippet:
lemma volQuantum_pos (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0) (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0)
    (hNx : 4 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 4 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 4 ≤ Tz.N) : 0 < volQuantum Tx Ty Tz

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.volQuantum_lt_volQuantum_x
entries.docstring: From `4 × 4 × 4` on, the volumetric quantum grows strictly along `x`.
entries.snippet:
lemma volQuantum_lt_volQuantum_x {Tx' : TightBindingChain} (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hx' : Tx'.t ≠ 0)
    (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0) (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0) (hNx : 4 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 4 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 4 ≤ Tz.N)
    (h : Tx.N < Tx'.N) : volQuantum Tx Ty Tz < volQuantum Tx' Ty Tz

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.volQuantum_lt_volQuantum_y
entries.docstring: From `4 × 4 × 4` on, the volumetric quantum grows strictly along `y`.
entries.snippet:
lemma volQuantum_lt_volQuantum_y {Ty' : TightBindingChain} (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0)
    (hy' : Ty'.t ≠ 0) (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0) (hNx : 4 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 4 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 4 ≤ Tz.N)
    (h : Ty.N < Ty'.N) : volQuantum Tx Ty Tz < volQuantum Tx Ty' Tz

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.volQuantum_lt_volQuantum_z
entries.docstring: From `4 × 4 × 4` on, the volumetric quantum grows strictly along `z`.
entries.snippet:
lemma volQuantum_lt_volQuantum_z {Tz' : TightBindingChain} (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0)
    (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0) (hz' : Tz'.t ≠ 0) (hNx : 4 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 4 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 4 ≤ Tz.N)
    (h : Tz.N < Tz'.N) : volQuantum Tx Ty Tz < volQuantum Tx Ty Tz'

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.volQuantum_lt
entries.docstring: From `4 × 4 × 4` on, the volumetric quantum stays below `(√(π² / 3 - 2) - 1)³`.
entries.snippet:
lemma volQuantum_lt (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0) (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0)
    (hNx : 4 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 4 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 4 ≤ Tz.N) :
    volQuantum Tx Ty Tz < (√(Real.pi ^ 2 / 3 - 2) - 1) ^ 3

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.current
entries.docstring: The current operator `J = i (H X - X H)` of the open chain, the velocity `dX/dt`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def current : T.HilbertSpace →ₗ[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.current_hermitian
entries.docstring: The current operator is hermitian.
entries.snippet:
lemma current_hermitian (ψ φ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    ⟪T.current ψ, φ⟫_ℂ = ⟪ψ, T.current φ⟫_ℂ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_current
entries.docstring: The matrix elements of `J` are those of `H`, weighted by `i` times the hopping distance.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_current (m n : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, T.current |n⟩⟫_ℂ =
      Complex.I * ((T.a * ((n : ℕ) - (m : ℕ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ⟪|m⟩, T.openHamiltonian |n⟩⟫_ℂ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_current_eq
entries.docstring:
The current moves the electron exactly one site, a distance `a`, with amplitude `∓ i a t`;
every other matrix element vanishes.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_current_eq (m n : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, T.current |n⟩⟫_ℂ =
      if (m : ℕ) + 1 = n then -(Complex.I * (T.a * T.t : ℝ))
      else if (n : ℕ) + 1 = m then Complex.I * (T.a * T.t : ℝ) else 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_current_self_of_eigen
entries.docstring: Stationary states carry no current: `⟨ψ|J|ψ⟩ = 0` whenever `H ψ = E ψ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_current_self_of_eigen {ψ : T.HilbertSpace} {E : ℝ}
    (h : T.openHamiltonian ψ = (E : ℂ) • ψ) : ⟪ψ, T.current ψ⟫_ℂ = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_current_localizedState
entries.docstring: A localized electron carries no current: `⟨n|J|n⟩ = 0`.
entries.snippet: lemma inner_current_localizedState (n : Fin T.N) : ⟪|n⟩, T.current |n⟩⟫_ℂ = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.hopping
entries.docstring: The hopping part `K = H - E₀` of the open Hamiltonian: its kinetic energy.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def hopping : T.HilbertSpace →ₗ[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_hopping
entries.docstring: `K` hops between neighbouring sites only, with amplitude `-t`, and has no diagonal.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_hopping (m n : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, T.hopping |n⟩⟫_ℂ = if (m : ℕ) + 1 = n ∨ (n : ℕ) + 1 = m then -(T.t : ℂ) else 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_apply_eq_sum
entries.docstring: An operator in components: `⟨m|A ψ⟩ = ∑ n, ⟨m|A|n⟩ ⟨n|ψ⟩`.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_apply_eq_sum (A : T.HilbertSpace →ₗ[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace) (m : Fin T.N)
    (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) : ⟪|m⟩, A ψ⟫_ℂ = ∑ n, ⟪|m⟩, A |n⟩⟫_ℂ * ⟪|n⟩, ψ⟫_ℂ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.ext_localizedState
entries.docstring: Two vectors with the same components on every site are equal.
entries.snippet: lemma ext_localizedState {ψ φ : T.HilbertSpace} (h : ∀ m, ⟪|m⟩, ψ⟫_ℂ = ⟪|m⟩, φ⟫_ℂ) : ψ = φ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.current_eq_hopping
entries.docstring: The current only sees the hopping: `J = i (K X - X K)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma current_eq_hopping :
    T.current = Complex.I • (T.hopping ∘ₗ T.position - T.position ∘ₗ T.hopping)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_current_hopping
entries.docstring: The matrix elements of `J` are those of `K`, weighted by `i` times the hopping distance.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_current_hopping (m n : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, T.current |n⟩⟫_ℂ =
      Complex.I * ((T.a * ((n : ℕ) - (m : ℕ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ⟪|m⟩, T.hopping |n⟩⟫_ℂ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.current_comp_position_sub
entries.docstring: **Position and current close on the kinetic energy.** `J X - X J = i a² K`.
entries.snippet:
lemma current_comp_position_sub :
    T.current ∘ₗ T.position - T.position ∘ₗ T.current =
      (Complex.I * (T.a : ℂ) ^ 2) • T.hopping

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_hopping_comp_current_sub
entries.docstring: On the hopping, `⟨m|(K J - J K)|n⟩ = i a ∑ k, ⟨m|K|k⟩ ⟨k|K|n⟩ (n + m - 2 k)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_hopping_comp_current_sub (m n : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, (T.hopping ∘ₗ T.current - T.current ∘ₗ T.hopping) |n⟩⟫_ℂ =
      ∑ k, Complex.I * T.a * ⟪|m⟩, T.hopping |k⟩⟫_ℂ * ⟪|k⟩, T.hopping |n⟩⟫_ℂ *
        (((n : ℕ) + (m : ℕ) - 2 * (k : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℂ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.sum_ite_succ_eq
entries.docstring: Counting the left neighbour: `∑ k, [k + 1 = m] = [1 ≤ m]`.
entries.snippet:
private lemma sum_ite_succ_eq (m : Fin T.N) :
    ∑ k : Fin T.N, (if (k : ℕ) + 1 = m then (1 : ℂ) else 0) = if 1 ≤ (m : ℕ) then 1 else 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.sum_ite_eq_succ
entries.docstring: Counting the right neighbour: `∑ k, [m + 1 = k] = [m + 1 < N]`.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.hopping_term_self
