entries.docstring: On the diagonal, a term of `inner_hopping_comp_current_sub` counts the neighbours of `m`.
entries.snippet:
private lemma hopping_term_self (m k : Fin T.N) :
    Complex.I * T.a * ⟪|m⟩, T.hopping |k⟩⟫_ℂ * ⟪|k⟩, T.hopping |m⟩⟫_ℂ *
        (((m : ℕ) + (m : ℕ) - 2 * (k : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      2 * Complex.I * T.a * T.t ^ 2 *
        ((if (k : ℕ) + 1 = m then 1 else 0) - (if (m : ℕ) + 1 = k then 1 else 0))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.hopping_term_ne
entries.docstring:
Off the diagonal every term of `inner_hopping_comp_current_sub` vanishes: two hops from `m`
to `n ≠ m` pass through the midpoint.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.openHamiltonian_comp_current_sub
entries.docstring: The current commutes with `H` as with its hopping part: `H J - J H = K J - J K`.
entries.snippet:
lemma openHamiltonian_comp_current_sub :
    T.openHamiltonian ∘ₗ T.current - T.current ∘ₗ T.openHamiltonian =
      T.hopping ∘ₗ T.current - T.current ∘ₗ T.hopping

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_openHamiltonian_comp_current_sub
entries.docstring:
**The current changes only at the two ends of the chain.** `H J - J H` is diagonal, with
entry `-2 i a t²` on the first site, `2 i a t²` on the last, and `0` inside the chain.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_openHamiltonian_comp_current_sub (m n : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, (T.openHamiltonian ∘ₗ T.current - T.current ∘ₗ T.openHamiltonian) |n⟩⟫_ℂ =
      if m = n then 2 * Complex.I * T.a * T.t ^ 2 *
        ((if 1 ≤ (m : ℕ) then 1 else 0) - (if (m : ℕ) + 1 < T.N then 1 else 0)) else 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.eq_zero_of_hopping_eq_smul
entries.docstring:
**The recurrence of the hopping.** A solution of `K ψ = μ ψ` vanishing on the first site
vanishes: the row `n` fixes `ψ (n + 1)` from `ψ n` and `ψ (n - 1)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_zero_of_hopping_eq_smul (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 0 < T.N) {μ : ℂ} {ψ : T.HilbertSpace}
    (h : T.hopping ψ = μ • ψ) (h0 : ⟪|(⟨0, hN⟩ : Fin T.N)⟩, ψ⟫_ℂ = 0) : ψ = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.eq_zero_of_hopping_eq_smul_of_current_eq_zero
entries.docstring:
**The hopping and the current share no eigenvector.** For `t ≠ 0` and `N ≥ 2`, `K ψ = μ ψ`
and `J ψ = 0` force `ψ = 0`: `X ψ` solves the same recurrence and vanishes on the first site, so
`ψ` lives on the first site, from which `K` moves it.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_zero_of_hopping_eq_smul_of_current_eq_zero (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) {μ : ℂ}
    {ψ : T.HilbertSpace} (hK : T.hopping ψ = μ • ψ) (hJ : T.current ψ = 0) : ψ = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.currentEigenstate
entries.docstring: The current eigenstate `∑ n, iⁿ sin ((n + 1) k π / (N + 1)) |n⟩`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def currentEigenstate (k : ℕ) : T.HilbertSpace

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.currentEigenvalue
entries.docstring: The current `2 a t cos (k π / (N + 1))` of the eigenstate with quantum number `k`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def currentEigenvalue (k : ℕ) : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_currentEigenstate
entries.docstring: The amplitude of the current eigenstate on the site `m`.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_currentEigenstate (k : ℕ) (m : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, T.currentEigenstate k⟫_ℂ =
      Complex.I ^ (m : ℕ) * Real.sin (((m : ℕ) + 1) * (k * Real.pi / (T.N + 1)))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.sum_ite_eq_of_unique
entries.docstring: A sum over the sites picking at most one site.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_ite_eq_of_unique {N : ℕ} (P : Fin N → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (v : ℂ)
    (h : ∀ n n', P n → P n' → n = n') (hv : (∀ n, ¬ P n) → v = 0) :
    ∑ n, (if P n then v else 0) = v

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.current_currentEigenstate
entries.docstring: The current eigenstates satisfy `J ψ_k = 2 a t cos (k π / (N + 1)) ψ_k`.
entries.snippet:
lemma current_currentEigenstate (k : ℕ) :
    T.current (T.currentEigenstate k) =
      (T.currentEigenvalue k : ℂ) • T.currentEigenstate k

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.sum_cos_eq_zero
entries.docstring: The cosines `cos (2 j k π / (N + 1))` sum to zero over `j < N + 1` for `1 ≤ k ≤ N`.
entries.snippet:
private lemma sum_cos_eq_zero {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkN : k ≤ T.N) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (T.N + 1), Real.cos (2 * (j * (k * Real.pi / (T.N + 1)))) = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.sum_sin_sq
entries.docstring: The squared sines `sin² (j k π / (N + 1))` sum to `(N + 1) / 2` over `j < N + 1`.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.norm_sq_currentEigenstate
entries.docstring: The current eigenstates have squared norm `(N + 1) / 2` for `1 ≤ k ≤ N`.
entries.snippet:
lemma norm_sq_currentEigenstate {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkN : k ≤ T.N) :
    ‖T.currentEigenstate k‖ ^ 2 = (T.N + 1) / 2

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.currentObservable
entries.docstring: The current `J = i (H X - X H)` as an observable.
entries.snippet: noncomputable abbrev currentObservable

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.coe_bracket_openHamiltonian_position
entries.docstring:
The bracket of the Hamiltonian and the position is minus half the current:
`⁅H, X⁆ = -J / 2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma coe_bracket_openHamiltonian_position :
    ((⁅T.openHamiltonianObservable, T.positionObservable⁆ : Observable _) :
      T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace) =
      (-(1 / 2) : ℂ) • (T.currentObservable : T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.expectation_bracket_openHamiltonian_position
entries.docstring: The expected bracket is minus half the expected current.
entries.snippet:
lemma expectation_bracket_openHamiltonian_position
    (ω : 𝓢[ℂ, T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace]) :
    ω⟨⁅T.openHamiltonianObservable, T.positionObservable⁆⟩ = -(ω⟨T.currentObservable⟩ / 2)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.sq_expectation_current_le
entries.docstring: In every state, `⟨J⟩² ≤ 4 Var H · Var X`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sq_expectation_current_le :
    ω⟨T.currentObservable⟩ ^ 2 ≤
      4 * (variance ω T.openHamiltonianObservable * variance ω T.positionObservable)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.mandelstam_tamm
entries.docstring:
**Mandelstam–Tamm.** The position moves no faster than the energy spread allows:
`|d⟨X⟩/dt| = |⟨J⟩| ≤ 2 ΔH ΔX`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mandelstam_tamm :
    |ω⟨T.currentObservable⟩| ≤
      2 * (√(variance ω T.openHamiltonianObservable) * √(variance ω T.positionObservable))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.cramer_rao
entries.docstring:
**Quantum Cramér–Rao.** For a displacement generated by `H`, the error-propagation Fisher
information `⟨J⟩² / Var X` of the position is at most `4 Var H`, the quantum Fisher information
of a pure state.
entries.snippet:
lemma cramer_rao :
    ω⟨T.currentObservable⟩ ^ 2 / variance ω T.positionObservable ≤
      4 * variance ω T.openHamiltonianObservable

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.mandelstamTammRatio
entries.docstring:
The Mandelstam–Tamm ratio `⟨J⟩² / (4 Var H · Var X)`: how close a state comes to both
Mandelstam–Tamm and Cramér–Rao.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def mandelstamTammRatio : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.mandelstamTammRatio_le_one
entries.docstring: The Mandelstam–Tamm ratio never exceeds one.
entries.snippet: lemma mandelstamTammRatio_le_one : T.mandelstamTammRatio ω ≤ 1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.maxCurrent
entries.docstring: The largest current `2 |a t| cos (π / (N + 1))` of the open chain.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def maxCurrent : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.abs_currentEigenvalue_le
entries.docstring: Every current eigenvalue is at most `maxCurrent` in absolute value.
entries.snippet:
lemma abs_currentEigenvalue_le {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkN : k ≤ T.N) :
    |T.currentEigenvalue k| ≤ T.maxCurrent

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.currentBasisVec
entries.docstring: The normalized current eigenstates `ψ_{k+1}`, `k < N`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def currentBasisVec (k : Fin T.N) : T.HilbertSpace

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.norm_currentBasisVec
entries.snippet: lemma norm_currentBasisVec (k : Fin T.N) : ‖T.currentBasisVec k‖ = 1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.orthonormal_currentBasisVec
entries.docstring: The normalized current eigenstates are orthonormal.
entries.snippet: lemma orthonormal_currentBasisVec (ht : T.t ≠ 0) : Orthonormal ℂ T.currentBasisVec

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.currentBasis
entries.docstring: The orthonormal basis of normalized current eigenstates.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def currentBasis (ht : T.t ≠ 0) : OrthonormalBasis (Fin T.N) ℂ T.HilbertSpace

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.current_currentBasis
entries.docstring: The current on the basis of current eigenstates.
entries.snippet:
lemma current_currentBasis (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (k : Fin T.N) :
    T.current (T.currentBasis ht k) =
      (T.currentEigenvalue ((k : ℕ) + 1) : ℂ) • T.currentBasis ht k

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.re_inner_current_eq_sum
entries.docstring:
The mean current in the basis of current eigenstates:
`re ⟨ψ|J|ψ⟩ = ∑ k, λ_k |⟨k|ψ⟩|²`.
entries.snippet:
lemma re_inner_current_eq_sum (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    (⟪ψ, T.current ψ⟫_ℂ).re =
      ∑ k : Fin T.N, T.currentEigenvalue ((k : ℕ) + 1) * ‖⟪T.currentBasis ht k, ψ⟫_ℂ‖ ^ 2

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.abs_re_inner_current_le
entries.docstring: In every vector, `|re ⟨ψ|J|ψ⟩| ≤ maxCurrent ‖ψ‖²`.
entries.snippet:
lemma abs_re_inner_current_le (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    |(⟪ψ, T.current ψ⟫_ℂ).re| ≤ T.maxCurrent * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.abs_expectation_current_le
entries.docstring:
**Speed limit.** In every state, `|⟨J⟩| ≤ maxCurrent`: no state of the open chain moves
faster than `2 |a t| cos (π / (N + 1))`.
entries.snippet:
lemma abs_expectation_current_le (ht : T.t ≠ 0)
    (ω : 𝓢[ℂ, T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace]) :
    |ω⟨T.currentObservable⟩| ≤ T.maxCurrent

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.expectation_current_maxCurrentState
entries.docstring: The maximal current state carries the current `⟨J⟩ = 2 a t cos (π / (N + 1))`.
entries.snippet:
lemma expectation_current_maxCurrentState :
    T.maxCurrentVectorState⟨T.currentObservable⟩ =
      2 * (T.a * T.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.abs_expectation_current_maxCurrentState
entries.docstring: The maximal current state moves at the speed limit.
entries.snippet:
lemma abs_expectation_current_maxCurrentState :
    |T.maxCurrentVectorState⟨T.currentObservable⟩| = T.maxCurrent

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.timeReversal
entries.docstring: Time reversal: complex conjugation of the amplitudes.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def timeReversal (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) : T.HilbertSpace

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.timeReversal_val
entries.snippet:
lemma timeReversal_val (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) (n : Fin T.N) :
    (T.timeReversal ψ).val n = (starRingEnd ℂ) (ψ.val n)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.timeReversal_sub
entries.snippet:
lemma timeReversal_sub (ψ φ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    T.timeReversal (ψ - φ) = T.timeReversal ψ - T.timeReversal φ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.timeReversal_smul
entries.snippet:
lemma timeReversal_smul (c : ℂ) (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    T.timeReversal (c • ψ) = (starRingEnd ℂ) c • T.timeReversal ψ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.timeReversal_real_smul
entries.snippet:
lemma timeReversal_real_smul (r : ℝ) (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    T.timeReversal (r • ψ) = r • T.timeReversal ψ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_timeReversal
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_timeReversal (ψ φ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    ⟪T.timeReversal ψ, T.timeReversal φ⟫_ℂ = (starRingEnd ℂ) ⟪ψ, φ⟫_ℂ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.norm_timeReversal
entries.snippet: lemma norm_timeReversal (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) : ‖T.timeReversal ψ‖ = ‖ψ‖

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.apply_timeReversal
entries.docstring: An operator with real matrix elements commutes with time reversal.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.openHamiltonian_timeReversal
entries.snippet:
lemma openHamiltonian_timeReversal (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    T.openHamiltonian (T.timeReversal ψ) = T.timeReversal (T.openHamiltonian ψ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.position_timeReversal
entries.snippet:
lemma position_timeReversal (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    T.position (T.timeReversal ψ) = T.timeReversal (T.position ψ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.current_timeReversal
entries.docstring: Time reversal reverses the current.
entries.snippet:
lemma current_timeReversal (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    T.current (T.timeReversal ψ) = -T.timeReversal (T.current ψ)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.currentEigenvalue_le_one
entries.docstring: For `t ≥ 0`, the current eigenstate with `k = 1` carries the largest current.
entries.snippet:
lemma currentEigenvalue_le_one (ht : 0 ≤ T.t) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkN : k ≤ T.N) :
    T.currentEigenvalue k ≤ T.currentEigenvalue 1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_openHamiltonian_currentEigenstate
entries.docstring:
The Hamiltonian on the current eigenstates:
`⟨m|H ψ_k⟩ = E0 ⟨m|ψ_k⟩ - 2 t sin θ iᵐ⁺¹ cos ((m + 1) θ)` with `θ = k π / (N + 1)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_openHamiltonian_currentEigenstate (k : ℕ) (m : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, T.openHamiltonian (T.currentEigenstate k)⟫_ℂ =
      T.E0 * ⟪|m⟩, T.currentEigenstate k⟫_ℂ - 2 * T.t * Real.sin (k * Real.pi / (T.N + 1)) *
        Complex.I ^ ((m : ℕ) + 1) * Real.cos (((m : ℕ) + 1) * (k * Real.pi / (T.N + 1)))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.maxCurrentState
entries.docstring: The maximal current state: the current eigenstate with `k = 1`, times `√(2 / (N + 1))`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def maxCurrentState : T.HilbertSpace

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.norm_maxCurrentState
entries.docstring: The maximal current state has norm one.
entries.snippet: lemma norm_maxCurrentState : ‖T.maxCurrentState‖ = 1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_maxCurrentState
entries.docstring: The amplitude of the maximal current state on the site `m`.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_maxCurrentState (m : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, T.maxCurrentState⟫_ℂ = (√(2 / (T.N + 1)) : ℝ) *
      (Complex.I ^ (m : ℕ) * Real.sin (((m : ℕ) + 1) * (Real.pi / (T.N + 1))))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_openHamiltonian_maxCurrentState
entries.docstring: The Hamiltonian on the maximal current state, site by site.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_openHamiltonian_maxCurrentState (m : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, T.openHamiltonian T.maxCurrentState⟫_ℂ = T.E0 * ⟪|m⟩, T.maxCurrentState⟫_ℂ -
      (√(2 / (T.N + 1)) : ℝ) * (2 * T.t * Real.sin (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)) *
        Complex.I ^ ((m : ℕ) + 1) * Real.cos (((m : ℕ) + 1) * (Real.pi / (T.N + 1))))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.current_maxCurrentState
entries.docstring: The maximal current state carries the current `2 a t cos (π / (N + 1))`.
entries.snippet:
lemma current_maxCurrentState :
    T.current T.maxCurrentState = (T.currentEigenvalue 1 : ℂ) • T.maxCurrentState

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.maxCurrentVectorState
entries.docstring: The maximal current state as a state on the operators of the chain.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable abbrev maxCurrentVectorState :
    𝓢[ℂ, T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace]

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.expectation_maxCurrentState
entries.docstring: Expectations in the maximal current state are real parts of its diagonal matrix elements.
entries.snippet:
lemma expectation_maxCurrentState (A : Observable (T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace)) :
    T.maxCurrentVectorState⟨A⟩ =
      (⟪T.maxCurrentState, (A : T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace) T.maxCurrentState⟫_ℂ).re

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.conj_I_pow_mul
entries.docstring: `conj (iᵐ) iᵐ = 1`.
entries.snippet: private lemma conj_I_pow_mul (m : ℕ) : (starRingEnd ℂ) (Complex.I ^ m) * Complex.I ^ m = 1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.sum_norm_sq_inner_maxCurrentState
entries.docstring: The squared amplitudes of the maximal current state add up to one.
entries.snippet:
private lemma sum_norm_sq_inner_maxCurrentState :
    ∑ m, ‖⟪|m⟩, T.maxCurrentState⟫_ℂ‖ ^ 2 = 1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.expectation_openHamiltonian_maxCurrentState
entries.docstring: The maximal current state sits at the centre of the band, `⟨H⟩ = E0`.
entries.snippet:
lemma expectation_openHamiltonian_maxCurrentState :
    T.maxCurrentVectorState⟨T.openHamiltonianObservable⟩ = T.E0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.expectation_position_maxCurrentState
entries.docstring: The maximal current state sits at the centre of the chain, `⟨X⟩ = a (N - 1) / 2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma expectation_position_maxCurrentState :
    T.maxCurrentVectorState⟨T.positionObservable⟩ = T.a * (T.N - 1) / 2

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.expectation_bracket_maxCurrentState
entries.docstring: The bracket of the maximal current state: `⟨⁅H, X⁆⟩ = -a t cos (π / (N + 1))`.
entries.snippet:
lemma expectation_bracket_maxCurrentState :
    T.maxCurrentVectorState⟨⁅T.openHamiltonianObservable, T.positionObservable⁆⟩ =
      -(T.a * T.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.robertson_schrodinger_maxCurrentState
entries.docstring:
**Energy–position uncertainty of the maximal current state.**
`Cov(H, X)² + (a t cos (π / (N + 1)))² ≤ Var H · Var X` in the maximal current state.
entries.snippet:
lemma robertson_schrodinger_maxCurrentState :
    covariance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable T.positionObservable ^ 2 +
        (T.a * T.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1))) ^ 2 ≤
      variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable *
        variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.positionObservable

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.fluctuationAngle
entries.docstring:
The fluctuation angle: the angle between the energy and position fluctuations in the maximal
current state, `arccos (‖ω(δH δX)‖ / (σ_H σ_X))`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def fluctuationAngle : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.fluctuationAngle_eq
entries.docstring: The fluctuation angle: `cos θ = 1 / C`.
entries.snippet:
lemma fluctuationAngle_eq (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    T.fluctuationAngle = Real.arccos (1 / T.uncertaintyRatio)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.fluctuationAngle_eq_zero_iff
entries.docstring: The fluctuation angle vanishes exactly for `N = 2` and `N = 3`.
entries.snippet:
lemma fluctuationAngle_eq_zero_iff (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    T.fluctuationAngle = 0 ↔ T.N = 2 ∨ T.N = 3

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.fluctuationAngle_pos
entries.docstring: From four sites on, the fluctuation angle is open.
entries.snippet: lemma fluctuationAngle_pos (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) : 0 < T.fluctuationAngle

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.arccos_inv_lt
entries.snippet:
private lemma arccos_inv_lt {C C' : ℝ} (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hCC' : C < C') :
    Real.arccos (1 / C) < Real.arccos (1 / C')

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.fluctuationAngle_lt_fluctuationAngle
entries.docstring: From four sites on, the fluctuation angle grows strictly with the number of sites.
entries.snippet:
lemma fluctuationAngle_lt_fluctuationAngle {T T' : TightBindingChain} (ht : T.t ≠ 0)
    (ht' : T'.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) (hNN' : T.N < T'.N) :
    T.fluctuationAngle < T'.fluctuationAngle

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.fluctuationAngle_lt
entries.docstring: From four sites on, the fluctuation angle stays below `arccos (1 / √(π² / 3 - 2))`.
entries.snippet:
lemma fluctuationAngle_lt (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) :
    T.fluctuationAngle < Real.arccos (1 / √(Real.pi ^ 2 / 3 - 2))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.dimQuantum
entries.docstring: The dimensional quantum of the chain: the excess `C - 1` over saturation.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def dimQuantum : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.dimQuantum_nonneg
entries.snippet: lemma dimQuantum_nonneg (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) : 0 ≤ T.dimQuantum

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.dimQuantum_eq_zero_iff
entries.docstring: The dimensional quantum vanishes exactly for `N = 2` and `N = 3`.
entries.snippet:
lemma dimQuantum_eq_zero_iff (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    T.dimQuantum = 0 ↔ T.N = 2 ∨ T.N = 3

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.dimQuantum_pos
entries.docstring: From four sites on, the dimensional quantum is positive.
entries.snippet: lemma dimQuantum_pos (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) : 0 < T.dimQuantum

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.dimQuantum_lt_dimQuantum
entries.docstring: From four sites on, the dimensional quantum grows strictly with the number of sites.
entries.snippet:
lemma dimQuantum_lt_dimQuantum {T T' : TightBindingChain} (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (ht' : T'.t ≠ 0)
    (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) (hNN' : T.N < T'.N) : T.dimQuantum < T'.dimQuantum

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.dimQuantum_lt
entries.docstring: From four sites on, the dimensional quantum stays below `√(π² / 3 - 2) - 1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma dimQuantum_lt (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) :
    T.dimQuantum < √(Real.pi ^ 2 / 3 - 2) - 1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.fluctuationAngle_eq_dimQuantum
entries.docstring: The dimensional quantum fixes the fluctuation angle: `θ = arccos (1 / (1 + δ))`.
entries.snippet:
lemma fluctuationAngle_eq_dimQuantum (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    T.fluctuationAngle = Real.arccos (1 / (1 + T.dimQuantum))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatioSqForm
entries.docstring: The closed form of `C²` as a function of `n = N + 1`, written with `sinc`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def uncertaintyRatioSqForm (n : ℝ) : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.tendsto_uncertaintyRatioSqForm
entries.docstring: The closed form tends to `π² / 3 - 2` as `n → ∞`.
entries.snippet:
lemma tendsto_uncertaintyRatioSqForm :
    Tendsto uncertaintyRatioSqForm atTop (𝓝 (Real.pi ^ 2 / 3 - 2))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatio_sq_eq_uncertaintyRatioSqForm
entries.docstring: For `N ≥ 2`, `C²` is the closed form at `n = N + 1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma uncertaintyRatio_sq_eq_uncertaintyRatioSqForm (T : TightBindingChain) (ht : T.t ≠ 0)
    (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    T.uncertaintyRatio ^ 2 = uncertaintyRatioSqForm (T.N + 1)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.tendsto_uncertaintyRatio
entries.docstring:
**The long chain limit.** Along any family of chains whose number of sites tends to infinity,
the constant `C` of the maximal current state tends to `√(π² / 3 - 2)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma tendsto_uncertaintyRatio {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} (T : ι → TightBindingChain)
    (ht : ∀ i, (T i).t ≠ 0) (hN : Tendsto (fun i => (T i).N) l atTop) :
    Tendsto (fun i => (T i).uncertaintyRatio) l (𝓝 √(Real.pi ^ 2 / 3 - 2))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.one_lt_sqrt_pi_sq_div_three_sub_two
entries.docstring: The limit `√(π² / 3 - 2)` is strictly larger than one, since `π > 3`.
entries.snippet: lemma one_lt_sqrt_pi_sq_div_three_sub_two : 1 < √(Real.pi ^ 2 / 3 - 2)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.cos_le_taylor
entries.snippet: private lemma cos_le_taylor {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : Real.cos x ≤ 1 - x ^ 2 / 2 + x ^ 4 / 24

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.sin_le_taylor
entries.snippet: private lemma sin_le_taylor {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : Real.sin x ≤ x - x ^ 3 / 6 + x ^ 5 / 120

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.remainder
entries.docstring: The remainder of the derivative: a polynomial in `x` and `p = π`, of degree three in `p`.
entries.snippet: private noncomputable def remainder (x p : ℝ) : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bound_poly_neg
entries.docstring:
The remainder with `π` replaced by rational bounds, `3.141592` in the terms of degree one and
two in `p` and `3.141593` in the term of degree three, is negative on `0 ≤ x ≤ 1571 / 2500`:
all thirteen Bernstein coefficients are negative.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.remainder_neg
entries.docstring: The remainder `P(x, π)` of the derivative is negative for `0 ≤ x ≤ 1571 / 2500`.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.angleForm
entries.docstring: The closed form of `C²` in the angle `x = π / n`.
entries.snippet: private noncomputable def angleForm (x : ℝ) : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatioSqForm_eq_angleForm
entries.snippet:
private lemma uncertaintyRatioSqForm_eq_angleForm {n : ℝ} (hn : 2 < n) :
    uncertaintyRatioSqForm n = angleForm (Real.pi / n)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.hasDerivAt_angleForm
entries.snippet:
private lemma hasDerivAt_angleForm {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hcos : Real.cos x ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt angleForm
      (((-2 * Real.pi ^ 2 / x ^ 3 + 2 * Real.pi / x ^ 2 + 8 / Real.pi) * Real.sin x ^ 2 *
          Real.cos x + 2 * (Real.pi ^ 2 / x ^ 2 - 2 * Real.pi / x - 4 + 8 * x / Real.pi) *
          Real.sin x + 12 / Real.pi * Real.cos x ^ 3) / (3 * Real.cos x ^ 3)) x

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.deriv_angleForm_neg
entries.snippet:
private lemma deriv_angleForm_neg {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx5 : x ≤ Real.pi / 5) :
    deriv angleForm x < 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.angleForm_strictAntiOn
entries.snippet: private lemma angleForm_strictAntiOn : StrictAntiOn angleForm (Ioc 0 (Real.pi / 5))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatio_nonneg
entries.snippet: private lemma uncertaintyRatio_nonneg : 0 ≤ T.uncertaintyRatio

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatioSqForm_strictMonoOn
entries.docstring: The closed form of `C²` is strictly increasing on `n ≥ 5`, that is, from four sites on.
entries.snippet: lemma uncertaintyRatioSqForm_strictMonoOn : StrictMonoOn uncertaintyRatioSqForm (Ici 5)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatio_lt_uncertaintyRatio
entries.docstring: **Monotonicity.** From four sites on, `C` strictly increases with the number of sites.
entries.snippet:
lemma uncertaintyRatio_lt_uncertaintyRatio {T T' : TightBindingChain} (ht : T.t ≠ 0)
    (ht' : T'.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) (hNN' : T.N < T'.N) :
    T.uncertaintyRatio < T'.uncertaintyRatio

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatio_lt_sqrt_pi_sq_div_three_sub_two
entries.docstring: From four sites on, `C` stays strictly below its long chain limit `√(π² / 3 - 2)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma uncertaintyRatio_lt_sqrt_pi_sq_div_three_sub_two (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) :
    T.uncertaintyRatio < √(Real.pi ^ 2 / 3 - 2)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.mandelstamTammRatio_maxCurrentState
entries.docstring: In the maximal current state the Mandelstam–Tamm ratio is `1 / C²`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mandelstamTammRatio_maxCurrentState :
    T.mandelstamTammRatio T.maxCurrentVectorState = 1 / T.uncertaintyRatio ^ 2

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.mandelstamTammRatio_maxCurrentState_eq_one_iff
entries.docstring: Mandelstam–Tamm and Cramér–Rao are attained in the maximal current state iff `N = 2, 3`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mandelstamTammRatio_maxCurrentState_eq_one_iff (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    T.mandelstamTammRatio T.maxCurrentVectorState = 1 ↔ T.N = 2 ∨ T.N = 3

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.mandelstamTammRatio_maxCurrentState_lt_one
entries.docstring: From four sites on, the maximal current state misses Mandelstam–Tamm and Cramér–Rao.
entries.snippet:
lemma mandelstamTammRatio_maxCurrentState_lt_one (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) :
    T.mandelstamTammRatio T.maxCurrentVectorState < 1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_energyFluctuation_maxCurrentState
entries.docstring: The energy fluctuation of the maximal current state, site by site.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_energyFluctuation_maxCurrentState (m : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, (T.openHamiltonianObservable : T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace) T.maxCurrentState -
      T.maxCurrentVectorState⟨T.openHamiltonianObservable⟩ • T.maxCurrentState⟫_ℂ =
      -((√(2 / (T.N + 1)) : ℝ) * (2 * T.t * Real.sin (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)) *
        Complex.I ^ ((m : ℕ) + 1) * Real.cos (((m : ℕ) + 1) * (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)))))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_positionFluctuation_maxCurrentState
entries.docstring: The position fluctuation of the maximal current state, site by site.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_positionFluctuation_maxCurrentState (m : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, (T.positionObservable : T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace) T.maxCurrentState -
      T.maxCurrentVectorState⟨T.positionObservable⟩ • T.maxCurrentState⟫_ℂ =
      (T.a * ((m : ℕ) - (T.N - 1) / 2) : ℝ) * ⟪|m⟩, T.maxCurrentState⟫_ℂ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.parallel_of_two_or_three
entries.docstring:
In the maximal current state, `(2 m - N + 1) cos θ sin ((m + 1) θ) + (N - 1) sin θ
cos ((m + 1) θ) = 0` on every site when `N = 2, 3`, where `θ = π / (N + 1)`.
entries.snippet:
private lemma parallel_of_two_or_three (h : T.N = 2 ∨ T.N = 3) (m : Fin T.N) :
    (2 * ((m : ℕ) : ℝ) - T.N + 1) * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)) *
        Real.sin (((m : ℕ) + 1) * (Real.pi / (T.N + 1))) +
      (T.N - 1) * Real.sin (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)) *
        Real.cos (((m : ℕ) + 1) * (Real.pi / (T.N + 1))) = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.centeredGramDefect_maxCurrentState_eq_zero_iff
entries.docstring:
In the maximal current state of a chain with `N ≥ 2` sites and hopping `t ≠ 0`, the centered
Gram defect of `H` and `X` vanishes exactly for `N = 2` and `N = 3`.
entries.snippet:
lemma centeredGramDefect_maxCurrentState_eq_zero_iff (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    centeredGramDefect T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable
      T.positionObservable = 0 ↔ T.N = 2 ∨ T.N = 3

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.robertson_schrodinger_maxCurrentState_eq_iff
entries.docstring:
**Saturation.** In the maximal current state of a chain with `N ≥ 2` sites and hopping
`t ≠ 0`, the energy–position uncertainty relation is an equality exactly for `N = 2, 3`.
entries.snippet:
lemma robertson_schrodinger_maxCurrentState_eq_iff (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    covariance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable T.positionObservable ^ 2 +
        (T.a * T.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1))) ^ 2 =
      variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable *
        variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.positionObservable ↔ T.N = 2 ∨ T.N = 3

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.robertson_schrodinger_maxCurrentState_lt
entries.docstring: From four sites on, the uncertainty relation of the maximal current state is strict.
entries.snippet:
lemma robertson_schrodinger_maxCurrentState_lt (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) :
    covariance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable T.positionObservable ^ 2 +
        (T.a * T.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1))) ^ 2 <
      variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable *
        variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.positionObservable

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.covariance_maxCurrentState
entries.docstring: The energy and position fluctuations of the maximal current state are uncorrelated.
entries.snippet:
lemma covariance_maxCurrentState :
    covariance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable T.positionObservable = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.variance_mul_variance_maxCurrentState
entries.docstring:
The uncertainty identity of the maximal current state:
`Var H · Var X = (a t cos (π / (N + 1)))² + defect`.
entries.snippet:
lemma variance_mul_variance_maxCurrentState :
    variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable *
        variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.positionObservable =
      (T.a * T.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1))) ^ 2 +
        centeredGramDefect T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable
          T.positionObservable

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatio
entries.docstring:
The uncertainty ratio `C = √(Var H · Var X) / |a t cos (π / (N + 1))|` of the maximal current
state: the uncertainty product over its Robertson bound.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def uncertaintyRatio : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bound_ne_zero
entries.docstring: The bound `a t cos (π / (N + 1))` is nonzero for `t ≠ 0` and `N ≥ 2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma bound_ne_zero (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    T.a * T.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)) ≠ 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.one_le_uncertaintyRatio
entries.docstring: `C` is at least one.
entries.snippet: lemma one_le_uncertaintyRatio (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) : 1 ≤ T.uncertaintyRatio

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatio_eq_one_iff
entries.docstring: `C` equals one exactly for `N = 2` and `N = 3`.
entries.snippet:
lemma uncertaintyRatio_eq_one_iff (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    T.uncertaintyRatio = 1 ↔ T.N = 2 ∨ T.N = 3

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.one_lt_uncertaintyRatio
entries.docstring: From four sites on, `C` is strictly larger than one.
entries.snippet: lemma one_lt_uncertaintyRatio (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) : 1 < T.uncertaintyRatio

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.robertson_schrodinger_uncertaintyRatio
entries.docstring:
The Robertson–Schrödinger relation through the uncertainty ratio. In the maximal
current state, `Var H · Var X = (a t cos (π / (N + 1)))² + defect`, `C` is at least one, and
it equals one exactly for `N = 2` and `N = 3`.
entries.snippet:
lemma robertson_schrodinger_uncertaintyRatio (ht : T.t ≠ 0)
    (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable *
        variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.positionObservable =
      (T.a * T.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1))) ^ 2 +
        centeredGramDefect T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable
          T.positionObservable ∧
      1 ≤ T.uncertaintyRatio ∧ (T.uncertaintyRatio = 1 ↔ T.N = 2 ∨ T.N = 3)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.sub_one_mul_sum_mul_pow
entries.docstring: Summation by parts against the powers of `z`.

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.sum_sq_mul_pow
entries.docstring: At a root of unity `z ≠ 1` of order `n`, `∑ j < n, (j - n / 2)² zʲ = -2 n z / (z - 1)²`.
entries.snippet:
private lemma sum_sq_mul_pow {z : ℂ} {n : ℕ} (hz : z ^ n = 1) (hz1 : z ≠ 1) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, ((j : ℂ) - n / 2) ^ 2 * z ^ j = -2 * n * z / (z - 1) ^ 2

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.sum_sq_mul_cos
entries.snippet:
private lemma sum_sq_mul_cos :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (T.N + 1), (((j : ℕ) : ℝ) - (T.N + 1) / 2) ^ 2 *
        Real.cos (2 * (j * (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)))) =
      (T.N + 1) / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)) ^ 2)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.sum_sub_sq
CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.sum_sin_sq_sites
entries.docstring: `∑ m, sin² ((m + 1) θ) = (N + 1) / 2` over the sites, for `θ = π / (N + 1)`.
entries.snippet:
private lemma sum_sin_sq_sites :
    ∑ m : Fin T.N, Real.sin (((m : ℕ) + 1) * (Real.pi / (T.N + 1))) ^ 2 = (T.N + 1) / 2

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.variance_openHamiltonian_maxCurrentState
entries.docstring: The energy variance of the maximal current state, `Var H = 4 t² sin² θ (N - 1) / (N + 1)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma variance_openHamiltonian_maxCurrentState :
    variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable =
      4 * T.t ^ 2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)) ^ 2 * (T.N - 1) / (T.N + 1)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.variance_position_maxCurrentState
entries.docstring:
The position variance of the maximal current state,
`Var X = a² (((N + 1)² + 2) / 12 - 1 / (2 sin² θ))`.
entries.snippet:
lemma variance_position_maxCurrentState :
    variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.positionObservable =
      T.a ^ 2 * (((T.N + 1) ^ 2 + 2) / 12 - 1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)) ^ 2))

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatio_sq_eq
entries.docstring:
The closed form of `C²` in the maximal current state, with `θ = π / (N + 1)`:
`C² = 2 (N - 1) / ((N + 1) cos² θ) · (((N + 1)² + 2) / 6 · sin² θ - 1)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma uncertaintyRatio_sq_eq (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    T.uncertaintyRatio ^ 2 = 2 * (T.N - 1) / ((T.N + 1) * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)) ^ 2) *
      (((T.N + 1) ^ 2 + 2) / 6 * Real.sin (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)) ^ 2 - 1)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.flucOf_eq_zero_of_eigen
entries.docstring: A unit eigenvector of `A` with real eigenvalue has no fluctuation in `A`.
entries.snippet:
lemma flucOf_eq_zero_of_eigen {A : T.HilbertSpace →ₗ[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace} {ψ : T.HilbertSpace}
    (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1) {c : ℝ} (h : A ψ = (c : ℂ) • ψ) : T.flucOf A ψ = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.fluc_ne_zero_of_defectOf_pos
entries.docstring: A positive defect forces fluctuations in both `H` and `X`.
entries.snippet:
lemma fluc_ne_zero_of_defectOf_pos {ψ : T.HilbertSpace} (h : 0 < T.defectOf ψ) :
    T.flucOf T.openHamiltonian ψ ≠ 0 ∧ T.flucOf T.position ψ ≠ 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.not_eigen_of_defectOf_pos
entries.docstring: A vector with positive defect is an eigenvector of neither `H` nor `X`.
entries.snippet:
lemma not_eigen_of_defectOf_pos {ψ : T.HilbertSpace} (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
    (h : 0 < T.defectOf ψ) (c : ℝ) :
    T.openHamiltonian ψ ≠ (c : ℂ) • ψ ∧ T.position ψ ≠ (c : ℂ) • ψ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.norm_localizedState
entries.snippet: lemma norm_localizedState (n : Fin T.N) : ‖(|n⟩ : T.HilbertSpace)‖ = 1

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.flucOf_position_localizedState
entries.docstring: A localized electron has no fluctuation in position.
entries.snippet: lemma flucOf_position_localizedState (n : Fin T.N) : T.flucOf T.position |n⟩ = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.exists_neighbour
entries.docstring: Every site of a chain with two sites has a neighbour.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_neighbour (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) (n : Fin T.N) :
    ∃ m : Fin T.N, (m : ℕ) + 1 = n ∨ (n : ℕ) + 1 = m

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.flucOf_openHamiltonian_localizedState_ne_zero
entries.docstring:
**A localized electron fluctuates in energy.** If the chain hops and has two sites,
`H |n⟩ - ⟨H⟩ |n⟩ ≠ 0`: its overlap with a neighbour is `-t`.
entries.snippet:
lemma flucOf_openHamiltonian_localizedState_ne_zero (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N)
    (n : Fin T.N) : T.flucOf T.openHamiltonian |n⟩ ≠ 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_bracket_localizedState
entries.docstring: The bracket `⁅H, X⁆` vanishes in a localized electron.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_bracket_localizedState (n : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|n⟩, ((⁅T.openHamiltonianObservable, T.positionObservable⁆ : Observable _) :
      _ →L[ℂ] _) |n⟩⟫_ℂ = 0

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.robertson_schrodinger_localizedState
entries.docstring:
**Robertson–Schrödinger is empty in a localized electron.** In `|n⟩`, `Var X = 0` and the
centered Gram defect is `0`: both sides of the relation vanish. The energy does not:
`Var H > 0` as soon as the chain hops and has two sites.
entries.snippet:
lemma robertson_schrodinger_localizedState (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) (n : Fin T.N) :
    variance (ofVec (T.norm_localizedState n)) T.positionObservable = 0 ∧
      centeredGramDefect (ofVec (T.norm_localizedState n)) T.openHamiltonianObservable
        T.positionObservable = 0 ∧
      0 < variance (ofVec (T.norm_localizedState n)) T.openHamiltonianObservable

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.meanOf
entries.docstring: The mean `re ⟨ψ|A|ψ⟩` of an operator in a vector.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def meanOf (A : T.HilbertSpace →ₗ[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace) (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.flucOf
entries.docstring: The fluctuation `A ψ - ⟨A⟩ ψ` of an operator in a vector.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def flucOf (A : T.HilbertSpace →ₗ[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace) (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    T.HilbertSpace

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.defectOf
entries.docstring: The centered Gram defect `‖u‖² ‖w‖² - |⟪u, w⟫|²` of `H` and `X` in a vector.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def defectOf (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.continuous_meanOf
entries.snippet: lemma continuous_meanOf (A : T.HilbertSpace →ₗ[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace) : Continuous (T.meanOf A)

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.continuous_defectOf
entries.snippet: lemma continuous_defectOf : Continuous T.defectOf

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.defectOf_nonneg
entries.snippet: lemma defectOf_nonneg (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) : 0 ≤ T.defectOf ψ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.expectation_ofVec
entries.docstring: In a unit vector, the mean is the expectation of the vector state.
entries.snippet:
lemma expectation_ofVec {ψ : T.HilbertSpace} (h : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
    (A : T.HilbertSpace →ₗ[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace) (hA : A.IsSymmetric) :
    (ofVec h)⟨T.toObservable A hA⟩ = T.meanOf A ψ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.centeredGramDefect_ofVec_eq
entries.docstring: In a unit vector, `defectOf` is the centered Gram defect of the vector state.
entries.snippet:
lemma centeredGramDefect_ofVec_eq {ψ : T.HilbertSpace} (h : ‖ψ‖ = 1) :
    centeredGramDefect (ofVec h) T.openHamiltonianObservable T.positionObservable =
      T.defectOf ψ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.minUncertainty
entries.docstring: The unit vectors of minimum uncertainty.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def minUncertainty : Set T.HilbertSpace

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.isCompact_minUncertainty
entries.snippet: lemma isCompact_minUncertainty : IsCompact T.minUncertainty

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.localizedState_mem_minUncertainty
entries.docstring: A localized electron has minimum uncertainty: its position is sharp.
entries.snippet:
lemma localizedState_mem_minUncertainty (n : Fin T.N) : (|n⟩ : T.HilbertSpace) ∈
    T.minUncertainty

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.threshold
entries.docstring: The largest speed `|⟨J⟩|` of a vector of minimum uncertainty.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def threshold : ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.exists_threshold
entries.docstring: The threshold is attained by a vector of minimum uncertainty.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_threshold :
    ∃ ψ ∈ T.minUncertainty, |T.meanOf T.current ψ| = T.threshold

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.le_threshold
entries.snippet:
lemma le_threshold {ψ : T.HilbertSpace} (hψ : ψ ∈ T.minUncertainty) :
    |T.meanOf T.current ψ| ≤ T.threshold

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.threshold_le_maxCurrent
entries.snippet: lemma threshold_le_maxCurrent (ht : T.t ≠ 0) : T.threshold ≤ T.maxCurrent

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.velocityBand
entries.docstring: The velocity band `(threshold, maxCurrent]` of forced uncertainty.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def velocityBand : Set ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.defectOf_pos_of_mem_velocityBand
entries.docstring: In the velocity band, the uncertainty defect is forced.
entries.snippet:
lemma defectOf_pos_of_mem_velocityBand {ψ : T.HilbertSpace} (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
    (hv : |T.meanOf T.current ψ| ∈ T.velocityBand) : 0 < T.defectOf ψ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.velocityBand_eq_empty
entries.docstring: For `N = 2, 3` the maximal current state has minimum uncertainty: the band is empty.
entries.snippet:
lemma velocityBand_eq_empty (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : T.N = 2 ∨ T.N = 3) :
    T.velocityBand = ∅

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.meanOf_timeReversal
CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.meanOf_current_timeReversal
entries.snippet:
lemma meanOf_current_timeReversal (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    T.meanOf T.current (T.timeReversal ψ) = -T.meanOf T.current ψ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.flucOf_timeReversal
CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.defectOf_timeReversal
entries.docstring: Time reversal keeps the uncertainty defect.
entries.snippet:
lemma defectOf_timeReversal (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    T.defectOf (T.timeReversal ψ) = T.defectOf ψ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.defectOf_smul
entries.docstring: A global phase keeps the uncertainty defect.
entries.snippet:
lemma defectOf_smul {c : ℂ} (hc : ‖c‖ = 1) (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    T.defectOf (c • ψ) = T.defectOf ψ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.timeReversal_currentEigenstate_one
entries.docstring: The time reverse of the longest standing wave is the shortest one.
entries.snippet:
lemma timeReversal_currentEigenstate_one :
    T.timeReversal (T.currentEigenstate 1) = T.currentEigenstate T.N

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.currentBasis_zero
entries.docstring: The maximal current state and its time reverse are the extreme current eigenstates.
entries.snippet:
lemma currentBasis_zero (ht : T.t ≠ 0) :
    T.currentBasis ht ⟨0, Nat.pos_of_neZero _⟩ = T.maxCurrentState

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.currentBasis_last
entries.snippet:
lemma currentBasis_last (ht : T.t ≠ 0) :
    T.currentBasis ht ⟨T.N - 1, Nat.sub_lt (Nat.pos_of_neZero _) one_pos⟩ =
      T.timeReversal T.maxCurrentState

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.defectOf_eq_of_meanOf_current_eq
entries.docstring: A unit vector moving at the speed limit has the defect of the maximal current state.
entries.snippet:
lemma defectOf_eq_of_meanOf_current_eq (ht : T.t ≠ 0) {ψ : T.HilbertSpace} (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
    (hv : T.meanOf T.current ψ = T.maxCurrent) :
    T.defectOf ψ = T.defectOf T.maxCurrentState

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.threshold_lt_maxCurrent
entries.docstring: From four sites on, the threshold lies strictly below the speed limit.
entries.snippet: lemma threshold_lt_maxCurrent (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) : T.threshold < T.maxCurrent

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.maxCurrent_mem_velocityBand
entries.docstring: From four sites on, the velocity band is not empty: it contains the speed limit.
entries.snippet:
lemma maxCurrent_mem_velocityBand (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) :
    T.maxCurrent ∈ T.velocityBand

entries.name: Space.div_differentiable_time
entries.snippet:
lemma div_differentiable_time {d} (f : Time → Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 ↿f) (x : Space d) :
    Differentiable ℝ (fun t => (∇ ⬝ f t) x)

entries.name: Space.time_deriv_div_commute
entries.docstring: The divergence and the time derivative commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma time_deriv_div_commute {d} (f : Time → Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 ↿f) (t : Time) (x : Space d) :
    ∂ₜ (fun t => (∇ ⬝ f t) x) t = (∇ ⬝ fun x => ∂ₜ (fun t => f t x) t) x

entries.name: Space.curl_contDiff
entries.snippet:
lemma curl_contDiff {n : WithTop ℕ∞} (f : Space → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ (n + 1) f) : ContDiff ℝ n (∇ ⨯ f)

entries.name: Space.div_mk_eq_sum_fderiv
entries.snippet:
lemma div_mk_eq_sum_fderiv {n : ℕ} (f : Space n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∇ ⬝ f) ⟨x⟩ = ∑ i, fderiv ℝ (fun y : Fin n → ℝ => f ⟨y⟩ i) x (Pi.single i 1)

entries.name: Space.integral_div_box
entries.docstring: The divergence theorem on a coordinate box in `Space`.
entries.snippet:
lemma integral_div_box {n : ℕ} (f : Space (n + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (a b : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hle : a ≤ b) :
    ∫ x in Icc a b, (∇ ⬝ f) ⟨x⟩ =
      ∑ i, ((∫ y in Icc (a ∘ i.succAbove) (b ∘ i.succAbove), f ⟨i.insertNth (b i) y⟩ i) -
        ∫ y in Icc (a ∘ i.succAbove) (b ∘ i.succAbove), f ⟨i.insertNth (a i) y⟩ i)

entries.name: Electromagnetism.ThreeDimension.continuity_of_gauss_ampere
entries.docstring:
Fields `E`, `B`, `ρ` and `J` obeying Gauss's law for the electric field and Ampère's law
obey the continuity equation.
entries.snippet:
lemma continuity_of_gauss_ampere (𝓕 : FreeSpace)
    {E B J : Time → Space → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)} {ρ : Time → Space → ℝ}
    (hE : ContDiff ℝ 2 ↿E) (hB : ∀ t, ContDiff ℝ 2 (B t))
    (hGauss : ∀ t x, (∇ ⬝ E t) x = ρ t x / 𝓕.ε₀)
    (hAmpere : ∀ t x, (∇ ⨯ B t) x = 𝓕.μ₀ • J t x + 𝓕.μ₀ • 𝓕.ε₀ • ∂ₜ (fun t => E t x) t)
    (t : Time) (x : Space) :
    ∂ₜ (fun t => ρ t x) t + (∇ ⬝ J t) x = 0

entries.name: Electromagnetism.ThreeDimension.magneticField_contDiff_space
entries.snippet:
lemma magneticField_contDiff_space (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (t : Time) :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (V.magneticField 𝓕.c t)

entries.name: Electromagnetism.ThreeDimension.continuityEquation
entries.docstring: The continuity equation: Maxwell's equations imply local conservation of charge.
entries.snippet:
theorem continuityEquation (t : Time) (x : Space)
    (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 V J₄) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J₄) :
    ∂ₜ (fun t => J₄.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t x) t + (∇ ⬝ J₄.currentDensity 𝓕.c t) x = 0

entries.name: Electromagnetism.LorentzCurrentDensity.boxFaceCurrent
entries.docstring:
The electric current at time `t` through the face `x i = s` of the coordinate box `[a, b]`,
counted positively in the direction of increasing `x i`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def _root_.Electromagnetism.LorentzCurrentDensity.boxFaceCurrent
    (c : SpeedOfLight) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity 3) (t : Time) (a b : Fin 3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3)
    (s : ℝ) : ℝ

entries.name: Electromagnetism.LorentzCurrentDensity.boxOutwardCurrent
entries.docstring:
The net electric current at time `t` leaving the coordinate box `[a, b]` through its six
faces.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def _root_.Electromagnetism.LorentzCurrentDensity.boxOutwardCurrent
    (c : SpeedOfLight) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity 3) (t : Time) (a b : Fin 3 → ℝ) : ℝ

entries.name: Electromagnetism.ThreeDimension.boxOutwardCurrent_eq
entries.docstring:
The net current leaving the coordinate box `[a, b]` equals minus the rate of change of the
charge inside it.
entries.snippet:
lemma boxOutwardCurrent_eq (t : Time) (a b : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hle : a ≤ b)
    (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 V J₄) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J₄) :
    J₄.boxOutwardCurrent 𝓕.c t a b =
      - ∫ x in Icc a b, ∂ₜ (fun t => J₄.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ⟨x⟩) t

entries.name: Electromagnetism.ThreeDimension.boxOutwardCurrent_eq_zero_of_steady
entries.docstring:
If no charge accumulates inside the coordinate box `[a, b]`, the net current leaving through
its six faces is zero. This is motivated by Kirchhoff's current law, with the box enclosing a
node of a circuit.
entries.snippet:
lemma boxOutwardCurrent_eq_zero_of_steady (t : Time) (a b : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hle : a ≤ b)
    (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 V J₄) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J₄)
    (hsteady : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ∂ₜ (fun t => J₄.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ⟨x⟩) t = 0) :
    J₄.boxOutwardCurrent 𝓕.c t a b = 0

entries.name: Space.distTimeDeriv_distSpaceDiv
entries.docstring: The divergence and the time derivative of distributions commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma distTimeDeriv_distSpaceDiv {d} (f : (Time × Space d) →d[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    distTimeDeriv (distSpaceDiv f) = distSpaceDiv (distTimeDeriv f)

entries.name: Space.exists_schwartz_eq_comp_ray
entries.docstring:
The restriction of a Schwartz function to a line through the origin is a Schwartz
function.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_schwartz_eq_comp_ray {d} (χ : 𝓢(Space d, ℝ)) {w : Space d} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ s : ℝ, g s = χ (s • w)

entries.name: Space.integral_Ioi_fderiv_ray
entries.docstring: The fundamental theorem of calculus along the ray in direction `w`.
entries.snippet:
lemma integral_Ioi_fderiv_ray {d} (ψ : 𝓢(Space d, ℝ)) {w : Space d} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    ∫ s in Ioi (0 : ℝ), fderiv ℝ ψ (s • w) w = - ψ 0

entries.name: Space.integral_Ioi_fderiv_ray_basis
Space.timeIntegralSchwartz_fderiv_space
entries.docstring: Integrating over time commutes with differentiating in space.
entries.snippet:
lemma timeIntegralSchwartz_fderiv_space {d} (η : 𝓢(Time × Space d, ℝ)) (i : Fin d)
    (x : Space d) :
    timeIntegralSchwartz (SchwartzMap.evalCLM ℝ (Time × Space d) ℝ (0, basis i)
      (fderivCLM ℝ (Time × Space d) ℝ η)) x = fderiv ℝ (timeIntegralSchwartz η) x (basis i)

entries.name: Space.exists_integral_time_ne_zero
entries.docstring: Some test function has a non-zero time integral at the origin.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_integral_time_ne_zero {d} :
    ∃ η : 𝓢(Time × Space d, ℝ), ∫ t, η (t, 0) ≠ 0

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistElectromagneticPotential.continuityEquation
entries.docstring:
The continuity equation for distributions: Maxwell's equations imply local conservation of
charge.
entries.snippet:
theorem continuityEquation {d} {𝓕 : FreeSpace} (A : TempDistElectromagneticPotential d)
    (J : TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity d) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J) (ε : 𝓢(Time × Space d, ℝ)) :
    distTimeDeriv (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c) ε + distSpaceDiv (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c) ε = 0

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity.IsWireJunction
entries.docstring:
The current density of `J` is that of steady currents `I k` flowing away from the origin
along thin, straight, semi-infinite wires in the directions `u k`.
entries.snippet:
def IsWireJunction {d} (c : SpeedOfLight) (J : TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity d) {ι : Type}
    [Fintype ι] (u : ι → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (I : ι → ℝ) : Prop

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity.IsWireJunction.distSpaceDiv_currentDensity
entries.docstring:
The wires of a junction meet at the origin, where they act as a source of strength the
total current leaving along them.

entries.name: Electromagnetism.TempDistLorentzCurrentDensity.IsWireJunction.sum_currents_eq_zero
entries.docstring:
If Maxwell's equations hold and no charge accumulates, the steady currents leaving a junction
of thin wires sum to zero. This is motivated by Kirchhoff's current law, of which it is the
special case of a single node.

entries.name: Algebra.range_le_of_adjoin_eq_top
entries.docstring:
If `s` generates `A` and a subalgebra `S` of `B` contains the image of `s`, then it
  contains the whole range of an algebra map `A →ₐ[R] B`.
entries.snippet:
lemma range_le_of_adjoin_eq_top {s : Set A} (hs : Algebra.adjoin R s = ⊤) (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    {S : Subalgebra R B} (h : ∀ x ∈ s, φ x ∈ S) : φ.range ≤ S

entries.name: Algebra.apply_mem_of_mem_adjoin
entries.docstring:
An algebra map carrying a generating set into a subalgebra `S` carries the generated
  subalgebra into `S`. This is what extends the stability of a subalgebra under an
  endomorphism from its generators to all of its elements.
entries.snippet:
lemma apply_mem_of_mem_adjoin {s : Set A} (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) {S : Subalgebra R B}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ s, φ x ∈ S) {x : A} (hx : x ∈ Algebra.adjoin R s) : φ x ∈ S

entries.name: Algebra.commute_of_adjoin_eq_top
entries.docstring:
If `s` generates `A` and `y` commutes with the image of `s` under an algebra map, then
  `y` commutes with the whole image. This is what extends a commutation relation from
  generators to a factor of a tensor product.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_of_adjoin_eq_top {s : Set A} (hs : Algebra.adjoin R s = ⊤) (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    {y : B} (h : ∀ x ∈ s, Commute (φ x) y) (a : A) : Commute (φ a) y

entries.name: Algebra.TensorProduct.mem_of_tmul_one_of_one_tmul
entries.docstring:
A subalgebra of `A ⊗[R] B` containing every `a ⊗ₜ 1` and every `1 ⊗ₜ b` contains
  everything, since a pure tensor is the product of the two.

entries.name: Algebra.TensorProduct.eq_top_of_tmul_one_of_one_tmul
entries.docstring:
A subalgebra of `A ⊗[R] B` containing every `a ⊗ₜ 1` and every `1 ⊗ₜ b` is the whole
  algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_top_of_tmul_one_of_one_tmul {S : Subalgebra R (A ⊗[R] B)}
    (hA : ∀ a : A, a ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B) ∈ S) (hB : ∀ b : B, (1 : A) ⊗ₜ[R] b ∈ S) : S = ⊤

entries.name: Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_mul_comm
entries.docstring:
A commutative right factor is central in the tensor product. Stated as an equation of
  products at abstract types, so that it can be instantiated on a concrete tensor product
  without unifying its multiplication instances.
entries.snippet:
lemma includeRight_mul_comm (b : B) (x : A ⊗[R] B) :
    x * includeRight (R := R) (A := A) b = includeRight (R := R) (A := A) b * x

entries.name: Algebra.TensorProduct.mem_adjoin_one_tmul
entries.docstring:
Extension of scalars on the elements `1 ⊗ₜ a`. If `s` generates `A` over `R` then
  every `1 ⊗ₜ a` lies in the `S`-subalgebra of `S ⊗[R] A` generated by `1 ⊗ₜ s`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_adjoin_one_tmul (hs : Algebra.adjoin R s = ⊤) (a : A) :
    (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] a ∈ Algebra.adjoin S ((fun a : A => (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] a) '' s)

entries.name: Algebra.TensorProduct.mem_adjoin_one_tmul_of_generates
entries.docstring: Every element of a base change lies in the subalgebra generated by the `1 ⊗ₜ s`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_adjoin_one_tmul_of_generates (hs : Algebra.adjoin R s = ⊤) (x : S ⊗[R] A) :
    x ∈ Algebra.adjoin S ((fun a : A => (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] a) '' s)

entries.name: Algebra.TensorProduct.adjoin_one_tmul_eq_top
entries.docstring:
Extension of scalars preserves generation. If `s` generates `A` over `R` then the
  elements `1 ⊗ₜ a`, for `a ∈ s`, generate `S ⊗[R] A` over `S`.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjoin_one_tmul_eq_top (hs : Algebra.adjoin R s = ⊤) :
    Algebra.adjoin S ((fun a : A => (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] a) '' s)
      = (⊤ : Subalgebra S (S ⊗[R] A))

entries.name: LinearMap.mul_swap_of_mul_self
entries.docstring:
Polarization. If every value of a linear map into a ring squares to zero, then any two
  values anticommute. Applied to a space of fermionic generators, this is what makes the
  single relation "every vector squares to zero" carry the anticommutation of distinct
  generators, including generators of different species, which sit in the same space.
entries.snippet:
lemma LinearMap.mul_swap_of_mul_self {R M B : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M]
    [Module R M] [Ring B] [Algebra R B] (f : M →ₗ[R] B) (h : ∀ v, f v * f v = 0) (v w : M) :
    f v * f w = -(f w * f v)

entries.name: DirectSum.mem_of_lof
entries.docstring: If a subalgebra contains the image of every summand, it contains the whole image.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_lof {S : Subalgebra R B} {F : (⨁ i, M i) →ₗ[R] B}
    (h : ∀ i x, F (lof R ι M i x) ∈ S) (v : ⨁ i, M i) : F v ∈ S

entries.name: DirectSum.commute_of_lof_left
entries.docstring:
If the image of every summand commutes with a fixed element, so does the whole
  image.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_of_lof_left {F : (⨁ i, M i) →ₗ[R] B} {b : B}
    (h : ∀ i x, Commute (F (lof R ι M i x)) b) (v : ⨁ i, M i) : Commute (F v) b

entries.name: DirectSum.commute_of_lof
entries.docstring:
Commutation extends from the summands. If the image of every summand of one direct
  sum commutes with the image of every summand of another, then the two images commute
  elementwise.

entries.name: DirectSum.mul_swap_of_lof
entries.docstring: Anticommutation extends from the summands.
entries.snippet:
lemma mul_swap_of_lof {F : (⨁ i, M i) →ₗ[R] B}
    (h : ∀ i j x y, F (lof R ι M i x) * F (lof R ι M j y)
      = -(F (lof R ι M j y) * F (lof R ι M i x)))
    (v w : ⨁ i, M i) : F v * F w = -(F w * F v)

entries.name: DirectSum.mul_self_of_lof
entries.snippet:
lemma mul_self_of_lof {F : (⨁ i, M i) →ₗ[R] B}
    (hsq : ∀ i x, F (lof R ι M i x) * F (lof R ι M i x) = 0)
    (hswap : ∀ i j x y, F (lof R ι M i x) * F (lof R ι M j y)
      = -(F (lof R ι M j y) * F (lof R ι M i x)))
    (v : ⨁ i, M i) : F v * F v = 0

entries.name: DirectSum.mul_self_iff_lof
entries.docstring:
Square-zero on a direct sum is not square-zero summand by summand. It is equivalent to
  square-zero on each summand together with anticommutation between the images of any two
  summands, the second condition being vacuous only when there is at most one summand.
  This is the precise sense in which Fermi statistics for a family of species is more than
  the Fermi statistics of the individual species.
entries.snippet:
lemma mul_self_iff_lof {F : (⨁ i, M i) →ₗ[R] B} :
    (∀ v, F v * F v = 0) ↔
      ((∀ i x, F (lof R ι M i x) * F (lof R ι M i x) = 0) ∧
        ∀ i j x y, F (lof R ι M i x) * F (lof R ι M j y)
          = -(F (lof R ι M j y) * F (lof R ι M i x)))

entries.name: Representation.tprod_apply_one
entries.docstring: The tensor product of two unit-preserving representations preserves the unit.
entries.snippet:
lemma tprod_apply_one {k G A B : Type*} [CommSemiring k] [Monoid G]
    [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [Ring B] [Algebra k B]
    (ρ : Representation k G A) (σ : Representation k G B) (g : G)
    (hρ : ρ g 1 = 1) (hσ : σ g 1 = 1) : (ρ.tprod σ) g 1 = 1

entries.name: Representation.tprod_apply_one_tmul
entries.docstring: On a pure tensor whose left entry is the unit only the right factor moves.
entries.snippet:
lemma tprod_apply_one_tmul {k G A B : Type*} [CommSemiring k]
    [Monoid G] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [Ring B] [Algebra k B]
    (ρ : Representation k G A) (σ : Representation k G B) (g : G)
    (hρ : ρ g 1 = 1) (y : B) :
    (ρ.tprod σ) g ((1 : A) ⊗ₜ[k] y) = (1 : A) ⊗ₜ[k] σ g y

entries.name: Representation.tprod_apply_tmul_one
entries.docstring: On a pure tensor whose right entry is the unit only the left factor moves.
entries.snippet:
lemma tprod_apply_tmul_one {k G A B : Type*} [CommSemiring k]
    [Monoid G] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [Ring B] [Algebra k B]
    (ρ : Representation k G A) (σ : Representation k G B) (g : G) (x : A)
    (hσ : σ g 1 = 1) :
    (ρ.tprod σ) g (x ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : B)) = ρ g x ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : B)

entries.name: Representation.tprod_apply_mul
entries.docstring:
The tensor product of two multiplicative representations on algebras is
  multiplicative.
entries.snippet:
lemma tprod_apply_mul {k G A B : Type*} [CommSemiring k] [Monoid G]
    [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [Ring B] [Algebra k B]
    (ρ : Representation k G A) (σ : Representation k G B)
    (hρ : ∀ (g : G) (x y : A), ρ g (x * y) = ρ g x * ρ g y)
    (hσ : ∀ (g : G) (x y : B), σ g (x * y) = σ g x * σ g y)
    (g : G) (x y : A ⊗[k] B) :
    (ρ.tprod σ) g (x * y) = (ρ.tprod σ) g x * (ρ.tprod σ) g y

entries.name: Representation.restrictSubalgebra
entries.docstring: The restriction of a representation to a subalgebra each group element preserves.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def restrictSubalgebra {k A G : Type*} [CommSemiring k]
    [Monoid G] [Semiring A] [Algebra k A] (ρ : Representation k G A) (S : Subalgebra k A)
    (hS : ∀ (g : G) {x : A}, x ∈ S → ρ g x ∈ S) : Representation k G S where

entries.name: Representation.coe_restrictSubalgebra
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coe_restrictSubalgebra {k A G : Type*} [CommSemiring k]
    [Monoid G] [Semiring A] [Algebra k A] (ρ : Representation k G A) (S : Subalgebra k A)
    (hS : ∀ (g : G) {x : A}, x ∈ S → ρ g x ∈ S) (g : G) (x : S) :
    (ρ.restrictSubalgebra S hS g x : A) = ρ g (x : A)

entries.name: Representation.inclusion_restrictSubalgebra
entries.docstring:
The restrictions to two nested invariant subalgebras agree along the inclusion of the
  smaller into the larger.
entries.snippet:
lemma inclusion_restrictSubalgebra {k A G : Type*} [CommSemiring k]
    [Monoid G] [Semiring A] [Algebra k A] (ρ : Representation k G A) {S S' : Subalgebra k A}
    (h : S ≤ S') (hS : ∀ (g : G) {x : A}, x ∈ S → ρ g x ∈ S)
    (hS' : ∀ (g : G) {x : A}, x ∈ S' → ρ g x ∈ S') (g : G) (x : S) :
    Subalgebra.inclusion h (ρ.restrictSubalgebra S hS g x)
      = ρ.restrictSubalgebra S' hS' g (Subalgebra.inclusion h x)

entries.name: Representation.restrictScalars
entries.docstring:
The restriction of scalars of a representation: a representation on an `S`-module is a
  representation on the same space as an `R`-module, for `R` acting through `S`.
entries.snippet:
def restrictScalars (R : Type*) {S G V : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S] [Monoid G]
    [AddCommMonoid V] [Module R V] [Module S V] [LinearMap.CompatibleSMul V V R S]
    (ρ : Representation S G V) : Representation R G V where

entries.name: Representation.restrictScalars_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma restrictScalars_apply (R : Type*) {S G V : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S]
    [Monoid G] [AddCommMonoid V] [Module R V] [Module S V] [LinearMap.CompatibleSMul V V R S]
    (ρ : Representation S G V) (g : G) (x : V) : ρ.restrictScalars R g x = ρ g x

entries.name: Representation.apply_one_of_mul
entries.docstring:
A representation of a group acting by multiplicative maps preserves the unit. The
  action of `g` is surjective, its inverse being the action of `g⁻¹`, so `ρ g 1` is a left
  unit on the whole algebra.
entries.snippet: lemma apply_one_of_mul (g : G) : ρ g 1 = 1

entries.name: Representation.toAlgHom
entries.docstring:
A representation of a group acting by multiplicative maps acts by algebra
  endomorphisms.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def toAlgHom (g : G) : A →ₐ[k] A where

entries.name: Representation.toAlgHom_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toAlgHom_apply (g : G) (x : A) : ρ.toAlgHom hρ g x = ρ g x

entries.name: Representation.EquivariantAlgHom
entries.docstring:
An algebra map `A →ₐ[k] B` intertwining two pairs of representations, `ρ₁, σ₁` of the
  monoid `G₁` and `ρ₂, σ₂` of the monoid `G₂`, with both target representations multiplicative
  on the whole of `B`. The two pairs are independent: the actions of `G₁` and `G₂` are not
  assumed to commute, and no relation between them is used. Unit preservation is not a field
  and does not follow from multiplicativity over a monoid; when the acting monoid is a group
  and the target is a ring it does (`Representation.apply_one_of_mul`), and the target action
  is then by algebra endomorphisms.
entries.snippet:
@[ext]
structure EquivariantAlgHom (ρ₁ : Representation k G₁ A) (σ₁ : Representation k G₁ B)
    (ρ₂ : Representation k G₂ A) (σ₂ : Representation k G₂ B) where
  toAlgHom : A →ₐ[k] B
  map_fst : ∀ (g : G₁) (x : A), toAlgHom (ρ₁ g x) = σ₁ g (toAlgHom x)
  map_snd : ∀ (g : G₂) (x : A), toAlgHom (ρ₂ g x) = σ₂ g (toAlgHom x)
  fst_mul : ∀ (g : G₁) (b₁ b₂ : B), σ₁ g (b₁ * b₂) = σ₁ g b₁ * σ₁ g b₂
  snd_mul : ∀ (g : G₂) (b₁ b₂ : B), σ₂ g (b₁ * b₂) = σ₂ g b₁ * σ₂ g b₂

entries.name: Representation.EquivariantAlgHom.id
entries.docstring: The identity map of an algebra carrying two multiplicative representations.

entries.name: Representation.EquivariantAlgHom.id_toAlgHom
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma id_toAlgHom (h₁ : ∀ (g : G₁) (x y : A), ρ₁ g (x * y) = ρ₁ g x * ρ₁ g y)
    (h₂ : ∀ (g : G₂) (x y : A), ρ₂ g (x * y) = ρ₂ g x * ρ₂ g y) :
    (EquivariantAlgHom.id ρ₁ ρ₂ h₁ h₂).toAlgHom = AlgHom.id k A

entries.name: Representation.EquivariantAlgHom.comp
entries.docstring:
The precomposition with an algebra map into the source intertwining two representations
  on its own source with the two source representations; the target and its two actions are
  unchanged.
entries.snippet:
def comp {A' : Type*} [Semiring A'] [Algebra k A'] {ρ₁' : Representation k G₁ A'}
    {ρ₂' : Representation k G₂ A'} (f : EquivariantAlgHom ρ₁ σ₁ ρ₂ σ₂) (φ : A' →ₐ[k] A)
    (hφ₁ : ∀ (g : G₁) (x : A'), φ (ρ₁' g x) = ρ₁ g (φ x))
    (hφ₂ : ∀ (g : G₂) (x : A'), φ (ρ₂' g x) = ρ₂ g (φ x)) :
    EquivariantAlgHom ρ₁' σ₁ ρ₂' σ₂ where

entries.name: Representation.EquivariantAlgHom.comp_toAlgHom
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma comp_toAlgHom {A' : Type*} [Semiring A'] [Algebra k A'] {ρ₁' : Representation k G₁ A'}
    {ρ₂' : Representation k G₂ A'} (f : EquivariantAlgHom ρ₁ σ₁ ρ₂ σ₂) (φ : A' →ₐ[k] A)
    (hφ₁ : ∀ (g : G₁) (x : A'), φ (ρ₁' g x) = ρ₁ g (φ x))
    (hφ₂ : ∀ (g : G₂) (x : A'), φ (ρ₂' g x) = ρ₂ g (φ x)) :
    (f.comp φ hφ₁ hφ₂).toAlgHom = f.toAlgHom.comp φ

entries.name: Representation.EquivariantAlgHom.compEquiv
entries.docstring:
Precomposition with an algebra equivalence of the sources intertwining the source
  representations: equivariant maps out of equivalent sources correspond.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def compEquiv {A' : Type*} [Semiring A'] [Algebra k A']
    {ρ₁' : Representation k G₁ A'} {ρ₂' : Representation k G₂ A'} (e : A' ≃ₐ[k] A)
    (he₁ : ∀ (g : G₁) (x : A'), e (ρ₁' g x) = ρ₁ g (e x))
    (he₂ : ∀ (g : G₂) (x : A'), e (ρ₂' g x) = ρ₂ g (e x)) :
    EquivariantAlgHom ρ₁ σ₁ ρ₂ σ₂ ≃ EquivariantAlgHom ρ₁' σ₁ ρ₂' σ₂ where

entries.name: Representation.EquivariantAlgHom.compEquiv_toAlgHom
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma compEquiv_toAlgHom {A' : Type*} [Semiring A'] [Algebra k A']
    {ρ₁' : Representation k G₁ A'} {ρ₂' : Representation k G₂ A'} (e : A' ≃ₐ[k] A)
    (he₁ : ∀ (g : G₁) (x : A'), e (ρ₁' g x) = ρ₁ g (e x))
    (he₂ : ∀ (g : G₂) (x : A'), e (ρ₂' g x) = ρ₂ g (e x))
    (f : EquivariantAlgHom ρ₁ σ₁ ρ₂ σ₂) :
    (compEquiv e he₁ he₂ f).toAlgHom = f.toAlgHom.comp e.toAlgHom

entries.name: Representation.EquivariantAlgHom.compEquiv_symm_toAlgHom
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma compEquiv_symm_toAlgHom {A' : Type*} [Semiring A'] [Algebra k A']
    {ρ₁' : Representation k G₁ A'} {ρ₂' : Representation k G₂ A'} (e : A' ≃ₐ[k] A)
    (he₁ : ∀ (g : G₁) (x : A'), e (ρ₁' g x) = ρ₁ g (e x))
    (he₂ : ∀ (g : G₂) (x : A'), e (ρ₂' g x) = ρ₂ g (e x))
    (f : EquivariantAlgHom ρ₁' σ₁ ρ₂' σ₂) :
    ((compEquiv e he₁ he₂).symm f).toAlgHom = f.toAlgHom.comp e.symm.toAlgHom

entries.name: Representation.EquivariantAlgHom.restrictSubalgebra
entries.docstring:
The restriction to a subalgebra of the source preserved by both source representations,
  along its inclusion; the target and its two actions are unchanged.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def restrictSubalgebra (f : EquivariantAlgHom ρ₁ σ₁ ρ₂ σ₂) (S : Subalgebra k A)
    (hS₁ : ∀ (g : G₁) {x : A}, x ∈ S → ρ₁ g x ∈ S)
    (hS₂ : ∀ (g : G₂) {x : A}, x ∈ S → ρ₂ g x ∈ S) :
    EquivariantAlgHom (ρ₁.restrictSubalgebra S hS₁) σ₁ (ρ₂.restrictSubalgebra S hS₂) σ₂

entries.name: Representation.EquivariantAlgHom.restrictSubalgebra_toAlgHom_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma restrictSubalgebra_toAlgHom_apply (f : EquivariantAlgHom ρ₁ σ₁ ρ₂ σ₂) (S : Subalgebra k A)
    (hS₁ : ∀ (g : G₁) {x : A}, x ∈ S → ρ₁ g x ∈ S)
    (hS₂ : ∀ (g : G₂) {x : A}, x ∈ S → ρ₂ g x ∈ S) (x : S) :
    (f.restrictSubalgebra S hS₁ hS₂).toAlgHom x = f.toAlgHom x

entries.name: Representation.EquivariantAlgHom.compFst
entries.docstring:
The precomposition of the first pair of representations with a monoid map; the algebra
  map is unchanged.
entries.snippet:
def compFst {H : Type*} [Monoid H] (f : EquivariantAlgHom ρ₁ σ₁ ρ₂ σ₂) (φ : H →* G₁) :
    EquivariantAlgHom (ρ₁.comp φ) (σ₁.comp φ) ρ₂ σ₂ where

entries.name: Representation.EquivariantAlgHom.compFst_toAlgHom
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma compFst_toAlgHom {H : Type*} [Monoid H] (f : EquivariantAlgHom ρ₁ σ₁ ρ₂ σ₂) (φ : H →* G₁) :
    (f.compFst φ).toAlgHom = f.toAlgHom

entries.name: Representation.liftEquiv_baseChange
entries.docstring:
Base change along `R → S` preserves equivariance: the `S`-algebra map out of `S ⊗[R] A`
  corresponding to an equivariant `R`-algebra map `f` intertwines the base change of the
  source action with the target action.
entries.snippet:
lemma liftEquiv_baseChange {R S A B G : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S] [Algebra R S]
    [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] [Semiring B] [Algebra S B] [Algebra R B] [IsScalarTower R S B]
    [Monoid G] (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (ρ : Representation R G A) (σ : Representation S G B)
    (hf : ∀ (g : G) (x : A), f (ρ g x) = σ g (f x)) (g : G) (x : S ⊗[R] A) :
    AlgHom.liftEquiv R S A B f (LinearMap.baseChange S (ρ g) x)
      = σ g (AlgHom.liftEquiv R S A B f x)

entries.name: Representation.baseChange
entries.docstring:
The base change of a representation along `R → S`: the same action on the second factor
  of `S ⊗[R] M`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def baseChange {R M G : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (S : Type*) [CommSemiring S]
    [Algebra R S] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Monoid G] (ρ : Representation R G M) :
    Representation S G (S ⊗[R] M) where

entries.name: Representation.baseChange_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma baseChange_tmul {R M G : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (S : Type*) [CommSemiring S]
    [Algebra R S] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Monoid G] (ρ : Representation R G M) (g : G)
    (s : S) (x : M) : baseChange S ρ g (s ⊗ₜ[R] x) = s ⊗ₜ[R] ρ g x

entries.name: Representation.baseChange_naturality
entries.docstring:
Base change is natural: a linear map intertwining two representations base changes to
  one intertwining their base changes.
entries.snippet:
lemma baseChange_naturality {R M N G : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (S : Type*) [CommSemiring S]
    [Algebra R S] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [Monoid G]
    {ρ : Representation R G M} {σ : Representation R G N} (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (h : ∀ (g : G) (x : M), f (ρ g x) = σ g (f x)) (g : G) (y : S ⊗[R] M) :
    LinearMap.baseChange S f (baseChange S ρ g y)
      = baseChange S σ g (LinearMap.baseChange S f y)

entries.name: Representation.eq_baseChange_of_tmul
entries.docstring:
A representation on a base change acting on the pure tensors through a representation on
  the second factor is that representation's base change.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_baseChange_of_tmul {R S A G : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S] [Algebra R S]
    [AddCommMonoid A] [Module R A] [Monoid G] (ρ : Representation R G A)
    (ρ' : Representation S G (S ⊗[R] A))
    (h : ∀ (g : G) (s : S) (x : A), ρ' g (s ⊗ₜ[R] x) = s ⊗ₜ[R] ρ g x) (g : G) (y : S ⊗[R] A) :
    ρ' g y = LinearMap.baseChange S (ρ g) y

entries.name: Representation.EquivariantAlgHom.liftEquivBaseChange
entries.docstring:
For a target over `S`, the equivariant `R`-algebra maps out of `A` are the equivariant
  `S`-algebra maps out of the base change `S ⊗[R] A`, by `AlgHom.liftEquiv`. The two source
  actions on the base change are recognised by their values on the pure tensors, and the
  target keeps its `S`-actions, restricted to `R` on the left-hand side.

entries.name: AlgHom.map_add_smul_one
entries.docstring:
An algebra map carries an affine combination `x + z • 1` to the same combination of the
  image, the shift being the image of a scalar.
entries.snippet:
lemma AlgHom.map_add_smul_one {k A B : Type*} [CommSemiring k] [Semiring A] [Algebra k A]
    [Semiring B] [Algebra k B] (f : A →ₐ[k] B) (x : A) (z : k) :
    f (x + z • (1 : A)) = f x + z • (1 : B)

entries.name: ExteriorAlgebra.derivationGen
entries.docstring:
The generator map of the derivation extending `d`, into the trivial square-zero
  extension of the exterior algebra: `ι x ↦ (ι x, ι (d x))`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def derivationGen :
    M →ₗ[R] TrivSqZeroExt (ExteriorAlgebra R M) (ExteriorAlgebra R M) where

entries.name: ExteriorAlgebra.derivationGen_fst
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma derivationGen_fst (x : M) : (derivationGen d x).fst = ι R x

entries.name: ExteriorAlgebra.derivationGen_snd
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma derivationGen_snd (x : M) : (derivationGen d x).snd = ι R (d x)

entries.name: ExteriorAlgebra.derivationGen_mul_self
entries.docstring:
The generator map squares to zero: degree-one elements of the exterior algebra
  anticommute, which is exactly the square-zero condition on the pair.
entries.snippet: lemma derivationGen_mul_self (x : M) : derivationGen d x * derivationGen d x = 0

entries.name: ExteriorAlgebra.derivationHom
entries.docstring:
The lift of the derivation extending `d` to the trivial square-zero extension of the
  exterior algebra: the algebra homomorphism `x ↦ (x, derivationOfLinear d x)`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def derivationHom :
    ExteriorAlgebra R M →ₐ[R]
      TrivSqZeroExt (ExteriorAlgebra R M) (ExteriorAlgebra R M)

entries.name: ExteriorAlgebra.derivationHom_ι
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma derivationHom_ι (x : M) : derivationHom d (ι R x) = derivationGen d x

entries.name: ExteriorAlgebra.derivationHom_fst
entries.docstring: The first component of the square-zero lift is the identity.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma derivationHom_fst (x : ExteriorAlgebra R M) : (derivationHom d x).fst = x

entries.name: ExteriorAlgebra.derivationOfLinear
entries.docstring:
The even derivation of the exterior algebra extending a linear endomorphism `d` of
  `M`: the map obeying the Leibniz rule, with no Koszul signs, whose value on a generator
  `ι x` is `ι (d x)`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def derivationOfLinear : ExteriorAlgebra R M →ₗ[R] ExteriorAlgebra R M where

entries.name: ExteriorAlgebra.derivationOfLinear_ι
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma derivationOfLinear_ι (x : M) : derivationOfLinear d (ι R x) = ι R (d x)

entries.name: ExteriorAlgebra.derivationOfLinear_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma derivationOfLinear_one : derivationOfLinear d (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R M) = 0

entries.name: ExteriorAlgebra.derivationOfLinear_algebraMap
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma derivationOfLinear_algebraMap (r : R) :
    derivationOfLinear d (algebraMap R (ExteriorAlgebra R M) r) = 0

entries.name: ExteriorAlgebra.derivationOfLinear_mul
entries.docstring:
The Leibniz rule for the derivation extending `d`, with no Koszul signs: the derivation
  is even even though the generators are odd.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivationOfLinear_mul (x y : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    derivationOfLinear d (x * y)
      = derivationOfLinear d x * y + x * derivationOfLinear d y

entries.name: ExteriorAlgebra.derivationOfLinear_comm_apply
entries.docstring: Derivations extending commuting endomorphisms commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivationOfLinear_comm_apply {d₁ d₂ : M →ₗ[R] M} (h : d₁ ∘ₗ d₂ = d₂ ∘ₗ d₁)
    (x : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    derivationOfLinear d₁ (derivationOfLinear d₂ x)
      = derivationOfLinear d₂ (derivationOfLinear d₁ x)

entries.name: ExteriorAlgebra.algHom_derivationOfLinear
entries.docstring:
An algebra map carries one derivation to the other when the linear map it is
  determined by on the generators intertwines the two endomorphisms. The hypotheses are
  stated pointwise so that the lemma can be applied without rewriting inside a large
  algebra.

entries.name: Representation.exteriorAlgebra
entries.docstring:
The representation on the exterior algebra extending a representation on the
  generators, by functoriality of `ExteriorAlgebra.map`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def exteriorAlgebra (ρ : Representation R G M) :
    Representation R G (ExteriorAlgebra R M) where

entries.name: Representation.exteriorAlgebra_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma exteriorAlgebra_apply (ρ : Representation R G M) (g : G)
    (x : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    ρ.exteriorAlgebra g x = ExteriorAlgebra.map (ρ g) x

entries.name: Representation.exteriorAlgebra_ι
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma exteriorAlgebra_ι (ρ : Representation R G M) (g : G) (x : M) :
    ρ.exteriorAlgebra g (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R x) = ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (ρ g x)

entries.name: Representation.exteriorAlgebra_apply_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma exteriorAlgebra_apply_one (ρ : Representation R G M) (g : G) :
    ρ.exteriorAlgebra g (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R M) = 1

entries.name: Representation.exteriorAlgebra_apply_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma exteriorAlgebra_apply_mul (ρ : Representation R G M) (g : G)
    (x y : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    ρ.exteriorAlgebra g (x * y) = ρ.exteriorAlgebra g x * ρ.exteriorAlgebra g y
