  | σ :: l, k => ∑ τ, (Λ⁻¹).1 τ σ • derivSum Λ l fun t => k (t + {τ})

entries.name: QED.derivSum_nil
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma derivSum_nil {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module ℝ M]
    (Λ : LorentzGroup 3) (k : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M) :
    derivSum Λ [] k = k 0

entries.name: QED.derivSum_cons
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma derivSum_cons {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module ℝ M]
    (Λ : LorentzGroup 3) (σ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (k : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M) :
    derivSum Λ (σ :: l) k =
      ∑ τ, (Λ⁻¹).1 τ σ • derivSum Λ l fun t => k (t + {τ})

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetGenerators
entries.docstring:
The jet coordinates of the electromagnetic potential: the symbol `∂_s A_μ`,
  the `s`-th derivative of the `μ`-th covariant component.
entries.snippet:
inductive JetGenerators where
  | dA (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : JetGenerators
  deriving DecidableEq

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetGenerators.massWeight
entries.docstring:
The mass weight (twice the mass dimension) of a photon jet coordinate:
  the potential has mass dimension one and each derivative adds one.
entries.snippet:
def JetGenerators.massWeight : JetGenerators → ℕ
  | .dA s _ => 2 + 2 * s.card

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetGenerators.indexClass
entries.docstring:
The symmetrized-index class of a photon jet coordinate: under a gauge
  transformation `∂_s A_μ` shifts by `∂_s ∂_μ χ`, which depends only on the
  multiset `s + {μ}`.  Coordinates in a common class shift together.
entries.snippet:
def JetGenerators.indexClass : JetGenerators → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
  | .dA s μ => s + {μ}

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetGenerators.classProj
entries.docstring:
The canonical jet coordinate of a symmetrized-index class: the coordinate
  whose Lorentz index is the canonical representative of the class.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def JetGenerators.classProj (j : JetGenerators) : JetGenerators

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra
entries.docstring: The jet algebra of the photon: real polynomials in the jet coordinates.
entries.snippet: abbrev JetAlgebra : Type

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.coord
entries.docstring: The jet coordinate `∂_s A_μ` as an element of the jet algebra.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def coord (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.GaugeJet
entries.docstring:
A photon gauge jet: the family `s ↦ ∂_s χ` of symmetrised derivatives of a
  gauge function at the base point.  This is all the photon jet algebra sees of
  a gauge transformation.
entries.snippet: abbrev GaugeJet : Type

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction
entries.docstring:
The gauge action on the photon jet algebra: the algebra map determined by
  `∂_s A_μ ↦ ∂_s A_μ + ∂_s ∂_μ χ`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def gaugeAction (c : GaugeJet) : JetAlgebra →ₐ[ℝ] JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_coord
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gaugeAction_coord (c : GaugeJet) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    gaugeAction c (coord s μ) = coord s μ + MvPolynomial.C (c (s + {μ}))

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_C
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAction_C (c : GaugeJet) (r : ℝ) :
    gaugeAction c (MvPolynomial.C r) = MvPolynomial.C r

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.derivMultiset
entries.docstring:
The iterated partial derivative `∂_s f` along a multiset `s` of spacetime
  directions, taken in the canonical order obtained by sorting `s`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def derivMultiset (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (f : SpaceTime 3 → ℝ) :
    SpaceTime 3 → ℝ

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.derivMultiset_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma derivMultiset_zero (f : SpaceTime 3 → ℝ) : derivMultiset 0 f = f

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.derivMultiset_singleton
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma derivMultiset_singleton (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (f : SpaceTime 3 → ℝ) :
    derivMultiset {μ} f = ∂_ μ f

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.coPotential
entries.docstring: The covariant components `A_μ = η_{μμ} A^μ` of an electromagnetic potential.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def coPotential (A : ElectromagneticPotential 3) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    SpaceTime 3 → ℝ

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.evalPotential
entries.docstring:
The evaluation of the photon jet algebra at an electromagnetic potential `A`:
  the algebra map sending the formal jet coordinate `∂_s A_μ` to the honest
  function `∂_s A_μ` on spacetime.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def evalPotential (A : ElectromagneticPotential 3) :
    JetAlgebra →ₐ[ℝ] (SpaceTime 3 → ℝ)

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.evalPotential_coord
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma evalPotential_coord (A : ElectromagneticPotential 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    evalPotential A (coord s μ) = derivMultiset s (coPotential A μ)

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the photon jet algebra: the algebra map transporting
  every lower index of `∂_s A_μ` with `Λ⁻¹`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def lorentzAction (Λ : LorentzGroup 3) : JetAlgebra →ₐ[ℝ] JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction_coord
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma lorentzAction_coord (Λ : LorentzGroup 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    lorentzAction Λ (coord s μ) =
      derivSum Λ (indexList s) fun t => ∑ ν, (Λ⁻¹).1 ν μ • coord t ν

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction_coord_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzAction_coord_zero (Λ : LorentzGroup 3) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    lorentzAction Λ (coord 0 μ) = ∑ ν, (Λ⁻¹).1 ν μ • coord 0 ν

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction_coord_singleton
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzAction_coord_singleton (Λ : LorentzGroup 3) (σ μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    lorentzAction Λ (coord {σ} μ) =
      ∑ τ, ∑ ν, ((Λ⁻¹).1 τ σ * (Λ⁻¹).1 ν μ) • coord {τ} ν

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.massScale
entries.docstring:
The mass-weight scaling on the photon jet algebra: the algebra map
  multiplying each jet coordinate by `c` to the power of its mass weight.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def massScale (c : ℝ) : JetAlgebra →ₐ[ℝ] JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.massScale_coord
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma massScale_coord (c : ℝ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    massScale c (coord s μ) = c ^ (2 + 2 * Multiset.card s) • coord s μ

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
The formal total spacetime derivative on the photon jet algebra in the
  direction `ρ`: the derivation appending the derivative index,
  `∂_s A_μ ↦ ∂_{s + {ρ}} A_μ`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def jetDeriv (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : JetAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_coord
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDeriv_coord (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    jetDeriv ρ (coord s μ) = coord (s + {ρ}) μ

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDeriv_one (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : jetDeriv ρ (1 : JetAlgebra) = 0

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_mul
entries.docstring: The total derivative is a derivation on the photon jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_mul (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x y : JetAlgebra) :
    jetDeriv ρ (x * y) = jetDeriv ρ x * y + x * jetDeriv ρ y

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_baseChange_mul
entries.docstring: The Leibniz rule for the complexified total derivative.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_baseChange_mul (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] JetAlgebra) :
    LinearMap.baseChange ℂ (jetDeriv ρ) (x * y) =
      LinearMap.baseChange ℂ (jetDeriv ρ) x * y +
        x * LinearMap.baseChange ℂ (jetDeriv ρ) y

entries.name: QED.sum_map_antidiagonal_ite
entries.docstring:
Summing an indicator supported on the splittings `(0, t)` over the
  antidiagonal of `t` picks out `f t`: the splitting `(0, t)` occurs exactly
  once in `Multiset.antidiagonal t`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_map_antidiagonal_ite {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (f : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M) :
    ((t.antidiagonal).map fun p => if p.1 = 0 then f p.2 else 0).sum = f t

entries.name: QED.phaseAct
entries.docstring:
The Leibniz convolution of a phase family against a module-valued family
  of jets, over the antidiagonal of the derivative multiset: the formal
  expansion `∂_s (u ⬝ f) = ∑_{x + y = s} (∂_x u) (∂_y f)`, with the
  multiplicities of `Multiset.antidiagonal` supplying the multinomial
  weights.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def phaseAct {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module ℂ M]
    (u : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ) (f : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M) :
    Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M

entries.name: QED.phaseAct_zero_arg
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma phaseAct_zero_arg : phaseAct u f 0 = u 0 • f 0

entries.name: QED.phaseAct_eq_sum
entries.docstring:
The convolution as a literal antidiagonal sum of products, for
  scalar-valued families.
entries.snippet:
lemma phaseAct_eq_sum (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    phaseAct u v s = (s.antidiagonal.map fun p => u p.1 * v p.2).sum

entries.name: QED.phaseAct_add_singleton
entries.docstring:
The Leibniz rule of the convolution: differentiating a convolution
  differentiates one factor at a time.
entries.snippet:
lemma phaseAct_add_singleton (a : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    phaseAct u f (s + {a}) =
      phaseAct u (fun t => f (t + {a})) s +
        phaseAct (fun t => u (t + {a})) f s

entries.name: QED.phaseAct_add_left
entries.snippet:
lemma phaseAct_add_left (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    phaseAct (fun t => u₁ t + u₂ t) f s = phaseAct u₁ f s + phaseAct u₂ f s

entries.name: QED.phaseAct_add_right
entries.snippet:
lemma phaseAct_add_right (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    phaseAct u (fun t => f t + g t) s = phaseAct u f s + phaseAct u g s

entries.name: QED.phaseAct_smul_left
entries.snippet:
lemma phaseAct_smul_left (c : ℂ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    phaseAct (fun t => c * u t) f s = c • phaseAct u f s

entries.name: QED.phaseAct_smul_right
entries.snippet:
lemma phaseAct_smul_right (c : ℂ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    phaseAct u (fun t => c • f t) s = c • phaseAct u f s

entries.name: QED.phaseAct_assoc
entries.docstring:
Associativity of the convolution: acting by `u` after `v` is acting by
  the convolution `u ⋆ v`.
entries.snippet:
lemma phaseAct_assoc (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    phaseAct u (phaseAct v f) s = phaseAct (phaseAct u v) f s

entries.name: QED.phaseAct_comm
entries.docstring: Commutativity of the scalar convolution.
entries.snippet:
lemma phaseAct_comm (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    phaseAct u v s = phaseAct v u s

entries.name: QED.map_phaseAct
entries.docstring: A linear map passes through the convolution.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_phaseAct {N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid N] [Module ℂ N] (L : M →ₗ[ℂ] N)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    L (phaseAct u f s) = phaseAct u (fun t => L (f t)) s

entries.name: QED.phaseAct_indicator
entries.docstring:
The convolution against the indicator of the empty multiset is the
  identity: the splitting `(0, t)` occurs exactly once in the
  antidiagonal.
entries.snippet:
lemma phaseAct_indicator (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    phaseAct (fun t => if t = 0 then 1 else 0) f s = f s

entries.name: QED.star_phaseAct
entries.docstring: The star of a convolution is the convolution of the stars.
entries.snippet:
lemma star_phaseAct (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    star (phaseAct u v s) =
      phaseAct (fun t => star (u t)) (fun t => star (v t)) s

entries.name: QED.GaugeJet
entries.docstring:
The jets of a `U(1)_em` gauge transformation with coupling `e`: the
  derivative jets `χjet s = ∂_s χ` of the real gauge function and
  `phase s = ∂_s (exp (I e χ))` of its unitary phase at the base point,
  subject to the two identities every honest gauge function satisfies:
  the phase has unit norm at the base point, and its derivatives obey the
  formal Leibniz expansion of `∂_μ (exp (I e χ)) = I e (∂_μ χ) exp (I e χ)`.
entries.snippet:
structure GaugeJet (e : ℝ) where
  χjet : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℝ
  phase : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ
  phase_zero_unitary : phase 0 * star (phase 0) = 1
  phase_deriv : ∀ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
    phase (s + {μ}) = Complex.I * e *
      ((s.antidiagonal.map fun p => (χjet (p.1 + {μ}) : ℂ) * phase p.2).sum)

entries.name: QED.GaugeJet.star_phase_zero_unitary
entries.snippet: lemma star_phase_zero_unitary : star (g.phase 0) * g.phase 0 = 1

entries.name: QED.GaugeJet.phase_singleton
entries.docstring:
The first derivative of the phase: the `s = 0` case of the Leibniz
  identity, `∂_μ u = I e (∂_μ χ) u` at the base point.
entries.snippet:
lemma phase_singleton (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    g.phase {μ} = Complex.I * e * (g.χjet {μ} * g.phase 0)

entries.name: QED.GaugeJet.star_phase_singleton
entries.docstring:
The first derivative of the conjugate phase,
  `∂_μ ū = -I e (∂_μ χ) ū` at the base point.
entries.snippet:
lemma star_phase_singleton (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    star (g.phase {μ}) = -(Complex.I * e * (g.χjet {μ} * star (g.phase 0)))

entries.name: QED.GaugeJet.trivial
entries.docstring: The trivial gauge jet: the jets of the constant gauge function `χ = 0`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def trivial (e : ℝ) : GaugeJet e where

entries.name: QED.GaugeJet.ext
entries.snippet:
lemma ext {g₁ g₂ : GaugeJet e} (h1 : g₁.χjet = g₂.χjet)
    (h2 : g₁.phase = g₂.phase) : g₁ = g₂

entries.name: QED.GaugeJet.«instance@280a180b»
entries.docstring:
The composite of two gauge jets: the gauge functions add and the phases
  convolve by the Leibniz rule.
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance : Mul (GaugeJet e) where

entries.name: QED.GaugeJet.mul_χjet
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma mul_χjet (g₁ g₂ : GaugeJet e) : (g₁ * g₂).χjet = g₁.χjet + g₂.χjet

entries.name: QED.GaugeJet.mul_phase
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma mul_phase (g₁ g₂ : GaugeJet e) :
    (g₁ * g₂).phase = phaseAct g₁.phase g₂.phase

entries.name: QED.GaugeJet.«instance@192399f3»
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance : One (GaugeJet e)

entries.name: QED.GaugeJet.one_χjet
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma one_χjet : (1 : GaugeJet e).χjet = 0

entries.name: QED.GaugeJet.one_phase
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma one_phase :
    (1 : GaugeJet e).phase = fun s => if s = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0

entries.name: QED.GaugeJet.«instance@26532684»
entries.docstring:
**The gauge jets form a commutative monoid**: the gauge symmetry data of
  QED composes associatively, with the trivial gauge jet as the unit.
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance : CommMonoid (GaugeJet e) where

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetGenerators
entries.docstring:
The jet coordinates of the Dirac electron: the symbols `∂_s ψ_α` and
  `∂_s ψ̄_α`, the `s`-th derivatives of the Dirac components and their
  conjugates.  The electron has electric charge `-1`; its conjugate has
  charge `+1`.
entries.snippet:
inductive JetGenerators where
  | dψ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) : JetGenerators
  | dbarψ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) : JetGenerators
  deriving DecidableEq

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetGenerators.massWeight
entries.docstring:
The mass weight (twice the mass dimension) of an electron jet coordinate:
  a fermion has mass dimension `3/2` and each derivative adds one.
entries.snippet:
def JetGenerators.massWeight : JetGenerators → ℕ
  | .dψ s _ => 3 + 2 * s.card
  | .dbarψ s _ => 3 + 2 * s.card

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetComponentSpace
entries.docstring:
The jet component space of the electron: the free complex module on the
  jet coordinates.
entries.snippet: abbrev JetComponentSpace : Type

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra
entries.docstring:
The jet algebra of the electron: the exterior algebra on the free module
  over the jet coordinates.  The exterior product implements the fermionic
  anticommutativity of the electron field.
entries.snippet: abbrev JetAlgebra : Type

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.ofGenerator
entries.docstring:
The jet coordinate `∂_s ψ_α` or `∂_s ψ̄_α` as an element of the jet
  algebra.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def ofGenerator (j : JetGenerators) : JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.gaugeActionGenerator
entries.docstring:
The gauge action on a single electron jet coordinate: the Leibniz
  expansion of `∂_s (ū ψ_α)` and `∂_s (u ψ̄_α)` over the splittings of `s`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def gaugeActionGenerator {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) :
    JetGenerators → JetComponentSpace
  | .dψ t α => (t.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
      Finsupp.single (JetGenerators.dψ p.2 α) (star (g.phase p.1))).sum
  | .dbarψ t α => (t.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
      Finsupp.single (JetGenerators.dbarψ p.2 α) (g.phase p.1)).sum

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.gaugeActionCS
entries.docstring:
The gauge action on the jet component space: the linear extension of the
  Leibniz expansion on the jet coordinates.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def gaugeActionCS {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) :
    JetComponentSpace →ₗ[ℂ] JetComponentSpace

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.gaugeActionCS_single
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gaugeActionCS_single {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) (j : JetGenerators) :
    gaugeActionCS g (Finsupp.single j 1) = gaugeActionGenerator g j

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction
entries.docstring:
The gauge action on the electron jet algebra: the algebra map induced by
  the Leibniz expansion on the jet coordinates.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def gaugeAction {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) :
    JetAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_ofGenerator_dψ
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAction_ofGenerator_dψ {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e)
    (t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    gaugeAction g (ofGenerator (.dψ t α)) =
      (t.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        star (g.phase p.1) • ofGenerator (.dψ p.2 α)).sum

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_ofGenerator_dbarψ
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAction_ofGenerator_dbarψ {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e)
    (t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    gaugeAction g (ofGenerator (.dbarψ t α)) =
      (t.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        g.phase p.1 • ofGenerator (.dbarψ p.2 α)).sum

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.antidiagonal_singleton
entries.snippet:
lemma antidiagonal_singleton (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    ({μ} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)).antidiagonal = {(0, {μ}), ({μ}, 0)}

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_ofGenerator_dψ_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gaugeAction_ofGenerator_dψ_zero {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    gaugeAction g (ofGenerator (.dψ 0 α)) =
      star (g.phase 0) • ofGenerator (.dψ 0 α)

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_ofGenerator_dbarψ_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gaugeAction_ofGenerator_dbarψ_zero {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    gaugeAction g (ofGenerator (.dbarψ 0 α)) =
      g.phase 0 • ofGenerator (.dbarψ 0 α)

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_ofGenerator_dψ_singleton
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAction_ofGenerator_dψ_singleton {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e)
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    gaugeAction g (ofGenerator (.dψ {μ} α)) =
      star (g.phase 0) • ofGenerator (.dψ {μ} α) +
        star (g.phase {μ}) • ofGenerator (.dψ 0 α)

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_ofGenerator_dbarψ_singleton
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAction_ofGenerator_dbarψ_singleton {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e)
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    gaugeAction g (ofGenerator (.dbarψ {μ} α)) =
      g.phase 0 • ofGenerator (.dbarψ {μ} α) +
        g.phase {μ} • ofGenerator (.dbarψ 0 α)

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.spinorRep
entries.docstring:
The Dirac spinor representation of `SL(2,ℂ)` in the chiral basis: the two
  Weyl components transform in the two conjugate-dual fundamental
  representations, `S(M) = ((M, 0), (0, (M†)⁻¹))`, the assignment being fixed
  by the conventions of `Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def spinorRep (M : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    Matrix (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) ℂ

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.lorentzActionGenerator
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on a single electron jet coordinate: the spinor index
  is rotated by the spinor representation (its conjugate for `∂_s ψ̄`) and the
  derivative indices are transported with `Λ(M)⁻¹`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def lorentzActionGenerator (M : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    JetGenerators → JetComponentSpace
  | .dψ t α => derivSum (Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup M) (indexList t) fun t' =>
      ∑ β, spinorRep M α β • Finsupp.single (JetGenerators.dψ t' β) 1
  | .dbarψ t α => derivSum (Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup M) (indexList t) fun t' =>
      ∑ β, star (spinorRep M α β) • Finsupp.single (JetGenerators.dbarψ t' β) 1

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.lorentzActionCS
entries.docstring: The Lorentz action on the jet component space.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def lorentzActionCS (M : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    JetComponentSpace →ₗ[ℂ] JetComponentSpace

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.lorentzActionCS_single
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma lorentzActionCS_single (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : JetGenerators) :
    lorentzActionCS M (Finsupp.single j 1) = lorentzActionGenerator M j

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the electron jet algebra: the algebra map induced by
  the action on the jet coordinates.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def lorentzAction (M : SL(2,ℂ)) : JetAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction_ofGenerator_dψ_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma lorentzAction_ofGenerator_dψ_zero (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    lorentzAction M (ofGenerator (.dψ 0 α)) =
      ∑ β, spinorRep M α β • ofGenerator (.dψ 0 β)

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction_ofGenerator_dbarψ_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma lorentzAction_ofGenerator_dbarψ_zero (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    lorentzAction M (ofGenerator (.dbarψ 0 α)) =
      ∑ β, star (spinorRep M α β) • ofGenerator (.dbarψ 0 β)

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction_ofGenerator_dψ_singleton
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzAction_ofGenerator_dψ_singleton (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (σ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    lorentzAction M (ofGenerator (.dψ {σ} α)) =
      ∑ τ, ∑ β, ((((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup M)⁻¹).1 τ σ : ℝ) • spinorRep M α β) •
        ofGenerator (.dψ {τ} β)

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction_ofGenerator_dbarψ_singleton
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzAction_ofGenerator_dbarψ_singleton (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (σ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    lorentzAction M (ofGenerator (.dbarψ {σ} α)) =
      ∑ τ, ∑ β, ((((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup M)⁻¹).1 τ σ : ℝ) •
          star (spinorRep M α β)) • ofGenerator (.dbarψ {τ} β)

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.massScaleCS
entries.docstring:
The mass-weight scaling on the jet component space: the diagonal map
  multiplying each jet coordinate by `c` to the power of its mass weight.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def massScaleCS (c : ℝ) : JetComponentSpace →ₗ[ℂ] JetComponentSpace

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.massScale
entries.docstring: The mass-weight scaling on the electron jet algebra.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def massScale (c : ℝ) : JetAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.massScale_ofGenerator
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma massScale_ofGenerator (c : ℝ) (j : JetGenerators) :
    massScale c (ofGenerator j) = (c : ℂ) ^ j.massWeight • ofGenerator j

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetGenerators.shift
entries.docstring: The jet coordinate with one further derivative in the direction `ρ`.
entries.snippet:
def JetGenerators.shift (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : JetGenerators → JetGenerators
  | .dψ s α => .dψ (s + {ρ}) α
  | .dbarψ s α => .dbarψ (s + {ρ}) α

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.jetDerivCS
entries.docstring:
The total derivative on the jet component space: the shift of the
  derivative multi-index.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetDerivCS (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    JetComponentSpace →ₗ[ℂ] JetComponentSpace

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.jetDerivCS_single
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDerivCS_single (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (j : JetGenerators) :
    jetDerivCS ρ (Finsupp.single j 1) =
      Finsupp.single (JetGenerators.shift ρ j) 1

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.jetDerivGen
entries.docstring:
The generator map of the total derivative into the trivial square-zero
  extension of the jet algebra: `ι x ↦ (ι x, ι (∂_ρ x))`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetDerivGen (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    JetComponentSpace →ₗ[ℂ] TrivSqZeroExt JetAlgebra JetAlgebra where

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.jetDerivGen_fst
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDerivGen_fst (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : JetComponentSpace) :
    (jetDerivGen ρ x).fst = ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ x

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.jetDerivGen_snd
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDerivGen_snd (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : JetComponentSpace) :
    (jetDerivGen ρ x).snd = ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ (jetDerivCS ρ x)

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.jetDerivGen_mul_self
entries.docstring:
The generator map squares to zero: degree-one elements of the exterior
  algebra anticommute.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDerivGen_mul_self (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : JetComponentSpace) :
    jetDerivGen ρ x * jetDerivGen ρ x = 0

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.jetDerivHom
entries.docstring:
The lift of the total derivative to the trivial square-zero extension of
  the jet algebra: the algebra homomorphism `x ↦ (x, ∂_ρ x)`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetDerivHom (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    JetAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] TrivSqZeroExt JetAlgebra JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.jetDerivHom_ι
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDerivHom_ι (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : JetComponentSpace) :
    jetDerivHom ρ (ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ x) = jetDerivGen ρ x

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.jetDerivHom_fst
entries.docstring: The first component of the square-zero lift is the identity.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDerivHom_fst (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : JetAlgebra) :
    (jetDerivHom ρ x).fst = x

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
The formal total spacetime derivative on the electron jet algebra in the
  direction `ρ`: the even derivation extending the shift
  `∂_s ψ_α ↦ ∂_{s + {ρ}} ψ_α` of the jet coordinates.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def jetDeriv (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : JetAlgebra →ₗ[ℂ] JetAlgebra where

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_apply (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : JetAlgebra) :
    jetDeriv ρ x = (jetDerivHom ρ x).snd

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_ι
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDeriv_ι (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : JetComponentSpace) :
    jetDeriv ρ (ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ x) =
      ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ (jetDerivCS ρ x)

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_ofGenerator
entries.docstring:
The total derivative appends the derivative index to each jet
  coordinate.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDeriv_ofGenerator (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (j : JetGenerators) :
    jetDeriv ρ (ofGenerator j) = ofGenerator (JetGenerators.shift ρ j)

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDeriv_one (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : jetDeriv ρ (1 : JetAlgebra) = 0

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_mul
entries.docstring:
The total derivative is an even derivation: the Leibniz rule holds on the
  electron jet algebra with no Koszul signs.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_mul (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x y : JetAlgebra) :
    jetDeriv ρ (x * y) = jetDeriv ρ x * y + x * jetDeriv ρ y

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra
entries.docstring:
The jet algebra of quantum electrodynamics: the tensor product of the
  complexified photon jet algebra with the electron jet algebra.

  This is a `def` rather than an `abbrev`, and its algebraic structure is fixed
  by the single `Ring` and `Algebra` instances below, so that every algebraic
  class projects from one root.  On the bare tensor product `One`, `Mul`,
  `Zero`, `Add`, `SMul` and `Module` are instead supplied by standalone
  `TensorProduct.*` instances rather than as projections of the semiring; those
  are definitionally the projections, but not syntactically, so a generic lemma
  whose type argument is not pinned by an explicit argument (such as `one_pow`)
  cannot be unified against a goal.  Rooting the structure here keeps the
  generic algebraic lemmas usable.
entries.snippet: def JetAlgebra : Type

entries.name: QED.«instance@2bfdae0f»
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance : Ring JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.«instance@a05bb107»
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance : Algebra ℂ JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.tmul
entries.docstring:
A pure tensor, as an element of the jet algebra.

  Writing `a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b` builds an element of the *underlying* tensor product,
  which is only definitionally an element of `JetAlgebra`.  A goal mixing such
  a term with the jet algebra's own operations is then not type-correct at
  `instances` transparency, and no rewrite can fire on it.  This constructor
  keeps pure tensors typed at `JetAlgebra`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def tmul (a : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra) (b : Electron.JetAlgebra) :
    JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.tmul_eq
entries.docstring:
`tmul` is the pure tensor of the underlying tensor product; use this to
  move between the jet algebra and lemmas stated for the tensor product.
entries.snippet:
lemma tmul_eq (a : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra) (b : Electron.JetAlgebra) :
    a ⊗ⱼ b = a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.one_eq_tmul
entries.snippet: lemma one_eq_tmul : (1 : JetAlgebra) = (1 : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra) ⊗ⱼ 1

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.tmul_mul_tmul
entries.docstring:
Multiplication of pure tensors. `Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul` does
  not rewrite here, even though it is definitionally the same statement.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma tmul_mul_tmul (a₁ a₂ : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra)
    (b₁ b₂ : Electron.JetAlgebra) :
    (a₁ ⊗ⱼ b₁) * (a₂ ⊗ⱼ b₂) = (a₁ * a₂) ⊗ⱼ (b₁ * b₂)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.zero_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma zero_tmul (b : Electron.JetAlgebra) :
    (0 : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra) ⊗ⱼ b = 0

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.tmul_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma tmul_zero (a : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra) :
    a ⊗ⱼ (0 : Electron.JetAlgebra) = 0

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.add_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma add_tmul (a₁ a₂ : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra) (b : Electron.JetAlgebra) :
    (a₁ + a₂) ⊗ⱼ b = a₁ ⊗ⱼ b + a₂ ⊗ⱼ b

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.tmul_add
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma tmul_add (a : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra) (b₁ b₂ : Electron.JetAlgebra) :
    a ⊗ⱼ (b₁ + b₂) = a ⊗ⱼ b₁ + a ⊗ⱼ b₂

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.sub_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma sub_tmul (a₁ a₂ : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra) (b : Electron.JetAlgebra) :
    (a₁ - a₂) ⊗ⱼ b = a₁ ⊗ⱼ b - a₂ ⊗ⱼ b

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.tmul_sub
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma tmul_sub (a : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra) (b₁ b₂ : Electron.JetAlgebra) :
    a ⊗ⱼ (b₁ - b₂) = a ⊗ⱼ b₁ - a ⊗ⱼ b₂

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.neg_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma neg_tmul (a : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra) (b : Electron.JetAlgebra) :
    (-a) ⊗ⱼ b = -(a ⊗ⱼ b)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.tmul_neg
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma tmul_neg (a : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra) (b : Electron.JetAlgebra) :
    a ⊗ⱼ (-b) = -(a ⊗ⱼ b)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.tmul_sum
entries.snippet:
lemma tmul_sum {ι : Type*} (a : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra) (s : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → Electron.JetAlgebra) : a ⊗ⱼ (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, a ⊗ⱼ f i

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.sum_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_tmul {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra)
    (b : Electron.JetAlgebra) : (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ⊗ⱼ b = ∑ i ∈ s, f i ⊗ⱼ b

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.tmul_smul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma tmul_smul (r : ℂ) (a : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra) (b : Electron.JetAlgebra) :
    a ⊗ⱼ (r • b) = r • (a ⊗ⱼ b)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.smul_tmul'
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma smul_tmul' (r : ℂ) (a : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra) (b : Electron.JetAlgebra) :
    (r • a) ⊗ⱼ b = r • (a ⊗ⱼ b)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.real_smul_tmul
entries.docstring: An `ℝ`-scalar on the photon factor is a `ℂ`-scalar of the jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma real_smul_tmul (r : ℝ) (a : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra)
    (b : Electron.JetAlgebra) :
    (r • a) ⊗ⱼ b = (r : ℂ) • (a ⊗ⱼ b)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.tmul_C_eq_smul_one
entries.docstring: A constant of the photon factor is a scalar of the jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma tmul_C_eq_smul_one (r : ℝ) :
    ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (MvPolynomial.C r : Photon.JetAlgebra)) ⊗ⱼ
        (1 : Electron.JetAlgebra) = (r : ℂ) • (1 : JetAlgebra)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.induction_on
entries.docstring:
Induction on the jet algebra, stated for `JetAlgebra` itself.  Using
  `TensorProduct.inductionOn` directly leaves the sum and the pure tensors in
  the goals carrying the tensor product's structure rather than the jet
  algebra's, which makes those goals unrewritable.
entries.snippet:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma induction_on {motive : JetAlgebra → Prop} (x : JetAlgebra)
    (tmul : ∀ (a : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra) (b : Electron.JetAlgebra),
      motive (a ⊗ⱼ b))
    (add : ∀ x y : JetAlgebra, motive x → motive y → motive (x + y)) : motive x

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.inclA
entries.docstring: The photon factor included into the QED jet algebra.
entries.snippet: noncomputable abbrev inclA : (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra) →ₐ[ℂ] JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.inclE
entries.docstring: The electron factor included into the QED jet algebra.
entries.snippet: noncomputable abbrev inclE : Electron.JetAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.inclA_apply
entries.snippet: lemma inclA_apply (a : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra) : inclA a = a ⊗ⱼ 1

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.inclE_apply
entries.snippet: lemma inclE_apply (b : Electron.JetAlgebra) : inclE b = 1 ⊗ⱼ b

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeActionPhoton
entries.docstring:
The gauge action on the complexified photon jet algebra: the
  complexification of the affine action `∂_s A_μ ↦ ∂_s A_μ + ∂_s ∂_μ χ`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def gaugeActionPhoton (c : Photon.JetAlgebra.GaugeJet) :
    (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra) →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeActionPhoton_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gaugeActionPhoton_tmul (c : Photon.JetAlgebra.GaugeJet) (x : ℂ)
    (p : Photon.JetAlgebra) :
    gaugeActionPhoton c (x ⊗ₜ[ℝ] p) = x ⊗ₜ[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction c p

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction
entries.docstring:
The gauge action on the QED jet algebra: the tensor product of the affine
  action on the photon factor with the Leibniz phase rotation on the electron
  factor.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def gaugeAction {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) :
    JetAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAction_tmul {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) (a : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra)
    (b : Electron.JetAlgebra) :
    gaugeAction g (a ⊗ⱼ b) =
      gaugeActionPhoton g.χjet a ⊗ⱼ Electron.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction g b

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.lorentzActionPhoton
entries.docstring: The Lorentz action on the complexified photon jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def lorentzActionPhoton (Λ : LorentzGroup 3) :
    (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra) →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.lorentzActionPhoton_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma lorentzActionPhoton_tmul (Λ : LorentzGroup 3) (x : ℂ) (p : Photon.JetAlgebra) :
    lorentzActionPhoton Λ (x ⊗ₜ[ℝ] p) = x ⊗ₜ[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction Λ p

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the QED jet algebra: the tensor product of the
  photon action through the covering map with the electron spinor action.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def lorentzAction (M : SL(2,ℂ)) : JetAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzAction_tmul (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (a : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra)
    (b : Electron.JetAlgebra) :
    lorentzAction M (a ⊗ⱼ b) =
      lorentzActionPhoton (Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup M) a ⊗ⱼ
        Electron.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction M b

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.massScalePhoton
entries.docstring: The mass-weight scaling on the complexified photon jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def massScalePhoton (c : ℝ) :
    (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra) →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.massScalePhoton_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma massScalePhoton_tmul (c : ℝ) (x : ℂ) (p : Photon.JetAlgebra) :
    massScalePhoton c (x ⊗ₜ[ℝ] p) = x ⊗ₜ[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra.massScale c p

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.massScale
entries.docstring:
The mass-weight scaling on the QED jet algebra: the algebra map
  multiplying each jet coordinate by `c` to the power of its mass weight,
  i.e. `c` squared to the power of its mass dimension.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def massScale (c : ℝ) : JetAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.massScale_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma massScale_tmul (c : ℝ) (a : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra)
    (b : Electron.JetAlgebra) :
    massScale c (a ⊗ⱼ b) =
      massScalePhoton c a ⊗ⱼ Electron.JetAlgebra.massScale c b

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
The formal total spacetime derivative on the QED jet algebra in the
  direction `ρ`: the Leibniz extension of the total derivatives of the photon
  and electron factors.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def jetDeriv (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : JetAlgebra →ₗ[ℂ] JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_tmul (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] Photon.JetAlgebra)
    (b : Electron.JetAlgebra) :
    jetDeriv ρ (a ⊗ⱼ b) =
      (LinearMap.baseChange ℂ (Photon.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv ρ) a) ⊗ⱼ b +
        a ⊗ⱼ Electron.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv ρ b

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDeriv_one (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : jetDeriv ρ (1 : JetAlgebra) = 0

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_mul
entries.docstring:
The total derivative is an even derivation on the QED jet algebra: the
  Leibniz rule holds with no Koszul signs.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_mul (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x y : JetAlgebra) :
    jetDeriv ρ (x * y) = jetDeriv ρ x * y + x * jetDeriv ρ y

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.A_mul_diracCurrent
entries.docstring:
The photon potential times the Dirac current, written through the fermion
  bilinears.
entries.snippet:
lemma A_mul_diracCurrent (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    A 0 μ * diracCurrent μ =
      ∑ α, ∑ β, kineticGamma μ α β • (A 0 μ * (barψ 0 α * ψ 0 β))

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.diracKineticTerm_eq_free_add_current
entries.docstring:
**Minimal coupling**: the Dirac kinetic term with coupling `e` is the free
  Dirac kinetic term plus the current coupling `- e J^μ A_μ`.  All of the
  interaction of QED is the photon contracted with the Dirac current, the
  jet-algebra counterpart of the current coupling of
  `Physlib.Electromagnetism.Dynamics`.
entries.snippet:
lemma diracKineticTerm_eq_free_add_current (e : ℝ) :
    diracKineticTerm e = diracKineticTerm 0 +
      (-e : ℂ) • ∑ μ, A 0 μ * diracCurrent μ

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_diracCurrent
entries.docstring:
**The Dirac current is gauge invariant**: the electron and its conjugate
  carry opposite charges, so the phases cancel by unitarity.  This is what
  makes `J^μ` a physically meaningful source for the photon.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gaugeAction_diracCurrent {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    gaugeAction g (diracCurrent μ) = diracCurrent μ

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.current_conservation
entries.docstring:
**Noether's identity for the Dirac current**: the divergence of the
  current is a combination of the Dirac-equation elements,
  `i ∂_μ J^μ = ψ̄ ⬝ (Dirac eq) + (adjoint Dirac eq) ⬝ ψ`.
  On solutions of the Dirac equations the current is conserved,
  `∂_μ J^μ = 0` — for every coupling `e` and mass `m`: the gauge interaction
  and the mass drop out of the divergence identically.
entries.snippet:
lemma current_conservation (e m : ℝ) :
    Complex.I • ∑ μ, jetDeriv μ (diracCurrent μ) =
      ∑ α, barψ 0 α * diracEquation e m α +
        ∑ β, diracAdjEquation e m β * ψ 0 β

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.deriv_coPotential
entries.docstring:
The derivative of a covariant component.  Differentiability is needed to move
  the constant `η_{νν}` through the derivative.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_coPotential (A : ElectromagneticPotential 3) (hA : Differentiable ℝ A)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : SpaceTime 3) :
    ∂_ μ (coPotential A ν) x = η ν ν * ∂_ μ A x ν

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.evalPotential_fieldStrength_zero_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma evalPotential_fieldStrength_zero_apply (A : ElectromagneticPotential 3)
    (hA : Differentiable ℝ A) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : SpaceTime 3) :
    evalPotential A (fieldStrength 0 μ ν) x = η ν ν * ∂_ μ A x ν - η μ μ * ∂_ ν A x μ

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.evalPotential_fieldStrength_zero
entries.docstring:
The formal field strength evaluates to the field strength of the potential
  with both indices lowered, `F_{μν} = η_{μμ} η_{νν} F^{μν}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma evalPotential_fieldStrength_zero (A : ElectromagneticPotential 3)
    (hA : Differentiable ℝ A) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : SpaceTime 3) :
    evalPotential A (fieldStrength 0 μ ν) x =
      η μ μ * η ν ν * toScalar {A.toFieldStrength x | [μ] [ν]}ᵀ

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.evalPotential_maxwellTerm
entries.docstring:
**The formal Maxwell term is the Maxwell Lagrangian.**  Evaluated on any
  differentiable electromagnetic potential, the gauge-invariant jet polynomial
  `F_{μν} F^{μν}` is `-4 μ₀` times the kinetic term
  `- 1/(4 μ₀) F_{μν} F^{μν}` of `Physlib.Electromagnetism`.
entries.snippet:
lemma evalPotential_maxwellTerm (𝓕 : FreeSpace) (A : ElectromagneticPotential 3)
    (hA : Differentiable ℝ A) (x : SpaceTime 3) :
    evalPotential A maxwellTerm x = -(4 * 𝓕.μ₀) * A.kineticTerm 𝓕 x

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.electricField_eq_evalPotential_fieldStrength
entries.docstring:
The electric field is (the speed of light times) the evaluated time–space
  components of the formal field strength: `E_i = c ∂_0 A_i - c ∂_i A_0`
  with lowered indices.
entries.snippet:
lemma electricField_eq_evalPotential_fieldStrength (c : SpeedOfLight)
    (A : ElectromagneticPotential 3) (hA : Differentiable ℝ A) (t : Time)
    (x : Space) (i : Fin 3) :
    A.electricField c t x i =
      c * evalPotential A (fieldStrength 0 (Sum.inl 0) (Sum.inr i))
        ((toTimeAndSpace c).symm (t, x))

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.magneticField_eq_evalPotential_fieldStrength
entries.docstring:
The magnetic field is the evaluated space–space components of the formal
  field strength, `B_i = - F_{(i+1)(i+2)}` with lowered indices.
entries.snippet:
lemma magneticField_eq_evalPotential_fieldStrength (c : SpeedOfLight)
    (A : ElectromagneticPotential 3) (hA : Differentiable ℝ A) (t : Time)
    (x : Space) (i : Fin 3) :
    A.magneticField c t x i =
      - evalPotential A (fieldStrength 0 (Sum.inr (i + 1)) (Sum.inr (i + 2)))
        ((toTimeAndSpace c).symm (t, x))

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.evalPotential_neg_quarter_maxwellTerm
entries.docstring:
The Maxwell part `- 1/4 F_{μν} F^{μν}` of the QED Lagrangian evaluates to
  `μ₀` times the electromagnetic kinetic term of
  `Physlib.Electromagnetism.Dynamics`: the two Lagrangians agree up to the
  choice of units absorbed into the field normalisation.
entries.snippet:
lemma evalPotential_neg_quarter_maxwellTerm (𝓕 : FreeSpace)
    (A : ElectromagneticPotential 3) (hA : Differentiable ℝ A) (x : SpaceTime 3) :
    evalPotential A ((-(1 : ℝ)/4) • maxwellTerm) x = 𝓕.μ₀ * A.kineticTerm 𝓕 x

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.contDiff_coPotential
entries.snippet:
lemma contDiff_coPotential {A : ElectromagneticPotential 3} (hA : ContDiff ℝ 2 A)
    (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (coPotential A ν)

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.derivMultiset_pair
entries.docstring:
The iterated derivative along a pair of directions, in either order: for a
  `C²` function the canonical sorted order is immaterial by Clairaut's
  theorem.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivMultiset_pair (a b : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (f : SpaceTime 3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) :
    derivMultiset {a, b} f = ∂_ a (∂_ b f)

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.deriv_sub_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_sub_eq {f g : SpaceTime 3 → ℝ} (lam : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hg : Differentiable ℝ g) :
    ∂_ lam (f - g) = ∂_ lam f - ∂_ lam g

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.evalPotential_fieldStrength_singleton
entries.docstring:
Evaluation intertwines the first-order jet with the spacetime derivative:
  the evaluated `∂_lam F_{μν}` is the derivative of the evaluated `F_{μν}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma evalPotential_fieldStrength_singleton (A : ElectromagneticPotential 3)
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ 2 A) (lam μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    evalPotential A (fieldStrength {lam} μ ν) =
      ∂_ lam (evalPotential A (fieldStrength 0 μ ν))

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.evalPotential_maxwell_homogeneous
entries.docstring:
**The homogeneous Maxwell equations** in covariant form,
  `∂_lam F_{μν} + ∂_μ F_{ν lam} + ∂_ν F_{lam μ} = 0`, as the evaluation of the
  formal Bianchi identity of `PhyslibAlpha.Particles.QED.FieldStrength`: Faraday's law and
  the absence of magnetic monopoles are its time–space–space and
  space–space–space components.
entries.snippet:
lemma evalPotential_maxwell_homogeneous (A : ElectromagneticPotential 3)
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ 2 A) (lam μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    ∂_ lam (evalPotential A (fieldStrength 0 μ ν)) +
      ∂_ μ (evalPotential A (fieldStrength 0 ν lam)) +
      ∂_ ν (evalPotential A (fieldStrength 0 lam μ)) = 0

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.deriv_const_mul_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_const_mul_apply (c : ℝ) {f : SpaceTime 3 → ℝ} (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (x : SpaceTime 3) :
    ∂_ ρ (fun y => c * f y) x = c * ∂_ ρ f x

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.isExtrema_iff_evalPotential_maxwellOperator
entries.docstring:
**The action principle through the jet algebra**: an electromagnetic
  potential extremises the Maxwell action with source `J` exactly when the
  evaluated formal Maxwell operator equals `μ₀ J` — the inhomogeneous Maxwell
  equations `∂_μ F^{μν} = μ₀ J^ν`.
entries.snippet:
lemma isExtrema_iff_evalPotential_maxwellOperator (𝓕 : FreeSpace)
    (A : ElectromagneticPotential 3) (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A)
    (J : LorentzCurrentDensity 3) (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) :
    ElectromagneticPotential.IsExtrema 𝓕 A J ↔
      ∀ x ν, evalPotential A (maxwellOperator ν) x = 𝓕.μ₀ * J x ν

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.evalPotential_fieldStrength_lorentzAction
entries.docstring:
**Compatibility of the formal and concrete Lorentz actions**: the
  evaluation of the field strength on `Λ • A` at `x` is the evaluation of its
  formal Lorentz transform on `A` at `Λ⁻¹ • x`, matching the equivariance
  `Physlib.Electromagnetism.Kinematics.FieldStrength.toFieldStrength_equivariant`
  on the concrete side.
entries.snippet:
lemma evalPotential_fieldStrength_lorentzAction (Λ : LorentzGroup 3)
    (A : ElectromagneticPotential 3) (hA : Differentiable ℝ A)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : SpaceTime 3) :
    evalPotential (Λ • A) (fieldStrength 0 μ ν) x =
      evalPotential A (lorentzAction Λ (fieldStrength 0 μ ν)) (Λ⁻¹ • x)

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.differentiable_gaugeTransform
QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.evalPotential_fieldStrength_gaugeTransform
entries.docstring:
The evaluated field strength is invariant under the concrete gauge
  transformation `A ↦ A + ∂χ`, matching the formal gauge invariance
  `Physlib.Particles.QED.GaugeInvariance.Photon.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_fieldStrength`.
entries.snippet:
lemma evalPotential_fieldStrength_gaugeTransform (A : ElectromagneticPotential 3)
    (χ : SpaceTime 3 → ℝ) (hA : Differentiable ℝ A) (hχ : ContDiff ℝ 2 χ)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : SpaceTime 3) :
    evalPotential (ElectromagneticPotential.gaugeTransform χ A) (fieldStrength 0 μ ν) x =
      evalPotential A (fieldStrength 0 μ ν) x

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.evalPotential_maxwellTerm_gaugeTransform
entries.docstring: The Maxwell Lagrangian is gauge invariant, as read off from the jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma evalPotential_maxwellTerm_gaugeTransform (A : ElectromagneticPotential 3)
    (χ : SpaceTime 3 → ℝ) (hA : Differentiable ℝ A) (hχ : ContDiff ℝ 2 χ)
    (x : SpaceTime 3) :
    evalPotential (ElectromagneticPotential.gaugeTransform χ A) maxwellTerm x =
      evalPotential A maxwellTerm x

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.ofGenerator_mul_self
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofGenerator_mul_self (j : JetGenerators) :
    ofGenerator j * ofGenerator j = 0

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.ofGenerator_anticommute
entries.docstring:
The jet coordinates of the electron anticommute: the electron is a
  fermion.
entries.snippet:
lemma ofGenerator_anticommute (i j : JetGenerators) :
    ofGenerator i * ofGenerator j = -(ofGenerator j * ofGenerator i)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.ψ_mul_ψ_anticomm
entries.docstring: The electron jet coordinates anticommute.
entries.snippet:
lemma ψ_mul_ψ_anticomm (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (α β : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    ψ s α * ψ t β = -(ψ t β * ψ s α)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.ψ_mul_barψ_anticomm
entries.docstring: The electron and conjugate-electron jet coordinates anticommute.
entries.snippet:
lemma ψ_mul_barψ_anticomm (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (α β : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    ψ s α * barψ t β = -(barψ t β * ψ s α)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.barψ_mul_barψ_anticomm
entries.docstring: The conjugate-electron jet coordinates anticommute.
entries.snippet:
lemma barψ_mul_barψ_anticomm (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (α β : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    barψ s α * barψ t β = -(barψ t β * barψ s α)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.ψ_mul_self
entries.docstring: Pauli exclusion: an electron jet coordinate squares to zero.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ψ_mul_self (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    ψ s α * ψ s α = 0

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.barψ_mul_self
entries.docstring: Pauli exclusion: a conjugate electron jet coordinate squares to zero.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma barψ_mul_self (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    barψ s α * barψ s α = 0

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.A_mul_A_comm
entries.docstring:
The photon jet coordinates commute among themselves: the photon is a
  boson.
entries.snippet:
lemma A_mul_A_comm (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    A s μ * A t ν = A t ν * A s μ

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.A_mul_ψ_comm
entries.docstring: The photon jet coordinates commute with the electron jet coordinates.
entries.snippet:
lemma A_mul_ψ_comm (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    A s μ * ψ t α = ψ t α * A s μ

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.A_mul_barψ_comm
entries.docstring:
The photon jet coordinates commute with the conjugate electron jet
  coordinates.
entries.snippet:
lemma A_mul_barψ_comm (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    A s μ * barψ t α = barψ t α * A s μ

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.fieldStrength
entries.docstring: The formal field strength `∂_s F_{μν} = ∂_s ∂_μ A_ν - ∂_s ∂_ν A_μ`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fieldStrength (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.maxwellTerm
entries.docstring:
The formal Maxwell term `F_{μν} F^{μν}`, both indices raised with the
  (diagonal) Minkowski metric.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def maxwellTerm : JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.maxwellOperator
entries.docstring:
The Maxwell operator `∂_μ F^{μν}`: the divergence of the field strength
  with raised indices.  Its vanishing is the vacuum Maxwell equation; its
  evaluation on an honest potential is the Euler–Lagrange gradient of the
  Maxwell action — see `PhyslibAlpha.Particles.QED.Evaluation`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def maxwellOperator (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.A
entries.docstring: The photon jet coordinate `∂_s A_μ` in the QED jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def A (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.ψ
entries.docstring: The electron jet coordinate `∂_s ψ_α` in the QED jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def ψ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.barψ
entries.docstring: The conjugate electron jet coordinate `∂_s ψ̄_α` in the QED jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def barψ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.fieldStrength
entries.docstring: The formal field strength `∂_s F_{μν}` in the QED jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fieldStrength (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.maxwellTerm
entries.snippet: noncomputable def maxwellTerm : JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gammaMatrix
entries.docstring:
The Dirac γ matrices in the chiral (Weyl) representation:
  `γ^μ = ((0, σ^μ), (σ̄^μ, 0))`, acting on the Dirac index `Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2`
  whose summands are the left- and right-handed Weyl components.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def gammaMatrix (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Matrix (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) ℂ

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.kineticGamma
entries.docstring:
The contraction matrices `γ⁰ γ^μ = ((σ̄^μ, 0), (0, σ^μ))` of the Dirac
  kinetic term `i ψ† (γ⁰ γ^μ) D_μ ψ`; see
  `Physlib.Particles.QED.GammaMatrices.kineticGamma_eq_gammaMatrix_mul`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def kineticGamma (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Matrix (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) ℂ

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.covDψ
entries.docstring:
The covariant derivative jet `(D_μ ψ)_α = ∂_μ ψ_α + i e A_μ ψ_α` of the
  electron.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def covDψ (e : ℝ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.covDbarψ
entries.docstring:
The covariant derivative jet `(D_μ ψ̄)_α = ∂_μ ψ̄_α - i e A_μ ψ̄_α` of the
  conjugate electron.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def covDbarψ (e : ℝ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.fieldStrength_antisymm
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrength_antisymm (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    fieldStrength s μ ν = -fieldStrength s ν μ

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.fieldStrength_self
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fieldStrength_self (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    fieldStrength s μ μ = 0

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.fieldStrength_bianchi
entries.docstring:
**The Bianchi identity** `∂_lam F_{μν} + ∂_μ F_{ν lam} + ∂_ν F_{lam μ} = 0`
  in the photon jet algebra: the homogeneous Maxwell equations hold exactly,
  for every derivative order `s`.
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrength_bianchi (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (lam μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    fieldStrength (s + {lam}) μ ν + fieldStrength (s + {μ}) ν lam +
      fieldStrength (s + {ν}) lam μ = 0

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.fieldStrength_eq_sub
entries.docstring:
The field strength is the antisymmetrised derivative of the potential,
  `∂_s F_{μν} = ∂_s ∂_μ A_ν - ∂_s ∂_ν A_μ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrength_eq_sub (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    fieldStrength s μ ν = A (s + {μ}) ν - A (s + {ν}) μ

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.fieldStrength_antisymm
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrength_antisymm (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    fieldStrength s μ ν = -fieldStrength s ν μ

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.fieldStrength_self
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fieldStrength_self (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    fieldStrength s μ μ = 0

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.fieldStrength_bianchi
entries.docstring: **The Bianchi identity** in the QED jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrength_bianchi (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (lam μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    fieldStrength (s + {lam}) μ ν + fieldStrength (s + {μ}) ν lam +
      fieldStrength (s + {ν}) lam μ = 0

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.fieldStrength_singleton_eq_jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
The first-order field-strength jet is the total derivative of the
  zeroth-order one, in the photon jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma _root_.QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.fieldStrength_singleton_eq_jetDeriv
    (ρ μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Photon.JetAlgebra.fieldStrength {ρ} μ ν =
      Photon.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv ρ (Photon.JetAlgebra.fieldStrength 0 μ ν)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_A
entries.docstring:
The total derivative appends the derivative index to the photon jet
  coordinate.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDeriv_A (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    jetDeriv ρ (A s μ) = A (s + {ρ}) μ

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_ψ
entries.docstring:
The total derivative appends the derivative index to the electron jet
  coordinate.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDeriv_ψ (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    jetDeriv ρ (ψ s α) = ψ (s + {ρ}) α

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_barψ
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDeriv_barψ (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    jetDeriv ρ (barψ s α) = barψ (s + {ρ}) α

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.pauliMatrix_mul_smul_add_swap
entries.snippet:
lemma pauliMatrix_mul_smul_add_swap (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    σ μ * (η ν ν • σ ν) + σ ν * (η μ μ • σ μ) =
      (2 * η μ ν) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.smul_pauliMatrix_mul_add_swap
entries.snippet:
lemma smul_pauliMatrix_mul_add_swap (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (η μ μ • σ μ) * σ ν + (η ν ν • σ ν) * σ μ =
      (2 * η μ ν) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gammaMatrix_mul_add_swap
entries.docstring:
**The Clifford algebra relation** of the Dirac γ matrices:
  `γ^μ γ^ν + γ^ν γ^μ = 2 η^{μν} 1`.  This is the algebraic identity that
  makes the Dirac operator a square root of the wave operator, and hence the
  Dirac equation relativistic.
entries.snippet:
lemma gammaMatrix_mul_add_swap (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    gammaMatrix μ * gammaMatrix ν + gammaMatrix ν * gammaMatrix μ =
      (2 * η μ ν) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) ℂ)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gammaMatrix_sq
entries.docstring: The square of a γ matrix: `(γ^μ)² = η^{μμ} 1` (no sum).
entries.snippet:
lemma gammaMatrix_sq (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    gammaMatrix μ * gammaMatrix μ =
      (η μ μ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) ℂ)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gammaMatrix_anticommute
entries.docstring: The γ matrices of distinct indices anticommute.
entries.snippet:
lemma gammaMatrix_anticommute {μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3} (h : μ ≠ ν) :
    gammaMatrix μ * gammaMatrix ν = -(gammaMatrix ν * gammaMatrix μ)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gammaMatrix_inl_zero
entries.docstring: `γ⁰` in the chiral representation is the block off-diagonal identity.
entries.snippet:
lemma gammaMatrix_inl_zero :
    gammaMatrix (Sum.inl 0) = Matrix.fromBlocks 0 1 1 0

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.kineticGamma_eq_gammaMatrix_mul
entries.docstring: The contraction matrices of the kinetic term are `γ⁰ γ^μ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma kineticGamma_eq_gammaMatrix_mul (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    kineticGamma μ = gammaMatrix (Sum.inl 0) * gammaMatrix μ

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.kineticGamma_conjTranspose
entries.snippet:
lemma kineticGamma_conjTranspose (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (kineticGamma μ)ᴴ = kineticGamma μ

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gammaMatrix_zero_conjTranspose
entries.docstring: `γ⁰` is self-adjoint.
entries.snippet:
lemma gammaMatrix_zero_conjTranspose :
    (gammaMatrix (Sum.inl 0))ᴴ = gammaMatrix (Sum.inl 0)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gammaMatrix_conjTranspose
entries.docstring: The hermiticity relation of the γ matrices, `(γ^μ)† = γ⁰ γ^μ γ⁰`.
entries.snippet:
lemma gammaMatrix_conjTranspose (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (gammaMatrix μ)ᴴ =
      gammaMatrix (Sum.inl 0) * gammaMatrix μ * gammaMatrix (Sum.inl 0)

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_comp
entries.docstring:
Photon gauge jets compose by addition: the gauge transformations form a
  group acting on the photon jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAction_comp (c₁ c₂ : GaugeJet) :
    (gaugeAction c₁).comp (gaugeAction c₂) = gaugeAction (c₁ + c₂)

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gaugeAction_zero : gaugeAction 0 = AlgHom.id ℝ JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_fieldStrength
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gaugeAction_fieldStrength (c : GaugeJet) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    gaugeAction c (fieldStrength s μ ν) = fieldStrength s μ ν

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_maxwellTerm
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gaugeAction_maxwellTerm (c : GaugeJet) : gaugeAction c maxwellTerm = maxwellTerm

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_trivial
entries.docstring:
The trivial gauge jet acts trivially on the electron jet algebra: the
  gauge action is unital.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAction_trivial (e : ℝ) :
    gaugeAction (GaugeJet.trivial e) = AlgHom.id ℂ JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_trivial
entries.docstring:
The trivial gauge jet acts trivially on the QED jet algebra: the gauge
  action is unital.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAction_trivial (e : ℝ) :
    gaugeAction (GaugeJet.trivial e) = AlgHom.id ℂ JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_mul
entries.docstring: The electron gauge actions compose through the monoid of gauge jets.
entries.snippet:
lemma _root_.QED.Electron.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_mul {e : ℝ} (g₁ g₂ : GaugeJet e) :
    (Electron.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction g₁).comp (Electron.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction g₂) =
      Electron.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction (g₁ * g₂)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeActionPhoton_comp
entries.docstring:
The complexified photon gauge actions compose by addition of the gauge
  jets.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeActionPhoton_comp (c₁ c₂ : Photon.JetAlgebra.GaugeJet) :
    (gaugeActionPhoton c₁).comp (gaugeActionPhoton c₂) =
      gaugeActionPhoton (c₁ + c₂)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_mul
entries.docstring:
**The gauge actions compose through the monoid of gauge jets**: the QED
  gauge action is a monoid action on the jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAction_mul {e : ℝ} (g₁ g₂ : GaugeJet e) :
    (gaugeAction g₁).comp (gaugeAction g₂) = gaugeAction (g₁ * g₂)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_mul_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAction_mul_apply {e : ℝ} (g₁ g₂ : GaugeJet e) (x : JetAlgebra) :
    gaugeAction (g₁ * g₂) x = gaugeAction g₁ (gaugeAction g₂ x)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_A
entries.docstring:
The gauge action on the photon jet coordinate: the affine shift
  `∂_s A_μ ↦ ∂_s A_μ + ∂_s ∂_μ χ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAction_A {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    gaugeAction g (A s μ) = A s μ + (g.χjet (s + {μ}) : ℂ) • 1

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_ψ_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gaugeAction_ψ_zero {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    gaugeAction g (ψ 0 α) = star (g.phase 0) • ψ 0 α

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_barψ_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gaugeAction_barψ_zero {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    gaugeAction g (barψ 0 α) = g.phase 0 • barψ 0 α

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_ψ_singleton
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAction_ψ_singleton {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    gaugeAction g (ψ {μ} α) =
      star (g.phase 0) • ψ {μ} α + star (g.phase {μ}) • ψ 0 α

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_barψ_singleton
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAction_barψ_singleton {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    gaugeAction g (barψ {μ} α) =
      g.phase 0 • barψ {μ} α + g.phase {μ} • barψ 0 α

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_fieldStrength
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gaugeAction_fieldStrength {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    gaugeAction g (fieldStrength s μ ν) = fieldStrength s μ ν

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_maxwellTerm
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gaugeAction_maxwellTerm {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) :
    gaugeAction g maxwellTerm = maxwellTerm

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_covDψ
entries.docstring:
**Gauge covariance of the covariant derivative**: `D_μ ψ` rotates by the
  conjugate phase, exactly like `ψ` itself.  The shift of the photon
  coordinate cancels the derivative of the phase.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAction_covDψ {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    gaugeAction g (covDψ e μ α) = star (g.phase 0) • covDψ e μ α

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_covDbarψ
entries.docstring:
Gauge covariance of the conjugate covariant derivative: `D_μ ψ̄` rotates
  by the phase, exactly like `ψ̄` itself.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAction_covDbarψ {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    gaugeAction g (covDbarψ e μ α) = g.phase 0 • covDbarψ e μ α

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_mul_phase_cancel
entries.docstring:
A product of a factor rotating by the phase and a factor rotating by the
  conjugate phase is gauge invariant: the phases cancel by unitarity.  This is
  the reason every charge-neutral fermion bilinear of QED is gauge
  invariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAction_mul_phase_cancel {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) {x y : JetAlgebra}
    (hx : gaugeAction g x = g.phase 0 • x)
    (hy : gaugeAction g y = star (g.phase 0) • y) :
    gaugeAction g (x * y) = x * y

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_diracKineticTerm
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gaugeAction_diracKineticTerm {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) :
    gaugeAction g (diracKineticTerm e) = diracKineticTerm e

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_diracKineticTermBar
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gaugeAction_diracKineticTermBar {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) :
    gaugeAction g (diracKineticTermBar e) = diracKineticTermBar e

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_electronMassTerm
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gaugeAction_electronMassTerm {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) :
    gaugeAction g electronMassTerm = electronMassTerm

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.gaugeAction_lagrangian
entries.docstring:
**Gauge invariance of the QED Lagrangian.**  The Maxwell term is invariant
  by the symmetry of the photon shift in its derivative indices, the kinetic
  term by the covariance of the covariant derivative, and the mass term by the
  unitarity of the phase.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAction_lagrangian {e : ℝ} (g : GaugeJet e) (m : ℝ) :
    gaugeAction g (lagrangian e m) = lagrangian e m

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetGenerators.indexClass_dA
entries.snippet:
lemma indexClass_dA (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (JetGenerators.dA s μ).indexClass = s + {μ}

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetGenerators.indexClass_ne_zero
entries.snippet: lemma indexClass_ne_zero (j : JetGenerators) : j.indexClass ≠ 0

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetGenerators.indexClass_classProj
entries.docstring:
Erasing the class representative and putting it back as the Lorentz index
  preserves the class.
entries.snippet:
lemma indexClass_classProj (j : JetGenerators) :
    j.classProj.indexClass = j.indexClass

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetGenerators.classProj_idem
entries.docstring: The class projection is idempotent.
entries.snippet: lemma classProj_idem (j : JetGenerators) : j.classProj.classProj = j.classProj

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetGenerators.classProj_eq_classProj_iff
entries.docstring:
Two jet coordinates have the same class projection exactly when they lie
  in the same symmetrized-index class.
entries.snippet:
lemma classProj_eq_classProj_iff (j j' : JetGenerators) :
    j.classProj = j'.classProj ↔ j.indexClass = j'.indexClass

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.coord_sub_classProj
entries.docstring:
A jet coordinate minus the canonical coordinate of its class is a
  derivative of the field strength.
entries.snippet:
lemma coord_sub_classProj (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (h : (JetGenerators.dA s μ).classProj ≠ JetGenerators.dA s μ) :
    (X (JetGenerators.dA s μ) : JetAlgebra) - X ((JetGenerators.dA s μ).classProj) =
      fieldStrength (s.erase (classRep (s + {μ}))) (classRep (s + {μ})) μ

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.fieldStrength_mem_range
entries.docstring: Every field-strength jet lies in the range of the field-strength family.
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrength_mem_range (t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    fieldStrength t μ ν ∈ Set.range (fun p :
        Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) =>
        fieldStrength p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.gaugeInvariant_iff_mem_adjoin_fieldStrength
entries.docstring:
**Completeness of the field strength for gauge invariance**: an element of
  the photon jet algebra is invariant under every gauge transformation if and
  only if it is a polynomial in the derivatives `∂_s F_{μν}` of the field
  strength.  The field strength does not just provide *some* gauge invariants
  — it generates *all* of them.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeInvariant_iff_mem_adjoin_fieldStrength (x : JetAlgebra) :
    (∀ c : GaugeJet, gaugeAction c x = x) ↔
      x ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℝ (Set.range fun p :
        Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) =>
        fieldStrength p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.diracKineticTerm
entries.docstring:
The Dirac kinetic term `i ψ̄ γ^μ D_μ ψ = i ψ†_α (γ⁰ γ^μ)_{αβ} (D_μ ψ)_β`
  of the electron.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def diracKineticTerm (e : ℝ) : JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.diracKineticTermBar
entries.docstring:
The conjugate Dirac kinetic term
  `-i (D_μ ψ̄) γ⁰ γ^μ ψ = -i (D_μ ψ̄)_α (γ⁰ γ^μ)_{αβ} ψ_β`; the hermitian form
  of the kinetic term is the average of `diracKineticTerm` and this term.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def diracKineticTermBar (e : ℝ) : JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.electronMassTerm
entries.docstring:
The Dirac mass term `ψ̄ ψ = ψ†_α (γ⁰)_{αβ} ψ_β` of the electron.  This is
  the dimension-three term available because the electron is a Dirac fermion:
  its two Weyl components have the same electric charge, so the bilinear
  pairing them against the conjugate components is charge neutral.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def electronMassTerm : JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.diracCurrent
entries.docstring:
The Dirac current `J^μ = ψ̄ γ^μ ψ = ψ†_α (γ⁰ γ^μ)_{αβ} ψ_β` of the
  electron: the Noether current of the `U(1)_em` phase symmetry.  Its coupling
  `- e J^μ A_μ` to the photon is the entire interaction of QED — this is the
  jet-algebra counterpart of the current coupling of
  `Physlib.Electromagnetism.Dynamics`; see `PhyslibAlpha.Particles.QED.CurrentCoupling`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def diracCurrent (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.diracEquation
entries.docstring:
The Dirac-equation element `γ⁰ (i γ^μ D_μ - m) ψ`, row `α`: its vanishing
  is the interacting Dirac equation.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def diracEquation (e m : ℝ) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) : JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.diracAdjEquation
entries.docstring:
The adjoint Dirac-equation element `i (D_μ ψ̄) γ⁰ γ^μ + m ψ̄ γ⁰`,
  column `β`: its vanishing is the interacting adjoint Dirac equation.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def diracAdjEquation (e m : ℝ) (β : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) : JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.qedMaxwellEquation
entries.docstring:
The QED Maxwell-equation element `∂_μ F^{μν} - e J^ν`: its vanishing is
  the inhomogeneous Maxwell equation sourced by the Dirac current.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def qedMaxwellEquation (e : ℝ) (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.lagrangian
entries.docstring:
The QED Lagrangian
  `L = - 1/4 F_{μν} F^{μν} + i ψ̄ γ^μ D_μ ψ - m ψ̄ ψ`
  with electric coupling `e` and electron mass `m`, as an element of the QED
  jet algebra.  Evaluated on an honest electromagnetic potential, the first
  term is the Maxwell Lagrangian of `Physlib.Electromagnetism`; see
  `PhyslibAlpha.Particles.QED.Evaluation`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def lagrangian (e m : ℝ) : JetAlgebra

entries.name: QED.sum_eta_inv_inv
entries.docstring:
The defining property of the Lorentz group in index form: contracting two
  rows of `Λ⁻¹` with the Minkowski metric reproduces the metric.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_eta_inv_inv (Λ : LorentzGroup 3) (τ τ' : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    ∑ μ, η μ μ * ((Λ⁻¹).1 τ μ * (Λ⁻¹).1 τ' μ) = η τ τ'

entries.name: QED.pauliSelfAdjoint'_coe
entries.docstring: The covariant Pauli matrices are `σ̄^μ = η_{μμ} σ^μ` (no sum).
entries.snippet:
lemma pauliSelfAdjoint'_coe (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (PauliMatrix.pauliSelfAdjoint' μ).1 = η μ μ • σ μ

entries.name: QED.kineticGamma_eq_fromBlocks_pauliSelfAdjoint'
entries.docstring:
The kinetic matrices through the covariant Pauli matrices:
  `γ⁰ γ^μ = ((σ̄^μ, 0), (0, η_{μμ} σ̄^μ))`.
entries.snippet:
lemma kineticGamma_eq_fromBlocks_pauliSelfAdjoint' (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    JetAlgebra.kineticGamma μ =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (PauliMatrix.pauliSelfAdjoint' μ).1 0 0
        (η μ μ • (PauliMatrix.pauliSelfAdjoint' μ).1)

entries.name: QED.sl2c_conj_pauliSelfAdjoint'
entries.docstring:
Conjugating a covariant Pauli matrix by `N : SL(2,ℂ)` transforms its
  index by the image of `N` in the Lorentz group; this is the defining
  property of the covering map.
entries.snippet:
lemma sl2c_conj_pauliSelfAdjoint' (N : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    N.1 * (PauliMatrix.pauliSelfAdjoint' μ).1 * N.1ᴴ =
      ∑ ν, (Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup N).1 ν μ •
        (PauliMatrix.pauliSelfAdjoint' ν).1

entries.name: QED.sum_fromBlocks
entries.docstring: A block matrix summed over the diagonal blocks.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_fromBlocks {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (A : ι → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (D : ι → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, Matrix.fromBlocks (A i) 0 0 (D i) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (∑ i ∈ s, A i) 0 0 (∑ i ∈ s, D i)

entries.name: QED.sum_lorentz_inv_conjTranspose_pauli_conj
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_lorentz_inv_conjTranspose_pauli_conj (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (τ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    ∑ μ, ((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup M)⁻¹).1 τ μ •
        (M.1ᴴ * (PauliMatrix.pauliSelfAdjoint' μ).1 * M.1) =
      (PauliMatrix.pauliSelfAdjoint' τ).1

entries.name: QED.sum_lorentz_inv_eta_pauli_conj
entries.docstring:
The right Weyl block: transporting the index of `η_{μμ} σ̄^μ` with
  `Λ(M)⁻¹` cancels the conjugation by `(M⁻¹)†`, through `Λ⁻¹ η (Λ⁻¹)ᵀ = η`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_lorentz_inv_eta_pauli_conj (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (τ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    ∑ μ, (((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup M)⁻¹).1 τ μ * η μ μ) •
        ((M⁻¹).1 * (PauliMatrix.pauliSelfAdjoint' μ).1 * ((M⁻¹).1)ᴴ) =
      η τ τ • (PauliMatrix.pauliSelfAdjoint' τ).1

entries.name: QED.sum_lorentz_inv_spinorRep_kineticGamma
entries.docstring:
The matrix form of the contraction identity: transporting the vector index
  of `γ⁰ γ^μ` with `Λ(M)⁻¹` cancels the conjugation by the spinor
  representation.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_lorentz_inv_spinorRep_kineticGamma (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (τ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    ∑ μ, ((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup M)⁻¹).1 τ μ •
        ((Electron.JetAlgebra.spinorRep M)ᴴ * JetAlgebra.kineticGamma μ *
          Electron.JetAlgebra.spinorRep M) =
      JetAlgebra.kineticGamma τ

entries.name: QED.sum_kineticGamma_contraction
entries.docstring:
**The contraction identity of the Dirac kinetic term**: the index form of
  `∑_μ (Λ⁻¹)_{τμ} S(M)† (γ⁰ γ^μ) S(M) = γ⁰ γ^τ`.  This is the identity that
  makes `i ψ̄ γ^μ D_μ ψ` a Lorentz scalar.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_kineticGamma_contraction (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (τ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (α' β' : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    ∑ μ, ∑ α, ∑ β, JetAlgebra.kineticGamma μ α β *
        (star (Electron.JetAlgebra.spinorRep M α α') *
          (((((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup M)⁻¹).1 τ μ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
            Electron.JetAlgebra.spinorRep M β β')) =
      JetAlgebra.kineticGamma τ α' β'

entries.name: QED.spinorRep_conjTranspose_gammaZero_spinorRep
entries.docstring:
The spinor representation preserves `γ⁰`: `S(M)† γ⁰ S(M) = γ⁰`.  This is
  the identity that makes the Dirac mass term `m ψ̄ ψ` a Lorentz scalar.
entries.snippet:
lemma spinorRep_conjTranspose_gammaZero_spinorRep (M : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    (Electron.JetAlgebra.spinorRep M)ᴴ * JetAlgebra.gammaMatrix (Sum.inl 0) *
      Electron.JetAlgebra.spinorRep M = JetAlgebra.gammaMatrix (Sum.inl 0)

entries.name: QED.sum_gammaZero_contraction
entries.docstring: The index form of `S(M)† γ⁰ S(M) = γ⁰`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_gammaZero_contraction (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (α' β' : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    ∑ α, ∑ β, JetAlgebra.gammaMatrix (Sum.inl 0) α β *
        (star (Electron.JetAlgebra.spinorRep M α α') *
          Electron.JetAlgebra.spinorRep M β β') =
      JetAlgebra.gammaMatrix (Sum.inl 0) α' β'

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction_A_zero
entries.docstring: The photon jet coordinate transforms as a covector.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzAction_A_zero (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    lorentzAction M (A 0 μ) =
      ∑ ν, ((((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup M)⁻¹).1 ν μ : ℝ) : ℂ) • A 0 ν

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction_A_singleton
entries.docstring: The first-order photon jet coordinate transforms as a two-tensor.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzAction_A_singleton (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (ρ μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    lorentzAction M (A {ρ} μ) =
      ∑ τ, ∑ ν, ((((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup M)⁻¹).1 τ ρ *
          ((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup M)⁻¹).1 ν μ : ℝ) : ℂ) • A {τ} ν

entries.docstring: The electron jet coordinate transforms in the spinor representation.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzAction_ψ_zero (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    lorentzAction M (ψ 0 α) =
      ∑ β, Electron.JetAlgebra.spinorRep M α β • ψ 0 β

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction_barψ_zero
entries.docstring:
The conjugate electron jet coordinate transforms in the conjugate spinor
  representation.
