lemma lorentzAction_barψ_zero (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    lorentzAction M (barψ 0 α) =
      ∑ β, star (Electron.JetAlgebra.spinorRep M α β) • barψ 0 β

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction_ψ_singleton
entries.docstring:
The first-order electron jet coordinate transforms as a spinor with a
  covector derivative index.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzAction_ψ_singleton (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    lorentzAction M (ψ {ρ} α) =
      ∑ τ, ∑ β, (((((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup M)⁻¹).1 τ ρ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          Electron.JetAlgebra.spinorRep M α β) • ψ {τ} β

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction_barψ_singleton
entries.snippet:

    (α : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    lorentzAction M (barψ {ρ} α) =

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction_fieldStrength_zero
entries.docstring: The formal field strength transforms as an antisymmetric two-tensor.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzAction_fieldStrength_zero (Λ : LorentzGroup 3) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    lorentzAction Λ (fieldStrength 0 μ ν) =
      ∑ a, ∑ b, ((Λ⁻¹).1 a μ * (Λ⁻¹).1 b ν) • fieldStrength 0 a b

entries.name: QED.Photon.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction_maxwellTerm
entries.docstring:
**Lorentz invariance of the Maxwell term** in the photon jet algebra:
  the two metric contractions absorb the four transformation matrices through
  `Λ⁻¹ η (Λ⁻¹)ᵀ = η`.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzAction_maxwellTerm (Λ : LorentzGroup 3) :
    lorentzAction Λ maxwellTerm = maxwellTerm

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction_maxwellTerm
entries.docstring:
**Lorentz invariance of the Maxwell term** in the QED jet algebra,
  inherited from the photon jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzAction_maxwellTerm (M : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    lorentzAction M maxwellTerm = maxwellTerm

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction_covDψ
entries.docstring:
The covariant derivative transforms exactly like the first-order jet
  coordinate: as a spinor with a covector derivative index.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzAction_covDψ (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (e : ℝ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (β : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    lorentzAction M (covDψ e μ β) =
      ∑ τ, ∑ β', (((((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup M)⁻¹).1 τ μ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        Electron.JetAlgebra.spinorRep M β β') • covDψ e τ β'

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction_electronMassTerm
entries.docstring:
**Lorentz invariance of the Dirac mass term**: the spinor phases of the
  electron and its conjugate cancel through `S(M)† γ⁰ S(M) = γ⁰`.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzAction_electronMassTerm (M : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    lorentzAction M electronMassTerm = electronMassTerm

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction_diracKineticTerm
entries.docstring:
**Lorentz invariance of the Dirac kinetic term**: the transformation of
  the two spinor slots and the derivative slot cancels through the contraction
  identity of the matrices `γ⁰ γ^μ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzAction_diracKineticTerm (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (e : ℝ) :
    lorentzAction M (diracKineticTerm e) = diracKineticTerm e

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.lorentzAction_lagrangian
entries.docstring:
**Lorentz invariance of the QED Lagrangian.**  The Maxwell term is
  invariant through `Λ⁻¹ η (Λ⁻¹)ᵀ = η`, the kinetic term through the
  contraction identity of `γ⁰ γ^μ` under the spinor representation, and the
  mass term through `S(M)† γ⁰ S(M) = γ⁰`.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzAction_lagrangian (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (e m : ℝ) :
    lorentzAction M (lagrangian e m) = lagrangian e m

entries.docstring:

  plain derivative: the electric coupling `e` is dimensionless.  This is the
  power-counting statement behind the renormalizability of QED.

    massScale c (covDψ e μ α) = (c : ℂ) ^ 5 • covDψ e μ α

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.massScale_maxwellTerm
entries.docstring: The Maxwell term has mass dimension four.
entries.snippet:
lemma massScale_maxwellTerm (c : ℝ) :
    massScale c maxwellTerm = (c : ℂ) ^ 8 • maxwellTerm

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.massScale_diracKineticTerm

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.massScale_diracKineticTermBar

entries.snippet:

entries.name: QED.JetAlgebra.massScale_lagrangian
entries.docstring:
**The QED Lagrangian has mass dimension four.**  Rescaling all fields by
  their mass weights takes `L(e, c² m)` to `c⁸ L(e, m)`: the coupling `e` is
  dimensionless and the electron mass is a coefficient of dimension one, so
  every term of the Lagrangian is renormalizable.
entries.snippet:
lemma massScale_lagrangian (c : ℝ) (e m : ℝ) :
    massScale c (lagrangian e (c ^ 2 * m)) = (c : ℂ) ^ 8 • lagrangian e m

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization
entries.docstring:
The algebra `B`, with a gauge action, a Lorentz action and a mass-weight grading, is a
  covariant Standard Model when it receives an algebra map from the covariant jet algebra of
  the Standard Model which is equivariant for both actions and compatible with the grading.
  The covariant fields of the Standard Model then sit inside `B` as the images of the
  covariant jet algebra's own, and every law they satisfy there is the covariant jet
  algebra's own law pushed along the map. It is the covariant counterpart of
  `AlgebraRealization`: where that asks for an equivariant algebra map out of `JetAlgebra`,
  on which the whole jet gauge group acts, this asks for one out of `CovJetAlgebra`, on
  which only the global gauge group acts. The last two fields are not consequences of the
  first four: an equivariant map forces the two actions to be multiplicative only on its
  image, whereas the sector structures demand them multiplicative on the whole of `B`.
entries.snippet:
structure CovAlgebraRealization (B : Type) [Ring B] [Algebra ℂ B]
    (repGauge : Representation ℂ GaugeGroupI B)
    (repLorentz : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) B)
    (massWeightPoly : B →ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial B) where
  toAlgHom : CovJetAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] B
  map_repGauge : ∀ (g : GaugeGroupI) (x : CovJetAlgebra),
    toAlgHom (CovJetAlgebra.repGaugeGroupI g x) = repGauge g (toAlgHom x)
  map_repLorentz : ∀ (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x : CovJetAlgebra),
    toAlgHom (CovJetAlgebra.repLorentzGroup Λ x) = repLorentz Λ (toAlgHom x)
  map_massWeight : ∀ x : CovJetAlgebra, massWeightPoly (toAlgHom x)
    = Polynomial.mapAlgHom toAlgHom (CovJetAlgebra.massWeightPoly x)
  repGauge_mul : ∀ (g : GaugeGroupI) (b₁ b₂ : B),
    repGauge g (b₁ * b₂) = repGauge g b₁ * repGauge g b₂
  repLorentz_mul : ∀ (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (b₁ b₂ : B),
    repLorentz Λ (b₁ * b₂) = repLorentz Λ b₁ * repLorentz Λ b₂

  the global gauge group.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.map_anticomm

    k.toAlgHom x = -k.toAlgHom y

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.map_lorentz

  slot mixing is a finite sum of scalar multiples, and the map is linear and equivariant.

    (fun {_n} l μ ν => k.covF l μ ν) massWeightPoly where

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.covF_comp_perm_of_map_lie
entries.docstring:
At a dual vector vanishing on every bracket, such as the hypercharge coordinate, the
  field-strength tower is symmetric in its derivative slots, at every order: the law of the
  covariant jet algebra, where those covariant derivatives are ordinary ones, pushed along the
  defining map. It is not a law of `IsGaugeSector`, and the components along the non-abelian
  factors have no such symmetry.
entries.snippet:
lemma covF_comp_perm_of_map_lie {φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra}
    (hφ : ∀ x y : GaugeAlgebra, φ ⁅x, y⁆ = 0) {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    k.covF (l ∘ σ) μ ν φ = k.covF l μ ν φ

entries.snippet:
lemma isFermionSector : IsFermionSector B repGauge k.repGauge_mul repLorentz k.repLorentz_mul
    (fun {_n} i l => k.covD i l) (fun {_n} i l => k.covBarD i l)
    (fun {_n} i l => k.covU i l) (fun {_n} i l => k.covBarU i l)
    (fun {_n} i l => k.covQ i l) (fun {_n} i l => k.covBarQ i l)
    (fun {_n} i l => k.covL i l) (fun {_n} i l => k.covBarL i l)
    (fun {_n} i l => k.covE i l) (fun {_n} i l => k.covBarE i l) massWeightPoly where

noncomputable abbrev mapAdj (Φ : B →ₐ[ℂ] B')
    (f : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B) : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B'

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.map_real_smul
entries.docstring: An algebra map over `ℂ` is real-linear.
entries.snippet: lemma map_real_smul (Φ : B →ₐ[ℂ] B') (r : ℝ) (b : B) : Φ (r • b) = r • Φ b

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFam_map
entries.docstring:
The action pairing commutes with an algebra map: it is a finite double sum of scalar
  multiples of products of components.
entries.snippet:
lemma actionFam_map (Φ : B →ₐ[ℂ] B') (act : GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (f : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B) (g : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    Φ (actionFam act f g φ) = actionFam act (mapAdj Φ f) (Φ.toLinearMap ∘ₗ g) φ

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_map
entries.docstring: The bracket of two adjoint families commutes with an algebra map.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFam_map (Φ : B →ₐ[ℂ] B') (f g : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    Φ (bracketFam f g φ) = bracketFam (mapAdj Φ f) (mapAdj Φ g) φ

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFam_map'
entries.docstring: The action pairing of two families related by an algebra map is the pairing of the images.
entries.snippet:
lemma actionFam_map' (Φ : B →ₐ[ℂ] B')
    {f : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B} {f' : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B'}
    (hf : ∀ ψ, Φ (f ψ) = f' ψ)
    {g : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B} {g' : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B'} (hg : ∀ χ, Φ (g χ) = g' χ)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    Φ (actionFam act f g φ) = actionFam act f' g' φ

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFam_map'
entries.docstring:
The bracket of two adjoint families related by an algebra map is the bracket of the

entries.docstring: The covariant derivative of a matter family commutes with an algebra map.

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivAdjoint_map'
entries.docstring: The covariant derivative of an adjoint family commutes with an algebra map.

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivIter_map'
entries.docstring: The iterated covariant derivative of a matter family commutes with an algebra map.
entries.snippet:
lemma covDerivIter_map' (Φ : B →ₐ[ℂ] B') (hA : ∀ p ρ ψ, Φ (A p ρ ψ) = A' p ρ ψ)
    {F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B}
    {F' : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B'}
    (hF : ∀ s χ, Φ (F s χ) = F' s χ) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V),
      Φ (covDerivIter A act F n l s φ) = covDerivIter A' act F' n l s φ
  | 0, _, s, φ => hF s φ
  | n + 1, l, s, φ =>
    covDerivAction_map' Φ hA
    (fun s' χ => covDerivIter_map' Φ hA hF n (fun i => l i.succ) s' χ) (l 0) s φ

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_map'
entries.docstring: The iterated covariant derivative of an adjoint family commutes with an algebra map.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_map' (Φ : B →ₐ[ℂ] B') (hA : ∀ p ρ ψ, Φ (A p ρ ψ) = A' p ρ ψ)
    {F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B}
    {F' : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B'}
    (hF : ∀ s χ, Φ (F s χ) = F' s χ) :
    ∀ (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra),
      Φ (iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l F s φ) = iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A' l F' s φ
  | [], s, φ => hF s φ
  | ρ :: l, s, φ =>
    covDerivAdjoint_map' Φ hA
    (fun s' χ => iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_map' Φ hA hF l s' χ) ρ s φ

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.toCovAlgebraRealization

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.commute_of_mem_gaugeAlgebra_of_mem_fermionAlgebra
entries.docstring:
The gauge algebra and the fermion algebra commute element-wise: every generator of
  the gauge algebra commutes with every generator of the fermion algebra by the
  structure fields `h.F_comm_d`, ..., `h.F_comm_bare`, and commutation extends from
  generators to the algebras they generate.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.fermionMassWeight_mul_gaugeMassWeight_le
entries.docstring:
The fermion sector's mass-weight submodules and the gauge sector's mass-weight
  submodules commute past each other, in the order needed by
  `sectorMassWeight_pair_le`.
entries.snippet:
lemma fermionMassWeight_mul_gaugeMassWeight_le (a b : ℕ) :
    h.isFermionSector.massWeightSubmodule a * h.isGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule b
      ≤ h.isGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule b * h.isFermionSector.massWeightSubmodule a

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_gauge_fermion_le
entries.docstring:
**The mixed gauge-fermion sector decomposition.** The weight-`w` piece of the
  `{gauge, fermion}` sector lies in the join, over the splittings of `w` into two
  non-zero parts, of the products of the gauge and fermion sectors' own mass-weight
  submodules.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_gauge_fermion_le (w : ℕ) :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.fermion} w
      ≤ ⨆ (p : ℕ × ℕ) (_ : p.1 + p.2 = w) (_ : p.1 ≠ 0) (_ : p.2 ≠ 0),
        h.isGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule p.1 * h.isFermionSector.massWeightSubmodule p.2

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_gauge_fermion_eq_bot_of_lt_seven
entries.docstring:
**The mixed gauge-fermion sector vanishes below weight `7`.** A non-zero gauge
  weight is at least `4` and a non-zero fermion weight is at least `3`, so no
  splitting of a weight below `7` into two non-zero parts can supply both.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_gauge_fermion_eq_bot_of_lt_seven {w : ℕ} (hw : w < 7) :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.fermion} w = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_gauge_fermion_eight
entries.docstring:
**The mixed gauge-fermion sector vanishes at weight `8`.** The only splittings of
  `8` into two non-zero parts with a non-zero gauge weight and a non-zero fermion
  weight would need the gauge part to be `4` or `6`(with fermion part `4` or `2`), but
  the fermion sector vanishes at both `4` and `2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_gauge_fermion_eight :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.fermion} 8 = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_gauge_fermion_seven
entries.docstring:
**The mixed gauge-fermion sector at weight `7`** is exactly the product of the
  underived field-strength submodule with the underived fermion submodule: the only
  splitting of `7` into a non-zero gauge weight and a non-zero fermion weight that
  survives is `4 + 3`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_gauge_fermion_seven :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.fermion} 7
      = h.isGaugeSector.derivSubmodule 0 * h.isFermionSector.derivSubmodule 0

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.gaugeFermion_le_centreEigenspace
entries.docstring:
A field-strength derivative submodule against a fermion one is of half-integer spin:
  `+1` times `-1`.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_of_lorentz_invariant_sectorMassWeight_gauge_fermion_seven_sup
entries.docstring:
Mass weight seven carries no Lorentz invariant modulo a Lorentz-stable submodule: a
  Lorentz invariant of `sectorMassWeight {gauge, fermion} 7 ⊔ S` lies in `S`. The weight is
  the underived field strength against the underived fermion towers, of half-integer
  spin.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_lorentz_invariant_sectorMassWeight_gauge_fermion_seven_sup (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.fermion} 7 ⊔ S)
    (hL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) : x ∈ S

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_of_invariant_sectorMassWeight_gauge_fermion_lt_nine_sup
entries.docstring:
Below mass weight nine the gauge-fermion sector carries no Lorentz invariant: a
  Lorentz invariant of `sectorMassWeight {gauge, fermion} w ⊔ S` for `w < 9` lies in `S`.
  Weights below seven and weight eight are trivial submodules, and weight seven is section
  B.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_invariant_sectorMassWeight_gauge_fermion_lt_nine_sup (w : ℕ) (hw : w < 9)
    (S : Submodule ℂ B) (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.fermion} w ⊔ S)
    (hL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) : x ∈ S

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_sectorMassWeight_gauge_fermion_lt_nine_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff
entries.docstring:
The classification below mass weight nine as an equivalence, in the shape of the gauge-
  and Yukawa-sector statements: an element of `sectorMassWeight {gauge, fermion} w ⊔ S` for
  `w < 9` is fixed by both groups exactly when it is itself an element of `S` fixed by both
  groups. Gauge stability of `S` is not needed, and neither is gauge invariance of `x`: the
  forward direction is the boost-weight parity argument, which uses the Lorentz group
  alone.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_sectorMassWeight_gauge_fermion_lt_nine_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff
    (w : ℕ) (hw : w < 9) (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.fermion} w ⊔ S
        ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x) ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g y = y)
          ∧ (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y)
          ∧ x = y

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_sectorMassWeight_gauge_fermion_lt_nine_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_mem
entries.docstring:
The same classification without the existential: below mass weight nine an element of
  `sectorMassWeight {gauge, fermion} w ⊔ S` fixed by both groups is an element of `S` fixed
  by both groups, and conversely.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_sectorMassWeight_gauge_fermion_lt_nine_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_mem
    (w : ℕ) (hw : w < 9) (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.fermion} w ⊔ S
        ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x) ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ (x ∈ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
          ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.commute_of_mem_gaugeAlgebra_of_mem_higgsAlgebra
entries.docstring: The gauge algebra and the Higgs algebra commute element-wise.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.higgsMassWeight_mul_gaugeMassWeight_le
entries.docstring: The Higgs and gauge mass-weight submodules commute past each other.
entries.snippet:
lemma higgsMassWeight_mul_gaugeMassWeight_le (a b : ℕ) :
    h.isHiggsSector.massWeightSubmodule a * h.isGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule b
      ≤ h.isGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule b * h.isHiggsSector.massWeightSubmodule a

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs_le
entries.docstring: The mixed gauge-Higgs sector decomposition.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs_le (w : ℕ) :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.higgs} w
      ≤ ⨆ (p : ℕ × ℕ) (_ : p.1 + p.2 = w) (_ : p.1 ≠ 0) (_ : p.2 ≠ 0),
        h.isGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule p.1 * h.isHiggsSector.massWeightSubmodule p.2

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs_eq_bot_of_lt_six
entries.docstring: The mixed gauge-Higgs sector vanishes below weight `6`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs_eq_bot_of_lt_six {w : ℕ} (hw : w < 6) :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.higgs} w = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs_seven
entries.docstring:
The mixed gauge-Higgs sector vanishes at weight `7`: both a gauge weight and a
  Higgs weight are even, so they cannot sum to an odd number.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs_seven :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.higgs} 7 = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs_six
entries.docstring:
**The mixed gauge-Higgs sector at weight `6`** is exactly the product of the
  underived field strength with the underived Higgs: the only surviving splitting is
  `4 + 2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs_six :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.higgs} 6
      = h.isGaugeSector.derivSubmodule 0 * h.isHiggsSector.derivSubmodule 0

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mul_le_sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs
entries.docstring:
A product of a gauge-weight piece and a Higgs-weight piece lands in the mixed
  sector of the total weight.
entries.snippet:
lemma mul_le_sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs {a b w : ℕ} {X Y : Submodule ℂ B}
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hab : a + b = w)
    (hX : X ≤ h.isGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule a)
    (hY : Y ≤ h.isHiggsSector.massWeightSubmodule b) :
    X * Y ≤ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.higgs} w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs_eight
entries.docstring:
**The mixed gauge-Higgs sector at weight `8`.** The surviving splittings are
  `4 + 4` and `6 + 2`, giving the field strength against the weight-four Higgs terms
  and the once-derived field strength against the underived Higgs.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs_eight :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.higgs} 8
      = h.isGaugeSector.derivSubmodule 0 * h.isHiggsSector.derivSubmodule 1
        ⊔ h.isGaugeSector.derivSubmodule 0 * h.isHiggsSector.derivSubmodule 0
          * h.isHiggsSector.derivSubmodule 0
        ⊔ h.isGaugeSector.derivSubmodule 1 * h.isHiggsSector.derivSubmodule 0

entries.name: Lorentz.IsLorentzCovariant.mul_fixed
entries.docstring:
Multiplying a Lorentz tensor family by a Lorentz-inert element gives a family of the
  same rank: the element rides through the transformation law untouched.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsLorentzCovariant.mul_fixed {n : ℕ}
    (hmul : ∀ (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x y : B), repLorentz Λ (x * y) = repLorentz Λ x * repLorentz Λ y)
    {T : (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B} (hT : IsLorentzCovariant n B repLorentz (ofComponents T))
    {y : B} (hy : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y) :
    IsLorentzCovariant n B repLorentz (ofComponents fun d => T d * y)

entries.name: Lorentz.ofComponents_mul_right
entries.docstring:
The map of a family multiplied on the right by an element is the map of the family,
  multiplied by that element.
entries.snippet:
lemma ofComponents_mul_right {n : ℕ} (T : (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) (y : B)
    (t : ℂT(fun _ : Fin n => Color.up)) :
    ofComponents (fun d => T d * y) t = ofComponents T t * y

entries.name: Lorentz.IsLorentzCovariant.mul_vector
entries.docstring:
A rank-two family against a Lorentz vector is a rank-three family: the two covector
  indices of the first factor and the single index of the second make three.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsLorentzCovariant.mul_vector
    (hmul : ∀ (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x y : B), repLorentz Λ (x * y) = repLorentz Λ x * repLorentz Λ y)
    {T : (Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B} (hT : IsLorentzCovariant 2 B repLorentz (ofComponents T))
    {U : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B}
    (hU : ∀ (g : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), repLorentz g (U μ)
      = ∑ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, (((SL2C.toLorentzGroup g).1 ν μ : ℝ) : ℂ) • U ν) :
    IsLorentzCovariant 3 B repLorentz
      (ofComponents fun d : Fin 3 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 => T ![d 0, d 1] * U (d 2))

entries.name: StandardModel.mem_of_lorentz_invariant_iSup_rankTwo_span
entries.docstring:
A Lorentz invariant of a join, over an arbitrary index type, of the spans of
  bi-Lorentz families with vanishing metric traces lies in the stable submodule it is taken
  modulo. Each span reduces to the line through its metric contraction, which is zero; the
  reductions combine over every finite set of indices, and so over the whole join.

entries.name: StandardModel.mem_of_lorentz_invariant_iSup_rankThree_span
entries.docstring:
A Lorentz invariant of a join, over an arbitrary index type, of the spans of triple
  Lorentz families lies in the stable submodule it is taken modulo: three covector indices
  admit no invariant contraction at all, so each span reduces to `⊥`, and the reductions
  combine over every finite set of indices, and so over the whole join.

entries.name: StandardModel.repLorentz_eq_self_of_mem_mul
entries.docstring: A product of two pointwise Lorentz-inert submodules is pointwise Lorentz inert.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_eq_self_of_mem_mul
    (hmul : ∀ (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x y : B), repLorentz Λ (x * y) = repLorentz Λ x * repLorentz Λ y)
    {V W : Submodule ℂ B} (hV : ∀ (g : SL(2,ℂ)), ∀ y ∈ V, repLorentz g y = y)
    (hW : ∀ (g : SL(2,ℂ)), ∀ y ∈ W, repLorentz g y = y) (g : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    ∀ y ∈ V * W, repLorentz g y = y

entries.name: StandardModel.repLorentz_mem_mul_of_stable
entries.docstring: A product of two Lorentz-stable submodules is Lorentz stable.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_mem_mul_of_stable
    (hmul : ∀ (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x y : B), repLorentz Λ (x * y) = repLorentz Λ x * repLorentz Λ y)
    {V W : Submodule ℂ B} (hV : ∀ (g : SL(2,ℂ)), ∀ y ∈ V, repLorentz g y ∈ V)
    (hW : ∀ (g : SL(2,ℂ)), ∀ y ∈ W, repLorentz g y ∈ W) (g : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    ∀ y ∈ V * W, repLorentz g y ∈ V * W

entries.name: StandardModel.repLorentz_mem_of_fixed
entries.docstring: A pointwise Lorentz-inert submodule is Lorentz stable.

entries.name: StandardModel.repLorentz_mem_sup_of_stable
entries.docstring: A join of two Lorentz-stable submodules is Lorentz stable.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_mem_sup_of_stable {V W : Submodule ℂ B}
    (hV : ∀ (g : SL(2,ℂ)), ∀ y ∈ V, repLorentz g y ∈ V)
    (hW : ∀ (g : SL(2,ℂ)), ∀ y ∈ W, repLorentz g y ∈ W) (g : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    ∀ y ∈ V ⊔ W, repLorentz g y ∈ V ⊔ W

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_eq_self_of_mem_higgs_derivSubmodule_zero
entries.docstring:
The underived Higgs and conjugate-Higgs symbols are Lorentz scalars with no derivative
  slot to rotate, so every element of the weight-two Higgs submodule is fixed by the whole
  Lorentz group.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_eq_self_of_mem_higgs_derivSubmodule_zero (g : SL(2,ℂ)) {y : B}
    (hy : y ∈ h.isHiggsSector.derivSubmodule 0) : repLorentz g y = y

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_of_lorentz_invariant_derivSubmodule_zero_mul_fixed_sup
entries.docstring:
An underived field strength against Lorentz-inert material carries no Lorentz
  invariant modulo a Lorentz-stable submodule.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_lorentz_invariant_derivSubmodule_zero_mul_fixed_sup (C : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hC : ∀ (g : SL(2,ℂ)), ∀ y ∈ C, repLorentz g y = y) (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.isGaugeSector.derivSubmodule 0 * C ⊔ S)
    (hinv : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) : x ∈ S

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_of_lorentz_invariant_derivSubmodule_one_mul_fixed_sup
entries.docstring:
A once-derived field strength against Lorentz-inert material carries no Lorentz
  invariant modulo a Lorentz-stable submodule.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_lorentz_invariant_derivSubmodule_one_mul_fixed_sup (C : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hC : ∀ (g : SL(2,ℂ)), ∀ y ∈ C, repLorentz g y = y) (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.isGaugeSector.derivSubmodule 1 * C ⊔ S)
    (hinv : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) : x ∈ S

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_of_lorentz_invariant_derivSubmodule_zero_mul_higgs_one_sup
entries.docstring:
An underived field strength against a once-derived Higgs carries no Lorentz invariant
  modulo a Lorentz-stable submodule: three covector indices admit no contraction.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_lorentz_invariant_derivSubmodule_zero_mul_higgs_one_sup (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.isGaugeSector.derivSubmodule 0 * h.isHiggsSector.derivSubmodule 1 ⊔ S)
    (hinv : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) : x ∈ S

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_of_lorentz_invariant_sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs_six_sup
entries.docstring:
Mass weight six carries no Lorentz invariant modulo a Lorentz-stable submodule: a
  Lorentz invariant of `sectorMassWeight {gauge, higgs} 6 ⊔ S` lies in `S`. The weight is
  the underived field strength against the underived Higgs, whose two covector indices are
  contracted only by the metric, and that trace vanishes.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_lorentz_invariant_sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs_six_sup (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.higgs} 6 ⊔ S)
    (hinv : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) : x ∈ S

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_of_lorentz_invariant_sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs_eight_sup
entries.docstring:
Mass weight eight carries no Lorentz invariant modulo a Lorentz-stable submodule: a
  Lorentz invariant of `sectorMassWeight {gauge, higgs} 8 ⊔ S` lies in `S`. The three
  products making up the weight are peeled off one at a time, the two carrying three
  covector indices by the absence of any contraction and the one carrying two by the
  vanishing of the metric trace.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_lorentz_invariant_sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs_eight_sup (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.higgs} 8 ⊔ S)
    (hinv : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) : x ∈ S

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_of_invariant_sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs_lt_nine_sup
entries.docstring:
Below mass weight nine the gauge-Higgs sector carries no Lorentz invariant: a Lorentz
  invariant of `sectorMassWeight {gauge, higgs} w ⊔ S` for `w < 9` lies in `S`. Weights
  below six and weight seven are trivial submodules, and weights six and eight are the two
  index counts.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_invariant_sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs_lt_nine_sup (w : ℕ) (hw : w < 9)
    (S : Submodule ℂ B) (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.higgs} w ⊔ S)
    (hL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) : x ∈ S

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs_lt_nine_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff
entries.docstring:
The classification below mass weight nine as an equivalence, in the shape of the gauge-
  and Yukawa-sector statements: an element of `sectorMassWeight {gauge, higgs} w ⊔ S` for
  `w < 9` is fixed by both groups exactly when it is itself an element of `S` fixed by both
  groups. Gauge stability of `S` is not needed, and neither is gauge invariance of `x`: the
  forward direction is the index count, which uses the Lorentz group alone.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs_lt_nine_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff
    (w : ℕ) (hw : w < 9) (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.higgs} w ⊔ S
        ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x) ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g y = y)
          ∧ (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y)
          ∧ x = y

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs_lt_nine_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_mem
entries.docstring:
The same classification without the existential: below mass weight nine an element of
  `sectorMassWeight {gauge, higgs} w ⊔ S` fixed by both groups is an element of `S` fixed by
  both groups, and conversely.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs_lt_nine_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_mem
    (w : ℕ) (hw : w < 9) (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.higgs} w ⊔ S
        ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x) ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ (x ∈ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
          ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.Generators
entries.docstring:
The abstract index of a single covariant generator of the field algebra: one of
  the covariant-derivative towers of the field strength, of the Higgs and its
  conjugate, or of the three families of each fermion species and their conjugates,
  applied to a member of the dual basis of its value space. Only basis indices are
  stored, so for a fixed tower length the generators of a given mass weight form a
  finite type. The evaluation in `B` is `generatorVal`.
entries.snippet:
inductive Generators where
  | H : (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Fin 2 → Generators
  | barH : (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Fin 2 → Generators
  | F : (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →
      (Fin 8 ⊕ Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1) → Generators
  | d : Fin 3 → (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Fin 2 × Fin 3 → Generators
  | bard : Fin 3 → (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Fin 2 × Fin 3 → Generators
  | u : Fin 3 → (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Fin 2 × Fin 3 → Generators
  | baru : Fin 3 → (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Fin 2 × Fin 3 → Generators
  | Q : Fin 3 → (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2 → Generators
  | barQ : Fin 3 → (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2 → Generators
  | L : Fin 3 → (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Fin 2 × Fin 2 → Generators
  | barL : Fin 3 → (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Fin 2 × Fin 2 → Generators
  | e : Fin 3 → (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Fin 2 → Generators
  | bare : Fin 3 → (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Fin 2 → Generators

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.Generators.IsFermionic
entries.docstring: Whether a generator is one of the twenty fermion towers, the barred ones included.
entries.snippet:
def IsFermionic : Generators → Prop
  | .H _ _ _ => False
  | .barH _ _ _ => False
  | .F _ _ _ _ _ => False
  | .d _ _ _ _ => True
  | .bard _ _ _ _ => True
  | .u _ _ _ _ => True
  | .baru _ _ _ _ => True
  | .Q _ _ _ _ => True
  | .barQ _ _ _ _ => True
  | .L _ _ _ _ => True
  | .barL _ _ _ _ => True
  | .e _ _ _ _ => True
  | .bare _ _ _ _ => True

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.Generators.IsHiggs
entries.docstring:
The Higgs generators: the covariant towers of the Higgs field and of its
  conjugate.
entries.snippet:
def IsHiggs : Generators → Prop
  | .H _ _ _ => True
  | .barH _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.Generators.IsGaugeField
entries.docstring: Whether a generator is a gauge-field symbol `∇_l F_{μν}^φ`.
entries.snippet:
def IsGaugeField : Generators → Prop
  | .F _ _ _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.Generators.toNumDerivatives
entries.docstring: The number of derivatives for a given generator.
entries.snippet:
def toNumDerivatives : Generators → ℕ
  | .H n _ _ => n
  | .barH n _ _ => n
  | .F n _ _ _ _ => n
  | .d _ n _ _ => n
  | .bard _ n _ _ => n
  | .u _ n _ _ => n
  | .baru _ n _ _ => n
  | .Q _ n _ _ => n
  | .barQ _ n _ _ => n
  | .L _ n _ _ => n
  | .barL _ n _ _ => n
  | .e _ n _ _ => n
  | .bare _ n _ _ => n

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.GeneratorClass
entries.docstring: The three classes of covariant generator.
entries.snippet:
inductive GeneratorClass where
  | gauge : GeneratorClass
  | higgs : GeneratorClass
  | fermion : GeneratorClass

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.instFintypeGeneratorClass
entries.docstring:
The three classes exhaust `GeneratorClass`. The instance is written out rather than
  derived: the `Fintype` deriving handler builds the enumerating `Finset` with a membership
  that resolves through `SetLike`, which is not type-correct here.
entries.snippet: instance instFintypeGeneratorClass : Fintype GeneratorClass where

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.Generators.kind
entries.docstring: The class of a covariant generator.
entries.snippet:
def Generators.kind : Generators → GeneratorClass
  | .F _ _ _ _ _ => .gauge
  | .H _ _ _ => .higgs
  | .barH _ _ _ => .higgs
  | _ => .fermion

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.Generators.isGaugeField_iff_kind
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma Generators.isGaugeField_iff_kind (g : Generators) :
    g.IsGaugeField ↔ g.kind = .gauge

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.Generators.isHiggs_iff_kind
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma Generators.isHiggs_iff_kind (g : Generators) : g.IsHiggs ↔ g.kind = .higgs

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.Generators.isFermionic_iff_kind
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma Generators.isFermionic_iff_kind (g : Generators) :
    g.IsFermionic ↔ g.kind = .fermion

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.Generators.weight
entries.docstring: The mass weight (twice the mass dimension) of a covariant generator.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.Generators.four_le_weight_of_gauge
entries.docstring:
A gauge-class generator — a field-strength tower symbol — carries mass weight at
  least four.
entries.snippet:
lemma Generators.four_le_weight_of_gauge {g : Generators} (hg : g.kind = GeneratorClass.gauge) :
    4 ≤ g.weight

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.Generators.two_le_weight_of_higgs
entries.docstring:
A Higgs-class generator — a Higgs or conjugate-Higgs tower symbol — carries mass
  weight at least two.
entries.snippet:
lemma Generators.two_le_weight_of_higgs {g : Generators} (hg : g.kind = GeneratorClass.higgs) :
    2 ≤ g.weight

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.Generators.three_le_weight_of_fermion
entries.docstring:
A fermion-class generator — any of the ten families of fermion tower symbols —
  carries mass weight at least three.
entries.snippet:
lemma Generators.three_le_weight_of_fermion {g : Generators}
    (hg : g.kind = GeneratorClass.fermion) : 3 ≤ g.weight

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.wordClasses
entries.docstring: The classes realised by a word in the covariant generators.
entries.snippet: def wordClasses (gl : List Generators) : Finset GeneratorClass

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.wordClasses_nil
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma wordClasses_nil : wordClasses [] = ∅

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.wordClasses_append
entries.docstring: Concatenating words unions the classes they realise.
entries.snippet:
lemma wordClasses_append (gl gl' : List Generators) :
    wordClasses (gl ++ gl') = wordClasses gl ∪ wordClasses gl'

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.wordClasses_cons
entries.docstring: Prepending a generator inserts its class.
entries.snippet:
lemma wordClasses_cons (a : Generators) (gl : List Generators) :
    wordClasses (a :: gl) = insert a.kind (wordClasses gl)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.classWeight
entries.docstring: The total mass weight carried by the generators of a given class in a word.
entries.snippet: def classWeight (c : GeneratorClass) (gl : List Generators) : ℕ

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.classWeight_cons_of_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma classWeight_cons_of_eq {c : GeneratorClass} {g : Generators} (hg : g.kind = c)
    (t : List Generators) :
    classWeight c (g :: t) = g.weight + classWeight c t

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.classWeight_cons_of_ne
entries.snippet:
lemma classWeight_cons_of_ne {c : GeneratorClass} {g : Generators} (hg : g.kind ≠ c)
    (t : List Generators) : classWeight c (g :: t) = classWeight c t

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.Generators.weight_pos
entries.docstring: Every generator carries a non-zero mass weight.
entries.snippet: lemma Generators.weight_pos (g : Generators) : 0 < g.weight

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.classWeight_ne_zero
entries.docstring: A class realised by a word carries a non-zero part of its weight.
entries.snippet:
lemma classWeight_ne_zero {c : GeneratorClass} {gl : List Generators}
    (hc : c ∈ wordClasses gl) : classWeight c gl ≠ 0

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.classWeight_add
entries.docstring:
Over a word realising only two classes, the two class weights add up to the total
  weight.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.le_classWeight_of_mem
entries.docstring:
A class realised by a word carries at least the minimum weight of that class: the
  generator witnessing the realisation already contributes that much, and the
  remaining generators of the class only add more.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.classWeight_add_three
entries.docstring:
The three class weights exhaust the total weight of a word: every generator has
  exactly one of the three kinds.
entries.snippet:
lemma classWeight_add_three (gl : List Generators) :
    classWeight GeneratorClass.gauge gl + classWeight GeneratorClass.higgs gl
      + classWeight GeneratorClass.fermion gl = (gl.map Generators.weight).sum

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.generatorVal
entries.docstring:
The value in `B` of a covariant generator: the corresponding covariant tower
  applied to the indicated dual basis vector of its value space.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def generatorVal
    (h : CovAlgebraRealization B repGauge repLorentz massWeightPoly) : Generators → B
  | .H _ l j => h.covH l (HiggsVec.orthonormBasis.toBasis.coord j)
  | .barH _ l j => h.covBarH l ((Basis.conj HiggsVec.orthonormBasis.toBasis).coord j)
  | .F _ l μ ν j => h.covF l μ ν (GaugeAlgebra.stdBasis.coord j)
  | .d i _ l j => h.covD i l (DownSinglet.basis.coord j)
  | .bard i _ l j => h.covBarD i l ((Basis.conj DownSinglet.basis).coord j)
  | .u i _ l j => h.covU i l (UpSinglet.basis.coord j)
  | .baru i _ l j => h.covBarU i l ((Basis.conj UpSinglet.basis).coord j)
  | .Q i _ l j => h.covQ i l (QuarkDoublet.basis.coord j)
  | .barQ i _ l j => h.covBarQ i l ((Basis.conj QuarkDoublet.basis).coord j)
  | .L i _ l j => h.covL i l (LeptonDoubletV.basis.coord j)
  | .barL i _ l j => h.covBarL i l ((Basis.conj LeptonDoubletV.basis).coord j)
  | .e i _ l j => h.covE i l (LeptonSinglet.basis.coord j)
  | .bare i _ l j => h.covBarE i l ((Basis.conj LeptonSinglet.basis).coord j)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.massWeightPoly_generatorVal
entries.docstring: Every covariant generator is a `massWeightPoly`-eigenvector of its weight.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_generatorVal (g : Generators) :
    massWeightPoly (h.generatorVal g) = Polynomial.monomial g.weight (h.generatorVal g)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.generatorVal_mem_fieldAlgebra
entries.snippet:
lemma generatorVal_mem_fieldAlgebra (g : Generators) :
    h.generatorVal g ∈ h.fieldAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.fieldAlgebra_le_adjoin_range
entries.docstring:
Expanding every dual vector in the dual basis of its value space: the field
  algebra is already generated by the countable family of basis generators.
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldAlgebra_le_adjoin_range :
    h.fieldAlgebra ≤ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range h.generatorVal)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.fieldAlgebra_eq_adjoin_range
entries.docstring: The field algebra is generated by the covariant basis generators.
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldAlgebra_eq_adjoin_range :
    h.fieldAlgebra = Algebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range h.generatorVal)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.exists_list_map_eq
entries.docstring: A list of generator values is the list of values of a list of generators.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_list_map_eq (l₀ : List B) :
    (∀ y ∈ l₀, y ∈ Set.range h.generatorVal) →
    ∃ gl : List Generators, gl.map h.generatorVal = l₀

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.massWeightPoly_generatorVal_list_prod
entries.docstring:
A word in the covariant generators is a `massWeightPoly`-eigenvector whose
  weight is the sum of the weights of its factors.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_generatorVal_list_prod (gl : List Generators) :
    massWeightPoly ((gl.map h.generatorVal).prod) =
      Polynomial.monomial ((gl.map Generators.weight).sum) ((gl.map h.generatorVal).prod)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.commute_F_generatorVal
entries.docstring:
The field-strength symbols commute with the value of every covariant
  generator.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_F_generatorVal {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) (g : Generators) :
    Commute (h.covF l μ ν ψ) (h.generatorVal g)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.commute_H_generatorVal
entries.docstring: The Higgs symbols commute with the value of every covariant generator.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_H_generatorVal {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ HiggsVec) (g : Generators) :
    Commute (h.covH l φ) (h.generatorVal g)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.commute_barH_generatorVal
entries.docstring:
The conjugate-Higgs symbols commute with the value of every covariant
  generator.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_barH_generatorVal {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule HiggsVec)) (g : Generators) :
    Commute (h.covBarH l φ) (h.generatorVal g)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.commute_generatorVal_of_even
entries.docstring:
A covariant generator of even mass weight is bosonic: its value commutes with
  the value of every covariant generator.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_generatorVal_of_even {g : Generators} (hg : g.weight % 2 = 0)
    (g' : Generators) : Commute (h.generatorVal g) (h.generatorVal g')

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.generatorVal_anticomm_of_odd_of_odd
entries.docstring:
Fermionic generator values anticommute: the values of two covariant generators
  of odd mass weight exchange with a sign.
entries.snippet:
lemma generatorVal_anticomm_of_odd_of_odd {g g' : Generators}
    (hg : g.weight % 2 = 1) (hg' : g'.weight % 2 = 1) :
    h.generatorVal g * h.generatorVal g'
      = -(h.generatorVal g' * h.generatorVal g)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.generatorVal_mul_generatorVal
entries.docstring:
Two covariant generators exchange up to the sign determined by their mass
  weights: the weight is odd exactly on the fermionic generators, so the sign is
  `-1` precisely when both generators are fermionic.
entries.snippet:
lemma generatorVal_mul_generatorVal (g g' : Generators) :
    h.generatorVal g * h.generatorVal g' =
      ((-1 : ℂ) ^ (g.weight * g'.weight)) • (h.generatorVal g' * h.generatorVal g)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.generatorVal_mul_list_prod
entries.docstring:
A generator value moves past a word of generators up to the sign of the
  product of the weights.
entries.snippet:
lemma generatorVal_mul_list_prod (g : Generators) (gl : List Generators) :
    h.generatorVal g * (gl.map h.generatorVal).prod =
      ((-1 : ℂ) ^ (g.weight * (gl.map Generators.weight).sum)) •
        ((gl.map h.generatorVal).prod * h.generatorVal g)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.list_prod_mul_list_prod
entries.docstring:
Two words of covariant generators exchange up to the sign of the product of
  their total weights.
entries.snippet:
lemma list_prod_mul_list_prod (gl gl' : List Generators) :
    (gl.map h.generatorVal).prod * (gl'.map h.generatorVal).prod =
      ((-1 : ℂ) ^ ((gl.map Generators.weight).sum * (gl'.map Generators.weight).sum)) •
        ((gl'.map h.generatorVal).prod * (gl.map h.generatorVal).prod)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring:
All elements of the field algebra of mass weight exactly `n`: the intersection of
  the algebra generated by the covariant fields with the part on which
  `massWeightPoly` is the monomial `X ^ n`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def massWeightSubmodule
    (h : CovAlgebraRealization B repGauge repLorentz massWeightPoly) (n : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.massWeightPoly_of_mem_massWeightSubmodule
StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_fieldAlgebra_of_mem_massWeightSubmodule
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_fieldAlgebra_of_mem_massWeightSubmodule {n : ℕ} {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule n) : x ∈ h.fieldAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_massWeightSubmodule_of
entries.docstring:
Membership in a mass-weight submodule: an element of the field algebra which
  `massWeightPoly` sends to the monomial of that weight.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmodule_of {n : ℕ} {x : B} (hmem : x ∈ h.fieldAlgebra)
    (hpoly : massWeightPoly x = Polynomial.monomial n x) :
    x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule n

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.list_prod_mem_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring:
A word in the covariant generators lies in the mass-weight submodule of its total
  weight.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.coeff_massWeightPoly_mem_span
entries.docstring:
Reading off the `X ^ w` coefficient of `massWeightPoly` sends the field algebra
  into the span of the words of total weight `w` — the projection onto the weight-`w`
  component, with no independence argument needed.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.massWeightSubmodule_eq_span
entries.docstring:
**The weight grading of the field algebra.** The submodule of elements of the
  field algebra of mass weight `w` is exactly the span of the words in the covariant
  basis generators of total weight `w`.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_eq_span (w : ℕ) :
    h.massWeightSubmodule w = Submodule.span ℂ
      {x | ∃ gl : List Generators,
        (gl.map Generators.weight).sum = w ∧ (gl.map h.generatorVal).prod = x}

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mul_eq_smul_mul_of_mem_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring:
Weight-homogeneous elements of the field algebra supercommute: elements of the
  mass-weight submodules of weights `w` and `w'` exchange up to the sign
  `(-1) ^ (w * w')` — fermion parity is the parity of the mass weight.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.exists_smul_mul_comm_of_mem_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring: Weight-homogeneous elements of the field algebra commute up to a scalar.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.span_mul_comm_of_mem_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring:
Reordering a product of two weight-homogeneous elements does not change its

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.eq_zero_of_sum_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring:
Components of pairwise distinct mass weights are independent: a vanishing sum
  of weight-homogeneous elements has vanishing terms.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.invariant_of_eq_sum_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring:
An invariant element decomposes into invariant weight components: if a gauge-
  and Lorentz-invariant `x` is the sum of components of pairwise distinct mass
  weights, every component is itself gauge and Lorentz invariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma invariant_of_eq_sum_massWeightSubmodule {n : ℕ} {x : B} {w : Fin n → ℕ}
    (hw : Function.Injective w) (f : Fin n → B) (hf : x = ∑ i, f i)
    (hx : ∀ i, f i ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule (w i))
    (hgauge : ∀ g, repGauge g x = x) (hlorentz : ∀ Λ, repLorentz Λ x = x) :
    ∀ i, (∀ g, repGauge g (f i) = f i) ∧ ∀ Λ, repLorentz Λ (f i) = f i

The reduction of questions on invariants to invariants within
