    (hgauge : ∀ g, repGauge g x = x) (hlorentz : ∀ Λ, repLorentz Λ x = x) :
    ∀ i, (∀ g, repGauge g (f i) = f i) ∧ ∀ Λ, repLorentz Λ (f i) = f i

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.massWeightSubmoduleLE
entries.docstring:
The elements of the field algebra of mass weight at most `w`: the join of the
  mass-weight submodules of weight `0` through `w`. This is where a Lagrangian lives, a
  sum of terms of every mass dimension up to a cut-off rather than of a single one.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def massWeightSubmoduleLE (w : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.massWeightSubmodule_le_massWeightSubmoduleLE
entries.docstring: Each graded piece of weight at most `w` sits inside the filtration at `w`.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_le_massWeightSubmoduleLE {k w : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ w) :
    h.massWeightSubmodule k ≤ h.massWeightSubmoduleLE w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_massWeightSubmoduleLE
entries.docstring: An element of a graded piece of weight at most `w` lies in the filtration at `w`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmoduleLE {k w : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ w) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule k) : x ∈ h.massWeightSubmoduleLE w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.massWeightSubmoduleLE_le
entries.docstring:
A submodule containing every graded piece of weight at most `w` contains the
  filtration at `w`: the join is taken over exactly those pieces.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmoduleLE_le {w : ℕ} {V : Submodule ℂ B}
    (hV : ∀ k ≤ w, h.massWeightSubmodule k ≤ V) : h.massWeightSubmoduleLE w ≤ V

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.massWeightSubmoduleLE_mono
entries.docstring: The filtration grows with the bound.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmoduleLE_mono {w w' : ℕ} (hw : w ≤ w') :
    h.massWeightSubmoduleLE w ≤ h.massWeightSubmoduleLE w'

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.massWeightSubmoduleLE_eq_iSup
entries.docstring:
The filtration as a join over a finite index type, which is the form in which the
  reduction of a join consumes it.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmoduleLE_eq_iSup (w : ℕ) :
    h.massWeightSubmoduleLE w = ⨆ k : Fin (w + 1), h.massWeightSubmodule (k : ℕ)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.isStableUnder_massWeightSubmoduleLE
entries.docstring:
The filtration is carried into itself by both groups: each graded piece is, and a
  join of stable submodules is stable.
entries.snippet:
lemma isStableUnder_massWeightSubmoduleLE (w : ℕ) :
    IsStableUnder (gaugeLorentzMaps repGauge repLorentz) (h.massWeightSubmoduleLE w)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.massWeightSubmodule_zero
entries.docstring:
The weight-zero part of the field algebra is the scalars. Every covariant generator
  carries positive mass weight, so the only word of total weight zero is the empty one,
  whose value is the unit. This is the constant term of the Lagrangian, of mass dimension
  zero — the cosmological term.
entries.snippet: lemma massWeightSubmodule_zero : h.massWeightSubmodule 0 = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.isFixedBy_massWeightSubmodule_zero
entries.docstring:
The scalars are fixed by both groups: each acts by an algebra map, so each fixes the
  unit. This is what makes the constant term an invariant, and it is what the backward
  direction of the classification needs of the weight-zero part of the span.
entries.snippet:
lemma isFixedBy_massWeightSubmodule_zero :
    IsFixedBy (gaugeLorentzMaps repGauge repLorentz) (h.massWeightSubmodule 0)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.standardModelSpanLE
entries.docstring:
The gauge- and Lorentz-invariant content of the Standard Model up to mass weight `w`:
  the weight-zero part of the field algebra, which is the constant term, joined with the
  Standard-Model span of every weight up to `w`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def standardModelSpanLE (w : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.massWeightSubmodule_zero_le_standardModelSpanLE
entries.docstring: The constant term lies in the span of the filtration, at every bound.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_zero_le_standardModelSpanLE (w : ℕ) :
    h.massWeightSubmodule 0 ≤ h.standardModelSpanLE w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.standardModelSpan_le_standardModelSpanLE
entries.docstring: The graded span of a weight at most `w` lies in the span of the filtration at `w`.
entries.snippet:
lemma standardModelSpan_le_standardModelSpanLE {k w : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ w) :
    h.standardModelSpan k ≤ h.standardModelSpanLE w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.standardModelSpanLE_le_massWeightSubmoduleLE
entries.docstring:
The span of the filtration at `w` has mass weight at most `w`: the constant term has
  weight zero and each graded span has its own weight.
entries.snippet:
lemma standardModelSpanLE_le_massWeightSubmoduleLE (w : ℕ) :
    h.standardModelSpanLE w ≤ h.massWeightSubmoduleLE w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.isFixedBy_standardModelSpanLE
entries.docstring:
The span of the filtration is fixed pointwise by the gauge and Lorentz groups
  together. At positive weight this is the fixedness of the graded spans; at weight zero
  it is the fixedness of the unit, and that is the only new content of the filtration.
entries.snippet:
lemma isFixedBy_standardModelSpanLE (w : ℕ) :
    IsFixedBy (gaugeLorentzMaps repGauge repLorentz) (h.standardModelSpanLE w)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.repGauge_of_mem_standardModelSpanLE
entries.docstring: Every element of the span of the filtration is a gauge invariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_of_mem_standardModelSpanLE (w : ℕ) (g : GaugeGroupI) {y : B}
    (hy : y ∈ h.standardModelSpanLE w) : repGauge g y = y

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_of_mem_standardModelSpanLE
entries.docstring: Every element of the span of the filtration is a Lorentz invariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_of_mem_standardModelSpanLE (w : ℕ) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) {y : B}
    (hy : y ∈ h.standardModelSpanLE w) : repLorentz Λ y = y

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.standardModelSpanLE_eight
entries.docstring:
The span of the filtration at bound eight in reduced form. Of the nine graded spans
  only two are non-trivial, the Higgs mass term at weight four and the dimension-four
  Lagrangian at weight eight, so what survives up to mass dimension four is the constant
  term, the Higgs mass term, and the Lagrangian.
entries.snippet:
lemma standardModelSpanLE_eight :
    h.standardModelSpanLE 8 = (1 : Submodule ℂ B) ⊔ (h.isHiggsSector.dotSpan 0 0
      ⊔ (h.isGaugeSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan
            ⊔ h.isHiggsSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan
          ⊔ (h.isFermionSector.kineticSpan ⊔ h.yukawaSpan)))

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.reducesInvariantsTo_massWeightSubmoduleLE
entries.docstring:
The filtration reduces to its span, at every bound up to eight. The filtration is a
  join of the graded pieces, each of them stable under both groups, and `ReducesInvariantsTo` is
  closed under joins in its source: the weights are taken one at a time, each in turn joining the
  error term of the others. At positive weight the graded reduction of `Invariants.lean` is
  used; at weight zero a submodule reduces to itself, the constant term being carried in the
  span.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_massWeightSubmoduleLE {w : ℕ} (hw : w ≤ 8) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (gaugeLorentzMaps repGauge repLorentz) (h.massWeightSubmoduleLE w)
      (h.standardModelSpanLE w)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_massWeightSubmoduleLE_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff
entries.docstring:
The classification of the Standard Model up to mass weight `w ≤ 8` as an equivalence,
  in the shape every sector uses: an element of `massWeightSubmoduleLE w ⊔ S`, with `S`
  stable under both groups, is fixed by both groups exactly when it is a combination of
  the constant term and the Standard-Model terms of weight at most `w`, up to a remainder
  in `S` fixed by both groups.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmoduleLE_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff (w : ℕ) (hw : w ≤ 8)
    (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hS : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, repGauge g y ∈ S)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.massWeightSubmoduleLE w ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
        ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g y = y)
          ∧ (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y)
          ∧ x - y ∈ h.standardModelSpanLE w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.exists_mem_standardModelSpanLE_of_gauge_and_lorentz_invariant
entries.docstring:
The gauge and Lorentz invariants of mass weight at most `w`, for `w ≤ 8`, modulo a
  submodule `S` stable under both groups: such an invariant is a combination of the
  constant term and the Standard-Model terms of weight at most `w`, plus a remainder in
  `S`, and the remainder is fixed by both groups as well, being the difference of two
  invariants.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_mem_standardModelSpanLE_of_gauge_and_lorentz_invariant (w : ℕ) (hw : w ≤ 8)
    (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hS : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, repGauge g y ∈ S)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.massWeightSubmoduleLE w ⊔ S)
    (hG : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
    (hL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) :
    ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g y = y)
      ∧ (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y)
      ∧ x - y ∈ h.standardModelSpanLE w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_massWeightSubmoduleLE_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_mem
entries.docstring:
The same classification without the existential: at every bound up to eight an element
  of `massWeightSubmoduleLE w ⊔ S` fixed by both groups is an element of the span of the
  filtration joined with `S` fixed by both groups, and conversely.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmoduleLE_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_mem (w : ℕ)
    (hw : w ≤ 8) (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hS : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, repGauge g y ∈ S)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.massWeightSubmoduleLE w ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
        ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ (x ∈ h.standardModelSpanLE w ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
          ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_massWeightSubmoduleLE_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff
entries.docstring:
The classification at bound eight, that is at mass dimension at most four, as an
  equivalence: an element of `massWeightSubmoduleLE 8 ⊔ S`, with `S` stable under both
  groups, is fixed by both groups exactly when it lies in the span of the filtration up to
  a remainder in `S` fixed by both groups.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmoduleLE_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff
    (S : Submodule ℂ B) (hS : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, repGauge g y ∈ S)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.massWeightSubmoduleLE 8 ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
        ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g y = y)
          ∧ (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y)
          ∧ x - y ∈ h.standardModelSpanLE 8

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_massWeightSubmoduleLE_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_mem
entries.docstring: The same at bound eight without the existential.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmoduleLE_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_mem
    (S : Submodule ℂ B) (hS : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, repGauge g y ∈ S)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.massWeightSubmoduleLE 8 ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
        ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ (x ∈ h.standardModelSpanLE 8 ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
          ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_massWeightSubmoduleLE_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_lagrangian
entries.docstring:
The invariant content of the Standard Model up to mass dimension four. An element of
  `massWeightSubmoduleLE 8 ⊔ S`, for `S` a submodule stable under both groups, is fixed by
  the gauge group and the Lorentz group exactly when it is a combination of
  the constant term, of mass dimension zero,
  the Higgs mass term `H† H`, of mass dimension two (`HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.dotSpan`),
  and the dimension-four span — the four Lorentz contractions of the three `F·F` trace
  families and of the twice-derived hypercharge field strength, among them the gauge
  kinetic and theta terms (`IsGaugeSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan`), the Higgs
  kinetic term, its quartic potential and its two box terms
  (`HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.lorentzContractionEightSpan`), the kinetic terms of the ten fermion
  species over the nine family pairs (`IsFermionSector.kineticSpan`), and the six Yukawa
  couplings over the nine family pairs (`yukawaSpan`) —
  up to a remainder in `S` fixed by both groups, and nothing else. The generators span;
  they are not shown to be independent, and no quotient by total derivatives is taken.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmoduleLE_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_lagrangian
    (S : Submodule ℂ B) (hS : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, repGauge g y ∈ S)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.massWeightSubmoduleLE 8 ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
        ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g y = y)
          ∧ (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y)
          ∧ x - y ∈ (1 : Submodule ℂ B) ⊔ (h.isHiggsSector.dotSpan 0 0
              ⊔ (h.isGaugeSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan
                    ⊔ h.isHiggsSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan
                  ⊔ (h.isFermionSector.kineticSpan ⊔ h.yukawaSpan)))

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.standardModelSpan
entries.docstring:
The gauge- and Lorentz-invariant content of the Standard Model at mass weight `w`:
  the join of the surviving spans of the eight sectors. At weight eight it is the gauge
  sector's four Lorentz contractions of each of its four families, two of which already span
  for each family (`IsGaugeSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan_eq`), and the two of the
  twice-derived hypercharge field strength vanish, leaving the two contractions of each of the
  three trace families (`isGaugeSector_lorentzContractionEightSpan_eq_traceFamilies`): the
  kinetic-shape and theta-shape contractions of the three gauge groups. Together with these come the
  Higgs sector's two box terms, kinetic term and quartic potential, the fermion sector's ten
  kinetic terms over the nine family pairs, and the six Yukawa couplings over the nine family
  pairs. Below weight eight only the Higgs sector survives, and only at weight four, where it
  contributes the Higgs mass term.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def standardModelSpan (w : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.standardModelSpan_eight
entries.docstring:
At mass weight eight the span is the gauge, Higgs, fermion and Yukawa spans
  together.
entries.snippet:
lemma standardModelSpan_eight :
    h.standardModelSpan 8 = h.isGaugeSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan
        ⊔ h.isHiggsSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan
      ⊔ (h.isFermionSector.kineticSpan ⊔ h.yukawaSpan)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.standardModelSpan_four
entries.docstring:
At mass weight four the span is the line through the Higgs mass term `H† H`, the one
  invariant of the Standard Model below mass dimension four.
entries.snippet: lemma standardModelSpan_four : h.standardModelSpan 4 = h.isHiggsSector.dotSpan 0 0

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.standardModelSpan_eq_bot
entries.docstring:
At every mass weight other than four and eight the span is trivial: apart from the
  Higgs mass term there is no Standard-Model term below mass dimension four.
entries.snippet:
lemma standardModelSpan_eq_bot {w : ℕ} (hw : w ≠ 8) (hw4 : w ≠ 4) :
    h.standardModelSpan w = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.hyperchargeDeriv_comp_swap_zero_one
entries.docstring:
The twice-derived hypercharge field strengths are symmetric in their two derivative
  slots.
entries.snippet:
lemma hyperchargeDeriv_comp_swap_zero_one (d : IsGaugeSector.EightIdx) :
    h.isGaugeSector.hyperchargeDeriv (d ∘ Equiv.swap 0 1) = h.isGaugeSector.hyperchargeDeriv d

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.hyperchargeDeriv_contractionTensor_one
entries.docstring:
`η^{μρ} η^{νσ} ∇_μ ∇_ν B_{ρσ} = 0`: a symmetric pair of derivatives contracted against the
  antisymmetric pair of field-strength indices.
entries.snippet:
lemma hyperchargeDeriv_contractionTensor_one :
    ofComponents h.isGaugeSector.hyperchargeDeriv (RankFour.contractionTensor 1) = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.hyperchargeDeriv_contractionTensor_three
entries.docstring:
`ε^{μνρσ} ∇_μ ∇_ν B_{ρσ} = 0`: a symmetric pair of derivatives contracted against the
  antisymmetric symbol.
entries.snippet:
lemma hyperchargeDeriv_contractionTensor_three :
    ofComponents h.isGaugeSector.hyperchargeDeriv (RankFour.contractionTensor 3) = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.isGaugeSector_lorentzContractionEightSpan_eq_traceFamilies
entries.docstring:
The gauge contribution at mass weight eight is spanned by the Lorentz contractions of the
  three trace families alone: for each of `gluonTrace`, `wTrace` and `hyperchargeTrace`, the
  `(0,2)(1,3)` metric contraction `η^{μρ} η^{νσ} F_{μν} F_{ρσ}` and the Levi-Civita contraction
  `ε^{μνρσ} F_{μν} F_{ρσ}`, as plain component sums. The two twice-derived hypercharge
  generators of `IsGaugeSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan_eq` vanish. The six span; they are
  not shown to be independent or nonzero.
entries.snippet:
lemma isGaugeSector_lorentzContractionEightSpan_eq_traceFamilies :
    h.isGaugeSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan
      = Submodule.span ℂ {ofComponents h.isGaugeSector.gluonTrace (contractionTensor 1),
          ofComponents h.isGaugeSector.gluonTrace (contractionTensor 3)}
        ⊔ (Submodule.span ℂ {ofComponents h.isGaugeSector.wTrace (contractionTensor 1),
            ofComponents h.isGaugeSector.wTrace (contractionTensor 3)}
          ⊔ Submodule.span ℂ {ofComponents h.isGaugeSector.hyperchargeTrace (contractionTensor 1),
            ofComponents h.isGaugeSector.hyperchargeTrace (contractionTensor 3)})

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.isGaugeSector_massWeightSubmodule_le
entries.docstring:
At a non-zero weight the gauge sector's mass-weight submodule sits inside the
  covariant model's, being the `{gauge}` piece of the sector decomposition there.
entries.snippet:
lemma isGaugeSector_massWeightSubmodule_le {w : ℕ} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    h.isGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule w ≤ h.massWeightSubmodule w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.isHiggsSector_massWeightSubmodule_le
entries.docstring:
At a non-zero weight the Higgs sector's mass-weight submodule sits inside the
  covariant model's.
entries.snippet:
lemma isHiggsSector_massWeightSubmodule_le {w : ℕ} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    h.isHiggsSector.massWeightSubmodule w ≤ h.massWeightSubmodule w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.isFermionSector_massWeightSubmodule_le
entries.docstring:
At a non-zero weight the fermion sector's mass-weight submodule sits inside the
  covariant model's.
entries.snippet:
lemma isFermionSector_massWeightSubmodule_le {w : ℕ} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    h.isFermionSector.massWeightSubmodule w ≤ h.massWeightSubmodule w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.standardModelSpan_le_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring:
The span at weight `w` has mass weight `w`: each of its contributions is a
  combination of words of that weight.
entries.snippet:
lemma standardModelSpan_le_massWeightSubmodule (w : ℕ) :
    h.standardModelSpan w ≤ h.massWeightSubmodule w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.isFixedBy_standardModelSpan
entries.docstring:
The span at weight `w` is fixed pointwise by the gauge and Lorentz groups together:
  every one of its contributions is a span of invariants. This is the easy direction of
  the classification, and it is also what supplies the stability the reduction asks of its
  target.
entries.snippet:
lemma isFixedBy_standardModelSpan (w : ℕ) :
    IsFixedBy (gaugeLorentzMaps repGauge repLorentz) (h.standardModelSpan w)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.repGauge_of_mem_standardModelSpan
entries.docstring: Every element of the span at weight `w` is a gauge invariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_of_mem_standardModelSpan (w : ℕ) (g : GaugeGroupI) {y : B}
    (hy : y ∈ h.standardModelSpan w) : repGauge g y = y

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_of_mem_standardModelSpan
entries.docstring: Every element of the span at weight `w` is a Lorentz invariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_of_mem_standardModelSpan (w : ℕ) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) {y : B}
    (hy : y ∈ h.standardModelSpan w) : repLorentz Λ y = y

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.reducesInvariantsTo_sectorMassWeight_empty
entries.docstring:
The empty sector reduces to the span: away from weight zero it is trivial, its only word
  being the empty one.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_sectorMassWeight_empty {w : ℕ} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (gaugeLorentzMaps repGauge repLorentz) (h.sectorMassWeight ∅ w)
      (h.standardModelSpan w)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.reducesInvariantsTo_sectorMassWeight_gauge
entries.docstring:
The gauge sector reduces to the span: at weight eight to the four Lorentz contractions of
  its four families, two of each spanning, below it to nothing at all.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_sectorMassWeight_gauge {w : ℕ} (hw0 : 0 < w) (hw : w ≤ 8) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (gaugeLorentzMaps repGauge repLorentz)
      (h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge} w) (h.standardModelSpan w)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.reducesInvariantsTo_sectorMassWeight_higgs
entries.docstring:
The Higgs sector reduces to the span: at weight eight to the two box terms, the kinetic
  term and the quartic potential, at weight four to the Higgs mass term, and elsewhere to
  nothing.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_sectorMassWeight_higgs {w : ℕ} (hw0 : 0 < w) (hw : w ≤ 8) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (gaugeLorentzMaps repGauge repLorentz)
      (h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.higgs} w) (h.standardModelSpan w)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.reducesInvariantsTo_sectorMassWeight_fermion
entries.docstring:
The fermion sector reduces to the span: at weight eight to the ten kinetic terms over the
  nine family pairs, below it to nothing — there is no Dirac mass term.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_sectorMassWeight_fermion {w : ℕ} (hw0 : 0 < w) (hw : w ≤ 8) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (gaugeLorentzMaps repGauge repLorentz)
      (h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.fermion} w) (h.standardModelSpan w)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.reducesInvariantsTo_sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion
entries.docstring:
The Yukawa sector reduces to the span: at weight eight to the six Yukawa couplings over the
  nine family pairs, below it to nothing.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion {w : ℕ} (hw : w ≤ 8) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (gaugeLorentzMaps repGauge repLorentz)
      (h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.higgs, GeneratorClass.fermion} w)
      (h.standardModelSpan w)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.reducesInvariantsTo_sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs
entries.docstring:
The gauge-Higgs sector reduces to nothing: it carries no Lorentz invariant below weight
  nine.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_sectorMassWeight_gauge_higgs {w : ℕ} (hw : w ≤ 8) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (gaugeLorentzMaps repGauge repLorentz)
      (h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.higgs} w)
      (h.standardModelSpan w)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.reducesInvariantsTo_sectorMassWeight_gauge_fermion
entries.docstring:
The gauge-fermion sector reduces to nothing: it carries no Lorentz invariant below weight
  nine.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_sectorMassWeight_gauge_fermion {w : ℕ} (hw : w ≤ 8) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (gaugeLorentzMaps repGauge repLorentz)
      (h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.fermion} w)
      (h.standardModelSpan w)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.reducesInvariantsTo_sectorMassWeight_mixed
entries.docstring: The mixed sector reduces to nothing: it is trivial below weight nine.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_sectorMassWeight_mixed {w : ℕ} (hw : w ≤ 8) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (gaugeLorentzMaps repGauge repLorentz)
      (h.sectorMassWeight
        {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.higgs, GeneratorClass.fermion} w)
      (h.standardModelSpan w)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.isStableUnder_sectorMassWeight
entries.docstring:
Every weight part of every sector is carried into itself by both groups: the stability
  the join of the reductions asks of its summands.
entries.snippet:
lemma isStableUnder_sectorMassWeight (T : Finset GeneratorClass) (w : ℕ) :
    IsStableUnder (gaugeLorentzMaps repGauge repLorentz) (h.sectorMassWeight T w)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.reducesInvariantsTo_sectorMassWeight
entries.docstring:
Every sector reduces to the span, at every weight from one to eight. The three
  constructors of `GeneratorClass` give eight class sets, and section C treats each.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_sectorMassWeight {w : ℕ} (hw0 : 0 < w) (hw : w ≤ 8)
    (T : Finset GeneratorClass) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (gaugeLorentzMaps repGauge repLorentz) (h.sectorMassWeight T w)
      (h.standardModelSpan w)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.reducesInvariantsTo_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring:
The whole weight-`w` submodule reduces to the span, for `w` from one to eight. The
  mass-weight submodule is the join of the eight sectors' weight-`w` parts, each of them
  stable under both groups, and `ReducesInvariantsTo` is closed under joins in its source: the
  sectors are taken one at a time, each in turn joining the error term of the others. No
  independence of the sectors is used, and none is available.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_massWeightSubmodule {w : ℕ} (hw0 : 0 < w) (hw : w ≤ 8) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (gaugeLorentzMaps repGauge repLorentz) (h.massWeightSubmodule w)
      (h.standardModelSpan w)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_massWeightSubmodule_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff
entries.docstring:
The classification of the Standard Model at mass dimension at most four as an
  equivalence, in the shape every sector uses: an element of `massWeightSubmodule w ⊔ S`
  for `0 < w ≤ 8`, with `S` stable under both groups, is fixed by both groups exactly when
  it is a combination of the Standard-Model terms of weight `w` up to a remainder in `S`
  fixed by both groups. Forwards this is the reduction of section D; backwards it uses
  that the span is made of invariants of weight `w`, section B. The weight-four Higgs mass
  term is what makes the span, rather than the bare equation `x = y`, the right form of
  the statement.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmodule_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff (w : ℕ) (hw0 : 0 < w)
    (hw : w ≤ 8) (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hS : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, repGauge g y ∈ S)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule w ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
        ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g y = y)
          ∧ (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y)
          ∧ x - y ∈ h.standardModelSpan w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.exists_mem_standardModelSpan_of_gauge_and_lorentz_invariant
entries.docstring:
The gauge and Lorentz invariants of mass weight `w` for `0 < w ≤ 8`, modulo a
  submodule `S` stable under both groups: such an invariant is a combination of the
  Standard-Model terms of that weight plus a remainder in `S`, and the remainder is fixed
  by both groups as well, being the difference of two invariants.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_mem_standardModelSpan_of_gauge_and_lorentz_invariant (w : ℕ)
    (hw0 : 0 < w) (hw : w ≤ 8) (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hS : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, repGauge g y ∈ S)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule w ⊔ S)
    (hG : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
    (hL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) :
    ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g y = y)
      ∧ (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y)
      ∧ x - y ∈ h.standardModelSpan w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_massWeightSubmodule_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_mem
entries.docstring:
The same classification without the existential: at every weight from one to eight an
  element of `massWeightSubmodule w ⊔ S` fixed by both groups is an element of the
  Standard-Model span joined with `S` fixed by both groups, and conversely.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmodule_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_mem (w : ℕ)
    (hw0 : 0 < w) (hw : w ≤ 8) (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hS : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, repGauge g y ∈ S)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule w ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
        ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ (x ∈ h.standardModelSpan w ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
          ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_massWeightSubmodule_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_lagrangian
entries.docstring:
The invariant content of the Standard Model at mass dimension four. An element of
  `massWeightSubmodule 8 ⊔ S`, for `S` a submodule stable under both groups, is fixed by
  the gauge group and the Lorentz group exactly when it is a combination of
  the four Lorentz contractions of the three `F·F` trace families and of the twice-derived
  hypercharge field strength (`IsGaugeSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan`), two of each
  spanning by `IsGaugeSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan_eq`: the kinetic-shape and
  theta-shape contractions of the three gauge groups and two contractions of the
  twice-derived hypercharge field strength, which vanish
  (`mem_massWeightSubmodule_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_lagrangian_traceFamilies`),
  the Higgs kinetic term, its quartic potential and its two box terms
  (`HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.lorentzContractionEightSpan`),
  the kinetic terms of the ten fermion species over the nine family pairs
  (`IsFermionSector.kineticSpan`),
  and the six Yukawa couplings over the nine family pairs (`yukawaSpan`),
  up to a remainder in `S` fixed by both groups — and nothing else. The generators span;
  they are not shown to be independent, and no quotient by total derivatives is taken.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmodule_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_lagrangian
    (S : Submodule ℂ B) (hS : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, repGauge g y ∈ S)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule 8 ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
        ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g y = y)
          ∧ (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y)
          ∧ x - y ∈ h.isGaugeSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan
                ⊔ h.isHiggsSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan
              ⊔ (h.isFermionSector.kineticSpan ⊔ h.yukawaSpan)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_massWeightSubmodule_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_lagrangian_traceFamilies
entries.docstring:
The invariant content of the Standard Model at mass dimension four with the gauge
  contribution written through the Lorentz contractions of the three trace families alone:
  the `(0,2)(1,3)` metric contraction and the Levi-Civita contraction of each of `gluonTrace`,
  `wTrace` and `hyperchargeTrace` (`isGaugeSector_lorentzContractionEightSpan_eq_traceFamilies`).
  The Higgs, fermion and Yukawa contributions are as in
  `mem_massWeightSubmodule_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_lagrangian`. The
  generators span; they are not shown to be independent or nonzero.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmodule_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_lagrangian_traceFamilies
    (S : Submodule ℂ B) (hS : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, repGauge g y ∈ S)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule 8 ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
        ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g y = y)
          ∧ (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y)
          ∧ x - y ∈ (Submodule.span ℂ
                {ofComponents h.isGaugeSector.gluonTrace (contractionTensor 1),
                  ofComponents h.isGaugeSector.gluonTrace (contractionTensor 3)}
              ⊔ (Submodule.span ℂ {ofComponents h.isGaugeSector.wTrace (contractionTensor 1),
                  ofComponents h.isGaugeSector.wTrace (contractionTensor 3)}
                ⊔ Submodule.span ℂ
                  {ofComponents h.isGaugeSector.hyperchargeTrace (contractionTensor 1),
                    ofComponents h.isGaugeSector.hyperchargeTrace (contractionTensor 3)}))
                ⊔ h.isHiggsSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan
              ⊔ (h.isFermionSector.kineticSpan ⊔ h.yukawaSpan)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_of_gauge_and_lorentz_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_sup
entries.docstring:
Below mass dimension two there is nothing at all, and at mass dimension two only the
  Higgs mass term: at every weight from one to seven other than four an element of
  `massWeightSubmodule w ⊔ S` fixed by both groups already lies in `S`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_gauge_and_lorentz_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_sup (w : ℕ) (hw0 : 0 < w)
    (hw : w < 8) (hw4 : w ≠ 4) (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hS : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, repGauge g y ∈ S)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule w ⊔ S)
    (hG : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
    (hL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) : x ∈ S

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_massWeightSubmodule_four_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_higgsMass
entries.docstring:
At mass dimension two the only invariant of the Standard Model is the Higgs mass term
  `H† H`: an element of `massWeightSubmodule 4 ⊔ S` fixed by both groups is a multiple of
  it up to a remainder in `S` fixed by both groups.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmodule_four_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_higgsMass
    (S : Submodule ℂ B) (hS : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, repGauge g y ∈ S)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule 4 ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
        ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g y = y)
          ∧ (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y)
          ∧ x - y ∈ h.isHiggsSector.dotSpan 0 0

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_mixed_eq_bot_of_lt_nine
entries.docstring:
The mixed sector vanishes below weight nine: a word realising all three
  classes carries gauge weight at least four, Higgs weight at least two and fermion
  weight at least three, for a total of at least nine — so no such word exists at a
  lower weight, and the sector's span there is trivial.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_mixed_eq_bot_of_lt_nine {w : ℕ} (hw : w < 9) :
    h.sectorMassWeight
      {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.higgs, GeneratorClass.fermion} w = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_mixed_eight
entries.docstring:
The weight-eight mixed sector vanishes: the mass weight of a dimension-four
  Standard-Model term is at most eight, and the mixed sector is trivial there — no
  dimension-four term mixes gauge, Higgs and fermion fields together.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_mixed_eight :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.higgs, GeneratorClass.fermion} 8
      = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_of_invariant_sectorMassWeight_mixed_lt_nine_sup
entries.docstring:
Below mass weight nine the mixed sector adds nothing to a submodule `S`: an element of
  `sectorMassWeight {gauge, higgs, fermion} w ⊔ S` for `w < 9` already lies in `S`. The
  sector is trivial there, so no invariance is asked of `x` and no stability of `S`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_invariant_sectorMassWeight_mixed_lt_nine_sup (w : ℕ) (hw : w < 9)
    (S : Submodule ℂ B) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.higgs,
      GeneratorClass.fermion} w ⊔ S) : x ∈ S

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_sectorMassWeight_mixed_lt_nine_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff
entries.docstring:
The classification below mass weight nine as an equivalence, in the shape of the
  gauge- and Yukawa-sector statements: an element of
  `sectorMassWeight {gauge, higgs, fermion} w ⊔ S` for `w < 9` is fixed by both groups
  exactly when it is itself an element of `S` fixed by both groups. Neither stability
  hypothesis on `S` is needed, the forward direction being the vanishing of the sector.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_sectorMassWeight_mixed_lt_nine_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff (w : ℕ)
    (hw : w < 9) (S : Submodule ℂ B) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.higgs,
          GeneratorClass.fermion} w ⊔ S
        ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x) ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g y = y)
          ∧ (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y)
          ∧ x = y

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_sectorMassWeight_mixed_lt_nine_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_mem
entries.docstring:
The same classification without the existential: below mass weight nine an element of
  `sectorMassWeight {gauge, higgs, fermion} w ⊔ S` fixed by both groups is an element of
  `S` fixed by both groups, and conversely.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_sectorMassWeight_mixed_lt_nine_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_mem (w : ℕ)
    (hw : w < 9) (S : Submodule ℂ B) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge, GeneratorClass.higgs,
          GeneratorClass.fermion} w ⊔ S
        ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x) ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ (x ∈ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
          ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorSubmodule
entries.docstring:
The span of the words in the covariant generators realising exactly the classes
  `S`.
entries.snippet: def sectorSubmodule (S : Finset GeneratorClass) : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mul_mem_sectorSubmodule
entries.docstring: Multiplication carries the class spans of `S` and `T` into that of `S ∪ T`.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sector
entries.docstring:
The sector realising exactly the classes `S`: the span of the words whose
  generators realise `S`. It is a non-unital subalgebra — closed under multiplication
  since `S ∪ S = S`, but containing no non-zero scalar, since the empty word realises
  no class.
entries.snippet: def sector (S : Finset GeneratorClass) : NonUnitalSubalgebra ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_sector
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma mem_sector {S : Finset GeneratorClass} {x : B} :
    x ∈ h.sector S ↔ x ∈ h.sectorSubmodule S

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.list_prod_mem_sector
entries.docstring: A word lies in the sector of the classes it realises.
entries.snippet:
lemma list_prod_mem_sector (gl : List Generators) :
    (gl.map h.generatorVal).prod ∈ h.sector (wordClasses gl)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mul_mem_sector
entries.docstring: Multiplication carries the sectors of `S` and `T` into the sector of `S ∪ T`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mul_mem_sector {S T : Finset GeneratorClass} {x y : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.sector S) (hy : y ∈ h.sector T) : x * y ∈ h.sector (S ∪ T)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_fieldAlgebra_of_mem_sector
entries.docstring: Every sector sits inside the field algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_fieldAlgebra_of_mem_sector {S : Finset GeneratorClass} {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.sector S) : x ∈ h.fieldAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.fieldAlgebra_eq_iSup_sector
entries.docstring:
**The sectors exhaust the field algebra**: every element of the field algebra is a
  sum of elements of the sectors, since every word realises exactly one class set. The
  unit is supplied by `sector ∅`, the sector of the empty word, so the join is the
  whole of `fieldAlgebra` — read as a non-unital subalgebra, the two sides having
  otherwise different types.
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldAlgebra_eq_iSup_sector :
    h.fieldAlgebra.toNonUnitalSubalgebra = ⨆ S : Finset GeneratorClass, h.sector S

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.H_mem_sector

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.repGauge_generatorVal_mem_sector
entries.docstring: The gauge action carries a covariant generator into the sector of its class.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_generatorVal_mem_sector (g : GaugeGroupI) (a : Generators) :
    repGauge g (h.generatorVal a) ∈ h.sector {a.kind}

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_generatorVal_mem_sector
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action carries a covariant generator into the sector of its
  class.

    repLorentz Λ (h.generatorVal a) ∈ h.sector {a.kind}

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.repGauge_mem_sector
entries.docstring: The action `repGauge` preserves every sector.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_mem_sector {S : Finset GeneratorClass} {x : B} (g : GaugeGroupI)
    (hx : x ∈ h.sector S) : repGauge g x ∈ h.sector S

entries.docstring: The action `repLorentz` preserves every sector.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_mem_sector {S : Finset GeneratorClass} {x : B} (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (hx : x ∈ h.sector S) : repLorentz Λ x ∈ h.sector S

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight
entries.docstring:
The span of the words realising exactly the classes `S` of total mass weight
  `w`.
entries.snippet: def sectorMassWeight (S : Finset GeneratorClass) (w : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_le_sectorSubmodule
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_le_sectorSubmodule (S : Finset GeneratorClass) (w : ℕ) :
    h.sectorMassWeight S w ≤ h.sectorSubmodule S

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_le_massWeightSubmodule
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_le_massWeightSubmodule (S : Finset GeneratorClass) (w : ℕ) :
    h.sectorMassWeight S w ≤ h.massWeightSubmodule w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.list_prod_mem_sectorMassWeight
entries.docstring: A word lies in the weight part of its sector given by its total weight.
entries.snippet:
lemma list_prod_mem_sectorMassWeight (gl : List Generators) :
    (gl.map h.generatorVal).prod
      ∈ h.sectorMassWeight (wordClasses gl) ((gl.map Generators.weight).sum)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mul_mem_sectorMassWeight
entries.docstring:
Multiplication carries the weight-`w` part of the sector of `S` and the
  weight-`w'` part of the sector of `T` into the weight-`w + w'` part of the sector
  of `S ∪ T`.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.coeff_massWeightPoly_mem_sectorMassWeight
entries.docstring:
Reading off the `X ^ w` coefficient of `massWeightPoly` sends the sector of `S`
  into its weight-`w` part — the projection onto the weight-`w` component, with no
  independence argument needed.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_eq_inf
entries.docstring:
The weight-`w` part of the sector of `S` is exactly the intersection of the
  sector with the mass-weight submodule.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_eq_inf (S : Finset GeneratorClass) (w : ℕ) :
    h.sectorMassWeight S w = h.sectorSubmodule S ⊓ h.massWeightSubmodule w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.massWeightSubmodule_eq_iSup_sectorMassWeight
entries.docstring:
**The decomposition of the mass-weight submodule into sectors**: the weight-`w`
  component of the field algebra is the join over the class sets `S` of the
  weight-`w` parts of the sectors, since every word realises exactly one class set.
  The empty class set contributes the scalars, at weight zero only.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_eq_iSup_sectorMassWeight (w : ℕ) :
    h.massWeightSubmodule w = ⨆ S : Finset GeneratorClass, h.sectorMassWeight S w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.repGauge_mem_sectorMassWeight
entries.docstring: The action `repGauge` preserves the weight parts of every sector.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_mem_sectorMassWeight
entries.docstring: The action `repLorentz` preserves the weight parts of every sector.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_empty_of_ne_zero
entries.docstring:
At a non-zero weight the `∅` sector has no weight part: its only word is the
  empty word, of weight zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_empty_of_ne_zero {w : ℕ} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    h.sectorMassWeight ∅ w = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.higgsAlgebra_le_sup_sectorSubmodule
entries.docstring:
The algebra generated by the Higgs towers decomposes into the `{higgs}` sector
  and the scalar `∅` sector.
entries.snippet:
lemma higgsAlgebra_le_sup_sectorSubmodule :
    Subalgebra.toSubmodule h.isHiggsSector.higgsAlgebra
      ≤ h.sectorSubmodule {GeneratorClass.higgs} ⊔ h.sectorSubmodule ∅

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_higgs_le
entries.docstring:
The weight-`w` part of the `{higgs}` sector lies in the Higgs-sector mass-weight
  submodule: its words are products of Higgs towers of total weight `w`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_higgs_le (w : ℕ) :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.higgs} w
      ≤ h.isHiggsSector.massWeightSubmodule w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_higgs_eq
entries.docstring:
**The Higgs-sector mass-weight submodules are the weight parts of the `{higgs}`
  sector**, at any non-zero weight. (At weight zero the Higgs-sector submodule also
  contains the scalars, which the sector decomposition files under the `∅` sector.)
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_higgs_eq {w : ℕ} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.higgs} w
      = h.isHiggsSector.massWeightSubmodule w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.gaugeAlgebra_le_sup_sectorSubmodule
entries.docstring:
The algebra generated by the field-strength towers decomposes into the `{gauge}` sector
  and the scalar `∅` sector.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAlgebra_le_sup_sectorSubmodule :
    Subalgebra.toSubmodule h.isGaugeSector.gaugeAlgebra
      ≤ h.sectorSubmodule {GeneratorClass.gauge} ⊔ h.sectorSubmodule ∅

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_gauge_le
entries.docstring:
The weight-`w` part of the `{gauge}` sector lies in the gauge sector's
  mass-weight submodule.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_gauge_le (w : ℕ) :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge} w
      ≤ h.isGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_gauge_eq
entries.docstring:
**The gauge sector's mass-weight submodules are the weight parts of the
  `{gauge}` sector**, at any non-zero weight. (At weight zero the sector's
  submodule also contains the scalars, which the sector decomposition files under the
  `∅` sector.)
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_gauge_eq {w : ℕ} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.gauge} w
      = h.isGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.fermionAlgebra_le_sup_sectorSubmodule
entries.docstring:
The algebra generated by the fermion towers decomposes into the `{fermion}` sector
  and the scalar `∅` sector.
entries.snippet:
lemma fermionAlgebra_le_sup_sectorSubmodule :
    Subalgebra.toSubmodule h.isFermionSector.fermionAlgebra
      ≤ h.sectorSubmodule {GeneratorClass.fermion} ⊔ h.sectorSubmodule ∅

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_fermion_le
entries.docstring:
The weight-`w` part of the `{fermion}` sector lies in the fermion sector's
  mass-weight submodule.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_fermion_le (w : ℕ) :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.fermion} w
      ≤ h.isFermionSector.massWeightSubmodule w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_fermion_eq
entries.docstring:
**The fermion sector's mass-weight submodules are the weight parts of the
  `{fermion}` sector**, at any non-zero weight. (At weight zero the sector's
  submodule also contains the scalars, which the sector decomposition files under the
  `∅` sector.)
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_fermion_eq {w : ℕ} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.fermion} w
      = h.isFermionSector.massWeightSubmodule w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.generatorVal_mem_of_kind
entries.docstring:
A single generator's value lies in any family of submodules dominating its own
  class's sector.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.list_prod_mem_mul_of_forall_kind
entries.docstring:
**The two-class word decomposition.** A word all of whose generators lie in one of
  two classes is a product of an element of weight `classWeight c₁` from the first
  class's family and an element of weight `classWeight c₂` from the second.
entries.snippet:
lemma list_prod_mem_mul_of_forall_kind {c₁ c₂ : GeneratorClass} (hne : c₁ ≠ c₂)
    {M₁ M₂ : ℕ → Submodule ℂ B}
    (hM₁ : ∀ w, h.sectorMassWeight {c₁} w ≤ M₁ w)
    (hM₂ : ∀ w, h.sectorMassWeight {c₂} w ≤ M₂ w)
    (hone₁ : (1 : Submodule ℂ B) ≤ M₁ 0) (hone₂ : (1 : Submodule ℂ B) ≤ M₂ 0)
    (hmul₁ : ∀ a b, M₁ a * M₁ b ≤ M₁ (a + b))
    (hmul₂ : ∀ a b, M₂ a * M₂ b ≤ M₂ (a + b))
    (hcomm : ∀ a b, M₂ a * M₁ b ≤ M₁ b * M₂ a)
    (gl : List Generators) (hgl : ∀ g ∈ gl, g.kind = c₁ ∨ g.kind = c₂) :
    (gl.map h.generatorVal).prod
      ∈ M₁ (classWeight c₁ gl) * M₂ (classWeight c₂ gl)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_pair_le
entries.docstring:
**The two-class sector decomposition.** The weight-`w` piece of the sector of two
  classes is contained in the join, over the splittings of `w` into two non-zero
  parts, of the products of the two classes' mass-weight submodules.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_pair_le {c₁ c₂ : GeneratorClass} (hne : c₁ ≠ c₂)
    {M₁ M₂ : ℕ → Submodule ℂ B}
    (hM₁ : ∀ w, h.sectorMassWeight {c₁} w ≤ M₁ w)
    (hM₂ : ∀ w, h.sectorMassWeight {c₂} w ≤ M₂ w)
    (hone₁ : (1 : Submodule ℂ B) ≤ M₁ 0) (hone₂ : (1 : Submodule ℂ B) ≤ M₂ 0)
    (hmul₁ : ∀ a b, M₁ a * M₁ b ≤ M₁ (a + b))
    (hmul₂ : ∀ a b, M₂ a * M₂ b ≤ M₂ (a + b))
    (hcomm : ∀ a b, M₂ a * M₁ b ≤ M₁ b * M₂ a) (w : ℕ) :
    h.sectorMassWeight {c₁, c₂} w
      ≤ ⨆ (p : ℕ × ℕ) (_ : p.1 + p.2 = w) (_ : p.1 ≠ 0) (_ : p.2 ≠ 0), M₁ p.1 * M₂ p.2

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sector_invariant_of_iSupIndep
entries.docstring:
An element of the weight-`w` submodule fixed by both actions is a sum of
  weight-`w` sector pieces, each of them fixed by both actions, provided the weight
  parts of the sectors are independent. Independence is what turns the two
  decompositions `x = ∑ s, f s` and `x = ∑ s, repGauge g (f s)` into an equality
  piece by piece; without it the pieces are not determined by their sum.
entries.snippet:
lemma sector_invariant_of_iSupIndep {w : ℕ}
    (hind : iSupIndep fun S : Finset GeneratorClass => h.sectorMassWeight S w)
    (x : B) (x_gauge_invariant : ∀ g, repGauge g x = x)
    (x_lorentz_invariant : ∀ g, repLorentz g x = x)
    (x_mass_dim : x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule w) :
    ∃ f : Finset GeneratorClass → B,
      x = ∑ s, f s ∧ (∀ s, f s ∈ h.sectorMassWeight s w ∧
      (∀ g, repGauge g (f s) = (f s)) ∧ (∀ g, repLorentz g (f s) = (f s)))

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.commute_of_mem_higgsAlgebra_of_mem_fermionAlgebra
entries.docstring:
**The Higgs sector is bosonic**: every element of the algebra generated by the
  Higgs towers commutes with every element of the algebra generated by the fermion
  towers.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.fermionMassWeight_mul_higgsMassWeight_le
entries.docstring:
The fermion-sector and Higgs-sector mass-weight submodules commute past each
  other, in the order needed by `sectorMassWeight_pair_le`.
entries.snippet:
lemma fermionMassWeight_mul_higgsMassWeight_le (a b : ℕ) :
    h.isFermionSector.massWeightSubmodule a * h.isHiggsSector.massWeightSubmodule b
      ≤ h.isHiggsSector.massWeightSubmodule b * h.isFermionSector.massWeightSubmodule a

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_le
entries.docstring:
**The Yukawa-sector decomposition**: the weight-`w` piece of the `{higgs,
  fermion}` sector is contained in the join, over the splittings of `w` into two
  non-zero parts, of the products of the Higgs-sector and fermion-sector mass-weight
  submodules.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_le (w : ℕ) :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.higgs, GeneratorClass.fermion} w
      ≤ ⨆ (p : ℕ × ℕ) (_ : p.1 + p.2 = w) (_ : p.1 ≠ 0) (_ : p.2 ≠ 0),
        h.isHiggsSector.massWeightSubmodule p.1 * h.isFermionSector.massWeightSubmodule p.2

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_eq_bot_of_lt_five
entries.docstring:
**Below weight five, the Yukawa sector vanishes**: no splitting of a total weight
  under five into two non-zero parts survives — the Higgs part is either odd (hence
  zero) or equal to two, forcing the fermion part to be one or two (hence also
  zero).
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_eq_bot_of_lt_five {w : ℕ} (hw : w < 5) :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.higgs, GeneratorClass.fermion} w = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_six
entries.docstring:
**The Yukawa sector vanishes at weight six**: every splitting of six into two
  non-zero parts has either an odd Higgs part or a fermion part of weight two or
  four, all of which vanish.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_six :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.higgs, GeneratorClass.fermion} 6 = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mul_le_sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion
entries.docstring:
A product of a Higgs-weight piece and a fermion-weight piece lands in the Yukawa
  sector of the total weight.
entries.snippet:
lemma mul_le_sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion {a b w : ℕ} {X Y : Submodule ℂ B}
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hab : a + b = w)
    (hX : X ≤ h.isHiggsSector.massWeightSubmodule a)
    (hY : Y ≤ h.isFermionSector.massWeightSubmodule b) :
    X * Y ≤ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.higgs, GeneratorClass.fermion} w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_five
entries.docstring:
**The weight-five Yukawa sector**: the only surviving splitting is the Higgs
  field itself (weight two) against the underived fermion towers (weight three).
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_five :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.higgs, GeneratorClass.fermion} 5
      = h.isHiggsSector.derivSubmodule 0 * h.isFermionSector.derivSubmodule 0

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_seven
entries.docstring:
**The weight-seven Yukawa sector**: the surviving splittings pair the Higgs
  field (weight two) with the once-derived fermion towers (weight five), or the
  once-derived Higgs field (weight four) with the underived fermion towers (weight
  three).
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_seven :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.higgs, GeneratorClass.fermion} 7
      = h.isHiggsSector.derivSubmodule 0 * h.isFermionSector.derivSubmodule 1
        ⊔ h.isHiggsSector.derivSubmodule 1 * h.isFermionSector.derivSubmodule 0
        ⊔ h.isHiggsSector.derivSubmodule 0 * h.isHiggsSector.derivSubmodule 0
          * h.isFermionSector.derivSubmodule 0

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_eight
entries.docstring:
**The weight-eight Yukawa sector**: the only surviving splitting pairs the Higgs
  field (weight two) with the product of two underived fermion towers (weight six)
  — this is the sector of the Yukawa term `H ψ ψ` itself.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_eight :
    h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.higgs, GeneratorClass.fermion} 8
      = h.isHiggsSector.derivSubmodule 0
        * (h.isFermionSector.derivSubmodule 0 * h.isFermionSector.derivSubmodule 0)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.barDownBlock
entries.docstring:
The components of the conjugate down-type Yukawa block `barH bard Q`: a conjugate
  Higgs symbol, a conjugate down-singlet symbol and a quark-doublet symbol, none carrying

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.yukawaSpan
entries.docstring:
The Yukawa span of the Standard Model at mass weight eight: the join of the six
  couplings, each over the nine family pairs.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def yukawaSpan : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.yukawaSpan_le_inf
entries.docstring:
The Yukawa span lies inside the gauge- and Lorentz-invariants of the Yukawa sector at
  mass weight eight. This is the easy direction of the classification: every Yukawa term
  is an invariant of the right mass weight, so the eventual classification is an
  equivalence and not merely a one-way inclusion.
entries.snippet:
lemma yukawaSpan_le_inf :
    h.yukawaSpan ≤ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.higgs, GeneratorClass.fermion} 8
        ⊓ repGauge.invariants ⊓ repLorentz.invariants

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.downBlock
entries.docstring:
The components of the down-type Yukawa block `H d barQ`: a Higgs symbol, a
  down-singlet symbol and a conjugate quark-doublet symbol, none carrying derivatives,
  multiplied in the order in which the block of
  `sectorMassWeightEightGaugeWeight_piece_zero` multiplies them.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def downBlock (f f' : Fin 3) (i sd : Fin 2) (cd : Fin 3) (sq : Fin 2)
    (cq : Fin 3) (wq : Fin 2) : B

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.isSU3FundamentalAntiFundamental_downBlock
entries.docstring:
The two colour indices of the down-type block carry one fundamental and one
  anti-fundamental `su(3)` index: the conjugate quark doublet supplies the fundamental
  index, so it goes in the first slot, and the down singlet the anti-fundamental one.
entries.snippet:
lemma isSU3FundamentalAntiFundamental_downBlock (f f' : Fin 3) (i sd sq wq : Fin 2) :
    IsSU3FundamentalAntiFundamental B repGauge
      (fun l : Fin 2 → Fin 3 => h.downBlock f f' i sd (l 1) sq (l 0) wq)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.isSU2FundamentalAntiFundamental_downBlock
entries.docstring:
The two isospin indices of the down-type block carry one fundamental and one
  anti-fundamental `su(2)` index: the conjugate quark doublet supplies the fundamental
  index and the Higgs symbol the anti-fundamental one, so the Higgs index goes in the
  second slot.
entries.snippet:
lemma isSU2FundamentalAntiFundamental_downBlock (f f' : Fin 3) (sd : Fin 2) (cd : Fin 3)
    (sq : Fin 2) (cq : Fin 3) :
    IsSU2FundamentalAntiFundamental B repGauge
      (fun l : Fin 2 → Fin 2 => h.downBlock f f' (l 1) sd cd sq cq (l 0))

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.isBiDualRightWeyl_downBlock
entries.docstring:
The two spinor indices of the down-type block are both dual right-handed: the down
  singlet and the conjugate quark doublet are both right-handed, and the Higgs symbol
  without derivatives is a Lorentz scalar.
entries.snippet:
lemma isBiDualRightWeyl_downBlock (f f' : Fin 3) (i : Fin 2) (cd cq : Fin 3) (wq : Fin 2) :
    IsBiDualRightWeyl B repLorentz
      (ofPairComponents fun a b => h.downBlock f f' i a cd b cq wq)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.repGauge_u1_downBlock
entries.docstring:
A hypercharge transformation fixes every component of the down-type block, the three
  hypercharges `-3`, `2` and `1` cancelling.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_u1_downBlock (t : unitary ℂ) (f f' : Fin 3) (i sd : Fin 2) (cd : Fin 3)
    (sq : Fin 2) (cq : Fin 3) (wq : Fin 2) :
    repGauge ((1, 1, t) : GaugeGroupI) (h.downBlock f f' i sd cd sq cq wq)
      = h.downBlock f f' i sd cd sq cq wq

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.downBlockColour
entries.docstring:
The colour contraction of the down-type block: the Kronecker delta joining the
  fundamental colour index of the conjugate quark doublet to the anti-fundamental one of
  the down singlet.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def downBlockColour (f f' : Fin 3) (i sd sq wq : Fin 2) : B

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.downBlockColour_eq
entries.docstring:
The colour contraction written out: the sum of the three components with equal colour
  indices.
entries.snippet:
lemma downBlockColour_eq (f f' : Fin 3) (i sd sq wq : Fin 2) :
    h.downBlockColour f f' i sd sq wq
      = ∑ a : Fin 3, h.downBlock f f' i sd a sq a wq

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.isSU2FundamentalAntiFundamental_downBlockColour
entries.docstring:
The colour contraction of the down-type block still carries one fundamental and one
  anti-fundamental isospin index, the colour sum being an isospin spectator.
entries.snippet:
lemma isSU2FundamentalAntiFundamental_downBlockColour (f f' : Fin 3) (sd sq : Fin 2) :
    IsSU2FundamentalAntiFundamental B repGauge
      (fun l : Fin 2 → Fin 2 => h.downBlockColour f f' (l 1) sd sq (l 0))

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.downBlockIsospin
entries.docstring:
The isospin contraction of the colour-contracted down-type block: the Kronecker delta
  joining the fundamental isospin index of the conjugate quark doublet to the
  anti-fundamental one of the Higgs.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def downBlockIsospin (f f' : Fin 3) (sd sq : Fin 2) : B

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.downBlockIsospin_eq
entries.docstring:
The doubly contracted block written out as a single sum over the isospin and colour
  indices it identifies.
entries.snippet:
lemma downBlockIsospin_eq (f f' : Fin 3) (sd sq : Fin 2) :
    h.downBlockIsospin f f' sd sq
      = ∑ p : Fin 2 × Fin 3, h.downBlock f f' p.1 sd p.2 sq p.2 p.1

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.isBiDualRightWeyl_downBlockIsospin
entries.docstring:
The doubly contracted block carries two dual right-handed Weyl indices, the colour and
  isospin sums being Lorentz spectators.
entries.snippet:
lemma isBiDualRightWeyl_downBlockIsospin (f f' : Fin 3) :
    IsBiDualRightWeyl B repLorentz (ofPairComponents (h.downBlockIsospin f f'))

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.downYukawa
entries.docstring:
The down-type Yukawa term of the family pair `(f, f')`: the down-singlet symbol of family `f`
  against the conjugate quark doublet of family `f'` and a Higgs symbol, with the colour indices
  joined by the Kronecker delta, the isospin indices by the Kronecker delta, and the two
  right-handed spinor indices by the antisymmetric symbol. It is the image of the metric `εR'` under
  the map with the contracted block as its components.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def downYukawa (f f' : Fin 3) : B

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.repGauge_su3_downBlockColour
entries.docstring: The colour contraction of the down-type block is fixed by the colour factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_su3_downBlockColour (U : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 3) ℂ) (f f' : Fin 3)
    (i sd sq wq : Fin 2) :
    repGauge ((U, 1, 1) : GaugeGroupI) (h.downBlockColour f f' i sd sq wq)
      = h.downBlockColour f f' i sd sq wq

entries.docstring: The doubly contracted down-type block is fixed by the colour factor.

    (sd sq : Fin 2) :

      = h.downBlockIsospin f f' sd sq

entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_su2_downBlockIsospin (V : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (f f' : Fin 3)
    (sd sq : Fin 2) :
    repGauge ((1, V, 1) : GaugeGroupI) (h.downBlockIsospin f f' sd sq)
      = h.downBlockIsospin f f' sd sq

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.repGauge_u1_downBlockIsospin
entries.docstring:
The doubly contracted down-type block is fixed by the hypercharge factor, already

entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_u1_downBlockIsospin (t : unitary ℂ) (f f' : Fin 3) (sd sq : Fin 2) :

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.repGauge_downYukawa
entries.docstring:
The down-type Yukawa term is gauge invariant: the colour indices are joined by the
  Kronecker delta, the isospin indices by the Kronecker delta, and the three hypercharges
  cancel.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_downYukawa (f f' : Fin 3) (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    repGauge g (h.downYukawa f f') = h.downYukawa f f'

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_downYukawa
entries.docstring:
The down-type Yukawa term is Lorentz invariant, the two right-handed spinor indices
  being joined by the antisymmetric symbol.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_downYukawa (f f' : Fin 3) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    repLorentz Λ (h.downYukawa f f') = h.downYukawa f f'

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.downBlock_mem_sectorMassWeight
entries.docstring:
Every component of the down-type block sits at mass weight eight in the Yukawa

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.repGauge_mul_fixed_left
entries.docstring:
A triple product whose first factor is fixed and whose second and third move by given
  coefficients moves by the product of those coefficients.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_mul_fixed_left (g : GaugeGroupI) {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {A : B} {X : ι → B} {Y : κ → B} {x₀ : ι} {y₀ : κ} {cX : ι → ℂ} {cY : κ → ℂ}
    (hA : repGauge g A = A) (hX : repGauge g (X x₀) = ∑ x, cX x • X x)
    (hY : repGauge g (Y y₀) = ∑ y, cY y • Y y) :
    repGauge g (A * (X x₀ * Y y₀)) = ∑ x, ∑ y, (cX x * cY y) • (A * (X x * Y y))

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.repGauge_mul_fixed_mid
entries.docstring: A triple product whose second factor is fixed.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_mul_fixed_mid (g : GaugeGroupI) {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {A : ι → B} {X : B} {Y : κ → B} {a₀ : ι} {y₀ : κ} {cA : ι → ℂ} {cY : κ → ℂ}
    (hA : repGauge g (A a₀) = ∑ a, cA a • A a) (hX : repGauge g X = X)
    (hY : repGauge g (Y y₀) = ∑ y, cY y • Y y) :
    repGauge g (A a₀ * (X * Y y₀)) = ∑ a, ∑ y, (cA a * cY y) • (A a * (X * Y y))

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.repGauge_mul_fixed_right
entries.docstring: A triple product whose third factor is fixed.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_mul_fixed_right (g : GaugeGroupI) {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {A : ι → B} {X : κ → B} {Y : B} {a₀ : ι} {x₀ : κ} {cA : ι → ℂ} {cX : κ → ℂ}
    (hA : repGauge g (A a₀) = ∑ a, cA a • A a)
    (hX : repGauge g (X x₀) = ∑ x, cX x • X x) (hY : repGauge g Y = Y) :
    repGauge g (A a₀ * (X x₀ * Y)) = ∑ a, ∑ x, (cA a * cX x) • (A a * (X x * Y))

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_mul_fixed_left
entries.docstring: The Lorentz analogue of `repGauge_mul_fixed_left`, the Higgs factor being inert.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_mul_fixed_left (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {A : B} {X : ι → B} {Y : κ → B} {x₀ : ι} {y₀ : κ} {cX : ι → ℂ} {cY : κ → ℂ}
    (hA : repLorentz Λ A = A) (hX : repLorentz Λ (X x₀) = ∑ x, cX x • X x)
    (hY : repLorentz Λ (Y y₀) = ∑ y, cY y • Y y) :
    repLorentz Λ (A * (X x₀ * Y y₀)) = ∑ x, ∑ y, (cX x * cY y) • (A * (X x * Y y))

An isospin transformation moves the isospin index of a lepton-doublet symbol by the
  conjugate matrix, the index being anti-fundamental.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_su2_L (V : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (f : Fin 3) {n : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s w : Fin 2) :
    repGauge ((1, V, 1) : GaugeGroupI) (h.isFermionSector.LComponent f l (s, w))
      = ∑ a, conj (V.1 a w) • h.isFermionSector.LComponent f l (s, a)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.repGauge_u1_L
entries.docstring:
A hypercharge transformation scales a lepton-doublet symbol by the cube of the scalar,
  the lepton doublet carrying `6Y = 3`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_u1_L (t : unitary ℂ) (f : Fin 3) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repGauge ((1, 1, t) : GaugeGroupI) (h.isFermionSector.LComponent f l j)
      = (t : ℂ) ^ 3 • h.isFermionSector.LComponent f l j

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mul_comm_of_le_derivSubmodule
entries.docstring:
Two submodules of fermion derivative submodules commute, the fermion symbols
  anticommuting and a submodule being closed under negation.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mul_mul_piece_swap
entries.docstring:
Swapping the two fermion factors of a block leaves every weight piece unchanged: the
  two fermion factors commute as submodules, so the two orderings of the block are the same
  submodule. This is what makes the six transposed blocks of the mass-weight-eight
  decomposition a rewrite rather than six fresh classifications.
entries.snippet:
lemma mul_mul_piece_swap {VH VX VY : Submodule ℂ B} {n m : ℕ}
    (dH : GaugeWeightDecomposition repGauge VH)
    (dX : GaugeWeightDecomposition repGauge VX)
    (dY : GaugeWeightDecomposition repGauge VY)
    (hX : VX ≤ h.isFermionSector.derivSubmodule n)
    (hY : VY ≤ h.isFermionSector.derivSubmodule m) (w : GaugeWeight) :
    (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dH)
        (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dX) (d' := dY))).piece w
      = (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dH)
        (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dY) (d' := dX))).piece w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mul_mul_swap_eq_neg
entries.docstring: Swapping the two fermion factors of a block negates it.
entries.snippet:
lemma mul_mul_swap_eq_neg {n m : ℕ} (a : B) {x y : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.isFermionSector.derivSubmodule n)
    (hy : y ∈ h.isFermionSector.derivSubmodule m) :
    a * (y * x) = -(a * (x * y))

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeightEightGaugeWeight
entries.docstring:
The gauge weight decomposition of the Yukawa sector at mass weight eight, transported
  along `sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_eight` from the product of the Higgs derivative
  submodule with two copies of the underived fermion towers.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable def sectorMassWeightEightGaugeWeight :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition repGauge
      (h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.higgs, GeneratorClass.fermion} 8)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.piece_mul_sup_mul
entries.docstring:
If the first fermion factor of a triple product is a join `VA ⊔ VB`, its weight-`w`
  piece splits along the join.
entries.snippet:
lemma piece_mul_sup_mul {VX VA VB VZ : Submodule ℂ B}
    (dX : GaugeWeightDecomposition repGauge VX) (dA : GaugeWeightDecomposition repGauge VA)
    (dB : GaugeWeightDecomposition repGauge VB) (dZ : GaugeWeightDecomposition repGauge VZ)
    (w : GaugeWeight) :
    (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dX)
        (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
          (d := GaugeWeightDecomposition.sup (d := dA) (d' := dB)) (d' := dZ))).piece w
      = (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dX)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dA) (d' := dZ))).piece w
        ⊔ (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dX)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dB) (d' := dZ))).piece w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.piece_mul_mul_sup
entries.docstring:
If the second fermion factor of a triple product is a join `VA ⊔ VB`, its weight-`w`
  piece splits along the join.
entries.snippet:
lemma piece_mul_mul_sup {VX VY VA VB : Submodule ℂ B}
    (dX : GaugeWeightDecomposition repGauge VX) (dY : GaugeWeightDecomposition repGauge VY)
    (dA : GaugeWeightDecomposition repGauge VA) (dB : GaugeWeightDecomposition repGauge VB)
    (w : GaugeWeight) :
    (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dX)
        (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dY)
          (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.sup (d := dA) (d' := dB)))).piece w
      = (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dX)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dY) (d' := dA))).piece w
        ⊔ (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dX)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dY) (d' := dB))).piece w

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mul_supp_hypercharge
entries.docstring:
Two decompositions with constant hypercharge have a product of constant hypercharge,
  the sum of the two: the support of a product is the pointwise sum of the supports, and
  hypercharge is the fourth coordinate of a gauge weight.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.higgsSubmoduleGaugeWeight_hc
entries.docstring:
The Higgs symbols carry hypercharge `-3`, independent of isospin and of the number of
  derivatives: the two weights in the support are `(0, 0, ∓1, -3)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma higgsSubmoduleGaugeWeight_hc (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ w ∈ (h.isHiggsSector.higgsSubmoduleGaugeWeight n).supp, w.2.2.2 = -3
