entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mul_speciesGaugeWeight_mul_piece_zero_neg_three
entries.docstring:
The hypercharge sieve against a Higgs symbol. If `dV` has constant hypercharge `-3`,
  as the Higgs symbols do, then of the hundred species pairings in a product of two fermion
  towers only the six whose hypercharges sum to `+3` survive at gauge weight zero: `d barQ`,
  `baru Q` and `barL e`, each in both orders. The other ninety-four pairings leave a nonzero
  hypercharge behind and so contribute nothing.
entries.snippet:
lemma mul_speciesGaugeWeight_mul_piece_zero_neg_three {V : Submodule ℂ B}
    {dV : GaugeWeightDecomposition repGauge V} (hV : ∀ w ∈ dV.supp, w.2.2.2 = -3)
    {n m : ℕ} (f f' : Fin 3) (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (l' : Fin m → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dV)
        (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
          (d := h.isFermionSector.speciesGaugeWeight f l)
          (d' := h.isFermionSector.speciesGaugeWeight f' l'))).piece 0
      = (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dV)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
              (d := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightD f l)
              (d' := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightBarQ f' l'))).piece 0
        ⊔ (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dV)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
              (d := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightBarQ f l)
              (d' := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightD f' l'))).piece 0
        ⊔ (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dV)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
              (d := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightBarU f l)
              (d' := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightQ f' l'))).piece 0
        ⊔ (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dV)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
              (d := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightQ f l)
              (d' := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightBarU f' l'))).piece 0
        ⊔ (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dV)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
              (d := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightBarL f l)
              (d' := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightE f' l'))).piece 0
        ⊔ (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dV)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
              (d := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightE f l)
              (d' := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightBarL f' l'))).piece 0

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mul_speciesGaugeWeight_mul_piece_zero_pos_three
entries.docstring:
The hypercharge sieve against a conjugate-Higgs symbol. If `dV` has constant
  hypercharge `3`, as the conjugate-Higgs symbols do, then of the hundred species pairings
  only the six whose hypercharges sum to `-3` survive at gauge weight zero: `bard Q`,
  `u barQ` and `L bare`, each in both orders.
entries.snippet:
lemma mul_speciesGaugeWeight_mul_piece_zero_pos_three {V : Submodule ℂ B}
    {dV : GaugeWeightDecomposition repGauge V} (hV : ∀ w ∈ dV.supp, w.2.2.2 = 3)
    {n m : ℕ} (f f' : Fin 3) (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (l' : Fin m → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dV)
        (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
          (d := h.isFermionSector.speciesGaugeWeight f l)
          (d' := h.isFermionSector.speciesGaugeWeight f' l'))).piece 0
      = (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dV)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
              (d := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightBarD f l)
              (d' := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightQ f' l'))).piece 0
        ⊔ (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dV)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
              (d := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightQ f l)
              (d' := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightBarD f' l'))).piece 0
        ⊔ (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dV)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
              (d := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightU f l)
              (d' := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightBarQ f' l'))).piece 0
        ⊔ (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dV)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
              (d := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightBarQ f l)
              (d' := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightU f' l'))).piece 0
        ⊔ (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dV)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
              (d := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightL f l)
              (d' := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightBarE f' l'))).piece 0
        ⊔ (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul (d := dV)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
              (d := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightBarE f l)
              (d' := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightL f' l'))).piece 0

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeightEightGaugeWeight_piece_zero
entries.docstring:
The weight-zero piece of the Yukawa sector at mass weight eight: the join, over pairs
  of families, of the twelve blocks that hypercharge allows.  Of the two hundred ways of
  choosing one Higgs symbol and two fermion species, only these twelve have vanishing total
  hypercharge; the remaining one hundred and eighty-eight are killed by
  `mul_speciesGaugeWeight_mul_piece_zero_neg_three` and
  `mul_speciesGaugeWeight_mul_piece_zero_pos_three`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorMassWeightEightGaugeWeight_piece_zero :
    h.sectorMassWeightEightGaugeWeight.piece 0
      = ⨆ (f : Fin 3) (f' : Fin 3),
        (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
            (d := h.isHiggsSector.higgsSubmoduleGaugeWeight 0)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
              (d := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightD f ![])
              (d' := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightBarQ f' ![]))).piece 0
        ⊔ (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
            (d := h.isHiggsSector.higgsSubmoduleGaugeWeight 0)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
              (d := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightBarQ f ![])
              (d' := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightD f' ![]))).piece 0
        ⊔ (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
            (d := h.isHiggsSector.higgsSubmoduleGaugeWeight 0)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
              (d := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightBarU f ![])
              (d' := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightQ f' ![]))).piece 0
        ⊔ (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
            (d := h.isHiggsSector.higgsSubmoduleGaugeWeight 0)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
              (d := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightQ f ![])
              (d' := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightBarU f' ![]))).piece 0
        ⊔ (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
            (d := h.isHiggsSector.higgsSubmoduleGaugeWeight 0)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
              (d := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightBarL f ![])
              (d' := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightE f' ![]))).piece 0
        ⊔ (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
            (d := h.isHiggsSector.higgsSubmoduleGaugeWeight 0)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
              (d := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightE f ![])
              (d' := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightBarL f' ![]))).piece 0
        ⊔ (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
            (d := h.isHiggsSector.barHiggsSubmoduleGaugeWeight 0)
            (d' := GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
              (d := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightBarD f ![])
              (d' := h.isFermionSector.rangeGaugeWeightQ f' ![]))).piece 0
        ⊔ (GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
            (d := h.isHiggsSector.barHiggsSubmoduleGaugeWeight 0)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.sectorMassWeightEightGaugeWeight_piece_zero_le
entries.docstring:
The weight-zero piece of the Yukawa sector at mass weight eight lies in the join of the
  six block submodules over the nine family pairs. The twelve blocks of
  `sectorMassWeightEightGaugeWeight_piece_zero` become six because the two fermion factors
  of a block commute, so the transposed block of `(f, f')` is the block of `(f', f)`; and
  the weight refinement inside a block is dropped, hypercharge having already done its
  work and colour, isospin and Lorentz being what decide the rest.

    h.sectorMassWeightEightGaugeWeight.piece 0 ≤ h.blockSubmodule

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.reducesInvariantsTo_sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_eight
entries.docstring:
The Yukawa sector at mass weight eight reduces, for the gauge and Lorentz groups
  together, to the Yukawa span. Hypercharge puts an invariant in the weight-zero piece, the
  piece lies in the six block submodules, and colour, isospin and Lorentz reduce each block
  to its Yukawa term.

    ReducesInvariantsTo (gaugeLorentzMaps repGauge repLorentz)
      (h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.higgs, GeneratorClass.fermion} 8) h.yukawaSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff
entries.docstring:
The classification of the Yukawa sector at mass weight eight as an equivalence: an
  element of the sector joined with a submodule `S` stable under both groups is fixed by
  both groups exactly when it is a combination of the six Yukawa couplings over the nine
  family pairs up to a remainder in `S` fixed by both groups.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff
    (S : Submodule ℂ B) (hS : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, repGauge g y ∈ S)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.higgs, GeneratorClass.fermion} 8 ⊔ S
        ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
        ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g y = y)
          ∧ (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y)
          ∧ x - y ∈ h.yukawaSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.higgsFermion_le_centreEigenspace
entries.docstring:
A Higgs derivative submodule against a fermion one is of half-integer spin: `+1` times
  `-1`.

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.higgsSqFermion_le_centreEigenspace
entries.docstring:
Two Higgs derivative submodules against a fermion one is of half-integer spin: `+1`
  times `+1` times `-1`.
entries.snippet:
private lemma higgsSqFermion_le_centreEigenspace (a b c : ℕ) :
    h.isHiggsSector.derivSubmodule a * h.isHiggsSector.derivSubmodule b
        * h.isFermionSector.derivSubmodule c
      ≤ centreEigenspace repLorentz (-1)

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_of_lorentz_invariant_sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_five_sup
entries.docstring:
Mass weight five carries no Lorentz invariant modulo a Lorentz-stable submodule: a
  Lorentz invariant of `sectorMassWeight {higgs, fermion} 5 ⊔ S` lies in `S`. The weight is
  one Higgs field against the underived fermion towers, of half-integer spin.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_lorentz_invariant_sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_five_sup (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.higgs, GeneratorClass.fermion} 5 ⊔ S)
    (hL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) : x ∈ S

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_of_lorentz_invariant_sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_seven_sup
entries.docstring:
Mass weight seven carries no Lorentz invariant modulo a Lorentz-stable submodule: a
  Lorentz invariant of `sectorMassWeight {higgs, fermion} 7 ⊔ S` lies in `S`. Each of the
  three products making up the weight has a single fermion factor, so each is of
  half-integer spin and so is their join.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_lorentz_invariant_sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_seven_sup
    (S : Submodule ℂ B) (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.higgs, GeneratorClass.fermion} 7 ⊔ S)
    (hL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) : x ∈ S

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_of_lorentz_invariant_sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_lt_eight_sup
entries.docstring:
Below mass weight eight the Yukawa sector carries no Lorentz invariant: a Lorentz
  invariant of `sectorMassWeight {higgs, fermion} w ⊔ S` for `w < 8` lies in `S`. Weights
  below five and weight six are trivial submodules, and weights five and seven are section
  B.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_lorentz_invariant_sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_lt_eight_sup (w : ℕ)
    (hw : w < 8) (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.higgs, GeneratorClass.fermion} w ⊔ S)
    (hL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) : x ∈ S

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_lt_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff
entries.docstring:
The classification below mass weight eight as an equivalence, in the shape of the
  gauge-sector statement `mem_massWeightSubmodule_lt_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff`:
  an element of `sectorMassWeight {higgs, fermion} w ⊔ S` for `w < 8` is fixed by both
  groups exactly when it is itself an element of `S` fixed by both groups. Gauge stability
  of `S` is not needed, and neither is gauge invariance of `x`: the forward direction is
  the spin parity argument, which uses the Lorentz group alone.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_lt_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff
    (w : ℕ) (hw : w < 8) (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.higgs, GeneratorClass.fermion} w ⊔ S
        ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x) ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g y = y)
          ∧ (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y)
          ∧ x = y

entries.name: StandardModel.CovAlgebraRealization.mem_sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_lt_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_mem
entries.docstring:
The same classification without the existential: below mass weight eight an element of
  `sectorMassWeight {higgs, fermion} w ⊔ S` fixed by both groups is an element of `S` fixed
  by both groups, and conversely.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_sectorMassWeight_higgs_fermion_lt_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_mem
    (w : ℕ) (hw : w < 8) (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.sectorMassWeight {GeneratorClass.higgs, GeneratorClass.fermion} w ⊔ S
        ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x) ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ (x ∈ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
          ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.basis
entries.docstring: A basis on the down singlets.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def basis : Module.Basis (Fin 2 × Fin 3) ℂ DownSinglet

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.«instance@0f32775c»
entries.snippet: instance : Module.Finite ℂ DownSinglet

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.«instance@cdb376e0»
entries.snippet: instance : Module.Free ℂ DownSinglet

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.jetValLinEquiv
entries.docstring:
Absorbs the jet ring into the colour index: a jet of a down-type singlet is the
same thing as a right-handed Weyl spinor tensored with a `SpaceTimeAlgebra`-valued colour
vector,

  `SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] DownSinglet ≃
    RightHandedWeyl ⊗[ℂ] EuclideanSpace SpaceTimeAlgebra (Fin 3)`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetValLinEquiv :
    SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] DownSinglet ≃ₗ[ℂ]
      Fermion.RightHandedWeyl ⊗[ℂ] EuclideanSpace SpaceTimeAlgebra (Fin 3)

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repJetGaugeGroupI
entries.docstring:
The `(3, 1)_{-2}` action of the jet gauge group on the jet space of the down-type
singlet. Through `jetValLinEquiv` the colour matrix of the gauge jet, carrying the
`-2` hypercharge phase `(star u) ^ 2`, acts `SpaceTimeAlgebra`-linearly on the colour factor by
matrix-vector multiplication, while the Weyl factor is untouched.

Both monoid laws come from bundled algebra maps — `Matrix.toLpLinAlgEquiv` and
`Module.End.lTensorAlgHom` are morphisms of algebras — so only the multiplicativity of
the colour-times-hypercharge matrix itself is checked. Note `Matrix.toLpLinAlgEquiv 2`
is the same map as the `Matrix.toEuclideanLin` used by `repGaugeGroupI`, which is an
abbreviation for `Matrix.toLpLin 2 2`, taken at the `CommRing` generality that
`SpaceTimeAlgebra` needs.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repJetGaugeGroupI :
    Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] DownSinglet) where

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.jetValLinEquiv_smul
entries.docstring:
The identification of the jets of the down-type singlet intertwines multiplication by
a scalar jet with the `SpaceTimeAlgebra`-scalar action on the colour coordinates.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetValLinEquiv_smul (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] DownSinglet) :
    jetValLinEquiv (χ • z)
      = Module.End.lTensorAlgHom ℂ (EuclideanSpace SpaceTimeAlgebra (Fin 3))
          Fermion.RightHandedWeyl
          ((LinearMap.lsmul SpaceTimeAlgebra
              (EuclideanSpace SpaceTimeAlgebra (Fin 3)) χ).restrictScalars ℂ)
          (jetValLinEquiv z)

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repJetGaugeGroupI_smul
entries.docstring:
**The jet gauge action on the jets of the down-type singlet is fibrewise**: it
commutes with multiplication by scalar jets, acting on the values of the field over the
identity on spacetime.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_smul (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra)
    (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] DownSinglet) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI U (χ • z) = χ • repJetGaugeGroupI U z

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repJetGaugeGroupI_ofConstant
entries.docstring:
On jets of constant gauge transformations the jet action reduces to the global
gauge action on the fibre: the `(3, 1)_{-2}` action on the down-singlet factor, and the
trivial action on the jet ring.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_ofConstant (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI (JetGaugeGroupI.ofConstant g) =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (repGaugeGroupI g)

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.basis_eq_mk
entries.docstring: The down-singlet basis vector as an explicit spinor–colour tensor.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_eq_mk (k : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3) : basis (k, c) =
    ⟨Fermion.RightHandedWeyl.basis k ⊗ₜ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℂ c⟩

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repLorentzGroup_apply_basis
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the down-singlet basis: the colour index is inert and the
  spinor index transforms by the entrywise conjugate matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (basis j) = ∑ β, star (Λ.1 β j.1) • basis (β, j.2)

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring:
The down-singlet coordinate functionals transform contragrediently, by the entrywise
  conjugate of the inverse matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repLorentzGroup.dual Λ (basis.dualBasis j) =
      ∑ β, star ((Λ⁻¹).1 j.1 β) • basis.dualBasis (β, j.2)

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the conjugate down-singlet basis: the coefficients are the
  conjugates of those of the down-singlet action, that is, the matrix itself.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj Λ ((Basis.conj basis) j)
      = ∑ β, Λ.1 β j.1 • (Basis.conj basis) (β, j.2)

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring: The conjugate down-singlet coordinate functionals transform by the inverse matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj.dual Λ ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis j) =
      ∑ β, (Λ⁻¹).1 j.1 β • (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis (β, j.2)

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repLorentzGroup_neg_one
entries.docstring:
**The centre of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts on the down-singlet space by `-1`**: the value space carries a
  single Weyl-spinor index, and `-1` is not the identity on a half-integer spin.
entries.snippet: lemma repLorentzGroup_neg_one : repLorentzGroup (-1) = -LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one
entries.docstring:
The centre acts on the conjugate down-singlet space by `-1` as well: conjugation does not
  move a real sign.
entries.snippet: lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one : repLorentzGroup.conj (-1) = -LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis
entries.docstring:
The gauge action on the down-singlet basis: the spinor index is inert and the colour
  index transforms by the `SU(3)` matrix, scaled by the hypercharge factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repGaugeGroupI g (basis j) =
      ∑ c, (star g.toU1.1 ^ 2 * g.toSU3.1 c j.2) • basis (j.1, c)

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring:
The down-singlet coordinate functionals carry the contragredient gauge action: the
  hypercharge and `SU(3)` factors of the inverse group element, transposed.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repGaugeGroupI.dual g (basis.dualBasis j) =
      ∑ c, (star (g⁻¹).toU1.1 ^ 2 * (g⁻¹).toSU3.1 j.2 c) • basis.dualBasis (j.1, c)

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis
entries.docstring:
The gauge action on the conjugate down-singlet basis: the coefficients of the
  down-singlet action, conjugated.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj g ((Basis.conj basis) j) =
      ∑ c, star (star g.toU1.1 ^ 2 * g.toSU3.1 c j.2) • (Basis.conj basis) (j.1, c)

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring:
The conjugate down-singlet coordinate functionals carry the conjugate of the
  contragredient gauge action.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual g ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis j) =
      ∑ c, star (star (g⁻¹).toU1.1 ^ 2 * (g⁻¹).toSU3.1 j.2 c) •
        (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis (j.1, c)

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.valueGaugeWeight
entries.docstring:
The gauge weight of the down-singlet basis: the colour weights and hypercharge
  `-2`.
entries.snippet: def DownSinglet.valueGaugeWeight (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) : GaugeWeight

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis
entries.docstring:
The gauge torus acts diagonally on the basis of `DownSinglet`, with the weights
  `DownSinglet.valueGaugeWeight`.
entries.snippet:
lemma DownSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    DownSinglet.repGaugeGroupI (gaugeTorusGen i) (DownSinglet.basis j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (DownSinglet.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        DownSinglet.basis j

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
entries.docstring:
The dual action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals of
  `DownSinglet`: the weights are negated.
entries.snippet:
lemma DownSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    DownSinglet.repGaugeGroupI.dual (gaugeTorusGen i) (DownSinglet.basis.coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ (-(GaugeWeight.coord (DownSinglet.valueGaugeWeight j) i))) •
        DownSinglet.basis.coord j

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
entries.docstring:
The dual of the conjugate action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals
  of the conjugate of `DownSinglet`: the two negations cancel and the weights are those of
  the value space.
entries.snippet:
lemma DownSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    DownSinglet.repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual (gaugeTorusGen i)
      (((Basis.conj DownSinglet.basis)).coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (DownSinglet.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        ((Basis.conj DownSinglet.basis)).coord j

entries.name: StandardModel.downSinglet_repLorentzGroup_boostAxis_two_basis
entries.docstring:
The down-singlet basis diagonalises the `z`-boost: the colour index is inert, so the
  weight is the Weyl weight of the spinor index.
entries.snippet:
lemma downSinglet_repLorentzGroup_boostAxis_two_basis (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    DownSinglet.repLorentzGroup (SL2C.boostAxis 2 t ht) (DownSinglet.basis j)
      = ((t : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ (weylWeight j.1) • DownSinglet.basis j

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.colourEnd
entries.docstring:
The endomorphism of the down singlet defined by a `3 × 3` complex matrix acting on
  the colour index, with the Weyl factor untouched.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def colourEnd (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) :
    DownSinglet →ₗ[ℂ] DownSinglet

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.colourEnd_apply_mk
entries.snippet:
lemma colourEnd_apply_mk (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) (v : DownSinglet) :
    colourEnd A v
      = valLinEquiv.symm
          (Module.End.lTensorAlgHom ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 3)) Fermion.RightHandedWeyl
            (Matrix.toLpLinAlgEquiv 2 A) (valLinEquiv v))

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.colourEnd_add
entries.snippet:
lemma colourEnd_add (A B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) :
    colourEnd (A + B) = colourEnd A + colourEnd B

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.colourEnd_smul
entries.snippet:
lemma colourEnd_smul (z : ℂ) (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) :
    colourEnd (z • A) = z • colourEnd A

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.colourEnd_zero
entries.snippet: lemma colourEnd_zero : colourEnd 0 = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.colourEnd_neg
entries.snippet: lemma colourEnd_neg (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) : colourEnd (-A) = -colourEnd A

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.colourEnd_multiset_sum
entries.snippet:
lemma colourEnd_multiset_sum (m : Multiset (Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ)) :
    colourEnd m.sum = (m.map colourEnd).sum

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.colourEnd_mul
entries.docstring: The colour endomorphisms compose through matrix multiplication.
entries.snippet:
lemma colourEnd_mul (A B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) :
    colourEnd (A * B) = colourEnd A ∘ₗ colourEnd B

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.actionMatrix
entries.docstring:
The matrix of the infinitesimal `(3, 1)_{-2}` action of a gauge algebra element on
  the colour index: `i` times the colour part, shifted by `i` times `-2` the
  hypercharge.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def actionMatrix (c : GaugeAlgebra) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction
entries.docstring:
**The infinitesimal action of the gauge algebra on the down-type singlet**: the
  derivative of the `(3, 1)_{-2}` action of the gauge group, real-linear in the
  algebra slot and complex-linear in the value slot — the form consumed by the
  covariant derivative `GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivIter` and by
  `LocalGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def gaugeAlgebraAction :
    GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] DownSinglet →ₗ[ℂ] DownSinglet where

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.foldl_pderiv_sub
entries.docstring: The iterated formal derivative of a difference.

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.jetActionMatrix
entries.docstring:
The jet-valued matrix of the infinitesimal `(3, 1)_{-2}` action of a jet of gauge
  algebra elements: the jet analogue of `actionMatrix`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def jetActionMatrix (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) SpaceTimeAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.jetActionMatrix_map_cc_foldl
entries.docstring:
The base-point Taylor coefficients of the jet action matrix are the action matrices
  of the base-point Taylor coefficients.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetActionMatrix_map_cc_foldl (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    ((jetActionMatrix a).map fun f =>
        constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv p f))
      = actionMatrix (JetGaugeAlgebra.eval (JetGaugeAlgebra.iteratedDeriv p a))

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.downMatrix
entries.docstring:
The `SpaceTimeAlgebra`-valued colour matrix of the jet gauge action on the down singlet: the
  colour matrix of the gauge jet carrying the `-2` hypercharge phase.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def downMatrix (U : JetGaugeGroupI) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) SpaceTimeAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repJetGaugeGroupI_eq_downMatrix
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_eq_downMatrix (U : JetGaugeGroupI)
    (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] DownSinglet) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI U z
      = jetValLinEquiv.symm
          (Module.End.lTensorAlgHom ℂ (EuclideanSpace SpaceTimeAlgebra (Fin 3))
            Fermion.RightHandedWeyl
            ((Matrix.toLpLinAlgEquiv 2 (downMatrix U)).restrictScalars ℂ)
            (jetValLinEquiv z))

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.pderivColour
entries.docstring: The entrywise formal derivative on the colour coordinates, as a `ℂ`-linear map.
entries.snippet:
private noncomputable def pderivColour (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    EuclideanSpace SpaceTimeAlgebra (Fin 3) →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace SpaceTimeAlgebra (Fin 3) where

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.foldColour
entries.docstring: The entrywise iterated formal derivative on the colour coordinates.
entries.snippet:
private noncomputable def foldColour (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    EuclideanSpace SpaceTimeAlgebra (Fin 3) →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace SpaceTimeAlgebra (Fin 3) where

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.ccColour
entries.docstring: The entrywise base-point evaluation on the colour coordinates.
entries.snippet:
private noncomputable def ccColour :
    EuclideanSpace SpaceTimeAlgebra (Fin 3) →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 3) where

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.pderivColour_comp_foldColour
StandardModel.DownSinglet.jetValLinEquiv_jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
The identification of down-singlet jets intertwines the formal derivative with the
  entrywise derivative on the colour coordinates.
entries.snippet:
private lemma jetValLinEquiv_jetDeriv (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] DownSinglet) :
    jetValLinEquiv (jetDeriv μ z)
      = (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (pderivColour μ)) (jetValLinEquiv z)

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.jetValLinEquiv_jetIteratedDeriv
entries.docstring:
The identification of down-singlet jets intertwines the iterated formal derivative
  with the entrywise iterated derivative on the colour coordinates.
entries.snippet:
private lemma jetValLinEquiv_jetIteratedDeriv (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] DownSinglet) :
    jetValLinEquiv (jetIteratedDeriv x z)
      = (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (foldColour x)) (jetValLinEquiv z)

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.valLinEquiv_jetEval
entries.docstring: The base-point evaluation of a down-singlet jet through the colour coordinates.

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.downMatrix_map_pderiv
entries.docstring:
**The derivative identity** for the colour matrix of the jet gauge action: the
  formal derivative of the colour matrix is minus the jet action matrix of the
  Maurer–Cartan form times the colour matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma downMatrix_map_pderiv (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (downMatrix U).map (fun f => pderiv μ f)
      = -(jetActionMatrix (maurerCartanForm U μ) * downMatrix U)

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.downMatrix_mul_jetActionMatrix
entries.docstring:
**The equivariance identity** for the colour matrix of the jet gauge action: the
  colour matrix intertwines the constant jet action matrix with its adjoint
  transform.
entries.snippet:
lemma downMatrix_mul_jetActionMatrix (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (c : GaugeAlgebra) :
    downMatrix U * jetActionMatrix (JetGaugeAlgebra.ofConstant c)
      = jetActionMatrix (JetGaugeAlgebra.adjointMap U (JetGaugeAlgebra.ofConstant c))
        * downMatrix U

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repCoeff_eq
entries.docstring:
**The base-point Taylor coefficients of the jet gauge action** on the down-type
  singlet are the colour endomorphisms of the base-point Taylor coefficients of the
  colour matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma repCoeff_eq (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff repJetGaugeGroupI U x
      = colourEnd ((downMatrix U).map fun f =>
          constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv x f))

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repCoeff_zero_of_eval_eq_one

At the base point, a gauge jet with trivial value acts trivially: the zeroth
  Taylor coefficient of the jet gauge action is the identity.
entries.snippet:
lemma repCoeff_zero_of_eval_eq_one {U : JetGaugeGroupI} (hU : U.eval = 1) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff repJetGaugeGroupI U 0 = LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.isInfinitesimalActionOf
entries.docstring:
**The `(3, 1)_{-2}` action of the gauge algebra is the infinitesimal action
  underlying the jet gauge action on the down-type singlet**: its base-point Taylor
  coefficients obey the Maurer–Cartan Leibniz law and intertwine the action with the
  adjoint transports.
entries.snippet:
lemma isInfinitesimalActionOf :
    localGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf gaugeAlgebraAction repJetGaugeGroupI

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The infinitesimal gauge action on the down-type singlet acts on the colour factor, the
  Lorentz action on the Weyl factor, so the two commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup (c : GaugeAlgebra) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (v : DownSinglet) :
    DownSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction c (DownSinglet.repLorentzGroup Λ v) =
      DownSinglet.repLorentzGroup Λ (DownSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction c v)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace
entries.docstring:
The total target space of the Standard Model fermions: the direct sum of three
  generations each of the lepton doublet, the charged-lepton singlet, the quark doublet, and
  the up- and down-type quark singlets. The three generations of a species sit together, so
  that a species can be split off the jet algebra as a single exterior factor.
entries.snippet: abbrev FermionSpace : Type

entries.name: StandardModel.generations
entries.docstring:
The matter field of three generations of one fermion species: the direct sum of three
  copies of it, which all carry the same mass weight and the same declared statistic.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def generations (M : MatterField localGaugeData) : MatterField localGaugeData

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionMatterField
entries.docstring:
**The fermionic matter field of the Standard Model**: the direct sum of three
  generations of each of the five species, in the order in which `FermionSpace` lists them.
  Its value space is `FermionSpace` by definition, and every summand carries mass weight
  three and is declared fermionic, which is what lets the direct sums be formed.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def fermionMatterField : MatterField localGaugeData

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionMatterField_V
entries.snippet: lemma fermionMatterField_V : fermionMatterField.V = FermionSpace

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the total fermionic target space: each species and generation
  transforms in its own Lorentz representation.

The global gauge action on the total fermionic target space: each species and
  generation transforms in its own representation of the gauge group.

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.jetEquiv
entries.docstring:
The jets of the total fermionic field as the product of the jets of the species and
  generations. The identification is `SpaceTimeAlgebra`-linear.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetEquiv :
    SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] FermionSpace ≃ₗ[SpaceTimeAlgebra]
      (Fin 3 → SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] LeptonDoubletV) ×
        ((Fin 3 → SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] LeptonSinglet) ×
          ((Fin 3 → SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] QuarkDoublet) ×
            ((Fin 3 → SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] UpSinglet) ×
              (Fin 3 → SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] DownSinglet))))

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.jetActionMap
entries.docstring:
The map through which a jet of gauge transformations acts on the jets of the total
  fermionic field: the species actions, factor by factor.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetActionMap (U : JetGaugeGroupI) :
    ((Fin 3 → SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] LeptonDoubletV) ×
      ((Fin 3 → SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] LeptonSinglet) ×
        ((Fin 3 → SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] QuarkDoublet) ×
          ((Fin 3 → SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] UpSinglet) ×
            (Fin 3 → SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] DownSinglet))))) →ₗ[ℂ]
    ((Fin 3 → SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] LeptonDoubletV) ×
      ((Fin 3 → SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] LeptonSinglet) ×
        ((Fin 3 → SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] QuarkDoublet) ×
          ((Fin 3 → SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] UpSinglet) ×
            (Fin 3 → SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] DownSinglet)))))

entries.name: LinearMap.piMap_id
entries.docstring: The pointwise lift of the identity maps is the identity.
entries.snippet:
lemma _root_.LinearMap.piMap_id {R ι : Type*} {φ : ι → Type*} [Semiring R]
    [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (φ i)] [∀ i, Module R (φ i)] :
    LinearMap.piMap (fun i => (LinearMap.id : φ i →ₗ[R] φ i)) = LinearMap.id

entries.name: LinearMap.piMap_comp_piMap
entries.docstring: The pointwise lift of compositions is the composition of the pointwise lifts.
entries.snippet:
lemma _root_.LinearMap.piMap_comp_piMap {R ι : Type*} {φ ψ ω : ι → Type*} [Semiring R]
    [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (φ i)] [∀ i, Module R (φ i)]
    [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (ψ i)] [∀ i, Module R (ψ i)]
    [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (ω i)] [∀ i, Module R (ω i)]
    (f : ∀ i, ψ i →ₗ[R] ω i) (g : ∀ i, φ i →ₗ[R] ψ i) :
    (LinearMap.piMap f).comp (LinearMap.piMap g)
      = LinearMap.piMap fun i => (f i).comp (g i)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.jetActionMap_one
entries.docstring: The map of jets of the identity is the identity.
entries.snippet: lemma jetActionMap_one : jetActionMap 1 = LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.jetActionMap_mul
entries.docstring: The map of jets of a product is the composition of the maps of jets.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetActionMap_mul (U V : JetGaugeGroupI) :
    jetActionMap (U * V) = (jetActionMap U).comp (jetActionMap V)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.repJetGaugeGroupI
entries.docstring:
**The jet gauge action on the jets of the total fermionic field**: the species
  actions, transported through the splitting of the jets.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repJetGaugeGroupI :
    Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] FermionSpace) where

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.repJetGaugeGroupI_smul
entries.docstring:
**The jet gauge action on the jets of the total fermionic field is fibrewise**: it
  commutes with multiplication by scalar jets, because the splitting of the jets is
  `SpaceTimeAlgebra`-linear and each species action is fibrewise.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_smul (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra)
    (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] FermionSpace) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI U (χ • z) = χ • repJetGaugeGroupI U z

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionJetAlgebra
entries.docstring:
**The jet algebra of the Standard Model fermions**: the exterior product of the fermionic
  algebras of the five species, realized as the fermionic algebra of their direct sum. Its
  generators are the component functions `∂_s ψ_φ` and `∂_s ψ̄_φ` of every species and
  generation, and any two of them anticommute — within a species and across species alike.

  This is the fermionic factor of the full Standard Model jet algebra; the gauge and Higgs
  factors are bosonic and commute with it.
entries.snippet: abbrev FermionJetAlgebra : Type

The component functions of the `i`-th generation lepton doublet inside the Standard

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionJetAlgebra.exteriorProductLeptonDoublet
entries.docstring:
The fermionic jet algebra as the exterior product of the three-generation
  lepton-doublet algebra with the algebra of the remaining four species.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def exteriorProductLeptonDoublet :
    FermionJetAlgebra ≃ₐ[ℂ] (FermionicAlgebra.evenOdd (generations LeptonDoubletV.matterField) ᵍ⊗[ℂ]
      FermionicAlgebra.evenOdd
          ((generations LeptonSinglet.matterField).prod
          ((generations QuarkDoublet.matterField).prod
          ((generations UpSinglet.matterField).prod
          (generations DownSinglet.matterField) rfl rfl) rfl rfl) rfl rfl))

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionJetAlgebra.exteriorProductLeptonSinglet
entries.docstring: The charged-lepton singlets split off the remaining three species.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def exteriorProductLeptonSinglet :
    FermionicAlgebra
        ((generations LeptonSinglet.matterField).prod
        ((generations QuarkDoublet.matterField).prod
        ((generations UpSinglet.matterField).prod (generations DownSinglet.matterField) rfl rfl)
        rfl rfl) rfl rfl) ≃ₐ[ℂ]
      (FermionicAlgebra.evenOdd (generations LeptonSinglet.matterField) ᵍ⊗[ℂ]
        FermionicAlgebra.evenOdd
            ((generations QuarkDoublet.matterField).prod
            ((generations UpSinglet.matterField).prod
            (generations DownSinglet.matterField) rfl rfl) rfl rfl))

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionJetAlgebra.exteriorProductQuarkDoublet
entries.docstring: The quark doublets split off the two quark singlets.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def exteriorProductQuarkDoublet :
    FermionicAlgebra
        ((generations QuarkDoublet.matterField).prod
        ((generations UpSinglet.matterField).prod
        (generations DownSinglet.matterField) rfl rfl) rfl rfl) ≃ₐ[ℂ]
      (FermionicAlgebra.evenOdd (generations QuarkDoublet.matterField) ᵍ⊗[ℂ]
        FermionicAlgebra.evenOdd
            ((generations UpSinglet.matterField).prod (generations DownSinglet.matterField)
              rfl rfl))

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionJetAlgebra.exteriorProductUpSinglet
entries.docstring: The two quark singlets as an exterior product.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def exteriorProductUpSinglet :
    FermionicAlgebra
        ((generations UpSinglet.matterField).prod (generations DownSinglet.matterField)
          rfl rfl) ≃ₐ[ℂ]
      (FermionicAlgebra.evenOdd (generations UpSinglet.matterField) ᵍ⊗[ℂ]
        FermionicAlgebra.evenOdd (generations DownSinglet.matterField))

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionJetAlgebra.massWeightScale

The mass-dimension scaling on the fermionic jet algebra: every Standard Model fermion
  has mass dimension `3/2`, that is mass weight three, and each derivative adds mass
  weight two.

entries.name: StandardModel.lTensor_comp_jetOfConstant
entries.docstring: Including a constant into value-space jets is natural in the value space.
entries.snippet:
lemma lTensor_comp_jetOfConstant (p : V →ₗ[ℂ] W) :
    (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra p).comp jetOfConstant = jetOfConstant.comp p

entries.name: StandardModel.lTensor_comp_jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
The formal derivative on value-space jets is natural in the value space: it touches
  only the jet factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma lTensor_comp_jetDeriv (p : V →ₗ[ℂ] W) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra p).comp (jetDeriv μ)
      = (jetDeriv μ).comp (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra p)

entries.name: StandardModel.lTensor_comp_jetIteratedDeriv
entries.docstring: The iterated formal derivative on value-space jets is natural in the value space.
entries.snippet:
lemma lTensor_comp_jetIteratedDeriv (p : V →ₗ[ℂ] W) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra p).comp (jetIteratedDeriv s)
      = (jetIteratedDeriv s).comp (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra p)

entries.name: StandardModel.jetEval_comp_lTensor
entries.docstring: Evaluation of a value-space jet at the base point is natural in the value space.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetEval_comp_lTensor (p : V →ₗ[ℂ] W) :
    (jetEval (V := W)).comp (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra p) = p.comp jetEval

entries.name: StandardModel.repCoeff_comp
entries.docstring:
The base-point Taylor coefficients of two jet gauge actions are intertwined by any map
  of value spaces intertwining the actions themselves: `repCoeff` is built from
  `jetOfConstant`, `jetIteratedDeriv` and `jetEval`, and each of those is natural.
entries.snippet:
lemma repCoeff_comp {repV : Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)}
    {repW : Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] W)} (p : V →ₗ[ℂ] W)
    (hp : ∀ U : JetGaugeGroupI, (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra p).comp (repV U)
      = (repW U).comp (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra p))
    (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    p.comp (GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff repV U s)
      = (GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff repW U s).comp p

entries.name: StandardModel.repDualCoeff_comp
entries.docstring:
The transposed form of `repCoeff_comp`: the dual coefficients, which act on the
  component-function index, are intertwined the other way round.
entries.snippet:
lemma repDualCoeff_comp {repV : Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)}
    {repW : Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] W)} (p : V →ₗ[ℂ] W)
    (hp : ∀ U : JetGaugeGroupI, (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra p).comp (repV U)
      = (repW U).comp (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra p))
    (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    (GaugeAlgebraRealization.repDualCoeff repV U s).comp (Module.Dual.transpose p)
      = (Module.Dual.transpose p).comp (GaugeAlgebraRealization.repDualCoeff repW U s)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.lTensor_leptonDoubletProj_repJetGaugeGroupI
entries.docstring:
The lepton-doublet projection intertwines the total jet gauge action with the
  lepton doublet's own.
entries.snippet:
lemma lTensor_leptonDoubletProj_repJetGaugeGroupI (i : Fin 3) (U : JetGaugeGroupI) :
    (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra (leptonDoubletProj i)).comp (repJetGaugeGroupI U)
      = (LeptonDoubletV.repJetGaugeGroupI U).comp
        (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra (leptonDoubletProj i))

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.leptonDoubletProj_comp_repCoeff
entries.docstring:
The lepton-doublet projection intertwines the base-point Taylor coefficients of
  the total jet gauge action with those of the lepton doublet's own.
entries.snippet:
lemma leptonDoubletProj_comp_repCoeff (i : Fin 3) (U : JetGaugeGroupI)

    (leptonDoubletProj i).comp (GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff repJetGaugeGroupI U s)

entries.docstring:
The charged-lepton-singlet projection intertwines the base-point Taylor coefficients of

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.leptonSingletProj_comp_repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The charged-lepton-singlet projection intertwines the total Lorentz action with the

lemma leptonSingletProj_comp_repLorentzGroup (i : Fin 3) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :

      = (LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup Λ).comp (leptonSingletProj i)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.quarkDoubletProj_comp_repLorentzGroup
