entries.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.sum_incl_proj
entries.docstring:
The identity on the total fermionic target space is the sum, over the five species and
  the three generations, of the inclusion after the projection.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_incl_proj (v : FermionSpace) :
    (∑ i, leptonDoubletIncl i (leptonDoubletProj i v))
      + (∑ i, leptonSingletIncl i (leptonSingletProj i v))
      + (∑ i, quarkDoubletIncl i (quarkDoubletProj i v))
      + (∑ i, upSingletIncl i (upSingletProj i v))
      + (∑ i, downSingletIncl i (downSingletProj i v)) = v

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.sum_conj_incl_proj
entries.docstring:
The conjugate form of `sum_incl_proj`: conjugation leaves the underlying additive
  group and the underlying maps alone.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_conj_incl_proj (v : ConjModule FermionSpace) :
    (∑ i, ConjModule.map (leptonDoubletIncl i)
        (ConjModule.map (leptonDoubletProj i) v))
      + (∑ i, ConjModule.map (leptonSingletIncl i)
          (ConjModule.map (leptonSingletProj i) v))
      + (∑ i, ConjModule.map (quarkDoubletIncl i)
          (ConjModule.map (quarkDoubletProj i) v))
      + (∑ i, ConjModule.map (upSingletIncl i)
          (ConjModule.map (upSingletProj i) v))
      + (∑ i, ConjModule.map (downSingletIncl i)
          (ConjModule.map (downSingletProj i) v)) = v

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.dual_eq_sum
entries.docstring:
Every covector on the total fermionic target space is the sum, over the five species
  and the three generations, of its restriction to that species and generation pulled back
  along the corresponding projection.
entries.snippet:
lemma dual_eq_sum (φ : Module.Dual ℂ FermionSpace) :
    φ = (∑ i, Module.Dual.transpose (leptonDoubletProj i)
          (Module.Dual.transpose (leptonDoubletIncl i) φ))
      + (∑ i, Module.Dual.transpose (leptonSingletProj i)
          (Module.Dual.transpose (leptonSingletIncl i) φ))
      + (∑ i, Module.Dual.transpose (quarkDoubletProj i)
          (Module.Dual.transpose (quarkDoubletIncl i) φ))
      + (∑ i, Module.Dual.transpose (upSingletProj i)
          (Module.Dual.transpose (upSingletIncl i) φ))
      + (∑ i, Module.Dual.transpose (downSingletProj i)
          (Module.Dual.transpose (downSingletIncl i) φ))

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.speciesDual
entries.docstring:
The covectors on the total fermionic target space that are pulled back from a single
  species and generation.
entries.snippet: def speciesDual : Set (Module.Dual ℂ FermionSpace)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.span_speciesDual_eq_top
entries.docstring:
The covectors pulled back from the individual species and generations span every
  covector on the total fermionic target space. This is what lets an adjoin taken over the
  species covectors reach an adjoin taken over all of them.
entries.snippet: lemma span_speciesDual_eq_top : Submodule.span ℂ speciesDual = ⊤

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.conjDual_eq_sum
entries.docstring:
The conjugate form of `dual_eq_sum`: every covector on the conjugate of the total
  fermionic target space is the sum of the covectors pulled back from the species and
  generations.
entries.snippet:
lemma conjDual_eq_sum (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule FermionSpace)) :
    φ = (∑ i, Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (leptonDoubletProj i))
          (Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (leptonDoubletIncl i)) φ))
      + (∑ i, Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (leptonSingletProj i))
          (Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (leptonSingletIncl i)) φ))
      + (∑ i, Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (quarkDoubletProj i))
          (Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (quarkDoubletIncl i)) φ))
      + (∑ i, Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (upSingletProj i))
          (Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (upSingletIncl i)) φ))
      + (∑ i, Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (downSingletProj i))
          (Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (downSingletIncl i)) φ))

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.speciesConjDual
entries.docstring:
The covectors on the conjugate of the total fermionic target space that are pulled
  back from a single species and generation.
entries.snippet: def speciesConjDual : Set (Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule FermionSpace))

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.span_speciesConjDual_eq_top
entries.docstring:
The conjugate covectors pulled back from the individual species and generations span
  every covector on the conjugate of the total fermionic target space.
entries.snippet: lemma span_speciesConjDual_eq_top : Submodule.span ℂ speciesConjDual = ⊤

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV
entries.docstring:
The target vector space of one Standard Model lepton doublet: the target space of the
  datum `StandardModel.Model.leptonDoublet`, a left-handed Weyl spinor tensored with the
  weak coordinates. It carries the `(1, 2)_{-3}` representation of the gauge group.
entries.snippet: abbrev LeptonDoubletV : Type

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.basis
entries.docstring:
A basis on the lepton doublets: the Weyl basis tensored with the coordinate basis of
  the weak index.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def basis : Module.Basis (Fin 2 × Fin 2) ℂ LeptonDoubletV

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.basis_apply
entries.docstring: The lepton-doublet basis vector as an explicit spinor–weak tensor.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_apply (k j : Fin 2) :
    basis (k, j) = Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl.basis k ⊗ₜ[ℂ] Pi.single j 1

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The left-handed Lorentz representation on lepton doublets: the Lorentz action the
  general theory derives from the datum.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def repLorentzGroup : Representation ℂ (SL(2,ℂ)) LeptonDoubletV

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_tmul
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on a pure spinor–weak tensor: the left-handed action on the Weyl
  factor, the weak index untouched.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_tmul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (s : Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl) (v : Fin 2 → ℂ) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (s ⊗ₜ v) = Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl.rep Λ s ⊗ₜ v

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.doubletMatrix
entries.docstring:
The `SpaceTimeAlgebra`-valued weak matrix of the jet gauge action on the lepton doublet: the
  matrix of jets by which a gauge jet acts on the datum.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def doubletMatrix (U : JetGaugeGroupI) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) SpaceTimeAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.doubletMatrix_eq
entries.docstring:
The weak matrix of a gauge jet is its `SU(2)` matrix carrying the `-3` hypercharge
  phase `(star u) ^ 3`.
entries.snippet:
lemma doubletMatrix_eq (U : JetGaugeGroupI) :
    doubletMatrix U = ((star ((U.2.2 : unitary SpaceTimeAlgebra) : SpaceTimeAlgebra)) ^ 3) •
      ((U.2.1 : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) SpaceTimeAlgebra) : Matrix (Fin 2)
          (Fin 2) SpaceTimeAlgebra)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.doubletMatrix_ofConstant_map_constantCoeff
entries.docstring:
The constant term of the weak matrix of a constant gauge jet: the `SU(2)` matrix of
  the gauge transformation carrying its `-3` hypercharge phase.
entries.snippet:
lemma doubletMatrix_ofConstant_map_constantCoeff (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    (doubletMatrix (JetGaugeGroupI.ofConstant g)).map (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra → ℂ)
      = (star g.toU1.1 ^ 3) • g.toSU2.1

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.doubletMatrix_ofConstant
entries.docstring: The weak matrix of a constant gauge jet is constant.
entries.snippet:
lemma doubletMatrix_ofConstant (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    doubletMatrix (JetGaugeGroupI.ofConstant g)
      = ((doubletMatrix (JetGaugeGroupI.ofConstant g)).map
          (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra → ℂ)).map
          (MvPowerSeries.C : ℂ → SpaceTimeAlgebra)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI
entries.docstring:
The `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of the unquotiented Standard Model gauge group: the global
  action the general theory derives from the datum, the constant term of the jet action.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def repGaugeGroupI : Representation ℂ GaugeGroupI LeptonDoubletV

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_tmul
entries.docstring:
The gauge action on a pure spinor–weak tensor: the `SU(2)` matrix, scaled by the
  hypercharge factor, acts on the weak index.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_tmul (g : GaugeGroupI) (v : Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl) (w : Fin 2 → ℂ) :
    repGaugeGroupI g (v ⊗ₜ w) = v ⊗ₜ ((star g.toU1.1 ^ 3) • g.toSU2.1).mulVec w

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis
entries.docstring:
The gauge action on the lepton-doublet basis: the spinor index is inert and the weak
  index transforms by the `SU(2)` matrix, scaled by the hypercharge factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI g (basis j) =
      ∑ w, (star g.toU1.1 ^ 3 * g.toSU2.1 w j.2) • basis (j.1, w)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_tmul_basis_eq_sum
entries.docstring: Expands the lepton-doublet gauge action on a tensor-product basis vector.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_tmul_basis_eq_sum (g : GaugeGroupI) (k j : Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI g (basis (k, j)) =
      ∑ j' : Fin 2, (star g.toU1.1 ^ 3 * g.toSU2.1 j' j) • basis (k, j')

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_eq_iff_mul_eq
entries.docstring:
Two gauge elements induce the same action exactly when their weak-basis coefficients
  agree.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_eq_iff_mul_eq {g₁ g₂ : GaugeGroupI} :
    repGaugeGroupI g₁ = repGaugeGroupI g₂ ↔ ∀ j j',
    star g₁.toU1.1 ^ 3 * g₁.toSU2.1 j' j =
      star g₂.toU1.1 ^ 3 * g₂.toSU2.1 j' j

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.mem_repGaugeGroupI_ker_iff_eq
entries.docstring: Characterizes the full-group elements acting trivially on the lepton doublet.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_repGaugeGroupI_ker_iff_eq {g : GaugeGroupI} :
    g ∈ repGaugeGroupI.ker ↔ ∃ a : ℂ, g.toSU2.1 = a • 1 ∧
      a * star g.toU1.1 ^ 3 = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.gaugeGroup_subgroup_ℤ₆_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI
entries.docstring: The central `ℤ₆` subgroup acts trivially on `(1, 2)_{-3}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeGroup_subgroup_ℤ₆_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI :
    GaugeGroupQuot.subgroup .ℤ₆ ≤ repGaugeGroupI.ker

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.gaugeGroup_subgroup_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI
entries.docstring: Every supported quotient subgroup acts trivially on the lepton doublet.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeGroup_subgroup_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI (Q : GaugeGroupQuot) :
    Q.subgroup ≤ repGaugeGroupI.ker

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroup
entries.docstring:
The `(1, 2)_{-3}` representation for every supported global form of the
  Standard Model gauge group.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repGaugeGroup : (Q : GaugeGroupQuot) →
    Representation ℂ (GaugeGroup Q) LeptonDoubletV
  | .I => repGaugeGroupI
  | .ℤ₆ => QuotientGroup.lift _ repGaugeGroupI (gaugeGroup_subgroup_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI .ℤ₆)
  | .ℤ₂ => QuotientGroup.lift _ repGaugeGroupI (gaugeGroup_subgroup_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI .ℤ₂)
  | .ℤ₃ => QuotientGroup.lift _ repGaugeGroupI (gaugeGroup_subgroup_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI .ℤ₃)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repJetGaugeGroupI
entries.docstring:
The `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of the jet gauge group on the jet space of the lepton
doublet: the jet action the general theory derives from the datum.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repJetGaugeGroupI :
    Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] LeptonDoubletV)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repJetGaugeGroupI_smul
entries.docstring:
**The jet gauge action on the jets of the lepton doublet is fibrewise**: it commutes
with multiplication by scalar jets.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_smul (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra)
    (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] LeptonDoubletV) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI U (χ • z) = χ • repJetGaugeGroupI U z

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repJetGaugeGroupI_ofConstant
entries.docstring:
On jets of constant gauge transformations the jet action reduces to the global
gauge action on the fibre: the `(1, 2)_{-3}` action on the lepton-doublet factor, and
the trivial action on the jet ring.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_ofConstant (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI (JetGaugeGroupI.ofConstant g) =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (repGaugeGroupI g)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_apply_basis
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the lepton-doublet basis: the weak index is inert and the
  spinor index transforms by the matrix itself.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (basis j) = ∑ β, Λ.1 β j.1 • basis (β, j.2)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring:
The lepton-doublet coordinate functionals transform contragrediently, by the
  inverse matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.dual Λ (basis.dualBasis j) =
      ∑ β, (Λ⁻¹).1 j.1 β • basis.dualBasis (β, j.2)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the conjugate lepton-doublet basis: the coefficients are the
  conjugates of those of the lepton-doublet action.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj Λ ((Basis.conj basis) j)
      = ∑ β, star (Λ.1 β j.1) • (Basis.conj basis) (β, j.2)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring:
The conjugate lepton-doublet coordinate functionals transform by the entrywise
  conjugate of the inverse matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj.dual Λ ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis j) =
      ∑ β, star ((Λ⁻¹).1 j.1 β) • (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis (β, j.2)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_neg_one
entries.docstring:
**The centre of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts on the lepton-doublet space by `-1`**: the value space carries a
  single Weyl-spinor index, and `-1` is not the identity on a half-integer spin.
entries.snippet: lemma repLorentzGroup_neg_one : repLorentzGroup (-1) = -LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one
entries.docstring:
The centre acts on the conjugate lepton-doublet space by `-1` as well: conjugation does not
  move a real sign.
entries.snippet: lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one : repLorentzGroup.conj (-1) = -LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring:
The lepton-doublet coordinate functionals carry the contragredient gauge action: the
  hypercharge and `SU(2)` factors of the inverse group element, transposed.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.dual g (basis.dualBasis j) =
      ∑ w, (star (g⁻¹).toU1.1 ^ 3 * (g⁻¹).toSU2.1 j.2 w) • basis.dualBasis (j.1, w)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis
entries.docstring:
The gauge action on the conjugate lepton-doublet basis: the coefficients of the
  lepton-doublet action, conjugated.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj g ((Basis.conj basis) j) =
      ∑ w, star (star g.toU1.1 ^ 3 * g.toSU2.1 w j.2) • (Basis.conj basis) (j.1, w)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring:
The conjugate lepton-doublet coordinate functionals carry the conjugate of the
  contragredient gauge action.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual g ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis j) =
      ∑ w, star (star (g⁻¹).toU1.1 ^ 3 * (g⁻¹).toSU2.1 j.2 w) •
        (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis (j.1, w)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.valueGaugeWeight
entries.docstring:
The gauge weight of the lepton-doublet basis: the isospin weight and hypercharge
  `-3`.
entries.snippet: def LeptonDoubletV.valueGaugeWeight (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) : GaugeWeight

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis
entries.docstring:
The gauge torus acts diagonally on the basis of `LeptonDoubletV`, with the weights
  `LeptonDoubletV.valueGaugeWeight`.
entries.snippet:
lemma LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI (gaugeTorusGen i) (LeptonDoubletV.basis j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (LeptonDoubletV.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        LeptonDoubletV.basis j

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
entries.docstring:
The dual action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals of
  `LeptonDoubletV`: the weights are negated.
entries.snippet:
lemma LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI.dual (gaugeTorusGen i) (LeptonDoubletV.basis.coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ (-(GaugeWeight.coord (LeptonDoubletV.valueGaugeWeight j) i))) •
        LeptonDoubletV.basis.coord j

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
entries.docstring:
The dual of the conjugate action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals
  of the conjugate of `LeptonDoubletV`: the two negations cancel and the weights are those of
  the value space.
entries.snippet:
lemma LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual (gaugeTorusGen i)
      (((Basis.conj LeptonDoubletV.basis)).coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (LeptonDoubletV.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        ((Basis.conj LeptonDoubletV.basis)).coord j

entries.name: StandardModel.leptonDoublet_repLorentzGroup_boostAxis_two_basis
entries.docstring: The lepton-doublet basis diagonalises the `z`-boost: the isospin index is inert.
entries.snippet:
lemma leptonDoublet_repLorentzGroup_boostAxis_two_basis (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup (SL2C.boostAxis 2 t ht) (LeptonDoubletV.basis j)
      = ((t : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ (weylWeight j.1) • LeptonDoubletV.basis j

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd
entries.docstring:
The endomorphism of the lepton doublet defined by a `2 × 2` complex matrix acting on
  the weak index, with the Weyl factor untouched.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def weakEnd (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    LeptonDoubletV →ₗ[ℂ] LeptonDoubletV

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd_tmul
entries.docstring:
The weak endomorphism on a pure spinor–weak tensor: the matrix acts on the weak
  coordinates.
entries.snippet:
lemma weakEnd_tmul (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (s : Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl)
    (v : Fin 2 → ℂ) :
    weakEnd A (s ⊗ₜ v) = s ⊗ₜ A.mulVec v

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd_add
entries.snippet:
lemma weakEnd_add (A B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    weakEnd (A + B) = weakEnd A + weakEnd B

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd_smul
entries.snippet:
lemma weakEnd_smul (z : ℂ) (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    weakEnd (z • A) = z • weakEnd A

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd_zero
entries.snippet: lemma weakEnd_zero : weakEnd 0 = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd_neg
entries.snippet: lemma weakEnd_neg (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : weakEnd (-A) = -weakEnd A

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd_multiset_sum
entries.snippet:
lemma weakEnd_multiset_sum (m : Multiset (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) :
    weakEnd m.sum = (m.map weakEnd).sum

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd_mul
entries.docstring: The weak endomorphisms compose through matrix multiplication.
entries.snippet:
lemma weakEnd_mul (A B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    weakEnd (A * B) = weakEnd A ∘ₗ weakEnd B

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd_one
entries.docstring: The weak endomorphism of the identity matrix is the identity.
entries.snippet: lemma weakEnd_one : weakEnd 1 = LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.actionMatrix
entries.docstring:
The matrix of the infinitesimal `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of a gauge algebra element on
  the weak index: the action matrix of the datum.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def actionMatrix (c : GaugeAlgebra) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.actionMatrix_eq
entries.docstring:
The action matrix is `i` times the weak part, shifted by `i` times `-3` the
  hypercharge.
entries.snippet:
lemma actionMatrix_eq (c : GaugeAlgebra) :
    actionMatrix c = Complex.I • (c.toSU2Matrix - ((3 : ℂ) • c.toU1Value) • 1)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.gaugeAlgebraAction
entries.docstring:
**The infinitesimal action of the gauge algebra on the lepton doublet**: the
  derivative of the `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of the gauge group, real-linear in the
  algebra slot and complex-linear in the value slot — the form consumed by the
  covariant derivative `GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivIter` and by
  `LocalGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf`. It is the action the general theory derives
  from the datum.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def gaugeAlgebraAction :
    GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] LeptonDoubletV →ₗ[ℂ] LeptonDoubletV

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.gaugeAlgebraAction_apply
entries.docstring: The gauge algebra acts by the weak endomorphism of its action matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAlgebraAction_apply (c : GaugeAlgebra) :
    gaugeAlgebraAction c = weakEnd (actionMatrix c)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.jetActionMatrix
entries.docstring:
The jet-valued matrix of the infinitesimal `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of a jet of gauge
  algebra elements: the jet action matrix of the datum.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def jetActionMatrix (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) SpaceTimeAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.jetActionMatrix_eq
entries.docstring:
The jet action matrix is `i` times the weak part, shifted by `i` times `-3` the
  hypercharge.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetActionMatrix_eq (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    jetActionMatrix a = Complex.I • (a.toSU2Matrix - ((3 : ℂ) • a.toU1Value) • 1)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.jetActionMatrix_map_cc_foldl
entries.docstring:
The base-point Taylor coefficients of the jet action matrix are the action matrices
  of the base-point Taylor coefficients.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetActionMatrix_map_cc_foldl (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    ((jetActionMatrix a).map fun f =>
        constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv p f))
      = actionMatrix (JetGaugeAlgebra.eval (JetGaugeAlgebra.iteratedDeriv p a))

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repCoeff_eq
entries.docstring:
**The base-point Taylor coefficients of the jet gauge action** on the lepton
  doublet are the weak endomorphisms of the base-point Taylor coefficients of the
  weak matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma repCoeff_eq (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff repJetGaugeGroupI U x
      = weakEnd ((doubletMatrix U).map fun f =>
          constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv x f))

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repCoeff_zero_of_eval_eq_one
entries.docstring:
At the base point, a gauge jet with trivial value acts trivially: the zeroth
  Taylor coefficient of the jet gauge action is the identity.
entries.snippet:
lemma repCoeff_zero_of_eval_eq_one {U : JetGaugeGroupI} (hU : U.eval = 1) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff repJetGaugeGroupI U 0 = LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.isInfinitesimalActionOf
entries.docstring:
**The `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of the gauge algebra is the infinitesimal action
  underlying the jet gauge action on the lepton doublet**: its base-point Taylor
  coefficients obey the Maurer–Cartan Leibniz law and intertwine the action with the
  adjoint transports. This is the generic statement for the datum's matrix
  representation.
entries.snippet:
lemma isInfinitesimalActionOf :
    localGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf gaugeAlgebraAction repJetGaugeGroupI

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The infinitesimal gauge action on the lepton doublet acts on the weak factor, the
  Lorentz action on the Weyl factor, so the two commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup (c : GaugeAlgebra) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (v : LeptonDoubletV) :
    LeptonDoubletV.gaugeAlgebraAction c (LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup Λ v) =
      LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup Λ (LeptonDoubletV.gaugeAlgebraAction c v)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.basis
entries.docstring: A basis on the charged-lepton singlets.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def basis : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℂ LeptonSinglet

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.«instance@970a17cd»
entries.snippet: instance : Module.Finite ℂ LeptonSinglet

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.«instance@ba3525a2»
entries.snippet: instance : Module.Free ℂ LeptonSinglet

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup_apply_basis
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the lepton-singlet basis: the right-handed Weyl
  action by the entrywise conjugate matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (α : Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (basis α) = ∑ β, star (Λ.1 β α) • basis β

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring:
The lepton jet coordinates transform contragrediently, by the entrywise
  conjugate of the inverse matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (α : Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.dual Λ (basis.dualBasis α) =
      ∑ β, star ((Λ⁻¹).1 α β) • basis.dualBasis β

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the conjugate lepton basis: the coefficients are the
  conjugates of those of the lepton action, that is, the matrix itself.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (α : Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj Λ ((Basis.conj basis) α) = ∑ β, Λ.1 β α • (Basis.conj basis) β

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring: The conjugate lepton jet coordinates transform by the inverse matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (α : Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj.dual Λ ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis α) =
      ∑ β, (Λ⁻¹).1 α β • (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis β

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup_neg_one
entries.docstring:
**The centre of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts on the charged-lepton-singlet space by `-1`**: the value
  space carries a single Weyl-spinor index, and `-1` is not the identity on a half-integer
  spin.
entries.snippet: lemma repLorentzGroup_neg_one : repLorentzGroup (-1) = -LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one
entries.docstring:
The centre acts on the conjugate charged-lepton-singlet space by `-1` as well:
  conjugation does not move a real sign.
entries.snippet: lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one : repLorentzGroup.conj (-1) = -LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis
entries.docstring:
The gauge action on the lepton-singlet basis: multiplication by the hypercharge
  scalar, the colour and weak factors acting trivially.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (α : Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI g (basis α) = (star g.toU1.1 ^ 6 : ℂ) • basis α

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring:
The lepton-singlet coordinate functionals carry the contragredient gauge action: the
  hypercharge scalar of the inverse group element.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (α : Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.dual g (basis.dualBasis α) =
      (star (g⁻¹).toU1.1 ^ 6 : ℂ) • basis.dualBasis α

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis
entries.docstring:
The gauge action on the conjugate lepton-singlet basis: the hypercharge scalar,
  conjugated.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (α : Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj g ((Basis.conj basis) α) =
      star (star g.toU1.1 ^ 6 : ℂ) • (Basis.conj basis) α

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring:
The conjugate lepton-singlet coordinate functionals carry the conjugate of the
  contragredient gauge action.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (α : Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual g ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis α) =
      star (star (g⁻¹).toU1.1 ^ 6 : ℂ) • (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis α

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repJetGaugeGroupI
entries.docstring:
The `(1, 1)_{-6}` action of the jet gauge group on the jet space of the charged-lepton
singlet: multiplication of the jet-ring factor by the hypercharge power series
`(star u) ^ 6`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repJetGaugeGroupI :
    Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] LeptonSinglet) where

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repJetGaugeGroupI_tmul
entries.docstring:
The jet gauge action on a pure tensor of the jet space of the charged-lepton
singlet.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_tmul (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (ψ : LeptonSinglet) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI U (f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ψ)
      = ((star ((U.2.2 : unitary SpaceTimeAlgebra) : SpaceTimeAlgebra)) ^ 6 * f) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ψ

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repJetGaugeGroupI_smul
entries.docstring:
**The jet gauge action on the jets of the charged-lepton singlet is fibrewise**: it
commutes with multiplication by scalar jets.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_smul (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra)
    (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] LeptonSinglet) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI U (χ • z) = χ • repJetGaugeGroupI U z

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repJetGaugeGroupI_ofConstant
entries.docstring:
On jets of constant gauge transformations the jet action reduces to the global
gauge action on the fibre: the `(1, 1)_{-6}` action on the lepton-singlet factor, and
the trivial action on the jet ring.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_ofConstant (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI (JetGaugeGroupI.ofConstant g) =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (repGaugeGroupI g)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.valueGaugeWeight
entries.docstring: The gauge weight of the lepton-singlet basis: hypercharge `-6`.
entries.snippet: def LeptonSinglet.valueGaugeWeight (_ : Fin 2) : GaugeWeight

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis
entries.docstring:
The gauge torus acts diagonally on the basis of `LeptonSinglet`, with the weights
  `LeptonSinglet.valueGaugeWeight`.
entries.snippet:
lemma LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2) :
    LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI (gaugeTorusGen i) (LeptonSinglet.basis j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (LeptonSinglet.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        LeptonSinglet.basis j

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
entries.docstring:
The dual action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals of
  `LeptonSinglet`: the weights are negated.
entries.snippet:
lemma LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2) :
    LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI.dual (gaugeTorusGen i) (LeptonSinglet.basis.coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ (-(GaugeWeight.coord (LeptonSinglet.valueGaugeWeight j) i))) •
        LeptonSinglet.basis.coord j

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
entries.docstring:
The dual of the conjugate action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals
  of the conjugate of `LeptonSinglet`: the two negations cancel and the weights are those of
  the value space.
entries.snippet:
lemma LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2) :
    LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual (gaugeTorusGen i)
      (((Basis.conj LeptonSinglet.basis)).coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (LeptonSinglet.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        ((Basis.conj LeptonSinglet.basis)).coord j

entries.name: StandardModel.leptonSinglet_repLorentzGroup_boostAxis_two_basis
entries.docstring: The charged-lepton-singlet basis diagonalises the `z`-boost.
entries.snippet:
lemma leptonSinglet_repLorentzGroup_boostAxis_two_basis (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≠ 0) (j : Fin 2) :
    LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup (SL2C.boostAxis 2 t ht) (LeptonSinglet.basis j)
      = ((t : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ (weylWeight j) • LeptonSinglet.basis j

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction
entries.docstring:
**The infinitesimal action of the gauge algebra on the charged-lepton singlet**:
  the derivative of the `(1, 1)_{-6}` action of the gauge group — scalar
  multiplication by `i` times `-6` times the `u(1)` value, real-linear in the algebra
  slot and complex-linear in the value slot — the form consumed by
  `LocalGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def gaugeAlgebraAction :
    GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] LeptonSinglet →ₗ[ℂ] LeptonSinglet where

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction_apply
entries.docstring:
The gauge-algebra action on the charged-lepton singlet is scalar multiplication
  by `i` times `-6` times the `u(1)` value.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAlgebraAction_apply (c : GaugeAlgebra) :
    gaugeAlgebraAction c
      = (Complex.I * (-(6 : ℂ) * c.toU1Value))
        • (LinearMap.id : LeptonSinglet →ₗ[ℂ] LeptonSinglet)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.jetPhase
entries.docstring:
The `SpaceTimeAlgebra`-valued hypercharge phase of the jet gauge action on the
  charged-lepton singlet: the `-6` hypercharge power series `(star u) ^ 6` of the
  gauge jet.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def jetPhase (U : JetGaugeGroupI) : SpaceTimeAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.jetPhase_eq
entries.docstring: The hypercharge phase, unfolded.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetPhase_eq (U : JetGaugeGroupI) :
    jetPhase U = (star ((U.2.2 : unitary SpaceTimeAlgebra) : SpaceTimeAlgebra)) ^ 6

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repJetGaugeGroupI_eq_jetPhase
entries.docstring:
The jet gauge action on the charged-lepton singlet is multiplication of the
  jet-ring factor by the hypercharge phase.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_eq_jetPhase (U : JetGaugeGroupI) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI U
      = LinearMap.rTensor LeptonSinglet (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (jetPhase U))

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.jetIteratedDeriv_tmul
entries.docstring:
The iterated formal derivative of a jet of charged-lepton singlets acts on the
  jet-ring factor of a pure tensor.
entries.snippet:
private lemma jetIteratedDeriv_tmul (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra)
    (ψ : LeptonSinglet) :
    jetIteratedDeriv x (f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ψ)
      = SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv x f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ψ

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.smul_id_comp
entries.docstring: Scalar multiples of the identity compose through multiplication.
entries.snippet:
private lemma smul_id_comp (a b : ℂ) :
    (a • (LinearMap.id : LeptonSinglet →ₗ[ℂ] LeptonSinglet))
        ∘ₗ (b • (LinearMap.id : LeptonSinglet →ₗ[ℂ] LeptonSinglet))
      = (a * b) • (LinearMap.id : LeptonSinglet →ₗ[ℂ] LeptonSinglet)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.sum_map_smul_id
entries.docstring:
A multiset sum of scalar multiples of the identity is the scalar multiple by the
  sum.

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repCoeff_eq
entries.docstring:
**The base-point Taylor coefficients of the jet gauge action** on the
  charged-lepton singlet are scalar: multiplication by the base-point Taylor
  coefficients of the hypercharge phase.
entries.snippet:
lemma repCoeff_eq (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff repJetGaugeGroupI U x
      = constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv x (jetPhase U))
        • (LinearMap.id : LeptonSinglet →ₗ[ℂ] LeptonSinglet)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repCoeff_zero_of_eval_eq_one
entries.docstring:
At the base point, a gauge jet with trivial value acts trivially: the zeroth
  Taylor coefficient of the jet gauge action is the identity.
entries.snippet:
lemma repCoeff_zero_of_eval_eq_one {U : JetGaugeGroupI} (hU : U.eval = 1) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff repJetGaugeGroupI U 0 = LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.jetPhase_pderiv
entries.docstring:
**The derivative identity** for the hypercharge phase of the jet gauge action: the
  formal derivative of the phase is minus `i` times `-6` times the `u(1)` value of the
  Maurer–Cartan form, times the phase.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetPhase_pderiv (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    pderiv μ (jetPhase U)
      = -(((Complex.I * (-(6 : ℂ))) • (maurerCartanForm U μ).toU1Value)
          * jetPhase U)

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.isInfinitesimalActionOf
entries.docstring:
**The `(1, 1)_{-6}` action of the gauge algebra is the infinitesimal action
  underlying the jet gauge action on the charged-lepton singlet**: its base-point
  Taylor coefficients obey the Maurer–Cartan Leibniz law and intertwine the action
  with the adjoint transports.
entries.snippet:
lemma isInfinitesimalActionOf :
    localGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf gaugeAlgebraAction repJetGaugeGroupI

entries.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The infinitesimal gauge action on the charged-lepton singlet is a scalar, so it
  commutes with the Lorentz action.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup (c : GaugeAlgebra) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (v : LeptonSinglet) :

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakEquiv
entries.docstring:
The colour and weak factors of the quark doublet combined into a single Euclidean
factor over `Fin 3 × Fin 2`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def colourWeakEquiv :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 3) ⊗[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 2) ≃ₗ[ℂ] (Fin 3 × Fin 2 → ℂ)

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakEquiv_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma colourWeakEquiv_tmul (c : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 3)) (w : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 2))
    (p : Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    colourWeakEquiv (c ⊗ₜ[ℂ] w) p = c.ofLp p.1 * w.ofLp p.2

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.jetValLinEquiv
entries.docstring:
Absorbs the jet ring into the combined colour–weak index: a jet of a quark doublet is
the same thing as a left-handed Weyl spinor tensored with a `SpaceTimeAlgebra`-valued
colour–weak vector,

  `SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] QuarkDoublet ≃
    LeftHandedWeyl ⊗[ℂ] EuclideanSpace SpaceTimeAlgebra (Fin 3 × Fin 2)`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetValLinEquiv :
    SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] QuarkDoublet ≃ₗ[ℂ]
      Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl ⊗[ℂ] EuclideanSpace SpaceTimeAlgebra (Fin 3 × Fin 2)

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.jetGaugeMatrix
entries.docstring:
The matrix of jets through which a jet of gauge transformations acts on the combined
colour–weak index of the quark doublet: the Kronecker product of the `SU(3)` and `SU(2)`
power-series matrices, scaled by the hypercharge power series `u`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetGaugeMatrix (U : JetGaugeGroupI) :
    Matrix (Fin 3 × Fin 2) (Fin 3 × Fin 2) SpaceTimeAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.jetGaugeMatrix_one
entries.snippet: lemma jetGaugeMatrix_one : jetGaugeMatrix 1 = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.jetGaugeMatrix_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma jetGaugeMatrix_mul (U₁ U₂ : JetGaugeGroupI) :
    jetGaugeMatrix (U₁ * U₂) = jetGaugeMatrix U₁ * jetGaugeMatrix U₂

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repJetGaugeGroupI
entries.docstring:
The `(3, 2)_{1}` action of the jet gauge group on the jet space of the quark doublet.
Through `jetValLinEquiv` the Kronecker matrix of the gauge jet, carrying the hypercharge
phase `u`, acts `SpaceTimeAlgebra`-linearly on the combined colour–weak factor by matrix-vector
multiplication, while the Weyl factor is untouched.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repJetGaugeGroupI :
    Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] QuarkDoublet) where

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.jetGaugeMatrix_ofConstant
entries.docstring:
The entries of the gauge matrix of a jet of a constant gauge transformation are the
constant power series with the global gauge coefficients.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetGaugeMatrix_ofConstant (g : GaugeGroupI) (p q : Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    jetGaugeMatrix (JetGaugeGroupI.ofConstant g) p q =
      MvPowerSeries.C ((g.toU1.1 : ℂ) * (g.toSU3.1 p.1 q.1 * g.toSU2.1 p.2 q.2))

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.jetValLinEquiv_smul
entries.docstring:
The identification of the jets of the quark doublet intertwines multiplication by a
scalar jet with the `SpaceTimeAlgebra`-scalar action on the colour–weak coordinates.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetValLinEquiv_smul (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] QuarkDoublet) :
    jetValLinEquiv (χ • z)
      = Module.End.lTensorAlgHom ℂ (EuclideanSpace SpaceTimeAlgebra (Fin 3 × Fin 2))
          Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl
          ((LinearMap.lsmul SpaceTimeAlgebra
            (EuclideanSpace SpaceTimeAlgebra (Fin 3 × Fin 2)) χ).restrictScalars ℂ)
          (jetValLinEquiv z)

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repJetGaugeGroupI_smul
entries.docstring:
**The jet gauge action on the jets of the quark doublet is fibrewise**: it commutes
with multiplication by scalar jets.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_smul (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra)
    (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] QuarkDoublet) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI U (χ • z) = χ • repJetGaugeGroupI U z

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repJetGaugeGroupI_ofConstant
entries.docstring:
On jets of constant gauge transformations the jet action reduces to the global gauge
action on the fibre: the `(3, 2)_{1}` action on the quark-doublet factor, and the trivial
action on the jet ring.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_ofConstant (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI (JetGaugeGroupI.ofConstant g) =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (repGaugeGroupI g)

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.basis_eq_mk
entries.docstring: The quark-doublet basis vector as an explicit spinor–colour–weak tensor.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_eq_mk (k : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3) (w : Fin 2) : basis (k, c, w) =
    ⟨Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl.basis k ⊗ₜ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℂ c
      ⊗ₜ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℂ w⟩

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repLorentzGroup_apply_basis
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the quark-doublet basis: the colour and weak indices are inert
  and the spinor index transforms by the matrix itself.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (basis j) = ∑ β, Λ.1 β j.1 • basis (β, j.2.1, j.2.2)

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring:
The quark-doublet coordinate functionals transform contragrediently, by the inverse
  matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.dual Λ (basis.dualBasis j) =
      ∑ β, (Λ⁻¹).1 j.1 β • basis.dualBasis (β, j.2.1, j.2.2)

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the conjugate quark-doublet basis: the coefficients are the
  conjugates of those of the quark-doublet action.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj Λ ((Basis.conj basis) j) =
      ∑ β, star (Λ.1 β j.1) • (Basis.conj basis) (β, j.2.1, j.2.2)

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring:
The conjugate quark-doublet coordinate functionals transform by the entrywise
  conjugate of the inverse matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj.dual Λ ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis j) =
      ∑ β, star ((Λ⁻¹).1 j.1 β) • (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis (β, j.2.1, j.2.2)

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repLorentzGroup_neg_one
entries.docstring:
**The centre of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts on the quark-doublet space by `-1`**: the value space carries a
  single Weyl-spinor index, and `-1` is not the identity on a half-integer spin.
entries.snippet: lemma repLorentzGroup_neg_one : repLorentzGroup (-1) = -LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one
entries.docstring:
The centre acts on the conjugate quark-doublet space by `-1` as well: conjugation does not
  move a real sign.
entries.snippet: lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one : repLorentzGroup.conj (-1) = -LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis
entries.docstring:
The gauge action on the quark-doublet basis: the spinor index is inert, the colour
  index transforms by the `SU(3)` matrix and the weak index by the `SU(2)` matrix, scaled
  by the hypercharge factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI g (basis j) =
      ∑ c, ∑ w, (g.toU1.1 * g.toSU3.1 c j.2.1 * g.toSU2.1 w j.2.2) • basis (j.1, c, w)

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring:
The quark-doublet coordinate functionals carry the contragredient gauge action: the
  hypercharge, `SU(3)` and `SU(2)` factors of the inverse group element, transposed.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.dual g (basis.dualBasis j) =
      ∑ c, ∑ w, ((g⁻¹).toU1.1 * (g⁻¹).toSU3.1 j.2.1 c * (g⁻¹).toSU2.1 j.2.2 w) •
        basis.dualBasis (j.1, c, w)

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis
entries.docstring:
The gauge action on the conjugate quark-doublet basis: the coefficients of the
  quark-doublet action, conjugated.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj g ((Basis.conj basis) j) =
      ∑ c, ∑ w, star (g.toU1.1 * g.toSU3.1 c j.2.1 * g.toSU2.1 w j.2.2) •
        (Basis.conj basis) (j.1, c, w)

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring:
The conjugate quark-doublet coordinate functionals carry the conjugate of the
  contragredient gauge action.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual g ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis j) =
      ∑ c, ∑ w, star ((g⁻¹).toU1.1 * (g⁻¹).toSU3.1 j.2.1 c * (g⁻¹).toSU2.1 j.2.2 w) •
        (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis (j.1, c, w)

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.valueGaugeWeight
entries.docstring:
The gauge weight of the quark-doublet basis: the colour and isospin weights and
  hypercharge `1`.
entries.snippet: def QuarkDoublet.valueGaugeWeight (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) : GaugeWeight

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis
entries.docstring:
The gauge torus acts diagonally on the basis of `QuarkDoublet`, with the weights
  `QuarkDoublet.valueGaugeWeight`.
entries.snippet:
lemma QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI (gaugeTorusGen i) (QuarkDoublet.basis j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (QuarkDoublet.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        QuarkDoublet.basis j

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
entries.docstring:
The dual action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals of
  `QuarkDoublet`: the weights are negated.
entries.snippet:
lemma QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4)
    (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI.dual (gaugeTorusGen i) (QuarkDoublet.basis.coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ (-(GaugeWeight.coord (QuarkDoublet.valueGaugeWeight j) i))) •
        QuarkDoublet.basis.coord j

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
entries.docstring:
The dual of the conjugate action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals
  of the conjugate of `QuarkDoublet`: the two negations cancel and the weights are those of
  the value space.
entries.snippet:
lemma QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4)
    (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual (gaugeTorusGen i)
      (((Basis.conj QuarkDoublet.basis)).coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (QuarkDoublet.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        ((Basis.conj QuarkDoublet.basis)).coord j

entries.name: StandardModel.quarkDoublet_repLorentzGroup_boostAxis_two_basis
entries.docstring:
The quark-doublet basis diagonalises the `z`-boost: the colour and isospin indices are
  inert.
entries.snippet:
lemma quarkDoublet_repLorentzGroup_boostAxis_two_basis (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    QuarkDoublet.repLorentzGroup (SL2C.boostAxis 2 t ht) (QuarkDoublet.basis j)
      = ((t : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ (weylWeight j.1) • QuarkDoublet.basis j

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakValLinEquiv
entries.docstring:
The identification of the quark doublet with a left-handed Weyl spinor tensored with
  a colour–weak vector over the combined index `Fin 3 × Fin 2`: the `ℂ`-level analogue
  of `jetValLinEquiv`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def colourWeakValLinEquiv :
    QuarkDoublet ≃ₗ[ℂ] Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl ⊗[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 3 × Fin 2)

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakEnd
entries.docstring:
The endomorphism of the quark doublet defined by a complex matrix over the
  combined colour–weak index, with the Weyl factor untouched.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def colourWeakEnd (A : Matrix (Fin 3 × Fin 2) (Fin 3 × Fin 2) ℂ) :
    QuarkDoublet →ₗ[ℂ] QuarkDoublet

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakEnd_apply_mk
entries.snippet:
lemma colourWeakEnd_apply_mk (A : Matrix (Fin 3 × Fin 2) (Fin 3 × Fin 2) ℂ)
    (v : QuarkDoublet) :
    colourWeakEnd A v
      = colourWeakValLinEquiv.symm
          (Module.End.lTensorAlgHom ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 3 × Fin 2))
            Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl
            (Matrix.toLpLinAlgEquiv 2 A) (colourWeakValLinEquiv v))

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakEnd_add
entries.snippet:
lemma colourWeakEnd_add (A B : Matrix (Fin 3 × Fin 2) (Fin 3 × Fin 2) ℂ) :
    colourWeakEnd (A + B) = colourWeakEnd A + colourWeakEnd B

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakEnd_smul
entries.snippet:
lemma colourWeakEnd_smul (z : ℂ) (A : Matrix (Fin 3 × Fin 2) (Fin 3 × Fin 2) ℂ) :
    colourWeakEnd (z • A) = z • colourWeakEnd A

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakEnd_zero
entries.snippet: lemma colourWeakEnd_zero : colourWeakEnd 0 = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakEnd_neg
entries.snippet:
lemma colourWeakEnd_neg (A : Matrix (Fin 3 × Fin 2) (Fin 3 × Fin 2) ℂ) :
    colourWeakEnd (-A) = -colourWeakEnd A

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakEnd_multiset_sum
entries.snippet:
lemma colourWeakEnd_multiset_sum
    (m : Multiset (Matrix (Fin 3 × Fin 2) (Fin 3 × Fin 2) ℂ)) :
    colourWeakEnd m.sum = (m.map colourWeakEnd).sum

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakEnd_mul
entries.docstring: The colour–weak endomorphisms compose through matrix multiplication.
entries.snippet:
lemma colourWeakEnd_mul (A B : Matrix (Fin 3 × Fin 2) (Fin 3 × Fin 2) ℂ) :
    colourWeakEnd (A * B) = colourWeakEnd A ∘ₗ colourWeakEnd B

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.actionMatrix
entries.docstring:
The matrix of the infinitesimal `(3, 2)_{1}` action of a gauge algebra element on
  the combined colour–weak index: `i` times the Kronecker sum of the colour and weak
  parts, shifted by `i` times the hypercharge.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def actionMatrix (c : GaugeAlgebra) :
    Matrix (Fin 3 × Fin 2) (Fin 3 × Fin 2) ℂ

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.gaugeAlgebraAction
entries.docstring:
**The infinitesimal action of the gauge algebra on the quark doublet**: the
  derivative of the `(3, 2)_{1}` action of the gauge group, real-linear in the
  algebra slot and complex-linear in the value slot — the form consumed by the
  covariant derivative `GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivIter` and by
  `LocalGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def gaugeAlgebraAction :
    GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] QuarkDoublet →ₗ[ℂ] QuarkDoublet where

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.jetActionMatrix
entries.docstring:
The jet-valued matrix of the infinitesimal `(3, 2)_{1}` action of a jet of gauge
  algebra elements: the jet analogue of `actionMatrix`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetActionMatrix (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    Matrix (Fin 3 × Fin 2) (Fin 3 × Fin 2) SpaceTimeAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.jetActionMatrix_map_cc_foldl
entries.docstring:
The base-point Taylor coefficients of the jet action matrix are the action matrices
  of the base-point Taylor coefficients.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetActionMatrix_map_cc_foldl (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    ((jetActionMatrix a).map fun f =>
        constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv p f))
      = actionMatrix (JetGaugeAlgebra.eval (JetGaugeAlgebra.iteratedDeriv p a))

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repJetGaugeGroupI_eq_jetGaugeMatrix
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_eq_jetGaugeMatrix (U : JetGaugeGroupI)
    (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] QuarkDoublet) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI U z
      = jetValLinEquiv.symm
          (Module.End.lTensorAlgHom ℂ (EuclideanSpace SpaceTimeAlgebra (Fin 3 × Fin 2))
            Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl
            ((Matrix.toLpLinAlgEquiv 2 (jetGaugeMatrix U)).restrictScalars ℂ)
            (jetValLinEquiv z))

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.pderivColourWeak
entries.docstring:
The entrywise formal derivative on the colour–weak coordinates, as a `ℂ`-linear
  map.

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.foldColourWeak
entries.docstring: The entrywise iterated formal derivative on the colour–weak coordinates.

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.ccColourWeak
entries.docstring: The entrywise base-point evaluation on the colour–weak coordinates.
entries.snippet:
private noncomputable def ccColourWeak :
    EuclideanSpace SpaceTimeAlgebra (Fin 3 × Fin 2) →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 3 × Fin 2) where

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.pderivColourWeak_comp_foldColourWeak
StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.jetValLinEquiv_jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
The identification of quark-doublet jets intertwines the formal derivative with the
  entrywise derivative on the colour–weak coordinates.
entries.snippet:
private lemma jetValLinEquiv_jetDeriv (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] QuarkDoublet) :
    jetValLinEquiv (jetDeriv μ z)
      = (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (pderivColourWeak μ)) (jetValLinEquiv z)

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.jetValLinEquiv_jetIteratedDeriv
entries.docstring:
The identification of quark-doublet jets intertwines the iterated formal derivative
  with the entrywise iterated derivative on the colour–weak coordinates.
entries.snippet:
private lemma jetValLinEquiv_jetIteratedDeriv (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] QuarkDoublet) :
    jetValLinEquiv (jetIteratedDeriv x z)
      = (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (foldColourWeak x)) (jetValLinEquiv z)

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakValLinEquiv_jetEval
entries.docstring:
The base-point evaluation of a quark-doublet jet through the colour–weak
  coordinates.

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.jetGaugeMatrix_map_pderiv
entries.docstring:
**The derivative identity** for the colour–weak matrix of the jet gauge action: the
  formal derivative of the colour–weak matrix is minus the jet action matrix of the
  Maurer–Cartan form times the colour–weak matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetGaugeMatrix_map_pderiv (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (jetGaugeMatrix U).map (fun f => pderiv μ f)
      = -(jetActionMatrix (maurerCartanForm U μ) * jetGaugeMatrix U)

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.jetGaugeMatrix_mul_jetActionMatrix
entries.docstring:
**The equivariance identity** for the colour–weak matrix of the jet gauge action:
  the colour–weak matrix intertwines the constant jet action matrix with its adjoint
  transform.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetGaugeMatrix_mul_jetActionMatrix (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (c : GaugeAlgebra) :
    jetGaugeMatrix U * jetActionMatrix (JetGaugeAlgebra.ofConstant c)
      = jetActionMatrix (JetGaugeAlgebra.adjointMap U (JetGaugeAlgebra.ofConstant c))
        * jetGaugeMatrix U

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repCoeff_eq
entries.docstring:
**The base-point Taylor coefficients of the jet gauge action** on the quark
  doublet are the colour–weak endomorphisms of the base-point Taylor coefficients of
  the colour–weak matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma repCoeff_eq (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff repJetGaugeGroupI U x
      = colourWeakEnd ((jetGaugeMatrix U).map fun f =>
          constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv x f))

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakEnd_one
entries.docstring: The colour–weak endomorphism of the identity matrix is the identity.
entries.snippet: lemma colourWeakEnd_one : colourWeakEnd 1 = LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repCoeff_zero_of_eval_eq_one
entries.docstring:
At the base point, a gauge jet with trivial value acts trivially: the zeroth
  Taylor coefficient of the jet gauge action is the identity.
entries.snippet:
lemma repCoeff_zero_of_eval_eq_one {U : JetGaugeGroupI} (hU : U.eval = 1) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff repJetGaugeGroupI U 0 = LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.isInfinitesimalActionOf
entries.docstring:
**The `(3, 2)_{1}` action of the gauge algebra is the infinitesimal action
  underlying the jet gauge action on the quark doublet**: its base-point Taylor
  coefficients obey the Maurer–Cartan Leibniz law and intertwine the action with the
  adjoint transports.
entries.snippet:
lemma isInfinitesimalActionOf :
    localGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf gaugeAlgebraAction repJetGaugeGroupI

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The infinitesimal gauge action on the quark doublet acts on the combined colour–weak
  factor, the Lorentz action on the Weyl factor, so the two commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup (c : GaugeAlgebra) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (v : QuarkDoublet) :
    QuarkDoublet.gaugeAlgebraAction c (QuarkDoublet.repLorentzGroup Λ v) =
      QuarkDoublet.repLorentzGroup Λ (QuarkDoublet.gaugeAlgebraAction c v)

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.basis
entries.docstring: A basis on the up singlets.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def basis : Module.Basis (Fin 2 × Fin 3) ℂ UpSinglet

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.«instance@bd18113d»
entries.snippet: instance : Module.Finite ℂ UpSinglet

entries.snippet: instance : Module.Free ℂ UpSinglet

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.jetValLinEquiv
entries.docstring:
Absorbs the jet ring into the colour index: a jet of an up-type singlet is the
same thing as a right-handed Weyl spinor tensored with a `SpaceTimeAlgebra`-valued colour
vector,

  `SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] UpSinglet ≃ RightHandedWeyl ⊗[ℂ] EuclideanSpace SpaceTimeAlgebra (Fin 3)`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetValLinEquiv :
    SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] UpSinglet ≃ₗ[ℂ]
      Fermion.RightHandedWeyl ⊗[ℂ] EuclideanSpace SpaceTimeAlgebra (Fin 3)

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repJetGaugeGroupI
entries.docstring:
The `(3, 1)_{4}` action of the jet gauge group on the jet space of the up-type
singlet. Through `jetValLinEquiv` the colour matrix of the gauge jet, carrying the
`4` hypercharge phase `u ^ 4`, acts `SpaceTimeAlgebra`-linearly on the colour factor by
matrix-vector multiplication, while the Weyl factor is untouched.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repJetGaugeGroupI :
    Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] UpSinglet) where

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.jetValLinEquiv_smul
entries.docstring:
The identification of the jets of the up-type singlet intertwines multiplication by
a scalar jet with the `SpaceTimeAlgebra`-scalar action on the colour coordinates.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetValLinEquiv_smul (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] UpSinglet) :
    jetValLinEquiv (χ • z)
      = Module.End.lTensorAlgHom ℂ (EuclideanSpace SpaceTimeAlgebra (Fin 3))
          Fermion.RightHandedWeyl
          ((LinearMap.lsmul SpaceTimeAlgebra
              (EuclideanSpace SpaceTimeAlgebra (Fin 3)) χ).restrictScalars ℂ)
          (jetValLinEquiv z)

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repJetGaugeGroupI_smul
entries.docstring:
**The jet gauge action on the jets of the up-type singlet is fibrewise**: it commutes
with multiplication by scalar jets.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_smul (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra)
    (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] UpSinglet) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI U (χ • z) = χ • repJetGaugeGroupI U z

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repJetGaugeGroupI_ofConstant
entries.docstring:
On jets of constant gauge transformations the jet action reduces to the global
gauge action on the fibre: the `(3, 1)_{4}` action on the up-singlet factor, and the
trivial action on the jet ring.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_ofConstant (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI (JetGaugeGroupI.ofConstant g) =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (repGaugeGroupI g)

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.basis_eq_mk
entries.docstring: The up-singlet basis vector as an explicit spinor–colour tensor.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_eq_mk (k : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3) : basis (k, c) =
    ⟨Fermion.RightHandedWeyl.basis k ⊗ₜ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℂ c⟩

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup_apply_basis
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the up-singlet basis: the colour index is inert and the
  spinor index transforms by the entrywise conjugate matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (basis j) = ∑ β, star (Λ.1 β j.1) • basis (β, j.2)

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring:
The up-singlet coordinate functionals transform contragrediently, by the entrywise
  conjugate of the inverse matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repLorentzGroup.dual Λ (basis.dualBasis j) =
      ∑ β, star ((Λ⁻¹).1 j.1 β) • basis.dualBasis (β, j.2)

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the conjugate up-singlet basis: the coefficients are the
  conjugates of those of the up-singlet action, that is, the matrix itself.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj Λ ((Basis.conj basis) j)
      = ∑ β, Λ.1 β j.1 • (Basis.conj basis) (β, j.2)

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring: The conjugate up-singlet coordinate functionals transform by the inverse matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj.dual Λ ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis j) =
      ∑ β, (Λ⁻¹).1 j.1 β • (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis (β, j.2)

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup_neg_one
entries.docstring:
**The centre of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts on the up-singlet space by `-1`**: the value space carries a
  single Weyl-spinor index, and `-1` is not the identity on a half-integer spin.
entries.snippet: lemma repLorentzGroup_neg_one : repLorentzGroup (-1) = -LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one
entries.docstring:
The centre acts on the conjugate up-singlet space by `-1` as well: conjugation does not
  move a real sign.
entries.snippet: lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one : repLorentzGroup.conj (-1) = -LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis
entries.docstring:
The gauge action on the up-singlet basis: the spinor index is inert and the colour
  index transforms by the `SU(3)` matrix, scaled by the hypercharge factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repGaugeGroupI g (basis j) =
      ∑ c, (g.toU1.1 ^ 4 * g.toSU3.1 c j.2) • basis (j.1, c)

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring:
The up-singlet coordinate functionals carry the contragredient gauge action: the
  hypercharge and `SU(3)` factors of the inverse group element, transposed.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repGaugeGroupI.dual g (basis.dualBasis j) =
      ∑ c, ((g⁻¹).toU1.1 ^ 4 * (g⁻¹).toSU3.1 j.2 c) • basis.dualBasis (j.1, c)

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis
entries.docstring:
The gauge action on the conjugate up-singlet basis: the coefficients of the
  up-singlet action, conjugated.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj g ((Basis.conj basis) j) =
      ∑ c, star (g.toU1.1 ^ 4 * g.toSU3.1 c j.2) • (Basis.conj basis) (j.1, c)

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring:
The conjugate up-singlet coordinate functionals carry the conjugate of the
  contragredient gauge action.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual g ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis j) =
      ∑ c, star ((g⁻¹).toU1.1 ^ 4 * (g⁻¹).toSU3.1 j.2 c) •
        (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis (j.1, c)

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.valueGaugeWeight
entries.docstring:
The gauge weight of the up-singlet basis: the colour weights and hypercharge
  `4`.
entries.snippet: def UpSinglet.valueGaugeWeight (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) : GaugeWeight

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis
entries.docstring:
The gauge torus acts diagonally on the basis of `UpSinglet`, with the weights
  `UpSinglet.valueGaugeWeight`.
entries.snippet:
lemma UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI (gaugeTorusGen i) (UpSinglet.basis j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (UpSinglet.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        UpSinglet.basis j

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
entries.docstring:
The dual action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals of
  `UpSinglet`: the weights are negated.
entries.snippet:
lemma UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI.dual (gaugeTorusGen i) (UpSinglet.basis.coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ (-(GaugeWeight.coord (UpSinglet.valueGaugeWeight j) i))) •
        UpSinglet.basis.coord j

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
entries.docstring:
The dual of the conjugate action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals
  of the conjugate of `UpSinglet`: the two negations cancel and the weights are those of
  the value space.
entries.snippet:
lemma UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual (gaugeTorusGen i) (((Basis.conj UpSinglet.basis)).coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (UpSinglet.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        ((Basis.conj UpSinglet.basis)).coord j

entries.name: StandardModel.upSinglet_repLorentzGroup_boostAxis_two_basis
entries.docstring: The up-singlet basis diagonalises the `z`-boost.
entries.snippet:
lemma upSinglet_repLorentzGroup_boostAxis_two_basis (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup (SL2C.boostAxis 2 t ht) (UpSinglet.basis j)
      = ((t : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ (weylWeight j.1) • UpSinglet.basis j

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.colourEnd
entries.docstring:
The endomorphism of the up singlet defined by a `3 × 3` complex matrix acting on
  the colour index, with the Weyl factor untouched.

noncomputable def colourEnd (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) :
    UpSinglet →ₗ[ℂ] UpSinglet

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.colourEnd_apply_mk

      = valLinEquiv.symm

            (Matrix.toLpLinAlgEquiv 2 A) (valLinEquiv v))

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.colourEnd_add
entries.snippet:
lemma colourEnd_add (A B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) :
    colourEnd (A + B) = colourEnd A + colourEnd B

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.colourEnd_smul
entries.snippet:
lemma colourEnd_smul (z : ℂ) (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) :
    colourEnd (z • A) = z • colourEnd A

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.colourEnd_zero

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.colourEnd_neg
entries.snippet: lemma colourEnd_neg (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) : colourEnd (-A) = -colourEnd A

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.colourEnd_multiset_sum

lemma colourEnd_multiset_sum (m : Multiset (Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ)) :

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.colourEnd_mul

      = jetActionMatrix (JetGaugeAlgebra.adjointMap U (JetGaugeAlgebra.ofConstant c))
        * upMatrix U

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repCoeff_eq
entries.docstring:
**The base-point Taylor coefficients of the jet gauge action** on the up-type
  singlet are the colour endomorphisms of the base-point Taylor coefficients of the
  colour matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma repCoeff_eq (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff repJetGaugeGroupI U x
      = colourEnd ((upMatrix U).map fun f =>
          constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv x f))

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.colourEnd_one
entries.docstring: The colour endomorphism of the identity matrix is the identity.
entries.snippet: lemma colourEnd_one : colourEnd 1 = LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repCoeff_zero_of_eval_eq_one
entries.docstring:
At the base point, a gauge jet with trivial value acts trivially: the zeroth
  Taylor coefficient of the jet gauge action is the identity.
entries.snippet:
lemma repCoeff_zero_of_eval_eq_one {U : JetGaugeGroupI} (hU : U.eval = 1) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff repJetGaugeGroupI U 0 = LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.isInfinitesimalActionOf
entries.docstring:
**The `(3, 1)_{4}` action of the gauge algebra is the infinitesimal action
  underlying the jet gauge action on the up-type singlet**: its base-point Taylor
  coefficients obey the Maurer–Cartan Leibniz law and intertwine the action with the
  adjoint transports.
entries.snippet:
lemma isInfinitesimalActionOf :
    localGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf gaugeAlgebraAction repJetGaugeGroupI

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The infinitesimal gauge action on the up-type singlet acts on the colour factor, the
  Lorentz action on the Weyl factor, so the two commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup (c : GaugeAlgebra) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (v : UpSinglet) :
    UpSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction c (UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup Λ v) =
      UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup Λ (UpSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction c v)

entries.name: StandardModel.fieldData_massWeightScaleFermion_inclFermion_basis_tmul
entries.docstring:
A fermionic component function `∂_s ψ_α` scales by `c ^ (3 + 2 |s|)`, whichever
  species it belongs to.

lemma fieldData_massWeightScaleFermion_inclFermion_basis_tmul (c : ℂ)
    (j : fieldData.FermionSpecies) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (fieldData.FermionValue j)) :
    fieldData.massWeightScaleFermion c (fieldData.inclFermion j
        ((SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ, 0) :
          JetComponentSpace (fieldData.fermion j)))
      = c ^ (3 + 2 * Multiset.card s) • fieldData.inclFermion j
          ((SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ, 0) :
            JetComponentSpace (fieldData.fermion j))

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra
entries.docstring:
The gauge algebra of the Standard Model: the Lie algebra of `GaugeGroupI`, with one
  factor per gauge group factor — traceless self-adjoint `3 × 3` and `2 × 2` complex
  matrices and a self-adjoint (i.e. real) scalar. This is the constant-coefficient
  analogue of `JetGaugeAlgebra`, and the value at the base point of the jets it contains.
entries.snippet: abbrev GaugeAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.«instance@d68648bd»
entries.docstring:
The self-adjoint scalars form a finite-dimensional real vector space, through the
  identification with the corresponding submodule.

entries.snippet: instance : Module.Finite ℝ GaugeAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.«instance@4c1ddbf6»
entries.docstring:
The bracket on the gauge algebra: `I` times the matrix commutator on the
  `su(3)` and `su(2)` factors, and zero on the (commutative) `u(1)` factor. The
  factor of `I` is what makes the bracket of two hermitian matrices hermitian
  again; it is also why the bracket is only `ℝ`-bilinear, not `ℂ`-bilinear.
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance : Bracket GaugeAlgebra GaugeAlgebra where

entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma bracket_toSU3Matrix (a b : GaugeAlgebra) :
    ⁅a, b⁆.toSU3Matrix =
      Complex.I • (a.toSU3Matrix * b.toSU3Matrix - b.toSU3Matrix * a.toSU3Matrix)

entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma bracket_toSU2Matrix (a b : GaugeAlgebra) :
    ⁅a, b⁆.toSU2Matrix =
      Complex.I • (a.toSU2Matrix * b.toSU2Matrix - b.toSU2Matrix * a.toSU2Matrix)

entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma bracket_toU1Value (a b : GaugeAlgebra) :
    ⁅a, b⁆.toU1Value = 0

The embedding of `2 × 2` matrices into the `3 × 3` matrices supported on the plane
  of two coordinate directions: the entries of `A` land at the row and column indices
  `p 0` and `p 1`, every other entry vanishing.
entries.snippet:
def planeEmbed (p : Fin 2 → Fin 3) (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ

entries.name: StandardModel.gellMannMatrix
entries.docstring:
The Gell-Mann matrices: the standard basis of the traceless hermitian `3 × 3`
  matrices. The first seven are the Pauli matrices `σ1`, `σ2`, `σ3` embedded along the
  three coordinate planes; the eighth is the normalised traceless diagonal matrix.
entries.snippet:
def gellMannMatrix : Fin 8 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ
  | 0 => planeEmbed ![0, 1] σ1
  | 1 => planeEmbed ![0, 1] σ2
  | 2 => planeEmbed ![0, 1] σ3
  | 3 => planeEmbed ![0, 2] σ1
  | 4 => planeEmbed ![0, 2] σ2
  | 5 => planeEmbed ![1, 2] σ1
  | 6 => planeEmbed ![1, 2] σ2
  | 7 => (((Real.sqrt 3 : ℝ) : ℂ))⁻¹ • !![1, 0, 0; 0, 1, 0; 0, 0, -2]

entries.name: StandardModel.gellMannMatrix_zero
entries.snippet: lemma gellMannMatrix_zero : gellMannMatrix 0 = !![0, 1, 0; 1, 0, 0; 0, 0, 0]

entries.name: StandardModel.gellMannMatrix_one
entries.snippet:
lemma gellMannMatrix_one :
    gellMannMatrix 1 = !![0, -Complex.I, 0; Complex.I, 0, 0; 0, 0, 0]

entries.name: StandardModel.gellMannMatrix_two
entries.snippet: lemma gellMannMatrix_two : gellMannMatrix 2 = !![1, 0, 0; 0, -1, 0; 0, 0, 0]

entries.name: StandardModel.gellMannMatrix_three
entries.snippet: lemma gellMannMatrix_three : gellMannMatrix 3 = !![0, 0, 1; 0, 0, 0; 1, 0, 0]

entries.name: StandardModel.gellMannMatrix_four
entries.snippet:
lemma gellMannMatrix_four :
    gellMannMatrix 4 = !![0, 0, -Complex.I; 0, 0, 0; Complex.I, 0, 0]

entries.name: StandardModel.gellMannMatrix_five
entries.snippet: lemma gellMannMatrix_five : gellMannMatrix 5 = !![0, 0, 0; 0, 0, 1; 0, 1, 0]

entries.name: StandardModel.gellMannMatrix_six
entries.snippet:
lemma gellMannMatrix_six :
    gellMannMatrix 6 = !![0, 0, 0; 0, 0, -Complex.I; 0, Complex.I, 0]

entries.snippet:
lemma gellMannMatrix_seven :
    gellMannMatrix 7 = (((Real.sqrt 3 : ℝ) : ℂ))⁻¹ • !![1, 0, 0; 0, 1, 0; 0, 0, -2]

entries.name: StandardModel.gellMannMatrix_selfAdjoint
entries.docstring: The Gell-Mann matrices are hermitian.
entries.snippet:
lemma gellMannMatrix_selfAdjoint (k : Fin 8) :
    star (gellMannMatrix k) = gellMannMatrix k

entries.snippet: lemma gellMannMatrix_trace (k : Fin 8) : (gellMannMatrix k).trace = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.sum_smul_gellMannMatrix
entries.docstring: A combination of the Gell-Mann matrices, entry by entry.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_smul_gellMannMatrix (g : Fin 8 → ℝ) :
    ∑ k, g k • gellMannMatrix k =
      !![((g 2 + (Real.sqrt 3)⁻¹ * g 7 : ℝ) : ℂ),
          ((g 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) - ((g 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I,
          ((g 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) - ((g 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I;
        ((g 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((g 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I,
          ((-g 2 + (Real.sqrt 3)⁻¹ * g 7 : ℝ) : ℂ),
          ((g 5 : ℝ) : ℂ) - ((g 6 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I;
        ((g 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((g 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I,
          ((g 5 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((g 6 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I,
          ((-2 * (Real.sqrt 3)⁻¹ * g 7 : ℝ) : ℂ)]

entries.name: StandardModel.sum_smul_pauliMatrix_inr
entries.docstring: A combination of the three Pauli matrices `σ1`, `σ2`, `σ3`, entry by entry.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_smul_pauliMatrix_inr (g : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    ∑ i, g i • pauliMatrix (Sum.inr i) =
      !![((g 2 : ℝ) : ℂ), ((g 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) - ((g 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I;
        ((g 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((g 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, ((-g 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)]

entries.name: StandardModel.pauliMatrix_inr_star
entries.docstring: The Pauli matrices `σ1`, `σ2`, `σ3` are hermitian, phrased through `star`.
entries.snippet:
lemma pauliMatrix_inr_star (i : Fin 3) :
    star (pauliMatrix (Sum.inr i)) = pauliMatrix (Sum.inr i)

entries.name: StandardModel.pauliMatrix_inr_trace
entries.docstring: The Pauli matrices `σ1`, `σ2`, `σ3` are traceless.
entries.snippet: lemma pauliMatrix_inr_trace (i : Fin 3) : (pauliMatrix (Sum.inr i)).trace = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.entry_symm_of_star_eq
entries.docstring: The entries of a hermitian matrix are conjugate-symmetric.
entries.snippet:
lemma entry_symm_of_star_eq {n : ℕ} {M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ} (hself : star M = M)
    (i j : Fin n) : M j i = (starRingEnd ℂ) (M i j)

entries.name: StandardModel.diag_re_of_star_eq
entries.docstring: The diagonal entries of a hermitian matrix are real.
entries.snippet:
lemma diag_re_of_star_eq {n : ℕ} {M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ} (hself : star M = M)
    (i : Fin n) : M i i = ((M i i).re : ℂ)

entries.name: StandardModel.gellMannCoeff
