entries.name: StandardModel.pauliCoeff
entries.docstring:
The coordinates of a matrix in the Pauli basis `σ1`, `σ2`, `σ3`, read off from its
  entries.
entries.snippet:
def pauliCoeff (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : Fin 3 → ℝ
  | 0 => (M 0 1).re
  | 1 => -(M 0 1).im
  | 2 => (M 0 0).re

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.stdBasis_inl_toSU2Matrix

@[simp]
lemma stdBasis_inl_toU1Value (k : Fin 8) :

@[simp]
lemma stdBasis_inr_inl_toSU3Matrix (i : Fin 3) :

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.stdBasis_inr_inl_toSU2Matrix

@[simp]
lemma stdBasis_inr_inl_toSU2Matrix (i : Fin 3) :

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.stdBasis_inr_inl_toU1Value

lemma stdBasis_inr_inr_toSU3Matrix (i : Fin 1) :

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.stdBasis_coord_inr_inr_lie
entries.docstring:
The hypercharge coordinate vanishes on every bracket: the `u(1)` factor is abelian, so a
  bracket has no `u(1)` component.
entries.snippet:
lemma stdBasis_coord_inr_inr_lie (i : Fin 1) (x y : GaugeAlgebra) :
    stdBasis.coord (Sum.inr (Sum.inr i)) ⁅x, y⁆ = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix
entries.docstring:
The matrix of the adjoint action of a gauge group element in the standard basis:
  block diagonal, with the `su(3)` and `su(2)` blocks the trace pairings
  `2⁻¹ * (trace (T a * g T b g⁻¹)).re` of the basis elements with the conjugated basis
  elements, `1` on the `u(1)` entry, and `0` between different factors.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def adjointMatrix (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    Matrix (Fin 8 ⊕ Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1) (Fin 8 ⊕ Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix_inl_inl
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma adjointMatrix_inl_inl (g : GaugeGroupI) (a b : Fin 8) :
    adjointMatrix g (Sum.inl a) (Sum.inl b)
      = 2⁻¹ * (Matrix.trace (gellMannMatrix a *
          (g.toSU3.1 * gellMannMatrix b * star g.toSU3.1))).re

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix_inl_inr
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma adjointMatrix_inl_inr (g : GaugeGroupI) (a : Fin 8) (x : Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1) :
    adjointMatrix g (Sum.inl a) (Sum.inr x) = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix_inr_inl
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma adjointMatrix_inr_inl (g : GaugeGroupI) (x : Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1) (b : Fin 8) :
    adjointMatrix g (Sum.inr x) (Sum.inl b) = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix_inr_inl_inr_inl
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma adjointMatrix_inr_inl_inr_inl (g : GaugeGroupI) (i j : Fin 3) :
    adjointMatrix g (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i)) (Sum.inr (Sum.inl j))
      = 2⁻¹ * (Matrix.trace (pauliMatrix (Sum.inr i) *
          (g.toSU2.1 * pauliMatrix (Sum.inr j) * star g.toSU2.1))).re

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix_inr_inl_inr_inr
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma adjointMatrix_inr_inl_inr_inr (g : GaugeGroupI) (i : Fin 3) (u : Fin 1) :
    adjointMatrix g (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i)) (Sum.inr (Sum.inr u)) = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix_inr_inr_inr_inl
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma adjointMatrix_inr_inr_inr_inl (g : GaugeGroupI) (u : Fin 1) (j : Fin 3) :
    adjointMatrix g (Sum.inr (Sum.inr u)) (Sum.inr (Sum.inl j)) = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix_inr_inr_inr_inr
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma adjointMatrix_inr_inr_inr_inr (g : GaugeGroupI) (u v : Fin 1) :
    adjointMatrix g (Sum.inr (Sum.inr u)) (Sum.inr (Sum.inr v)) = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjoint_stdBasis
entries.docstring:
The adjoint action of the gauge group acts on the standard basis through
  `adjointMatrix`.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjoint_stdBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (b : Fin 8 ⊕ Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1) :
    adjoint g (stdBasis b) = ∑ a, adjointMatrix g a b • stdBasis a

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.toMatrix_adjoint
entries.docstring: The matrix of the adjoint action in the standard basis is `adjointMatrix`.
entries.snippet:
lemma toMatrix_adjoint (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix stdBasis stdBasis (adjoint g) = adjointMatrix g

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix_mulVec_repr
entries.docstring:
The action of `adjointMatrix` on coordinates in the standard basis corresponds to
  the adjoint action of the gauge group on the gauge algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointMatrix_mulVec_repr (g : GaugeGroupI) (a : GaugeAlgebra) :
    (adjointMatrix g).mulVec (stdBasis.repr a) = ⇑(stdBasis.repr (adjoint g a))

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjoint_dualMap_coord
entries.docstring:
The dual adjoint action on the dual standard basis: the coordinate functions
  transform through the rows of `adjointMatrix`.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjoint_dualMap_coord (g : GaugeGroupI) (a : Fin 8 ⊕ Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1) :
    (adjoint g).dualMap (stdBasis.coord a)
      = ∑ b, adjointMatrix g a b • stdBasis.coord b

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix_mul
entries.docstring:
The matrix of the adjoint action turns a product in the gauge group into the
  product of the corresponding matrices.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointMatrix_mul (g h : GaugeGroupI) :
    GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix (g * h)
      = GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix g * GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix h

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix_one
entries.docstring: The matrix of the adjoint action of the identity is the identity matrix.
entries.snippet: lemma adjointMatrix_one : GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix (1 : GaugeGroupI) = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.gaugeGroup_mul_star_self
entries.docstring: The star of a gauge group element is its inverse.
entries.snippet: lemma gaugeGroup_mul_star_self (g : GaugeGroupI) : g * star g = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix_star
entries.docstring:
The matrix of the adjoint action of the star of a gauge group element is the
  transpose of the matrix of the adjoint action, since the trace pairing is symmetric
  under moving the conjugation from one argument to the other.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointMatrix_star (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix (star g) = (GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix g)ᵀ

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix_mul_transpose
entries.docstring: The matrix of the adjoint action is orthogonal.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointMatrix_mul_transpose (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix g * (GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix g)ᵀ = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.sum_adjointMatrix_inl_row_mul
entries.docstring:
The rows of the `su(3)` block of the adjoint matrix are orthonormal. The matrix is
  block diagonal, so orthogonality of the whole matrix restricts to each block.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_adjointMatrix_inl_row_mul (g : GaugeGroupI) (c d : Fin 8) :
    ∑ a : Fin 8, adjointMatrix g (Sum.inl c) (Sum.inl a) *
      adjointMatrix g (Sum.inl d) (Sum.inl a) = if c = d then 1 else 0

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.sum_adjointMatrix_inr_inl_row_mul
entries.docstring: The rows of the `su(2)` block of the adjoint matrix are orthonormal.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_adjointMatrix_inr_inl_row_mul (g : GaugeGroupI) (c d : Fin 3) :
    ∑ a : Fin 3, adjointMatrix g (Sum.inr (Sum.inl c)) (Sum.inr (Sum.inl a)) *
      adjointMatrix g (Sum.inr (Sum.inl d)) (Sum.inr (Sum.inl a))
      = if c = d then 1 else 0

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix_inv_apply
entries.docstring:
The matrix of the adjoint action of the inverse of a gauge group element is the
  transpose of the matrix of the adjoint action.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointMatrix_inv_apply (g : GaugeGroupI) (a b : Fin 8 ⊕ Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1) :
    adjointMatrix g⁻¹ a b = adjointMatrix g b a

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra
entries.docstring:
The jet gauge algebra: the Lie-algebra analogue of `JetGaugeGroupI`, with one factor per gauge
  group factor — traceless self-adjoint `3 × 3` and `2 × 2` matrices and a self-adjoint scalar, all
  with coefficients in the ring `SpaceTimeAlgebra` of formal power series in the spacetime
  coordinates. The Maurer–Cartan forms of the jet gauge group are valued here, hermiticity being
  `star_maurerCartanSU3` and its companions.
entries.snippet: abbrev JetGaugeAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.toSU3Matrix
entries.docstring: The `su(3)`-factor component of an element of the jet gauge algebra.
entries.snippet: def toSU3Matrix (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) SpaceTimeAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.toSU2Matrix
entries.docstring: The `su(2)`-factor component of an element of the jet gauge algebra.
entries.snippet: def toSU2Matrix (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) SpaceTimeAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.toU1Value
entries.docstring: The `u(1)`-factor component of an element of the jet gauge algebra.
entries.snippet: def toU1Value (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :  SpaceTimeAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.toVal
entries.docstring:
The underlying matrix value of an element of the jet gauge algebra, as a
  product of matrices.

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.toVal_fst
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toVal_fst (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) : a.toVal.1 = a.toSU3Matrix

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.toVal_snd_fst
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toVal_snd_fst (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) : a.toVal.2.1 = a.toSU2Matrix

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.toVal_snd_snd
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toVal_snd_snd (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) : a.toVal.2.2 = a.toU1Value

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.ext_of_matrix
entries.snippet:
@[ext]
lemma ext_of_matrix {a b : JetGaugeAlgebra} (h1 : a.toSU3Matrix = b.toSU3Matrix)
    (h2 : a.toSU2Matrix = b.toSU2Matrix) (h3 : a.toU1Value = b.toU1Value) : a = b

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.ofMatrixProd
entries.docstring:
A jet of the gauge algebra from a triple of matrices of jets: the `SU(3)` and `SU(2)`
  components self-adjoint and traceless, the `U(1)` component self-adjoint.
entries.snippet:
def ofMatrixProd (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) SpaceTimeAlgebra ×
    Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) SpaceTimeAlgebra × SpaceTimeAlgebra)
        (hA : star A.1 = A.1 ∧ A.1.trace = 0)
    (hB : star A.2.1 = A.2.1 ∧ A.2.1.trace = 0) (hC : star A.2.2 = A.2.2) : JetGaugeAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.ofMatrixProd_toSU3Matrix
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofMatrixProd_toSU3Matrix (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) SpaceTimeAlgebra ×
    Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) SpaceTimeAlgebra × SpaceTimeAlgebra)
        (hA : star A.1 = A.1 ∧ A.1.trace = 0)
    (hB : star A.2.1 = A.2.1 ∧ A.2.1.trace = 0) (hC : star A.2.2 = A.2.2) :
    (ofMatrixProd A hA hB hC).toSU3Matrix = A.1

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.ofMatrixProd_toSU2Matrix
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofMatrixProd_toSU2Matrix (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) SpaceTimeAlgebra ×
    Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) SpaceTimeAlgebra × SpaceTimeAlgebra)
        (hA : star A.1 = A.1 ∧ A.1.trace = 0)
    (hB : star A.2.1 = A.2.1 ∧ A.2.1.trace = 0) (hC : star A.2.2 = A.2.2) :
    (ofMatrixProd A hA hB hC).toSU2Matrix = A.2.1

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.ofMatrixProd_toU1Value
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofMatrixProd_toU1Value (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) SpaceTimeAlgebra ×
    Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) SpaceTimeAlgebra × SpaceTimeAlgebra)
        (hA : star A.1 = A.1 ∧ A.1.trace = 0)
    (hB : star A.2.1 = A.2.1 ∧ A.2.1.trace = 0) (hC : star A.2.2 = A.2.2) :
    (ofMatrixProd A hA hB hC).toU1Value = A.2.2

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.add_toSU3Matrix
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma add_toSU3Matrix (a b : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (a + b).toSU3Matrix = a.toSU3Matrix + b.toSU3Matrix

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.add_toSU2Matrix
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma add_toSU2Matrix (a b : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (a + b).toSU2Matrix = a.toSU2Matrix + b.toSU2Matrix

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.add_toU1Value
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma add_toU1Value (a b : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (a + b).toU1Value = a.toU1Value + b.toU1Value

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.toSU3Matrix_sum
entries.snippet:
lemma toSU3Matrix_sum {ι : Type*} (t : Finset ι) (f : ι → JetGaugeAlgebra) :

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.«instance@7a984c0f»
entries.docstring:
The bracket on the jet gauge algebra: `I` times the matrix commutator on the
  `su(3)` and `su(2)` factors, and zero on the (commutative) `u(1)` factor. The
  factor of `I` is what makes the bracket of two hermitian matrices hermitian
  again; it is also why the bracket is only `ℝ`-bilinear, not `ℂ`-bilinear.
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance : Bracket JetGaugeAlgebra JetGaugeAlgebra where

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.bracket_toSU3Matrix
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma bracket_toSU3Matrix (a b : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    ⁅a, b⁆.toSU3Matrix =
      Complex.I • (a.toSU3Matrix * b.toSU3Matrix - b.toSU3Matrix * a.toSU3Matrix)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.bracket_toSU2Matrix
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma bracket_toSU2Matrix (a b : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    ⁅a, b⁆.toSU2Matrix =
      Complex.I • (a.toSU2Matrix * b.toSU2Matrix - b.toSU2Matrix * a.toSU2Matrix)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.bracket_toU1Value
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma bracket_toU1Value (a b : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    ⁅a, b⁆.toU1Value = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.«instance@b456b6e9»
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance : LieRing JetGaugeAlgebra where

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.«instance@fed136e9»

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.deriv
entries.docstring:
The formal derivative in the direction `μ` on the jet gauge algebra, acting
  entrywise on each factor. It preserves hermiticity since `star` commutes with
  `pderiv`, and tracelessness since the trace of the entrywise derivative is the
  derivative of the trace.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def deriv (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : JetGaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] JetGaugeAlgebra where

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.deriv_toSU3Matrix
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma deriv_toSU3Matrix (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (deriv μ a).toSU3Matrix = a.toSU3Matrix.map (pderiv μ)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.deriv_toSU2Matrix
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma deriv_toSU2Matrix (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (deriv μ a).toSU2Matrix = a.toSU2Matrix.map (pderiv μ)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.deriv_toU1Value
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma deriv_toU1Value (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (deriv μ a).toU1Value = pderiv μ a.toU1Value

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.coord
entries.docstring:
Multiplication by the spacetime coordinate `x_μ`, entrywise on each factor. It
  preserves hermiticity since the coordinates are self-adjoint, and tracelessness since
  it is a scalar.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def coord (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : JetGaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] JetGaugeAlgebra where

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.coord_toSU3Matrix
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coord_toSU3Matrix (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (coord μ a).toSU3Matrix = (X μ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • a.toSU3Matrix

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.coord_toSU2Matrix
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coord_toSU2Matrix (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (coord μ a).toSU2Matrix = (X μ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • a.toSU2Matrix

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.coord_toU1Value
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coord_toU1Value (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (coord μ a).toU1Value = (X μ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) * a.toU1Value

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.deriv_coord
entries.docstring: The Leibniz rule for a coordinate: `∂_μ (x_ν a) = x_ν ∂_μ a + δ_{μν} a`.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_coord (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    deriv μ (coord ν a) = coord ν (deriv μ a) + if μ = ν then a else 0

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.coord_lie
entries.docstring: The coordinates are central for the bracket.
entries.snippet:
lemma coord_lie (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a b : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    ⁅coord μ a, b⁆ = coord μ ⁅a, b⁆

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.deriv_comm
entries.docstring: Formal derivatives on the jet gauge algebra commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_comm (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    deriv μ (deriv ν a) = deriv ν (deriv μ a)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.deriv_bracket
entries.docstring:
The derivative is a derivation of the bracket: the Leibniz rule
  `deriv μ ⁅x, y⁆ = ⁅deriv μ x, y⁆ + ⁅x, deriv μ y⁆`.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_bracket (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x y : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    deriv μ ⁅x, y⁆ = ⁅deriv μ x, y⁆ + ⁅x, deriv μ y⁆

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.«instance@d389e58d»
entries.docstring:
Post-composition with `deriv` is right-commutative, since formal derivatives
  commute (`deriv_comm`). This is what allows iterated derivatives to be indexed by a
  `Multiset` of directions.
entries.snippet:
instance : RightCommutative
    (fun (D : JetGaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] JetGaugeAlgebra) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) => D.comp (deriv μ)) where

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.iteratedDeriv
entries.docstring:
The iterated formal derivative on the jet gauge algebra, in the (unordered, since
  derivatives commute) directions given by the multiset `μs`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def iteratedDeriv (μs : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    JetGaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] JetGaugeAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.iteratedDeriv_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma iteratedDeriv_zero : iteratedDeriv 0 = LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.iteratedDeriv_cons
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedDeriv_cons (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μs : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    iteratedDeriv (μ ::ₘ μs) = (deriv μ).comp (iteratedDeriv μs)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.iteratedDeriv_add
entries.docstring:
The iterated derivative is additive in the multiset of directions: deriving
  along `s + t` is deriving along `t` and then along `s`.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedDeriv_add (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    iteratedDeriv (s + t) = (iteratedDeriv s).comp (iteratedDeriv t)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.iteratedDeriv_singleton
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma iteratedDeriv_singleton (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    iteratedDeriv ({μ} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) = deriv μ

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.iteratedDeriv_toSU3Matrix
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedDeriv_toSU3Matrix (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (iteratedDeriv s a).toSU3Matrix =
      a.toSU3Matrix.map fun f => SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv s f

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.iteratedDeriv_toSU2Matrix
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedDeriv_toSU2Matrix (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (iteratedDeriv s a).toSU2Matrix =
      a.toSU2Matrix.map fun f => SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv s f

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.iteratedDeriv_toU1Value
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedDeriv_toU1Value (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (iteratedDeriv s a).toU1Value = SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv s a.toU1Value

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.taylorCoeff
entries.docstring:
The Taylor coefficient of an element of the jet gauge algebra at the monomial
  given by the multiset `r` of spacetime directions, taken entrywise, as an
  `ℝ`-linear map to the constant gauge algebra `GaugeAlgebra`.

  For `r ≠ 0` this is only linear: the coefficient of a product is a convolution of
  coefficients, so it does not respect the bracket. The zeroth coefficient does; see
  `eval` for that morphism of Lie algebras.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def taylorCoeff (r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    JetGaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] GaugeAlgebra where

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.taylorCoeff_toSU3Matrix
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma taylorCoeff_toSU3Matrix (r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (taylorCoeff r a).toSU3Matrix = a.toSU3Matrix.map (coeff r.toFinsupp)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.taylorCoeff_toSU2Matrix
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma taylorCoeff_toSU2Matrix (r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (taylorCoeff r a).toSU2Matrix = a.toSU2Matrix.map (coeff r.toFinsupp)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.taylorCoeff_toU1Value
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma taylorCoeff_toU1Value (r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (taylorCoeff r a).toU1Value = coeff r.toFinsupp a.toU1Value

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.taylorCoeff_zero_bracket
entries.docstring:
The zeroth Taylor coefficient respects the bracket, since the constant coefficient
  of a product of jets is the product of the constant coefficients.
entries.snippet:
lemma taylorCoeff_zero_bracket (a b : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    taylorCoeff 0 ⁅a, b⁆ = ⁅taylorCoeff 0 a, taylorCoeff 0 b⁆

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.eval
entries.docstring:
Evaluation of the jet gauge algebra at the base point: the zeroth Taylor
  coefficient, as a morphism of Lie algebras.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def eval : JetGaugeAlgebra →ₗ⁅ℝ⁆ GaugeAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.ofConstant
entries.docstring:
The inclusion of the constant gauge algebra into the jet gauge algebra: the jets
  with no spacetime dependence, given entrywise by the constant power series. This is
  a section of `eval`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def ofConstant : GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] JetGaugeAlgebra where

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.ofConstant_toSU3Matrix
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofConstant_toSU3Matrix (a : GaugeAlgebra) :
    (ofConstant a).toSU3Matrix = a.toSU3Matrix.map (C : ℂ → SpaceTimeAlgebra)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.ofConstant_toSU2Matrix
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofConstant_toSU2Matrix (a : GaugeAlgebra) :
    (ofConstant a).toSU2Matrix = a.toSU2Matrix.map (C : ℂ → SpaceTimeAlgebra)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.ofConstant_toU1Value
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofConstant_toU1Value (a : GaugeAlgebra) :
    (ofConstant a).toU1Value = C a.toU1Value

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.eval_apply
entries.snippet: lemma eval_apply (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) : eval a = taylorCoeff 0 a

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.eval_ofConstant
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma eval_ofConstant (a : GaugeAlgebra) : eval (ofConstant a) = a

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.eval_toSU3Matrix_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma eval_toSU3Matrix_apply (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) (i j : Fin 3) :
    (eval a).toSU3Matrix i j = constantCoeff (a.toSU3Matrix i j)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.eval_toSU2Matrix_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma eval_toSU2Matrix_apply (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) (i j : Fin 2) :
    (eval a).toSU2Matrix i j = constantCoeff (a.toSU2Matrix i j)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.eval_toU1Value_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma eval_toU1Value_eq (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (eval a).toU1Value = constantCoeff a.toU1Value

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.eval_coord
entries.docstring: A coordinate multiple vanishes at the base point.
entries.snippet: lemma eval_coord (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) : eval (coord μ a) = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.eval_iteratedDeriv_toSU3Matrix
entries.docstring: The `su(3)` component of the base-point Taylor coefficients.
entries.snippet:
lemma eval_iteratedDeriv_toSU3Matrix (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (eval (iteratedDeriv x a)).toSU3Matrix
      = a.toSU3Matrix.map fun f => constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv x f)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.eval_iteratedDeriv_toSU2Matrix
entries.docstring: The `su(2)` component of the base-point Taylor coefficients.
entries.snippet:
lemma eval_iteratedDeriv_toSU2Matrix (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (eval (iteratedDeriv x a)).toSU2Matrix
      = a.toSU2Matrix.map fun f => constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv x f)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.eval_iteratedDeriv_toU1Value
entries.docstring: The `u(1)` component of the base-point Taylor coefficients.
entries.snippet:
lemma eval_iteratedDeriv_toU1Value (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (eval (iteratedDeriv x a)).toU1Value
      = constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv x a.toU1Value)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.ext_of_eval_iteratedDeriv
entries.docstring:
Taylor determinacy: a jet gauge algebra element is determined by the base-point
  values of its iterated derivatives.
entries.snippet:
lemma ext_of_eval_iteratedDeriv {x y : JetGaugeAlgebra}
    (h : ∀ s, eval (iteratedDeriv s x) = eval (iteratedDeriv s y)) : x = y

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.adjointMap
entries.docstring:
The adjoint action of an element `U` of the jet gauge group on the jet gauge algebra,
  acting on the `su(3)` and `su(2)` factors by `a ↦ U a U⁻¹`, with `U⁻¹ = star U` by
  unitarity, and trivially on the `u(1)` factor since `SpaceTimeAlgebra` is commutative.
  Hermiticity is preserved since `star (U a (star U)) = U (star a) (star U)`, and
  tracelessness since the trace is invariant under conjugation.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def adjointMap (U : JetGaugeGroupI) : JetGaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] JetGaugeAlgebra where

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.adjointMap_toSU3Matrix
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma adjointMap_toSU3Matrix (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (adjointMap U a).toSU3Matrix = U.1.1 * a.toSU3Matrix * star U.1.1

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.adjointMap_toSU2Matrix
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma adjointMap_toSU2Matrix (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (adjointMap U a).toSU2Matrix = U.2.1.1 * a.toSU2Matrix * star U.2.1.1

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.adjointMap_toU1Value
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma adjointMap_toU1Value (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    (adjointMap U a).toU1Value = a.toU1Value

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.adjoint
entries.docstring:
The adjoint representation of the jet gauge group on the jet gauge algebra,
  `U ↦ (a ↦ U a U⁻¹)` factorwise.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def adjoint : Representation ℝ JetGaugeGroupI JetGaugeAlgebra where

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.eval_adjointMap
entries.docstring:
At the base point the adjoint action of a gauge jet is the adjoint action of its
  value: the constant coefficient of `U x U†` is `U₀ x₀ U₀†`.
entries.snippet:
lemma eval_adjointMap (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (x : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    eval (adjointMap U x) = GaugeAlgebra.adjoint U.eval (eval x)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.ofConstant_lie
entries.docstring:
The constant inclusion is a morphism of Lie algebras: constants bracket to
  constants.
entries.snippet:
lemma ofConstant_lie (a b : GaugeAlgebra) :
    ofConstant ⁅a, b⁆ = ⁅ofConstant a, ofConstant b⁆

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeAlgebra.adjointMap_lie
entries.docstring:
The adjoint action preserves the bracket: conjugation is an automorphism of the
  Lie algebra, using unitarity to cancel the inner `U† U` factors.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointMap_lie (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (x y : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    adjointMap U ⁅x, y⁆ = ⁅adjointMap U x, adjointMap U y⁆

entries.name: StandardModel.star_expI_zpow
entries.docstring: Conjugation inverts a power of `expI`.
entries.snippet: lemma star_expI_zpow (z : ℤ) : star ((expI : ℂ) ^ z) = (expI : ℂ) ^ (-z)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.stdCoeff
entries.docstring: coords
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def stdCoeff (x : GaugeAlgebra) : Fin 8 ⊕ Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1 → ℝ
  | Sum.inl k => gellMannCoeff x.toSU3Matrix k
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inl i) => pauliCoeff x.toSU2Matrix i
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inr _) => (x.toU1Value).re

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.eq_sum_stdCoeff
entries.snippet: lemma eq_sum_stdCoeff (x : GaugeAlgebra) : x = ∑ y, stdCoeff x y • stdBasis y

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.stdBasis_coord_apply
entries.docstring:
The coordinate functionals of `stdBasis` read off a gauge-algebra element's matrix
  entries.
entries.snippet:
lemma stdBasis_coord_apply (y : GaugeAlgebra) (a : Fin 8 ⊕ Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1) :
    stdBasis.coord a y = stdCoeff y a

entries.name: StandardModel.torusSU3Diag
entries.docstring: su3 diagonals of inverse torus gens
entries.snippet: noncomputable def torusSU3Diag : Fin 4 → Fin 3 → ℂ

entries.name: StandardModel.torusSU2Diag
entries.docstring: su2
entries.snippet: noncomputable def torusSU2Diag : Fin 4 → Fin 2 → ℂ

entries.name: StandardModel.toSU3_inv_gaugeTorusGen
entries.snippet:
lemma toSU3_inv_gaugeTorusGen (i : Fin 4) :
    ((GaugeGroupI.toSU3 (gaugeTorusGen i)⁻¹ : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 3) ℂ) :
      Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) = Matrix.diagonal (torusSU3Diag i)

entries.name: StandardModel.toSU2_inv_gaugeTorusGen
entries.snippet:
lemma toSU2_inv_gaugeTorusGen (i : Fin 4) :
    ((GaugeGroupI.toSU2 (gaugeTorusGen i)⁻¹ : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
      Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) = Matrix.diagonal (torusSU2Diag i)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointMap_toSU3Matrix_apply_diagonal
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointMap_toSU3Matrix_apply_diagonal {g : GaugeGroupI} {d : Fin 3 → ℂ}
    (hg : ((GaugeGroupI.toSU3 g : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 3) ℂ) :
      Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) = Matrix.diagonal d)
    (x : GaugeAlgebra) (j k : Fin 3) :
    (adjointMap g x).toSU3Matrix j k = d j * star (d k) * x.toSU3Matrix j k

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointMap_toSU2Matrix_apply_diagonal
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointMap_toSU2Matrix_apply_diagonal {g : GaugeGroupI} {d : Fin 2 → ℂ}
    (hg : ((GaugeGroupI.toSU2 g : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
      Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) = Matrix.diagonal d)
    (x : GaugeAlgebra) (j k : Fin 2) :
    (adjointMap g x).toSU2Matrix j k = d j * star (d k) * x.toSU2Matrix j k

entries.name: StandardModel.torusSU3Diag_mul_star
entries.snippet:
lemma torusSU3Diag_mul_star (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) :
    torusSU3Diag i j * star (torusSU3Diag i j) = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.torusSU2Diag_mul_star
entries.snippet:
lemma torusSU2Diag_mul_star (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2) :
    torusSU2Diag i j * star (torusSU2Diag i j) = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.dualMap_pair_of_entry
StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.rootIdx
entries.docstring: The four root directions of the adjoint.
entries.snippet:
def rootIdx : Fin 4 → (Fin 8 ⊕ Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1) × (Fin 8 ⊕ Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1)
  | 0 => (Sum.inl 0, Sum.inl 1)
  | 1 => (Sum.inl 3, Sum.inl 4)
  | 2 => (Sum.inl 5, Sum.inl 6)
  | 3 => (Sum.inr (Sum.inl 0), Sum.inr (Sum.inl 1))

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.rootWeight
entries.docstring: The gauge weight of each root direction.

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.rootEntry
entries.docstring: The matrix entry scaled by the torus along each root direction.
entries.snippet:
def rootEntry : Fin 4 → GaugeAlgebra → ℂ
  | 0, x => x.toSU3Matrix 0 1
  | 1, x => x.toSU3Matrix 0 2
  | 2, x => x.toSU3Matrix 1 2
  | 3, x => x.toSU2Matrix 0 1

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.su3CartanId
entries.docstring: The Gell-Mann indices of the two Cartan directions of `su(3)`.
entries.snippet:
abbrev su3CartanId : Fin 2 → Fin 8
  | 0 => 2
  | 1 => 7

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.su2CartanId
entries.docstring: The Pauli index of the Cartan direction of `su(2)`.
entries.snippet: abbrev su2CartanId : Fin 3

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.cartanIdx
entries.docstring:
The four weight-zero directions: the two `su(3)` Cartan generators, the `su(2)`
  Cartan generator and the `u(1)` generator.
entries.snippet:
def cartanIdx : Fin 4 → (Fin 8 ⊕ Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1)
  | 0 => Sum.inl (su3CartanId 0)
  | 1 => Sum.inl (su3CartanId 1)
  | 2 => Sum.inr (Sum.inl su2CartanId)
  | 3 => Sum.inr (Sum.inr 0)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.coord_rootIdx_fst
entries.snippet:
lemma coord_rootIdx_fst (r : Fin 4) (x : GaugeAlgebra) :
    stdBasis.coord (rootIdx r).1 x = (rootEntry r x).re

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.coord_rootIdx_snd
entries.snippet:
lemma coord_rootIdx_snd (r : Fin 4) (x : GaugeAlgebra) :
    stdBasis.coord (rootIdx r).2 x = -(rootEntry r x).im

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.rootEntry_adjointMap
entries.snippet:
lemma rootEntry_adjointMap (r : Fin 4) (i : Fin 4) (x : GaugeAlgebra) :
    rootEntry r (adjointMap (gaugeTorusGen i)⁻¹ x)
      = star ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (rootWeight r) i) * rootEntry r x

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.dualMap_coord_cartanIdx
entries.snippet:
lemma dualMap_coord_cartanIdx (c : Fin 4) (i : Fin 4) :
    (adjointMap (gaugeTorusGen i)⁻¹).dualMap (stdBasis.coord (cartanIdx c))
      = stdBasis.coord (cartanIdx c)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.real_smul_eq_complex_smul
entries.docstring: A real scalar acts on a complex algebra through its complex image.
entries.snippet: lemma real_smul_eq_complex_smul (r : ℝ) (b : B) : r • b = ((r : ℂ)) • b

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.IsCoadjointSymbol
entries.docstring:
A coadjoint symbol map: a real-linear map from the dual of the gauge algebra into a
  complex algebra which intertwines the gauge action with the dual adjoint action. The
  field strength of the gauge sector is one such map.
entries.snippet:
def IsCoadjointSymbol (rep : Representation ℂ GaugeGroupI B)
    (F : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B) : Prop

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.AdjIdx
entries.docstring:
The index type of the adjoint weight vectors: four positive roots, four negative
  roots and four Cartan directions.
entries.snippet: abbrev AdjIdx : Type

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjWeight
entries.docstring: The gauge weight carried by each adjoint weight vector.
entries.snippet:
def adjWeight : AdjIdx → GaugeWeight
  | Sum.inl r => rootWeight r
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inl r) => -(rootWeight r)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inr _) => 0

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjVec
entries.docstring:
The weight vectors of the adjoint in the image of a coadjoint symbol map: for each
  root the two combinations of its paired coordinate symbols, and for each Cartan
  direction the symbol itself.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def adjVec (F : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B) : AdjIdx → B
  | Sum.inl r => F (stdBasis.coord (rootIdx r).1)
      + Complex.I • F (stdBasis.coord (rootIdx r).2)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inl r) => F (stdBasis.coord (rootIdx r).1)
      - Complex.I • F (stdBasis.coord (rootIdx r).2)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inr c) => F (stdBasis.coord (cartanIdx c))

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjWeight_eq_zero_iff
entries.docstring:
A weight vector carries zero gauge weight exactly when it is a Cartan direction; the
  eight root directions all carry a nonzero weight.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjWeight_eq_zero_iff (k : AdjIdx) :
    adjWeight k = 0 ↔ ∃ c : Fin 4, k = Sum.inr (Sum.inr c)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.exists_rootIdx_or_cartanIdx
entries.docstring:
The root and Cartan directions exhaust the standard basis: every standard index is
  one of the two members of a root pair, or a Cartan index.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_rootIdx_or_cartanIdx (a : Fin 8 ⊕ Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1) :
    (∃ r : Fin 4, a = (rootIdx r).1) ∨ (∃ r : Fin 4, a = (rootIdx r).2)
      ∨ ∃ c : Fin 4, a = cartanIdx c

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.rep_pair_add
entries.docstring: The positive combination of a rotating pair of symbols is scaled by the rotation.
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_pair_add (hF : IsCoadjointSymbol rep F) (g : GaugeGroupI)
    (φ₁ φ₂ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) (z : ℂ)
    (h1 : (adjointMap g⁻¹).dualMap φ₁ = z.re • φ₁ - z.im • φ₂)
    (h2 : (adjointMap g⁻¹).dualMap φ₂ = z.im • φ₁ + z.re • φ₂) :
    rep g (F φ₁ + Complex.I • F φ₂) = z • (F φ₁ + Complex.I • F φ₂)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.rep_pair_sub
entries.docstring:
The negative combination of a rotating pair of symbols is scaled by the conjugate
  rotation.
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_pair_sub (hF : IsCoadjointSymbol rep F) (g : GaugeGroupI)
    (φ₁ φ₂ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) (z : ℂ)
    (h1 : (adjointMap g⁻¹).dualMap φ₁ = z.re • φ₁ - z.im • φ₂)
    (h2 : (adjointMap g⁻¹).dualMap φ₂ = z.im • φ₁ + z.re • φ₂) :
    rep g (F φ₁ - Complex.I • F φ₂)
      = (starRingEnd ℂ z) • (F φ₁ - Complex.I • F φ₂)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.rep_fixed
entries.docstring: A symbol at a fixed coordinate functional is itself fixed.
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_fixed (hF : IsCoadjointSymbol rep F) (g : GaugeGroupI)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) (h1 : (adjointMap g⁻¹).dualMap φ = φ) :
    rep g (F φ) = F φ

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.rep_adjVec
entries.docstring:
Each adjoint weight vector is a simultaneous eigenvector of the four torus
  generators, at the character of its weight.
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_adjVec (hF : IsCoadjointSymbol rep F) (k : AdjIdx) (i : Fin 4) :
    rep (gaugeTorusGen i) (adjVec F k)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (adjWeight k) i) • adjVec F k

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.symbol_rootIdx_fst
entries.docstring: The first symbol of a root pair, recovered from the two weight vectors.
entries.snippet:
lemma symbol_rootIdx_fst (F : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B) (r : Fin 4) :
    F (stdBasis.coord (rootIdx r).1)
      = (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (adjVec F (Sum.inl r) + adjVec F (Sum.inr (Sum.inl r)))

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.symbol_rootIdx_snd
entries.docstring: The second symbol of a root pair, recovered from the two weight vectors.
entries.snippet:
lemma symbol_rootIdx_snd (F : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B) (r : Fin 4) :
    F (stdBasis.coord (rootIdx r).2)
      = (-(Complex.I / 2)) • (adjVec F (Sum.inl r) - adjVec F (Sum.inr (Sum.inl r)))

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.symbol_mem_iSup
entries.docstring: Every standard coordinate symbol lies in the join of the twelve weight lines.

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.span_range_eq_iSup
entries.docstring: The span of the symbols is the join of the twelve weight lines.
entries.snippet:
lemma span_range_eq_iSup (F : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range F) = ⨆ k : AdjIdx, Submodule.span ℂ {adjVec F k}

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointDecomposition
entries.docstring:
The root decomposition read as a gauge weight decomposition: the span of the symbols
  of a coadjoint map, joined out of the twelve root and Cartan lines.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable def adjointDecomposition (hmul : IsMulRep rep)
    (hF : IsCoadjointSymbol rep F) :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range F))

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointDecomposition_supp
entries.docstring:
The gauge weights of the adjoint: the six `su(3)` roots, the two `su(2)` roots and
  the zero weight of the Cartan and `u(1)` directions. Every one of them has vanishing
  hypercharge.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointDecomposition_supp (hmul : IsMulRep rep) (hF : IsCoadjointSymbol rep F) :
    (adjointDecomposition hmul hF).supp
      = {((2, -1, 0, 0) : GaugeWeight), (1, 1, 0, 0), (-1, 2, 0, 0), (0, 0, 2, 0),
        (-2, 1, 0, 0), (-1, -1, 0, 0), (1, -2, 0, 0), (0, 0, -2, 0), (0, 0, 0, 0)}

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointDecomposition_piece
entries.docstring:
The pieces of the decomposition: the weight-`w` piece is the join of the weight lines
  whose weight is `w`.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointDecomposition_piece (hmul : IsMulRep rep) (hF : IsCoadjointSymbol rep F)
    (w : GaugeWeight) :
    (adjointDecomposition hmul hF).piece w
      = ⨆ k : AdjIdx, if w = adjWeight k then Submodule.span ℂ {adjVec F k} else ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointDecomposition_piece_rootWeight
entries.docstring: The piece at a root weight is the line of that root alone.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointDecomposition_piece_rootWeight (hmul : IsMulRep rep)
    (hF : IsCoadjointSymbol rep F) (r : Fin 4) :
    (adjointDecomposition hmul hF).piece (rootWeight r)
      = Submodule.span ℂ {adjVec F (Sum.inl r)}

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointDecomposition_piece_neg_rootWeight
entries.docstring: The piece at the opposite of a root weight is the line of the opposite root.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointDecomposition_piece_neg_rootWeight (hmul : IsMulRep rep)
    (hF : IsCoadjointSymbol rep F) (r : Fin 4) :
    (adjointDecomposition hmul hF).piece (-(rootWeight r))
      = Submodule.span ℂ {adjVec F (Sum.inr (Sum.inl r))}

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointDecomposition_piece_zero
entries.docstring:
The weight-zero piece is the span of the four Cartan symbols: the two `su(3)` Cartan
  generators, the `su(2)` Cartan generator and the `u(1)` generator.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointDecomposition_piece_zero (hmul : IsMulRep rep)
    (hF : IsCoadjointSymbol rep F) :
    (adjointDecomposition hmul hF).piece 0
      = ⨆ c : Fin 4, Submodule.span ℂ {F (stdBasis.coord (cartanIdx c))}

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjointDecomposition_piece_eq_bot
entries.docstring: Every weight outside the nine is absent from the adjoint.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjointDecomposition_piece_eq_bot (hmul : IsMulRep rep)
    (hF : IsCoadjointSymbol rep F) {w : GaugeWeight}
    (hw : w ∉ (adjointDecomposition hmul hF).supp) :
    (adjointDecomposition hmul hF).piece w = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.su3WeightIdx
entries.docstring:
The index type of the `su(3)` weight coordinates: three positive roots, three negative
  roots and two Cartan directions.
entries.snippet: abbrev su3WeightIdx : Type

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.su3RootPair
entries.docstring: The pairs of Gell-Mann indices making up the three root directions of `su(3)`.

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.rootIdx_castSucc
entries.docstring: The `su(3)` root pairs are the first three root pairs of the whole gauge algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma rootIdx_castSucc (r : Fin 3) :
    rootIdx r.castSucc = (Sum.inl (su3RootPair r).1, Sum.inl (su3RootPair r).2)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.cartanIdx_castSucc
entries.docstring:
The `su(3)` Cartan indices are the first two Cartan indices of the whole gauge
  algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma cartanIdx_castSucc (c : Fin 2) :
    cartanIdx c.castSucc.castSucc = Sum.inl (su3CartanId c)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.su3WeightCoeff
entries.docstring:
The `su(3)` weight coordinates in Gell-Mann coordinates: `x₁ ± i x₂` on each root pair,
  and the Cartan coordinates themselves.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def su3WeightCoeff : su3WeightIdx → Fin 8 → ℂ
  | Sum.inl r, a => (if a = (su3RootPair r).1 then 1 else 0)
      + Complex.I * (if a = (su3RootPair r).2 then 1 else 0)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inl r), a => (if a = (su3RootPair r).1 then 1 else 0)
      - Complex.I * (if a = (su3RootPair r).2 then 1 else 0)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inr c), a => if a = su3CartanId c then 1 else 0

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.su2WeightIdx
entries.docstring:
The index type of the `su(2)` weight coordinates: the positive root, the negative root
  and the Cartan direction.
entries.snippet: abbrev su2WeightIdx : Type

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.su2RootPair
entries.docstring: The pair of Pauli indices making up the root direction of `su(2)`.
entries.snippet: def su2RootPair : Fin 3 × Fin 3

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.rootIdx_three
entries.docstring: The `su(2)` root pair is the fourth root pair of the whole gauge algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma rootIdx_three :
    rootIdx 3 = (Sum.inr (Sum.inl su2RootPair.1), Sum.inr (Sum.inl su2RootPair.2))

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.cartanIdx_two
entries.docstring: The `su(2)` Cartan index is the third Cartan index of the whole gauge algebra.
entries.snippet: lemma cartanIdx_two : cartanIdx 2 = Sum.inr (Sum.inl su2CartanId)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.su2WeightCoeff
entries.docstring:
The `su(2)` weight coordinates in Pauli coordinates: `x₁ ± i x₂` on the root pair, and
  the Cartan coordinate itself.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def su2WeightCoeff : su2WeightIdx → Fin 3 → ℂ
  | Sum.inl _, a => (if a = su2RootPair.1 then 1 else 0)
      + Complex.I * (if a = su2RootPair.2 then 1 else 0)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inl _), a => (if a = su2RootPair.1 then 1 else 0)
      - Complex.I * (if a = su2RootPair.2 then 1 else 0)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inr _), a => if a = su2CartanId then 1 else 0

entries.name: StandardModel.su2AdjointMatrix
entries.docstring:
The adjoint matrix of an element of `SU(2)`: the trace pairing of the Pauli basis of
  `su(2)` with the Pauli basis conjugated by that element.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def su2AdjointMatrix (U : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ

entries.name: StandardModel.su2AdjointMatrix_apply
entries.docstring: The entries of the adjoint matrix.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma su2AdjointMatrix_apply (U : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (i j : Fin 3) :
    su2AdjointMatrix U i j
      = 2⁻¹ * (Matrix.trace (pauliMatrix (Sum.inr i) *
          (U.1 * pauliMatrix (Sum.inr j) * star U.1))).re

entries.name: StandardModel.sum_su2AdjointMatrix_row_mul
entries.docstring: The rows of the adjoint matrix are orthonormal.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_su2AdjointMatrix_row_mul (U : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (c d : Fin 3) :
    ∑ a : Fin 3, su2AdjointMatrix U c a * su2AdjointMatrix U d a
      = if c = d then 1 else 0

entries.name: StandardModel.su2AdjointMatrix_inv
entries.docstring: The adjoint matrix of the inverse is the transpose.
entries.snippet:
lemma su2AdjointMatrix_inv (U : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (a b : Fin 3) :
    su2AdjointMatrix U⁻¹ a b = su2AdjointMatrix U b a

entries.name: StandardModel.su3AdjointMatrix
entries.docstring:
The adjoint matrix of `U ∈ SU(3)`: the trace pairing of the Gell-Mann basis with the
  Gell-Mann basis conjugated by `U`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def su3AdjointMatrix (U : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 3) ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin 8) (Fin 8) ℝ

entries.name: StandardModel.su3AdjointMatrix_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma su3AdjointMatrix_apply (U : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 3) ℂ) (i j : Fin 8) :
    su3AdjointMatrix U i j
      = 2⁻¹ * (Matrix.trace (gellMannMatrix i * (U.1 * gellMannMatrix j * star U.1))).re

entries.name: StandardModel.sum_su3AdjointMatrix_row_mul
entries.docstring: The rows of the adjoint matrix are orthonormal.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_su3AdjointMatrix_row_mul (U : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 3) ℂ) (c d : Fin 8) :
    ∑ a : Fin 8, su3AdjointMatrix U c a * su3AdjointMatrix U d a
      = if c = d then 1 else 0

entries.name: StandardModel.su3AdjointMatrix_inv
entries.docstring: The adjoint matrix of the inverse is the transpose.
entries.snippet:
lemma su3AdjointMatrix_inv (U : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 3) ℂ) (a b : Fin 8) :
    su3AdjointMatrix U⁻¹ a b = su3AdjointMatrix U b a

entries.name: StandardModel.cubeRootOfUnity
entries.docstring: The primitive cube root of unity `ω = exp (2 π i / 3)`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def cubeRootOfUnity : ℂ

entries.name: StandardModel.cubeRootOfUnity_isPrimitiveRoot
entries.docstring: `ω` is a primitive cube root of unity.
entries.snippet: lemma cubeRootOfUnity_isPrimitiveRoot : IsPrimitiveRoot cubeRootOfUnity 3

entries.name: StandardModel.cubeRootOfUnity_ne_zero
entries.docstring: `ω` is nonzero, being a value of the complex exponential.
entries.snippet: lemma cubeRootOfUnity_ne_zero : cubeRootOfUnity ≠ 0

entries.name: StandardModel.cubeRootOfUnity_pow_mod
entries.docstring: Powers of `ω` only see the exponent modulo three.
entries.snippet:
lemma cubeRootOfUnity_pow_mod (m : ℕ) :
    cubeRootOfUnity ^ (m % 3) = cubeRootOfUnity ^ m

entries.name: StandardModel.cubeRootOfUnity_mul_star
entries.docstring: `ω` has modulus one.
entries.snippet: lemma cubeRootOfUnity_mul_star : cubeRootOfUnity * star cubeRootOfUnity = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.expI
entries.docstring: The unitary scalar `exp i`, a point of the unit circle of infinite order.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def expI : unitary ℂ

entries.name: StandardModel.expI_zpow_injective
entries.docstring: The powers of `exp i` are pairwise distinct, by the irrationality of `π`.
entries.snippet: lemma expI_zpow_injective : Function.Injective fun n : ℤ => ((expI : ℂ) ^ n)

entries.name: StandardModel.expI_ne_zero
entries.docstring: `exp i` is nonzero.
entries.snippet: lemma expI_ne_zero : ((expI : ℂ)) ≠ 0

entries.name: StandardModel.expI_inv_eq_star
entries.docstring: The inverse of `exp i` is its star.
entries.snippet: lemma expI_inv_eq_star : ((expI : ℂ))⁻¹ = star (expI : ℂ)

entries.name: StandardModel.expI_mul_conj
entries.docstring: `exp i` times its conjugate is one.
entries.snippet: lemma expI_mul_conj : (expI : ℂ) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (expI : ℂ) = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.conj_mul_expI
entries.docstring: The conjugate of `exp i` times `exp i` is one.
entries.snippet: lemma conj_mul_expI : (starRingEnd ℂ) (expI : ℂ) * (expI : ℂ) = 1

entries.name: Matrix.mem_specialUnitaryGroup_diagonal
entries.docstring:
A diagonal matrix whose entries are unit scalars with product one lies in the special
  unitary group.
entries.snippet:
lemma _root_.Matrix.mem_specialUnitaryGroup_diagonal {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (d : n → ℂ) (hd : ∀ i, d i * star (d i) = 1) (hdet : ∏ i, d i = 1) :
    Matrix.diagonal d ∈ Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup n ℂ

entries.name: StandardModel.su3ExpIOne
entries.docstring: The first colour torus generator, `diag (exp i, exp (-i), 1)`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def su3ExpIOne : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 3) ℂ

entries.name: StandardModel.su3ExpITwo
entries.docstring: The second colour torus generator, `diag (1, exp i, exp (-i))`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def su3ExpITwo : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 3) ℂ

entries.name: StandardModel.su2ExpI
entries.docstring: The `SU(2)` torus element, `diag (exp i, exp (-i))`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def su2ExpI : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ

entries.name: StandardModel.su2ExpI_coe
entries.docstring: The underlying matrix of the `SU(2)` torus element.
entries.snippet:
lemma su2ExpI_coe :
    (su2ExpI : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ).1
      = !![(expI : ℂ), 0; 0, star (expI : ℂ)]

entries.name: StandardModel.su2ExpI_inv_coe
entries.docstring:
The inverse torus element is `diag (exp (-i), exp i)`, so on a doublet the two components
  are scaled by the reciprocal characters.
entries.snippet:
lemma su2ExpI_inv_coe :
    (su2ExpI⁻¹ : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ).1
      = !![star (expI : ℂ), 0; 0, (expI : ℂ)]

entries.name: StandardModel.gaugeTorusGen
entries.docstring: The four commuting generators of the maximal torus of the gauge group.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def gaugeTorusGen : Fin 4 → GaugeGroupI

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeight
entries.docstring:
A **gauge weight**, the four exponents `(colour₁, colour₂, isospin, hypercharge)`
  recording how a vector scales under `gaugeTorusGen`.
entries.snippet: abbrev GaugeWeight : Type

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeight.coord
entries.docstring: The exponent of a gauge weight against the `i`-th torus generator.
entries.snippet: def GaugeWeight.coord (w : GaugeWeight) : Fin 4 → ℤ

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeight.coord_add
entries.docstring:
Weights add coordinatewise. With `zero_coord` this says `coord` is additive, which is
  what makes gauge weights add under multiplication.
entries.snippet:
lemma GaugeWeight.coord_add (w w' : GaugeWeight) (i : Fin 4) :
    (w + w').coord i = w.coord i + w'.coord i

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeight.coord_injective
entries.docstring:
A gauge weight is determined by its four exponents. This is what lets a weight be
  recovered from the characters by which the torus acts; see `piece_eq_inf`.
entries.snippet: lemma GaugeWeight.coord_injective : Function.Injective GaugeWeight.coord

entries.name: StandardModel.IsMulRep
entries.docstring:
A representation acts by algebra maps, respecting multiplication. This is the
  hypothesis under which charges are additive.
entries.snippet: abbrev IsMulRep (rep : Representation ℂ GaugeGroupI B) : Prop

entries.name: StandardModel.IsMulRep.map_one
entries.docstring:
A representation that respects multiplication respects the unit, since `g` is invertible
  and so `rep g 1` is cancellable.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsMulRep.map_one {rep : Representation ℂ GaugeGroupI B} (hmul : IsMulRep rep)
    (g : GaugeGroupI) : rep g 1 = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.starRingEnd_expI_pow
entries.snippet:
lemma starRingEnd_expI_pow (n : ℕ) :
    ((starRingEnd ℂ) (expI : ℂ)) ^ n = ((expI : ℂ) ^ n)⁻¹

entries.name: StandardModel.starRingEnd_expI_zpow
entries.snippet:
lemma starRingEnd_expI_zpow (z : ℤ) :
    (starRingEnd ℂ) ((expI : ℂ) ^ z) = (expI : ℂ) ^ (-z)

entries.name: StandardModel.expI_zpow_ne_zero
entries.snippet: lemma expI_zpow_ne_zero (z : ℤ) : ((expI : ℂ) ^ z) ≠ 0

entries.name: StandardModel.colourWeight
entries.docstring:
The colour weights of the fundamental of `SU(3)` against the two colour torus
  generators.
entries.snippet: def colourWeight (c : Fin 3) : ℤ × ℤ

entries.name: StandardModel.isoWeight
entries.docstring:
The isospin weight of the fundamental of `SU(2)` against the isospin torus
  generator.
entries.snippet: def isoWeight (s : Fin 2) : ℤ

entries.name: StandardModel.dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
entries.snippet:
lemma dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (ρ : Representation ℂ GaugeGroupI V)
    (b : Module.Basis ι ℂ V) (g : GaugeGroupI) (w : ι → ℤ)
    (hb : ∀ j, ρ g (b j) = ((expI : ℂ) ^ w j) • b j) (j : ι) :
    ρ.dual g (b.coord j) = ((expI : ℂ) ^ (-(w j))) • b.coord j

entries.name: StandardModel.conj_gaugeTorusGen_basis
entries.snippet:
lemma conj_gaugeTorusGen_basis (ρ : Representation ℂ GaugeGroupI V)
    (b : Module.Basis ι ℂ V) (g : GaugeGroupI) (w : ι → ℤ)
    (hb : ∀ j, ρ g (b j) = ((expI : ℂ) ^ w j) • b j) (j : ι) :
    ρ.conj g (Basis.conj b j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ (-(w j))) • Basis.conj b j

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition
entries.docstring:
A **gauge weight decomposition** of a submodule `V`, a finitely supported family of
  subspaces of pure gauge weight whose supremum is `V`. Purity is recorded against the four
  commuting torus generators simultaneously.
entries.snippet:
class GaugeWeightDecomposition (rep : Representation ℂ GaugeGroupI B)
    (V : Submodule ℂ B) where
  piece : GaugeWeight → Submodule ℂ B
  supp : Finset GaugeWeight
  rep_mul : IsMulRep rep
  piece_le : ∀ w, ∀ x, x ∈ piece w → ∀ i,
    rep (gaugeTorusGen i) x = ((expI : ℂ) ^ w.coord i) • x
  piece_eq_bot : ∀ w ∉ supp, piece w = ⊥
  iSup_piece : (⨆ w, piece w) = V

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.piece_le_eigenspace
entries.docstring:
The weight-`w` piece lies in the eigenspace of the `i`-th torus generator at the
  eigenvalue `(exp i) ^ (w.coord i)`. This is `piece_le` phrased as an inequality of
  submodules.
entries.snippet:
lemma piece_le_eigenspace (d : GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V) (w : GaugeWeight) (i : Fin 4) :
    d.piece w ≤ Module.End.eigenspace (rep (gaugeTorusGen i)) ((expI : ℂ) ^ w.coord i)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.piece_eq_zero_of_not_mem_supp
entries.docstring:
A weight outside the support has vanishing piece. This is the `piece_eq_bot` field, in
  the form a `simp` set can use to discard the absent weights of a computed product.
entries.snippet:
lemma piece_eq_zero_of_not_mem_supp (d : GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V) (w : GaugeWeight)
    (hw : w ∉ d.supp) : d.piece w = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.piece_le_self
entries.docstring: A weight piece lies inside the submodule it decomposes.
entries.snippet:
lemma piece_le_self (d : GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V) (w : GaugeWeight) :
    d.piece w ≤ V

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.copy
entries.docstring: Transport a decomposition along an equality of submodules.

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.copy_piece
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma copy_piece (d : GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V) (W : Submodule ℂ B) (hW : W = V) :
    (copy d W hW).piece = d.piece

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.sup
entries.docstring:
The join of two gauge weight decompositions, decomposing `V ⊔ V'`. Pieces and supports
  combine one weight at a time.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable instance sup [d : GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V]
    [d' : GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V'] : GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (V ⊔ V') where

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.sup_piece
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma sup_piece [GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V] [GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V']
    (w : GaugeWeight) : piece rep (V ⊔ V') w = piece rep V w ⊔ piece rep V' w

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.bot
entries.docstring: The zero submodule carries the empty decomposition.

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.bot_piece
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma bot_piece (hmul : IsMulRep rep)
    (w : GaugeWeight) : (bot hmul).piece w = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.bot_supp
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma bot_supp (hmul : IsMulRep rep) :
    (bot hmul).supp = ∅

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.spanSingleton
entries.docstring:
The span of a single simultaneous eigenvector of the gauge torus, as a
  decomposition concentrated in its one weight. This is the base case from which the
  decompositions of spans of weight vectors are assembled by `iSup` and `sup`.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable def spanSingleton (hmul : IsMulRep rep) (x : B) (w : GaugeWeight)
    (hx : ∀ i, rep (gaugeTorusGen i) x = ((expI : ℂ) ^ w.coord i) • x) :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (Submodule.span ℂ {x}) where

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.spanSingleton_piece
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma spanSingleton_piece (hmul : IsMulRep rep) (x : B) (w : GaugeWeight)
    (hx : ∀ i, rep (gaugeTorusGen i) x = ((expI : ℂ) ^ w.coord i) • x)
    (w' : GaugeWeight) :
    (spanSingleton hmul x w hx).piece w'
      = if w' = w then Submodule.span ℂ {x} else ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.iSup
entries.docstring:
An indexed join of decompositions. A family of decompositions indexed by a finite type
  decomposes the join, its pieces joined and its supports united one weight at a time. This is
  the arbitrary-arity form of `sup`.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable def iSup {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {V : ι → Submodule ℂ B}
    (hmul : IsMulRep rep)
    (d : (a : ι) → GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (V a)) :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (⨆ a, V a) where

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.piece_iSup
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma piece_iSup {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {V : ι → Submodule ℂ B}
    (hmul : IsMulRep rep)
    (d : (a : ι) → GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (V a)) (w : GaugeWeight) :
    (iSup hmul d).piece w = ⨆ a, (d a).piece w

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.iSup_supp
entries.docstring: The support of an indexed join is the union of the supports.
entries.snippet:
lemma iSup_supp {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {V : ι → Submodule ℂ B}
    (hmul : IsMulRep rep)
    (d : (a : ι) → GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (V a)) :
    (iSup hmul d).supp = Finset.univ.biUnion fun a => (d a).supp

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.iSupProp
entries.docstring:
A join over a proposition. `⨆ _ : p, V` is `V` when `p` holds and `⊥` otherwise, so
  it is decomposed by the given decomposition or by `bot`. The argument is a function of the
  proof, so the decomposition of `V` may itself depend on `p`.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable def iSupProp {p : Prop} [Decidable p]
    (hmul : IsMulRep rep)
    (d : p → GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V) :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (⨆ _ : p, V)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul
entries.docstring: The product of two gauge weight decompositions, decomposing `V * V'`.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable instance mul [d : GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V]
    [d' : GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V'] :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (V * V') where

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul_supp
entries.docstring: The support of a product is the pointwise sum of the supports.
entries.snippet:
lemma mul_supp [GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V] [GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V'] :
    supp rep (V * V') = supp rep V + supp rep V'

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul_piece
entries.docstring:
Weights add under multiplication. The weight-`w` piece of a product is spanned by the
  products of pieces whose weights sum to `w`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mul_piece [GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V] [GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V']
    (w : GaugeWeight) :
    piece rep (V * V') w
      = ⨆ w₁, ⨆ w₂, ⨆ _ : w₁ + w₂ = w, piece rep V w₁ * piece rep V' w₂

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul_piece_eq_sub
entries.docstring:
The product formula with the second weight eliminated against the support of the left
  factor, the right factor being read at the complement `w - w₁`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mul_piece_eq_sub [d : GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V]
    [d' : GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V'] (w : GaugeWeight) :
    piece rep (V * V') w = ⨆ w₁ ∈ supp rep V, piece rep V w₁ * piece rep V' (w - w₁)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.mul_piece_eq_sub'
entries.docstring: The mirror of `mul_piece_eq_sub`, joining over the weights of the right factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma mul_piece_eq_sub' [d : GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V]
    [d' : GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V'] (w : GaugeWeight) :
    piece rep (V * V') w = ⨆ w₂ ∈ supp rep V', piece rep V (w - w₂) * piece rep V' w₂

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.mem_iSup_of_eigenvector
entries.docstring:
The one-generator refinement step. A vector in the span of a family graded along a
  single operator, and an eigenvector of that operator at exponent `n`, lies in the span of
  just those pieces at exponent `n`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_iSup_of_eigenvector {ι : Type*} {T : Module.End ℂ B} {p : ι → Submodule ℂ B}
    {f : ι → ℤ} (hp : ∀ j, p j ≤ Module.End.eigenspace T ((expI : ℂ) ^ f j))
    {x : B} (hx : x ∈ ⨆ j, p j) {n : ℤ} (hT : T x = ((expI : ℂ) ^ n) • x) :
    x ∈ ⨆ j, ⨆ _ : f j = n, p j

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.mem_iSup_of_forall_eigenvector
entries.docstring:
The many-generator refinement. The same for a finite family of operators. A vector in
  the span of the family and an eigenvector of every operator lies in the span of just those
  pieces whose exponents match throughout.

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.piece_eq_inf
entries.docstring:
The pieces are canonical. The weight-`w` piece is exactly the part of `V` on which the
  four torus generators act by the weight-`w` characters. See `piece_congr`.
entries.snippet:
lemma piece_eq_inf (d : GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V) (w : GaugeWeight) :
    d.piece w
      = V ⊓ ⨅ i, Module.End.eigenspace (rep (gaugeTorusGen i)) ((expI : ℂ) ^ w.coord i)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.piece_congr
entries.docstring:
The pieces depend only on the submodule. Two decompositions of equal submodules have
  the same pieces, so a computation of `piece` may be carried along any equality of
  submodules.
entries.snippet:
lemma piece_congr {W : Submodule ℂ B} [d : GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V]
    [d' : GaugeWeightDecomposition rep W] (hVW : V = W) (w : GaugeWeight) :
    d.piece w = d'.piece w

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.mem_zero_of_invariant
entries.docstring:
A gauge-invariant element sits in the zero-weight piece. Only invariance under the
  four torus generators is used. The converse is false; see the warning in section F.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_zero_of_invariant (d : GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ V)
    (hV : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, rep g x = x) : x ∈ d.piece 0

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.reducesInvariantsTo_piece_zero
entries.docstring:
The torus sieve as a reduction for the four torus generators: modulo a torus-stable
  submodule, their invariants in `V` lie in the weight-zero piece. Every other weight in the
  support is scaled by some generator by `(exp i) ^ n` with `n ≠ 0`, a scalar other than `1`,
  so its piece reduces to `⊥` by `reducesInvariantsTo_bot_of_apply_eq_smul`; each piece is
  carried into itself by the torus, and `ReducesInvariantsTo.iSup` joins the pieces.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_piece_zero (dV : GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun i => rep (gaugeTorusGen i)) V (dV.piece 0)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeWeightDecomposition.mem_piece_zero_sup_of_invariant
entries.docstring:
An element of `V ⊔ S` fixed by the four torus generators, for `S` closed under them,
  lies in the weight-zero piece joined with `S`. This is `reducesInvariantsTo_piece_zero`
  unfolded, the form used to sieve a sector with `S` the part already understood. Only the
  torus is used, so gauge invariance of the element and gauge stability of `S` are more than
  is needed.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_piece_zero_sup_of_invariant {S : Submodule ℂ B}
    (dV : GaugeWeightDecomposition rep V)
    (hS : ∀ (i : Fin 4) (y : B), y ∈ S → rep (gaugeTorusGen i) y ∈ S)
    {x : B} (hx : x ∈ V ⊔ S) (hinv : ∀ i : Fin 4, rep (gaugeTorusGen i) x = x) :
    x ∈ dV.piece 0 ⊔ S

entries.name: StandardModel.su3LabelFun
entries.docstring:
The labels of the Gell-Mann matrices of `su(3)` as generalized Gell-Mann labels: the
  symmetric and antisymmetric matrices of the planes `(0, 1)`, `(0, 2)` and `(1, 2)`, and the two
  diagonal matrices.
entries.snippet:
def su3LabelFun : Fin 8 → GellMann.Index 3
  | 0 => .inl ⟨(0, 1), by decide⟩
  | 1 => .inr (.inl ⟨(0, 1), by decide⟩)
  | 2 => .inr (.inr 0)
  | 3 => .inl ⟨(0, 2), by decide⟩
  | 4 => .inr (.inl ⟨(0, 2), by decide⟩)
  | 5 => .inl ⟨(1, 2), by decide⟩
  | 6 => .inr (.inl ⟨(1, 2), by decide⟩)
  | 7 => .inr (.inr 1)

entries.name: StandardModel.su3Label
entries.docstring: The relabelling of the Gell-Mann matrices of `su(3)` by generalized Gell-Mann labels.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def su3Label : Fin 8 ≃ GellMann.Index 3

entries.name: StandardModel.su2LabelFun
entries.docstring: The labels of the Pauli matrices of `su(2)` as generalized Gell-Mann labels.
entries.snippet:
def su2LabelFun : Fin 3 → GellMann.Index 2
  | 0 => .inl ⟨(0, 1), by decide⟩
  | 1 => .inr (.inl ⟨(0, 1), by decide⟩)
  | 2 => .inr (.inr 0)

entries.name: StandardModel.su2Label
entries.docstring: The relabelling of the Pauli matrices of `su(2)` by generalized Gell-Mann labels.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def su2Label : Fin 3 ≃ GellMann.Index 2

entries.name: StandardModel.su3Label_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma su3Label_apply (a : Fin 8) : su3Label a = su3LabelFun a

entries.name: StandardModel.su2Label_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma su2Label_apply (i : Fin 3) : su2Label i = su2LabelFun i

entries.name: StandardModel.gellMannMatrix_eq_matrix
entries.docstring: The Gell-Mann matrices of `su(3)` are the generalized Gell-Mann matrices.
entries.snippet:
lemma gellMannMatrix_eq_matrix (a : Fin 8) :
    gellMannMatrix a = GellMann.matrix (su3Label a)

entries.name: StandardModel.pauliMatrix_inr_eq_matrix
entries.docstring: The Pauli matrices are the generalized Gell-Mann matrices of `su(2)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma pauliMatrix_inr_eq_matrix (i : Fin 3) :
    pauliMatrix (Sum.inr i) = GellMann.matrix (su2Label i)

entries.name: StandardModel.ofReal_half_re_trace
entries.docstring: A complex number fixed by conjugation is the image of its real part.
entries.snippet:
lemma ofReal_half_re_trace {z : ℂ} (hz : star (z / 2) = z / 2) :
    ((2⁻¹ * z.re : ℝ) : ℂ) = z / 2

entries.name: StandardModel.su3AdjointMatrix_eq_adjMatrix
entries.docstring:
The adjoint matrix of `SU(3)` is the matrix of the adjoint action in the Gell-Mann
  basis.
entries.snippet:
lemma su3AdjointMatrix_eq_adjMatrix (U : SU 3) (a b : Fin 8) :
    ((su3AdjointMatrix U a b : ℝ) : ℂ) = adjMatrix U (su3Label a) (su3Label b)

entries.name: StandardModel.su2AdjointMatrix_eq_adjMatrix
entries.docstring: The adjoint matrix of `SU(2)` is the matrix of the adjoint action in the Pauli basis.
entries.snippet:
lemma su2AdjointMatrix_eq_adjMatrix (U : SU 2) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ((su2AdjointMatrix U i j : ℝ) : ℂ) = adjMatrix U (su2Label i) (su2Label j)

entries.name: StandardModel.adjMap_smul_of_relabel_law
entries.docstring:
A linear map moving a family with one adjoint label by the Standard Model adjoint matrix of
  `U` intertwines the map of the relabelled family with the action of `U`.

entries.name: StandardModel.adjPairMap_smul_of_relabel_law
entries.docstring:
A linear map moving a family with two adjoint labels by the Standard Model adjoint matrix of
  `U` on each label intertwines the map of the relabelled family with the action of `U`.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjPairMap_smul_of_relabel_law (T : (Fin 2 → ι) → B) {f : B →ₗ[ℂ] B} {U : SU N}
    (hf : ∀ l, f (T l) = ∑ a : Fin 2 → ι, (∏ i : Fin 2, ((M U (a i) (l i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • T a)
    (t : SuT[N, .adj, .adj]) :
    f (adjPairMap (fun n => T (e.symm ∘ n)) t) = adjPairMap (fun n => T (e.symm ∘ n)) (U • t)

entries.name: StandardModel.adjPairMap_relabel_two_smul_adjUnitTensor
entries.docstring: The map of the relabelled family sends twice the unit tensor to the trace contraction.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjPairMap_relabel_two_smul_adjUnitTensor (T : (Fin 2 → ι) → B) :
    adjPairMap (fun n => T (e.symm ∘ n)) ((2 : ℂ) • adjUnitTensor N) = ∑ a : ι, T ![a, a]

entries.name: StandardModel.IsSU3AdjointMat
entries.docstring:
The linear map `f` moves the components of `T` as `U ∈ SU(3)` moves a tensor with one
  adjoint index: one factor of the adjoint matrix, the summed index first.
entries.snippet: def IsSU3AdjointMat (U : SU 3) (f : B →ₗ[ℂ] B) (T : Fin 8 → B) : Prop

entries.name: StandardModel.IsSU3Adjoint
entries.docstring:
A family `T^a` with one `su(3)` adjoint index: the map of the relabelled family out of the
  tensors of `SU(3)` is equivariant for the colour factor of the gauge group.
entries.snippet:
abbrev IsSU3Adjoint (B : Type*) [AddCommGroup B] [Module ℂ B]
    (repGauge : Representation ℂ GaugeGroupI B) (T : Fin 8 → B) : Prop

entries.name: StandardModel.IsSU3BiAdjointMat
entries.docstring:
The linear map `f` moves the components of `T` as `U ∈ SU(3)` moves a tensor with two
  adjoint indices: one factor of the adjoint matrix per index, the summed index first.
entries.snippet: def IsSU3BiAdjointMat (U : SU 3) (f : B →ₗ[ℂ] B) (T : (Fin 2 → Fin 8) → B) : Prop

entries.name: StandardModel.IsSU3BiAdjoint
entries.docstring:
A family `T^{ab}` with two `su(3)` adjoint indices: the map of the relabelled family out of
  the tensors of `SU(3)` is equivariant for the colour factor of the gauge group.
entries.snippet:
abbrev IsSU3BiAdjoint (B : Type*) [AddCommGroup B] [Module ℂ B]
    (repGauge : Representation ℂ GaugeGroupI B) (T : (Fin 2 → Fin 8) → B) : Prop

entries.name: StandardModel.IsSU3Adjoint.of_law
entries.docstring: A family obeying the law for every colour rotation is such a family.
entries.snippet:
lemma of_law (hT : ∀ U : SU 3, IsSU3AdjointMat U (repGauge (U, 1, 1)) T) :
    IsSU3Adjoint B repGauge T

entries.name: StandardModel.IsSU3Adjoint.isStableUnder_span
entries.docstring: The span of the components is stable under the colour factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma isStableUnder_span (hT : IsSU3Adjoint B repGauge T) :
    IsStableUnder (fun U : SU 3 => repGauge ((U, 1, 1) : GaugeGroupI))
      (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range T))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsSU3Adjoint.reducesInvariantsTo_bot
entries.docstring:
A colour invariant of the span of the components joined with a stable submodule lies in
  that submodule: an adjoint index contributes nothing to the invariants.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_bot (hT : IsSU3Adjoint B repGauge T) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun U : SU 3 => repGauge ((U, 1, 1) : GaugeGroupI))
      (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range T)) ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.IsSU3BiAdjoint.of_law
entries.docstring: A family obeying the law for every colour rotation is such a family.
entries.snippet:
lemma of_law (hT : ∀ U : SU 3, IsSU3BiAdjointMat U (repGauge (U, 1, 1)) T) :
    IsSU3BiAdjoint B repGauge T

entries.name: StandardModel.IsSU3BiAdjoint.traceContraction
entries.docstring: The trace contraction `∑ a, T ![a, a]` of the two adjoint indices.
entries.snippet: def traceContraction (T : (Fin 2 → Fin 8) → B) : B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsSU3BiAdjoint.traceContraction_mem_span
entries.snippet:
lemma traceContraction_mem_span (T : (Fin 2 → Fin 8) → B) :
    traceContraction T ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range T)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsSU3BiAdjoint.map_traceContraction
entries.docstring:
Any map moving the components by the adjoint matrix of an element of `SU(3)` fixes the
  trace contraction.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_traceContraction {U : SU 3} {f : B →ₗ[ℂ] B} (hf : IsSU3BiAdjointMat U f T) :
    f (traceContraction T) = traceContraction T

entries.name: StandardModel.IsSU3BiAdjoint.range_adjPairMap
entries.docstring: The range of the map of the relabelled family is the span of the components.
entries.snippet:
lemma range_adjPairMap (T : (Fin 2 → Fin 8) → B) :
    LinearMap.range (adjPairMap fun n => T (su3Label.symm ∘ n))
      = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range T)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsSU3BiAdjoint.isStableUnder_span
entries.docstring: The span of the components is stable under the colour factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma isStableUnder_span (hT : IsSU3BiAdjoint B repGauge T) :
    IsStableUnder (fun U : SU 3 => repGauge ((U, 1, 1) : GaugeGroupI))
      (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range T))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsSU3BiAdjoint.reducesInvariantsTo_span_traceContraction
entries.docstring:
The colour invariants of the span of the components reduce to the line through the trace
  contraction.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_span_traceContraction (hT : IsSU3BiAdjoint B repGauge T) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun U : SU 3 => repGauge ((U, 1, 1) : GaugeGroupI))
      (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range T)) (ℂ ∙ traceContraction T)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsSU2AdjointMat
entries.docstring:
The linear map `f` moves the components of `T` as `U ∈ SU(2)` moves a tensor with one
  adjoint index: one factor of the adjoint matrix, the summed index first.
entries.snippet: def IsSU2AdjointMat (U : SU 2) (f : B →ₗ[ℂ] B) (T : Fin 3 → B) : Prop

entries.name: StandardModel.IsSU2Adjoint
entries.docstring:
A family `T^a` with one `su(2)` adjoint index: the map of the relabelled family out of the
  tensors of `SU(2)` is equivariant for the isospin factor of the gauge group.
entries.snippet:
abbrev IsSU2Adjoint (B : Type*) [AddCommGroup B] [Module ℂ B]
    (repGauge : Representation ℂ GaugeGroupI B) (T : Fin 3 → B) : Prop

entries.name: StandardModel.IsSU2BiAdjointMat
entries.docstring:
The linear map `f` moves the components of `T` as `U ∈ SU(2)` moves a tensor with two

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeGroupI
entries.docstring:
The group of formal infinite-order jets, at a spacetime point, of local gauge
  transformations of the Standard Model: the `R`-points of the gauge group for `R`
  the ring `SpaceTimeAlgebra` of formal power series in the spacetime coordinates.

  Since gauge transformations multiply pointwise, jets multiply as power series and
  the group structure is that of the matrix groups over `SpaceTimeAlgebra`. The unitarity and
  determinant constraints hold as power-series identities, i.e. at every jet order.

  Evaluation at the base point recovers `GaugeGroupI`; see `JetGaugeGroupI.eval`.
entries.snippet: abbrev JetGaugeGroupI : Type

entries.docstring: The underlying matrix value of an element of `JetGaugeGroupI`.

def toVal (U : JetGaugeGroupI) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) SpaceTimeAlgebra × Matrix (Fin 2)
    (Fin 2) SpaceTimeAlgebra × SpaceTimeAlgebra

entries.docstring: Entrywise evaluation at the base point commutes with the conjugate transpose.
entries.snippet:
lemma mapMatrix_constantCoeff_star {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix (star A) =
      star ((constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix A)

noncomputable def truncation (n : ℕ) (U : JetGaugeGroupI) :

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeGroupI.coeff_maurerCartanForm_eq_zero_of_mem_truncationKer
entries.docstring:
The base-point Taylor data of the Maurer–Cartan form of a jet trivial to order `n`,
  read as power-series coefficients of a scalar component `f` of the jet gauge algebra
  through a scalar `ψ` of the gauge algebra computing evaluated iterated derivatives: they
  vanish below degree `n`.
entries.snippet:
lemma coeff_maurerCartanForm_eq_zero_of_mem_truncationKer (ψ : GaugeAlgebra → ℂ)
    (hψ : ψ 0 = 0) (f : JetGaugeAlgebra → SpaceTimeAlgebra)
    (hf : ∀ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra),
      ψ (JetGaugeAlgebra.eval (JetGaugeAlgebra.iteratedDeriv s a)) =
        constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv s (f a)))
    {U : JetGaugeGroupI} {n : ℕ} (hU : U ∈ localGaugeData.truncationKer n) (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    {m : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ} (hm : Finsupp.degree m < n) :
    coeff m (f (maurerCartanForm U ρ)) = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeGroupI.coeff_maurerCartanForm_toSU3Matrix_eq_zero_of_mem_truncationKer
entries.docstring: The `su(3)` entries of `coeff_maurerCartanForm_eq_zero_of_mem_truncationKer`.
entries.snippet:
lemma coeff_maurerCartanForm_toSU3Matrix_eq_zero_of_mem_truncationKer {U : JetGaugeGroupI}
    {n : ℕ} (hU : U ∈ localGaugeData.truncationKer n) (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    {m : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ} (hm : Finsupp.degree m < n) (i j : Fin 3) :
    coeff m ((maurerCartanForm U ρ).toSU3Matrix i j) = 0

entries.docstring: The `su(2)` entries of `coeff_maurerCartanForm_eq_zero_of_mem_truncationKer`.
entries.snippet:
lemma coeff_maurerCartanForm_toSU2Matrix_eq_zero_of_mem_truncationKer {U : JetGaugeGroupI}
    {n : ℕ} (hU : U ∈ localGaugeData.truncationKer n) (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    {m : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ} (hm : Finsupp.degree m < n) (i j : Fin 2) :
    coeff m ((maurerCartanForm U ρ).toSU2Matrix i j) = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.JetGaugeGroupI.coeff_maurerCartanForm_toU1Value_eq_zero_of_mem_truncationKer
