entries.docstring:
The hypercharge contribution to the field strength (and its covariant derivatives),
  i.e. the `B`-boson contribution: the field-strength symbol evaluated on the coordinate
  dual to the single basis direction of the `u(1)` factor of the standard basis of the
  gauge algebra.
entries.snippet:
@[nolint unusedArguments]
noncomputable def hyperchargeField (h : IsGaugeSector B repGauge hrepGauge_mul repLorentz
      hrepLorentz_mul F massWeightPoly) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.derivSubmodule
entries.docstring:
The submodule of `B` generated by the field-strength symbols carrying exactly `n`
  covariant derivatives: the join, over the derivative slots and the two covector
  indices, of the ranges of the symbol maps.
entries.snippet:
@[nolint unusedArguments]
def derivSubmodule (h : IsGaugeSector B repGauge hrepGauge_mul repLorentz hrepLorentz_mul
    F massWeightPoly) (n : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.commute_of_mem_derivSubmodule
entries.docstring:
The gauge sector is bosonic: any element of a derivative-`n` submodule commutes with any
  element of a derivative-`m` submodule. This extends `F_comm_F` from generators to the
  submodules that they span.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_of_mem_derivSubmodule {n m : ℕ} {x y : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.derivSubmodule n) (hy : y ∈ h.derivSubmodule m) : Commute x y

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.derivSubmodule_mul_comm
entries.docstring:
The derivative-`n` and derivative-`m` submodules commute with one another as submodules
  of `B`, since every pair of their elements commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_mul_comm (n m : ℕ) :
    h.derivSubmodule n * h.derivSubmodule m = h.derivSubmodule m * h.derivSubmodule n

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.derivSubmodule_map_repGauge_le
entries.docstring:
The image of a derivative-`n` submodule under a gauge transformation lies inside the
  same submodule: each generator `F l μ ν φ` is sent by `repGauge_F` to another generator
  `F l μ ν φ'` with the same derivative slots and covector indices.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_map_repGauge_le (n : ℕ) (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    (h.derivSubmodule n).map (repGauge g) ≤ h.derivSubmodule n

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.derivSubmodule_map_repGauge
entries.docstring: The derivative-`n` submodule is invariant, as a set, under the gauge group.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_map_repGauge (n : ℕ) (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    (h.derivSubmodule n).map (repGauge g) = h.derivSubmodule n

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.derivSubmodule_map_repLorentz_le
entries.docstring:
The image of a derivative-`n` submodule under a Lorentz transformation lies inside the
  same submodule: `repLorentz_F` expands each generator into a finite linear combination of
  generators with the same number `n` of derivative slots.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_map_repLorentz_le (n : ℕ) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    (h.derivSubmodule n).map (repLorentz Λ) ≤ h.derivSubmodule n

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.derivSubmodule_map_repLorentz
entries.docstring: The derivative-`n` submodule is invariant, as a set, under the Lorentz group.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_map_repLorentz (n : ℕ) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    (h.derivSubmodule n).map (repLorentz Λ) = h.derivSubmodule n

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.repLorentz_neg_one_F
entries.docstring:
A field-strength symbol is fixed by the centre of `SL(2,ℂ)`: all of its indices mix by the
  Lorentz matrix, which is the identity there.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_neg_one_F {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) : repLorentz (-1) (F l μ ν φ) = F l μ ν φ

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.span_range_F_le_centreEigenspace
entries.docstring: The span of a field-strength symbol family carries the sign `+1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma span_range_F_le_centreEigenspace {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (F l μ ν)) ≤ centreEigenspace repLorentz 1

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.derivSubmodule_le_centreEigenspace
entries.docstring:
**The centre of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts on the field-strength derivative submodules by `+1`**, for
  any number of covariant derivatives: the field strength is of integer spin and every one of
  its indices is inert at the centre.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_le_centreEigenspace (n : ℕ) :
    h.derivSubmodule n ≤ centreEigenspace repLorentz 1

entries.name: StandardModel.biUnion_univ_const
entries.docstring: A join over a nonempty index of a constant family of supports is that support.
entries.snippet:
lemma biUnion_univ_const {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (t : Finset GaugeWeight) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset ι).biUnion (fun _ => t) = t

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.real_smul_eq
entries.snippet: lemma real_smul_eq (r : ℝ) (b : B) : r • b = ((r : ℂ)) • b

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.repGauge_pair_add
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_pair_add (g : GaugeGroupI) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ₁ φ₂ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) (z : ℂ)
    (h1 : (GaugeAlgebra.adjointMap g⁻¹).dualMap φ₁ = z.re • φ₁ - z.im • φ₂)
    (h2 : (GaugeAlgebra.adjointMap g⁻¹).dualMap φ₂ = z.im • φ₁ + z.re • φ₂) :
    repGauge g (F l μ ν φ₁ + Complex.I • F l μ ν φ₂)
      = z • (F l μ ν φ₁ + Complex.I • F l μ ν φ₂)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.repGauge_pair_sub
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_pair_sub (g : GaugeGroupI) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ₁ φ₂ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) (z : ℂ)
    (h1 : (GaugeAlgebra.adjointMap g⁻¹).dualMap φ₁ = z.re • φ₁ - z.im • φ₂)
    (h2 : (GaugeAlgebra.adjointMap g⁻¹).dualMap φ₂ = z.im • φ₁ + z.re • φ₂) :
    repGauge g (F l μ ν φ₁ - Complex.I • F l μ ν φ₂)
      = (starRingEnd ℂ z) • (F l μ ν φ₁ - Complex.I • F l μ ν φ₂)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.repGauge_fixed
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_fixed (g : GaugeGroupI) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra)
    (h1 : (GaugeAlgebra.adjointMap g⁻¹).dualMap φ = φ) :
    repGauge g (F l μ ν φ) = F l μ ν φ

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.adjVec
entries.docstring:
The weight vectors of the adjoint: for each root the two complex combinations of
  the paired coordinate symbols, and for each Cartan direction the symbol itself.
entries.snippet:
@[nolint unusedArguments]
noncomputable def adjVec (h : IsGaugeSector B repGauge hrepGauge_mul repLorentz
      hrepLorentz_mul F massWeightPoly) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 4 → B
  | Sum.inl r => F l μ ν (stdBasis.coord (rootIdx r).1)
      + Complex.I • F l μ ν (stdBasis.coord (rootIdx r).2)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inl r) => F l μ ν (stdBasis.coord (rootIdx r).1)
      - Complex.I • F l μ ν (stdBasis.coord (rootIdx r).2)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inr c) => F l μ ν (stdBasis.coord (cartanIdx c))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.adjWeight
entries.docstring: The gauge weight of each adjoint weight vector.
entries.snippet:
def adjWeight : Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 4 → GaugeWeight
  | Sum.inl r => GaugeAlgebra.rootWeight r
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inl r) => -(GaugeAlgebra.rootWeight r)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inr _) => 0

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.repGauge_adjVec
entries.docstring: Each adjoint weight vector is a simultaneous eigenvector of the gauge torus.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_adjVec {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (k : Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 4) (i : Fin 4) :
    repGauge (gaugeTorusGen i) (h.adjVec l μ ν k)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (adjWeight k) i) • h.adjVec l μ ν k

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.F_coord_rootIdx_fst
entries.docstring: The first symbol of a root pair, recovered from the two weight vectors.
entries.snippet:
lemma F_coord_rootIdx_fst {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (r : Fin 4) :
    F l μ ν (stdBasis.coord (rootIdx r).1)
      = (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (h.adjVec l μ ν (Sum.inl r)
        + h.adjVec l μ ν (Sum.inr (Sum.inl r)))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.F_coord_rootIdx_snd
entries.docstring: The second symbol of a root pair, recovered from the two weight vectors.
entries.snippet:
lemma F_coord_rootIdx_snd {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (r : Fin 4) :
    F l μ ν (stdBasis.coord (rootIdx r).2)
      = (-(Complex.I / 2)) • (h.adjVec l μ ν (Sum.inl r)
        - h.adjVec l μ ν (Sum.inr (Sum.inl r)))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.F_coord_mem_iSup
entries.docstring: Every standard coordinate symbol lies in the join of the weight-vector lines.
entries.snippet:
lemma F_coord_mem_iSup {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (a : Fin 8 ⊕ Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1) :
    F l μ ν (stdBasis.coord a)
      ∈ ⨆ k, Submodule.span ℂ {h.adjVec l μ ν k}

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.span_range_eq_iSup
entries.docstring: The span of the field-strength symbols is the join of the twelve weight lines.

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.rangeGaugeWeight
entries.docstring: The gauge weight decomposition of the span of one field-strength symbol map.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable def rangeGaugeWeight {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition repGauge (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (F l μ ν)))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight
entries.docstring:
**The gauge weight decomposition of the gauge derivative submodules**, for any
  number of covariant derivatives.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable instance derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight (n : ℕ) :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition repGauge (h.derivSubmodule n)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.rangeGaugeWeight_supp
entries.docstring: The support of the decomposition of one symbol map: the image of `adjWeight`.
entries.snippet:
lemma rangeGaugeWeight_supp {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (h.rangeGaugeWeight l μ ν).supp
      = Finset.univ.biUnion fun k : Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 4 =>
        ({adjWeight k} : Finset GaugeWeight)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_supp
entries.docstring:
**The gauge weights occurring in the gauge derivative submodules**: the six `su(3)`
  roots, the two `su(2)` roots and the zero weight carried by the Cartan and `u(1)`
  directions.  The weights do not depend on the number of covariant derivatives, and
  every one of them has vanishing hypercharge.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_supp (n : ℕ) :
    (h.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight n).supp
      = {((2, -1, 0, 0) : GaugeWeight), (1, 1, 0, 0), (-1, 2, 0, 0), (0, 0, 2, 0),
        (-2, 1, 0, 0), (-1, -1, 0, 0), (1, -2, 0, 0), (0, 0, -2, 0), (0, 0, 0, 0)}

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece
entries.docstring:
**The pieces of the gauge weight decomposition.**  The weight-`w` piece is the join,
  over the derivative slots and the two covector indices, of the lines spanned by those
  weight vectors whose weight is `w`.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece (n : ℕ) (w : GaugeWeight) :
    (h.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight n).piece w
      = ⨆ (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
        (k : Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 4),
        (if w = adjWeight k then ℂ ∙ h.adjVec l μ ν k else ⊥)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_rootWeight
entries.docstring: The piece at a root weight: the `+` combination for that root alone.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_rootWeight (n : ℕ) (r : Fin 4) :
    (h.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight n).piece (GaugeAlgebra.rootWeight r)
      = ⨆ (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
        ℂ ∙ h.adjVec l μ ν (Sum.inl r)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_neg_rootWeight
entries.docstring: The piece at the opposite of a root weight: the `-` combination for that root.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_neg_rootWeight (n : ℕ) (r : Fin 4) :
    (h.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight n).piece (-(GaugeAlgebra.rootWeight r))
      = ⨆ (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
        ℂ ∙ h.adjVec l μ ν (Sum.inr (Sum.inl r))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_zero'
entries.docstring:
The weight-zero piece: the two `su(3)` Cartan generators, the `su(2)` Cartan
  generator and the `u(1)` generator, the only directions the torus fixes.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_zero' (n : ℕ) :
    (h.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight n).piece 0
      = ⨆ (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
          (c : Fin 4),
        ℂ ∙ h.adjVec l μ ν (Sum.inr (Sum.inr c))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_eq_bot
entries.docstring: Every other weight has a trivial piece.

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring:
All elements of the gauge algebra of mass weight exactly `w`: the intersection of
  the algebra generated by the field-strength towers with the part on which
  `massWeightPoly` is the monomial `X ^ w`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def massWeightSubmodule
  (h : IsGaugeSector B repGauge hrepGauge_mul repLorentz hrepLorentz_mul
      F massWeightPoly) (w : ℕ) :
    Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightPoly_of_mem_massWeightSubmodule
StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.mem_gaugeAlgebra_of_mem_massWeightSubmodule
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_gaugeAlgebra_of_mem_massWeightSubmodule {w : ℕ} {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule w) : x ∈ h.gaugeAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.one_le_massWeightSubmodule_zero
entries.snippet: lemma one_le_massWeightSubmodule_zero : (1 : Submodule ℂ B) ≤ h.massWeightSubmodule 0

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule_mul_le
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_mul_le (m n : ℕ) :
    h.massWeightSubmodule m * h.massWeightSubmodule n ≤ h.massWeightSubmodule (m + n)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.gaugeAlgebra_eq_adjoin_derivSubmodule
entries.docstring:
The gauge algebra is generated by the field-strength towers of every derivative
  order.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeAlgebra_eq_adjoin_derivSubmodule :
    h.gaugeAlgebra = Algebra.adjoin ℂ (⋃ n, (h.derivSubmodule n : Set B))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightPoly_of_mem_derivSubmodule
entries.docstring:
`massWeightPoly` is the monomial `X ^ (2 * (2 + n))` on the field-strength towers with
  `n` covariant derivatives.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_of_mem_derivSubmodule (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ x ∈ h.derivSubmodule n, massWeightPoly x = Polynomial.monomial (2 * (2 + n)) x

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.derivSubmodule_le_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring:
A field-strength tower with `n` covariant derivatives has mass weight
  `2 * (2 + n)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_le_massWeightSubmodule (n : ℕ) :
    h.derivSubmodule n ≤ h.massWeightSubmodule (2 * (2 + n))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule_zero_eq
entries.docstring: Weight zero is the scalars: every field-strength tower has positive weight.
entries.snippet: lemma massWeightSubmodule_zero_eq : h.massWeightSubmodule 0 = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule_eq
entries.docstring:
The weight recursion: an element of positive mass weight `i` is a sum of single
  field-strength towers of weight `i` and of products of two elements of lower positive
  weights summing to `i`.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_eq (i : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) :
    h.massWeightSubmodule i
      = (⨆ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k : Fin i => 2 * (2 + (k : ℕ)) = i),
          h.derivSubmodule (k : ℕ))
        ⊔ (⨆ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin i × Fin i => (p.1 : ℕ) + (p.2 : ℕ) = i),
            h.massWeightSubmodule (p.1 : ℕ) * h.massWeightSubmodule (p.2 : ℕ))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule_eq_iSup_mul
entries.docstring:
Removing the leftmost field-strength tower: an element of positive weight `w` is a sum
  of products of a tower `∇ⁿF` of weight `2 * (2 + n) ≤ w` with an element of the
  remaining weight.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_eq_iSup_mul (w : ℕ) (hw : 0 < w) :
    h.massWeightSubmodule w
      = ⨆ n ∈ (Finset.range (w + 1)).filter (fun n => 2 * (2 + n) ≤ w),
          h.derivSubmodule n * h.massWeightSubmodule (w - 2 * (2 + n))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule_eq_bot
entries.docstring:
The weights `1`, `2`, `3`, `5` and `7` are empty: the tower weights `4, 6, 8, …` and
  their sums only reach `0` and the even weights from `4` on.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_eq_bot {w : ℕ} (hw : ¬ (w = 0 ∨ (4 ≤ w ∧ w % 2 = 0))) :
    h.massWeightSubmodule w = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule_one_eq
entries.docstring: There is nothing of weight one.
entries.snippet: lemma massWeightSubmodule_one_eq : h.massWeightSubmodule 1 = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule_two_eq
entries.docstring: There is nothing of weight two.
entries.snippet: lemma massWeightSubmodule_two_eq : h.massWeightSubmodule 2 = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule_three_eq
entries.docstring: There is nothing of weight three.
entries.snippet: lemma massWeightSubmodule_three_eq : h.massWeightSubmodule 3 = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule_four_eq
entries.docstring: Weight four is the underived field-strength towers: `F` leaves weight zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_four_eq :
    h.massWeightSubmodule 4 = h.derivSubmodule 0

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule_five_eq
entries.docstring: There is nothing of weight five.
entries.snippet: lemma massWeightSubmodule_five_eq : h.massWeightSubmodule 5 = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule_six_eq
entries.docstring:
Weight six is the once-derived field-strength towers: `F` would leave weight two,
  which is empty, and `∇F` leaves weight zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_six_eq :
    h.massWeightSubmodule 6 = h.derivSubmodule 1

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule_seven_eq
entries.docstring: There is nothing of weight seven.
entries.snippet: lemma massWeightSubmodule_seven_eq : h.massWeightSubmodule 7 = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmodule_eight_eq
entries.docstring:
Weight eight is the twice-derived field-strength towers together with the products
  of two underived ones, the `∇∇F` and `F · F` sectors: `F` leaves weight four, which is
  `F`, `∇F` would leave weight two, which is empty, and `∇∇F` leaves weight zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_eight_eq :
    h.massWeightSubmodule 8 = h.derivSubmodule 2 ⊔ h.derivSubmodule 0 * h.derivSubmodule 0

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.rangeGaugeWeight_piece_zero
entries.docstring:
The weight-zero piece of one symbol map's decomposition: the Cartan and `u(1)`
  directions, the only ones the torus fixes.
entries.snippet:
lemma rangeGaugeWeight_piece_zero {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (h.rangeGaugeWeight l μ ν).piece 0
      = ⨆ c : Fin 4, ℂ ∙ F l μ ν (stdBasis.coord (cartanIdx c))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_zero
entries.docstring:
**The weight-zero piece of the gauge derivative submodules**: the spans of the
  field-strength symbols evaluated on the four weight-zero directions of the adjoint —
  the two `su(3)` Cartan generators, the `su(2)` Cartan generator and the `u(1)`
  generator.  The four are distinct, so the join carries no duplicates.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_zero (n : ℕ) :
    (h.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight n).piece 0
      = ⨆ (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
          (c : Fin 4),
        ℂ ∙ F l μ ν (stdBasis.coord (cartanIdx c))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightOne_piece_zero
entries.docstring: The weight-zero piece at mass weight 1: the submodule itself is trivial.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightOne_piece_zero :
    (h.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightOne).piece 0 = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightTwo_piece_zero
entries.docstring: The weight-zero piece at mass weight 2: the submodule itself is trivial.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightTwo_piece_zero :
    (h.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightTwo).piece 0 = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightThree_piece_zero
entries.docstring: The weight-zero piece at mass weight 3: the submodule itself is trivial.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightThree_piece_zero :
    (h.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightThree).piece 0 = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightFive_piece_zero
entries.docstring: The weight-zero piece at mass weight 5: the submodule itself is trivial.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightFive_piece_zero :
    (h.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightFive).piece 0 = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightSeven_piece_zero

entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightSeven_piece_zero :
    (h.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightSeven).piece 0 = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightFour_piece_zero
entries.docstring:
The weight-zero piece at mass weight four: the undifferentiated field strength on
  the four fixed directions of the adjoint.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightFour_piece_zero :
    (h.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightFour).piece 0
      = ⨆ (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (c : Fin 4),
        ℂ ∙ F ![] μ ν (stdBasis.coord (cartanIdx c))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightSix_piece_zero
entries.docstring:
The weight-zero piece at mass weight six: the once-differentiated field strength on
  the four fixed directions of the adjoint.
entries.snippet:

    (h.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightSix).piece 0
      = ⨆ (l : Fin 1 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
          (c : Fin 4),
        ℂ ∙ F l μ ν (stdBasis.coord (cartanIdx c))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.piece_mul_comm
entries.docstring:
Any two weight pieces of a gauge derivative submodule commute: the gauge sector is
  bosonic, and every piece sits inside the derivative submodule.
entries.snippet:
lemma piece_mul_comm (n : ℕ) (w w' : GaugeWeight) :
    (h.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight n).piece w * (h.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight n).piece w'
      = (h.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight n).piece w' * (h.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight n).piece w
