  Cartan direction and hypercharge.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def neutralCartanPart : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightEight_piece_zero
entries.docstring:
The weight-zero piece at mass weight eight, split into the contributions of the
  three gauge group factors: the twice-differentiated field strength on the four fixed
  directions of the adjoint, joined with the gluon, isospin and neutral parts.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightEight_piece_zero :
    (h.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightEight).piece 0
      = (⨆ (l : Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
          (c : Fin 4),
          ℂ ∙ F l μ ν (stdBasis.coord (cartanIdx c)))
        ⊔ (h.gluonRootPart ⊔ (h.isospinRootPart ⊔ h.neutralCartanPart))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.iSup_span_singleton_le
entries.docstring: A span lies in a submodule as soon as its generators do.
entries.snippet:
lemma iSup_span_singleton_le {ι : Sort*} (T : ι → B) {V : Submodule ℂ B}
    (hV : ∀ i, T i ∈ V) : (⨆ i, ℂ ∙ T i) ≤ V

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.mem_iSup_span₃
entries.docstring: A generator of a family with three indices lies in its span.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_iSup_span₃ {α β γ : Sort*} (T : α → β → γ → B) (a : α) (b : β) (c : γ) :
    T a b c ∈ ⨆ (a) (b) (c), ℂ ∙ T a b c

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.span_stable_of_map_eq_sum
entries.docstring:
A linear map moving each generator to a combination of the generators carries the span
  into itself; the transformation laws of this file all have this shape.
entries.snippet:
lemma span_stable_of_map_eq_sum {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (T : ι → B) (f : B →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    {c : ι → ι → ℂ} (hf : ∀ l, f (T l) = ∑ a, c a l • T a) :
    ∀ y ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range T), f y ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range T)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.map_eq_self_of_mem_iSup_span
entries.docstring: A linear map fixing each generator fixes the span pointwise.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_eq_self_of_mem_iSup_span {ι : Sort*} (T : ι → B) (f : B →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (hf : ∀ i, f (T i) = T i) : ∀ y ∈ ⨆ i, ℂ ∙ T i, f y = y

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton_le
entries.docstring:
The product of two lines lies in a submodule as soon as the product of the two
  generators does.
entries.snippet:
lemma span_singleton_mul_span_singleton_le {a b : B} {V : Submodule ℂ B} (hab : a * b ∈ V) :
    (ℂ ∙ a) * (ℂ ∙ b) ≤ V

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.iSup_span_mul_iSup_span_le
entries.docstring:
The product of two spans lies in a submodule as soon as the products of their
  generators do.
entries.snippet:
lemma iSup_span_mul_iSup_span_le {α β γ α' β' γ' : Sort*} (T : α → β → γ → B)
    (T' : α' → β' → γ' → B) {V : Submodule ℂ B} (hV : ∀ a b c a' b' c', T a b c * T' a' b' c' ∈ V) :
    (⨆ (a) (b) (c), ℂ ∙ T a b c) * (⨆ (a) (b) (c), ℂ ∙ T' a b c) ≤ V

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.sum_mul_sum_eq_sum_pi_two
entries.docstring: A product of two combinations is a combination indexed by pairs.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_mul_sum_eq_sum_pi_two {k : ℕ} (c₀ c₁ : Fin k → ℂ) (X Y : Fin k → B) :
    (∑ a, c₀ a • X a) * ∑ b, c₁ b • Y b
      = ∑ d : Fin 2 → Fin k, (c₀ (d 0) * c₁ (d 1)) • (X (d 0) * Y (d 1))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.map_mul_fixed_eq_sum
entries.docstring:
A multiplicative map moving a family by a matrix and fixing a vector moves the
  products of the family with that vector by the same matrix.

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.map_fixed_mul_eq_sum
entries.docstring: The mirror of `map_mul_fixed_eq_sum` with the fixed vector on the left.

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.repGauge_F_coord
entries.docstring:
The field-strength symbol evaluated on a standard-basis coordinate transforms under
  the gauge group through the column of `adjointMatrix` indexed by that coordinate.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_F_coord (g : GaugeGroupI) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (c : Fin 8 ⊕ Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1) :
    repGauge g (F l μ ν (GaugeAlgebra.stdBasis.coord c))
      = ∑ b, ((GaugeAlgebra.adjointMatrix g b c : ℝ) : ℂ) •
          F l μ ν (GaugeAlgebra.stdBasis.coord b)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.repGauge_gluonField
entries.docstring:
The gluon field strength transforms in the adjoint representation of the `su(3)`
  factor of the gauge group.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_gluonField (g : GaugeGroupI) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (c : Fin 8) :
    repGauge g (h.gluonField l μ ν c)
      = ∑ a : Fin 8, ((su3AdjointMatrix (GaugeGroupI.toSU3 g) a c : ℝ) : ℂ) •
          h.gluonField l μ ν a

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.repGauge_wField
entries.docstring:
The `W`-boson field strength transforms in the adjoint representation of the `su(2)`
  factor of the gauge group.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_wField (g : GaugeGroupI) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (c : Fin 3) :
    repGauge g (h.wField l μ ν c)
      = ∑ i : Fin 3, ((su2AdjointMatrix (GaugeGroupI.toSU2 g) i c : ℝ) : ℂ) •
          h.wField l μ ν i

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.repGauge_hyperchargeField
entries.docstring:
The hypercharge field strength is gauge invariant: the adjoint action of the gauge
  group on the `u(1)` factor of the gauge algebra is trivial.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_hyperchargeField (g : GaugeGroupI) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    repGauge g (h.hyperchargeField l μ ν) = h.hyperchargeField l μ ν

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.repGauge_su3_wField
entries.docstring:
The `W`-boson field strengths are fixed by the colour factor of the gauge group: the
  `su(2)` block of the adjoint matrix reads the isospin factor alone.

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isSU3Adjoint_gluonField
entries.docstring:
The gluon field strengths at fixed derivative slots and covector indices form a family
  of one `su(3)` adjoint index.
entries.snippet:
lemma isSU3Adjoint_gluonField {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    IsSU3Adjoint B repGauge (h.gluonField l μ ν)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isSU2Adjoint_wField
entries.docstring:
The `W`-boson field strengths at fixed derivative slots and covector indices form a
  family of one `su(2)` adjoint index.
entries.snippet:
lemma isSU2Adjoint_wField {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    IsSU2Adjoint B repGauge (h.wField l μ ν)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.EightIdx
entries.docstring:
The index of a product of two underived field strengths: the two covector indices of
  the first factor followed by the two of the second, read as one family of four
  four-vector indices so that the Lorentz classification applies to it.
entries.snippet: abbrev EightIdx : Type

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.gluonPair
entries.docstring:
The product of two underived gluon field strengths at the covector indices `p`, indexed
  by the two `su(3)` adjoint indices it carries.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def gluonPair (p : EightIdx) (a : Fin 2 → Fin 8) : B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.wPair
entries.docstring:
The product of two underived `W`-boson field strengths at the covector indices `p`,
  indexed by the two `su(2)` adjoint indices it carries.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def wPair (p : EightIdx) (a : Fin 2 → Fin 3) : B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.hyperchargePair
entries.docstring:
The product of two underived hypercharge field strengths at the covector indices `p`,
  indexed by the two `u(1)` adjoint indices it carries.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def hyperchargePair (p : EightIdx) (_ : Fin 2 → Fin 1) : B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.hyperchargeDeriv
entries.docstring:
The twice-derived hypercharge field strength at the derivative slots `d 0`, `d 1` and
  the covector indices `d 2`, `d 3`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def hyperchargeDeriv (d : EightIdx) : B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isSU3BiAdjointMat_gluonPair
entries.docstring:
A gauge transformation moves a gluon pair as the `SU(3)` factor of that gauge group
  element moves a tensor with two `su(3)` adjoint indices.
entries.snippet:
lemma isSU3BiAdjointMat_gluonPair (p : EightIdx) (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    IsSU3BiAdjointMat (GaugeGroupI.toSU3 g) (repGauge g) (h.gluonPair p)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isSU3BiAdjoint_gluonPair
entries.docstring: A gluon pair is a bi-adjoint `su(3)` tensor.
entries.snippet: lemma isSU3BiAdjoint_gluonPair (p : EightIdx) : IsSU3BiAdjoint B repGauge (h.gluonPair p)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isSU2BiAdjointMat_wPair
entries.docstring:
A gauge transformation moves a `W`-boson pair as the `SU(2)` factor of that gauge group
  element moves a tensor with two `su(2)` adjoint indices.
entries.snippet:
lemma isSU2BiAdjointMat_wPair (p : EightIdx) (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    IsSU2BiAdjointMat (GaugeGroupI.toSU2 g) (repGauge g) (h.wPair p)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isSU2BiAdjoint_wPair
entries.docstring: A `W`-boson pair is a bi-adjoint `su(2)` tensor.
entries.snippet: lemma isSU2BiAdjoint_wPair (p : EightIdx) : IsSU2BiAdjoint B repGauge (h.wPair p)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isU1BiAdjointMat_hyperchargePair
entries.docstring: A gauge transformation fixes a hypercharge pair, which is the `u(1)` bi-adjoint law.
entries.snippet:
lemma isU1BiAdjointMat_hyperchargePair (p : EightIdx) (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    IsU1BiAdjointMat (GaugeGroupI.toU1 g) (repGauge g) (h.hyperchargePair p)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isU1BiAdjoint_hyperchargePair
entries.docstring: A hypercharge pair is a bi-adjoint `u(1)` tensor.
entries.snippet:
lemma isU1BiAdjoint_hyperchargePair (p : EightIdx) :
    IsU1BiAdjoint B repGauge (h.hyperchargePair p)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.gluonTrace
entries.docstring:
The gluon trace contraction at the covector indices `p`: the Kronecker contraction of
  the two colour indices of the gluon pair.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def gluonTrace (p : EightIdx) : B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.wTrace
entries.docstring: The `W`-boson trace contraction at the covector indices `p`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def wTrace (p : EightIdx) : B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.hyperchargeTrace
entries.docstring: The hypercharge trace contraction at the covector indices `p`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def hyperchargeTrace (p : EightIdx) : B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.gluonTrace_eq
entries.docstring: The gluon trace contraction is the kinetic pairing of two gluon field strengths.
entries.snippet:
lemma gluonTrace_eq (p : EightIdx) :
    h.gluonTrace p
      = ∑ a : Fin 8, h.gluonField ![] (p 0) (p 1) a * h.gluonField ![] (p 2) (p 3) a

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.wTrace_eq
entries.docstring:
The `W`-boson trace contraction is the kinetic pairing of two `W`-boson field
  strengths.
entries.snippet:
lemma wTrace_eq (p : EightIdx) :
    h.wTrace p = ∑ i : Fin 3, h.wField ![] (p 0) (p 1) i * h.wField ![] (p 2) (p 3) i

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.hyperchargeTrace_eq
entries.docstring:
The hypercharge trace contraction is the product of the two hypercharge field
  strengths, the `u(1)` factor being one dimensional.
entries.snippet:
lemma hyperchargeTrace_eq (p : EightIdx) :
    h.hyperchargeTrace p
      = h.hyperchargeField ![] (p 0) (p 1) * h.hyperchargeField ![] (p 2) (p 3)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.repGauge_gluonTrace
entries.docstring: The gluon trace contraction is fixed by the whole gauge group.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_gluonTrace (g : GaugeGroupI) (p : EightIdx) :
    repGauge g (h.gluonTrace p) = h.gluonTrace p

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.repGauge_wTrace
entries.docstring: The `W`-boson trace contraction is fixed by the whole gauge group.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_wTrace (g : GaugeGroupI) (p : EightIdx) :
    repGauge g (h.wTrace p) = h.wTrace p

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.repGauge_hyperchargeTrace
entries.docstring: The hypercharge trace contraction is fixed by the whole gauge group.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_hyperchargeTrace (g : GaugeGroupI) (p : EightIdx) :
    repGauge g (h.hyperchargeTrace p) = h.hyperchargeTrace p

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.repGauge_hyperchargeDeriv
entries.docstring: The twice-derived hypercharge field strength is fixed by the whole gauge group.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_hyperchargeDeriv (g : GaugeGroupI) (d : EightIdx) :
    repGauge g (h.hyperchargeDeriv d) = h.hyperchargeDeriv d

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.F_mem_derivSubmodule
entries.docstring:
Every field-strength symbol lies in the derivative submodule of its own number of
  covariant derivatives.
entries.snippet:
lemma F_mem_derivSubmodule {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) : F l μ ν φ ∈ h.derivSubmodule n

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.F_mem_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring: A field-strength symbol with `n` covariant derivatives has mass weight `2 * (2 + n)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma F_mem_massWeightSubmodule {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) : F l μ ν φ ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule (2 * (2 + n))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.F_mul_F_mem_massWeightSubmodule_eight
entries.docstring: A product of two underived field-strength symbols has mass weight eight.
entries.snippet:
lemma F_mul_F_mem_massWeightSubmodule_eight (μ ν μ' ν' : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ φ' : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    F ![] μ ν φ * F ![] μ' ν' φ' ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule 8

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.gluonTrace_mem_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring: The gluon trace contraction has mass weight eight.
entries.snippet:
lemma gluonTrace_mem_massWeightSubmodule (p : EightIdx) :
    h.gluonTrace p ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule 8

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.wTrace_mem_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring: The `W`-boson trace contraction has mass weight eight.
entries.snippet: lemma wTrace_mem_massWeightSubmodule (p : EightIdx) : h.wTrace p ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule 8

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.hyperchargeTrace_mem_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring: The hypercharge trace contraction has mass weight eight.
entries.snippet:
lemma hyperchargeTrace_mem_massWeightSubmodule (p : EightIdx) :
    h.hyperchargeTrace p ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule 8

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.hyperchargeDeriv_mem_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring: The twice-derived hypercharge field strength has mass weight `2 * (2 + 2)`, eight.
entries.snippet:
lemma hyperchargeDeriv_mem_massWeightSubmodule (d : EightIdx) :
    h.hyperchargeDeriv d ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule 8

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.su3AdjIdx
entries.docstring:
The `su(3)` adjoint weight indices read as weight indices of the whole gauge
  algebra: the three colour roots and the two colour Cartan directions.
entries.snippet:
def su3AdjIdx : GaugeAlgebra.su3WeightIdx → Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 4
  | Sum.inl r => Sum.inl r.castSucc
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inl r) => Sum.inr (Sum.inl r.castSucc)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inr c) => Sum.inr (Sum.inr c.castSucc.castSucc)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.su2AdjIdx
entries.docstring:
The `su(2)` adjoint weight indices read as weight indices of the whole gauge
  algebra: the isospin root and the isospin Cartan direction.
entries.snippet:
def su2AdjIdx : GaugeAlgebra.su2WeightIdx → Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 4
  | Sum.inl _ => Sum.inl 3
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inl _) => Sum.inr (Sum.inl 3)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inr _) => Sum.inr (Sum.inr 2)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.sum_su3WeightCoeff_smul_gluonField
entries.docstring:
A weight vector of the colour part of the adjoint is the matching combination of
  gluon field strengths.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_su3WeightCoeff_smul_gluonField {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (k : GaugeAlgebra.su3WeightIdx) :
    ∑ a : Fin 8, GaugeAlgebra.su3WeightCoeff k a • h.gluonField l μ ν a
      = h.adjVec l μ ν (su3AdjIdx k)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.sum_su2WeightCoeff_smul_wField
entries.docstring:
A weight vector of the isospin part of the adjoint is the matching combination of
  `W`-boson field strengths.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_su2WeightCoeff_smul_wField {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (k : GaugeAlgebra.su2WeightIdx) :
    ∑ i : Fin 3, GaugeAlgebra.su2WeightCoeff k i • h.wField l μ ν i
      = h.adjVec l μ ν (su2AdjIdx k)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.adjVec_mul_adjVec_mem_gluonPair_span
entries.docstring:
A product of two colour weight vectors of the adjoint lies in the span of the matching
  gluon pair family.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjVec_mul_adjVec_mem_gluonPair_span (p : EightIdx)
    (k₀ k₁ : GaugeAlgebra.su3WeightIdx) :
    h.adjVec ![] (p 0) (p 1) (su3AdjIdx k₀) * h.adjVec ![] (p 2) (p 3) (su3AdjIdx k₁)
      ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (h.gluonPair p))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.adjVec_mul_adjVec_mem_wPair_span
entries.docstring:
A product of two isospin weight vectors of the adjoint lies in the span of the matching
  `W`-boson pair family.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjVec_mul_adjVec_mem_wPair_span (p : EightIdx) (k₀ k₁ : GaugeAlgebra.su2WeightIdx) :
    h.adjVec ![] (p 0) (p 1) (su2AdjIdx k₀) * h.adjVec ![] (p 2) (p 3) (su2AdjIdx k₁)
      ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (h.wPair p))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.gluonPairSpan
entries.docstring: The join, over all covector indices, of the spans of the gluon pair families.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def gluonPairSpan : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.wPairSpan
entries.docstring: The join, over all covector indices, of the spans of the `W`-boson pair families.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def wPairSpan : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.gluonRootPart_le_gluonPairSpan
entries.docstring:
The gluon root part of the zero-weight piece, the three products of a colour raising
  vector against the matching lowering vector, lies in the gluon pair spans.
entries.snippet: lemma gluonRootPart_le_gluonPairSpan : h.gluonRootPart ≤ h.gluonPairSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isospinRootPart_le_wPairSpan
entries.docstring:
The isospin root part of the zero-weight piece, the product of the isospin raising
  vector against the lowering vector, lies in the `W`-boson pair spans.
entries.snippet: lemma isospinRootPart_le_wPairSpan : h.isospinRootPart ≤ h.wPairSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.hyperchargeTraceSpan
entries.docstring: The span of the hypercharge trace contractions.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def hyperchargeTraceSpan : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.hyperchargeDerivSpan
entries.docstring: The span of the twice-derived hypercharge field strengths.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def hyperchargeDerivSpan : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.neutralVec
entries.docstring:
The two neutral underived directions that pair with a colour index in the mixed
  neutral products: the isospin Cartan direction and hypercharge.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def neutralVec (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : Fin 2 → B
  | 0 => h.wField ![] μ ν GaugeAlgebra.su2CartanId
  | 1 => h.hyperchargeField ![] μ ν

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.repGauge_su3_neutralVec
entries.docstring: The neutral directions are fixed by the colour factor of the gauge group.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_su3_neutralVec (U : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 3) ℂ) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (j : Fin 2) : repGauge (U, 1, 1) (h.neutralVec μ ν j) = h.neutralVec μ ν j

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.DerivIdx
entries.docstring:
The index of a twice-derived symbol: the two derivative slots and the two covector
  indices.
entries.snippet: abbrev DerivIdx : Type

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.MixIdx
entries.docstring:
The index of a mixed neutral product: the two covector indices of the colour factor,
  the two of the neutral factor, and which of the two neutral directions it is.
entries.snippet: abbrev MixIdx : Type

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.ColourIdx
entries.docstring:
The index of a family carrying one unpaired `su(3)` adjoint index at mass weight
  eight: a twice-derived gluon tower, or an underived gluon field strength against a
  neutral underived factor on either side.
entries.snippet: abbrev ColourIdx : Type

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.colourFamily
entries.docstring: The families carrying one unpaired `su(3)` adjoint index.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def colourFamily : ColourIdx → Fin 8 → B
  | Sum.inl p => h.gluonField p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inl q) =>
      fun a => h.gluonField ![] q.1 q.2.1 a * h.neutralVec q.2.2.1 q.2.2.2.1 q.2.2.2.2
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inr q) =>
      fun a => h.neutralVec q.2.2.1 q.2.2.2.1 q.2.2.2.2 * h.gluonField ![] q.1 q.2.1 a

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isSU3Adjoint_colourFamily
entries.docstring:
Each colour family is an `su(3)` adjoint family: the colour factor moves the gluon
  index and fixes the neutral factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma isSU3Adjoint_colourFamily : ∀ i : ColourIdx, IsSU3Adjoint B repGauge (h.colourFamily i)
  | Sum.inl p => h.isSU3Adjoint_gluonField p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inl q) => IsSU3Adjoint.of_law fun U => map_mul_fixed_eq_sum (hrepGauge_mul _)
      (h.repGauge_gluonField (U, 1, 1) ![] q.1 q.2.1) (h.repGauge_su3_neutralVec U _ _ _)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inr q) => IsSU3Adjoint.of_law fun U => map_fixed_mul_eq_sum (hrepGauge_mul _)
      (h.repGauge_gluonField (U, 1, 1) ![] q.1 q.2.1) (h.repGauge_su3_neutralVec U _ _ _)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.IsospinIdx
entries.docstring:
The index of a family carrying one unpaired `su(2)` adjoint index at mass weight
  eight: a twice-derived `W`-boson tower, or an underived `W`-boson field strength against
  an underived hypercharge field strength on either side.
entries.snippet: abbrev IsospinIdx : Type

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isospinFamily
entries.docstring: The families carrying one unpaired `su(2)` adjoint index.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def isospinFamily : IsospinIdx → Fin 3 → B
  | Sum.inl p => h.wField p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inl q) => fun i => h.wField ![] (q 0) (q 1) i * h.hyperchargeField ![] (q 2) (q 3)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inr q) => fun i => h.hyperchargeField ![] (q 2) (q 3) * h.wField ![] (q 0) (q 1) i

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isSU2Adjoint_isospinFamily
entries.docstring:
Each isospin family is an `su(2)` adjoint family: the isospin factor moves the
  `W`-boson index and fixes hypercharge.
entries.snippet:
lemma isSU2Adjoint_isospinFamily : ∀ i : IsospinIdx, IsSU2Adjoint B repGauge (h.isospinFamily i)
  | Sum.inl p => h.isSU2Adjoint_wField p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inl q) => IsSU2Adjoint.of_law fun U => map_mul_fixed_eq_sum (hrepGauge_mul _)
      (h.repGauge_wField (1, U, 1) ![] (q 0) (q 1)) (h.repGauge_hyperchargeField _ _ _ _)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inr q) => IsSU2Adjoint.of_law fun U => map_fixed_mul_eq_sum (hrepGauge_mul _)
      (h.repGauge_wField (1, U, 1) ![] (q 0) (q 1)) (h.repGauge_hyperchargeField _ _ _ _)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.repGauge_su3_isospinFamily
entries.docstring:
The isospin families are fixed by the colour factor, every one of their factors
  being.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_su3_isospinFamily (U : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 3) ℂ) :
    ∀ (i : IsospinIdx) (a : Fin 3),
      repGauge (U, 1, 1) (h.isospinFamily i a) = h.isospinFamily i a
  | Sum.inl p, a => h.repGauge_su3_wField U p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 a
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inl q), a => by
      simp only [isospinFamily, hrepGauge_mul, h.repGauge_su3_wField, h.repGauge_hyperchargeField]
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inr q), a => by
      simp only [isospinFamily, hrepGauge_mul, h.repGauge_su3_wField, h.repGauge_hyperchargeField]

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.unpairedColourSpan
entries.docstring: The join of the spans of the colour families.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def unpairedColourSpan : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.unpairedIsospinSpan
entries.docstring: The join of the spans of the isospin families.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def unpairedIsospinSpan : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.colourFamily_mem
entries.docstring: A component of a colour family lies in the join of the colour spans.
entries.snippet: lemma colourFamily_mem (i : ColourIdx) (a : Fin 8) : h.colourFamily i a ∈ h.unpairedColourSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isospinFamily_mem
entries.docstring: A component of an isospin family lies in the join of the isospin spans.
entries.snippet:
lemma isospinFamily_mem (i : IsospinIdx) (a : Fin 3) :
    h.isospinFamily i a ∈ h.unpairedIsospinSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.repGauge_su3_of_mem_unpairedIsospinSpan
entries.docstring: The join of the isospin families is fixed pointwise by the colour factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_su3_of_mem_unpairedIsospinSpan (U : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 3) ℂ) :
    ∀ y ∈ h.unpairedIsospinSpan, repGauge (U, 1, 1) y = y

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.colourCartanSpan
entries.docstring:
The colour Cartan directions of the underived tower: the two weight-zero directions of
  the `su(3)` factor.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def colourCartanSpan : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.neutralSpan
entries.docstring:
The neutral directions of the underived tower: the isospin Cartan direction and
  hypercharge.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def neutralSpan : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.adjVec_colourCartan
entries.docstring:
A colour Cartan weight vector is the gluon field strength on the matching Cartan
  direction of `su(3)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjVec_colourCartan {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (c : Fin 2) :
    h.adjVec l μ ν (Sum.inr (Sum.inr c.castSucc.castSucc))
      = h.gluonField l μ ν (GaugeAlgebra.su3CartanId c)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.cartanSpan_le
entries.docstring:
The weight-zero directions of the adjoint are the colour Cartan directions and the
  neutral directions.
entries.snippet: lemma cartanSpan_le : h.cartanSpan ≤ h.colourCartanSpan ⊔ h.neutralSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.colourCartanSpan_mul_colourCartanSpan_le
entries.docstring: A product of two colour Cartan directions is a component of a gluon pair family.
entries.snippet:
lemma colourCartanSpan_mul_colourCartanSpan_le :
    h.colourCartanSpan * h.colourCartanSpan ≤ h.gluonPairSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.colourCartanSpan_mul_neutralSpan_le
entries.docstring:
A colour Cartan direction against a neutral direction is a component of a colour
  family.
entries.snippet:
lemma colourCartanSpan_mul_neutralSpan_le :
    h.colourCartanSpan * h.neutralSpan ≤ h.unpairedColourSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.neutralSpan_mul_colourCartanSpan_le
entries.docstring:
A neutral direction against a colour Cartan direction is a component of a colour
  family.
entries.snippet:
lemma neutralSpan_mul_colourCartanSpan_le :
    h.neutralSpan * h.colourCartanSpan ≤ h.unpairedColourSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.neutralSpan_mul_neutralSpan_le
entries.docstring:
A product of two neutral directions: isospin against isospin is a component of a
  `W`-boson pair family, hypercharge against hypercharge is a hypercharge trace
  contraction, and the two mixed products are components of isospin families.
entries.snippet:
lemma neutralSpan_mul_neutralSpan_le :
    h.neutralSpan * h.neutralSpan
      ≤ h.unpairedIsospinSpan ⊔ (h.wPairSpan ⊔ h.hyperchargeTraceSpan)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.neutralCartanPart_le
entries.docstring:
The neutral part of the zero-weight piece: the products pairing a factor with itself
  are components of the pair families or hypercharge trace contractions, and the mixed
  products carry an unpaired non-abelian index.
entries.snippet:
lemma neutralCartanPart_le :
    h.neutralCartanPart ≤ (h.unpairedColourSpan ⊔ h.unpairedIsospinSpan)
      ⊔ (h.gluonPairSpan ⊔ (h.wPairSpan ⊔ h.hyperchargeTraceSpan))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.derivCartanSpan_le
entries.docstring:
The twice-derived symbols on the weight-zero directions: on a colour or isospin Cartan
  direction a component of an adjoint family, on hypercharge a twice-derived hypercharge
  field strength.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivCartanSpan_le :
    (⨆ (l : Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (c : Fin 4),
        ℂ ∙ F l μ ν (GaugeAlgebra.stdBasis.coord (GaugeAlgebra.cartanIdx c)))
      ≤ (h.unpairedColourSpan ⊔ h.unpairedIsospinSpan) ⊔ h.hyperchargeDerivSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightEight_piece_zero_le
entries.docstring:
The zero-weight piece of mass weight eight is bounded by the joins of the unpaired
  families together with the pair spans, the hypercharge trace contractions and the
  twice-derived hypercharge field strengths.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightEight_piece_zero_le :
    (h.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightEight).piece 0
      ≤ (h.unpairedColourSpan ⊔ h.unpairedIsospinSpan)
        ⊔ (h.gluonPairSpan
          ⊔ (h.wPairSpan ⊔ (h.hyperchargeTraceSpan ⊔ h.hyperchargeDerivSpan)))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.reducesInvariantsTo_unpaired
entries.docstring:
The joins of the unpaired families reduce to `⊥` for the gauge group: the colour
  families for the colour factor, with the colour-fixed isospin join kept in the target, and
  then the isospin families for the isospin factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_unpaired :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : GaugeGroupI => repGauge g)
      (h.unpairedColourSpan ⊔ h.unpairedIsospinSpan) ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.gluonTraceSpan
entries.docstring: The span of the gluon trace contractions.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def gluonTraceSpan : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.wTraceSpan
entries.docstring: The span of the `W`-boson trace contractions.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def wTraceSpan : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.traceContractionEightSpan
entries.docstring:
The span of the three underived trace contractions, over all covector indices: the
  gauge invariants of mass weight eight that the bi-adjoint classification produces.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def traceContractionEightSpan : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isStableUnder_gluonPairSpan
entries.docstring: The gluon pair spans are stable under the gauge group.
entries.snippet:
lemma isStableUnder_gluonPairSpan :
    IsStableUnder (fun g : GaugeGroupI => repGauge g) h.gluonPairSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isStableUnder_wPairSpan
entries.docstring: The `W`-boson pair spans are stable under the gauge group.
entries.snippet:
lemma isStableUnder_wPairSpan :
    IsStableUnder (fun g : GaugeGroupI => repGauge g) h.wPairSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.repGauge_of_mem_hyperchargeTraceSpan
entries.docstring: The hypercharge trace contractions are fixed pointwise by the gauge group.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_of_mem_hyperchargeTraceSpan (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    ∀ y ∈ h.hyperchargeTraceSpan, repGauge g y = y

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.repGauge_of_mem_hyperchargeDerivSpan
entries.docstring:
The twice-derived hypercharge field strengths are fixed pointwise by the gauge
  group.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGauge_of_mem_hyperchargeDerivSpan (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    ∀ y ∈ h.hyperchargeDerivSpan, repGauge g y = y

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.traceContractionEightSpan_sup_hyperchargeDerivSpan_le
entries.docstring:
The gauge span is a space of gauge invariants of mass weight eight: each generator is
  fixed by the gauge group and has mass weight eight by section C. This is the converse of
  the classification.
entries.snippet:
lemma traceContractionEightSpan_sup_hyperchargeDerivSpan_le :
    h.traceContractionEightSpan ⊔ h.hyperchargeDerivSpan
      ≤ h.massWeightSubmodule 8 ⊓ repGauge.invariants

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isFixedBy_traceContractionEightSpan_sup
entries.docstring: The gauge span is fixed pointwise by the gauge group.
entries.snippet:
lemma isFixedBy_traceContractionEightSpan_sup :
    IsFixedBy (fun g : GaugeGroupI => repGauge g)
      (h.traceContractionEightSpan ⊔ h.hyperchargeDerivSpan)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.reducesInvariantsTo_gluonPairSpan
entries.docstring:
The gluon pair spans reduce, for the gauge group, to the gluon trace contractions: each
  gluon pair family is bi-adjoint for the colour factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_gluonPairSpan :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : GaugeGroupI => repGauge g) h.gluonPairSpan h.gluonTraceSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.reducesInvariantsTo_wPairSpan
entries.docstring:
The `W`-boson pair spans reduce, for the gauge group, to the `W`-boson trace
  contractions: each `W`-boson pair family is bi-adjoint for the isospin factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_wPairSpan :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : GaugeGroupI => repGauge g) h.wPairSpan h.wTraceSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.reducesInvariantsTo_traceContractionEightSpan_sup
entries.docstring:
Mass weight eight reduces, for the gauge group, to the three underived trace
  contractions and the twice-derived hypercharge field strengths. The torus puts a gauge
  invariant in the zero-weight piece; of the parts bounding it, the unpaired joins reduce to
  `⊥`, the pair spans to their trace contractions, and the hypercharge spans are already
  fixed.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_traceContractionEightSpan_sup :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : GaugeGroupI => repGauge g) (h.massWeightSubmodule 8)
      (h.traceContractionEightSpan ⊔ h.hyperchargeDerivSpan)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.repLorentz_F_underived
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz transformation of an underived field-strength symbol: the general law of
  `IsGaugeSector` at no covariant derivatives, where the sum over the derivative slots is
  a single term, written with the two covector rotations gathered into one coefficient.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_F_underived (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    repLorentz Λ (F ![] μ ν φ)
      = ∑ a : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3,
        ((((SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 a μ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          (((SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 b ν : ℝ) : ℂ)) • F ![] a b φ

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.sum_mul_sum_eq_sum_pi_four
entries.docstring: A product of two double combinations is a combination indexed by quadruples.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_mul_sum_eq_sum_pi_four (c c' : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ)
    (X Y : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) :
    (∑ a, ∑ b, c a b • X a b) * (∑ x, ∑ y, c' x y • Y x y)
      = ∑ d : Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3,
        (c (d 0) (d 1) * c' (d 2) (d 3)) • (X (d 0) (d 1) * Y (d 2) (d 3))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isLorentzCovariant_F_mul
entries.docstring:
A product of two underived field-strength symbols, viewed as a family indexed by the
  four covector indices it carries, is a quadruple Lorentz tensor.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzCovariant_F_mul (φ ψ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    IsLorentzCovariant 4 B repLorentz (ofComponents
      fun d : Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 => F ![] (d 0) (d 1) φ * F ![] (d 2) (d 3) ψ)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isLorentzCovariant_sum
entries.docstring:
A finite sum of quadruple Lorentz tensors is a quadruple Lorentz tensor: the
  transformation law is linear in the family.

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isLorentzCovariant_of_eq_sum
entries.docstring:
A family of four four-vector indices whose members are sums of products of two
  underived field-strength symbols is a quadruple Lorentz tensor.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzCovariant_of_eq_sum {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] {T : EightIdx → B}
    (φ : ι → Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra)
    (hT : ∀ d, T d = ∑ i, F ![] (d 0) (d 1) (φ i) * F ![] (d 2) (d 3) (φ i)) :
    IsLorentzCovariant 4 B repLorentz (ofComponents T)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isLorentzCovariant_gluonTrace
entries.docstring:
The gluon trace contractions, read as a family of four four-vector indices, form a
  quadruple Lorentz tensor: a sum over the colour index of products of two underived
  field-strength symbols.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzCovariant_gluonTrace :
    IsLorentzCovariant 4 B repLorentz (ofComponents h.gluonTrace)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isLorentzCovariant_wTrace
entries.docstring: The `W`-boson trace contractions form a quadruple Lorentz tensor.
entries.snippet: lemma isLorentzCovariant_wTrace : IsLorentzCovariant 4 B repLorentz (ofComponents h.wTrace)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isLorentzCovariant_hyperchargeTrace
entries.docstring: The hypercharge trace contractions form a quadruple Lorentz tensor.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzCovariant_hyperchargeTrace :
    IsLorentzCovariant 4 B repLorentz (ofComponents h.hyperchargeTrace)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isLorentzCovariant_hyperchargeDeriv
entries.docstring:
The twice-derived hypercharge field strengths, read as a family of four four-vector
  indices, form a quadruple Lorentz tensor: the two derivative slots and the two covector
  indices all rotate. This is the second shape of mass weight eight.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzCovariant_hyperchargeDeriv :
    IsLorentzCovariant 4 B repLorentz (ofComponents h.hyperchargeDeriv)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.gluonTrace_comp_swap_two_three
entries.docstring:
The gluon trace contractions are antisymmetric in the last two covector indices, by
  `F_antisymm` in the second factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma gluonTrace_comp_swap_two_three (d : EightIdx) :
    h.gluonTrace (d ∘ Equiv.swap 2 3) = -h.gluonTrace d

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.wTrace_comp_swap_two_three
entries.docstring: The `W`-boson trace contractions are antisymmetric in the last two covector indices.
entries.snippet:
lemma wTrace_comp_swap_two_three (d : EightIdx) :
    h.wTrace (d ∘ Equiv.swap 2 3) = -h.wTrace d

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.hyperchargeTrace_comp_swap_two_three
entries.docstring: The hypercharge trace contractions are antisymmetric in the last two covector indices.
entries.snippet:
lemma hyperchargeTrace_comp_swap_two_three (d : EightIdx) :
    h.hyperchargeTrace (d ∘ Equiv.swap 2 3) = -h.hyperchargeTrace d

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.hyperchargeDeriv_comp_swap_two_three
entries.docstring:
The twice-derived hypercharge field strengths are antisymmetric in their two covector
  indices, the last two slots, by `F_antisymm` at two covariant derivatives. Nothing is
  assumed about the two derivative slots.
entries.snippet:
lemma hyperchargeDeriv_comp_swap_two_three (d : EightIdx) :
    h.hyperchargeDeriv (d ∘ Equiv.swap 2 3) = -h.hyperchargeDeriv d

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.quadContractionSpan
entries.docstring:
The span of the four Lorentz contractions of a quadruple Lorentz tensor: the images of
  the three metric pairings and of the Levi-Civita symbol.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def quadContractionSpan (T : (Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.quadContractionSpan_le_span
entries.docstring:
The span of the four Lorentz contractions of a quadruple Lorentz family lies in the
  span of its components: each contraction is a combination of components with constant
  coefficients.
entries.snippet:
lemma quadContractionSpan_le_span {T : (Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B} :
    quadContractionSpan T ≤ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range T)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.quadContractionSpan_le_lorentzInvariants
entries.docstring:
The span of the four Lorentz contractions of a quadruple Lorentz family is a space of
  Lorentz invariants, the four contractions being invariant by `RankFour`.

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.quadContractionSpan_eq_of_antisymm
entries.docstring:
For a quadruple family antisymmetric in its last two slots the four Lorentz contractions
  reduce to two, the `(0,2)(1,3)` metric contraction and the Levi-Civita one: the
  `(0,1)(2,3)` metric contraction vanishes and the `(0,3)(1,2)` one is minus the
  `(0,2)(1,3)` one.

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan
entries.docstring:
The span of the four Lorentz contractions of each of the three underived
  trace-contraction families and of the twice-derived hypercharge family: the gauge and
  Lorentz invariants of mass weight eight that the two classifications together produce.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def lorentzContractionEightSpan : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan_le_traceContractionEightSpan_sup
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz contraction span sits inside the gauge span: each of its four blocks is
  spanned by the four contractions of a quadruple Lorentz family whose components generate
  the matching block of the gauge span.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzContractionEightSpan_le_traceContractionEightSpan_sup :
    h.lorentzContractionEightSpan ≤ h.traceContractionEightSpan ⊔ h.hyperchargeDerivSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan_le_invariants
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz contraction span is a space of gauge invariants: it lies in the gauge
  span, whose generators the gauge group fixes.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzContractionEightSpan_le_invariants :
    h.lorentzContractionEightSpan ≤ repGauge.invariants

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan_eq
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz contraction span is spanned by eight of its sixteen generators: for each
  family the `(0,2)(1,3)` metric contraction and the Levi-Civita contraction. All four families
  are antisymmetric in their last two slots by `F_antisymm`, which removes the other two
  contractions of each.

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan_le_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring: The Lorentz contraction span lies in the mass-weight eight submodule.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzContractionEightSpan_le_massWeightSubmodule :
    h.lorentzContractionEightSpan ≤ h.massWeightSubmodule 8

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan_le_lorentzInvariants
entries.docstring: The Lorentz contraction span is a space of Lorentz invariants.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzContractionEightSpan_le_lorentzInvariants :
    h.lorentzContractionEightSpan ≤ repLorentz.invariants

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isFixedBy_lorentzContractionEightSpan
entries.docstring: The Lorentz contraction span is fixed pointwise by both groups.
entries.snippet:
lemma isFixedBy_lorentzContractionEightSpan :
    IsFixedBy (gaugeLorentzMaps repGauge repLorentz) h.lorentzContractionEightSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.reducesInvariantsTo_lorentzContractionEightSpan
entries.docstring:
The gauge sector at mass weight eight reduces, for the gauge and Lorentz groups
  together, to the four Lorentz contractions of each of the four families. The gauge group
  leaves the trace contractions and the twice-derived hypercharge field strengths; each of
  the four spans is spanned by a quadruple Lorentz tensor and reduces, for the Lorentz
  group, to the span of its four contractions. Two of the four suffice for each family, by
  `lorentzContractionEightSpan_eq`.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_lorentzContractionEightSpan :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (gaugeLorentzMaps repGauge repLorentz) (h.massWeightSubmodule 8)
      h.lorentzContractionEightSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.mem_massWeightSubmodule_eight_sup_and_invariant_iff
entries.docstring:
The gauge classification of mass weight eight as an equivalence: an element of
  `massWeightSubmodule 8 ⊔ S` is gauge invariant exactly when it is a combination of the
  three underived trace contractions and the twice-derived hypercharge field strengths up
  to a gauge-invariant remainder in `S`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmodule_eight_sup_and_invariant_iff (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hS : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, repGauge g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule 8 ⊔ S ∧ ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
      ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g y = y)
          ∧ x - y ∈ h.traceContractionEightSpan ⊔ h.hyperchargeDerivSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.mem_massWeightSubmodule_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff
entries.docstring:
The gauge and Lorentz classification of mass weight eight as an equivalence: an
  element of `massWeightSubmodule 8 ⊔ S` is fixed by both groups exactly when it is a
  combination of the four Lorentz contractions of the four families of section H up to a
  remainder in `S` fixed by both groups. The version with two contractions of each family is
  `mem_massWeightSubmodule_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_reduced`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmodule_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff
    (S : Submodule ℂ B) (hS : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, repGauge g y ∈ S)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule 8 ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
        ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g y = y)
          ∧ (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y)
          ∧ x - y ∈ h.lorentzContractionEightSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.mem_massWeightSubmodule_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_reduced
entries.docstring:
The same equivalence with the eight generators of `lorentzContractionEightSpan_eq`: for
  each of the three underived trace families its `(0,2)(1,3)` metric contraction, of the shape
  `η^{μρ} η^{νσ} F_{μν} F_{ρσ}`, and its Levi-Civita contraction, of the shape
  `ε^{μνρσ} F_{μν} F_{ρσ}`, and for the twice-derived hypercharge field strengths
  `η^{μρ} η^{νσ} ∇_μ ∇_ν B_{ρσ}` and `ε^{μνρσ} ∇_μ ∇_ν B_{ρσ}`. The eight span; they are not
  shown to be independent or nonzero.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmodule_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_reduced
    (S : Submodule ℂ B) (hS : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, repGauge g y ∈ S)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule 8 ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
        ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g y = y)
          ∧ (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y)
          ∧ x - y ∈ Submodule.span ℂ {ofComponents h.gluonTrace (contractionTensor 1),
              ofComponents h.gluonTrace (contractionTensor 3)}
            ⊔ (Submodule.span ℂ {ofComponents h.wTrace (contractionTensor 1),
                ofComponents h.wTrace (contractionTensor 3)}
              ⊔ (Submodule.span ℂ {ofComponents h.hyperchargeTrace (contractionTensor 1),
                  ofComponents h.hyperchargeTrace (contractionTensor 3)}
                ⊔ Submodule.span ℂ {ofComponents h.hyperchargeDeriv (contractionTensor 1),
                  ofComponents h.hyperchargeDeriv (contractionTensor 3)}))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.F_mem_iSup_span_coord
entries.docstring:
A field-strength symbol lies in the span of the twelve symbols evaluated on the
  coordinates of the standard basis of the gauge algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma F_mem_iSup_span_coord {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    F l μ ν φ ∈ ⨆ c : Fin 8 ⊕ Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1,
      ℂ ∙ F l μ ν (GaugeAlgebra.stdBasis.coord c)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.sum_cov_one
entries.docstring: A sum over families of one covector index is a single sum.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_cov_one {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : (Fin 1 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M) :
    ∑ d : Fin 1 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, f d = ∑ x : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, f ![x]

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.sum_cov_three
entries.docstring: A sum over families of three covector indices is a triple sum.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_cov_three {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : (Fin 3 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M) :
    ∑ d : Fin 3 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, f d
      = ∑ x : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, ∑ y : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, ∑ z : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, f ![x, y, z]

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isLorentzCovariant_F_underived
entries.docstring:
An underived field-strength symbol, viewed as a family indexed by its two covector
  indices, is a bi-Lorentz tensor.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzCovariant_F_underived (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    IsLorentzCovariant 2 B repLorentz
      (ofComponents fun d : Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 => F ![] (d 0) (d 1) φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.isLorentzCovariant_F_deriv_one
entries.docstring:
A once-derived field-strength symbol, viewed as a family indexed by its derivative
  slot and its two covector indices, is a triple Lorentz tensor.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzCovariant_F_deriv_one (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    IsLorentzCovariant 3 B repLorentz
      (ofComponents fun d : Fin 3 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 => F ![d 0] (d 1) (d 2) φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.ofComponents_metric_eq_zero_of_antisymm
entries.docstring:
The metric trace of a bi-Lorentz family antisymmetric in its two indices vanishes:
  the metric is diagonal, and the diagonal components of such a family are zero.

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.mem_of_lorentz_invariant_biSup_rankTwo_span
entries.docstring:
A finite join of the spans of bi-Lorentz families with vanishing metric traces carries
  no Lorentz invariant modulo a Lorentz-stable submodule: a Lorentz invariant of the join
  together with `S` lies in `S`. Each span reduces to the line through its metric
  contraction, which is zero, and `ReducesInvariantsTo.biSup` combines the reductions.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_lorentz_invariant_biSup_rankTwo_span {ι : Type} [DecidableEq ι]
    {T : ι → (Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B}
    (hT : ∀ i, IsLorentzCovariant 2 B repLorentz (ofComponents (T i)))
    (hzero : ∀ i, ofComponents (T i) RankTwo.metric = 0) (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hS : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (s : Finset ι) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ (⨆ i ∈ s, Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (T i))) ⊔ S)
    (hinv : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) : x ∈ S

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.mem_of_lorentz_invariant_biSup_rankThree_span
entries.docstring:
A finite join of the spans of triple Lorentz families carries no Lorentz invariant
  modulo a Lorentz-stable submodule: three covector indices carry no invariant contraction
  at all, so each span reduces to `⊥`, and `ReducesInvariantsTo.biSup` combines the
  reductions.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_lorentz_invariant_biSup_rankThree_span {ι : Type} [DecidableEq ι]
    {T : ι → (Fin 3 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B}
    (hT : ∀ i, IsLorentzCovariant 3 B repLorentz (ofComponents (T i)))
    (S : Submodule ℂ B) (hS : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (s : Finset ι)
    {x : B} (hx : x ∈ (⨆ i ∈ s, Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (T i))) ⊔ S)
    (hinv : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) : x ∈ S

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.iSup_eq_biSup_univ
entries.docstring: A join over a finite index type is the join over its universal finite set.
entries.snippet:
lemma iSup_eq_biSup_univ {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → Submodule ℂ B) :
    ⨆ i, f i = ⨆ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι), f i

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.ofComponents_F_underived_metric_eq_zero
entries.docstring:
The metric trace of the underived field-strength symbols at a fixed direction of the
  gauge algebra vanishes, the symbol being antisymmetric in its two covector indices.
entries.snippet:
lemma ofComponents_F_underived_metric_eq_zero (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    ofComponents (fun d : Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 => F ![] (d 0) (d 1) φ) RankTwo.metric = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.derivSubmodule_zero_le_iSup_span
entries.docstring:
The underived field strengths lie in the join, over the twelve directions of the
  standard basis of the gauge algebra, of the spans of the bi-Lorentz families they
  form.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_zero_le_iSup_span :
    h.derivSubmodule 0 ≤ ⨆ c : Fin 8 ⊕ Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1,
      Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun d : Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 =>
        F ![] (d 0) (d 1) (GaugeAlgebra.stdBasis.coord c))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.mem_of_lorentz_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_four_sup
entries.docstring:
Mass weight four carries no Lorentz invariant modulo a Lorentz-stable submodule: a
  Lorentz invariant of `massWeightSubmodule 4 ⊔ S` lies in `S`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_lorentz_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_four_sup (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule 4 ⊔ S)
    (hinv : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) : x ∈ S

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.etaExpand_cov_one
entries.docstring: A family of one covector index is the tuple of its own entry.
entries.snippet: lemma etaExpand_cov_one (l : Fin 1 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : ![l 0] = l

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.derivSubmodule_one_le_iSup_span
entries.docstring:
The once-derived field strengths lie in the join, over the twelve directions of the
  standard basis of the gauge algebra, of the spans of the triple Lorentz families they
  form.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_one_le_iSup_span :
    h.derivSubmodule 1 ≤ ⨆ c : Fin 8 ⊕ Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1,
      Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun d : Fin 3 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 =>
        F ![d 0] (d 1) (d 2) (GaugeAlgebra.stdBasis.coord c))

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.mem_of_lorentz_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_six_sup
entries.docstring:
Mass weight six carries no Lorentz invariant modulo a Lorentz-stable submodule: a
  Lorentz invariant of `massWeightSubmodule 6 ⊔ S` lies in `S`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_lorentz_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_six_sup (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule 6 ⊔ S)
    (hinv : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) : x ∈ S

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.mem_of_lorentz_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_lt_eight_sup
entries.docstring:
Between mass weight zero and mass weight eight there is no Lorentz invariant: a
  Lorentz invariant of `massWeightSubmodule w ⊔ S` for `0 < w < 8` lies in `S`. The five
  odd or small weights are trivial submodules, and weights four and six are sections F
  and G.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_lorentz_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_lt_eight_sup (w : ℕ) (hw0 : 0 < w)
    (hw : w < 8) (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule w ⊔ S)
    (hinv : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) : x ∈ S

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.mem_massWeightSubmodule_lt_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff
entries.docstring:
The classification below mass weight eight as an equivalence, in the shape of
  `mem_massWeightSubmodule_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff`: an element of
  `massWeightSubmodule w ⊔ S` for `0 < w < 8` is fixed by both groups exactly when it is
  itself an element of `S` fixed by both groups. The span of invariants that the weight
  eight statement leaves over is here the trivial one, so `x - y` lies in it exactly when
  `x = y`. Gauge stability of `S` is not needed, and neither is gauge invariance of `x`:
  the forward direction is
  `mem_of_lorentz_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_lt_eight_sup`, which uses the Lorentz
  group alone.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmodule_lt_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff (w : ℕ)
    (hw0 : 0 < w) (hw : w < 8) (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule w ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
        ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g y = y)
          ∧ (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y)
          ∧ x = y

entries.name: StandardModel.IsGaugeSector.mem_massWeightSubmodule_lt_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_mem
entries.docstring:
The same classification without the existential: below mass weight eight an element
  of `massWeightSubmodule w ⊔ S` fixed by both groups is an element of `S` fixed by both
  groups, and conversely.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmodule_lt_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_mem (w : ℕ)
    (hw0 : 0 < w) (hw : w < 8) (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule w ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
        ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ (x ∈ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGauge g x = x)
          ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.algebraRealization_fieldAlgebra_eq_top
entries.docstring:
The fields of the Standard Model generate its jet algebra: the field algebra of the
  instance is the whole of `JetAlgebra`.
entries.snippet: lemma algebraRealization_fieldAlgebra_eq_top : AlgebraRealization.id.fieldAlgebra = ⊤

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.massWeightSubmodule_eq_ker
entries.docstring:
When the field algebra is everything the graded piece of mass weight `n` is the
  weight-`n` eigenspace of `massWeightPoly` on the whole algebra: the intersection with the
  field algebra in the definition of `massWeightSubmodule` cuts nothing away.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_eq_ker (htop : h.fieldAlgebra = ⊤) (n : ℕ) :
    h.massWeightSubmodule n
      = LinearMap.ker (massWeightPoly.toLinearMap
        - (Polynomial.monomial n : B →ₗ[B] Polynomial B).restrictScalars ℂ)

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.massWeightSubmoduleLE_eq_iSup_ker
entries.docstring:
When the field algebra is everything the filtration by mass weight at most `w` is the
  join of the eigenspaces of `massWeightPoly` of weight `0` through `w`, taken over the
  whole algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmoduleLE_eq_iSup_ker (htop : h.fieldAlgebra = ⊤) (w : ℕ) :
    h.massWeightSubmoduleLE w
      = ⨆ k ∈ Finset.range (w + 1), LinearMap.ker (massWeightPoly.toLinearMap
          - (Polynomial.monomial k : B →ₗ[B] Polynomial B).restrictScalars ℂ)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring:
The weight-`n` piece of the jet algebra, defined on the algebra itself: the eigenspace
  on which `massWeightPoly` is the monomial `X ^ n`. Nothing about `AlgebraRealization` enters
  the definition; that it agrees with the instance's graded piece is
  `algebraRealization_massWeightSubmodule`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def massWeightSubmodule (n : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ JetAlgebra where

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.mem_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring: Membership of the weight-`n` piece is the eigenvalue equation.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma mem_massWeightSubmodule {n : ℕ} {x : JetAlgebra} :
    x ∈ massWeightSubmodule n ↔ massWeightPoly x = Polynomial.monomial n x

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.massWeightSubmoduleLE
entries.docstring:
The mass-weight filtration of the jet algebra, defined on the algebra itself: the join
  of the weight pieces of weight at most `w`. An element lies in it exactly when it is a
  sum of eigenvectors of `massWeightPoly` of weight at most `w`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def massWeightSubmoduleLE (w : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ JetAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.algebraRealization_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring:
The graded piece defined on the jet algebra is the graded piece of the instance: the
  two differ only by the intersection with the field algebra, which is everything.
entries.snippet:
lemma algebraRealization_massWeightSubmodule (n : ℕ) :
    AlgebraRealization.id.massWeightSubmodule n = massWeightSubmodule n

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.mem_submodule_congr
entries.docstring:
Membership of two equal submodules of the jet algebra agree. It is stated at variable
  endpoints so that the substitution never abstracts a pattern out of a goal mentioning the
  jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
private lemma mem_submodule_congr {S T : Submodule ℂ JetAlgebra} (h : S = T)
    (x : JetAlgebra) : x ∈ S ↔ x ∈ T

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.algebraRealization_massWeightSubmoduleLE
entries.docstring: The filtration defined on the jet algebra is the filtration of the instance.
entries.snippet:
lemma algebraRealization_massWeightSubmoduleLE (w : ℕ) :
    AlgebraRealization.id.massWeightSubmoduleLE w = massWeightSubmoduleLE w

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.mem_massWeightSubmoduleLE_eight_and_invariant_iff_lagrangian
entries.docstring:
The invariant content of the Standard Model up to mass dimension four, on the jet
  algebra of the Standard Model itself, with nothing set aside. An element of mass weight
  at most eight is fixed by the jet gauge group and by the Lorentz group exactly when it is
  a combination of the constant term, the Higgs mass term `H† H`, and the dimension-four
  span: the Lorentz contractions of the gauge sector, among them the gauge kinetic and theta
  terms (`IsGaugeSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan`), the Higgs kinetic term, quartic potential
  and box terms (`HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.lorentzContractionEightSpan`),
    the fermion kinetic terms
  (`IsFermionSector.kineticSpan`) and the Yukawa couplings (`yukawaSpan`) — and nothing
  else.

  There are no other hypotheses. The mass-weight condition is a condition on `x` alone: by
  `mem_massWeightSubmodule` it says that `x` is a sum of eigenvectors of `massWeightPoly`
  of weight at most eight, with no demand that `x` lie in any subalgebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmoduleLE_eight_and_invariant_iff_lagrangian (x : JetAlgebra) :
    (x ∈ massWeightSubmoduleLE 8
        ∧ (∀ U : JetGaugeGroupI, repJetGaugeGroupI U x = x)
        ∧ ∀ Λ : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentzGroup Λ x = x)
      ↔ x ∈ 1
        ⊔ (AlgebraRealization.id.toCovAlgebraRealization.isHiggsSector.dotSpan 0 0
          ⊔ (AlgebraRealization.id.toCovAlgebraRealization.isGaugeSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan
           ⊔ AlgebraRealization.id.toCovAlgebraRealization.isHiggsSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan
            ⊔ (AlgebraRealization.id.toCovAlgebraRealization.isFermionSector.kineticSpan
              ⊔ AlgebraRealization.id.toCovAlgebraRealization.yukawaSpan)))

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.mem_massWeightSubmoduleLE_eight_sup_and_invariant_iff_lagrangian
entries.docstring:
The same classification as
  `mem_massWeightSubmoduleLE_eight_and_invariant_iff_lagrangian`, with a submodule `S` set
  aside — the operators of mass dimension above four, say. An element of
  `massWeightSubmoduleLE 8 ⊔ S` is fixed by the jet gauge group and the Lorentz group
  exactly when it is the Standard Model Lagrangian, the Higgs mass term and a constant, up
  to a remainder in `S` fixed by both groups.

  The hypothesis `hScov` does not disappear when the field algebra becomes everything: the
  covariant subalgebra `covAlgebra` remains a proper subalgebra, because a covariant
  element is fixed by the pure gauge jets whereas the gauge potential picks up the
  Maurer–Cartan shift. A set-aside `S` therefore still has to be written in the covariant
  towers, which is the case of interest — higher-dimension operators are built from
  covariant derivatives and the field strength.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmoduleLE_eight_sup_and_invariant_iff_lagrangian
    (S : Submodule ℂ JetAlgebra)
    (hS : ∀ U : JetGaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, repJetGaugeGroupI U y ∈ S)
    (hSL : ∀ Λ : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentzGroup Λ y ∈ S)
    (hScov : S ≤ AlgebraRealization.id.covAlgebra.toSubmodule) (x : JetAlgebra) :
    (x ∈ massWeightSubmoduleLE 8 ⊔ S
        ∧ (∀ U : JetGaugeGroupI, repJetGaugeGroupI U x = x)
        ∧ ∀ Λ : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentzGroup Λ x = x)
      ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ U : JetGaugeGroupI, repJetGaugeGroupI U y = y)
          ∧ (∀ Λ : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentzGroup Λ y = y)
          ∧ x - y ∈ 1
          ⊔ (AlgebraRealization.id.toCovAlgebraRealization.isHiggsSector.dotSpan 0 0
          ⊔ (AlgebraRealization.id.toCovAlgebraRealization.isGaugeSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan
           ⊔ AlgebraRealization.id.toCovAlgebraRealization.isHiggsSector.lorentzContractionEightSpan
            ⊔ (AlgebraRealization.id.toCovAlgebraRealization.isFermionSector.kineticSpan
              ⊔ AlgebraRealization.id.toCovAlgebraRealization.yukawaSpan)))

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra
entries.docstring:
The jet algebra of the Standard Model: the local field algebra of the Standard
  Model field datum. A Standard Model Lagrangian is an element of this algebra.
entries.snippet: abbrev JetAlgebra : Type

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.includeFermion
entries.docstring: The inclusion of the fermionic sector.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def includeFermion : FermionJetAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] JetAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.includeHiggs
entries.docstring: The inclusion of the Higgs sector.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def includeHiggs : HiggsJetAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] JetAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.includeGauge
entries.docstring:
The inclusion of the gauge sector. The Standard Model gauge bosons are the generic
  ones at `GaugeAlgebra`, so this is the connection inclusion of the datum itself.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def includeGauge :
    (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra)) →ₐ[ℂ] JetAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.includeGauge_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma includeGauge_apply (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra)) :
    includeGauge y = ((1 : fieldData.MatterAlgebra) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y : JetAlgebra)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.includeFermion_apply_equiv
entries.docstring:
The fermionic sector inclusion factors through the sector equivalence and the generic
  fermionic factor inclusion.
entries.snippet:
lemma includeFermion_apply_equiv (a : FermionJetAlgebra) :
    includeFermion a = fieldData.includeFermion (fermionAlgebraEquiv a)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.includeHiggs_apply_equiv
entries.docstring:
The Higgs sector inclusion factors through the sector equivalence and the generic
  bosonic factor inclusion.
entries.snippet:
lemma includeHiggs_apply_equiv (h : HiggsJetAlgebra) :
    includeHiggs h = fieldData.includeBoson (higgsAlgebraEquiv h)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.includeGauge_eq_includeConnection
entries.docstring: The gauge sector inclusion is the generic connection factor inclusion.
entries.snippet:
lemma includeGauge_eq_includeConnection :
    includeGauge = fieldData.includeConnection

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.includeFermion_ι
entries.docstring:
A degree-one element of the fermionic sector, included, is a total fermionic generator
  of the field datum, read through the fermionic generator identification.
entries.snippet:
lemma includeFermion_ι (v : JetComponentSpace fermionMatterField) :
    includeFermion (ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ v)
      = fieldData.ιFermionTotal (fermionGeneratorsEquiv.symm v)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.includeHiggs_ι
entries.docstring:
A degree-one element of the Higgs sector, included, is the generator of the one bosonic
  species of the field datum.
entries.snippet:
lemma includeHiggs_ι (v : JetComponentSpace HiggsVec.matterField) :
    includeHiggs (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ (JetComponentSpace HiggsVec.matterField) v)
      = fieldData.ιBoson () v

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.includeGauge_one_tmul_ι
entries.docstring:
A real degree-one element of the gauge sector, included, is a connection generator of
  the field datum: the connection factors of the two presentations are the same type, and
  the complexification is the scalar one.
entries.snippet:

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.tensor_includeRight_comm
entries.docstring:
The right factor of a tensor product with a commutative right factor is central:
  the abstract statement, proved by tensor induction at abstract types so that it can be
  instantiated on the jet algebra without rewriting inside it.
entries.snippet:
private lemma tensor_includeRight_comm {A B : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    [CommRing B] [Algebra ℂ B] (y : B) (x : A ⊗[ℂ] B) :
    x * Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := ℂ) (A := A) y
      = Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := ℂ) (A := A) y * x

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.covGenerators_induction
entries.docstring:
A property that holds of every covariant tower holds of every covariant generator:
  the case analysis of the generating set, done once.
entries.snippet:
lemma covGenerators_induction {P : B → Prop}
    (hF : ∀ {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
      (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra), P (h.covF l μ ν φ))
    (hH : ∀ {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ HiggsVec),
      P (h.covDerivH l φ))
    (hBarH : ∀ {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule HiggsVec)),
      P (h.covDerivBarH l φ))
    (hD : ∀ (i : Fin 3) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ DownSinglet), P (h.covDerivD i l φ))
    (hBarD : ∀ (i : Fin 3) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule DownSinglet)), P (h.covDerivBarD i l φ))
    (hU : ∀ (i : Fin 3) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ UpSinglet), P (h.covDerivU i l φ))
    (hBarU : ∀ (i : Fin 3) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule UpSinglet)), P (h.covDerivBarU i l φ))
    (hQ : ∀ (i : Fin 3) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ QuarkDoublet), P (h.covDerivQ i l φ))
    (hBarQ : ∀ (i : Fin 3) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule QuarkDoublet)), P (h.covDerivBarQ i l φ))
    (hL : ∀ (i : Fin 3) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ LeptonDoubletV), P (h.covDerivL i l φ))
    (hBarL : ∀ (i : Fin 3) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule LeptonDoubletV)), P (h.covDerivBarL i l φ))
    (hE : ∀ (i : Fin 3) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ LeptonSinglet), P (h.covDerivE i l φ))
    (hBarE : ∀ (i : Fin 3) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule LeptonSinglet)), P (h.covDerivBarE i l φ)) :
    ∀ x ∈ h.covGenerators, P x

entries.name: StandardModel.CovJetAlgebra.isLorentzCovDerivTransforms_of
entries.docstring:
A Lorentz law of the jet algebra, for a family valued in the covariant jet algebra, is a
  Lorentz law there: the coercion is additive and commutes with scalar multiplication.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzCovDerivTransforms_of {V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    {rep : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) V}
    {G : {n : ℕ} → (Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] CovJetAlgebra}
    (hG : ∀ (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V),
      JetAlgebra.repLorentzGroup Λ ((G l φ : CovJetAlgebra) : JetAlgebra) =
        ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
          (∏ i, (((SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 (p i) (l i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) •
            ((G p (rep.dual Λ φ) : CovJetAlgebra) : JetAlgebra)) :
    IsLorentzCovDerivTransforms repLorentzGroup rep G

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.generators
entries.docstring:
The derivative symbols of every field of the Standard Model: the gauge field, the Higgs
  and its conjugate, and the three generations of each of the five fermion species with
  their conjugates. The set is written in exactly the shape of the body of
  `AlgebraRealization.fieldAlgebra`, so that the field algebra of the eventual
  `AlgebraRealization` instance on the jet algebra is this set adjoined.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def generators : Set JetAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.mem_of_adjoin_eq_top
entries.docstring:
If a set generates an algebra, then every image of that algebra under an algebra map
  lies in any subalgebra of the target containing the image of the generating set. This is
  the step that transports each sector's own generation theorem into the jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
private lemma mem_of_adjoin_eq_top {R A B : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A]
    [Algebra R A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R B] (f : A →ₐ[R] B) {T : Set A}
    (hT : Algebra.adjoin R T = ⊤) {C : Subalgebra R B} (hfT : f '' T ⊆ (C : Set B))
    (x : A) : f x ∈ C

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.mem_adjoin_generators_of_eq
entries.docstring:
Membership in the generated algebra transported along an equation. It is stated at
  variable endpoints so that the substitution never has to abstract a pattern out of a goal
  mentioning the jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
private lemma mem_adjoin_generators_of_eq {x y : JetAlgebra} (h : x = y)
    (hx : x ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ generators) : y ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ generators

lemma higgsField_eq_includeHiggs (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))

    higgsField s φ
      = includeHiggs (BosonicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv s (BosonicAlgebra.ofField φ))

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.iteratedD_complexJetDeriv_tmul
entries.docstring:
The iterated derivative of the complexification acts on a pure tensor through the
  gauge sector's own iterated derivative.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedD_complexJetDeriv_tmul (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (z : ℂ)
    (x : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra)) :
    Lorentz.iteratedD (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexJetDeriv GaugeAlgebra)
        LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexJetDeriv_comm s (z ⊗ₜ[ℝ] x)
      = z ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv GaugeAlgebra) s x

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.includeGaugeReal
entries.docstring:
The real gauge-boson jet algebra inside the jet algebra of the Standard Model: the
  inclusion of the gauge sector precomposed with the inclusion of the real part of the
  complexification. It is a map of `ℝ`-algebras, which is the level at which the gauge
  sector's generation theorem is stated.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def includeGaugeReal : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra) →ₐ[ℝ] JetAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.includeGaugeReal_apply
entries.docstring:
The real gauge inclusion is the gauge inclusion of the pure tensor with complex part
  one.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma includeGaugeReal_apply (x : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra)) :
    includeGaugeReal x = includeGauge ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] x)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.gaugeField_eq_includeGaugeReal
entries.docstring:
A gauge-field symbol is the gauge sector's own derivative symbol, included through the
  real part of the complexification.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeField_eq_includeGaugeReal (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    gaugeField s μ φ
      = includeGaugeReal ((LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv GaugeAlgebra) s
          ((LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.ofA GaugeAlgebra) μ φ))

entries.docstring:
Every element of the real gauge sector lies in the algebra generated by the symbols:
  the gauge-boson jet algebra is generated over `ℝ` by the derivative symbols of the gauge
  field, and those are the gauge family.
entries.snippet:
lemma includeGaugeReal_mem_adjoin_generators (x : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra)) :
    includeGaugeReal x ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ generators

entries.snippet:
lemma includeGauge_mem_adjoin_generators (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra)) :
    includeGauge y ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ generators

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.tensor_tmul_tmul
entries.docstring:
A triple pure tensor is the product of the three factors placed in their own slots:
  the abstract statement, proved at abstract types so that it can be instantiated on the
  jet algebra without rewriting inside it.
entries.snippet:
private lemma tensor_tmul_tmul {A B C : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A] [Ring B]
    [Algebra ℂ B] [Ring C] [Algebra ℂ C] (a : A) (b : B) (c : C) :
    ((a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1 : B)) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1 : C)) * (((1 : A) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1 : C))
        * (((1 : A) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1 : B)) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] c)
      = (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] c

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.includeFermionFactor_mul_includeBosonFactor_mul_includeConnection
entries.docstring:
A pure tensor of the jet algebra is the product of the three factor inclusions applied
  to its factors. The three inclusions are unfolded through the abstract `GaugeFieldData`
  rules, which is what keeps the computation out of the carrier's own instances.
entries.snippet:
lemma includeFermionFactor_mul_includeBosonFactor_mul_includeConnection
    (a : ExteriorAlgebra ℂ fieldData.FermionGenerators)
    (b : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ fieldData.BosonGenerators)
    (c : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra)) :
    fieldData.includeFermion a * fieldData.includeBoson b * fieldData.includeConnection c
      = ((a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] c : JetAlgebra)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.tmul_mem_adjoin_generators

entries.snippet:

    (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra)) :
    (w ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y : JetAlgebra) ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ generators

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.adjoin_generators_eq_top
entries.docstring:
The fields of the Standard Model generate its jet algebra. As a `ℂ`-algebra,
  `JetAlgebra` is adjoined by the derivative symbols of the gauge field, the Higgs and its
  conjugate, and the three generations of each of the five fermion species with their
  conjugates.

  Physically: every element of the algebra in which a Standard Model Lagrangian lives is a
  polynomial in the fields and their spacetime derivatives — nothing else is available to
  write down. Formally it is the statement that the field algebra of the eventual
  `AlgebraRealization` instance on the jet algebra is the whole of it.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjoin_generators_eq_top :
    Algebra.adjoin ℂ generators = (⊤ : Subalgebra ℂ JetAlgebra)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupIFermion
entries.docstring:
The jet gauge action on the fermionic factor: the exterior-algebra functor applied to
  the species-wise action on the fermionic generator space.

noncomputable abbrev repJetGaugeGroupIFermion :
    Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI (ExteriorAlgebra ℂ fieldData.FermionGenerators)

entries.docstring:

  the species-wise action on the bosonic generator space.
