entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI
entries.docstring:
The jet gauge action on the jet algebra of the Standard Model. Matter is acted on
  species by species from `fieldData`; the connection factor carries the generic affine
  `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJet` action of the Standard Model local gauge data.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def repJetGaugeGroupI : Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI JetAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_tmul (U : JetGaugeGroupI)
    (w : ExteriorAlgebra ℂ fieldData.FermionGenerators ⊗[ℂ]
      SymmetricAlgebra ℂ fieldData.BosonGenerators)
    (g : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] _root_.LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI U (w ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g)
      = ((repJetGaugeGroupIFermion.tprod repJetGaugeGroupIBoson) U w)
          ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (_root_.LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJet localGaugeData U g)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_apply_mul
entries.docstring:
The jet gauge action on the jet algebra is multiplicative: a jet of gauge
  transformations acts on a Lagrangian term factor by factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_apply_mul (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (x y : JetAlgebra) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI U (x * y) = repJetGaugeGroupI U x * repJetGaugeGroupI U y

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.complexRepJetGaugeGroupI_apply_one
entries.docstring: The jet gauge action on the complexified gauge sector fixes the unit.
entries.snippet:
lemma complexRepJetGaugeGroupI_apply_one (U : JetGaugeGroupI) :
    (_root_.LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJet localGaugeData) U
      (1 : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra)) = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_matter_one
entries.docstring:
The matter factor of the jet gauge action fixes the unit. The proof instantiates the
  abstract `Representation.tprod_apply_one`, so that the unit of the matter factor is never
  unfolded: its two free algebras are quotients by congruences.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_matter_one (U : JetGaugeGroupI) :
    (repJetGaugeGroupIFermion.tprod repJetGaugeGroupIBoson) U
        (1 : fieldData.MatterAlgebra) = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_includeConnection
entries.docstring:
The jet gauge action restricts to the generic connection factor, where it is the
  generic affine action of the Standard Model local gauge data.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_includeConnection (U : JetGaugeGroupI)
    (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] _root_.LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI U (fieldData.includeConnection y)
      = fieldData.includeConnection
          (_root_.LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJet localGaugeData U y)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_includeFermionFactor
entries.docstring:
The jet gauge action restricts to the fermionic factor, where it is the
  exterior-algebra functor applied to the species-wise action of the datum. The factor
  inclusions are unfolded through the generic `GaugeFieldData` rules rather than by `rfl`:
  at the Standard Model datum the definitional unfolding of the units has to see through
  the unexposed ring congruence of the symmetric algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_includeFermionFactor (U : JetGaugeGroupI)
    (a : ExteriorAlgebra ℂ fieldData.FermionGenerators) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI U (fieldData.includeFermion a)
      = fieldData.includeFermion (repJetGaugeGroupIFermion U a)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_includeGauge
entries.docstring:
The jet gauge action restricts to the gauge sector's own action. The gauge sector
  inclusion is the connection inclusion of the datum, the Standard Model gauge bosons being
  the generic ones at `GaugeAlgebra`.
entries.snippet:

    (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra)) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI U (includeGauge y)
      = includeGauge (_root_.LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJet localGaugeData U y)

entries.docstring: The jet gauge action restricts to the fermionic sector's own action.

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_includeHiggs

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.tensor_left_comm_right
entries.docstring:
The right factor of a tensor product commutes with the left: the abstract statement,
  proved at abstract types so that it can be instantiated on the jet algebra without
  rewriting inside it.
entries.snippet:
private lemma tensor_left_comm_right {A B C : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    [Ring B] [Algebra ℂ B] [Ring C] [Algebra ℂ C] (a : A) (b : B) :
    (((1 : A) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1 : C)) * ((a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1 : B)) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1 : C))
      = ((a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1 : B)) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1 : C)) * (((1 : A) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1 : C))

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.MemHiggsSector.commute_of_memFermionSector
entries.docstring:
An element of the Higgs sector commutes with an element of the fermionic sector: they
  sit in different factors of the tensor product, so their product is the same pure tensor
  in either order. This is the statement that the Higgs is a boson — it carries no
  statistics against the fermions.
entries.snippet:
lemma MemHiggsSector.commute_of_memFermionSector {x y : JetAlgebra}
    (hx : MemHiggsSector x) (hy : MemFermionSector y) : Commute x y

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.IsFermionGenerator

  fermionic inclusion, of a degree-one element of the fermionic jet algebra. Every one of
  the ten fermion families consists of such elements, by the reductions of section B.3.
entries.snippet: def IsFermionGenerator (x : JetAlgebra) : Prop

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.IsFermionGenerator.anticomm
entries.docstring:
Two fermionic generators anticommute: they are degree-one elements of an exterior
  algebra, pushed through an algebra map. This single fact is the Fermi statistics of every
  matter symbol of the Standard Model, across species and generations alike.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsFermionGenerator.anticomm {x y : JetAlgebra} (hx : IsFermionGenerator x)
    (hy : IsFermionGenerator y) : x * y = -(y * x)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.gaugeField
entries.docstring:
The gauge-field derivative symbols of the jet algebra of the Standard Model: the
  gauge sector's symbols, included into the full algebra. It is written as a composite of
  two existing linear maps rather than as an anonymous constructor, so that its real
  linearity is inherited rather than proved by rewriting inside the jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def gaugeField (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] JetAlgebra

    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    gaugeField s μ φ = includeGauge ((LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.gaugeField GaugeAlgebra) s μ φ)

The gauge-field symbols `∂_s A_μ^φ` are the connection generators of the field datum:
  the derivative label, the spacetime index and the adjoint covector are unchanged, and the
  real generator enters the complexification with the scalar one.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeField_eq_ιConnection (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    gaugeField s μ φ
      = fieldData.ιConnection (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset s ⊗ₜ[ℝ]
          GaugeBoson.componentDual GaugeAlgebra
            (Lorentz.CoVector.basis.dualBasis μ) φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.invariant_mem_adjoin_fieldStrength
entries.docstring:
**The classification of gauge invariants of the jet algebra of the Standard Model**:
  a gauge-invariant element of the subalgebra generated by the gauge-field symbols
  `∂_s A_μ^φ` and a set `S` of elements fixed by the pure jets — such as the covariant
  towers of the fermion and Higgs fields — is a polynomial in the covariant derivatives
  of the field strength and the elements of `S`.

  This is the covariance reduction of the Standard Model jet algebra: gauge invariance
  eliminates the bare gauge-field symbols in favour of the field strength, its covariant
  derivatives, and the matter content `S`.
entries.snippet:
lemma invariant_mem_adjoin_fieldStrength (S : Set JetAlgebra)
    (hS : ∀ y ∈ S, ∀ U : localGaugeData.truncationKer 0, repJetGaugeGroupI U.1 y = y)
    {x : JetAlgebra}
    (hx : x ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ ({b : JetAlgebra |
      ∃ (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
        (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra),
      b = gaugeField p μ φ} ∪ S))
    (hinv : ∀ U : JetGaugeGroupI, repJetGaugeGroupI U x = x) :
    x ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ ({b : JetAlgebra |
      ∃ (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ν lam : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
        (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra),
      b = GaugeAlgebraRealization.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint gaugeField l
        (GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength gaugeField ν lam) 0 φ} ∪ S)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.jetDerivFermionFactor
entries.docstring:
The total derivative on the fermionic factor: the even derivation of the exterior
  algebra extending the derivative shift on the fermionic generator space of the datum.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable abbrev jetDerivFermionFactor (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    ExteriorAlgebra ℂ fieldData.FermionGenerators →ₗ[ℂ]
      ExteriorAlgebra ℂ fieldData.FermionGenerators

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.jetDerivBosonFactor
entries.docstring:
The total derivative on the bosonic factor: the derivation of the symmetric algebra
  extending the derivative shift on the bosonic generator space of the datum.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable abbrev jetDerivBosonFactor (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    SymmetricAlgebra ℂ fieldData.BosonGenerators →ₗ[ℂ]
      SymmetricAlgebra ℂ fieldData.BosonGenerators

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
**The formal total derivative on the jet algebra of the Standard Model**: the sum of
  the total derivatives of the three factors, each acting on its own factor.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def jetDeriv (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : JetAlgebra →ₗ[ℂ] JetAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_tmul (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (f : ExteriorAlgebra ℂ fieldData.FermionGenerators)
    (h : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ fieldData.BosonGenerators)
    (g : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] _root_.LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra) :
    jetDeriv μ ((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] h) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g)
      = ((jetDerivFermionFactor μ f) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] h) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g
        + (f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (jetDerivBosonFactor μ h)) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g
        + (f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] h) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (_root_.LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexJetDeriv GaugeAlgebra μ g)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.deriv₃_tmul_left
entries.docstring:
The three-factor derivation on a pure tensor, with the second and third derivatives
  annihilating their entries. Like the assemblies of sections B–D it is proved at abstract
  types and instantiated, so that the unit of a factor is never unfolded: the free algebras
  are quotients by congruences.
entries.snippet:
private lemma deriv₃_tmul_left {A B C : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [Module ℂ A]
    [AddCommGroup B] [Module ℂ B] [AddCommGroup C] [Module ℂ C]
    (D : A →ₗ[ℂ] A) (E : B →ₗ[ℂ] B) (F : C →ₗ[ℂ] C) {b : B} {c : C}
    (hE : E b = 0) (hF : F c = 0) (a : A) :
    (TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map D (LinearMap.id (M := B)))
          (LinearMap.id (M := C))
        + TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id (M := A)) E)
          (LinearMap.id (M := C))
        + TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id (M := A ⊗[ℂ] B)) F) ((a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] c)
      = (D a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] c

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.deriv₃_tmul_mid
entries.docstring: The same with only the middle derivative surviving.
entries.snippet:
private lemma deriv₃_tmul_mid {A B C : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [Module ℂ A]
    [AddCommGroup B] [Module ℂ B] [AddCommGroup C] [Module ℂ C]
    (D : A →ₗ[ℂ] A) (E : B →ₗ[ℂ] B) (F : C →ₗ[ℂ] C) {a : A} {c : C}
    (hD : D a = 0) (hF : F c = 0) (b : B) :
    (TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map D (LinearMap.id (M := B)))
          (LinearMap.id (M := C))
        + TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id (M := A)) E)
          (LinearMap.id (M := C))
        + TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id (M := A ⊗[ℂ] B)) F) ((a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] c)
      = (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] E b) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] c

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.deriv₃_tmul_right
entries.docstring: The same with only the third derivative surviving.
entries.snippet:
private lemma deriv₃_tmul_right {A B C : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [Module ℂ A]
    [AddCommGroup B] [Module ℂ B] [AddCommGroup C] [Module ℂ C]
    (D : A →ₗ[ℂ] A) (E : B →ₗ[ℂ] B) (F : C →ₗ[ℂ] C) {a : A} {b : B}
    (hD : D a = 0) (hE : E b = 0) (c : C) :
    (TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map D (LinearMap.id (M := B)))
          (LinearMap.id (M := C))
        + TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id (M := A)) E)
          (LinearMap.id (M := C))
        + TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id (M := A ⊗[ℂ] B)) F) ((a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] c)
      = (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] F c

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.map_comp_map_left
entries.docstring: Composition of two factorwise maps on the left factor, at abstract types.
entries.snippet:
private lemma map_comp_map_left {A B : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [Module ℂ A]
    [AddCommGroup B] [Module ℂ B] (D D' : A →ₗ[ℂ] A) :
    (TensorProduct.map D (LinearMap.id (M := B))).comp
        (TensorProduct.map D' (LinearMap.id (M := B)))
      = TensorProduct.map (D.comp D') (LinearMap.id (M := B))

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.map_comp_map_right
entries.docstring: Composition of two factorwise maps on the right factor, at abstract types.
entries.snippet:
private lemma map_comp_map_right {A B : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [Module ℂ A]
    [AddCommGroup B] [Module ℂ B] (D D' : B →ₗ[ℂ] B) :
    (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id (M := A)) D).comp
        (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id (M := A)) D')
      = TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id (M := A)) (D.comp D')

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.map_left_comm_map_right
entries.docstring: Maps on opposite factors commute, at abstract types.
entries.snippet:
private lemma map_left_comm_map_right {A B : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [Module ℂ A]
    [AddCommGroup B] [Module ℂ B] (D : A →ₗ[ℂ] A) (D' : B →ₗ[ℂ] B) :
    (TensorProduct.map D (LinearMap.id (M := B))).comp
        (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id (M := A)) D')
      = (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id (M := A)) D').comp
        (TensorProduct.map D (LinearMap.id (M := B)))

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.iteratedD_map
entries.docstring:
A linear map intertwining two commuting families intertwines their iterates.
  Proved at abstract types and instantiated in term mode, so that the induction never runs
  inside the jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
private lemma iteratedD_map {A B : Type} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A] [Ring B] [Algebra ℂ B]
    (D : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → A →ₗ[ℂ] A)
    (hD : ∀ μ ν, (D μ).comp (D ν) = (D ν).comp (D μ))
    (E : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (hE : ∀ μ ν, (E μ).comp (E ν) = (E ν).comp (E μ))
    (φ : A →ₗ[ℂ] B) (hφ : ∀ μ x, φ (D μ x) = E μ (φ x))
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (x : A) :
    φ (Lorentz.iteratedD D hD s x) = Lorentz.iteratedD E hE s (φ x)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.complexJetDeriv_one
entries.docstring:
The connection factor's derivative annihilates the unit of the complexified
  gauge-boson jet algebra.

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_includeFermionFactor
entries.docstring:
The derivative acts on the fermionic factor through that factor's own derivation. The
  factor inclusions are unfolded through the generic `GaugeFieldData` rules rather than by
  `rfl`: at the Standard Model datum the definitional unfolding of the units has to see
  through the unexposed ring congruence of the symmetric algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_includeFermionFactor (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (f : ExteriorAlgebra ℂ fieldData.FermionGenerators) :
    jetDeriv μ (fieldData.includeFermion f)
      = fieldData.includeFermion (jetDerivFermionFactor μ f)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_includeBosonFactor
entries.docstring: The derivative acts on the bosonic factor through that factor's own derivation.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_includeBosonFactor (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (h : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ fieldData.BosonGenerators) :
    jetDeriv μ (fieldData.includeBoson h)
      = fieldData.includeBoson (jetDerivBosonFactor μ h)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_includeConnection
entries.docstring:
The derivative acts on the connection factor through the generic gauge-boson
  derivative.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_includeConnection (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] _root_.LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra) :
    jetDeriv μ (fieldData.includeConnection y)
      = fieldData.includeConnection
          (_root_.LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexJetDeriv GaugeAlgebra μ y)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_includeFermion
entries.docstring:
The derivative acts on the fermionic sector through the fermionic sector's own
  derivative.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_includeFermion (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (f : FermionJetAlgebra) :
    jetDeriv μ (includeFermion f) = includeFermion (FermionicAlgebra.jetDeriv μ f)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_includeHiggs
entries.docstring: The derivative acts on the Higgs sector through the Higgs sector's own derivative.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_includeHiggs (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (h : HiggsJetAlgebra) :
    jetDeriv μ (includeHiggs h) = includeHiggs (BosonicAlgebra.jetDeriv μ h)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_includeGauge
entries.docstring:
The derivative acts on the gauge sector through the gauge sector's own derivative. The
  gauge sector inclusion is the connection inclusion of the datum, the Standard Model gauge
  bosons being the generic ones at `GaugeAlgebra`.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_includeGauge (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra)) :
    jetDeriv μ (includeGauge y)
      = includeGauge (_root_.LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexJetDeriv GaugeAlgebra μ y)

entries.name: TensorProduct.map_derivation_left
entries.docstring: A derivation of the left factor extends to a derivation of the tensor product.
entries.snippet:
lemma _root_.TensorProduct.map_derivation_left {A B : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    [Ring B] [Algebra ℂ B] (D : A →ₗ[ℂ] A)
    (hD : ∀ x y, D (x * y) = D x * y + x * D y) (x y : A ⊗[ℂ] B) :
    TensorProduct.map D LinearMap.id (x * y)
      = TensorProduct.map D LinearMap.id x * y
        + x * TensorProduct.map D LinearMap.id y

entries.name: TensorProduct.map_derivation_right
entries.docstring: A derivation of the right factor extends to a derivation of the tensor product.
entries.snippet:
lemma _root_.TensorProduct.map_derivation_right {A B : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    [Ring B] [Algebra ℂ B] (D : B →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (hD : ∀ x y, D (x * y) = D x * y + x * D y) (x y : A ⊗[ℂ] B) :
    TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id D (x * y)
      = TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id D x * y
        + x * TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id D y

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.add₃_derivation
entries.docstring:
The sum of three derivations is a derivation: the purely additive assembly, stated
  abstractly so it can be instantiated without rewriting inside a large type.
entries.snippet:
private lemma add₃_derivation {R : Type*} [NonUnitalNonAssocRing R]
    {D₁ D₂ D₃ : R → R} {x y : R}
    (h₁ : D₁ (x * y) = D₁ x * y + x * D₁ y)
    (h₂ : D₂ (x * y) = D₂ x * y + x * D₂ y)
    (h₃ : D₃ (x * y) = D₃ x * y + x * D₃ y) :
    D₁ (x * y) + D₂ (x * y) + D₃ (x * y)
      = (D₁ x + D₂ x + D₃ x) * y + x * (D₁ y + D₂ y + D₃ y)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_mul
entries.docstring: **The Leibniz rule** for the total derivative on the jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_mul (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x y : JetAlgebra) :
    jetDeriv μ (x * y) = jetDeriv μ x * y + x * jetDeriv μ y

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.add₃_comp_comm
entries.docstring:
The sum of three maps pairwise commuting with the sum of three others commutes with
  it: the purely additive assembly, stated abstractly so it can be instantiated without
  rewriting inside a large type.
entries.snippet:
private lemma add₃_comp_comm {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module ℂ M]
    {A₁ A₂ A₃ B₁ B₂ B₃ : M →ₗ[ℂ] M}
    (h11 : A₁.comp B₁ = B₁.comp A₁) (h12 : A₁.comp B₂ = B₂.comp A₁)
    (h13 : A₁.comp B₃ = B₃.comp A₁) (h21 : A₂.comp B₁ = B₁.comp A₂)
    (h22 : A₂.comp B₂ = B₂.comp A₂) (h23 : A₂.comp B₃ = B₃.comp A₂)
    (h31 : A₃.comp B₁ = B₁.comp A₃) (h32 : A₃.comp B₂ = B₂.comp A₃)
    (h33 : A₃.comp B₃ = B₃.comp A₃) :
    (A₁ + A₂ + A₃).comp (B₁ + B₂ + B₃) = (B₁ + B₂ + B₃).comp (A₁ + A₂ + A₃)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.jetDeriv_comm
entries.docstring: The total derivatives on the jet algebra commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_comm (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (jetDeriv μ).comp (jetDeriv ν) = (jetDeriv ν).comp (jetDeriv μ)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.iteratedD_includeFermion
entries.docstring:
The iterated total derivative acts on the fermionic sector through the fermionic
  sector's own iterated derivative.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedD_includeFermion (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (f : FermionJetAlgebra) :
    Lorentz.iteratedD jetDeriv jetDeriv_comm s (includeFermion f)
      = includeFermion (FermionicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv s f)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.iteratedD_includeHiggs
entries.docstring:
The iterated total derivative acts on the Higgs sector through the Higgs sector's own
  iterated derivative.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedD_includeHiggs (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (h : HiggsJetAlgebra) :
    Lorentz.iteratedD jetDeriv jetDeriv_comm s (includeHiggs h)
      = includeHiggs (BosonicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv s h)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.iteratedD_includeGauge
entries.docstring:
The iterated total derivative acts on the gauge sector through the gauge sector's own
  iterated derivative. Like its two siblings this instantiates the abstract
  `iteratedD_map` rather than running the induction inside the jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedD_includeGauge (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra)) :
    Lorentz.iteratedD jetDeriv jetDeriv_comm s (includeGauge y)
      = includeGauge (Lorentz.iteratedD
          (_root_.LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexJetDeriv GaugeAlgebra)
          _root_.LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexJetDeriv_comm s y)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repLorentzGroupFermion
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the fermionic factor: the exterior-algebra functor applied to
  the species-wise Lorentz action on the fermionic generator space.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable abbrev repLorentzGroupFermion :
    Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) (ExteriorAlgebra ℂ fieldData.FermionGenerators)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repLorentzGroupBoson
entries.docstring: The Lorentz action on the bosonic factor.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable abbrev repLorentzGroupBoson :
    Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) (SymmetricAlgebra ℂ fieldData.BosonGenerators)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the jet algebra of the Standard Model: the three factors
  transform independently.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def repLorentzGroup : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) JetAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repLorentzGroup_tmul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (w : ExteriorAlgebra ℂ fieldData.FermionGenerators ⊗[ℂ]
      SymmetricAlgebra ℂ fieldData.BosonGenerators)
    (g : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] _root_.LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (w ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g)
      = ((repLorentzGroupFermion.tprod repLorentzGroupBoson) Λ w)
          ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (_root_.LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepLorentzGroup GaugeAlgebra Λ g)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_apply_mul
entries.docstring: The Lorentz action on the jet algebra is multiplicative.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_mul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x y : JetAlgebra) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (x * y) = repLorentzGroup Λ x * repLorentzGroup Λ y

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.complexRepLorentzGroup_apply_one
entries.docstring: The Lorentz action on the complexified gauge sector fixes the unit.
entries.snippet:
lemma complexRepLorentzGroup_apply_one (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    (_root_.LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepLorentzGroup GaugeAlgebra) Λ
      (1 : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra)) = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_matter_one
entries.docstring:
The matter factor of the Lorentz action fixes the unit, by the same abstract
  instantiation as in the gauge action.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_matter_one (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    (repLorentzGroupFermion.tprod repLorentzGroupBoson) Λ
        (1 : fieldData.MatterAlgebra) = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_includeConnection
entries.docstring: The Lorentz action restricts to the generic connection factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_includeConnection (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] _root_.LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (fieldData.includeConnection y)
      = fieldData.includeConnection
          (_root_.LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepLorentzGroup GaugeAlgebra Λ y)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_includeFermionFactor
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action restricts to the fermionic factor, where it is the
  exterior-algebra functor applied to the species-wise action of the datum.

lemma repLorentzGroup_includeFermionFactor (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (a : ExteriorAlgebra ℂ fieldData.FermionGenerators) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (fieldData.includeFermion a)

The Lorentz action restricts to the bosonic factor, where it is the

lemma repLorentzGroup_includeBosonFactor (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (b : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ fieldData.BosonGenerators) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (fieldData.includeBoson b)
      = fieldData.includeBoson (repLorentzGroupBoson Λ b)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_includeGauge
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action restricts to the gauge sector's own action. The gauge sector
  inclusion is the connection inclusion of the datum, the Standard Model gauge bosons being
  the generic ones at `GaugeAlgebra`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_includeGauge (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra)) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (includeGauge y)
      = includeGauge (_root_.LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepLorentzGroup GaugeAlgebra Λ y)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_includeFermion
entries.docstring: The Lorentz action restricts to the fermionic sector's own action.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_includeFermion (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (f : FermionJetAlgebra) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (includeFermion f)
      = includeFermion (FermionJetAlgebra.repLorentzGroup Λ f)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_includeHiggs
entries.docstring: The Lorentz action restricts to the Higgs sector's own action.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_includeHiggs (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (h : HiggsJetAlgebra) :

      = includeHiggs (HiggsJetAlgebra.repLorentzGroup Λ h)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.tprod_deriv_sum
entries.docstring:
A factorwise sum of Lorentz-vector derivatives on a tensor product is a Lorentz
  vector: the abstract two-factor assembly, proved by tensor induction at abstract types
  so that it can be instantiated on the jet algebra without rewriting inside it.
entries.snippet:
private lemma tprod_deriv_sum {M N : Type} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℂ M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℂ N]
    (ρ : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) M) (σ : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) N)
    (D : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M →ₗ[ℂ] M) (E : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → N →ₗ[ℂ] N)
    (c : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (hD : ∀ ν x, ρ Λ (D ν x) = ∑ a, c a ν • D a (ρ Λ x))
    (hE : ∀ ν x, σ Λ (E ν x) = ∑ a, c a ν • E a (σ Λ x)) (x : M ⊗[ℂ] N) :
    (ρ.tprod σ) Λ
        ((TensorProduct.map (D μ) (LinearMap.id (M := N))
          + TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id (M := M)) (E μ)) x)
      = ∑ a, c a μ •
          (TensorProduct.map (D a) (LinearMap.id (M := N))
            + TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id (M := M)) (E a))
            ((ρ.tprod σ) Λ x)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_jetDeriv
entries.docstring: **The total derivative on the jet algebra is a Lorentz vector.**
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_jetDeriv (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : JetAlgebra) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (jetDeriv μ x) =
      ∑ a, (((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 a μ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        jetDeriv a (repLorentzGroup Λ x)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.instIsLorentzDeriv
entries.docstring: The total derivatives on the jet algebra form a Lorentz derivative.
entries.snippet: instance instIsLorentzDeriv : Lorentz.IsLorentzDeriv repLorentzGroup jetDeriv where

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.commute_monomial
entries.docstring:
Two monomials with commuting coefficients commute: the variable is central, so the two
  products are the same monomial.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_monomial {C : Type*} [Semiring C] {a b : C} (h : Commute a b)
    (n m : ℕ) : Commute (Polynomial.monomial n a) (Polynomial.monomial m b)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.commute_mapAlgHom
entries.docstring:
Polynomials pushed forward along two algebra maps with commuting images commute: every
  polynomial is a sum of monomials, and monomials with commuting coefficients commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_mapAlgHom {A B C : Type*} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A] [Semiring B]
    [Algebra ℂ B] [Semiring C] [Algebra ℂ C] (f : A →ₐ[ℂ] C) (g : B →ₐ[ℂ] C)
    (h : ∀ (a : A) (b : B), Commute (f a) (g b)) (p : Polynomial A) (q : Polynomial B) :
    Commute (Polynomial.mapAlgHom f p) (Polynomial.mapAlgHom g q)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.commute_mapAlgHom_includeGauge
entries.docstring:
Every polynomial over the jet algebra commutes with a polynomial whose coefficients lie
  in the gauge sector: the gauge sector is central, so the commutation holds coefficient by
  coefficient.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_mapAlgHom_includeGauge (p : Polynomial JetAlgebra)
    (q : Polynomial (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra))) :
    Commute p (Polynomial.mapAlgHom includeGauge q)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.fermionMassWeightPoly
entries.docstring:
The fermionic mass-weight grading, transported into the full jet algebra. The fermionic
  symbols have mass dimension `3/2`, hence mass weight three.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fermionMassWeightPoly :
    FermionJetAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial JetAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.higgsMassWeightPoly
entries.docstring:
The Higgs mass-weight grading, transported into the full jet algebra. The Higgs symbols
  have mass dimension one, hence mass weight two.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def higgsMassWeightPoly : HiggsJetAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial JetAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.gaugeMassWeightPoly
entries.docstring:
The gauge-boson mass-weight grading, transported into the full jet algebra. The gauge
  symbols have mass dimension one, hence mass weight two.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def gaugeMassWeightPoly :
    (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra)) →ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial JetAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.fermionFactorMassWeightPoly
entries.docstring:
The fermionic grading read on the fermionic factor of the carrier: the fermionic sector
  grading, precomposed with the sector equivalence. The sector helper above keeps its own
  domain, the fermionic sector algebra; this is the map the carrier's factor needs.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fermionFactorMassWeightPoly :
    ExteriorAlgebra ℂ fieldData.FermionGenerators →ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial JetAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.bosonFactorMassWeightPoly
entries.docstring: The Higgs grading read on the bosonic factor of the carrier.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def bosonFactorMassWeightPoly :
    SymmetricAlgebra ℂ fieldData.BosonGenerators →ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial JetAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.fermionFactorMassWeightPoly_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma fermionFactorMassWeightPoly_apply (a : ExteriorAlgebra ℂ fieldData.FermionGenerators) :
    fermionFactorMassWeightPoly a
      = Polynomial.mapAlgHom includeFermion
        (FermionicAlgebra.massWeightPoly 3 (fermionAlgebraEquiv.symm a))

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.bosonFactorMassWeightPoly_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma bosonFactorMassWeightPoly_apply (b : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ fieldData.BosonGenerators) :
    bosonFactorMassWeightPoly b
      = Polynomial.mapAlgHom includeHiggs
        (BosonicAlgebra.massWeightPoly 2 (higgsAlgebraEquiv.symm b))

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.matterMassWeightPoly
entries.docstring:
The mass-weight grading on the matter factor of the jet algebra: the fermionic and
  Higgs gradings, lifted over the tensor product of the two matter factors of the carrier.
  The side condition is that the two images commute, which they do because the Higgs sector
  commutes with the fermionic sector.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def matterMassWeightPoly :
    fieldData.MatterAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial JetAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.massWeightPoly
entries.docstring:
The mass-weight polynomial on the jet algebra of the Standard Model: the `ℂ`-algebra
  map sending a generator of mass weight `n` to `X ^ n` times itself, so that the
  coefficient of `X ^ n` in `massWeightPoly a` is the part of `a` of mass weight `n`. It is
  the three sector gradings lifted over the tensor product, the side condition for the
  outer lift being the centrality of the gauge sector.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def massWeightPoly : JetAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial JetAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.massWeightPoly_tmul
entries.docstring: On a pure tensor the grading is the product of the matter and gauge gradings.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_tmul (x : fieldData.MatterAlgebra)
    (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra)) :
    massWeightPoly (x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y) = matterMassWeightPoly x * gaugeMassWeightPoly y

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.matterMassWeightPoly_tmul
entries.docstring:
On a pure tensor the matter grading is the product of the fermionic and bosonic factor
  gradings.
entries.snippet:
lemma matterMassWeightPoly_tmul (a : ExteriorAlgebra ℂ fieldData.FermionGenerators)
    (b : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ fieldData.BosonGenerators) :
    matterMassWeightPoly (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b)
      = fermionFactorMassWeightPoly a * bosonFactorMassWeightPoly b

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.massWeightPoly_includeFermionFactor
entries.docstring:
On the fermionic factor the grading is that factor's own grading. Like every step
  below it is written as an equation chain, which never abstracts a pattern out of a goal
  mentioning the jet algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_includeFermionFactor
    (a : ExteriorAlgebra ℂ fieldData.FermionGenerators) :
    massWeightPoly (fieldData.includeFermion a) = fermionFactorMassWeightPoly a

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.massWeightPoly_includeBosonFactor
entries.docstring: On the bosonic factor the grading is that factor's own grading.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_includeBosonFactor
    (b : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ fieldData.BosonGenerators) :
    massWeightPoly (fieldData.includeBoson b) = bosonFactorMassWeightPoly b

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.massWeightPoly_includeConnection
entries.docstring: On the connection factor the grading is the generic gauge-boson grading.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_includeConnection (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra)) :
    massWeightPoly (fieldData.includeConnection y) = gaugeMassWeightPoly y

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.massWeightPoly_includeFermion
entries.docstring:
On the fermionic sector the grading is the fermionic sector's own grading, pushed
  forward along the fermionic inclusion.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_includeFermion (a : FermionJetAlgebra) :
    massWeightPoly (includeFermion a)
      = Polynomial.mapAlgHom includeFermion (FermionicAlgebra.massWeightPoly 3 a)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.massWeightPoly_includeHiggs
entries.docstring:
On the Higgs sector the grading is the Higgs sector's own grading, pushed forward along
  the Higgs inclusion.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_includeHiggs (h : HiggsJetAlgebra) :
    massWeightPoly (includeHiggs h)
      = Polynomial.mapAlgHom includeHiggs (BosonicAlgebra.massWeightPoly 2 h)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.massWeightPoly_includeGauge
entries.docstring:
On the gauge sector the grading is the gauge sector's own grading, pushed forward along
  the gauge inclusion. The gauge sector inclusion is the connection inclusion of the datum,
  so there is nothing to transport here.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_includeGauge (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra GaugeAlgebra)) :
    massWeightPoly (includeGauge y)
      = Polynomial.mapAlgHom includeGauge (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexMassWeightPoly y)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.monomial_two_mul_one_add
entries.docstring:
The mass-weight exponent of a symbol of mass dimension one, in the two forms the
  statements below use: `AlgebraRealization` asks for `2 * (1 + |s|)`, and each sector
  grading produces `2 + 2 * |s|`.
entries.snippet:
private lemma monomial_two_mul_one_add (n : ℕ) (x : JetAlgebra) :
    Polynomial.monomial (2 + 2 * n) x = Polynomial.monomial (2 * (1 + n)) x

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.massWeightPoly_higgsField
entries.docstring:
The Higgs symbol `∂_s H_φ` is a monomial eigenvector of mass weight `2 * (1 + |s|)`:
  the Higgs field has mass dimension one and each derivative adds one more.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_higgsField (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ HiggsVec) :
    massWeightPoly (higgsField s φ)
      = Polynomial.monomial (2 * (1 + Multiset.card s)) (higgsField s φ)

entries.docstring:
The conjugate Higgs symbol `∂_s H̄_φ` is a monomial eigenvector of the same mass weight
  `2 * (1 + |s|)` as the symbol it conjugates.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_conjHiggsField (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule HiggsVec)) :
    massWeightPoly (conjHiggsField s φ)
      = Polynomial.monomial (2 * (1 + Multiset.card s)) (conjHiggsField s φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.id
entries.docstring:
The jet algebra of the Standard Model is a Standard Model: it is one along the identity
  algebra map.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def id : AlgebraRealization JetAlgebra JetAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI
    JetAlgebra.repLorentzGroup JetAlgebra.massWeightPoly where

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionSpaceEquiv
entries.docstring:
The total fermionic target space is the fermionic module of the datum. The nested
  product of five three-generation blocks that `FermionSpace` is, rearranged into a
  dependent function on the fifteen species. It is a relabelling: every component of a
  value on one side is a component of the corresponding value on the other.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fermionSpaceEquiv :
    fermionMatterField.V ≃ₗ[ℂ] (fieldData.fermionMatterField 3 fieldData_fermion_massWeight).V where

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionProj
entries.docstring:
The projection of the total fermionic target space onto the value space of a species
  of the datum: the relabelling followed by the projection of the module.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fermionProj (t : fieldData.FermionSpecies) :
    fermionMatterField.V →ₗ[ℂ] (fieldData.fermion t).V

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionProj_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma fermionProj_eq (t : fieldData.FermionSpecies) :
    fermionProj t = (fieldData.projFermionField 3 fieldData_fermion_massWeight t).comp
      fermionSpaceEquiv.toLinearMap

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionProj_leptonDoublet
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fermionProj_leptonDoublet (i : Fin 3) :
    fermionProj (.leptonDoublet i) = FermionSpace.leptonDoubletProj i

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionProj_leptonSinglet
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fermionProj_leptonSinglet (i : Fin 3) :
    fermionProj (.leptonSinglet i) = FermionSpace.leptonSingletProj i

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionProj_quarkDoublet
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fermionProj_quarkDoublet (i : Fin 3) :
    fermionProj (.quarkDoublet i) = FermionSpace.quarkDoubletProj i

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionProj_upSinglet
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fermionProj_upSinglet (i : Fin 3) :
    fermionProj (.upSinglet i) = FermionSpace.upSingletProj i

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionProj_downSinglet
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fermionProj_downSinglet (i : Fin 3) :
    fermionProj (.downSinglet i) = FermionSpace.downSingletProj i

entries.name: StandardModel.higgsModuleEquiv
entries.docstring:
The Higgs multiplet is the bosonic module of the datum. There is one bosonic
  species, so the module of bosonic values is the constant family on it.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def higgsModuleEquiv :
    HiggsVec.matterField.V ≃ₗ[ℂ] (fieldData.bosonMatterField 2 fieldData_boson_massWeight).V where

entries.name: StandardModel.projBosonValue_comp_higgsModuleEquiv
entries.docstring: Reading off the one species undoes the relabelling.
entries.snippet:
lemma projBosonValue_comp_higgsModuleEquiv (j : fieldData.BosonSpecies) :
    (fieldData.projBosonField 2 fieldData_boson_massWeight j).comp
        higgsModuleEquiv.toLinearMap = LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.comap_projBosonValue_comp_comap_higgsModuleEquiv
entries.docstring: The pullback along the relabelling undoes the pullback along the one projection.
entries.snippet:
lemma comap_projBosonValue_comp_comap_higgsModuleEquiv (j : fieldData.BosonSpecies) :
    (JetComponentSpace.comap higgsModuleEquiv.toLinearMap).comp
        (JetComponentSpace.comap (fieldData.projBosonField 2 fieldData_boson_massWeight j))
      = LinearMap.id

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionGeneratorsEquiv
entries.docstring:
The fermionic generator space of the datum is the component space of the total
  fermionic target space. The generic presentation of the direct sum as the component
  space of the fermionic module, followed by the relabelling of the target space.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fermionGeneratorsEquiv :
    fieldData.FermionGenerators ≃ₗ[ℂ] JetComponentSpace fermionMatterField

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionGeneratorsEquiv_inclFermion
entries.docstring:
A species sits inside the fermionic generators as the pullback along the projection
  onto that species.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fermionGeneratorsEquiv_inclFermion (t : fieldData.FermionSpecies)
    (x : JetComponentSpace (fieldData.fermion t)) :
    fermionGeneratorsEquiv (fieldData.inclFermion t x)
      = JetComponentSpace.comap (fermionProj t) x

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionGeneratorsEquiv_symm_comap
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fermionGeneratorsEquiv_symm_comap (t : fieldData.FermionSpecies)
    (x : JetComponentSpace (fieldData.fermion t)) :
    fermionGeneratorsEquiv.symm (JetComponentSpace.comap (fermionProj t) x)
      = fieldData.inclFermion t x

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.comap_snd_of_zero
entries.docstring: The second half of a pullback of an unconjugated symbol vanishes.
entries.snippet:
lemma _root_.JetComponentSpace.comap_snd_of_zero {G₀ : Type} [Group G₀] {𝔤 : Type} [LieRing 𝔤]
    [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤]
    {GJ : Type} [Group GJ] {𝔤J : Type} [LieRing 𝔤J] [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤J]
    {jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 GJ 𝔤J} {M N : MatterField jets}
    (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) (x : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ N.V) :
    (JetComponentSpace.comap f ((x, 0) : JetComponentSpace N)).2 = 0

entries.name: JetComponentSpace.comap_fst_of_zero
entries.docstring: The first half of a pullback of a conjugate symbol vanishes.
entries.snippet:
lemma _root_.JetComponentSpace.comap_fst_of_zero {G₀ : Type} [Group G₀] {𝔤 : Type} [LieRing 𝔤]
    [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤]
    {GJ : Type} [Group GJ] {𝔤J : Type} [LieRing 𝔤J] [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤J]
    {jets : LocalGaugeData G₀ 𝔤 GJ 𝔤J} {M N : MatterField jets}
    (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) (y : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule N.V)) :
    (JetComponentSpace.comap f ((0, y) : JetComponentSpace N)).1 = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionGeneratorsEquiv_symm_basis_tmul
entries.docstring: The unconjugated symbol `∂_s ψ_φ` of a species, read on the total target space.
entries.snippet:
lemma fermionGeneratorsEquiv_symm_basis_tmul (t : fieldData.FermionSpecies)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (fieldData.FermionValue t)) :
    fermionGeneratorsEquiv.symm ((SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
        Module.Dual.transpose (fermionProj t) φ, 0) : JetComponentSpace fermionMatterField)
      = fieldData.inclFermion t ((SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ, 0) :
          JetComponentSpace (fieldData.fermion t))

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionGeneratorsEquiv_symm_basis_tmul_conj
entries.docstring: The conjugate symbol `∂_s ψ̄_φ` of a species, read on the total target space.
entries.snippet:
lemma fermionGeneratorsEquiv_symm_basis_tmul_conj (t : fieldData.FermionSpecies)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (fieldData.FermionValue t))) :
    fermionGeneratorsEquiv.symm ((0, SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
        Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (fermionProj t)) φ) :
          JetComponentSpace fermionMatterField)
      = fieldData.inclFermion t ((0, SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ) :
          JetComponentSpace (fieldData.fermion t))

entries.name: StandardModel.bosonGeneratorsEquiv
entries.docstring:
The bosonic generator space of the datum is the component space of the Higgs.
  There is one bosonic species, so the direct sum has one summand and the relabelling of
  the target space is the identification of a one-element function space with its
  value.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def bosonGeneratorsEquiv :

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionGeneratorsEquiv_jetDerivFermion

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionicAlgebra_jetDeriv_eq
entries.docstring:
The total derivative on the fermionic algebra of a species is the general even
  derivation of its exterior algebra extending the derivative shift. The two constructions
  are the same lift into the trivial square-zero extension, written once in the matter
  sector and once in general; the identification lets the general theory apply to the
  fermionic factor of the migrated carrier, whose generator space is a direct sum of
  component spaces rather than a single one.
entries.snippet:
private lemma fermionicAlgebra_jetDeriv_eq (M : MatterField localGaugeData)
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    FermionicAlgebra.jetDeriv (M := M) μ
      = ExteriorAlgebra.derivationOfLinear (JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv μ)

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionAlgebraEquiv_jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
The fermionic sector equivalence is a map of differential algebras: the exterior
  derivation extending the derivative shift on the total target space goes to the exterior
  derivation extending the derivative shift of the datum.
entries.snippet:
lemma fermionAlgebraEquiv_jetDeriv (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (f : FermionJetAlgebra) :
    fermionAlgebraEquiv (FermionicAlgebra.jetDeriv μ f)
      = ExteriorAlgebra.derivationOfLinear (fieldData.jetDerivFermion μ)
          (fermionAlgebraEquiv f)

entries.name: StandardModel.higgsAlgebraEquiv_jetDeriv
entries.docstring: The Higgs sector equivalence is a map of differential algebras.
entries.snippet:
lemma higgsAlgebraEquiv_jetDeriv (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (h : HiggsJetAlgebra) :
    higgsAlgebraEquiv (BosonicAlgebra.jetDeriv μ h)
      = SymmetricAlgebra.derivationOfLinear (fieldData.jetDerivBoson μ)
          (higgsAlgebraEquiv h)

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionProj_comp_repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The projection onto a species intertwines the total Lorentz action on the fermionic
  target space with that species' own.
entries.snippet:
lemma fermionProj_comp_repLorentzGroup (t : fieldData.FermionSpecies) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    (fermionProj t).comp (FermionSpace.repLorentzGroup Λ)
      = ((fieldData.fermion t).repLorentz Λ).comp (fermionProj t)

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionSpaceEquiv_comp_repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The relabelling of the fermionic target space is Lorentz-equivariant. Both actions
  are species-diagonal, so this is the previous lemma read one species at a time.
entries.snippet:
lemma fermionSpaceEquiv_comp_repLorentzGroup (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    fermionSpaceEquiv.toLinearMap.comp (FermionSpace.repLorentzGroup Λ)
      = (fieldData.repLorentzFermionModule Λ).comp fermionSpaceEquiv.toLinearMap

entries.name: StandardModel.higgsModuleEquiv_comp_repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The relabelling of the Higgs is Lorentz-equivariant. The Higgs is a Lorentz scalar,
  so both sides are the identity; the content is that the one bosonic species of the datum
  carries exactly the trivial Higgs representation.
entries.snippet:
lemma higgsModuleEquiv_comp_repLorentzGroup (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    higgsModuleEquiv.toLinearMap.comp (Representation.trivial ℂ SL(2,ℂ) HiggsVec Λ)
      = (fieldData.repLorentzBosonModule Λ).comp higgsModuleEquiv.toLinearMap

entries.name: StandardModel.lTensor_fermionProj_repJetGaugeGroupI
entries.docstring:
The projection onto a species intertwines the total jet gauge action on the jets of
  the fermionic target space with that species' own.
entries.snippet:
lemma lTensor_fermionProj_repJetGaugeGroupI (t : fieldData.FermionSpecies)
    (U : JetGaugeGroupI) :
    (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra (fermionProj t)).comp (fermionMatterField.repJet U)
      = ((fieldData.fermion t).repJet U).comp
        (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra (fermionProj t))

entries.name: StandardModel.lTensor_fermionSpaceEquiv_repJetGaugeGroupI
entries.docstring:
The relabelling of the fermionic target space is equivariant for the jet gauge
  action. Both actions are species-diagonal, so this is the previous lemma read one
  species at a time, the two being compared through the splitting of the jets of a
  product.
entries.snippet:
lemma lTensor_fermionSpaceEquiv_repJetGaugeGroupI (U : JetGaugeGroupI) :
    (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra fermionSpaceEquiv.toLinearMap).comp
        (fermionMatterField.repJet U)
      = ((fieldData.fermionMatterField 3 fieldData_fermion_massWeight).repJet U).comp
        (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra fermionSpaceEquiv.toLinearMap)

entries.name: StandardModel.lTensor_higgsModuleEquiv_repJetGaugeGroupI
entries.docstring:
The relabelling of the Higgs is equivariant for the jet gauge action. There is one
  bosonic species, and reading it off undoes the relabelling, so both sides are the Higgs
  action itself; the content is that the single bosonic species of the datum carries
  exactly the Higgs representation.
entries.snippet:
lemma lTensor_higgsModuleEquiv_repJetGaugeGroupI (U : JetGaugeGroupI) :
    (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra higgsModuleEquiv.toLinearMap).comp
        (HiggsVec.matterField.repJet U)
      = ((fieldData.bosonMatterField 2 fieldData_boson_massWeight).repJet U).comp
        (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra higgsModuleEquiv.toLinearMap)

entries.name: StandardModel.fermionGeneratorsEquiv_massWeightScaleFermion
entries.docstring:
The fermionic generator identification intertwines the mass-weight scalings: the
  per-species scaling of the datum, which carries the weight three of every Standard Model
  fermion, with the single weight-three scaling of the component space of the total target
  space. That the two agree is exactly the statement that all fifteen species have the same
  weight; the relabelling of the target space costs nothing, the scaling being natural in
  the value space.
entries.snippet:
lemma fermionGeneratorsEquiv_massWeightScaleFermion (c : ℂ)
    (v : fieldData.FermionGenerators) :
    fermionGeneratorsEquiv (fieldData.massWeightScaleFermion c v)
      = JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale 3 c (fermionGeneratorsEquiv v)

      = (JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale 3 c).comp
        fermionGeneratorsEquiv.toLinearMap

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.transformsIn_species
entries.docstring:
The jet gauge transformation law of a fermion species: a family of symbols obtained
  from the total fermionic symbols by pulling covectors back along a projection
  intertwining the two jet gauge actions transforms in the species' own representation.
entries.snippet:
private lemma transformsIn_species {W : Type} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W]
    (repW : Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] W)) (p : FermionSpace →ₗ[ℂ] W)
    (hp : ∀ U : JetGaugeGroupI, (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra p).comp
        (FermionSpace.repJetGaugeGroupI U)
      = (repW U).comp (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra p))
    {F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ W →ₗ[ℂ] JetAlgebra}
    (hF : ∀ s φ, F s φ = fermionSymbol s (Module.Dual.transpose p φ)) :
    LocalGaugeData.TransformsIn (B := JetAlgebra) repJetGaugeGroupI repW F

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.repDualCoeff_repConj_transpose
entries.docstring:
The base-point Taylor coefficients of two conjugate jet gauge actions are intertwined,
  on the component-function index, by the conjugate of any map of value spaces intertwining
  the unconjugated coefficients: conjugation changes neither the underlying maps nor the
  real directions in which the coefficients are taken.
entries.snippet:
private lemma repDualCoeff_repConj_transpose {V W : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W]
    {repV : Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)}
    {repW : Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] W)} (p : V →ₗ[ℂ] W)
    (hp : ∀ (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)),
      p.comp (GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff repV U s)
        = (GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff repW U s).comp p)
    (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule W)) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.repDualCoeff (JetComponentSpace.repConj repV) U s
        (Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map p) φ)
      = Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map p)
          (GaugeAlgebraRealization.repDualCoeff (JetComponentSpace.repConj repW) U s φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.transformsIn_conjSpecies
entries.docstring:
The jet gauge transformation law of the conjugate symbols of a fermion species: the law
  of the species itself, read on the conjugate representations.
entries.snippet:
private lemma transformsIn_conjSpecies {W : Type} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W]
    (repW : Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] W)) (p : FermionSpace →ₗ[ℂ] W)
    (hp : ∀ U : JetGaugeGroupI, (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra p).comp
        (FermionSpace.repJetGaugeGroupI U)
      = (repW U).comp (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra p))
    {F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule W) →ₗ[ℂ] JetAlgebra}
    (hF : ∀ s φ, F s φ = conjFermionSymbol s
      (Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map p) φ)) :
    LocalGaugeData.TransformsIn (B := JetAlgebra) repJetGaugeGroupI
      (JetComponentSpace.repConj repW) F

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.isLorentzDerivTransforms_species
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz transformation law of a fermion species: a family of symbols obtained from
  the total fermionic symbols by pulling covectors back along a projection whose
  contragredient is species-diagonal transforms in the species' own Weyl representation.
entries.snippet:
private lemma isLorentzDerivTransforms_species {W : Type} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W]
    (repW : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) W) (p : FermionSpace →ₗ[ℂ] W)
    (hdual : ∀ (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ W),
      FermionSpace.repLorentzGroup.dual Λ (Module.Dual.transpose p φ)
        = Module.Dual.transpose p (repW.dual Λ φ))
    {F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ W →ₗ[ℂ] JetAlgebra}
    (hF : ∀ s φ, F s φ = fermionSymbol s (Module.Dual.transpose p φ)) :
    IsLorentzDerivTransforms (A := JetAlgebra) repLorentzGroup repW F

entries.name: StandardModel.JetAlgebra.isLorentzDerivTransforms_conjSpecies
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz transformation law of the conjugate symbols of a fermion species: the law
  of the species itself, read on the conjugate representations.
entries.snippet:
private lemma isLorentzDerivTransforms_conjSpecies {W : Type} [AddCommGroup W]
    [Module ℂ W] (repW : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) W) (p : FermionSpace →ₗ[ℂ] W)
    (hdual : ∀ (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule W)),
      FermionSpace.repLorentzGroup.conj.dual Λ
          (Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map p) φ)
        = Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map p) (repW.conj.dual Λ φ))
    {F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule W) →ₗ[ℂ] JetAlgebra}
    (hF : ∀ s φ, F s φ = conjFermionSymbol s
      (Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map p) φ)) :
    IsLorentzDerivTransforms (A := JetAlgebra) repLorentzGroup repW.conj F
