entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra
entries.docstring:
The bosonic algebra of the matter field `M`: the symmetric algebra on the space
  of component functions `∂_s φ_α` and `∂_s φ̄_α`. The symmetric product is the product of
  bosonic fields, its commutativity the Bose statistics.
entries.snippet: abbrev BosonicAlgebra (M : MatterField jets) : Type

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.adjoin_ι_eq_top
entries.docstring:
**The bosonic algebra is generated by the component functions.** Every element is a
  polynomial in the degree-one elements — the symbols `∂_s φ_α` and `∂_s φ̄_α` themselves.
  This is the algebraic form of "every Lagrangian term is a polynomial in the component
  functions".
entries.snippet:
lemma adjoin_ι_eq_top :
    Algebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ (JetComponentSpace M))) = ⊤

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.ι_mul_ι_comm
entries.docstring: Two component functions commute: Bose statistics.
entries.snippet:
lemma ι_mul_ι_comm (x y : JetComponentSpace M) :
    (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _ x * SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _ y : BosonicAlgebra M)
      = SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _ y * SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _ x

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.ofField
entries.docstring:
**The component function `ψ_φ` of the matter field** along the covector `φ` on `V`: the
  undifferentiated generator, sitting at the empty derivative label in the unconjugated half
  of the component space.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def ofField : Module.Dual ℂ M.V →ₗ[ℂ] BosonicAlgebra M

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.ofConjField
entries.docstring:
**The component function `ψ̄_φ` of the conjugate matter field** along the covector `φ`
  on `ConjModule M.V`: the undifferentiated generator in the conjugate half of the component
  space.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def ofConjField : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V) →ₗ[ℂ] BosonicAlgebra M

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.ofField_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma ofField_apply (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V) :
    ofField φ = SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _
      (((1 : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ, 0) : JetComponentSpace M)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.ofConjField_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma ofConjField_apply (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    ofConjField φ = SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _
      ((0, (1 : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ) : JetComponentSpace M)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.comap
entries.docstring:
**The bosonic algebra is contravariant in the target space.** A linear map
  `f : V →ₗ[ℂ] W` induces an algebra homomorphism `BosonicAlgebra N →ₐ[ℂ] BosonicAlgebra M`
  by pulling back component functions. Applied to a *projection* out of a multi-species
  target space, this is the inclusion of one species' algebra into the whole.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def comap (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) : BosonicAlgebra N →ₐ[ℂ] BosonicAlgebra M

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.comap_ι
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma comap_ι (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) (x : JetComponentSpace N) :
    comap f (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _ x)
      = SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _ (JetComponentSpace.comap f x)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.comap_id
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma comap_id : comap (LinearMap.id : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] M.V) = AlgHom.id ℂ (BosonicAlgebra M)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.comap_comp
entries.docstring: Functoriality: the order reverses, as it must for a contravariant construction.
entries.snippet:
lemma comap_comp {P : MatterField jets} (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) (g : N.V →ₗ[ℂ] P.V) :
    comap (g.comp f) = (comap f).comp (comap g)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.comap_ofField
entries.docstring:
The inclusion sends a component function of the species to the corresponding component
  function of the whole.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma comap_ofField (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ N.V) :
    comap f (ofField φ) = ofField (φ ∘ₗ f)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.comap_ofConjField
entries.docstring:
The inclusion sends a conjugate component function of the species to the corresponding
  conjugate component function of the whole.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma comap_ofConjField (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule N.V)) :
    comap f (ofConjField φ) = ofConjField (φ ∘ₗ ConjModule.map f)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI
entries.docstring:
**The jet gauge action on the bosonic algebra** of the matter field `M`: the symmetric-algebra
  functor applied to the gauge action on the jet component space. The fibrewise action on the jets
  and its fibrewise-linearity are fields of `M`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repJetGaugeGroupI :
    Representation ℂ GJ (BosonicAlgebra M) where

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_apply
    (U : GJ) (x : BosonicAlgebra M) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI M U x =
      SymmetricAlgebra.map (JetComponentSpace.repJet M U) x

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_apply_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_apply_one
    (U : GJ) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI M U (1 : BosonicAlgebra M) = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_apply_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_apply_mul
    (U : GJ) (x y : BosonicAlgebra M) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI M U (x * y) =
      repJetGaugeGroupI M U x * repJetGaugeGroupI M U y

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_ι
entries.docstring: On a component function the jet gauge action is the action on the component space.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_ι
    (U : GJ) (v : JetComponentSpace M) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI M U (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _ v) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _ (JetComponentSpace.repJet M U v)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupIAlgHom
entries.docstring:
The jet gauge action as an algebra homomorphism: a gauge transformation acts on a
  Lagrangian term factor by factor.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repJetGaugeGroupIAlgHom
    (U : GJ) : BosonicAlgebra M →ₐ[ℂ] BosonicAlgebra M where

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_ofField
entries.docstring:
**`ofField` is gauge equivariant.** The undifferentiated component functions transform
  by the contragredient of the value of the gauge transformation at the base point; no
  derivative of the gauge jet contributes.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_ofField
    (U : GJ) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI M U (ofField φ) =
      ofField (Module.Dual.transpose (jetEval ∘ₗ (M.repJet U⁻¹).comp jetOfConstant) φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_ofConjField
entries.docstring:
**`ofConjField` is gauge equivariant**, for the conjugate action
  `JetComponentSpace.repConj rep` on the
  jets of the conjugate field — which is the physicists' `φ̄ ↦ φ̄ U†`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_ofConjField
    (U : GJ) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI M U (ofConjField φ) =
      ofConjField (Module.Dual.transpose
        (jetEval ∘ₗ (JetComponentSpace.repConj M.repJet U⁻¹).comp jetOfConstant) φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repGaugeGroupI
entries.docstring:
The action of the constant — that is, global — gauge transformations on the bosonic
  algebra, obtained by including a gauge transformation as a constant gauge jet.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repGaugeGroupI :
    Representation ℂ G₀ (BosonicAlgebra M)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repGaugeGroupI_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_apply
    (g : G₀) (x : BosonicAlgebra M) :
    repGaugeGroupI M g x =
      repJetGaugeGroupI M (jets.ofConstant g) x

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repGaugeGroupI_apply_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repGaugeGroupI_apply_one
    (g : G₀) :
    repGaugeGroupI M g (1 : BosonicAlgebra M) = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repGaugeGroupI_apply_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_apply_mul
    (g : G₀) (x y : BosonicAlgebra M) :
    repGaugeGroupI M g (x * y) =
      repGaugeGroupI M g x * repGaugeGroupI M g y

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repGaugeGroupI_ofField
entries.docstring:
A constant gauge transformation acts on the undifferentiated field by the
  contragredient of its value — which for a constant jet is the transformation itself.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_ofField
    (g : G₀) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V) :
    repGaugeGroupI M g (ofField φ) =
      ofField (Module.Dual.transpose
        (jetEval ∘ₗ (M.repJet (jets.ofConstant g⁻¹)).comp jetOfConstant) φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repGaugeGroupI_ofConjField
entries.docstring:
A constant gauge transformation acts on the undifferentiated conjugate field by the
  conjugate contragredient of its value.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_ofConjField
    (g : G₀) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    repGaugeGroupI M g (ofConjField φ) =
      ofConjField (Module.Dual.transpose
        (jetEval ∘ₗ (JetComponentSpace.repConj M.repJet (jets.ofConstant g⁻¹)).comp
          jetOfConstant) φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
The formal total spacetime derivative on the bosonic algebra of a `V`-valued matter
  field in the direction `μ`: the derivation extending the shift
  `∂_s φ_α ↦ ∂_{s + {μ}} φ_α` of the component functions.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetDeriv (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    BosonicAlgebra M →ₗ[ℂ] BosonicAlgebra M

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.jetDeriv_ι
entries.docstring: On a component function the total derivative is the shift of the derivative label.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDeriv_ι (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    jetDeriv μ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _ x) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _ (JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv μ x)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.jetDeriv_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDeriv_one (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : jetDeriv (M := M) μ (1 : BosonicAlgebra M) = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.jetDeriv_algebraMap
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDeriv_algebraMap (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (r : ℂ) :
    jetDeriv (M := M) μ (algebraMap ℂ (BosonicAlgebra M) r) = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.jetDeriv_mul
entries.docstring:
The total derivative is a derivation: the Leibniz rule holds on the bosonic
  algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_mul (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x y : BosonicAlgebra M) :
    jetDeriv μ (x * y) = jetDeriv μ x * y + x * jetDeriv μ y

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.jetDeriv_comm_apply
entries.docstring:
**Mixed partials agree.** The derivative labels live in a *symmetric* algebra, so the
  total derivatives in different directions commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_comm_apply (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : BosonicAlgebra M) :
    jetDeriv μ (jetDeriv ν x) = jetDeriv ν (jetDeriv μ x)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.jetDeriv_comm
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_comm (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (jetDeriv (M := M) μ).comp (jetDeriv ν) = (jetDeriv (M := M) ν).comp (jetDeriv μ)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv
entries.docstring:
The iterated total derivative `∂_s = ∂_{ν₁} ⋯ ∂_{νₙ}` along a multiset `s` of
  directions. It is well defined on a multiset — i.e. independent of the order in which the
  directions are listed — because the directional derivatives commute.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def iteratedJetDeriv (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    BosonicAlgebra M →ₗ[ℂ] BosonicAlgebra M

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_zero :
    iteratedJetDeriv (0 : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      = LinearMap.id (R := ℂ) (M := BosonicAlgebra M)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_cons
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_cons (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    iteratedJetDeriv (M := M) (μ ::ₘ s) = (jetDeriv μ).comp (iteratedJetDeriv s)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_cons'
entries.docstring: The companion of `iteratedJetDeriv_cons`, peeling the extra derivative on the inside.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_cons' (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    iteratedJetDeriv (M := M) (μ ::ₘ s) = (iteratedJetDeriv s).comp (jetDeriv μ)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_singleton
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_singleton (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    iteratedJetDeriv (M := M) {μ} = jetDeriv μ

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_add
entries.docstring:
The iterated derivative is additive in the multiset of directions: differentiating
  along `s + t` is differentiating along `t` and then along `s`.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_add (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    iteratedJetDeriv (M := M) (s + t)
      = (iteratedJetDeriv s).comp (iteratedJetDeriv t)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_mul
entries.docstring:
**The all-orders Leibniz rule.** The iterated derivative of a product distributes over
  the antidiagonal of the multiset of directions: each way of splitting the derivatives
  between the two factors contributes one term.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_mul (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (x y : BosonicAlgebra M) :
    iteratedJetDeriv s (x * y) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        iteratedJetDeriv p.1 x * iteratedJetDeriv p.2 y).sum

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_one_of_ne_zero
entries.docstring: A nonempty iterated derivative kills the constants.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_one_of_ne_zero {s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)} (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    iteratedJetDeriv (M := M) s (1 : BosonicAlgebra M) = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_ι
entries.docstring:
**On a component function the iterated derivative is the derivative symbol `∂_s`.**
  Both halves of the component space — the field and its conjugate — are multiplied by the
  degree-`|s|` element `∂_s` of `SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ` in their derivative-label factor,
  with the target index untouched.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_ι (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    iteratedJetDeriv s (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _ x) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _
        (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s))
            LinearMap.id x.1,
          TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s))
            LinearMap.id x.2)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_ofField
entries.docstring:
The iterated derivative of the field is the generator carrying the derivative symbol
  `∂_s`: applying `∂_s` to `ψ_φ` writes the label `s` into the derivative factor.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_ofField (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V) :
    iteratedJetDeriv s (ofField φ) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _
        ((SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ, 0) : JetComponentSpace M)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_ofConjField
entries.docstring:
The iterated derivative of the conjugate field is the conjugate generator carrying the
  derivative symbol `∂_s`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_ofConjField (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    iteratedJetDeriv s (ofConjField φ) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _
        ((0, SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ) : JetComponentSpace M)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.adjoin_iteratedJetDeriv_eq_top
entries.docstring:
**The bosonic algebra is generated by the field, its conjugate, and their
  derivatives.** As a `ℂ`-algebra, `BosonicAlgebra M` is the algebra adjoined by the
  iterated total derivatives `∂_s ψ_φ` and `∂_s ψ̄_φ` of the undifferentiated component
  functions. Physically: every Lagrangian term for a `V`-valued bosonic matter field is a
  polynomial in the field, its conjugate, and their spacetime derivatives — nothing else is
  available to write down.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjoin_iteratedJetDeriv_eq_top :
    Algebra.adjoin ℂ
      (⋃ s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
        Set.range (fun φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V => iteratedJetDeriv s (ofField φ)) ∪
          Set.range (fun φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V) =>
            iteratedJetDeriv s (ofConjField φ)))
      = (⊤ : Subalgebra ℂ (BosonicAlgebra M))

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.comap_jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
**The inclusion of a species is a map of differential algebras.** Pulling back along a
  map of target spaces commutes with the total derivative: the two act on different labels
  of a component function.
entries.snippet:
lemma comap_jetDeriv (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : BosonicAlgebra N) :
    comap f (jetDeriv μ x) = jetDeriv μ (comap f x)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.comap_iteratedJetDeriv
entries.docstring: The inclusion of a species commutes with the iterated total derivative.
entries.snippet:
lemma comap_iteratedJetDeriv (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (x : BosonicAlgebra N) :
    comap f (iteratedJetDeriv s x) = iteratedJetDeriv s (comap f x)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
**The Lorentz action on the bosonic algebra** of the matter field `M`, induced
  from a representation `M.repLorentz` of `SL(2,ℂ)` on `V`: the symmetric-algebra functor applied
  to the Lorentz action on the jet component space.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repLorentzGroup :
    Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) (BosonicAlgebra M) where

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (x : BosonicAlgebra M) :
    repLorentzGroup M Λ x =
      SymmetricAlgebra.map (JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup M Λ) x

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_apply_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_one (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    repLorentzGroup M Λ (1 : BosonicAlgebra M) = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_apply_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_mul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (x y : BosonicAlgebra M) :
    repLorentzGroup M Λ (x * y)
      = repLorentzGroup M Λ x * repLorentzGroup M Λ y

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_ι
entries.docstring: On a component function the Lorentz action is the action on the component space.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repLorentzGroup_ι (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (v : JetComponentSpace M) :
    repLorentzGroup M Λ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _ v) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _ (JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup M Λ v)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repLorentzGroupAlgHom
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action as an algebra homomorphism: it preserves the symmetric product, so a
  Lorentz transformation acts on a Lagrangian term factor by factor.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repLorentzGroupAlgHom (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    BosonicAlgebra M →ₐ[ℂ] BosonicAlgebra M where

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_ofField
entries.docstring:
**`ofField` is `SL(2,ℂ)`-equivariant.** The undifferentiated component functions carry
  the contragredient of the representation on the target space, and no derivative labels
  are generated: `ofField` intertwines `M.repLorentz.dual` with the action on the bosonic
  algebra.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repLorentzGroup_ofField (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V) :
    repLorentzGroup M Λ (ofField φ) = ofField (M.repLorentz.dual Λ φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_ofConjField
entries.docstring:
**`ofConjField` is `SL(2,ℂ)`-equivariant**, for the conjugate of the representation on
  the target space: the conjugate component functions transform by `star` of the spinor
  matrix.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repLorentzGroup_ofConjField (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    repLorentzGroup M Λ (ofConjField φ) = ofConjField (M.repLorentz.conj.dual Λ φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
**The total derivative on the bosonic algebra is a Lorentz vector.** The four
  derivations `∂_μ` transform into each other by the columns of the Lorentz matrix of `Λ`,
  exactly as the covector index `μ` should.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_jetDeriv (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : BosonicAlgebra M) :
    repLorentzGroup M Λ (jetDeriv μ x) =
      ∑ a, (((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 a μ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        jetDeriv a (repLorentzGroup M Λ x)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.instIsLorentzDeriv
entries.docstring:
The total derivatives on the bosonic algebra form a Lorentz derivative, giving access
  to the boost-weight machinery of `PhyslibAlpha.Relativity.IsLorentzDeriv`.
entries.snippet:
instance instIsLorentzDeriv :
    Lorentz.IsLorentzDeriv (repLorentzGroup M) (jetDeriv (M := M)) where

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.massWeightScale
entries.docstring:
**The mass-weight scaling on the bosonic algebra** of a field of mass weight `w`:
  the algebra endomorphism scaling the generator `∂_s φ_α` by `c ^ (w + 2 |s|)`, the
  functorial lift of the scaling on the jet component space.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def massWeightScale (w : ℕ) (c : ℂ) : BosonicAlgebra M →ₐ[ℂ] BosonicAlgebra M

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.massWeightScale_ι
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma massWeightScale_ι (w : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    massWeightScale w c (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _ x)
      = SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _ (JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale w c x)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.massWeightScale_ofField
entries.docstring: The undifferentiated field carries its own mass weight.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma massWeightScale_ofField (w : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V) :
    massWeightScale w c (ofField φ) = c ^ w • ofField φ

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.massWeightScale_ofConjField
entries.docstring: The undifferentiated conjugate field carries the same mass weight as the field.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma massWeightScale_ofConjField (w : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    massWeightScale w c (ofConjField φ) = c ^ w • ofConjField φ

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.massWeightScale_jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
**A total derivative adds mass weight two**: the scaling intertwines the total
  derivative up to a factor `c ^ 2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightScale_jetDeriv (w : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : BosonicAlgebra M) :
    massWeightScale w c (jetDeriv μ x) = c ^ 2 • jetDeriv μ (massWeightScale w c x)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.massWeightScale_iteratedJetDeriv
entries.docstring: **The iterated derivative `∂_s` adds mass weight `2 |s|`.**
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightScale_iteratedJetDeriv (w : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (x : BosonicAlgebra M) :
    massWeightScale w c (iteratedJetDeriv s x)
      = c ^ (2 * Multiset.card s) • iteratedJetDeriv s (massWeightScale w c x)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.monomialₗ
entries.docstring:
The monomial map into polynomials over the bosonic algebra, as a map of `ℂ`-modules
  rather than of `BosonicAlgebra M`-modules.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def monomialₗ (n : ℕ) :
    BosonicAlgebra M →ₗ[ℂ] Polynomial (BosonicAlgebra M)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.monomialₗ_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma monomialₗ_apply (n : ℕ) (x : BosonicAlgebra M) :
    monomialₗ n x = Polynomial.monomial n x

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.halfPoly
entries.docstring:
One half of the mass-weight polynomial on the jet component space, for a field of mass
  weight `w`: the linear map sending the symbol `∂_s φ` to `X ^ (w + 2 |s|)` times its
  image under `k`. The two halves of the component space differ only in the inclusion `k`
  of the symbols into the bosonic algebra, so both are instances of this map.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def halfPoly {W : Type} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W] (w : ℕ)
    (k : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] W →ₗ[ℂ] BosonicAlgebra M) :
    SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] W →ₗ[ℂ] Polynomial (BosonicAlgebra M)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.halfPoly_basis_tmul
entries.docstring:
On the symbol `∂_s φ` the half mass-weight polynomial is the monomial of degree
  `w + 2 |s|`: the field contributes `w` and each derivative two.
entries.snippet:
lemma halfPoly_basis_tmul {W : Type} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W] (w : ℕ)
    (k : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] W →ₗ[ℂ] BosonicAlgebra M)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (x : W) :
    halfPoly w k (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] x) =
      Polynomial.monomial (w + 2 * Multiset.card s)
        (k (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] x))

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.ιFst
entries.docstring: The inclusion of the unconjugated symbols into the bosonic algebra.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def ιFst : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ M.V →ₗ[ℂ] BosonicAlgebra M

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.ιSnd
entries.docstring: The inclusion of the conjugate symbols into the bosonic algebra.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def ιSnd :
    SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V) →ₗ[ℂ] BosonicAlgebra M

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.jetComponentPoly
entries.docstring:
The mass-weight polynomial of a component function of a field of mass weight `w`: the
  sum of the two half maps, one for the field and one for its conjugate.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetComponentPoly (w : ℕ) :
    JetComponentSpace M →ₗ[ℂ] Polynomial (BosonicAlgebra M)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.jetComponentPoly_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma jetComponentPoly_apply (w : ℕ) (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    jetComponentPoly w x = halfPoly w ιFst x.1 + halfPoly w ιSnd x.2

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.jetComponentPoly_inl
entries.docstring: On an unconjugated derivative monomial the component map is a monomial eigenvector.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetComponentPoly_inl (w : ℕ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V) :
    jetComponentPoly w ((SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ, 0) : JetComponentSpace M) =
      Polynomial.monomial (w + 2 * Multiset.card s)
        (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ (JetComponentSpace M)
          ((SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ, 0) : JetComponentSpace M))

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.jetComponentPoly_inr
entries.docstring: On a conjugate derivative monomial the component map is a monomial eigenvector.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetComponentPoly_inr (w : ℕ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    jetComponentPoly w ((0, SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ) : JetComponentSpace M) =
      Polynomial.monomial (w + 2 * Multiset.card s)
        (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ (JetComponentSpace M)
          ((0, SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ) : JetComponentSpace M))

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.massWeightPoly
entries.docstring:
The mass-weight polynomial on the bosonic algebra of a field of mass weight `w`: the
  `ℂ`-algebra map sending a generator of mass weight `n` to `X ^ n` times itself. It is
  `BosonicAlgebra.massWeightScale` with the scalar replaced by the formal variable `X`, and
  needs no side condition because `Polynomial (BosonicAlgebra M)` is commutative.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def massWeightPoly (w : ℕ) :
    BosonicAlgebra M →ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial (BosonicAlgebra M)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.massWeightPoly_ι
entries.docstring: On a component function the mass-weight polynomial is the component-function map.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma massWeightPoly_ι (w : ℕ) (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    massWeightPoly w (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ (JetComponentSpace M) x) =
      jetComponentPoly w x

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.massWeightPoly_iteratedJetDeriv_ofField
entries.docstring:
The generator `∂_s ψ_φ` is a monomial eigenvector of mass weight `w + 2 |s|`: the field
  carries its own mass weight and each derivative adds two.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_iteratedJetDeriv_ofField (w : ℕ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V) :
    massWeightPoly w (iteratedJetDeriv s (ofField φ)) =
      Polynomial.monomial (w + 2 * Multiset.card s) (iteratedJetDeriv s (ofField φ))

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.massWeightPoly_iteratedJetDeriv_ofConjField
entries.docstring:
The conjugate generator `∂_s ψ̄_φ` is a monomial eigenvector of the same mass weight
  `w + 2 |s|` as the generator it conjugates.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_iteratedJetDeriv_ofConjField (w : ℕ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    massWeightPoly w (iteratedJetDeriv s (ofConjField φ)) =
      Polynomial.monomial (w + 2 * Multiset.card s)
        (iteratedJetDeriv s (ofConjField φ))

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.massWeightPoly_ofField
entries.docstring: The undifferentiated field has mass weight `w`.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_ofField (w : ℕ) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V) :
    massWeightPoly w (ofField φ) = Polynomial.monomial w (ofField φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.massWeightPoly_ofConjField
entries.docstring: The undifferentiated conjugate field has mass weight `w`.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_ofConjField (w : ℕ) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    massWeightPoly w (ofConjField φ) = Polynomial.monomial w (ofConjField φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.halfPoly_eval_one
entries.docstring:
Setting the formal variable to one collapses a half mass-weight polynomial back to the
  symbol it graded. The derivative monomials span, so it is enough to check this on the
  multiset basis.
entries.snippet:
lemma halfPoly_eval_one {W : Type} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W] (w : ℕ)
    (k : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] W →ₗ[ℂ] BosonicAlgebra M)
    (y : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] W) : (halfPoly w k y).eval 1 = k y

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.jetComponentPoly_eval_one
entries.docstring: Setting the formal variable to one recovers the component function.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetComponentPoly_eval_one (w : ℕ) (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    (jetComponentPoly w x).eval 1 = SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ (JetComponentSpace M) x

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.massWeightPoly_eval_one
entries.docstring:
Setting the formal variable to one recovers the original element: the mass-weight
  pieces of an element sum back to it.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_eval_one (w : ℕ) (a : BosonicAlgebra M) :
    (massWeightPoly w a).eval 1 = a

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.massWeightPoly_injective
entries.docstring:
The mass-weight polynomial is injective: an element is recovered from its graded
  pieces. It is not surjective, since a monomial of the wrong degree is not the grading of
  anything.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_injective (w : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (massWeightPoly (M := M) w)

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.prodEquiv
entries.docstring:
**The bosonic algebra of a direct sum is the tensor product of the bosonic algebras.**
  Two bosonic matter fields taken together are one field valued in the direct sum of their
  target spaces, and its bosonic algebra is the tensor product of theirs. The ordinary —
  rather than the graded — tensor product is correct here: bosonic generators commute
  across species just as they do within one.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def BosonicAlgebra.prodEquiv (M N : MatterField jets)
    (h : M.massWeight = N.massWeight) (hσ : M.statistic = N.statistic) :
    BosonicAlgebra (M.prod N h hσ) ≃ₐ[ℂ] BosonicAlgebra M ⊗[ℂ] BosonicAlgebra N

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.sum_inl
entries.docstring:
A multiset sum in the unconjugated half of the component space passes through the
  inclusion of the generators.
entries.snippet:
private lemma sum_inl (m : Multiset (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ M.V)) :
    SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _ ((m.sum, 0) : JetComponentSpace M)
      = (m.map fun a =>
          SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _ ((a, 0) : JetComponentSpace M)).sum

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.sum_inr
entries.docstring:
A multiset sum in the conjugate half of the component space passes through the
  inclusion of the generators.
entries.snippet:
private lemma sum_inr (m : Multiset (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V))) :
    SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _ ((0, m.sum) : JetComponentSpace M)
      = (m.map fun a =>
          SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ _ ((0, a) : JetComponentSpace M)).sum

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_iteratedJetDeriv_ofField
entries.docstring:
The transformation law of the derivative generators of a matter field: a jet of gauge
  transformations mixes `∂_s ψ_φ` with the lower generators, each splitting `s = s₁ + s₂` of
  the derivative multiset contributing the base-point Taylor coefficient of the gauge jet at
  `s₁` acting on the target index of `∂_{s₂} ψ_φ`. There is no inhomogeneous term: unlike a
  gauge field, a matter field transforms linearly.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_iteratedJetDeriv_ofField
    (U : GJ) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI M U (iteratedJetDeriv s (ofField φ)) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        iteratedJetDeriv p.2
          (ofField (GaugeAlgebraRealization.repDualCoeff M.repJet U⁻¹ p.1 φ))).sum

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.transformsIn_iteratedJetDeriv_ofField
entries.docstring:
The derivative generators of a matter field transform in the representation `rep`
  carried by its jets, in the sense demanded by `LocalGaugeData.TransformsIn`.
entries.snippet:
lemma transformsIn_iteratedJetDeriv_ofField :
    LocalGaugeData.TransformsIn (repJetGaugeGroupI M) M.repJet
      fun s => (iteratedJetDeriv s).comp (ofField (M := M))

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_iteratedJetDeriv_ofConjField
entries.docstring:
The transformation law of the derivative generators of the conjugate matter field. It
  is the law of the field itself for the conjugate action `JetComponentSpace.repConj M.repJet` on
  the jets of the
  conjugate field — the physicists' `ψ̄ ↦ ψ̄ U†` and its derivatives.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_iteratedJetDeriv_ofConjField
    (U : GJ) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V))
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI M U (iteratedJetDeriv s (ofConjField φ)) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        iteratedJetDeriv p.2
          (ofConjField
            (GaugeAlgebraRealization.repDualCoeff (JetComponentSpace.repConj M.repJet) U⁻¹ p.1
              φ))).sum

entries.name: StandardModel.BosonicAlgebra.transformsIn_iteratedJetDeriv_ofConjField
entries.docstring:
The derivative generators of the conjugate matter field transform in the conjugate
  representation `JetComponentSpace.repConj M.repJet`, in the sense demanded by
  `LocalGaugeData.TransformsIn`.
entries.snippet:
lemma transformsIn_iteratedJetDeriv_ofConjField :
    LocalGaugeData.TransformsIn (repJetGaugeGroupI M) (JetComponentSpace.repConj M.repJet)
      fun s => (iteratedJetDeriv s).comp (ofConjField (M := M))

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra
entries.docstring:
The fermionic algebra of the matter field `M`: the exterior algebra on the space
  of component functions `∂_s ψ_α` and `∂_s ψ̄_α`. The exterior product is the product of
  fermionic fields, its anticommutativity the Fermi statistics.
entries.snippet: abbrev FermionicAlgebra (M : MatterField jets) : Type

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.adjoin_ι_eq_top
entries.docstring:
**The fermionic algebra is generated by the component functions.** Every element is a
  polynomial in the degree-one elements — the symbols `∂_s ψ_α` and `∂_s ψ̄_α` themselves.
  This is the algebraic form of "every Lagrangian term is a polynomial in the component
  functions".
entries.snippet:
lemma adjoin_ι_eq_top :
    Algebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ (M := JetComponentSpace M))) = ⊤

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.ι_sq_zero
entries.docstring: A component function squares to zero: no fermionic field appears twice.
entries.snippet:
lemma ι_sq_zero (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ x * ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ x = (0 : FermionicAlgebra M)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.ι_mul_ι_swap
entries.docstring: Two component functions anticommute.
entries.snippet:
lemma ι_mul_ι_swap (x y : JetComponentSpace M) :
    (ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ x * ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ y : FermionicAlgebra M)
      = - (ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ y * ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ x)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.ofField
entries.docstring:
**The component function `ψ_φ` of the matter field** along the covector `φ` on `V`: the
  undifferentiated generator, sitting at the empty derivative label in the unconjugated half
  of the component space.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def ofField : Module.Dual ℂ M.V →ₗ[ℂ] FermionicAlgebra M

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.ofConjField
entries.docstring:
**The component function `ψ̄_φ` of the conjugate matter field** along the covector `φ` on
  `ConjModule M.V`: the undifferentiated generator in the conjugate half of the component
  space.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def ofConjField : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V) →ₗ[ℂ] FermionicAlgebra M

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.ofField_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma ofField_apply (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V) :
    ofField φ = ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ
      (((1 : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ, 0) : JetComponentSpace M)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.ofConjField_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma ofConjField_apply (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    ofConjField φ = ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ
      ((0, (1 : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ) : JetComponentSpace M)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.comap
entries.docstring:
**The fermionic algebra is contravariant in the target space.** A linear map
  `f : V →ₗ[ℂ] W` induces an algebra homomorphism `FermionicAlgebra N →ₐ[ℂ] FermionicAlgebra M`
  by pulling back component functions. Applied to a *projection* out of a multi-species target
  space, this is the inclusion of one species' algebra into the whole.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def comap (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) : FermionicAlgebra N →ₐ[ℂ] FermionicAlgebra M

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.comap_ι
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma comap_ι (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) (x : JetComponentSpace N) :
    comap f (ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ x)
      = ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ (JetComponentSpace.comap f x)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.comap_id
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma comap_id : comap (LinearMap.id : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] M.V) = AlgHom.id ℂ (FermionicAlgebra M)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.comap_comp
entries.docstring: Functoriality: the order reverses, as it must for a contravariant construction.
entries.snippet:
lemma comap_comp {P : MatterField jets} (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) (g : N.V →ₗ[ℂ] P.V) :
    comap (g.comp f) = (comap f).comp (comap g)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.comap_ofField
entries.docstring:
The inclusion sends a component function of the species to the corresponding component
  function of the whole.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma comap_ofField (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ N.V) :
    comap f (ofField φ) = ofField (φ ∘ₗ f)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.comap_ofConjField
entries.docstring:
The inclusion sends a conjugate component function of the species to the corresponding
  conjugate component function of the whole.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma comap_ofConjField (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule N.V)) :
    comap f (ofConjField φ) = ofConjField (φ ∘ₗ ConjModule.map f)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI
entries.docstring:
**The jet gauge action on the fermionic algebra** of the matter field `M`: the exterior-algebra
  functor applied to the gauge action on the jet component space. The fibrewise action on the jets
  and its fibrewise-linearity are fields of `M`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repJetGaugeGroupI :
    Representation ℂ GJ (FermionicAlgebra M) where

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_apply
    (U : GJ) (x : FermionicAlgebra M) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI M U x =
      ExteriorAlgebra.map (JetComponentSpace.repJet M U) x

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_apply_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_apply_one
    (U : GJ) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI M U (1 : FermionicAlgebra M) = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_apply_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_apply_mul
    (U : GJ) (x y : FermionicAlgebra M) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI M U (x * y) =
      repJetGaugeGroupI M U x * repJetGaugeGroupI M U y

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_ι
entries.docstring: On a component function the jet gauge action is the action on the component space.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_ι
    (U : GJ) (v : JetComponentSpace M) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI M U (ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ v) =
      ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ (JetComponentSpace.repJet M U v)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupIAlgHom
entries.docstring:
The jet gauge action as an algebra homomorphism: a gauge transformation acts on a
  Lagrangian term factor by factor.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repJetGaugeGroupIAlgHom
    (U : GJ) : FermionicAlgebra M →ₐ[ℂ] FermionicAlgebra M where

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_ofField
entries.docstring:
**`ofField` is gauge equivariant.** The undifferentiated component functions transform
  by the contragredient of the value of the gauge transformation at the base point; no
  derivative of the gauge jet contributes.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_ofField
    (U : GJ) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI M U (ofField φ) =
      ofField (Module.Dual.transpose (jetEval ∘ₗ (M.repJet U⁻¹).comp jetOfConstant) φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_ofConjField
entries.docstring:
**`ofConjField` is gauge equivariant**, for the conjugate action
  `JetComponentSpace.repConj rep` on the
  jets of the conjugate field — which is the physicists' `ψ̄ ↦ ψ̄ U†`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_ofConjField
    (U : GJ) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI M U (ofConjField φ) =
      ofConjField (Module.Dual.transpose
        (jetEval ∘ₗ (JetComponentSpace.repConj M.repJet U⁻¹).comp jetOfConstant) φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repGaugeGroupI
entries.docstring:
The action of the constant — that is, global — gauge transformations on the fermionic
  algebra, obtained by including a gauge transformation as a constant gauge jet.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repGaugeGroupI :
    Representation ℂ G₀ (FermionicAlgebra M)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repGaugeGroupI_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_apply
    (g : G₀) (x : FermionicAlgebra M) :
    repGaugeGroupI M g x =
      repJetGaugeGroupI M (jets.ofConstant g) x

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repGaugeGroupI_apply_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repGaugeGroupI_apply_one
    (g : G₀) :
    repGaugeGroupI M g (1 : FermionicAlgebra M) = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repGaugeGroupI_apply_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_apply_mul
    (g : G₀) (x y : FermionicAlgebra M) :
    repGaugeGroupI M g (x * y) =
      repGaugeGroupI M g x * repGaugeGroupI M g y

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repGaugeGroupI_ofField
entries.docstring:
A constant gauge transformation acts on the undifferentiated field by the
  contragredient of its value — which for a constant jet is the transformation itself.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_ofField
    (g : G₀) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V) :
    repGaugeGroupI M g (ofField φ) =
      ofField (Module.Dual.transpose
        (jetEval ∘ₗ (M.repJet (jets.ofConstant g⁻¹)).comp jetOfConstant) φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repGaugeGroupI_ofConjField
entries.docstring:
A constant gauge transformation acts on the undifferentiated conjugate field by the
  conjugate contragredient of its value.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_ofConjField
    (g : G₀) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    repGaugeGroupI M g (ofConjField φ) =
      ofConjField (Module.Dual.transpose
        (jetEval ∘ₗ (JetComponentSpace.repConj M.repJet (jets.ofConstant g⁻¹)).comp
          jetOfConstant) φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetDerivGen
entries.docstring:
The generator map of the total derivative into the trivial square-zero extension of the
  fermionic algebra: `ι x ↦ (ι x, ι (∂_μ x))`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetDerivGen (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    JetComponentSpace M →ₗ[ℂ] TrivSqZeroExt (FermionicAlgebra M) (FermionicAlgebra M) where

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetDerivGen_fst
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDerivGen_fst (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    (jetDerivGen μ x).fst = ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ x

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetDerivGen_snd
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDerivGen_snd (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    (jetDerivGen μ x).snd = ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ (JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv μ x)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetDerivGen_mul_self
entries.docstring:
The generator map squares to zero: degree-one elements of the exterior algebra
  anticommute.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDerivGen_mul_self (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    jetDerivGen μ x * jetDerivGen μ x = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetDerivHom
entries.docstring:
The lift of the total derivative to the trivial square-zero extension of the fermionic
  algebra: the algebra homomorphism `x ↦ (x, ∂_μ x)`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetDerivHom (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    FermionicAlgebra M →ₐ[ℂ] TrivSqZeroExt (FermionicAlgebra M) (FermionicAlgebra M)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetDerivHom_ι
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDerivHom_ι (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    jetDerivHom μ (ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ x) = jetDerivGen μ x

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetDerivHom_fst
entries.docstring: The first component of the square-zero lift is the identity.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDerivHom_fst (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : FermionicAlgebra M) :
    (jetDerivHom μ x).fst = x

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
The formal total spacetime derivative on the fermionic algebra of a `V`-valued matter
  field in the direction `μ`: the even derivation extending the shift
  `∂_s ψ_α ↦ ∂_{s + {μ}} ψ_α` of the component functions.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetDeriv (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    FermionicAlgebra M →ₗ[ℂ] FermionicAlgebra M where

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetDeriv_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_apply (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : FermionicAlgebra M) :
    jetDeriv μ x = (jetDerivHom μ x).snd

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetDeriv_ι
entries.docstring: On a component function the total derivative is the shift of the derivative label.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDeriv_ι (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    jetDeriv μ (ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ x) =
      ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ (JetComponentSpace.jetDeriv μ x)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetDeriv_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDeriv_one (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : jetDeriv (M := M) μ (1 : FermionicAlgebra M) = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetDeriv_algebraMap
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetDeriv_algebraMap (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (r : ℂ) :
    jetDeriv (M := M) μ (algebraMap ℂ (FermionicAlgebra M) r) = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetDeriv_mul
entries.docstring:
The total derivative is an even derivation: the Leibniz rule holds on the fermionic
  algebra with no Koszul signs.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_mul (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x y : FermionicAlgebra M) :
    jetDeriv μ (x * y) = jetDeriv μ x * y + x * jetDeriv μ y

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetDeriv_comm_apply
entries.docstring:
**Mixed partials agree.** The derivative labels live in a *symmetric* algebra, so the
  total derivatives in different directions commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_comm_apply (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : FermionicAlgebra M) :
    jetDeriv μ (jetDeriv ν x) = jetDeriv ν (jetDeriv μ x)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetDeriv_comm
entries.snippet:
lemma jetDeriv_comm (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (jetDeriv (M := M) μ).comp (jetDeriv ν) = (jetDeriv (M := M) ν).comp (jetDeriv μ)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv
entries.docstring:
The iterated total derivative `∂_s = ∂_{ν₁} ⋯ ∂_{νₙ}` along a multiset `s` of
  directions. It is well defined on a multiset — i.e. independent of the order in which the
  directions are listed — because the directional derivatives commute.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def iteratedJetDeriv (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    FermionicAlgebra M →ₗ[ℂ] FermionicAlgebra M

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_zero :
    iteratedJetDeriv (0 : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      = LinearMap.id (R := ℂ) (M := FermionicAlgebra M)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_cons
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_cons (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    iteratedJetDeriv (M := M) (μ ::ₘ s) = (jetDeriv μ).comp (iteratedJetDeriv s)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_cons'
entries.docstring: The companion of `iteratedJetDeriv_cons`, peeling the extra derivative on the inside.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_cons' (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    iteratedJetDeriv (M := M) (μ ::ₘ s) = (iteratedJetDeriv s).comp (jetDeriv μ)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_singleton
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_singleton (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    iteratedJetDeriv (M := M) {μ} = jetDeriv μ

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_add
entries.docstring:
The iterated derivative is additive in the multiset of directions: differentiating
  along `s + t` is differentiating along `t` and then along `s`.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_add (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    iteratedJetDeriv (M := M) (s + t)
      = (iteratedJetDeriv s).comp (iteratedJetDeriv t)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_mul
entries.docstring:
**The all-orders Leibniz rule.** The iterated derivative of a product distributes over
  the antidiagonal of the multiset of directions: each way of splitting the derivatives
  between the two factors contributes one term.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_mul (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (x y : FermionicAlgebra M) :
    iteratedJetDeriv s (x * y) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        iteratedJetDeriv p.1 x * iteratedJetDeriv p.2 y).sum

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_one_of_ne_zero
entries.docstring: A nonempty iterated derivative kills the constants.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_one_of_ne_zero {s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)} (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    iteratedJetDeriv (M := M) s (1 : FermionicAlgebra M) = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_ι
entries.docstring:
**On a component function the iterated derivative is the derivative symbol `∂_s`.**
  Both halves of the component space — the field and its conjugate — are multiplied by the
  degree-`|s|` element `∂_s` of `SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ` in their derivative-label factor,
  with the target index untouched.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_ι (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    iteratedJetDeriv s (ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ x) =
      ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ
        (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s))
            LinearMap.id x.1,
          TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s))
            LinearMap.id x.2)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_ofField
entries.docstring:
The iterated derivative of the field is the generator carrying the derivative symbol
  `∂_s`: applying `∂_s` to `ψ_φ` writes the label `s` into the derivative factor.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_ofField (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V) :
    iteratedJetDeriv s (ofField φ) =
      ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ ((SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ, 0) : JetComponentSpace M)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_ofConjField
entries.docstring:
The iterated derivative of the conjugate field is the conjugate generator carrying the
  derivative symbol `∂_s`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_ofConjField (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    iteratedJetDeriv s (ofConjField φ) =
      ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ ((0, SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ) : JetComponentSpace M)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.adjoin_iteratedJetDeriv_eq_top
entries.docstring:
**The fermionic algebra is generated by the field, its conjugate, and their
  derivatives.** As a `ℂ`-algebra, `FermionicAlgebra M` is the algebra adjoined by the
  iterated total derivatives `∂_s ψ_φ` and `∂_s ψ̄_φ` of the undifferentiated component
  functions. Physically: every Lagrangian term for the matter field `M` is a
  polynomial in the field, its conjugate, and their spacetime derivatives — nothing else is
  available to write down.

  This sharpens `adjoin_ι_eq_top`, which only says the algebra is generated by the
  component functions; here the component functions are themselves produced from the two
  inclusions `ofField` and `ofConjField` by differentiating.
entries.snippet:
lemma adjoin_iteratedJetDeriv_eq_top :
    Algebra.adjoin ℂ
      (⋃ s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
        Set.range (fun φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V => iteratedJetDeriv s (ofField φ)) ∪
          Set.range (fun φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V) =>
            iteratedJetDeriv s (ofConjField φ)))
      = (⊤ : Subalgebra ℂ (FermionicAlgebra M))

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.comap_jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
**The inclusion of a species is a map of differential algebras.** Pulling back along a
  map of target spaces commutes with the total derivative: the two act on different labels
  of a component function.
entries.snippet:
lemma comap_jetDeriv (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : FermionicAlgebra N) :
    comap f (jetDeriv μ x) = jetDeriv μ (comap f x)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.comap_iteratedJetDeriv
entries.docstring: The inclusion of a species commutes with the iterated total derivative.
entries.snippet:
lemma comap_iteratedJetDeriv (f : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] N.V) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (x : FermionicAlgebra N) :
    comap f (iteratedJetDeriv s x) = iteratedJetDeriv s (comap f x)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
**The Lorentz action on the fermionic algebra** of the matter field `M`, induced
  from a representation `M.repLorentz` of `SL(2,ℂ)` on `V`: the exterior-algebra functor applied to
  the Lorentz action on the jet component space.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repLorentzGroup :
    Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) (FermionicAlgebra M) where

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (x : FermionicAlgebra M) :
    repLorentzGroup M Λ x =
      ExteriorAlgebra.map (JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup M Λ) x

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_apply_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_one (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    repLorentzGroup M Λ (1 : FermionicAlgebra M) = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_apply_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_mul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (x y : FermionicAlgebra M) :
    repLorentzGroup M Λ (x * y)
      = repLorentzGroup M Λ x * repLorentzGroup M Λ y

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_ι
entries.docstring: On a component function the Lorentz action is the action on the component space.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repLorentzGroup_ι (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (v : JetComponentSpace M) :
    repLorentzGroup M Λ (ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ v) =
      ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ (JetComponentSpace.repLorentzGroup M Λ v)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repLorentzGroupAlgHom
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action as an algebra homomorphism: it preserves the exterior product, so a
  Lorentz transformation acts on a Lagrangian term factor by factor.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repLorentzGroupAlgHom (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    FermionicAlgebra M →ₐ[ℂ] FermionicAlgebra M where

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_ofField
entries.docstring:
**`ofField` is `SL(2,ℂ)`-equivariant.** The undifferentiated component functions carry
  the contragredient of the representation on the target space, and no derivative labels
  are generated: `ofField` intertwines `M.repLorentz.dual` with the action on the fermionic
  algebra.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repLorentzGroup_ofField (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V) :
    repLorentzGroup M Λ (ofField φ) = ofField (M.repLorentz.dual Λ φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_ofConjField
entries.docstring:
**`ofConjField` is `SL(2,ℂ)`-equivariant**, for the conjugate of the representation on
  the target space: the conjugate component functions transform by `star` of the spinor
  matrix.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repLorentzGroup_ofConjField (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    repLorentzGroup M Λ (ofConjField φ) = ofConjField (M.repLorentz.conj.dual Λ φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
**The total derivative on the fermionic algebra is a Lorentz vector.** The four
  derivations `∂_μ` transform into each other by the columns of the Lorentz matrix of `Λ`,
  exactly as the covector index `μ` should.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_jetDeriv (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : FermionicAlgebra M) :
    repLorentzGroup M Λ (jetDeriv μ x) =
      ∑ a, (((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 a μ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        jetDeriv a (repLorentzGroup M Λ x)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.instIsLorentzDeriv
entries.docstring:
The total derivatives on the fermionic algebra form a Lorentz derivative, giving access
  to the boost-weight machinery of `PhyslibAlpha.Relativity.IsLorentzDeriv`.
entries.snippet:
instance instIsLorentzDeriv :
    Lorentz.IsLorentzDeriv (repLorentzGroup M) (jetDeriv (M := M)) where

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.massWeightScale
entries.docstring:
**The mass-weight scaling on the fermionic algebra** of a field of mass weight `w`:
  the algebra endomorphism scaling the generator `∂_s ψ_α` by `c ^ (w + 2 |s|)`, the
  functorial lift of the scaling on the jet component space.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def massWeightScale (w : ℕ) (c : ℂ) :
    FermionicAlgebra M →ₐ[ℂ] FermionicAlgebra M

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.massWeightScale_ι
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma massWeightScale_ι (w : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    massWeightScale w c (ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ x)
      = ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ (JetComponentSpace.massWeightScale w c x)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.massWeightScale_ofField
entries.docstring: The undifferentiated field carries its own mass weight.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma massWeightScale_ofField (w : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V) :
    massWeightScale w c (ofField φ) = c ^ w • ofField φ

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.massWeightScale_ofConjField
entries.docstring: The undifferentiated conjugate field carries the same mass weight as the field.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma massWeightScale_ofConjField (w : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    massWeightScale w c (ofConjField φ) = c ^ w • ofConjField φ

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.massWeightScale_jetDeriv
entries.docstring:
**A total derivative adds mass weight two**: the scaling intertwines the total
  derivative up to a factor `c ^ 2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightScale_jetDeriv (w : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (x : FermionicAlgebra M) :
    massWeightScale w c (jetDeriv μ x) = c ^ 2 • jetDeriv μ (massWeightScale w c x)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.massWeightScale_iteratedJetDeriv
entries.docstring: **The iterated derivative `∂_s` adds mass weight `2 |s|`.**
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightScale_iteratedJetDeriv (w : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (x : FermionicAlgebra M) :
    massWeightScale w c (iteratedJetDeriv s x)
      = c ^ (2 * Multiset.card s) • iteratedJetDeriv s (massWeightScale w c x)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.monomialₗ
entries.docstring:
The monomial map into polynomials over the fermionic algebra, as a map of `ℂ`-modules
  rather than of `FermionicAlgebra M`-modules.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def monomialₗ (n : ℕ) :
    FermionicAlgebra M →ₗ[ℂ] Polynomial (FermionicAlgebra M)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.monomialₗ_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma monomialₗ_apply (n : ℕ) (x : FermionicAlgebra M) :
    monomialₗ n x = Polynomial.monomial n x

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.halfPoly
entries.docstring:
One half of the mass-weight polynomial on the jet component space, for a field of mass
  weight `w`: the linear map sending the symbol `∂_s ψ` to `X ^ (w + 2 |s|)` times its image
  under `k`. The two halves of the component space differ only in the inclusion `k` of the
  symbols into the fermionic algebra, so both are instances of this map.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def halfPoly {W : Type} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W] (w : ℕ)
    (k : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] W →ₗ[ℂ] FermionicAlgebra M) :
    SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] W →ₗ[ℂ] Polynomial (FermionicAlgebra M)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.halfPoly_basis_tmul
entries.docstring:
On the symbol `∂_s ψ` the half mass-weight polynomial is the monomial of degree
  `w + 2 |s|`: the field contributes `w` and each derivative two.
entries.snippet:
lemma halfPoly_basis_tmul {W : Type} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W] (w : ℕ)
    (k : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] W →ₗ[ℂ] FermionicAlgebra M)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (x : W) :
    halfPoly w k (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] x) =
      Polynomial.monomial (w + 2 * Multiset.card s)
        (k (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] x))

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.ιFst
entries.docstring: The inclusion of the unconjugated symbols into the fermionic algebra.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def ιFst : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ M.V →ₗ[ℂ] FermionicAlgebra M

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.ιSnd
entries.docstring: The inclusion of the conjugate symbols into the fermionic algebra.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def ιSnd :
    SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V) →ₗ[ℂ] FermionicAlgebra M

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetComponentPoly
entries.docstring:
The mass-weight polynomial of a component function of a field of mass weight `w`: the
  sum of the two half maps, one for the field and one for its conjugate.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetComponentPoly (w : ℕ) :
    JetComponentSpace M →ₗ[ℂ] Polynomial (FermionicAlgebra M)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetComponentPoly_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma jetComponentPoly_apply (w : ℕ) (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    jetComponentPoly w x = halfPoly w ιFst x.1 + halfPoly w ιSnd x.2

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetComponentPoly_inl
entries.docstring: On an unconjugated derivative monomial the component map is a monomial eigenvector.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetComponentPoly_inl (w : ℕ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V) :
    jetComponentPoly w ((SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ, 0) : JetComponentSpace M) =
      Polynomial.monomial (w + 2 * Multiset.card s)
        (ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ
          ((SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ, 0) : JetComponentSpace M))

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetComponentPoly_inr
entries.docstring: On a conjugate derivative monomial the component map is a monomial eigenvector.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetComponentPoly_inr (w : ℕ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    jetComponentPoly w ((0, SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ) : JetComponentSpace M) =
      Polynomial.monomial (w + 2 * Multiset.card s)
        (ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ
          ((0, SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] φ) : JetComponentSpace M))

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.basisTmul_span_top
entries.docstring:
The derivative monomials span a tensor product with the derivative algebra: this is the
  spanning set on which the square-zero condition is checked.

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.generators
entries.docstring:
The set of derivative monomials in the jet component space: the unconjugated symbols
  `∂_s ψ_φ` together with the conjugate symbols `∂_s ψ̄_φ`.
entries.snippet: def generators (M : MatterField jets) : Set (JetComponentSpace M)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.span_generators_eq_top
entries.docstring:
The derivative monomials span the jet component space: every component function is the
  sum of its two halves, and each half is spanned by derivative monomials.
entries.snippet: lemma span_generators_eq_top : Submodule.span ℂ (generators M) = ⊤

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.exists_jetComponentPoly_eq_monomial
entries.docstring:
Every derivative monomial is a monomial eigenvector of the component map: this is the
  only property of the component map that the square-zero argument uses.

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetComponentPoly_mul_self
entries.docstring:
The component map squares to zero, as the universal property of the exterior algebra
  demands. The symmetrised square is a bilinear form, so it is enough to check that it
  vanishes on the derivative monomials, where it is a monomial multiple of
  `ExteriorAlgebra.ι_add_mul_swap`; halving then gives the square itself.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetComponentPoly_mul_self (w : ℕ) (v : JetComponentSpace M) :
    jetComponentPoly w v * jetComponentPoly w v = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.massWeightPoly
entries.docstring:
The mass-weight polynomial on the fermionic algebra of a field of mass weight `w`: the
  `ℂ`-algebra map sending a generator of mass weight `n` to `X ^ n` times itself. It is
  `FermionicAlgebra.massWeightScale` with the scalar replaced by the formal variable `X`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def massWeightPoly (w : ℕ) :
    FermionicAlgebra M →ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial (FermionicAlgebra M)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.massWeightPoly_ι
entries.docstring: On a component function the mass-weight polynomial is the component-function map.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma massWeightPoly_ι (w : ℕ) (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    massWeightPoly w (ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ x) = jetComponentPoly w x

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.massWeightPoly_iteratedJetDeriv_ofField
entries.docstring:
The generator `∂_s ψ_φ` is a monomial eigenvector of mass weight `w + 2 |s|`: the field
  carries its own mass weight and each derivative adds two.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_iteratedJetDeriv_ofField (w : ℕ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V) :
    massWeightPoly w (iteratedJetDeriv s (ofField φ)) =
      Polynomial.monomial (w + 2 * Multiset.card s) (iteratedJetDeriv s (ofField φ))

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.massWeightPoly_iteratedJetDeriv_ofConjField
entries.docstring:
The conjugate generator `∂_s ψ̄_φ` is a monomial eigenvector of the same mass weight
  `w + 2 |s|` as the generator it conjugates.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_iteratedJetDeriv_ofConjField (w : ℕ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    massWeightPoly w (iteratedJetDeriv s (ofConjField φ)) =
      Polynomial.monomial (w + 2 * Multiset.card s)
        (iteratedJetDeriv s (ofConjField φ))

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.massWeightPoly_ofField
entries.docstring: The undifferentiated field has mass weight `w`.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_ofField (w : ℕ) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V) :
    massWeightPoly w (ofField φ) = Polynomial.monomial w (ofField φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.massWeightPoly_ofConjField
entries.docstring: The undifferentiated conjugate field has mass weight `w`.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_ofConjField (w : ℕ) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V)) :
    massWeightPoly w (ofConjField φ) = Polynomial.monomial w (ofConjField φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.halfPoly_eval_one
entries.docstring:
Setting the formal variable to one collapses a half mass-weight polynomial back to the
  symbol it graded. The derivative monomials span, so it is enough to check this on the
  multiset basis.
entries.snippet:
lemma halfPoly_eval_one {W : Type} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W] (w : ℕ)
    (k : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] W →ₗ[ℂ] FermionicAlgebra M)
    (y : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] W) : (halfPoly w k y).eval 1 = k y

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.jetComponentPoly_eval_one
entries.docstring: Setting the formal variable to one recovers the component function.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetComponentPoly_eval_one (w : ℕ) (x : JetComponentSpace M) :
    (jetComponentPoly w x).eval 1 = ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ x

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.massWeightPoly_eval_one
entries.docstring:
Setting the formal variable to one recovers the original element: the mass-weight
  pieces of an element sum back to it.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_eval_one (w : ℕ) (a : FermionicAlgebra M) :
    (massWeightPoly w a).eval 1 = a

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.massWeightPoly_injective
entries.docstring:
The mass-weight polynomial is injective: an element is recovered from its graded
  pieces. It is not surjective, since a monomial of the wrong degree is not the grading of
  anything.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_injective (w : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (massWeightPoly (M := M) w)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.evenOdd
entries.docstring:
**The Fermi-parity grading** of the fermionic algebra: the `ZMod 2` grading of the
  exterior algebra by the number of component functions in a monomial. An even element
  commutes with everything; two odd elements anticommute.
entries.snippet:
abbrev FermionicAlgebra.evenOdd (M : MatterField jets) :
    ZMod 2 → Submodule ℂ (FermionicAlgebra M)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.prodEquiv
entries.docstring:
**The fermionic algebra of a direct sum is the exterior product of the fermionic
  algebras.** Two matter fields taken together are one field valued in the direct sum of
  their target spaces, and its fermionic algebra is the graded tensor product of theirs.

  The tensor product must be the *graded* one `ᵍ⊗`: an ordinary `⊗[ℂ]` would make a
  generator of the first field commute with a generator of the second, whereas fermionic
  generators anticommute across species just as they do within one.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def FermionicAlgebra.prodEquiv (M N : MatterField jets)
    (h : M.massWeight = N.massWeight) (hσ : M.statistic = N.statistic) :
    FermionicAlgebra (M.prod N h hσ) ≃ₐ[ℂ]
      (FermionicAlgebra.evenOdd M ᵍ⊗[ℂ] FermionicAlgebra.evenOdd N)

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.sum_inl
entries.docstring:
A multiset sum in the unconjugated half of the component space passes through the
  inclusion of the generators.

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.sum_inr
entries.docstring:
A multiset sum in the conjugate half of the component space passes through the
  inclusion of the generators.

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_iteratedJetDeriv_ofField
entries.docstring:
The transformation law of the derivative generators of a matter field: a jet of gauge
  transformations mixes `∂_s ψ_φ` with the lower generators, each splitting `s = s₁ + s₂` of
  the derivative multiset contributing the base-point Taylor coefficient of the gauge jet at
  `s₁` acting on the target index of `∂_{s₂} ψ_φ`. There is no inhomogeneous term: unlike a
  gauge field, a matter field transforms linearly.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_iteratedJetDeriv_ofField
    (U : GJ) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ M.V) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI M U (iteratedJetDeriv s (ofField φ)) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        iteratedJetDeriv p.2
          (ofField (GaugeAlgebraRealization.repDualCoeff M.repJet U⁻¹ p.1 φ))).sum

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.transformsIn_iteratedJetDeriv_ofField
entries.docstring:
The derivative generators of a matter field transform in the representation `rep`
  carried by its jets, in the sense demanded by `LocalGaugeData.TransformsIn`.
entries.snippet:
lemma transformsIn_iteratedJetDeriv_ofField :
    LocalGaugeData.TransformsIn (repJetGaugeGroupI M) M.repJet
      fun s => (iteratedJetDeriv s).comp (ofField (M := M))

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI_iteratedJetDeriv_ofConjField
entries.docstring:
The transformation law of the derivative generators of the conjugate matter field. It
  is the law of the field itself for the conjugate action `JetComponentSpace.repConj M.repJet` on
  the jets of the
  conjugate field — the physicists' `ψ̄ ↦ ψ̄ U†` and its derivatives.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_iteratedJetDeriv_ofConjField
    (U : GJ) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule M.V))
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI M U (iteratedJetDeriv s (ofConjField φ)) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        iteratedJetDeriv p.2
          (ofConjField
            (GaugeAlgebraRealization.repDualCoeff (JetComponentSpace.repConj M.repJet) U⁻¹ p.1
              φ))).sum

entries.name: StandardModel.FermionicAlgebra.transformsIn_iteratedJetDeriv_ofConjField
entries.docstring:
The derivative generators of the conjugate matter field transform in the conjugate
  representation `JetComponentSpace.repConj M.repJet`, in the sense demanded by
  `LocalGaugeData.TransformsIn`.
entries.snippet:
lemma transformsIn_iteratedJetDeriv_ofConjField :
    LocalGaugeData.TransformsIn (repJetGaugeGroupI M) (JetComponentSpace.repConj M.repJet)
      fun s => (iteratedJetDeriv s).comp (ofConjField (M := M))

entries.name: StandardModel.Model.localGaugeData_eq
entries.docstring:
The local gauge data assembled from the factors of the table is the existing local
  gauge data of the Standard Model.
entries.snippet: lemma localGaugeData_eq : StandardModel.localGaugeData = gaugeData

entries.name: StandardModel.Model.quarkDoublet_rep_mat
entries.docstring:
The quark doublet acts on its colour–weak index by the existing matrix `u · (U₃ ⊗ U₂)`
  of the quark doublet.
entries.snippet:
lemma quarkDoublet_rep_mat (U : JetGaugeGroupI) :
    quarkDoublet.rep.mat U = QuarkDoublet.jetGaugeMatrix U

entries.name: StandardModel.Model.leptonDoublet_toMatterField_eq
entries.docstring:
**The matter field of the datum is the matter field of the species**: the table's
  description and the species' description of the lepton doublet are one definition.
entries.snippet:
lemma leptonDoublet_toMatterField_eq :
    leptonDoublet.toMatterField = LeptonDoubletV.matterField

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization
entries.docstring:
The algebra `B`, with a jet gauge action, a Lorentz action and a mass-weight grading,
  is a Standard Model when it receives an algebra map from the jet algebra of the Standard
  Model which is equivariant for both actions and compatible with the grading. The fields
  of the Standard Model then sit inside `B` as the images of the jet algebra's own, and
  every law they satisfy there is the jet algebra's own law pushed along the map.

  The last two fields are not consequences of the first four: an equivariant map forces the
  two actions to be multiplicative only on its image, whereas the covariant derivative of a
  matter field needs them multiplicative on the whole of `B`.
entries.snippet:
structure AlgebraRealization (B : Type) [Ring B] [Algebra ℂ B]
    (repJet : Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI B)
    (repLorentz : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) B)
    (massWeightPoly : B →ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial B) where
  toAlgHom : JetAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] B
  map_repJet : ∀ (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (x : JetAlgebra),
    toAlgHom (JetAlgebra.repJetGaugeGroupI U x) = repJet U (toAlgHom x)
  map_repLorentz : ∀ (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x : JetAlgebra),
    toAlgHom (JetAlgebra.repLorentzGroup Λ x) = repLorentz Λ (toAlgHom x)
  map_massWeight : ∀ x : JetAlgebra, massWeightPoly (toAlgHom x)
    = Polynomial.mapAlgHom toAlgHom (JetAlgebra.massWeightPoly x)
  repJet_mul : ∀ (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (b₁ b₂ : B),
    repJet U (b₁ * b₂) = repJet U b₁ * repJet U b₂
  repLorentz_mul : ∀ (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (b₁ b₂ : B),
    repLorentz Λ (b₁ * b₂) = repLorentz Λ b₁ * repLorentz Λ b₂
