entries.name: StandardModel.lorentzMixStep
entries.docstring:
One peeling step of the Lorentz mixing: the direction `a` is removed from the multiset
  index of the family and put back as every direction `b`, weighted by `L[Λ] b a`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def lorentzMixStep (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (a : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (G : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M) : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M

entries.name: StandardModel.«instance@f19f6486»
entries.docstring: Peeling two directions commutes, so the mixing is well defined on a multiset.
entries.snippet: instance (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) : LeftCommutative (lorentzMixStep (M := M) Λ) where

entries.name: StandardModel.lorentzMix
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz mixing of a multiset-indexed family along a multiset `s` of directions:
  every direction of `s` is peeled and replaced by all directions, weighted by the
  corresponding column of the Lorentz matrix.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def lorentzMix (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (G : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M

entries.name: StandardModel.lorentzMix_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma lorentzMix_zero : lorentzMix Λ G 0 = G

entries.name: StandardModel.lorentzMix_cons_apply
entries.docstring: Mixing along `a ::ₘ s` peels `a` after mixing along `s`.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzMix_cons_apply (a : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    lorentzMix Λ G (a ::ₘ s) t = ∑ b, L[Λ] b a • lorentzMix Λ G s (b ::ₘ t)

entries.name: StandardModel.lorentzMix_apply_add
entries.docstring:
Evaluating a mixed family away from the empty multiset is mixing the translated
  family at the empty multiset.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzMix_apply_add (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    ∀ (G : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M) (t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)),
      lorentzMix Λ G s t = lorentzMix Λ (fun r => G (r + t)) s 0

entries.name: StandardModel.lorentzMix_cons_zero
entries.docstring: Peeling at the empty multiset: the peeled direction is pushed into the family.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzMix_cons_zero (a : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    lorentzMix Λ G (a ::ₘ s) 0 = ∑ b, L[Λ] b a • lorentzMix Λ (fun t => G (b ::ₘ t)) s 0

entries.name: StandardModel.lorentzMix_map
entries.docstring: The mixing operator commutes with any linear map applied to the values.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzMix_map (Φ : M →ₗ[ℂ] N) (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    Φ (lorentzMix Λ G s t) = lorentzMix Λ (fun r => Φ (G r)) s t

entries.name: StandardModel.lorentzMix_smul_fam
entries.docstring: The mixing operator is homogeneous in the family.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzMix_smul_fam (c : ℂ) (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    lorentzMix Λ (fun r => c • G r) s t = c • lorentzMix Λ G s t

entries.name: StandardModel.lorentzMix_add_fam
entries.docstring: The mixing operator is additive in the family.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzMix_add_fam (G₁ G₂ : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M) (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    lorentzMix Λ (fun r => G₁ r + G₂ r) s t = lorentzMix Λ G₁ s t + lorentzMix Λ G₂ s t

entries.name: StandardModel.lorentzMix_sum_fam
entries.docstring: The mixing operator commutes with finite sums of families.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzMix_sum_fam {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (H : ι → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M)
    (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    lorentzMix Λ (fun r => ∑ i, H i r) s t = ∑ i, lorentzMix Λ (H i) s t

entries.name: StandardModel.sum_fin_succ_prod_smul
entries.docstring:
A sum over tuples of directions, with one Lorentz matrix factor per slot, split into
  its first slot and the remaining ones.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_fin_succ_prod_smul {n : ℕ} (l : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (X : (Fin (n + 1) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) → M) :
    ∑ q : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ i, L[Λ] (q i) (l i)) • X q =
      ∑ b, ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
        (L[Λ] b (l 0) * ∏ i, L[Λ] (p i) (l i.succ)) • X (Fin.cons b p)

entries.name: StandardModel.lorentzMix_ofFn
entries.docstring:
The mixing operator agrees with the tuple form of the Lorentz law: along an ordered
  tuple of directions it is the sum over all tuples with one Lorentz matrix factor per
  slot.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzMix_ofFn {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    lorentzMix Λ G (List.ofFn l) t =
      ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
        (∏ i, L[Λ] (p i) (l i)) • G ((List.ofFn p : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) + t)

entries.name: StandardModel.lorentzMix_neg_fam
entries.docstring: The mixing operator commutes with negation of the family.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzMix_neg_fam (G : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M) (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    lorentzMix Λ (fun r => -G r) s t = -lorentzMix Λ G s t

entries.name: StandardModel.lorentzMix_sub_fam
entries.docstring: The mixing operator is additive in the family, in subtracted form.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzMix_sub_fam (G₁ G₂ : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M) (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    lorentzMix Λ (fun r => G₁ r - G₂ r) s t = lorentzMix Λ G₁ s t - lorentzMix Λ G₂ s t

entries.name: StandardModel.multiset_sum_map_sum
entries.docstring: A finite sum inside a multiset sum may be taken outside.
entries.snippet:
lemma multiset_sum_map_sum {α ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (m : Multiset α) (F : ι → α → B) :
    (m.map fun x => ∑ i, F i x).sum = ∑ i, (m.map (F i)).sum

entries.name: StandardModel.derivConv
entries.docstring:
The Leibniz convolution of two families of derivative symbols: the sum over the
  splittings of the multiset of the products of the two symbols.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def derivConv (f g : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) : B

entries.name: StandardModel.derivConv_cons
entries.docstring: One derivative peeled off a convolution lands on one factor or the other.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivConv_cons (f g : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) (a : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    derivConv f g (a ::ₘ s) =
      derivConv f (fun r => g (a ::ₘ r)) s + derivConv (fun r => f (a ::ₘ r)) g s

entries.name: StandardModel.derivConv_sum_right
entries.docstring: The convolution is linear in its right-hand family.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivConv_sum_right {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B)
    (c : ι → ℂ) (g : ι → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    derivConv f (fun r => ∑ i, c i • g i r) s = ∑ i, c i • derivConv f (g i) s

entries.name: StandardModel.derivConv_sum_left
entries.docstring: The convolution is linear in its left-hand family.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivConv_sum_left {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (g : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B)
    (c : ι → ℂ) (f : ι → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    derivConv (fun r => ∑ i, c i • f i r) g s = ∑ i, c i • derivConv (f i) g s

entries.name: StandardModel.lorentzMix_derivConv
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz mixing operator is a morphism for the Leibniz convolution: mixing the two
  factors separately and convolving is the same as convolving and then mixing.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzMix_derivConv (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    ∀ (f g : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B),
      derivConv (fun x => lorentzMix Λ f x 0) (fun y => lorentzMix Λ g y 0) s =
        lorentzMix Λ (derivConv f g) s 0

entries.name: StandardModel.repLorentz_derivConv
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of a Leibniz convolution: the mixing operator is a morphism for the
  convolution, so a convolution of two families with Lorentz laws has one too.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_derivConv
    (hmul : ∀ (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (b₁ b₂ : B), repLorentz Λ (b₁ * b₂) = repLorentz Λ b₁ * repLorentz Λ b₂)
    (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (f f' g g' : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B)
    (hf : ∀ x, repLorentz Λ (f x) = lorentzMix Λ f' x 0)
    (hg : ∀ y, repLorentz Λ (g y) = lorentzMix Λ g' y 0) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    repLorentz Λ (derivConv f g s) = lorentzMix Λ (derivConv f' g') s 0

entries.name: StandardModel.repLorentz_tower
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of a covariant tower. The tower `T` is built by the step `hstep` out of
  a correction `C`, and so is the tower `T'` it transforms into; the seed of `T` transforms
  into the seed of `T'` with the value index twisted by `τ` (`hzero`); and the correction is
  Lorentz covariant (`hC`), linear in the family it corrects (`hClin`), and lets the twist
  through (`hCτ`). Then the covariant slots mix by their own columns, the plain slots by
  `lorentzMix`, and the value index by `τ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_tower {K : Type} [Field K] {W : Type} [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [Module K B] [SMulCommClass K ℂ B] (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (T T' : (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → W →ₗ[K] B)
    (C : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → W →ₗ[K] B) →
      Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → W →ₗ[K] B)
    (τ : W →ₗ[K] W)
    (hstep : ∀ (n : ℕ) (l : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)),
      T (n + 1) l s = T n (fun i => l i.succ) (l 0 ::ₘ s) + C (l 0) (T n fun i => l i.succ) s)
    (hstep' : ∀ (n : ℕ) (l : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)),
      T' (n + 1) l s = T' n (fun i => l i.succ) (l 0 ::ₘ s) + C (l 0) (T' n fun i => l i.succ) s)
    (hzero : ∀ (l : Fin 0 → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : W),
      repLorentz Λ (T 0 l s φ) = lorentzMix Λ (fun t => T' 0 l t (τ φ)) s 0)
    (hC : ∀ (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (G G' : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → W →ₗ[K] B),
      (∀ y χ, repLorentz Λ (G y χ) = lorentzMix Λ (fun t => G' t χ) y 0) →
      ∀ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : W), repLorentz Λ (C ρ G s φ) =
        ∑ a, L[Λ] a ρ • lorentzMix Λ (fun t => C a G' t φ) s 0)
    (hClin : ∀ (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (c : ι → ℂ)
      (G : ι → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → W →ₗ[K] B) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : W), C ρ (fun t => ∑ i, c i • G i t) s φ = ∑ i, c i • C ρ (G i) s φ)
    (hCτ : ∀ (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (G : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → W →ₗ[K] B)
      (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : W),
      C ρ (fun t => G t ∘ₗ τ) s φ = C ρ G s (τ φ)) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : W),
      repLorentz Λ (T n l s φ) =
        ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
          (∏ i, L[Λ] (p i) (l i)) • lorentzMix Λ (fun t => T' n p t (τ φ)) s 0

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.sum_comm₃
entries.docstring: Rotating a triple sum so that the innermost index comes first.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_comm₃ {α β γ M : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ] [AddCommMonoid M]
    (X : α → β → γ → M) : (∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, X a b c) = ∑ c, ∑ a, ∑ b, X a b c

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.sum_derivConv_sum_fam
entries.docstring:
A scalar combination of convolutions against the gauge field is linear in the
  right-hand families.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_derivConv_sum_fam {ι κ ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype ι']
    (f : ι → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) (coef : ι → κ → ℂ) (c : ι' → ℂ)
    (g : ι' → κ → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    ∑ j, ∑ k, coef j k • derivConv (f j) (fun y => ∑ i, c i • g i k y) s =
      ∑ i, c i • ∑ j, ∑ k, coef j k • derivConv (f j) (g i k) s

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_eq_lorentzMix
entries.docstring:
A Lorentz law in the tuple form, read on the underlying multisets: the transformed
  family mixes by `lorentzMix`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_eq_lorentzMix (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (f g : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B)
    (hfg : ∀ (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)), repLorentz Λ (f (List.ofFn l)) =
      ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ i, L[Λ] (p i) (l i)) • g (List.ofFn p))
    (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) : repLorentz Λ (f x) = lorentzMix Λ g x 0

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_apply_mix
entries.docstring: The Lorentz law of the gauge-field symbols, in the multiset form.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_apply_mix (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (χ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    repLorentz Λ (h.A x μ χ) = lorentzMix Λ (fun t => ∑ a, L[Λ] a μ • h.A t a χ) x 0

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.isLorentzDerivTransforms_mix
entries.docstring: The Lorentz law of a family of derivative symbols, in the multiset form.

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_sum_derivConv
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of a scalar combination of convolutions against the gauge field: the
  direction of the gauge field mixes by its own column, the derivative slots by
  `lorentzMix`, and the right-hand families are replaced by their transforms.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_sum_derivConv (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (bg : Module.Basis ι ℝ GaugeAlgebra) (coef : ι → κ → ℂ)
    (g g' : κ → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B)
    (hg : ∀ k y, repLorentz Λ (g k y) = lorentzMix Λ (g' k) y 0) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    repLorentz Λ (∑ j, ∑ k, coef j k • derivConv (fun x => h.A x ρ (bg.coord j)) (g k) s) =
      ∑ a, L[Λ] a ρ • lorentzMix Λ
        (fun t => ∑ j, ∑ k, coef j k • derivConv (fun x => h.A x a (bg.coord j)) (g' k) t) s 0

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFam_apply_eq_sum
entries.docstring: The action of families expanded in bases of the gauge algebra and the value space.
entries.snippet:
lemma actionFam_apply_eq_sum {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (bg : Module.Basis ι ℝ GaugeAlgebra) (bv : Module.Basis κ ℂ V)
    (f : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B) (g : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    actionFam act f g φ =
      ∑ j, ∑ k, φ (act (bg j) (bv k)) • (f (bg.coord j) * g (bv.coord k))

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFamConv_eq_sum
entries.docstring: The derived action family expanded in bases.
entries.snippet:
lemma actionFamConv_eq_sum {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (bg : Module.Basis ι ℝ GaugeAlgebra) (bv : Module.Basis κ ℂ V)
    (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (G : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    actionFamConv A act ρ G s φ = ∑ j, ∑ k, φ (act (bg j) (bv k)) •
      derivConv (fun x => A x ρ (bg.coord j)) (fun y => G y (bv.coord k)) s

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFamConv_sum_fam
entries.docstring: The derived action family is linear in the matter family.
entries.snippet:
lemma actionFamConv_sum_fam {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (c : ι → ℂ)
    (H : ι → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    actionFamConv A act ρ (fun t => ∑ i, c i • H i t) s φ =
      ∑ i, c i • actionFamConv A act ρ (H i) s φ

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_actionFamConv
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of the derived action family: the derivative slots mix, the direction
  of the gauge field mixes by its own column, and the value index is carried by the
  transformed matter family.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_actionFamConv (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (G G' : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (hG : ∀ y χ, repLorentz Λ (G y χ) = lorentzMix Λ (fun t => G' t χ) y 0)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    repLorentz Λ (actionFamConv h.A act ρ G s φ) =
      ∑ a, L[Λ] a ρ • lorentzMix Λ (fun t => actionFamConv h.A act a G' t φ) s 0

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.dual_twist
entries.docstring:
The twist of the value index past the gauge action: an endomorphism commuting with
  the gauge action may be moved from the dual basis onto the dual vector.
entries.snippet:
lemma dual_twist {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] (bv : Module.Basis κ ℂ V) (T : V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (hT : ∀ (c : GaugeAlgebra) (v : V), act c (T v) = T (act c v))
    (ψ : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B) (c : GaugeAlgebra) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    ∑ k, φ (act c (bv k)) • ψ (T.dualMap (bv.coord k)) =
      ∑ k, (T.dualMap φ) (act c (bv k)) • ψ (bv.coord k)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFam_comp_dual
entries.docstring:
The contragredient action may be pulled out of an action of families, provided the
  gauge action commutes with it on the value space.
entries.snippet:
lemma actionFam_comp_dual (T : V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (hT : ∀ (c : GaugeAlgebra) (v : V), act c (T v) = T (act c v))
    (f : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B) (g : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    actionFam act f (g ∘ₗ T.dualMap) φ = actionFam act f g (T.dualMap φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionFamConv_comp_dual
entries.docstring: The contragredient action may be pulled out of a derived action family.
entries.snippet:
lemma actionFamConv_comp_dual (T : V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (hT : ∀ (c : GaugeAlgebra) (v : V), act c (T v) = T (act c v)) (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (K : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    actionFamConv A act ρ (fun t => K t ∘ₗ T.dualMap) s φ =
      actionFamConv A act ρ K s (T.dualMap φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_covDerivIter
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of the iterated covariant derivative of a matter family: the ordered
  covariant slots mix by their own columns and the multiset of plain derivative slots
  mixes by `lorentzMix`, while the value index transforms contragrediently.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_covDerivIter {rep : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) V}
    (hcomm : ∀ (c : GaugeAlgebra) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (v : V), act c (rep Λ v) = rep Λ (act c v))
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (hF : IsLorentzDerivTransforms repLorentz rep F) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    repLorentz Λ (covDerivIter h.A act F n l s φ) = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
      (∏ i, L[Λ] (p i) (l i)) •
        lorentzMix Λ (fun t => covDerivIter h.A act F n p t (rep.dual Λ φ)) s 0

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.isLorentzCovDerivTransforms_covDerivIter
entries.docstring:
The iterated covariant derivative of a matter family transforms as the covariant
  derivatives of a Lorentz-covariant field, given the Lorentz law of the bare symbols,
  the Lorentz law of the gauge field, and the commutation of the infinitesimal gauge
  action with the Lorentz action on the value space.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzCovDerivTransforms_covDerivIter {rep : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) V}
    (hcomm : ∀ (c : GaugeAlgebra) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (v : V), act c (rep Λ v) = rep Λ (act c v))
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (hF : IsLorentzDerivTransforms repLorentz rep F) :
    IsLorentzCovDerivTransforms repLorentz rep (fun {n} l => covDerivIter h.A act F n l 0)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.actionConj_comm_repConj
entries.docstring:
Conjugation preserves the commutation of the gauge action with the Lorentz action:
  both are read on the conjugate module through the same underlying maps.
entries.snippet:
lemma actionConj_comm_repConj (rep : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) V)
    (hcomm : ∀ (c : GaugeAlgebra) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (v : V), act c (rep Λ v) = rep Λ (act c v))
    (c : GaugeAlgebra) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (v : ConjModule V) :
    LocalGaugeData.actionConj act c (rep.conj Λ v) =
      rep.conj Λ (LocalGaugeData.actionConj act c v)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.isLorentzCovDerivTransforms_covDerivIter_conj
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of the covariant tower of a conjugate family, from the commutation of
  the gauge action with the Lorentz action of the unconjugated species.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzCovDerivTransforms_covDerivIter_conj {rep : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) V}
    (hcomm : ∀ (c : GaugeAlgebra) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (v : V), act c (rep Λ v) = rep Λ (act c v))
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule V) →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (hF : IsLorentzDerivTransforms repLorentz rep.conj F) :
    IsLorentzCovDerivTransforms repLorentz rep.conj
      (fun {n} l => covDerivIter h.A (LocalGaugeData.actionConj act) F n l 0)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFamConv_eq_sum
entries.docstring: The derived bracket family expanded in a basis of the gauge algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFamConv_eq_sum (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (G : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    bracketFamConv A ρ G s φ =
      ∑ j, ∑ k, ((φ ⁅Module.Free.chooseBasis ℝ GaugeAlgebra j,
            Module.Free.chooseBasis ℝ GaugeAlgebra k⁆ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        derivConv (fun x => A x ρ ((Module.Free.chooseBasis ℝ GaugeAlgebra).coord j))
          (fun y => G y ((Module.Free.chooseBasis ℝ GaugeAlgebra).coord k)) s

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.bracketFamConv_sum_fam
entries.docstring: The derived bracket family is linear in the second family.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracketFamConv_sum_fam {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (c : ι → ℂ)
    (H : ι → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    bracketFamConv A ρ (fun t => ∑ i, c i • H i t) s φ =
      ∑ i, c i • bracketFamConv A ρ (H i) s φ

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_bracketFamConv
entries.docstring: The Lorentz law of the derived bracket family.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_bracketFamConv (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (G G' : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (hG : ∀ y χ, repLorentz Λ (G y χ) = lorentzMix Λ (fun t => G' t χ) y 0)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    repLorentz Λ (bracketFamConv h.A ρ G s φ) =
      ∑ a, L[Λ] a ρ • lorentzMix Λ (fun t => bracketFamConv h.A a G' t φ) s 0

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of the iterated covariant derivative in the adjoint: the covariant
  slots mix by their own columns and the seed family is replaced by its transform.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (F F' : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (hF : ∀ x χ, repLorentz Λ (F x χ) = lorentzMix Λ (fun t => F' t χ) x 0)
    (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    repLorentz Λ (iteratedCovDerivAdjoint h.A (List.ofFn l) F x φ) = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
      (∏ i, L[Λ] (p i) (l i)) •
        lorentzMix Λ (fun t => iteratedCovDerivAdjoint h.A (List.ofFn p) F' t φ) x 0

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_sum_fam
entries.docstring: The iterated covariant derivative in the adjoint is linear in the seed family.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_sum_fam {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (c : ι → ℂ)
    (H : ι → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    ∀ (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra),
      iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l (fun t => ∑ i, c i • H i t) x φ =
        ∑ i, c i • iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l (H i) x φ
  | [], x, φ => by simp only [iteratedCovDerivAdjoint, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  | ρ :: l, x, φ => by
      have hfam : iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l (fun t => ∑ i, c i • H i t) =
          fun t => ∑ i, c i • iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l (H i) t

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_neg_fam
entries.docstring:
The iterated covariant derivative is odd in the family it differentiates: the case of
  a one-element index in `iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_sum_fam`.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_neg_fam
    (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l (fun t => - F t) x φ = - iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l F x φ

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_fieldStrength_mix
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of the field strength: both covector indices mix by their columns,
  and the derivative slots mix by `lorentzMix`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_fieldStrength_mix (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    repLorentz Λ (fieldStrength h.A μ ν x φ) =
      lorentzMix Λ (fun t => ∑ a, L[Λ] a μ • ∑ b, L[Λ] b ν • fieldStrength h.A a b t φ) x 0

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.repLorentz_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of the covariant tower of the field strength: the covariant slots
  mix by their own columns and the two covector indices of the field strength mix by
  theirs.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (n : ℕ)
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    repLorentz Λ (iteratedCovDerivAdjoint h.A (List.ofFn l) (fieldStrength h.A μ ν) 0 φ) =
      ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ i, L[Λ] (p i) (l i)) • ∑ a, L[Λ] a μ • ∑ b, L[Λ] b ν •
        iteratedCovDerivAdjoint h.A (List.ofFn p) (fieldStrength h.A a b) 0 φ

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.symbol_mem_adjoin
entries.docstring:
A bare matter symbol is a polynomial in the gauge-field symbols and the covariant
  tower of its family.
entries.snippet:
lemma symbol_mem_adjoin {X : Set B} (hA : ∀ s μ ψ, A s μ ψ ∈ X)
    (hF : ∀ (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) φ, covDerivIter A act F n l 0 φ ∈ X)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) : F s φ ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ X

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivIter_mem_adjoin
entries.docstring:
A symbol of a covariant tower is a polynomial in the gauge-field symbols and the bare
  symbols of its family.
entries.snippet:
lemma covDerivIter_mem_adjoin {X : Set B} (hA : ∀ s μ ψ, A s μ ψ ∈ X)
    (hF : ∀ s φ, F s φ ∈ X) (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    covDerivIter A act F n l 0 φ ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ X

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.commute_covDerivIter
entries.docstring:
A symbol of a covariant tower commutes with the gauge-field symbols, as soon as the
  bare symbols of its family do.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_covDerivIter
    (hAA : ∀ (s s' : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ μ' : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
      (ψ ψ' : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra), Commute (A s μ ψ) (A s' μ' ψ'))
    (hAF : ∀ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra)
      (s' : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V), Commute (A s μ ψ) (F s' φ))
    (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V)
    (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    Commute (covDerivIter A act F n l 0 φ) (A p μ ψ)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebraRealization.repDualCoeff_zero_of_mem_truncationKer_zero
entries.docstring:
A pure gauge jet acts trivially through the dual base-point coefficient of a
  representation whose zeroth Taylor coefficient is the identity on pure jets.
entries.snippet:
lemma repDualCoeff_zero_of_mem_truncationKer_zero
    {rep : Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)}
    (hrep : ∀ {W : JetGaugeGroupI}, localGaugeData.eval W = 1 → repCoeff rep W 0 = LinearMap.id)
    (U : localGaugeData.truncationKer 0) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    repDualCoeff rep U.1⁻¹ 0 φ = φ

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.matterTowers_induction
entries.docstring: A property of every symbol of every matter tower is proved tower by tower.

lemma matterTowers_induction (P : B → Prop) {b : B} (hb : b ∈ h.matterTowers)
    (hH : ∀ (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) φ, P (h.covDerivH l φ))
    (hbarH : ∀ (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) φ, P (h.covDerivBarH l φ))
    (hd : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) φ, P (h.covDerivD i l φ))
    (hbard : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) φ, P (h.covDerivBarD i l φ))
    (hu : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) φ, P (h.covDerivU i l φ))
    (hbaru : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) φ, P (h.covDerivBarU i l φ))
    (hQ : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) φ, P (h.covDerivQ i l φ))
    (hbarQ : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) φ, P (h.covDerivBarQ i l φ))
    (hL : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) φ, P (h.covDerivL i l φ))
    (hbarL : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) φ, P (h.covDerivBarL i l φ))
    (he : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) φ, P (h.covDerivE i l φ))

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.symbols_subset_adjoin_matterTowers
entries.docstring: Every bare symbol is a polynomial in the gauge-field symbols and the matter towers.
entries.snippet:
lemma symbols_subset_adjoin_matterTowers :
    h.symbols ⊆ Algebra.adjoin ℂ
      ((⋃ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), Set.range (h.A s μ)) ∪
        h.matterTowers)

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.fieldAlgebra_eq_covDeriv
entries.docstring:
The covariant towers generate the field algebra: replacing the plain derivative
  symbols of every matter field by their covariant derivative towers does not change the
  generated algebra; only the gauge-field symbols remain plain.
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldAlgebra_eq_covDeriv :
    h.fieldAlgebra = Algebra.adjoin ℂ
    ((⋃ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), Set.range (h.A s μ)) ∪
      (⋃ (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)),
        Set.range (h.covDerivH l) ∪ Set.range (h.covDerivBarH l)) ∪
      (⋃ (i : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)),
        Set.range (h.covDerivD i l) ∪ Set.range (h.covDerivBarD i l) ∪
        Set.range (h.covDerivU i l) ∪ Set.range (h.covDerivBarU i l) ∪
        Set.range (h.covDerivQ i l) ∪ Set.range (h.covDerivBarQ i l) ∪
        Set.range (h.covDerivL i l) ∪ Set.range (h.covDerivBarL i l) ∪
        Set.range (h.covDerivE i l) ∪ Set.range (h.covDerivBarE i l)))

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.covF_comp_perm_of_map_lie
entries.docstring:
At a dual vector vanishing on every bracket, such as the hypercharge coordinate, the
  field-strength tower is symmetric in its derivative slots, at every order: there the
  covariant derivatives are the ordinary ones, which commute. The components along the
  non-abelian factors have no such symmetry.
entries.snippet:
lemma covF_comp_perm_of_map_lie (h : AlgebraRealization B repJet repLorentz massWeightPoly)
    {φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra} (hφ : ∀ x y : GaugeAlgebra, φ ⁅x, y⁆ = 0) {n : ℕ}
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    h.covF (l ∘ σ) μ ν φ = h.covF l μ ν φ

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.repGlobal
entries.docstring:
The action of the global gauge group on the algebra: the jet action restricted
  along the inclusion of the constant jets.

noncomputable def repGlobal (repJet : Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI B) :
    Representation ℂ GaugeGroupI B

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.repGlobal_apply
entries.docstring: The global gauge action is the jet action at the corresponding constant jet.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repGlobal_apply (repJet : Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI B) (g : GaugeGroupI)
    (b : B) : repGlobal repJet g b = repJet (JetGaugeGroupI.ofConstant g) b

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.repGlobal_mul
entries.docstring:
The global gauge action is multiplicative: it is the jet action at a constant jet,
  and the jet action is an algebra map.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGlobal_mul (g : GaugeGroupI) (b₁ b₂ : B) :
    repGlobal repJet g (b₁ * b₂) = repGlobal repJet g b₁ * repGlobal repJet g b₂

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.Species
entries.docstring:
A matter species of the Standard Model, as the laws of this file consume it: the
  gauge-algebra action on its value space, its bare family of derivative symbols, the
  mass weight `c` of its undifferentiated symbols, and the two facts that the family
  commutes with the gauge-field symbols and has mass weight `c + 2 * |t|` at the
  derivative multiset `t`.
entries.snippet:
structure Species (V : Type) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] where
  act : GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V
  F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B
  c : ℕ
  A_comm : ∀ (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra)
    (t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (χ : Module.Dual ℂ V), Commute (h.A p μ ψ) (F t χ)
  massWeight : ∀ (t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (χ : Module.Dual ℂ V),
    massWeightPoly (F t χ) = Polynomial.monomial (c + 2 * Multiset.card t) (F t χ)

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.matterTowers_induction_species
entries.docstring:
A property of every symbol of every matter tower is proved species by species: each
  matter tower is the tower of one of the twelve species.
entries.snippet:
lemma matterTowers_induction_species (P : B → Prop) {b : B} (hb : b ∈ h.matterTowers)
    (hS : ∀ {V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (S : h.Species V)
      (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V), P (S.tower l φ)) : P b

A property of every covariant generator is proved for the field-strength tower and
  for the matter towers.

    (hF : ∀ (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
      (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra), P (h.covF l μ ν φ))
    (hM : ∀ b ∈ h.matterTowers, P b) : P b

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.repJet_algebraMap
entries.docstring:
Gauge jets fix the scalars: the action is multiplicative, hence unital, and
  complex-linear.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_algebraMap (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (c : ℂ) :
    repJet U (algebraMap ℂ B c) = algebraMap ℂ B c

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.repJet_eq_of_mem_covGenerators_of_mem_truncationKer_zero
entries.docstring:
Pure gauge jets fix the covariant generators: the thirteen cases are section L of
  `AlgebraRealization.CovariantDeriv`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_eq_of_mem_covGenerators_of_mem_truncationKer_zero
    (U : localGaugeData.truncationKer 0) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ h.covGenerators) :
    repJet U.1 x = x

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.repJet_eq_of_mem_covAlgebra_of_mem_truncationKer_zero
entries.docstring:
Pure gauge jets fix the covariant algebra pointwise: they fix its generators, and
  the jet action is an algebra map.
entries.snippet:
lemma repJet_eq_of_mem_covAlgebra_of_mem_truncationKer_zero
    (U : localGaugeData.truncationKer 0) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ h.covAlgebra) :
    repJet U.1 x = x

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.forall_repJet_eq_iff
entries.docstring:
The reduction of jet gauge invariance to global gauge invariance: an element of the
  field algebra is invariant under the whole jet gauge group exactly when it lies in
  the covariant algebra and is invariant under the global gauge group.
entries.snippet:
lemma forall_repJet_eq_iff {x : B} (hx : x ∈ h.fieldAlgebra) :
    (∀ U : JetGaugeGroupI, repJet U x = x) ↔
      x ∈ h.covAlgebra ∧ ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGlobal repJet g x = x

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.forall_repJet_and_repLorentz_eq_iff
entries.docstring:
The reduction theorem in the form used for Lagrangians: on the field algebra, invariance
  under the jet gauge group and the Lorentz group is membership of the covariant algebra
  with invariance under the global gauge group and the Lorentz group.
entries.snippet:
lemma forall_repJet_and_repLorentz_eq_iff {x : B} (hx : x ∈ h.fieldAlgebra) :
    ((∀ U : JetGaugeGroupI, repJet U x = x) ∧ ∀ Λ : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz Λ x = x) ↔
      (x ∈ h.covAlgebra ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, repGlobal repJet g x = x) ∧
        ∀ Λ : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz Λ x = x)

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.repCoeff_zero_ofConstant
entries.docstring:
The zeroth Taylor coefficient of a jet representation at a constant jet is the
  underlying action of the global gauge group.

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.repGlobal_of_repJet
entries.docstring:
A tower that transforms through the base-point dual coefficient of a gauge jet is
  equivariant for the global gauge group, in the contragredient of the global
  representation.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGlobal_of_repJet {V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    {rep : Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)}
    {repG : Representation ℂ GaugeGroupI V} {T : Module.Dual ℂ V →ₗ[ℂ] B}
    (hT : ∀ (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V),
      repJet U (T φ) = T (GaugeAlgebraRealization.repDualCoeff rep U⁻¹ 0 φ))
    (hg : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI,
      rep (JetGaugeGroupI.ofConstant g) = TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (repG g))
    (g : GaugeGroupI) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    repGlobal repJet g (T φ) = T (repG.dual g φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.repGlobal_of_repJet_conj
entries.docstring:
The conjugate form of `repGlobal_of_repJet`: a tower transforming through the dual
  coefficient of the conjugate representation is equivariant in its conjugate contragredient.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGlobal_of_repJet_conj {V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    {rep : Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)}
    {repG : Representation ℂ GaugeGroupI V} {T : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule V) →ₗ[ℂ] B}
    (hT : ∀ (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule V)), repJet U (T φ) =
      T (GaugeAlgebraRealization.repDualCoeff (JetComponentSpace.repConj rep) U⁻¹ 0 φ))
    (hg : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI,
      rep (JetGaugeGroupI.ofConstant g) = TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (repG g))
    (g : GaugeGroupI) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule V)) :
    repGlobal repJet g (T φ) = T (repG.conj.dual g φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.localGaugeData.adjointDualCoeff_zero_ofConstant_inv
entries.docstring:
At an inverse constant jet the dual adjoint coefficient is the contragredient
  adjoint action of the global gauge group.
entries.snippet:
lemma localGaugeData.adjointDualCoeff_zero_ofConstant_inv (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    localGaugeData.adjointDualCoeff (JetGaugeGroupI.ofConstant g)⁻¹ 0 =
      (GaugeAlgebra.adjointMap g⁻¹).dualMap

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.repGlobal_covF
entries.docstring:
The field-strength tower is equivariant for the global gauge group, in the
  contragredient adjoint representation.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGlobal_covF (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    repGlobal repJet g (h.covF l μ ν φ) =
      h.covF l μ ν ((GaugeAlgebra.adjointMap g⁻¹).dualMap φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.covF_mem_adjoin_gaugeSymbols
entries.docstring:
The covariant derivatives of the field strength are polynomials in the gauge-field
  symbols.
entries.snippet:
lemma covF_mem_adjoin_gaugeSymbols {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    h.covF l μ ν φ ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ {b : B | ∃ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra), b = h.A s ρ ψ}

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.covF_comm_of_comm_A
entries.docstring:
The field-strength tower commutes with anything the gauge-field symbols commute
  with.
entries.snippet:
lemma covF_comm_of_comm_A {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) {y : B}
    (hy : ∀ (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (ψ' : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra),
      Commute (h.A p ρ ψ') y) : Commute (h.covF l μ ν ψ) y

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.commute_gaugeSymbol_of_mem_covGenerators
entries.docstring:
Every covariant generator commutes with every gauge-field symbol: the covariant towers
  are polynomials in the gauge-field and matter symbols, and the gauge field is bosonic.

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.covF_commute_of_mem_covAlgebra
entries.docstring:
The field-strength tower is central in the covariant algebra: it commutes with every
  covariant generator, and commutation extends to the algebra they generate.

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.actionFam_apply_mem_submodule
entries.docstring:
The action pairing of two families lands in any submodule containing the products of
  their components: expanded in bases it is a finite sum of scalar multiples of them.

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.bracketFam_apply_mem_submodule
entries.docstring:
The bracket pairing of two adjoint families lands in any submodule containing the
  products of their components: it is the sum of the structure constants against them.

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.massWeightEigenspace
entries.docstring:
The weight-`w` part of the algebra: the elements on which the mass-weight algebra
  map is the monomial `X ^ w`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def massWeightEigenspace (massWeightPoly : B →ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial B) (w : ℕ) :
    Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.mem_massWeightEigenspace_iff
entries.docstring: Membership of the weight-`w` part is the eigenvector equation itself.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightEigenspace_iff {w : ℕ} {b : B} :
    b ∈ massWeightEigenspace massWeightPoly w ↔
      massWeightPoly b = Polynomial.monomial w b

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.mul_mem_massWeightEigenspace
entries.docstring:
The mass weight is additive on products: `massWeightPoly` is an algebra map and
  monomials multiply by adding their degrees.
entries.snippet:
lemma mul_mem_massWeightEigenspace {w w' : ℕ} {b b' : B}
    (hb : b ∈ massWeightEigenspace massWeightPoly w)
    (hb' : b' ∈ massWeightEigenspace massWeightPoly w') :
    b * b' ∈ massWeightEigenspace massWeightPoly (w + w')

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.A_mem_massWeightEigenspace
entries.docstring: A gauge-field symbol with `|p|` derivatives has mass weight `2 * (1 + |p|)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma A_mem_massWeightEigenspace (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    h.A p μ ψ ∈ massWeightEigenspace massWeightPoly (2 * (1 + Multiset.card p))

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.Species.covDerivIter_mem_massWeightEigenspace
entries.docstring:
The mass weight of a matter covariant tower: the `n`-fold covariant derivative of the
  family at the derivative multiset `s` has weight `c + 2 * n + 2 * |s|`. Each covariant
  derivative costs two units, whether it lands on the derivative index or brings down a
  gauge-field factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma covDerivIter_mem_massWeightEigenspace {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivIter h.A S.act S.F n l s φ ∈
      massWeightEigenspace massWeightPoly (S.c + 2 * n + 2 * Multiset.card s)

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.Species.massWeight_tower
entries.docstring:
The mass weight of the tower of a species is `c + 2 * n`: the form in which the
  sector structures ask for it.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeight_tower {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    massWeightPoly (S.tower l φ) = Polynomial.monomial (S.c + 2 * n) (S.tower l φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.fieldStrength_mem_massWeightEigenspace
entries.docstring:
The mass weight of the bare field strength: two gauge-field symbols, or one with an
  extra derivative, in either case weight `4 + 2 * |s|`.
entries.snippet:
lemma fieldStrength_mem_massWeightEigenspace (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.fieldStrength h.A μ ν s φ ∈
      massWeightEigenspace massWeightPoly (4 + 2 * Multiset.card s)

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_mem_massWeightEigenspace
entries.docstring:
The mass weight of an adjoint covariant tower: the adjoint analogue of
  `Species.covDerivIter_mem_massWeightEigenspace`, with the bracket pairing in place of
  the action pairing.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_mem_massWeightEigenspace (c : ℕ)
    (G : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (hG : ∀ (t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (χ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra),
      G t χ ∈ massWeightEigenspace massWeightPoly (c + 2 * Multiset.card t))
    (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint h.A l G s φ ∈
      massWeightEigenspace massWeightPoly (c + 2 * l.length + 2 * Multiset.card s)

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.anticommuteSubmodule
entries.docstring:
The elements of the algebra anticommuting with a fixed element. It is a submodule,
  which is what lets the anticommutation of a tower be checked term by term.
entries.snippet: def anticommuteSubmodule (x : B) : Submodule ℂ B where

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.mem_anticommuteSubmodule_iff
entries.docstring: Membership of the anticommutant is the anticommutation relation itself.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_anticommuteSubmodule_iff {x y : B} :
    y ∈ anticommuteSubmodule x ↔ x * y = -(y * x)

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.anticomm_symm
entries.docstring: Anticommutation is symmetric in its two arguments.
entries.snippet: lemma anticomm_symm {a b : B} (hab : a * b = -(b * a)) : b * a = -(a * b)

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.mul_mem_anticommuteSubmodule
entries.docstring:
Multiplying an anticommuting element on the left by a commuting one keeps it
  anticommuting.
entries.snippet:
lemma mul_mem_anticommuteSubmodule {x a b : B} (ha : Commute x a)
    (hb : b ∈ anticommuteSubmodule x) : a * b ∈ anticommuteSubmodule x

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.Species.commute_tower
entries.docstring:
Anything commuting with every gauge-field symbol and with every bare symbol of the
  species commutes with its tower.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_tower {y : B}
    (hyA : ∀ (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra),
      Commute (h.A p μ ψ) y)
    (hyF : ∀ (t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (χ : Module.Dual ℂ V), Commute (S.F t χ) y)
    {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) : Commute (S.tower l φ) y

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.Species.commute_tower_tower
entries.docstring:
The towers of two species whose bare families commute with each other commute. The
  hypothesis is stated in the shape of the bare laws `H_comm_d`.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_tower_tower (T : h.Species W)
    (hST : ∀ (t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (χ : Module.Dual ℂ V) (t' : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (χ' : Module.Dual ℂ W), Commute (S.F t χ) (T.F t' χ'))
    {n m : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V)
    (l' : Fin m → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ' : Module.Dual ℂ W) :
    Commute (S.tower l φ) (T.tower l' φ')

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.Species.anticomm_tower
entries.docstring:
Anything commuting with every gauge-field symbol and anticommuting with every bare
  symbol of the species anticommutes with its tower: each term of the tower is a product
  of gauge-field symbols with a single bare symbol.
entries.snippet:
lemma anticomm_tower {x : B}
    (hxA : ∀ (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra),
      Commute x (h.A p μ ψ))
    (hxF : ∀ (t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (χ : Module.Dual ℂ V), x * S.F t χ = -(S.F t χ * x))
    {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V) :
    x * S.tower l φ = -(S.tower l φ * x)

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.Species.anticomm_tower_tower
entries.docstring:
The towers of two species whose bare families anticommute with each other
  anticommute. The hypothesis is stated in the shape of the bare laws `d_anticomm_bard`.
entries.snippet:
lemma anticomm_tower_tower (T : h.Species W)
    (hST : ∀ (t t' : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (χ : Module.Dual ℂ V) (χ' : Module.Dual ℂ W),
      S.F t χ * T.F t' χ' = -(T.F t' χ' * S.F t χ))
    {n m : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ V)
    (l' : Fin m → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ' : Module.Dual ℂ W) :
    S.tower l φ * T.tower l' φ' = -(T.tower l' φ' * S.tower l φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.Species.covF_comm_tower
entries.docstring: The field-strength tower commutes with the tower of every species.

entries.name: StandardModel.AlgebraRealization.repLorentz_covF
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of the covariant field-strength tower: the covariant derivative
  slots mix by their own columns of the Lorentz matrix, and the two covector indices
  of the field strength mix by theirs.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_covF (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ GaugeAlgebra) :
    repLorentz Λ (h.covF l μ ν φ) =
      ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
        (∏ i, (((SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 (p i) (l i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) •
      ∑ a, (((SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 a μ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
      ∑ b, (((SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 b ν : ℝ) : ℂ) • h.covF p a b φ

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization
entries.docstring:
The algebra `B`, with a gauge action, a Lorentz action and a mass-weight grading,
  carries a Higgs sector when it receives an algebra map from the covariant jet algebra of
  the Higgs field which is equivariant for both actions and compatible with the grading.
  The covariant towers `∇_l H` and `∇_l H̄` then sit inside `B` as the images of that
  algebra's own, and every law they satisfy there is its law pushed along the map.

  It is the Higgs-sector counterpart of `CovAlgebraRealization`, and stands to
  `CovHiggsJetAlgebra` as that does to `CovJetAlgebra`.

  The last two fields are not consequences of the first three: an equivariant map forces
  the two actions to be multiplicative only on its image, whereas the sector needs them
  multiplicative on the whole of `B`.
entries.snippet:
structure HiggsAlgebraCovRealization (B : Type) [Ring B] [Algebra ℂ B]
    (rep : Representation ℂ GaugeGroupI B)
    (repLorentz : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) B)
    (massWeightPoly : B →ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial B) where
  toAlgHom : CovHiggsJetAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] B
  map_rep : ∀ (g : GaugeGroupI) (x : CovHiggsJetAlgebra),
    toAlgHom (CovHiggsJetAlgebra.repGaugeGroupI g x) = rep g (toAlgHom x)
  map_repLorentz : ∀ (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x : CovHiggsJetAlgebra),
    toAlgHom (CovHiggsJetAlgebra.repLorentzGroup Λ x) = repLorentz Λ (toAlgHom x)
  map_massWeight : ∀ x : CovHiggsJetAlgebra, massWeightPoly (toAlgHom x)
    = Polynomial.mapAlgHom toAlgHom (CovHiggsJetAlgebra.massWeightPoly x)
  rep_mul : ∀ (g : GaugeGroupI) (b₁ b₂ : B), rep g (b₁ * b₂) = rep g b₁ * rep g b₂
  repLorentz_mul : ∀ (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (b₁ b₂ : B),
    repLorentz Λ (b₁ * b₂) = repLorentz Λ b₁ * repLorentz Λ b₂

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.H_equivariant
entries.docstring:
The Higgs symbol carries the dual of the gauge representation on `HiggsVec`: the
  `SU(2)` index transforms contragrediently, and the hypercharge character by `u⁻³`.
entries.snippet:
lemma H_equivariant (g : GaugeGroupI) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ HiggsVec) (n : ℕ)
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    rep g (h.covH n l φ) = h.covH n l (HiggsVec.repGaugeGroupI.dual g φ)

entries.docstring:
The conjugate Higgs symbol carries the conjugate-dual of the gauge representation:
  the physicists' `H^† ↦ H^† g^†`.
entries.snippet:
lemma barH_equivariant (g : GaugeGroupI) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule HiggsVec)) (n : ℕ)
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    rep g (h.covBarH n l φ) = h.covBarH n l (HiggsVec.repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual g φ)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.repLorentz_H_apply
entries.docstring:
The pointwise form of `repLorentz_H`: the Lorentz action rotates the derivative indices
  of a Higgs symbol, and the value index is inert.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_H_apply (g : SL(2,ℂ)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ HiggsVec) (n : ℕ)
    (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    repLorentz g (h.covH n l φ) = ∑ (a : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
      (∏ (i : Fin n), (((SL2C.toLorentzGroup g).1 (a i) (l i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • h.covH n a φ

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.higgsAlgebra_induction
entries.docstring:
Induction on the Higgs algebra: a property of elements of `B` which holds on every
  Higgs and conjugate Higgs symbol and on every scalar, and is closed under sums and
  products of elements of the algebra, holds on the whole algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma higgsAlgebra_induction {P : B → Prop}
    (hH : ∀ (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ HiggsVec),
      P (h.covH n d φ))
    (hbarH : ∀ (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule HiggsVec)),
      P (h.covBarH n d φ))
    (halg : ∀ r : ℂ, P (algebraMap ℂ B r))
    (hadd : ∀ x y, x ∈ h.higgsAlgebra → y ∈ h.higgsAlgebra → P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (hmul : ∀ x y, x ∈ h.higgsAlgebra → y ∈ h.higgsAlgebra → P x → P y → P (x * y))
    {x : B} (hx : x ∈ h.higgsAlgebra) : P x

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.commute_of_mem_higgsAlgebra
entries.docstring: Any two elements of the Higgs algebra commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_of_mem_higgsAlgebra {x y : B} (hx : x ∈ h.higgsAlgebra)
    (hy : y ∈ h.higgsAlgebra) : Commute x y

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.higgs
entries.docstring: The component `∇_d H^i` in the algebra.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def higgs (h : HiggsAlgebraCovRealization B rep repLorentz massWeightPoly)
    {n : ℕ} (d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (i : Fin 2) : B

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.barHiggs
entries.docstring: The component `∇_d H̄^i` in the algebra.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def barHiggs (h : HiggsAlgebraCovRealization B rep repLorentz massWeightPoly)
