entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.rep_higgsComponent
entries.docstring:
The gauge group mixes the components of `∇_d H` by the matrix `u⁻³ g⁻¹` of the
  hypercharge and `SU(2)` parts of `g⁻¹`.
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_higgsComponent (g : GaugeGroupI) {n : ℕ} (d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (i : Fin 2) :
    rep g (h.higgs d i) =
      ∑ j, (((g⁻¹).toU1 : ℂ) ^ 3 * (g⁻¹).toSU2.1 i j) • h.higgs d j

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.rep_barHiggsComponent
entries.docstring: The gauge group mixes the components of `∇_d H̄` by the conjugate matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_barHiggsComponent (g : GaugeGroupI) {n : ℕ} (d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (i : Fin 2) :
    rep g (h.barHiggs d i) =
      ∑ j, (starRingEnd ℂ (((g⁻¹).toU1 : ℂ) ^ 3 * (g⁻¹).toSU2.1 i j)) • h.barHiggs d j

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.higgsSubmodule
entries.docstring:
The submodule of `B` generated by the Higgs symbols carrying `n` derivatives: the join,
  over the Lorentz indices `d`, of the ranges of the symbol maps `H n d`. Its elements are
  the terms linear in `∇_d H` — of mass dimension `1 + n`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def higgsSubmodule
    (h : HiggsAlgebraCovRealization B rep repLorentz massWeightPoly) (n : ℕ) :
    Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.barHiggsSubmodule
entries.docstring:
The submodule of `B` generated by the conjugate Higgs symbols carrying `n` derivatives:
  the join, over the Lorentz indices `d`, of the ranges of the symbol maps `barH n d`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def barHiggsSubmodule
    (h : HiggsAlgebraCovRealization B rep repLorentz massWeightPoly) (n : ℕ) :
    Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.higgsSubmodule_eq_iSup_span
entries.docstring: The Higgs submodule is spanned by the components `∇_d H^j`.
entries.snippet:
lemma higgsSubmodule_eq_iSup_span (n : ℕ) :
    h.higgsSubmodule n = ⨆ (d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (j : Fin 2), ℂ ∙ h.higgs d j

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.barHiggsSubmodule_eq_iSup_span
entries.docstring: The conjugate Higgs submodule is spanned by the components `∇_d H̄^j`.
entries.snippet:
lemma barHiggsSubmodule_eq_iSup_span (n : ℕ) :
    h.barHiggsSubmodule n
      = ⨆ (d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (j : Fin 2), ℂ ∙ h.barHiggs d j

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.higgsSubmodule_le_higgsAlgebra
entries.docstring: The Higgs submodule lies in the Higgs algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma higgsSubmodule_le_higgsAlgebra (n : ℕ) :
    h.higgsSubmodule n ≤ Subalgebra.toSubmodule h.higgsAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.barHiggsSubmodule_le_higgsAlgebra
entries.docstring: The conjugate Higgs submodule lies in the Higgs algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma barHiggsSubmodule_le_higgsAlgebra (n : ℕ) :
    h.barHiggsSubmodule n ≤ Subalgebra.toSubmodule h.higgsAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.barHiggsSubmodule_comm_higgsSubmodule
entries.docstring: The conjugate Higgs and Higgs submodules commute.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma barHiggsSubmodule_comm_higgsSubmodule (n1 n2 : ℕ) :
    (h.barHiggsSubmodule n1) * (h.higgsSubmodule n2)
    =  (h.higgsSubmodule n2)  * (h.barHiggsSubmodule n1)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.higgsSubmodule_comm_higgsSubmodule
entries.docstring: Two Higgs submodules commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma higgsSubmodule_comm_higgsSubmodule (n1 n2 : ℕ) :
    (h.higgsSubmodule n1) * (h.higgsSubmodule n2)
    =  (h.higgsSubmodule n2)  * (h.higgsSubmodule n1)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.barHiggsSubmodule_comm_barHiggsSubmodule
entries.docstring: Two conjugate Higgs submodules commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma barHiggsSubmodule_comm_barHiggsSubmodule (n1 n2 : ℕ) :
    (h.barHiggsSubmodule n1) * (h.barHiggsSubmodule n2)
    =  (h.barHiggsSubmodule n2)  * (h.barHiggsSubmodule n1)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.barHiggs_higgs_left_comm
entries.docstring:
A conjugate Higgs submodule commutes past a Higgs submodule standing in front of a third
  factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma barHiggs_higgs_left_comm (n1 n2 : ℕ) (C : Submodule ℂ B) :
    h.barHiggsSubmodule n1 * (h.higgsSubmodule n2 * C)
      = h.higgsSubmodule n2 * (h.barHiggsSubmodule n1 * C)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.rep_gaugeTorusGen_higgs
entries.docstring:
The torus generators act on `∇_d H^j` by the character of weight
  `(0, 0, -isoWeight j, -3)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_gaugeTorusGen_higgs (i : Fin 4) {n : ℕ} (d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (j : Fin 2) :
    rep (gaugeTorusGen i) (h.higgs d j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (0, 0, -isoWeight j, -3) i) • h.higgs d j

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.rep_gaugeTorusGen_barHiggs
entries.docstring:
The torus generators act on `∇_d H̄^j` by the character of weight
  `(0, 0, isoWeight j, 3)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_gaugeTorusGen_barHiggs (i : Fin 4) {n : ℕ} (d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (j : Fin 2) :
    rep (gaugeTorusGen i) (h.barHiggs d j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (0, 0, isoWeight j, 3) i) • h.barHiggs d j

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.iSup_span_le_eigenspace
entries.docstring: The span of a family of eigenvectors of a torus generator lies in its eigenspace.
entries.snippet:
lemma iSup_span_le_eigenspace {ι : Type} (i : Fin 4) (y : ι → B) (w : GaugeWeight)
    (hy : ∀ d, rep (gaugeTorusGen i) (y d) = ((expI : ℂ) ^ w.coord i) • y d) :
    (⨆ d, ℂ ∙ y d) ≤ Module.End.eigenspace (rep (gaugeTorusGen i)) ((expI : ℂ) ^ w.coord i)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.doubletGaugeWeight
entries.docstring:
The gauge weight decomposition of the span of a two-component family `x d j` of torus
  eigenvectors, the components `x d 0` of weight `w₀` and `x d 1` of weight `w₁ ≠ w₀`: the
  weight-`w₀` piece is the span of the `x d 0` and the weight-`w₁` piece that of the
  `x d 1`.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable def doubletGaugeWeight {ι : Type} (hmul : IsMulRep rep) (x : ι → Fin 2 → B)
    (w₀ w₁ : GaugeWeight) (hw : w₀ ≠ w₁)
    (hx₀ : ∀ (i : Fin 4) (d : ι),
      rep (gaugeTorusGen i) (x d 0) = ((expI : ℂ) ^ w₀.coord i) • x d 0)
    (hx₁ : ∀ (i : Fin 4) (d : ι),
      rep (gaugeTorusGen i) (x d 1) = ((expI : ℂ) ^ w₁.coord i) • x d 1) :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (⨆ (d : ι) (j : Fin 2), ℂ ∙ x d j) where

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.higgsSubmoduleGaugeWeight
entries.docstring:
The gauge weight decomposition of the Higgs submodule: `∇_d H⁰` spans the piece of
  weight `(0, 0, -1, -3)` and `∇_d H¹` that of weight `(0, 0, 1, -3)`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable instance higgsSubmoduleGaugeWeight (n : ℕ) :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (h.higgsSubmodule n)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.barHiggsSubmoduleGaugeWeight
entries.docstring:
The gauge weight decomposition of the conjugate Higgs submodule: `∇_d H̄⁰` spans the
  piece of weight `(0, 0, 1, 3)` and `∇_d H̄¹` that of weight `(0, 0, -1, 3)`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable instance barHiggsSubmoduleGaugeWeight (n : ℕ) :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (h.barHiggsSubmodule n)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.dotGaugeHiggs
entries.docstring: The gauge-invariant pairing `∇_{d1} H^j ∇_{d2} H̄^j`, summed over the isospin index.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def dotGaugeHiggs (h : HiggsAlgebraCovRealization B rep repLorentz massWeightPoly)
    {n1 n2 : ℕ} (d1 : Fin n1 → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (d2 : Fin n2 → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    B

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.rep_dotGaugeHiggs_invariant
entries.docstring:
The pairing is gauge invariant: the matrix acting on `H` is unitary, and `H̄` transforms
  by its conjugate.
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_dotGaugeHiggs_invariant {n1 n2 : ℕ} (g : GaugeGroupI) (d1 : Fin n1 → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (d2 : Fin n2 → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    rep g (h.dotGaugeHiggs d1 d2) = h.dotGaugeHiggs d1 d2

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.repLorentz_higgs
entries.docstring: The Lorentz action rotates the derivative indices of a Higgs component.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_higgs {n : ℕ} (g : SL(2,ℂ)) (d : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (k : Fin 2) :
    repLorentz g (h.higgs d k) = ∑ a : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3,
      (∏ j, (((SL2C.toLorentzGroup g).1 (a j) (d j) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • h.higgs a k

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.repLorentz_barHiggs
entries.docstring: The Lorentz action rotates the derivative indices of a conjugate Higgs component.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_barHiggs {n : ℕ} (g : SL(2,ℂ)) (d : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (k : Fin 2) :
    repLorentz g (h.barHiggs d k) = ∑ a : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3,
      (∏ j, (((SL2C.toLorentzGroup g).1 (a j) (d j) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • h.barHiggs a k

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.repLorentz_dotGaugeHiggs
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the Higgs inner product: the two factors' derivative indices
  rotate independently, and the inner product itself is a Lorentz scalar.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_dotGaugeHiggs {m n : ℕ} (g : SL(2,ℂ))
    (d₁ : Fin m → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (d₂ : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    repLorentz g (h.dotGaugeHiggs d₁ d₂) =
      ∑ a₁ : Fin m → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, ∑ a₂ : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3,
        ((∏ j, (((SL2C.toLorentzGroup g).1 (a₁ j) (d₁ j) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
          (∏ j, (((SL2C.toLorentzGroup g).1 (a₂ j) (d₂ j) : ℝ) : ℂ))) •
          h.dotGaugeHiggs a₁ a₂

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring:
All terms built from the Higgs symbols and their derivatives which have mass weight
  exactly `n`: the intersection of the algebra generated by every `∇_d H` and `∇_d H̄` with
  the part on which `massWeightPoly` is the monomial `X ^ n`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def massWeightSubmodule
    (h : HiggsAlgebraCovRealization B rep repLorentz massWeightPoly) (n : ℕ) :
    Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.mem_massWeightSubmodule_iff
entries.docstring:
An element has mass weight `n` when it lies in the Higgs algebra and `massWeightPoly`
  scales it by `X ^ n`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmodule_iff {n : ℕ} {x : B} :
    x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule n
      ↔ x ∈ h.higgsAlgebra ∧ massWeightPoly x = Polynomial.monomial n x

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightPoly_of_mem_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring: The mass weight of an element of the weight-`n` submodule.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_of_mem_massWeightSubmodule {n : ℕ} {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule n) : massWeightPoly x = Polynomial.monomial n x

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.mem_higgsAlgebra_of_mem_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring: The weight-`n` submodule lies in the Higgs algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_higgsAlgebra_of_mem_massWeightSubmodule {n : ℕ} {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule n) : x ∈ h.higgsAlgebra

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmodule_mul_comm
entries.docstring: Two mass weight submodules commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_mul_comm (n m : ℕ) :
    h.massWeightSubmodule n * h.massWeightSubmodule m
    = h.massWeightSubmodule m * h.massWeightSubmodule n

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.one_le_massWeightSubmodule_zero
entries.docstring: The scalars have mass weight zero.
entries.snippet: lemma one_le_massWeightSubmodule_zero : (1 : Submodule ℂ B) ≤ h.massWeightSubmodule 0

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmodule_mul_le
entries.docstring: Mass weights add under multiplication.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_mul_le (m n : ℕ) :
    h.massWeightSubmodule m * h.massWeightSubmodule n ≤ h.massWeightSubmodule (m + n)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmodule_higgsSubmodule_le
entries.docstring: The Higgs symbols with `n` derivatives have mass weight `2 * (1 + n)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_higgsSubmodule_le (n : ℕ) :
    h.higgsSubmodule n ≤ h.massWeightSubmodule (2 * (1 + n))

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmodule_barHiggsSubmodule_le
entries.docstring: The conjugate Higgs symbols with `n` derivatives have mass weight `2 * (1 + n)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_barHiggsSubmodule_le (n : ℕ) :
    h.barHiggsSubmodule n ≤ h.massWeightSubmodule (2 * (1 + n))

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.higgsAlgebra_eq_adjoin
entries.docstring:
The Higgs algebra is generated by the Higgs and conjugate Higgs towers of every
  derivative order.
entries.snippet:
lemma higgsAlgebra_eq_adjoin :
    h.higgsAlgebra = Algebra.adjoin ℂ
      (⋃ n, ((h.higgsSubmodule n ⊔ h.barHiggsSubmodule n : Submodule ℂ B) : Set B))

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightPoly_of_mem_higgsSubmodule_sup
entries.docstring:
`massWeightPoly` is the monomial `X ^ (2 * (1 + n))` on the Higgs and conjugate Higgs
  towers with `n` derivatives.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightPoly_of_mem_higgsSubmodule_sup (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ x ∈ h.higgsSubmodule n ⊔ h.barHiggsSubmodule n,
      massWeightPoly x = Polynomial.monomial (2 * (1 + n)) x

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmodule_zero_eq
entries.docstring: Weight zero is the scalars: every Higgs tower has positive weight.
entries.snippet: lemma massWeightSubmodule_zero_eq : h.massWeightSubmodule 0 = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmodule_eq
entries.docstring:
The weight recursion: a term of positive mass weight `i` is a sum of symbols of weight
  `i` and of products of two terms of lower positive weight adding up to `i`.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_eq (i : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) :
    h.massWeightSubmodule i
      = (⨆ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k : Fin i => 2 * (1 + (k : ℕ)) = i),
          h.higgsSubmodule (k : ℕ) ⊔ h.barHiggsSubmodule (k : ℕ))
        ⊔ (⨆ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin i × Fin i => (p.1 : ℕ) + (p.2 : ℕ) = i),
            h.massWeightSubmodule (p.1 : ℕ) * h.massWeightSubmodule (p.2 : ℕ))

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmodule_eq_iSup_mul
entries.docstring:
Removing the leftmost Higgs tower: a term of positive weight `w` is a sum of products
  of a tower `∇ⁿH` or `∇ⁿH̄`, of weight `2 * (1 + n) ≤ w`, with a term of the remaining
  weight.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_eq_iSup_mul (w : ℕ) (hw : 0 < w) :
    h.massWeightSubmodule w
      = ⨆ n ∈ (Finset.range (w + 1)).filter (fun n => 2 * (1 + n) ≤ w),
          (h.higgsSubmodule n ⊔ h.barHiggsSubmodule n) * h.massWeightSubmodule (w - 2 * (1 + n))

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmodule_odd_eq_bot
entries.docstring:
The odd mass weight submodules are trivial: every Higgs tower has even weight, and
  weights add under products.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_odd_eq_bot (n : ℕ) (hn : Odd n) :
    h.massWeightSubmodule n = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeight
entries.docstring:
The gauge weight decomposition of the mass weight submodules. By recursion on the
  weight through `massWeightSubmodule_eq`: a term of weight `i` is either a symbol of that
  weight — decomposed by `higgsSubmoduleGaugeWeight` and `barHiggsSubmoduleGaugeWeight` — or
  a product of two terms of lower positive weight, decomposed by `mul` from the
  decompositions supplied by the recursion.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable def massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeight :
    (i : ℕ) → 0 < i → GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (h.massWeightSubmodule i)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightOfNeZero
entries.docstring: The `NeZero` form of `massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeight`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable instance massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightOfNeZero (i : ℕ) [NeZero i] :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (h.massWeightSubmodule i)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmodule_two_eq
entries.docstring: Weight two: the underived Higgs and conjugate Higgs.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_two_eq :
    h.massWeightSubmodule 2 = h.higgsSubmodule 0 ⊔ h.barHiggsSubmodule 0

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmodule_four_eq
entries.docstring:
Weight four: the once-derived symbols and the products of two underived ones. The
  leftmost tower is underived, leaving weight two, or once-derived, leaving weight zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_four_eq :
    h.massWeightSubmodule 4 = h.higgsSubmodule 1 ⊔ h.barHiggsSubmodule 1 ⊔
    h.higgsSubmodule 0 * h.higgsSubmodule 0 ⊔ h.higgsSubmodule 0 *
    h.barHiggsSubmodule 0 ⊔ h.barHiggsSubmodule 0 * h.barHiggsSubmodule 0

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmodule_six_eq
entries.docstring:
Weight six: the twice-derived symbols, a once-derived symbol against an underived one,
  and the products of three underived ones. The leftmost tower leaves weight four, two or
  zero.
entries.snippet: lemma massWeightSubmodule_six_eq : h.massWeightSubmodule 6 =

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmodule_eight_eq
entries.docstring:
Weight eight: the derivative terms with up to three derivatives, and the products of
  four underived symbols. The leftmost tower leaves weight six, four, two or zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_eight_eq :
    h.massWeightSubmodule 8 =

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.gaugeInvariantOfMassDim
entries.docstring: The gauge invariants of a given mass weight.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def gaugeInvariantOfMassDim (M : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmodule
entries.docstring:
The submodule of `B` generated by the Higgs symbols and their conjugates carrying
  `n` derivatives.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def derivSubmodule (h : HiggsAlgebraCovRealization B rep repLorentz massWeightPoly)
    (n : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmodule_le_ker_H
entries.docstring: Every element of a derivative submodule commutes with a fixed Higgs symbol.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_le_ker_H {n k : ℕ} (d : Fin k → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ HiggsVec) :
    h.derivSubmodule n
      ≤ LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (h.covH k d φ)
        - LinearMap.mulRight ℂ (h.covH k d φ))

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmodule_le_ker_barH
entries.docstring:
Every element of a derivative submodule commutes with a fixed conjugate-Higgs
  symbol.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_le_ker_barH {n k : ℕ} (d : Fin k → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule HiggsVec)) :
    h.derivSubmodule n
      ≤ LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (h.covBarH k d φ)
        - LinearMap.mulRight ℂ (h.covBarH k d φ))

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.commute_of_mem_derivSubmodule
entries.docstring:
Any element of a derivative submodule commutes with any element of any derivative
  submodule: the Higgs is bosonic.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_of_mem_derivSubmodule {n m : ℕ} {x y : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.derivSubmodule n) (hy : y ∈ h.derivSubmodule m) : Commute x y

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmodule_mul_comm
entries.docstring:
Derivative submodules commute with one another at the level of submodule
  products.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_mul_comm (n m : ℕ) :
    h.derivSubmodule n * h.derivSubmodule m = h.derivSubmodule m * h.derivSubmodule n

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmodule_map_rep_le
entries.docstring:
The derivative submodules are closed under the gauge action: each symbol is carried
  to a symbol with the same number of derivatives.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_map_rep_le (n : ℕ) (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    (h.derivSubmodule n).map (rep g) ≤ h.derivSubmodule n

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmodule_map_rep
entries.docstring: The derivative submodules are closed under the gauge action.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_map_rep (n : ℕ) (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    (h.derivSubmodule n).map (rep g) = h.derivSubmodule n

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmodule_map_repLorentz_le
entries.docstring:
The derivative submodules are closed under the Lorentz action: the Lorentz group
  only mixes the derivative indices within a fixed number of derivatives.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_map_repLorentz_le (n : ℕ) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    (h.derivSubmodule n).map (repLorentz Λ) ≤ h.derivSubmodule n

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmodule_map_repLorentz
entries.docstring: The derivative submodules are closed under the Lorentz action.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_map_repLorentz (n : ℕ) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    (h.derivSubmodule n).map (repLorentz Λ) = h.derivSubmodule n

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.range_covH_le_centreEigenspace
entries.docstring: The Higgs symbols carry the sign `+1`: their value space is a Lorentz scalar.
entries.snippet:
lemma range_covH_le_centreEigenspace (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    LinearMap.range (h.covH n l) ≤ centreEigenspace repLorentz 1

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.range_covBarH_le_centreEigenspace
entries.docstring: The conjugate Higgs symbols carry the sign `+1`, for the same reason.
entries.snippet:
lemma range_covBarH_le_centreEigenspace (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    LinearMap.range (h.covBarH n l) ≤ centreEigenspace repLorentz 1

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmodule_le_centreEigenspace
entries.docstring:
**The centre of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts on the Higgs derivative submodules by `+1`**, for any
  number of covariant derivatives: the Higgs is a Lorentz scalar and the derivative slots are
  inert at the centre.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_le_centreEigenspace (n : ℕ) :
    h.derivSubmodule n ≤ centreEigenspace repLorentz 1

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight
entries.docstring:
**The gauge weight decomposition of the Higgs derivative submodules**: the join of
  the decompositions of the Higgs and conjugate-Higgs submodules, whose weights are
  `(0, 0, ∓1, -3)` and `(0, 0, ±1, 3)` respectively.

  This is an instance: its statement mentions `h`, so unification against the goal
  recovers the sector and with it the rest of the structure's implicit data.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable instance derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight (n : ℕ) :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (h.derivSubmodule n)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_supp
entries.docstring:
The gauge weights occurring in the Higgs derivative submodules: the two Higgs
  weights `(0, 0, ∓1, -3)` and the two conjugate-Higgs weights `(0, 0, ±1, 3)`.

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmodule_le_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring: The derivative submodule sits in the mass-weight submodule of weight `2 * (1 + n)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_le_massWeightSubmodule (n : ℕ) :
    h.derivSubmodule n ≤ h.massWeightSubmodule (2 * (1 + n))

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmodule_eq_derivSubmodule
entries.docstring:
The weight recursion, with the single-symbol part written as a derivative
  submodule.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_eq_derivSubmodule (i : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) :
    h.massWeightSubmodule i
      = (⨆ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k : Fin i => 2 * (1 + (k : ℕ)) = i),
          h.derivSubmodule (k : ℕ))
        ⊔ (⨆ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin i × Fin i => (p.1 : ℕ) + (p.2 : ℕ) = i),
            h.massWeightSubmodule (p.1 : ℕ) * h.massWeightSubmodule (p.2 : ℕ))

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmodule_eq_iSup_derivSubmodule_mul
entries.docstring:
Removing the leftmost Higgs tower, written with the derivative submodules: a term of
  positive weight `w` is a sum of products of a tower `derivSubmodule n`, of weight
  `2 * (1 + n) ≤ w`, with a term of the remaining weight.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_eq_iSup_derivSubmodule_mul (w : ℕ) (hw : 0 < w) :
    h.massWeightSubmodule w
      = ⨆ n ∈ (Finset.range (w + 1)).filter (fun n => 2 * (1 + n) ≤ w),
          h.derivSubmodule n * h.massWeightSubmodule (w - 2 * (1 + n))

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmodule_two_eq_deriv
entries.docstring: Weight two is the underived Higgs symbols.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_two_eq_deriv :
    h.massWeightSubmodule 2 = h.derivSubmodule 0

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmodule_four_eq_deriv
entries.docstring:
Weight four: the leftmost tower is underived, leaving weight two, which is an underived
  tower, or once-derived, leaving weight zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_four_eq_deriv :
    h.massWeightSubmodule 4
      = h.derivSubmodule 1 ⊔ h.derivSubmodule 0 * h.derivSubmodule 0

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmodule_six_eq_deriv
entries.docstring:
Weight six: the leftmost tower leaves weight four, two or zero. The product of an
  underived tower with a once-derived one occurs in both orders, which agree by
  `derivSubmodule_mul_comm`.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_six_eq_deriv :
    h.massWeightSubmodule 6
      = h.derivSubmodule 2 ⊔ h.derivSubmodule 1 * h.derivSubmodule 0
        ⊔ h.derivSubmodule 0 * h.derivSubmodule 0 * h.derivSubmodule 0

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmodule_eight_eq_deriv
entries.docstring:
Weight eight: the leftmost tower leaves weight six, four, two or zero. Products that
  differ only in the order of commuting towers agree by `derivSubmodule_mul_comm`.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmodule_eight_eq_deriv :
    h.massWeightSubmodule 8
      = h.derivSubmodule 3 ⊔ h.derivSubmodule 2 * h.derivSubmodule 0
        ⊔ h.derivSubmodule 1 * h.derivSubmodule 1
        ⊔ h.derivSubmodule 1 * h.derivSubmodule 0 * h.derivSubmodule 0
        ⊔ h.derivSubmodule 0 * h.derivSubmodule 0 * h.derivSubmodule 0
          * h.derivSubmodule 0

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightOdd
entries.docstring: The odd mass-weight submodules are trivial, so they carry the empty decomposition.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable def massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightOdd (n : ℕ) (hn : Odd n) :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (h.massWeightSubmodule n)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightOne
entries.docstring: Weight one is trivial.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable def massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightOne :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (h.massWeightSubmodule 1)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightTwo
entries.docstring: Weight two is the underived Higgs tower.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable def massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightTwo :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (h.massWeightSubmodule 2)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightThree
entries.docstring: Weight three is trivial.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable def massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightThree :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (h.massWeightSubmodule 3)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightFour
entries.docstring:
Weight four is the once-derived tower together with the products of two underived
  ones.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable def massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightFour :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (h.massWeightSubmodule 4)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightFive
entries.docstring: Weight five is trivial.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable def massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightFive :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (h.massWeightSubmodule 5)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightSix
entries.docstring:
Weight six is the twice-derived tower, the once-derived tower against an underived
  one, and the products of three underived ones.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable def massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightSix :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (h.massWeightSubmodule 6)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightSeven
entries.docstring: Weight seven is trivial.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable def massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightSeven :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (h.massWeightSubmodule 7)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightEight
entries.docstring:
Weight eight: the thrice-derived tower, the two ways of splitting the derivatives over
  two towers, the once-derived tower against two underived ones, and the products of four
  underived ones.
entries.snippet:
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable def massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightEight :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition rep (h.massWeightSubmodule 8)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_eq
entries.docstring:
The weight-`w` piece of a derivative submodule, as the join of the Higgs and
  conjugate-Higgs pieces.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_eq (n : ℕ) (w : GaugeWeight) :
    (h.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight n).piece w
      = (if w = ((0, 0, -1, -3) : GaugeWeight) then
          ⨆ d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), ℂ ∙ h.higgs d 0
        else if w = ((0, 0, 1, -3) : GaugeWeight) then
          ⨆ d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), ℂ ∙ h.higgs d 1
        else ⊥)
        ⊔ (if w = ((0, 0, 1, 3) : GaugeWeight) then
            ⨆ d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), ℂ ∙ h.barHiggs d 0
          else if w = ((0, 0, -1, 3) : GaugeWeight) then
            ⨆ d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), ℂ ∙ h.barHiggs d 1
          else ⊥)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_higgs_zero
entries.docstring: The piece at the weight of the upper Higgs component.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_higgs_zero (n : ℕ) :
    (h.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight n).piece (0, 0, -1, -3)
      = ⨆ d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), ℂ ∙ h.higgs d 0

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_higgs_one
entries.docstring: The piece at the weight of the lower Higgs component.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_higgs_one (n : ℕ) :
    (h.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight n).piece (0, 0, 1, -3)
      = ⨆ d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), ℂ ∙ h.higgs d 1

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_barHiggs_zero
entries.docstring: The piece at the weight of the upper conjugate-Higgs component.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_barHiggs_zero (n : ℕ) :
    (h.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight n).piece (0, 0, 1, 3)
      = ⨆ d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), ℂ ∙ h.barHiggs d 0

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_barHiggs_one
entries.docstring: The piece at the weight of the lower conjugate-Higgs component.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_barHiggs_one (n : ℕ) :
    (h.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight n).piece (0, 0, -1, 3)
      = ⨆ d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), ℂ ∙ h.barHiggs d 1

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_zero
entries.docstring:
A derivative submodule has no weight-zero content: every Higgs symbol carries
  hypercharge.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight_piece_zero (n : ℕ) :
    (h.derivSubmoduleGaugeWeight n).piece 0 = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.higgsBarHiggsSpan
entries.docstring:
The span of the isospin-diagonal pairings of a Higgs symbol carrying `n` derivatives
  with a conjugate-Higgs symbol carrying `m` derivatives, at isospin component `i`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def higgsBarHiggsSpan (h : HiggsAlgebraCovRealization B rep repLorentz massWeightPoly)
    (n m : ℕ) (i : Fin 2) : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.quarticSpan
entries.docstring:
The span of the underived quartic monomial pairing the isospin components `i` and
  `j`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def quarticSpan (h : HiggsAlgebraCovRealization B rep repLorentz massWeightPoly)
    (i j : Fin 2) : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmodule_mul_piece_zero
entries.docstring:
The weight-zero piece of a product of two derivative submodules: the isospin-diagonal
  pairings, taken in both orders of the two towers.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_mul_piece_zero (n m : ℕ) :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition.piece rep (h.derivSubmodule n * h.derivSubmodule m) 0
      = h.higgsBarHiggsSpan n m 0 ⊔ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan n m 1
        ⊔ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan m n 0 ⊔ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan m n 1

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmodule_mul_mul_piece_zero
entries.docstring:
A product of three derivative submodules has no weight-zero content: the hypercharge of
  three Higgs generators is an odd multiple of three.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_mul_mul_piece_zero (n m k : ℕ) :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition.piece rep
      (h.derivSubmodule n * h.derivSubmodule m * h.derivSubmodule k) 0 = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.derivSubmodule_zero_pow_four_piece_zero
entries.docstring:
The weight-zero piece of the product of four underived derivative submodules: the three
  quartic monomials, the ones pairing two Higgs symbols against two conjugate ones with
  matching isospin.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivSubmodule_zero_pow_four_piece_zero :
    GaugeWeightDecomposition.piece rep
      (h.derivSubmodule 0 * h.derivSubmodule 0 * h.derivSubmodule 0
        * h.derivSubmodule 0) 0
      = h.quarticSpan 0 0 ⊔ h.quarticSpan 0 1 ⊔ h.quarticSpan 1 1

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightOdd_piece_zero
entries.docstring: The weight-zero piece at an odd mass weight: the submodule itself is trivial.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightOdd_piece_zero (n : ℕ) (hn : Odd n) :
    (h.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightOdd n hn).piece 0 = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightTwo_piece_zero
entries.docstring:
The weight-zero piece at mass weight two: a single Higgs symbol carries
  hypercharge.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightTwo_piece_zero :
    (h.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightTwo).piece 0 = ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightFour_piece_zero
entries.docstring: The weight-zero piece at mass weight four: the underived isospin-diagonal pairings.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightFour_piece_zero :
    (h.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightFour).piece 0
      = h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 0 0 0 ⊔ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 0 0 1

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightSix_piece_zero
entries.docstring:
The weight-zero piece at mass weight six: the isospin-diagonal pairings carrying one
  derivative, on either of the two factors.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightSix_piece_zero :
    (h.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightSix).piece 0
      = h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 1 0 0 ⊔ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 1 0 1
        ⊔ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 0 1 0 ⊔ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 0 1 1

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightEight_piece_zero
entries.docstring:
The weight-zero piece at mass weight eight: the isospin-diagonal pairings carrying two
  derivatives on one factor or one on each, together with the three quartic monomials.
entries.snippet:
lemma massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightEight_piece_zero :
    (h.massWeightSubmoduleGaugeWeightEight).piece 0
      = h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 2 0 0 ⊔ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 2 0 1
        ⊔ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 0 2 0 ⊔ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 0 2 1
        ⊔ (h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 1 1 0 ⊔ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 1 1 1)
        ⊔ (h.quarticSpan 0 0 ⊔ h.quarticSpan 0 1 ⊔ h.quarticSpan 1 1)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.eq_zero_of_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_odd
entries.docstring: A gauge-invariant term of odd mass weight vanishes.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_zero_of_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_odd (n : ℕ) (hn : Odd n) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule n) : x = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.eq_zero_of_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_two
entries.docstring:
A gauge-invariant term of mass weight two vanishes: a single Higgs symbol carries
  hypercharge, so nothing at that weight is neutral.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_zero_of_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_two {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule 2) (hg : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, rep g x = x) : x = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.mem_of_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_four
entries.docstring:
A gauge-invariant term of mass weight four is a combination of the two underived
  isospin-diagonal pairings.

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.mem_of_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_six
entries.docstring:
A gauge-invariant term of mass weight six is a combination of the isospin-diagonal
  pairings carrying one derivative, on either factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_six {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule 6) (hg : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, rep g x = x) :
    x ∈ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 1 0 0 ⊔ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 1 0 1
      ⊔ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 0 1 0 ⊔ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 0 1 1

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.mem_of_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_eight
entries.docstring:
A gauge-invariant term of mass weight eight is a combination of the isospin-diagonal
  pairings carrying two derivatives and of the three quartic monomials.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_of_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_eight {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule 8) (hg : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, rep g x = x) :
    x ∈ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 2 0 0 ⊔ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 2 0 1
      ⊔ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 0 2 0 ⊔ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 0 2 1
      ⊔ (h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 1 1 0 ⊔ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan 1 1 1)
      ⊔ (h.quarticSpan 0 0 ⊔ h.quarticSpan 0 1 ⊔ h.quarticSpan 1 1)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.su2_inv_apply
entries.docstring:
The entries of the inverse of an `SU(2)` element are the conjugated transposed
  entries, the inverse of a unitary matrix being its conjugate transpose.
entries.snippet:
lemma su2_inv_apply (V : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (a b : Fin 2) :
    (V⁻¹).1 a b = conj (V.1 b a)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.rep_su2_higgs
entries.docstring:
An isospin transformation moves the isospin index of a Higgs symbol by the conjugate
  matrix: the index of a Higgs symbol is anti-fundamental.
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_su2_higgs (V : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) {n : ℕ}
    (d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (i : Fin 2) :
    rep ((1, V, 1) : GaugeGroupI) (h.higgs d i)
      = ∑ a, conj (V.1 a i) • h.higgs d a

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.rep_su2_barHiggs
entries.docstring:
An isospin transformation moves the isospin index of a conjugate Higgs symbol by the
  matrix itself: the index of a conjugate Higgs symbol is fundamental.
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_su2_barHiggs (V : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) {n : ℕ}
    (d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (i : Fin 2) :
    rep ((1, V, 1) : GaugeGroupI) (h.barHiggs d i)
      = ∑ a, V.1 a i • h.barHiggs d a

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.rep_mul_pair
entries.docstring:
A product of two symbols each moving by given coefficients moves by the product of
  those coefficients.
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_mul_pair (g : GaugeGroupI) {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {X : ι → B} {Y : κ → B} {x₀ : ι} {y₀ : κ} {cX : ι → ℂ} {cY : κ → ℂ}
    (hX : rep g (X x₀) = ∑ x, cX x • X x) (hY : rep g (Y y₀) = ∑ y, cY y • Y y) :
    rep g (X x₀ * Y y₀) = ∑ x, ∑ y, (cX x * cY y) • (X x * Y y)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.higgs_mul_barHiggs_comm
entries.docstring: A Higgs symbol commutes with a conjugate Higgs symbol, in the components.
entries.snippet:
lemma higgs_mul_barHiggs_comm {n m : ℕ} (d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (d' : Fin m → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (i j : Fin 2) :
    h.higgs d i * h.barHiggs d' j = h.barHiggs d' j * h.higgs d i

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.higgs_mul_higgs_comm
entries.docstring: Two Higgs symbols commute, in the components.
entries.snippet:
lemma higgs_mul_higgs_comm {n m : ℕ} (d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (d' : Fin m → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (i j : Fin 2) :
    h.higgs d i * h.higgs d' j = h.higgs d' j * h.higgs d i

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.barHiggs_mul_barHiggs_comm
entries.docstring: Two conjugate Higgs symbols commute, in the components.
entries.snippet:
lemma barHiggs_mul_barHiggs_comm {n m : ℕ} (d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (d' : Fin m → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (i j : Fin 2) :
    h.barHiggs d i * h.barHiggs d' j = h.barHiggs d' j * h.barHiggs d i

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.isoFamily
entries.docstring:
The isospin family of a Higgs tower carrying `n` derivatives against a conjugate tower
  carrying `m`: the conjugate symbol supplies the fundamental index and so goes in the
  first slot, the Higgs symbol the anti-fundamental one.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def isoFamily (h : HiggsAlgebraCovRealization B rep repLorentz massWeightPoly)
    {n m : ℕ} (d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (d' : Fin m → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) : (Fin 2 → Fin 2) → B

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.isSU2FundamentalAntiFundamental_isoFamily
entries.docstring: The isospin family carries one fundamental and one anti-fundamental isospin index.
entries.snippet:
lemma isSU2FundamentalAntiFundamental_isoFamily {n m : ℕ} (d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (d' : Fin m → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) : IsSU2FundamentalAntiFundamental B rep (h.isoFamily d d')

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.deltaContraction_isoFamily
entries.docstring:
The delta contraction of the isospin family, which spans its isospin invariants, is the
  isospin contraction: the Higgs mass term of the two towers.
entries.snippet:
lemma deltaContraction_isoFamily {n m : ℕ} (d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (d' : Fin m → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    IsSU2FundamentalAntiFundamental.deltaContraction (h.isoFamily d d') = h.dotGaugeHiggs d d'

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.dotSpan
entries.docstring:
The span of the isospin contractions of a Higgs tower carrying `n` derivatives against
  a conjugate tower carrying `m`: the gauge invariants the isospin classification leaves
  at those two derivative orders.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def dotSpan (h : HiggsAlgebraCovRealization B rep repLorentz massWeightPoly)
    (n m : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.isoFamily_span_stable
entries.docstring:
The span of the isospin family is stable under the whole gauge group: each factor of a
  component goes to a combination of the factors of components.
entries.snippet:
lemma isoFamily_span_stable {n m : ℕ} (d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (d' : Fin m → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (g : GaugeGroupI) {y : B}
    (hy : y ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (h.isoFamily d d'))) :
    rep g y ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (h.isoFamily d d'))

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.higgsBarHiggsSpan_le_isoFamily_span
entries.docstring:
The isospin-diagonal pairing spans of section C sit inside the span of the isospin
  family: a diagonal pairing is one of the four components, the two factors commuting.
entries.snippet:
lemma higgsBarHiggsSpan_le_isoFamily_span (n m : ℕ) :
    h.higgsBarHiggsSpan n m 0 ⊔ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan n m 1
      ≤ ⨆ (d : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (d' : Fin m → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)),
        Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (h.isoFamily d d'))

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.tildeHiggs
entries.docstring:
The re-index of an underived Higgs symbol by the antisymmetric symbol, `H̃⁰ = H¹` and
  `H̃¹ = -H⁰`.  `SU(2)` is pseudo-real, so this turns the anti-fundamental index of a Higgs
  symbol into a fundamental one, which is what the quartic family needs.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def tildeHiggs (h : HiggsAlgebraCovRealization B rep repLorentz massWeightPoly)
  (i : Fin 2) : B

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.rep_su2_tildeHiggs
entries.docstring:
The re-indexed Higgs symbol carries a fundamental isospin index: the four entry
  identities of `GaugeGroup.SU2Conjugation` remove every complex conjugate.
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_su2_tildeHiggs (V : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin 2) :
    rep ((1, V, 1) : GaugeGroupI) (h.tildeHiggs i)
      = ∑ a, V.1 a i • h.tildeHiggs a

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.quadFamily
entries.docstring:
The quartic isospin family: two conjugate Higgs symbols against two re-indexed Higgs
  symbols, each of the four carrying a fundamental isospin index.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def quadFamily (h : HiggsAlgebraCovRealization B rep repLorentz massWeightPoly) :
    (Fin 4 → Fin 2) → B

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.isSU2QuadFundamental_quadFamily
entries.docstring: The quartic family carries four fundamental isospin indices.
entries.snippet: lemma isSU2QuadFundamental_quadFamily : IsSU2QuadFundamental B rep h.quadFamily

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.barHiggs_higgs_left_comm_zero
entries.docstring:
Moving a Higgs symbol past a conjugate one, at no derivatives and inside a product:
  the normalisation used to compare quartic monomials.

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.barHiggs_mul_higgs_comm_zero
entries.docstring: Moving a Higgs symbol past a conjugate one, at no derivatives.

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.higgs_left_comm_zero
entries.docstring: Sorting two Higgs symbols inside a product.

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.epsilonContraction₁₂_quadFamily
entries.docstring:
The first epsilon contraction of the quartic family is the square of the isospin
  contraction: pairing the first conjugate symbol with the first Higgs symbol, and the
  second with the second, is pairing each `H̄` with an `H`.
entries.snippet:
lemma epsilonContraction₁₂_quadFamily :
    IsSU2QuadFundamental.epsilonContraction₁₂ h.quadFamily
      = h.dotGaugeHiggs ![] ![] * h.dotGaugeHiggs ![] ![]

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.epsilonContraction₁₃_quadFamily
entries.docstring:
The second epsilon contraction of the quartic family vanishes: it pairs the two
  conjugate symbols with each other and the two Higgs symbols with each other, and an
  antisymmetric contraction of two commuting factors is zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma epsilonContraction₁₃_quadFamily :
    IsSU2QuadFundamental.epsilonContraction₁₃ h.quadFamily = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.quarticSpan_le_quadFamily_span
entries.docstring:
The three quartic monomials of section C lie in the span of the components of the
  quartic family, each being one of those components up to a sign.
entries.snippet:
lemma quarticSpan_le_quadFamily_span :
    h.quarticSpan 0 0 ⊔ h.quarticSpan 0 1 ⊔ h.quarticSpan 1 1
      ≤ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range h.quadFamily)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.isoSpan
entries.docstring:
The span of the components of all the isospin families of a Higgs tower carrying `n`
  derivatives against a conjugate tower carrying `m`.  This is the gauge-stable
  enlargement of the pairing span of section C.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def isoSpan (h : HiggsAlgebraCovRealization B rep repLorentz massWeightPoly)
    (n m : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.isStableUnder_isoSpan
entries.docstring: The isospin span is stable under the gauge group.
entries.snippet:
lemma isStableUnder_isoSpan (n m : ℕ) :
    IsStableUnder (fun g : GaugeGroupI => rep g) (h.isoSpan n m)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.isFixedBy_dotSpan
entries.docstring: The span of the isospin contractions is fixed pointwise by the gauge group.
entries.snippet:
lemma isFixedBy_dotSpan (n m : ℕ) :
    IsFixedBy (fun g : GaugeGroupI => rep g) (h.dotSpan n m)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.higgsBarHiggsSpan_le_isoSpan'
entries.docstring: Each isospin-diagonal pairing span of section C sits inside the isospin span.
entries.snippet:
lemma higgsBarHiggsSpan_le_isoSpan' (n m : ℕ) (i : Fin 2) :
    h.higgsBarHiggsSpan n m i ≤ h.isoSpan n m

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.higgsBarHiggsSpan_le_isoSpan
entries.docstring: The pairing span of section C sits inside the isospin span.
entries.snippet:
lemma higgsBarHiggsSpan_le_isoSpan (n m : ℕ) :
    h.higgsBarHiggsSpan n m 0 ⊔ h.higgsBarHiggsSpan n m 1 ≤ h.isoSpan n m

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.reducesInvariantsTo_isoSpan
entries.docstring:
The isospin span reduces, for the gauge group, to the span of the isospin contractions:
  each family's span reduces to the line through its delta contraction, which is the
  isospin contraction of the two towers.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_isoSpan (n m : ℕ) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : GaugeGroupI => rep g) (h.isoSpan n m) (h.dotSpan n m)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.reducesInvariantsTo_massWeightSubmodule_two
entries.docstring:
Mass weight two reduces to `⊥` for the gauge group: a single Higgs symbol carries
  hypercharge, so the weight-zero piece is trivial.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_massWeightSubmodule_two :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : GaugeGroupI => rep g) (h.massWeightSubmodule 2) ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.reducesInvariantsTo_massWeightSubmodule_four
entries.docstring:
Mass weight four reduces, for the gauge group, to the underived isospin contraction,
  the Higgs mass term.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_massWeightSubmodule_four :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : GaugeGroupI => rep g) (h.massWeightSubmodule 4)
      (h.dotSpan 0 0)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.reducesInvariantsTo_massWeightSubmodule_six
entries.docstring:
Mass weight six reduces, for the gauge group, to the isospin contractions carrying one
  derivative, on either factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_massWeightSubmodule_six :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : GaugeGroupI => rep g) (h.massWeightSubmodule 6)
      (h.dotSpan 1 0 ⊔ h.dotSpan 0 1)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.reducesInvariantsTo_massWeightSubmodule_eight
entries.docstring:
Mass weight eight reduces, for the gauge group, to the isospin contractions carrying two
  derivatives and the square of the underived one, the quartic potential.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_massWeightSubmodule_eight :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : GaugeGroupI => rep g) (h.massWeightSubmodule 8)
      (h.dotSpan 2 0 ⊔ h.dotSpan 0 2 ⊔ h.dotSpan 1 1
        ⊔ ℂ ∙ (h.dotGaugeHiggs ![] ![] * h.dotGaugeHiggs ![] ![]))

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.mem_dotSpan_of_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_four
entries.docstring:
A gauge-invariant term of mass weight four is a multiple of the underived isospin
  contraction.

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.mem_dotSpan_of_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_six
entries.docstring:
A gauge-invariant term of mass weight six is a combination of the isospin contractions
  carrying one derivative, on either factor.

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.mem_dotSpan_of_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_eight
entries.docstring:
A gauge-invariant term of mass weight eight is a combination of the isospin
  contractions carrying two derivatives and of the square of the underived contraction.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_dotSpan_of_invariant_massWeightSubmodule_eight {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule 8) (hg : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, rep g x = x) :
    x ∈ h.dotSpan 2 0 ⊔ h.dotSpan 0 2 ⊔ h.dotSpan 1 1
      ⊔ ℂ ∙ (h.dotGaugeHiggs ![] ![] * h.dotGaugeHiggs ![] ![])

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.dotGaugeHiggs_mem_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring: An isospin contraction has the mass weight of its two towers together.
entries.snippet:
lemma dotGaugeHiggs_mem_massWeightSubmodule {n1 n2 : ℕ} (d1 : Fin n1 → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (d2 : Fin n2 → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    h.dotGaugeHiggs d1 d2 ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule (2 * (1 + n1) + 2 * (1 + n2))

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.gaugeInvariantOfMassDim_four_eq_dotSpan
entries.docstring: The gauge invariants of mass weight four: the underived isospin contraction.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeInvariantOfMassDim_four_eq_dotSpan :
    h.gaugeInvariantOfMassDim 4 = h.dotSpan 0 0

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.gaugeInvariantOfMassDim_six_eq_dotSpan
entries.docstring:
The gauge invariants of mass weight six: the isospin contractions with one derivative
  on either factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeInvariantOfMassDim_six_eq_dotSpan :
    h.gaugeInvariantOfMassDim 6 = h.dotSpan 1 0 ⊔ h.dotSpan 0 1

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.gaugeInvariantOfMassDim_eight_eq_dotSpan
entries.docstring:
The gauge invariants of mass weight eight: the isospin contractions with two
  derivatives distributed over the two factors, together with the square of the underived
  contraction — the quartic potential.
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeInvariantOfMassDim_eight_eq_dotSpan :
    h.gaugeInvariantOfMassDim 8 = h.dotSpan 2 0 ⊔ h.dotSpan 0 2 ⊔ h.dotSpan 1 1
      ⊔ ℂ ∙ (h.dotGaugeHiggs ![] ![] * h.dotGaugeHiggs ![] ![])

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.sum_cov_one
entries.docstring: A sum over families of one covector index is a single sum.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_cov_one {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : (Fin 1 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M) :
    ∑ d : Fin 1 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, f d = ∑ x : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, f ![x]

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.etaExpand_cov_one
entries.docstring: A family of one covector index is the tuple of its own entry.
entries.snippet: lemma etaExpand_cov_one (l : Fin 1 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : ![l 0] = l

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.isLorentzCovariant_rankTwo_dotGaugeHiggs_left
entries.docstring:
Both derivatives on the Higgs tower: a bi-Lorentz tensor in the two derivative
  slots.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzCovariant_rankTwo_dotGaugeHiggs_left :
    IsLorentzCovariant 2 B repLorentz
      (ofComponents fun d : Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 => h.dotGaugeHiggs d ![])

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.isLorentzCovariant_rankTwo_dotGaugeHiggs_right
entries.docstring: Both derivatives on the conjugate tower: a bi-Lorentz tensor in the same way.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzCovariant_rankTwo_dotGaugeHiggs_right :
    IsLorentzCovariant 2 B repLorentz
      (ofComponents fun d : Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 => h.dotGaugeHiggs ![] d)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.isLorentzCovariant_rankTwo_dotGaugeHiggs_mixed
entries.docstring:
One derivative on each tower: the family whose metric contraction is the kinetic
  term.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzCovariant_rankTwo_dotGaugeHiggs_mixed :
    IsLorentzCovariant 2 B repLorentz
      (ofComponents fun d : Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 => h.dotGaugeHiggs ![d 0] ![d 1])

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.dotSpan_two_zero_eq
entries.docstring:
The span of the isospin contractions with both derivatives on the Higgs tower is the
  span of the components of the corresponding bi-Lorentz tensor.
entries.snippet:
lemma dotSpan_two_zero_eq :
    h.dotSpan 2 0
      = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun d : Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 => h.dotGaugeHiggs d ![])

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.dotSpan_zero_two_eq
entries.docstring:
The span of the isospin contractions with both derivatives on the conjugate tower is
  the span of the components of the corresponding bi-Lorentz tensor.
entries.snippet:
lemma dotSpan_zero_two_eq :
    h.dotSpan 0 2
      = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun d : Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 => h.dotGaugeHiggs ![] d)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.dotSpan_one_one_eq
entries.docstring:
The span of the isospin contractions with one derivative on each tower is the span of
  the components of the mixed bi-Lorentz tensor.
entries.snippet:
lemma dotSpan_one_one_eq :
    h.dotSpan 1 1
      = Submodule.span ℂ
        (Set.range fun d : Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 => h.dotGaugeHiggs ![d 0] ![d 1])

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.rep_ofComponents_metric
entries.docstring: The metric trace of a family of gauge invariants is a gauge invariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_ofComponents_metric {T : (Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B}
    (hTG : ∀ (g : GaugeGroupI) (d : Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), rep g (T d) = T d)
    (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    rep g (ofComponents T RankTwo.metric) = ofComponents T RankTwo.metric

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.lorentzContractionEightSpan
entries.docstring:
The gauge and Lorentz invariants of the Higgs sector at mass weight eight: the two box
  terms `□H† H` and `H† □H`, the kinetic term `∂^μ H† ∂_μ H`, and the quartic potential
  `(H† H)²`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def lorentzContractionEightSpan
    (h : HiggsAlgebraCovRealization B rep repLorentz massWeightPoly) :
    Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.invariant_dotGaugeHiggs_sq
entries.docstring:
The square of the underived isospin contraction is fixed by both groups: it is a
  product of two invariants and both representations are multiplicative.
entries.snippet:
lemma invariant_dotGaugeHiggs_sq :
    (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g (h.dotGaugeHiggs (![] : Fin 0 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) ![]
        * h.dotGaugeHiggs ![] ![])
      = h.dotGaugeHiggs ![] ![] * h.dotGaugeHiggs ![] ![])
    ∧ ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, rep g (h.dotGaugeHiggs (![] : Fin 0 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) ![]
        * h.dotGaugeHiggs ![] ![])
      = h.dotGaugeHiggs ![] ![] * h.dotGaugeHiggs ![] ![]

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.ofComponents_metric_mem_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring:
The metric trace of a family of elements of mass weight eight has mass weight
  eight.

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.lorentzContractionEightSpan_le_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring: The weight-eight span lies in the mass-weight submodule of weight eight.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzContractionEightSpan_le_massWeightSubmodule :
    h.lorentzContractionEightSpan ≤ h.massWeightSubmodule 8

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.rep_of_mem_lorentzContractionEightSpan
entries.docstring: Every element of the weight-eight span is a gauge invariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_of_mem_lorentzContractionEightSpan (g : GaugeGroupI) {y : B}
    (hy : y ∈ h.lorentzContractionEightSpan) : rep g y = y

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.repLorentz_of_mem_lorentzContractionEightSpan
entries.docstring: Every element of the weight-eight span is a Lorentz invariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_of_mem_lorentzContractionEightSpan (g : SL(2,ℂ)) {y : B}
    (hy : y ∈ h.lorentzContractionEightSpan) : repLorentz g y = y

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.isFixedBy_lorentzContractionEightSpan
entries.docstring: The weight-eight span is fixed pointwise by both groups.
entries.snippet:
lemma isFixedBy_lorentzContractionEightSpan :
    IsFixedBy (gaugeLorentzMaps rep repLorentz) h.lorentzContractionEightSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.reducesInvariantsTo_lorentzContractionEightSpan
entries.docstring:
The Higgs sector at mass weight eight reduces, for the gauge and Lorentz groups
  together, to the two box terms, the kinetic term and the quartic potential. The gauge group
  leaves the isospin contractions with two derivatives and the square of the underived one;
  the Lorentz group contracts the two derivative slots of each family with the metric, and
  the square, which carries no index, is fixed.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_lorentzContractionEightSpan :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (gaugeLorentzMaps rep repLorentz) (h.massWeightSubmodule 8)
      h.lorentzContractionEightSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.mem_massWeightSubmodule_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff
entries.docstring:
The gauge and Lorentz classification of mass weight eight as an equivalence: an element
  of `massWeightSubmodule 8 ⊔ S` is fixed by both groups exactly when it is a combination of
  the two box terms, the kinetic term and the quartic potential, up to a remainder in `S`
  fixed by both groups.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmodule_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff
    (S : Submodule ℂ B) (hS : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, rep g y ∈ S)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule 8 ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, rep g x = x)
        ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, rep g y = y)
          ∧ (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y)
          ∧ x - y ∈ h.lorentzContractionEightSpan

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.sum_cov_zero
entries.docstring: A sum over families of no covector indices is its single term.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_cov_zero {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : (Fin 0 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M) :
    ∑ d : Fin 0 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, f d = f ![]

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.isLorentzCovariant_rankOne_dotGaugeHiggs_left
entries.docstring:
The isospin contraction of a once-derived Higgs tower against an underived conjugate
  tower, read as a family indexed by its derivative slot, is a Lorentz vector.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzCovariant_rankOne_dotGaugeHiggs_left :
    IsLorentzCovariant 1 B repLorentz
      (ofComponents fun d : Fin 1 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 => h.dotGaugeHiggs d ![])

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.isLorentzCovariant_rankOne_dotGaugeHiggs_right
entries.docstring:
The isospin contraction of an underived Higgs tower against a once-derived conjugate
  tower is a Lorentz vector in the same way.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzCovariant_rankOne_dotGaugeHiggs_right :
    IsLorentzCovariant 1 B repLorentz
      (ofComponents fun d : Fin 1 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 => h.dotGaugeHiggs ![] d)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.dotSpan_one_zero_eq
entries.docstring:
The span of the isospin contractions with one derivative on the Higgs tower is the
  span of the components of the corresponding Lorentz vector.
entries.snippet:
lemma dotSpan_one_zero_eq :
    h.dotSpan 1 0
      = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun d : Fin 1 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 => h.dotGaugeHiggs d ![])

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.dotSpan_zero_one_eq
entries.docstring:
The span of the isospin contractions with one derivative on the conjugate tower is the
  span of the components of the corresponding Lorentz vector.
entries.snippet:
lemma dotSpan_zero_one_eq :
    h.dotSpan 0 1
      = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun d : Fin 1 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 => h.dotGaugeHiggs ![] d)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.repLorentz_dotGaugeHiggs_zero
entries.docstring: The underived isospin contraction is a Lorentz scalar.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_dotGaugeHiggs_zero (g : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    repLorentz g (h.dotGaugeHiggs (![] : Fin 0 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) ![])
      = h.dotGaugeHiggs ![] ![]

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.dotSpan_zero_zero_eq
entries.docstring: The span of the underived isospin contractions is the line through the mass term.
entries.snippet:
lemma dotSpan_zero_zero_eq :
    h.dotSpan 0 0 = ℂ ∙ h.dotGaugeHiggs (![] : Fin 0 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) ![]

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.repLorentz_of_mem_dotSpan_zero_zero
entries.docstring:
Every element of the line through the underived isospin contraction is a Lorentz
  invariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_of_mem_dotSpan_zero_zero (g : SL(2,ℂ)) {y : B} (hy : y ∈ h.dotSpan 0 0) :
    repLorentz g y = y

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.rep_of_mem_dotSpan
entries.docstring: Every element of a span of isospin contractions is a gauge invariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_of_mem_dotSpan {n m : ℕ} (g : GaugeGroupI) {y : B} (hy : y ∈ h.dotSpan n m) :
    rep g y = y

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.dotSpan_zero_zero_le_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring: The line through the underived isospin contraction lies in mass weight four.
entries.snippet:
lemma dotSpan_zero_zero_le_massWeightSubmodule :
    h.dotSpan 0 0 ≤ h.massWeightSubmodule 4

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.reducesInvariantsTo_dotSpan_one_zero_sup_zero_one
entries.docstring:
The once-derived isospin contractions reduce to `⊥` for the Lorentz group: each span is
  spanned by a Lorentz vector, and a single covector index carries no invariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_dotSpan_one_zero_sup_zero_one :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : SL(2,ℂ) => repLorentz g) (h.dotSpan 1 0 ⊔ h.dotSpan 0 1) ⊥

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.lorentzContractionLTEightSpan
entries.docstring:
The gauge and Lorentz invariants of the Higgs sector at mass weight `w` for
  `0 < w < 8`: the line through the Higgs mass term at weight four, and nothing at any
  other weight.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def lorentzContractionLTEightSpan
    (h : HiggsAlgebraCovRealization B rep repLorentz massWeightPoly)
    (w : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ B

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.lorentzContractionLTEightSpan_le_massWeightSubmodule
entries.docstring: The surviving span at weight `w` lies in the mass-weight submodule of weight `w`.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzContractionLTEightSpan_le_massWeightSubmodule (w : ℕ) :
    h.lorentzContractionLTEightSpan w ≤ h.massWeightSubmodule w

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.rep_of_mem_lorentzContractionLTEightSpan
entries.docstring: Every element of the surviving span is a gauge invariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_of_mem_lorentzContractionLTEightSpan (w : ℕ) (g : GaugeGroupI) {y : B}
    (hy : y ∈ h.lorentzContractionLTEightSpan w) : rep g y = y

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.repLorentz_of_mem_lorentzContractionLTEightSpan
entries.docstring: Every element of the surviving span is a Lorentz invariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_of_mem_lorentzContractionLTEightSpan (w : ℕ) (g : SL(2,ℂ)) {y : B}
    (hy : y ∈ h.lorentzContractionLTEightSpan w) : repLorentz g y = y

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.isFixedBy_lorentzContractionLTEightSpan
entries.docstring: The surviving span below weight eight is fixed pointwise by both groups.
entries.snippet:
lemma isFixedBy_lorentzContractionLTEightSpan (w : ℕ) :
    IsFixedBy (gaugeLorentzMaps rep repLorentz) (h.lorentzContractionLTEightSpan w)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.reducesInvariantsTo_lorentzContractionLTEightSpan
entries.docstring:
Below mass weight eight the Higgs sector reduces, for the gauge and Lorentz groups
  together, to the surviving span. The four odd weights are trivial submodules, weight two
  dies on hypercharge, weight four leaves the Higgs mass term, which the Lorentz group fixes,
  and at weight six the gauge group leaves the once-derived contractions and the Lorentz
  group nothing.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_lorentzContractionLTEightSpan {w : ℕ} (hw0 : 0 < w) (hw : w < 8) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (gaugeLorentzMaps rep repLorentz) (h.massWeightSubmodule w)
      (h.lorentzContractionLTEightSpan w)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.mem_massWeightSubmodule_lt_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff
entries.docstring:
The classification below mass weight eight as an equivalence, in the shape of
  `mem_massWeightSubmodule_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff`: an element of
  `massWeightSubmodule w ⊔ S` for `0 < w < 8` is fixed by both groups exactly when it is an
  element of the surviving span up to a remainder in `S` fixed by both groups.  That span
  is the line through the Higgs mass term at weight four and trivial elsewhere, so at every
  weight but four this says `x = y`, as in the gauge and Yukawa sectors.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmodule_lt_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff (w : ℕ)
    (hw0 : 0 < w) (hw : w < 8) (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hS : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, rep g y ∈ S)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule w ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, rep g x = x)
        ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, rep g y = y)
          ∧ (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y)
          ∧ x - y ∈ h.lorentzContractionLTEightSpan w

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsAlgebraCovRealization.mem_massWeightSubmodule_lt_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_mem
entries.docstring:
The same classification without the existential: below mass weight eight an element of
  `massWeightSubmodule w ⊔ S` fixed by both groups is an element of the surviving span
  joined with `S` fixed by both groups, and conversely.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_massWeightSubmodule_lt_eight_sup_and_gauge_lorentz_invariant_iff_mem (w : ℕ)
    (hw0 : 0 < w) (hw : w < 8) (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hS : ∀ g : GaugeGroupI, ∀ y ∈ S, rep g y ∈ S)
    (hSL : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) (x : B) :
    (x ∈ h.massWeightSubmodule w ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, rep g x = x)
        ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ (x ∈ h.lorentzContractionLTEightSpan w ⊔ S ∧ (∀ g : GaugeGroupI, rep g x = x)
          ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
