entries.snippet:
lemma starHomRealOperator_le_cfcSpectralOperator_of_support_subse
    {V : Set (X)} (hV : IsOpen V)
    (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (X) ℝ)
    (hfV : tsupport f ⊆ V) (hf : ∀ z, f z ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    starHomRealOperator Φ f ≤ starHomSpectralOperator Φ V

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.starHomRealOperator_mul_self
entries.snippet:
lemma starHomRealOperator_mul_self
    (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (X) ℝ) :
    starHomRealOperator Φ (f * f) = starHomRealOperator Φ f * starHomRealOperator Φ f

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.starHomRealOperator_sub_mul_self
entries.snippet:
lemma starHomRealOperator_sub_mul_self
    (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (X) ℝ) :
    starHomRealOperator Φ (f - f * f) =
      starHomRealOperator Φ f - starHomRealOperator Φ f * starHomRealOperator Φ f

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.starHomSpectralOperator_isIdempotent_of_isCompact
entries.snippet:
lemma starHomSpectralOperator_isIdempotent_of_isCompact
    {K : Set (X)} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    IsIdempotentElem (starHomSpectralOperator Φ K)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.starHomSpectralOperatorAux_isIdempotentElem
entries.docstring:
**`E(S)` is idempotent.** For compact `S` this follows from a Urysohn function between `S` and
an open neighbourhood, using `0 ≤ A ≤ 1 ⟹ ‖A x‖² ≤ re ⟪x, A x⟫`; inner regularity extends it to
measurable `S`.
entries.snippet:
lemma starHomSpectralOperatorAux_isIdempotentElem (S : Set (X)) (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
    starHomSpectralOperatorAux Φ S hS * starHomSpectralOperatorAux Φ S hS =
      starHomSpectralOperatorAux Φ S hS

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.starHomSpectralOperator_isIdempotentElem
entries.docstring:
Idempotency of `starHomSpectralOperator` on every set — `0` (hence trivially idempotent) off the
measurable sets, and the order/regularity theorem above on measurable sets.
entries.snippet:
lemma starHomSpectralOperator_isIdempotentElem (S : Set (X)) :
    IsIdempotentElem (starHomSpectralOperator Φ S)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.starHomSpectralOperator_isStarProjection
entries.docstring:
`starHomSpectralOperator Φ S` is a star-projection, for every `S`; both self-adjointness and
idempotency are proved.
entries.snippet:
lemma starHomSpectralOperator_isStarProjection (S : Set (X)) :
    IsStarProjection (starHomSpectralOperator Φ S)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.starHomSpectralMeasure
entries.docstring:
**The weak-operator spectral measure of a bounded normal operator.**  Assembled from the
Riesz-represented, weakly σ-additive family `starHomSpectralOperator` (Steps B–C, fully proved) and
the star-projection property (Step D), including the order/regularity proof of idempotency.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def starHomSpectralMeasure : QuantumMechanics.WOTSpectralMeasure (X) H where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.starHomSpectralMeasure_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma starHomSpectralMeasure_apply (S : Set (X)) :
    starHomSpectralMeasure Φ S = starHomSpectralMeasureFun Φ S

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.starHomSpectralMeasure_scalarMeasure
entries.docstring:
The scalar
  measure attached to `starHomSpectralMeasure` is exactly the polarized Riesz measure it
was built from.
entries.snippet:
lemma starHomSpectralMeasure_scalarMeasure (x y : H) :
    (starHomSpectralMeasure Φ).scalarMeasure x y = polarizedStarHomScalarMeasure Φ x y

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.starHomSpectralMeasure_reconstruction
entries.docstring:
**The spectral measure reconstructs the functional calculus**: integrating a continuous function
`f` gives `f(U)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma starHomSpectralMeasure_reconstruction
    (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (X) ℝ) (x y : H) :
    (starHomSpectralMeasure Φ).complexWeakIntegral (fun z => (f z : ℂ)) x y =
      ⟪y, starHomRealOperator Φ f x⟫_ℂ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.starHomRealOperator_commute
entries.docstring: An operator commuting with the range of `Φ` commutes with `Φ` at every real test function.
entries.snippet:
lemma starHomRealOperator_commute {T : H →L[ℂ] H} (hT : ∀ f : C(X, ℂ), Commute (Φ f) T)
    (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (X) ℝ) :
    Commute (starHomRealOperator Φ f) T

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.starHomScalarMeasure_eq_of_commute_isometry
entries.docstring:
If `T` is an isometry (`star T * T = 1`) commuting with `U` and `star U`, the vector-state
Riesz measure at `T v` agrees with the one at `v`: an isometric intertwiner of `U` leaves the
diagonal spectral measure unchanged.
entries.snippet:
lemma starHomScalarMeasure_eq_of_commute_isometry
    {T : H →L[ℂ] H} (hT : ∀ f : C(X, ℂ), Commute (Φ f) T)
    (hTiso : star T * T = 1) (v : H) :
    starHomScalarMeasure Φ (T v) = starHomScalarMeasure Φ v

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.polarizedStarHomScalarMeasure_eq_of_commute_unitary
entries.docstring:
If `T` is unitary and commutes with `U` and `star U`, the polarized Riesz measure intertwines:
testing at `(T x, y)` matches testing at `(x, star T y)`.  This is the sesquilinear form of the
commutation identity,
  and is exactly what `starHomSpectralOperator_inner` needs to see commutation of
each spectral projection with `T`.
entries.snippet:
lemma polarizedStarHomScalarMeasure_eq_of_commute_unitary
    {T : H →L[ℂ] H} (hT : ∀ f : C(X, ℂ), Commute (Φ f) T)
    (hTunit : T ∈ unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) (x y : H) :
    polarizedStarHomScalarMeasure Φ (T x) y =
      polarizedStarHomScalarMeasure Φ x (star T y)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.starHomSpectralOperator_commute_of_commute_unitary
entries.docstring:
Every spectral operator `starHomSpectralOperator Φ S` commutes with any unitary intertwiner of
`U` (i.e. any unitary commuting with both `U` and `star U`).  Holds for *every* `S`, measurable or
not, since `starHomSpectralOperator_inner` itself needs no measurability hypothesis.
entries.snippet:
lemma starHomSpectralOperator_commute_of_commute_unitary
    {T : H →L[ℂ] H} (hT : ∀ f : C(X, ℂ), Commute (Φ f) T)
    (hTunit : T ∈ unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) (S : Set (X)) :
    starHomSpectralOperator Φ S * T = T * starHomSpectralOperator Φ S

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.starHomSpectralMeasure_commute_of_commute_unitary
entries.docstring:
The weak-operator spectral measure `starHomSpectralMeasure Φ` commutes with any unitary
intertwiner of `U`, at every set (measurable or not).
entries.snippet:
lemma starHomSpectralMeasure_commute_of_commute_unitary
    {T : H →L[ℂ] H} (hT : ∀ f : C(X, ℂ), Commute (Φ f) T)
    (hTunit : T ∈ unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) (S : Set (X)) :
    starHomSpectralMeasure Φ S * ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ofCLM T =
      ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ofCLM T * starHomSpectralMeasure Φ S

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.AlgebraNet
entries.docstring:
A net of unital complex `*`-algebras over the finite regions of a set of sites: the algebra of
each region, and the inclusion of the algebra of a region in that of a larger region.
entries.snippet:
structure AlgebraNet (S : Type*) where
  A : Finset S → Type*
  [ring : ∀ X, Ring (A X)]
  [algebra : ∀ X, Algebra ℂ (A X)]
  [starRing : ∀ X, StarRing (A X)]
  [starModule : ∀ X, StarModule ℂ (A X)]
  incl : ∀ {X Y : Finset S}, X ≤ Y → A X →⋆ₐ[ℂ] A Y
  incl_refl : ∀ (X : Finset S) (a : A X), incl (le_refl X) a = a
  incl_trans : ∀ {X Y Z : Finset S} (h₁ : X ≤ Y) (h₂ : Y ≤ Z) (a : A X),
    incl (h₁.trans h₂) a = incl h₂ (incl h₁ a)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.AlgebraNet.«instance@1d3fcc1f»
entries.snippet: instance : DirectedSystem N.A (fun X Y (h : X ≤ Y) => N.incl h) where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.AlgebraNet.Quasilocal
entries.docstring:
**The quasi-local algebra** of a net: the direct limit of the algebras of the finite
regions.
entries.snippet: abbrev Quasilocal : Type _

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.AlgebraNet.of
entries.docstring:
The embedding of the algebra of a region in the quasi-local algebra, as a unital
`*`-homomorphism.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def of (X : Finset S) : N.A X →⋆ₐ[ℂ] N.Quasilocal where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.AlgebraNet.of_incl
entries.docstring: The embeddings of the local algebras are compatible with the inclusions.
entries.snippet: lemma of_incl {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (a : N.A X) : N.of Y (N.incl h a) = N.of X a

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.AlgebraNet.exists_of
entries.docstring: Every element of the quasi-local algebra is an observable of some finite region.
entries.snippet: lemma exists_of (x : N.Quasilocal) : ∃ (X : Finset S) (a : N.A X), N.of X a = x

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.AlgebraNet.moveHom
entries.docstring:
A map of the quasi-local algebra induced by maps of the local algebras that move regions: a
monotone map `ρ` of regions and, for each region `X`, a unital `*`-homomorphism of its algebra
into that of `ρ X`, natural with respect to the inclusions.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def moveHom (ρ : Finset S → Finset S) (hρ : Monotone ρ)
    (φ : ∀ X, N.A X →⋆ₐ[ℂ] N.A (ρ X))
    (hφ : ∀ {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (a : N.A X), φ Y (N.incl h a) = N.incl (hρ h) (φ X a)) :
    N.Quasilocal →⋆ₐ[ℂ] N.Quasilocal where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.AlgebraNet.moveHom_of
entries.snippet:
lemma moveHom_of (ρ : Finset S → Finset S) (hρ : Monotone ρ) (φ : ∀ X, N.A X →⋆ₐ[ℂ] N.A (ρ X))
    (hφ : ∀ {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (a : N.A X), φ Y (N.incl h a) = N.incl (hρ h) (φ X a))
    (X : Finset S) (a : N.A X) : N.moveHom ρ hρ φ hφ (N.of X a) = N.of (ρ X) (φ X a)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.sumSq
entries.docstring: The sums of squares `∑ s_i* s_i` of a `*`-algebra.
entries.snippet: def sumSq (A : Type*) [Ring A] [StarRing A] : AddSubmonoid A

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.normSq_le
entries.docstring: **The Cauchy–Schwarz inequality for states**: `|ω(a)|² ≤ ω(a* a)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma _root_.ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.normSq_le (ω : AlgState A) (a : A) :
    ((‖ω a‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) ≤ ω (star a * a)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.AlgebraNet.IsLocallyBounded
entries.docstring:
**Local boundedness**: for every local observable `a` some multiple `c · 1` of the identity
exceeds `a* a` by a sum of squares.
entries.snippet: def AlgebraNet.IsLocallyBounded : Prop

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.nonneg_of_mem_sumSq
entries.docstring: A state is nonnegative on sums of squares.
entries.snippet:
lemma _root_.ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.nonneg_of_mem_sumSq
    {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A] [StarRing A] [StarModule ℂ A] (ω : AlgState A)
    {p : A} (hp : p ∈ sumSq A) : 0 ≤ ω p

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.AlgebraNet.norm_sq_le
entries.docstring: **The expectation of a locally bounded observable in any larger region is bounded.**
entries.snippet:
lemma AlgebraNet.norm_sq_le (hb : N.IsLocallyBounded) {X Λ : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Λ)
    (ω : AlgState (N.A Λ)) (a : N.A X) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, ‖ω (N.incl h a)‖ ^ 2 ≤ c ∧ ∀ Λ' (h' : X ≤ Λ') (ω' : AlgState (N.A Λ')),
      ‖ω' (N.incl h' a)‖ ^ 2 ≤ c

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.localSeq
entries.docstring:
The expectation of a local observable `a` of the region `X` in the region `Λ`, zero if `Λ`
does not contain `X`.
entries.snippet: def localSeq (X : Finset S) (a : N.A X) (Λ : Finset S) : ℂ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.localSeq_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma localSeq_eq (X : Finset S) (a : N.A X) {Λ : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Λ) :
    localSeq ω X a Λ = ω Λ (N.incl h a)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.exists_tendsto_localSeq
entries.docstring: The expectations of a local observable have a limit along a fine ultrafilter.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_tendsto_localSeq (hb : N.IsLocallyBounded) (h𝒰 : (𝒰 : Filter (Finset S)) ≤ atTop)
    (X : Finset S) (a : N.A X) : ∃ z, Tendsto (localSeq ω X a) 𝒰 (𝓝 z)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.limitValue
entries.docstring: The limit along the ultrafilter of the expectations of a local observable.
entries.snippet: def limitValue (X : Finset S) (a : N.A X) : ℂ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.tendsto_limitValue
entries.snippet:
lemma tendsto_limitValue (X : Finset S) (a : N.A X) :
    Tendsto (localSeq ω X a) 𝒰 (𝓝 (limitValue ω hb h𝒰 X a))

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.limitFamily
entries.docstring:
**The limit of a net of local states along an ultrafilter** is a compatible family of local
states.
entries.snippet: def limitFamily : LocalStateFamily N where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.limitState
entries.docstring:
**The limit state** of a net of local states along an ultrafilter: a state of the
quasi-local algebra.
entries.snippet: def limitState : AlgState N.Quasilocal

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.limitState_of
entries.docstring: The limit state on a local observable is the limit of the local expectations.
entries.snippet:
lemma limitState_of (X : Finset S) (a : N.A X) :
    Tendsto (fun Λ => localSeq ω X a Λ) 𝒰 (𝓝 (limitState ω hb h𝒰 (N.of X a)))

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.LocalStateFamily
entries.docstring: A compatible family of local states of a net of algebras.
entries.snippet:
structure LocalStateFamily where
  state : ∀ X : Finset S, N.A X →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ
  compat : ∀ {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (a : N.A X), state Y (N.incl h a) = state X a
  map_one : ∀ X, state X 1 = 1
  map_star : ∀ X (a : N.A X), state X (star a) = star (state X a)
  nonneg : ∀ X (a : N.A X), 0 ≤ state X (star a * a)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.LocalStateFamily.lift
entries.docstring: The linear functional on the quasi-local algebra defined by a compatible family.
entries.snippet: def LocalStateFamily.lift (ω : LocalStateFamily N) : N.Quasilocal →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.LocalStateFamily.lift_of
entries.snippet:
lemma LocalStateFamily.lift_of (ω : LocalStateFamily N) (X : Finset S) (a : N.A X) :
    ω.lift (N.of X a) = ω.state X a

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.LocalStateFamily.toAlgState
entries.docstring: **The state of the quasi-local algebra** defined by a compatible family.
entries.snippet: def LocalStateFamily.toAlgState (ω : LocalStateFamily N) : AlgState N.Quasilocal where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuasiLocal.LocalStateFamily.toAlgState_of
entries.docstring: The state of a compatible family on a local observable is the local expectation.
entries.snippet:
lemma LocalStateFamily.toAlgState_of (ω : LocalStateFamily N) (X : Finset S) (a : N.A X) :
    ω.toAlgState (N.of X a) = ω.state X a

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.family
entries.docstring: The operators of a unitary representation of an abelian group, as a commuting ⋆-family.
entries.snippet: def family : CommutingStarFamily H where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.mem_family
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_family (g : Multiplicative G) :
    ((π g : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) : H →L[ℂ] H) ∈ (family π).carrier

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.elem
entries.docstring: The element of the algebra generated by the representation given by `π g`.
entries.snippet: def elem (g : Multiplicative G) : (family π).algebra

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.elem_mul
entries.snippet: lemma elem_mul (g h : Multiplicative G) : elem π (g * h) = elem π g * elem π h

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.elem_one
entries.snippet: lemma elem_one : elem π 1 = 1

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.star_elem
entries.snippet: lemma star_elem (g : Multiplicative G) : star (elem π g) = elem π g⁻¹

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.charValue
entries.docstring: The value at `π g` of a character of the algebra generated by the representation.
entries.snippet: def charValue (ψ : characterSpace ℂ (family π).algebra) (g : Multiplicative G) : ℂ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.norm_charValue
entries.snippet:
lemma norm_charValue (ψ : characterSpace ℂ (family π).algebra) (g : Multiplicative G) :
    ‖charValue π ψ g‖ = 1

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.charValue_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma charValue_mul (ψ : characterSpace ℂ (family π).algebra) (g h : Multiplicative G) :
    charValue π ψ (g * h) = charValue π ψ g * charValue π ψ h

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.charValue_one
entries.snippet: lemma charValue_one (ψ : characterSpace ℂ (family π).algebra) : charValue π ψ 1 = 1

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.continuous_charValue
entries.snippet:
lemma continuous_charValue (g : Multiplicative G) :
    Continuous fun ψ : characterSpace ℂ (family π).algebra => charValue π ψ g

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.dual
entries.docstring:
A character of the algebra generated by the representation restricts to a unitary character
of the group.
entries.snippet: def dual (ψ : characterSpace ℂ (family π).algebra) : PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G) where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.coe_dual
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coe_dual (ψ : characterSpace ℂ (family π).algebra) (g : Multiplicative G) :
    ((dual π ψ g : Circle) : ℂ) = ψ (elem π g)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.continuous_dual
entries.snippet: lemma continuous_dual : Continuous (dual π)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.spectralMeasure
entries.docstring:
The projection-valued measure of a unitary representation of an abelian group, on the
Pontryagin dual of the group.
entries.snippet: def spectralMeasure : WOTSpectralMeasure (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G)) H

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.boundedIntegral_character
entries.docstring:
**Spectral theorem for unitary representations of abelian groups**: every operator `π(g)` of
the representation is the integral of the character `χ ↦ χ(g)` against the projection-valued
measure on the Pontryagin dual.
entries.snippet:
lemma boundedIntegral_character (g : Multiplicative G) :
    ContinuousLinearMapWOT.toCLM
      (WOTSpectralMeasure.boundedIntegral (spectralMeasure π)
        (fun χ : PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G) => ((χ g : Circle) : ℂ))
        (TauCeti.PontryaginDual.continuous_coe_eval_const g).measurable
        ⟨1, fun χ => by simp⟩) = ((π g : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) : H →L[ℂ] H)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.bandOf
entries.docstring: The `k`-th largest eigenvalue of a Hermitian matrix: its `k`-th band.
entries.snippet:
def bandOf {N : ℕ} {M : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ} (hM : M.IsHermitian)
    (k : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin N))) : ℝ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.abs_bandOf_sub_le
entries.docstring:
**Weyl's inequality for bands**: the `k`-th band of two Hermitian matrices differ by at most
the operator norm of the difference.
entries.snippet:
lemma abs_bandOf_sub_le {N : ℕ} {M S : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ} (hM : M.IsHermitian)
    (hS : S.IsHermitian) (k : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin N))) :
    |bandOf hM k - bandOf hS k| ≤
      ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (M - S))‖

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.continuous_bandOf
entries.docstring:
**Bands are continuous**: the `k`-th band of a continuous family of Hermitian matrices is a
continuous function.

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.isSelfAdjoint_blochHom
entries.docstring: The operator of a Hermitian symbol is self-adjoint.
entries.snippet:
lemma isSelfAdjoint_blochHom
    (b : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ))
    (hb : ∀ χ, (b χ).IsHermitian) : IsSelfAdjoint (blochHom π ι hι b)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.exists_band_eq_of_mem_spectrum
entries.docstring:
**Every point of the spectrum of the operator of a Hermitian symbol is a band value**: it is
the `k`-th band `ε_k(χ)` of some crystal momentum `χ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_band_eq_of_mem_spectrum
    (b : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ))
    (hb : ∀ χ, (b χ).IsHermitian) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ spectrum ℂ (blochHom π ι hι b)) :
    ∃ (χ : PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G)) (k : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin N))),
      z = ((bandOf (hb χ) k : ℝ) : ℂ)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.projection
entries.docstring: The spectral projection of a set of characters, as a bounded operator.
entries.snippet: def projection (S : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))) : H →L[ℂ] H

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.projection_isStarProjection
entries.snippet:
lemma projection_isStarProjection (S : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))) :
    IsStarProjection (projection π S)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.projection_eq_zero_of_not_measurable
entries.snippet:
lemma projection_eq_zero_of_not_measurable {S : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))}
    (hS : ¬ MeasurableSet S) : projection π S = 0

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.projection_commute
entries.docstring:
**The commutant is decomposable**: every bounded operator commuting with the representation
commutes with every spectral projection.

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.commute_starProjection_of_mapsTo
entries.docstring:
An operator mapping a closed subspace and its orthogonal complement into themselves commutes
with the orthogonal projection onto the subspace.
entries.snippet:
lemma commute_starProjection_of_mapsTo (W : Submodule ℂ H) [W.HasOrthogonalProjection]
    {T : H →L[ℂ] H} (hW : ∀ v ∈ W, T v ∈ W) (hWo : ∀ v ∈ Wᗮ, T v ∈ Wᗮ) :
    Commute (W.starProjection : H →L[ℂ] H) T

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.inner_unitary_left
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_unitary_left (g : Multiplicative G) (x w : H) :
    ⟪((π g : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) : H →L[ℂ] H) x, w⟫_ℂ =
      ⟪x, ((π g⁻¹ : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) : H →L[ℂ] H) w⟫_ℂ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.mapsTo_projection_of_invariant
entries.docstring:
A closed subspace invariant under the representation is invariant under every spectral
projection.
entries.snippet:
lemma mapsTo_projection_of_invariant (W : Submodule ℂ H) [W.HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (hW : ∀ g, ∀ v ∈ W, ((π g : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) : H →L[ℂ] H) v ∈ W)
    (S : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))) {v : H} (hv : v ∈ W) :
    projection π S v ∈ W

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.mapsTo_of_projection_invariant
entries.docstring:
A closed subspace invariant under every spectral projection is invariant under the
representation.
entries.snippet:
lemma mapsTo_of_projection_invariant (W : Submodule ℂ H) [W.HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (hW : ∀ (S : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))), ∀ v ∈ W, projection π S v ∈ W)
    (g : Multiplicative G) {v : H} (hv : v ∈ W) :
    ((π g : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) : H →L[ℂ] H) v ∈ W

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.toEnd
entries.docstring: The linear action of a unitary representation on its Hilbert space.
entries.snippet: def toEnd : Multiplicative G →* Module.End ℂ H where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.toEnd_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma toEnd_apply (g : Multiplicative G) (v : H) :
    toEnd π g v = ((π g : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) : H →L[ℂ] H) v

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.character_mul_projection_singleton
entries.docstring:
The operator `π(g)` acts on the spectral projection of the single character `χ` as the scalar
`χ(g)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma character_mul_projection_singleton (χ : PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))
    (g : Multiplicative G) :
    ((π g : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) : H →L[ℂ] H) * projection π {χ} =
      ((χ g : Circle) : ℂ) • projection π {χ}

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.ae_eq_of_mem_sector
entries.docstring:
A vector of momentum `χ` is carried by the single character `χ`: its spectral measure is
concentrated at `χ`.

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.projection_singleton_eq_self_of_mem_sector
entries.docstring: **A vector of momentum `χ` lies in the range of the spectral projection of `χ`.**

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.range_projection_singleton
entries.docstring:
**The spectral projection of a single character is the projection onto the sector of
definite momentum**: its range is the subspace of vectors on which the group acts through the
character.
entries.snippet:
lemma range_projection_singleton (χ : PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G)) :
    LinearMap.range (projection π {χ} : H →L[ℂ] H).toLinearMap =
      ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.sector (toEnd π) (fun g => ((χ g : Circle) : ℂ))

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.«instance@03caf83c»
entries.snippet: instance : Nonempty (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.calculus
entries.docstring:
**The functional calculus of a unitary representation**: `f ↦ ∫ f dP` is a unital
⋆-homomorphism from the continuous functions on the Pontryagin dual to the bounded operators.
entries.snippet: def calculus : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.calculus_character
entries.docstring: The functional calculus sends the character `χ ↦ χ(g)` to the operator `π(g)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma calculus_character (g : Multiplicative G) :
    calculus π ⟨fun χ => ((χ g : Circle) : ℂ),
      (TauCeti.PontryaginDual.continuous_coe_eval_const (G := Multiplicative G) g)⟩ =
      ((π g : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) : H →L[ℂ] H)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.calculus_commute
entries.docstring: An operator commuting with the representation commutes with its functional calculus.

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.entry
entries.docstring: The `(i, j)` entry of a continuous matrix-valued function.
entries.snippet:
def entry (f : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)) (i j : Fin N) :
    C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), ℂ)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.calculus_commute_ι
entries.snippet:
lemma calculus_commute_ι (f : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), ℂ))
    (M : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) : calculus π f * ι M = ι M * calculus π f

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.blochOp
entries.docstring: The operator `∑_{ij} (∫ f_{ij} dP) ι(E_{ij})` of a continuous matrix-valued function.
entries.snippet: def blochOp (f : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)) : H →L[ℂ] H

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.entry_add
entries.snippet:
lemma entry_add (f g : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ))
    (i j : Fin N) : entry (f + g) i j = entry f i j + entry g i j

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.entry_smul
entries.snippet:
lemma entry_smul (c : ℂ) (f : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ))
    (i j : Fin N) : entry (c • f) i j = c • entry f i j

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.entry_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma entry_zero (i j : Fin N) :
    entry (0 : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)) i j = 0

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.entry_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma entry_mul (f g : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ))
    (i j : Fin N) : entry (f * g) i j = ∑ k, entry f i k * entry g k j

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.entry_star
entries.snippet:
lemma entry_star (f : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ))
    (i j : Fin N) : entry (star f) i j = star (entry f j i)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.entry_one
entries.snippet:
lemma entry_one (i j : Fin N) :
    entry (1 : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)) i j =
      if i = j then 1 else 0

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.blochOp_add
entries.snippet:
lemma blochOp_add (f g : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)) :
    blochOp π ι (f + g) = blochOp π ι f + blochOp π ι g

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.blochOp_smul
entries.snippet:
lemma blochOp_smul (c : ℂ)
    (f : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)) :
    blochOp π ι (c • f) = c • blochOp π ι f

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.blochOp_one
entries.snippet:
lemma blochOp_one : blochOp π ι (1 : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G),
    Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)) = 1

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.blochOp_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma blochOp_mul (f g : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)) :
    blochOp π ι (f * g) = blochOp π ι f * blochOp π ι g

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.blochOp_star
entries.snippet:
lemma blochOp_star (f : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)) :
    blochOp π ι (star f) = star (blochOp π ι f)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.blochHom
entries.docstring:
**Bloch–Floquet**: the map `f ↦ ∑_{ij} (∫ f_{ij} dP) ι(E_{ij})` is a unital ⋆-homomorphism from
the continuous matrix-valued functions on the Brillouin zone to the bounded operators.
entries.snippet:
def blochHom : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ]
    (H →L[ℂ] H) where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.spectrum_blochHom_subset
entries.docstring:
**The spectrum of the operator of a symbol is contained in the union of the spectra of the
symbol's values**: a translation-invariant operator has no spectrum outside its Bloch bands.
entries.snippet:
lemma spectrum_blochHom_subset
    (b : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)) :
    spectrum ℂ (blochHom π ι hι b) ⊆
      ⋃ χ : PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), spectrum ℂ (b χ)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.HasFullSupport
entries.docstring:
A representation has **full support** relative to the internal space when the spectral
projection of every nonempty open set of crystal momenta is nonzero on every internal state:
every crystal momentum is present in every orbital.
entries.snippet: def HasFullSupport : Prop

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.compress_blochOp
entries.docstring:
Compressing the image of a matrix-valued function to the `(i, j)` orbitals isolates the
`(i, j)` entry.
entries.snippet:
lemma compress_blochOp (f : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ))
    (i j : Fin N) :
    ι (Matrix.single i i 1) * blochOp π ι f * ι (Matrix.single j i 1) =
      calculus π (entry f i j) * ι (Matrix.single i i 1)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.entry_eq_zero_of_blochOp_eq_zero
entries.docstring:
An entry of the image vanishes only if the entry function vanishes: this is the content of
full support.
entries.snippet:
lemma entry_eq_zero_of_blochOp_eq_zero (hfull : HasFullSupport π ι)
    (f : C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ))
    (hf : blochOp π ι f = 0) : f = 0

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.blochHom_injective
entries.docstring: Under full support the map `f ↦ ∫ f dP` is injective.
entries.snippet:
lemma blochHom_injective (hfull : HasFullSupport π ι) :
    Function.Injective (blochHom π ι hι)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.hopping
entries.docstring:
A translation-invariant hopping operator `∑_r π(r) ι(A_r)` with finitely many matrices `A_r`,
the amplitude of hopping by the lattice vector `r` between orbitals.
entries.snippet: def hopping (A : G →₀ Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) : H →L[ℂ] H

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.blochMatrix
entries.docstring:
The Bloch matrix `b(χ) = ∑_r χ(r) A_r` of a hopping operator, a continuous matrix-valued
function on the Brillouin zone.
entries.snippet:
def blochMatrix (A : G →₀ Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) :
    C(PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.blochMatrix_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma blochMatrix_apply (A : G →₀ Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)
    (χ : PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G)) :
    blochMatrix A χ = A.sum fun r M => ((χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd r) : Circle) : ℂ) • M

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.blochHom_blochMatrix
entries.docstring: **The hopping operator is the integral of its Bloch matrix.**
entries.snippet:
lemma blochHom_blochMatrix (A : G →₀ Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) :
    blochHom π ι hι (blochMatrix A) = hopping π ι A

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.spectrum_hopping_subset
entries.docstring:
The spectrum of a finite-range translation-invariant operator is contained in the union of the
spectra of its Bloch matrices.
entries.snippet:
lemma spectrum_hopping_subset (A : G →₀ Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) :
    spectrum ℂ (hopping π ι A) ⊆
      ⋃ χ : PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), spectrum ℂ (blochMatrix A χ)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.symmetrize
entries.docstring:
The Hermitian completion of a family of hopping matrices: the amplitude for hopping by `r` is
`A r` plus the adjoint of the amplitude for hopping back by `-r`.
entries.snippet: def symmetrize (A : G →₀ Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) : G →₀ Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.symmetrize_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma symmetrize_apply (A : G →₀ Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) (r : G) :
    symmetrize A r = A r + (A (-r))ᴴ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.conjTranspose_symmetrize
entries.docstring: A symmetrized family of hopping matrices satisfies `(A r)ᴴ = A (-r)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma conjTranspose_symmetrize (A : G →₀ Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) (r : G) :
    (symmetrize A r)ᴴ = symmetrize A (-r)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.isHermitian_blochMatrix
entries.docstring:
**Hermitian hopping gives Hermitian Bloch matrices.** If `(A r)ᴴ = A (-r)` for every `r`, then
the Bloch matrix `∑_r χ(r) A_r` is Hermitian at every crystal momentum `χ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma isHermitian_blochMatrix (A : G →₀ Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ r, (A r)ᴴ = A (-r)) (χ : PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G)) :
    (blochMatrix A χ).IsHermitian

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.koopmanIsometry
entries.docstring: The composition operator `f ↦ f ∘ T_g⁻¹` on `L²(μ)` as a linear isometry.
entries.snippet: def koopmanIsometry (g : Γ) : Lp E 2 μ →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Lp E 2 μ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.compMeasurePreserving_congr
entries.snippet:
lemma compMeasurePreserving_congr {f f' : X → X} (hf : MeasurePreserving f μ μ)
    (hf' : MeasurePreserving f' μ μ) (e : f = f') (g : Lp E 2 μ) :
    Lp.compMeasurePreserving f hf g = Lp.compMeasurePreserving f' hf' g

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.koopmanIsometry_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma koopmanIsometry_apply (g : Γ) (f : Lp E 2 μ) :
    koopmanIsometry μ T hT g f = Lp.compMeasurePreserving (T g⁻¹) (hT g⁻¹) f

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.koopmanIsometry_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma koopmanIsometry_mul (g h : Γ) (f : Lp E 2 μ) :
    koopmanIsometry μ T hT (g * h) f = koopmanIsometry μ T hT g (koopmanIsometry μ T hT h f)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.koopmanIsometry_one
entries.snippet: lemma koopmanIsometry_one (f : Lp E 2 μ) : koopmanIsometry μ T hT 1 f = f

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.koopmanEquiv
entries.docstring: The Koopman operator as a linear isometric equivalence.
entries.snippet: def koopmanEquiv (g : Γ) : Lp E 2 μ ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Lp E 2 μ where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.koopmanEquiv_one
entries.snippet: lemma koopmanEquiv_one : koopmanEquiv (E := E) μ T hT 1 = 1

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.koopmanEquiv_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma koopmanEquiv_mul (g h : Γ) :
    koopmanEquiv (E := E) μ T hT (g * h) =
      koopmanEquiv (E := E) μ T hT g * koopmanEquiv (E := E) μ T hT h

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.koopman
entries.docstring:
**The Koopman representation**: a group acting on a measure space by measure-preserving
bijections acts unitarily on `L²(μ)` by `(U_g f)(x) = f(g⁻¹ x)`.
entries.snippet: def koopman : Γ →* unitary (Lp E 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp E 2 μ) where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.koopman_apply
entries.docstring: The Koopman operator acts by composition with the inverse of the group action.
entries.snippet:
lemma koopman_apply (g : Γ) (f : Lp E 2 μ) :
    ((koopman μ T hT g : unitary (Lp E 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp E 2 μ)) : Lp E 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp E 2 μ) f =
      Lp.compMeasurePreserving (T g⁻¹) (hT g⁻¹) f

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.inner_koopman
entries.docstring:
**The correlation function of an observable**: the matrix coefficient of the Koopman
representation is the covariance `∫ ⟨f(x), f(g⁻¹ x)⟩ dμ(x)` of `f` with its translate.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_koopman (g : Γ) (f : Lp E 2 μ) :
    ⟪f, ((koopman μ T hT g : unitary (Lp E 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp E 2 μ)) : Lp E 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp E 2 μ) f⟫_ℂ =
      ∫ x, ⟪f x, f (T g⁻¹ x)⟫_ℂ ∂μ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.range_projection_one_koopman
entries.docstring:
**Invariant observables of a classical system have zero momentum**: the spectral projection of
the trivial character of the Koopman representation projects onto the translation-invariant
functions in `L²(μ)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma range_projection_one_koopman :
    LinearMap.range (projection (koopman (E := E) μ T hT)
        {(1 : PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))} : Lp E 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp E 2 μ).toLinearMap =
      ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.sector (toEnd (koopman (E := E) μ T hT)) (fun _ =>
        (1 : ℂ))

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.sector
entries.docstring: The momentum sector of the character `χ`: vectors on which `g` acts as the scalar `χ g`.
entries.snippet: def sector (β : G →* Module.End K V) (χ : G → K) : Submodule K V where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.mem_sector
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_sector {β : G →* Module.End K V} {χ : G → K} {v : V} :
    v ∈ sector β χ ↔ ∀ g, β g v = χ g • v

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.cobound
entries.docstring:
The submodule `span {β g v - χ g • v}` whose quotient is the momentum fiber. It is the
"coboundary" submodule of the twisted action.
entries.snippet: def cobound (β : G →* Module.End K V) (χ : G → K) : Submodule K V

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.sub_smul_mem_cobound
entries.snippet:
lemma sub_smul_mem_cobound (β : G →* Module.End K V) (χ : G → K) (g : G) (v : V) :
    β g v - χ g • v ∈ cobound β χ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.Fiber
entries.docstring: The momentum fiber of the character `χ`: `V` modulo the vectors `β g v - χ g • v`.
entries.snippet: abbrev Fiber (β : G →* Module.End K V) (χ : G → K) : Type _

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.Fiber.mk
entries.docstring: The canonical projection `V → V(χ)`.
entries.snippet: def Fiber.mk (β : G →* Module.End K V) (χ : G → K) : V →ₗ[K] Fiber β χ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.Fiber.mk_action
entries.docstring: In the fiber, `g` acts as the scalar `χ g`.
entries.snippet:
lemma Fiber.mk_action (β : G →* Module.End K V) (χ : G → K) (g : G) (v : V) :
    Fiber.mk β χ (β g v) = χ g • Fiber.mk β χ v

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.IsEquivariant
entries.docstring: A linear map intertwining two actions of the same monoid.
entries.snippet:
def IsEquivariant (β : G →* Module.End K V) (β' : G →* Module.End K W)
    (T : V →ₗ[K] W) : Prop

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.IsEquivariant.mapsTo_sector
entries.docstring: Every equivariant linear map preserves each momentum sector.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsEquivariant.mapsTo_sector (hT : IsEquivariant β β' T) {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ sector β χ) : T v ∈ sector β' χ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.IsEquivariant.sectorMap
entries.docstring: The restriction of an equivariant map to a momentum sector.
entries.snippet:
def IsEquivariant.sectorMap (hT : IsEquivariant β β' T) (χ : G → K) :
    sector β χ →ₗ[K] sector β' χ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.IsEquivariant.coe_sectorMap
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma IsEquivariant.coe_sectorMap (hT : IsEquivariant β β' T) (v : sector β χ) :
    (hT.sectorMap χ v : W) = T v

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.IsEquivariant.cobound_le_comap
entries.docstring:
An equivariant map sends the span defining the fiber of `V` into the span defining the fiber
of `W`.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsEquivariant.cobound_le_comap (hT : IsEquivariant β β' T) (χ : G → K) :
    cobound β χ ≤ (cobound β' χ).comap T

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.IsEquivariant.fiberMap
entries.docstring: Every equivariant linear map induces a well-defined linear map on each momentum fiber.
entries.snippet:
def IsEquivariant.fiberMap (hT : IsEquivariant β β' T) (χ : G → K) :
    Fiber β χ →ₗ[K] Fiber β' χ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.IsEquivariant.fiberMap_mk
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma IsEquivariant.fiberMap_mk (hT : IsEquivariant β β' T) (χ : G → K) (v : V) :
    hT.fiberMap χ (Fiber.mk β χ v) = Fiber.mk β' χ (T v)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.IsEquivariant.fiberMap_comp_mk
entries.docstring: The fiber map is the unique map making the square with the projections commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsEquivariant.fiberMap_comp_mk (hT : IsEquivariant β β' T) (χ : G → K) :
    (hT.fiberMap χ).comp (Fiber.mk β χ) = (Fiber.mk β' χ).comp T

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.isEquivariant_id
entries.snippet: lemma isEquivariant_id (β : G →* Module.End K V) : IsEquivariant β β LinearMap.id

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.IsEquivariant.comp
entries.snippet:
lemma IsEquivariant.comp (hS : IsEquivariant β' β'' S) (hT : IsEquivariant β β' T) :
    IsEquivariant β β'' (S ∘ₗ T)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.fiberMap_id
entries.snippet:
lemma fiberMap_id (χ : G → K) :
    (isEquivariant_id β).fiberMap χ = LinearMap.id

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.IsEquivariant.fiberMap_comp
entries.snippet:
lemma IsEquivariant.fiberMap_comp (hS : IsEquivariant β' β'' S) (hT : IsEquivariant β β' T)
    (χ : G → K) :
    (hS.comp hT).fiberMap χ = (hS.fiberMap χ) ∘ₗ (hT.fiberMap χ)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.IsEquivariant.mapsTo_sector_self
entries.docstring:
Equivariant maps commute with the dynamics they generate: if `D` is an equivariant
endomorphism, it preserves every sector and descends to every fiber. This is the form used for
translation-invariant evolution.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsEquivariant.mapsTo_sector_self {D : V →ₗ[K] V} (hD : IsEquivariant β β D) {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ sector β χ) : D v ∈ sector β χ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.sectorToFiber
entries.docstring: The canonical map from the sector of `χ` to the fiber of `χ`.
entries.snippet:
def sectorToFiber (β : G →* Module.End K V) (χ : G → K) :
    sector β χ →ₗ[K] Fiber β χ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.Representation.IsEquivariant.fiberMap_comp_sectorToFiber
entries.docstring: The canonical map from sector to fiber is natural for equivariant maps.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsEquivariant.fiberMap_comp_sectorToFiber (hT : IsEquivariant β β' T) (χ : G → K) :
    (hT.fiberMap χ).comp (sectorToFiber β χ)
      = (sectorToFiber β' χ).comp (hT.sectorMap χ)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.rationalCircle
entries.docstring: The injection of `ℚ/ℤ` into the circle, `q ↦ e^{2πi q}`.
entries.snippet: def rationalCircle : AddCircle (1 : ℚ) →+ Additive Circle

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.rationalCircle_eq_zero
entries.snippet: lemma rationalCircle_eq_zero {x : AddCircle (1 : ℚ)} (h : rationalCircle x = 0) : x = 0

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.exists_character_apply_ne_one
entries.docstring: **Characters separate the points of a discrete abelian group.**
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_character_apply_ne_one [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G] {g : G}
    (hg : g ≠ 0) : ∃ χ : PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G), χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd g) ≠ 1

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.dualHaar
entries.docstring: The normalized Haar measure of the compact dual group.
entries.snippet: def dualHaar : Measure (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.«instance@11211cdc»
entries.snippet: instance : (dualHaar (G := G)).IsHaarMeasure

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.«instance@04d02e60»
entries.snippet: instance : IsProbabilityMeasure (dualHaar (G := G))

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.integral_character_dualHaar
entries.docstring:
**Orthogonality of characters**: the evaluation characters are orthonormal for the Haar
probability measure of the dual group.
entries.snippet:
lemma integral_character_dualHaar (g : G) :
    ∫ χ, ((χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd g) : Circle) : ℂ) ∂(dualHaar (G := G)) =
      if g = 0 then 1 else 0

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.autCont
entries.docstring: The automorphism `φ p` of the translation group as a continuous homomorphism.
entries.snippet: def autCont (p : P) : Multiplicative G →ₜ* Multiplicative G where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.dualAct
entries.docstring: The action of `p` on a character `χ`: `(p • χ)(g) = χ(φ(p⁻¹) g)`.
entries.snippet: def dualAct (p : P) : PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G) →ₜ* PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.dualAct_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma dualAct_apply (p : P) (χ : PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G)) (g : Multiplicative G) :
    dualAct φ p χ g = χ (φ p⁻¹ g)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.dualAct_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma dualAct_mul (p q : P) (χ : PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G)) :
    dualAct φ (p * q) χ = dualAct φ p (dualAct φ q χ)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.dualAct_one
entries.snippet: lemma dualAct_one (χ : PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G)) : dualAct φ 1 χ = χ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.dualActEquiv
entries.docstring: The action of `p` on the characters is a bijection.
entries.snippet:
def dualActEquiv (p : P) :
    PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G) ≃ PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G) where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.IsCovariantRep
entries.docstring:
The representation `ρ` of `P` is covariant with respect to the translations `π` and the
action `φ`: `ρ(p) π(g) = π(φ(p) g) ρ(p)`.
entries.snippet: def IsCovariantRep : Prop

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.measurable_dualAct
entries.snippet: lemma measurable_dualAct (p : P) : Measurable (dualAct φ p)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.isCovariantRep_comp
entries.docstring:
A representation of a group `Q` acting on the translations, restricted to the translations,
is covariant when the group relation `s t(a) = t(φ(s) a) s` holds.
entries.snippet:
lemma isCovariantRep_comp {Q : Type*} [Group Q] (φ : Q →* MulAut (Multiplicative G))
    (U : Q →* unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) (τ : Multiplicative G →* Q)
    (h : ∀ (s : Q) (a : Multiplicative G), s * τ a = τ (φ s a) * s) :
    IsCovariantRep φ (U.comp τ) U

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.inner_rho_translation
entries.docstring: The matrix coefficient of the translated vector.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_rho_translation (hcov : IsCovariantRep φ π ρ) (p : P) (g : Multiplicative G)
    (ξ : H) :
    ⟪((ρ p : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ,
        ((π g : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) : H →L[ℂ] H) (((ρ p : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)⟫_ℂ
      = ⟪ξ, ((π (φ p⁻¹ g) : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ⟫_ℂ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.vectorMeasure_rho
entries.docstring:
**The spectral measure of `ρ(p) ξ` is the pushforward of that of `ξ`** under the action of `p`
on the characters.
entries.snippet:
lemma vectorMeasure_rho (hcov : IsCovariantRep φ π ρ) (p : P) (ξ : H) :
    vectorMeasure π (((ρ p : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) =
      Measure.map (dualAct φ p) (vectorMeasure π ξ)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.norm_sq_projection
entries.snippet:
lemma norm_sq_projection (S : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))) (hS : MeasurableSet S)
    (η : H) : ‖projection π S η‖ ^ 2 = (vectorMeasure π η S).toReal

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.inner_projection_self
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_projection_self (S : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))) (η : H) :
    ⟪projection π S η, η⟫_ℂ = ((‖projection π S η‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.rho_mul_projection
entries.docstring:
**The spectral projections are covariant**: `ρ(p) P(S) = P(p • S) ρ(p)` for every measurable
set `S` of characters. The unitary `ρ(p)` carries the sector of momenta in `S` onto the sector of
momenta in `p • S`.
entries.snippet:
lemma rho_mul_projection (hcov : IsCovariantRep φ π ρ) (p : P)
    {S : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))} (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
    ((ρ p : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) : H →L[ℂ] H) * projection π S =
      projection π (dualAct φ p '' S) * ((ρ p : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) : H →L[ℂ] H)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.sector
entries.docstring:
The sector of a set of characters: the vectors of total momentum in the set, the range of the
spectral projection.
entries.snippet: def sector (S : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))) : Submodule ℂ H

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.mem_sector_iff
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_sector_iff (S : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))) (x : H) :
    x ∈ sector π S ↔ ∃ y, projection π S y = x

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.dualAct_image_image
entries.snippet:
lemma dualAct_image_image (p : P) (S : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))) :
    dualAct φ p⁻¹ '' (dualAct φ p '' S) = S

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.measurableSet_dualAct_image
entries.snippet:
lemma measurableSet_dualAct_image (p : P) {S : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))}
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) : MeasurableSet (dualAct φ p '' S)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.rho_inv_rho
entries.snippet: lemma rho_inv_rho (p : P) (x : H) : (𝓡 p⁻¹) ((𝓡 p) x) = x

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.rho_rho_inv
entries.snippet: lemma rho_rho_inv (p : P) (x : H) : (𝓡 p) ((𝓡 p⁻¹) x) = x

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.norm_rho
entries.snippet: lemma norm_rho (p : P) (x : H) : ‖(𝓡 p) x‖ = ‖x‖

ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.rho_mem_sector
ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.rho_inv_mem_sector
ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.sectorEquiv
entries.docstring:
**The equivalence of sectors**: `ρ(p)` is an isometric equivalence of the sector of `S` onto
the sector of `p • S`.
entries.snippet:
def sectorEquiv (p : P) {S : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))} (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
    sector π S ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] sector π (dualAct φ p '' S) where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.coe_sectorEquiv
ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.sectorOp
entries.docstring: An operator commuting with the translations restricts to each sector.
entries.snippet:
def sectorOp (hT : ∀ g, Commute ((π g : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) : H →L[ℂ] H) T)
    (S : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))) : Module.End ℂ (sector π S)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.coe_sectorOp
entries.snippet:
lemma coe_sectorOp (hT : ∀ g, Commute ((π g : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) : H →L[ℂ] H) T)
    (S : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))) (x : sector π S) :
    ((sectorOp hT S x : sector π S) : H) = T x.1

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.sectorEquiv_sectorOp
entries.docstring: **The equivalence of sectors intertwines the restrictions of an invariant operator.**
entries.snippet:
lemma sectorEquiv_sectorOp (p : P) {S : Set (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))}
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) (x : sector π S) :
    sectorEquiv hcov p hS (sectorOp hTπ S x) = sectorOp hTπ (dualAct φ p '' S)
      (sectorEquiv hcov p hS x)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.spectrum_sectorOp_eq
entries.docstring:
**Symmetry reduction.** The spectrum of an operator invariant under the translations and the
covariant point group, restricted to the sector of the characters in `S`, is its spectrum on the
sector of the characters in `p • S`.

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.StructureFactor.correlation
entries.docstring: The correlation function `g ↦ ω(a⋆ α_g(a))` of an observable `a`.
entries.snippet: def correlation (a : B) (g : G) : ℂ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.StructureFactor.isPositiveDefiniteSub_correlation
entries.docstring: **The correlation function of an invariant positive functional is positive definite.**
entries.snippet:
lemma isPositiveDefiniteSub_correlation (hpos : ∀ b : B, 0 ≤ ω (star b * b))
    (hinv : ∀ g b, ω (α g b) = ω b) (a : B) :
    TauCeti.IsPositiveDefiniteSub (correlation ω α a)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.StructureFactor.exists_measure
entries.docstring:
**The structure factor exists.** The correlation function of an observable in an invariant
positive functional is the Fourier transform of a finite positive measure on the momenta:
`ω(a⋆ α_g(a)) = ∫ χ(g) dμ_a(χ)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_measure (hpos : ∀ b : B, 0 ≤ ω (star b * b)) (hinv : ∀ g b, ω (α g b) = ω b)
    (a : B) :
    ∃ μ : Measure (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G)), IsFiniteMeasure μ ∧ μ.InnerRegular ∧
      ∀ g : G, ∫ χ, ((χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd g) : Circle) : ℂ) ∂μ = correlation ω α a g

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.StructureFactor.integral_one_eq
entries.docstring: The total mass of the structure factor is the expectation of `a⋆ a`.
entries.snippet:
lemma integral_one_eq {μ : Measure (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))}
    (a : B) (h : ∀ g : G, ∫ χ, ((χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd g) : Circle) : ℂ) ∂μ =
      correlation ω α a g) :
    (μ.real univ : ℂ) = ω (star a * a)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.StructureFactor.eq_of_transform_eq
entries.docstring:
**The structure factor is unique.** For a countable group a finite measure on the momenta is
determined by its Fourier transform.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_of_transform_eq {μ ν : Measure (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (h : ∀ g : G, ∫ χ, ((χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd g) : Circle) : ℂ) ∂μ =
      ∫ χ, ((χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd g) : Circle) : ℂ) ∂ν) : μ = ν

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.StructureFactor.isPositiveDefiniteSub_iff_exists_measure
entries.docstring:
**Positive semidefinite translation-invariant couplings are Fourier transforms of positive
measures.** A coupling `J(r)` depending only on the displacement `r` is positive semidefinite, in
the sense that every finite quadratic form `∑ c_i c̄_j J(r_i - r_j)` is nonnegative, if and only if
it is the Fourier transform of a finite positive measure on the momenta, whose density is the
dispersion of the coupling.
entries.snippet:
lemma isPositiveDefiniteSub_iff_exists_measure (J : G → ℂ) :
    TauCeti.IsPositiveDefiniteSub J ↔
      ∃ μ : Measure (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G)), IsFiniteMeasure μ ∧ μ.InnerRegular ∧
        ∀ r : G, J r = ∫ χ, ((χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd r) : Circle) : ℂ) ∂μ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.vectorMeasure
entries.docstring:
The spectral measure `S ↦ ‖P(S) ξ‖²` of a vector `ξ`, a finite measure on the Pontryagin dual:
the distribution of `ξ` over the characters of the group.
entries.snippet: def vectorMeasure (ξ : H) : Measure (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G))

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.«instance@43204425»
entries.snippet: instance (ξ : H) : IsFiniteMeasure (vectorMeasure π ξ)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.vectorMeasure_apply
ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.vectorMeasure_univ
entries.docstring: The total mass of the spectral measure of a vector is its squared norm.
entries.snippet: lemma vectorMeasure_univ (ξ : H) : vectorMeasure π ξ univ = ENNReal.ofReal (‖ξ‖ ^ 2)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.vectorMeasure_eq_map
entries.docstring: The vector measure is the pushforward of the Riesz measure of the vector state.
entries.snippet:
lemma vectorMeasure_eq_map (ξ : H) :
    vectorMeasure π ξ = Measure.map (dual π) (starHomScalarMeasure (family π).starHom ξ)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.inner_eq_integral_vectorMeasure
entries.docstring:
**The spectral measure of a vector represents its matrix coefficients**:
`⟪ξ, π(g) ξ⟫ = ∫ χ(g) dμ_ξ(χ)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_eq_integral_vectorMeasure (ξ : H) (g : Multiplicative G) :
    ⟪ξ, ((π g : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ⟫_ℂ =
      ∫ χ, ((χ g : Circle) : ℂ) ∂vectorMeasure π ξ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.QuantumMechanics.UnitaryRep.eq_vectorMeasure_of_transform_eq
entries.docstring:
**Uniqueness of the spectral measure of a vector.** For a countable group, a finite measure on
the Pontryagin dual whose Fourier–Stieltjes transform is `g ↦ ⟪ξ, π(g) ξ⟫` is the spectral
measure of `ξ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_vectorMeasure_of_transform_eq (ξ : H) (μ : Measure (PontryaginDual (Multiplicative G)))
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (h : ∀ g : Multiplicative G, ∫ χ, ((χ g : Circle) : ℂ) ∂μ =
      ⟪ξ, ((π g : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ⟫_ℂ) :
    μ = vectorMeasure π ξ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.complexExtension
entries.docstring:
The complex-linear extension of an expectation value on self-adjoint operators to all
operators: `⟨a⟩ = ⟨ℜ a⟩ + i ⟨ℑ a⟩`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def complexExtension (φ : selfAdjoint A →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) : A →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.complexExtension_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma complexExtension_apply (φ : selfAdjoint A →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (a : A) :
    complexExtension φ a = φ (ℜ a) + Complex.I * φ (ℑ a)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.complexExtension_coe
entries.docstring: On self-adjoint operators the extension is the original expectation value.
entries.snippet:
lemma complexExtension_coe (φ : selfAdjoint A →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (a : selfAdjoint A) :
    complexExtension φ (a : A) = φ a

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.complexExtension_star
entries.docstring: The expectation value of the adjoint is the complex conjugate of the expectation value.
entries.snippet:
lemma complexExtension_star (φ : selfAdjoint A →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (a : A) :
    complexExtension φ (star a) = starRingEnd ℂ (complexExtension φ a)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.realPart_linearMap
entries.docstring:
A complex-linear map commuting with the adjoint maps the real part of an operator to the real
part of its image.
entries.snippet:
lemma realPart_linearMap (f : C →ₗ[ℂ] D) (hf : ∀ a, f (star a) = star (f a)) (a : C) :
    ((ℜ (f a) : selfAdjoint D) : D) = f (ℜ a : C)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.imaginaryPart_linearMap
entries.docstring:
A complex-linear map commuting with the adjoint maps the imaginary part of an operator to the
imaginary part of its image.
entries.snippet:
lemma imaginaryPart_linearMap (f : C →ₗ[ℂ] D) (hf : ∀ a, f (star a) = star (f a)) (a : C) :
    ((ℑ (f a) : selfAdjoint D) : D) = f (ℑ a : C)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.fluctuationMap
entries.docstring: The fluctuation `a - ω(a)` of an element, as a linear map.
entries.snippet: def fluctuationMap : A →ₗ[ℂ] A where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.fluctuationMap_apply
entries.snippet: lemma fluctuationMap_apply (a : A) : ω.fluctuationMap a = a - ω a • 1

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covarianceForm
entries.docstring:
The covariance form `C(a, b) = ω(a⋆ b) - conj (ω a) ω(b)`, the inner product of the
fluctuations in the pre-Hilbert space of the state.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def covarianceForm (a b : A) : ℂ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covarianceForm_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma covarianceForm_apply (a b : A) :
    ω.covarianceForm a b = ω (star a * b) - star (ω a) * ω b

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covarianceForm_smul_left
entries.snippet:
lemma covarianceForm_smul_left (c : ℂ) (a b : A) :
    ω.covarianceForm (c • a) b = star c * ω.covarianceForm a b

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covarianceForm_smul_right
entries.snippet:
lemma covarianceForm_smul_right (c : ℂ) (a b : A) :
    ω.covarianceForm a (c • b) = c * ω.covarianceForm a b

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covarianceForm_sum_left
entries.snippet:
lemma covarianceForm_sum_left {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → A) (b : A) :
    ω.covarianceForm (∑ i ∈ s, a i) b = ∑ i ∈ s, ω.covarianceForm (a i) b

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covarianceForm_sum_right
entries.snippet:
lemma covarianceForm_sum_right {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a : A) (b : ι → A) :
    ω.covarianceForm a (∑ i ∈ s, b i) = ∑ i ∈ s, ω.covarianceForm a (b i)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covarianceForm_selfAdjoint
entries.docstring: For observables, `C(a, b) = Cov(a, b) + i ω⟨⁅a, b⁆⟩`.
entries.snippet:
lemma covarianceForm_selfAdjoint (a b : selfAdjoint A) :
    ω.covarianceForm a b = ω.covariance a b + Complex.I * ω.bracket a b

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covarianceForm_map
entries.docstring: **A symmetry of the state preserves the covariance form**: `C(σ a, σ b) = C(a, b)`.
entries.snippet: lemma covarianceForm_map (a b : A) : ω.covarianceForm (σ a) (σ b) = ω.covarianceForm a b

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covarianceForm_eq_zero_of_smul
entries.docstring:
Elements multiplied by `χ` and `χ'` under a symmetry, with `conj χ · χ' ≠ 1`, have
covariance zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma covarianceForm_eq_zero_of_smul {a b : A} {χ χ' : ℂ} (ha : σ a = χ • a) (hb : σ b = χ' • b)
    (h : star χ * χ' ≠ 1) : ω.covarianceForm a b = 0

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covarianceForm_eq_zero_of_neg
entries.docstring: **An even and an odd element have covariance zero.**
entries.snippet:
lemma covarianceForm_eq_zero_of_neg {a b : A} (ha : σ a = a) (hb : σ b = -b) :
    ω.covarianceForm a b = 0

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covarianceForm_eq_zero_of_character
entries.docstring:
**Elements transforming with different unitary characters have covariance zero.** If
`α g a = χ g • a` and `α g b = χ' g • b` with `|χ g| = 1` and `χ ≠ χ'`, then `C(a, b) = 0`.
entries.snippet:
lemma covarianceForm_eq_zero_of_character {a b : A} {χ χ' : Γ → ℂ} (hχ : ∀ g, ‖χ g‖ = 1)
    (ha : ∀ g, α g a = χ g • a) (hb : ∀ g, α g b = χ' g • b) (hne : χ ≠ χ') :
    ω.covarianceForm a b = 0

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covarianceMatrixForm
entries.docstring: The matrix `M_ik = C(a_i, b_k)` of covariances of two families.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def covarianceMatrixForm (a : ι → A) (b : κ → A) : Matrix ι κ ℂ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.posSemidef_covarianceMatrixForm
entries.docstring: **The matrix of covariances of a family is positive semidefinite**, being a Gram matrix.
entries.snippet: lemma posSemidef_covarianceMatrixForm (a : ι → A) : (ω.covarianceMatrixForm a a).PosSemidef

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.conjTranspose_mul_covarianceMatrixForm_mul
entries.docstring:
**A symmetry of the state preserves the matrix of covariances**: if `σ` acts on the two
families by the matrices `R` and `S`, then `Rᴴ M S = M`.
entries.snippet:
lemma conjTranspose_mul_covarianceMatrixForm_mul (σ : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A) (hω : ∀ x, ω (σ x) = ω x)
    {a : ι → A} {b : κ → A} {R : Matrix ι ι ℂ} {S : Matrix κ κ ℂ}
    (ha : ∀ i, σ (a i) = ∑ j, R j i • a j) (hb : ∀ k, σ (b k) = ∑ l, S l k • b l) :
    Rᴴ * ω.covarianceMatrixForm a b * S = ω.covarianceMatrixForm a b

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covarianceMatrixForm_isIntertwining
entries.docstring:
If `α` acts on the families `a` and `b` by `ρ` and `π`, with `ρ` unitary, then the matrix of
covariances intertwines `π` with `ρ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma covarianceMatrixForm_isIntertwining {a : ι → A} {b : κ → A}
    (hρ : ∀ g, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g) ∈ unitaryGroup ι ℂ)
    (ha : ∀ g i, α g (a i) = ∑ j, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g) j i • a j)
    (hb : ∀ g k, α g (b k) = ∑ l, LinearMap.toMatrix' (π g) l k • b l) (g : Γ) :
    toLin' (ω.covarianceMatrixForm a b) ∘ₗ π g =
      ρ g ∘ₗ toLin' (ω.covarianceMatrixForm a b)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covarianceMatrixForm_eq_zero_of_irreducible
entries.docstring:
**Schur's lemma for covariances.** If a group of symmetries of the state acts on the family
`a` by the irreducible unitary representation `ρ` and on the family `b` by the irreducible
representation `π`, and `π` and `ρ` are not equivalent, then `C(a_i, b_k) = 0` for all `i, k`.
entries.snippet:
lemma covarianceMatrixForm_eq_zero_of_irreducible [ρ.IsIrreducible] [π.IsIrreducible]
    [IsEmpty (π.Equiv ρ)] {a : ι → A} {b : κ → A}
    (hρ : ∀ g, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g) ∈ unitaryGroup ι ℂ)
    (ha : ∀ g i, α g (a i) = ∑ j, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g) j i • a j)
    (hb : ∀ g k, α g (b k) = ∑ l, LinearMap.toMatrix' (π g) l k • b l) :
    ω.covarianceMatrixForm a b = 0

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.apply_nonneg
entries.docstring: On a star-ordered ring a state is nonnegative on every nonnegative element.
entries.snippet: lemma apply_nonneg {a : A} (ha : 0 ≤ a) : 0 ≤ ω a

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.star_dotProduct_covarianceMatrixForm_mulVec
entries.docstring:
The quadratic form of the matrix of covariances at `c` is the covariance form of `∑ cⱼ aⱼ`
with itself.
entries.snippet:
lemma star_dotProduct_covarianceMatrixForm_mulVec {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (ω : AlgState A)
    (a : ι → A) (c : ι → ℂ) :
    star c ⬝ᵥ (ω.covarianceMatrixForm a a *ᵥ c) =
      ω.covarianceForm (∑ j, c j • a j) (∑ j, c j • a j)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covarianceForm_sub_covarianceForm_map
entries.docstring:
Pulling the observable through `Φ` and pushing the state differ by the value of `ω` on
`Φ(X⋆ X) - Φ(X)⋆ Φ(X)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma covarianceForm_sub_covarianceForm_map (hω' : ∀ x, ω' x = ω (Φ x)) (X : A) :
    ω'.covarianceForm X X - ω.covarianceForm (Φ X) (Φ X) =
      ω (Φ (star X * X) - star (Φ X) * Φ X)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covarianceForm_map_le
entries.docstring:
**A Schwarz inequality for `Φ` bounds the covariance form**: if
`Φ(X)⋆ Φ(X) ≤ Φ(X⋆ X)`, then `C_ω(Φ X, Φ X) ≤ C_ω'(X, X)`.

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covarianceMatrixForm_map_le
entries.docstring:
**Maps satisfying the Schwarz inequality do not decrease the matrix of covariances.** The
hypothesis holds for completely positive unital maps.
entries.snippet:
lemma covarianceMatrixForm_map_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (hω' : ∀ x, ω' x = ω (Φ x))
    (hΦ : ∀ X, star (Φ X) * Φ X ≤ Φ (star X * X)) (a : ι → A) (c : ι → ℂ) :
    star c ⬝ᵥ (ω.covarianceMatrixForm (Φ ∘ a) (Φ ∘ a) *ᵥ c) ≤
      star c ⬝ᵥ (ω'.covarianceMatrixForm a a *ᵥ c)

entries.name: Matrix.sq_sum_le_sum_sq
entries.docstring: With positive `Qₖ` summing to `1`, `(∑ λₖ Qₖ)² ≤ ∑ λₖ² Qₖ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sq_sum_le_sum_sq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (Q : ι → Matrix m m ℂ)
    (hQ : ∀ k, (Q k).PosSemidef) (h1 : ∑ k, Q k = 1) (c : ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ k, (c k : ℂ) • Q k) * ∑ k, (c k : ℂ) • Q k ≤ ∑ k, ((c k : ℂ) * c k) • Q k

entries.name: Matrix.kadison
entries.docstring:
**Kadison's inequality**: for a positive unital map and Hermitian `A`,
`Φ(A)² ≤ Φ(A²)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma kadison (Φ : Matrix n n ℂ →ₚ₁[ℂ] Matrix m m ℂ) {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) : (Φ A)ᴴ * Φ A ≤ Φ (Aᴴ * A)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covarianceForm_map_le_of_positive
entries.docstring: **Positive unital maps do not decrease the covariance form of Hermitian matrices.**
entries.snippet:
lemma covarianceForm_map_le_of_positive (hω' : ∀ x, ω' x = ω (Φ x)) {X : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hX : X.IsHermitian) : ω.covarianceForm (Φ X) (Φ X) ≤ ω'.covarianceForm X X

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covarianceMatrixForm_map_le_of_positive
entries.docstring:
**Positive unital maps do not decrease the matrix of covariances** of Hermitian matrices at
real coefficients.
entries.snippet:
lemma covarianceMatrixForm_map_le_of_positive {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (hω' : ∀ x, ω' x = ω (Φ x)) {a : ι → Matrix n n ℂ} (ha : ∀ i, (a i).IsHermitian)
    (c : ι → ℝ) :
    star (fun i => (c i : ℂ)) ⬝ᵥ (ω.covarianceMatrixForm (Φ ∘ a) (Φ ∘ a) *ᵥ fun i => (c i : ℂ)) ≤
      star (fun i => (c i : ℂ)) ⬝ᵥ (ω'.covarianceMatrixForm a a *ᵥ fun i => (c i : ℂ))

entries.name: Matrix.stateZero
entries.docstring: The state `X ↦ X₀₀` of `2 × 2` matrices, the vector state of `|0⟩`.
entries.snippet: def stateZero : ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) where

entries.name: Matrix.stateZero_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma stateZero_apply (X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : stateZero X = X 0 0

entries.name: Matrix.transposeMap
entries.docstring: The transpose of `2 × 2` matrices.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def transposeMap : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ →ₚ₁[ℂ] Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ

entries.name: Matrix.transposeMap_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma transposeMap_apply (X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : transposeMap X = Xᵀ

entries.name: Matrix.stateZero_transposeMap
entries.docstring: The state `X ↦ X₀₀` is unchanged by the transpose.
entries.snippet:
lemma stateZero_transposeMap (X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    stateZero X = stateZero (transposeMap X)

entries.name: Matrix.transposeMap_gap
entries.docstring:
**The transpose is positive and unital, but the bound fails for `E₀₁`**: for positive maps
it holds only on Hermitian matrices.
entries.snippet:
lemma transposeMap_gap :
    ¬ stateZero.covarianceForm (transposeMap (single 0 1 1)) (transposeMap (single 0 1 1)) ≤
      stateZero.covarianceForm (single 0 1 1) (single 0 1 1)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState
entries.docstring:
A state on a unital complex `*`-algebra: a normalized, Hermitian, positive linear
functional.
entries.snippet:
structure AlgState (A : Type*) [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A] [StarRing A] [StarModule ℂ A] where
  toLinearMap : A →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ
  map_one' : toLinearMap 1 = 1
  map_star' : ∀ a, toLinearMap (star a) = star (toLinearMap a)
  nonneg' : ∀ a, 0 ≤ toLinearMap (star a * a)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.«instance@628abb26»
entries.snippet: instance : FunLike (AlgState A) A ℂ where
