entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.inner_pre
entries.snippet: lemma inner_pre (a b : ω.PreGNS) : ⟪a, b⟫_ℂ = ω (star (ω.ofPre a) * ω.ofPre b)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.GNS
entries.docstring:
The **GNS Hilbert space** of a state: the completion of the algebra for the inner product
`⟨a, b⟩ = ω (a* b)`.
entries.snippet: abbrev GNS : Type _

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.preAut
entries.docstring: The map `[a] ↦ [σ a]` on the pre-Hilbert space.
entries.snippet: def preAut : ω.PreGNS →ₗ[ℂ] ω.PreGNS

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.ofPre_preAut
entries.snippet: lemma ofPre_preAut (x : ω.PreGNS) : ω.ofPre (preAut ω σ x) = σ (ω.ofPre x)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.inner_preAut
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_preAut (hσ : ∀ a, ω (σ a) = ω a) (x y : ω.PreGNS) :
    ⟪preAut ω σ x, preAut ω σ y⟫_ℂ = ⟪x, y⟫_ℂ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.norm_preAut
entries.snippet: lemma norm_preAut (hσ : ∀ a, ω (σ a) = ω a) (x : ω.PreGNS) : ‖preAut ω σ x‖ = ‖x‖

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.preAutCLM
entries.docstring: The automorphism as a bounded operator on the pre-Hilbert space.
entries.snippet: def preAutCLM (hσ : ∀ a, ω (σ a) = ω a) : ω.PreGNS →L[ℂ] ω.PreGNS

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.gnsAut
entries.docstring: **The operator on the GNS space implementing a state preserving automorphism.**
entries.snippet: def gnsAut (hσ : ∀ a, ω (σ a) = ω a) : ω.GNS →L[ℂ] ω.GNS

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.gnsAut_coe
entries.snippet:
lemma gnsAut_coe (hσ : ∀ a, ω (σ a) = ω a) (x : ω.PreGNS) :
    gnsAut σ hσ (x : ω.GNS) = ((preAut ω σ x : ω.PreGNS) : ω.GNS)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.inner_gnsAut
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_gnsAut (hσ : ∀ a, ω (σ a) = ω a) (x y : ω.GNS) :
    ⟪gnsAut σ hσ x, gnsAut σ hσ y⟫_ℂ = ⟪x, y⟫_ℂ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.gnsAut_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma gnsAut_mul (g h : Γ) :
    gnsAut (α (g * h)) (hα (g * h)) = gnsAut (α g) (hα g) * gnsAut (α h) (hα h)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.gnsAut_one
entries.snippet: lemma gnsAut_one : gnsAut (α 1) (hα 1) = 1

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.star_gnsAut_mul_gnsAut
entries.snippet:
lemma star_gnsAut_mul_gnsAut (g : Γ) :
    star (gnsAut (α g) (hα g)) * gnsAut (α g) (hα g) = 1

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.star_gnsAut
entries.snippet: lemma star_gnsAut (g : Γ) : star (gnsAut (α g) (hα g)) = gnsAut (α g⁻¹) (hα g⁻¹)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.gnsUnitary
entries.docstring: **The unitary operator on the GNS space implementing a symmetry** of the state.
entries.snippet: def gnsUnitary (g : Γ) : unitary (ω.GNS →L[ℂ] ω.GNS)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.gnsRep
entries.docstring:
**The unitary representation of a group of symmetries on the GNS space of an invariant
state.**
entries.snippet: def gnsRep : Γ →* unitary (ω.GNS →L[ℂ] ω.GNS) where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.cyclicVector
entries.docstring: The cyclic vector: the class of the unit.
entries.snippet: def cyclicVector : ω.GNS

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.gnsAut_comp
entries.docstring: The operator implementing a composite of automorphisms is the composite of the operators.
entries.snippet:
lemma gnsAut_comp :
    gnsAut (σ * τ) (fun a => by rw [StarAlgEquiv.mul_apply, hσ, hτ]) =
      gnsAut σ hσ * gnsAut τ hτ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.gnsAut_congr
entries.docstring: Equal automorphisms are implemented by equal operators.
entries.snippet:
lemma gnsAut_congr {σ τ : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A} (h : σ = τ) (hσ : ∀ a, ω (σ a) = ω a)
    (hτ : ∀ a, ω (τ a) = ω a) : gnsAut σ hσ = gnsAut τ hτ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.gnsAut_commute
entries.docstring: Commuting automorphisms are implemented by commuting operators.
entries.snippet:
lemma gnsAut_commute {σ τ : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A} (hσ : ∀ a, ω (σ a) = ω a) (hτ : ∀ a, ω (τ a) = ω a)
    (h : σ * τ = τ * σ) : Commute (gnsAut σ hσ) (gnsAut τ hτ)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.IsBounded
entries.docstring:
An observable `a` is **bounded** if some multiple `c · 1` of the identity exceeds `a* a` by a
sum of squares.
entries.snippet: def IsBounded (a : A) : Prop

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.norm_sq_le_of_isBounded
entries.docstring: **Every state is bounded on a bounded observable**, by the same constant.
entries.snippet:
lemma AlgState.norm_sq_le_of_isBounded {a : A} {c : ℝ} {p : A} (hp : p ∈ sumSq A)
    (h : star a * a + p = (c : ℂ) • (1 : A)) (ω : AlgState A) : ‖ω a‖ ^ 2 ≤ c

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.sumSq_map
entries.docstring: A star-algebra equivalence maps sums of squares to sums of squares.
entries.snippet:
lemma sumSq_map {B : Type*} [Ring B] [Algebra ℂ B] [StarRing B]
    (σ : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] B) {p : A} (hp : p ∈ sumSq A) : σ p ∈ sumSq B

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.IsBounded.map
entries.docstring: A star-algebra automorphism preserves boundedness.
entries.snippet: lemma IsBounded.map {a : A} (ha : IsBounded a) (σ : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A) : IsBounded (σ a)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.exists_tendsto_state
entries.docstring: The values of a bounded net of states on an observable have a limit along an ultrafilter.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_tendsto_state (ψ : ι → AlgState A) (𝒰 : Ultrafilter ι)
    (hb : ∀ a : A, ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ i, ‖ψ i a‖ ≤ c) (a : A) :
    ∃ z, Tendsto (fun i => ψ i a) 𝒰 (𝓝 z)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.limit
entries.docstring: **The limit of a bounded net of states along an ultrafilter** is a state.
entries.snippet:
def AlgState.limit (ψ : ι → AlgState A) (𝒰 : Ultrafilter ι)
    (hb : ∀ a : A, ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ i, ‖ψ i a‖ ≤ c) : AlgState A where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.tendsto_limit
entries.snippet:
lemma AlgState.tendsto_limit (ψ : ι → AlgState A) (𝒰 : Ultrafilter ι)
    (hb : ∀ a : A, ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ i, ‖ψ i a‖ ≤ c) (a : A) :
    Tendsto (fun i => ψ i a) 𝒰 (𝓝 (AlgState.limit ψ 𝒰 hb a))

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.starAlgEquiv_smul
entries.snippet: lemma starAlgEquiv_smul (σ : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A) (c : ℂ) (a : A) : σ (c • a) = c • σ a

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.averageMap
entries.docstring: The linear functional `a ↦ |F|⁻¹ ∑_{g ∈ F} φ (α g a)`.
entries.snippet: def averageMap (φ : AlgState A) (α : Γ → (A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A)) (F : Finset Γ) : A →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.averageMap_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma averageMap_apply (φ : AlgState A) (α : Γ → (A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A)) (F : Finset Γ) (a : A) :
    averageMap φ α F a = ((F.card : ℂ))⁻¹ * ∑ g ∈ F, φ (α g a)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.average
entries.docstring: **The average of a state over a finite set of automorphisms** is a state.
entries.snippet:
def AlgState.average (φ : AlgState A) (α : Γ → (A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A)) (F : Finset Γ)
    (hF : F.Nonempty) : AlgState A where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.average_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma AlgState.average_apply (φ : AlgState A) (α : Γ → (A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A)) (F : Finset Γ)
    (hF : F.Nonempty) (a : A) :
    φ.average α F hF a = ((F.card : ℂ))⁻¹ * ∑ g ∈ F, φ (α g a)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.compMap
entries.docstring: The linear functional `a ↦ φ (σ a)`.
entries.snippet: def compMap (φ : AlgState A) (σ : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A) : A →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.compMap_apply
entries.snippet: lemma compMap_apply (φ : AlgState A) (σ : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A) (a : A) : compMap φ σ a = φ (σ a)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.comp
entries.docstring: **The composition of a state with an automorphism** is a state.
entries.snippet: def AlgState.comp (φ : AlgState A) (σ : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A) : AlgState A where

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.comp_apply
entries.snippet: lemma AlgState.comp_apply (φ : AlgState A) (σ : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A) (a : A) : φ.comp σ a = φ (σ a)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.norm_le_of_isBounded
entries.docstring: The bound on a state on a bounded observable, as a norm bound.
entries.snippet:
lemma AlgState.norm_le_of_isBounded {a : A} {c : ℝ} {p : A} (hp : p ∈ sumSq A)
    (h : star a * a + p = (c : ℂ) • (1 : A)) (ω : AlgState A) : ‖ω a‖ ≤ c + 1

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.norm_sum_sub_le
entries.docstring:
A difference of two sums of a bounded function is bounded by the size of the symmetric
difference of the index sets.
entries.snippet:
lemma norm_sum_sub_le (f : Γ → ℂ) (C : ℝ) (hf : ∀ k, ‖f k‖ ≤ C) (S T : Finset Γ) :
    ‖∑ k ∈ S, f k - ∑ k ∈ T, f k‖ ≤ ((S \ T).card + (T \ S).card) * C

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.IsRightFolner
entries.docstring:
The finite sets `F i` are **asymptotically invariant under right translation** along an
ultrafilter (a Følner condition): `|F h Δ F| / |F| → 0` for every `h`.
entries.snippet: def IsRightFolner (F : ι → Finset Γ) (𝒰 : Ultrafilter ι) : Prop

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.average_bounded
entries.docstring: The averaged states of a state over the sets `F i` are bounded on every observable.
entries.snippet:
lemma average_bounded (φ : AlgState A) (hb : ∀ a : A, IsBounded a) (a : A) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ i, ‖(φ.average (fun g => α g) (F i) (hne i)) a‖ ≤ c

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.invariantLimit
entries.docstring: **The Følner limit of a state**: the ultrafilter limit of its averages over the sets `F i`.
entries.snippet:
def AlgState.invariantLimit (φ : AlgState A) (hb : ∀ a : A, IsBounded a) (𝒰 : Ultrafilter ι) :
    AlgState A

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.invariantLimit_invariant
entries.docstring:
**The Følner limit of a state is invariant.** When the sets `F i` are asymptotically invariant
under right translation along `𝒰`, every limit of the averages of a state over them is invariant
under the group.
entries.snippet:
lemma AlgState.invariantLimit_invariant (φ : AlgState A) (hb : ∀ a : A, IsBounded a)
    (𝒰 : Ultrafilter ι) (hF : IsRightFolner F 𝒰) (h : Γ) (a : A) :
    AlgState.invariantLimit α F hne φ hb 𝒰 (α h a) = AlgState.invariantLimit α F hne φ hb 𝒰 a

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.sumSq_map_hom
entries.docstring: A star-algebra homomorphism maps sums of squares to sums of squares.
entries.snippet:
lemma sumSq_map_hom {B : Type*} [Ring B] [Algebra ℂ B] [StarRing B]
    (σ : A →⋆ₐ[ℂ] B) {p : A} (hp : p ∈ sumSq A) : σ p ∈ sumSq B

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgebraNet.isBounded_of_isLocallyBounded
entries.docstring: **Every observable of the quasi-local algebra of a locally bounded net is bounded.**
entries.snippet:
lemma AlgebraNet.isBounded_of_isLocallyBounded (hb : N.IsLocallyBounded) (x : N.Quasilocal) :
    IsBounded x

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.apply_selfAdjoint
entries.docstring: A self-adjoint element has a real expectation.
entries.snippet: lemma apply_selfAdjoint (a : selfAdjoint A) : ω (a : A) = ((ω (a : A)).re : ℂ)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.fluctuation
entries.docstring: The fluctuation `a - ω(a)` of an observable.
entries.snippet: def fluctuation (a : selfAdjoint A) : A

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.star_fluctuation
entries.snippet: lemma star_fluctuation (a : selfAdjoint A) : star (ω.fluctuation a) = ω.fluctuation a

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covariance
entries.docstring: The covariance `Re ω((a - ω(a)) (b - ω(b)))` of two observables.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def covariance (a b : selfAdjoint A) : ℝ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.variance
entries.docstring: The variance of an observable.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def variance (a : selfAdjoint A) : ℝ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.bracket
entries.docstring: The expectation of the bracket of two observables.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def bracket (a b : selfAdjoint A) : ℝ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.apply_fluctuation_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma apply_fluctuation_mul (a b : selfAdjoint A) :
    ω (ω.fluctuation a * ω.fluctuation b) = ω ((a : A) * b) - ω (a : A) * ω (b : A)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.bracket_eq_im
entries.docstring: The bracket is the imaginary part of `ω((a - ω(a)) (b - ω(b)))`.
entries.snippet:
lemma bracket_eq_im (a b : selfAdjoint A) :
    ω.bracket a b = (ω (ω.fluctuation a * ω.fluctuation b)).im

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covarianceMatrix
entries.docstring: The covariance matrix `Σ_jk = Cov(a_j, a_k)` of a family of observables.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def covarianceMatrix (a : ι → selfAdjoint A) : Matrix ι ι ℝ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.bracketMatrix
entries.docstring: The matrix `Ω_jk = ω⟨⁅a_j, a_k⁆⟩` of expectations of brackets.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def bracketMatrix (a : ι → selfAdjoint A) : Matrix ι ι ℝ

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.fluctuationVector
entries.docstring: The fluctuation of an observable as a vector of the pre-Hilbert space of the state.
entries.snippet: def fluctuationVector (a : selfAdjoint A) : ω.PreGNS

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.inner_fluctuationVector
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_fluctuationVector (a b : selfAdjoint A) :
    ⟪ω.fluctuationVector a, ω.fluctuationVector b⟫_ℂ =
      ω (ω.fluctuation a * ω.fluctuation b)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.gram_fluctuation
entries.docstring: **`Σ + iΩ` is the Gram matrix of the fluctuations.**
entries.snippet:
lemma gram_fluctuation (a : ι → selfAdjoint A) :
    gram ℂ (fun j => ω.fluctuationVector (a j)) =
      (ω.covarianceMatrix a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) +
        Complex.I • (ω.bracketMatrix a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.transpose_gram_fluctuation
entries.docstring: `Σ - iΩ` is the transpose of the Gram matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma transpose_gram_fluctuation (a : ι → selfAdjoint A) :
    (gram ℂ (fun j => ω.fluctuationVector (a j)))ᵀ =
      (ω.covarianceMatrix a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) -
        Complex.I • (ω.bracketMatrix a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ)

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.robertson_schrodinger
entries.docstring:
**The Robertson–Schrödinger relation** for a state on a `*`-algebra:
`Cov(a, b)² + ω⟨⁅a, b⁆⟩² ≤ Var a · Var b`.
entries.snippet:
lemma robertson_schrodinger (a b : selfAdjoint A) :
    ω.covariance a b ^ 2 + ω.bracket a b ^ 2 ≤ ω.variance a * ω.variance b

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.robertson_det
entries.docstring:
**Robertson's uncertainty relation for several observables** for a state on a `*`-algebra:
for every finite family of observables, `|det Ω| ≤ det Σ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma robertson_det [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (a : ι → selfAdjoint A) :
    |(ω.bracketMatrix a).det| ≤ (ω.covarianceMatrix a).det

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.apply_eq_zero_of_symm
entries.snippet: lemma apply_eq_zero_of_symm : ω (b : A) = 0

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.apply_mul_eq_zero_of_symm
entries.snippet: lemma apply_mul_eq_zero_of_symm : ω ((a : A) * b) = 0

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.covariance_eq_zero_of_symm
entries.docstring: **In a symmetric state, an even and an odd observable have covariance zero.**
entries.snippet: lemma covariance_eq_zero_of_symm : ω.covariance a b = 0

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.AlgState.bracket_eq_zero_of_symm
entries.docstring:
**In a symmetric state, an even and an odd observable have a bracket of expectation
zero.**
entries.snippet: lemma bracket_eq_zero_of_symm : ω.bracket a b = 0

entries.name: ProbabilisticTheory.UnitalPositiveLinearMap.apply_effectEquiv
entries.docstring:
A state's value at a doubled, re-centered effect (`Effect.effectEquiv`) is twice its value at
the effect, minus one.
entries.snippet:
lemma apply_effectEquiv (ψ : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (e : Effect E) :
    ψ ((Effect.effectEquiv e : E)) = 2 * ψ (e : E) - 1

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.tensor
entries.docstring: The coupled angular momentum `J = J₁ ⊗ 1 + 1 ⊗ J₂` on `V ⊗ W`.
entries.snippet:
def tensor (ρ₁ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) (ρ₂ : AngularMomentumRepresentation W) :
    AngularMomentumRepresentation (V ⊗[ℂ] W) where

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.tensor_Jp
entries.snippet:
lemma tensor_Jp (ρ₁ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) (ρ₂ : AngularMomentumRepresentation W) :
    (tensor ρ₁ ρ₂).Jp = diagEnd ρ₁.Jp ρ₂.Jp

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.tensor_Jm
entries.snippet:
lemma tensor_Jm (ρ₁ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) (ρ₂ : AngularMomentumRepresentation W) :
    (tensor ρ₁ ρ₂).Jm = diagEnd ρ₁.Jm ρ₂.Jm

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.ρE_mul_ρF
entries.docstring: `EF = FE + H` on `V(n)`, the associative form of `⁅E, F⁆ = H`.
entries.snippet:
lemma ρE_mul_ρF :
    (ρE : Module.End ℂ (StandardSl2Module ℂ n)) * ρF = ρF * ρE + ρH

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.ρH_mul_ρE
entries.docstring: `HE = EH + 2E` on `V(n)`, the associative form of `⁅H, E⁆ = 2E`.
entries.snippet:
lemma ρH_mul_ρE :
    (ρH : Module.End ℂ (StandardSl2Module ℂ n)) * ρE = ρE * ρH + (2 : ℂ) • ρE

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.ρH_mul_ρF
entries.docstring: `HF = FH - 2F` on `V(n)`, the associative form of `⁅H, F⁆ = -2F`.
entries.snippet:
lemma ρH_mul_ρF :
    (ρH : Module.End ℂ (StandardSl2Module ℂ n)) * ρF = ρF * ρH + (-2 : ℂ) • ρF

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.stdJx
entries.snippet: def stdJx : Module.End ℂ (StandardSl2Module ℂ n)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.stdJy
entries.snippet: def stdJy : Module.End ℂ (StandardSl2Module ℂ n)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.stdJz
entries.docstring: `Jz = H/2` on `V(n)`.
entries.snippet: def stdJz : Module.End ℂ (StandardSl2Module ℂ n)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.stdJx_stdJy
entries.snippet: lemma stdJx_stdJy : ⁅stdJx n, stdJy n⁆ = Complex.I • stdJz n

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.stdJy_stdJz
entries.snippet: lemma stdJy_stdJz : ⁅stdJy n, stdJz n⁆ = Complex.I • stdJx n

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.stdJz_stdJx
entries.snippet: lemma stdJz_stdJx : ⁅stdJz n, stdJx n⁆ = Complex.I • stdJy n

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.standard
entries.docstring:
The spin-`n/2` representation on `V(n)`: `Jz = H/2`, `Jx = (E + F)/2`,
`Jy = -i(E - F)/2`, so that `J+ = E` and `J- = F`.
entries.snippet: def standard : AngularMomentumRepresentation (StandardSl2Module ℂ n) where

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.standard_Jp
entries.snippet: lemma standard_Jp : (standard n).Jp = ρE

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.standard_Jm
entries.snippet: lemma standard_Jm : (standard n).Jm = ρF

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.standard_Jz
entries.snippet: lemma standard_Jz : (standard n).Jz = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • ρH

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.coupled
entries.docstring: The coupled representation of spins `m/2` and `n/2` on `V(m) ⊗ V(n)`.
entries.snippet:
abbrev coupled (m n : ℕ) :
    AngularMomentumRepresentation (StandardSl2Module ℂ m ⊗[ℂ] StandardSl2Module ℂ n)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.coupled_Jz
entries.snippet: lemma coupled_Jz : (coupled m n).Jz = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • tensorH m n

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.coupled_Jp
entries.snippet: lemma coupled_Jp : (coupled m n).Jp = tensorE m n

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.coupled_Jm
entries.snippet: lemma coupled_Jm : (coupled m n).Jm = tensorF m n

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.Jz_coupled_stringVec
entries.docstring: `Jz` acts on the `l`-th vector of the `k`-th string by `J - l`, `J = (m + n - 2k)/2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma Jz_coupled_stringVec (l : ℕ) :
    (coupled m n).Jz (stringVec m n k l) =
      (((m + n - 2 * k : ℕ) : ℂ) / 2 - l) • stringVec m n k l

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.Jsq_coupled_stringVec
entries.docstring: The total `J²` acts on the `k`-th string by `J(J + 1)`, `J = (m + n - 2k)/2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma Jsq_coupled_stringVec (l : ℕ) :
    (coupled m n).Jsq (stringVec m n k l) =
      (((m + n - 2 * k : ℕ) : ℂ) / 2 * (((m + n - 2 * k : ℕ) : ℂ) / 2 + 1)) •
        stringVec m n k l

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sumEnd_smul
entries.snippet:
lemma sumEnd_smul (c : ℂ) (A : ∀ k, Module.End ℂ (CGSummand ℂ m n k)) (y : CGSum ℂ m n) :
    sumEnd (fun k => c • A k) y = c • sumEnd A y

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgEquiv_Jz_coupled
entries.docstring: `cgEquiv` intertwines the total `Jz` with `Jz` of the spin-`J` summands.
entries.snippet:
lemma cgEquiv_Jz_coupled (hmn : 0 < m + n)
    (x : StandardSl2Module ℂ m ⊗[ℂ] StandardSl2Module ℂ n) :
    cgEquiv hmn ((coupled m n).Jz x) = sumEnd (fun _ => (standard _).Jz) (cgEquiv hmn x)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgEquiv_Jp_coupled
entries.docstring: `cgEquiv` intertwines the total `J+` with `J+` of the spin-`J` summands.
entries.snippet:
lemma cgEquiv_Jp_coupled (hmn : 0 < m + n)
    (x : StandardSl2Module ℂ m ⊗[ℂ] StandardSl2Module ℂ n) :
    cgEquiv hmn ((coupled m n).Jp x) = sumEnd (fun _ => (standard _).Jp) (cgEquiv hmn x)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgEquiv_Jm_coupled
entries.docstring: `cgEquiv` intertwines the total `J-` with `J-` of the spin-`J` summands.
entries.snippet:
lemma cgEquiv_Jm_coupled (hmn : 0 < m + n)
    (x : StandardSl2Module ℂ m ⊗[ℂ] StandardSl2Module ℂ n) :
    cgEquiv hmn ((coupled m n).Jm x) = sumEnd (fun _ => (standard _).Jm) (cgEquiv hmn x)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation
entries.docstring:
Angular momentum representation. Three operators
`Jx, Jy, Jz` on a state space `V`, satisfying the `so(3)` commutation relations
`[Jx,Jy] = iJz` and cyclic permutations. (The physical requirement that they be
self-adjoint on a Hilbert space is out of scope for this algebraic model.)
entries.snippet:
structure AngularMomentumRepresentation where
  Jx : Module.End ℂ V
  Jy : Module.End ℂ V
  Jz : Module.End ℂ V
  comm_xy : ⁅Jx, Jy⁆ = Complex.I • Jz
  comm_yz : ⁅Jy, Jz⁆ = Complex.I • Jx
  comm_zx : ⁅Jz, Jx⁆ = Complex.I • Jy

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jp
entries.docstring: Ladder operators. `J± := Jx ± iJy`.
entries.snippet: def Jp (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) : Module.End ℂ V

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jm
entries.snippet:
@[inherit_doc Jp]
def Jm (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) : Module.End ℂ V

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.comm_z_p
entries.docstring:
Commutation relations for the ladder operators:
`[Jz, J±] = ±J±` and `[J+, J-] = 2Jz`.
entries.snippet: lemma comm_z_p (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) : ⁅ρ.Jz, ρ.Jp⁆ = ρ.Jp

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.comm_z_m
entries.snippet: lemma comm_z_m (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) : ⁅ρ.Jz, ρ.Jm⁆ = -ρ.Jm

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.comm_p_m
entries.snippet:
lemma comm_p_m (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) :
    ⁅ρ.Jp, ρ.Jm⁆ = (2 : ℂ) • ρ.Jz

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.isSl2Triple
entries.docstring:
Angular momentum generates an `sl₂`-triple, via
`h := 2 • Jz`, `e := J+`, `f := J-` (the doubling of `Jz` reconciles the physicists'
normalization `[Jz,J±]=±J±` with the `sl₂`-triple normalization `[h,e]=2e`).

The hypothesis `ρ.Jz ≠ 0` is necessary: the all-zero representation
(`Jx = Jy = Jz = 0`) satisfies every field of `AngularMomentumRepresentation`
but gives `h = 2 • Jz = 0`, which `IsSl2Triple` explicitly excludes
(`h_ne_zero`) — the trivial, spin-`0` representation does not generate an
honest copy of `sl₂` inside `End(V)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma isSl2Triple (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) (hz : ρ.Jz ≠ 0) :
    IsSl2Triple ((2 : ℂ) • ρ.Jz) ρ.Jp ρ.Jm where

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.IsIrreducible
entries.docstring:
Irreducibility of an angular momentum representation: no proper subspace is
invariant under `Jx`, `Jy`, and `Jz` simultaneously.
entries.snippet: def IsIrreducible (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) : Prop

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jx_mem_sl2
entries.docstring:
Irreducibility transfers along the bridge:
`ρ.IsIrreducible` agrees with irreducibility of the induced module for the `sl₂`-subalgebra
generated by `(2Jz, J+, J-)` (via the automatic `LieSubalgebra.lieRingModule`/`lieModule`
instances restricting the tautological `Module.End ℂ V`-action on `V`).
entries.snippet:
lemma Jx_mem_sl2 (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) (hz : ρ.Jz ≠ 0) :
    ρ.Jx ∈ (ρ.isSl2Triple hz).toLieSubalgebra ℂ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jy_mem_sl2
entries.snippet:
lemma Jy_mem_sl2 (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) (hz : ρ.Jz ≠ 0) :
    ρ.Jy ∈ (ρ.isSl2Triple hz).toLieSubalgebra ℂ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jz_mem_sl2
entries.snippet:
lemma Jz_mem_sl2 (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) (hz : ρ.Jz ≠ 0) :
    ρ.Jz ∈ (ρ.isSl2Triple hz).toLieSubalgebra ℂ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jp_mem_of_invariant
entries.snippet:
lemma Jp_mem_of_invariant (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V)
    (W : Submodule ℂ V) (hx : ∀ v ∈ W, ρ.Jx v ∈ W)
    (hy : ∀ v ∈ W, ρ.Jy v ∈ W) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ W) : ρ.Jp v ∈ W

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jm_mem_of_invariant
entries.snippet:
lemma Jm_mem_of_invariant (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V)
    (W : Submodule ℂ V) (hx : ∀ v ∈ W, ρ.Jx v ∈ W)
    (hy : ∀ v ∈ W, ρ.Jy v ∈ W) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ W) : ρ.Jm v ∈ W

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.sl2_invariant_of_angular_invariant
entries.snippet:
lemma sl2_invariant_of_angular_invariant (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V)
    (hz : ρ.Jz ≠ 0) (W : Submodule ℂ V)
    (hx : ∀ v ∈ W, ρ.Jx v ∈ W) (hy : ∀ v ∈ W, ρ.Jy v ∈ W)
    (hzW : ∀ v ∈ W, ρ.Jz v ∈ W) {x : ↥((ρ.isSl2Triple hz).toLieSubalgebra ℂ)}
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ W) : ⁅x, v⁆ ∈ W

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.nontrivial_of_Jz_ne_zero
entries.docstring: A nonzero `Jz` forces the representation space to be nontrivial.
entries.snippet:
lemma nontrivial_of_Jz_ne_zero (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) (hz : ρ.Jz ≠ 0) :
    Nontrivial V

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.lieSubmodule_stable
entries.docstring: Lie submodules are stable under every operator in the generated subalgebra.

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.angular_irreducible_implies_sl2
entries.snippet:
lemma angular_irreducible_implies_sl2 (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V)
    (hz : ρ.Jz ≠ 0) (hirr : ρ.IsIrreducible) :
    LieModule.IsIrreducible ℂ ↥((ρ.isSl2Triple hz).toLieSubalgebra ℂ) V

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.sl2_irreducible_implies_angular
entries.snippet:
lemma sl2_irreducible_implies_angular (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V)
    (hz : ρ.Jz ≠ 0)
    (hirr : LieModule.IsIrreducible ℂ ↥((ρ.isSl2Triple hz).toLieSubalgebra ℂ) V) :
    ρ.IsIrreducible

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.isIrreducible_iff
entries.docstring:
Invariance under `Jx`, `Jy`, `Jz` is equivalent to irreducibility for the generated
`sl₂` Lie subalgebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma isIrreducible_iff (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) (hz : ρ.Jz ≠ 0) :
    ρ.IsIrreducible ↔ LieModule.IsIrreducible ℂ (↥((ρ.isSl2Triple hz).toLieSubalgebra ℂ)) V

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.spin_classification
entries.docstring:
A finite-dimensional irreducible angular momentum representation is isomorphic to a
standard `sl₂` module for the subalgebra generated by `(2Jz, Jp, Jm)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma spin_classification [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V)
    (hz : ρ.Jz ≠ 0) (hirr : ρ.IsIrreducible) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, letI

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jp_mul_Jm
entries.docstring:
`J+J- = Jx²+Jy²+Jz`: the standard ladder-operator identity, a purely algebraic
consequence of the commutation relations (no representation theory needed). Used to
reduce `Jsq_eq_smul` to a statement about `Jp * Jm`, via
`J² = Jp*Jm + Jz*Jz - Jz` (equivalently `Jm*Jp + Jz*Jz + Jz`).
entries.snippet:
lemma Jp_mul_Jm (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) :
    ρ.Jp * ρ.Jm = ρ.Jx * ρ.Jx + ρ.Jy * ρ.Jy + ρ.Jz

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jsq_eq_Jp_mul_Jm
entries.docstring:
`J² = J+J- + Jz² - Jz`: a purely algebraic consequence of the commutation
relations (no representation theory needed), used to reduce `Jsq_eq_smul` to a
statement about the ladder operators.
entries.snippet:
lemma Jsq_eq_Jp_mul_Jm (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) :
    ρ.Jx * ρ.Jx + ρ.Jy * ρ.Jy + ρ.Jz * ρ.Jz =
      ρ.Jp * ρ.Jm + ρ.Jz * ρ.Jz - ρ.Jz

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.leibniz_end
entries.docstring:
Product Leibniz rule for the associative-ring bracket on `Module.End ℂ V`:
`⁅a*x, z⁆ = a*⁅x,z⁆ + ⁅a,z⁆*x`.
entries.snippet:
lemma leibniz_end (a x z : Module.End ℂ V) :
    (⁅a * x, z⁆ : Module.End ℂ V) = a * ⁅x, z⁆ + ⁅a, z⁆ * x

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.mul_eq_of_lie_eq
entries.docstring: Unfolds the associative-ring bracket relation `⁅a, b⁆ = c` into `a * b = b * a + c`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mul_eq_of_lie_eq {a b c : Module.End ℂ V} (h : (⁅a, b⁆ : Module.End ℂ V) = c) :
    a * b = b * a + c

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jsq_comm_p
entries.docstring:
`J²` commutes with `J+`: a step towards showing `J²` is central, hence (on an
irreducible module) acts as a scalar.
entries.snippet:
lemma Jsq_comm_p (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) :
    (⁅ρ.Jx * ρ.Jx + ρ.Jy * ρ.Jy + ρ.Jz * ρ.Jz, ρ.Jp⁆ : Module.End ℂ V) = 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jsq_comm_m
entries.docstring:
`J²` commutes with `J-`: a step towards showing `J²` is central, hence (on an
irreducible module) acts as a scalar.
entries.snippet:
lemma Jsq_comm_m (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) :
    (⁅ρ.Jx * ρ.Jx + ρ.Jy * ρ.Jy + ρ.Jz * ρ.Jz, ρ.Jm⁆ : Module.End ℂ V) = 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jsq_comm_z
entries.docstring:
`J²` commutes with `Jz`: derived from `Jsq_comm_p`/`Jsq_comm_m` via the Jacobi
identity, since `2•Jz = ⁅Jp,Jm⁆`.
entries.snippet:
lemma Jsq_comm_z (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) :
    (⁅ρ.Jx * ρ.Jx + ρ.Jy * ρ.Jy + ρ.Jz * ρ.Jz, ρ.Jz⁆ : Module.End ℂ V) = 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jsq
entries.docstring: The quadratic angular momentum operator `Jx² + Jy² + Jz²`.
entries.snippet: def Jsq (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) : Module.End ℂ V

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.JpJm_on_primitive
entries.docstring: On a primitive vector of weight `n`, `Jp Jm` acts by `n`.
entries.snippet:
lemma JpJm_on_primitive (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) (hz : ρ.Jz ≠ 0)
    {n : ℕ} {v : V} (P : (ρ.isSl2Triple hz).HasPrimitiveVectorWith v (n : ℂ)) :
    ρ.Jp (ρ.Jm v) = (n : ℂ) • v

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jz_on_primitive
entries.docstring: The Cartan operator acts by half the highest weight on a primitive vector.
entries.snippet:
lemma Jz_on_primitive (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) (hz : ρ.Jz ≠ 0)
    {n : ℕ} {v : V} (P : (ρ.isSl2Triple hz).HasPrimitiveVectorWith v (n : ℂ)) :
    ρ.Jz v = ((n : ℂ) / 2) • v

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jsq_on_primitive
entries.docstring: The quadratic operator has the expected eigenvalue on a primitive vector.
entries.snippet:
lemma Jsq_on_primitive (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) (hz : ρ.Jz ≠ 0)
    {n : ℕ} {v : V} (P : (ρ.isSl2Triple hz).HasPrimitiveVectorWith v (n : ℂ)) :
    ρ.Jsq v = ((n : ℂ) / 2 * ((n : ℂ) / 2 + 1)) • v

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.ker_scalar_stable
entries.docstring: An eigenspace of an endomorphism is stable under commuting endomorphisms.
entries.snippet:
lemma ker_scalar_stable (C A : Module.End ℂ V) (c : ℂ)
    (hCA : (⁅C, A⁆ : Module.End ℂ V) = 0)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ LinearMap.ker (C - c • (1 : Module.End ℂ V))) :
    A v ∈ LinearMap.ker (C - c • (1 : Module.End ℂ V))

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jx_apply_eq
entries.docstring: `Jx` is half the sum of the ladder operators.
entries.snippet:
lemma Jx_apply_eq (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) (v : V) :
    ρ.Jx v = ((1 : ℂ) / 2) • (ρ.Jp v + ρ.Jm v)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jy_apply_eq
entries.docstring: `Jy` is `-i/2` times the difference of the ladder operators.
entries.snippet:
lemma Jy_apply_eq (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) (v : V) :
    ρ.Jy v = (-(Complex.I / 2)) • (ρ.Jp v - ρ.Jm v)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jsq_ker_stable_x
entries.docstring: The `J²` eigenspace is stable under `Jx`.
entries.snippet:
lemma Jsq_ker_stable_x (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) (c : ℂ)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ LinearMap.ker (ρ.Jsq - c • (1 : Module.End ℂ V))) :
    ρ.Jx v ∈ LinearMap.ker (ρ.Jsq - c • (1 : Module.End ℂ V))

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jsq_ker_stable_y
entries.docstring: The `J²` eigenspace is stable under `Jy`.
entries.snippet:
lemma Jsq_ker_stable_y (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) (c : ℂ)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ LinearMap.ker (ρ.Jsq - c • (1 : Module.End ℂ V))) :
    ρ.Jy v ∈ LinearMap.ker (ρ.Jsq - c • (1 : Module.End ℂ V))

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jsq_ker_eq_top
entries.docstring: A nonzero vector in a `J²` eigenspace forces that eigenspace to be everything.
entries.snippet:
lemma Jsq_ker_eq_top (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V)
    (hirr : ρ.IsIrreducible) (c : ℂ) {v : V} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hmem : v ∈ LinearMap.ker (ρ.Jsq - c • (1 : Module.End ℂ V))) :
    LinearMap.ker (ρ.Jsq - c • (1 : Module.End ℂ V)) = ⊤

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jsq_eq_scalar_of_eigenvector
entries.docstring: A nonzero `J²` eigenvector forces `J²` to be that scalar on an irreducible module.
entries.snippet:
lemma Jsq_eq_scalar_of_eigenvector (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V)
    (hirr : ρ.IsIrreducible) (c : ℂ) {v : V} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hCv : ρ.Jsq v = c • v) : ρ.Jsq = c • (1 : Module.End ℂ V)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jsq_eq_zero_of_Jz_eq_zero
entries.docstring:
If `Jz = 0`, the commutation relations force all three angular momentum operators
to vanish.
entries.snippet:
lemma Jsq_eq_zero_of_Jz_eq_zero (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V)
    (hz : ρ.Jz = 0) : ρ.Jsq = 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jsq_eq_smul
entries.docstring:
On an irreducible finite-dimensional representation, `J²` acts by `j(j+1)` for
some `j = n/2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma Jsq_eq_smul [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V)
    (hirr : ρ.IsIrreducible) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ρ.Jsq = ((n : ℂ) / 2 * ((n : ℂ) / 2 + 1)) • (1 : Module.End ℂ V)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.magneticBasisVec
entries.docstring:
Magnetic-weight ladder vectors: given a primitive vector
`v₀` of weight `n` for the triple `(2Jz, J+, J-)`, this defines `(J-)ᵏ v₀` for
`k = 0,…,n`. A basis theorem and reindexing by `m = n/2 - k` remain to be added.
entries.snippet:
def magneticBasisVec (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) (hz : ρ.Jz ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} {v₀ : V}
    (_ : (ρ.isSl2Triple hz).HasPrimitiveVectorWith v₀ (n : ℂ)) (k : Fin (n + 1)) : V

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorForm
entries.docstring: The contravariant form on `V(m) ⊗ V(n)`: `⟨x ⊗ y, x' ⊗ y'⟩ = ⟨x, x'⟩ ⟨y, y'⟩`.
entries.snippet: def tensorForm : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ (StandardSl2Module ℝ m ⊗[ℝ] StandardSl2Module ℝ n)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorForm_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorForm_tmul (x x' : StandardSl2Module ℝ m) (y y' : StandardSl2Module ℝ n) :
    tensorForm m n (x ⊗ₜ y) (x' ⊗ₜ y') = invForm ℝ m x x' * invForm ℝ n y y'

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorBilin_ext
entries.docstring: Two bilinear forms on `V(m) ⊗ V(n)` agree if they agree on pure tensors.

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.invForm_ρE_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma invForm_ρE_apply (x y : StandardSl2Module ℝ n) :
    invForm ℝ n (ρE x) y = invForm ℝ n x (ρF y)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.invForm_ρH_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma invForm_ρH_apply (x y : StandardSl2Module ℝ n) :
    invForm ℝ n (ρH x) y = invForm ℝ n x (ρH y)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorForm_comm
entries.docstring: The form on the tensor product is symmetric.
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorForm_comm (x y : StandardSl2Module ℝ m ⊗[ℝ] StandardSl2Module ℝ n) :
    tensorForm m n x y = tensorForm m n y x

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorForm_tensorE
entries.docstring: The diagonal raising and lowering operators are adjoint: `⟨E x, y⟩ = ⟨x, F y⟩`.
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorForm_tensorE (x y : StandardSl2Module ℝ m ⊗[ℝ] StandardSl2Module ℝ n) :
    tensorForm m n (tensorE m n x) y = tensorForm m n x (tensorF m n y)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorForm_tensorF
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorForm_tensorF (x y : StandardSl2Module ℝ m ⊗[ℝ] StandardSl2Module ℝ n) :
    tensorForm m n (tensorF m n x) y = tensorForm m n x (tensorE m n y)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorForm_tensorH
entries.docstring: The diagonal weight operator is symmetric.
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorForm_tensorH (x y : StandardSl2Module ℝ m ⊗[ℝ] StandardSl2Module ℝ n) :
    tensorForm m n (tensorH m n x) y = tensorForm m n x (tensorH m n y)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorForm_hwVec_of_ne
entries.docstring: Highest-weight vectors of different weight are orthogonal.
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorForm_hwVec_of_ne {k k' : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ k') :
    tensorForm m n (hwVec m n k) (hwVec m n k') = 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.stringVec_zero'
entries.snippet: lemma stringVec_zero' (k : ℕ) : stringVec (K := ℝ) m n k 0 = hwVec m n k

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorForm_stringVec
entries.docstring:
The inner products of the lowering strings:
`⟨f^a w_k, f^b w_{k'}⟩ = δ_{kk'} δ_{ab} · normSq (m + n - 2k) a · ⟨w_k, w_k⟩`.
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorForm_stringVec (hmn : 0 < m + n) {k k' : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (hk'm : k' ≤ m) (hk'n : k' ≤ n) (a b : ℕ) :
    tensorForm m n (stringVec m n k a) (stringVec m n k' b) =
      if k = k' ∧ a = b then
        (normSq (m + n - 2 * k) a : ℝ) * tensorForm m n (hwVec m n k) (hwVec m n k)
      else 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.hwNormSq
entries.docstring: The squared norm `⟨w_k, w_k⟩` of the highest-weight vector `w_k`.
entries.snippet: def hwNormSq (k : ℕ) : ℝ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.hwNormSq_eq
entries.docstring: `⟨w_k, w_k⟩ = Σ_a cgCoeff(a)² · normSq m a · normSq n (k - a)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma hwNormSq_eq {k : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    hwNormSq m n k = ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
      cgCoeff (K := ℝ) m n k a ^ 2 * (normSq m a : ℝ) * (normSq n (k - a) : ℝ)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgCoeff_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma cgCoeff_zero (k : ℕ) :
    cgCoeff (K := ℝ) m n k 0 = ((n - k).factorial * m.factorial : ℕ)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.hwNormSq_pos
entries.snippet: lemma hwNormSq_pos {k : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) : 0 < hwNormSq m n k

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.coupledVec
entries.docstring: The normalised coupled state `|J, M⟩` with `J = (m + n)/2 - k`, `M = J - l`.
entries.snippet: def coupledVec (k l : ℕ) : StandardSl2Module ℝ m ⊗[ℝ] StandardSl2Module ℝ n

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorForm_coupledVec
entries.docstring: The coupled states are orthonormal.
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorForm_coupledVec (hmn : 0 < m + n) {k k' l l' : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (hk'm : k' ≤ m) (hk'n : k' ≤ n) (hl : l ≤ m + n - 2 * k) :
    tensorForm m n (coupledVec m n k l) (coupledVec m n k' l') =
      if k = k' ∧ l = l' then 1 else 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sqrt_coupled_succ
entries.snippet:
lemma sqrt_coupled_succ {k l : ℕ} :
    Real.sqrt ((normSq (m + n - 2 * k) (l + 1) : ℝ) * hwNormSq m n k) =
      Real.sqrt ((normSq (m + n - 2 * k) l : ℝ) * hwNormSq m n k) *
        Real.sqrt (((l : ℝ) + 1) * (((m + n - 2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ) - l))

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorF_coupledVec
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorF_coupledVec {k l : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) (hl : l < m + n - 2 * k) :
    tensorF m n (coupledVec m n k l) =
      Real.sqrt (((l : ℝ) + 1) * (((m + n - 2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ) - l)) • coupledVec m n k (l + 1)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorE_coupledVec_succ
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorE_coupledVec_succ (hmn : 0 < m + n) {k l : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (hl : l < m + n - 2 * k) :
    tensorE m n (coupledVec m n k (l + 1)) =
      Real.sqrt (((l : ℝ) + 1) * (((m + n - 2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ) - l)) • coupledVec m n k l

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgCoefficient
entries.docstring:
The Clebsch–Gordan coefficient `⟨j₁ m₁ j₂ m₂ | J M⟩ = ⟨u_a ⊗ u_b, |J, M⟩⟩` with `j₁ = m/2`,
`m₁ = j₁ - a`, `j₂ = n/2`, `m₂ = j₂ - b`, `J = (m + n)/2 - k` and `M = J - l`.
entries.snippet: def cgCoefficient (k l a b : ℕ) : ℝ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorH_normVec_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorH_normVec_tmul (a b : ℕ) :
    tensorH m n (normVec m a ⊗ₜ normVec n b) =
      (((m : ℝ) - 2 * a) + ((n : ℝ) - 2 * b)) • (normVec m a ⊗ₜ normVec n b)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorH_coupledVec
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorH_coupledVec (hmn : 0 < m + n) {k : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) (l : ℕ) :
    tensorH m n (coupledVec m n k l) =
      (((m + n - 2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ) - 2 * l) • coupledVec m n k l

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgCoefficient_eq_zero_of_ne
entries.docstring: **Weight rule.** `⟨j₁ m₁ j₂ m₂ | J M⟩ = 0` unless `m₁ + m₂ = M`, i.e. `a + b = k + l`.
entries.snippet:
lemma cgCoefficient_eq_zero_of_ne (hmn : 0 < m + n) {k l a b : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (h : a + b ≠ k + l) : cgCoefficient m n k l a b = 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.invForm_normVec_vNat
entries.snippet:
lemma invForm_normVec_vNat {a : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ n) (c : ℕ) :
    invForm ℝ n (normVec n a) (vNat n c) = if a = c then Real.sqrt (normSq n a) else 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorForm_normVec_hwVec
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorForm_normVec_hwVec {k a : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) (ha : a ≤ k) :
    tensorForm m n (normVec m a ⊗ₜ normVec n (k - a)) (hwVec m n k) =
      cgCoeff m n k a * Real.sqrt (normSq m a) * Real.sqrt (normSq n (k - a))

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgCoefficient_top
entries.docstring:
The coefficients of the top state `|J, J⟩`:
`⟨j₁ m₁ j₂ m₂ | J J⟩ = cgCoeff(a) · √(normSq m a) · √(normSq n (k - a)) / √⟨w_k, w_k⟩`.
entries.snippet:
lemma cgCoefficient_top {k a : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) (ha : a ≤ k) :
    cgCoefficient m n k 0 a (k - a) =
      cgCoeff m n k a * Real.sqrt (normSq m a) * Real.sqrt (normSq n (k - a)) /
        Real.sqrt (hwNormSq m n k)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgCoefficient_top_pos
entries.docstring: **Condon–Shortley phase convention.** `⟨j₁ j₁ j₂ (J - j₁) | J J⟩ > 0`.
entries.snippet:
lemma cgCoefficient_top_pos {k : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    0 < cgCoefficient m n k 0 0 k

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.eq_sum_normVec
entries.docstring: Every vector of `V(n)` is `Σ_a ⟨u_a, x⟩ u_a`.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_sum_normVec (x : StandardSl2Module ℝ n) :
    x = ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), invForm ℝ n (normVec n a) x • normVec n a

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.eq_sum_normVec_tmul
entries.docstring: Every vector of `V(m) ⊗ V(n)` is `Σ_{a b} ⟨u_a ⊗ u_b, x⟩ u_a ⊗ u_b`.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_sum_normVec_tmul (x : StandardSl2Module ℝ m ⊗[ℝ] StandardSl2Module ℝ n) :
    x = ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      tensorForm m n (normVec m a ⊗ₜ normVec n b) x • (normVec m a ⊗ₜ normVec n b)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.coupledVec_eq_sum
entries.docstring: `|J, M⟩ = Σ_{m₁ m₂} ⟨j₁ m₁ j₂ m₂ | J M⟩ |j₁ m₁⟩ ⊗ |j₂ m₂⟩`.
entries.snippet:
lemma coupledVec_eq_sum (k l : ℕ) :
    coupledVec m n k l = ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      cgCoefficient m n k l a b • (normVec m a ⊗ₜ normVec n b)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sum_cgCoefficient_mul
entries.docstring:
**Orthogonality relation.**
`Σ_{m₁ m₂} ⟨j₁ m₁ j₂ m₂ | J M⟩ ⟨j₁ m₁ j₂ m₂ | J' M'⟩ = δ_{JJ'} δ_{MM'}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_cgCoefficient_mul (hmn : 0 < m + n) {k k' l l' : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (hk'm : k' ≤ m) (hk'n : k' ≤ n) (hl : l ≤ m + n - 2 * k) :
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      cgCoefficient m n k l a b * cgCoefficient m n k' l' a b =
        if k = k' ∧ l = l' then 1 else 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.hwNormSq_zero
entries.snippet: lemma hwNormSq_zero : hwNormSq m n 0 = ((n.factorial * m.factorial : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgCoefficient_stretched
entries.docstring: `⟨j₁ j₁ j₂ j₂ | j₁+j₂, j₁+j₂⟩ = 1`.
entries.snippet: lemma cgCoefficient_stretched : cgCoefficient m n 0 0 0 0 = 1

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.hwNormSq_one_one
entries.snippet: lemma hwNormSq_one_one : hwNormSq 1 1 1 = 2

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgCoefficient_singlet_up
entries.docstring: Singlet: `⟨½ ½ ½ -½ | 0 0⟩ = 1/√2`.
entries.snippet: lemma cgCoefficient_singlet_up : cgCoefficient 1 1 1 0 0 1 = 1 / Real.sqrt 2

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgCoefficient_singlet_down
entries.docstring: Singlet: `⟨½ -½ ½ ½ | 0 0⟩ = -1/√2`.
entries.snippet: lemma cgCoefficient_singlet_down : cgCoefficient 1 1 1 0 1 0 = -1 / Real.sqrt 2

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.coupledVec_one_one_zero_one
entries.snippet:
lemma coupledVec_one_one_zero_one :
    coupledVec 1 1 0 1 = (1 / Real.sqrt 2) • tensorF 1 1 (coupledVec 1 1 0 0)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.ρE_normVec_one_zero
entries.snippet: lemma ρE_normVec_one_zero : (ρE : Module.End ℝ (StandardSl2Module ℝ 1)) (normVec 1 0) = 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.ρE_normVec_one_one
entries.snippet:
lemma ρE_normVec_one_one :
    (ρE : Module.End ℝ (StandardSl2Module ℝ 1)) (normVec 1 1) = normVec 1 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgCoefficient_triplet_zero_up
entries.docstring: Triplet: `⟨½ ½ ½ -½ | 1 0⟩ = 1/√2`.
entries.snippet: lemma cgCoefficient_triplet_zero_up : cgCoefficient 1 1 0 1 0 1 = 1 / Real.sqrt 2

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgCoefficient_triplet_zero_down
entries.docstring: Triplet: `⟨½ -½ ½ ½ | 1 0⟩ = 1/√2`.
entries.snippet: lemma cgCoefficient_triplet_zero_down : cgCoefficient 1 1 0 1 1 0 = 1 / Real.sqrt 2

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorForm_coupledVec_stringVec
entries.docstring: `⟨|J, M⟩, f^{l'} w_{k'}⟩ = δ_{kk'} δ_{ll'} √(normSq N l · ⟨w_k, w_k⟩)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorForm_coupledVec_stringVec (hmn : 0 < m + n) {k k' l l' : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m)
    (hkn : k ≤ n) (hk'm : k' ≤ m) (hk'n : k' ≤ n) (hl : l ≤ m + n - 2 * k) :
    tensorForm m n (coupledVec m n k l) (stringVec m n k' l') =
      if k = k' ∧ l = l' then
        Real.sqrt ((normSq (m + n - 2 * k) l : ℝ) * hwNormSq m n k)
      else 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.eq_sum_coupledVec
entries.docstring: **Completeness.** Every vector of `V(m) ⊗ V(n)` is `Σ_{J M} ⟨|J, M⟩, x⟩ |J, M⟩`.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_sum_coupledVec (hmn : 0 < m + n) (x : StandardSl2Module ℝ m ⊗[ℝ] StandardSl2Module ℝ n) :
    x = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (min m n + 1), ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + n - 2 * k + 1),
      tensorForm m n (coupledVec m n k l) x • coupledVec m n k l

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sum_cgCoefficient_mul_cgCoefficient
entries.docstring:
**Second orthogonality relation.**
`Σ_{J M} ⟨j₁ m₁ j₂ m₂ | J M⟩ ⟨j₁ m₁' j₂ m₂' | J M⟩ = δ_{m₁ m₁'} δ_{m₂ m₂'}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_cgCoefficient_mul_cgCoefficient (hmn : 0 < m + n) {a b a' b' : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ m)
    (hb : b ≤ n) (ha' : a' ≤ m) (hb' : b' ≤ n) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (min m n + 1), ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + n - 2 * k + 1),
      cgCoefficient m n k l a b * cgCoefficient m n k l a' b' =
        if a = a' ∧ b = b' then 1 else 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.factorialSum
entries.snippet: def factorialSum (k p s : ℕ) : ℕ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.factorialSum_succ
entries.docstring: Pascal's rule for `S`.
entries.snippet:
lemma factorialSum_succ (k p s : ℕ) :
    factorialSum (k + 1) p s = factorialSum k p (s + 1) + factorialSum k (p + 1) s

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.factorialSum_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma factorialSum_mul (k p s : ℕ) :
    factorialSum k p s * (p + s + 1).factorial =
      (p + k + s + 1).factorial * p.factorial * s.factorial

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sum_choose_mul_factorial
entries.docstring:
The factorial identity in the form used for `⟨w_k, w_k⟩`:
`Σ_a C(k, a) (p + a)! (s + k - a)! · (p + s + 1)! = (p + k + s + 1)! p! s!`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_choose_mul_factorial (k p s : ℕ) :
    (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), k.choose a * ((p + a).factorial * (s + (k - a)).factorial)) *
      (p + s + 1).factorial = (p + k + s + 1).factorial * p.factorial * s.factorial

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.hwNormNum
entries.docstring: The numerator `k! m! n! (m + n - k + 1)! (n - k)! (m - k)!` of `⟨w_k, w_k⟩`.
entries.snippet: def hwNormNum (m n k : ℕ) : ℕ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgCoeff_sq_mul_normSq
entries.snippet:
lemma cgCoeff_sq_mul_normSq {k a : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) (ha : a ≤ k) :
    cgCoeff (K := ℝ) m n k a ^ 2 * (normSq m a : ℝ) * (normSq n (k - a) : ℝ) =
      ((k.choose a * ((n - k + a).factorial * (m - a).factorial) *
        (k.factorial * m.factorial * n.factorial) : ℕ) : ℝ)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.hwNormSq_mul_factorial
entries.snippet:
lemma hwNormSq_mul_factorial {k : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    hwNormSq m n k * ((m + n - 2 * k + 1).factorial : ℝ) = hwNormNum m n k

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.hwNormSq_closed
entries.docstring:
**The closed norm.**
`⟨w_k, w_k⟩ = k! m! n! (m + n - k + 1)! (n - k)! (m - k)! / (m + n - 2k + 1)!`.
entries.snippet:
lemma hwNormSq_closed {k : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    hwNormSq m n k = hwNormNum m n k / ((m + n - 2 * k + 1).factorial : ℝ)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.ρF_pow_vNat
entries.snippet:
lemma ρF_pow_vNat (a l : ℕ) :
    ((ρF : Module.End ℝ (StandardSl2Module ℝ n)) ^ l) (vNat n a) = vNat n (a + l)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorF_pow_tmul_vNat
entries.docstring:
The binomial theorem for the lowering operator:
`f^l (v_a ⊗ v_b) = Σ_i C(l, i) v_{a+i} ⊗ v_{b+l-i}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorF_pow_tmul_vNat (a b l : ℕ) :
    (tensorF (K := ℝ) m n ^ l) (vNat m a ⊗ₜ vNat n b) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (l + 1), (l.choose i : ℝ) • (vNat m (a + i) ⊗ₜ vNat n (b + (l - i)))

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgSum
entries.docstring: The alternating sum `Σ_{a ≤ min(k, α)} (-1)^a C(k, a) (n - k + a)! (m - a)! C(l, α - a)`.
entries.snippet: def cgSum (m n k l α : ℕ) : ℝ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sum_choose_mul_ite
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_choose_mul_ite {l a α : ℕ} (X : ℝ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (l + 1), (l.choose i : ℝ) * (if α = a + i then X else 0) =
      if a ≤ α then (l.choose (α - a) : ℝ) * X else 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorForm_normVec_tmul_vNat
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorForm_normVec_tmul_vNat {α β a i k l : ℕ} (hα : α ≤ m) (hβ : β ≤ n)
    (h : α + β = k + l) (hak : a ≤ k) (hil : i ≤ l) :
    tensorForm m n (normVec m α ⊗ₜ normVec n β) (vNat m (a + i) ⊗ₜ vNat n (k - a + (l - i))) =
      if α = a + i then Real.sqrt (normSq m α) * Real.sqrt (normSq n β) else 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorForm_normVec_stringVec
entries.docstring: `⟨u_α ⊗ u_β, f^l w_k⟩ = cgSum · √(normSq m α) √(normSq n β)` for `α + β = k + l`.
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorForm_normVec_stringVec {k l α β : ℕ} (hα : α ≤ m) (hβ : β ≤ n)
    (h : α + β = k + l) :
    tensorForm m n (normVec m α ⊗ₜ normVec n β) (stringVec m n k l) =
      cgSum m n k l α * Real.sqrt (normSq m α) * Real.sqrt (normSq n β)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgCoefficient_eq_cgSum
entries.docstring: The Clebsch–Gordan coefficient as one finite sum, with the norm of `w_k` still unevaluated.
entries.snippet:
lemma cgCoefficient_eq_cgSum {k l α β : ℕ} (hα : α ≤ m) (hβ : β ≤ n) (h : α + β = k + l) :
    cgCoefficient m n k l α β =
      (Real.sqrt ((normSq (m + n - 2 * k) l : ℝ) * hwNormSq m n k))⁻¹ *
        (cgSum m n k l α * Real.sqrt (normSq m α) * Real.sqrt (normSq n β))

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgCoefficient_closed
entries.docstring:
**Closed formula for the Clebsch–Gordan coefficients.** For `α + β = k + l`, with
`N = m + n - 2k`,
`⟨j₁ m₁ j₂ m₂ | J M⟩ = cgSum · √(normSq m α · normSq n β · (N + 1)! / (normSq N l · hwNormNum))`.
For `α + β ≠ k + l` the coefficient vanishes by `cgCoefficient_eq_zero_of_ne`.
entries.snippet:
lemma cgCoefficient_closed {k l α β : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (hl : l ≤ m + n - 2 * k) (hα : α ≤ m) (hβ : β ≤ n) (h : α + β = k + l) :
    cgCoefficient m n k l α β = cgSum m n k l α *
      Real.sqrt ((normSq m α : ℝ) * normSq n β * (m + n - 2 * k + 1).factorial /
        ((normSq (m + n - 2 * k) l : ℝ) * hwNormNum m n k))

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.zchoose
entries.docstring: `C(n, j)` for `j ≥ 0` and `0` for `j < 0`.
entries.snippet: def zchoose (n : ℕ) (j : ℤ) : ℤ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.zchoose_natCast
entries.snippet: lemma zchoose_natCast (n t : ℕ) : zchoose n t = n.choose t

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.zchoose_of_neg
entries.snippet: lemma zchoose_of_neg {n : ℕ} {j : ℤ} (h : j < 0) : zchoose n j = 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.zchoose_succ
entries.docstring: Pascal's rule `C(n + 1, j) = C(n, j) + C(n, j - 1)` for all integers `j`.
entries.snippet: lemma zchoose_succ (n : ℕ) (j : ℤ) : zchoose (n + 1) j = zchoose n j + zchoose n (j - 1)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sum_range_choose_succ_mul
entries.docstring: Pascal's rule inside a binomial sum.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_range_choose_succ_mul (f : ℕ → ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (k + 1 + 1), ((k + 1).choose a : ℤ) * f a =
      ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose a : ℤ) * f a +
        ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose a : ℤ) * f (a + 1)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.racahL
entries.docstring:
`L(k, α, s) = Σ_a (-1)^a C(k, a) C(r + k - a, α - a) C(p + a, s + a)`: the sum `cgSum` after
dividing out factorials.
entries.snippet: def racahL (r p k : ℕ) (α s : ℤ) : ℤ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.racahR
entries.docstring:
`R(k, α, s) = Σ_z (-1)^z C(k, z) C(r, α - z) C(p, s + z)`: Racah's sum after dividing out
factorials.
entries.snippet: def racahR (r p k : ℕ) (α s : ℤ) : ℤ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.racahL_succ
entries.snippet:
lemma racahL_succ (r p k : ℕ) (α s : ℤ) :
    racahL r p (k + 1) α s = racahL r p k α s - racahL r p k (α - 1) (s + 1)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.racahR_succ
entries.snippet:
lemma racahR_succ (r p k : ℕ) (α s : ℤ) :
    racahR r p (k + 1) α s = racahR r p k α s - racahR r p k (α - 1) (s + 1)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.racahL_eq_racahR
entries.docstring:
**The transformation.** `L = R`, by induction on `k`: both satisfy
`X(k + 1, α, s) = X(k, α, s) - X(k, α - 1, s + 1)` and agree for `k = 0`.
entries.snippet: lemma racahL_eq_racahR (r p k : ℕ) (α s : ℤ) : racahL r p k α s = racahR r p k α s

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.racahSum
entries.docstring:
Racah's alternating sum
`Σ_z (-1)^z / (z! (k - z)! (α - z)! (n - β - z)! (m - k - α + z)! (β - k + z)!)`
over the `z` for which all six arguments are nonnegative. In spin notation the arguments are
`z`, `j₁ + j₂ - J - z`, `j₁ - m₁ - z`, `j₂ + m₂ - z`, `J - j₂ + m₁ + z` and `J - j₁ - m₂ + z`.
entries.snippet: def racahSum (m n k α β : ℕ) : ℝ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgSum_eq_racahL
entries.snippet:
lemma cgSum_eq_racahL {k l α β : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) (hα : α ≤ m) (hβ : β ≤ n)
    (h : α + β = k + l) :
    cgSum m n k l α = (l.factorial : ℝ) * (m - α).factorial * (n - β).factorial *
      (racahL (m - k) (n - k) k α ((l : ℤ) - α) : ℝ)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.racahR_eq_racahSum
entries.snippet:
lemma racahR_eq_racahSum {k l α β : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) (h : α + β = k + l) :
    (racahR (m - k) (n - k) k α ((l : ℤ) - α) : ℝ) =
      (k.factorial : ℝ) * (m - k).factorial * (n - k).factorial * racahSum m n k α β

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgSum_eq_racahSum
entries.docstring: `cgSum = l! (m - α)! (n - β)! · k! (m - k)! (n - k)! · racahSum`.
entries.snippet:
lemma cgSum_eq_racahSum {k l α β : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) (hα : α ≤ m) (hβ : β ≤ n)
    (h : α + β = k + l) :
    cgSum m n k l α = (l.factorial : ℝ) * (m - α).factorial * (n - β).factorial *
      ((k.factorial : ℝ) * (m - k).factorial * (n - k).factorial) * racahSum m n k α β

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgCoefficient_racah
entries.docstring:
**Racah's formula.** For `α + β = k + l`, with `j₁ = m/2`, `m₁ = j₁ - α`, `j₂ = n/2`,
`m₂ = j₂ - β`, `J = (m + n)/2 - k`, `M = J - l`,
`⟨j₁ m₁ j₂ m₂ | J M⟩ = √((2J + 1) (J + j₁ - j₂)! (J - j₁ + j₂)! (j₁ + j₂ - J)! / (j₁ + j₂ + J + 1)!)
  · √((J + M)! (J - M)! (j₁ - m₁)! (j₁ + m₁)! (j₂ - m₂)! (j₂ + m₂)!) · racahSum`.
entries.snippet:
lemma cgCoefficient_racah {k l α β : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (hl : l ≤ m + n - 2 * k) (hα : α ≤ m) (hβ : β ≤ n) (h : α + β = k + l) :
    cgCoefficient m n k l α β =
      Real.sqrt (((m + n - 2 * k + 1) * (m - k).factorial * (n - k).factorial * k.factorial : ℕ) /
        ((m + n - k + 1).factorial : ℝ)) *
      Real.sqrt (((m + n - 2 * k - l).factorial * l.factorial * α.factorial * (m - α).factorial *
        β.factorial * (n - β).factorial : ℕ) : ℝ) * racahSum m n k α β

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.embed
entries.docstring:
The isometric embedding `V(m + n - 2k) → V(m) ⊗ V(n)` onto the `k`-th irreducible component,
`u_l ↦ |J, J - l⟩`.

def embed : StandardSl2Module ℝ (m + n - 2 * (k : ℕ)) →ₗ[ℝ]

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgEquiv_symm_sumVec

lemma cgEquiv_symm_sumVec (l : ℕ) :

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.embed_vNat

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorE_embed

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorForm_embed

lemma tensorForm_embed (x y : StandardSl2Module ℝ (m + n - 2 * (k : ℕ))) :

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorForm_embed_of_ne

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.Triple

PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.invForm_ρF_apply

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tripleForm_tripleF

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tripleForm_tripleE

lemma tripleForm_tripleE (u v : Triple a b c) :

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tripleForm_assoc_symm
entries.snippet:
lemma tripleForm_assoc_symm (x x' : StandardSl2Module ℝ a)
    (w w' : StandardSl2Module ℝ b ⊗[ℝ] StandardSl2Module ℝ c) :
    tripleForm a b c ((TensorProduct.assoc ℝ _ _ _).symm (x ⊗ₜ w))
      ((TensorProduct.assoc ℝ _ _ _).symm (x' ⊗ₜ w')) = invForm ℝ a x x' * tensorForm b c w w'

entries.snippet:
lemma tripleF_assoc_symm (x : StandardSl2Module ℝ a)
    (w : StandardSl2Module ℝ b ⊗[ℝ] StandardSl2Module ℝ c) :
    tripleF a b c ((TensorProduct.assoc ℝ _ _ _).symm (x ⊗ₜ w)) =
      (TensorProduct.assoc ℝ _ _ _).symm (ρF x ⊗ₜ w + x ⊗ₜ tensorF b c w)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorCas

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tensorCas_stringVec
entries.docstring: `2 J² = N(N + 2)/2 = 2 J(J + 1)` on the `k`-th string, `N = m + n - 2k`.
entries.snippet:
lemma tensorCas_stringVec {k : ℕ} (hmn : 0 < m + n) (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) (l : ℕ) :
    tensorCas m n (stringVec m n k l) =
      (((m + n - 2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ) * (((m + n - 2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) / 2) • stringVec m n k l

    tensorCas m n (coupledVec m n k l) =
      (((m + n - 2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ) * (((m + n - 2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) / 2) • coupledVec m n k l

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.wigner3j_cycle
entries.docstring:
`(j₁ j₂ J; m₁ m₂ -M) = (j₂ J j₁; m₂ -M m₁)` in the parameters of
`ClebschGordanCoefficients`: the new triple is `(n, m + n - 2k)` with `k' = n - k`, `l' = m - α`,
`α' = β` and `β' = m + n - 2k - l`.
entries.snippet:
lemma wigner3j_cycle {k l α β : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) (hl : l ≤ m + n - 2 * k)
    (hα : α ≤ m) (hβ : β ≤ n) :
    wigner3j m n k l α β =
      wigner3j n (m + n - 2 * k) (n - k) (m - α) β (m + n - 2 * k - l)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sum_sq_cgCoefficient_initial
entries.docstring:
**Sum rule for multipole transitions.** With `j₁ = m/2 = J_i`, `j₂ = n/2 = λ`,
`J = (m + n)/2 - k = J_f` and `m₁ = j₁ - α = M_i`,
`Σ_{μ M_f} ⟨J_i M_i λ μ | J_f M_f⟩² = (2J_f + 1) / (2J_i + 1)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_sq_cgCoefficient_initial (hmn : 0 < m + n) {k α : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (hα : α ≤ m) :
    ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + n - 2 * k + 1),
      cgCoefficient m n k l α b ^ 2 = ((m + n - 2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.normSq
entries.docstring: The squared norm `⟨v_a, v_a⟩ = a! · n!/(n - a)!` of the basis vector `v_a` of `V(n)`.

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.normSq_succ
entries.snippet: lemma normSq_succ (n a : ℕ) : normSq n (a + 1) = normSq n a * ((a + 1) * (n - a))

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.normSq_pos
entries.snippet: lemma normSq_pos {n a : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ n) : 0 < normSq n a

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.invForm

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.invForm_v
entries.snippet:
lemma invForm_v (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    invForm K n (v i) (v j) = if i = j then (normSq n i : K) else 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.invForm_vNat
entries.snippet:
lemma invForm_vNat (a b : ℕ) :
    invForm K n (vNat n a) (vNat n b) = if a = b ∧ a ≤ n then (normSq n a : K) else 0
