entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.normVec
entries.docstring:
The normalised basis vector `u_a = v_a / √(normSq n a)` of `V(n)` over `ℝ`; for `a ≤ n` it
is the state `|j, m⟩` with `j = n/2`, `m = j - a`.
entries.snippet: def normVec (n a : ℕ) : StandardSl2Module ℝ n

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sqrt_normSq_succ
entries.snippet:
lemma sqrt_normSq_succ (n a : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt (normSq n (a + 1)) =
      Real.sqrt (normSq n a) * Real.sqrt (((a : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) - a))

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.invForm_normVec
entries.docstring: Orthonormality: `⟨u_a, u_b⟩ = δ_ab` for `a, b ≤ n`.
entries.snippet:
lemma invForm_normVec {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ n) (hb : b ≤ n) :
    invForm ℝ n (normVec n a) (normVec n b) = if a = b then 1 else 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.ρH_normVec
entries.docstring:
The weight operator on the normalised basis: `h u_a = (n - 2a) u_a`, i.e.
`Jz |j, m⟩ = m |j, m⟩`.
entries.snippet:
lemma ρH_normVec (a : ℕ) :
    (ρH : Module.End ℝ (StandardSl2Module ℝ n)) (normVec n a) =
      ((n : ℝ) - 2 * a) • normVec n a

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.ρF_normVec
entries.docstring:
The lowering operator on the normalised basis: `f u_a = √((a+1)(n-a)) u_{a+1}` for `a < n`,
i.e. `J₋ |j, m⟩ = √((j + m)(j - m + 1)) |j, m - 1⟩`.
entries.snippet:
lemma ρF_normVec {a : ℕ} (ha : a < n) :
    (ρF : Module.End ℝ (StandardSl2Module ℝ n)) (normVec n a) =
      Real.sqrt (((a : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) - a)) • normVec n (a + 1)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.ρE_normVec_succ
entries.docstring:
The raising operator on the normalised basis: `e u_{a+1} = √((a+1)(n-a)) u_a` for `a < n`,
i.e. `J₊ |j, m⟩ = √((j - m)(j + m + 1)) |j, m + 1⟩`.
entries.snippet:
lemma ρE_normVec_succ {a : ℕ} (ha : a < n) :
    (ρE : Module.End ℝ (StandardSl2Module ℝ n)) (normVec n (a + 1)) =
      Real.sqrt (((a : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) - a)) • normVec n a

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.IsTensorIntertwiner.exists_eq_smul_of_ne_zero
entries.docstring:
Two tensor intertwiners into the same `V(p)` are proportional, provided the second one is
nonzero.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsTensorIntertwiner.exists_eq_smul_of_ne_zero (hmn : 0 < m + n)
    {φ ψ : StandardSl2Module K m ⊗[K] StandardSl2Module K n →ₗ[K] StandardSl2Module K p}
    (hφ : IsTensorIntertwiner φ) (hψ : IsTensorIntertwiner ψ) (hψ0 : ψ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ c : K, φ = c • ψ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.IsTensorOperator.exists_eq_smul_of_ne_zero
entries.docstring:
Two tensor operators of rank `k` from `V(m)` to `V(p)` are proportional, provided the second
one is nonzero.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsTensorOperator.exists_eq_smul_of_ne_zero (hkm : 0 < k + m)
    {T S : StandardSl2Module K k →ₗ[K] StandardSl2Module K m →ₗ[K] StandardSl2Module K p}
    (hT : IsTensorOperator T) (hS : IsTensorOperator S) (hS0 : S ≠ 0) :
    ∃ c : K, T = c • S

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sl2Operator
entries.docstring:
The `sl₂` action on `V(n)` as a tensor operator of rank 2: `v_0 ↦ e`, `v_1 ↦ -h`,
`v_2 ↦ -2f`. These are the spherical components of the angular momentum, up to normalisation.
entries.snippet: def sl2Operator : StandardSl2Module K 2 →ₗ[K] Module.End K (StandardSl2Module K n)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sl2Operator_vNat_zero
entries.snippet: lemma sl2Operator_vNat_zero : sl2Operator (K := K) n (vNat 2 0) = ρE

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sl2Operator_vNat_one
entries.snippet: lemma sl2Operator_vNat_one : sl2Operator (K := K) n (vNat 2 1) = (-1 : K) • ρH

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sl2Operator_vNat_two
entries.snippet: lemma sl2Operator_vNat_two : sl2Operator (K := K) n (vNat 2 2) = (-2 : K) • ρF

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sl2Operator_vNat_of_lt
entries.snippet: lemma sl2Operator_vNat_of_lt {l : ℕ} (hl : 2 < l) : sl2Operator (K := K) n (vNat 2 l) = 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.ρE_mul_ρF'
entries.snippet: lemma ρE_mul_ρF' : (ρE : Module.End K (StandardSl2Module K n)) * ρF = ρF * ρE + ρH

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.ρH_mul_ρE'
entries.snippet: lemma ρH_mul_ρE' : (ρH : Module.End K (StandardSl2Module K n)) * ρE = ρE * ρH + (2 : K) • ρE

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.ρH_mul_ρF'
entries.snippet: lemma ρH_mul_ρF' : (ρH : Module.End K (StandardSl2Module K n)) * ρF = ρF * ρH - (2 : K) • ρF

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.ρE_vNat_two_one
entries.snippet:
lemma ρE_vNat_two_one : (ρE : Module.End K (StandardSl2Module K 2)) (vNat 2 1) =
    (2 : K) • vNat 2 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.ρE_vNat_two_two
entries.snippet:
lemma ρE_vNat_two_two : (ρE : Module.End K (StandardSl2Module K 2)) (vNat 2 2) =
    (2 : K) • vNat 2 1

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.ρH_vNat_two_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma ρH_vNat_two_zero : (ρH : Module.End K (StandardSl2Module K 2)) (vNat 2 0) =
    (2 : K) • vNat 2 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.ρH_vNat_two_one
entries.snippet: lemma ρH_vNat_two_one : (ρH : Module.End K (StandardSl2Module K 2)) (vNat 2 1) = 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.ρH_vNat_two_two
entries.snippet:
lemma ρH_vNat_two_two : (ρH : Module.End K (StandardSl2Module K 2)) (vNat 2 2) =
    (-2 : K) • vNat 2 2

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.comm_of_vNat
entries.docstring:
A commutation relation `[Y, A x] = A (X x)` for a linear `A` holds for all `x` once it holds
on the coordinate vectors.

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.isTensorOperator_sl2Operator
entries.docstring: The `sl₂` action is a tensor operator of rank 2 on every `V(n)`.
entries.snippet: lemma isTensorOperator_sl2Operator : IsTensorOperator (sl2Operator (K := K) n) where

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sl2Operator_ne_zero
entries.docstring: On `V(n)` with `n > 0` the `sl₂` action is a nonzero tensor operator.
entries.snippet: lemma sl2Operator_ne_zero (hn : 0 < n) : sl2Operator (K := K) n ≠ 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.IsTensorOperator.exists_eq_smul_sl2Operator
entries.docstring:
**Projection theorem.** Every vector operator (tensor operator of rank 2) on the multiplet
`V(n)` is a scalar multiple of the angular momentum `sl2Operator n`.

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.TriangleRule
entries.docstring:
The triangle rule in doubled units: `p ≤ k + m`, `k ≤ m + p`, `m ≤ k + p` and `k + m + p`
even. For `k = 2λ`, `m = 2Iᵢ`, `p = 2I_f` this is `|Iᵢ - I_f| ≤ λ ≤ Iᵢ + I_f` with
`Iᵢ + I_f + λ` an integer.
entries.snippet: def TriangleRule (k m p : ℕ) : Prop

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.«instance@f3105477»
entries.snippet: instance (k m p : ℕ) : Decidable (TriangleRule k m p)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.exists_eq_iff_triangleRule
entries.docstring:
`p` occurs in the Clebsch–Gordan decomposition of `V(k) ⊗ V(m)` exactly when the triangle
rule holds.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_eq_iff_triangleRule {k m p : ℕ} :
    (∃ j : Fin (min k m + 1), k + m - 2 * (j : ℕ) = p) ↔ TriangleRule k m p

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.IsTensorOperator.triangleRule
entries.docstring:
**Triangle rule.** A nonzero tensor operator of rank `k` from `V(m)` to `V(p)` satisfies
`TriangleRule k m p`.

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.parity_eq_of_ne_zero
entries.docstring:
**Parity rule.** If a linear map between states of definite parities `πᵢ` and `π_f` has
parity `π_T`, in the sense `π_f • T = π_T • πᵢ • T`, and is nonzero, then `π_f = π_T * πᵢ`.

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.MultipoleType
entries.docstring: Electric and magnetic multipoles.
entries.snippet:
inductive MultipoleType
  | electric
  | magnetic
  deriving DecidableEq

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.MultipoleType.parity
entries.docstring: The parity of a multipole operator of order `λ`: `(-1)^λ` for `Eλ`, `(-1)^(λ+1)` for `Mλ`.
entries.snippet:
def MultipoleType.parity : MultipoleType → ℕ → ℤ
  | .electric, l => (-1) ^ l
  | .magnetic, l => (-1) ^ (l + 1)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.IsAllowedMultipole
entries.docstring:
A multipole transition of type `t` and order `l` between a state of spin `Iᵢ` and parity
`πᵢ` and a state of spin `I_f` and parity `π_f` (spins in doubled units `twoIi = 2Iᵢ`,
`twoIf = 2I_f`) is allowed if `l ≥ 1`, the triangle rule holds and the parities match.
entries.snippet: def IsAllowedMultipole (twoIi twoIf : ℕ) (πi πf : ℤ) (t : MultipoleType) (l : ℕ) : Prop

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.«instance@657547d6»
entries.snippet:
instance (twoIi twoIf : ℕ) (πi πf : ℤ) (t : MultipoleType) (l : ℕ) :
    Decidable (IsAllowedMultipole twoIi twoIf πi πf t l)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.hf178_primary_branches_allowed
entries.docstring:
The three branches depopulating the `16⁺` isomer are allowed: `E3` to `13⁻`, `M4` to `12⁻`,
`E5` to `11⁻`.
entries.snippet:
lemma hf178_primary_branches_allowed :
    IsAllowedMultipole 32 26 1 (-1) .electric 3 ∧ IsAllowedMultipole 32 24 1 (-1) .magnetic 4 ∧
      IsAllowedMultipole 32 22 1 (-1) .electric 5

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.hf178_E3_lowest
entries.docstring: `E3` is the lowest allowed multipole for `16⁺ → 13⁻`.
entries.snippet:
lemma hf178_E3_lowest : ∀ l < 3, ¬ IsAllowedMultipole 32 26 1 (-1) .electric l ∧
    ¬ IsAllowedMultipole 32 26 1 (-1) .magnetic l

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.hf178_M4_lowest
entries.docstring: `M4` is the lowest allowed multipole for `16⁺ → 12⁻`; `E4` is forbidden by parity.
entries.snippet:
lemma hf178_M4_lowest : (∀ l < 4, ¬ IsAllowedMultipole 32 24 1 (-1) .electric l ∧
    ¬ IsAllowedMultipole 32 24 1 (-1) .magnetic l) ∧
    ¬ IsAllowedMultipole 32 24 1 (-1) .electric 4

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.hf178_E5_lowest
entries.docstring: `E5` is the lowest allowed multipole for `16⁺ → 11⁻`.
entries.snippet:
lemma hf178_E5_lowest : (∀ l < 5, ¬ IsAllowedMultipole 32 22 1 (-1) .electric l ∧
    ¬ IsAllowedMultipole 32 22 1 (-1) .magnetic l) ∧
    ¬ IsAllowedMultipole 32 22 1 (-1) .magnetic 5

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.hf178_E1_8minus
entries.docstring: The `8⁻ → 8⁺` decay of the `4 s` isomer is `E1`, and `M1` is forbidden by parity.
entries.snippet:
lemma hf178_E1_8minus : IsAllowedMultipole 16 16 (-1) 1 .electric 1 ∧
    ¬ IsAllowedMultipole 16 16 (-1) 1 .magnetic 1

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tripleH_stateA
entries.snippet:
lemma tripleH_stateA (l : ℕ) :
    tripleH a b c (stateA hab k₁ k₂ l) =
      (((a + b - 2 * (k₁ : ℕ) + c - 2 * k₂ : ℕ) : ℝ) - 2 * l) • stateA hab k₁ k₂ l

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tripleCas_stateA
entries.snippet:
lemma tripleCas_stateA (l : ℕ) :
    tripleCas a b c (stateA hab k₁ k₂ l) =
      (((a + b - 2 * (k₁ : ℕ) + c - 2 * k₂ : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (((a + b - 2 * (k₁ : ℕ) + c - 2 * k₂ : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) / 2) • stateA hab k₁ k₂ l

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tripleF_stateA
entries.snippet:
lemma tripleF_stateA {l : ℕ} (hl : l < a + b - 2 * (k₁ : ℕ) + c - 2 * k₂) :
    tripleF a b c (stateA hab k₁ k₂ l) =
      Real.sqrt (((l : ℝ) + 1) * (((a + b - 2 * (k₁ : ℕ) + c - 2 * k₂ : ℕ) : ℝ) - l)) •
        stateA hab k₁ k₂ (l + 1)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tripleH_stateB
entries.snippet:
lemma tripleH_stateB (l : ℕ) :
    tripleH a b c (stateB hbc k₃ k₄ l) =
      (((a + (b + c - 2 * (k₃ : ℕ)) - 2 * k₄ : ℕ) : ℝ) - 2 * l) • stateB hbc k₃ k₄ l

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tripleCas_stateB
entries.snippet:
lemma tripleCas_stateB (l : ℕ) :
    tripleCas a b c (stateB hbc k₃ k₄ l) =
      (((a + (b + c - 2 * (k₃ : ℕ)) - 2 * k₄ : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (((a + (b + c - 2 * (k₃ : ℕ)) - 2 * k₄ : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) / 2) • stateB hbc k₃ k₄ l

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tripleE_stateB_succ
entries.snippet:
lemma tripleE_stateB_succ {l : ℕ} (hl : l < a + (b + c - 2 * (k₃ : ℕ)) - 2 * k₄) :
    tripleE a b c (stateB hbc k₃ k₄ (l + 1)) =
      Real.sqrt (((l : ℝ) + 1) * (((a + (b + c - 2 * (k₃ : ℕ)) - 2 * k₄ : ℕ) : ℝ) - l)) •
        stateB hbc k₃ k₄ l

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tripleForm_stateB_self
entries.snippet:
lemma tripleForm_stateB_self {l : ℕ} (hl : l ≤ a + (b + c - 2 * (k₃ : ℕ)) - 2 * k₄) :
    tripleForm a b c (stateB hbc k₃ k₄ l) (stateB hbc k₃ k₄ l) = 1

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tripleForm_stateB_of_ne
entries.snippet:
lemma tripleForm_stateB_of_ne {k₃' : Fin (min b c + 1)} (hk : k₃ ≠ k₃') (k₄' l l' : ℕ) :
    tripleForm a b c (stateB hbc k₃ k₄ l) (stateB hbc k₃' k₄' l') = 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.eq_sum_of_orthonormal
entries.docstring: An orthonormal family of `finrank` many vectors expands every vector.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_sum_of_orthonormal {ι M : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module ℝ M] (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ M) (v : ι → M)
    (hv : ∀ i j, B (v i) (v j) = if i = j then 1 else 0)
    (hcard : Fintype.card ι = Module.finrank ℝ M) (x : M) :
    x = ∑ i, B (v i) x • v i

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.IndexA
entries.docstring: The index set `(k₁, k₂, l)` of the first coupling scheme.
entries.snippet: abbrev IndexA : Type

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.«instance@10b7218b»
entries.snippet: instance : Nonempty (IndexA a b c)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.vecA
entries.docstring: The states of the first coupling scheme, as a family indexed by `IndexA`.
entries.snippet: def vecA (hab : 0 < a + b) (i : IndexA a b c) : Triple a b c

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.card_indexA
entries.snippet: lemma card_indexA : Fintype.card (IndexA a b c) = Module.finrank ℝ (Triple a b c)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tripleForm_vecA
entries.snippet:
lemma tripleForm_vecA (hab : 0 < a + b) (hc : 0 < c) (i j : IndexA a b c) :
    tripleForm a b c (vecA hab i) (vecA hab j) = if i = j then 1 else 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.eq_sum_vecA
entries.docstring: **Completeness.** The states `|(j₁ j₂) j₁₂, j₃; J, M⟩` form an orthonormal basis.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_sum_vecA (hab : 0 < a + b) (hc : 0 < c) (x : Triple a b c) :
    x = ∑ i, tripleForm a b c (vecA hab i) x • vecA hab i

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.nat_eq_of_mul_add_two_eq
entries.snippet: lemma nat_eq_of_mul_add_two_eq {p q : ℕ} (h : p * (p + 2) = q * (q + 2)) : p = q

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tripleForm_stateA_stateB_eq_zero
entries.docstring: States of different total `J` or different `M` are orthogonal.
entries.snippet:
lemma tripleForm_stateA_stateB_eq_zero (hab : 0 < a + b) (hbc : 0 < b + c) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hc : 0 < c) {k₁ : Fin (min a b + 1)} {k₃ : Fin (min b c + 1)} {k₂ k₄ l' l : ℕ}
    (h₁ : k₂ ≤ a + b - 2 * (k₁ : ℕ)) (h₂ : k₂ ≤ c) (h₃ : k₄ ≤ a)
    (h₄ : k₄ ≤ b + c - 2 * (k₃ : ℕ)) (h : ¬((k₁ : ℕ) + k₂ = k₃ + k₄ ∧ l' = l)) :
    tripleForm a b c (stateA hab k₁ k₂ l') (stateB hbc k₃ k₄ l) = 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.ValidA
entries.docstring: `k₁` gives an admissible intermediate `j₁₂` for the total `J = (a + b + c)/2 - K`.
entries.snippet: abbrev ValidA (K k₁ : ℕ) : Prop

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.ValidB
entries.docstring: `k₃` gives an admissible intermediate `j₂₃` for the total `J = (a + b + c)/2 - K`.
entries.snippet: abbrev ValidB (K k₃ : ℕ) : Prop

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.recoupling
entries.docstring:
The recoupling coefficient `⟨(j₁ j₂) j₁₂, j₃; J M | j₁, (j₂ j₃) j₂₃; J M⟩` with
`J = (a + b + c)/2 - K`, `M = J - l`, `j₁₂ = (a + b)/2 - k₁` and `j₂₃ = (b + c)/2 - k₃`.
entries.snippet:
def recoupling (hab : 0 < a + b) (hbc : 0 < b + c) (K l : ℕ) (k₁ : Fin (min a b + 1))
    (k₃ : Fin (min b c + 1)) : ℝ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.recoupling_succ
entries.snippet:
lemma recoupling_succ (hab : 0 < a + b) (hbc : 0 < b + c) (ha : 0 < a) {K l : ℕ}
    {k₁ : Fin (min a b + 1)} {k₃ : Fin (min b c + 1)} (hA : ValidA a b c K k₁)
    (hB : ValidB a b c K k₃) (hl : l < a + b + c - 2 * K) :
    recoupling hab hbc K (l + 1) k₁ k₃ = recoupling hab hbc K l k₁ k₃

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.recoupling_eq_recoupling_zero
entries.docstring: The recoupling coefficients do not depend on `M`.
entries.snippet:
lemma recoupling_eq_recoupling_zero (hab : 0 < a + b) (hbc : 0 < b + c) (ha : 0 < a)
    {K l : ℕ} {k₁ : Fin (min a b + 1)} {k₃ : Fin (min b c + 1)} (hA : ValidA a b c K k₁)
    (hB : ValidB a b c K k₃) (hl : l ≤ a + b + c - 2 * K) :
    recoupling hab hbc K l k₁ k₃ = recoupling hab hbc K 0 k₁ k₃

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sum_recoupling_mul_recoupling
entries.docstring:
**Orthogonality of the recoupling coefficients.** For fixed `J` and `M`,
`Σ_{j₁₂} ⟨(j₁ j₂) j₁₂, j₃; J M | j₁, (j₂ j₃) j₂₃; J M⟩ ⟨(j₁ j₂) j₁₂, j₃; J M |
j₁, (j₂ j₃) j₂₃'; J M⟩ = δ_{j₂₃ j₂₃'}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_recoupling_mul_recoupling (hab : 0 < a + b) (hbc : 0 < b + c) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hc : 0 < c) {K l : ℕ} (hl : l ≤ a + b + c - 2 * K) {k₃ k₃' : Fin (min b c + 1)}
    (hB : ValidB a b c K k₃) (hB' : ValidB a b c K k₃') :
    ∑ k₁ : Fin (min a b + 1), (if ValidA a b c K k₁ then
      recoupling hab hbc K l k₁ k₃ * recoupling hab hbc K l k₁ k₃' else 0) =
        if k₃ = k₃' then 1 else 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixJ
entries.docstring:
The **6j symbol** `{j₁ j₂ j₁₂; j₃ J j₂₃}`, with `j₁ = a/2`, `j₂ = b/2`, `j₃ = c/2`,
`j₁₂ = (a + b)/2 - k₁`, `j₂₃ = (b + c)/2 - k₃` and `J = (a + b + c)/2 - K`, defined through
`⟨(j₁ j₂) j₁₂, j₃; J | j₁, (j₂ j₃) j₂₃; J⟩ = (-1)^(j₁ + j₂ + j₃ + J) √((2j₁₂ + 1)(2j₂₃ + 1)) {6j}`
(`j₁ + j₂ + j₃ + J = a + b + c - K`), and zero for inadmissible arguments.
entries.snippet:
def sixJ (hab : 0 < a + b) (hbc : 0 < b + c) (K : ℕ) (k₁ : Fin (min a b + 1))
    (k₃ : Fin (min b c + 1)) : ℝ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.recoupling_eq_sixJ
entries.docstring: The recoupling coefficients in terms of the 6j symbols, for every `M`.
entries.snippet:
lemma recoupling_eq_sixJ (hab : 0 < a + b) (hbc : 0 < b + c) (ha : 0 < a) {K l : ℕ}
    {k₁ : Fin (min a b + 1)} {k₃ : Fin (min b c + 1)} (hA : ValidA a b c K k₁)
    (hB : ValidB a b c K k₃) (hl : l ≤ a + b + c - 2 * K) :
    recoupling hab hbc K l k₁ k₃ = (-1) ^ (a + b + c - K) *
      Real.sqrt (((a + b - 2 * (k₁ : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((b + c - 2 * (k₃ : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        sixJ hab hbc K k₁ k₃

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.mul_mul_div_mul_div_sqrt
entries.snippet:
lemma mul_mul_div_mul_div_sqrt {s U U' p₁ p₃ p₃' : ℝ} (hs : s * s = 1) (h₁ : 0 < p₁) :
    p₁ * p₃ * (s * U / Real.sqrt (p₁ * p₃)) * (s * U' / Real.sqrt (p₁ * p₃')) =
      Real.sqrt p₃ / Real.sqrt p₃' * (U * U')

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sum_sixJ_mul_sixJ
entries.docstring:
**Orthogonality of the 6j symbols.**
`Σ_{j₁₂} (2j₁₂ + 1)(2j₂₃ + 1) {j₁ j₂ j₁₂; j₃ J j₂₃} {j₁ j₂ j₁₂; j₃ J j₂₃'} = δ_{j₂₃ j₂₃'}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_sixJ_mul_sixJ (hab : 0 < a + b) (hbc : 0 < b + c) (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c)
    {K : ℕ} {k₃ k₃' : Fin (min b c + 1)} (hB : ValidB a b c K k₃)
    (hB' : ValidB a b c K k₃') :
    ∑ k₁ : Fin (min a b + 1), ((a + b - 2 * (k₁ : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      ((b + c - 2 * (k₃ : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * sixJ hab hbc K k₁ k₃ * sixJ hab hbc K k₁ k₃' =
        if k₃ = k₃' then 1 else 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.Adm3
entries.docstring:
Admissibility of `(j₁ j₂ j₃; m₁ m₂ m₃)` in doubled units: the projections add up to zero,
`|mᵢ| ≤ jᵢ`, `jᵢ - mᵢ` is even and the triangle condition holds with even perimeter.
entries.snippet: abbrev Adm3 (j₁ j₂ j₃ : ℕ) (m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℤ) : Prop

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.reggeJ
entries.docstring: The Regge square of `(j₁ j₂ j₃; m₁ m₂ m₃)` in doubled units.
entries.snippet: def reggeJ (j₁ j₂ j₃ : ℕ) (m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℤ) : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℕ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.threeJ
entries.docstring:
The **3j symbol** `(j₁ j₂ j₃; m₁ m₂ m₃)` with `jᵢ` and `mᵢ` given in doubled units, zero for
inadmissible arguments.
entries.snippet: def threeJ (j₁ j₂ j₃ : ℕ) (m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℤ) : ℝ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.threeJ_of_not
entries.snippet: lemma threeJ_of_not (h : ¬Adm3 j₁ j₂ j₃ m₁ m₂ m₃) : threeJ j₁ j₂ j₃ m₁ m₂ m₃ = 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.adm3_of_threeJ_ne_zero
entries.snippet: lemma adm3_of_threeJ_ne_zero (h : threeJ j₁ j₂ j₃ m₁ m₂ m₃ ≠ 0) : Adm3 j₁ j₂ j₃ m₁ m₂ m₃

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.isMagic_reggeJ
entries.snippet: lemma isMagic_reggeJ (h : Adm3 j₁ j₂ j₃ m₁ m₂ m₃) : IsMagic (reggeJ j₁ j₂ j₃ m₁ m₂ m₃)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.reggeJ_row_sum
entries.snippet:
lemma reggeJ_row_sum (h : Adm3 j₁ j₂ j₃ m₁ m₂ m₃) :
    reggeJ j₁ j₂ j₃ m₁ m₂ m₃ 0 0 + reggeJ j₁ j₂ j₃ m₁ m₂ m₃ 0 1 +
      reggeJ j₁ j₂ j₃ m₁ m₂ m₃ 0 2 = (j₁ + j₂ + j₃) / 2

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.threeJ_swap
entries.docstring:
Exchange of the first two columns:
`(j₂ j₁ j₃; m₂ m₁ m₃) = (-1)^(j₁+j₂+j₃) (j₁ j₂ j₃; m₁ m₂ m₃)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma threeJ_swap (j₁ j₂ j₃ : ℕ) (m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℤ) :
    threeJ j₂ j₁ j₃ m₂ m₁ m₃ = (-1) ^ ((j₁ + j₂ + j₃) / 2) * threeJ j₁ j₂ j₃ m₁ m₂ m₃

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.threeJ_cycle
entries.docstring: Cyclic permutation of the columns: `(j₂ j₃ j₁; m₂ m₃ m₁) = (j₁ j₂ j₃; m₁ m₂ m₃)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma threeJ_cycle (j₁ j₂ j₃ : ℕ) (m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℤ) :
    threeJ j₂ j₃ j₁ m₂ m₃ m₁ = threeJ j₁ j₂ j₃ m₁ m₂ m₃

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.threeJ_neg
entries.docstring:
Reversal of the projections:
`(j₁ j₂ j₃; -m₁ -m₂ -m₃) = (-1)^(j₁+j₂+j₃) (j₁ j₂ j₃; m₁ m₂ m₃)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma threeJ_neg (j₁ j₂ j₃ : ℕ) (m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℤ) :
    threeJ j₁ j₂ j₃ (-m₁) (-m₂) (-m₃) = (-1) ^ ((j₁ + j₂ + j₃) / 2) * threeJ j₁ j₂ j₃ m₁ m₂ m₃

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.wigner3j_eq_threeJ
entries.docstring: The 3j symbols of `Wigner3j` in terms of `threeJ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma wigner3j_eq_threeJ {m n k l α β : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (hl : l ≤ m + n - 2 * k) (hα : α ≤ m) (hβ : β ≤ n) :
    wigner3j m n k l α β = threeJ m n (m + n - 2 * k) ((m : ℤ) - 2 * α) ((n : ℤ) - 2 * β)
      (-(((m + n - 2 * k : ℕ) : ℤ) - 2 * l))

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixJTerm
entries.docstring:
The summand of `sixJSym`:
`(-1)^(Σ (jᵢ - mᵢ)) (j₁ j₂ j₃; -m₁ -m₂ -m₃) (j₁ j₅ j₆; m₁ -m₅ m₆) (j₄ j₂ j₆; m₄ m₂ -m₆)
(j₄ j₅ j₃; -m₄ m₅ m₃)`.
entries.snippet: def sixJTerm (j₁ j₂ j₃ j₄ j₅ j₆ : ℕ) (m : Fin 6 → ℤ) : ℝ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixJBox
entries.docstring: The projections `|mᵢ| ≤ jᵢ`.
entries.snippet: def sixJBox (j₁ j₂ j₃ j₄ j₅ j₆ : ℕ) : Finset (Fin 6 → ℤ)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.mem_sixJBox
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_sixJBox {j₁ j₂ j₃ j₄ j₅ j₆ : ℕ} {m : Fin 6 → ℤ} :
    m ∈ sixJBox j₁ j₂ j₃ j₄ j₅ j₆ ↔ (-(j₁ : ℤ) ≤ m 0 ∧ m 0 ≤ j₁) ∧
      (-(j₂ : ℤ) ≤ m 1 ∧ m 1 ≤ j₂) ∧ (-(j₃ : ℤ) ≤ m 2 ∧ m 2 ≤ j₃) ∧
        (-(j₄ : ℤ) ≤ m 3 ∧ m 3 ≤ j₄) ∧ (-(j₅ : ℤ) ≤ m 4 ∧ m 4 ≤ j₅) ∧
          (-(j₆ : ℤ) ≤ m 5 ∧ m 5 ≤ j₆)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixJSym
entries.docstring:
The **6j symbol** `{j₁ j₂ j₃; j₄ j₅ j₆}` (doubled units) as a sum over the projections of
four 3j symbols.
entries.snippet: def sixJSym (j₁ j₂ j₃ j₄ j₅ j₆ : ℕ) : ℝ

PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.prod_four_eq_zero_or

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.term_congr_1324
entries.snippet:
lemma term_congr_1324 {S S' : ℤ} {p q r s : ℕ} {F₁ F₂ F₃ F₄ : ℝ}
    (h : F₁ ≠ 0 → F₂ ≠ 0 → F₃ ≠ 0 → F₄ ≠ 0 → (S' + p + q + r + s) % 2 = S % 2) :
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ S * (F₁ * F₂ * F₃ * F₄) =
      (-1) ^ S' * ((-1) ^ p * F₁ * ((-1) ^ q * F₃) * ((-1) ^ r * F₂) * ((-1) ^ s * F₄))

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.term_congr_1243
entries.snippet:
lemma term_congr_1243 {S S' : ℤ} {p q r s : ℕ} {F₁ F₂ F₃ F₄ : ℝ}
    (h : F₁ ≠ 0 → F₂ ≠ 0 → F₃ ≠ 0 → F₄ ≠ 0 → (S' + p + q + r + s) % 2 = S % 2) :
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ S * (F₁ * F₂ * F₃ * F₄) =
      (-1) ^ S' * ((-1) ^ p * F₁ * ((-1) ^ q * F₂) * ((-1) ^ r * F₄) * ((-1) ^ s * F₃))

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.term_congr_4321
PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.threeJ_swap₂₃
entries.docstring:
Exchange of the last two columns:
`(j₁ j₃ j₂; m₁ m₃ m₂) = (-1)^(j₁+j₂+j₃) (j₁ j₂ j₃; m₁ m₂ m₃)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma threeJ_swap₂₃ (j₁ j₂ j₃ : ℕ) (m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℤ) :
    threeJ j₁ j₃ j₂ m₁ m₃ m₂ = (-1) ^ ((j₁ + j₂ + j₃) / 2) * threeJ j₁ j₂ j₃ m₁ m₂ m₃

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.threeJ_negCycle
entries.docstring: `(j₂ j₃ j₁; -m₂ m₃ -m₁) = (-1)^(j₁+j₂+j₃) (j₁ j₂ j₃; m₁ m₂ -m₃)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma threeJ_negCycle (j₁ j₂ j₃ : ℕ) (x y z : ℤ) :
    threeJ j₂ j₃ j₁ (-y) z (-x) = (-1) ^ ((j₁ + j₂ + j₃) / 2) * threeJ j₁ j₂ j₃ x y (-z)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixJSym_swap₁₂
entries.docstring: Exchange of the first two columns: `{j₂ j₁ j₃; j₅ j₄ j₆} = {j₁ j₂ j₃; j₄ j₅ j₆}`.
entries.snippet: lemma sixJSym_swap₁₂ : sixJSym j₂ j₁ j₃ j₅ j₄ j₆ = sixJSym j₁ j₂ j₃ j₄ j₅ j₆

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixJSym_swap₂₃
entries.docstring: Exchange of the last two columns: `{j₁ j₃ j₂; j₄ j₆ j₅} = {j₁ j₂ j₃; j₄ j₅ j₆}`.
entries.snippet: lemma sixJSym_swap₂₃ : sixJSym j₁ j₃ j₂ j₄ j₆ j₅ = sixJSym j₁ j₂ j₃ j₄ j₅ j₆

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixJSym_flip₁₂
entries.docstring:
Exchange of upper and lower arguments in the first two columns:
`{j₄ j₅ j₃; j₁ j₂ j₆} = {j₁ j₂ j₃; j₄ j₅ j₆}`.
entries.snippet: lemma sixJSym_flip₁₂ : sixJSym j₄ j₅ j₃ j₁ j₂ j₆ = sixJSym j₁ j₂ j₃ j₄ j₅ j₆

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixJSymEdge
entries.docstring:
The 6j symbol as a function of the edge labels of the tetrahedron whose vertices are the four
triads `0 = (j₁ j₂ j₃)`, `1 = (j₁ j₅ j₆)`, `2 = (j₄ j₂ j₆)`, `3 = (j₄ j₅ j₃)`.
entries.snippet: def sixJSymEdge (j : Sym2 (Fin 4) → ℕ) : ℝ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixJSymEdge_comp_map_swap₁₂
entries.snippet:
lemma sixJSymEdge_comp_map_swap₁₂ (j : Sym2 (Fin 4) → ℕ) :
    sixJSymEdge (j ∘ Sym2.map (Equiv.swap 1 2)) = sixJSymEdge j

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixJSymEdge_comp_map_swap₂₃
entries.snippet:
lemma sixJSymEdge_comp_map_swap₂₃ (j : Sym2 (Fin 4) → ℕ) :
    sixJSymEdge (j ∘ Sym2.map (Equiv.swap 2 3)) = sixJSymEdge j

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixJSymEdge_comp_map_flip
entries.snippet:
lemma sixJSymEdge_comp_map_flip (j : Sym2 (Fin 4) → ℕ) :
    sixJSymEdge (j ∘ Sym2.map (Equiv.swap 0 3 * Equiv.swap 1 2 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4))) =
      sixJSymEdge j

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixJSymEdge_comp_map_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma sixJSymEdge_comp_map_mul {σ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)}
    (hσ : ∀ j, sixJSymEdge (j ∘ Sym2.map σ) = sixJSymEdge j)
    (hτ : ∀ j, sixJSymEdge (j ∘ Sym2.map τ) = sixJSymEdge j) (j : Sym2 (Fin 4) → ℕ) :
    sixJSymEdge (j ∘ Sym2.map (σ * τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4))) = sixJSymEdge j

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixJSymEdge_comp_map
entries.docstring:
**Tetrahedral symmetry.** The 6j symbol is invariant under every permutation of the four
triads.
entries.snippet:
lemma sixJSymEdge_comp_map (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (j : Sym2 (Fin 4) → ℕ) :
    sixJSymEdge (j ∘ Sym2.map σ) = sixJSymEdge j

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sym2_map_perm_injective
entries.docstring:
The permutations of the triads act faithfully on the edges, so the symmetries of
`sixJSymEdge_comp_map` are 24 distinct permutations of the arguments.
entries.snippet:
lemma sym2_map_perm_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4) => Sym2.map σ)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.link_congr
entries.snippet:
lemma link_congr {S : ℤ} {p₁ p₂ p₃ p₄ q₁ q₂ q₃ q₄ r : ℕ} {A B C T₁ T₂ T₃ T₄ : ℝ}
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (h : T₁ ≠ 0 → T₂ ≠ 0 → T₃ ≠ 0 → T₄ ≠ 0 →
      (S + p₁ + p₂ + p₃ + p₄ + q₁ + q₂ + q₃ + q₄ + r) % 2 = 0) :
    (-1) ^ p₂ * Real.sqrt B * T₂ * ((-1) ^ p₁ * Real.sqrt A * T₁ *
        ((-1) ^ p₄ * Real.sqrt B * T₄ * ((-1) ^ p₃ * Real.sqrt C * T₃))) =
      Real.sqrt (A * C) * B * (-1) ^ r * ((-1) ^ S *
        ((-1) ^ q₁ * T₁ * ((-1) ^ q₄ * T₄) * ((-1) ^ q₃ * T₃) * ((-1) ^ q₂ * T₂)))

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.tripleForm_normVec_stateB
entries.snippet:
lemma tripleForm_normVec_stateB (hbc : 0 < b + c) (k₃ : Fin (min b c + 1)) (k₄ l : ℕ)
    {α : ℕ} (hα : α ≤ a) (β γ : ℕ) :
    tripleForm a b c ((normVec a α ⊗ₜ normVec b β) ⊗ₜ normVec c γ) (stateB hbc k₃ k₄ l) =
      ∑ ν ∈ Finset.range (b + c - 2 * (k₃ : ℕ) + 1),
        cgCoefficient a (b + c - 2 * (k₃ : ℕ)) k₄ l α ν * cgCoefficient b c k₃ ν β γ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.recoupling_eq_sum
entries.docstring: The recoupling coefficient as a sum over products of four Clebsch–Gordan coefficients.
entries.snippet:
lemma recoupling_eq_sum (hab : 0 < a + b) (hbc : 0 < b + c) (K l : ℕ) (k₁ : Fin (min a b + 1))
    (k₃ : Fin (min b c + 1)) :
    recoupling hab hbc K l k₁ k₃ =
      ∑ μ ∈ Finset.range (a + b - 2 * (k₁ : ℕ) + 1), ∑ γ ∈ Finset.range (c + 1),
        cgCoefficient (a + b - 2 * (k₁ : ℕ)) c (K - k₁) l μ γ *
          ∑ α ∈ Finset.range (a + 1), ∑ β ∈ Finset.range (b + 1),
            cgCoefficient a b k₁ μ α β *
              ∑ ν ∈ Finset.range (b + c - 2 * (k₃ : ℕ) + 1),
                cgCoefficient a (b + c - 2 * (k₃ : ℕ)) (K - k₃) l α ν *
                  cgCoefficient b c k₃ ν β γ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cg_four_eq
entries.docstring: One summand of `recoupling_eq_sum` is a summand of `sixJSym`.
entries.snippet:
lemma cg_four_eq {a b c e f g k₁ k₂ k₃ k₄ l μ γ α β ν : ℕ}
    (hab : 0 < a + b) (hbc : 0 < b + c) (hec : 0 < e + c) (haf : 0 < a + f)
    (he : e = a + b - 2 * k₁) (hf : f = b + c - 2 * k₃) (hg₂ : g = e + c - 2 * k₂)
    (hg₄ : g = a + f - 2 * k₄) (h₁a : k₁ ≤ a) (h₁b : k₁ ≤ b) (h₂e : k₂ ≤ e) (h₂c : k₂ ≤ c)
    (h₃b : k₃ ≤ b) (h₃c : k₃ ≤ c) (h₄a : k₄ ≤ a) (h₄f : k₄ ≤ f) (hl : l ≤ g) (hμ : μ ≤ e)
    (hγ : γ ≤ c) (hα : α ≤ a) (hβ : β ≤ b) (hν : ν ≤ f) :
    cgCoefficient e c k₂ l μ γ * (cgCoefficient a b k₁ μ α β *
        (cgCoefficient a f k₄ l α ν * cgCoefficient b c k₃ ν β γ)) =
      Real.sqrt (((e + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((f + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * ((g + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (-1) ^ (a + b + c - (k₁ + k₂)) *
          sixJTerm a b e c g f ![(a : ℤ) - 2 * α, (b : ℤ) - 2 * β, -((e : ℤ) - 2 * μ),
            (c : ℤ) - 2 * γ, (g : ℤ) - 2 * l, (f : ℤ) - 2 * ν]

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sum_sixJTerm_eq
entries.docstring: The sum of `sixJTerm` over the six projections, written through `jᵢ - 2·index`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_sixJTerm_eq (a b c e f g : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ Finset.range (g + 1) ×ˢ (Finset.range (e + 1) ×ˢ (Finset.range (c + 1) ×ˢ
        (Finset.range (a + 1) ×ˢ (Finset.range (b + 1) ×ˢ Finset.range (f + 1))))),
      sixJTerm a b e c g f ![(a : ℤ) - 2 * x.2.2.2.1, (b : ℤ) - 2 * x.2.2.2.2.1,
        -((e : ℤ) - 2 * x.2.1), (c : ℤ) - 2 * x.2.2.1, (g : ℤ) - 2 * x.1,
        (f : ℤ) - 2 * x.2.2.2.2.2] = sixJSym a b e c g f

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixJ_eq_sixJSym
entries.docstring:
**The 6j symbols of `SixJ` are the symmetric sums over four 3j symbols.** With
`j₁₂ = (a + b)/2 - k₁`, `j₂₃ = (b + c)/2 - k₃` and `J = (a + b + c)/2 - K`,
`{j₁ j₂ j₁₂; j₃ J j₂₃}` of `sixJ` equals `sixJSym`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sixJ_eq_sixJSym (hab : 0 < a + b) (hbc : 0 < b + c) (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c) {K : ℕ}
    {k₁ : Fin (min a b + 1)} {k₃ : Fin (min b c + 1)} (hA : ValidA a b c K k₁)
    (hB : ValidB a b c K k₃) :
    sixJ hab hbc K k₁ k₃ =
      sixJSym a b (a + b - 2 * (k₁ : ℕ)) c (a + b + c - 2 * K) (b + c - 2 * (k₃ : ℕ))

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.dot
entries.docstring: The scalar product `L · S = Lx ⊗ Sx + Ly ⊗ Sy + Lz ⊗ Sz` on `V ⊗ W`.
entries.snippet:
def dot (ρ₁ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) (ρ₂ : AngularMomentumRepresentation W) :
    Module.End ℂ (V ⊗[ℂ] W)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jsq_tensor
entries.docstring: **`J² = L² + S² + 2 L · S`.**
entries.snippet:
lemma Jsq_tensor (ρ₁ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) (ρ₂ : AngularMomentumRepresentation W) :
    (tensor ρ₁ ρ₂).Jsq = ρ₁.Jsq.rTensor W + ρ₂.Jsq.lTensor V + (2 : ℂ) • dot ρ₁ ρ₂

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.Jsq_standard
entries.docstring: `J² = j(j + 1)` on the spin-`j` representation `V(2j)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma Jsq_standard (n : ℕ) :
    (standard n).Jsq =
      ((n : ℂ) / 2 * ((n : ℂ) / 2 + 1)) • (1 : Module.End ℂ (StandardSl2Module ℂ n))

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.spinOrbitValue
entries.docstring:
The eigenvalue `(J(J + 1) - l(l + 1) - s(s + 1)) / 2` of `L · S` for `l = m/2`, `s = n/2`
and `J = (m + n)/2 - k`.
entries.snippet: def spinOrbitValue (m n k : ℕ) : ℂ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.dot_coupled_stringVec
entries.docstring:
**Spin–orbit eigenvalues.** Every vector of the `k`-th lowering string of `V(m) ⊗ V(n)`, a
state of total angular momentum `J = (m + n)/2 - k`, is an eigenvector of `L · S` with eigenvalue
`(J(J + 1) - l(l + 1) - s(s + 1)) / 2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma dot_coupled_stringVec {k : ℕ} (hmn : 0 < m + n) (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) (l : ℕ) :
    dot (standard m) (standard n) (stringVec m n k l) =
      spinOrbitValue m n k • stringVec m n k l

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.dot_coupled_stringVec_doublet_upper
entries.docstring:
**Fine-structure doublet, upper level.** For spin `1/2` and `J = l + 1/2`,
`L · S = l/2` (`l = m/2`).
entries.snippet:
lemma dot_coupled_stringVec_doublet_upper (l' : ℕ) :
    dot (standard m) (standard 1) (stringVec m 1 0 l') =
      ((m : ℂ) / 4) • stringVec m 1 0 l'

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.dot_coupled_stringVec_doublet_lower
entries.docstring:
**Fine-structure doublet, lower level.** For spin `1/2` and `J = l - 1/2`,
`L · S = -(l + 1)/2` (`l = m/2`, `m ≥ 1`).
entries.snippet:
lemma dot_coupled_stringVec_doublet_lower (hm : 1 ≤ m) (l' : ℕ) :
    dot (standard m) (standard 1) (stringVec m 1 1 l') =
      (-((m : ℂ) + 2) / 4) • stringVec m 1 1 l'

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.spinOrbitValue_doublet_sub
entries.docstring: The doublet splitting `l/2 + (l + 1)/2 = (2l + 1)/2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma spinOrbitValue_doublet_sub (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    spinOrbitValue m 1 0 - spinOrbitValue m 1 1 = ((m : ℂ) + 1) / 2

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.spinOrbitValue_sub_succ
entries.docstring:
**Landé's interval rule.** The levels `J` and `J - 1` of a multiplet differ in `L · S` by `J`,
`J = (m + n)/2 - k`.
entries.snippet:
lemma spinOrbitValue_sub_succ {k : ℕ} (hkm : k + 1 ≤ m) (hkn : k + 1 ≤ n) :
    spinOrbitValue m n k - spinOrbitValue m n (k + 1) = ((m + n - 2 * k : ℕ) : ℂ) / 2

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.invFact
entries.docstring: `1/u!` for `u ≥ 0` and `0` for `u < 0`.
entries.snippet: def invFact (u : ℤ) : ℝ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.invFact_natCast
entries.snippet: lemma invFact_natCast (t : ℕ) : invFact t = ((t.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.invFact_eq
entries.snippet: lemma invFact_eq {u : ℤ} {t : ℕ} (h : u = t) : invFact u = ((t.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.invFact_of_neg
entries.snippet: lemma invFact_of_neg {u : ℤ} (h : u < 0) : invFact u = 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.nonneg_of_invFact_ne_zero
entries.snippet: lemma nonneg_of_invFact_ne_zero {u : ℤ} (h : invFact u ≠ 0) : 0 ≤ u

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.neg_one_zpow_congr
entries.snippet: lemma neg_one_zpow_congr {p q : ℤ} (h : p % 2 = q % 2) : (-1 : ℝ) ^ p = (-1) ^ q

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixTerm
entries.docstring: The summand of `sixSum`.
entries.snippet: def sixTerm (a₁ a₂ a₃ b₁ b₂ b₃ z : ℤ) : ℝ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixSum
entries.docstring:
`Σ_z (-1)^z / ((z - a₁)! (z - a₂)! (z - a₃)! (b₁ - z)! (b₂ - z)! (b₃ - z)!)`, over the `z`
for which all six arguments are nonnegative.
entries.snippet: def sixSum (a₁ a₂ a₃ b₁ b₂ b₃ : ℤ) : ℝ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixSum_swap_a12
entries.snippet:
lemma sixSum_swap_a12 (a₁ a₂ a₃ b₁ b₂ b₃ : ℤ) :
    sixSum a₁ a₂ a₃ b₁ b₂ b₃ = sixSum a₂ a₁ a₃ b₁ b₂ b₃

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixSum_swap_a23
entries.snippet:
lemma sixSum_swap_a23 (a₁ a₂ a₃ b₁ b₂ b₃ : ℤ) :
    sixSum a₁ a₂ a₃ b₁ b₂ b₃ = sixSum a₁ a₃ a₂ b₁ b₂ b₃

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixSum_swap_b12
entries.snippet:
lemma sixSum_swap_b12 (a₁ a₂ a₃ b₁ b₂ b₃ : ℤ) :
    sixSum a₁ a₂ a₃ b₁ b₂ b₃ = sixSum a₁ a₂ a₃ b₂ b₁ b₃

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixSum_swap_b23
entries.snippet:
lemma sixSum_swap_b23 (a₁ a₂ a₃ b₁ b₂ b₃ : ℤ) :
    sixSum a₁ a₂ a₃ b₁ b₂ b₃ = sixSum a₁ a₂ a₃ b₁ b₃ b₂

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixSum_shift
entries.docstring: Shifting all arguments by `c` multiplies the sum by `(-1)^c`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sixSum_shift (a₁ a₂ a₃ b₁ b₂ b₃ c : ℤ) :
    sixSum (a₁ + c) (a₂ + c) (a₃ + c) (b₁ + c) (b₂ + c) (b₃ + c) =
      (-1) ^ c * sixSum a₁ a₂ a₃ b₁ b₂ b₃

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixSum_neg
entries.docstring: The reflection `z ↦ -z`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sixSum_neg (a₁ a₂ a₃ b₁ b₂ b₃ : ℤ) :
    sixSum a₁ a₂ a₃ b₁ b₂ b₃ = sixSum (-b₁) (-b₂) (-b₃) (-a₁) (-a₂) (-a₃)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.IsMagic
entries.docstring: All rows and columns of `R` have the same sum as the first row.
entries.snippet: def IsMagic (R : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℕ) : Prop

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.threeJR
entries.docstring: The 3j symbol of a Regge square `R`, by Racah's formula.
entries.snippet: def threeJR (R : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℕ) : ℝ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.neg_one_pow_mul_mul_zpow
entries.snippet:
lemma neg_one_pow_mul_mul_zpow {n n' q : ℕ} {s : ℤ} (X Y : ℝ)
    (h : ((n' : ℤ) + s) % 2 = ((n : ℤ) + q) % 2) :
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ n' * X * ((-1) ^ s * Y) = (-1) ^ q * ((-1) ^ n * X * Y)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.neg_one_pow_mul_mul_zpow'
entries.snippet:
lemma neg_one_pow_mul_mul_zpow' {n n' : ℕ} {s : ℤ} (X Y : ℝ)
    (h : ((n' : ℤ) + s) % 2 = (n : ℤ) % 2) :
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ n' * X * ((-1) ^ s * Y) = (-1) ^ n * X * Y

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.threeJR_transpose
entries.docstring: **Regge symmetry.** Transposing the square leaves the 3j symbol unchanged.
entries.snippet:
lemma threeJR_transpose {R : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℕ} (hR : IsMagic R) :
    threeJR (fun i j => R j i) = threeJR R

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.threeJR_swap_columns
entries.docstring: Swapping the first two columns multiplies the 3j symbol by `(-1)^J`.
entries.snippet:
lemma threeJR_swap_columns {R : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℕ} (hR : IsMagic R) :
    threeJR (fun i => ![R i 1, R i 0, R i 2]) = (-1) ^ (R 0 0 + R 0 1 + R 0 2) * threeJR R

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.threeJR_cycle_columns
entries.docstring: Permuting the columns cyclically leaves the 3j symbol unchanged.
entries.snippet:
lemma threeJR_cycle_columns {R : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℕ} (hR : IsMagic R) :
    threeJR (fun i => ![R i 1, R i 2, R i 0]) = threeJR R

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.threeJR_swap_rows
entries.docstring: Swapping the last two rows, `m ↦ -m`, multiplies the 3j symbol by `(-1)^J`.
entries.snippet:
lemma threeJR_swap_rows {R : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℕ} (hR : IsMagic R) :
    threeJR ![R 0, R 2, R 1] = (-1) ^ (R 0 0 + R 0 1 + R 0 2) * threeJR R

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.isMagic_iff
entries.snippet:
lemma isMagic_iff {R : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℕ} :
    IsMagic R ↔ (∀ i, ∑ j, R i j = ∑ j, R 0 j) ∧ ∀ j, ∑ i, R i j = ∑ j, R 0 j

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.isMagic_perm
entries.snippet:
lemma isMagic_perm {R : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℕ} (hR : IsMagic R) (σ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
    IsMagic (fun i j => R (σ i) (τ j))

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.isMagic_transpose
entries.snippet:
lemma isMagic_transpose {R : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℕ} (hR : IsMagic R) :
    IsMagic (fun i j => R j i)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.isMagic_perm_sum
entries.docstring: Under a permutation of rows and columns the sum `J` of a magic square is unchanged.
entries.snippet:
lemma isMagic_perm_sum {R : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℕ} (hR : IsMagic R) (σ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
    R (σ 0) (τ 0) + R (σ 0) (τ 1) + R (σ 0) (τ 2) = R 0 0 + R 0 1 + R 0 2

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.isMagic_transpose_sum
entries.snippet:
lemma isMagic_transpose_sum {R : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℕ} (hR : IsMagic R) :
    R 0 0 + R 1 0 + R 2 0 = R 0 0 + R 0 1 + R 0 2

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.threeJR_perm_columns
entries.docstring: A permutation `τ` of the columns multiplies the 3j symbol by `sign(τ)^J`.
entries.snippet:
lemma threeJR_perm_columns (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) {R : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℕ} (hR : IsMagic R) :
    threeJR (fun i j => R i (τ j)) =
      ((Equiv.Perm.sign τ : ℤ) : ℝ) ^ (R 0 0 + R 0 1 + R 0 2) * threeJR R

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.threeJR_perm
entries.docstring:
**Symmetries of the 3j symbol.** Permuting the rows by `σ` and the columns by `τ` multiplies
the 3j symbol by `(sign(σ) sign(τ))^J`.
entries.snippet:
lemma threeJR_perm (σ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) {R : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℕ} (hR : IsMagic R) :
    threeJR (fun i j => R (σ i) (τ j)) =
      ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ * Equiv.Perm.sign τ : ℤˣ) : ℝ) ^ (R 0 0 + R 0 1 + R 0 2) *
        threeJR R

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.perm_prodMap_injective
entries.docstring: Distinct pairs of row and column permutations move the entries of a square differently.
entries.snippet:
lemma perm_prodMap_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun p : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3) × Equiv.Perm (Fin 3) =>
      Prod.map (p.1 : Fin 3 → Fin 3) p.2)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.prodMap_ne_swap
entries.docstring: Transposition is not a permutation of rows and columns.
entries.snippet:
lemma prodMap_ne_swap (σ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
    Prod.map (σ : Fin 3 → Fin 3) τ ≠ Prod.swap

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.regge
entries.docstring:
The Regge square of `(j₁ j₂ J; m₁ m₂ -M)` in the parameters of `ClebschGordanCoefficients`:
`m = 2j₁`, `n = 2j₂`, `J = (m + n)/2 - k`, `M = J - l`, `m₁ = j₁ - α`, `m₂ = j₂ - β`.
entries.snippet: def regge (m n k l α β : ℕ) : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℕ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.isMagic_regge
entries.snippet:
lemma isMagic_regge {k l α β : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) (hl : l ≤ m + n - 2 * k)
    (hα : α ≤ m) (hβ : β ≤ n) (h : α + β = k + l) : IsMagic (regge m n k l α β)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sixSum_regge_eq_racahSum
entries.docstring: Racah's sum `racahSum` of `ClebschGordanFormula` is the six-factorial sum of the square.
entries.snippet:
lemma sixSum_regge_eq_racahSum {k α β : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) (hβ : β ≤ n) :
    sixSum 0 ((α : ℤ) - (m - k : ℕ)) (((n - β : ℕ) : ℤ) - (n - k : ℕ)) k α (n - β : ℕ) =
      racahSum m n k α β

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgCoefficient_eq_threeJR
entries.docstring:
**The 3j symbols and the Clebsch–Gordan coefficients.**
`⟨j₁ m₁ j₂ m₂ | J M⟩ = (-1)^(j₁ - j₂ + M) √(2J + 1) (j₁ j₂ J; m₁ m₂ -M)`, where
`j₁ - j₂ + M = m - k - l ≡ m + k + l (mod 2)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma cgCoefficient_eq_threeJR {k l α β : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (hl : l ≤ m + n - 2 * k) (hα : α ≤ m) (hβ : β ≤ n) (h : α + β = k + l) :
    cgCoefficient m n k l α β = (-1) ^ (m + k + l) *
      Real.sqrt ((m + n - 2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * threeJR (regge m n k l α β)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.wigner3j
entries.docstring:
The 3j symbol `(j₁ j₂ J; m₁ m₂ -M)` in the parameters of `ClebschGordanCoefficients`, zero
unless `m₁ + m₂ = M`.
entries.snippet: def wigner3j (m n k l α β : ℕ) : ℝ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgCoefficient_eq_wigner3j
entries.snippet:
lemma cgCoefficient_eq_wigner3j (hmn : 0 < m + n) {k l α β : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (hl : l ≤ m + n - 2 * k) (hα : α ≤ m) (hβ : β ≤ n) :
    cgCoefficient m n k l α β = (-1) ^ (m + k + l) *
      Real.sqrt ((m + n - 2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * wigner3j m n k l α β

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sum_wigner3j_mul_wigner3j
entries.docstring:
**Orthogonality.** `Σ_{m₁ m₂} (j₁ j₂ J; m₁ m₂ -M) (j₁ j₂ J'; m₁ m₂ -M') =
δ_{JJ'} δ_{MM'} / (2J + 1)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_wigner3j_mul_wigner3j (hmn : 0 < m + n) {k k' l l' : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (hk'm : k' ≤ m) (hk'n : k' ≤ n) (hl : l ≤ m + n - 2 * k) (hl' : l' ≤ m + n - 2 * k') :
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      wigner3j m n k l a b * wigner3j m n k' l' a b =
        if k = k' ∧ l = l' then 1 / ((m + n - 2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) else 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.sum_wigner3j_mul_wigner3j_JM
entries.docstring:
**Second orthogonality relation.**
`Σ_{J M} (2J + 1) (j₁ j₂ J; m₁ m₂ -M) (j₁ j₂ J; m₁' m₂' -M) = δ_{m₁ m₁'} δ_{m₂ m₂'}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_wigner3j_mul_wigner3j_JM (hmn : 0 < m + n) {a b a' b' : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ m) (hb : b ≤ n)
    (ha' : a' ≤ m) (hb' : b' ≤ n) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (min m n + 1), ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + n - 2 * k + 1),
      ((m + n - 2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * wigner3j m n k l a b * wigner3j m n k l a' b' =
        if a = a' ∧ b = b' then 1 else 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.IsTensorOperator
entries.docstring:
A tensor operator of rank `k` from `V(m)` to `V(p)`: a linear map
`T : V(k) → Hom(V(m), V(p))` with `[X, T x] = T (X x)` for `X = e, f, h`.
entries.snippet:
structure IsTensorOperator
    (T : StandardSl2Module K k →ₗ[K] StandardSl2Module K m →ₗ[K] StandardSl2Module K p) :
    Prop where
  comm_E : ∀ x, ρE ∘ₗ T x - T x ∘ₗ ρE = T (ρE x)
  comm_F : ∀ x, ρF ∘ₗ T x - T x ∘ₗ ρF = T (ρF x)
  comm_H : ∀ x, ρH ∘ₗ T x - T x ∘ₗ ρH = T (ρH x)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.IsTensorOperator.apply_ρE
entries.docstring: Leibniz form of the commutation relation for the raising operator.
entries.snippet:
lemma apply_ρE (hT : IsTensorOperator T) (x : StandardSl2Module K k)
    (y : StandardSl2Module K m) : ρE (T x y) = T (ρE x) y + T x (ρE y)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.IsTensorOperator.apply_ρF
entries.docstring: Leibniz form of the commutation relation for the lowering operator.
entries.snippet:
lemma apply_ρF (hT : IsTensorOperator T) (x : StandardSl2Module K k)
    (y : StandardSl2Module K m) : ρF (T x y) = T (ρF x) y + T x (ρF y)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.IsTensorOperator.apply_ρH
entries.docstring: Leibniz form of the commutation relation for the weight operator.
entries.snippet:
lemma apply_ρH (hT : IsTensorOperator T) (x : StandardSl2Module K k)
    (y : StandardSl2Module K m) : ρH (T x y) = T (ρH x) y + T x (ρH y)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.IsTensorOperator.lift_isTensorIntertwiner
entries.docstring: The map `x ⊗ y ↦ T x y` of a tensor operator is a tensor intertwiner.
entries.snippet:
lemma lift_isTensorIntertwiner (hT : IsTensorOperator T) :
    IsTensorIntertwiner (TensorProduct.lift T) where

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.IsTensorOperator.eq_zero_of_forall_ne
entries.docstring:
**Triangle and parity rule.** If `p` is not of the form `k + m - 2j` with `j ≤ min k m`,
every tensor operator of rank `k` from `V(m)` to `V(p)` is zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_zero_of_forall_ne (hkm : 0 < k + m)
    {T : StandardSl2Module K k →ₗ[K] StandardSl2Module K m →ₗ[K] StandardSl2Module K p}
    (hT : IsTensorOperator T) (hp : ∀ j : Fin (min k m + 1), k + m - 2 * (j : ℕ) ≠ p) :
    T = 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.IsTensorOperator.exists_eq_smul_cgProj
entries.docstring:
**Wigner–Eckart theorem.** A tensor operator of rank `k` from `V(m)` to `V(k + m - 2j)`
factorises as `T x y = c • cgProj (x ⊗ y)`: a single reduced matrix element `c` times the
Clebsch–Gordan projection.

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.IsTensorOperator.exists_coord_eq
entries.docstring:
**Wigner–Eckart theorem**, matrix-element form: every matrix element
`⟨v_s | T v_q | v_r⟩` is the reduced matrix element `c` times the Clebsch–Gordan coefficient, the
`v_s`-coordinate of `cgProj (v_q ⊗ v_r)`.

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.IsTensorOperator.apply_vNat_eq_zero_of_weight_ne
entries.docstring:
**Weight selection rule.** The matrix element `⟨v_s | T v_q | v_r⟩` vanishes unless the
weights add up, `(k - 2q) + (m - 2r) = p - 2s`. In physics notation this is `μ + m_j = m_{j'}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma apply_vNat_eq_zero_of_weight_ne
    {T : StandardSl2Module K k →ₗ[K] StandardSl2Module K m →ₗ[K] StandardSl2Module K p}
    (hT : IsTensorOperator T) (q r : ℕ) (s : Fin (p + 1))
    (hne : (k : ℤ) - 2 * q + ((m : ℤ) - 2 * r) ≠ (p : ℤ) - 2 * (s : ℕ)) :
    T (vNat k q) (vNat m r) s = 0

lemma standard_bracket_eSub (t : IsSl2Triple h e f) (w : StandardSl2Module K n) :

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.IsStandardEquiv
entries.docstring: A linear equivalence `V ≃ V(n)` carrying `J₊`, `J₋` and `2Jz` to `e`, `f` and `h`.
entries.snippet:
structure IsStandardEquiv (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V) {n : ℕ}
    (ψ : V ≃ₗ[ℂ] StandardSl2Module ℂ n) : Prop where
  map_Jp : ∀ v, ψ (ρ.Jp v) = ρE (ψ v)
  map_Jm : ∀ v, ψ (ρ.Jm v) = ρF (ψ v)
  map_Jz : ∀ v, ψ (((2 : ℂ) • ρ.Jz) v) = ρH (ψ v)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.exists_isStandardEquiv
entries.docstring:
A finite-dimensional irreducible representation with `Jz ≠ 0` is isomorphic to a standard
module by a standard equivalence.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_isStandardEquiv [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V)
    (hz : ρ.Jz ≠ 0) (hirr : ρ.IsIrreducible) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (ψ : V ≃ₗ[ℂ] StandardSl2Module ℂ n), ρ.IsStandardEquiv ψ

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.IsStandardEquiv.pos
entries.docstring:
A standard equivalence for a representation with `Jz ≠ 0` lands in some `V(n)` with
`n > 0`.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsStandardEquiv.pos {ρ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V} {n : ℕ}
    {ψ : V ≃ₗ[ℂ] StandardSl2Module ℂ n} (hψ : ρ.IsStandardEquiv ψ) (hz : ρ.Jz ≠ 0) : 0 < n

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.IsStandardEquiv.symm_ρE
PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.IsStandardEquiv.symm_ρF
PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.IsStandardEquiv.symm_ρH
PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.IsTensorOperatorOf
entries.docstring:
A tensor operator of rank `k` from `ρ₁` on `V` to `ρ₂` on `W`: a linear map
`T : V(k) → Hom(V, W)` with `[J₊, T x] = T (e x)`, `[J₋, T x] = T (f x)` and
`[2Jz, T x] = T (h x)`.
entries.snippet:
structure IsTensorOperatorOf (ρ₁ : AngularMomentumRepresentation V)
    (ρ₂ : AngularMomentumRepresentation W) (T : StandardSl2Module ℂ k →ₗ[ℂ] V →ₗ[ℂ] W) :
    Prop where
  comm_p : ∀ x, ρ₂.Jp ∘ₗ T x - T x ∘ₗ ρ₁.Jp = T (ρE x)
  comm_m : ∀ x, ρ₂.Jm ∘ₗ T x - T x ∘ₗ ρ₁.Jm = T (ρF x)
  comm_z : ∀ x, ((2 : ℂ) • ρ₂.Jz) ∘ₗ T x - T x ∘ₗ ((2 : ℂ) • ρ₁.Jz) = T (ρH x)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.conjStd
entries.docstring: Conjugation of an operator-valued map by linear equivalences `V ≃ V(n₁)` and `W ≃ V(n₂)`.

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.conjStd_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma conjStd_apply {n₁ n₂ : ℕ} (ψ₁ : V ≃ₗ[ℂ] StandardSl2Module ℂ n₁)
    (ψ₂ : W ≃ₗ[ℂ] StandardSl2Module ℂ n₂) (T : StandardSl2Module ℂ k →ₗ[ℂ] V →ₗ[ℂ] W)
    (x : StandardSl2Module ℂ k) (y : StandardSl2Module ℂ n₁) :
    conjStd ψ₁ ψ₂ T x y = ψ₂ (T x (ψ₁.symm y))

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.conjStd_injective
PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.IsTensorOperatorOf.isTensorOperator_conjStd
entries.docstring:
Conjugation by standard equivalences turns a tensor operator between representations into a
tensor operator between standard modules.

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.IsTensorOperatorOf.conjStd_zero
entries.snippet:

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.IsTensorOperatorOf.triangleRule
entries.docstring:
**Triangle rule** for irreducible representations: a nonzero tensor operator of rank `k`
from `ρ₁ ≅ V(n₁)` to `ρ₂ ≅ V(n₂)` satisfies `TriangleRule k n₁ n₂`, i.e. `|j₁ - j₂| ≤ κ ≤ j₁ + j₂`
for `k = 2κ`, `n₁ = 2j₁`, `n₂ = 2j₂`.

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation.IsTensorOperatorOf.exists_eq_smul_of_ne_zero
entries.docstring:
**Wigner–Eckart theorem** for irreducible representations: two tensor operators of the same
rank between the same irreducible representations are proportional, provided the second is
nonzero.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_eq_smul_of_ne_zero (h₁z : ρ₁.Jz ≠ 0) (h₁ : ρ₁.IsIrreducible) (h₂z : ρ₂.Jz ≠ 0)
    (h₂ : ρ₂.IsIrreducible) {T S : StandardSl2Module ℂ k →ₗ[ℂ] V →ₗ[ℂ] W}
    (hT : IsTensorOperatorOf ρ₁ ρ₂ T) (hS : IsTensorOperatorOf ρ₁ ρ₂ S) (hS0 : S ≠ 0) :
    ∃ c : ℂ, T = c • S

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.wigner3j_swap
entries.docstring: `(j₂ j₁ J; m₂ m₁ -M) = (-1)^(j₁ + j₂ + J) (j₁ j₂ J; m₁ m₂ -M)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma wigner3j_swap {k l α β : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) (hl : l ≤ m + n - 2 * k)
    (hα : α ≤ m) (hβ : β ≤ n) :
    wigner3j n m k l β α = (-1) ^ (m + n - k) * wigner3j m n k l α β

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.cgCoefficient_swap
entries.docstring: **Exchange symmetry.** `⟨j₁ m₁ j₂ m₂ | J M⟩ = (-1)^(j₁ + j₂ - J) ⟨j₂ m₂ j₁ m₁ | J M⟩`.
entries.snippet:
lemma cgCoefficient_swap (hmn : 0 < m + n) {k l α β : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (hl : l ≤ m + n - 2 * k) (hα : α ≤ m) (hβ : β ≤ n) :
    cgCoefficient m n k l α β = (-1) ^ k * cgCoefficient n m k l β α

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.stringVec_eq_smul_embed
entries.snippet:
lemma stringVec_eq_smul_embed (hmn : 0 < m + n) (j : Fin (min m n + 1)) (l : ℕ) :
    stringVec m n j l = Real.sqrt (hwNormSq m n j) • embed hmn j (vNat _ l)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.invForm_cgProj
entries.docstring: `⟨u, cgProj x⟩ = ⟨w_j, w_j⟩^(-1/2) ⟨embed u, x⟩`.
entries.snippet:
lemma invForm_cgProj (hmn : 0 < m + n) (j : Fin (min m n + 1))
    (y : StandardSl2Module ℝ (m + n - 2 * (j : ℕ)))
    (x : StandardSl2Module ℝ m ⊗[ℝ] StandardSl2Module ℝ n) :
    invForm ℝ _ y (cgProj hmn j x) =
      (Real.sqrt (hwNormSq m n j))⁻¹ * tensorForm m n (embed hmn j y) x

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.IsTensorOperator.exists_normVec_eq
entries.docstring:
**Wigner–Eckart theorem with Clebsch–Gordan coefficients.** With `κ = k/2`, `μ = κ - q`,
`J = m/2`, `M = J - r`, `J' = (k + m)/2 - j` and `M' = J' - s`, there is a reduced matrix element
`R` with `⟨J' M' | T^κ_μ | J M⟩ = R · ⟨κ μ J M | J' M'⟩` for all `q, r, s`.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_normVec_eq (hT : IsTensorOperator T) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ q r s : ℕ, invForm ℝ _ (normVec _ s) (T (normVec k q) (normVec m r)) =
      R * cgCoefficient k m j s q r

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.IsTensorOperator.sum_sq_normVec
entries.docstring:
**The total strength out of a substate.** If `⟨J' M' | T^κ_μ | J M⟩ = R · ⟨κ μ J M | J' M'⟩`,
then `Σ_{μ M'} |⟨J' M' | T^κ_μ | J M⟩|² = R² (2J' + 1) / (2J + 1)` for every `M`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_sq_normVec (R : ℝ)
    (hR : ∀ q r s : ℕ, invForm ℝ _ (normVec _ s) (T (normVec k q) (normVec m r)) =
      R * cgCoefficient k m j s q r) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ m) :
    ∑ q ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (k + m - 2 * (j : ℕ) + 1),
      (invForm ℝ _ (normVec _ s) (T (normVec k q) (normVec m r))) ^ 2 =
        R ^ 2 * (((k + m - 2 * (j : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))

entries.name: BlackBody.quantizedOscillator
entries.docstring:
The quantized oscillator with level spacing `ε`: the microstates `n : ℕ` have energy `n ε`
and are counted with unit weight.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def quantizedOscillator (ε : ℝ) : CanonicalEnsemble ℕ where

entries.name: BlackBody.exp_neg_lt_one
entries.docstring: For `x > 0`, the Boltzmann factor `e^{-x}` has norm below one.
entries.snippet: lemma exp_neg_lt_one {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : ‖exp (-x)‖ < 1

entries.name: BlackBody.exp_neg_mul_nat
entries.docstring: The Boltzmann factor of the level `n` is the `n`-th power of that of the first level.
entries.snippet: lemma exp_neg_mul_nat (b ε : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : exp (-b * (n * ε)) = exp (-(b * ε)) ^ n

entries.name: BlackBody.hasSum_exp_neg_levels
entries.docstring: The partition sum of the levels: `∑ e^{-β n ε} = (1 - e^{-β ε})⁻¹`.
entries.snippet:
lemma hasSum_exp_neg_levels {b ε : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b * ε) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => exp (-b * (n * ε))) (1 - exp (-(b * ε)))⁻¹

entries.name: BlackBody.hasSum_energy_levels
entries.docstring: The energy sum of the levels: `∑ n ε e^{-β n ε} = ε e^{-β ε} / (1 - e^{-β ε})²`.
entries.snippet:
lemma hasSum_energy_levels {b ε : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b * ε) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => n * ε * exp (-b * (n * ε)))
      (ε * (exp (-(b * ε)) / (1 - exp (-(b * ε))) ^ 2))

entries.name: BlackBody.quantizedOscillator_meanEnergy
entries.docstring: The mean energy of the quantized oscillator is Planck's `ε / (e^{β ε} - 1)`.

entries.name: BlackBody.classicalOscillator
entries.docstring: The classical oscillator: energies `E > 0` with Lebesgue measure.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def classicalOscillator : CanonicalEnsemble ℝ where

entries.name: BlackBody.classicalOscillator_meanEnergy
entries.docstring: Equipartition: the mean energy of the classical oscillator is `kB T`.
entries.snippet:
lemma classicalOscillator_meanEnergy {T : Temperature} (hT : 0 < (T : ℝ)) :
    classicalOscillator.meanEnergy T = kB * T

entries.name: BlackBody.quantizedOscillator_meanEnergy_lt
entries.docstring: The quantized mean energy lies strictly below the classical one, `kB T`.

entries.name: BlackBody.spectralRadiance_eq_meanEnergy
entries.docstring: Planck's law is `2 ν² / c²` times the mean energy of the oscillator of spacing `h ν`.
entries.snippet:
lemma spectralRadiance_eq_meanEnergy (B : BlackBody) (c : SpeedOfLight) {ν : Frequency}
    (hν : 0 < ν.val) (hT : 0 < (B.T : ℝ)) :
    B.spectralRadiance c ν =
      2 * (ν.val : ℝ) ^ 2 / (c : ℝ) ^ 2
        * (quantizedOscillator (h * (ν.val : ℝ))).meanEnergy B.T

entries.name: BlackBody.rayleighJeans
entries.docstring: The Rayleigh–Jeans spectral radiance `2 ν² kB T / c²` of a black body `B`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def rayleighJeans (B : BlackBody) (c : SpeedOfLight) (ν : Frequency) : ℝ

entries.name: BlackBody.rayleighJeans_eq_meanEnergy
entries.docstring: The Rayleigh–Jeans law is `2 ν² / c²` times the mean energy of the classical oscillator.
entries.snippet:
lemma rayleighJeans_eq_meanEnergy (B : BlackBody) (c : SpeedOfLight) (ν : Frequency)
    (hT : 0 < (B.T : ℝ)) :
    B.rayleighJeans c ν
      = 2 * (ν.val : ℝ) ^ 2 / (c : ℝ) ^ 2 * classicalOscillator.meanEnergy B.T

entries.name: BlackBody.spectralRadiance_lt_rayleighJeans
entries.docstring:
Planck's law lies strictly below the Rayleigh–Jeans law at every positive frequency and
every positive temperature.

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.OntologicalModel
entries.docstring:
An ontological model (Harrigan–Spekkens) of the quantum system `𝓗[d]`, with ontic state
space `Λ`.

Preparations are indexed by unit vectors rather than by states. This is more general: a model
whose preparations depend only on the vector state `ofVec hψ` is a special case, while here two
unit vectors differing by a global phase, which have the same vector state and hence the same
measurement statistics, may be prepared with different measures. Only pure-state preparations
are modelled, as only these are needed for the PBR theorem. Measurements have finitely many
outcomes, and response functions take values in `ℝ≥0∞` so that they can be integrated with the
Lebesgue integral `∫⁻`.
entries.snippet:
structure OntologicalModel (d : Type*) [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (Λ : Type*)
    [MeasurableSpace Λ] where
  prep (ψ : 𝓗[d]) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1) : Measure Λ
  isProbabilityMeasure_prep (ψ : 𝓗[d]) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1) : IsProbabilityMeasure (prep ψ hψ)
  resp {X : Type} [Fintype X] [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSingletonClass X] :
    Measurement X (Observable (𝓗[d] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[d])) → X → Λ → ℝ≥0∞
  measurable_resp {X : Type} [Fintype X] [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSingletonClass X]
    (M : Measurement X (Observable (𝓗[d] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[d]))) (x : X) : Measurable (resp M x)
  sum_resp {X : Type} [Fintype X] [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSingletonClass X]
    (M : Measurement X (Observable (𝓗[d] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[d]))) (l : Λ) : ∑ x, resp M x l = 1
  lintegral_resp {X : Type} [Fintype X] [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSingletonClass X]
    (M : Measurement X (Observable (𝓗[d] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[d]))) (ψ : 𝓗[d]) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1) (x : X) :
    ∫⁻ l, resp M x l ∂prep ψ hψ =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((ofVec hψ)⟨M {x} (measurableSet_singleton x)⟩)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.OntologicalModel.IsPsiOntic
entries.docstring:
An ontological model is ψ-ontic if the preparation measures of any two unit vectors with
different vector states are mutually singular, so that the ontic state determines the quantum
state. Unit vectors differing only by a global phase have the same vector state, and may share
ontic states.
entries.snippet: def IsPsiOntic (M : OntologicalModel d Λ) : Prop

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.OntologicalModel.PreparationIndependent
entries.docstring:
The preparation-independence assumption of Pusey, Barrett and Rudolph for the model `M`,
relative to a family of models `Mn n` of `n` copies of the system (on `𝓗[Fin n → d]`, with ontic
states `Λn n`). It asks that `n` independently prepared systems have independent ontic states
which jointly determine the ontic state of the `n` copies: there are measurable maps
`ι n : (Fin n → Λ) → Λn n` such that preparing the product vector `piProdVec ψ` gives the ontic
state `ι n l`, where the `l i` are independent and distributed according to `M.prep (ψ i)`.

The ontic space `Λn n` need not be the Cartesian product `Fin n → Λ`; taking `Λn n = Fin n → Λ`
and `ι n = id` gives the stronger Cartesian Product Assumption (in Leifer's terminology), see
`PreparationIndependent.of_prep_piProdVec`.

Since preparations are indexed by vectors, two families `ψ`, `ψ'` with the same product vector
(for example `ψ 0 ⊗ ψ 1 = (i • ψ 0) ⊗ (-i • ψ 1)`) must give the same pushed-forward product
measure, and at `n = 0` the preparation `(Mn 0).prep` of the trivial product vector must be a
Dirac measure. The first condition is automatic when `M.prep` depends only on the ray of the
vector, and the second only concerns the trivial system `n = 0`, which the PBR theorem does not
use; so the standard PBR setting is covered by choosing one representative vector per ray.
entries.snippet:
def PreparationIndependent (M : OntologicalModel d Λ) {Λn : ℕ → Type*}
    [∀ n, MeasurableSpace (Λn n)] (Mn : (n : ℕ) → OntologicalModel (Fin n → d) (Λn n)) : Prop

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.OntologicalModel.PreparationIndependent.of_prep_piProdVec
entries.docstring:
The Cartesian-product form of preparation independence: if the `n`-copy models have ontic
space `Fin n → Λ` and prepare the product vector `piProdVec ψ` with the product of the
measures `M.prep (ψ i)`, then `M` is preparation independent (with `ι n = id`).

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.PBR.exists_two_mul_pow_le
entries.docstring: For `0 < c` and `0 < s`, some number of copies `n` gives `2 cⁿ ≤ (c + s)ⁿ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_two_mul_pow_le {c s : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hs : 0 < s) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 2 * c ^ n ≤ (c + s) ^ n

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.PBR.exists_norm_pow_sub_pow_eq
entries.docstring:
If `0 ≤ s ≤ c` and `2 cⁿ ≤ (c + s)ⁿ`, some angle `α` gives
`‖(c + e^{iα} s)ⁿ - cⁿ‖ = cⁿ` (intermediate value theorem on `[0, π]`).
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_norm_pow_sub_pow_eq {c s : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hsc : s ≤ c)
    (hn : 2 * c ^ n ≤ (c + s) ^ n) :
    ∃ α : ℝ, ‖((c : ℂ) + Complex.exp (α * Complex.I) * s) ^ n - (c : ℂ) ^ n‖ = c ^ n

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.PBR.prod_phase_mul_prod_amp
entries.docstring:
The phase product `∏ i, ![1, e] (z i)` times the amplitude product `∏ i, ![c, s] (z i)` is
the amplitude product `∏ i, ![c, e * s] (z i)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma prod_phase_mul_prod_amp {n : ℕ} (e c s : ℂ) (z : Fin n → Fin 2) :
    (∏ i, ![1, e] (z i)) * ∏ i, ![c, s] (z i) = ∏ i, ![c, e * s] (z i)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.PBR.norm_prod_phase
entries.docstring: The phase product `∏ i, ![1, e] (z i)` has unit norm when `e` does.
entries.snippet:
lemma norm_prod_phase {n : ℕ} {e : ℂ} (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (z : Fin n → Fin 2) :
    ‖∏ i, ![1, e] (z i)‖ = 1

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.PBR.sum_phases_mul_amp
entries.docstring:
The phases `ω 0 = -((c + e s)ⁿ - cⁿ) / cⁿ` and `ω z = ∏ i, ![1, e] (z i)` for `z ≠ 0`
cancel the amplitude products.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_phases_mul_amp {n : ℕ} (c s e : ℂ) (hc : c ^ n ≠ 0) :
    ∑ z : Fin n → Fin 2, (if z = 0 then -(((c + e * s) ^ n - c ^ n) / c ^ n)
      else ∏ i, ![1, e] (z i)) * ∏ i, ![c, s] (z i) = 0

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.PBR.exists_phases
entries.docstring:
Unit-modulus phases `ω z` with `∑ z, ω z * ∏ i, ![c, s] (z i) = 0`, for `0 ≤ s ≤ c`,
`0 < c` and `2 cⁿ ≤ (c + s)ⁿ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_phases {c s : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hsc : s ≤ c)
    (hn : 2 * c ^ n ≤ (c + s) ^ n) :
    ∃ ω : (Fin n → Fin 2) → ℂ,
      (∀ z, ‖ω z‖ = 1) ∧ ∑ z, ω z * ∏ i, ![(c : ℂ), (s : ℂ)] (z i) = 0

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.val_apply_basisFun
entries.docstring: The amplitude `⟨a|A|a'⟩` of an operator is the `a` component of `A |a'⟩`.
entries.snippet:
lemma val_apply_basisFun (A : 𝓗[α] →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓗[α]) (a a' : α) :
    (A (basisFun α a')).val a = ⟪basisFun α a, A (basisFun α a')⟫_ℂ

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.val_apply
entries.docstring: An operator in components: `(A ψ) a = ∑ a', ⟨a|A|a'⟩ ψ a'`.
entries.snippet:
lemma val_apply (A : 𝓗[α] →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓗[α]) (ψ : 𝓗[α]) (a : α) :
    (A ψ).val a = ∑ a', (A (basisFun α a')).val a * ψ.val a'

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.onFst
entries.docstring: The operator `A` acting on the first coordinate: `(A Ψ) (a, b) = ∑ a', ⟨a|A|a'⟩ Ψ (a', b)`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def onFst (A : 𝓗[α] →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓗[α]) : 𝓗[α × β] →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓗[α × β] where

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.onSnd
entries.docstring: The operator `B` acting on the second coordinate: `(B Ψ) (a, b) = ∑ b', ⟨b|B|b'⟩ Ψ (a, b')`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def onSnd (B : 𝓗[β] →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓗[β]) : 𝓗[α × β] →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓗[α × β] where

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.onFst_val
entries.snippet:
lemma onFst_val (A : 𝓗[α] →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓗[α]) (Ψ : 𝓗[α × β]) (p : α × β) :
    (onFst A Ψ).val p = ∑ a, (A (basisFun α a)).val p.1 * Ψ.val (a, p.2)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.onSnd_val
entries.snippet:
lemma onSnd_val (B : 𝓗[β] →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓗[β]) (Ψ : 𝓗[α × β]) (p : α × β) :
    (onSnd B Ψ).val p = ∑ b, (B (basisFun β b)).val p.2 * Ψ.val (p.1, b)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.onFst_comp
entries.docstring: Acting twice on the first coordinate composes the operators.
entries.snippet:
lemma onFst_comp (A A' : 𝓗[α] →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓗[α]) :
    onFst (β := β) (A ∘ₗ A') = onFst A ∘ₗ onFst A'

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.onSnd_comp
entries.docstring: Acting twice on the second coordinate composes the operators.
entries.snippet:
lemma onSnd_comp (B B' : 𝓗[β] →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓗[β]) :
    onSnd (α := α) (B ∘ₗ B') = onSnd B ∘ₗ onSnd B'

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.onFst_comp_onSnd
entries.docstring: Operators on different coordinates commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma onFst_comp_onSnd (A : 𝓗[α] →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓗[α]) (B : 𝓗[β] →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓗[β]) :
    onFst A ∘ₗ onSnd B = onSnd B ∘ₗ onFst A

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.inner_eq_sum
entries.docstring: The inner product of `𝓗[α × β]` in components.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_eq_sum (Ψ Φ : 𝓗[α × β]) :
    ⟪Ψ, Φ⟫_ℂ = ∑ p, (starRingEnd ℂ) (Ψ.val p) * Φ.val p

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.conj_val_apply_basisFun
entries.docstring: Hermitian amplitudes: `conj ⟨a'|A|a⟩ = ⟨a|A|a'⟩`.
entries.snippet:
lemma conj_val_apply_basisFun {A : 𝓗[α] →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓗[α]} (hA : A.IsSymmetric) (a a' : α) :
    (starRingEnd ℂ) ((A (basisFun α a)).val a') = (A (basisFun α a')).val a

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.onFst_isSymmetric
entries.docstring: A hermitian operator on the first coordinate is hermitian.
entries.snippet:
lemma onFst_isSymmetric {A : 𝓗[α] →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓗[α]} (hA : A.IsSymmetric) :
    (onFst (β := β) A).IsSymmetric

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.onSnd_isSymmetric
entries.docstring: A hermitian operator on the second coordinate is hermitian.
entries.snippet:
lemma onSnd_isSymmetric {B : 𝓗[β] →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓗[β]} (hB : B.IsSymmetric) :
    (onSnd (α := α) B).IsSymmetric

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.prodVec
entries.docstring: The product vector `(ψ ⊗ φ) (a, b) = ψ a φ b`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def prodVec (ψ : 𝓗[α]) (φ : 𝓗[β]) : 𝓗[α × β]

entries.snippet:
lemma prodVec_val (ψ : 𝓗[α]) (φ : 𝓗[β]) (p : α × β) :
    (prodVec ψ φ).val p = ψ.val p.1 * φ.val p.2

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.inner_prodVec

lemma inner_prodVec (ψ ψ' : 𝓗[α]) (φ φ' : 𝓗[β]) :
    ⟪prodVec ψ φ, prodVec ψ' φ'⟫_ℂ = ⟪ψ, ψ'⟫_ℂ * ⟪φ, φ'⟫_ℂ

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.norm_prodVec
entries.snippet: lemma norm_prodVec (ψ : 𝓗[α]) (φ : 𝓗[β]) : ‖prodVec ψ φ‖ = ‖ψ‖ * ‖φ‖

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.norm_prodVec_eq_one
entries.docstring: The product of two unit vectors is a unit vector.
entries.snippet:
lemma norm_prodVec_eq_one {ψ : 𝓗[α]} {φ : 𝓗[β]} (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1) (hφ : ‖φ‖ = 1) :
    ‖prodVec ψ φ‖ = 1

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.prodVec_sub_left
entries.snippet:
lemma prodVec_sub_left (ψ ψ' : 𝓗[α]) (φ : 𝓗[β]) :
    prodVec (ψ - ψ') φ = prodVec ψ φ - prodVec ψ' φ

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.prodVec_sub_right
entries.snippet:
lemma prodVec_sub_right (ψ : 𝓗[α]) (φ φ' : 𝓗[β]) :
    prodVec ψ (φ - φ') = prodVec ψ φ - prodVec ψ φ'

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.prodVec_smul_left
entries.snippet:
lemma prodVec_smul_left (r : ℝ) (ψ : 𝓗[α]) (φ : 𝓗[β]) :
    prodVec (r • ψ) φ = r • prodVec ψ φ

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.prodVec_smul_right
entries.snippet:
lemma prodVec_smul_right (r : ℝ) (ψ : 𝓗[α]) (φ : 𝓗[β]) :
    prodVec ψ (r • φ) = r • prodVec ψ φ

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.onFst_prodVec
entries.snippet:
lemma onFst_prodVec (A : 𝓗[α] →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓗[α]) (ψ : 𝓗[α]) (φ : 𝓗[β]) :
    onFst A (prodVec ψ φ) = prodVec (A ψ) φ

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.onSnd_prodVec
entries.snippet:
lemma onSnd_prodVec (B : 𝓗[β] →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓗[β]) (ψ : 𝓗[α]) (φ : 𝓗[β]) :
    onSnd B (prodVec ψ φ) = prodVec ψ (B φ)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.onFstObservable
entries.docstring: An observable of the first coordinate as an observable of `𝓗[α × β]`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def onFstObservable (a : Observable (𝓗[α] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[α])) :
    Observable (𝓗[α × β] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[α × β])

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.onSndObservable
entries.docstring: An observable of the second coordinate as an observable of `𝓗[α × β]`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def onSndObservable (b : Observable (𝓗[β] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[β])) :
    Observable (𝓗[α × β] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[α × β])

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.expectation_onFstObservable
entries.docstring: The mean of the first coordinate is that of `ψ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma expectation_onFstObservable (a : Observable (𝓗[α] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[α])) :
    (ofVec (norm_prodVec_eq_one hψ hφ))⟨onFstObservable a⟩ = (ofVec hψ)⟨a⟩

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.fluctuation_onFstObservable
entries.docstring: The fluctuation of the first coordinate is that of `ψ`, tensored with `φ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma fluctuation_onFstObservable (a : Observable (𝓗[α] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[α])) :
    (onFstObservable (β := β) a : 𝓗[α × β] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[α × β]) (prodVec ψ φ) -
        (ofVec (norm_prodVec_eq_one hψ hφ))⟨onFstObservable a⟩ • prodVec ψ φ =
      prodVec ((a : 𝓗[α] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[α]) ψ - (ofVec hψ)⟨a⟩ • ψ) φ

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.variance_onFstObservable
entries.snippet:
lemma variance_onFstObservable (a : Observable (𝓗[α] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[α])) :
    variance (ofVec (norm_prodVec_eq_one hψ hφ)) (onFstObservable a) = variance (ofVec hψ) a

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.covariance_onFstObservable
entries.snippet:
lemma covariance_onFstObservable (a b : Observable (𝓗[α] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[α])) :
    covariance (ofVec (norm_prodVec_eq_one hψ hφ)) (onFstObservable a) (onFstObservable b) =
      covariance (ofVec hψ) a b

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.centeredGramDefect_onFstObservable
entries.snippet:
lemma centeredGramDefect_onFstObservable (a b : Observable (𝓗[α] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[α])) :
    centeredGramDefect (ofVec (norm_prodVec_eq_one hψ hφ)) (onFstObservable a)
      (onFstObservable b) = centeredGramDefect (ofVec hψ) a b

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.expectation_onSndObservable
entries.docstring: The mean of the second coordinate is that of `φ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma expectation_onSndObservable (b : Observable (𝓗[β] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[β])) :
    (ofVec (norm_prodVec_eq_one hψ hφ))⟨onSndObservable b⟩ = (ofVec hφ)⟨b⟩

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.fluctuation_onSndObservable
entries.docstring: The fluctuation of the second coordinate is `ψ` tensored with that of `φ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma fluctuation_onSndObservable (b : Observable (𝓗[β] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[β])) :
    (onSndObservable (α := α) b : 𝓗[α × β] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[α × β]) (prodVec ψ φ) -
        (ofVec (norm_prodVec_eq_one hψ hφ))⟨onSndObservable b⟩ • prodVec ψ φ =
      prodVec ψ ((b : 𝓗[β] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[β]) φ - (ofVec hφ)⟨b⟩ • φ)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.variance_onSndObservable
entries.snippet:
lemma variance_onSndObservable (b : Observable (𝓗[β] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[β])) :
    variance (ofVec (norm_prodVec_eq_one hψ hφ)) (onSndObservable b) = variance (ofVec hφ) b

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.covariance_onSndObservable
entries.snippet:
lemma covariance_onSndObservable (a b : Observable (𝓗[β] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[β])) :
    covariance (ofVec (norm_prodVec_eq_one hψ hφ)) (onSndObservable a) (onSndObservable b) =
      covariance (ofVec hφ) a b

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.centeredGramDefect_onSndObservable
entries.snippet:
lemma centeredGramDefect_onSndObservable (a b : Observable (𝓗[β] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[β])) :
    centeredGramDefect (ofVec (norm_prodVec_eq_one hψ hφ)) (onSndObservable a)
      (onSndObservable b) = centeredGramDefect (ofVec hφ) a b

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.inner_fluctuation
entries.docstring: The fluctuation vector of an observable is orthogonal to the state.
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_fluctuation {γ : Type*} [Fintype γ] [DecidableEq γ] {χ : 𝓗[γ]} (hχ : ‖χ‖ = 1)
    (c : Observable (𝓗[γ] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[γ])) :
    ⟪χ, (c : 𝓗[γ] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[γ]) χ - (ofVec hχ)⟨c⟩ • χ⟫_ℂ = 0

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.covariance_onFstObservable_onSndObservable
entries.docstring:
In a product state, an observable of the first coordinate and one of the second are
uncorrelated.
entries.snippet:
lemma covariance_onFstObservable_onSndObservable (a : Observable (𝓗[α] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[α]))
    (b : Observable (𝓗[β] →L[ℂ] 𝓗[β])) :
    covariance (ofVec (norm_prodVec_eq_one hψ hφ)) (onFstObservable a) (onSndObservable b) = 0

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.piProdVec
entries.docstring:
The product vector `(⊗ i, v i) k = ∏ i, v i (k i)` of a finite family of vectors,

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.piProdVec_val

entries.snippet:
lemma piProdVec_val (v : ι → 𝓗[α]) (k : ι → α) :

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.inner_piProdVec
entries.snippet:
lemma inner_piProdVec (v w : ι → 𝓗[α]) :

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.norm_piProdVec
entries.snippet: lemma norm_piProdVec (v : ι → 𝓗[α]) : ‖piProdVec v‖ = ∏ i, ‖v i‖

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.FiniteHilbertSpace.norm_piProdVec_eq_one

entries.snippet: lemma norm_piProdVec_eq_one {v : ι → 𝓗[α]} (hv : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ = 1) : ‖piProdVec v‖ = 1

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Hydrogen.polyLaplacian
entries.docstring: The Laplacian `Σᵢ ∂ᵢ² P` of a polynomial in `d` variables.

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Hydrogen.harmonicSubmodule
entries.docstring: The homogeneous harmonic polynomials of degree `l` in `d` variables.

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Hydrogen.finrank_homogeneousSubmodule
entries.docstring:
The homogeneous polynomials of degree `l` in `d ≥ 1` variables form a space of dimension
`C(l + d - 1, d - 1)`: their monomials correspond to multisets of size `l` in `d` letters.
entries.snippet:
lemma finrank_homogeneousSubmodule {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (l : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin d) ℝ l) = (l + d - 1).choose (d - 1)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Hydrogen.polyLaplacian_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma polyLaplacian_apply {d : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ) :
    polyLaplacian d P = ∑ i, pderiv i (pderiv i P)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Hydrogen.polyLaplacian_isHomogeneous
entries.docstring: The Laplacian lowers the degree of a homogeneous polynomial by two.
entries.snippet:
lemma polyLaplacian_isHomogeneous {d l : ℕ} {P : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ}
    (hP : P.IsHomogeneous (l + 2)) : (polyLaplacian d P).IsHomogeneous l

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Hydrogen.pderiv_eq_zero_of_isHomogeneous_zero
entries.docstring: A homogeneous polynomial of degree `0` is constant, so its derivatives vanish.
entries.snippet:
lemma pderiv_eq_zero_of_isHomogeneous_zero {d : ℕ} {Q : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ}
    (hQ : Q.IsHomogeneous 0) (i : Fin d) : pderiv i Q = 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Hydrogen.polyLaplacian_eq_zero_of_lt_two
entries.docstring: The Laplacian vanishes on homogeneous polynomials of degree `0` and `1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma polyLaplacian_eq_zero_of_lt_two {d l : ℕ} {P : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ}
    (hP : P.IsHomogeneous l) (hl : l < 2) : polyLaplacian d P = 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Hydrogen.fischerWeight
entries.docstring: The weight `m! = Πⱼ mⱼ!` of a monomial exponent `m`.

entries.snippet: lemma fischerWeight_pos (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ) : 0 < fischerWeight m

lemma fischerWeight_add_single (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin d) :

lemma fischer_add_left (P P' Q : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ) :

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Hydrogen.fischer_sum_left

lemma fischer_sum_left {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ)

entries.snippet: lemma fischer_zero_right (P : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ) : fischer P 0 = 0

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Hydrogen.fischer_mul_X
entries.docstring: Multiplication by `Xᵢ` is adjoint to `∂ᵢ` for the Fischer inner product.
entries.snippet:
lemma fischer_mul_X (P Q : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ) (i : Fin d) :
    fischer (P * X i) Q = fischer P (pderiv i Q)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Hydrogen.fischer_self_pos

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Hydrogen.rSq

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Hydrogen.eq_zero_of_polyLaplacian_eq_zero_of_eq_rSq_mul
entries.docstring: A harmonic polynomial divisible by `r²` vanishes: `⟨r² P, r² P⟩ = ⟨P, Δ(r² P)⟩ = 0`.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_zero_of_polyLaplacian_eq_zero_of_eq_rSq_mul {d : ℕ} {P Q : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ}

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Hydrogen.finrank_harmonicSubmodule_add_finrank
entries.docstring: `dim Harm_{l+2} + dim Hom_l = dim Hom_{l+2}`: the Laplacian `Hom_{l+2} → Hom_l` is onto.
entries.snippet:
lemma finrank_harmonicSubmodule_add_finrank {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (l : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (harmonicSubmodule d (l + 2)) +
        Module.finrank ℝ (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin d) ℝ l) =
      Module.finrank ℝ (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin d) ℝ (l + 2))

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Hydrogen.finrank_harmonicSubmodule
entries.docstring:
The homogeneous harmonic polynomials of degree `l` in `d ≥ 2` variables form a space of
dimension `C(l + d - 1, d - 1) - C(l + d - 3, d - 1)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma finrank_harmonicSubmodule {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (l : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (harmonicSubmodule d l) =
      (l + d - 1).choose (d - 1) - (l + d - 3).choose (d - 1)

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Hydrogen.finrank_harmonicSubmodule_three
entries.docstring:
In three variables the homogeneous harmonic polynomials of degree `l` form a space of
dimension `2l + 1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma finrank_harmonicSubmodule_three (l : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (harmonicSubmodule 3 l) = 2 * l + 1

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Hydrogen.sum_two_mul_add_one
entries.snippet: lemma sum_two_mul_add_one (n : ℕ) : ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (2 * l + 1) = (n + 1) ^ 2

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Hydrogen.toFun
entries.docstring: A polynomial in `d` variables as a function on `Space d`.

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Hydrogen.toFun_C

@[simp]
lemma toFun_C {d : ℕ} (a : ℝ) : toFun (C a : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ) = fun _ => a

entries.name: PhyslibAlpha.Hydrogen.toFun_add
