  out of `ℂT[.upL, .upR]`.
entries.snippet:
abbrev IsLeftRightWeyl (B : Type*) [AddCommMonoid B] [Module ℂ B]
    (repLorentz : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) B) (f : ℂT[.upL, .upR] →ₗ[ℂ] B) : Prop

entries.name: Lorentz.IsDualLeftRightWeyl
entries.docstring:
A family with a dual left- and a dual right-handed Weyl index `T_{α α'}`: an equivariant
  linear map out of `ℂT[.downL, .downR]`.
entries.snippet:
abbrev IsDualLeftRightWeyl (B : Type*) [AddCommMonoid B] [Module ℂ B]
    (repLorentz : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) B) (f : ℂT[.downL, .downR] →ₗ[ℂ] B) : Prop

entries.name: Lorentz.eq_zero_of_invariant_leftRight
entries.docstring:
An invariant tensor with a left- and a right-handed Weyl index, or with their duals, is
  zero. The inverse boost along `z` scales the two diagonal components by `4⁻¹` and `4`, and the
  inverse half turn about `z` negates the two mixed ones; for the dual colours the inverse
  cancels against the inverse in the matrix of the colour.

entries.name: Lorentz.IsLeftRightWeyl.reducesInvariantsTo_bot
entries.docstring:
The invariants of the range of a left-right family reduce to `⊥`: a Lorentz invariant of
  `LinearMap.range f ⊔ S`, for `S` a Lorentz-stable submodule, lies in `S`.

entries.name: Lorentz.IsLeftRightWeyl.eq_zero_of_invariant
entries.docstring: Every Lorentz invariant in the range of a left-right family is zero.

entries.name: Lorentz.IsDualLeftRightWeyl.reducesInvariantsTo_bot
entries.docstring:
The invariants of the range of a dual left-right family reduce to `⊥`: a Lorentz invariant
  of `LinearMap.range f ⊔ S`, for `S` a Lorentz-stable submodule, lies in `S`.

entries.name: Lorentz.IsDualLeftRightWeyl.eq_zero_of_invariant
entries.docstring: Every Lorentz invariant in the range of a dual left-right family is zero.

entries.name: Lorentz.IsVectorLeftRightWeyl
entries.docstring:
A family with a four-vector index and a left- and a right-handed Weyl index `T^{μ α α'}`:
  an equivariant linear map out of `ℂT[.up, .upL, .upR]`.
entries.snippet:
abbrev IsVectorLeftRightWeyl (B : Type*) [AddCommMonoid B] [Module ℂ B]
    (repLorentz : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) B) (f : ℂT[.up, .upL, .upR] →ₗ[ℂ] B) : Prop

entries.name: Lorentz.IsVectorLeftRightWeyl.repLorentz_map_indexBasis
entries.docstring:
The components of an equivariant map are moved as `T^{μ α α'}`, the summed index first in
  each factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_map_indexBasis (g : SL(2,ℂ)) (d : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentz g (f (indexBasis d)) = ∑ e : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × Fin 2 × Fin 2,
      ((((SL2C.toLorentzGroup g).1 e.1 d.1 : ℝ) : ℂ)
        * (g.1 e.2.1 d.2.1 * star (g.1 e.2.2 d.2.2))) • f (indexBasis e)

entries.name: Lorentz.IsVectorLeftRightWeyl.repLorentz_sum_smul
entries.docstring:
Moving a contraction of the Weyl pair at vector index `μ`: the vector index moves by the
  Lorentz matrix and the coefficients of the Weyl pair by the matrix of `g` and its complex
  conjugate.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_sum_smul (g : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (c : Fin 2 × Fin 2 → ℂ) :
    repLorentz g (∑ a : Fin 2 × Fin 2, c a • f (indexBasis (μ, a)))
      = ∑ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, (((SL2C.toLorentzGroup g).1 ν μ : ℝ) : ℂ)
        • ∑ q : Fin 2 × Fin 2, (∑ d : Fin 2 × Fin 2, c d * (g.1 q.1 d.1 * star (g.1 q.2 d.2)))
          • f (indexBasis (ν, q))

entries.name: Lorentz.IsVectorLeftRightWeyl.vectorPair
entries.docstring:
The family of two four-vector indices obtained by contracting the Weyl pair of the
  components of `f` against the covariant Pauli matrices.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def vectorPair (f : ℂT[.up, .upL, .upR] →ₗ[ℂ] B) :
    (Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B

entries.name: Lorentz.IsVectorLeftRightWeyl.isLorentzCovariant_vectorPair
entries.docstring:
The reduced family is a rank-two Lorentz family: the intertwining identity
  `SL2C.sum_pauliLower_mul_sl2c` carries the Weyl pair into a second vector index.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzCovariant_vectorPair :
    IsLorentzCovariant 2 B repLorentz (ofComponents (vectorPair f))

entries.name: Lorentz.IsVectorLeftRightWeyl.map_indexBasis_eq_sum_vectorPair
entries.docstring:
The reduction is invertible: by the Fierz completeness relation each component of `f` is
  recovered from the reduced family.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_indexBasis_eq_sum_vectorPair (f : ℂT[.up, .upL, .upR] →ₗ[ℂ] B)
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (b : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    f (indexBasis (μ, b)) = ∑ ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3,
      ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹ * PauliMatrix.pauliLower ρ b.2 b.1) • vectorPair f ![μ, ρ]

entries.name: Lorentz.IsVectorLeftRightWeyl.span_range_vectorPair
entries.docstring: The reduction does not change the span: the reduced family spans the range of `f`.
entries.snippet:
lemma span_range_vectorPair (f : ℂT[.up, .upL, .upR] →ₗ[ℂ] B) :
    Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (vectorPair f)) = LinearMap.range f

entries.name: Lorentz.IsVectorLeftRightWeyl.ofComponents_vectorPair_metric
entries.docstring:
The image of the metric under the map of the reduced family is the image `f σ^^^` of the
  Pauli tensor: the two lowerings of the vector index cancel, so no sign and no scalar appear.
entries.snippet:
lemma ofComponents_vectorPair_metric (f : ℂT[.up, .upL, .upR] →ₗ[ℂ] B) :
    ofComponents (vectorPair f) RankTwo.metric = f σ^^^

entries.name: Lorentz.IsVectorLeftRightWeyl.repLorentz_map_pauliMatrix
entries.docstring: The image `f σ^^^` of the Pauli tensor is Lorentz invariant.
entries.snippet: lemma repLorentz_map_pauliMatrix (g : SL(2,ℂ)) : repLorentz g (f σ^^^) = f σ^^^

entries.name: Lorentz.IsVectorLeftRightWeyl.exists_smul_map_pauliMatrix_add_of_invariant
entries.docstring:
Every Lorentz invariant of `LinearMap.range f ⊔ S`, for `S` a Lorentz-stable submodule, is a
  multiple of the image `f σ^^^` of the Pauli tensor plus an element of `S`: the shape of the
  fermion kinetic term.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_smul_map_pauliMatrix_add_of_invariant (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hS : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ LinearMap.range f ⊔ S) (hinv : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) :
    ∃ a : ℂ, ∃ y ∈ S, x = a • f σ^^^ + y

entries.name: Lorentz.IsVectorLeftRightWeyl.invariantReductionToSpan
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz invariants of the range of `f` reduce to the span of the image `f σ^^^` of the
  Pauli tensor.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def invariantReductionToSpan :
    InvariantReductionToSpan (fun g : SL(2,ℂ) => repLorentz g) (LinearMap.range f) where

entries.name: Lorentz.ofVectorComponents
entries.docstring:
The linear map out of `ℂT[.up, .upL, .upR]` sending `e_μ ⊗ e_α ⊗ e_α'` to
  `T (μ, α, α')`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def ofVectorComponents (T : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × Fin 2 × Fin 2 → B) :
    ℂT[.up, .upL, .upR] →ₗ[ℂ] B

entries.name: Lorentz.ofVectorComponents_indexBasis
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofVectorComponents_indexBasis (T : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × Fin 2 × Fin 2 → B)
    (d : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × Fin 2 × Fin 2) : ofVectorComponents T (indexBasis d) = T d

entries.name: Lorentz.range_ofVectorComponents
entries.docstring: The range of `ofVectorComponents T` is the span of the vectors `T d`.
entries.snippet:
lemma range_ofVectorComponents (T : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × Fin 2 × Fin 2 → B) :
    LinearMap.range (ofVectorComponents T) = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range T)

entries.name: Lorentz.isVectorLeftRightWeyl_ofVectorComponents
entries.docstring:
`ofVectorComponents T` is equivariant when `T (μ, α, α')` is moved as `T^{μ α α'}`: the
  vector index by the Lorentz matrix, the left index by the matrix of `g` and the right index by
  its complex conjugate, the summed index first in each factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma isVectorLeftRightWeyl_ofVectorComponents {repLorentz : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) B}
    (T : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × Fin 2 × Fin 2 → B)
    (hT : ∀ (g : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (l : Fin 2 × Fin 2),
      repLorentz g (T (μ, l)) = ∑ (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), ∑ (a : Fin 2 × Fin 2),
        ((((SL2C.toLorentzGroup g).1 ν μ : ℝ) : ℂ)
          * (g.1 a.1 l.1 * star (g.1 a.2 l.2))) • T (ν, a)) :
    IsVectorLeftRightWeyl B repLorentz (ofVectorComponents T)

entries.name: Lorentz.IsVectorDualLeftRightWeyl
entries.docstring:
A family with a four-vector index and a dual right- and a dual left-handed Weyl index
  `T^μ{}_{α' α}`: an equivariant linear map out of `ℂT[.up, .downR, .downL]`.
entries.snippet:
abbrev IsVectorDualLeftRightWeyl (B : Type*) [AddCommMonoid B] [Module ℂ B]
    (repLorentz : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) B) (f : ℂT[.up, .downR, .downL] →ₗ[ℂ] B) : Prop

entries.name: Lorentz.dualWeylMap
entries.docstring:
Dualising the two Weyl indices of a tensor with a four-vector index and a left-right Weyl
  pair, the dual indices listed in the order of `σ^__`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def dualWeylMap : ℂT[.up, .upL, .upR] →ₗ[ℂ] ℂT[.up, .downR, .downL]

entries.name: Lorentz.dualWeylMap_equivariant
entries.docstring: Dualising the Weyl indices commutes with the action of `SL(2,ℂ)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma dualWeylMap_equivariant (g : SL(2,ℂ)) (t : ℂT[.up, .upL, .upR]) :
    dualWeylMap (g • t) = g • dualWeylMap t

entries.name: Lorentz.dualWeylMap_pauliMatrix
entries.docstring: Dualising the Weyl indices of `σ^^^` gives `σ^__`.
entries.snippet: lemma dualWeylMap_pauliMatrix : dualWeylMap σ^^^ = σ^__

entries.name: Lorentz.dualWeylMap_surjective
entries.docstring:
Dualising the Weyl indices is surjective: the dualisations are inverted by raising the
  indices again, and the relabelling by its inverse.
entries.snippet: lemma dualWeylMap_surjective : Function.Surjective dualWeylMap

entries.name: Lorentz.IsVectorDualLeftRightWeyl.isVectorLeftRightWeyl_comp_dualWeylMap
entries.docstring:
Composing with the dualisation of the Weyl indices gives a family with a four-vector index
  and a left-right Weyl pair.
entries.snippet:
lemma isVectorLeftRightWeyl_comp_dualWeylMap :
    IsVectorLeftRightWeyl B repLorentz (f ∘ₗ dualWeylMap) where

entries.name: Lorentz.IsVectorDualLeftRightWeyl.range_comp_dualWeylMap
entries.docstring: Composing with the dualisation of the Weyl indices does not change the range.
entries.snippet: lemma range_comp_dualWeylMap : LinearMap.range (f ∘ₗ dualWeylMap) = LinearMap.range f

entries.name: Lorentz.IsVectorDualLeftRightWeyl.exists_smul_map_pauliContrDown_add_of_invariant
entries.docstring:
Every Lorentz invariant of `LinearMap.range f ⊔ S`, for `S` a Lorentz-stable submodule, is a
  multiple of the image `f σ^__` of the Pauli tensor with dual Weyl indices plus an element of
  `S`: the kinetic term of a Weyl fermion.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_smul_map_pauliContrDown_add_of_invariant (S : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hS : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ LinearMap.range f ⊔ S) (hinv : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) :
    ∃ a : ℂ, ∃ y ∈ S, x = a • f σ^__ + y

entries.name: Lorentz.IsVectorDualLeftRightWeyl.invariantReductionToSpan
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz invariants of the range of `f` reduce to the span of the image `f σ^__` of the
  Pauli tensor with dual Weyl indices.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def invariantReductionToSpan :
    InvariantReductionToSpan (fun g : SL(2,ℂ) => repLorentz g) (LinearMap.range f) where

entries.name: Lorentz.dualIndexEquiv
entries.docstring:
The component indices of a tensor of `ℂT[.up, .downR, .downL]`, as a four-vector index, a
  dual left-handed and a dual right-handed Weyl index.
entries.snippet:
def dualIndexEquiv : ComponentIdx (S := complexLorentzTensor) ![.up, .downR, .downL] ≃
    (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × Fin 2 × Fin 2 where

entries.name: Lorentz.ofDualVectorComponents
entries.docstring:
The linear map out of `ℂT[.up, .downR, .downL]` sending `e_μ ⊗ e_α' ⊗ e_α` to
  `T (μ, α, α')`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def ofDualVectorComponents (T : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × Fin 2 × Fin 2 → B) :
    ℂT[.up, .downR, .downL] →ₗ[ℂ] B

entries.name: Lorentz.range_ofDualVectorComponents
entries.docstring: The range of `ofDualVectorComponents T` is the span of the vectors `T d`.
entries.snippet:
lemma range_ofDualVectorComponents (T : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × Fin 2 × Fin 2 → B) :
    LinearMap.range (ofDualVectorComponents T) = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range T)

entries.name: Lorentz.ofDualVectorComponents_mem_span
entries.docstring: The image of `ofDualVectorComponents T` lies in the span of the vectors `T d`.
entries.snippet:
lemma ofDualVectorComponents_mem_span (T : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × Fin 2 × Fin 2 → B)
    (t : ℂT[.up, .downR, .downL]) :
    ofDualVectorComponents T t ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range T)

entries.name: Lorentz.ofDualVectorComponents_sum
entries.docstring: `ofDualVectorComponents` of a sum of families is the sum of the maps.
entries.snippet:
lemma ofDualVectorComponents_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (T : ι → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × Fin 2 × Fin 2 → B) :
    ofDualVectorComponents (fun d => ∑ i ∈ s, T i d) = ∑ i ∈ s, ofDualVectorComponents (T i)

entries.name: Lorentz.isVectorDualLeftRightWeyl_ofDualVectorComponents
entries.docstring:
`ofDualVectorComponents T` is equivariant when `T (μ, α, α')` is moved as `T^μ{}_{α α'}`: the
  vector index by the Lorentz matrix, the dual left index by `(g⁻¹)ᵀ` and the dual right index
  by `(g⁻¹)ᴴ`, the summed index first in each factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma isVectorDualLeftRightWeyl_ofDualVectorComponents
    {repLorentz : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) B} (T : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × Fin 2 × Fin 2 → B)
    (hT : ∀ (g : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (l : Fin 2 × Fin 2),
      repLorentz g (T (μ, l)) = ∑ (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), ∑ (a : Fin 2 × Fin 2),
        ((((SL2C.toLorentzGroup g).1 ν μ : ℝ) : ℂ)
          * ((g.1⁻¹)ᵀ a.1 l.1 * (g.1⁻¹)ᴴ a.2 l.2)) • T (ν, a)) :
    IsVectorDualLeftRightWeyl B repLorentz (ofDualVectorComponents T)

entries.name: Lorentz.IsVectorDualLeftRightWeyl.invariantReductionToComponentSpan
entries.docstring:
For a family whose map is equivariant, the Lorentz invariants of the span of the family
  reduce to the span of the image `ofDualVectorComponents T σ^__` of the Pauli tensor with dual
  Weyl indices.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def IsVectorDualLeftRightWeyl.invariantReductionToComponentSpan
    {repLorentz : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) B} {T : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × Fin 2 × Fin 2 → B}
    (hT : IsVectorDualLeftRightWeyl B repLorentz (ofDualVectorComponents T)) :
    InvariantReductionToSpan (fun g : SL(2,ℂ) => repLorentz g)
      (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range T)) where

entries.name: Lorentz.Invariants.lightConeCoeffZ
entries.docstring: The four light-cone directions of axis `i`, as integers.
entries.snippet: def lightConeCoeffZ (i : Fin 3) (κ : Fin 4) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : ℤ

entries.name: Lorentz.Invariants.coe_lightConeCoeffZ
entries.docstring: The integer copy casts to `lightConeCoeff`.
entries.snippet:
lemma coe_lightConeCoeffZ (i : Fin 3) (κ : Fin 4) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    ((lightConeCoeffZ i κ μ : ℤ) : ℂ) = lightConeCoeff i κ μ

entries.name: Lorentz.Invariants.lightConeCoeffInvZ
entries.docstring: Twice the coordinate directions in the light-cone basis, the `2` clearing the halves.
entries.snippet: def lightConeCoeffInvZ (i : Fin 3) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (κ : Fin 4) : ℤ

entries.name: Lorentz.Invariants.coe_lightConeCoeffInvZ_eq_two_mul
entries.docstring: The integer copy is exactly twice `lightConeCoeffInv`.
entries.snippet:
lemma coe_lightConeCoeffInvZ_eq_two_mul (i : Fin 3) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (κ : Fin 4) :
    ((lightConeCoeffInvZ i μ κ : ℤ) : ℂ) = 2 * lightConeCoeffInv i μ κ

entries.name: Lorentz.Invariants.InBoostPlane
entries.docstring: The boost plane of axis `i`: time and the axis, the two directions the boost moves.
entries.snippet: def InBoostPlane (i : Fin 3) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : Prop

entries.name: Lorentz.Invariants.«instance@9fecb20d»
entries.snippet: instance (i : Fin 3) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : Decidable (InBoostPlane i μ)

entries.name: Lorentz.Invariants.lightConeCoeffInvZ_eq_zero_of_inBoostPlane
entries.docstring: A direction in the boost plane has no transverse light-cone components.

entries.name: Lorentz.Invariants.lightConeCoeffInvZ_eq_zero_of_not_inBoostPlane
entries.docstring: A transverse direction has no light-cone components in the boost plane.

entries.name: Lorentz.Invariants.slotZ
entries.docstring: One slot's factor: twice the coefficient of `κ` in `μ`, times that of `ν` in `κ`.
entries.snippet: def slotZ (i : Fin 3) (κ : Fin 4) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : ℤ

entries.name: Lorentz.Invariants.transitionZ
entries.docstring:
Two to the number of slots times the entry, at `d` and `e`, of the map keeping the light-cone
  components of total weight `m` along axis `i`; the factor is the one `lightConeCoeffInvZ`
  carries, one per slot. A slot of `d` in the boost plane takes weight `2` or `-2`, leaving
  `m - 2` or `m + 2`; a transverse slot takes weight `0` and leaves `m`.
entries.snippet:
def transitionZ (i : Fin 3) : {n : ℕ} → (d e : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℤ → ℤ
  | 0, _, _, m => if m = 0 then 1 else 0
  | _ + 1, d, e, m =>
    if InBoostPlane i (d 0) then
      slotZ i 0 (d 0) (e 0) * transitionZ i (Fin.tail d) (Fin.tail e) (m - 2)
        + slotZ i 1 (d 0) (e 0) * transitionZ i (Fin.tail d) (Fin.tail e) (m + 2)
    else (slotZ i 2 (d 0) (e 0) + slotZ i 3 (d 0) (e 0))
      * transitionZ i (Fin.tail d) (Fin.tail e) m

entries.name: Lorentz.Invariants.transitionZ_succ
entries.docstring:
One slot of the transition, with the case split of the recursion resolved: the first slot
  runs over all four light-cone directions, each taking its own weight out of `m`. The two
  directions of the boost plane drop out of a transverse slot and the two transverse ones drop
  out of a slot in the boost plane, which is what the two branches of `transitionZ` record.
entries.snippet:
lemma transitionZ_succ (i : Fin 3) {n : ℕ} (d e : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (m : ℤ) :
    transitionZ i d e m
      = ∑ κ : Fin 4, slotZ i κ (d 0) (e 0)
          * transitionZ i (Fin.tail d) (Fin.tail e) (m - lightConeWeight κ)

entries.name: Lorentz.Invariants.transitionZ_eq_sum
entries.docstring: The recursion unfolded, as a sum over the multi-indices of total weight `m`.
entries.snippet:
lemma transitionZ_eq_sum (i : Fin 3) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (d e : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (m : ℤ),
    transitionZ i d e m
      = ∑ κ ∈ Finset.univ.filter
          (fun κ : Fin n → Fin 4 => (∑ s, lightConeWeight (κ s)) = m),
        ∏ s, slotZ i (κ s) (d s) (e s)
  | 0, d, e, m => by
    rw [Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_unique]
    simp [transitionZ, eq_comm]
  | n + 1, d, e, m => by
    rw [transitionZ_succ,
      Physlib.Fin.sum_filter_weight_succ lightConeWeight fun s κ => slotZ i κ (d s) (e s)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun κ₀ _ => ?_
    rw [transitionZ_eq_sum i (Fin.tail d) (Fin.tail e)]
    rfl

entries.name: Lorentz.IsLorentzCovariant
entries.docstring:
A family with `n` four-vector indices `T^{μ₁ ⋯ μₙ}` in a representation `repLorentz` of
  `SL(2,ℂ)`: an equivariant linear map out of the complex Lorentz tensors with `n` contravariant
  indices.
entries.snippet:
abbrev IsLorentzCovariant (n : ℕ) (B : Type*) [AddCommMonoid B] [Module ℂ B]
    (repLorentz : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) B)
    (f : ℂT(fun _ : Fin n => Color.up) →ₗ[ℂ] B) : Prop

entries.name: Lorentz.sum_pi_fin_two
entries.docstring: A sum over families of two four-vector indices is a double sum.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_pi_fin_two {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : (Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M) :
    ∑ d : Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, f d
      = ∑ x : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, ∑ y : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, f ![x, y]

entries.name: Lorentz.vectorIdx
entries.docstring:
The component indices of a tensor with `n` contravariant indices, which are labelled by
  `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3` in each slot.

entries.name: Lorentz.vectorIdx_symm_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma vectorIdx_symm_apply (d : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (i : Fin n) :
    (vectorIdx n).symm d i = d i

entries.name: Lorentz.coeffEquiv
entries.docstring: The components of a tensor with `n` contravariant indices, as a coefficient tensor.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def coeffEquiv (n : ℕ) :
    ℂT(fun _ : Fin n => Color.up) ≃ₗ[ℂ] ((Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ)

entries.name: Lorentz.coeffEquiv_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma coeffEquiv_apply (t : ℂT(fun _ : Fin n => Color.up)) (d : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    coeffEquiv n t d = (Tensor.basis _).repr t ((vectorIdx n).symm d)

entries.name: Lorentz.coeffEquiv_symm_apply
entries.docstring:
The tensor with coefficient tensor `c` is the combination of the basis tensors with those
  coefficients.
entries.snippet:
lemma coeffEquiv_symm_apply (c : (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ) :
    (coeffEquiv n).symm c = ∑ d, c d • Tensor.basis _ ((vectorIdx n).symm d)

entries.name: Lorentz.permT_coeffEquiv_symm
entries.docstring:
Permuting the slots of a tensor by `σ` permutes its coefficient tensor: slot `i` of
  `permT σ h t` holds slot `σ i` of `t`, so the new coefficient at `d` is the old one at
  `d ∘ σ.symm`.
entries.snippet:
lemma permT_coeffEquiv_symm (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (h : IsReindexing (fun _ : Fin n => Color.up) (fun _ => Color.up) σ)
    (c : (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ) :
    permT σ h ((coeffEquiv n).symm c) = (coeffEquiv n).symm fun d => c (d ∘ σ.symm)

entries.name: Lorentz.coeffEquiv_smul
entries.docstring:
The action of `g` on tensors is the action `act` of its Lorentz matrix on coefficient
  tensors.
entries.snippet:
lemma coeffEquiv_smul (g : SL(2,ℂ)) (t : ℂT(fun _ : Fin n => Color.up)) :
    coeffEquiv n (g • t) = act (SL2C.toLorentzGroup g).1 (coeffEquiv n t)

entries.name: Lorentz.invariant_iff_isInvariantCoeff
entries.docstring:
A tensor is invariant exactly when its coefficient tensor is an invariant coefficient
  tensor.
entries.snippet:
lemma invariant_iff_isInvariantCoeff (t : ℂT(fun _ : Fin n => Color.up)) :
    (∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), g • t = t) ↔ IsInvariantCoeff (coeffEquiv n t)

entries.name: Lorentz.IsLorentzCovariant.reducesInvariantsTo_span
entries.docstring:
When the invariant coefficient tensors lie in the span of the coefficient tensors `K j`, the
  invariants of the range of `f` reduce to the span of the images of the tensors with those
  coefficients.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_span (hf : IsLorentzCovariant n B repLorentz f) {ι : Type*}
    (K : ι → (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ)
    (hK : ∀ c, IsInvariantCoeff c → c ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range K)) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : SL(2,ℂ) => repLorentz g) (LinearMap.range f)
      (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun j => f ((coeffEquiv n).symm (K j))))

entries.name: Lorentz.IsLorentzCovariant.reducesInvariantsTo_bot_of_isInvariantCoeff
entries.docstring: When the only invariant coefficient tensor is zero, the range of `f` reduces to `⊥`.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_bot_of_isInvariantCoeff (hf : IsLorentzCovariant n B repLorentz f)
    (hK : ∀ c : (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ, IsInvariantCoeff c → c = 0) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : SL(2,ℂ) => repLorentz g) (LinearMap.range f) ⊥

entries.name: Lorentz.IsLorentzCovariant.eq_zero_of_isInvariantCoeff
entries.docstring:
When the only invariant coefficient tensor is zero, so is every Lorentz invariant in the
  range of `f`.

entries.name: Lorentz.ofComponents
entries.docstring:
The linear map out of the tensors with `n` contravariant indices sending the basis tensor
  with components `d` to `T d`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def ofComponents (T : (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) :
    ℂT(fun _ : Fin n => Color.up) →ₗ[ℂ] B

entries.name: Lorentz.ofComponents_coeffEquiv_symm
entries.docstring: `ofComponents T` contracts the coefficient tensor of its argument with `T`.
entries.snippet:
lemma ofComponents_coeffEquiv_symm (T : (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B)
    (c : (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ) :
    ofComponents T ((coeffEquiv n).symm c) = ∑ d, c d • T d

entries.name: Lorentz.range_ofComponents
entries.docstring: The range of `ofComponents T` is the span of the vectors `T d`.
entries.snippet:
lemma range_ofComponents (T : (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) :
    LinearMap.range (ofComponents T) = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range T)

entries.name: Lorentz.ofComponents_sum
entries.docstring: `ofComponents` of a sum of families is the sum of the maps.
entries.snippet:
lemma ofComponents_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (T : ι → (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) :
    ofComponents (fun d => ∑ i ∈ s, T i d) = ∑ i ∈ s, ofComponents (T i)

entries.name: Lorentz.comp_ofComponents
entries.docstring:
A linear map applied after `ofComponents T` is `ofComponents` of its values on the
  components.
entries.snippet:
lemma comp_ofComponents {B' : Type*} [AddCommGroup B'] [Module ℂ B'] (σ : B →ₗ[ℂ] B')
    (T : (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) :
    σ ∘ₗ ofComponents T = ofComponents fun d => σ (T d)

entries.name: Lorentz.ofComponents_comp_permT
entries.docstring:
Precomposing `ofComponents T` with the slot permutation `permT σ` reads the family at the
  permuted index vectors `d ∘ σ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma ofComponents_comp_permT (σ : Fin n → Fin n)
    (h : IsReindexing (fun _ : Fin n => Color.up) (fun _ => Color.up) σ)
    (T : (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) :
    ofComponents T ∘ₗ permT σ h = ofComponents fun d => T (d ∘ σ)

entries.name: Lorentz.ofComponents_comp_permT_eq_neg
entries.docstring:
A family antisymmetric under reading its index vectors through `σ` gives a map
  antisymmetric under `permT σ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma ofComponents_comp_permT_eq_neg (σ : Fin n → Fin n)
    (h : IsReindexing (fun _ : Fin n => Color.up) (fun _ => Color.up) σ)
    {T : (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B} (hT : ∀ d, T (d ∘ σ) = -T d) :
    ofComponents T ∘ₗ permT σ h = -ofComponents T

entries.name: Lorentz.ofComponents_comp_permT_eq_self
entries.docstring:
A family symmetric under reading its index vectors through `σ` gives a map invariant under
  `permT σ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma ofComponents_comp_permT_eq_self (σ : Fin n → Fin n)
    (h : IsReindexing (fun _ : Fin n => Color.up) (fun _ => Color.up) σ)
    {T : (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B} (hT : ∀ d, T (d ∘ σ) = T d) :
    ofComponents T ∘ₗ permT σ h = ofComponents T

entries.name: Lorentz.isLorentzCovariant_ofComponents_iff
entries.docstring:
The map of a family is equivariant exactly when the family obeys the transformation law of
  the components of a tensor with `n` four-vector indices.
entries.snippet:
lemma isLorentzCovariant_ofComponents_iff {repLorentz : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) B}
    (T : (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) :
    IsLorentzCovariant n B repLorentz (ofComponents T) ↔
      ∀ (g : SL(2,ℂ)) l, repLorentz g (T l) = ∑ a : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3,
        (∏ i, (((SL2C.toLorentzGroup g).1 (a i) (l i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • T a

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.contractionCoeff
entries.docstring: The four coefficient tensors: the three metric pairings, then the Levi-Civita symbol.
entries.snippet: def contractionCoeff : Fin 4 → (Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℤ

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.contractionTensor
entries.docstring:
The four invariant tensors with four contravariant indices: `η_{μν} η_{ρσ}`,
  `η_{μρ} η_{νσ}`, `η_{μσ} η_{νρ}` and `ε_{μνρσ}`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def contractionTensor (i : Fin 4) : ℂT(fun _ : Fin 4 => Color.up)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.ofComponents_contractionTensor
entries.docstring:
`ofComponents T` sends each invariant tensor to the contraction of `T` with its
  coefficients.
entries.snippet:
lemma ofComponents_contractionTensor (T : (Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) (i : Fin 4) :
    ofComponents T (contractionTensor i) = ∑ d, ((contractionCoeff i d : ℤ) : ℂ) • T d

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.sum_pi_four
entries.docstring: Bookkeeping: a sum over index vectors is a fourfold sum over directions.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_pi_four {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (F : (Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M) :
    ∑ d : Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, F d
      = ∑ x : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, ∑ y : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, ∑ z : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3,
        ∑ w : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, F ![x, y, z, w]

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.act_outerPair
entries.docstring:
The pairing of slots `(0,1)` and `(2,3)` is fixed: two copies of
  `LorentzGroup.sum_minkowskiMatrixZ_mul`.
entries.snippet:
lemma act_outerPair (Λ : LorentzGroup 3) (a : Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    act Λ.1 (fun d => ((minkowskiMatrixZ (d 0) (d 1) * minkowskiMatrixZ (d 2) (d 3) : ℤ) : ℂ)) a
      = ((minkowskiMatrixZ (a 0) (a 1) * minkowskiMatrixZ (a 2) (a 3) : ℤ) : ℂ)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.act_outerPair_comp
entries.docstring: The same for the slots permuted by `σ`, by renaming the summation variable.
entries.snippet:
lemma act_outerPair_comp (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (Λ : LorentzGroup 3)
    (a : Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    act Λ.1 (fun d => ((minkowskiMatrixZ (d (σ 0)) (d (σ 1))
        * minkowskiMatrixZ (d (σ 2)) (d (σ 3)) : ℤ) : ℂ)) a
      = ((minkowskiMatrixZ (a (σ 0)) (a (σ 1))
        * minkowskiMatrixZ (a (σ 2)) (a (σ 3)) : ℤ) : ℂ)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.act_leviCivitaSymbol
entries.docstring:
The symbol is fixed by a Lorentz matrix of determinant `1`; in general it picks up `det Λ`,
  by `sum_leviCivitaSymbol_mul_prod`.
entries.snippet:
lemma act_leviCivitaSymbol (Λ : LorentzGroup 3) (hΛ : Λ.1.det = 1) (a : Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    act Λ.1 (fun d => ((leviCivitaSymbol fun μ => d (finSumFinEquiv μ) : ℤ) : ℂ)) a
      = ((leviCivitaSymbol fun μ => a (finSumFinEquiv μ) : ℤ) : ℂ)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.isInvariantCoeff_contractionCoeff
entries.docstring: The four coefficient tensors are invariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma isInvariantCoeff_contractionCoeff (i : Fin 4) :
    IsInvariantCoeff fun d => ((contractionCoeff i d : ℤ) : ℂ)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.contractionTensor_invariant
entries.docstring: Each of the four tensors is Lorentz invariant, its coefficient tensor being invariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma contractionTensor_invariant (i : Fin 4) (g : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    g • contractionTensor i = contractionTensor i

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.isReindexing_swap_two_three
entries.docstring: Exchanging the last two of four contravariant slots is a reindexing.
entries.snippet:
lemma isReindexing_swap_two_three :
    Tensor.IsReindexing (fun _ : Fin 4 => Color.up) (fun _ => Color.up)
      ⇑(Equiv.swap (2 : Fin 4) 3)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.permT_swap_two_three_contractionTensor_zero
entries.docstring: `η_{μν} η_{ρσ}` is unchanged by exchanging its last two slots.
entries.snippet:
lemma permT_swap_two_three_contractionTensor_zero :
    Tensor.permT _ isReindexing_swap_two_three (contractionTensor 0) = contractionTensor 0

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.permT_swap_two_three_contractionTensor_one
entries.docstring: Exchanging the last two slots of `η_{μρ} η_{νσ}` gives `η_{μσ} η_{νρ}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma permT_swap_two_three_contractionTensor_one :
    Tensor.permT _ isReindexing_swap_two_three (contractionTensor 1) = contractionTensor 2

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.apply_contractionTensor_zero_of_antisymm
entries.docstring: A map antisymmetric in the last two slots sends `η_{μν} η_{ρσ}` to zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma apply_contractionTensor_zero_of_antisymm
    (hf : f ∘ₗ Tensor.permT _ isReindexing_swap_two_three = -f) :
    f (contractionTensor 0) = 0

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.apply_contractionTensor_two_of_antisymm
entries.docstring:
A map antisymmetric in the last two slots sends `η_{μσ} η_{νρ}` to minus the image of
  `η_{μρ} η_{νσ}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma apply_contractionTensor_two_of_antisymm
    (hf : f ∘ₗ Tensor.permT _ isReindexing_swap_two_three = -f) :
    f (contractionTensor 2) = -f (contractionTensor 1)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.span_range_contractionTensor_of_antisymm
entries.docstring:
For a map antisymmetric in the last two slots, the images of the four invariant tensors
  span the same as the images of `η_{μρ} η_{νσ}` and `ε_{μνρσ}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma span_range_contractionTensor_of_antisymm
    (hf : f ∘ₗ Tensor.permT _ isReindexing_swap_two_three = -f) :
    Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun i => f (contractionTensor i))
      = Submodule.span ℂ {f (contractionTensor 1), f (contractionTensor 3)}

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.isReindexing_swap_zero_one
entries.docstring: Exchanging the first two of four contravariant slots is a reindexing.
entries.snippet:
lemma isReindexing_swap_zero_one :
    Tensor.IsReindexing (fun _ : Fin 4 => Color.up) (fun _ => Color.up)
      ⇑(Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 4) 1)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.permT_swap_zero_one_contractionTensor_one
entries.docstring: Exchanging the first two slots of `η_{μρ} η_{νσ}` gives `η_{μσ} η_{νρ}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma permT_swap_zero_one_contractionTensor_one :
    Tensor.permT _ isReindexing_swap_zero_one (contractionTensor 1) = contractionTensor 2

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.permT_swap_zero_one_contractionTensor_three
entries.docstring: Exchanging the first two slots negates `ε_{μνρσ}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma permT_swap_zero_one_contractionTensor_three :
    Tensor.permT _ isReindexing_swap_zero_one (contractionTensor 3) = -contractionTensor 3

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.apply_contractionTensor_one_of_symm_of_antisymm
entries.docstring:
A map symmetric in the first two slots and antisymmetric in the last two sends
  `η_{μρ} η_{νσ}` to zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma apply_contractionTensor_one_of_symm_of_antisymm
    (hs : f ∘ₗ Tensor.permT _ isReindexing_swap_zero_one = f)
    (ha : f ∘ₗ Tensor.permT _ isReindexing_swap_two_three = -f) :
    f (contractionTensor 1) = 0

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.apply_contractionTensor_three_of_symm
entries.docstring: A map symmetric in the first two slots sends `ε_{μνρσ}` to zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma apply_contractionTensor_three_of_symm
    (hs : f ∘ₗ Tensor.permT _ isReindexing_swap_zero_one = f) :
    f (contractionTensor 3) = 0

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.IsHalfTurnFixed
entries.docstring:
All three half turns fix the coefficient at `d`, that is the sign product is `1` for each
  axis. Equivalently, and not used below, all four directions occur an even number of times
  among the slots, or all four an odd number.
entries.snippet: def IsHalfTurnFixed (d : Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : Prop

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.«instance@a4f244ea»
entries.snippet: instance : DecidablePred IsHalfTurnFixed

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.eq_zero_of_not_isHalfTurnFixed
entries.docstring: An invariant coefficient tensor vanishes off the half-turn fixed index vectors.

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.sixteen_mul_eq_sum_transitionZ
entries.docstring: An invariant coefficient tensor is its own weight-zero projection.

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.orbitRep
entries.docstring: One index vector from each of the `22` orbits, checked by the two lemmas below.
entries.snippet: def orbitRep : Fin 22 → Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.orbit
entries.docstring: The `k`-th representative and its two cyclings; for `tttt` the three coincide.
entries.snippet: def orbit (k : Fin 22) : Finset (Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.isHalfTurnFixed_iff_exists_mem_orbit
entries.docstring: The vectors in one of the `22` orbits are exactly the half-turn fixed ones, a finite check.
entries.snippet:
lemma isHalfTurnFixed_iff_exists_mem_orbit :
    ∀ d, IsHalfTurnFixed d ↔ ∃ k, d ∈ orbit k

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.disjoint_orbit
entries.docstring: Different orbits share no index vector, a finite check.
entries.snippet: lemma disjoint_orbit : ∀ k l : Fin 22, k ≠ l → Disjoint (orbit k) (orbit l)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.eq_of_mem_orbit
entries.docstring: An index vector lies in at most one orbit.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_of_mem_orbit {k l : Fin 22} {d : Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3}
    (hk : d ∈ orbit k) (hl : d ∈ orbit l) : k = l

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.eq_orbitRep_of_mem_orbit
entries.docstring: A tensor unchanged by cycling takes, on an orbit, its value at the representative.

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.ofOrbitCoord
entries.docstring: The coefficient tensor with orbit coordinates `b`, and `0` off the orbits.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def ofOrbitCoord (b : Fin 22 → ℂ) (d : Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : ℂ

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.eq_ofOrbitCoord
entries.docstring: An invariant coefficient tensor is rebuilt from its `22` orbit coordinates.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_ofOrbitCoord {c : (Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ} (hc : IsInvariantCoeff c) :
    c = ofOrbitCoord fun k => c (orbitRep k)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.sum_mul_ofOrbitCoord
entries.docstring: Contracting against such a tensor collects the `256` index vectors into the `22` orbits.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_mul_ofOrbitCoord (f : (Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ) (b : Fin 22 → ℂ) :
    ∑ e, f e * ofOrbitCoord b e = ∑ l, (∑ e ∈ orbit l, f e) * b l

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.orbitMatrix
entries.docstring:
Forty-eight times the weight-zero projection along `z` on the orbit coordinates, the three
  cyclings summed and not averaged, so `48 = 3 * 16`. Meaningful only through
  `orbitMatrix_apply`.
entries.snippet: def orbitMatrix : Matrix (Fin 22) (Fin 22) ℤ

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.decidableForallEntries
entries.docstring: Decidability for a matrix against a function; search misses the `Matrix` synonym.
entries.snippet:
private instance decidableForallEntries {n : ℕ} (f : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ)
    (g : Fin n → Fin n → ℤ) : Decidable (∀ k l, f k l = g k l)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.decidableForallEntries'
entries.docstring: The same for two matrices, which is the shape of `certificate`.
entries.snippet:
private instance decidableForallEntries' {n : ℕ} (f g : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) :
    Decidable (∀ k l, f k l = g k l)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.orbitMatrix_apply
entries.docstring: Each entry sums the `z`-axis transitions from orbit `k` into orbit `l`, a finite check.
entries.snippet:
lemma orbitMatrix_apply : ∀ k l : Fin 22,
    orbitMatrix k l = ∑ e ∈ orbit l, (transitionZ 2 (orbitRep k) e 0
      + transitionZ 2 (cycIdx (orbitRep k)) e 0
      + transitionZ 2 (cycIdx (cycIdx (orbitRep k))) e 0)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.orbitMatrix_mulVec
entries.docstring: The orbit coordinates of an invariant coefficient tensor satisfy `M b = 48 b`.
entries.snippet:
lemma orbitMatrix_mulVec {c : (Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ}
    (hc : IsInvariantCoeff c) :
    orbitMatrix.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℂ) *ᵥ (fun k => c (orbitRep k))
      = (48 : ℂ) • fun k => c (orbitRep k)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.contractionOrbit
entries.docstring: The orbit coordinates of the `i`-th coefficient tensor.
entries.snippet: def contractionOrbit (i : Fin 4) (k : Fin 22) : ℤ

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.contractionWeight
entries.docstring:
Four rows of `22` integers paired with `contractionOrbit` to build `projector`. Found by
  computation and characterised by `contractionWeight_mul_contractionOrbit`; unrelated to boost
  weight.
entries.snippet: def contractionWeight : Fin 4 → Fin 22 → ℤ

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.contractionWeight_mul_contractionOrbit
entries.docstring: The weight rows and orbit coordinates pair to `24 δᵢⱼ`, a finite check.
entries.snippet:
lemma contractionWeight_mul_contractionOrbit : ∀ i j : Fin 4,
    ∑ k, contractionWeight i k * contractionOrbit j k = if i = j then 24 else 0

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.projector
entries.docstring: Four rank-one matrices, so it sends any vector to a combination of the `v i`.
entries.snippet: def projector : Matrix (Fin 22) (Fin 22) ℤ

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.certificate
entries.docstring: An identity between `22 × 22` integer matrices, a finite check over `484` entries.
entries.snippet:
lemma certificate :
    orbitMatrix * (orbitMatrix - 32 • 1) * (orbitMatrix - 16 • 1)
      * (orbitMatrix * orbitMatrix - 44 • orbitMatrix + 192 • 1) = 393216 • projector

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.projector_mulVec
entries.docstring:
The integer projector matrix acts on invariant orbit coordinates by multiplication by `24`.
  The `24` is the normalization of `projector`: each factor of the certificate acts on such a
  vector as a scalar, `M` by `48`, `M - z` by `48 - z` and the quadratic factor by
  `48 ^ 2 - 44 * 48 + 192 = 384`, so the left-hand side scales it by
  `48 * 32 * 16 * 384 = 9437184`, and dividing by the `393216` on the right leaves `24`.
entries.snippet:
lemma projector_mulVec {c : (Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ} (hc : IsInvariantCoeff c) :
    projector.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℂ) *ᵥ (fun k => c (orbitRep k))
      = (24 : ℂ) • fun k => c (orbitRep k)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.orbitCoord_eq
entries.docstring:
`24` times an orbit coordinate of an invariant tensor, read entry by entry off the previous
  lemma: `projector` is built from the columns `contractionOrbit i` and the rows
  `contractionWeight i`.
entries.snippet:
lemma orbitCoord_eq {c : (Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ} (hc : IsInvariantCoeff c)
    (k : Fin 22) :
    24 * c (orbitRep k)
      = ∑ i, (contractionOrbit i k : ℂ) * ∑ l, (contractionWeight i l : ℂ) * c (orbitRep l)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.exists_eq_sum
entries.docstring: An invariant coefficient tensor is a combination of the four.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_eq_sum {c : (Fin 4 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ} (hc : IsInvariantCoeff c) :
    ∃ a : Fin 4 → ℂ, c = fun d => ∑ i, a i * ((contractionCoeff i d : ℤ) : ℂ)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.reducesInvariantsTo_span_contractionTensor
entries.docstring:
The invariants of the range of `f` reduce to the span of the images of the four invariant
  tensors.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_span_contractionTensor (hf : IsLorentzCovariant 4 B repLorentz f) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : SL(2,ℂ) => repLorentz g) (LinearMap.range f)
      (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun i => f (contractionTensor i)))

entries.name: Lorentz.RankFour.mem_range_sup_invariant_iff
entries.docstring:
A vector of `LinearMap.range f ⊔ S`, for `S` a Lorentz-stable submodule, is invariant exactly
  when it is a combination of the images of the four invariant tensors plus an invariant of
  `S`. `hS` is used only left to right.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_range_sup_invariant_iff (hf : IsLorentzCovariant 4 B repLorentz f) (x : B)
    (S : Submodule ℂ B) (hS : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) :
    (x ∈ LinearMap.range f ⊔ S ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x)
      ↔ ∃ a : Fin 4 → ℂ, ∃ y ∈ S, x = ∑ i, a i • f (contractionTensor i) + y
        ∧ ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g y = y

entries.name: Lorentz.RankOne.Transverse
entries.docstring: A direction transverse to the boost along axis `i`: neither time nor the axis.
entries.snippet: def Transverse (i : Fin 3) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : Prop

entries.name: Lorentz.RankOne.«instance@7a1aa37e»
entries.snippet: instance (i : Fin 3) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : Decidable (Transverse i μ)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankOne.prod_lightConeCoeffInv_eq_zero
entries.docstring: A non-transverse direction has no weight-zero light-cone coefficient.

entries.name: Lorentz.RankOne.eq_zero_of_not_transverse
entries.docstring: An invariant coefficient tensor vanishes off the two directions transverse to the axis.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_zero_of_not_transverse {c : (Fin 1 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ} (hc : IsInvariantCoeff c)
    (i : Fin 3) {d : Fin 1 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3} (hd : ¬ Transverse i (d 0)) : c d = 0

entries.name: Lorentz.RankOne.not_transverse_all
entries.docstring: No direction is transverse to all three axes at once, a finite check.
entries.snippet:
lemma not_transverse_all (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    ¬(Transverse 0 μ ∧ Transverse 1 μ ∧ Transverse 2 μ)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankOne.eq_zero_of_isInvariantCoeff
entries.docstring: An invariant coefficient tensor is zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_zero_of_isInvariantCoeff {c : (Fin 1 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ}
    (hc : IsInvariantCoeff c) : c = 0

entries.name: Lorentz.RankOne.eq_zero_of_invariant
entries.docstring:
Every Lorentz invariant in the range of `f` is zero: one index carry no invariant
  contraction.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_zero_of_invariant (hf : IsLorentzCovariant 1 B repLorentz f) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ LinearMap.range f) (hinv : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) : x = 0

entries.name: Lorentz.RankOne.reducesInvariantsTo_bot
entries.docstring:
The range of `f` reduces to `⊥`: a Lorentz invariant of `LinearMap.range f ⊔ S`, for `S` a
  Lorentz-stable submodule, lies in `S`.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_bot (hf : IsLorentzCovariant 1 B repLorentz f) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : SL(2,ℂ) => repLorentz g) (LinearMap.range f) ⊥

entries.name: Lorentz.lightConeSign
entries.docstring:
The sign the half turn about an axis gives each light-cone direction of that axis: `1` on
  the two of weight `±2`, `-1` on the two transverse ones.
entries.snippet: def lightConeSign (κ : Fin 4) : ℤ

entries.name: Lorentz.sum_halfTurn_lightConeCoeff
entries.docstring:
The half turn about the axis `i` acts on each light-cone direction along that axis
  by its sign.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_halfTurn_lightConeCoeff (i : Fin 3) (κ : Fin 4) (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    ∑ μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, lightConeCoeff i κ μ *
        (((SL2C.toLorentzGroup (SL2C.halfTurn i)).1 ν μ : ℝ) : ℂ)
      = ((lightConeSign κ : ℤ) : ℂ) * lightConeCoeff i κ ν

entries.name: Lorentz.sum_prod_halfTurn_lightConeCoeff
entries.docstring:
The scalar behind the action of the half turn on a light-cone multi-index: the half
  turn acts slot by slot, so the product of the per-slot signs factors out.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_prod_halfTurn_lightConeCoeff (i : Fin 3) {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Fin 4)
    (a : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    ∑ d : Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, (∏ j, lightConeCoeff i (c j) (d j)) *
        (∏ j, (((SL2C.toLorentzGroup (SL2C.halfTurn i)).1 (a j) (d j) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      = ((∏ j, lightConeSign (c j) : ℤ) : ℂ) * ∏ j, lightConeCoeff i (c j) (a j)

entries.name: Lorentz.prod_lightConeSign_of_sum_lightConeWeight_eq_zero
entries.docstring:
A light-cone multi-index of three slots and total boost weight zero has an odd
  number of transverse slots, so the half turn acts on it by `-1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma prod_lightConeSign_of_sum_lightConeWeight_eq_zero (c : Fin 3 → Fin 4)
    (hc : (∑ j, lightConeWeight (c j)) = 0) : ∏ j, lightConeSign (c j) = -1

entries.name: Lorentz.RankThree.lightConeComponent_act_halfTurn
entries.docstring: The half turn multiplies a light-cone component by the product of the signs of its slots.
entries.snippet:
lemma lightConeComponent_act_halfTurn {n : ℕ} (i : Fin 3)
    (c : (Fin n → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ) (κ : Fin n → Fin 4) :
    lightConeComponent i (act (SL2C.toLorentzGroup (SL2C.halfTurn i)).1 c) κ
      = ((∏ s, lightConeSign (κ s) : ℤ) : ℂ) * lightConeComponent i c κ

entries.name: Lorentz.RankThree.lightConeComponent_eq_zero_of_weight_zero
entries.docstring:
An invariant coefficient tensor has no weight-zero light-cone component either, the half
  turn negating those.

entries.name: Lorentz.RankThree.eq_zero_of_isInvariantCoeff
entries.docstring: An invariant coefficient tensor is zero: no light-cone component of it survives.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_zero_of_isInvariantCoeff {c : (Fin 3 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ}
    (hc : IsInvariantCoeff c) : c = 0

entries.name: Lorentz.RankThree.eq_zero_of_invariant
entries.docstring:
Every Lorentz invariant in the range of `f` is zero: three indices carry no invariant
  contraction.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_zero_of_invariant (hf : IsLorentzCovariant 3 B repLorentz f) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ LinearMap.range f) (hinv : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) : x = 0

entries.name: Lorentz.RankThree.reducesInvariantsTo_bot
entries.docstring:
The range of `f` reduces to `⊥`: a Lorentz invariant of `LinearMap.range f ⊔ S`, for `S` a
  Lorentz-stable submodule, lies in `S`.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_bot (hf : IsLorentzCovariant 3 B repLorentz f) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : SL(2,ℂ) => repLorentz g) (LinearMap.range f) ⊥

entries.name: Lorentz.RankTwo.metric
entries.docstring:
The metric `η` on two contravariant indices, with its colours relabelled from
  `![.up, .up]` to `fun _ => .up`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def metric : ℂT(fun _ : Fin 2 => Color.up)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankTwo.metric_invariant
entries.docstring: The metric is Lorentz invariant.
entries.snippet: lemma metric_invariant (g : SL(2,ℂ)) : g • metric = metric

entries.name: Lorentz.RankTwo.coeffEquiv_symm_minkowskiMatrixZ
entries.docstring: The coefficient tensor of the metric is the Minkowski metric.
entries.snippet:
lemma coeffEquiv_symm_minkowskiMatrixZ :
    (coeffEquiv 2).symm (fun d => ((minkowskiMatrixZ (d 0) (d 1) : ℤ) : ℂ)) = metric

entries.name: Lorentz.RankTwo.ofComponents_metric
entries.docstring: `ofComponents T` sends the metric to the contraction `η_{μν} T^{μν}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma ofComponents_metric (T : (Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) :
    ofComponents T metric
      = ∑ d : Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, ((minkowskiMatrixZ (d 0) (d 1) : ℤ) : ℂ) • T d

entries.name: Lorentz.RankTwo.exists_halfTurnSign_mul_ne_one
entries.docstring:
Two distinct directions are told apart by the half turn about some axis: it keeps one and
  negates the other, a finite check.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_halfTurnSign_mul_ne_one :
    ∀ μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, μ ≠ ν → ∃ k, halfTurnSign k μ * halfTurnSign k ν ≠ 1

entries.name: Lorentz.RankTwo.eq_zero_of_ne
entries.docstring:
An invariant coefficient tensor has no off-diagonal coefficients: for `μ ≠ ν` some half
  turn multiplies `c_{μν}` by `-1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_zero_of_ne {c : (Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ} (hc : IsInvariantCoeff c)
    {d : Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3} (hd : d 0 ≠ d 1) : c d = 0

entries.name: Lorentz.RankTwo.apply_inr_inr_eq
entries.docstring:
The three spatial diagonal coefficients of an invariant coefficient tensor agree: the
  cyclic rotation carries `c_xx` to `c_yy` to `c_zz`.
entries.snippet:
lemma apply_inr_inr_eq {c : (Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ} (hc : IsInvariantCoeff c)
    (j : Fin 3) : c ![Sum.inr j, Sum.inr j] = c ![Sum.inr 2, Sum.inr 2]

entries.name: Lorentz.RankTwo.apply_inl_inl_add_apply_inr_inr
entries.docstring:
The time and spatial diagonal coefficients of an invariant coefficient tensor are opposite.
  The boost along `z` scales the light-cone component along `D₀ - D_z` in both slots by `t⁴`, so
  that component, `c_tt - c_tz - c_zt + c_zz`, vanishes, and the mixed terms are `0`.
entries.snippet:
lemma apply_inl_inl_add_apply_inr_inr {c : (Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ}
    (hc : IsInvariantCoeff c) : c ![Sum.inl 0, Sum.inl 0] + c ![Sum.inr 2, Sum.inr 2] = 0

entries.name: Lorentz.RankTwo.eq_smul_minkowskiMatrixZ
entries.docstring: An invariant coefficient tensor is `c_tt` times the Minkowski metric.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_smul_minkowskiMatrixZ {c : (Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ} (hc : IsInvariantCoeff c)
    (d : Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    c d = c ![Sum.inl 0, Sum.inl 0] * ((minkowskiMatrixZ (d 0) (d 1) : ℤ) : ℂ)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankTwo.reducesInvariantsTo_span_metric
entries.docstring:
The invariants of the range of `f` reduce to the line through the image `f metric` of the
  metric: a Lorentz invariant of `LinearMap.range f ⊔ S`, for `S` a Lorentz-stable submodule, is
  a multiple of `f metric` plus an element of `S`.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_span_metric (hf : IsLorentzCovariant 2 B repLorentz f) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : SL(2,ℂ) => repLorentz g) (LinearMap.range f)
      (ℂ ∙ f metric)

entries.name: Lorentz.RankTwo.exists_smul_map_metric_add_of_invariant
entries.docstring:
Every Lorentz invariant of `LinearMap.range f ⊔ S`, for `S` a Lorentz-stable submodule, is a
  multiple of the image `f metric` of the metric plus an element of `S`.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_smul_map_metric_add_of_invariant (hf : IsLorentzCovariant 2 B repLorentz f)
    (S : Submodule ℂ B) (hS : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), ∀ y ∈ S, repLorentz g y ∈ S) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ LinearMap.range f ⊔ S) (hinv : ∀ g : SL(2,ℂ), repLorentz g x = x) :
    ∃ a : ℂ, ∃ y ∈ S, x = a • f metric + y

entries.name: Lorentz.RankTwo.exists_smul_map_metric_of_invariant
entries.docstring:
Every Lorentz invariant in the range of `f` is a multiple of the image `f metric` of the
  metric.

entries.name: Lorentz.lorentzMixStep
entries.docstring:
One peeling step of the Lorentz mixing: the direction `a` is removed from the multiset
  index of the family and put back as every direction `b`, weighted by `Λ_{b a}`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def lorentzMixStep (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (a : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (G : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M) : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M

entries.name: Lorentz.«instance@f19f6486»
entries.docstring: Peeling two directions commutes, so the mixing is well defined on a multiset.
entries.snippet: instance (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) : LeftCommutative (lorentzMixStep (M := M) Λ) where

entries.name: Lorentz.lorentzMix
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz mixing of a multiset-indexed family along a multiset `s` of directions:
  every direction of `s` is peeled and replaced by all directions, weighted by the
  corresponding column of the Lorentz matrix.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def lorentzMix (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (G : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M

entries.name: Lorentz.lorentzMix_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma lorentzMix_zero : lorentzMix Λ G 0 = G

entries.name: Lorentz.lorentzMix_cons_apply
entries.docstring: Mixing along `a ::ₘ s` peels `a` after mixing along `s`.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzMix_cons_apply (a : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    lorentzMix Λ G (a ::ₘ s) t = ∑ b, L[Λ] b a • lorentzMix Λ G s (b ::ₘ t)

entries.name: Lorentz.lorentzMix_apply_add
entries.docstring:
Evaluating a mixed family away from the empty multiset is mixing the translated
  family at the empty multiset.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzMix_apply_add (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    ∀ (G : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M) (t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)),
      lorentzMix Λ G s t = lorentzMix Λ (fun r => G (r + t)) s 0

entries.name: Lorentz.lorentzMix_cons_zero
entries.docstring: Peeling at the empty multiset: the peeled direction is pushed into the family.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzMix_cons_zero (a : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    lorentzMix Λ G (a ::ₘ s) 0 = ∑ b, L[Λ] b a • lorentzMix Λ (fun t => G (b ::ₘ t)) s 0

entries.name: Lorentz.lorentzMix_map
entries.docstring: The mixing operator commutes with any linear map applied to the values.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzMix_map (Φ : M →ₗ[ℂ] N) (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    Φ (lorentzMix Λ G s t) = lorentzMix Λ (fun r => Φ (G r)) s t

entries.name: Lorentz.lorentzMix_smul_fam
entries.docstring: The mixing operator is homogeneous in the family.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzMix_smul_fam (c : ℂ) (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    lorentzMix Λ (fun r => c • G r) s t = c • lorentzMix Λ G s t

entries.name: Lorentz.lorentzMix_add_fam
entries.docstring: The mixing operator is additive in the family.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzMix_add_fam (G₁ G₂ : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M)
    (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    lorentzMix Λ (fun r => G₁ r + G₂ r) s t = lorentzMix Λ G₁ s t + lorentzMix Λ G₂ s t

entries.name: Lorentz.lorentzMix_sum_fam
entries.docstring: The mixing operator commutes with finite sums of families.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzMix_sum_fam {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (H : ι → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → M)
    (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    lorentzMix Λ (fun r => ∑ i, H i r) s t = ∑ i, lorentzMix Λ (H i) s t

entries.name: Lorentz.lorentzMix_ofFn
entries.docstring:
The mixing operator agrees with the tuple form of the Lorentz law: along an ordered
  tuple of directions it is the sum over all tuples with one Lorentz matrix factor per
  slot.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzMix_ofFn {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    lorentzMix Λ G (List.ofFn l) t =
      ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
        (∏ i, L[Λ] (p i) (l i)) • G ((List.ofFn p : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) + t)

entries.name: Lorentz.derivConv
entries.docstring:
The Leibniz convolution of two families of derivative symbols: the sum over the
  splittings of the multiset of the products of the two symbols.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def derivConv (f g : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) : B

entries.name: Lorentz.derivConv_cons
entries.docstring: One derivative peeled off a convolution lands on one factor or the other.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivConv_cons (f g : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) (a : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    derivConv f g (a ::ₘ s) =
      derivConv f (fun r => g (a ::ₘ r)) s + derivConv (fun r => f (a ::ₘ r)) g s

entries.name: Lorentz.derivConv_sum_right
entries.docstring: The convolution is linear in its right-hand family.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivConv_sum_right {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B)
    (c : ι → ℂ) (g : ι → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    derivConv f (fun r => ∑ i, c i • g i r) s = ∑ i, c i • derivConv f (g i) s

entries.name: Lorentz.derivConv_sum_left
entries.docstring: The convolution is linear in its left-hand family.
entries.snippet:
lemma derivConv_sum_left {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (g : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B)
    (c : ι → ℂ) (f : ι → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    derivConv (fun r => ∑ i, c i • f i r) g s = ∑ i, c i • derivConv (f i) g s

entries.name: Lorentz.lorentzMix_derivConv
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz mixing operator is a morphism for the Leibniz convolution: mixing the two
  factors separately and convolving is the same as convolving and then mixing.
entries.snippet:
lemma lorentzMix_derivConv (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    ∀ (f g : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B),
      derivConv (fun x => lorentzMix Λ f x 0) (fun y => lorentzMix Λ g y 0) s =
        lorentzMix Λ (derivConv f g) s 0

entries.name: Lorentz.repLorentz_derivConv
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of a Leibniz convolution: the mixing operator is a morphism for the
  convolution, so a convolution of two families with Lorentz laws has one too.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_derivConv {repLorentz : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) B}
    (hmul : ∀ (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (b₁ b₂ : B),
      repLorentz Λ (b₁ * b₂) = repLorentz Λ b₁ * repLorentz Λ b₂)
    (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (f f' g g' : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → B)
    (hf : ∀ x, repLorentz Λ (f x) = lorentzMix Λ f' x 0)
    (hg : ∀ y, repLorentz Λ (g y) = lorentzMix Λ g' y 0) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    repLorentz Λ (derivConv f g s) = lorentzMix Λ (derivConv f' g') s 0

entries.name: Lorentz.repLorentz_tower
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz law of a covariant tower `T` built by the step `hstep` from a correction
  `C`, transforming into a tower `T'` built by the same step: the seed of `T` transforms
  into the seed of `T'` with the value index twisted by `τ` (`hzero`), and the correction is
  Lorentz covariant (`hC`), linear in the family it corrects (`hClin`) and lets the twist
  through (`hCτ`). Then the covariant slots mix by their own columns of the Lorentz matrix,
  the plain slots by `lorentzMix`, and the value index by `τ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentz_tower {K : Type} [Field K] {W : Type} [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [Module K B] [SMulCommClass K ℂ B] (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (T T' : (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → W →ₗ[K] B)
    (C : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → W →ₗ[K] B) →
      Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → W →ₗ[K] B)
    (τ : W →ₗ[K] W)
    (hstep : ∀ (n : ℕ) (l : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)),
      T (n + 1) l s = T n (fun i => l i.succ) (l 0 ::ₘ s) + C (l 0) (T n fun i => l i.succ) s)
    (hstep' : ∀ (n : ℕ) (l : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)),
      T' (n + 1) l s = T' n (fun i => l i.succ) (l 0 ::ₘ s) + C (l 0) (T' n fun i => l i.succ) s)
    (hzero : ∀ (l : Fin 0 → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : W),
      repLorentz Λ (T 0 l s φ) = lorentzMix Λ (fun t => T' 0 l t (τ φ)) s 0)
    (hC : ∀ (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (G G' : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → W →ₗ[K] B),
      (∀ y χ, repLorentz Λ (G y χ) = lorentzMix Λ (fun t => G' t χ) y 0) →
      ∀ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : W), repLorentz Λ (C ρ G s φ) =
        ∑ a, L[Λ] a ρ • lorentzMix Λ (fun t => C a G' t φ) s 0)
    (hClin : ∀ (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (c : ι → ℂ)
      (G : ι → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → W →ₗ[K] B) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : W), C ρ (fun t => ∑ i, c i • G i t) s φ = ∑ i, c i • C ρ (G i) s φ)
    (hCτ : ∀ (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (G : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → W →ₗ[K] B)
      (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : W),
      C ρ (fun t => G t ∘ₗ τ) s φ = C ρ G s (τ φ)) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : W),
      repLorentz Λ (T n l s φ) =
        ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
          (∏ i, L[Λ] (p i) (l i)) • lorentzMix Λ (fun t => T' n p t (τ φ)) s 0

entries.name: minkowskiMatrixZ
entries.docstring:
The Minkowski matrix over the integers, `diag(1, -1, -1, ...)` in `ℤ`. Its cast to `ℝ` is
  `minkowskiMatrix`, by `minkowskiMatrixZ.cast_apply`.
entries.snippet: def minkowskiMatrixZ {d : ℕ} : Matrix (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℤ

entries.name: minkowskiMatrixZ.as_diagonal
entries.docstring: The integer Minkowski matrix as a diagonal matrix.
entries.snippet: lemma as_diagonal : @minkowskiMatrixZ d = diagonal (Sum.elim 1 (-1))

entries.name: minkowskiMatrixZ.inl_0_inl_0
entries.docstring: The time-time component of the integer Minkowski matrix is `1`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma inl_0_inl_0 : @minkowskiMatrixZ d (Sum.inl 0) (Sum.inl 0) = 1

entries.name: minkowskiMatrixZ.inr_i_inr_i
entries.docstring: The space diagonal components of the integer Minkowski matrix are `-1`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma inr_i_inr_i (i : Fin d) : @minkowskiMatrixZ d (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inr i) = -1

entries.name: minkowskiMatrixZ.off_diag_zero
entries.docstring: The off-diagonal components of the integer Minkowski matrix vanish.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma off_diag_zero {μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d} (h : μ ≠ ν) : @minkowskiMatrixZ d μ ν = 0

entries.name: minkowskiMatrixZ.comm
entries.docstring: The integer Minkowski matrix is symmetric, being diagonal.
entries.snippet: lemma comm (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) : @minkowskiMatrixZ d μ ν = minkowskiMatrixZ ν μ

entries.name: minkowskiMatrixZ.cast_apply
entries.docstring: The integer Minkowski matrix casts to the Minkowski matrix, entry by entry.
entries.snippet:
lemma cast_apply (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    ((minkowskiMatrixZ μ ν : ℤ) : ℝ) = minkowskiMatrix μ ν

entries.name: PauliMatrix.IsAnticommuting
entries.docstring: A family of `2 × 2` matrices with `τ_a τ_b + τ_b τ_a = 2 δ_ab 1`.
entries.snippet: def IsAnticommuting {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (τ : ι → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : Prop

entries.name: PauliMatrix.IsAnticommuting.mul_self
entries.snippet: lemma mul_self (a : ι) : τ a * τ a = 1

entries.name: PauliMatrix.IsAnticommuting.mul_comm_of_ne
entries.snippet: lemma mul_comm_of_ne {a b : ι} (h : a ≠ b) : τ b * τ a = -(τ a * τ b)

entries.name: PauliMatrix.IsAnticommuting.trace_mul
entries.docstring: The trace pairs the members orthogonally: `tr (τ_a τ_b) = 2 δ_ab`.
entries.snippet: lemma trace_mul (a b : ι) : (τ a * τ b).trace = if a = b then 2 else 0

entries.name: PauliMatrix.IsAnticommuting.trace_eq_zero
entries.docstring: In a family with at least two members, every member is traceless.
entries.snippet: lemma trace_eq_zero {a b : ι} (hab : b ≠ a) : (τ a).trace = 0

entries.name: PauliMatrix.IsAnticommuting.linearIndependent
entries.docstring:
In a family with at least two members, the members together with `1` are linearly
independent.
entries.snippet:
lemma linearIndependent [Fintype ι] [Nontrivial ι] :
    LinearIndependent ℂ (fun o : Option ι => o.elim (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) τ)

entries.name: PauliMatrix.IsAnticommuting.card_le_three
entries.docstring: **An anticommuting family of `2 × 2` matrices has at most three members.**
entries.snippet: lemma card_le_three [Fintype ι] : Fintype.card ι ≤ 3

entries.name: PauliMatrix.isAnticommuting_pauliMatrix
entries.docstring: The Pauli matrices `σ1, σ2, σ3` are an anticommuting family.
entries.snippet: lemma isAnticommuting_pauliMatrix : IsAnticommuting fun i : Fin 3 => pauliMatrix (Sum.inr i)

entries.name: PauliMatrix.isGreatest_card_isAnticommuting
entries.docstring:
**The Pauli matrices are a maximal anticommuting family.** The largest anticommuting family
of `2 × 2` matrices has three members.
entries.snippet:
lemma isGreatest_card_isAnticommuting :
    IsGreatest {n : ℕ | ∃ τ : Fin n → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ, IsAnticommuting τ} 3

entries.name: PauliMatrix.pauliLower
entries.docstring:
The Pauli matrices with the vector index lowered by the Minkowski metric,
  `σ_μ = η_{μμ} σ^μ`, as plain matrices: the underlying matrices of `pauliSelfAdjoint'`.
entries.snippet: def pauliLower (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ

entries.name: PauliMatrix.pauliBasis'_coe
entries.docstring: The covariant Pauli matrices are the underlying matrices of the basis `pauliBasis'`.
entries.snippet: lemma pauliBasis'_coe (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : (pauliBasis' μ).1 = pauliLower μ

entries.name: PauliMatrix.pauliLower_eq_smul
entries.docstring: Lowering the vector index multiplies by the diagonal entry of the metric.
entries.snippet:
lemma pauliLower_eq_smul (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    pauliLower μ = ((minkowskiMatrixZ μ μ : ℤ) : ℂ) • pauliMatrix μ

entries.name: PauliMatrix.sum_pauliLower_mul_pauliLower
entries.docstring:
The Fierz completeness relation: the covariant Pauli matrices span the `2 × 2` matrices,
  with the trace pairing as the duality and normalisation `2`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_pauliLower_mul_pauliLower (α α' β β' : Fin 2) :
    ∑ ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, pauliLower ρ β' β * pauliLower ρ α α'
      = 2 * ((if α = β then 1 else 0) * (if α' = β' then 1 else 0))

entries.name: PauliMatrix.indexBasis
entries.docstring:
The basis of `ℂT[.up, .upL, .upR]` indexed by `(Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × Fin 2 × Fin 2` through
  `indexEquiv`: `indexBasis (μ, α, β) = e_μ ⊗ e_α ⊗ e_β`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def indexBasis :
    Basis ((Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × Fin 2 × Fin 2) ℂ ℂT[.up, .upL, .upR]

entries.name: PauliMatrix.indexBasis_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma indexBasis_apply (d : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    indexBasis d = Tensor.basis ![Color.up, Color.upL, Color.upR] (indexEquiv.symm d)

entries.name: PauliMatrix.toTensor_eq_sum_indexBasis
entries.docstring: The Pauli tensor as a sum over its components, `σ^^^ = ∑ σ^μ_{α β} e_μ ⊗ e_α ⊗ e_β`.
entries.snippet:
lemma toTensor_eq_sum_indexBasis : σ^^^ = ∑ d : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) × Fin 2 × Fin 2,
    pauliMatrix d.1 d.2.1 d.2.2 • indexBasis d

entries.name: Lorentz.cycDir
entries.docstring:
The cyclic permutation of Lorentz direction labels: time is fixed and the spatial
directions rotate as `x → y → z → x`.
entries.snippet: def cycDir : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3

entries.name: Lorentz.cycDir_comp_two
entries.docstring: Composing the cyclic permutation with a two-slot index vector rotates both entries.
entries.snippet:
lemma cycDir_comp_two (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (fun j => cycDir (![μ, ν] j)) = ![cycDir μ, cycDir ν]

entries.name: Lorentz.cycDir_comp_one
entries.docstring: Composing the cyclic permutation with a one-slot index vector rotates its entry.
entries.snippet:
lemma cycDir_comp_one (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (fun j => cycDir (![μ] j)) = ![cycDir μ]

entries.name: Lorentz.cycDir_comp_nil
entries.docstring: Composing the cyclic permutation with the empty index vector is the empty vector.
entries.snippet: lemma cycDir_comp_nil : (fun j : Fin 0 => cycDir (![] j)) = ![]

entries.name: Lorentz.cycDir_cycDir_cycDir
entries.docstring: The cyclic permutation of Lorentz direction labels has order three.
entries.snippet: lemma cycDir_cycDir_cycDir (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : cycDir (cycDir (cycDir μ)) = μ

entries.name: Lorentz.cycDir_injective
entries.docstring:
The cyclic permutation of Lorentz direction labels is injective: applying it twice
more returns the original label.
entries.snippet: lemma cycDir_injective : Function.Injective cycDir

entries.name: Lorentz.cycDir_orbit_distinct
entries.docstring: An index not fixed by the rotation has three distinct rotations.
entries.snippet:
lemma cycDir_orbit_distinct {ι : Type*} (d : ι → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (hd : (fun s => cycDir (d s)) ≠ d) :
    (fun s => cycDir (cycDir (d s))) ≠ d
      ∧ (fun s => cycDir (cycDir (d s))) ≠ (fun s => cycDir (d s))

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.rotationCycle
entries.docstring:
The cyclic rotation `x → y → z → x` in `SL(2,ℂ)`, realized as the rotation by
`2π/3` about the diagonal spatial axis.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def rotationCycle : SL(2,ℂ)

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup_rotationCycle_apply
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz matrix of `rotationCycle`: it is the permutation matrix associated with
`cycDir`.
entries.snippet:
lemma toLorentzGroup_rotationCycle_apply (a b : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (toLorentzGroup rotationCycle).1 a b = if a = cycDir b then 1 else 0

entries.name: Lorentz.halfTurnSign
entries.docstring:
The sign the half turn about the axis `k` gives a direction: `1` on time and on the axis,
`-1` on the two transverse directions.
entries.snippet: def halfTurnSign (k : Fin 3) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : ℤ

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.halfTurn
entries.docstring:
The half turn about the axis `k`, the rotation by `π` about it, as the element `-i σ_k` of
`SL(2,ℂ)`. The other lift `i σ_k` is `-halfTurn k`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def halfTurn : Fin 3 → SL(2,ℂ)
  | 0 => ⟨!![0, -Complex.I; -Complex.I, 0], by
      rw [Matrix.det_fin_two_of]
      simp [Complex.I_mul_I]⟩
  | 1 => ⟨!![0, -1; 1, 0], by
      rw [Matrix.det_fin_two_of]
      simp⟩
  | 2 => ⟨!![-Complex.I, 0; 0, Complex.I], by
      rw [Matrix.det_fin_two_of]
      simp [Complex.I_mul_I]⟩

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup_halfTurn_apply
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz matrix of the half turn about the axis `k` is diagonal, with the signs
`halfTurnSign k`: it fixes time and the axis and negates the two transverse directions.
entries.snippet:
lemma toLorentzGroup_halfTurn_apply (k : Fin 3) (a b : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (toLorentzGroup (halfTurn k)).1 a b = if a = b then (halfTurnSign k a : ℝ) else 0

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup_halfTurn_symm
entries.docstring: The Lorentz matrix of the half turn is diagonal, hence symmetric.
entries.snippet:
lemma toLorentzGroup_halfTurn_symm (k : Fin 3) (a b : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (toLorentzGroup (halfTurn k)).1 a b = (toLorentzGroup (halfTurn k)).1 b a

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.conjHom
entries.docstring:
Entrywise complex conjugation as a monoid endomorphism of `SL(2,ℂ)`: Mathlib's
  `SpecialLinearGroup.map` along `starRingEnd ℂ`.
entries.snippet: abbrev conjHom : SL(2,ℂ) →* SL(2,ℂ)

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.conjHom_coe
entries.snippet: lemma conjHom_coe (g : SL(2,ℂ)) : (conjHom g).1 = g.1.map star

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.conjHom_involutive
entries.docstring: Conjugation is an involution, hence surjective.
entries.snippet: lemma conjHom_involutive : Function.Involutive conjHom

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.conjHom_inv_conjTranspose
entries.docstring:
Conjugating the group argument undoes the conjugation of the entries: the inverse
  conjugate transpose at `conjHom g` is the inverse transpose at `g`.
entries.snippet: lemma conjHom_inv_conjTranspose (g : SL(2,ℂ)) : (((conjHom g).1)⁻¹)ᴴ = (g.1⁻¹)ᵀ

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup_neg_one
entries.docstring:
**The centre of `SL(2, ℂ)` covers the identity Lorentz transformation.** The covering
  map sandwiches, `A ↦ M A Mᴴ`, so the two signs of `-1` cancel. Together with
  `_root_.map_one` this says that the covering map is two-to-one.
entries.snippet: lemma toLorentzGroup_neg_one : toLorentzGroup (-1) = 1

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.sum_pauliLower_mul_sl2c
entries.docstring:
The intertwining identity `toSelfAdjointMap_basis` read entrywise: sandwiching the
  covariant Pauli matrix `σ_μ` between `g` and `gᴴ` mixes the covariant Pauli matrices by the
  column `μ` of the Lorentz matrix of `g`, the summed Lorentz index first.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_pauliLower_mul_sl2c (g : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (β β' : Fin 2) :
    ∑ p : Fin 2 × Fin 2, PauliMatrix.pauliLower μ p.1 p.2 * (g.1 β p.1 * star (g.1 β' p.2))
      = ∑ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3, (((toLorentzGroup g).1 ν μ : ℝ) : ℂ)
        * PauliMatrix.pauliLower ν β β'

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup_conjTranspose
entries.docstring:
The covering map intertwines conjugate transposition with matrix
  transposition: `L(M†) = L(M)ᵀ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma toLorentzGroup_conjTranspose {M N : SL(2,ℂ)} (hN : N.1 = M.1ᴴ) :
    (toLorentzGroup N).1 = (toLorentzGroup M).1ᵀ

entries.name: Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.SL2CRep_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring:
The dual of the complex covector representation on the dual basis: dual covectors
  transform contravariantly, by the columns of the (complexified) Lorentz matrix. The
  complex analogue of `Lorentz.CoVector.sl2Rep_dual_dualBasis`.
entries.snippet:
lemma ComplexCoVector.SL2CRep_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.SL2CRep.dual Λ (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis μ) =
      ∑ j, (((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 j μ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis j

entries.name: TensorSpecies.IsEquivariant
entries.docstring:
A linear map `f` from the tensors of the species `S` with index colors `c` to a
  representation `ρ` of the group of the species, which is equivariant: it intertwines the action
  of the group on tensors with `ρ`.
entries.snippet:
structure IsEquivariant (S : TensorSpecies k C G V basisIdx rep b) {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → C)
    {B : Type*} [AddCommMonoid B] [Module k B] (ρ : Representation k G B)
    (f : S.Tensor c →ₗ[k] B) : Prop where
  equivariant : ∀ (g : G) (t : S.Tensor c), f (g • t) = ρ g (f t)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.smul_basis_eq_sum
entries.docstring:
The action of `g` on a basis tensor: the coefficient of `e_ψ` in `g • e_φ` is the product over
  the indices of the matrix entries of `g` in the color of that index.
entries.snippet:
lemma smul_basis_eq_sum {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → C) (g : G) (φ : ComponentIdx (S := S) c) :
    g • Tensor.basis (S := S) c φ
      = ∑ ψ : ComponentIdx (S := S) c,
        (∏ i, LinearMap.toMatrix (b (c i)) (b (c i)) (rep (c i) g) (ψ i) (φ i)) •
        Tensor.basis (S := S) c ψ

entries.name: TensorSpecies.basis_repr_smul
entries.docstring:
The components of `g • t`: the matrix of products of the matrix entries of `g`, one factor
  per index, applied to the components of `t`.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_repr_smul {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → C) (g : G) (t : S.Tensor c)
    (φ : ComponentIdx (S := S) c) :
    (Tensor.basis c).repr (g • t) φ
      = ∑ ψ, (∏ i, LinearMap.toMatrix (b (c i)) (b (c i)) (rep (c i) g) (φ i) (ψ i)) *
        (Tensor.basis c).repr t ψ

entries.name: TensorSpecies.IsEquivariant.isStableUnder_range
entries.docstring: The range of an equivariant map is stable under the group.
entries.snippet: lemma isStableUnder_range : IsStableUnder (fun g : G => ρ g) (LinearMap.range f)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.IsEquivariant.rep_map_of_invariant
entries.docstring: The image of an invariant tensor under an equivariant map is invariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_map_of_invariant {t : S.Tensor c} (ht : ∀ g : G, g • t = t) (g : G) :
    ρ g (f t) = f t

entries.name: TensorSpecies.IsEquivariant.sum
entries.docstring: A sum of equivariant maps is equivariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {F : ι → S.Tensor c →ₗ[k] B}
    (hF : ∀ i ∈ s, S.IsEquivariant c ρ (F i)) : S.IsEquivariant c ρ (∑ i ∈ s, F i) where

entries.name: TensorSpecies.IsEquivariant.comp
entries.docstring: Composing with a linear map that intertwines `ρ` with `ρ'` keeps a map equivariant.

entries.name: TensorSpecies.IsEquivariant.sub
entries.docstring: A difference of equivariant maps is equivariant.
entries.snippet:
lemma sub {f' : S.Tensor c →ₗ[k] B} (hf' : S.IsEquivariant c ρ f') :
    S.IsEquivariant c ρ (f - f') where

entries.name: TensorSpecies.IsAdjointClosed
entries.docstring:
The colors `c` of a complex species are closed under adjoints when for every `g` some `g'`
  acts on each of them by the conjugate transpose of the matrix of `g`. For a unitary group
  `g' = g⁻¹` and orthonormal bases; for `SL(2,ℂ)` on the Weyl colors, `g' = g†`.

entries.name: TensorSpecies.IsEquivariant.exists_invariant_eq_of_mem_range
entries.docstring:
An invariant in the range of `f` is the image of an invariant tensor, when the colors are
  closed under adjoints: the adjoint of the action of `g` on the coefficients is that of `g'`.

entries.name: TensorSpecies.IsEquivariant.exists_invariant_add_of_mem_sup
entries.docstring:
An invariant of `LinearMap.range f ⊔ W`, for `W` a stable submodule, is the image of an
  invariant tensor plus an element of `W`.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_invariant_add_of_mem_sup (hc : S.IsAdjointClosed c) (W : Submodule ℂ B)
    (hW : ∀ g : G, ∀ y ∈ W, ρ g y ∈ W) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ LinearMap.range f ⊔ W)
    (hinv : ∀ g : G, ρ g x = x) :
    ∃ t : S.Tensor c, (∀ g : G, g • t = t) ∧ ∃ y ∈ W, x = f t + y

entries.name: TensorSpecies.IsEquivariant.reducesInvariantsTo_map
entries.docstring:
When every invariant tensor of `S.Tensor c` lies in `I`, the invariants of the range of `f`
  reduce to the image of `I`.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_map (hc : S.IsAdjointClosed c) (I : Submodule ℂ (S.Tensor c))
    (hI : ∀ t : S.Tensor c, (∀ g : G, g • t = t) → t ∈ I) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : G => ρ g) (LinearMap.range f) (I.map f)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.IsEquivariant.reducesInvariantsTo_bot
entries.docstring: When the only invariant tensor of `S.Tensor c` is zero, the range of `f` reduces to `⊥`.
entries.snippet:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_bot (hc : S.IsAdjointClosed c)
    (hI : ∀ t : S.Tensor c, (∀ g : G, g • t = t) → t = 0) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : G => ρ g) (LinearMap.range f) ⊥

entries.name: TensorSpecies.IsEquivariant.eq_zero_of_invariant
entries.docstring:
When the only invariant tensor of `S.Tensor c` is zero, so is every invariant in the range
  of `f`.

entries.name: TensorSpecies.IsEquivariant.invariantReductionToSpan
entries.docstring:
When the invariant tensors of `S.Tensor c` are the multiples of one tensor `t₀`, the
  invariants of the range of `f` reduce to the span of `f t₀`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def invariantReductionToSpan (hc : S.IsAdjointClosed c) (t₀ : S.Tensor c)
    (ht₀ : ∀ g : G, g • t₀ = t₀)
    (hclass : ∀ t : S.Tensor c, (∀ g : G, g • t = t) → ∃ a : ℂ, t = a • t₀) :
    InvariantReductionToSpan (fun g : G => ρ g) (LinearMap.range f) where

entries.name: TensorSpecies.IsEquivariant.invariantReductionToSpanOfEq
entries.docstring:
The reduction of `invariantReductionToSpan`, stated for a submodule `V` equal to the range of
  `f` and with the spanning vector given by any expression `v` for `f t₀`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def invariantReductionToSpanOfEq (hc : S.IsAdjointClosed c) (t₀ : S.Tensor c)
    (ht₀ : ∀ g : G, g • t₀ = t₀)
    (hclass : ∀ t : S.Tensor c, (∀ g : G, g • t = t) → ∃ a : ℂ, t = a • t₀)
    {V : Submodule ℂ B} (hV : LinearMap.range f = V) (v : B) (hv : f t₀ = v) :
    InvariantReductionToSpan (fun g : G => ρ g) V where

entries.name: TensorSpecies.isEquivariant_constr
entries.docstring:
The linear map with prescribed values `T ψ` on the basis tensors is equivariant when the
  values are moved by `ρ` as the basis tensors are moved by the group.
entries.snippet:
lemma isEquivariant_constr {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} {B : Type*} [AddCommGroup B] [Module k B]
    {ρ : Representation k G B} (T : ComponentIdx (S := S) c → B)
    (hT : ∀ (g : G) φ, ρ g (T φ)
      = ∑ ψ, (∏ i, LinearMap.toMatrix (b (c i)) (b (c i)) (rep (c i) g) (ψ i) (φ i)) • T ψ) :
    S.IsEquivariant c ρ ((Tensor.basis c).constr k T) where
