entries.name: TensorSpecies.familyMap
entries.docstring:
The linear map out of `S.Tensor c` sending the basis tensor with components `e.symm l` to
  `T l`, for a relabelling `e` of the component indices by `ι`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def familyMap (e : ComponentIdx (S := S) c ≃ ι) (T : ι → B) :
    S.Tensor c →ₗ[k] B

entries.name: TensorSpecies.familyMap_basis
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma familyMap_basis (e : ComponentIdx (S := S) c ≃ ι) (T : ι → B) (l : ι) :
    familyMap e T (Tensor.basis c (e.symm l)) = T l

entries.name: TensorSpecies.range_familyMap
entries.docstring: The range of `familyMap e T` is the span of the vectors `T l`.
entries.snippet:
lemma range_familyMap (e : ComponentIdx (S := S) c ≃ ι) (T : ι → B) :
    LinearMap.range (familyMap e T) = Submodule.span k (Set.range T)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.familyMap_mem_span
entries.docstring: The image of `familyMap e T` lies in the span of the vectors `T l`.
entries.snippet:
lemma familyMap_mem_span (e : ComponentIdx (S := S) c ≃ ι) (T : ι → B) (t : S.Tensor c) :
    familyMap e T t ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range T)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.familyMap_sum
entries.docstring: `familyMap` of a sum of families is the sum of the maps.
entries.snippet:
lemma familyMap_sum (e : ComponentIdx (S := S) c ≃ ι) {α : Type*} (s : Finset α)
    (T : α → ι → B) :
    familyMap e (fun l => ∑ i ∈ s, T i l) = ∑ i ∈ s, familyMap e (T i)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.familyMap_sub
entries.docstring: `familyMap` of a difference of families is the difference of the maps.
entries.snippet:
lemma familyMap_sub (e : ComponentIdx (S := S) c ≃ ι) (T T' : ι → B) :
    familyMap e (fun l => T l - T' l) = familyMap e T - familyMap e T'

entries.name: TensorSpecies.comp_familyMap
entries.docstring:
A linear map applied after `familyMap e T` is `familyMap` of its values on the
  components.
entries.snippet:
lemma comp_familyMap (e : ComponentIdx (S := S) c ≃ ι) {B' : Type*} [AddCommGroup B']
    [Module k B'] (σ : B →ₗ[k] B') (T : ι → B) :
    σ ∘ₗ familyMap e T = familyMap e fun l => σ (T l)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.familyMap_smul_of_law
entries.docstring:
A linear map moving a family as `g` moves the basis tensors intertwines the map of the family
  with the action of `g`.
entries.snippet:
lemma familyMap_smul_of_law (e : ComponentIdx (S := S) c ≃ ι) [Fintype ι] (T : ι → B)
    {σ : B →ₗ[k] B} (g : G)
    (hσ : ∀ l : ι, σ (T l) = ∑ a, (∏ i, LinearMap.toMatrix (b (c i)) (b (c i)) (rep (c i) g)
      (e.symm a i) (e.symm l i)) • T a) (t : S.Tensor c) :
    σ (familyMap e T t) = familyMap e T (g • t)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.isEquivariant_familyMap_iff
entries.docstring:
The map of a family is equivariant exactly when the family is moved as the basis tensors
  are: one matrix entry of `g` per index, the summed index first in each factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma isEquivariant_familyMap_iff (e : ComponentIdx (S := S) c ≃ ι) [Fintype ι]
    {ρ : Representation k G B} (T : ι → B) :
    S.IsEquivariant c ρ (familyMap e T) ↔ ∀ (g : G) (l : ι), ρ g (T l)
      = ∑ a, (∏ i, LinearMap.toMatrix (b (c i)) (b (c i)) (rep (c i) g)
        (e.symm a i) (e.symm l i)) • T a

entries.name: Lorentz.CoVector.sl2Rep
entries.docstring:
The representation of `SL(2,ℂ)` on real Lorentz covectors, obtained from the
  representation of the Lorentz group through the covering map
  `SL(2,ℂ) →* LorentzGroup 3`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def sl2Rep : Representation ℝ SL(2,ℂ) Lorentz.CoVector

entries.name: Lorentz.CoVector.sl2Rep_dual_dualBasis
entries.docstring:
The dual of the covector representation on the dual basis: dual covectors
  transform contravariantly, by the columns of the Lorentz matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma sl2Rep_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Lorentz.CoVector.sl2Rep.dual Λ (Lorentz.CoVector.basis.dualBasis μ) =
      ∑ j, (Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 j μ •
        Lorentz.CoVector.basis.dualBasis j

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.starConjEquiv
entries.docstring:
**The real structure of the jet ring.** Coefficientwise conjugation is a `ℂ`-linear
equivalence from the conjugate module of the jet ring back to the jet ring itself. It is
honestly `ℂ`-linear, not merely semilinear, because the conjugate-linearity of `star`
cancels against the twisted scalar action of `ConjModule`.

This is what identifies the jets of a conjugate field with the conjugates of the jets:
`ConjModule (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)` and `SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] ConjModule V` differ
exactly by this equivalence on the jet-ring factor.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def starConjEquiv : ConjModule SpaceTimeAlgebra ≃ₗ[ℂ] SpaceTimeAlgebra

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.starConjEquiv_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma starConjEquiv_apply (f : ConjModule SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    starConjEquiv f = star ((conjEquiv (k := ℂ) (M := SpaceTimeAlgebra)).symm f)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.starConjEquiv_symm_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma starConjEquiv_symm_apply (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    starConjEquiv.symm f = conjEquiv (k := ℂ) (M := SpaceTimeAlgebra) (star f)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_single_one_mul
entries.docstring:
The first-order Leibniz rule: the degree-one Taylor coefficient, in the
  direction `μ`, of a product of jets. This is the coefficient-level statement
  that the first jet of a product is given by the product rule.
entries.snippet:
lemma coeff_single_one_mul (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (f g : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    coeff (Finsupp.single μ 1) (f * g) =
      coeff (Finsupp.single μ 1) f * constantCoeff g +
        constantCoeff f * coeff (Finsupp.single μ 1) g

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.constantCoeffₗ
entries.docstring: The constant-coefficient evaluation of a jet, as a `ℂ`-linear map.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def constantCoeffₗ : SpaceTimeAlgebra →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ where

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.constantCoeffₗ_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma constantCoeffₗ_apply (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) : constantCoeffₗ f = constantCoeff f

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv_pderiv
entries.docstring: Iterated formal derivatives commute with a single formal partial derivative.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedPDeriv_pderiv (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    iteratedPDeriv s (pderiv μ f) = pderiv μ (iteratedPDeriv s f)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv_smul
entries.docstring: Iterated formal derivatives preserve complex scalar multiplication.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedPDeriv_smul (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (c : ℂ)
    (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    iteratedPDeriv s (c • f) = c • iteratedPDeriv s f

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv_neg
entries.docstring: Iterated formal derivatives commute with negation.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedPDeriv_neg (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    iteratedPDeriv s (-f) = -iteratedPDeriv s f

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv_zero_apply
entries.docstring: The iterated formal derivative of the zero jet vanishes.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma iteratedPDeriv_zero_apply (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    iteratedPDeriv s (0 : SpaceTimeAlgebra) = 0

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv_sum
entries.docstring: The iterated formal derivative of a finite sum.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedPDeriv_sum {κ : Type*} (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (t : Finset κ)
    (f : κ → SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    iteratedPDeriv s (∑ k ∈ t, f k)
      = ∑ k ∈ t, iteratedPDeriv s (f k)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv_C_of_ne_zero
entries.docstring:
The iterated derivative of a constant jet vanishes for a nonempty multiset of
  directions.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedPDeriv_C_of_ne_zero {s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)} (hs : s ≠ 0) (c : ℂ) :
    iteratedPDeriv s (C c : SpaceTimeAlgebra) = 0

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.truncation
entries.docstring:
The `n`-th truncation of a jet: the Taylor coefficients of total degree
  greater than `n` are set to zero.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def truncation (n : ℕ) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) : SpaceTimeAlgebra

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_truncation_of_le
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coeff_truncation_of_le {n : ℕ} {m : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ}
    (h : Finsupp.degree m ≤ n) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    coeff m (truncation n f) = coeff m f

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_truncation_of_gt
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coeff_truncation_of_gt {n : ℕ} {m : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ}
    (h : n < Finsupp.degree m) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    coeff m (truncation n f) = 0

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.truncation_add
entries.snippet:
lemma truncation_add (n : ℕ) (f g : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    truncation n (f + g) = truncation n f + truncation n g

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.truncation_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma truncation_zero (n : ℕ) : truncation n (0 : SpaceTimeAlgebra) = 0

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.truncation_one
entries.docstring:
Truncation fixes the identity: a constant series has its only nonzero Taylor
  coefficient in degree zero, which every truncation keeps.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma truncation_one (n : ℕ) : truncation n (1 : SpaceTimeAlgebra) = 1

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.truncation_eq_one_of_coeff
entries.docstring:
A power series with value `1` and no coefficients in nonzero degree up to `n`
  truncates to `1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma truncation_eq_one_of_coeff {n : ℕ} {f : SpaceTimeAlgebra} (h0 : constantCoeff f = 1)
    (hf : ∀ p : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ, p ≠ 0 → Finsupp.degree p ≤ n → coeff p f = 0) :
    SpaceTimeAlgebra.truncation n f = SpaceTimeAlgebra.truncation n (1 : SpaceTimeAlgebra)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_X_smul
entries.docstring:
The Taylor coefficients of a jet multiplied by a formal coordinate: the
  coefficient shifts down by one in that direction.
entries.snippet:
lemma coeff_X_smul (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (p : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff p ((X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • f) =
      if Finsupp.single ρ 1 ≤ p then coeff (p - Finsupp.single ρ 1) f else 0

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_sum_X_smul_pderiv
entries.docstring:
The Euler (radial) operator acts on Taylor coefficients as multiplication by the
  total degree.
entries.snippet:
lemma coeff_sum_X_smul_pderiv (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (p : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff p (∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • pderiv ρ f) =
      ((Finsupp.degree p : ℕ) : ℂ) * coeff p f

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.eq_zero_of_sum_X_smul_pderiv_eq_zero
entries.docstring:
The scalar vanishing principle for the Euler operator: a jet vanishing at the base
  point that is killed by the Euler operator is zero.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_zero_of_sum_X_smul_pderiv_eq_zero {f : SpaceTimeAlgebra} (h0 : constantCoeff f = 0)
    (hf : ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • pderiv ρ f = 0) : f = 0

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_mul_eq_zero_of_lt
entries.docstring:
A product with a factor whose coefficients vanish below degree `n` has coefficients
  vanishing below degree `n`.

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_eq_zero_of_coeff_pderiv_eq_zero
entries.docstring:
The Euler vanishing principle: a power series all of whose first derivatives have
  coefficients vanishing below degree `n` has vanishing coefficients in every nonzero degree
  up to `n`, since `∑_ρ x_ρ ∂_ρ f` has the coefficient of `f` at `p` scaled by the degree
  of `p`.
entries.snippet:
lemma coeff_eq_zero_of_coeff_pderiv_eq_zero {n : ℕ} {f : SpaceTimeAlgebra}
    (hf : ∀ (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (q : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ), Finsupp.degree q < n →
      coeff q (pderiv ρ f) = 0)
    {p : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (hpn : Finsupp.degree p ≤ n) : coeff p f = 0

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_eq_zero_of_pderiv_eq_mul
entries.docstring:
A power series satisfying a radial relation `∂_ρ f = x_ρ f`, with the `x_ρ` vanishing
  below degree `n`, has no coefficients in nonzero degree up to `n`.

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.C_real_smul
entries.snippet:
lemma C_real_smul (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) :
    (MvPowerSeries.C (r • x) : SpaceTimeAlgebra) = r • MvPowerSeries.C x

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.constantCoeff_real_smul
entries.docstring: The constant coefficient commutes with real scalars.
entries.snippet:
lemma constantCoeff_real_smul (r : ℝ) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (r • f) = r • MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff f

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.pderiv_real_smul
entries.docstring: The formal derivatives commute with real scalars.
entries.snippet:
lemma pderiv_real_smul (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (r : ℝ) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    MvPowerSeries.pderiv μ (r • f) = r • MvPowerSeries.pderiv μ f

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.pderiv_finset_prod
entries.docstring: The Leibniz rule for a finite product.
entries.snippet:
lemma pderiv_finset_prod {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    pderiv μ (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, (∏ j ∈ s.erase i, f j) * pderiv μ (f i)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.jacobi
entries.docstring:
**Jacobi's formula**: the derivative of a determinant is the trace of the derivative
  against the adjugate.
entries.snippet:
lemma jacobi {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (M : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra)
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    pderiv μ M.det = (M.map (pderiv μ) * M.adjugate).trace

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.mapMatrix_constantCoeff_star
entries.docstring: Entrywise evaluation at the base point commutes with the conjugate transpose.
entries.snippet:
lemma mapMatrix_constantCoeff_star {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix (star A) =
      star ((constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix A)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_sum_X_smul_map_pderiv
entries.docstring:
The Euler operator on matrices of jets acts entrywise on Taylor coefficients as
  multiplication by the total degree.
entries.snippet:
lemma coeff_sum_X_smul_map_pderiv {κ : Type}
    (M : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) (p : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ) (i j : κ) :
    coeff p ((∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • M.map (pderiv ρ)) i j) =
      ((Finsupp.degree p : ℕ) : ℂ) * coeff p (M i j)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.matrix_eq_zero_of_euler_eq_mul_add_mul
entries.docstring:
The vanishing principle for the Euler operator: a matrix of jets vanishing at the
  base point and satisfying `E W = A W + W B` with `A`, `B` vanishing at the base point
  is zero. Each Taylor coefficient of `W` is a multiple of coefficients of strictly
  smaller degree, so all vanish by strong induction on the degree.
entries.snippet:
lemma matrix_eq_zero_of_euler_eq_mul_add_mul {κ : Type} [Fintype κ]
    {W : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra} (A B : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra)
    (hA : ∀ i j, constantCoeff (A i j) = 0) (hB : ∀ i j, constantCoeff (B i j) = 0)
    (h0 : ∀ i j, constantCoeff (W i j) = 0)
    (hW : ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • W.map (pderiv ρ) = A * W + W * B) :
    W = 0

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.exists_matrix_eulerTransport
entries.docstring:
The Euler (radial) transport of a jet matrix `R` vanishing at the base point:
  a fundamental solution of the radial system `E U = R U` based at the identity,
  built order-by-order by the Euler recursion.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_matrix_eulerTransport {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (R : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) (hR0 : ∀ i j, constantCoeff (R i j) = 0) :
    ∃ U : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra, (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix U = 1 ∧
      ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • U.map (pderiv ρ) = R * U

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_entry_eq_zero_of_map_pderiv_eq_mul
entries.docstring:
The matrix form of `coeff_eq_zero_of_pderiv_eq_mul`: the entries of a matrix of power
  series satisfying `∂_ρ A = X_ρ A`, with the `X_ρ` vanishing below degree `n`, have no
  coefficients in nonzero degree up to `n`.
entries.snippet:
lemma coeff_entry_eq_zero_of_map_pderiv_eq_mul {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] {n : ℕ}
    {A : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra} {X : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra}
    (hd : ∀ ρ, A.map (pderiv ρ) = X ρ * A)
    (hX : ∀ (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (q : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ), Finsupp.degree q < n →
      ∀ i j, coeff q (X ρ i j) = 0)
    (i j : κ) {p : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (hpn : Finsupp.degree p ≤ n) :
    coeff p (A i j) = 0

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.matrix_map_truncation_eq_one
entries.docstring:
A matrix of power series with identity value and no coefficients in nonzero degree up
  to `n` truncates to the identity.
entries.snippet:
lemma matrix_map_truncation_eq_one {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] {n : ℕ}
    {A : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra}
        (h0 : (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix A = 1)
    (hA : ∀ (i j : κ) (p : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ), p ≠ 0 → Finsupp.degree p ≤ n →
      coeff p (A i j) = 0) :
    A.map (SpaceTimeAlgebra.truncation n) = (1 : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra).map
        (SpaceTimeAlgebra.truncation n)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.matrix_map_pderiv_mul
entries.docstring: The entrywise Leibniz rule for matrix products of jets.
entries.snippet:
lemma matrix_map_pderiv_mul {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (M N : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    (M * N).map (pderiv ρ) = M.map (pderiv ρ) * N + M * N.map (pderiv ρ)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.sum_X_smul_map_pderiv_mul
entries.docstring: The Euler operator on matrices of jets is a derivation.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_X_smul_map_pderiv_mul {κ : Type} [Fintype κ]
    (M N : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • (M * N).map (pderiv ρ) =
      (∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • M.map (pderiv ρ)) * N +
        M * ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • N.map (pderiv ρ)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.sum_X_smul_map_pderiv_star
entries.docstring: The Euler operator commutes with the conjugate transpose.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_X_smul_map_pderiv_star {κ : Type}
    (M : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • (star M).map (pderiv ρ) =
      star (∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • M.map (pderiv ρ))

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.sum_X_smul_map_pderiv_one
entries.docstring: The Euler operator kills the identity matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_X_smul_map_pderiv_one {κ : Type} [DecidableEq κ] :
    ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • (1 : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra).map (pderiv ρ) = 0

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.eulerTransport_mul_star
entries.docstring:
A fundamental solution of the radial system `E U = R U` based at the identity is
  unitary when `R` is anti-hermitian: `U U† − 1` vanishes at the base point and
  satisfies a homogeneous linear radial system, so it vanishes identically.
entries.snippet:
lemma eulerTransport_mul_star {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    {R U : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra} (hRstar : star R = -R)
    (hR0 : ∀ i j, constantCoeff (R i j) = 0)
    (hU0 : (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix U = 1)
    (hEU : ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • U.map (pderiv ρ) = R * U) :
    U * star U = 1

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.sum_X_smul_mcMatrix_of_eulerTransport
entries.docstring:
The radial Maurer–Cartan component of a unitary fundamental solution of the radial
  system `E V = −i P V` is `P`: `∑_μ x_μ · i (∂_μ V) V† = P`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_X_smul_mcMatrix_of_eulerTransport {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    {P V : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra} (hVu : V * star V = 1)
    (hEV : ∑ μ, (X μ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • V.map (pderiv μ) = ((-Complex.I) • P) * V) :
    ∑ μ, (X μ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • (Complex.I • (V.map (pderiv μ) * star V)) = P

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.eulerTransport_det
entries.docstring:
A fundamental solution of the radial system `E U = R U` based at the identity has
  determinant one when `R` is traceless: by Jacobi's formula the determinant is killed
  by the Euler operator, so it is the constant `1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma eulerTransport_det {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    {R U : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra}
    (hjac : ∀ (M : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
      pderiv μ M.det = (M.map (pderiv μ) * M.adjugate).trace)
    (hRtr : R.trace = 0)
    (hU0 : (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix U = 1)
    (hEU : ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • U.map (pderiv ρ) = R * U) :
    U.det = 1

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.matrix_multiset_sum_apply
entries.docstring: The entry of a multiset sum of matrices is the multiset sum of the entries.
entries.snippet:
lemma matrix_multiset_sum_apply {κ α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α]
    (m : Multiset (Matrix κ κ α)) (i j : κ) :
    m.sum i j = (m.map fun A => A i j).sum

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.matrix_constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv_mul
entries.docstring:
The matrix Leibniz rule at the base point: the base-point Taylor coefficients of a
  product of matrices of jets are the antidiagonal convolution of the base-point
  coefficients of the factors.
entries.snippet:
lemma matrix_constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv_mul {κ : Type} [Fintype κ]
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (M N : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    ((M * N).map fun f => constantCoeff (iteratedPDeriv s f))
      = (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          (M.map fun f => constantCoeff (iteratedPDeriv p.1 f)) *
            (N.map fun f => constantCoeff (iteratedPDeriv p.2 f))).sum

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.mapMatrix_C_star
entries.docstring: Entrywise inclusion of constants commutes with the conjugate transpose.
entries.snippet:
lemma mapMatrix_C_star [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (A : Matrix κ κ ℂ) :
    (C : ℂ →+* SpaceTimeAlgebra).mapMatrix (star A) = star
        ((C : ℂ →+* SpaceTimeAlgebra).mapMatrix A)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.mapMatrix_C_smul
entries.docstring: Entrywise inclusion of constants commutes with complex scalars.
entries.snippet:
lemma mapMatrix_C_smul [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (c : ℂ) (M : Matrix κ κ ℂ) :
    (C : ℂ →+* SpaceTimeAlgebra).mapMatrix (c • M) = c •
        (C : ℂ →+* SpaceTimeAlgebra).mapMatrix M

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.mapMatrix_constantCoeff_smul
entries.docstring: The entrywise constant coefficient commutes with complex scalars.
entries.snippet:
lemma mapMatrix_constantCoeff_smul [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (c : ℂ)
    (M : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix (c • M)
      = c • (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix M

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.star_map_pderiv
entries.docstring: The entrywise derivative commutes with the conjugate transpose.
entries.snippet:
lemma star_map_pderiv (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (A : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    star (A.map (pderiv μ)) = (star A).map (pderiv μ)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.map_pderiv_smul
entries.docstring: Pulling a complex scalar out of the entrywise derivative.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_pderiv_smul (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (c : ℂ) (M : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    (c • M).map (pderiv μ) = c • M.map (pderiv μ)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.map_pderiv_sub
entries.docstring: The entrywise derivative of a difference.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_pderiv_sub (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (M N : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    (M - N).map (pderiv μ) = M.map (pderiv μ) - N.map (pderiv μ)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.map_pderiv_star_of_unitary
entries.docstring:
The entrywise derivative of the conjugate transpose of a unitary matrix, through the
  differentiated unitarity relation.
entries.snippet:
lemma map_pderiv_star_of_unitary [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    {U : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra}
    (hU : U * star U = 1) (hU' : star U * U = 1) :
    (star U).map (pderiv μ) = -(star U * U.map (pderiv μ) * star U)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.star_mcMatrix
entries.docstring: The Maurer–Cartan matrix `i (∂_μ U) U†` of a unitary matrix of jets is hermitian.
entries.snippet:
lemma star_mcMatrix [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    {U : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra}
    (hU : U * star U = 1) (hU' : star U * U = 1) :
    star (Complex.I • (U.map (pderiv μ) * star U)) = Complex.I • (U.map (pderiv μ) * star U)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.star_ofDerivValues
entries.snippet:
lemma star_ofDerivValues (f : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ) :
    star (ofDerivValues f) = ofDerivValues fun s => star (f s)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.ofDerivValues_sum
entries.snippet:
lemma ofDerivValues_sum {ι : Type} (t : Finset ι) (f : ι → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ) :
    ofDerivValues (fun s => ∑ i ∈ t, f i s) = ∑ i ∈ t, ofDerivValues (f i)

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.taylorMatrix
entries.docstring: The matrix of jets with prescribed base-point Taylor data `M`, entrywise.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def taylorMatrix {κ : Type} (M : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Matrix κ κ ℂ) :
    Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.taylorMatrix_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma taylorMatrix_apply {κ : Type} (M : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Matrix κ κ ℂ) (i j : κ) :
    taylorMatrix M i j = ofDerivValues fun s => M s i j

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.star_taylorMatrix
entries.snippet:
lemma star_taylorMatrix {κ : Type} {M : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Matrix κ κ ℂ}
    (hM : ∀ s, star (M s) = M s) : star (taylorMatrix M) = taylorMatrix M

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.trace_taylorMatrix
entries.snippet:
lemma trace_taylorMatrix {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] {M : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Matrix κ κ ℂ}
    (hM : ∀ s, (M s).trace = 0) : (taylorMatrix M).trace = 0

entries.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.map_constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv_taylorMatrix
entries.docstring: The base-point Taylor data of `taylorMatrix M` are `M`, entrywise.

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis_apply_symmetricAlgebra
entries.docstring:
The basis vector at a multiset of derivative indices is the corresponding basis monomial
  of the symmetric algebra of dual symbols. This is `basis_apply` of
  `Physlib.SpaceAndTime.SpaceTime.SpaceTimeDerivAlgebra.Basic` in the symmetric-algebra form,
  rather than through `SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial`.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_apply_symmetricAlgebra (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    basis s =
      Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis.symmetricAlgebra (Multiset.toFinsupp s)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis_nil
entries.docstring:
The basis vector at the empty multiset is the unit of the algebra: the
  zeroth-order symbol carries no derivatives.
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_nil :
    basis ({} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) = 1

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.deriv
entries.docstring:
The derivative of an element in `SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ` taking e.g.
  `∂_s` to `∂_μ ∂_s`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def deriv (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ →ₗ[ℂ] SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.deriv_basis
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_basis (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (m : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ) :
    deriv μ (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis.symmetricAlgebra m) =
      Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis.symmetricAlgebra (m + Finsupp.single μ 1)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.deriv_comm_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_comm_apply (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) :
    deriv μ (deriv ν x) = deriv ν (deriv μ x)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.deriv_basis_multiset
entries.docstring:
The derivative operator on the multiset basis: appending the derivative
  index to the multiset.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_basis_multiset (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    deriv μ (basis s) = basis (s + {μ})

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.deriv_apply_eq_mul
entries.docstring:
The derivative operator is right multiplication by the first-order derivative
  symbol.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_apply_eq_mul (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) :
    deriv μ a = a * basis ({μ} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))

entries.name: MvPowerSeries.pderiv_comm
entries.docstring:
Formal partial derivatives of a multivariate power series commute: each is given on
  coefficients by a shift and a multiplication, and the two shifts commute.
entries.snippet:
lemma _root_.MvPowerSeries.pderiv_comm {σ R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (i j : σ)
    (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    MvPowerSeries.pderiv i (MvPowerSeries.pderiv j f) =
      MvPowerSeries.pderiv j (MvPowerSeries.pderiv i f)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.«instance@9e6f07e7»
entries.docstring:
Differentiating a jet along a multiset of directions is well defined: the partial
  derivatives commute, so the fold over a multiset does not depend on the order.
entries.snippet:
instance : RightCommutative
    (fun (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) => MvPowerSeries.pderiv μ f) where

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.eval
entries.docstring: The evaluation map taking a function `f : SpaceTimeAlgebra` to `∂_μ f`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def eval : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ →ₗ[ℂ] SpaceTimeAlgebra →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.eval_basis
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma eval_basis (m : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    eval (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis.symmetricAlgebra m) f =
      (∏ μ, (m μ)! : ℕ) • MvPowerSeries.coeff m f

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.eval_monomial
entries.snippet:
lemma eval_monomial (p : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) (m : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ) :
    eval p (MvPowerSeries.monomial m 1) =
      ((∏ μ, (m μ)! : ℕ) : ℂ) *
        Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis.symmetricAlgebra.repr p m

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.eval_injective
entries.snippet:
lemma eval_injective {p q : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ}
    (h : ∀ f, eval p f = eval q f) : p = q

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.eval_deriv
entries.docstring:
Adjointness: the shift of derivative symbols is the transpose of the formal
  partial derivative under the divided-power pairing.
entries.snippet:
lemma eval_deriv (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (p : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    eval (deriv ν p) f = eval p (MvPowerSeries.pderiv ν f)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.eval_one
entries.docstring:
The pairing of the unit derivative symbol with a jet is its value at the base
  point: the empty derivative multiset reads off the constant term.
entries.snippet:
lemma eval_one (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    eval (1 : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) f = MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff f

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.eval_basis_eq_constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv
entries.docstring:
Iterating adjointness: the pairing of the basis monomial `∂_s` with a jet is the
  constant term of the iterated formal partial derivative `∂_s f`. This is the concrete
  description of the divided-power pairing that `eval_deriv` encodes one derivative at a
  time.
entries.snippet:
lemma eval_basis_eq_constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    eval (basis s) f =
      MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv s f)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction
entries.docstring:
The action of `χ` on the derivatives, this takes `∂_μ ·` to `∂_μ (χ ·)`,
  expanded out explicitly.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def jetRingAction (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ →ₗ[ℂ] SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_basis
entries.snippet:
lemma jetRingAction_basis (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (m : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ) :
    jetRingAction χ (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis.symmetricAlgebra m) =
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m,
        ((∏ μ, (m μ).descFactorial (p.1 μ) : ℕ) : ℂ) • MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 χ •
          Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis.symmetricAlgebra p.2

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.eval_jetRingAction
entries.snippet:
lemma eval_jetRingAction (χ f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (p : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) :
    eval (jetRingAction χ p) f = eval p (χ * f)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_basis_multiset
entries.docstring:
The action of a jet on a derivative monomial, in multiset form: `∂_s` is sent to the
  all-orders Leibniz convolution, each splitting `s = s₁ + s₂` of the derivative multiset
  contributing the base-point Taylor coefficient `(∂_{s₁} χ)(0)` against the lower monomial
  `∂_{s₂}`.

  This is `jetRingAction_basis` with the `Nat.choose` bookkeeping traded for the
  divided-power pairing: both sides are compared through `eval`, where the identity is the
  Leibniz rule `SpaceTimeAlgebra.constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv_mul` at the base point. It is the form
  in which the transformation law of a matter field is stated.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetRingAction_basis_multiset (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    jetRingAction χ (basis s) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff
            (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv p.1 χ) • basis p.2).sum

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_C
entries.docstring:
Constant jets act on the derivative symbols by their value: `C c` has no
  derivative coordinates.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetRingAction_C (c : ℂ) :
    jetRingAction (MvPowerSeries.C c) = c • LinearMap.id

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetRingAction_one : jetRingAction (1 : SpaceTimeAlgebra) = LinearMap.id

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_mul
entries.docstring:
The derivative action is multiplicative: it is the transpose of multiplication
  in the commutative jet ring. This makes `χ ↦ χ(∂)` a monoid homomorphism and
  hence yields representations of the jet gauge group on polynomial jet spaces.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetRingAction_mul (χ ψ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    jetRingAction (χ * ψ) = jetRingAction χ ∘ₗ jetRingAction ψ

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetRingAction_zero : jetRingAction (0 : SpaceTimeAlgebra) = 0

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_add
entries.snippet:
lemma jetRingAction_add (χ ψ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    jetRingAction (χ + ψ) = jetRingAction χ + jetRingAction ψ

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingActionHom
entries.docstring:
The derivative action as a ring homomorphism from the jet ring to the
  endomorphisms of the algebra of derivative symbols: the module structure of the
  jet ring on its graded dual.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def jetRingActionHom : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* Module.End ℂ SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ where

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_comm
entries.docstring: The actions of two jets commute: the jet ring is commutative.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetRingAction_comm (χ ψ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) :
    jetRingAction χ (jetRingAction ψ a) = jetRingAction ψ (jetRingAction χ a)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_apply_one
entries.docstring:
The derivative action on the zeroth-order (field) symbol: it is scaled by the
  value of the jet at the base point.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma jetRingAction_apply_one (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    jetRingAction χ (1 : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) =
      MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff χ • 1

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_apply_ι
entries.docstring:
The derivative action on a first-order derivative symbol implements the Leibniz
  rule: `∂_μ ↦ χ(0) ∂_μ + (∂_μχ)(0) 1`. The value of the jet multiplies the
  first-derivative symbol, and its first derivative feeds the zeroth-order
  symbol.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetRingAction_apply_ι (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    jetRingAction χ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ (Module.Dual ℂ Lorentz.ComplexCoVector)
        (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis μ)) =
      MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff χ •
        SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ (Module.Dual ℂ Lorentz.ComplexCoVector)
          (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis μ) +
        MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single μ 1) χ • 1

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_deriv
entries.docstring:
The commutation of the jet-ring action with the derivative operator: acting by
  `χ` after differentiating equals differentiating after acting, plus the action
  of the derivative `∂_ν χ`. This is the operator form of the Leibniz rule
  `∂_ν (χ f) = χ ∂_ν f + (∂_ν χ) f` under the divided-power pairing.
entries.snippet:
lemma jetRingAction_deriv (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) :
    jetRingAction χ (deriv ν a) =
      deriv ν (jetRingAction χ a) + jetRingAction (MvPowerSeries.pderiv ν χ) a

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The representation of the Lorentz group `SL(2,ℂ)` on the algebra of derivative
  symbols, extending the dual covector representation multiplicatively.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def repLorentzGroup : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ where

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.repLorentzGroup_apply_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_one (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) : repLorentzGroup Λ 1 = 1

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.repLorentzGroup_apply_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_mul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (a b : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (a * b) = repLorentzGroup Λ a * repLorentzGroup Λ b

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.repLorentzGroup_apply_ι
entries.docstring: The Lorentz action on a generator.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_ι (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x : Module.Dual ℂ Lorentz.ComplexCoVector) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ (Module.Dual ℂ Lorentz.ComplexCoVector) x) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ (Module.Dual ℂ Lorentz.ComplexCoVector)
        (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.SL2CRep.dual Λ x)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.repLorentzGroup_deriv
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on a derivative: the derivative symbol transforms as a
  covector, mixing the spacetime directions by the components of `Λ` in the dual
  covector representation.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_deriv (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (deriv μ a) =
      ∑ ν, (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.SL2CRep.dual Λ (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis μ))
        (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis ν) • deriv ν (repLorentzGroup Λ a)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.repLorentzGroup_basis_singleton
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the singleton derivative monomial: the derivative
  slot transforms by the columns of the Lorentz matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_basis_singleton (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (basis ({μ} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))) =
      ∑ ν, (((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 ν μ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        basis ({ν} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.repLorentzGroup_basis_ofFn
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz action on the derivative monomial of an ordered tuple of directions: every
  slot mixes by the columns of the Lorentz matrix, one factor per slot.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_basis_ofFn (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (basis (List.ofFn l)) =
      ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
        (∏ i, (((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 (p i) (l i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • basis (List.ofFn p)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.gradeScale
entries.docstring:
The derivative-degree scaling on the algebra of derivative symbols: the
  algebra map multiplying each generator by `t`, hence each degree-`n` monomial
  by `t ^ n`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def gradeScale (t : ℂ) : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ →ₐ[ℂ] SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.gradeScale_ι
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gradeScale_ι (t : ℂ) (x : Module.Dual ℂ Lorentz.ComplexCoVector) :
    gradeScale t (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ (Module.Dual ℂ Lorentz.ComplexCoVector) x) =
      t • SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ (Module.Dual ℂ Lorentz.ComplexCoVector) x

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.gradeScale_basis
entries.docstring: The degree scaling multiplies the basis monomial at `s` by `t ^ |s|`.
entries.snippet:
lemma gradeScale_basis (t : ℂ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    gradeScale t (basis s) = t ^ s.card • basis s

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.gradeScale_repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The degree scaling commutes with the Lorentz action: the Lorentz action
  preserves the derivative degree.
entries.snippet:
lemma gradeScale_repLorentzGroup (t : ℂ) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) :
    gradeScale t (repLorentzGroup Λ a) = repLorentzGroup Λ (gradeScale t a)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.gradePoly
entries.docstring:
The derivative-degree polynomial on the algebra of derivative symbols: the linear map
  sending the basis monomial `∂_s` to `X ^ |s|` times itself. It is `gradeScale` with the
  scalar replaced by the formal variable `X`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def gradePoly : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ →ₗ[ℂ] Polynomial SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.gradePoly_basis
entries.docstring: The derivative-degree polynomial of a basis monomial is the monomial of degree `|s|`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gradePoly_basis (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    gradePoly (basis s) = Polynomial.monomial (Multiset.card s) (basis s)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.eval_algebraMap_gradePoly
entries.docstring:
Evaluating the derivative-degree polynomial at a scalar is the derivative-degree
  scaling by that scalar: the two descriptions of the grading agree.
entries.snippet:
lemma eval_algebraMap_gradePoly (t : ℂ) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) :
    (gradePoly a).eval (algebraMap ℂ SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ t) = gradeScale t a

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.gradePoly_eval_one
entries.docstring:
Setting the formal variable to one recovers the original element: the pieces of a
  graded decomposition sum to the element.
entries.snippet: lemma gradePoly_eval_one (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) : (gradePoly a).eval 1 = a

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ
entries.docstring: The ℝ-algebra of derivative symbols in spacetime.
entries.snippet: abbrev SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The representation of the Lorentz group `SL(2,ℂ)` on the algebra of derivative
  symbols, extending the dual covector representation multiplicatively.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def repLorentzGroup : Representation ℝ SL(2,ℂ) SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ where

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.repLorentzGroup_apply_ι
entries.docstring: The Lorentz action on a generator of the real derivative algebra.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_ι (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x : Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ (Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector) x) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ (Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector)
        (Lorentz.CoVector.sl2Rep.dual Λ x)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.repLorentzGroup_apply_mul
entries.docstring:
The real derivative-algebra representation is multiplicative: it is the lift of a linear
  map to the symmetric algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_mul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (a b : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ) :
    SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.repLorentzGroup Λ (a * b) =
      SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.repLorentzGroup Λ a * SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.repLorentzGroup Λ b

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.repLorentzGroup_apply_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_one (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.repLorentzGroup Λ 1 = 1

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.gradeScale
entries.docstring:
The derivative-degree scaling on the real algebra of derivative symbols:
  the algebra map multiplying each generator by `t`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def gradeScale (t : ℝ) : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ →ₐ[ℝ] SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.gradeScale_ι
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gradeScale_ι (t : ℝ) (x : Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector) :
    gradeScale t (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ (Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector) x) =
      t • SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ (Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector) x

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.gradeScale_repLorentzGroup
entries.docstring:
The degree scaling commutes with the Lorentz action on the real derivative
  symbols.
entries.snippet:
lemma gradeScale_repLorentzGroup (t : ℝ) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ) :
    gradeScale t (repLorentzGroup Λ a) = repLorentzGroup Λ (gradeScale t a)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset
entries.docstring:
The basis of the symmetric algebra of dual real jet slots, indexed by multisets of
  spacetime indices.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def basisMultiset :
    Basis (Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) ℝ (SymmetricAlgebra ℝ (Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector))

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset_apply
entries.docstring:
The multiset basis of the dual derivative symbols, as a basis vector of the
  symmetric algebra at the corresponding multi-index.
entries.snippet:
lemma basisMultiset_apply (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    basisMultiset s =
      Lorentz.CoVector.basis.dualBasis.symmetricAlgebra (Multiset.toFinsupp s)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset_mul
entries.docstring:
The multiset basis vectors of the real dual derivative slots multiply by adding the
  multisets.
entries.snippet:
lemma basisMultiset_mul (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    basisMultiset s * basisMultiset t =
      basisMultiset (s + t)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset_nil
entries.docstring:
The multiset basis of the real dual derivative slots at the empty multiset is the
  unit.
entries.snippet:
lemma basisMultiset_nil :
    basisMultiset (0 : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) = 1

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset_singleton
entries.docstring: The multiset basis of the real dual derivative slots at a singleton index.
entries.snippet:
lemma basisMultiset_singleton (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    basisMultiset ({μ} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ (Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector)
        (Lorentz.CoVector.basis.dualBasis μ)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.gradeScale_basisMultiset
entries.docstring: The degree scaling multiplies the real basis monomial at `s` by `t ^ |s|`.
entries.snippet:
lemma gradeScale_basisMultiset (t : ℝ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    gradeScale t (basisMultiset s) = t ^ Multiset.card s • basisMultiset s

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.gradePoly
entries.docstring:
The derivative-degree polynomial on the real algebra of derivative symbols: the linear
  map sending the basis monomial `∂_s` to `X ^ |s|` times itself.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def gradePoly : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ →ₗ[ℝ] Polynomial SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.gradePoly_basisMultiset
entries.docstring:
The derivative-degree polynomial of a real basis monomial is the monomial of degree
  `|s|`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gradePoly_basisMultiset (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    gradePoly (basisMultiset s) =
      Polynomial.monomial (Multiset.card s) (basisMultiset s)

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.eval_algebraMap_gradePoly
entries.docstring:
Evaluating the real derivative-degree polynomial at a scalar is the derivative-degree
  scaling by that scalar.
entries.snippet:
lemma eval_algebraMap_gradePoly (t : ℝ) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ) :
    (gradePoly a).eval (algebraMap ℝ SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ t) = gradeScale t a

entries.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.gradePoly_eval_one
entries.docstring:
Setting the formal variable to one recovers the original element of the real
  derivative algebra.
entries.snippet: lemma gradePoly_eval_one (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ) : (gradePoly a).eval 1 = a

entries.name: Hₛ_eq_expect_val
entries.docstring:
Shannon entropy is the expected negative logarithm of the outcome probability.
Zero-probability outcomes contribute zero to the expectation.
entries.snippet:
lemma Hₛ_eq_expect_val (d : ProbDistribution α) :
    Hₛ d = ProbDistribution.expect_val ⟨fun x ↦ -Real.log (d x), d⟩

entries.name: Hₛ_concave
entries.docstring: Shannon entropy is concave under convex mixtures of distributions.
entries.snippet:
lemma Hₛ_concave (d₁ d₂ : ProbDistribution α) (p : Prob) :
    p[Hₛ d₁ ↔ Hₛ d₂] ≤ Hₛ (p[d₁ ↔ d₂])

entries.name: Prob.negLog_strictAnti
entries.docstring: Smaller probabilities have strictly greater negative logarithms, including at zero.
entries.snippet: lemma negLog_strictAnti : StrictAnti negLog

entries.name: Prob.negLog_surjective
entries.docstring: Every extended nonnegative value is the negative logarithm of a probability.
entries.snippet: lemma negLog_surjective : Function.Surjective negLog

entries.name: Prob.negLogOrderIso
entries.docstring:
The negative logarithm identifies probabilities with extended nonnegative values in reverse
order, sending zero to infinity and one to zero.
entries.snippet: def negLogOrderIso : Prob ≃o ENNRealᵒᵈ

entries.name: Prob.negLogOrderIso_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma negLogOrderIso_apply (p : Prob) : negLogOrderIso p = OrderDual.toDual (negLog p)

entries.name: Finset.prod_apply_update
entries.docstring:
Changing coordinate `i` of `x` to `a` changes only the factor indexed by `i` in
`∏ j, v j (x j)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma Finset.prod_apply_update (v : (i : ι) → κ i → K) (x : (i : ι) → κ i) (i : ι)
    (a : κ i) : ∏ j, v j (update x i a j) = v i a * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, v j (x j)

entries.name: Finset.prod_update_const_mul
entries.docstring: Multiplying the function indexed by `i₀` by `c` multiplies `∏ i, v i (x i)` by `c`.
entries.snippet:
lemma Finset.prod_update_const_mul (v : (i : ι) → κ i → K) (c : K) (i₀ : ι)
    (x : (i : ι) → κ i) :
    ∏ i, update v i₀ (fun a ↦ c * v i₀ a) i (x i) = c * ∏ i, v i (x i)

entries.name: prod_apply_update_mul_prod_apply_update
entries.docstring:
A product `x ↦ ∏ i, v i (x i)` of functions of one variable satisfies the exchange
relations.
entries.snippet:
lemma prod_apply_update_mul_prod_apply_update (v : (i : ι) → κ i → K) (x y : (i : ι) → κ i)
    (i : ι) (a b : κ i) :
    (∏ j, v j (update x i a j)) * ∏ j, v j (update y i b j) =
      (∏ j, v j (update x i b j)) * ∏ j, v j (update y i a j)

entries.name: eq_mul_prod_of_mul_update
entries.docstring:
If `T` satisfies the exchange relations and `T x₀ ≠ 0`, then every `x` that agrees with `x₀`
outside a finite set `s` of coordinates satisfies
`T x = T x₀ * ∏ j ∈ s, T (update x₀ j (x j)) / T x₀`.
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_mul_prod_of_mul_update {T : ((i : ι) → κ i) → K}
    (hT : ∀ i (a b : κ i) x y, T (update x i a) * T (update y i b) =
      T (update x i b) * T (update y i a))
    {x₀ : (i : ι) → κ i} (h₀ : T x₀ ≠ 0) (s : Finset ι) :
    ∀ x : (i : ι) → κ i, (∀ j ∉ s, x j = x₀ j) →
      T x = T x₀ * ∏ j ∈ s, T (update x₀ j (x j)) / T x₀

entries.name: exists_prod_of_mul_update
entries.docstring:
If `ι` is nonempty, a function on a finite product that satisfies the exchange relations
factors as a product of functions of one variable.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_prod_of_mul_update [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] {T : ((i : ι) → κ i) → K}
    (hT : ∀ i (a b : κ i) x y, T (update x i a) * T (update y i b) =
      T (update x i b) * T (update y i a)) :
    ∃ v : (i : ι) → κ i → K, ∀ x, T x = ∏ i, v i (x i)

entries.name: exists_prod_iff_mul_update
entries.docstring:
If `ι` is nonempty, a function on a finite product factors as a product of functions of one
variable if and only if it satisfies the exchange relations.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_prod_iff_mul_update [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] {T : ((i : ι) → κ i) → K} :
    (∃ v : (i : ι) → κ i → K, ∀ x, T x = ∏ i, v i (x i)) ↔
      ∀ i (a b : κ i) x y, T (update x i a) * T (update y i b) =
        T (update x i b) * T (update y i a)

entries.name: MState.relabel_pure
entries.docstring:
Relabeling the pure state associated to a ket gives the pure state associated to the
relabeled ket.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma relabel_pure (ψ : Ket d₁) (e : d₂ ≃ d₁) :
    (pure ψ).relabel e = pure (ψ.relabel e)

entries.name: MState.pure_piProd
entries.docstring:
The pure state of `Ket.piProd ψ` is `MState.piProd` of the pure states `pure (ψ i)`,
generalizing `MState.pure_prod_pure`.
entries.snippet:
lemma pure_piProd (ψ : (i : ι) → Ket (dI i)) :
    pure (Ket.piProd ψ) = piProd (fun i ↦ pure (ψ i))

entries.name: MState.isPiProd_iff_exists_pure_eq_piProd
entries.docstring:
With at least one party, a ket satisfies `Ket.IsPiProd` if and only if its associated
pure state `MState.pure ψ` is an `MState.piProd` of pure states.
entries.snippet:
lemma isPiProd_iff_exists_pure_eq_piProd [Nonempty ι] (ψ : Ket ((i : ι) → dI i)) :
    ψ.IsPiProd ↔ ∃ φ : (i : ι) → Ket (dI i), pure ψ = piProd (fun i ↦ pure (φ i))

entries.name: Ket.relabel
entries.docstring:
Relabel a ket along an equivalence of basis index types. Given `e : d₂ ≃ d₁`,
the amplitude of `ψ.relabel e` at `i : d₂` is the amplitude of `ψ` at `e i`.
entries.snippet: def Ket.relabel (ψ : Ket d₁) (e : d₂ ≃ d₁) : Ket d₂ where

entries.name: Ket.relabel_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma Ket.relabel_apply (ψ : Ket d₁) (e : d₂ ≃ d₁) (i : d₂) :
    ψ.relabel e i = ψ (e i)

entries.name: Ket.piProd
entries.docstring:
The tensor product of a finite family of kets, generalizing `Ket.prod`. Party `i` has
basis index type `d i`, and a joint index `j` selects one index `j i` for each party; the
amplitude at `j` is `∏ i, ψ i (j i)`.
entries.snippet:
def Ket.piProd {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] {d : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, Fintype (d i)] (ψ : (i : ι) → Ket (d i)) : Ket ((i : ι) → d i) where

entries.name: Ket.piProd_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma Ket.piProd_apply {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] {d : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, Fintype (d i)] (ψ : (i : ι) → Ket (d i)) (j : (i : ι) → d i) :
    Ket.piProd ψ j = ∏ i, ψ i (j i)

entries.name: Ket.IsPiProd
entries.docstring:
A ket on the joint system of a finite family of parties is a product state if it is
the `Ket.piProd` of one ket for each party, generalizing `Ket.IsProd`.
entries.snippet:
def Ket.IsPiProd {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] {d : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, Fintype (d i)] (ψ : Ket ((i : ι) → d i)) : Prop

entries.name: Ket.isPiProd_piProd
entries.docstring: Every `Ket.piProd` state satisfies `Ket.IsPiProd`, generalizing `Ket.IsProd_prod`.

entries.name: Ket.isPiProd_iff_isProd_relabel
entries.docstring:
For two parties, `Ket.IsPiProd` agrees with `Ket.IsProd` after relabeling the joint
index type `(i : Fin 2) → d i` as `d 0 × d 1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma Ket.isPiProd_iff_isProd_relabel {d : Fin 2 → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (d i)]
    (ψ : Ket ((i : Fin 2) → d i)) :
    ψ.IsPiProd ↔ (ψ.relabel (piFinTwoEquiv d).symm).IsProd

entries.name: Ket.IsPiProd.of_phaseEquiv
entries.docstring:
If a ket is phase-equivalent to a `Ket.IsPiProd` state, then it is also a
`Ket.IsPiProd` state, provided there is at least one party. The global phase is
absorbed into one tensor factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma Ket.IsPiProd.of_phaseEquiv [Nonempty ι] {ψ ψ' : Ket ((i : ι) → d i)}
    (h' : ψ'.IsPiProd) (h : Ket.PhaseEquiv.r ψ ψ') : ψ.IsPiProd

entries.name: PRSummary.DeclChange
entries.docstring: How a declaration changed.
entries.snippet:
inductive DeclChange where
  | added (loc : Location)
  | restated (loc : Location)
  | moved (old new : Location)
  | removed (loc : Location)
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

entries.name: PRSummary.DeclChange.rank
entries.docstring:
The order in which the changes are reported, as in leaff: additions, removals, then
modifications.
entries.snippet:
def DeclChange.rank : DeclChange → Nat
  | .added .. => 0
  | .removed .. => 1
  | .restated .. => 2
  | .moved .. => 3

entries.name: PRSummary.DeclChange.isNew
entries.docstring: Whether the head revision has a statement the base did not: an added or a restated one.
entries.snippet:
def DeclChange.isNew : DeclChange → Bool
  | .added .. | .restated .. => true
  | .moved .. | .removed .. => false

entries.docstring: Where to read the declaration now, or, if it is gone, where it was.
entries.snippet:
def DeclChange.target : DeclChange → Location
  | .added loc | .restated loc | .removed loc => loc
  | .moved _ new => new

  | .noModuleDoc => "Add module documentation `/-! … -/` with the standard headings."
  | .titleHead => "Add a title heading starting with '# ' for the whole module, as the first heading."
  | .extraTitle => "Only the module title should use '# '; use '## A.', '### A.1.' etc. for sections."

entries.name: tocMismatch
entries.docstring:
The first difference between the given table of contents entries (with line numbers) and the
  expected ones, as an optional line number and a message.
entries.snippet:
def tocMismatch : List (Nat × String) → List String → Option (Option Nat × String)
  | [], [] => none
  | (n, x) :: gs, y :: es =>
    if x == y then tocMismatch gs es else some (some n, s!"Entry '{x}' should be '{y}'")
  | [], y :: es =>
    some (none, s!"Missing entry '{y}'" ++ if es.isEmpty then "" else s!" (and {es.length} more)")
  | (n, x) :: gs, [] =>
    some (some n, s!"Unexpected entry '{x}'" ++ if gs.isEmpty then "" else s!" (and {gs.length} more)")

entries.name: TheoremLint.ErrorKind
entries.docstring: The kinds of error the linter reports.
entries.snippet:
inductive ErrorKind where
  | unknownSection (text : String)
  | beforeFirstSection (text : String)
  | notAName (text : String)
  | duplicate (name : Name) (firstLine : Nat)
  | noDocString (name : Name)
  | notListed (library name : Name)
  | writtenWithLemma (name : Name) (file : System.FilePath) (pos : Position)
  | notADeclaration (name : Name)
  | wrongLibrary (library name module : Name)
  | notATheorem (name : Name)

entries.name: TheoremLint.ErrorKind.rank
entries.docstring: The place of the kind of `kind` in the order in which the errors are reported.
entries.snippet:
def ErrorKind.rank : ErrorKind → Nat
  | .unknownSection .. => 0
  | .beforeFirstSection .. => 1
  | .notAName .. => 2
  | .duplicate .. => 3
  | .noDocString .. => 4
  | .notListed .. => 5
  | .writtenWithLemma .. => 6
  | .notADeclaration .. => 7
  | .wrongLibrary .. => 8
  | .notATheorem .. => 9

entries.name: TheoremLint.ErrorKind.title
entries.docstring: The heading of the errors of the kind of `kind`.
entries.snippet:
def ErrorKind.title : ErrorKind → String
  | .unknownSection .. => "Unknown sections"
  | .beforeFirstSection .. => "Names listed before the first section"
  | .notAName .. => "Lines which are not Lean names"
  | .duplicate .. => "Names listed twice"
  | .noDocString .. => "Theorems without a doc-string"
  | .notListed .. => s!"Theorems not listed in {theoremsFile}"
  | .writtenWithLemma .. => "Listed results written with `lemma`"
  | .notADeclaration .. => "Listed names which are not declarations"
  | .wrongLibrary .. => "Names listed under the wrong library"
  | .notATheorem .. => "Listed names which are not theorems"

entries.name: TheoremLint.ErrorKind.hint
entries.docstring: How to fix the errors of the kind of `kind`.
entries.snippet:
def ErrorKind.hint : ErrorKind → String
  | .unknownSection .. => s!"The sections are \
      {", ".intercalate (libraries.map (s!"`[{·}]`")).toList}."
  | .beforeFirstSection .. => "List each name under the section `[L]` of its library `L`."
  | .notAName .. => "Each line is a section `[L]`, a fully qualified name, or a comment starting \
      with `--`."
  | .duplicate .. => "Remove the repeated entries."
  | .noDocString .. => "Add a doc-string `/-- … -/` to each of these theorems."
  | .notListed .. => "Use `lemma`. Only list a result, under the section of its library, if it \
      is a significant result in physics, usually known by name."
  | .writtenWithLemma .. => "Use `theorem`, or remove the name from the theorems file."
  | .notADeclaration .. => "Give the fully qualified name of each result."
  | .wrongLibrary .. => "Move each name to the section of the library declaring it."
  | .notATheorem .. => "Only results written with `theorem` can be listed."

entries.name: TheoremLint.ErrorKind.detail
entries.docstring: The details of the error `kind`, shown after its location.
entries.snippet:
def ErrorKind.detail : ErrorKind → String
  | .unknownSection text | .beforeFirstSection text | .notAName text => text
  | .duplicate name firstLine => s!"{name}, first listed on line {firstLine}"
  | .noDocString name | .notListed _ name | .notADeclaration name | .notATheorem name =>
    name.toString
  | .writtenWithLemma name file pos =>
    s!"{name}, written with `lemma` at {file}:{pos.line}:{pos.column}"
  | .wrongLibrary library name module =>
    s!"{name}, listed under `[{library}]` but declared in {module}"
